review_title: A really fun evening in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
My wife and I did the evening food tour around Ho Chi Minh city with Vespa Adventures. We had a brilliant time and really enjoyed the experience. Our riders, A Huy and Huy Kid, made us feel super safe and we loved whizzing around HCM seeing the sites after dark with the city light up.
The restaurants and bars we visited were very authentic and definitely not the types of places we would have found on our own. And the food was delicious.
Our guide/host, Linh, was lovely...very knowledgeable and great company, making this one of our most memorable evenings in Vietnam.

Experiencing Saigon's traffic from the street, a car or a bus is nothing like actually getting on a Vespa & joining in the mayhem, which 18 friends & I did on a recent night food tour of Saigon with Vespa Adventures.
Our group, including me on the back of a Vespa expertly driven by Phu & ably guided by Tien, took us to a number of "foodie" places but I can only really remember the first location being a top hotel, from which we enjoyed stunning views of Saigon from their top floor bar & the final destination which was a thriving nightlife venue. All the rest was ablur as I enjoyed the adventure through what felt like the busiest place on earth!
Highly recommend the tour!

My driver Mark and guide Tien were the best. Mark took me through Saigon with expertise (and fun). Great way to see the place.
Tien was a joy, full of information and a wicked sense of fun. She really was brilliant 👍 and nothing was a bother.

review_title: An Unforgettable Vespa Ride from Da Nang to Hue
review_text:
This was an amazing Vespa tour from Da Nang to Hue in July 2026. Riding a classic Vespa through the Hai Van Pass was definitely the highlight of the trip. The scenery was absolutely beautiful, with mountains, ocean views, and winding roads along the way. The tour also included a delicious BBQ grilled chicken lunch and a refreshing swim at Suoi Mo, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.
The tour was well worth the price. Considering the Vespa ride, experienced guide, meals, sightseeing stops, and activities included, I felt that I got great value for money.

We had a great half day tour of Hanoi City by vintage Vespa courtesy of vespaadventures.com. Nhi, Tung and Dustin took great care of us. Tung and Dustin made us feel very safe on the Vespas and Nhi, as our guide, was very knowledgeable and made us feel very comfortable when asking questions. It was a lovely way to see the City, sample some Vietnamese drinks and snacks and understand more about the City, Country and its people.

As they say themselves: this is the ride of your life, and there is nothing to lie about that!
Everything was perfectly arranged, the food, the route, the drivers who made us feel extremely safe on the back (Thanh, Vu, Cuc, C.Liem) and not to mention: our guide Thu Truong! A true 5 star experience! Thu was a top guide! She spoke good English, was genuinely interested and you could chat with it. Thanks to Thu and the drivers!

We were so excited to do a food tour in Vietnam and thankfully this did not disappoint!

Our guide Duyeh met us at our hotel in Ho Chi Minh and was so friendly it really set the tone for the night. The drivers (Lo, Hau, Du) were amazing as they expertly navigated through the hectic streets. You couldn’t wipe the smile off my 14 year olds face as he sat behind Hau and sped off into the night!

The food at all the stops was excellent and I would highly recommend doing this tour!

review_title: An absolute blast - really, really enjoyed it...
review_text: This was by far-and-away one of the best things we did in Vietnam. Having seen the Ho Chi Minh City rush-hour, we were quite sceptical (and a bit worried) about being joining it on the back of a scooter. However, the scooter drivers (mine was named An) were incredibly skilful, really considerate about their 'first time riders', and we felt absolutely and completely safe at all times. Plus it was an incredible experience, a lot of fun, and with plenty of stops for interesting food ('jumping chicken' anyone?), a few drinks, and a stop at a local dive bar that literally was unlike any place I had ever been (and wouldn't have expected to have otherwise seen in Vietnam - it was quite an eye-opener seeing local office workers starting off their weekend at 100mph). Thoroughly recommended and we had such a good night both with the drivers, the other riders on the tour, and of course seeing Ho Chi Minh from a completely different perspective/speed...

A brilliant way to end our holiday. Before booking we were a bit nervous about the idea of our kids (11 + 13) being on the bikes but our drivers (A. Ut, Nhat, A. Hoāng, and A. Vń) took amazing care of all four of us and are clearly well trained.
Our guide Duŷen was fantastic and sharing knowledge of the food and sights as well as engaging in the kids fully in the experience.
One of our favourite activities!!

I organized two groups for Vespa rides in Hoi An as part of a wellness retreat, and this was the favorite group activity, hands down. From the moment we got picked up at our hotel to the very end, the staff and drivers were absolutely amazing. Our groups were led by Chikki, who was funny, charismatic, and helpful.

Our group learned a lot of history, saw amazing views, and had some of the best food on this ride. Highly recommend!

review_title: A fabulous night out in Saigon to see the night scene
review_text: An amazing night with our group. This is a definite must for visitors. The trip is amazing to 4 bars and restaurants? So well planned and such an amazing adventure and trip for a few hours at night . The driver was amazing and his name is A Chieu. I even met his family who joined us at one of the places . So friendly and made me feel safe. A fabulous night out

If you want to experience how crazy and at the same time safe it is to navigate through the traffic of Saigon... call on this crew. Combined with 4 stops where you can enjoy local delicacies makes this a fantastic experience not to be missed in Ho Chi Ming city.

We had the best time traveling the sights of Saigon with our Fabulous guide Linh and our very safe and careful drivers in Hau and Cuong, Being an older couple in our seventies did we at any time feel unsafe navigating the traffic ,With Linh leading the way we visited places not necessarily on your typical tourist map and her knowledge of the city and places we visited were exceptional. This is the second trip with the company in 3days and will definitely book another when we return to Saigon,
Our guide Tracey, with her energy and good humor, showed us an unusual side of Vietnam, very safe, a lot of fun, thank you.

An super tour of Ho Chi Minh City by vespa! The food was delicious - the best Banh Mi we had on our entire trip! Plus seafood, drinks, dessert! Cruising through fascinating neighborhoods and buzzing traffic! We loved our guide Jens who told stories, took pictures, made us feel like special guests all evening. The drivers were amazing! Ended the evening at a cool secret bar, enjoying live music, trading stories and toasting this wonderful adventure.

review_title: A must-have in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: This was so much fun! We took the Night Time Foodie tour and can highly recommend this: great food stops, great guides and drivers and an incredible experience! You each get your own driver, and they are very safe and professional. Our drivers (C.Nam and H.Vu) were lovely and our guide, Quy (or Will) was brilliant. Amazing English language skills and passionate discussion and explanation of Vietnamese cuisine and culture. Highly recommend this experience and this company!

Fabulous experience! Nao took me to the most amazing street food venues where I was the only tourist among the locals. QHau was an incredibly experienced rider. I would definitely recommend while in Saigon.

Unforgettable night in Saigon! Roof top bar, x2 restaurants and live music bar. Each time safely transported by our fabulous drivers (A Huy, Jason, Va, Huy Kid). Our guide Chi (Jasmine) was awesome and informative about the food and city. Couldn't recommend more highly. An absolute highlight of out trip.

Great tour in the middle of Saigon, drink in the rooftop bar with spectacular views, delicious street food, Vietnamese singers in the small club, at the end cover music band in the basement club! Perfect!

An unforgettable night in Saigon! We loved exploring everything from the luxury skyline to the heartbeat of the local alleys. The blend of street food, live music, and the cool night air on a Vespa was magical.
Special thanks to Mr. Quan and Mr. V. Son driver for taking such good care of us. specifically, Mr. Quan's wealth of knowledge and vibrant personality added a wonderful layer of depth to the experience. He didn't just show us the city; he shares its soul with humor and heart.

review_title: Vespa Tours in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
I went on two Vespa Tours around Ho Chi Minh City during my stay in March 2026 - craft beer tour and a food tour. Both were amazing fun. The excitement of navigating the city on a Vespa experiencing the apparent order within the true chaos of traffic in Ho Chi Minh City was the biggest highlight of the whole trip.
Thank you so much to the team for the amazing fun!

What a wonderful evening! Tuyen let us in on Vietnamese culture as we visited places we would not have found on our own — and he would be a great guest at any dinner party! I loved riding with Jackie, who safely but thrillingly drove me around the crazy Saigon traffic. A must do!

Great Vespa food tour in Ho Chi Minh City. The stop for Vietnamese pancakes was unique! Final stop was a very cool, chill coffee house with live music. Our leaders- Duten & Tuyen took very good care of us. Thanks To all the drivers, especially Martin, for getting us around safely!!

review_title: Avoid this vendor, they are making money at the expenses of the local people well-being and environment
review_text:
Sharing again the review I wrote last November. There has been no improvement, no feedback from the owner.

Consider the environmental impact of old model vehicles: the smoke, the noise
Review of Vespa Adventures
Reviewed November 23, 2025
I'm not writing as a tourist, I'm a local citizen living near the warehouse where they store the Vespa scooters for this tour. Despite the new outlook, the scooters are of old models. The old machines, therefore, need to be tuned very carefully before they are put in use. When they do this, the whole neighborhood becomes noisy with tens of scooters roaring at the same time. In addition, the smoke, the smell envelop the whole area. When they run on the street, for sure they discharge much more pollution than newer model scooters. So before you book the service, think again about the impact it creates on the local people and the environment. Alternatives? Consider similar tours using newer vehicles, some of which run by young people, so it's great that you support them. I'm not running any business, I have no benefit from this review, but our city has already been overly polluted, please do not add any more. Have fun in Hochiminh City. Thank you for choosing Vietnam.

This is so much fun! We booked a private night time foody tour of Ho Chi Minh City. We were picked up at our hotel and introduced to our two drivers by our host who was a charming lady who spoke very good English. She was to follow us on her own scooter and popped up to guide us whenever we stopped. Our two drivers of the Vespas were very skilled and knew exactly what they were doing! Luckily as driving in HCM city is not for the faint hearted! We first visited a sky bar where we had a stiff drink which we needed and it helped us relax and enjoy the ride! What a ride! We had several stood at various street food restaurants where we were introduced to seafood, crispy pancakes, Vietnamese rice paper rolls, and other delights. All delicious and great fun to arrive as a local on the back of a vintage Vespa. We finished off the evening at a late night cocktail bar where a great band were doing their thing. We felt safe and looked after, we ate great food and learnt a lot too. But the best thing was joining the throng of scooters swooshing around Saigon in the dark!

review_title: Do the by Night one, you will see the true Saigon city.
review_text: It really overrated our expectations, such a cool experience to do and you see Ho Chi Minh really on a other way like this! We first thought would be bit touristic to do, but we would recommend it to everyone! Especially the one by night. Because the city comes to live in the night. Special thanks to our Guide Will and drivers Bao & James!!!

review_title: Incredible experience in Hoh chi Minh
review_text: Unique and atypical experience in the heart of the city with a top team and very pro! To do absolutely! Thanks to Ty, Tuyen and Q. Hau!

Thanks to Tom, we discovered the great food of Vietnam, its history and culture. It is a perfect tour of HCM, with capable drivers and a touch of vintage with the vespa’s. Thanks for sharing this with us. Highly recommended.

review_title: Great way to start our Saigon travels!
review_text: This was a blast! Great way to see the city, experience some awesome food - and enjoy the fast-paced driving but feeling very safe. Hein was our guide and she was awesome! I hope everyone has the chance to be with her! The drivers were fantastic and I would recommend this to anyone for a fun night out.

review_title: Indeed a ride of our life
review_text: We did this as a couple and I must say it was indeed "A ride of our lives". This is an amazing experience one that everyone much try when in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh). Ofcourse the ride itself is an experience, dodging through the chaotic traffic and zipping in and out between, cars, buses and other scooters. I was told there are 1.5 million scooters in saigon city itself and more than 65 million on entire Vietnam. That's more than the entire population of Canada. 😂🤪. Other than that the people, which would be the tour guide, Minh, who was funny, but very knowledgeable and made the goal experience fun. The food places he took us to were amazing, the code of food excellence. He was even so nice that he taught us the right was to say cheers in Vietnamese and cracked open crab legs for us. What a lovely and caring person. Thank you Minh you were one of the reasons this heroic was so memorable. Ofcourse this post would not be complete without a mention to our 2 drivers, A.Hoang and A. Lit. They maneuvered through the traffic very safely and with confidence. I must say there was never a single moment when we felt scared. These guys rock it.
Hoi An le 18 -janvier 2026.A very plaisant moment during a street food , with an adorable guide on vespa.i highly recommend it

review_title: Fabulous scooter experience - Not to be missed Vietnam experience.
review_text: Fabulous experience on the scooter. We are two 61 year olds from the UK with no previous experience on a scooter. Kim was our guide and Ty and Minzhou our drivers. We everything loved about the tour from the scooter experience to the food, views and music. Highly recommended.
Excellent experience on our honeymoon in Vietnam in July. The glorious Duyen was our guide and she was very kind, knowledgeable and attentive. A big shout out to our fabulous drivers, A.Thuan and TY.

review_title: A great way to see the city - Vroom Vroom!
review_text: My 4th time with Vespa adventures since 2016. Always reliable - good communication, snd always a great tour and an excellent time! This time we had Nhi as our guide. She was kind, funny, knowledgeable and friendly. She made sure I was well catered for as a vegetarian and showed everyone how to handle/eat the dishes we were served (they were all delicious!). She also made sure we had a roadie beer after the first place, which definitely added to the journey to the next place! My driver was Sha - He was excellent - not only is he super cool and a great driver, but he also pointed out landmarks and interesting things as we drove around - I've been to HCMC 6 times before and he was pointing out lots of new things to me! My mum was very nervous about getting on a bike but her driver took great care of her, taking it easy and making sure she felt safe. All in all, an excellent evening. I really recommend them and I'll use them again.

review_title: Unforgettable New Year's Eve experience at Vespa in Saigon!
review_text:
Unforgettable New Year's Eve experience at Vespa in Saigon!

The Vintage Vespa Food Tour on New Year's Eve 2025 with Vespa Adventures was simply an absolute highlight and one of the best experiences of our trip!

There were three of us and each had its own driver – Black, An and PNGUYEN – all three extremely professional, safe, attentive and incredibly friendly. Despite the crazy impressive and traffic in Saigon, we felt absolutely safe at all times. Driving through the big city at night on a vintage Vespa was simply spectacular.

Our guide Duyen was outstanding: very competent, personable, open, humorous and approachable at all times. All the questions were answered in detail, and we learned an incredible amount about Saigon, life, culture and of course food. You immediately notice how much experience and passion goes into this.

We were picked up directly from the hotel and then we started to four stations:
a great rooftop bar and three different restaurants, each in its own special way, very high quality and culinary extremely exciting. The selection was perfectly matched and offered a great insight into Vietnamese cuisine.

The whole tour was perfectly organized, varied, entertaining and unique – especially on New Year's Eve, with this atmosphere, this city and this way of getting around.
An absolute top recommendation, you can't experience Saigon better!

Thanks to Vespa Adventures, Duyen and the great riders – unforgettable!

review_title: Great time with tour guide Will!
review_text: We had a wonderful experience, maybe even the best thing we did in Vietnam and we have been here for 15 days! We loved exploring Saigon at night with Will our tour guide and Daniel and Bao as our drivers. Really fun ride, felt very safe the whole time, while still going fast and feeling the thrill of the motorbike in Saigon. Would definitely recommend to about anyone. I did this ride with my father who was in his 70s and we saw children as well.

review_title: What a great experience! Vespa night tour of Saigon!
review_text:
Our night foodie tour of Saigon was so exceptionally wonderful! Totally above my expectations with Quyen as our guide and Ty and Loc as drivers, we uncovered some memorable experiences, Including great dining, snacking, entertainment, Scenic, photo ops and even some drinks and dancing! Something that I would not have dared to do alone, Quyen was a great hostess sharing photos and videos to create our memorable experiences. The ride was quite adventuresome and seeing Saigon light up at night while riding within 100's of other scooters is an added bonus. My only wish would have had me as driver instead of passenger. ( no-go due to liabilities). Riding the streets, traffic jams, back alleys was never a fear as our drivers Ty and Luc always made us feel safe. Our Street foods experiences were diverse and exceptional, (usually too much) especially w unlimited beers at every stop....street foods that I dare not have experienced without a guide to ensure health & safety.
Roof top bars with drinks, music and photos, followed by a late night club w live band, music, dancing and song (Quyen, dance w me!) rounded out the evening making it a truly memorable night. I now know that 4 hours is not enough... lol.
I highly recommend Ride of your Life and Quyen as a great guide/hostess to make your eveningvexveptional.

review_title: Truly brilliant way to spend your evening.
review_text:
What an amazing evening - one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. Ours included a rooftop bar, two street food venues and two live music venues.

The guides were brilliant, the street food choices just perfect, the live music venues overflowing with vibe, and the bikes zipping in and out of traffic, nipping down back alleys etc all brilliant fun. My wife has to have a gluten free diet and the guide accommodated this perfectly. Do it - you’ll love it.

review_title: What A Fun and Delicious Evening in Ho Chi Min...Do Not Miss It
review_text: I recently returned from a 3 day stay in HCM (Sai ​​Gon) and took part in a Vespa Food Tour through VespaAdventures.com and all I can say is what fun it was and how delicious the food was at each different stop. My guide for the evening was Rosie. She was truly delightful and her command of the English language was outstanding. My driver for this evening's food tour was Luis. I felt completely safe and comfortable with Luis at the controls of his Vespa as we weaved our way around the city full of scooters, cars and pedestrians. Our first stop was a roof top bar atop of a commercial skyscraper overlooking all of Sai Gon. What an amazing view it was!! Rosie ordered us drinks and explained to me the history of the city and what I was seeing; as well as, suggests some wonderful photo opportunities. Upon leaving and heading to our first of several food stops she asked if I had any food allergies or anything I did not like to eat, which I found very thoughtful. Upon leaving the roof top bar Luis was there waiting for us with helmet in hand. The ride with Luis was just incredible as he drove me past several of Sai Gon's most iconic landmarks fully illuminated just so beautiful. Unfortunately, I can not remember the names of each of the places we stopped and ate at, just know the restaurants and food at each stop were lovely and delicious. The evening ended at a local bar with a live band and a female singer. Once again Rosie ordered us a drink and we enjoyed the music. Around 11pm I was returned safely to my hotel and completely full from all the wonderful food I had enjoyed for a peaceful night's sleep. If and when you are in HCM city book this food tour and request Rosie and Luis. They will take great care of you and you will certainly have a ride of a lifetime.

review_title: Consider the environmental impact of old model vehicles: the smoke, the noise
review_text: I'm not writing as a tourist, I'm a local citizen living near the warehouse where they store the Vespa scooters for this tour. Despite the new outlook, the scooters are of old models. The old machines, therefore, need to be tuned very carefully before they are put in use. When they do this, the whole neighborhood becomes noisy with tens of scooters roaring at the same time. In addition, the smoke, the smell envelop the whole area. When they run on the street, for sure they discharge much more pollution than newer model scooters. Consider similar tours using newer vehicles, some of which run by young people, so it's great that you support them. I'm not running any business, I have no benefit from this review, but our city has already been overly polluted, please do not add any more. Have fun in Hochiminh City. Thank you for choosing Vietnam.

We did the Vesper Adventures night tour in November in Ho Chi Minh City and absolutely loved it. Our driver Luis and the other driver Kiet were fantastic – confident, safe and calm in the traffic, which meant we could just relax and enjoy riding through the streets with the locals on the Vespas. Our guide Anh was a perfect host: friendly, knowledgeable and easy to chat with, always making sure we were comfortable and looked after.

The itinerary was spot on. We started at a rooftop bar with amazing views over the city, then visited two local family-run spots for delicious Vietnamese food that we probably wouldn’t have found on our own. We finished the night at two different live music venues, each with a great atmosphere and a real local feel.

The whole experience was around four hours of fun and never felt rushed. We felt safe the entire time and really got to see a different side of Ho Chi Minh City after dark. Thoroughly recommend this tour – definitely a must-do in Ho Chi Minh City.

This was honestly the best trip we have ever been on! Vespa Adventures truly gave us the ride of our life. Our amazing team Giang, Quynh, Dat, Huy, Hieu, Thai and James went above and beyond in every possible way. They were fun, professional and made us feel completely safe while showing us incredible sights and local life.

What made it even more special was how thoughtful they were. They surprised us with a cake to celebrate a 30th wedding anniversary and our honeymoon, which meant so much to us. It was such a beautiful and unexpected gesture that we’ll never forget.

Every moment was unforgettable from the views to the food to all the laughter. We cannot recommend this experience enough. If you’re looking for something unique, exciting and full of heart, this is it. Truly a once in a lifetime adventure!
Navi was a brilliant host. Very knowledgeable and chatty! Made us feel right at ease. An experience I would totally recommend!

I had an absolutely fantastic time riding pillion on a Vespa with my driver, Son. Even in the narrowest streets, Son drove me safely and competently.
Highly recommended. The selection of stops (Skyline Bar, street food (egg omelet and seafood), and the bar/club left nothing to be desired.

My daughter and me had a great time on our Vespa tour in Ho Chi Minh! Our guide Tom was very knowledgable and told us lots of interesting facts about all the places we visited. Would definitely recommend- such a great way to experience the city!
The highlight of our time in Saigon, cannot recommend more highly 11/10. Our guide Long was terrific and the stops are brilliant. Thank you!

Great guide, Trang, and riders Cuong and A.Chieu.
Felt safe despite the crazy morning traffic, saw some sites we wouldn't have found on foot and had an excellent, fun time.
Highly recommended

review_title: Best night out! A fabulous way to explore Ho ChiMinh after dark.
review_text: Possibly the best tourist activity I have ever done. Not only informative and interesting, giving us a glimpse into Ho Chi Minh night time but SO much fun. Very generous with good drinks and delicious food and a fantastic opportunity to meet new and interesting people. I felt safe and exhilarated on the Vespa as we explored the city at night. A must do experience
Our night time Food Vespa tour was fantastic. We loved every minute. Our two drivers H Phu and Thuan were excellent. Our guide M Thu was outstanding. Highly recommend

A must do in HCM!
We had a very enthusiastic and very well English speaking guide My Tien and driver An!
They made us feel very safe in crazy HCM traffic but they did amazing.
The best way to discover the city!

Thank you both for a great experience, I will make sure to recommend you!

Thank you - Robby and Asiye from Belgium

review_title: Don’t come to Saigon without a Vespa experience. Doing a food tour is best of both worlds.
review_text: This tour was amazing. Firstly, I felt very safe with the experienced and organized drivers in orange uniforms with vintage vespas with all safety equipment including helmets. We went to four unique venues with Vespa travel between. We started at a rooftop bar with views of Saigon. The off to a very clean and fun restaurant for Vietnamese specialties. But lots of other options too. Then to a famous Michelin star street food experience. Topped by the last stop a popular bar with live music. All drinks mixed water soft drinks and beer included. It would be a mistake if you came to HCM and missed this unique cultural experience. Shout out to Linh who accompanied us everywhere and make it extra fun. I would say try is best for travelers who want a fun local experience in top notch venues.

One of my favourite experiences in Vietnam. The food was divine ; the guide, Jess was brilliant and a great host. The live music bar at the end of the tour topped it off.
I was recommend this tour highly.

Fantastic night out!
What a buzz riding about HCMC at night. Drivers were great and felt very safe. Thanks Peter and team! Well organised, food and bars were excellent.
Highly recommend ' Saigon By Night' tour.

This was one of the highlights of our Vietnam holiday and a particular hit with the teenagers in our family. It was so much fun experiencing Saigon traffic from the back of the Vespas and enjoying the street food in places we wouldn’t have otherwise tried. Our guide was Sunny who was so enthusiastic, fun, informative and accommodating to my request to see the skyline from over the river. We felt completely safe with drivers Bo, Lo, Red and Daniel who whizzed us through small back streets as well as along the busy main roads. They were ready to dress us in ponchos when the rain arrived half way through the tour. We enjoyed the food and loved the final bar stop which was a hidden surprise.

Great morning with Tien and the 3 drivers
Beautiful safe way to visit the city
Well maintained vespa and pro drivers
Must do

We had spend the morning in the tunnels and upon return to the pier we were greeted by Phi from Vespa Adventures.
What an afternoon ! It was an incredible experience… an insightful glimpse into busy Saigon! Whizzing around the city and stopping in various local & authentic spots …
This was really made special by our tour guide … Phi.
We have travelled many places in the world and have had many tour guides but Phi was special… he is an incredible young man .. intelligent, kind, respectful and genuine. We enjoyed his company so so much and learned a lot l, both about the history of the city and the life there now.
We had 2 gentleman driving the Vespas and we felt so safe in their hands weaving through the chaos of the city!! C. Teó & Cuong .. thank you both for keeping us safe and making it such a fun experience.. thanks also for your patience.. nothing was a problem for these 2 guys or indeed Phi … they couldn’t do enough for us. So once again thanks for a memorable day ! Kathleen & John

Absolutely amazing, great way to take in the vibe of the city and enjoy great views and local food along the way! Highly recommend! Our guide Helen was brilliant, great company and very knowledgeable - she also surprised us at the jazz bar with a cake for our 20th wedding anniversary!

What a fabulous and fun way to take in the sights and sounds of city life when staying in Saigon. We were met at our hotel by the lovely Dave and A.Vu who demonstrated all safety aspects of riding a bike on the crazy city roads! They took us to our first stop where we were greeted by Tom who introduced us to the first round of craft beers. Tom was full of information about all things beers and city life, he was also full of life himself! We were taken to three further stops to enjoy more beers and food too! Despite being a non-beer drinker, I was hooked by the end of the evening! We had fun chatting to other members of the tour and Tom whilst enjoying food and a variety of craft beers. The ride on the Vespa from bar to bar was such fun too! This experience is a must in Saigon - a highlight of our holiday. Thanks to the lovely Tom, Dave and A.Vu 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

review_title: Had the BEST time with Vespa Adventures in HCMC! 🛵✨
review_text: We had a great experience with Vespa Adventures in HCMC. Our driver Andy was super friendly and professional. We felt very safe with him on the Vespa. We stopped at some really tasty local food spots, which was the highlight of the evening. It was a fun way to explore the city. Definitely recommend it if you’re visiting!
Highly recommend trip! Best way to see the city and immerse in the local culture. Sunny and Sang took care of me and showed me so many interesting places. Loved it!

review_title: WELL ORGANISED, SAFE FUN - A 'MUST DO'!
review_text: Great, great fun - don't miss it! Vespa drivers were safe and competent - no risks taken in the dense traffic. Food was excellent, too!

We were warmly greeted by Mike in our hotel lobby. He made us feel comfortable and excited about the experience to come! He was knowledgeable about the city and kept us entertained throughout! Our drivers were also very safe as they zipped through the streets, great fun would do it again!

review_title: Saigon After Dark - Gret tour - family with three teenagers
review_text: Our family loved the Saigon After Dark Vespa tour! Tom, our guide, was knowledgeable and fun, and our drivers (including Bao, Teot, and Dona) made us feel safe zipping through the city. We enjoyed trying local street food and seeing parts of Ho Chi Minh City we wouldn’t have found on our own. It was a unique and exciting way to experience the city’s nightlife—highly recommended for families with teens!

We were warmly greeted at our hotel by Sunny our guide for the evening. Her energy level was untamed by the heat that night. We were informed of our itineraries, introduced to our drivers, helmeted and off we went.
Merged into the flow of tons of other motorcycles we were on our way to the first drinking place which was a fantastic sky bar. View was gorgeous!!! A must see!
-ride to the second place was brief and safe. One can safely snap photos or videos in the back. We arrived at A well-known banh xeo (Vietnamese crispy turmeric pancake filled with shrimps, pork and bean sprouts). We definitely had some truly authentic Viet dishes

Onward to the next local restaurant with umami seafood dishes. Our drivers were safe drivers and no apprehension was had. The last watering hole was a fun bar with live music. Singers’ voices were great and smiles were on everyone’s faces.
-Sunny took great care of us with attention to details. Her amiable nature, her infectious energy and enthusiasm and the great places curated made our evening. The tour had ended but the great vibes propelled us to seek out another Skybar and our drivers came through with a great recommendation. We enjoyed the evening so much and decided to roam the streets back to our boutique hotel.

We had an exhilarating tour experience with Tien and her very professional colleagues who took us around on the Vespas. Our family saw Saigon in all it’s glory, all through downtown, the backstreets, taste the best banh xeo, and enjoy the live band at the bar. Tien is so gracious!!

Absolutely amazing adventure around the Hoi An countryside. We loved the scenic tour and visiting the rural homes and workplaces. The included food and drinks were delicious. Many thanks to Lanh, Hugo, Nhan and Binh, great tour guides and drivers.

We had a great tour with Sunny! We were a family of 6 and she took us to many districts throughout HCMC, and saw a pagoda, temple, a bird cafe, the flower market where she bought a flower for each woman in our group and we she also got street food for us, a memorial to a monk, the Independence Palace, and the historic Post Office. We stopped frequently and the tour includes food snacks and coffee. She also arranged for pictures of each of us on a vespa and had them printed as a keepsake for us. Sunny was very knowledgeable about the city, spoke English well, and clearly explained where we would be going. Highly recommend!

review_title: Discovery of street food by vintage Vespa scooter in Saigon. Wow!
review_text: To feel the pulse of the city of Saigon nothing better than this gastronomic tour in Vespa. Our very friendly guide "Duyen" holds a quite contagious joie de vivre. She introduced us to places and small restaurants that offer culinary treasures that we enjoyed until the last bite. Our two charming drivers O Nam and Phuoc are very safe. An activity that clears your head and fills you with pleasure. Thanks to the whole team. I highly recommend "The Original Vespa Adventures" in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City).

In Saigon, we thoroughly enjoyed our 4 hour Vespa Adventures motorbike tour, led by very personable Minh Hang (Alina). She vividly revealed Saigon’s culture and day-to-day life through her enlightening tours of the temples, street markets, alley mazes, open-air dwellings, while our two drivers safely navigated Saigon's frenetic flow of cars and cycles. Alina opened our eyes to Saigon in the best possible way.

This was the highlight of our time in Saigon! I was a little nervous to be on a Vespa amongst all of the motorbikes, but my driver, Luis (and my husband’s driver, Harry), was very safe and reassuring. Our guide, Sunny, was absolutely delightful and so much fun! Our first stop was a rooftop bar with a gorgeous view of Saigon at night. Next stop was a restaurant where we ate delicious crab legs, clams and bbq frog legs. Then, we moved on to a restaurant that Anthony Bourdain visited and enjoyed the famous Vietnamese pancakes. Our last stop of the night was a karaoke bar. The local talent was incredible! Our group size was only six people and we had an absolute blast!! Thank you for showing us Saigon like a local!!

review_title: Don't hesitate- book the Vespa tour!
review_text:
When we told people we were going on a Vespa tour in Ho Chi Minh City, most thought we were crazy! First of all, the drivers were all very nice, professional and courteous drivers. Daniel was my driver for the outing. I never felt unsafe or unsure of the driving conditions. Yes, it's busy around the city but most people do not drive very fast.
Our guide Ruby was very knowledgeable and was easy to understand. She was a great ambassador for the Vietnamese people.
The whole tour was a lot of fun. We saw many different sites, got to try some foods and experience some of the culture of the city. I especially enjoyed the iced Vietnamese coffee!

A fun and unique way to see the city. Sunny is the best guide. She is not only informative. She is also funny and enthusiastic. She made the tour very enjoyable, and I highly recommend her if she is available. The Notre Dame cathedral was being renovated. So we did not get to enjoy that site. However, the other sites included are worthwhile. The tour is well-organized, and hotel pick-up/drop off makes it very convenient

As a 15 year vet of the travel biz it is hard to impress me. Last night Vespa Adventures did it. Our group had an amazing time touring the city at night with great group of guests from over the USA. Our drivers were exceptional and most importantly very safe. No request was too big or small. I will do this again. Food, drink and safety was unmatched. Don't miss out on this very special adventure.

review_title: A Experience of a lifetime! See all the Districts, educated on the Historical events and Cultural experiences.
review_text: This is a must do adventure and very educational experience! The tour guide (Sunny) was excellent, very personable and professional. The driver were very experienced, kind and considerate.

Had a fabulous experience with this company, doing a street food tour at night. A group of 20 on the back of vintage Vespas, skilled riders, (especially Q. Hoang), the chaos of Saigon traffic, wonderful food, a cocktail and the view from the H’Up bar - truly a night to remember

A fabulous tour by night around restaurants weaving into little lanes and amongst the traffic. Finally finishing at a really cool bar with musicians. Our guide Annie was suburb, spoke clear English and helpful. Peter and I would recommend this tour.

We have a fantastic evening with Qui our guide and the 2 drivers A. Thuan and C. Nam. We would recommend it to everyone. There was a lot of beer and food on our craft beer and food tour, so make sure you are hungry
Lots of fun riding round Ho Chi Minh City in the rush hour!!!

Our extroverted guide, Tuyen, expertly lead our evening expedition of Saigon nightlife. After being picked up from our hotel, we started with a drink at a vibrant rooftop bar then scooted to appetisers (pancakes, self-constructed rice paper rolls) at an alleged Michelin Star, family run, open air eatery. We scooted to our seafood restaurant for our main meal (crab, shellfish broth, frog, noodles) then on to a local nightclub where we enjoyed live music (Vietnamese interpretations of Amy Winehouse, Coldplay, Lady Gaga) with the locals. Alcoholic beverages were freely available and included throughout. I was entirely safe and comfortable with my rider, Hon. The group of vintage Vespas navigated the Saturday night traffic like a beautifully choreographed dance. Do this tour. You’ll be buzzing afterwards.

We to Vietnam for our honeymoon in April 2025. The Vespa tour was amazing and the went absolute highlight of our trip. Not only was it fun but the destinations & food were amazing! Annie was our guide and she was fantastic! At Carmen’s night club she told the band it was our honeymoon and they dedicated a special song to us. Thank you again Annie and Vespa tours for “the ride of our life”! Jan & Tom

Visit the city of Ho Chi Minh in Vespa.
Visit of the main sights of the city, with guide and drivers of Vespa.
Attentive service with fresh water bottles, and a break in a typical bird bar.

Vespa tour with the family = total hit! My wife, three kids and I couldn't stop talking about doing it again. Zooming through different neighborhoods of Saigon was the perfect way to see the city and the kids loved it. Our guide Sunny knew all the local gems - restaurants and bars where we were practically the only tourists. Watched our food being cooked right in front of us and tried some amazing dishes, even frog legs (jumping chicken)! Great food, cool spots, fun rides - an adventure our family won't forget. Worth every penny!

If you want to step into a bit of Saigon daily life, can recommend these guys. It's exhilarating and gives you a great view of street life. Jayden, my driver spoke excellent English. He was a very good driver .. safe, courteous and informed. I think about an hour would be good on a busy 🌙 But choose your type and time.

We had the most amazing experience touring the Mekong on Vespas - we were a little concerned at outset that our youngest (12) wouldn’t be happy on the back of the scooter - within 30 mins all sense of fear was gone and she was mentally racing through the streets! Just riding Vespa’s through Ho Chi Min is an experience in itself, but this tour is so much more. Our guide (Sunny) introduced us to a whole side of Vietnam that we ( but more importantly) our children) would not have seen inside the city. Each stop off was full of insights. The highlight for all of us was the local markets - vibrant and full of life. Sunny was a perfect guide full of knowledge and enthusiasm. The riders were all brilliant and we felt perfectly safe in their hands. This will no doubt be one of the highlights from Vietnam.

review_title: Vespa night food tour in Saigon
review_text:
Chi & her 2 Vespa drivers took us on a very special adventure in Ho Chi Min.
Chi was very personable and smart!! Gave us a great insight into life here in Saigon. The food stops were very well thought out & were amazingly excellent, this was not an average tour. We were very well taken care of. We HIGHLY recommend this tour for an elevated experience!

review_title: The best way to see the city with a breeze.
review_text: I was so lucky to join the after-dark tour last-minute. Loved it so much - what a fun and adventurous way to see the city. Blend in with the locals for a true moped ride experience, tasting absolutely delicious diverse food, and even learning about main historical sites. Our guide Sunny was the the most amazing host - so kind, good energy and welcoming! and my moped guide Andy was so friendly and knowledgeable too. I have the warmest memory of this experience and would recommend without a second of doubt! Truly amazing how much can be packed in 4 hours!

Most fun tour of our 14 days in Vietnam. Our guide Tien and drivers Sha and T. Dung showed us the best time. It was hectic on the vespas but we felt to safe at all times, even in the pelting rain. Yummy food at 2 restaurants, great city view in roof top bar and finished off listening to a live band. Highly recommend this tour.

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience!
review_text: So much fun and an amazing way to experience Saigon. Seeing the city on the back of a vespa is unparalleled. Plus, the food was so delicious! The seafood restaurant was one of the best meals I've had in years. An incredible night and I will always remember my ride. We loved our vespa guides who were so sweet and cautious - TK, Rich, Nguyen, and A Thuan. Plus, our guide, Nhi, was wonderful even though she tricked me into eating frogs legs! Thank you for a night we will treasure!

We did this as an optional part of a Scenic Cruises tour. This was one of the best things we did in Vietnam. You get a different perspective on the traffic when you're part of it. The street food stops were all different and they couldn't have done more for you. In one place they did french fries for my husband and in another a plain Vietnamese pancake. At no point did we feel unsafe and would recommend it to friends.
Very nice tour. We went with Alina on the Mekong delta tour. She took us to several local places with no tourists. My driver DoNa did a very nice job.

review_title: Unique way to experience the nightlife of Ho Chi Min City
review_text: Excellent city tour experienced as the locals do on the back of their scooters, great food & bars! Drivers Kiet & A.Thuan and our fab Guide Yen took great care of us, we felt completely safe driving through the city-highly recommended.

review_title: A great snapshot of Sth Vietnamese food
review_text: We had a fabulous lunchtime tour with Kimmy as our guide and Cuong and Luis as our drivers. We felt completely safe with them in this chaotic city. All the food was fabulous - four stops - don’t eat before you go - you can’t fit it all in. A fabulous way to experience South Vietnamese food. So professional - highly recommend!!

review_title: Perfect, delicious and interesting culinary Vespa tour in Saigon
review_text: We booked the culinary Vespa tour and bevor we were worried about the chaotic traffic in Ho Chi Minh City. We were first picked up by the drivers, who were dressed in orange. They were very friendly and drove us safely from station to station all evening. When we met our guide Như Ý (SunnY) at the first stop, all our worries were forgotten. She led us through the four-hour Vespa tour with lots of fun, interesting information and friendliness. We learned a lot about Vietnamese cuisine. The food was all very good and consideration was given to allergies or intolerances. The restaurants were very authentic and made the evening perfect.

Go do this! My first time visiting, my first evening here, perfect introduction to the city. Like food? Go on this. Sunny was my tour guide, outstanding! Humour, friendly approach, highly recommend. And my driver Sha, brilliant driver, skill and knowledge, both are excellent!

review_title: Hold on tight for a fabulous night.
review_text: A fantastic evening with The Ride of Your Life Vespa Adventures. Our guide, Sunny, was lovely and we felt very safe with our drivers Phu and Phuoc as we plunged into the peak hour Saigon traffic and zoomed from place to place. The rooftop bar was fun and the food at the two restaurants we visited was delicious and authentic. We finished at a nightclub with a really good band. Happy travellers.

Lots of fun, and as safe as one can be on a scooter in traffic (good drivers) we did a foodie trip: stop for a drink at a rooftop bar, on to a multi course Vietnamese dinner at a local hole-in-the-wall place, then on to crispy pancakes, ending at a quirky basement club with live music and another drink. Price is very reasonable considering food and drink. And the hostess who led the expedition was wonderful. Way better than expected.

review_title: Best experience of the whole trip - top provider
review_text: Incredibly great evening! From front to back absolutely perfect! Unusual and very good locations, excellent food, great bar visits with live music. Very entertaining and exciting set up. Extraordinarily friendly and very good drivers as well as adorable guide yen. This was our best food tour ever and our greatest experience in 2.5 weeks of Vietnam.

review_title: A night out with Vespa Adventures: a not to be missed experience in Ho Chi Minh City !
review_text:
We had the most amazing night out with Vespa Adventures in Ho Chi Minh City. The tour went for four hours. We started with rooftop drinks at Zion then had two delicious food stops with more food than we could eat. We finished the night at a cool local music bar, before being taken home by Vespa.
Our guide MrQuan was very knowledgeable and great company at all our stops. My driver Mr Khoa was fantastic, and very kind and patient as I was quite nervous at the beginning of the night because of the traffic. But I quickly felt very safe and relaxed and had a great time.
We are nearly at the end of a ten day tour of Vietnam, and it has been a wonderful holiday, but our night with Vespa Adventures has been a real highlight .
One of our best experiences on our SE Asia trip - fun riding a vespa through Saigon streets and alleys and exporing the city while stopping at local spots for great food and conversation.

review_title: Vespa,street food tour of Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
review_text: This was the highlight of our time in Vietnam. Our drivers Shar and Phuoc and guide Alina were fantastic 😊The street food was excellent tasting food we had not tried before. Absolutely fabulous time would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants THE RIDE OF YOUR LIFE!!!

We had a great trip with Vespa Adventures. We were taken to some great spots and it was a great way to explore the city. We are hoping to do it again in Cambodia. Our guide (Quyen) was very informative, welcoming and funny. My boyfriend and I felt very safe being expertly navigated by A Thuan & Phuoc. We only did the city tour but were given some street food to try and take to a cafe for a quick rest too.

My wife and I loved this tour. We did it at night. My driver Sha was a consummate professional. In the seemingly chaos he made me feel safe and enjoy the sights, all with a Saigon Lager in my hand! Thien was an amazing tour guide with excellent English. We enjoyed a cocktail in an upmarket rooftop bar, then to a seafood restaurant, another restaurant where we tried Vietnamese pancakes and finished at a funky hidden bar that had amazing talent. Such a great night. Must do in Saigon.

This was the highlight of our stay in Saigon. Our guide Tien was amazing and even though we are in our seventies we had no trouble at all getting on and off the bikes as we travelled to various destinations all over the city. Our drivers H. Cuc and A. Thuan were so helpful and we felt very safe in the crazy Saigon traffic. We were collected from our hotel and started with cocktails in a rooftop bar. We ate frogs legs and other Vietnamese dishes and finished with another cocktail at a nightclub. The whole evening was perfect. Thank you sooo much.

When I arrived in Ho Chi Minh City, I barely dared to cross the road. The chaos was overwhelming. But the moment I hopped onto the back of Phuoc's Vespa, my fear melted away, replaced by pure exhilaration.

Our guide, Trang, was fantastic—knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate about sharing the city's hidden gems. She led us through vibrant alleys and into tucked-away eateries that I would never have found on my own. Each stop was a feast for the senses, from mouthwatering street food to lively local hangouts brimming with energy.

This vespa tour makes you feel the city, I 🧡 it!

Thank you, Phuoc and Trang!

review_title: Get this in your ‘must do’ list in Saigon
review_text:
No better way to explore Saigon at night. Couldn’t have been better looked after by our friendly and engaging guide, Ouy and drivers Huy Kid and A Thuan.
Fabulous mix of street food and 2 entertainment stops with excellent live music. All starting with hotel pick up and a stop for a drink at a high end rooftop bar.
So much packed in from 6pm til 10.15pm. Great fun zooming through the traffic on the Vespa’s.
Thoroughly recommended.

We did the night Saigon after dark tour on the last night of our holidays. We had an amazing night. Our drivers Loc and Luis were excellent. Very safe but fun and shared lots of facts. Our guide Trang was delightful and was great at giving us insight into all the foods we tried. We were collected from our hotel at 6pm and got back about 10.20pm. We started with a drink in a sky bar then enjoyed two restaurant stops and finally a bar with live music. Good value given everything we got to enjoy and would highly recommend for a fun evening but also a way to see the city at night. Fabulous evening.

review_title: Great ride Great food Great guide
review_text: Fantastic night with Mai Mai our guide, had great fun on the back of the scooters. Both riders where awesome, stopped off at 2 bars one with views one with live music. Ate at 2 restaurants both really really good. Tour lasted about 4 hrs and would thoroughly enjoyed recommend. Traffic is crazy !!!!

So it was raining - did that dampen the fun? Not at all! Owing to the sparkling personality of our guide Annie, we had a wonderful evening touring and eating delicious street food throughout the city. The highlight was having a boisterous anniversary toast at the speakeasy-styled Carmen Bar when Annie secretly told the band of our celebration. It made for one of our best evenings in Saigon!

It’s not easy to manage a group of 45 guest to go on the tour, but Mrs.Thy and her team have done a good job. During 3 hours on the tour, we visited so many famous destinations in Saigon in the proper time as the itinerary planned. Thank you so much.

These Vespa food tours in Ho Chi Minh City truly offer an incredible way to experience the city vibrant street food culture. The combination of riding a vintage Vespa through the lively streets and indulging in authentic Vietnamese cuisine is both thrilling and immersive. Each tour operator brings something, whether the intimate local knowledge, the handpicked food stops, or the engaging storytelling.

It is so impressive how these tours not only showcase amazing dishes but also create unforgettable cultural experiences. Sunn Y passion, attention to detail, and warm hospitality make these tours stand out. A big compliment to all the teams who work hard to offer such a seamless and enjoyable adventure for US.

review_title: Beautiful way to spend an afternoon
review_text: We had such a memorable afternoon with Vespa Adventures. Our guide was warm and friendly, gave us so much information and we visited new and different places. The drivers drove safely and carefully (thanks Hien!) and everyone we met had a beautiful and unique story. Thank you, we had a wonderful time!

Had a great time on the "Glimpse of the Mekong" with Tom (Quan) and Ty.
As well as enjoying the ride (expertly ride by Ty) I learned so much about Vietnam and in particular the Mekong Delta from Tom.
A must do.

We had an absolutely fantastic time with Sunny as our guide and Daniel and Lui as our drivers. I was petrified to go on this tour, but they made it very comfortable and it ended up being one of my favorite parts of the trip. It is completely worth it. Go! Even if you're a little tentative! I liked it so much that we booked another tour from them in Hanoi. We saw sites that we never would have found on our own, including a cool bird cafe and a fortune teller vending machine.

I was quite disenchanted at first on rhe Vespa although the rest of my family loved it from the start ! But once I got used to the traffic and realized the drivers were all really experienced and safe it ended up being the best night of the holiday. Great seeing the bright lights and skyscrapers with the roof top bars but also the back streets and the street food . Our guide Jesse was lovely and the food was fantastic

We did the Saigon Foodie Experience and it was fantastic. Our guide was friendly, warm & engaging (it felt like we were just hanging out with her as friends - "our local friend for the day" as she described it herself); the drivers were great too! The food stops were all excellent and the tour of the flower / food market felt like an authentic Saigon experience (far away from the tourist trail). It was one of the standout highlights of our 2 week trip to Vietnam.

review_title: Experiencing Mekong Delta Local Life and Culture through Vespa Journey
review_text:
The Vespa trip from Ho Chi Minh City to the Mekong Delta was an interesting way to experience the area's local culture and daily life. Riding through HCMC's traffic was a notable part of the journey, especially coming from Indonesia, where traffic conditions are similar.

An unexpected part of the trip was riding on fixed roads, which seemed to be a regular part of local travel but stood out to me. It feels like a small connection to the routines of local life, something that isn't usually highlighted in typical tourist experiences.

Visiting the markets in the Mekong Delta provides a clear view of local life. The visit offered a direct look at how people in the region live and work daily. The atmosphere was different from more curated tourist sites and felt genuine.

The route was well-planned, though it would have been beneficial to have more opportunities to interact with locals. Such interactions could have added more depth to the trip by providing a better understanding of their lifestyle and culture.

A big shoutout to our guide, Sunny, who was knowledgeable and helpful throughout the trip, making the experience smoother and more informative. Thanks also to our Vespa drivers, CNam and Ty, who ensure we navigated safely and comfortably.

Overall, the Vespa ride from HCMC to the Mekong Delta was a practical way to observe the area's everyday life and landscape, offering a different perspective than more traditional tours.

The evening with the great staff at Vespa Adventures was a great experience in this vibrant city!
The drivers Dee and Lo drove us safely and regularly from place to place and Nhi was a fantastic woman who performed us well everywhere:-)
The visit to the Rooftop Bar was sensational, the many wonderful food a great pleasure!
Only the visit to the bar with live music was a bit very touristy, as 95% of people were brought in by Vespa Adventures ;-)
The Vespas are really extremely beautiful and super restored. Thanks for the great experience!

review_title: Best thing we did in HCMC
review_text: Fantastic tour! This was our favorite thing we did in HCMC. Sunny, our guide, took us to fascinating parts of Saigon that we would have had no idea about on our own. It was a diverse, fun and interesting exploration. Luis, my driver, was great at his job, safe and careful but also fast. An exhilarating way to explore HCMC. Totally recommended and we are looking at their tours in other places as enjoyed it so much. Thanks Sunny and Luis.
Highly recommend this tour! Lots of fun! Very safe and confident drivers! Truong and Loc were amazing drivers with Chloe as our Guide. All wonderful and made it a very special night. Thank you!

The Saigon by night food tour was the highlight of our trip to HCM. Our guide Julie N was fantastic and the drivers were all courteous and helpful. The rooftop bars had great views of the city and the places we went to eat were off the beaten track which we would never have found without a guide

review_title: Vespa tour in Saigon - a must do!
review_text:
A hilarious & fun tour around Saigon! Navi our guide & my Vespa driver Tata were exceptional. Navi was high energy and excitement ensuring everyone was having a great time, with informative stories along the way. Tour began with a drink on a rooftop bar overlooking the lights of the city. Next stop a great seafood restaurant. The food was divine, highly recommend the crab legs & “jumping chicken”. Followed by our next location which was more street food with Vietnamese pancake. Last stop was a Vietnamese bar with live music and cocktails.

12 on the tour broken into groups of 4 each with a guide and leaving at different times so definitely not a tour with the masses. Couldn't recommend this enough.

review_title: Vespa Nighttime Excursion and Foodie Tour ROCKS!
review_text: This Vespa foodie tour was one of the best experiences we had in Saigon. Even in the pouring rain, our drivers (C. Nam and Lui) along with our guide (Tom) took complete and total care of us. We were provided with super-sized ponchos and had a great time zipping through Saigon on what was both a night excursion and street food adventure. Tom made sure to take loads of pictures and videos for us as we ate and drank our way across the city! The tour ends with a stop at a Vietnamese-style coffee shop with live music and dancing. We totally recommend this tour and would do it again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Just do it - you won't forget nor regret
review_text: Probably the best experience we've had. It was a family thing with my 10 and 13 year olds. Safe, fun, exhilarating. My wife and kids are vegan and they were well catered for. The food was exceptional as was being able to experience the organized chaos of Saigon. Our guide Trang made sure everything was spot on and my driver Teo was great and reassuring (easy for a westerner to feel anxious). What a great way to experience Saigon / HCMC. We visited a great seafood restaurant and the oldest Bahn Xeo place ending in a live music bar. So so fun. Highly recommended.

This was one of those experiences that needed an extra star to really set it apart. What a fantastic time. Everyone had their own scooter and driver. We started out having a drink at a rooftop bar with amazing city views. Our guide points out from the roof where we will be going as well as some of the history of Saigon. Traveling on the back of scooters in Saigon traffic was a hoot. Thrilling but never felt unsafe. We had amazing food in two different restaurants. I thought it would just be appetizers but it was a full meal at both. Then we finished at a cool little bar with fabulous live music. I traveled a lot and this was top ten experience.

review_title: Fantastic way to experience Hoi An food and culture
review_text: Our family had an amazing time on this tour. John and his team were so kind and he shared with us so many local insights into the food and culture of Hoi An. The food was abundant, unique and delicious and getting to ride the Vespas was a great experience. Would highly recommend this tour.

review_title: VESPA ADVENTURES is a GREAT company: tour quality, service, WhatsApp response time & safety. Many cities &tour options
review_text:
This is a GREAT company in terms of quality of tour, service, response time, and safety of drivers.
We took the Hanoi insider's tour, it was outstanding. Very interesting & safe. Andy- the tour guide, and Mike the vespa driver spoke excellent English.
We liked it so much that we also booked the Mekong river adventure. The tour details of the Mekong ride sounded great, well off the regular tourist path. Unfortunately, we became sick. The tour operator was very kind with offering a nearly-full refund. Cancellation policy is extremely fair, with a full refund if canceled at least 24hrs in advance, payment by PayPal is possible, and communication by WhatsApp great.

This was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. My driver Dung-N was great. He looked after me very well. The food was delicious and the live music was fabulous. If you get the chance you should definitely take this adventure.
So much fun! We saw neighborhoods and alleys we never would have seen unless on scooter. Driver Thanh was terrific. Guide Sunny too. A highlight of our trip to Vietnam!

Exhilarating, authentic & professional
On the last day of our vacation we took a “taste of the Mekong delta” day tour from Saigon. Collected at our hotel by knowledgeable guide Alina , we sped out of Saigon on vintage vespas - we've been watching the amazing moped driving in Vietnam for 3 weeks and now it was time to take part - the tour was exciting through the traffic, peaceful in the off road sections as we approached the delta & punctuated with coffee breaks and visits to small factories, a market, temple, and street food vendors. We didn't see any fellow tourists and felt fully immersed in authentic local culture. My driver Dana was an absolute Ace, I felt safe at all times and he was amazingly skillful weaving through the traffic and avoiding potholes - thanks for a magic last day in Vietnam. I can really recommend this tour.

review_title: Great tour with Phuong and Rose
review_text: What a great adventure! An excellent way to see the city and visit truly authentic places. Our guide Rose was great fun shepherding us from each of the places that we visited. Phuong my driver was excellent very skillful and safe navigating the city traffic

review_title: Certainly the ride of my (long) life!
review_text: Absolutely wonderful introduction to Saigon ... 4 authentic food, cocktails and music chosen a la carte by Rosie our guide. Felt totally safe being driven on a sturdy Vespa
Fantastic, fun, safe experience. Our guide Ruby was fabulous and gave us all a good laugh ! Great stops along the way to experience some authentic Vietnamese food ! Highly recommend

Excellent evening spent with Sunny and our drivers, Cuong and Bin. Always felt safe on the very busy roads - it was great fun and a really good way to get around the city, plus experience the sights, sounds and smells more authentically. Sunny was delightful, so enthusiastic and good company. We had a lovely evening and would highly recommend using this company - and Sunny - for your Vespa food tour.

review_title: See Saigon from the back of a Vespa.
review_text: This was a lot of fun. It gives you a safe opportunity to experience the craziness of moped traffic in Saigon without having to actually drive the bike. You get good insight into the variety of neighborhoods too. Highly recommended.

review_title: Excellent fun night experiencing how locals live
review_text: What a really fun experience! Tour guide Kathy was excellent, friendly funny knowledgeable and my driver Hai was great safe and attentive- highly recommend for a fun night experiencing local cafe restaurants - not just for young people- our group were retirees and we all had a ball!

Exceeded expectations. The best way to see the city, back lanes and local streets. The food experience was awesome - we learned so much from our guide Van (she is awesome) and had the most incredible experience.

The ride of your life for sure!

Just a brilliant trip for myself and my wife, both late 50's and never ridden a motorbike. A great way to experience the chaos of Saigon with great venues for drinks and food, plus great music. Our guide Nga was so helpful and even arranged a small cake in one of the venues as she found out it was my birthday! Great drivers in Cuong & M. Hai soon calmed our initial trepidation and we had a blast. We we took to lovely places we would never have found, and even went back to the Latin music venue on another night. Would love to do it again sometime.

review_title: Full Vespa tour off the beaten track, local Point of Sale, temple that mixes several religions. Exotic!
review_text:
I did a “Glimpse of the Mekong Delta” tour with Nhu Y (SunnY) from Vespa Adventures at the end of September. I booked very late, but the tour still took place, even though I was the only participant!
Nhu Y was riding his own motorcycle while I was on the very comfortable Vespa of a driver (whose name I forgot, I blame myself ..) who drove very carefully and was careful not to shake too much, especially when we entered the trails altered by the rain.
The stages of the visit were very pleasant: cafe, Point of Sale, restaurant on stilts.... Nhu Y was very available to answer all my questions and discuss what I was discovering.
At the end, they gave me a picture of myself on Vespa, which I keep as a great souvenir! Thank you for everything!

Never having ridden a motorbike before we decided to add this to our trip anyway as it sounded great and it WAS! Our driver puk and Duy were excellent and our guide sunny were like family making sure we had a safe but fun time. This was definitely the MUST DO moment of the trip as the night life and food in Ho Chi Minh was first class. I guarantee you will want to go again! Thanks to sunny Duy and Puk!!

Navi and her riders were fabulous. Each of the five visits was unique and each was an incredible experience - we would never have found such wonderful places on our own. The food was exceptional and the entertainment superb. Navi shared her experiences of living, working and studying in Ho Chi Minh City - she was delightful. Highly recommended.

review_title: Fun ride (of your life) and lovely food
review_text: we had a great experience with our three drivers (An, Cliong and Nahn) and Sunny our guide …. food was excellent (very local) and Sunny added nice stories and local color … zipping around among traffic and past the major sites of District 1 is much fun .. would definitely recommend

review_title: Beautiful Vespatour of Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
Last night we did a vespatour of Ho Chi Minh City.
It was a very nice experience, we had a lot of fun with our guide Jasemine, she told us a lot about Vietnam and also gave us brief insights into the language. The food was delicious and gave us wonderful insights into the typical local food of Vietnam. The drivers got us safely through the daily traffic chaos.
All in all, it was an eventful evening that we can unreservedly recommend.

Brilliant evening with super drivers- they looked after my 3 daughters- 18, 16 and 9. Sunny our host was friendly and very helpful. Great food and cocktails also. Great way to also see the city. Would very much recommend to anyone.

Was an unbelievable ride, my driver lo was amazing, best bloke. I want to do this again with the same guy because it was very good because it was good. The food and drink stops were very good (tasty food) yum!,

review_title: The ride of your life - it's true!
review_text: This was recommended to me by two separate friends who had visited HMC last year and I was quite unsure I would enjoy this but booked it for my teenage sons. However, we all absolutely loved it! So much fun on the bikes - felt really safe but really excited - fabulous views riding through the streets and across the river. Food and drink stops were excellent - our guide Diep was friendly and fun and our drivers Cuong, M.Nhat,M.Phuc and T.Dung were amazing! What a great night to remember.

I was a bit anxious about this as I am 65 and wasn't sure that a Vespa ride in Saigon was the perfect activity for me!! However, the 4 hour street food tour around Saigon with Navi as a (wonderful) guide, and the most careful and skilled bike drivers….. was one of the best holiday experiences ever!
The quality of the food and the well organized event added to a perfect evening! I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this to anyone!! Go and enjoy 😊
Went on a group tour with my friends had a great experience great way to see the city at night very friendly staff I highly recommend it. Will be

review_title: Wonderful fun evening with tour leader Linh from Vespa Adventures along with Hai and Luyen our drivers. Superb! Thx
review_text: Linh was a wonderful friendly team leader from Vespa Adventures. She gave us the ride of our lives as we scooted around Saigon under the safe and experienced drivers, Hai and Luyen. Fun bars, met some lovely people and the live music too. Thank you!

review_title: The best tour with the best tour guides
review_text: We had so much fun with Mai as our tour guide, and our drivers, Gnam and Luis were so nice and kind, and we were completely safe the whole time. They have been doing this for 10 years plus, so are completely at home on the busy roads. This tour was great value for money. I would highly recommend to anyone who is coming to Ho Chi Minh city.

Did a Vespa tour with an amazing guide. Her year is Nhu Y (SunnY). She took us around the back streets with the locals and got to visit and have coffee and tea with them. I would have liked to have tried a local dish, so maybe that could be a part of the tour in the future, I would have made sure to not have eaten, Or maybe a little time to shop with the locals. Nhu Y was such a joy to be around and she was very pleasant. She made the tour very enjoyable, I'd give her 5 ⭐️.

review_title: The way to discover Ho Chi Minh
review_text: We had a fantastic evening during the Vespa Food tour with Vespa Adventures. It is THE way to really experience Ho Chi Minh. Our fantastic guide Navi took us to a cool rooftop bar and a few top addresses to taste delicious street food. We ended the evening in a bar with a live performance by a local band. Truly an evening you will never forget.

review_title: Ho Chi Minh Vespa City Tour
review_text: We took the Vespa tour around Ho Chi Minh City with our well spoken English guide Tom & drivers Ty and Hien. The drivers were very experienced, making us feel safe on the vintage Vespas. Great food and fabulous fun, so glad we managed to fit this into our trip to the city. Would highly recommend this trip 😃💕🇻🇳

review_title: Amazing way to see (and taste) the city
review_text:
We entrusted Vespa Adventures with our first evening in Ho Chi Minh city - it was a highlight of our time in Vietnam!

Our guide Ma Dup made us feel very at home and welcome as we traveled round the city, trying some delicious local food and enjoying live music as we went. Despite the chaotic traffic we felt very safe riding with Mr Hau and Mr Cuong and want to thank them for looking after us as we toured the city.

If you're thinking about tasting the city's food look no further!

review_title: A great way to experience Vietnam!
review_text: Great day trip, well rounded, get to see urban and rural Vietnam which was spectacular. Nice stops for coffee, snacks and meals and learning the culture

Drivers Tuan, Vinh, Nhi and Nhan, and our guide Diep (Shane) gave the whole family one of the highlights of our trip. Mixing it with the other mopeds on the back streets of Saigon, and taking us to memorable foodie joints (we revisited one of the areas ourselves the next night). First time on a moped for my teenage daughter, but she is a convert!

review_title: A fun way to see Ho Chi Minh City at night. Highly Recommend.
review_text: We had such a fun time on our Vespa foodie tour of Saigon. Three couples who have no experience riding scooters or motorcycles. We had some trepidation at first. But it turned out to be such a beautiful evening. We flew around the city at night and they took us to great places - a rooftop bar, a seafood joint, some other local places we would never have found on our own and finally a latin bar with live music for our final stop. Our guide was Quyen and she did a great job or organizing the trip. Highly recommend.

There were 4 in our group. 3 took the Vespa's and 1, who did not want to travel on a motorbike, was escorted in a car, but didn't feel that they missed out on anything as they were fully included at all stops. We sampled street food at the flower market, local tea at the side of the road and stopped to admire the view of Saigon followed by a meal at an open air restaurant frequented by locals. It was fabulous to see some of the real Vietnam with young vibrant locals. The food was excellent! Hans and his team, Giang, Giang, Xiao and Lam really looked after us.

Our travel agency suggested and booked the Food&Drink Evening Tour with Vespa Adventures the oroginal...ans whoaaaaaaa.... it was great. Even the traffic is chaotic we felt safe and the choosen bars and food locations together with our guides Tom information made it very memorable. Dear Tom and our drivers, Thanks again for a fantastic evening! We highly recommend it!
Wir können die Vespa Night Tour sehr empfehlen. Die Fahrer schlängeln sich sicher durch den Verkehr, die ausgewählten Stops sind keine Touristenfallen und der Rundum Service ab& bis Hotel runden das Erlebnis ab.
Amazing tour with Ruby, Dtuan and Luyen- a really enriching experience around the Mekong plus some really delicious food! Highlight of the trip and felt extremely safe on the bikes :)

These people are just amazing!!! we did 2 tours with them...Angkor wat sunrise and Siem reap night tour.

we loved every minute with them...we always felt safe, well looked after and loved our riders and tour guide.

an absolute must !

My wife and I enjoyed a fantastic evening around Ho Chi Minh City with The Original Vespa Adventures.

During the evening we visited four bars and enjoyed a very wide selection of excellent beers supplemented by some very tasty snack food.

Traveling by Vespa around the busy streets of Saigon was really enjoyable.

We will take home some very fond memories of our tour which is highly recommended.

Special thanks goes to our host Quyen and our Vespa drivers D Tuan, Gaiu, T Phu and Q Quong.

review_title: Exciting ride around Saigon with street food and drinks
review_text:
Vespaadventures.com.4 hours street food and bar tour. Was AMAZING!
My husband and I were driving on the back of old Vespas around Ho Chi Minh City.Stopped at 3 bars and 2 restaurants. The drivers-Cham and Cung were exceptional . So polite and helpful and felt so safe. The guide -Q.Mai was also exceptional. She rode ahead and made sure we were happy with all the food and drinks provided, then explained what we were eating and then sorted the bill. The food we had was fab. A real great trip around the city. Would highly recommend. Thankyou for a brilliant experience!

review_title: Whoa what fun! Yes it's well worth it!
review_text: Weren't sure about paying almost double of the other trips offered but I can't think of anything I would have changed. Great energetic guide and although nervous at first, we quickly trusted our terrific drivers and enjoyed the many sights both on the chaotic main streets and down the narrow alleyways. The food was very tasty and our personable guide was very careful to demonstrate how to assemble the dishes at each place. The cocktails were very good. Not sugary or watered down. Views from the high atop a hotel bar for the welcome drink and then the cave bar with their Latin fusion band for the night cap. Loved the whole experience! The best tour we've had in Vietnam after 2 weeks here!

There is hardly a more adventurous way to get to know the lively Saigon: exploring the city with a driver on a Vespa, letting yourself be carried away by non-existent road rules and still always being in the flow - it works, without any stress or tirades! Our two drivers Harry and P.Hai drove us safely through the evening and we felt very safe! This experience far exceeded our expectations! Above all, the stops at various restaurants and the brilliant, detailed introduction to Vietnamese cuisine by our tour guide Binh An were exciting very and informative!
Thank you for this unforgettable adventure!
this is a really well oiled tour with greta drivers ,well organized venues -it was a lot of fun and very safe -Hanh. our guide was great and our drivers B-loc, Teo T and were excellent

This turned out to be one of the best experiences of our holiday. Our drivers Son and Andy were very professional and skilled in getting us around Saigon safely. It was great fun! We sampled some great street food (especially
