the jumping chicken) thanks to our wonderful guide Sunny.

review_title: A Must Do Tour. Experience of a lifetime.
review_text:
An absolute must do tour in Saigon.
The Vespa evening tour was amazing. We all felt completely safe on the back of our vintage 1990's Vespa’s
We were picked up from our hotel and spent the next 5 hours visiting local bars, sampled amazing street food and just soaked up the atmosphere of Saigon at night on the back of a Vespa.
Rosie our fantastic guide some how managed to see us off from our stop and be at the next stop as we arrived. She was amazing, even picked up that it had been my birthday a couple of days ago and arranged a small cake to celebrate at the final bar we stopped at.

DO NOT MISS THIS TOUR. Quality from start to finish.

Celebrated our last night in Vietnam by doing the Saigon by Night Scooter tour… It did not disappoint. Riding round the streets of Saigon was exhilarating and getting to see and learn about what happens outside of District 1 was really interesting. Started with drinks at a Sky Bar followed by 2 food stops (best food we had in Vietnam) and drinks at a Flamenco bar! Our tour guides (Alina and Jasmine) were friendly and informative and our drivers (Daniel and David) were great. Felt completely safe at all times.

review_title: This is a must tour when visiting Saigon
review_text: My hubby and I booked this tour after other travelers suggested this tour. So glad we did as this was a highlight of our trip. We had Q. MAI as our tour guide and drivers Cung and K.DUY. The drivers were great and we were both safe at all times. Our tour guide was super cute and funny. Great way to experience the culture and city. Thanks so much.
Fantastic experience with a wonderful host, Will, that showed us some authentic venues together with his nice drivers!

Fantastic. From Vivienne making the booking so easy to Mai being the most charming guide and Andy and Luyen being such good safe and lovely drivers. This really was a super night out - shared with a lovely small group. Mai was fun, she had great English and explained the food to us - and the routes we had taken around the city, we will always remember her
5*

Honestly one of the best things we could have done in HCM.
Navi was our tour guide and honestly this girl is unbelievably good at her job. Such good energy, speaks amazing English, very fun to be with and just all-round great 👏🙌
We had a brilliant time and would definitely 100% recommend to anyone.

What a nice experience.
On the back of the Vespa by Ho Chi Minh.
At 8 o'clock we were picked up to first have coffee at the bird market, then to the flower market and the pagoda.
Quyen was great and provided a lot of information

If you only do one thing in the evening in HCMC do the evening food tour with these guys. Our two families had a brilliant night with our guide Hoang and drivers Son, Sang, and Quang. Fantastic views of the city whilst drinking cocktails then fantastic food and music throughout the night at various bars. We all felt safe and cannot rate this trip highly enough. Thanks 🛵🛵🛵🛵🛵

Just had the best tour ever
Alina our host and our Vespa drivers Thuam and Cuong just gave us an excellent culinary tour of Ho Chi Ming city they were great , extremely safe and knowledgeable.
The Street food was exceptional and the 2 night time singing venues were all top notch.
This is a must book trip, we only arrived 4 hours earlier and we were swept into a fantastic trip by the Original Vespa team, making our first night in Vietnam extremely memorable.

review_title: Great intro to night life in Saigon.
review_text: We had a blast on the tour. Hoang was our guide and took us to lots of places we never would have found on our own. We actually ended up going back to one of the bars where they had great live music a couple days later. Our drivers Sang and Hein were amazing weaving us through the city and traffic which was a thrill. Definitely recommend doing this as soon as you arrive in the city.
Thank you Trang and to our wonderful Vespa drivers Nam, Ty, Bao and P.Cuong for our wonderful tour of Saigon, we couldn't have asked for a better morning and the kids absolutely loved it

review_title: Saigon with Mai Mai on a Vespa
review_text: This was our most fun Vietnam tour. Cruising with a Vespa through Saigon's district, experiencing different types of food, coffee and music was just spectacular. What better way to experience the traffic than on a scooter. Our guide Mai Mai did her first tour with us and she was a natural. So much fun with Mai Mai and so many stories about Saigon and Vietnam to share. Thank you Mai Mai. We had a blast and you were amazed. We already recommend this tour to other travelers and rate it a must do!

review_title: A 'must do' excursion, so much fun!
review_text: This was one of the highlights of my trip to Saigon. Very well organized from the moment of pick up to drop off. The traffic in the city is insane but at no point did I ever feel unsafe. The drivers were careful and extremely friendly and I felt really looked after. I got to see spots I would never have realized existed. It was informative, interesting and best of all, fun! Our guide Kathy was so lovely and helpful. This is a 'must do' excursion. The memories will last forever, Thanks to all the drivers, Bao, Chung, County and Ty who couldn't do enough for us and went over and above with our requests. I'm still smiling when I think back to this experience.

Get ready for "The Ride of Your Life." Scooter traffic in Ho Chi Minh City is insane -- but these drivers are really professional. Went after dark and did a food tasting experience. Great exposure to Vietnamese street food.

Done this tour with a bus group on 4th October. I highly recommend this tour, venue's chosen brilliant variety from Cocktails with view of Saigon to street venue and two excellent music venues. The tour was well organized and safe and the driver Mr. Nam was fun as well as very professional.

But the highlight of the tour was the bundle of energy that was the guide Miss Vivian, she was fun, knowledgeable and just made the experience extra special. The group I was with had some very awkward people on it but Miss Vivian was professional and patient with them in spite of the constant problems they were raising.

I will come to Saigon again just for the opportunity to do this tour again with Miss Vivian.
Wonderful evening riding through Saigon. Felt very safe throughout. Even with a huge downpour of rain, my driver pulled over and covered me with a poncho. Highly recommend this!!

review_title: An amazing night time tour of Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Our group of four chose the Saigon After Dark Vespa tour. We'd never been on the back of a bike before, but it was such good fun! My driver Nhi was very safe and professional, as were all the drivers. It was exhilarating be part of the moped madness in Ho Ch Minh City! Kathy, our lovely guide took us to various local outdoor restaurants to sample delicious and varied food. We started with cocktails at a roof top bar and also had coffee at a lounge bar with great local singers. We finished up at another lively venue for after dinner cocktails. The whole tour was amazing and a highlight of our time there. I can highly recommend it!

review_title: MUST DO. Ask Kathy to be your guide
review_text:
This is MUST DO tour in Vietnam. This was our best adventure during our 2 weeks here.

The stops: every stop was unique with great food and/or drinks at each one. We LOVED Cooku's Nest, which had good coffee, outstanding musicians, and a rule of no talking! We followed that with a stop at an acoustic bar which featured a wonderful, energetic band.

The guide: Kathy was an excellent guide! Her English was very good, and she had a great personality that was fun to be around. At each stop she provides background information on the history or culture, a description of the food/drinks and how to eat them.

The drive: we felt completely safe and comfortable on the Vespas on major thoroughfares and alleys. Coung and Duy were great drivers and nice guys.

We had the best time on the back of a Vespa touring Saigon by night. The food bars and live music were fantastic. Nicole our guide was so full of energy and had us all feeling like we knew her forever! She is a gem! Our riders made us feel so safe even in the rain and took great care of us. The food was flipping fabulous. We have already recommended this tour to friends and will do it again if back here! 💯 you need to do this!

This would have to be hands down one of the best most fun things we’ve done. What an awesome experience this adventure was and Ms Vivian made the night. Her bubbly personality and knowledge of everything was exceptional.
We started off in a torrential downpour but we just popped on a poncho and away we went, it just added to the fun of it all. Zipping around on the back of the Vespas was so cool, the way the drivers dart in and out of the traffic will blow you away.

Food and entertainment was amazing from places we wouldn’t have gone to.

This is 100% a must do when you are in Ho Chi Minh, you’ll love it!!!

What a fantastic night! Guided by Kathy who was an excellent host and two excellent drivers Duy and Cuong. Superb food experiences and great bar visits. The drivers were so good, my wife had a bit of a wobble but the guys were able to drive like a police protection unit and shield her from the crazy traffic which helped her regain her confidence and enjoy a brilliant night. Highly recommended, one of our best nights in Saigon.

review_title: Awesome experience and lots of fun
review_text: Great experience and so much fun on the Vespa tour. We visited places we would have missed if not on the vespas. Kathy was our awesome guide who made the trip so much fun. Went to some great little local places we would not have seen with out this great tour. I would recommend this Vespa tour for any age. The drivers are very safe and you have the same driver for the whole tour. We had 5 of us on our little tour and laughed the whole time.

review_title: Best Night of our holiday by far!
review_text: One of our best nights ever and we've had some good nights. Nicole, our guide for the night made it so. Initially nervous, the moment the 3 of us went pillion we knew we were safe, what an experience riding pillion in Saigon in the nighttime.Nicole - what a guide, her energy from the getgo was infectious and we laughed together all night. Each course of our tour was delicious. We loved the chicken, no it's frog, no it's jumping chicken, no it's frog, yes it's frog. The live music club was magical and our time there will forever be a special personal memory that Nicole created for us and videoed. And our drivers, great guys - Chuong, and the other 2 cool guys just accepted us rookie passengers with good grace and eyes that say everything. Guys - your horns sound like ducks, you know it :) We were so sad when we left the last venue but there were 2 more special moments to come, one being the drive back to the hotel when the streets were quiet and all 3 drivers pulled level and rode alongside each other. I felt like I was in the closing scene of a coming-of-age movie. And the other special moments I won't spoil.

review_title: Best way to see Saigon at night!
review_text:
This was the second Vespa tour we did in Vietnam (the first was in Hue) - fantastic fun. Food tour by night on the back of Vespas - zipping round on the streets, accompanied by our wonderful hostess for the evening, Nicole (who organized the food and cocktails, told us about the places we visited. ). We finished in a live music venue, with cocktails, watching the bands. A really great night out and a fabulous way to see Saigon.
The drivers were excellent - we felt really safe with them. A big call out to our drivers Luyen, Hieu and Chung. Thank you!

The Original Vespa Adventures

The experience was exceptional!!
We had the coolest Vespa drivers Nam and Tuan who moved through Saigons busy traffic with ease. This was the most fun fab experience of the entire trip!!!! oh yeah, the food stops, cocktails and live music were fantastic too! It was a perfect night out in Saigon!! Yayasss!!
A lot of amazing food! Our tour guide and drivers were very nice and we got a wonderful tour of the city.

review_title: Don't think about it- book it NOW!
review_text:
Had wifeo & the 3 kids in tow (9,10 & 11 year olds) & hands down the best night of our Saigon trip.
Kathy & Allen were brilliant hosts, with all the venues above our expectations!
Cocktails lovely, food perfect (the kids even went back for 2nds of the jumping chicken!) & the 2 bars were a great mix of quiet & noisey.
The little fella even got dragged up on stage at the last bar. The night was sad then done, could have done it all again!
What a great experience, the best way to see and experience Saigon. A fantastic tour experiencing local foods and drinks as well!

The highlight of our stay in Saigon !!! The vintage vespas were amazing and the bars & restaurants we were taken to were AMAZING ! Our tour guide Nicole was so much fun while remaining professional! She was fabulous! Highly recommend.. would do it again

Tom and his team were brilliant! We booked in the half day afternoon local street food tour. It was a jam packed 4 hours of scooting around Saigon and eating delicious local dishes. We felt 100% safe at all times and Tom had a wealth of knowledge. My daughter 12 and son 10 loved this unique experience.

review_title: The best thing we did in HCMC
review_text: This was easily the best thing we did in HCMC. The Vespas come pick you up from your hostel and zip you away to exciting bars and proper local restaurants with great food. You get a considerable amount of time on the bike so you get to properly experience riding through the city. You even get to take beers with you on the Vespas. All the drivers (shout out to Nam) were lovely and rode safely and Kathy who led our tour was very friendly, warm and full of great information and insight into the city and the country.

review_title: Wonderful Journey with a Super Team
review_text: Wonderful journey with a team with experience and tourist orientation. Our guide (Hang) masters a lot of knowledge that she communicates with efficiency. The drivers are very professional and we feel very secure. BRAVO!

We had the BEST time with our guide Quyen, our drivers - Long and Ttianh. They all looked after us so well. The vespas were really fun and the beer tour was so worth it.
We will tell all our friends back home.
Well done guys! We cant wait to do another Vespa tour with you. Keep up the fantastic work!
Excellent way for 1st time visitors to get an overview of Hanoi and it's people. We enjoyed the half day tour. 8am to 12noon. Thanks to our guide Tommy and our riders, Mark and Nam

review_title: Streets & Eats of Hoi An - so much fun!
review_text:
What a fantastic experience with a private tour for 4 of us! Tour Guide Moon, and the rest of the driving team Oggy, Hanh and Huynh, were great fun, making the evening unforgettable!!

Highly recommend booking direct m, as easy to deal with and great communication for things like allergy preferences etc.

We all felt so safe, even whilst still getting the full immersive Street experience and eating at places we would never normally be brave enough to try!!

review_title: A great way to experience Ho Chi Minh nightlife
review_text: An excellent evening in Ho Chi Minh City visiting rooftop bars, a couple of local street food restaurants and finally visiting two nightspots enjoying local singing and music talent. Our guide and two drivers were excellent making us feel safe when driving and entertaining whilst visiting the various venues. A thoroughly good experience and very worth doing.

Watching all the scooters flying around the streets in Ho Chi Minh City is a bit unnerving, but being on the back of a Vespa is pure fun! Fantastic evening with tour guide Rosie and driver Sang. Loved the ride and every food and drink stop along the way.

review_title: You have to take one of these tours. It's a total blast
review_text: Rosie did an excellent job organizing our evening Vespa tour of Saigon. The five of us in the group had a blast for four hours tonight seeing this huge city and eating local food. The drivers were very professional and I felt very safe buzzing through heavy city traffic with Dona.
Did 4 tours with Nichole x 2 & Kathy x 2 and you could not find more caring guides and then you have Nam & Ty as drivers for the safest of rides.

Utterly exciting! Having watched the motorcycle chaos in Saigon for a few days we were a little apprehensive but need not have worried.
Our guide Quyen was so lovely, a warm and friendly lady who put us at ease. She was so attentive and explained all the food wonderfully. Drivers Duy and K.Long were marvelous, felt just like a local and completely safe weaving in and out the traffic.
Drinking beer while riding pillion through the neon chaos of night time Saigon is a memory that will endure.
Don't miss!

What an amazing experience, this was the best Vespa experience in a City that operates on complete traffic chaos! Kathy organized a Street Food Experience for 11 off us, good was fantastic and we ended in an amazing club listening to local very good singers. My rider was a great guy called Dat, he took really good care of me and filled me with confidence. I can't recommend this outing highly enough

What a great night. Vespas were fab and riders,Lu and Dona really good. You get into the heart of the city. Roof top bar and views were amazing. Lovely food, so many things we had not tried or tasted before. So much we couldn't eat it all. Our guide Quyen was exceptional, very attentive and knowledgeable and obviously enjoyed her job. Live singers in the coffee bar were so good. A thoroughly enjoyable evening which we'd highly recommend.

We loved the vespa tour. I am 20 yo and i was with my mum, both of us really enjoyed it. Our guide was Long and he's really funny, smart, interesting and knows everything! He gave us the best advice about the city. The food is really good and it's very typical, it's not touristic but is great! The drivers are really kind and really careful, we traveled with T Tam and Hung and they were the best!! love u all from Italy!

review_title: A Ho Chi Minh City must do
review_text: The whole evening was great, cocktails at a rooftop bar, great street food in 2 restaurants and drinks in a club and rock bar at the end. The traffic was crazy but we felt safe on the scooters. Cuong and his colleague were great pilots and Dang Thanh Minh as the leader was informative and charming giving the impression that nothing was too much trouble. Our best night out in 2 weeks in Vietnam.

review_title: Vespas and street food with live music. Fab
review_text: Fantastic fun evening in Saigon. Our Vespa drivers Cuong and Thanh Ton were excellent. I was a bit nervous to start with but felt completely safe. It's great fun to get a scooter eyed view of the crazy traffic. Quyen was a super guide and good company and made the evening fun. A highlight of our Vietnam holiday.

review_title: Street food by Vespa in Saigon
review_text: Tour booked well before arrival in Saigon by our UK agent, and we had no idea what to expect. It was absolutely amazing, 4 hours went by in the blink of an eye. Our guide Quyen and drivers Thlian and Phong were brilliant, so friendly and funny and very reassuring to people who'd never sat on scooter anywhere, let alone in the chaos of Saigon traffic. Food fantastic, delicious and authentic and the choice of bars and music venues was perfect. Would do it all over again in a heartbeat, one of the highlights of our 2 weeks in Vietnam for sure.

Had this tour booked before we arrived in Saigon but didn't know what to expect. Absolutely fabulous. From the moment we were picked up from our hotel to the minute we were dropped off. Staff on our tour was so kind and friendly. Stopped off at some lovely local restaurants and bars that would have probably walked past if we hadn't done the tour. Won't say too much as don't want to spoil the fun but this is definitely a must if you are visiting Saigon. Well done to Mai and the team especially Cteo (Bill) my driver. 🙌🛵💙

Wow - what a great night. Rosie (our guide) was super-friendly and knowledgeable, full of energy and spoke excellent English. I can't believe she sometimes does this five times a week - it feels like we were special to her. We went to two places we would never have found on our own (for seafood and then pancakes) - this was really, really fun. The other two places (rooftop bar and coffee) were also lovely. The absolutely most fun bit was zooming around on scooters - what a great way to see the city, and again, I wouldn't have known what to ask for if this hadn't been a tour. I felt very safe with my driver (who I thought was just called D) - he was great. The whole thing was really easy, too - you pay in advance and drinks, meals and coffee are all included. So you don't have to worry about having change, working out the exchange rate and so on. Thoroughly recommended. Thank you!

review_title: The best way to end an amazing holiday
review_text:
We had booked the Vespa tour for the last night of our trip in Vietnam, and honestly cannot recommend the tour enough. Some of our party were super apprehensive, but our tour guide Long was absolutely amazing and so were all of our drivers so made everyone love the trip
Straight away!
The restaurants and bar visits were all absolutely amazing and even catered to some of us fussy eaters on the trip. Everything was so well organised and just brilliant.
An absolute MUST when in Vietnam, cannot recommend enough.
A special shout out to my driver Kha who was super at navigating the busy streets and made me feel at ease straight away!
None of us wanted the night to end!

Had nam and nicole as driver and guide for the glimpse of the delta.They were excellent , however the tour itself was only average. Some of places we went to were less than overwhelming. The restaurant for lunch was great. If they went to more interesting places the tour would be excellent.

review_title: Great fun and a nice way to dip into Vietnamese food
review_text: We had a great time zipping in and out of the traffic on the Vespas that were excellently piloted. My driver, Bao somehow avoided everything. Rosie the guide was very friendly and explained the food at two different venues all delicious. The music bar was OK and is the reason that this is 4 and not 5 stars, the band were pretty lame!

Make this tour a must on your itinerary, we became part of the scooter traffic rather than an observer and visited street food venues we never would have tried on our own. We were taken to 3 different districts across town. Amazing food, saw live music in coffee bars & tried cocktails in genuine Vietnamese bar rather than tourist area - all included. Guides were great, friendly and not scared once! Best tour of the holiday so far.

Our local guide Nghia was excellent and Kind friendly. He was very informative and helpful using his local knowledge to explain everything very well. Driver PHONG was kind friendly & carefully. Thank you

review_title: Vespas beer and lots of fun
review_text: If you want to try some craft beers, eat some awesome food and ride around Saigon on a vintage Vespa, then this is the tour for you. Our personal guide, Nico, made the experience extra special and fun. The vespa drivers were professional and made you felt safe when riding with them. If you have a night free in Saigon make sure you try the Saigon craft beer scene with Vespa Adventures.

review_title: Mekong Delta - Enjoy the Countryside! On a Vespa!
review_text: We did the Mekong Delta Day tour and had a great time. It was a great way to explore an area of ​​Vietnam we would not have otherwise had the time to explore. The trip was well organized, had great food, and we learned about the life of the people living in the Mekong Delta. There is a good amount of time on the Vespa, but I found it worthwhile to get out of HCMC and see some of the countryside. Tour guide was explanatory on all stops of the trip and was informative on the general attitudes and history of people in the area.
Our guide Rosie was excellent, very chatty, took us to some amazing places. The drivers were very skilled and we felt safe at all times. Food is delicious and well worth the trip.
This was the highlight of our trip to Saigon. Expert drivers, fabulous local food, and an outstanding guide (Lilly). If you're thinking about a vespa tour, just book it. It's an amazing experience.

review_title: Fun on the back of a Vespa
review_text: Such fun, and felt completely safe on the back of the vespa. The first stop was a roof top bar with amazing views. Lovely welcome cocktails there. Rosie was our guide, she was such fun. Food was authentic. Overall a great experience

Fantastic craft beer tour

This was by far the best way to see Saigon, if you like beer, food & you want to have some fun we would highly recommend this tour. Our guide had exceptionally good English and was a great teacher of Vietnamese to us at the same time. You will not regrets booking this trip our vespa drivers made us feel super safe on the busy roads

This was the best way to see Saigon. What an experience. Learn and see so much more than we expected. Both drivers and guides were helpful , friendly and went above and beyond to make our day trip very special

review_title: Don't hesitate to do this tour, is well worth it!
review_text: Me and my friends had an amazing experience. Quyen was our tour guide and she showed us beautiful places in Saigon, shared insights from Vietnamese culture, and taught us about the amazing Vietnamese food and how to enjoy it in perfect English. We had more than enough food and drinks, this tour is really worth it. Our drivers: Thanh, Chi Cuong, Thuan, Nghia, and Tien, drove very carefully and responsibly in the crazy streets of HCMC. Thank you for a memorable experience!

review_title: A great mini adventure for food and music
review_text: We had great fun on this trip, it took us beyond the normal places we would have gone to. The street food and music venues were places we wouldn't have found ourselves. The scooter drivers were friendly and made us feel very safe driving around. The tour guide was excellent, very good English and explained all the food.

A breathtaking ride through Ho Chi Minh during nightfall, a versed Vespa-driver, Bao, 5 locations with wonderful food and drinking and a very kind guide, Khanh Van. At the end live music and drinks. I warmly recommend this trip.

review_title: Vespas, food and cocktails in Saigon
review_text:
Having never been on a moped before was a little apprehensive. But within minutes felt comfortable and safe with the whizzing city passed like a pillion passengers.
The evening started with a ride to a roof top bar where Rosie met us (she looked after us all evening and made our time fun and exciting - thank you Rosie).
We then went on moped to two food stops, drinks with music.
A great night out - might even buy a moped!

The trip was great and I felt very safe throughout the journey. The driver was very friendly and did a great job. I enjoyed it a lot and would recommend it to everyone as its a great way to see the city!

review_title: It really is the 'ride of your life'!!
review_text: It was an Amazing experience - excellent organization, we visited amazing venues with great food and bar experiences with very competent riders and great fun ! The Vespers are also really comfortable and the riders make you feel safe but at the same time you experience the madness of Saigon on two wheels.

We had the most amazing experience on the above tour. Everything was wonderful and we cannot recommend enough. However, we chose to have an extra drink at the last stop. This was not included and the charge was really expensive, which was a shame after such an amazing time.

review_title: Excellent tour - spoiled by rip off beer price at the last stop
review_text: Overall the trip was excellent, with great drivers and knowledgeable guide, however the night was spoiled by the outrageous price for a beer 250,000 Dong (AUD15.25) for one beer at the last stop of the night. Shame for such greed to leave a bad taste at the end of a great night

Oh my goodness, I just returned from the most exciting adventure tour. My driver, Tam, was excellent and I only had to close my eyes a few times😄 she is really a great and safe driver, always in control and watching all traffic. My guide, Ruby, was friendly and personable and helped make the evening all the more enjoyable. The choice of local food music etc. Couldn't have been better. I can't recommend this opportunity more highly. Make a reservation when you can.

Our drivers and tour guide Mai was amazing! She was such a great host, the drivers were so attentive and the food was amazing ! We had such a fun and amazing night. Mai also spoke English very well so was easy to understand. Would highly recommend!

review_title: The best way to experience the real Saigon
review_text:
Nghia (our guide) and our 2 expert Vespa riders (Thang and Son) gave us a fantastic time. We visited 5 different venues - a trendy rooftop bar where we enjoyed cocktails at sunset with views right across the city, a trip across the river to a street restaurant specialising in seafood, then it was a trip to sample Bahn Xeo (where Nghia showed us how to roll the crispy pancake in fresh green leaves), then to a tiny music venue for coffee before cocktails to round off the evening at 6E1 a bar with a live rock band.

Criss-crossing the city on the back of a scooter was an unforgettable experience with the amazing numbers of other bikes obeying no obvious traffic rules but somehow missing each other. But we felt quite safe all the time.

Nghia was a brilliant and very informative host with excellent English. We thoroughly recommend this to anyone who wants to experience the real Saigon and visit the sort of places you wouldn't otherwise discover. Nghia also called ahead to adapt the food order to suit vegetarian.

review_title: What a blast! Vespa Food Tour
review_text: We did the Ho Chi Minh foodie tour - which was just great! Our guide, Fully (and drivers) were superb; knowledgeable, funny and great company! What an amazing way to see and experience the city, buzzing through the traffic - an experience we won’t forget! The food stops were excellent and got to sample some local dishes in local restaurants (that we may have got to try without the guide). Music venues are excellent too, plus the sky bar was great too! We’d highly recommend Vespa Adventures and so happy we booked this! Thanks Fully!!

This was a fantastic tour. I have never been on a vespa or any type of motorised bike and was a bit nervous, but there was no need my driver was excellent, and I felt safe the entire time. Rosie was our hostess, and she was so lovely and happy, and we enjoyed spending time with her. She went above and beyond to look after us. I would highly recommend giving this tour a try.

This was such a fun night. Riding on a vespa was such an awesome experience and w had a real taste of the night life in Vietnam. Our guide Mai made the whole trip easy and enjoyable. First we stopped off at a rooftop bar with beautiful views of the city and cocktails, this was followed by trying the local delicacies and finished off with some fantastic live music. I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Saigon!

review_title: Do it! Great way to safely feel a part of the Ho Chi Minh action
review_text: This was our favorite activity in Ho Chi Minh! The night tour was a great way to see a variety of venues...we ended up completely stuffed after visiting multiple restaurants. Loved a lounge with a lineup of lounge singers, while the "Acoustic Bar" with ear-splitting music was less our style. Guide and drivers were great. Sitting comfortably on the back of a Vespa navigating the crazy traffic was truly a memorable experience, definitely recommend!

Did the night tour and was So Much Fun. Drivers, guide and the agenda/itinerary all terrific - including special care from the guide to help with gluten free food options for our daughter (unfortunately the 'head office' did not pass on this dietary need as they said they would prior but worked out ok in the end thanks to extra effort from guide). Great venues with mixture of 'trendy' rooftop bars (with awesome view), local food, ice cream, very cool live music and route which took us through variety of the city

review_title: Best Way to Experience Ho Chi Minh City!!
review_text: Lily and Ty made this tour one of the absolute best I've ever experienced in Asia!! If you want to experience life from a local's perspective, I would highly recommend this Vespa tour! Not only will you experience the excitement of riding on the back of a motorbike amidst the chaotic traffic of Vietnam, but you'll also get to stop and try excellent food. My favorites from our several stops included the seafood and the pancakes! I also greatly enjoyed the frog! This tour will also let you get your dance on as we visited karaoke bars! This tour is a MUST for anyone coming to Ho Chi Minh City!!!

A great tour and amazing experience around Chiang Mai and into the hills with excellent guides who made this trip so much fun. It is the best way to get to know a city by buzzing around on a Vespa through the narrow streets and in the countryside.

Thoroughly recommended.

review_title: Amazing Vespa Food and Music Tour
review_text: Amazing 4 hours on a classic Vespa scooter! Weaving our way through the streets of Saigon and tasting delicious local street food. My highlight was Banh Xeo prepared in charcoal fire! So rare these days! And the lovely cozy bars where live bands played Vietnamese and English music. Thanks to Mr Loi ,our tour guide who made our trip so memorable!

A must do when in Ho Chi Minh an experience of a lifetime Vy our guide was brilliant the Vespa drivers were super professional and kept us all safe the tour was well worth it u get to see hidden gems through the tour a 10/10

review_title: The High Light of our visit to Ho Chi Min City
review_text: We took Vespa Adventures as one of our shore excursions during our Mekong River tour with Scenic, and the Vespa Adventures was probably the high light of our tour in Ho Chi Min City. The Vespa drivers are excellent (and completely safe), the Vespas themselves are mint condition and the places that they stopped for food and drinks were amazing. Driving around at night in Ho Chi Min City with the traffic is crazy...but Vespa Adventures gives a tourist a real sense of what traveling around the city by motorbike is like. Definitely would do this again...but only with Vespa Ventures!! They're the best!!

For our last day in Vietnam, as a family of 4, we decided to book a Vespa Adventures tour in Ho Chi Minh City to the Mekong Delta… It could possibly have been the best decision that we made all trip. We were met with an extremely friendly and thoughtful tour guide, Miggi, and 4 drivers that were polite, nice and enthusiastic. We got to see the local markets, try rice wine and a range of different Vietnamese activities. We went to places not many tourists go and experienced the livelihoods of those living close to the delta. Our tour guide was an absolute legend who we could chat to all day long while eating food with the ability to speak the best English that we had heard on our entire Vietnam trip. The fish markets, temples, cafes, fishing restaurants etc. all made it extremely worthwhile as well as driving down highways and through the hectic Vietnamese traffic.
What an amazing end to our journey and we are so happy that we spent it with Vespa Adventures.
This is the best experience it's a great way to see the city going to different bars and local restaurants on the back of a Vespa I felt safe in the hands of the driver

review_title: The best way to see Saigon!
review_text: We were out in Vietnam for 2 weeks and this was definitely one of the highlights of our time out there! The tour was run so smoothly, with 5 stops including, a sky top bar, a seafood restaurant, a pancake restaurant and two live music bars. The drivers were brilliant and going around Saigon at night on the back of Vespa is definitely the best way to see Saigon!! Food, drinks and entry to venues were all included. I would 100% recommend this tour to anyone visiting Saigon!

review_title: Fabulous 5 hour tour into rural Vietnam.
review_text: Fantastic way to experience rural Vietnam. Really can't praise the tour highly enough. The guide was excellent speaking good English and providing detailed and entertaining descriptions of what we were seeing. Five hours flies by.

review_title: Amazing experience with tour guide Miggy along the Mekong Delta!
review_text: Just absolutely mind blown by this tour with Miggy and the 2 drivers leading the way. We just finished our tour today Tuesday November 22, 2022. This was a 6-7 hour tour along the Mekong Delta. They picked us up from our hotel in District 1. Everyone was so friendly and knowledgeable right from the start. I learned so much from Miggy at every stop, from the shrimp farming to the local market. We had 2 stops for food and we were graciously served at each restaurant. They supplied cold bottled water and rain coats for the rainstorm that came at the end of the tour. I will most definitely be returning to this tour with friends and family in the future. We can't wait to book the Saigon night tour also. I just can't say enough nice things about our experience. Thank you so much Miggy and to the drivers!

review_title: Riding with Rosie and her bunch
review_text: A wonderful night on the vespas taking us from place to place downtown Saigon with the lovely miss Rosie taking care of us. Recommended! The froglegs were a nice surprise and the clams were wondeful!

review_title: Great evening of beer, snacks and HCMC exploration!
review_text: What a great way to enjoy craft beer, explore the city, and learn a bit about HCMC! Really excellent guide and driver, took us on a well thought out and curated evening of beer tasting and accompanying food. The vespas are super comfy to sit on, and the driver exceptional at calmly navigating the city and traffic. The guide was so friendly, knowledgeable, and made the evening flawless.

review_title: EVENING STREET FOOD TOUR ON SCOOTERS.
review_text: Vespa adventures were brilliant from start at 6.00pm to finish at 10.30pm for our street food tour of Ho Chi Minh on scooters. Special thanks to Lung who was our guide for the evening. From rooftop cocktails to authentic street food and then brilliant acoustic bar night club. Thank you so much.

My husband and I did a tour with Fully and had a fantastic time! He took us to a number of spots we never would have found on our own and knowledgeably answered our many questions. He also tweaked the tour here and there to our liking, enabling us to try some off the beaten path items that we truly loved.

Kathy you were amazing!
Spend the money and do this tour like I did with my three mates. Authentic tour of Saigon that won't disappoint. I don't think I'll ever have a better night here in Ho Chi Minh.

Great trip to start the tour. See parts of HCMC authentically with shazam :-)
Cathy our guide was fantastic. Great food and plenty of beer. See how the Saigon locals live after dark highly recommend

The Saigon Craft Beer Tour was an unforgettable experience! Riding a Vintage Vespa was something we've never done before and so of course we were hesitant at first -- but all those worries disappeared all thanks to our guide Vy and the Vespa drivers of this tour company.

Each craft beer location we visited was so special and we could not recommend this tour enough!

Was one of the best things we did in Vietnam. We got to try loads of new local food and drink, experience the nightlife of Saigon and of course ride around the streets on Vespas. Our guide Nghia was super nice and really funny, and the drivers were also fantastic. Overall a really good night out and definitely something you should do if you're ever in Saigon.

We had the best night with our guide Kingsley and very professional Vespa drivers who took the 4 of us around the city through the crazy traffic to places we would never have otherwise had the opportunity to visit! A great variety of fantastic food and music. What an experience!

review_title: The very best way to experience Hanoi. Ask for Guide Tommy.
review_text: We felt that the tour showed us so much more of Hanoi than any other type of tour. In the streets and laneways with numerous and appropriate stops showing us history, current lifestyle and the way the people live. Our guide, Tommy, was outstanding in every way. He is a gentleman, he speaks perfect English, his knowledge of all aspects of Vietnamese life (present and past), was thorough and he had a delightful, respectful sense of humour. The drivers were equally responsive to our needs and we felt safe. Highly recommended. Chris

This was a brilliant evening out. We were picked up from our hotel by 2 lovely Vespa drivers. To start with I was really nervous in the crazy traffic but you soon realized they knew exactly how to keep you safe. Our first stop was for a cocktail at a 22nd floor roof bar with fabulous views over the city. Then off to a seafood restaurant with delicious food including frogs legs, prawns and clams. Next a banh xeo restaurant for traditional Vietnamese pancakes. Then a bar with live acoustic music. A very talented singer singing romantic songs accompanied by a guitar and violin. Finally, a lively bar with a variety of pop singers and a fantastic band. Our hostess Vy looked after us very well and was informative about all the food and kept the drinks flowing.

review_title: Unforgettable Ho Chi Minh City/Saigon city experience
review_text: Great fun, very personal attention by the staff, excellent selection of all food and entertainment places, perfect organization regarding timing and sequence of events, very safe drivers for the tour and the photos at the end were a perfect good- bye gift as a memory of an unforgettable experience. I highly recommend this activity to everyone who wants a special event in cities like Ho Chi Minh City/Saigon.

If you have the opportunity, take this tour... I was on a group tour and we had a blast. It does not matter how old you are or how fit you are, it is a great time. The vespas were safe and the drivers superb. I do have to say merging onto a rotary was a true experience, After the first 'leg', I did not even need to hold on it was completely comfortable, you just enjoy the breeze and the city going by. The stops were fun and places I never would have seen otherwise.

There were six of us on this tour and we all thought it was amazing. Despite the craziness of the traffic and the thousands of other motorbikes, we all felt secure on the backs of the scooters. The food stops were amazing and we finished in a small music bar. A night to remember and also to be recommended.

Six friends having a reunion holiday, getting on in years, riding around the city on the back of Vespa scooters, dodging the hundreds of other scooters in the mad city traffic - exhilarating! We visited lots of places to taste a variety of food (and drink) then back on the scooter to the next place. We finished at a coffee bar/nightclub listening to excellent local singers.

This was the highlight of the holiday - great fun and interesting food. Would definitely recommend it.

Had an amazing time on the Saigon After Dark tour. Absolutely brilliant tour of a great city. Visited many great places for food and drink off the beaten track. Food was amazing and the drinks were flowing. Our guide Sunny was informative, hilarious and full of energy. Would definitely recommend this tour whilst in Ho Chi Minh City.

review_title: Vespa food and bar tour in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: A highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh - Kingsley did a great job hosting the evening and looking after us. Both music venues we stopped at were great. I would strongly recommend this trip !

review_title: Best things to do in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Couldn't recommend this any more! We had such a great time riding around the city at night on the back of a Vespa and stopped for some lovely food and experiences (hidden bar where we heard some local people singing a range of Vietnamese and western music)! Such a fun concept and great way to see the city by night!

review_title: A must do in Ho Chi Minh! Night time Vespa tour
review_text:
This was the best thing we did in Ho Chi Minh!
Our guide Tuan was amazing and our driver Tu was great.
I have never been on a bike before and was a little scared before but on the night I felt completely safe. It's incredible how the bikes weave in and out of the traffic. The food we ate was delicious and we tried all types of local food we would never have eaten otherwise.
We visited areas away from the tourist trap and went to an amazing piano violin bar with three superb singers. We ended the night at a bar with a band in which again was amazing. Everyone was up dancing and it made the night.
If you do nothing else whilst here do this tour. I think it's also better than the others as many just go to a roof top bar which sounds a little boring.

review_title: What a ton of fun running all around Saigon on our Vespas and hanging out with the locals!
review_text: There were 10 in our group, plus Sunny our guide. I felt like we were a motorcycle gang out on the town! Our first stop was for cocktails at a rooftop open-air bar with a spectacular view! Then we went to two eateries (that seemed to me to be largely frequented by locals) experiencing different kinds of Vietnamese dishes. This was followed by 2 different nightspots, with some pretty good singers! All in all, this was a very fun night, led in large part by Sunny's enthusiasm.

If you visit Siagon then you must try this. This is truly fantastic, a great way of seeing the sights and an absolutely brilliant experience. My husband and I loved it. Sunny is such a wonderful lady, very good at keeping the fun going when you stop at different places. We had a very enjoyable night. Thank you

review_title: Best night in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: If you're visiting this city you must do this! Absolutely fabulous night, plenty to eat & drink, safe drivers and locations you wouldn't even know were there! As for Sunny, she is aptly named, bright as a button, incredibly enthusiastic & couldn't have done more to make sure you enjoyed the night! Definitely a 10/10 👏

review_title: Great fun food and scooter tour +++
review_text: An excellent evening spent with Sunny (our host) andQ Tai (scooter driver) who safely took us to two food venues, one music spot and a final fling to dance to a live band. More to drink and eat than anyone could need, and well humoured and lively young guides. Absolutely no hidden extras. A fantastic evening. Thank you.

What an incredible experience! This is a must for anyone visiting Saigon and was the highlight of our visit to Saigon. Thanks to our guide, Quy, for giving us such a brilliant tour. Driving in Saigon is extremely chaotic, but our Vespa drivers were fantastic and made us feel safe and secure at all times. I can't recommend this tour highly enough!

review_title: Vespa your of Ho Cho Minh
review_text: Wow - what a blast! We had the best time on this night tour. We were both very nervous at first due to the volume of traffic and the general driving but we both relaxed into it. We saw things we wouldn't have seen had we not done this tour, met some great like minded people and tried some great food. Thoroughly recommend this tour and Sunny our driver was great.

A big group of us were met at our hotel (intercontinental hotel) by a lovely tour guide named 'Sunny' (who is great and so friendly). We were shown to our Vespa riders who rode us around Saigon and we stopped at a few venues where we ate and drank. The whole night was a great experience and everyone in our group thoroughly enjoyed ourselves!! Was a beautiful city! What an excellent experience and such great people. Thank you Q_Tai (my rider) and thank you to Sunny 🙏🏾🙏🏾 Love from Clare x
We had the best craft beer tour with Nicole. She was super fun to hang out with and became an instant friend. If you take a tour make sure you ask for Nicole to get the best guide!!
Saigon after Dark!! What an amazing experience , thanks Miggy for giving us such unique Saigon time.

Fantastic tour through the streets of Saigon at night - Dodging the hundreds of bikes - there doesn't seem to be any rights of way! Brilliant, exhillarating and lovely food experience. Last stop was at a vibrant club with live music - of course that got me up and dancing with the singer leaving the stage and thanking me for joining in! Great food, company and fun.

Did the Vespa adventures tour in late February. A great experience traveling the streets of Saigon on the back of a Vespa scooter. The five locations visited for food and entertainment were all excellent, giving us authentic flavors of Saigon and its culture. Our guide provides succinct background information on the tour while our driver, safe yet fearless, navigated the chaotic Saigon traffic with relative ease. A very well organized and executed tour.

We did Saigon After Dark with Sunny, it was fab and so much fun! The only way to see the city at night with great bars, food and 2 awesome live music venues. The drivers were very experienced and made you feel at ease in the crazy traffic. You must do it!!

review_title: Night time street food tour by vespa
review_text: Went on the night time street food tour around Hoi An with Tran and Rin and had a brilliant night whizzing around town on the back of a Vespa - we went to places which we wouldn't have tried on our own and the food was delicious. Apart from the food they really made the evening fun - thank you both for sharing with us!

We had a great day out in a small group with our guide Miggy. Drivers were fantastic, food great but we didn't actually go to The Mekong, just tributaries of the waterways around Saigon. No lush green paddy fields as promised, only a glimpse of a river(not the Mekong). Loved going to the market and buying food which was later presented as brunch.But the tour is entitled Glimpse of the Mekong and we didn't even get a glimpse.

Just an amazing adventure and experience - being on a scooter in busy downtown Saigon and sampling the very best street food. Brilliant organization for the evening starting with cocktails at a rooftop bar and ending with live singing in a lovely setting. Our guide Hang looked after us so well and arranged the food and our two Vespa drivers were very friendly and kept us secure and safe. Would recommend!!!!

The most exhilarating experience riding on the back of a Vespa weaving our way through the traffic in Hoi Chi Minh city.
It was such a comfortable ride and the best way to see the city.
Our stops on the way to enjoy some amazing food- seafood, noodles & pancakes were followed by coffee, music and ended with a cool bar & rock band.
Thanks Jenny, it was amazing!
A fantastic evening and a brilliant way to immerse yourself in Saigon. The whole experience was brilliant from start to finish...and impressively organised. The music stops were an unexpected extra!

We were a bit nervous about riding around Saigon on the back of a scooter but we absolutely loved it. Competent drivers that made us feel so safe, charming hostess who looked after us very well, fantastic food, great nights - it was the best thing we did all holiday. Would highly recommend.

We arrived at our hotel and within half an hour were on the back of a vintage Vespa. Having seen how people drive in Vietnam it was a little scary but we soon felt our drivers, Cnami and Ngoc, knew exactly what they were doing. Our guide was Kathy. She was really informative and took us to places that we probably woudn't have found. She also gave us lots of interesting information on the way. We finished the evening in a lovely secret bar with live music. This trip is a must.

review_title: First night in Ho Chi Minh City fun
review_text: A few hours after landing in the city, we went off on a food tour through Vespa Adventures. We'd asked for a car as there was no way I'd get on the scooters having seen the the locals drive! They organized it quickly with no bother. Sunny matched her name, she was bright friendly and a lot of fun. We found out a lot about traditional food and all of it was tasty -even the 'jumping chicken'. We ate and drank and danced in places we might not have gone on our own .and definitely ate food we wouldn't have tried. We couldn't fault this tour. It was great! Thank you, 😎 Sunny!

Wonderful experience for my wife and I with Sunny and two brilliant riders. Made the night memorable as we drank, ate and had a honeymoon cake surprise too. Made two over 60 Yr old very happy. Would recommend this as an essential trip to have while in Saigon...

It was the best tour we had in Vietnam!!! It was very funny and flexible. We want to see some different things they weren't on the normal tour and it was no problem! Very, very good. We had so much fun. Sorry my English is not so good, that I can explain it in English.
But this tour you must have to do! Thank you very much.
With best regards, Simone und Günter from Bielefeld, Germany

Great fun. Charming hostess. Friendly and competent drivers. They took us to great night spots.

It's a blast swinging in and out of traffic!!

Brilliant night in Saigon doing the street food tour. Our guide, Sunny, was an absolute delight. She was so efficient, informative and most importantly bubbly and fun. One of our best nights in Vietnam.

We took the morning tour of Saigon with Vespa Adventures and couldn't have been more satisfied. It was a fantastic tour and an amazing experience getting to see the city from the back of a vintage vespa! We saw so much including Chinatown and the amazing pagoda, the burning monk statue, markets where we got to sample some delicious street food and much more! We loved every minute of it! Thanks to our lovely tour guide Sunny too for her friendliness and giving us some great information and taking our picture!!

A great night out.
Picked up at our hotel and taken to local restaurants and coffee shops on the back of a Vespa Motorcycle. Our guide led the way and my wife and myself followed on the back of our drivers Vespa's. I must say just driving through the traffic is unbelievably good, they don't seem to have any rules (they do) with motorcycles going every which way, never anyone hitting or having an argument, just beeping their horns. Crazy.
The food tour was great, stopping at small backstreet restaurants that only had locals eating there (true Vietnamese food). All we had to do was eat and enjoy, our guide took care of all the costs. When we booked we thought their would be a group of us, but it was just us !! Great.
We had plenty to eat, (maybe to much) many different foods and a great time doing it.
Would definitely recommend this.

We went on the Vespa tour with sunny! It was one of the highlights of our whole trip! We ate in local restaurants, that we would never have picked out in our own. We ate very special Vietnamese cusine and it was so delicious. Would recommend it any day. Thank you for the experience :)
Brilliant Vespa tour , tour guide was so friendly , took us to great places off the beaten track , could not fault
really enjoyed this outing saw different parts of the city had delicious food (couldn't eat it all) thought it was worth for money

What a fantastic experience on Vespa... exceptional riders. Very well laid out tour with good street food and night life.
Well done team Vespa....and keep it up.

We took this tour in January on a brief stay in Saigon. We picked this on the recommendation of our Vietnamese Tour Company we worked with to plan our trip. We were met at our hotel by 4 Vespa drivers and our tour guide who spoke excellent English. We rode through the streets of Saigon which is a surreal experience in itself with the insane traffic and crazy driving of the locals. Surprisingly I never felt in danger which if you've seen Saigon driving you might find unbelievable. We had 5 destinations that were very unique and most likely places we would have never gone to on our own.

The first stop was for a cold beer on the sidewalk seating of a local bar where we had an appetizer and learned about the tour ahead of us. I apologize that I don't have food descriptions but everything we had was very good. Second stop was a large street side family restaurant that was open air. The sites and sounds of Saigon while we had local food and Tiger beer was exhilarating. Our guide answered all our questions and added local knowledge and history. Our third stop was a quiet restaurant down an alley where we had the local delicacy. The last two stops were a local bar and lastly a night club that had live music which was really quite good.

I highly recommend this tour to get a behind the scenes look at night life in Saigon. The Vespa rides between each stop were about 10-15 minutes which was a great way to see the streets and sights around the city. They drove us back to our hotel and it was a thrilling 4 hour tour that I'll always remember.

review_title: Saigon After Dark - better the second time!
review_text: Our second time experiencing Saigon After Dark was even better than the first. Excellent food, cold drinks, and navigating through the city on the back of a vespa - EPIC. Absolutely a must-do when visiting Ho Chi Minh City!

review_title: Saigon After Dark - highlight of our trip
review_text: We absolutely loved the Saigon After Dark tour -- it was a highlight of our trip. Starting at Vespa Adventures' cafe for a welcome drink was a great way to kick off the evening. We were really impressed with the food, drinks, and authentic experience of this tour. I was initially worried about riding on the back of a Vespa, but the staff did an excellent job of making me feel safe. Luna is an excellent guide! Words can't describe how much fun this evening was.

review_title: Excellent Way to See Hanoi and Learn More About Local Life
review_text: In Hanoi for the first time with time on my hands, so what to do? Spent the afternoon with Mike and Muse from Vespa Adventures seeing some of the sights & also learning about the true way of life and living in modern Vietnam. Mike was very good in what I think is pretty horrific traffic whilst Muse was very polite, friendly and able to answer my daft questions. I'd certainly recommend it.

review_title: ONE OF MOST ENJOYABLE & MEMORABLE DAYS OF OUR VIETNAM EXPERIENCE
review_text: My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our amazing day as we explored the beautiful countryside that we never would have had the opportunity to immerse ourselves in without their comfortable cycles, meet delightful artisans, and have a wonderful delicious lunch at a beautiful cafe along the way. Our guides were outstanding, knowledgeable, considerate and excellent, safe drivers. I absolutely LOVED the day and it was one of the highlights of our trip HIGHLY RECOMMEND. YOU MUST DO THIS!!!
Can't speak highly enough of this trip. Booked it on recommendation. Although initially it was a bit expensive, but it turned out nothing like it. Great value, great experience. Thoroughly recommend

We had a group of 7 and we went on the Saigon night tour. This is one of the most fun things we have ever done. There are 5 stops: A coffee shop for a beer to get started, a seafood restaurant, a traditional pancake place, a nightclub with jazz singers and a bar with a rock band. Food and alcohol included. The Vespa rides themselves are the highlight, since traffic flows like a river with few stops and lots of high speed merges. Our guide, T.Vi, was great as were all of the drivers. An exhilarating and fun experience good for all!

What a great evening! It was like having best friends in town. Our guide Tri (English name Drake) was FANTASTIC. We would give him 10 stars if we could. The drivers were excellent and great fun too. HIGHLY recommend this tour. We will be talking about this for YEARS!

review_title: Absolute highlight in Saigon - a must do!
review_text: Soooo good. A must do in Saigon. Exhilarating and exciting. We had so much fun and felt very safe. Kathy was the perfect hostess and guided us beautifully. The drivers were skillful and careful. The food was amazing and the venues unbelievable. Thank you so much for an unforgettable night in Saigon.

An absolutely amazing night riding through the streets of Saigon on the back of a scooter. My driver made me feel completely safe at all times. The food was incredible, we visited places I'd never have found or had the confidence to visit. Our tour guide was really informative and friendly. The evening was topped off with a visit to two very different, but totally enjoyable night clubs, shame it had to end. Thank you Vespa Adventures for ending my Saigon trip on such a high.

review_title: Saigon After Dark with Vespa Adventures
review_text:
What an absolutely amazing experience. 4 hours on the back of a vintage Vespa scooter in Saigon traffic. Adrenaline pumping to say the least as the drivers negotiate through 1,000's of other scooters, cars, buses and meandering pedestrians. Fabulous authentic Vietnamese food prepared at out of the way places and entertainment from a bunch of talented singers and instrumentalists made this night one of our most memorable in Vietnam. Highly recommend this to people of all ages.
Vespaadventures.com for more information.

review_title: Hue to Hoi An - A Great Ride!
review_text:
I have taken many Vespa Adventure tours and have never been disappointed. My daughter and I recently took the Hue to Hoi An ride and had fabulous nine hours with our crew. I never worry about safety when riding ... every driver is professional and places safety first.

We chose to travel from Hue with Vespa adventures to take advantage of seeing the countryside. There were so many interesting small villages along the way, and the breezy trip up to the Hai Ban Pass added to the enjoyment of the trip.

Thank you Team for giving us a ride we will not forget!

Dee Koch

Although we were apprehensive after experiencing the traffic in Hanoi, this is a great way to see the city at night, go to some really interesting places and try some of the great local food. Our guide, Gabby, was very knowledgable, friendly and helpful and spoke good English. Our drivers, Lucky and Tea drove us carefully, ensuring our crash helmets were fixed, and we felt safe from the start where they picked us up from our hotel. The evening ends in a small jazz bar with live music. All in all a great Vespa experience!

The day was very professional ran from the start and our host Rosie was very knowledgeable and polite. The riders make us feel safe at all times even weaving through the very tight street stalls and traffic. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Hanoi.

review_title: One of the most entertaining and enjoyable evenings ever
review_text: One of the most entertaining and enjoyable evenings ever. On the back of an authentic Italian 1960s Vespa scooter driven by a very experienced motorcyclist ( and I am 105kg and 1.95m), weaving safely through the crazy evening traffic of Ho Chi Minh. Picked up at our hotel at 18:30. Each stop is about 10-12 minutes and I guess through the evening covered 10kms or more. First stop was a local cafe to meet our “ food guide” ( she arrives first and organises the table) and a brief discussion on the evening including food allergies. A snack and beer to start. A lot of delicious food across the evening and time for 2,possibly more ,drinks on each stop. Off to a seafood restaurant where we ate Crabs legs with salt & chilli/clams with lemongrass/stir fried rice noodles with vegetables and superb frogs legs with fish sauce. Back on the bike to a family owned Banh Xeo and watching 2 ladies cook pork, shrimp and onion pancakes over charcoal fires. Then to a hidden cafe where we listened to 2 singers ( one in English and one in Vietnamese) sing nice ballads, without microphones. Finally to a trendy music bar where I had 2 mojitos and listened to 3 singers, ( with a backing group)one of which was very very good. Back to the hotel around 22:30. A fantastic evening. All in cost ,including the insurance they arrange, was $97 I think. Don’t miss it !! Book direct at vespaadventures.com

Our family had an amazing experience with Sunny and the Vespa Adventures team while in Saigon. The tour was 4 and a half hours long and we visited many local sites such as Notre Dame and Reunification Palace of Saigon, several pagodas, China town, and the river bank overseeing the city. All of our Vespa drivers (mine was the travel leader Khanh and he was terrific!) were experienced and careful and we always felt relaxed and confident that we were safe. Sunny was a terrific guide, giving us thoughtful and detailed historical information as we moved from location to location. This was a fantastic way to see the sites and sounds of Saigon. We will definitely do another Vespa Adventures trip while in Vietnam. And lunch at the end of the tour was excellent as well!

Just did the After Dark Food Tour in Hanoi and can recommend the tour from our hearts. Rosie was the most amazing tour guide for us. It was an unforgettable evening and thank you, also to the nice and safe Vespa drivers.

Martina + Arthur

review_title: The most amazing evening of food and fun
review_text: My wife and I (both over 65) were certainly hesitant to go on this excursion after a day touring through Ho Chi Minh traffic -- we'd never ridden a motor bike before. But after our first 15 minute ride on the back of the Vestpa, we couldn't wait to get onto the next venue. Not only is the ride safe and thrilling (better than any rollercoaster), but the restaurant venues visited are all clean but clearly "local" (not your typical "western-style" menus). And we ended the tour at a very small cafe listening to some incredible local singers. An amazing, exhilarating evening that let us "feel like a true LOCAL"! Do NOT MISS IT

Best Experience ever, loved it. will definitely do again.
you dont have to be a drinker to do this, even though that is one of the main reasons some on our tour did it. i'm not a drinker and i loved it. got to see the city from the eyes of the locals, and eat where they eat. danced the night away.
loved it
will do again

review_title: Most fun you'll have on a Vespa
review_text: Great food! Great fun! Great company! Saigon beer best accompaniment to crazy Vespa ride around HCMC 😁

review_title: Amazing, relaxing, and educational experience with good food and coffee
review_text: My fiancé and I did a Vespa Adventure with Sinh as our tour guide and Quy as the additional Vespa driver. We did the 5 hour Country and Islands tour in Hoi An. Sinh spoke great conversational English and we learned a lot about the country and culture through him as he had a wide knowledge of history and various topics such as ship building, coffee farms, wildlife, religion, language. He drove safely. We enjoyed all the stops we made - mat making, coffee shop, and many stops to take photos that will last a lifetime. We got great photos. The cost included a filling and delicious lunch at their office. We also bought some coffee but were not pressured to do so. The ride on the Vespa was very relaxing and scenic. This was a highlight of the trip and I would definitely recommend!

My husband and I did the Vespa food tour in Saigon in the evening, with the wonderful, appropriately named Sunny! She was adorable! The traffic in Saigon is something else and the thought of getting on the back of a scooter disenchanted me! However, our very capable drivers drove us around the city expertly. One of the most fun things ever! We started off at a Sky bar which was amazing, with beautiful views of the city. We then visited 2 restaurants where locals eat and were lucky to experience delicious food in both places. We then had finished the evening with a coffee listening to live music before a final scoot around the city prior to being delivered back to our hotel. A must do experience!

This was one of the best tours of my life. Driving on the back of a Vespa through bustling Saigon is the experience !!! I felt always safe with my driver „Teon of Leon of Tom“ and my Guide Miggy was very knowledgable and explained a lot about the Food (wich was very delicious, even the frog!). The places have Bern clean and the live music was excellent. Just the Ride of your life - everyone will enjoy

Beware of imitators! These guys -"Vespa Adventures" AKA "The Ride of your Life" pioneered day tours on the back of vintage Vespa bikes. Very professional and well run tours with high quality bikes, drivers and guides.

This was the second tour we had done with them. We chose "Glimpse of the Mekong", a 7 hour adventure that takes you out of the city to see countryside life in the nearest part of the Mekong delta to Saigon. It was fascinating to see different suburbs of the city, as gradually high-rise condos gave way to mangrove and water-palm lined channels.

It was a very well planned and executed tour which gave us a range of experiences. Highlights were the wet market in a small bustling town and the river crossing on a ferry. Unfortunately with it being New Year, some of the manufacturing processes were not taking place as the workers were on holiday.

The drivers were top notch, and our guide Kathy was knowledgeable and funny. Highly receommended and will definitely do another tour with Vespa Adventures.

review_title: Feel the fear and do it anyway. Well described as "the ride of your life"
review_text:
It seems like a good idea months earlier, when your travel agent slips this in to your itinerary. Sit on the back of a Vespa and be whisked round Ho Chi Minh City sampling beer. You then arrive in the place and witness the traffic for yourself. 11 million people, and everyone of them on the streets on their Vespas. At the same time. The one saving grace is that the driving is not overly aggressive; however, if you leave a gap of more than 6 inches (in any direction) between you and any other vehicle, it will be filled. There are occasional traffic lights, but these, apparently, don't apply to scooters or motor bikes, These swerve cheerfully around those pedestrians brave enough to attempt road crossing.

The enormity of what you have signed up for quickly dawns on you. Wimp out? It's a serious thought, but we resisted that temptation. Picked up at the hotel by two likely lads and a guide. Whisked to a local cafe and given a beer. No, this isn't really part of the tour, just a meeting point. From there we go round four places. In most of them they give you a drink before the arrival, two minutes later, of your sampling beers. The craft movement is alive and well here. There are some very interesting examples, to suit all tastes, some at dangerously high ABV levels. Food is provided at each venue, mostly of the junk but tasty variety, sadly not particularly Vietnamese. If you scoffed all the beer on offer, you would consume the best part of 8 (British) pints.

They boast that they haven't lost a customer yet. The quality of the drivers is such that you don't actually feel scared, even before the drink begins to bite.

An evening out which was both exhilarating and great fun.

We enjoyed a wonderful and exciting evening.Saigon at Night is beautiful and being a part of the fast moving sparkling event was great fun. It really was the ride of my life😎Thank you Thy, Thank you Long!

review_title: The best ride of your life ;)
review_text:
It was amazing!
Our guide Rosy was so friendly and make our ride unique, the rest of the staff as well.
It was delicious and interesting.
Recommended!!

review_title: A wonderful way to see a different Saigon.
review_text:
We visited Saigon on January 2nd and after city tour, decided to take the vespa tour, a bit reluctantly at the beginning, because of the crazy traffic in the city.

We had an amazing night! Responsible drivers, authentic local restaurants, tons of local food to try, and a couple of music bars, where we enjoyed a bit of the city's very active night life.

It is not a historical or very informative tour, but it is one that shows you how locals live.

Thanks Tony and the rest of the team for a great night out!

You have to do this if you're visiting Ho Chi Minh! It's an absolute must do.
The guide and vespa drivers were some of the nicest people we met on our trip.
The whole night, from start to finish was incredible. Great food and drinks. We can't recommend this ever highly enough. So much fun.
Thanks again, from the 6 New Zealanders

i wish to recommend the vespa adventures in Saigon. we were two in person with my friend bobby and we enjoyed it a lot. it was excellent. M.TU the driver was driving carefully and cautiously since i had a back problem. food, entertainment and the host SUNNY were all great.

thank you all for making my last night in Saigon and Vietnam a memorable evening with my travel buddy Bobby.

Jay

We did this tour expecting to learn about the city and enjoy the street food and have a few drinks. Riding the bikes was great fun and the food was really tasty. But you learn absolutely nothing about the city or the buildings and you won't get ideas about what attractions you might want to visit as you're not told anything which is really disappointing. And at the end of the night, we were told we had to pay for the last drink we had, which was the expensive drink you'll be most charged in Vietnam. We questioned why we were having to pay for these on top of the $97 we already paid and eventually we were told the company would cover it. This puts a dampener on the night unfortunately. You definitely don't get $97 worth of entertainment, food and drink

My family and I did the Saigon at Night Vespa tour and it was amazing. They allowed my 6 year old daughter to also ride and I can confidently say it was the best experience of her life. Her driver was cautious and courteous and put my mama mind at ease as he carefully guided her through the heart of Saigon. Our tour guide was knowledgable and gregarious and we had a blast eating our way through some of the best street food Saigon had to offer. The price of the tour is well worth it for all of the food and drink provided throughout the night.
We tipped our drivers and our tour guides and they were so refreshingly grateful.

I highly recommend this tour if you are visiting Saigon. It was such a great time!

I rode on Vespa Adventures on the last night of a mother /daughter trip in Vietnam and we had such a wonderful time! Luna was a great guide and Cang a fantastic driver. This was the best way to see the city, try food at real local hot spots, and see live music, at both local and more Western-targeted bars. Normally, I'm weary of this type of tour and would prefer to go it alone to the local hotspots. While some locations were crowded with other Vespa Adventures groups, I did not feel like we were taken to touristy areas. The choice of venues was authentic. This was especially notable during our stop to a cafe for local music. Would definitely recommend, especially to those not likely to get out and explore the streets/street food/nightlife without a guide!

We had a wonderful time with our tour guide, Nicole Truc who was very knowledgeable about Saigon’s cuisine and was quick to arrange food, drink that we had. We really enjoyed the ride throught hustle-bustle city. All spots that we visited were highlights. We particularly enjoyed the "Saigon after dark"

The trip was also beautiful to be with 4 other guests who are from Australia, we had nice conversation.
We highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Saigon Craft Beer Tour - so much fun!!!!
review_text: My husband and I had an absolute blast on the Saigon Craft Beer Tour. Our guide Vy, was so much fun and incredibly knowledgeable. Riding on the back of a Vespa through the streets of Saigon is an unforgettable experience, pair that with visits to some amazing local craft beer venues and you can’t go wrong!! Highly recommend.

review_title: Not as good as Hoi An’s tour
review_text:
We had a great time at Hoi An using the same company but the HCM tour didn’t live up to my expectations

The first stop, we were offered Western food which seemed odd for a tour that wants customers to experience/see the authentic VN way of life. That’s when they made you pay the bills for the tour.

Then we stopped at a coffee shop where there were few birds in a cage singing. The place was not clean. We stayed for 5mn wondering why we were here....This stop was not warranted.

They also made us stop at a herbal medicine store and offered some random tea. We stopped for another 5mn. This stop seemed unnecessary.

The last few stops were a bit more interesting. Seeing HCM on a Vespa is a great but you don’t need to pay so much money.

My suggestion for them is to try to duplicate the Hoi An tour from the same company.

1. Great lunch in a rice field
2. Awesome stops
3. We got to see the rice fields
4. The stops seemed to be more connected. The HCM tour seems disjointed

Overall, I would not recommend this tour in HCM for the price. The drivers and guides were great!

We had an amazing tour with Chris and our drivers Mike and Wick. They were all so friendly and really fun. The food was fantastic and the drinks were flowing. This has been a highlight of our trip and we would highly recommend this company to friends and family. Thanks so much!
Had a good time but thought the tour was way overpriced. Not enough food stops but too many drinking stops

We just returned from a fantastic Vespa tour. (Saigon at Night). Our leader was Ahn who was absolutely wonderful! She was a wealth of information, so much fun to be with and so organized! Hung was my driver and he was wonderful as well and I felt safe and secure the entire ride. My husband's driver was Thuy and he was terrific as well. All of the stops were great and the food was delicious. The two music stops were great as well. We had so much fun zipping around the city like a local and experiencing restaurants and night clubs we never would have known about. A truly wonderful evening!

We were unsure of what we had booked from home. However, when our guide picked us up at the hotel, all our fears were allayed.
We are a family of seven spanning three generations. Our children and grandchildren were delighted with the tour. The drivers were cautious and safe. They knew how to cut across traffic and move us from place to place safely.
There is no other way to get around Ho Chi Minh City. It was the best.

This tour has been the best experience of our 14 days traveling from north to south.
Our guide Sunny was excellent and the drivers did an amazing job. The whole experience what the best! Don't miss this adventure!

review_title: Craft beer tour in Ho Chi Minh city
