review_text: Comfortable vespas driven by safe drivers! We were the only two on the tour along with our guide over 4 breweries. While more expensive than many tours in Vietnam, it was a very unique experience and is certainly recommend it to others.

Did this experience for a second time with a group of girlfriends on our quick trip to Hcmc in October. Just as fun the second time around. Plenty of food, drinks, combined with a lively commentary by our guide. We did the after dark tour, finishing off in a club with and excellent cover and. So good, we stayed until stumps !!!!!

review_title: Ultimate tour of fun and discovery
review_text: The staff were very friendly, helpful and and professional. The experience was full of fun, culture and excitement and was the ultimate tour of the city.

review_title: A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text:
Amazing way to spend an evening - great thing for the entire family including kids 10 y/o. Awesome combination of the experience on a scooter in the crazy streets of Saigon, as well as a great foodie experience.
Drivers were awesome, and we especially LOVED our amazing food, culture, and everything guide - Ann.
A must do and a memorable night!

This tour is very well executed - great Vespas, great drivers, and our leader, Luna, was super charming! While you get taken to places which seem full of only other people doing the tour it still really works. And being on a bike in the Saigon traffic is the most exhilarating experience and we all adored it. Highly recommend.

Mrs D had never been on a Vespa and was equally disenchanted by the thought of not just that, but the amazing street traffic in Saigon! She needn't have worried. Collected from the hotel, after just a few minutes confidence in your skilled and well-trained safety-first driver grows. Taken to a local cafe to meet your guide for the evening - the excellent Tuan in our case - the rest of the 4 hour excursion is a delight of dining in out of the way establishments, eating (and in our case being shown how to eat) genuine Vietnamese food, a coffee house and a very jolly music bar to round off. All in all, thoroughly recommended for a great evening out, to the extent that in the end MrsD was sorry the actual Vespa riding drew to a close. Will repeat in Siem Reap!

review_title: Great experience! Very save, too! Try it!
review_text:
Althoug it was difficult to choose the right Vespa tour among the rather big offers, we are sure we did it right.
Very professional. Everyone was very nice . The tour is completely planned.
We were not sure if that's too risky on the back of a Vespa in this crazy traffic in Saigon. However we always felt very saved.
The drivers were perfect.
Thanks for the Saigon after dark adventure!

review_title: Best Tour in Saigon with Rosie
review_text:
Best Saigon activities for sure.
The Only way to really understand the beat of Saigon. We Did the night tour with local food and music. Definitely a memorable & great tour. Rosie our guide was so charming. We Loved the funky Coffeehouse with live music and the lively Rock Bar with a great band. Traveling by Vespa is important to understand Saigon life, but vintage Vespas are unnecessary as the old scooters pollute and give off stinky fumes and the old rear lights are barely visible.

Our family went on a Foodie tour with a group of friends, didn't know what to expect when booking but what a great time.
Were picked up from our hotel by 3 Vespa guys, absolute professionals, they were all about looking after us and keeping us safe.
Got to their cafe base and had a few beers, we were then briefed on the night tour by a bubbly character then off on our way. Stopped at many great little restaurants in out of the way places all with great food and new experiences. The piano bar we stopped at was the highlight of the night.
The Vespa ride through Saigon was amazing, the traffic in this city is crazy as hell, we loved it, somehow the traffic chaos works and everyone gets around without too many problems. The drivers were awesome and got us home at the end of a great night, Highly recommend this tour, so much fun.

This was one of the best things we did on our trip to HCM. We were picked up from our hotel and taken to a small bar to meet our guide. Her name was Vy and she was amazing, so full of life and very knowledgeable. We took off into the hustle and bustle of the city on the back of experienced drivers, it was incredible. We stopped off at various places for food and drink, places we probably would have never seen without help, street food, back street coffee houses and bars. It was just brilliant! I owned my own Vespa 30 years ago and it really took me back to my youth. I would certainly recommend this Saigon after dark trip.

This is a great tour to see parts of the city you otherwise wouldn't. Felt very safe, friendly staff especially 'Sunny'. The guide stays with you as you eat and at first we thought we wouldn't like that, but she tells you all about what you are eating and shows you the best way to put it together. We did the night tour started at 6pm and finished at 10pm. We would highly recommend

review_title: Vespa adventures offers an andrenelin thrilling tour of Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon)
review_text:
The traffic in Ho Chi Minh City is not for the faint hearted. 6 of us all cousins ​​headed off into the traffic on the back of Vespas, with an obviously skilled and knowledgeable driver, for each of us. This was managed overall by a very capable supervisor. The traffic is dense varied and fast moving, great for andrenelin junkies, and Vietnamese with nerves of steel. For the tourist like us a wonderful and unique way to see the sights, of which we stopped to visit several, whilst joining the roaring sound and fast pace of masses of vespas, bikes, cars and other vehicles. Asia on the move is possibly almost rivaled by Egypt but certainly Europe is tame by comparison.
Vespa adventures operates in several cities offering varied excitement and insights into life and living.
This is the way to get off the beaten track and see traditional Cambodia. A ride through the countryside and visit to the homes of the local people.

review_title: Fun adventures on the After Dark Foodie Tour
review_text: We just returned from Vietnam and wanted to share our fun experience that we had with Vespa Adventures. We spent a night on the town with a Saigon Food Night and it could not have been more perfect. The drivers were great, very attentive. Not to mention, we had the very best tour guide, Sunny. Her infectious bubbly personality just added to the fun. Thank you for a wonderful experience.

HCMC offers many motorbike adventures, but I think this is the best so far. What we liked best was that some of the temples and sites visited were not the typical well known spots. As well the vintage Vespas were a hit.

Would recommend to anyone visiting Ho Chi . Don't be put off by the traffic all the riders are very good and at no time did any of us feel unsafe in fact in was great fun and a good way to see the city. The choice of bars and restaurants was excellent.

review_title: Must do! Saigon After Dark foodie adventure
review_text:
An evening outing for a foodie trek with Vespa Adventures is a must when visiting Saigon!! It was the highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh City. “Saigon After Dark” was one of the dinner choices offered on Oct. 21 by our vacation tour provider, Scenic. So glad we chose it.

Having seen day time traffic, we wondered (before we set out) if being on Vespas on the streets of Saigon was a crazy decision. However, evening traffic was a bit lighter, and our drivers were cautious and skilled. We relaxed in a short time, and it was so much fun! And we got to see a lot of the city.

We went to two different locations for food. Not fancy (as it is street food), but clean and local authentic food. We were offered a variety of delicious dishes and got so full! Our third stop was a lovely coffee house on the upper level of an old French house. Three vocalists, a pianist and violist provided enjoyable entertainment. They serve a great Vietnamese cold coffee with milk.

Many thanks to our bubbly and attentive hostesses Sunny and Ruby. Also, to our fabulous drivers Chu Thanh and Ray (hope we’ve got your name right … connected to Amazing Race 😊). What a memorable experience!

A great half day tour -see the countryside - the places we went to were great, see how the people live in country. Lunch was amazing, our drivers were very experienced & I felt safe at all times. Thank you Moon & Phuoc xx

Vespa Adventures through Ho Chi Minh was the highlight of our trip! Our guide Miggy gave great insight to local life and my driver Louis was very skilled in zipping through the city traffic. Our adult children (18 and 22) loved the experience too. Although I was nervous at first, it is the best way to see Saigon!

We had a fantastic evening being vespered around the city. Our host and guide Jenny was warm and friendly and introduced us to our fellow riders at Zoom cafe. First drinks and snacks. We always felt safe, our riders were very skilled and we very thoroughly looked after. The experience of being in the mix of such a fun and crazy city, we will never forget. We visited I think 4 or 5 eateries and bars. We are vegans and they catered for us at each location. The food was very nice, we enjoyed making the salad/pancake rolls. The final venues, both music joints were very contrasting but enjoyable. Plenty of drinks included at all locations, even for the ride. We can't recommend or rate the experience higher. We will be checking out Vespa Adventures as we continue our adventure through Vietnam. Hope to see you in Hoi An soon!

A great half day tour. You get to see a variety of places and experience what it is like to be a local traveling through the busy streets. Our tour guide made sure we had an amazing time and also taught us how to cross the busy roads (wave like Miss Universe when crossing!). We also learned about some historical events and visited some hidden gems. Our drivers were very experienced and I felt safe at all times.

We are both not in the first flush of youth but were very well looked after and made to feel safe on our evening outing with Vespa adventures. Exciting riding in the thick of the Saigon traffic and recapturing our youth when we both had small motorbikes! Food generally good too and the last destination, the 'dive' where we had delicious fresh juices and singing, was most enjoyable. Special thanks to both our drivers and Miggy, our guide.

We had a brilliant evening being driven around the streets of Saigon stopping at numerous street eateries for excellent food with wonderful guide Miggy and our drivers Huy and Robert all ending in a club with very talented local musicians. Night to remember

This was such an awesome experience and a great way to get around Saigon city. It was a little bit wet but we were provided with poncho's and it was so much fun. Did not feel unsafe at all, our drivers and tour guide were fantastic. Highly recommend.

review_title: Great Vespa rides, but rest disappointing
review_text: The espadrille rides were fabulous- really fun to be in the midst of the chaos of the traffic, but always feeling totally safe with excellent drivers. The two entertainment venues we went to at the end were also fun and interesting. However, the food part was disappointing- many very spicy dishes that I couldn't eat and no alternatives offered. The toilet in the restaurant leaves a great deal to be desired. Our tour leader seemed to think she was taking a bunch of 10 year olds on a summer camp- grated on all the group. Without the Vespas this would have been a very disappointing experience, but they were a great thing to do.

We have been picked up at our hotel at 18:00 and came back at 22:30. We had a fantastic evening during which we have visited 3 restaurants and 2 clubs with live music.
The Vespa drivers where very experienced and safe drivers while the food was excellent . Overall was a night to remember.

This was an amazing evening. The excitement of riding in all that hustle & bustle & weaving in & out of all the traffic is great fun. Both our drivers Vuon & Thuan had to make some very swift moves which they did quickly & safely. They were both brilliant & chatty. Our food guide Nghia (Neil) meets us at some real street food restaurants. The food was incredible & he explained what we were eating & how best to eat it. A really great experience. Thanks guys👍🏻😀

review_title: Vespa in Saigon-a very goog experience
review_text:
Don´t worry- go vespa.You see a lot of very interesting location.Very fine meals and good music.
The vespa driver made a very good job. I was never afraid.

review_title: Best way to know Ho Chi Minh
review_text: The first day I arrived at Ho Chi Minh I booked the Vespa tour. It's a great way to explore the city. You see different areas, taste the local food and enjoy cafe's/bars you wouldn't find by yourself. And on top of that it's so cool to be part of the crazy traffic and watch it from the backseat of a Vespa.
Great exploration of food, lovely restaurants and adventure. Very welcoming team of drivers and tour guide, try it you'll have fun!

Ist was an absolut great experience to Drive with the Roller and the other thousands of rollers in Saigon.
The whole event was very good organized. At all five stations we have a lot of fun
Week doke

I enjoyed this. We saw some great live music and the sights and sounds of HCM by night. The food wasn't brilliant; I wonder if they could maybe upgrade their pancake stop especially... but the service really was. Our guide was fantastic.

Place your trust in your driver and you'll have a brilliant tour.
Our guide, Luna, was excellent and very knowledgeable. She was also great fun.
We were taken to the 'real HCM' and saw loads of areas.
You also have lunch, coffee and water.
Great fun and recommend you try this tour.
It was my first experience with Vespa adventure but i truly enjoyed it. All the staffs are well trained and the stories were well told. Many thanks for this beautiful experience!

The Vespa trip is really amazing, very kind guides to help you though the traffic. Also the stops with food and drinks are very good and special. You get enough from anything. You see places you would never find alone, such as the pianobar was really a nice experience!!!

A fabulous experience! Such a good way to really experience Saigon, right among the traffic. A great selection of different restaurants, felt completely safe and relaxed on the Vespas - both of us in our 70's. Very courteous drivers and instructions.

I had a great time with the half day trip I took in Hanoi.
Muse and Bean were very nice and Bean is a great driver. They were very helpfull and take there time so you can enjoy. I would advise this trip to anyone and it's very nice to do when you are traveling alone.
Thanks to Muse and Bean I had a great day!

review_title: Great way to see a lot
review_text: Sunny was an amazing tour guide—very proud of the city and excited to show us around. We never felt unsafe on the bikes. Please pay it forward and tip Sunny well—I was still figuring out the exchange rate and wishing I'd give her more!

review_title: Amazing tour between a lot of scooters!
review_text: It was a fantastic tour with amazing seafood we never tried before and other typical Vietnamese snacks ! Our tour guide Nicole was really friendly and showed the group all the vietnamese traditions! A real highlight!

The Vespa tour was an amazing way to experience Ho Chi Minh city. The local food we tried was delicious. The places we ate were off the beaten track and very popular with locals but would have been hard to find on your own as a tourist. So it was great to have the opportunity to experience them.

Highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh City/Saigon. Our guide Rosy took us to some amazing spots and experienced some of the local night life and delicious local food.

Our Vespa drivers were excellent, the best way to see the sights of the city is from the back of a bike.

Such a great experience. A unique way to truly see the city and get to areas you may not venture to otherwise. The guides are wonderful and the drivers are so careful, I felt completely safe. We ate some of the best Vietnamese food I have ever tried! Will definitely do it again.

We had so much fun and it was so exciting to be in amongst the crazy traffic. Yet we felt very safe, the drivers were great. And our guide took us to some really interesting parts of HoChiMin. It would have taken us days to see all these attractions if we tried to do it on our own. 100% recommended this tour. It was a highlight for our family

review_title: Motorbike tour is the only way to see the city
review_text: This was our second Vespa Adventures tour--our first was in Hanoi. Sunny led our tour in Saigon/Ho Chi Mihn City. The tour is a great introduction to the city and its most well known features. We started at a cafe, moved on to a park, the famous bird cafe, flower market, Chinatown, temples, and other sights. We receive information about history and culture. Sunny was informative and entertaining, and our drivers easily handled the motorbikes in the crazy city traffic. We highly recommend this company and their tours.

review_title: Vespa Food Adventure - Ho Chi Min
review_text: Excellent night, 4 hours of fun, yummy food, fabulous way to see the city at night, very good tour guide, guys on bikes were super great, super enjoyable evening, highlight of Ho Chi Min!!

review_title: Highlights of the trip to Vietnam
review_text: Great way to see Saigon, delicious food, great bars. The host was good fun and interesting. The moped drivers were the best, felt super safe despite the busy city streets. Fabulous experience !!

From the moment on meeting our Vespa drivers to the time we got dropped back off to our hotel the whole evening was fab!
Our host for the eating was bright, bubbly, helpful and intelligent.
Overall experience on the motor scooters - amazing never felt unsafe. My age 59.

Great opportunity to see the less touristy parts of the city. Very flexible tour and good guide. We ended in District 2 by the riverbank to see the city from the other side of the river. Ask them to take you to the main street also if you want to visit the shops and cafes.
This was one of many highlights of our month in Vietnam. It is a very professional set up and we got to see a side of HCMC that we would never have discovered without taking this tour. Great fun!

review_title: Loved this tour! So much fun!!
review_text: Okay, first off this kind of tour is not for the timid. The traffic in HCMC is next-level crazy! But if you really want a FUN way to experience the city, you simply can't beat a ride on a vintage Vespa. Excellent drivers expertly and SAFELY whisk you to places in HCMC you will never see otherwise. Our guide (so sorry I forgot her name) was a bundle of happy energy, so proud to share her city with us. Even my wife, who had never been on a scooter or motorbike, rides like a veteran and enjoys every second. Highly recommended!

review_title: An ideal way to experience Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: The team leader T Vi welcomed us, reassured us and had the entire evening organized to the last detail. She was extremely competent and an excellent communicator. The expert drivers negotiate the city's traffic mayhem with confidence and ease. A selection of venues had been chosen and we visited two restaurants to sample the superb local cuisine and to round off the evening visits had been arranged to two bars with great atmosphere and memorable live music. The whole evening was an absolute success; we were able to experience the city in a way that would have been impossible without such a carefully planned itinerary. We can't recommend Vespa Adventures highly enough.
We had an absolute blast! Food was great and although I was nervous at first, riding around the city was such a fun experience!!

I had three trips in and around Saigon. What a fantastic way to really see a city. Up close !! No sterile enclosure here !! Great drivers and guides. Very informative and caring to all of their customers. An excellent introduction to a great city. Also met other great travelers.

The vespa tour was the best thing I did in Saigon, was a little scared at first, but turned into enjoyment. They took you round Saigon to different restaurants, where you enjoy the local food. The only down side for me, is that they supplied all your drinks as well, but it was only beer, no choice for the ladies, only juice. That's the only reason I didn't score it 4 out of 5
Perfect Ride, Perfect Night!!!! Great Locations and Good Food . And the best guide Rosy. Thank you!

Just back from a tour of Ho Chi Minh City with Kingsley, Thanh & Quyen.
Loved being part of the crazy traffic. Great driving!
The venues we stopped at were all v different - various types of food, followed by music venues. Kingsley was very knowledgeable, looked after us, spoke excellent English and was easy to chat to.
Thoroughly recommend this tour.
Highly recommended this tour it was so much fun food was great but the experience on the back of the Vespa was amazing thanks for the ride
Great experience - a must do in Saigon. Don't miss out! Make sure to eat the "morning glory" simple but absolutely delicious.

we had a beautiful experience with Vespa Adventures.
very nice stuff and very good Vespa drivers. we never felt uncomfortable. and anybody woh ever had visited Vietnam, knows how crowded and chaotic traffic is!!

We really enjoyed our tour with vespa adventures the bikes and drivers where helpful and friendly. Our guide was delightful and knew so much about the local area. It exceeded our expectations brilliant
We did this Tour the second time. Sunny shows us hidden places. We were able to widen our horizon and get used to the land and the people. She tried hard to make this trip an unforgetable one for us.

review_title: Vespa ride in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Great fun! Saw a different part of HCMC. We rode down little streets that we would have missed out on. The guide was lovely and spoke English very well.

review_title: Most exhilaratingly fun adventure of our trip !
review_text: We organized it through concierge at the Park Hyatt and just loved every minute of it ! The Vespa part of it is so fun and feels very safe. They took us to some amazing spots showing us a very very local and yet delicious perspective on local Saigon life plus some really cool and hip night spots ! Loved it and honestly highlight of our trip ! The guides were all so warm and friendly

Excellent tour must do in Saigon. Well organized. Our tour guide Vy (?) was fantastic. So influential.
Highly recommended.

review_title: Vintage Vespa Tours Hoi An -Countryside & Island Explorer
review_text:
To Bean and the Hoi An Crew,
Thank you for sharing your amazing world with us. You stole our hearts 💕💕Your culture
and olde world is an experience all travelers should experience. A must for anyone visiting the beautiful Hoi Ann. Jay and Dave 🙏

Our guides, Lam and Thai were the best. We got to see much of the city from the back of a scooter, and we felt safe and well taken care of for the entire time. We ate food and found places that we would have never been able to find. These guys were great and showed us a terrific experience. We will go back just to do this again.

Phantastic experience and great way to discover Saigon, its local restaurants and its nightlife. It was great experience to discover how smoothly the vespas drove through the city and how different the perspective was from traveling by car or coach. I would also like to thank both my driver Dat, who was a very friendly and good driver and also explained the sights, and our host Alina, who accompanied us throughout the entire trip. When you are in Saigon, this trip is definitely a must do!

My husband and I (aged 63) took the Vespa Adventure tour (Saigon after dark) last night. We've taken many food and city tours before and this was our favorite. It was a little pricey, but worth more. For 4 1/2 hours we had a Vespa driver each, and a “local friend @ who took us to two great restaurants and to two different live music venues. The Vespa ride alone was worth the price. So much fun to sit back and marvel at how the locals navigate!

Took up the beer tour at night. Overall good service by the guide and vespa rider. Visited a few cool hangout spots as well. Pricing is a bit on the high side given the amount of drinks included. However, just pay and enjoy.

We loved Saigon After Dark. Such a fantastic way to experience local food and culture, zipping around the city on a vespa. The highlight for me was the hidden cafe. SO fantastic. The overall experience was great and I would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh and wants an adventure. Ailina our guide was super cool and made the whole experience all the better.

Everything went well with our group. I am quite surprised that there were a lot of activities.

My driver Mr. Nguyen The Hung is nice and attentive.

Recommend it.
Highly recommended, great way to see HCMC at night... felt safe the whole way...food was excellent as were the sights.
Touring Hanoi with an expert Vespa driver was so very fun and exciting. My driver Son Adam was the Bedt!!

Was afraid to ride because of the busy traffic in Hanoi but was made comfortable by our tour guide.my driver Tea a woman was great maneuvering around Hanoi. Loved the places we visited .The tea ceremony was great too.

My husband and I have now done two Vespa tours. One in Hanoi and the other in Hoi An. They were quite simply fantastic fun. Our Hanoi trip was in the evening and involved riding around that completely insane city where no one stops at red lights and pedestrians walk on the road because the pavements are full of scooters and traffic seems to use whatever side of the road they feel like. Somehow it works and we both felt completely safe at all times. We made several stops at authentic Vietnamese restaurants and ate some of the tastiest food you could imagine and it was fabulous. Our drivers were brilliant young guys and Kevan who seemed to be the boss met us at each stop with great explanations about cultural and culinary aspects of Vietnam.
Down in Hoi An we did a morning ride through the countryside on tiny wee roads and tracks visiting local craft workshops and a coffee roaster before finally having a delicious lunch back at the company offices. Again our drivers were brilliant, we always felt safe and Ty was great with his explanations of various local aspects of the tour. We could not have been looked after better and I would recommend a Vespa Tour to anyone as a great way of seeing and learning a lot in quite a short time.
You don’t need anything special just t shirt and jeans or shorts. Helmets were provided and adjusted for you and any age can enjoy it. I will be 70 on my next birthday and would do it again given a chance so a great big thank you to Kevan and the drivers in Hanoi and to Ty and my own driver here in Hoi An

I really wasn't keen to do this tour. I hate bikes and traffic so not a great combination for me. However, the team were all amazing. They were kind patient and drove very slowly especially for me. My driver let me hang n to him rather than the bike. Kathy was brilliant too. All the stops were interesting and informative. I would highly recommend.

Me and my friend decided to go on this tour even though we were both anxious about the traffic in HCMC.

Still, we experienced something quite opposite:
- the driver was on time. Knowing English and briefing us in a few minutes only. All was clear and we were feeling safe.
- drivers were experienced and the driving was exciting at the end. Didn't take ya much to gain trust in drivers. Even though traffic is really chaotic.
- the guide, Jammy (sorry if I miss spell the name) were welcoming and warm. Giving here best explains every detail about food and even preparing the meal for You.
- the choice of locations was excellent!

The only children. I can give is that the agenda is so tight that we wanted to have at least a moment more at each location. Proving my last point above.

Overall, all was really good and would recommend this tour to anyone who wants a bit of adventure around the city.

It was a fantastic experience to discover Saigon like a local. Sitting behind an experienced scooterdriver, Kingsley gave us new insides in Vietnamees life. He was a very funny and happy guide. This tour is highly recommended by us.
Erica and Maarten/Holland

review_title: Most fabulous adventure, even with kids
review_text: We had the most amazing night in Ho Chi Minh, doing our Saigon after Dark tour with Vespa Adventures. I had my hesitations, as we had my 12 year old daughter and 14 year old son with us... But this ended up being one of the highlights of our 3 weeks in Vietnam! It was the most fabulous foody tour, looking at a number of different places, with delicious (and abundant) food, we had a very personable and informative guide, and the riders who took us around were all super safe and made you feel at ease. What an adventure navigating around the traffic, so much fun! It was all very professional and the tour worked like a well oiled machine. Would highly recommend!!

We are a family (55,53,22,18),that booked 2 Vespas tours in Hanoi and Saigon (Hochi Minh City). The Saigon tour by far better. The food was .
superb, excellent alcohol drinks
T.Vi was our guide. funny, generous and explained in details how to eat...she was great!
strongly recommend!

This was so much fun! The traffic in Vietnam can appear quite daunting, but our drivers, Teo T and K Hoang, made it seem easy. The Vespas were comfortable and it was a wonderful way to see Saigon at night. Our guide, Quy, was interesting and informative and the food was just fantastic. We also visited a coffee bar with music - guitar, violin and 3 who each had a turn singing. Very easy listening. Then on to a more upbeat bar with a rocking band. Drinks were covered until 10pm. And a complimentary photo at the end of the tour. What more could you want?! This was one of the highlights of our trip - highly recommended
I'm interested in Vespa Adventures's trip to Dong Anh. Foods & drinks were delicious. Lanscapes were spectascular, I've never seen before

What an experience!!! Had a fantastic evening with our local friend Nam and our drivers flying around the city streets on the back of a Vespa and trying new food in places we would never have been able
to find ourselves. All food and drinks were included and weren't limited. Definitely a must do in Ho Chi Minh City

review_title: Great Way to Explore a VERY Busy City
review_text:
My wife and I spent 3 days in Hanoi and our vespa tour was without question our favorite organized activity. Hanoi is an incredibly busy city and traffic is bonkers so exploring on a vespa is a great way to get around and through the traffic seamlessly.

Our drivers and guide were so friendly and provided lots of interesting information at each of our stops along the way and just riding on the back (which was surprisingly comfortable) as you weave through the other scooters, bikes and cars is an experience not to be forgotten.

We highly recommend this excursion for anyone visiting Vietnam!
All round this was an amazing trip! Our tour guide Rosy was so sweet and all of our drivers were great. The food was great, the locations were interesting and I would definitely recommend this!

One of the best things we've tried on our trip so far:
Open-minded and nice guides/drivers, Great local food, awesome hidden bars with live music.

Highly recommended 😉

review_title: Great local experience not to be missed in Saigon
review_text: I made the tailor made Vespa tour after dark and craft beer around Saigon in the evening. I can't praise enough Vespa adventures for the awesome experience with so much tasty local food and loads of fun, even for me as a local Vietnamese! especially the craft beer-food pairing is simply fantastic! Craft beers tasting is terrific with several many types to try with the food going with each. Strongly recommended! Vy the local Guide was wonderful and fun! Huy the driver was safe and interactive. Great job!

I have just done this trip with our team at the office. I honestly didn't know what to expect as I didn't do any research or check the reviews on TripAdvisor. My friend highly recommended this tour to me. From the moment that I was picked up to the drop off, the service provided by the Vespa Adventures Team members was great, the restaurants visited, offered amazing Vietnamese food, we had local craft beer food pairing, clam soup, crab legs, frog legs etc, I can recommend this tour to everyone, especially if you are a "Gourmand" like me 😀. Vy our host for the night was funny, informative and attentive. If you are in town, a must do! Thanks guys and keep it up

My first night in Saigon, it was pouring down with rain, I have never been on a scooer/motorcycle/vespa....and I took the plunge and climbed onto the back of the Vespa and had the best time eating my way around town!

Jenny, my guide, is a gem. Her enthusiasm for food is infectious! She took me to 2 places, one being for seafood. It was some of the best food I had in all of Vietnam! I don't want to spoil the surprises for anyone so won't share the details, but suffice it to say, I'm still thinking about that night and food.

I highly recommend using Vespa Adventures! Ask for Jenny, her English is great and she's very knowledgeable, and equally interested in you!

review_title: Vespa Adventures Night time Saigon Food Tour
review_text: In August 2019 we joined a Vespa Adventures night time food tour of Saigon. We had done the same tour 3 years ago and loved it so mush we dived in again. We weren't disappointed.

review_title: A must do experience in Saigon
review_text:
We had an amazing times with Vespa Adventures doing the Saigon after Dark tour. The tour takes you to five different places. A bar, two restaurants, a cafe with live Vietnamese music and a rock bar to end up on a high! Our guide and riders spoke great English and were really thoughtful and caring. I did the tour with my 72-years-old dad, and they took excellent care of him.
It is great fun, but also very interesting, as the tour goes to different places in the city, not just to District 1. The chosen restaurants are spot on, as they are restaurants for locals, not for tourists. There is a mixture of seafood, meat, and typical pancakes and springrolls. All food and drinks are included, so we had really a lot to it.

It is a really nice experience to see the city from the back of the vespa. It rained quite a lot during our tour. Don't be put away if this happens. You are given a raincoat that covers you perfectly. I actually thought doing the tour on the rain adds to the experience!

Overall, we cannot fault the tour, the service and the peple. A really great time in Saigon and we want to thank our guides and riders for an incredible time.

review_title: Vespa Tour of Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: We had a fantastic tour of Ho Chi Minh City recently with Vespa Adventures. Our family, including 2 early-twenty-something boys were ferried around HCMC each on the back of a Vespa. It felt extremely safe with our superb drivers and our guide Miggy was great fun and extremely informative. A great way to see the City, possibly the best way in our opinion!

Vespa Adventures' "Insider's Saigon" tourism a must do. Our guide, Miggy, had excellent English and was very knowledgeable. Our drivers, Huy and Hoa, agreed Saigon's crowded, chaotic streets expertly, and the vintage Vespas are a stable and comfortable ride. We explored places we wouldn't have found by ourselves and the tour was well paced. We finished with a delicious complimentary lunch at their HQ, Cafe Zoo, then Huy and Hoa tookus back to our hotel. They also do a craft beer tour, and daytime and evening food tours. We're sorrywe didn'tknowaboutthrm when we were in Cambodia 3 weeks ago; they operate in Hoi An, Hanoi, Phnom Penh, Siem Reap and Chiang Mai. Excellent value, not to be missed.

We booked the Craft Beer and food tour and wasn’t sure what to expect. The drivers picked us up on time and looked after us on the bikes from start to finish. Our guide was very knowledgeable about the 4 craft breweries we visited and places to visit whilst in Ho Chi Minh. The beer and food were plentiful so if your thinking of doing this tour make sure you don’t eat to much before hand. Highly recommended this tour with Vespa Adventures.

review_title: Simply great fun, food and adventure!
review_text: This was most definitely one of the highlights of our SE Asia trip. Great in every way! We had several stops for food and drinks and music entertainment.

review_title: Try Vespa advanture for local sight seeing
review_text: It was a wonderful experience to see local market / street food on a Vespa ride. Safe as you ride as a pillion. Can try all kind of street foods. We used "Saigon After Dark"company for our ride. Can contact them on "info@vespaadventures.com" . A must try.

Best experience we had in Saigon! It was really awesome to travel as a local (thank you C. Hōa :)), to discover more district than usual tourism do, and explore the culture, custom, and history of Saigon thanks to Sunny! She was an astonishing guide :) Thank you Team Vespa Adventure for this trip!!!

review_title: A one of a kind experience!
review_text:
With my brother, we spend and amazing moment discovering Ho Chi Minh City with Vespa adventure!
Sunny gave us a lot of insights of local culture and history of this city. We really felt the way of life of native people! We learn much more with Sunny than with any kind of online documentation.
Also to be honest, the trafic in Vietnam didn't make us feel comfortable. But the driver, Loc, was kind and smooth when driving. I never felt in danger with him.

Thanks you very much Sunny and Loc for this wondefull moment discovery!

P.S. The picture with them and the vespa is a very pleasant bonus thta was totally not expected! =D

Fun way to sightsee, sample local cuisine and experience HMC at night. We have two girls aged 7 and 9 and they loved it. Drivers were friendly and very safe.

Nicole our tour guide was a genuine superstar!

review_title: Highlight of my visit to Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: Wef took the night time foodie tour. It was a blast!!! We stopped a few restaurants and had genuine Vietnamese food. The ride was terrifyingly wonderful. The food was outstanding. At the end we went to a local club and got to see local amateur singers and had a night cap. The entire tour was well planned out, well executed and extremely fun! I highly recommend this activity!

What a great way to see and experience a little taste of Siagon and all the city sights by night on the back of a vesper. Loved it and didn't want it to end. Felt safe & confident with my young driver Vuon. Sunny our tour leader was welcoming.
The only disappointment was that our tour start time was delayed due to the late arrival of others in our group by approx 45 mins.
As a result stop felt rushed often with little time to finish drinks. It would have been better to have allowed us to commence the tour on schedule. Overall would highly recommend

I really did have the time of my life on this tour. Long drove the Vespa and Tu was my drinking companion as we went to 4 craft breweries, tasted beer and ate great food. I would recommend this tour to anyone who likes beer. Riding the Vespa in Saigon just added to the experience and Long is a very capable driver. Thanks Long and Tu for a most memorable experience.

review_title: The tourist sights are not normally seen
review_text: An amazing 4.5 hours of touring Ho Chi Minh's different tourist sights on the rear of a Vespa - The only way to Go!!! Safe drivers, Knowledgable guides great food, drinks, service, and a peek into the culture of the city. A must for any scooterist, and I would love to do it all again with all the great people I met and a big thanks to those that looked after me and gave me such a great time

This nighttime food tour on the back of a Vespa was so much fun, we did it twice. Although not recommended if you have small children (think 8 and younger), it's fun! Kathy our tour guide (Hi Kathy) was terrific, organized each stop immediately, announced we had drinks and seconds if we really enjoyed the presented dish (which we did on a lot of the stops). The food is delicious and a very fun outing!! Very professional and good value.

review_title: Great great great fun 100% should do
review_text: Would recommend if you are in Ho Chi Minh city to do we have done it twice now great food lots of drinks it's a must do the ride are very helpful

review_title: Vespa Tour - A must in Ho Chin Minh City
review_text: Great adventure with sightseeing, food, drinks, introduction of off-beaten places and new foods. A Must Try

review_title: A cool corner on HCM City and Vietnam
review_text:
In spite of the initial rain, the VA team took our family of four out for what was to be one of the highlights of our holidays in Vietnam. After a cordial welcome drink at VA headquarters, we were off to three extremely tasty authentic restaurants and enjoyed the local food and the company of our wonderful English and French speaking guide Mai Ly. A sampling of Saigonese singing and music club life ensued. A perfect menu that leaves us with that satisfied "we want more" - sensation!
A total and absolute must do!
What a great night in Saigon on the back of a vespa visiting 5 locations for food and drinks, highlight at the end visiting pub with live band.

Our Vespa tour has easily been the best part of trip so far. Out host “Folly” was pleasant. Funny and knowledgeable. The riders were fantastic. If you go to Vietnam and don't take this tour then you are missing out on the adventure of a lifetime.

I had a chance to join the Saigon After Dark tour. I was very impressed by friendly driver and guide (Ms. Vy). She was humorous and well took care of guests. I enjoyed many kinds of food (seafood, banh xeo, enjoy music, etc.) after a working day. I'll share it to my friends.

review_title: Thrilling ride through Ho Chi Min city
review_text:
This was one of our highlights from our visit to Vietnam.
Very professional, safe and fun! We saw a lot of the city and it was great being part of the hectic traffic!
Fantastic night one of the highlights of our holiday. Drinks, great food, listens to great music and crazy riding on the back of a vesper. Good value for money would recommend this tour

We had such an amazing time on the Vespa adventure! Tour guide was awesome, and food was fantastic. I loved seeing Ho Chi Minh city by Vespa at night. This was the highlight of my time in Ho Chi Minh city and would recommend to anyone.
What an experience! Don't be daunted by what looks chaotic on the roads-these guys know their stuff and get your around the city in the very best way. Unforgettable.

review_title: Best fun ever on two wheels
review_text: A great way to taste Saigon's street food a music venues on the back of a 1960s classic Vespa. The traffic was horrendous but these experienced riders transported us from venue to venue in a safe but fun filled manner. Our guide Vy was helpful and informative, and the mix of three food stops, a French style coffee lounge with live acoustic music, and a full on rock bar with a six piece band was amazing. Heaps of food and drinks and door to door pickup and drop off. You must do this if you visit Saigon

My wife, 13-year old daughter and I all loved this tour. We booked for a Friday night, and everything was superbly run. Our drivers were extremely professional (which is good, as the roads can be a bit daunting) and our 'local friend', Rachel, really lived up to the title. We visited 3 cafes for food and a couple of spots for music, all distributed around the city. The food was amazing, but it was the discussion with Rachel that really bought the city to life. Highly recommended!

On our stay at Ho Chi Minh city we had the Vespa street food tour booked for us by our agent. Despite the many interesting and fun things we did in this amazing city this was definitely our favourite. The riders that took us on the tour were super experienced and provided a fun and safe tour for us in such a busy city. Our tour guide was so knowledgeable and so much fun. Barely a. Minute went by where we didn't learn something or have a laugh. The food on the tour gave us a real insight we're to go for the real authentic Vietnamese cuisine was in this massive city.

Everything was just perfect. We saw bars and restaurants we wouldn't have found by ourselves. And we had our own driver, who was waiting for us in every place. Our 'friend', Vy, was so kind and really good at talking about the local stuff. She was just interesting.
The Vespa ride for our tour group was a lot of fun. Our drivers took us around Saigon with care and safety. Definitely a highlight of our three-week tour.

We went on the Vespa tour in June. After some problems with the rain and a reschedule by the tour company we set off on our adventure. Never felt unsafe. Never got wet as we had great ponchos. Food was varied and great. Our guide was great. A very happy, smiling and helpful lady young. I would do this trip again without question.

This was one of the highlights of our visit to Vietnam. Great people running the Vespa Adventures and interesting places visited during the ride. Highly recommend. Don't worry about the traffic they know what they're doing.

We rode the Vespa tour of Hoi An on our recent trip. Highlights for me were making white rose at the white rose cafe - so much more delicious than in other cafes in hoi an - learning (at last) how to properly roll rice paper rolls, and stopping on a street corner where I would never normally stop to eat sausage herbs and noodles from a street vendor which was superb.

The tour takes you to places that tourists don't go to and we were quite taken back by the locals tend to throw their rubbish on the floor in restaurants. But the food was good.

We also enjoyed a boat ride down the river to light a paper lantern. A fun night out but maybe one eatery too much.
Did the Vespa tour with my wife who doesn't like motorbikes. But she loved it, it was interstellar and the guides were great. I'd recommend this tour to anyone
A very good night, driving through the streets of Saigon was very exciting the food supplied was superb, only thing was I thought it was a bit expensive
Daisy is a fantastic tour guide & very knowledgeable. I would recommend her to anyone. She is bright and friendly as well. Very interesting tour

We had a great night out exploring Saigon on the back our very capably driven vespas. My driver K. Dong was such a lovely girl and felt really safe on those busy roads. Totally recommend this experience
Definitely worth doing: great fun, friendly drivers and a really good host Vy (knowledgeable and entertaining). Good value for money too.

review_title: No better way to discover Saigon and to meet new people
review_text:
Very well organized
Good food during the various stops
Unexpected place for listening to local bands
Crazy ride among the thousands of motorbikes

You won't want to miss this. Despite the fact that it looks as if it would be the scariest thing in the world, it absolutely wasn't. This is because the drivers were so capable and experienced. It was both exhilarating and enjoyable. What a fabulous way to see such a huge, diverse and fascinating city. Both my 19 year old granddaughter and I (77 years old) thought it to be the highlight of our visit there.

review_title: Great way to experience the city
review_text: Had great fun exploring Ho Chi Minh City with Vespatours. I had a comfortable bike & an experienced & calm driver who put me at ease. We visited 6 different venues - 2 for drinks, 2 for food & 2 for live music. All places we wouldn't have found on our own. Terrific way to spend an evening!

I wasn't sure what to expect, but it was great. We were picked up from our hotel on the Vespas, taken to a welcome drink, followed by a local restaurant, another restaurant, cool jazz bar for coffee, followed by live music venue; weaving in & out of the traffic on the Vespas. The drivers were very competent and safe.

Had the best night what an amazing experience it went from different levels of craziness. The tour took us to some great places that were ready for us. The leader was a hoot and so much fun. Would loved to stay st the last 2 venues much longer
Would highly recommend

This tour was epic. I went with the rest of my tour group as it was organized by our tour. It was an optional extra and I'm so glad I did it. It was amazing. So much fun. Driving around Chiang Mai we saw everything and it was a really fun experience. The stops we did were great too, learning how to make papaya salad and then stopping at a really lovely restaurant. It was a highlight of the trip.

We had an amazing time last night on our Vespa adventure. It was great fun zipping around the city and our drivers were lovely and made us feel safe even in the crazy traffic. From the start in the fabulous roof top bar to the finish in a tiny live music venue our guide Mai had everything organized brilliantly. We tasted delicious food- too much to actually eat!! We would thoroughly recommend this tour; it was a brilliant end to our trip to Vietnam and an experience we will never forget.

review_title: Zip around Ho Chi Minh on a Vespa!
review_text: What an exhilarating and sometimes, slightly scary experience! The city traffic is bonkers but these guys know their way around and looked after us so well. We were picked up from our hotel at 8 am and immediately got on a Vespa (7 of us ranging from 16 - 52 years of age) and were taken to the Zoom cafe for a briefing. We then set off on our tour around Ho Chi Minh - seeing things that we probably wouldn't have done had we gone sightseeing on our own! The Bird Park and cafe where the locals drink coffee and bring their birds to socialise - we were introduced to Vietnamese coffee. We zipped down the alleyways, visiting the flower market & the food market, Chinese temples, the Pagoda of 10,000 Buddhas ... the list goes on! Alina was our tour guide and so informative about the sights and also the local culture. We were provided with water throughout the tour and were given lunch back at the cafe at the end of the tour. Recommend this adventure - highlight of our visit!

What a fabulous way to see MCHC - as a family of 5 we had such fun seeing places we would never have found on our own, eating amazing food and really chatting with our lovely guide Rosie. Lots of laughter, a great way to spend our last night in this amazing city - you'd be missing out if you didn't do it!

We had an amazing time on our tour of the Mekong delta. All riders where great, never felt unsafe, despite the total chaos of Ho Chi Min traffic. Was collected from the hotel on time, great tour taking in all the sights, shrimp farm, local market, incense factory, monastery and lunch on stilted restaurant on the river, had a ball

You won’t regret booking this! We booked as a family of four - 2 adults, a 13 and 10 year old! This is one of the safest places to be on a motorcycle! Cars and bikes are very aware of each other! We did not feel in any danger at any point.

We visited some amazing sights - things we would not have visited or found on our own (as well as the “hot spots”). Fantastic way to see Saigon in a short space of time (4 hours) and one of the best tours we have done (probably ever!).

review_title: The Greatest Highlight of my Vacation!
review_text:
I have traveled from North to south Vietnam through 3 weeks. Hanoi, Sapa, Halong Bay, Ninh Binh, Hue, Hoi An and Saigon.

This was the first activity I did in Saigon, just a few hours after arriving at the airport, and it was the best decision ever!

Cruising through the crowded streets of Saigon on the back of a Vespa, eating AMAZING local food accompanied by our superb guide Vy, and listening to lovely live music.
I couldn't have asked for a greater evening! Thank you so much Vespa Adventures!

Saigon After Dark is most definitely a MUST do if you are visiting the city!

This was so much fun. They took us to two restaurants for dinner with a 20 minute tour of the city in between, then onto a bar with local singers. The drivers were fantastic, food amazing. What a way to experience Saigon by night. Loved it. Our guide Jenny was lovely and so funny. They even gave us a photo of us with our driver at the end of the night.

We would never have been brave enough to do this on our own! Being driven by expert drivers on vintage Vespas through Ho Chi Minh city is an adventure in itself, and the tour overall was amazing. We went to street food restaurants we would never had tried and had delicious food, with all drinks included (beer, cocktails etc). Then just when we thought it was over we went to an acoustic cafe - incredible! Listening to such high quality performance in an authentic Vietnamese atmosphere, drinking Vietnamese coffee (or more beer!). Even then it wasn't over as we went on to a lively music venue as our last stop (more drinks). The whole trip gave us a real experience of Saigon we would not have found on our own. Fabulous. Highly recommend.

review_title: Vespa Night tour with 2 grown up sons
review_text:
Honestly, riding ourselves in this city - - no way.. But being driven by this crew.. Priceless! Not only included the tour a lot of fun on the original Vespas, but we also got to taste great local food at local places (only known to the other group driven by this company 😉), we had live singers (no Karaoke!) with the coffee and the drinks at the last stop were even more life music!!
Very careful drivers, friendly and great English and French speaking guide!

We have had the best experience despite rain showers. Excellent drivers and superb guide who took us to a rooftop bar, several local street food restaurants and two different experiences of live music. Oh what a night! We will be talking about it for a long time. It was definitely the best way to see Saigon 😁

review_title: The Fun way to see Ho Chi Min City
review_text: This is the fun way to see Ho Chi Min City on the back of a vintage Vespa. The drivers are very friendly and manage their way through the busy traffic with ease. Our guide was very knowledgeable too. We enjoyed lunch, tea and visited 5 locations. Pick up and drop off from our accommodation. Recommended even in the rainy season.

Vietnam runs on Vespas - no trip is complete without this experience . A fun ride through small villages & rice paddies . A variety of sight seeing & activities - my mat weaving & rice crackers are now legend ! We felt safe in the hands of our guide Moon & her guys Dong, Quy & Balo . Definitely a highlight .

review_title: Saigon After Dark - Best part of the entire trip!
review_text: This night time food tour of Ho Chi Minh was hands down, the best experience of our family holiday around Vietnam. Our guide, Vy, was very accommodating, informative and approachable throughout the evening. Being able to taste and witness the making of so many delicious local foods at establishments that we otherwise would never have known of was a great insight into Vietnamese food and culture. The drivers on each of our bikes were extremely good drivers, although the roads are scary with the chaos, I never felt unsafe on the back of the Vespa.

This was so much fun! Our guide Jenny was fantastic and the amount and variety of food was amazing. Would thoroughly recommend it. The Vespa drivers were very responsible and despite the crazy traffic we always felt safe.

review_title: Night tour of Saigon, great finale to Vietnam!
review_text: We had the best evening on this tour. The guides were waiting for us outside the hotel and introduced themselves, helmets were distributed and made sure everyone was happy before setting off. Great stops along the way, fantastic food, wonderful local friend, Tam (not a tour guide!) it was truly an evening to remember and all 3 of our girls (20, 18 and 12) agreed.

I did the Glimpse of the Mekong tour and loved it! They really take us off the beaten track, didn’t see tourists where we were, mostly locals, which was great! Our guide, Miggy, was supper knowledgable and went out of her way to make sure the group was having fun and got the best quality food. She spoke great English too! Small groups, only 4 people, which was nice. My driver, Thanh, was also very nice and always asking if I was doing fine. Everyone super respectful and service minded. Got a picture and a little souvenir at the end. Would definitely do more tours with them!

review_title: Wonderful experience for the whole family!
review_text: This was an amazing experience for all of us. We did the “Saigon After Dark” tour with our two kids age 8 and 10 and all of us loved it. Rachel, our tour guide, was great with the kids and really taught all of us more about the culture and experience of Vietnam. She was so patient with the kids and even took them outside to play games with our son and braid our daughter's hair in a more traditional Vietnamese style at one of the music venues so we could enjoy a moment of adult time. The food was great and music venues were excellent choices and were well paced. We all felt completely safe and in great hands the entire trip. Highly recommended to anyone!

We just completed a tour with our12 and 15 year olds, it was absolutely excellent! Picked up at the hotel and taken to restaurant for lunch and met our guide Kathy who explained the tour, where we will go and what we will see. Driven by the excellent Vespa drivers with a photographer taking pictures we were taken on a local tour of the city to places only locals would know.
Very informative explanations, easy to ask lots of questions with knowledgable answers. If there were 6 stars would give it! Michelle, Thomas, Fynn and Mia

review_title: Mr. and Mrs. Steve Lyn Andersen
review_text: Fantastic sight seeing trip, awesome drivers, would highly recommend this tour to anyone, had a great time and will never forget the experience of seeing coffee making and making and eating rice noodles, awesome. Special thanks to phi and phuoc for making a memorable trip.

“Ride is your life” is the tagline for this company. I was skeptical but had a free day during a business trip. I was traveling alone and really wanted to get out of the city so I gave it a shot. It blew my mind.

Our leader, Alina (sp?) was lovely - friendly, knowledgeable and charismatic. I went with a small group, 5 in all. A few people decided to drive their own but I was more than happy to ride on the back. The scooter culture there is INSANE and I wasn't willing to risk it. Plus I wanted to take lots of photos. My driver was calm and reliable so I felt very safe.

It took a while to get out of the city. But once we did it was like another world. We crossed small, metal bridges, took a scooter ferry to cross rivers, walked through a squatting market and shopped for food. Then we went to a local tented area where the food was cooked for us. I don't know what I ate but it was delicious along with a cold beer. We had a tour or a stickey rice family-run business as well as an incense business. We saw churches, shrimp farms and lots of interesting people and countryside.

Later in the day, there was a torrential storm. The drivers anticipated this and outfitted us in lightweight ponchos before a drop of rain touched us. This part was delightful as it became scorching really hot and the rains cooled us down.

I got the most amazing photos of the local people and a real taste of their lifestyle.

If this wasn't enough, we were taken to the most beautiful floating restaurant with hanging lights in the trees. For a full meal. It feels like a dream.

I couldn't recommend this tour more!

What a lovely team that showed us around Saigon by Vespa. We soon got over our nerves and found traveling on a Vespa is a lot safer than it looks! Really good fun in fact. And the street food restaurants and hidden away cafes that they took us too were absolutely first rate and we would never have found/tried them ourselves. No up-selling just a really friendly and helpful team who wanted to ensure we had a really enjoyable time. Happily recommend. Took our 14 & 16 year old daughters and found it very safe and suitable.
We had a wonderful evening on the HCMC Vespa adventures. Would highly recommend for a fun activity. Eric was a great host.

We did the Saigon After Dark tour and it was one of the highlights of our two weeks in Vietnam. Our hostess was Rosy and she was so great, we were sad to say goodbye at the end of the night. We were picked up at 6:00 from our hotel and dropped off about 10:15. It was all very easy. Our drivers were all very professional and we felt safe the whole time. We went to five different places and it was a great way to try some authentic Vietnamese food, which I was a bit nervous about. Our teenagers even tried things like frog, which they probably wouldn't have done otherwise. This adventure was well worth the money and I'd totally recommend it.

review_title: I would give this 6 stars if I could!
review_text: I felt like I was seeing Ho Chi Minh with a friend who knew all the best places. Highlight of our trip so far. I was nervous about tackling Ho Chi Minh traffic on the back of a bike but I felt so safe with my very professional driver. Destinations were great. Our group of 5 had our own guide, Vy, who introduced us to all the secrets of nightlife in this city. She made the night very special. Beware of imitators, there are many others offering this trip. This is the one I would recommend with a score of 10 out of 10. They wear orange T-shirt's and helmets and there is an s at the end of adventures.

review_title: Saigon After Dark - food and music
review_text: Strongly recommend this! You are collected from your hotel by Vespa and then join the throng around the bustle of HCMC in the evening rush. We had a seafood stop - sensational crab and an amazing tasting clam broth - then a meat based cafe (nine courses in all) plus two music venues. All included in the main price. Loads of fun, very well organized and safe. Will do again here or elsewhere.

Today we went on the vespa tour to Mekong delta. If we say it was amazing, it's not enough! 😍 Our guide Sunny was the best - she is funny and knows soooo many things! We learned a lot about the culture, about life in Mekong delta and we tried the best food in Vietnam! We loved our rides with vespas and the drivers were really good, we felt totally safe but yet adventurous. We can't speak highly enough of this tour and of Sunny. Would absolutely recommend it to everyone!
Hana and Tom

This is the second time I have done the night foodie tour and I loved every minute of it. The fun atmosphere of the staff and our group was fantastic. The staff made us feel welcome and looked after us very well. The exhilaration of riding on the back of a vespa in the traffic of Saigon has to be experienced and truly shows the skill of your drivers. I feel very safe with my driver. The food and drink should satisfy any traveler. I would highly recommend doing this tour, and I would definitely do it again if I ever had the privilege of visiting Saigon again.

Mark and his crew did a brilliant job at showing us (8) the country side around hoi an. At all times we felt safe, the riders knew what they were doing and enjoyed a laugh and Mark was very knowledgeable about the places we visited. Lunch was included and it was delicious. I can highly recommend this tour, especially with Mark as your guide.

review_title: Highlight of our stay in Saigon
review_text: WOW. This has got to be the best night out in Saigon. On the back of a Vespa, you get to see heaps of Saigon by night when traveling in and around Saigon. Amazing culinary delights (you can be adventurous or not with the food), great hosts and drivers, finished off with beautiful music and drinks, back to your hotel safe and sound. We will all talk of this night for years to come. Thanks to the lovely LUNA who looked after us. A must in Saigon!!

review_title: Do you like having fun? Then this is the tour for you
review_text: So just looked over the pictures from our night tour with Vespa Adventures. Like the joy was jumping out at me. Seriously so much freaking fun. I am a Vespa owner and lover and the rides they pick you up in are absolutely amazing. Aside from the fine machinery you saddle up on the guides and drivers are incredible, I feel 100% safe the entire time. Ho Chi Minh is a scooter city, the drivers around you are no amateurs and the locals, at least I feel, truly respect the fact that tourists are out and aide in helping you feel safe and have fun as well. The stops are incredible, from Anthony Bourdain recommended food stalls to attic like jazz bars. Can not recommend any more

I'm traveling with family but decided to take this tour on my own. I'm a 68 year old, active woman and knew I wanted a motorbike tour of some sort.My guide was Alina. Her knowledge, humor, and concern for safety make her an excellent guide. Tham (Tom?) is an excellent driver.I enjoyed being part of the city traffic especially with him as my driver. I took the morning trip and it ended deliciously with a fabulous lunch at the Zoom Cafe. All the staff that I met were friendly and helpful. One of THE best decisions I've made on this trip was to tour with Vespa Adventures. Thanks, Alina and Tham!

Our family (including two teenage girls) absolutely LOVED our foodie tour after dark. Our drivers were fantastic and our tour guide, Rosie, was brilliant too. She made us very comfortable right from the start and told us many things about the food and places we visited. Would do this again in a heartbeat! Great work Vespa Adventures!

We did the Angkor Wat sunrise tour today with Mr. Hor Heang as our guide. He was on time, which was great. It was very nice to be able to beat the crowds by taking all the off road routes. We were able to get to different temples before most of the other tourists. Mr. Heang is very knowledgeable about the temples and history of Cambodia in general. This was such a pleasant surprise. He is also very friendly and funny and this makes the activity even more enjoyable. The drivers were very competent. So at no time did we feel unsafe. They had a good supply of complimentary drinks for us and the food we had for breakfast (included) was delicious. My friend and I highly recommend this tour and if you can get this guide, even better.

review_title: Fantastic trip around Ho Chi Min
review_text: Our Vespa tour was brilliant from start to finish. I was a little nervous about being on the back of the bike but our drivers were caring, considerate and I quickly relaxed and enjoyed experiencing Ho Chi Min traffic from within.... which actually is less scary than watching or trying to cross the road!! our guide Miggy was brilliant, knowledgable and considerate. She gave great advice relating to enjoying our time in HCM in addition to the sites we saw. I have a stomach condition and she helped with food choices and also when we visited the herbal store recommended a tea that I could buy from them that she finds helps her. The sites on the tour (we did the morning city tour) were a mix of District 1, 3 and China Town. We saw places we would never have found alone, nor had the time to get to. The drivers will often take us through markets and areas so we can see local life around the destinations on tour. Miggy was also aware of safety and would tell us when to keep our bags close etc....The food for lunch was delicious and we were given water regularly. All in all a brilliant trip and highly recommended as a way to see a lot of HCM city quickly. We are visiting Siem Reap in Cambodia in October and are looking at booking the countryside tour with Vespa Adventures based on our fantastic experience in Ho Chi Min. You won't regret using them, it really is the ride of your life!

review_title: Authentic tour in the Mekong Delta
review_text: This was my second tour with Vespa Adventures and they did not disappoint. As someone who has done one of the tours in the Mekong Delta where you are herded around to places catering only to tourists, this was NOT that. We were the only tourists everywhere we went. It was great to see the market up close, eat street food, see rice wine being made (and try it) and incense makers --- all while riding on the back of a Vespa. While you don't get deep in the heart of the delta - because that would be a much longer drive - it was a perfect day adventure outside of HCMC.

A really memorable night. Adrenaline rush on a scooter with excellent driver and a friendly fun tour guide called Fully. Great mix of eateries and bars. The food was amazing. Drinks superb. I loved every minute.

review_title: Hi Chi Minh City Bike Tour
review_text: Our, tour riders picked us up promptly at the arranged time from our hotel. We started with a nice lunch, refreshing beverage and got an overview of what our day would look like...and then we were off (voom, voom). This tour will NOT disappoint. You become a local and get to see the many attractions and beautiful sites in Ho Chi Minh City. Highly recommended

review_title: Amazing food and exhilarating scooter ride!
review_text:
This was certainly one of the highlights of our holiday! Having seen the chaos traffic that is the HCM (although we never saw any crashes!) we were a bit nervous but the drivers were so skilled we (including my 12 year old) were at ease immediately even though the drivers were certainly taking no prisoners weaving through traffic. In fact my 12 year old now wants a motor bike!
The street food was amazing and we visited some restaurants and music bars that we certainly wouldn't have ventured into, let alone even discovered, had we been on our own.
Overall a fantastic evening and thoroughly recommended!
Great night. Thoroughly recommend. On holiday with young adult family- was highlight of holiday. So much fun. Great food and hospitality. Included live entertainment. Great guide, Miggy. A must do.

Morning tour - Insiders Saigon. Our guide Kathy was great- very knowledgeable. Our drivers were very courteous and guaranteed we stayed safe in the hustle and bustle of Saigon. The tour was very well organized- especially enjoyed the 10000 Buddhas and the bird club! Saw things we wouldn't have seen otherwise. These guys are really professional and everything was great. Finished off with a lovely lunch. Can't thank you enough for one of the highlights of our Vietnam holiday. Worth every penny to ride around on an authentic Vespa!

Thoroughly enjoyed this, would recommend to everyone. It was out of my comfort zone but so well worth it. Such an experience in the middle of the traffic - all the buzz and noise. Also seeing the culture side of Saigon.

We had the BEST time on this Vespa street food tour in Saigon. We were really nervous beforehand given the traffic and driving in Vietnam but the drivers were friendly and safe drivers, that immediately put us at ease. I'm so glad we did it, it was an incredible experience! Definitely a MUST DO in Saigon! We had a tour guide Rosy who was with us at every stop, we enjoyed great Vietnamese food, she told us all about the food and life in Vietnam, she was lovely! The restaurants and bars we went to were great and they weren't places tourists would go on their own, brilliant way to see the city as we covered 3 districts. Would 100% recommend to anyone!

What a fabulous and crazy city! Vespa Adventures brought it all to life on a sundown by night tour of the city. Experienced drivers and we feel very safe in what will be a unique experience for most! Great vespas. One of the original tour operators in town. They even found two female riders for our girls aged 10 & 12. Knowledgeable tour guide Fulli who spoke great English. Highly recommended.

We had an excellent tour with our guide Kathy and drivers. We visited the countryside-- shrimp farm, market, coffee house, rice wine distillery, incense factory, and temple-- before a nice lunch. It rained a bit, but Our drivers just pulled out ponchos. We learned a lot about Vietnamese culture and living.

We were in Saigon with friends and vented on a tour through the city with Vespa Adventures. What a truly amazing journey through places in the city that we would not have been able to find on our own. The drivers were responsible and friendly and I highly recommend a tour with them.

I cannot recommend this trip enough. The ride through the country side alone was a pleasure, however, there were a lot of interesting stops. Our tour guide Sunny was full of facts and just a truly lovely person. We had two meals and every effort was made to ensure that I had tasty vegetarian options. The drivers were all skilled, extremely cautious, and my driver Hoa even made sure I had my helmet safely strapped every time we would depart!

This is an amazing experience! 10 of 10 and highly recommended. Riding on the back of an old vesper in and amongst the traffic is an experience in it self, on top of that, the food was perfection, our tour guide Rosy a ray of sunshine and great company and the live music was incredibly professional and enjoyable. This was a perfect evening. We even got given a gift and photo at the end of our evening! Thank you all so much, we loved this tour.

Highlight of our trip to HoiAn so far. What a great team of guides. Phi (Onion), Phuoc, Son & Boy were very skilled drivers and we all felt very safe as we zipped through the narrow lanes of the country side. Onion spoke excellent English and gave us an indepth insite of the local culture and way of everyday life. Highly recommend this trip!

Thanks from Lyn Steve Mal and Cathy - Perth, Australia
The staff were amazing and the food was out if this world. I would recommend everyone to do the vespa adventures
Great fun, enjoyed the team & especially our host. Got to see a few different sides to Saigon. Wish it could have been longer.

Our family had a wonderful night tour on Vespa scooters throughout the city of Saigon. At first I was a bit scared but the drivers were so competent that I soon relaxed and enjoyed the sights as we zipped around town. The restaurants had fabulous food and we stopped at two music places and it was a perfect night out on the town. Our guide Miggy, was fun and talked to us all about Vietnam and we just had a great time!

We went on the after dark food tour of Saigon and it was honestly one of the best things we did on our trip. We were met at our hotel by our excellent drivers Danh and Quyen. It was my first time on a moped and I was a little nervous but was instantly made to feel at ease. We were then met by our knowledgeable and friendly guide Kathy and went to a roof top bar for views of the city at night and a cocktail. All the food was of excellent quality and gave us a real taste of local cuisine. Kathy was even willing to add in a taste of snails at our request. The night ended at a local music bar where we weren't allowed to talk, only enjoyed the fabulous performances. I could not recommend this tour any more.
Best thing we did in Saigon. This is a really great way to see the city at night, to experience the rush of riding a Vespa and to taste food that the locals eat.

This was a great time and one of the highlights of our trip! Worth the money. The guides were great. The stops were excellent. We had a group of 5 and all of us were more than pleased. Thank you for the amazing experience!

Had an absolute ball did the Saigon after dark tour which took us around the city into markets and tasting local cuisine our tour guide Vy was an absolute gem a very delightful character she made the tour fun highly recommend this tour

Not to be missed. A real experience weaving through the traffic on the back of a Vespa. A little scary at first, but you soon relax becoming part of the traffic flow with experienced drivers. Great food, our host was excellent.

review_title: Great experience and so much worth it!
review_text: I can only say it was fantastic experience to explore Saigon by night with Vespa Adventures. People who take care of you are professionals. The whole experience is well tailored and I feel very safe. Our group of 6 people, which means 6 drivers and 6 vespas. There was a lot of fun, good food and beer, music and dancing at the end. We had a blast. They pick good places to show you around HCMC. I would do it again for sure.

The whole trip was amazing! From the friendly staff who would go out of there way to help to the scenic rides. This tour is packed full with fun, excitement and tons of laughs!

This is a MUST DO!!

Our group of four adults loved the night tour of Saigon on Vespas. Food was great and places we would never have found on our own. Guide Tony was excellent company and very knowledgable and we felt very safe with our drivers. A highlight of our Vietnam tour.

A friend had recommended the Vespa Tour to us and so we booked the tour for our first morning in Saigon. Met by the drivers bang on time- taken for lunch at their little HQ cafe (all included in the tour price) and met with a couple who were also booked on the tour. After a light lunch we set off and visited places we never would have found or managed had we been on foot. We had a guide with us- Sunny- who was lovely and very interesting. Felt totally safe the whole time- the drivers were very careful and considerate. Thank you so much to the crew- I'd totally recommend this adventure!

This was the first thing I did when I got there. It probably was the most memorable, despite the fact the entire trip was beautiful. What a beautiful country! I was there in the US Army 51 years ago as an 18 year old.

We had an amazing night ....this ended up being one of our Vietnam highlights.....fun from the moment we got picked up from our hotel, Kathy was brilliant & showed us Saigon by night as we ate & drank our way through the traffic, & felt safe with our drivers who looked after us the whole night. Highly recommended if you want an enjoyable experience.

review_title: The best of my Vietnam experience
review_text: This tour is really good you go have off the beaten path you see and experience so much more than a regular tour and it's a local experience I didn't see any other tourist apart from our stop at the post office and the Palace loved our guide everything was great.

We have been a group of 11 persons and enjoyed tasty food and very good live-music. All drivers have been very careful inspite of the traffic.

over all: excellent

Thank You

review_title: Being part of the Vespa swarm
review_text: Crossing streets in Saigon was challenging because of thousands of Vespa´s on the streets. We were wondering how it would be to ride with the swarm on a Vespa. It was great!! The drivers brought us safely to five different locations with very good food, drinks and music and dancing at the end. Everything was perfectly organized. Thanks to the whole team for the great experience.

My wife and i did the glimpse of the Mekong tour, our drivers were tam, tam 8 and our guide Christina.
