We were picked up bang on time by the tam's and whisked off to a cafe, after meeting christina and an over view 9f the tour we headed off, being in the Saigon traffic isnt for the faint hearted but our drivers made us feel safe no matter what and all safety gear, face masks and water proofs are provided. the tour was amazing so many interesting stops and christina was super informative about the area, people and culture. The sights are stunning along the way, numerous little stops for coffee or points of interest along the way, going to a local market and picking our own shrimp and fruit before taking them to be cooked in a very local nearby market was an awesome experience, the whole tour was well run and great fun and ended in a tasty local lunch at a traditional restaurant, it was delicious. The company catered for a food allergy (gluten) which can be an issue on tours sometimes but not on this one. We can't reccomend this tour enough from getting picked up to dropped off it was well run and a brilliant experience.

review_title: Most FUN of our three week extraordinary vacation
review_text: My wife and I (both 70) did an evening bar and food tour of Saigon on Vespas. We each had a bike with drivers and with a guide who accompanied us on his own bike. It was really fun to finally be out in the middle of all the bike traffic we'd been watching for two weeks. Admittedly it was daring and a bit scary, but the drivers were sooooo careful with us... I felt like a five year old being taken care of solicitous adults... even when a monsoon downpour started. The drivers quickly pulled over, removed our helmets (yes, we were not allowed to do our own helmet placement and removal as the drivers wanted to be sure they were snug and properly affixed), dressed us in ponchos, put our helmets back on and took off again. Everyone on bikes around us did the same and in two minutes were back out in the flow in a full downpour. It was an explosion. The food was a good sampling of Saigon (not that I'm an expert, but it was all good) and the bars were a real treat. From fifties crooners to Beatles "Let It Be" (with the crowd all singing) and you haven't lived until you've heard (or suffered... a matter of musical opinion) Saigon rap. The guide met us at each restaurant (and helped us order... I have some food allergies so this was really helpful) and at each bar. He was clearly known, had great seats waiting for us, and usually served us drinks from behind the bar. The bars were largely filled with locals, not tourists (there were some), so it felt like an authentic scene (again, not that I would know authentic Saigon, but, hey I was too busy having a great time). All in all my wife and I will do this again in a second Saigon.

Excellent trip!
Staff was very friendly and kind!
My Vespa driver was very nice and answered all my questions, that was my best experience I have had about Sai Gon city tour!

We decided on this adventure for our first trip. What an experience. I am an experienced Rider but this was incredible. The trip like a pillion rider was overwhelming. The sheer traffic of Scooters from all directions but above! The food at the cafes was tasty and interesting, it was followed by a visit to a in image music club. All in all one of the highlights of our holiday.
What a hoot, great night on the back of the Vespa, felt very safe with our drivers and had lovely meals a few drinks and great entertainment i would highly recommend this adventure
Loved it will come back anytime. Food was great and so was the company. Rosey was lovely and very friendly

An experience that was well worth it. Staff were fantastic and the food we were introduced to were excellent. Locations of restaurants were well chosen and the Poh was excellent, the different ways it was served.
They were amazing keeping up the good work. Friendly and really looking after their customers. They were very safe drivers.
Would recommend this to anyone, an amazing experience. Thank you! The highlight of our trip. My driver Kim Dong , Such an amazing person, wanted to bring her back home with me

review_title: a great way to experience contemporary Vietnam
review_text: We had super time. We learned a lot, enjoyed great food and it was a great way to experience contemporary Vietnam.

The Saigon by night tour was a highlight of our trip.
Well organized, interesting and I felt perfectly safe.
I managed to take a few photos while we manoeuvred in the traffic.
Recommended.

Had the best night in Ho Chi Minh with Vespa adventures!
My sister is an expat and they have done this tour before and said that it is "THE" tour to do in Vietnam. I was nervous at first but my driver Thuan was surprised, checked that I was OK and was happy with the speed that he was going. At every stop he was ready and waiting with my helmet and checked that I was happy and comfortable with everything. I later learned that he was new at this and I never would have known.
We were picked up in District 2 and had a beautiful ride along the river as the sun was set to our first stop to meet with Rosy who was our guide. Rosy looked after us at each stop and had so much information about the city and the food that we were eating.
Drinks are included in the package and there is so much great food. My favorite stop was the second in District 5 where we had the most amazing seafood and "jumping chicken". The food on this trip is just outstanding so I wouldn't eat anything at all prior.
We had 4 stops on the night, each very different to each other and then were taken home on the Vespas with a view of the city at night. It was the best city tour I think I have ever done! A lot to do with the people I was with, and Rosy and Thuan looking after me. Thank you!
Really nice Vespa adventure! Places we went to were amazing, especially live music bars. The driver Quyen was so nice and our local friend Mai was the best!! See you next time
We enjoyed a fun evening joining the locals on a vespa. We ate great food and enjoyed good music at the 5 venues we visited on the night.

Was dismayed at the prospect of this but the Vespa drivers were really skilled and reassuring. The food stops were amazing and our guide was fun but showed us how to enjoy the food and the different districts of Saigon. I loved the secret coffee shop with its fabulous singers and musicians which a Western visitor could never have found. Excellent value for money and very well organised. Everyone should do this!

Vy (host), Binn (driver), the locations (After Dark); the food, the drink,(& the rest of our group) made this one of the best activities we chose on holiday. I was apprehensive before picking up - then it was safe, secure, entertaining and pampered for the rest of the night! Definitely do it again at any opportunity or at any location these guys run.

review_title: A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: Our Saigon After Dark experience was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. If you are visiting Ho Chi Min City you must do this tour. It was such a great night and gave us an experience we could never get on our own. Our drivers were excellent and made us feel safe at all times and our tour guide T Vi was great and took us to some great local places to eat and hidden music venues. Such a great night ..... we wish I could do it again!

review_title: I was frightened and had the most fun ever
review_text: Our tour package had this as one of our options and we had to do it and no regrets. I felt propelled through the streets of Saigon holding tight onto this tiny little bar behind the driver. The vespa driver, mainly students, reassured me it was safe as I was amazed of being in the middle of a sea of cars and vespa weaving in and out at night. We stopped by several places to sample street food and beer. The best thing I have ever done! The tour hosts made sure we had fun and kept everyone engaged and safe.

You wouldn’t want to ride a Vespa in Ho Chi Minh City yourself but these guys made it look so easy. The tour itself was excellent with stop offs for sea food, frogs legs and pancakes for your body and then a cafe and club for your soul. Highlight of the night was listening to singers range from Uptown Funk to It’s My Life. Riding through the streets, lit up for Tet, was amazing. One of the best things we’ve ever done!!

review_title: Want the time of your life in Ho Chi Minh City stress and hassle free?
review_text: Capture the intensity of night-life in Ho Chi Minh City by taking a guided Vespa tour with knowledgeable and passionate your driver-guides. Thy take you to places that they know from experience will excite your eating/drinking/entertainment senses. One of the best ways to bond with a new city and make new friends. Ho Chi Minh will never be the same to you. Excitement plus!

review_title: Saigon After Dark tour a must do!!
review_text: First sight of Saigon traffic would make you think twice about this experience but if you do, you will miss out on such a food, sight and adrenalin experience. You don't have to ride bikes to participate, as we talked our friends into it who had not riden on a motorcycle before. The smile on their faces at the end of the evening said it all. Picked up at our hotel and taken to Zoom Cafe where we met our guide, Kathy. Tour included 4 other destinations, with a 20 odd minute ride in between each. Nine courses of exceptional local food at two restaurants and all drinks were included. The riders were very skillful and never once do you feel unsafe. The thrill of zipping through traffic and seeing the lights of the city was exceptional. The evening went by way too fast. So enjoyable!

What a fantastic night we had, our guide FULLY and our riders were EASSY and DAMN , they were such incredible safe riders we never felt unsafe , the tour started with food and food just kept on coming all through the night. I think 9 courses in total, all had with beers . The music venues were great with something for everyone, violin piano singer bar, then rock and roll music bar. We were taken to districts that is not touristy ate clams mussels frog legs, rice paper rolls and savory pancakes, it was great to be shown how to eat these properly. High 5 guys you made our night so memorable, one of our best nights yet

We were a bit apprehensive when booking this tour due to local traffic but were absolutely 'blown away' with the professionalism and personal service from the Vespa Tours Crew. We all felt safe on the scooters and the drivers gave our guests plenty of help throughout the tour. Our oldest passenger is 75 and feels like 18 again as we made our way through the busy streets. I would strongly recommend this tour as a 'must do' for anyone who is going to Ho Chi Minh. Well done to the Vespa Tours team.

Never in my wildest dreams did I think I would hop on the back of a vespa let alone in Ho Chi Minh City! It was definitely crazy but it was the highlight of our 15 day trip in Vietnam. There were 6 people in our group and all in our 50's doing the Saigon by Night tour. Our guide, Tv was fantastic and she lead us through some amazing Street food and great music. Ty, my driver always makes me feel safe..eventhough the traffic just can't be explained, you really need to see it to believe it. Highly recommend Vespa Adventures, it was a brilliant way to end our trip. Thanks guys...it really was "the ride of my life"

review_title: Great tours in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi
review_text:
My daughter and I appreciated our day tours in Ho Chi Minh and Hanoi. Our guides, Tam and Tommy, were knowledgeable about their city and in answering our questions.

The tour provided us with a better feel and understanding about each city. We highly recommend these tours to get to know the city contours and the culture!!!

review_title: Great nightlife experience with enjoying local food & drinks
review_text:
Everything was perfectly organized + surprised memorable photo at the end of the tour-).
Good company, interesting stops, info and delicious food!
One thing I didn't like is very old stylish Vespa scooter with really terrible smell & noise pollution

Miggi was our guide as we whizzed round Saigon on the back of the Vespas. This was simply great. We are both 70 and screaming like a couple of kids the whole time. What a thrill - extremely competent guide and drivers (mine was Binh), wonderful visits to bars and parts of the city that we wouldn't have seen and great company of fellow tourists. Apart from anything else, it gives such pleasure to say we went round Saigon on the back of a Vespa and people look at you as if you're mad but they don't know how safe we ​​felt!

It was with some trepidation, given the Saigon traffic of largely motorcycles of one kind or another, that we left our hotel. At the event the whole evening was great fun with a visit to a bar to start, 2 restaurants and finishing at a Coffee Bar with live music. Whizzing all over Saigon was an education in vespa driving brilliance with the thousands of other bikes in very close proximity. I would recommend it to anyone along with our vivacious guide Sunny.

review_title: Amazing time! Saigon after dark food tour.
review_text: We did the Saigon after dark food tour. It was great fun our guide Sunny was excellent and very knowledgeable. We where able to try many different delicious foods. The guys drove the Vespas where very good and we felt very safe zipping about the city.The hidden Café at the end was a real highlight of the tour and a lovely place to finish before being dropped back at our hotel.

review_title: Vespa Tour Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Upon arrival at my hotel in Saigon I immediately signed up for the Vespa Night Tour. What a wonderful exciting way to see the City and experience the culture. While visiting the city I did recommend to other visitors of the great adventure they will have on this tour. I highly recommend it.

This was our 3rd tour with Vespa Adventures and it was again an exceptional experience and amazing ride starting at 4:40 am to see the sunrise at Angkor Wat. This tour earns more than just one wow. Drivers and the tour guide were passionate about what they are doing. Great insights and great ride. We only can recommend a tour with these guys, better than other typical sightseeing tour. Chapeau

We definitely had a good time myself and my colleagues traveling through the streets of HCMC and visiting the different bars/restaurants.
Very well organised and friendly staff.
Recommended

we booked both the Saigon Night Tour and the Glimpse of the Mekong.

They were both fabulous as experience and could not wish for better as a mean to discover Viet Nam richness.

Members of staff were absolutely friendly and were always ready to make you comfortable or to outperform your expectations.

Sadly time were against us, otherwise we would have booked a lot more with Vespa Adventures.

They are a must to book with if you are planning a visit to Viet Nam.

Cheers to this state of the art business model and members of staff!!!

Recommend this to everyone who wants adventure......and experience being a local whilst in Vietnam, local food was delicious just try everything.
Really well organised and suited for all age groups....the guide was terrific and the riders are very experienced riders and I felt really safe at all times.
Even when the rains came down, pull over and out comes this big poncho so we stayed dry!!!!
Good way to see another part of Vietnam go on be daring you won’t regret a thing!

This was the highlight of my trip, Rosy took me to be best restaurant, street food, café and bar in Saigon, this was really the ride of my life!

Thank you Rosy, you’re the best!

review_title: What a fun way to see Saigon After Dark !
review_text:
Was a bit nervous about the traffic before I got on the back of the Vespa but my fears were unfounded ! My driver was so professional, caring and experienced. It was such a fantastic last night on our holiday, lovely welcome drink to meet our local guide , then onto 2 restaurants for delicious authentic Vietnamese food.
Live music at a local coffee cafe and rock bar for the last 2 stops .Did not want this night to finish !
Great value with so much food and drinks included so cannot recommend highly enough to anyone visiting Saigon !

What a wonderful tour this was. riding on the back of a Vespa at night in Saigon. Exciting. 5 stops and 9 courses of authentic Vietnamese food, finished off by a stop in a local Café for icecream and then a local rock Bar for some Music and dancing. We had a blast. This is a must do tour. Drivers and guide were all very professional.

Having been recommended to this by my sister in law who did the tour last year, I was a little nervous on my arrival in Ho Chi Min to see the amount of bikes we would be riding alongside. Once I got on the Vespa I was quickly reassured that I was in safe hands and I enjoyed driving round the city stopping at various restaurants and bars to sample lots of food and drink - there was in great supply! It was a great way to see the city and also to eat food that we probably wouldn't have tried otherwise. There was so much food on offer at various places and we even finished in a bar listening to an English singer. Lovely way to finish what was a very enjoyable evening.

These guys took us a passengers on their Scooters around Hanoi for a brilliant evening.
Visiting restaurants and Bars for a perfect evening, It was such fun. Just contact them and arrange your own adventure, Really really enjoyed it.

review_title: Great way to whizz around HCM
review_text: We chose the evening tour which when the heat of the day had died down. 9 Vespa drivers arrived at our hotel at 6pm and took us off around the city. Our first stop was a bar where we met our tour leader Sunny, then we were given drinks and asked what we would like for dinner. We then moved to our next location which was the restaurant where we had dinner which was delicious. We then moved on to a third location for some more food. Our 4th place was a cafe the atmosphere was great with live singers and the coffee wasn't too shabby either, kids were given ice cream instead of coffee. We also had 2 people turning 40 in our group and were given cake. Our final stop was a bar ageing with drinks and some dancing. Sunny looked after our every need through the whole tour, it is a must in HCM.

review_title: Best way for an authentic experience of the city!
review_text:
We were a group of 5 persons to book a day tour and we are so happy we have done it !
We booked by email one day before and the communication was very smooth.
Tam and the teams are really nice and do their best to offer you the best experience !
We visited different spots in different areas of the city, some popular among tourists and other ones off the track that only local people could know.
For those who are scared, don’t worry they are all excellent drivers and you will feel really safe!
100% recommended !!

review_title: Not as scary as I thought! And Lots of food!
review_text: We did the Food Tour in Saigon (Ho Chi Min). The drivers were very cautious. The food was amazing and so much! Having the drinks covered in each location was a delightful surprise. We especially enjoyed the live music venues we visited. We would have enjoyed being part of a larger group but our guide, Jenny was funny and delightful.

We, two friends, booked a Vespa tour in Saigon in the evenings. It was a beautiful and lasting
Experience and a highlight of our Vietnam holiday. We had excellent and very nice drivers and a companion who gave us a lot of information in a very likeable way. The drive through the nightly Saigon with the selected stations in restaurants and clubs was great. Excellent food, good artists and a rock club with a great atmosphere. It was a very successful evening and a lasting memory. We especially thank our companions and our drivers. The Vespa adventure is recommended by us to every Vietnam traveler and receives the best rating from us
Sunny and the team were gave us a great introduction to historical, cultural and culinary Saigon. The Vespa is a fun and exciting way to navigate the busy streets, Thank you

review_title: Great Way To See Parts Of The City You Wouldn't Otherwise See
review_text:
Vespa Adventures are so professional and run a great tour. We also used them in Cambodia and got the same experience. Their drivers are safe, and their guides are excellent. Our guide on this tour was Fully, and he was fabulous.
This tour took us to places we would definitely not have seen or found otherwise. Local markets and odd little things that were just really good experiences of local Vietnamese life in the city.
I highly recommend this, and on the back of the scooter is so much fun (my wife and I are 50+ and were very comfortable with them).

Christina was very knowledgeable and showed us a great time at the market. A great way to see more of the countryside and get outside the city. Ty and Hoa were great drivers and made us feel safe the whole time. Definitely recommend!

review_title: Phenomenal tour through streets of Saigon
review_text: Khanh and Teo picked us up on Vespa scooters and off we headed down streets of Ho Ch Minh, safely navigating around thousands of other motorbikes and vehicles past store fronts, buildings and crowds where we met up with Fuly, our foodie guide. Great fun, delicious food, unique experience. Even in the rain, with ponchos, we stayed dry and was not an issue.

Picked up from our hotel by two guys on vintages Vespas. Helmets provided and masks if desired. As it was nearly 40 years since I had last been on the back of a scooter. I was a bit apprehensive but need not have been as we whizzed off safely into the busy Saigon traffic. First destination the Zoom bar where we had a cocktails and were introduced to the rest of our group. Our guide, Sunny, made sure about any food preferences or allergies then it was off to our first destination. We visited a further 2 restaurants tasting delicious food that we would not have discovered on our normal tourist trail, then coffee and ice cream where Sunny had arranged for the singer to dedicate his next song to us and for us to have cakes. Then to our last destination, a bar with a great band. Our host was attentive and fun and our scooter drivers made us feel safe. When in Saigon you must try this trip!
We had a fantastic time. Great guides. A truly unique experience! Attention to detail was above expectations. Thank you!

Seven of us did this tour with Vespa Adventures last Friday on our last night in Ho CHi Mh an it was a real highlight of our two weeks in Vietnam. Our guide Danny was fantastic and looked after us extremely well! We had more food than we expected, or needed, but it was all so good. And all of us felt safe with our drivers. We ended up at a place playing live music and had a couple more beers. I would highly recommend this tour and cannot fault it!!

This is changing to a Best Western Plus and it was wonderful! Clean, new and nice decor. The TV reception was spotty and the water took 10 minutes to get warm but the place is in construction. What we loved most was the free nice breakfast, kind staff, and the locale and service to the airport. We were able to leave our car there all week. Good deal and nice area!

review_title: Great Experience for the First Night in Vietnam
review_text:
We were recommended to go on this tour by good friends and are so glad we added it to a busy itinerary.
Immediately after booking we received confirmatory emails that were personal. we confirmed just prior to travel and were given a genuine welcome and "look forward to meeting you".
My wife was very nervous, due to the shear volume of scooters and motorbikes on the road but the drivers, although young, were confident and competent.
We were picked up from our hotel and driven to the meeting point where we had our first drinks.
All meals and drinks on the trip were included but we were advised that it is customary to tip the drivers at the end, and they surely earned it.
We enjoyed both the experience of several Vespa journeys across the city and the experience of the places we visited, for food and entertainment.
I have recommended the tour to friends and I recommend it to you too. Hope you have the same wonderful experience.

A beautiful day. We had a lot of fun on board the Vespa. The staff is really very prepared, both the drivers and the guide have always accompanied us with great availability and kindness. Highly recommended for visiting the Mekong Delta.

My son and i had a fabulous time on our Vespa tour. We stopped off at different places to eat which was ll yummy. Felt very safe with the drivers an had a great hostess.It was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

We booked our Vespa Tour after seeing all of the great reviews. It was the highlight of our stay in Ho Chi Minh. Amazing food, great service, and definitely the best way to see the city. We have recommended to all our friends and will definitely do it next time we are in Vietnam.

review_title: So Much Fun - Saigon After Dark
review_text: We did this tour on our first night in Saigon and had so much fun! The drivers were awesome and our tour guide, Christina, was the best! I would definitely recommend - the food is delicious as well!

I had been nervous of doing this in the traffic of Hi Chi Minh city, but the drivers of the Vespas were not only super friendly, but super skilled drivers. Our main guide was delightful. The food in the restaurants was brilliant. Highly recommend the whole experience!

review_title: Saigon by night, food, drinks, music, the life of the city on a Vespa!
review_text:
"Saigon by Night on a Vespa "has been the most exciting adventure during our Vietnam tour so far. The vespa tour started at the hotel exact in time at 18:00 hours. Four “Riders” have been waiting for us. A short introduction and off it went through the dense traffic, at first a strange feeling but the drivers know what they are doing and we all started to feel well. At the first stop our host of the night, Kelsey, gave us a briefing about the tour and what we would see, taste and hear. The tour leads through some parts of the city, a stop at Cafė Zoom, drinks and a snack. After some introductory words, questions and answers about the city, we breezed further through the city towards the next stop at a well known (for the locals) seafood restaurant. Kelsey lead us in preparing and tasting the absolutely excellent food, the landlady passed by and brought more of the goodies. Then again mounting the Vespas and though the soft draft of the evening during the ride towards a pancake specialist, good food and drinks again and we heard more about customs and the way of life here in Saigon and further North. The two last stops were as special as the previous ones, the hidden cafė - it needs to remain hidden - good iced coffee and excellent music. (Especially one of the singers was remarkable !!!) and then a soft ride again in between all the other bikers towards a Rock Bar. A nice drink with a touch of Rock. All together an unforgettable evening. It is an excellent event for young and old (I am - by the way - 74 years old) and our guide Kelsey made our day, good English, many good hints and explanations, a charming young Vietnamese, a lady! Thank you all the team, thank you Kelsey! Riders Good Luck!
Weniger anzeigen
Best way to see the special sites of Saigon. Ride on the back of a Vespa with a skilled experienced driver for a thrilling morning tour.

I was a bit nervous before about this I met my Vespa Driver Mr Tuan and Miggi who led the tour as Saigon traffic is so busy . Tuan was an excellent driver who reasssured me and drove safely . Miggi was great fun and took us to 5 different places , all quite different eateries and two nightclubs with music . We went to places That we could never have found ourselves and it was amazing .Riding through the flower market was special . The food was delicious freshly cooked and so tasty .Stronly recommend this tour
Great tour. Despite the challenging traffic it felt very safe and all the stops were different and good fun.

review_title: Great way to experience Ho Chi Minh CIty
review_text: Super nice drivers and guides. Exploring Ho Chi Minh City on the back of a Vespa is a great experience.

Vespa Adventures was worth every penny we spent! A friend recommended we take the foodie tour when visiting Vietnam and she was absolutely right! I didn’t know which company to use but Vespa turned out to be the right choice. The drivers arrived on time and took us to the first stop, where we met our coordinator. Forgot her name but she was awesome! We joined four others and made several interesting stops. First a bar with drinks and snacks, then to a local restaurant for noodles and delicious seafood, Then on to more food… spring rolls and Vietnamese pancakes and lettuce wraps.
Then a stop to listen to live music in a cozy setting. And if that wasn't enough...coffee and dessert. Then on to a pub with live band and dancing. Adventure is the right way to describe this perfect evening of fun, food and friends. The drivers were friendly and took us from place to place safely. I highly recommend Vespa Adventures. It isn’t cheap, but you definitely get your money’s worth and more, Thank you VA for a fun-filled night! Our tummies were full from great eating, drinking and laughing,
Jim from Hawaii

review_title: The Ride of Your Life Vespa Adventure
review_text: This tour was definitely a highlight of our trip. An amazing way to see Ho Chi Min City on vespas driving through the maize of traffic. We felt very safe with our experienced riders that kept our group of 4 close together. The food and entertainment also added to the local experience. Our tour guide was also fantastic. Our teenage children also loved it.

It was our 1st time to HoChiMin. We have 12 years old daughter. Our friend recommended Vespa to us but my husband and daughter were not sure. We joined anyway and they love it.

It’s worth to do but have a light lunch. Otherwise, you won’t fully enjoy it.
Me and my friends had the best time on the Saigon Vespa tour. I highly recommend this for anyone who wants a whirlwind night of great food and drink.

This was the highlight of our the trip for all 11 of us, ages from 9 to 48. We felt so well looked after, the food was amazing, the drivers exceptional and the experience exhilarating. Whilst I was nervous of the thought of us on the crazy streets of Saigon, we felt so secure and it was just plain fun.
Had a great time on the Vespa Tour. We ate authentic food, rode around the city to multiple spots, and landed on some great music! I would definitely do it again!

Sunny was terrific in showing us around the markets and local food and local sights. It gave us a great introduction to the culture of the country. The drivers were exceptional and tool great care of our 12 year old.

Having previously been on three tours in Cambodia we booked up for two tours (Nightlife and Countryside tours) for our recent trip to Ho Chi Minh. Again we were not disappointed. Both tours were great, with great guides and riders. We would particularly recommend the Nightlife tour. So much food and drink available and they took us to some great sports which we would certainly have not found on our own.

Great way to experience HCM - especially if your new to vespas!! The drivers were amazing - felt completely safe in our party of 5, including teens and their grandmother. Fabulous opportunity to see the city and be a part of local mode of transport

We did the Vespa tour around Ho Chi Minh City, the drivers were very safe and they took us to places we would not have ordinarily probably gone. The guide was extremely good and knowledgeable. It also taught us how to cross the roads in the city , as that can be daunting. We learnt how the riders cope with traffic and pedestrians and realized that they just go around pedestrians and it isn’t as scary as you first think . Well worth doing and an awesome lunch at the end of our tour.

review_title: Great way to see the city!
review_text: I went on Vespa adventures and had a great time on my tour. My tour guide Kathy was incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. This was a great way to see different parts of the city that I was not able to walk to. The company also fed me before the tour and made sure I stayed hydrated during the tour. I had a lot of fun and would highly recommend Vespa adventures.

I was extremely nervous when we were picked up at our hotel by the two Vespa drivers. They were very understanding and after 5 minutes with them, I knew it would be ok. Our guide was also on her own scooter and we would stop at the various temples and landmarks. She was also an excellent guide. I am so glad we decided to partake in this as it was one of the highlights of our trip.
We had the most amazing of experiences. The whole evening was truly a thrill, really safe and very interesting. Thank you everyone involved.

review_title: Vespa Adventures: A great night out!
review_text: A fun adventure through Saigon! Staff was professional and enthusiastic. Sit back and everything is laid out for you to enjoy.

Like everybody else says, this is one great night. Lots of contrast, interesting things to eat, beautiful cafe live music experience where the crowd actually listens to and appreciates the musicians, then finished off with a classic nightclub ending. Hosted well with lots of attention, and Vespa riding skill and safety unquestionable in our case. This is in my top two!
We enjoyed the Ho Chi Mihn City Tour 100%. We felt safe all the time, on the bike and at all the stops. The best way to visit and to see places you wouldn't see without such a tour.

review_title: Our first trip on a Vespa
review_text: We really enjoyed being carried around in the crazy Saigon traffic. Both the drivers and the guide, Harry, were very charming and looked after us well. We felt safe all the time, visited a lot of interesting sites and were entertained as guests of honour. Many thanks to your team!

This tour was one of the highlights during our trip to Saigon. It’s run very professionally and is a lot of fun! You get all drinks and food included - and the Vespa drivers are very experienced, safe and lovely. Cannot recommend this tour more highly!!!

This was one of the best things I have done in Asia. Everything was so great, the food was so lovely and really was things I would never have tried or places I would have been without this tour. An abundance of it as well. Also they are not sparing with anything on the tour, whenever we wanted drinks we could get them, we took beer from bars on our scooter and had so much fun. Very safe drivers and great little Vespas, our host was amazing as well she could not of been more friendly/ informative or great. Couldn't recommend this enough!

An after dark ride through Saigon on restored vintage Vespa scooters. Sitting on the back with an experienced rider upfront you can enjoy all the thrills but none of the spills of Ho Chi Minh City's traffic. The three of us were met at our hotel at 6pm by our drivers; Tuan, Linh and An. We mounted up and were off. At our first stop we met Rosy our guide for the evening and after a briefing of what the night held in store we set off for our next destination and taste of classic Vietnamese street food.
The whole experience was unhurried, there was no sense of being on a fixed schedule and at our final stop (Carmen Bar) we stayed for an extra song or two and arrived back at our hotel at 10:30pm, 30 minutes later than scheduled.
In a sentence, a great way to sample HCMC's night attractions a definite 5 star experience.

We have been doing food tours all over Vietnam and this is definitely one we will do again next time we come back. The food is to die for and the places you visit you will never find on your own. Highly recommend

review_title: Saigon After Dark Orange Vespa Tour
review_text: This is a must do if you're in Saigon and fancy something different! So well organized with four stops which include fantastic food stops, places off on the beaten track which I don't think tourists would normally find! Last stop is a night club!! Really experienced drivers and a guide who meets you at every stop. Tran was our guide and she was superb. So glad I did this tour!

Yesterday I went with my sister and friend on the ‘Glimpse of the Mekong’ tour. We were picked up at 7:45am and returned by 3:30pm. It’s a long day in the sun but heaps of fun zooming to the countryside then stopping off at various places to look at life in the Mekong - local coffee shop, incense making, happy juice aka rice wine, and a temple. We selected fruit and shellfish from the wet market which was then cooked up for our mid-morning snack. The tour concluded with a delicious lunch at a stilted restaurant in D7. Na our tour guide was informative and fun, cracking jokes to keep us entertained.
The drivers are excellent keeping you safe on the bikes and in the traffic. You are provided with everything from bottled water, wet tissues, face mask etc. I suggest you take a lightweight long sleeve jacket/top to keep you protected from the sun when riding on the bike.
It’s a little more expensive than some of the other companies but you pay for what you get! There is heaps of food & water, and Vespa Adventures takes you to places off the beaten track and gives you an insight beyond the regular tourist mecca.
Thank you to Steve and his team for the super awesome tours they provide. This was my third tour with Vespa Adventures and the quality and standard of each tour has been outstanding. Always a highlight of my time in HCMC.
I can recommend this trip. Amazing view of Saigon with some really wonderful drivers thank you so much.

I went on the insiders tour of Saigon. Guide was Sunny, driver was Tuan. It was a great group - two other solo travelers and a family. It's a perfect and thrilling way to see Saigon in four to five hours including a couple of spots you really would never go to - a fascinatingly weird bird owners cafe (I can't describe it any better than that), a Chinese temple full of smoke and incense, an ancient medicines store. But the highlight by far was being on the back of the vespa weaving impossibly in and out of traffic. At first it was a bit scary (for someone who never does anything too scary) but by the end I was hooked, and planning to go on at least one (but hopefully two) more tours with these guys before I leave. Apparently it is a slightly pricier tour but it's worth it, spend the extra money- these guys are great

Wow🥰One of the most amazing things I have done!! It was the beast night out I have had for ages!! The view from the bikes when traveling around!! The food was amazing and then dancing at a night club with our guides!! Didn’t want the night to end💕Can’t wait to do it again

Very safe drivers. Helps you have the confidence to use and cross the roads safely and more determinedly. Quality and taste of the food superb. Knowledgeable and very friendly guide. All in all a super ride not to be missed.

We took the tour with our son (14) and daughter (21) and we all loved it. Health and safety? We felt perfectly safe at all times. You wear new helmets; sit on the back on your own seat; hold onto a bar (not the driver); your feet rest flat on the main footplate, away from the exhaust. The drivers were excellent, made sure we we're perfectly safe and never went too fast. We felt so safe and secure that we took pictures on our phones as we drove. They picked us up from our hotel and took us to a bar; a seafood restaurant (the soft shell crab was amazing); another buzzy restaurant (probably too much food at this point - you won't go hungry); an intimate little jazz/ live music place hidden away in the back streets (loved it) and then finished in a bigger bar with more live music, which we liked so much we stayed, danced and drank more cocktails. Tables were reserved everywhere, so you walk in like VIPs with food and drink ready for us and all included in the price. Our daughter doesn't eat seafood, so our guide drove on ahead to the first place and made sure there was delicious non-seafood dishes waiting for her - what service! We met some great people, saw all the sights of Ho Chi Minh City at night, ate way too much, drank a little too much too and had the best night of our holidays. Also because you're whizzing around on mopeds in 35 degree heat at night, the cooling breeze is a real treat. We can't recommend these guys highly enough.

review_title: Foodie & Drink Tour of Saigon After Dark
review_text: Ian and his mate David had an unreal night with TV their lively guide. Food, drink and company were awesome we don't have any hesitation in recommending them.

Very professional organization from start to finish. Email confirmation, picked up no problem, helmet on and ride into unbelievable roads of Ho Chi Minh City. Met our guide and another couple. After cocktails, we enjoyed 2 great restaurants, followed by 2 awesome musical venues. Didn't want to leave, Highly recommended.
This was a fun adventure, riding around HCM City at night with our young Vespa drivers with a few bar stops. We were three couples in our 60s and 70s. I highly recommend it.

review_title: Amazing Saigon at night by moped
review_text: Very professional company organized a truly memorable night out. Riding on the back of a scooter in Saigon must be the eighth wonder of the world. Unbelievable.

Great way of seeing the city and experiencing the busy streets by Vespa! Great food and local beers. Drivers were friendly and safe and our guide, T. Vi, who looked after us at every stop was excellent.

review_title: Best concerts and food all incl.
review_text: We did a street food in all cities during our trip to Vietnam. This one was the best. The drinks and food were all inklusive. We went to some concerts. We loved it.

After navigating the vespas as a pedestrian we decided it was time to see what it was like to be on one. And picking The Ride of Your Life was a great choice. They were so engaging and the stops were well planned out. It was a fabulous way to see Saigon at night.
an amazing experience; I feel a real part of Saigon! I recommend this to anyone seeking an experience that is out of the main tourist stuff!!

The exciting foody tour belongs to the best experiences we had during our Vietnam vacation. We enjoyed the good food, the well picked destinations and the very friendly staff. We highly recommend the tour.

This Vespa Ride in Ho Chi Minh City/Saigon was one of the best adventures I have ever done in my life. You feel the feeling of being alive. You do not stand in the sidelines you are right in the middle of it. The ride through the city was amazing, the food - in different street food restaurants was fantastic. Our guide Nguyen was very friendly and showed us how to eat these different types of street food. The last station of the tour was a music bar with excellent life music.

review_title: Great experience, wonderful food, superb staff
review_text: From start to finish we couldn't have wanted a better experience. Confidant, safe drivers HuyG10 and CTam, wonderful hostess Mai, great food and drink, great and diverse live music at multiple venues

It took a bit of time getting used to crossing roads in Saigon on foot due to the chaotic traffic, it was great to experience the traffic on the back of a Vespa. 'Who dares, wins......'. The street food was most enjoyable as were the beers.....
Was very friendly, classic, well maintained Vespas, felt safe at all times and was an excellent way to explore HCM City/Saigon

review_title: A fabulous peep at the old and new Saigon
review_text: I am delighted to have taken a half day Ho Chi Minh city tour with Vespa Adventures. Riding pillion seat on a refurbished Vespa driven by a very competent young man, and a charming guide for the four of us on this tour was memorable indeed. The lady, our guide, obviously loves Saigon, and took pride in showing us the less visited parts of this historic city. strongly recommended. PRADIP CHANDA
This was one of my favorite ever holiday experiences: well worth it in every sense. A fantastic way to see the night life and cuisine of the bustling Ho Chi Minh City.

Take it from someone who was so afraid of riding on the back of a Vespa on the busy streets of Hanoi - it was a great time. Each of the drivers were very careful and considerate, the food tour offered great selections and our guide was absolutely delightful!

I have done 3 day trips with this company in HCMC and all were brilliant. Miggy is a great tour guide. I highly recommend the Mekong Day trip (actually I 've done this twice - 5 years apart) and the brewery night tour around HCMC.
An authentic Saigon experience, enjoying the most amazing street food whilst learning about the culture and nightlife. A definite must-do when visiting Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City).

review_title: Evening tour with a taxi! We desidet to take a Taxi instead of a Vespa.
review_text: It was a really perfect tour. Our Lady-Guide was really nice! It was My husbands Birthday and she organized a Birthday-cake and a Birthday Song at the bar, for him! Really nice of her!
I was trying to ward off jet lag by staying awake and decided to book the craft beer tour. Very fun and interesting.

review_title: MUST DO IN HO CHI MINH
review_text:
We were on a world trip and this half day Vespa tour is one of our best memories! Well organized, safe, unusual and great fun. The guide was just perfect
The drivers either.
Highly recommended!!

Great fun to visit the city on a Vespa. I actually got to understand the traffic flow by being in it.
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Exciting ride. Amazing food. Lovely music. Tasty cocktails. Great organization. Me and my husband had fun all the way and enjoyed every minute of this great and unique experience.

review_title: You get to see a lot of Saigon!
review_text:
My friend and I did the Saigon After Dark tour on our first night in Saigon and it was absolutely amazing. The vespa rides were great (our drivers, Phong & Cuong were so friendly) - and you got to see a lot of the city -- driving through traffic and highways and through small streets.

Our tour guide (Hanh) was also super friendly and did such a great job leading us and answering questions while giving us enough space to enjoy ourselves. Food was great, the salsa bar at the very end with live music was a great way to end the night! Definitely a must do in Saigon/Vietnam

One of our most favorite memories of Vietnam. The drivers and certainly our guide were just so wonderful. All the restaurants etc. that we were visited excellent The food was amazing. It truly was the ride of our life.

We felt the trip was commercialized, and not authentic. The photographer was too much and distracting. The food was only fair, very greasy. Our drivers were lovely but other than that the experience was not enjoyable.
My wife and I done the Mekong day tour had a great time .tour guide Sunny was brilliant.will be Dack in June to do the after dark tour of HCMC with 12 people looking forward to it.

A fun way to spend an evening, the drivers safely navigated us through the city and backstreets to 'hidden' places with delicious streetfood and music. A helmet and facemask was provided along with a photo of our evening at the end of the tour, very sociable evening

review_title: Vespa Adventures in Saigon was awesome
review_text: The Vespa Adventures experience in Saigon, Vietnam was definitely a highlight of my 3 week tour in Southeast Asia. The ride was very safe. The experience stopping at various bars was terrific. And the best past was the last stop at the American rock & roll bar; there we all got up to sing and dance.

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip!!
review_text:
A truly wonderful, well organized thrilling motorbike food & drink experience.
The drivers were amazing given the unbelievable traffic & driving culture. The lady young guide was so full of fun and informative during this fabulous evening.

We had a great moment with Vespa Adventure team in Saïgon. Staff was very nice and drivers were very safe in Saïgon trafic jam. Our guide was also absolutely perfect. Vespa is a perfect way to visit Saïgon, especially at night.
We did 4 or 5 stops. All were very good, food but also entertainments. The Cooku's Nest was a fantastic place.
Don't hesitate to use Vespa Adventure in Saïgon.

Way better than expected. Highly recommended. This is a great way to experience parts of the city you otherwise wouldn't. It was like having a friend showing you around. This adventure was with 4 friends. We are from California.
You truly get the feel of a local, it's an incredible rush being on the back of a scooter. Just make sure you don't eat anything before you go as you get SO much food!!! Loved every bit of it!

Spent a month in Asia and this was the most incredible adventure and highlight of our trip. From the moment they picked us up at our Hotel, snap on our helmets it was nothing but smiles on our faces. Recommend it to everyone. Kathy was the best host and guide you could imagine. Thanks again for an incredible time!

review_title: A great way to see the city
review_text: Initial apprehension at joining the thousands of moped riders soon disappeared and our confidence grew with each stop. We saw a very different view of Saigon and thoroughly enjoyed the food at the different locations. The music in both the Piano Bar and the salsa club finished the evening on a high.
A lot of fun. At first I was nervous about the risk, but the driver was so good I was completely comfortable about a half hour into the ride.
Excellent experience. My wife and i loved it. Not as mad as they look. Really good driver and an excellent guide who told us stuff we would never have got from a guide book.

review_title: best way to explore Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) and beyond
review_text: Well organized enterprise, courteous, attentive. Excellent guides let you explore the city as you would never be able to do otherwise, with interesting insights into history, customs and folklore.
We got to see the city as the 'locals' do. We felt safe and definitely 'in the mix'! It is hard to imagine seeing all we did by foot in the amount of time we had dedicated to HCMC.

To be honest, we were not convinced we should do this as people in their sixties. But after a few minutes were aware there is no better way to take part in and become a part of the blustering traffic of Vietnam. We will never forget this perfect evening with our cautious young drivers.

It was a very nice experience for us because it was our first trip by vespa. Our guide ,I think Alina was very nice and very helpfull regarding our trip, restaurants and bars. Thank you and we'll recommend you to our friends.

review_title: Saigon Street Food on the back of a Scooter.
review_text: Safe and sound fun......speedily taken to some tasty street food cafes......plus free drinks and great music thrown in.....a memorable adventure !
Very well organized. If you have short holidays in Saigon, it is strongly suggested. Well done guys!

review_title: It was the ride of our lives.
review_text: Great fun, but a bit scary for two 70+ Year olds! Food great, entertainment excellent. A night to remember!

review_title: Nice to ride through Saigon on the Vespa!
review_text:
It was a really good tour. Only we wish that we had more time. We saw so much, but did not have much time to really walk around when we stopped.
I do recommend everyone to do this!
Excellent. Well organised. Very safe. A wonderful evening. Highly recommend. Although there were quite a few people going out we were kept in small groups just 4 in ours. Enjoy

review_title: Excellent Vespatour with very friendly guide, not to miss.
review_text: About 4 Hours of safe driving in the middle of many other Vespa Drivers wituout any dangerous Situation. Nice musicbars with life Music and typical Food on the way. A highlight of our tour through Vietnam, Cambodia and Laos.

Have been on a tour with Wendy Wu who arranged our ride.
It was excellent my driver Tuan and our guide Jenny were so nice, friendly and very helpful at all times. Best time whilst in Saigon. Would highly recommend it

4 hrs of non stop entertainment soaking the very essence of hi chi Minh. The restaurant stops were amazing. And the whole experience was truly memorable. We were a team of 13 men. We had a great time. Make sure you leave enough space in your tummy before the trip😉

review_title: brilliant way to see the city and so much fun
review_text: We did two tours with Vespa Adventures - one daytime and one evening - and absolutely loved them both. They were very well organized, including picking us up from where we were staying, really interesting, contained lots of variety and we felt very safe throughout despite the hairy traffic! Daytime one is more cultural and gave us the opportunity to see lots of the city we wouldn't have otherwise. Nighttime focused on food and drink and included great food, a tiny 'secret' bar with live singing and a kind of karaoke club. Everyone was friendly and we had a brilliant trip both times. Heartily recommended; brilliant memories. Thank you Vespa Adventures

I hesitantly agreed to go on a Vespa tour with friends we met on our trip throughout Vietnam and Cambodia. It turned out to be one of the best things I've ever done. It was not only fun, but very informative. We saw parts of Saigon we never would have seen on our own, in a much shorter period of time. Our tour guides and drivers were very professional and skilled. I' highly recommend this experience, and would definitely do again if I had the opportunity.
It was a nice ride with all our colleagues with good foods and drinks on the way. Also the night life of the Saigon City was also wonderful.

review_title: One of the highlights of the holiday!
review_text: We are so glad we did this trip! It was a great way to get out and about in the city at night and explore places we would never have found on our own. We loved being part of the city activity and we felt very safe with Thai and Thieu our Vespa drivers. Nicole was a fantastic host introducing us to street food, music and culture and she guaranteed the whole evening was relaxing and fun. We were picked up from our hotel at 6pm and met Nicole at the Zoom Cafe. From there our group of 7 visited a seafood cafe, pancake cafe, local coffee shop with live music, and finished in a lively Spanish style bar with a great band. In between we wove through the traffic of Saigon and took in the markets and sites all lit up at night. There was plenty of food and the drinks flowed without pause. We had so much fun and I think it would suit all ages. I have been recommending this trip to everyone I speak to. Make sure you book with these guys though, there are several other similar companies on line. Look out for the orange shirts and helmets!
The best way to experience the organized chaos of the traffic. Add to that the off the beaten track restaurants, bars and clubs they take you to, makes this a must do trip.

review_title: See Saigon from the back of a vintage Vespa.
review_text: The best way to see, feel, smell and taste a wonderful vibrant city like Saigon, especially one that is synonymous with scooters and the ubiquitous Vespa.

An absolute must if you are spending some time in Saigon. The drivers and tour guides were excellent. They were very knowledgable about the food as we have quite a restrictive diet. The rock bar at the end of the night was a particular highlight.

After seeing the traffic in Saigon we were very reluctant to get near the street traffic, let alone get on a Vespa and drive in it.
We're we wrong. By far the best part of our trip. This is something not to be missed. Our driver was courteous and extremely safe. Our stops for drinks, food, music and dance were fantastic. Do not miss this experience.
it was a very good night in the city. all well organized with a good and nice guide. the places were excellent and we could get a good idea of ​​the life in Saigon.

A ride on the back of a Vespa wouldn't have been my idea of ​​a night out, but being in a group of 13 people who wanted to do it I went along with them. It turned out to be one of the highlights of my holiday. The people, food and places you visited were excellent. Well worth the money, will do it again when I return xx
Such a great night. The drivers were fantastic and fun. The tour guide was accomodating and knowledgeable about gluten free dietary requirements.
The guide was friendly and knowledgeable. Drivers were very safe and skilled. A memorable experience- one of the highlights of our trip to Saigon.

We did the Saigon After Dark tour and we're amazed! It truly is “the ride of your life”! We ate great food and our group guide, Nicola, was fantastic at giving us foodie insights! Great bars and bistros and felt we wouldn't have found these places on our own, nor gone there on a Vespa! The drivers are friendly and careful and we feel safe in their capable hands! Totally recommend because it's a once in a lifetime experience!!!

The Insider's tour was thrilling yet we felt safe every step of the way. Fantastic way to experience Saigon, Alina was lovely, drivers knew what they were doing. We saw amazing sights and had a blast and would recommend for families with kids older than 8.

review_title: What a blast, cannot thank you enough,
review_text: Had this tour as an option on a scenic trip and what a surprise. We laughed all the way it was a great adventure on the road among the most hectic traffic in the world. Absolute madness but somehow felt safer than peak hour in Sydney. My driver Mr Phong and the rest were very calm and confident. The food was varied and abundant with a real local experience as we jumped from different locations and ended with some great voices in a small nightclub. No one from our group was dissatisfied with this adventure everyone saying how good it was. I have to congratulate our guide, Kathy, who was as professional as she was charming and funny. This experience was one of the highlights of our scenic tour.

I booked this trip in Saigon - only one word - WOW!! It was amazing exploring the city at night, having the opportunity to try different local foods and coffee I would not normally have tried, then enjoy some live music.
From the minute I was picked up from my hotel to being dropped off I was well looked after and felt completely safe on the roads and in company. I will talk about this Vesta adventure for years to come!

The tour was well organized, Informative and all the drivers were Exceptionally friendly and Caring. I did not feel unsafe at any time ( Even in Crazy Traffic ). It was so much fun that i could have done it all again the next day. I would highly recommend Onion and the rest of the lads. The lunch was one of the best meals i had had on the trip. I'm ceoliac and they were all over it, making sure that there was no cross contamination. The whole of my tour group had huge smiles on their faces the whole day.

review_title: A Blast on our last night in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Don't miss this one, what a blast, Tam, a top person, and his crew looked after us so well, took us to places we might not normally get to see, we always felt safe, we just traveled with the traffic negotiating corners and roundabouts in the manner that's done in Saigon, the food was tasty, delicious, and plenty of it, plus night clubs for young and old along with a few drinks. I recommend anyone should dismiss any apprehensions of going on a scooter in Saigon and just enjoy the skills the locals have learned to navigate in their city. We will do it again.5 stars.

My husband and I booked this tour after recommendations from a friend. It was seriously one of the best tours we have ever done. We had a great bunch of people with us and the guides were second to none. We did the Hoi An Food tour and we would highly recommend this as a must do experience. If you are in Hoi An or planning to go..... put it on the list of things to do.

My friend and I were recommended to do this tour in Ho Chi Minh and I am so glad we did. There can be no better way to experience how the traffic in this amazing city works than on the back of a beautifully reconditioned vintage Vespa! We were taken to fantastic restaurants and bars, had mouth watering street food and all with a fantastic team of tour guides and safe Scooter drivers. Thanks to all Mark and John!

Should anyone be visiting Saigon, this is a must try experience they should not miss.

We had booked this tour as part of our itinerary traveling through Vietnam. Having seen the way the traffic negotiates it's way around Saigon, I must admit that I was feeling a little apprehensive whilst waiting in our hotel lobby, for our pick up. I need not have worried as this after dark tour was absolutely fabulous, literally “the ride of your life”.

We were part of a small group who were taken to a number of street food outlets, off the beaten track, so to speak. The food was really very good and plenty of it, along with drinks at every stop.

Our guide was very informative and our riders were amazing, they were very polite, attentive but above all, they were very skillful and competent.

This tour lasted approximately four and a half hours and took in some sights that you probably will not have seen under your own steam. It was a fun experience that I would not hesitate in doing again, if the opportunity arose.

C. Briggs, England.

This is a MUST if visiting HCMH. The traffic is crazy, but the riders are very safe - such an amazing experience, with a knowledgeable and friendly tour guide. Same tours available in other SE Asian cities, which I would definitely do if visiting these.

If all you have is one night in Ho Chi Minh, this is the 'must do' tour. We were picked up at our hotel and whisked away on the back of a Vespa into the streets of Ho Chi Minh just as the sun started to set. Bring your camera, your appetite and your sense of adventure as you join the hundreds of other vespas working their way through the roads of Ho Chi Minh. Jenny was the ultimate tour guide as we enjoyed a beverage at Zoom Cafe before heading to two more amazing 'street food' restaurants for the ultimate in Vietnamese cuisine. Then off to a romantic lounge that is off the beaten track for a yummy dessert before heading to a music club for some live music. It was definitely the 'ride of my life'.
4 craft breweries, awesome food pairing at each, well organised, safe riders, a must do tour in Ho Chi Minh.

review_title: Fantastic and not to be missed
review_text: We have just got back from a two week trip to Vietnam and one of the highlights was this After Dark Saigon Adventure. This is a well organised and professional operation that takes you to numerous destinations to sample drink and food. Our 'host' was Sunny who was bright and happy and gave us a great evening and the drivers were very reliable and trustworthy. When my wife booked this I was disappointed that I wasn't going to be driving (having grown up on Lambrettas), but when you get to Vietnam you'll know you made the right choice to leave the driving to those with experience of those roads. If you're hesitating to book this experience, don't because you'll regret it. Book it and have a great evening.

Billed as Saigon after dark tour this was just an amazing experience. Lots of fun with just the two of us being transported around the manic streets of Ho Chi Minh City with scooters, cars, buses and everything else coming straight at us!. The drivers were superb, making us feel very safe and confident. Our guide Trinh was helpful, knowledgable and very friendly telling us all about the various street food venues that we stopped at, the local food and nightlife. We ended the tour at a nightclub where several singers performed English, French and Vietnamese songs. An experience I will treasure for ever - stunning.

review_title: Sunny side of Saigon! Night tour.
review_text:
Brilliant idea! Fantastic tour and great value for money. Fun, and informative and felt very safe riding around on the back of a scooter in the crazy land of no road rules vietnam! Sunny was our guide and was brilliant! She was funny, interesting and totally engaging. Drinks were included which we didn’t expect and we even got the chance to try a lot of different food.
As it was our wedding anniversary Sunny even arranged a cake and fir the music venue to play a song for us. Randomly and without knowing it was our Wedding song!
Great company and if you can get Sunny as your guide she will brighten your night! (Genius, can’t teach it! 😉)

To be sat on a back of a scooter amidst the manic traffic of Ho Chi Minh City was an experience which at first seemed daunting but at the end was exhilarating.
Part foodie adventure, part music experiencing, the stops we had, be it to sample food or listen to music, was something we are so glad we did.
I would have given 5*, the only reason being that the stops, especially at the two music venues, were not long enough.
Personally, we would have done an individual scooter ride to sample the food and another for sampling the music scene.
Something the company should consider.

This was a lot of fun. 28 of us on our tour participated in this optional event. We thoroughly enjoyed it and it was not anything we thought we would ever do. We knew our children and grandchildren get a kick out of our participating. The last stop of 5 was a bar with great music and we loved to dance. Turned out to be highlight. The first three stops were progressive dinner, then dessert, then dancing! A fun evening for 80+ year olds!

review_title: What fun! Most memorable experience of trip
review_text: Cocktails and then a crazy ride on the back of a Vespa thru the evening rush hour traffic to a crowded street brimming with street food vendors and restaurants. We sampled 9 dishes at two restaurants - one that specialized in seafood and the other a form of rice pancakes. Great authentic food. Dinner was followed by music at two venues; the Hidden Cafe and a bar that played rock music. After that, another Vespa ride back to the Hotel in traffic that never seems to abate. Our host, Kathy, was charming and attentive. This tour is excellent for just about everyone of all ages.

My mother and I had a fantastic time being driven around Saigon by Nam and Ting (?) and a friendly, knowledgable tour guide (Fully). Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Saigon - Vespa is the best way to see the city!!

This ride through Saigon traffic was the most fun we’ve had in a long time. The young women in charge were energetic and professional; very organized. Our drivers were skilled and fun! It was crazy, but safe fun. Helmets for all!
We had street food in two locations (delicious)and finished the night in a nightclub, with songs from three talented singers.

Anyone who knows what Saigon traffic is like may wonder at the sanity of those who opt to take a ride on a Vespa in order to experience the sights and the tastes on offer. They are probably right to do so, but Vespa Adventures provides an experience that is utterly safe yet totally exciting. Our drivers took great care of us, weaving through the streets and the traffic with assurance and skill, pointing places of interest, and depositing us at each food/music venue to meet our 'foodie guide' in perfect time for the next gastronomic treat. We were introduced to new culinary techniques and flavors and got to eat an array of fabulous food. And to top all that we were Vespa-ed to a couple of tucked away music venues for coffee and drinks. The musicians performing were tremendous. We can't thank our drivers and guides enough for giving us such lasting and delicious memories of Saigon.
We really enjoyed our tour of SAIGON, would go again for sure, drivers were safe, and I don't usually do motorbikes at all. Enjoyed our lunch too!

If you want to get an insider's view of Saigon and have a great time doing it in an usual fashion, Vespa Adventures can't be beat
We had taken this half-day tour of Saigon on the back of a Vespa nearly 4 years ago and remember it having been so much fun that we decided to do it again on this visit. It was fantastic! We were picked up at the cruise ship and taken to the restaurant for a cup of coffee and an explanation of our tour from our tour guide, “Sunny” who then joined us on the rest of the trip, which was 4 hours in length. We cover the length and breath of the city, including a special park, Chinatown, the flower market, the Chinese Pagoda of 10,000 Buddhas, and several other significant stops. Sunny gave us a great explanation of the history and customs and people of the country. We learned a lot and felt we really got to know Vietnam much better this trip, thanks to our drivers and ”Sunny.” We felt completely safe even though we were riding in the unbelievable Saigon traffic. The drivers were extremely competent and concerned about our safety.
I can't recommend Vespa Adventures enough-Communication from the very beginning was excellent and they addressed every concern that we had, including my dietary restrictions, since lunch was included in the tour. All I can say is if you want a really great adventure in Saigon go for Vespa Adventures!

As a family of four we had an awesome adventure! Trying and our Vespa drivers took us on a fantastic ride through The city! Food was delicious and experiencing Saigon at night allowed us to see local life. Our preteen and teen loved it and enjoyed the music! Thanks for keeping us safe and an awesome adventure!

review_title: A fantastic end to our holiday in Vietnam
review_text:
We had a fantastic night tour. Everything was organized to ensure our safety and enjoyment. It was wonderful touring the city at night in this way. We loved the idea of ​​stopping at different places for food (which was excellent), drink and entertainment. We left at 6pm and got back to the hotel at 10.30pm. A generous tour. There were six in our group, which was a nice number.
It was my first time on a motor scooter. I had no qualms at all about being out on the road. It felt perfectly safe. The traffic looks chaotic but it is not aggressive and drivers look out for each other.

My wife and I were picked up at our hotel by the two vespa drivers who were to transport us the entire evening, and taken to a cafe where a large number of customers were gathered by the company to be briefed. It was the rush hour, which is pretty crazy in Ho Chi Minh City if you are not used to it, and at first my wife and I were both a tad nervous. However our drivers were both very good and made us feel safe. Once we got used to it, riding around in heavy traffic on the back of a vespa was fine. At the first cafe we ​​met our guide for the evening, Miggy, and enjoyed our first complimentary drink. There were two other couples in our group and we then proceeded (on our six vespas) to our first stop at a seafood restaurant some 20 minutes away. The food there was first class. We then went on to a pancake restaurant perhaps another 20 minute ride away where the food was also good. Then to a bar with live music where we enjoyed a dessert or another drink. We finished up at a rock bar where it a succession of singers were performing with the house backing group. The atmosphere was great. All the drinks throughout the evening were complimentary (ie included in the price of the tour). The only downside is that we had to tear ourselves away from the rock bar after 10 pm in order to be delivered back to our hotel on our vespas.

review_title: Great way to see the city!
review_text: We did the Local afternoon your in Ho Chi Minh City. We booked only a few hours in advance using the chat feature on the website. Everything was amazing! We experienced sights of Saigon we NEVER would have found or appreciated on our own. Zipping around the city on a motorbike was super fun, and we felt very safe with our drivers. Would highly recommend.

review_title: A Glimpse of the Mekong - a true insight into the local's life outside Saigon
review_text:
I booked this adventure quite late but thanks for the organizers, they managed to take me for a ride. And what a ride it was!

I was picked up from my hotel right on time, then we went to the local coffee shop to meet the team. Tam was my ever so reliable driver on the Vespa while lovely Na was my dedicated tour guide. Tam knew pretty much all the cracks, bumps and shortcuts on the road and drove very safely, even in the country side.
But Na was the one who really made this trip special. She was lovely, friendly and very keen to answer to all my questions and trust me, I had a lot of them :)

The market was awesome and how she chatted with the locals. Clearly they all love her too. Then we went to a small stall area where the food we bought on the market was cooked for us and it was delicacies and plenty.

We then visited some locals and Na told me their stories. It was quite shocking to learn how little some of them can earn. We tried the local rice alcoholic drink which was yummy. Na, if you read this, you need to try our Hungarian traditional drink called Palinka :) you will like that too!
After that, we visited a local church (?) and ended the tour at a wonderful place where we ate more food :)
Thanks Na and Tam for the fun!
Domi
adventure in Ho Chi Min City. We really really hade the time of our lives. God food, nice service and really god music!!

After watching HCM traffic I was very nervous about being on the back of a scooter. My driver was very confident and put me at ease, it was exhilarating! Our guide Vy was such good fun, she was very knowledgeable and explained a lot about our food and life in Vietnam. 5 stops with some amazing and fascinating food (9 courses all together), you won't go hungry! I had 3 Mojito at the first stop! Music at hidden cafe was beautiful followed by the fun rock bar. Loved the whole experience, thank you Vy. X

What a great evening tour. To experience riding a Vespa in the busy city was incredible. We were collected from our hotel and taken to the first location, a roof top bar with great views. Our guide was Sunny, she was excellent and our two drivers were brilliant. We had lots of laughs, Sunny was amazing. We went to two locations for food and finished off at a music bar for a coffee. A great tour.

Excellent time! Best thing to do right when you arrive! It puts everything else you do into perspective.
Young, fun and committed crew shows off their navigator skills as they whisk you from one great destination to another. The noise, the harmony, the smoke, the fun and all the near misses are part of the ride.
Authentic locations, real food culture and cold beer make a most memorable night in Ho Chi Minh!
Special thanks to Ty, Dien & Khan for taking great care of us.
Take the ride!

review_title: A great way to see HCMC
review_text: From the moment you are greeted, you are in good hands ok this tour. Proper helmets, masks and a comfortable seat on the bike. The food is great (and in abundance!), the places are authentic, full of locals, and drinks are free flowing. The drivers are incredibly safe too. But the best thing is the little touches - a free keyring, a postcard and a printed & mountain picture of you, your driver and your guide, all done by the time the tour ends! Amazing, 10/10.

Tonight we went on a Vespa adventure which was truly one of the highlights of our trip. We experienced local foods in restaurants off the beaten path. The food was all outstanding!! The music (in 2 venues) was superb!!
Rosey our tour guide was fabulous! Her excitement and knowledge about each segment of the adventure was contagious! We loved being part of the motobike scene. Thank you Rosey and Vespa Adventures!

review_title: Great way to see the city and fun for teens
review_text: We booked this as part of a package put together by a travel agent and it was probably the most fun our two teen daughters had on our Vietnam trip. The drivers are really fun and great at navigating the chaos that passes for traffic in the city. Although there were often other Vespa Adventures groups at each stop, it never felt like the tourists were overwhelming the places we visited. The food stops were all really good and our guide, Nicole, was super informative about the food, neighborhood, culture and history. The last stop was at a live music bar, and unfortunately our younger teen girls were not so psyched about being crowded in, and all the smoking and drinking. So we decided to call it an early night. But that in no way detracted from the overall fun of the evening. Highly recommended.

4 of us went on the Vespa adventures and had a brilliant time. Over 4 hours travelling around the city , visiting restaurants , bars and just mixing it in the traffic. Recommend to anyone and dont think you are too old - it’s fun for all ages!!!!

We signed up for the Vespa Adventure in HCMC...4 hours on a Vespa going from bar to restaurant. Our friends had done it and highly recommended it. Well, I have to say we had a fabulous time. The stops for food were great and they were so organized and got us seated and fed in short order. I wasn't sure how much time we would actually spend on the scooter but was pleasantly surprised that it was a lot! We also saw parts of the city we would never have seen and ate at places we would not have dared on our own.
Our favorite stop was the Coffee House. The performers were exceptional and we would have been happy to spend the rest of the evening there. The drivers are very safe. Don't hesitate putting this on your itinerary! It is worth the money.

review_title: Best way to see & experience the "kinetic" energy of Vietnam
review_text:
My wife and I just returned from Vietnam, and we booked our Vespa Adventure in Saigon and loved it so much that we booked again with Vespa Adventures in Hoi An and Hanoi. We had a blast!

Highly recommend the city dining tours as the best way to see the sites, experience the "kinetic" atmosphere of the streets, and sample true local cuisine. We only went to places where the locals eat. The only other tourists were other Vespa Adventurers.

Tour guides were awesome and took the time to engage us with some of the food prep, and the Vespa drivers were safe and always right there with a smile and our helmets.

By the time we were on our 3rd Vespa Adventure in Hanoi, we felt comfortable enough to take video and even ham it up for our forever memories.

My wife and I are both in our sixties, and we think this is a "must do" for anyone visiting Vietnam.

review_title: Zooming the streets of Saigon (HCM City)
review_text: It was the end of our tour of Vietnam. Our Tour Director, Huy recommended Vespa Adventures and as ever, he was right. It was the perfect experience to end our discovery of Vietnam. At the very beginning of our trip he taught us how to navigate nightmarish Vietnamese traffic (rules are a mere suggestion) so that eventually we crossed streets solo. It was a dreamlike experience to ride on the back of a Vespa in the middle of a dense pack of scooters, motorcycles, bicycles and cards. Everyone was close enough to touch but no one threatened, screamed, gestured rudely. Everyone was in the zone.
