Otherwise we rode from cafe to cafe happy in our cocoon of wine, beer, massive amounts of delicious seafood and finished at a pair of music clubs. I haven't done that in years. Great evening. Would love to do it again.

Loved it. Take a spin into the nighttime rush. Cars bikes scooters mopeds all horns blazing. Soak in the apparent lack of road rules. Everyone seems to know where they are going and how to get there. Weave in and out of the traffic and then stop and enjoy fabulous food stops. Meal courses in the middle of city sightseeing. I cant recommend this tour enough. I felt completely safe and confident in my driver. What a way to see the city.

If you enjoy an adrenalin rush then this is for you! Even though I am not a biker this was fun and it felt safe even though the streets of Saigon are hectic to say the least. The drivers are very efficient.
The food tour is a great way of tasting the local cuisine although it is all pretty basic. It was well organized and you stayed with your small group all night allowing for a level of intamacy.
A great way to spend an evening in Saigon.

The nervousness lasts only a few minutes and the drivers expertly take you through the crazy traffic - you'll end up wanting more!
Food was good and Nicole a great guide to explain the wide variety of dishes you get to try. This tour is not only great fun but an excellent introduction to Vietnamese food.

A brilliant Vespa tour- small groups, local places, great drivers and guides. We saw a rival tour group who were going around in a group of 25- we were 3! So felt very authentic and local- they do this deliberately and split up the larger group so you really feel like you have an authentic experience and aren't part of a huge package excursion. Highly recommend!!!

We spent 4.5 hrs on the backseat of the Vespa in HCMC incl. several stops for cocktails, food and live music breaks. That was a fantastic trip with our two drivers Son and Dung and the guide Fully. Safe all the time and be entertained at it's best. Amazing food tasting like froglegs, best view from the rooftop bar and original vietnames music. T-you very much, guys! You were the best of Vietnam! The trip was arranged by the german internet agency: erlebe-fernreisen.de. So barr in mind this ride for everyone who likes to join Vietnam.

review_title: Great experience! - Street food by night
review_text:
The drivers picked us up at our hotel by Vespa and took us to meet the guide and the others in the group. We had a couple of stops for drinks and street food. We tried almost everything - not the best option for vegetarians but the experience of eating street food is great anyhow. Clean and safe!
The vespa ride itself is just amazing...crazy but great feeling. I felt safe all the time despite the craziness given by cars and scooters around.
T.Vy, our guide, was amazing. She made the night special with her entertaining skills and positive energy.
Overall it was the best tour in HCM City and we definitely recommend these guys!

We had a great night and even thought about taking a second tour. Next time! They pick you up at your hotel and explain your evening to you then off you go. We were in a group of 5 and we got to see Saigon in a different way on a vintage vespa. The food and drinks were great. Its an adventure you don't want to miss. Great guide and driver.
A superb night from start to finish. Great guides & drivers, interesting sights, fantastic food & drink, fabulous entertainment. Everything about Vespa Adventures is highly recommended.

review_title: Could you have any more fun in Saigon? I doubt it!!!!!!!!!!
review_text:
I've done a lot of crazy things in my travels around the world, but none beat the experience of Vespa Scootering in the crazy Streets of Saigon. I know - you have witnessed the wildness that is Saigon traffic, millions of motor bikes, cars, buses, no traffic laws that I can see. The last thing you want to do is jump on a scooter. Wrong. Best, most enjoyable, and absolutely safe evening my wife and I have had in years! The Vespa drivers were safe and courteous, knew the ins and outs of getting around. Yep your right there in the mix of things! Totally outrageous, but after a few minutes - totally at ease cruising the streets like you done it all your life. The drivers connect you to your personal guide who is with you the rest of the night on her own scooter. Can't tell you where we went - District 1, 4 - who knows. They give you a card with all the restaurants and bars we are to visit. They explain where your going, but from the back of the scooter good luck keeping track. Off the beaten tourist path, local restaurants, cool little coffee shop with live music, and then ends up a a "western" type bar for a night cap. Food was great. Drinks were flowing. "Sunny" our guide was over the top fabulous. Could not have had a better evening.
Anyway - Don't hesitate booking - young - old - go with the flow. You will not regret!!!!

review_title: Great tour, perfect adapted to gluten-free Diet
review_text: We had a great experience in Saigon with Vespa Adventures! Honestly there is not too much to see in Saigon because it is so huge. But with the Vespa tour we got a great experience. I would highly recommend it to everyone who doesn’t have time to discover it on their own. And besides that it’s a lot of fun driving with a Vespa trough the city. My driver Q. Quan was a very safe and super nice driver. Our local guide Hoang was very kind and funny. Since I am celiac and can’t eat gluten it’s a little difficult in Vietnam but with Vespa adventures it was no problem. Hoang always took care of me and showed me what I could eat.

We did a Vespa City tour in Saigon. They did well above expectations.
The Vespa drivers drive you through Saigon without any problem and the guide tells you all kinds of fun, special and sometimes horrifying stories about the city. Really recommended

review_title: Great trip with Vy and her boys!
review_text:
We went on the craft beer experience but after 3 breweries we really wanted pho and VY and her team were so lovely, they changed location and brought us to eat and explained everything and talked a lot about local culture. Had an awesome time with them and although the traffic at rush hour was seriously manic, felt safe the entire time with them.
Really enjoyed it.

We both loved the morning tour to orient ourselves to HCMC as well as the craft beer tour of four brew pubs. It is fun to be on one of those motorcycles, instead of being mowed down by them. I had complete confidence in our drivers.
Brilliant evening - great restaurants and bars plus an exhilarating ride around town : felt safe despite traffic and driving. Really recommend this if you have a spare evening in HCMC

I spent a few hours as a pillion rider with Tuan and Kathy as a guide. Tuan drove very safely and Kathy was great with her local knowledge. A must if you want to experience the delights of local life. Highly recommended

One of the best tours we have taken and well worth the money. A perfect opportunity to experience the excitement of riding a Scooter in what must be the craziest traffic in the world without the danger of driving yourself along with the chance to try amazing foods, Coffee House and live band night club all in one fun packed evening.

The restaurants were filled with locals that speak of the quality of the foods you are about to eat. The Coffee House was relaxing as was the live music there. Can't say enough about the Night Club. The entertainer was like watching an Asian Freddy Mercury. To top it all off they even include beer at each stop and a Mai Tai at the Night Club. Hard to beat the fun and value of this tour.

This was our very first night in Vietnam and what an amazing start to our holiday! Our travel agent recommended this tour,by simply saying it was a food tour. He had asked if Iwas comfortable on the back of a motorbike and I had said “no” - I did not realise he was talking about this particular tour, but it was all arranged that we went by car with the Vespa guide. She came to our hotel to collect us and what an amazing evening it was! First she took us to a local outside place, for drinks, sitting amongst the hustle and bustle of Saigon’s streets. Then off to a fish restaurant. Sitting amongst locals on low chairs and the food just kept coming. An amazing amount and incredible choice! My husband is strict vegetarian- no meat, chicken or fish and no fish sauce. There was a fabulous collections of vegetarian (and fish dishes for me to also enjoy) . The food was amazing and we enjoyed every last bite. We had no idea that we were then going to a pancake restaurant to sample an array of spring rolls and summer rolls and other types of delicious savoury pancakes and rounding it off with watermelon. Then off through the back streets to a small coffee house/ folk bar to enjoy local music and sip ginger tea. Lovely! And to round off the evening, we then went to a very lively bar, filled with locals (all much younger than us!) enjoying pop music on What was Valentines Night. An amazing evening and huge thanks to our guide, Na - she was wonderful and such a delight to spend the evening with. A real pleasure meeting her! A fabulous way to start our vacation. Thank you!

We probably would not have booked this had the travel agent not done so. However once you get over being on the back of a Vespa and being in Saigon traffic it is a hoot. Nicole marshalled us about and kept the drinks flowing. She explained about the food so we understood not just what we were eating but the significance of the food and how to eat it properly. The drivers were great. On the back you do not really need to hold on so can get pictures as well as people watching other bikes and their passengers-kids, ladies riding side saddle, dogs etc etc. GO.

review_title: Best way to really see Ho Chi Minh
review_text: We loved it! Absolutely loved every minute of this experience. I can’t recommend improvements b/c it was perfect in every way.

There were 4 of is last night, each on the back of a Vespa with our own driver each. We also had a host, who met us at each stop and explained the area and the food, and answered a million questions. There were 5 stops; cocktails, food, food, coffee or drinks with singers backed by piano and violin, then drinks at a club with a pop band. Crowded, energetic and fun. The drivers were expert and made us feel safe (!) In a very crowded traffic city. We scooted past many landmarks and neighborhoods. Nam (our host ) was very friendly and a font of knowledge. Food was good. Drinks were legit. A must-do!

After seeing the traffic in Ho Chi Minh City I feel very apprehensive about this trip which was booked by our travel company. I was so wrong. This is just an amazing experience - such care was taken by Sunny our tour guide to make we had the best time with amazing food, fun and laughter. Met some amazing people on our trip who all felt the same about this experience. The food was delicious. I highly recommend this experience to anyone even the over 60s!

review_title: Great night out - Saigon After Dark
review_text: Neil and his two riders gave us an excellent tour of the city at night. They took us to places we would never have gone to or found on our own. I wasn't very well and they were very accommodating shortening the trip for us (to 3 instead of 4.5 hours). My husband ate the food and he said it was very good. We are late 50s and think it was one of the best tours we've done in the four weeks we've been away. We felt completely safe all the time, even though the streets are mad! I loved it even though unwell, and would have enjoyed it even more if I'd been ok and been able to eat and drink. If you get a chance to do it, you won't regret it.

Great fun!

We are in our mid-60s so given what was for us, the hair-raising driving of motor cyclists in this city, we started out on this adventure with some trepidation. However, our two drivers, N.Tu and Loc, drove with great skill and, most importantly, managed to keep us safe.

We were taken first to a cafe where we enjoyed cocktails and were introduced to our host for the evening, Nicole, a very friendly and charming young Vietnamese woman who accompanied us to each of the venues. From there we were driven to our next two venues, both 'street food' restaurants, one a little more casual than the other. We were served lots of tasty dishes at each but there was so much food that, sadly, we were unable to do it justice. Our next venue was a 'secret cafe' hidden up a small alley way where, in an intimate setting, was live music - we watched and listened to a series of several singers, whose performances (some in English and some in Vietnamese) we really enjoyed. We decided not to go to the final venue, a bar with dancing, as we were given the option, instead, to stay a little longer at the cafe.

We loved our journeys by Vespa, a wonderful way to see the city at night and, thankfully, were in safe and experienced hands. Overall, it was a great experience which we would thoroughly recommend.
Great fun. Amazing drivers so no matter your age you will feel safe. You get to see the city and taste local food as you go. Well worth doing!

review_title: Awesome experience! You feel like a local
review_text: We had a great time with Vespa Adventures. The staff is really nice, prepared and fun. Riding a Vespa with experienced drivers makes you feel like a local in Ho Chi Minh. We had AMAZING food in two restaurants, then we went to a secret concert and we ended with rock music in a local bar. I highly recommend a tour with Vespa Adventures, it's a really fun and true local experience.

Our travel company suggested this tour for us so we had no expectations. We only had two days in Saigon and this was a perfect way to end our trip.
It was a thoroughly enjoyable experience. Driving around the frenetic streets of Saigon with experienced drivers seeing all of life pass by was very exhilarating. Yes, there were other Vespa adventure guests at some of our venues but by no means were the restaurants solely full of foreigners. The food was amazing. The secret location was a charming shabby chic intimate venue with a mixture of Vietnamese and foreign guests and the artists performing were extraordinarily talented. Likewise, the rock cafe.
This was a marvellous experience and to be highly recommended.

Vespa Adventures was recommended by a friend and we absolutely LOVED our Insiders' Saigon tour. We were picked up at our hotel, right on time, by experienced scooter drivers (a necessity in a city with seemingly insane traffic). Met with our awesome Tour Guide, Fully, at Cafe Zoom and had a friendly conversation. Fully laid out all the details of the tour we were about to take and then we were off! It's hard to say which part was more fun - riding on the back of the Vespa in Saigon traffic or Fully's in-depth information and wonderful tour. We felt like we learned so much about the city that we couldn't have experienced otherwise. This unforgettable activity is a must-do in Saigon, hands down.

We were picked up on time at our hotel & the two Vespa drivers were absolutely safe. We then met Hoang at our first stop who stayed with us and looked after us all evening. His English was excellent & he was entertaining, providing numerous interesting facts together with a bit of fun. A drink, a starter, an main course and a sweet at 4 different places, all authentic Vietnamese establishments & the last a nice jazz club. We learnt quite a bit about Vietnamese cuisine which was handy on the remainder of our trip and had an absolute hoot on the bikes. Ensure you are hungry as there is quite a bit of food!

We were apprehensive about whether we would feel safe, but any worries vanished at the beginning of the 4-hour tour. The tour guide and drivers were first class, the food was excellent, and the entertainment was super. Highly recommended.

Despite strong nervousness to be part of unbeliveable Friday Night trafic in Saigon, we got an unforgettable experience. The two drivers did at great work, we felt completely safe and got one more jackpot at our Vietnam Roundtrip; experience the Vietnamese people and the city life from a Vespa/motorbike rear seat - beeing part of the crowd. We got fantastic view, nice drink, even more delicious and exiting Vietnamese gourmet street food ending up in a “hinden” coffee shop/club packed with people excellent skilled musicians performing live music. The chief attraction of the day was the guide Hoang. Beside beeing a very pleasant person, he carried out hvis guide job so well, we felt ourselves in a timeless soap boubble with humor, discussions abort Vietnamese people and culture and not least, a look into challenges and dreams of a bright Vietnamese young man. Our greatest honor to this arrangement/package.

What a wonderful way to start your day. We were picked up from our hotel by our amazing guide Flower and the two incredibly skill riders Quoc and Orange and driving through beautiful rural Hoi An and the surrounding area. There were plenty of stops along the way including the ship yard, coffee roasting house and then lunch overlooking the river. Our three traveling companions couldn't have been any more friendly or attentive. A really enjoyable trip made even more special traveling on vintage Vespas.

review_title: Saigon on the back of a vesper!
review_text:
Wow - what an absolutely wonderful experience.

In the early evening, we were picked up at our hotel in District 1 by two vesper drivers (M Tuan and C Tam, and our guide Ely Binh) and set off for our first stop at the "zoom cafe" to enjoy a cocktail before venturing into the city. As passengers on the back of a vesper, we had the chance to experience Saigon in a unique way. Our journey starts in District 4 via crowded streets and busy alleys filled with people sitting on small plastic seats. We were able to enjoy some seafood dishes. Then, moving to District 3 through to District 1 we enjoyed the views, noises and smells of the city with stops along the way to take a closer look whenever we liked. The tour highlight was a visit to a well-hidden Vietnamese cafe (The Hidden Cafe) to enjoy some Vietnamese live music - the cafe was at the top of some stairs in a back street - the singers sing three or so songs and then move onto the next hidden venue - great singers and a thoroughly enjoyable evening. Thank you vesperadventures.com

Do not miss your opportunity for “the ride of your life” while in Saigon! The experience is so much fun and the detail to every part of the evening makes for a great way to enjoy the “real” roadways and taste delicious street food without a worry. I can't wait for my next ride!
We booked the vespa tour in Saigon. And it is A MUST!! Our guide - Sunny was the best guide ever. We did amazing city sightseeing on a bike!

Was an incredible experience which shaped our visit to HCMC! Staff and guide were very friendly and accommodating and the tour itself was interesting and enjoyable as we explored places we would never have gone ourselves via Vespa!

review_title: A great guide and a wonderful city
review_text: Sunny was a brilliant guide and she showed us all corners of the city with our interests and needs in mind. We were driven safely and felt at ease the whole time. I would not hesitate in recommending this tour!

We were met at the hotel by our two guides and headed off on the Vespas! It was quite exhilarating and felt completely safe with our drivers despite the heavy traffic. We went to places we would never have gone on foot and loved seeing parts of the city that other tourists may not have seen. Lunch at a local restaurant was very tasty too. Thanks again for a fab tour.
it was so funny and culinary very varied. we have seen Locations we would not have seen otherwise. it was cool

Fantastic Viet experience ar HCMC with Vespa ride. Mr. Nam and his team of drivers gave a memorable and awesome tour, during 4 and half hours, plenty of fun, views, excellent south Vietnam food, music and drinks.
It's a MUST if you're at HCMC/Saigon.

review_title: The first half is amazing & the food outstanding. The end unnecessary. Definitely worth a try.
review_text: We did the night tour. The drivers were fantastic even in the craziest traffic I've seen in all of Asia. I feel super safe. The food stops were delicious & fresh. The secret coffee shop with live music was lovely & the singers/musicians very talented. The guide was adorable, but I felt bad for him by the end of the night because the last stop is clearly a contrived bar with a band situation likely hired by Vespa Tours. I think the photo & key chain is unnecessary. I think the bar at the end is unnecessary. I understand they are clearly trying to round out the evening with the bar, but it felt robbed of authenticity. A drink back at headquarters would have made more sense. The highlight is definitely the amazing food from a local perspective & the great way to experience the city with your own designated driver on a comfy bike. Just expect to have it be a little funny at the end. Grab & go bike might be similar, but you'd miss out on the food experience.

A fun packed night of amazing food and fantastic music.
Our guide - Fully - was incredible and showed us how to eat the 9 amazing dishes. The 2 restaurants were authentic and had good atmosphere.
Our riders - Huy and Devol - were super friendly and made our night! They took us to and from our destinations and were great to talk to and we had such a laugh with these guys.
The music venues were unique. The rock bar was the best bar ever!! Live music and the atmosphere were incredible.
Can't recommend this food tour enough. We spent 4 nights in Saigon and this was the highlight.

A unique, exhilarating and memorable way to explore Saigon. We were traveling as 2 families, with 7 kids (aged 9-21) and all thoroughly enjoyed this experience. It is surprising that you can feel safe and secure on the back of a Vespa in the crazy traffic of Ho Chi Amin, but we did. The food was outstanding, our host and drivers amazing and we particularly enjoyed the quirky little cafe in an upstairs room where we were entertained by some amazing soloists. I am usually pretty risky, but I didn't stop smiling the whole time. Highly recommend.

We had a great ride through the crazy traffic of Saigon. Thanks to our drivers Dat and Hoa we felt safe all the time. Additionally, we got to know nice places and good food. Special thanks to our "local friend" Nguyen, we had great fun with and we learned a lot from.

We were 2 couples and 3 of the 4 people were ambiguous about this (I couldn't wait). My wife said flatly that she wouldn't go. After changing her mind, she pronounced this "insanely fun." I couldn't agree more. What a perfect way to experience Saigon (HCM City) at night, like the tens of thousands of others crammed into, yet zipping around, the streets of the city center. It requires some faith that you'll actually make it through some of the intersections and turns across traffic or through roundabouts. But somehow it all works out. The tour included stops and restaurants and bars. After drinks at Cafe Zoom, we headed to a seafood place in District 4, where we sat outside and had some outrageously good stir fried crab, mussels, clams, and (I alone in our group) frog (which was tremendous). Then on to the banh khot (Vietnamese crepes) restaurant. By the end, I was stuffed and thoroughly entertained.

Do yourself a favor and do this tour. Taken to great street food places. Drivers very capable and guides fantastic. Definitely not for the faint hearted as riding around the city is quite hairy. Great way to see this beautiful city at night.

When we arrived in HCMC the night before the scheduled tour it was pouring rain and I drove to our hotel and I saw the thousands of scooters going through the city with no apparent driving rules/regulations (chaos!) I was slightly dismayed imagining our tour the following day. Well our family of 5 (3 children-2 teens and a 12 year old) had the time of our lives. It really was super fun. We saw some great sights, and got a good sense of the city at large. One of the highlights of our trip-highly recommended!
It was a great event to go through Saigon on a Vespa with a good driver. We're lucky to smelt the nice food and dir locations.
It was a great experience to drive/be driven by Vespa drivers through Saigon and have different stops at great locations - my full recommendation!

We did this trip in Saigon and it really is as good as people say. Having seen the We traffic in HCM city, I was apprehensive about riding on the back of a scooter, but once we got going I realized that I was in safe hands and relaxed!! The food was excellent throughout and we ended up in a rock bar which was brilliant!! Thanks Guys!!!
Just a wonderful way to be introduced to the sights and food of Saigon. I have a shrimp allergy and my wife does not eat meat but all was OK and we had amble choices of dishes.

Excellent! Dat was a very savvy driver and Jenny an excellent hostess. The food was delicious. I would recommend this tour for anyone interested in the syncretism between an elated stomach and stimulated adrenal gland.
the adv. that combined vespa driving in busy saigon with excellent street food and the polite staff, was beyond any expectation. thanks
Very interesting experience. Great opportunity to explore the city at night in a very fun and entertaining way.

review_title: Great, fun experience and no better way to see the city at night.
review_text: This was just the best way to see Ho Chi Minh city. We were picked up from our hotel and rode pillion to the welcome place where we were given a drink and explained what the tour of the city entailed. We saw the city at night taking in the sights, a meal, an upstairs bar where we listened to singers before heading off to another bar with more drinks and more singing. A great fun evening in this bonkers city.

What a fun night out! Having seen how the local traffic works I was a bit apprehensive of riding on the back of a classic Vespa but it was unwarranted. Great driver who weaves through the city with ease. Our host, Mai Li, who met us at each location was really lovely and informative. From roof top bars to genuine, local Vietnamese street food, this was such an enjoyable night out.
Cannot recommend vespa adventures enough, thank you.

review_title: Very good way to discover a city
review_text: Our 3 hours tour with the guides was great. We could drive through very tiny streets, discover some markets (food and flower market) and stop when we saw something interesting. The mix of merging into the crowd and having some explanations about history when standing in front of some buildings or roads made our experience very exiting. Our guides were very friendly, lovely and flexible. We recommend this way of discovering a city! :)

This is a fantastic experience. Miggy our guide was absolutely awesome. So knowledgeable and friendly and kind. The food she took us to was the best we've had in Vietnam (and we've had a lot!) and it was great to have her company too-we felt like she was a friend by the end. We ate so well and had such a variety-you could never manage this in one week in Saigon, never mind one night. At the end we had ginger tea in an amazing coffee house tucked away somewhere in District 1 and were serenaded by the fantastic house jazz band. Our drivers Phat and Tuan were both brilliant. The ride was on the right side of exciting ie not scary just fun! We were just gutted we'd forgotten our money as they all deserved a tip for being so excellent. Thank you Miggy, Phat and Tuan. Highly recommended.

review_title: Great way to get a feel for the City
review_text: Fantastic way to see Saigon, I was apprehensive before doing this trip .The riders were very safe , polite and attentive. An Exhilarating way to travel through the city and a trip to remember.The guide that was overseeing us made it fun and exciting, A must do in Saigon.

Our tour guide was awesome! We had a great time with him, touring the city, and exploring conversations on the culture, history, and food in one of the most exciting cities in Asia. Highly recommended!

review_title: Zooming through the streets of Saigon!
review_text: So fun. The only way to see Saigon is on the back of a Vespa Adventures scooter! You get a true sense of the chaos of Saigon traffic and yet these young drivers are experts at navigating the flow of scooters, cars and humanity. Quite a thrill, and they're very knowledgeable about their city. Don't be shy, go for it!

This was my second time taking the tour, and I organized it for my colleagues as part of a company trip. There we 14 of us in total and the team at Vespa Adventures were very helpful in adjusting the program to suit our needs, making this real fun for us. A few things worth mentioning: 1) the Saigon Insider tour which we took is really fantastic and full of interesting content. 2) The team at Vespa Adventures are super organized, proactive and reliable. 3) If you want to get a feel for the city in a short time and pack in a lot of non-touristy and insightful stuff, look no further... I would not only recommend the tour, I would also definitely go back and try their other programs.

We took the nighttime food tour, and what an amazing experience. From picking us up at the hotel, to dropping us off, the drivers were courteous, excellent drivers. The food was delicious. Our guide Hoang was friendly and very knowledgeable. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone, to any age.
This was incredible. One of the best things I have ever done. Drivers are kind courteous and safe. Experience the crazy traffic in Saigon right in the middle of it. Totally amazing.

Even though we live in HCMC it was nice to get this guided tour around the outlying areas of HCMC. The drivers were very safe and concerned about your comfort. There were a couple of people on our trip with food concerns and they were able to take that into consideration when we ordered our lunch!

review_title: Amazing way to see the city!
review_text: We had so much fun experiencing the city with the vespa tour! They take you to all different parts of the city that we would not have gotten to without them. It was also a cool way to experience the scooter life without having to actually drive!
One of the best things you can do to learn something about a strange City in a short time with very friendly people

We booked with Vespa Adventures for their Angkor tour. We were a group of 9, with children ages 8,10,14 and 16. We all had a blast while learning a ton from our very engaging and knowledgeable guide. Taking this tour allows us to use “off the beaten path” entrances to the temples and also less traveled roads between them. We stopped for at a local village in the morning and a delicious meal for lunch. We felt super safe the whole time and the drivers were friendly. Highly recommended!

review_title: One of the highlights of our tour
review_text: We did the Vespa tour on our first evening after long flights to Vietnam, and that was a fantastic welcome , the team is great, the plan includes all the stations...Highly recommended
Highly recommend this tour. The drivers were fantastic and very safe. No need to be nervous. The stops were great. Excllent way to feel the thrill of the city at night!! Would definitely do it again.

Sunny our guide and Huy my driver we're excellent! The tour of Ho Chi Minh City was fabulous. I was a bit worried to tour on a scooter after seeing how crazy everyone drives in the city, but Huy was so great in the road! I felt safe the entire time, and the experience was awesome. We are going on the food tour this evening...wish Sunny and Huy were my driver! 100%recimmend!!!
Felt very safe with the drivers, guide took us to places we wouldn't have found during the time we were there. Good food. Well worth it.

My husband & I did this tour last night in a group of 6. We had the best time, it was so much fun. The street food places we were taken to provide delicious, tasty food & there was ample of it. The drinks were also free flowing. Our guide Toung Vi was awesome, she was funny & knowledgeable. All in all it was awesome & definitely a highlight in our trip. Would definitely recommend this company. I would do it again

We wanted an experience with a difference. And we got it! We live here but our friends are from the USA. None of us had been on the back of a previous Vespa. The day could not have gone better. Superbly organized, risk free from the point of the company taking all reasonable safety measures. All the riders were very professional and we all felt as safe as one can on the back of a bike in Vietnam! Seeing the Mekong up close was just brilliant. Would recommend Vespa Adventures in a heartbeat

We thoroughly enjoyed our city sights tour of Saigon with Vespa tours. Our teenage girls loved the thrill of experiencing the markets, pagodas and other sights and sounds of Saigon with the safe and friendly drivers as much as we did. There is no other way to cover the best this city has to offer!

This was one of the highlights of our trip. Good food with Vietnamese specialties. The driver was excellent and confident and the tour guide Quy very knowledgeable. A great way to see the city. I thought it was going to be a bit scary with the hcm traffic but after the first mojito 😁😁!! Good band playing too. Highly recommend

Ournexperince was amazing. We were a bit afraid about security. But motorrider were specially professionals and polites. Soon relaxed on vespa, we enjoyed the jorney. We tried Vietnamese foods and drinks. And our guide was specially funny and friendly

review_title: awesome way to see experience Saigon nightlife
review_text:
Really enjoyed the night tour on the vintage Vespa. It's really a unique way to experience Saigon - in the middle of the traffic and seeing areas of the city you probably wouldn't visit on your own. I especially liked the hidden coffee shop and the seafood restaurant. It's also nice that there is a photographer with the group that can take photos so you don't have to worry about that throughout the whole night! Our guide was awesome and my driver was super friendly. I had a lot of fun as well with the other people in my group that night.

The only downside is that it is a bit expensive, especially compared to other similar tours in Saigon. The tour is all you can eat & drink and the service is fantastic though so it does feel worth the price.

review_title: The most fun you can have on 2 wheels in Saigon!
review_text: We did this excursion on our last day and it was fantastically organized and informative. We were collected directly from our hotel on the vespa's, had a fun ride through the city to the tour office and then off on the tour itself. The places we saw were given more information to us by our very informative guide and we got to see parts of Saigon that you just wouldn't get to if you weren't with a local! Cannot recommend this trip highly enough.

We had a great tour with Nam and his crew. Loved the detailed descriptions of the city from Nam. The local dinner was the best food we had in Saigon. I will highly recommend to anyone I know coming to Vietnam.

review_title: An exciting night right 'in amongst it' in Saigon
review_text:
Recommended by friends of ours and we know pass on the fun ....this was a well organized and thought-out trip for a taste of nightlife and food in Saigon. Our teenagers couldn't stop smiling (even under the provided masks) and we enjoyed the 'beep beep beep' and feeling safe among the thousands of bikes when the sun goes down. The live music bars at the end of the night were a treat. Certainly enough food for all (possibly a little too much for our NZ tummies) but delicious and all food/drinks included. Our guide Houng spoke English well, was friendly, informative and who is new he would know so many flags of the world lol :) Would highly recommend!
go for it !!

review_title: An exciting night of fun and smiles
review_text: What a well organized an adventurous night of beep beep beeping and eating through Saigon city ! Our teenage boys loved it and couldn't keep the smiles off their faces(hidden underneath the provided masks). A great way to sample the enticing food and sights after dark. The secret local bar with musicians and then rock bar was a treat. All food and drink provided and our host Houng(?) had great English skills and very informative (plus was a whizz with world flags lol) Would highly recommend!
We had a blast! The guide was super knowledgeable and the drivers were awesome. Great beer and food pairings!Such a fun way to see the city!

review_title: Best way to see war history in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Sunny and her drivers were informative and knowledgeable about Ho Chi Minh City. We went in the War Time Memories tour and loved it! I was worried about driving on a scooter in the crazy traffic but the Vespa drivers were excellent and I wasn't worried at all about safety on the bike- I was completely at ease. It was a super fun way to see the city! We did our tour on a Sunday so traffic was lighter. Sunny did a great job at pointing out all the sights with informative commentary. Would highly recommend and would use the company again.
My family booked the Insider's Saigon Vespa tour while in Vietnam in December and everyone loved it! The guide and Vespa drivers were great. Definitely the highlight of our stay in HCMC.

review_title: So much fun! Brewery vespa tour
review_text:
I originally booked this tour for a friends birthday as we are all beer lovers and it sounded like a fun way to explore.
SO MUCH FUN. Our tour guide was Phi and she is so lovely, so friendly and so fun. It was really amazing to be a part of the millions of motorbikes on the street, we went on a friday night so traffic was crazy but it was so much fun! I felt super save and my driver Quon was lovely.
We visited 4 places and we had so much food with each beer tasting. The beers were amazing and the food was really good. It's also a great way to see which brewery is your favorite and if you have time you can head back for longer.
Would definitely recommend!

We had so much on the craft brew tour in Ho Chi Minh! Would highly recommend this with a group of friends or as a couple. Way more food then we expected & beer so definitely don't eat or drink before it starts :) all was delicious and beers were great! Tour guide was amazing (forgetting her name though) and our drivers kept us safe all night!
Was a fantastic experience riding the Vespa thru the city in peak hour traffic and sampling Vietnamese street food . Recommend it highly was a highlight for me

This is a MUST DO tour. Thoroughly enjoyed the ride and was surprised and delighted with the food stops as well as the music stops. The places they took us to were unique and well vetted. Excellent local food and talented singers.The vespa drive was thrilling, yet safe.

I booked a Vespa tour of Saigon. My husband and two teens were resistant; they didn't want to be passengers (my husband rides a motorcycle) and they were worried about the crazy traffic. But, as we all know, mom knows best. We had a blast! They loved it! It was so much fun touring the city this way; our drivers were super skilled and our guide was really friendly and knowledgeable. We were able to cover way more ground and take in many more sights than we would have on foot (with the kids complaining the whole way about walking in the heat). Half day was the perfect amount of time. At the end of the day, I got to hear those magic words, "Thanks, mom, that was really great!"
Excellent Food was really good the Vespa drivers were great It really was a fun way to View the city at night and a must do when you are in Saigon
What a night!! Great company great food. Felt safe as on the back of the vintage Vespa scooters with the expert drivers. Our host for the night Rosey was fantastic with her local knowledge and humor.

We really crossed the city many times thanks to nice riders, and could benefit from very good places to be and eat in different parts of the town. We prefer the place where they serve real good tasting and original seafood in one place that I will remember for a long time (with lemongrass sauce)Riding is safe and we feel like being vietnamese...

This was such a great way to see the city and explore. Our group was wonderful company for the evening and our tour guide An was a great guide and companion throughout. We couldn't have asked for a more fun experience! I would highly recommend this to anyone new to the city!

review_title: Awesome great people great venues all in all a highlight of our month traveling with our two teenagers
review_text: Great venues what a fun night highlight of our month away with two teenagers would highly recommend love to do again.
A very good way the expirience the city like locals on a vespa.also get to know different niebrhoods.

Friendly English speaking companion for the night. Excellently organized so that you had a 15 - 20 drive on a Vespa then food, this meant that you felt you had enough scooter riding without doing a large drive in one go. Plus you visit more restaurants. Very generous with drinks - you could have as many as you liked.
Me and boyfriend with Sunny (our guide), Tuan and Hoa (the drivers) had a great time in the countryside, along the Mekong river, throw the rice field and shrimp farm! Highly raccomended

review_title: Vespa tour among the football fans
review_text: GREAT ! Touring Saigon among the football fans after the Vietnam victory in Asia Cup Semi-finals was a hit in our trip.... The drivers were at the agility level of " ropedancers".... Absolutely fabulous !!!!

Having participated 3 times with Vespa Adventures, (Cambodia, Hanoi and HCM City) each time has been wonderful. The attention to detail is amazing and the staff are absolutely the best we have encountered.
It was a really great excursion - perfect save and friendly drivers, a lot of impression about the outback of Saigon and their people - good information by excursion head - great!
I did both the night tour and hidden Saigon tour - both were great fun and would highly recommend them both especially the hidden Saigon trip where we got to see stuff most tourists wouldn't....

This tour is great! Great organization, great guide and drivers.This is an opportunity to visit Saïgon differently and to discover some typical and nice places to have drinks, dinner and dance.It is a bit expensive but still worth to enjoy !

My husband and I were extremely impressed with the service and our tour. Our guide Kathy made us feel super spoiled throughout the day. She even purchased a bouquet of flowers for me as we were on our honeymoon. This tour was the highlight of my time in HCMC and was the best way to experience our time in the hectic city. The tour was very fast paced but did not feel rushed and every stop was thoroughly explained.
We had a super fun time and love everything about this tour. Professional and a lot of fun. Thank you
Excellent service and brilliant street food with a knowledgeable and fun guide! The photos they provided afterwards were a great memory too.

My wife and me booked the Delta tour (selfdrive). The tour was well organized, we visited places, no other tourist would see, we had local food on a local market, etc. Our guide Na was great, her English was perfect, it was really fun to be shown around by her. All in all we would definitely recommend a tour with Vespa Adventures !!!!

We were a family group of 6 (ages ranging from 34-73) and this was by far the most enjoyable group activity we did in Vietnam. Absolutely loved every minute of it! Even though the sight of seeing all those mopeds looked very daunting, once you were on you felt very safe and the drivers were very friendly too and made you feel at ease. All the food we had was brilliant too - cannot remember the name of the seafood place they took us to but the crab, scallops etc were to die for! I would highly recommend this to everyone - its a must do! VERY VERY well done Vespa Adventures!
The best experience you can have!! It's a must Do!! Just loved the idea of ​​riding a motorcycle in the busiest city a have ever seen!! Thank you very much!! We loved

review_title: Unbelievable trip to the Mekong delta
review_text: This is a must if you want to experience the Vietnamese culture and life in The Mekong delta on the back of a vintage Vespa. We got picked up by our Vespa drivers early from our hotel then rode a short distance to meet our guide for the Sunny day. Riding on the back of a Vespa through Ho Chi Minh city was very exhilarating and great fun. Once we got out of the city we stopped for coffee taking in the Mekong and excited about what was to come. We stopped at a shrimp farm, markets, mainly schools, temples, incense factory and rice wine factory then had a great lunch. There was plenty of food and water/ beer provided Our guide sunny was fantastic she was very friendly and extremely knowledgeable , very good English , such a nice person. My Vespa driver Huy was awesome. Great value for money. This is a must do if you want to get out of the concert jungle and explore the Mekong..

Fantastic evening out for myself, husband and two teenagers (16 and 15). Slightly apprehensive previously due to the sheer volume of traffic but the riders and guides were absolutely superb. This was most definitely the highlight of our 3 nights in Ho Chi Minh City and will be remembered for many years to come. If you do one thing when you visit this city make sure it is this!! Well done everyone - hoping to do the same in Chiang Mai one day.

We had an amazing evening with Sunny our guide, her name says it all, she was so much fun and made our evening,
Beware though do not eat a big lunch! We tried 9 amazing Vietnamese, we also had tea and ice cream in the most quaint coffee house that had a pianist, violinist and singer to end the night, we where so full we skipped breakfast the next day.
The 2 riders where super careful and cautious so we both felt safe as their passengers, however it's super busy and may not be for the faint hearted,

review_title: Saigon by night, food, drinks, music, the life of the city on a Vespa!
review_text: This has been the most exciting adventure during our Vietnam tour so far. The tour starts at the hotel exactly in time at 18:00 hours. Four “Riders” have been waiting for us. A short introduction and off through the dense traffic, at first a strange feeling but the drivers know what they are doing and we all start to feel well. At the first stop our host of the night, Kelsey, gave us a briefing about the tour and what we will see, taste and hear. The tour leads through several parts of the city, a stop at Cafė Zoom, drinks and a snack. After some introductory words, questions and answers about the city, we breezed further through the city towards the next stop at a well known (for the locals) seafood restaurant. Kelsey leads us in preparing and tasting the absolutely excellent food, the landlady passed by and brought more of the goodies. Then again on to the Vespa and though the soft draft during the ride towards a pancake specialist, good food and drinks again and we heard more about customs and the way of life here and further North. The two last stops were as special as the previous ones, the hidden cafe - it needs to teaming hidden - good iced coffee and excellent music. (Especially one of the singers was remarkable!!!) an den then a soft ride again in between all the other bikers towards a Rock Bar. A lot of drinks with a touch of Rock. All together an unforgettable evening. It is an excellent event for young and old (I am by the way 73) and our guide Kelsey made our day, good English, many good hints and explanations, a charming young Vietnamese, a lady! Thank you all the team, Riders Nd Guide!

review_title: best way to see Saigon by night
review_text:
This was one of the best things we did in Saigon, exciting and great fun .zooming around the city stopping off at street cafes. I
My chauffeur was very polite and helpful and our tour guide lady was great fun and had great energy that gave a party atmosphere. The only criticism would be that most of the food was pork or shellfish and we had previously given notice that some of the out party didn't eat these foods.
I particularly enjoyed the visit to the hidden away music cafe.
I would definitely recommend the tour - it was a great way to get the feel of this wonderful city.

review_title: Great taste of Saigon and environs
review_text: The trip leader and drivers were total professionals. The route of the Mekong Delta trip was excellent and the food was phenomenal. A truly awesome and memorable experience. We always feel safe no matter the traffic situation. Highly recommend.

I would actually say this was the highlight of our Vietnam trip - such fun! I know it isn't cheap but has everything- adventure being on the Vespa's on the mad busy city roads (although the guys are very good riders so felt completely safe) nice food, free flowing drinks and great venues. Would thoroughly recommend for a great night out.

review_title: Best way to do a pub crawl in Saigon
review_text: From meeting the host, the other guys on the 'trip' and your 'chauffeur' the evening was brilliant. The other guys were fun, but the experience was even better, local food and free flowing drink while being taken to places I would never have found. Amazing surprise bar with great singers. Very good evening. Thank you.

review_title: 5+ You MUST do a Vespa Tour - Family night out on the town
review_text:
Our kids say the best thing they have ever done. Nothing makes you feel more like being in Vietnam then a Vespa Tour. Make it your first activity. Make sure it's the night tour.

The Vespa tour guide and riders picked us all up from the hotel. Very professional service. Our safety was there priority. With your family they matched our riders so our kids would be comfortable.
The host was great, friendly and engaged with the kids well. We stayed at the back of the group riding to make sure everyone was together the whole time. The food stops were perfect. I particularly liked the Piano room🤫. We were a large group so it was quite a private tour although you run into other groups along the way.
Because we had kids, they changed the last stop of the tour to an Amazing Icecreamery..... Awesome night out. We have done them everyone we travel to Vietnam.

HCMC twice and Also 1 in Hanoi.... I'd still do it again.

After long day work, I decided to have a Vespa Tour and recommended to take the "After Dark" it was really funtastic evening I had, was picked up on time and gently introduced how to get in and get out from the Vespa. Briefed about Saigon traffic till stop at first Stop point togather and briefed more by the guide.
Tran Kelsey and G Huy always show the interesting place and interesting food during the stop. Food was superb especially Ban Xeo, that was my favorite. And also Vung Cafe. That was really entertaining. And finally Kelsey and Huy made me more funtastic night! Thank you Vespa Adventures.

We loved our trip around Saigon by Vespa. We had seen a few sights already but all the spots in the tour were still new. Loved the diversity of the flower market, fabric market, Chinatown and the exotic district 2.
Most fun was riding in the HCM traffic and down the laneways!
So great with our guide Quy and drivers Dung N and Q Quan. Everyone should do this. They know the city and foodlife so well.

We had a great afternoon out with Bryan (Tour leader) and his other guides.
We saw great areas in the countryside around Hanoi and the knowledge of the guides about what was around and what we could see was outstanding.
We would highly recommend the tours and our son (15) had the time of his life death g through the streets with his "driver".
A great afternoon that we would recommend to any of our friends heading to Hanoi.

We did the Vespa Foodie Tour by night in Ho Chi Min as one of the excursions on our Scenic River Cruise. It was great fun experiencing the traffic, night life and different foods. We did not feel unsafe at any time and were well looked after by our guide and driver. The tour was about 4 hours which included 2 restaurants and the last stop being a coffee house with live entertainment. A most memorable experience and definitely the ride of your life.

I found a recommendation in a Vietnam guidebook and thought "why not" even though I am 72 years young. I booked the Mekong tour for a friend and myself. What a wonder filled day. Of all the tours that we took via the Viking Ocean Cruise that we were on, this one booked on our own was the best. Being submerged in the local culture, food, and sights was amazing. We always felt safe and we were well taken care of. Our guide was so well informed she made the trip a real learning experience. They came to the cruise terminal to pick us up even though it was a 45 minute ride into town to their office. The tour was as advertised with the added excitement of a torrential downpour on the way to our last stop at a great restaurant. They had ponchos that covered us up but we still got pretty wet. That was no problem thought because after all it is 85 degrees. It feels kind of good. After our late afternoon meal we decided that we were having so much fun that we booked the evening food tour of HCMC. They even dropped us off at the war memorial museum (highly recommended) to spend some time and then picked us up again for the evening tour. That tour was great too with plenty of food and drinks. Just seeing how all the people managed to move through the city on motor scooters was amazing. Sometimes a family of 5 on one scooter. All in all it was a fantastic experience and the highlight of our ocean cruise from Hong Kong to Bangkok via China, Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand.

We enjoyed our tour - it was my wife's first time on a Vespa or motorbike. The food was interesting and the guide was very good and knowledgeable. We discovered that they don't take credit cards but you can pay in advance using Paypal

review_title: Repeat Performance from 2015 - As good/better than ever.
review_text:
In 2015 I took my first Vespa Adventure in HCMC. (see that Review).

This time, with girlfriend, we took 3 of their tours to include day, night, and Glimpse of Mekong. All were worth while and fun. The tours are not so much about the Vespas as about the motorbike ability to feel that you are integrated with the transportation culture. Any fear or trepidation of the traffic vanishes quickly when you ride with their professional drivers. Hue was my driver for 2/3 days. Hue spoke English, which is not the usual driver. The tour guides, like Stormy and Miggy, were great with excellent knowledge of the food, culture, and more.

I have done my share of car and Bus(:-)) tours. These trips in HCMC are best on Vespas. By the way. It works for all ages.....I am 70.

Have fun! They will see to your safety.

We did this Vespa foodie tour as part of our Scenic tour and it was really one of the highlights of Ho Chi Minh. We weren't sure what to expect when we signed up but I'm sure glad we did. Each person was assigned a driver and a Vespa and we then went as a group to three different places. First there was a seafood restaurant, then a classic Vietnamese place and then a speakeasy for beer, tea and to listen to people singing French torch songs. The food was incredible especially the crab..boy I could have eaten that all night. We ate until we couldn't eat anymore. But it was the Vespa ride through the streets and traffic that was the real draw. It was exciting and scary all at the same time. Our guides Na, and Vy were full of energy and information...they were great! All in all I would definitely recommend doing this when you are in Ho Chi Minh.

Had the best HCMC experience with super friendly and caring drivers and staff. Felt safe and very well taken care of by drivers M. Thuan, Vu, Ty and Easy and excellent hosting by Kelsy. Would recommend this to food lovers and families with teenagers — ours had a blast.

review_title: Great fun with my family also with my young 7 year old sister.
review_text: Hi, this is Kevin I had great fun and amazing food during the trip. They were really friendly and funny. Our guides were: Bean, Nine, Sa, Dung 1 and Nhan 2. They had a lot of energy on and off the bike which was fantastic. The coffee tasting was spectacular and we met cute puppies and 2 very cute babies.
Loved every second, and our guide Alina was exceptional. We learn so much in so many levels, historical, religious, spiritual and cultural.

We had a great time - There were 5 of us on a private tour. They arranged a van from cruise port, and had everything coordinated. The tour itself was a lot of fun and we saw a great deal of sights. The drivers were very good at keeping us safe and together. Would do this again in a heartbeat.

Had a great time visiting Ho Chi Minh by night and tasting some good food and drink. KIET was a really good driver and very friendly. SUNNY, was our guide and stayed with us to explain all we wanted to know about Vietnam and its culture every time we stopped to eat or drink. After tasting some delicious food in 2 different restaurants, and drinking coffee in a friendly coffee lounge, the evening was topped off with some really good live music in a local bar. Great trip. Fantastic people. Thanks Kiet & Sunny!

We had an exhilarating day of adventure on our Vespa tour of Hoian and the surrounding area. It was so much fun to actually be on one of the vehicles we had seen everyone else on during our trip. And this tour did everything! We saw rice paddies, boat making, bridges, weaving demos, rice cracker making, coffee production. And our guides -- Ben, Garlic, Sang and Thanh Now -- were friendly, knowledgeable and a lot of fun. Don't miss this experience!

I was admittedly nervous about getting on the back of a Vespa to drive around Ho Chi Minh City, but I soon overcame my fear as my driver safely navigated his way to the several dining spots we visited. Our guide, Kelsey, was delightful, with lots of interesting stories about the city and its food. Our seafood stop was great, with a variety of dishes and flavors. Kelsey made sure to show us how to best eat and enjoy each dish. Loved our stop at the Secret Cafe for Vietnamese “Brown” Coffee and live entertainment (think open mic night for singers.) On the Vespa, we were able to cover a lot more of the city than we could have by foot, crossing the river and seeing all the holiday lights. It was also the night that Vietnam won a big soccer match and the streets were filled with motorbike riders proudly displaying the country flag. A night to remember!
Forgot to mention how wonderful Gabby was! Best guide ever! She was very personable and helped us understand Vietnamese culture on a whole new level.

I've never thought one day I would hop on a motorbike, especially in Vietnam.
but these guys convinced me to do so and it was an outstanding experience. i feel so safe with them.

review_title: Don't hesitate to book this tour!
review_text: We did the Evening tour by Vespa and it was amazing! The guide and drivers were incredible, the food was some of the best we had our whole trip, and driving around Saigon by night on bikes was truly an amazing experience. We cannot recommend this tour and company enough!

review_title: An exceptional tour by Vespas Adventures with two great guys in Hoi An in Vietnam
review_text:
Me an my wife had a wonderful experience with Garlic and Sinh, as our guides and drivers, in Hoi An in Vietnam, visiting a coffee house, Traditional boat builder yard, rice paper for making spring rolls, etc but mainly seeing and enjoying the breath taking scenery of the area. The tour with the guys, on the Vespas, was enjoyable and we enjoyed their care and hospitality so much.
Avinoam

review_title: Riding with a woman driver made all the difference
review_text:
Riding on the back a a vespa is a great way to become part of the city and see it.

If you have any concerns, I would highly advise you to ask for a woman to drive you. If Leo is available, ask for her. She will take good care of you and make you feel safe.

Saigon is a crazy city with traffic laws throught of more as a suggestion than a regulation. I was apprehensive about going on a Vespa tour, but am so happy I went.

My friend and I were picked up from our hotel and taken to the office to meet others and start the tour.

My friend had Leo, a sweet woman driving her to the meeting spot, and I had a male driver on the way to the office.

After weaving in and out of traffic and cutting in front of buses, I arrived terrified.

I didn't want to spend the next 4 hours with my eyes closed, so I asked for Leo, a woman to drive me. With her as the driver, I was able to enjoy the sites without fearing for my saftey. It was an amazing expereince!!!

My friend and I did the Saigon after Dark tour and had a blast. We were both a little nervous traveling about in the Vespas in the crazy Saigon traffic but the drivers really put us at ease.

The food at the restaurants that they took us to was among the best food we had during our trip to Vietnam. The seafood place was excellent as well as the place we got the omelets. There was so much food but you have to try everything!

The nightclub was a nice change of pace and we ended up skipping the rock club only because I was nursing a cold and didn't want to stay up too late. This was a really enjoyable experience and well worth doing again.

review_title: A great way to spend your 50th birthday!!
review_text:
It was my husbands 50th, so we decided to do the Saigon by night night tour.. what a fantastic night!! The drivers were brilliant, going on the Vespa gives you another view of Saigon - and the traffic!!
Nam was our host, he was brilliant, he really looked after us and made sure we had lots to eat and drink.
we rode to a seafood restaurant, then a pancake restaurant, then onto listen to some acoustic music which was excellent, they sung “happy birthday “ to my husband and Nam had organised a cake..
We then went to a club to listen to a band. The teenagers really enjoyed this.
This is such a great experience to do while you are in Saigon, thank you Nam and the team for making it a night to remember!!

We were somewhat concerned with the literally millions of motorcycles and scooters in HCM city and agreed to this evening street food tour on Vespas with some trepidation!
However with excellent experienced scooter drivers we were driven through the traffic melee to several back street eateries that were off the beaten track but served delicious varied local cuisine. A real experience and one we would highly recommend

We love Asian food but are a bit shy in Asia if it comes to street food because of hygine. But this trip gave us an insight in the Vietnamese street food we will never forget. Our yesterdays guide, Mai, was so lovely and nice. We started with a rooftop bar, very nice. Then we visited two restaurants where almost only local residents were eating. In total we had 9 dished and one was better than the other. I`m writing this one day later and can tell you that our stomachs are absoloutely fine afterwards. Afterwards we visited a music bar: Great performers. We loved it. Last one was a kind of live music / Karaoke bar. Great as well only the Chinese smokers I didn´t like so much. The ride with the Vespa was a great experience as well. Traffic is so crazy here but we always felt save. So: If you love food: DO IT. It`s really worth while.

review_title: Great food, guides, rides, and beer.
review_text: My partner and I took a craft beer tour with Vespa Adventures. The entire process from the pick up at our hotel until the drop off was memorable. We were a little worried at first due to the busy streets but our drivers put us right at ease. We arrived at the meeting point and stared with our first beer and snacks. We then went on to visit several craft beer pubs and restaurants. The drivers are very safe. We were never afraid even with the traffic. Our guide had previously worked in the craft been pubs and gave some good advice on what to choose. Each restaurant paired beer with tasty bites. I recommend this tour 100%.
Amazing fun, see parts of the city you won’t have seen before all on the back of a Vespa with a great knowledgeable guide. Guide was brillaint, drivers were excellent. Highly recommended

review_title: FANTASTIC VESPA ADVENTURES - never disappoints- always fabulous
review_text:
Last month I joined a number of Vespa tours, riding pillion both through the busy streets and countryside tours. Each time I return to Vietnam these Vespa tours are my absolute favourite thing to do.
From the Glimpse of the Mekong 6 hours day trip (thanks to our expert guide Mrs Na -always quick to make us laugh and lots of fun, and lovely caring driver Mr Tan 8)
to my favourite Saigon after Dark tour (foodies note - the seafood and pancake restaurants are simply fabulous). Many thanks to Orange and driver Q Quan for looking after us so thoughtfully. Thank you Steve for your friendly welcome at the Zoom Cafe.
In Hanoi the team helped us by tailoring a night trip to meet our groups' needs that was a great night. Many thanks.
Providing a safe, fun and informative view of wonderful Vietnam - just that little bit off the main tourist track is the main aim of this company. They do it so well. Thank you Vespa Adventures

If you're visiting HCMC then one of the best ways to explore the city is on the back of a Vespa. We had a party of 9 (4 adults and 5 children) and we all had a wonderful time. Our guides were experienced, attentive and fun and this adventure was one of the highlights of our trip.

We stopped at 5 different restaurants and the food we received was lovely. Vespa Adventures were extremely flexible with our route and happily changed a destination upon our request (prior to setting off). You won't be disappointed if you do this tour and you'll get to appreciate what a truly amazing city HCM is.

As a group of 6 we scooted around town on Vespas. Very well organized, each one of us had a driver and we sat behind. Excellent way to see the city. We stopped at local street food restaurants for dining. All local and delicious.
Our guide, Jenny, was excellent.

We did the Vespa Hidden City tour as an add on from our Les Rives tour of Cu Chi Tunnels. We experienced the scooter chaos in Hanoi and HCMC in taxis and walking, but riding on the Vespa was a completely different experience. We actually felt safe. We had a very enjoyable tour of the city and saw things not on the traditional tourist track. It was fun to see Chinese quarter and walk through the flower market. We booked this before arriving in the country...it was fun.

review_title: The highlight of our visit to Saigon!
review_text:
We just had such a great time on November 10. T Vi is a fab hostess, and Thien and Phong are great riders. We felt completely relaxed and confident as pills. The bars, restaurants and clubs that we visited were fantastic; we could have spent all evening in each one. Time just flashed past and we were sad that it came to an end all too quickly. We cannot recommend this trip highly enough.

Emma & Noel Lindsay

vespa tour was definitely a great way to start the holiday in Vietnam. the restaurants were all nice and the food was great. my driver, Luan, was very kind and good on the bike, 10/10. would definitely rate. all should consider this as a way to explore Vietnam.

One of the highlights of our Vietnam trip.
I would highly recommend doing this experience.
It ended up costing us around NZD$300 for two people, but it was well worth it.
3 hours of excitement, entertainment and great food.
We were collected on a Vespa from our hotel around 7pm when it was dark and transported to the Vespa Cafe which was the meeting point for the tour where we met our guide and drivers.
It happened to be raining for the first hour of tour, but the guides had rain ponchos for us.
It was exciting to be on Vespa amongst the organized chaos with experienced local drivers. You get taken to different districts to try different local cuisines with the locals. The Jumping Chicken (frogs legs) was tasty! And the beverages on the tour were all inclusive. Added bonus of not having to drive 🙂.
Some of the places we visited we never would have known existed without this amazing tour. Especially the lovely bar with the live singing and fantastic coffee. Amazing!!! The club we went to finish the night off was awesome, albeit crowded.
I'd absolutely recommend you add this to your to do list while in Ho Chi Minh

A Glimpse of the Mekong tour was fabulous!
Our leader Na was wonderful. Generous with her knowledge of the area and fun to have with us. She is very professional and speaks perfect English.
My Vespa driver Ty, was THE BEST! He was an expert in the traffic congestion and I never felt nervous. In the rural areas he stayed back from the dust caused by other vehicles and was constantly checking on me to ensure I was comfortable and traveling well.
We experienced such a lot in a few hours! The city congestion, the rural gorgeous rice paddies, fresh food markets, tasting local foods and rice wine, ferry ride and a delicious lunch in a gorgeous restaurant
Thank you Vespa Adventures....especially Ty.
It was absolutely fabulous!

Did the beer tour
Great value
Highly recommend
It was a bit scary at first on the back of the bike but the drivers were experts and I felt very safe
We visited four breweries, had taster plates at each with food

The Craft Beer Tour exceeded all of our expectations! Tam took us to four unique places. All of the places were located outside of District 1 so that we could try places that were new to us. The local beers were delicious and we drank several glasses per place. A pleasant surprise was the delicious food we ate on the tour. Way more than just bar snacks, we had full dishes that were new to us and tasted amazing! thanks
Tam and his colleagues were fantastic. They introduced us to new locales and the associated communities. They were polite, knowledgeable, and saw to our every need and want.
We finished the tour full and more knowledgeable about the local craft scene. I would 100% recommend this tour.

Did the Vespa Tour already in Hanoi. Got the same positive and special experience in HCMC (Saigon) again. Roomy Vespa Model with comfortable seats and space for the feet. Professional careful drivers in the chaos of the City traffic. Beside the usual Sightseeing Landmarks you pass local flower, and food markets hidden in small path ways - not reachable by car -. Friendly Guide (Sunny) adaptive to the customer wishes with interesting explanations. The Pagoda with the 10k Buddhas and absolut highlights! In all a highlight of that week in HCMC.
This was such a fun and memorable experience. Luna, Dat, Tuan, and Luan were amazing hosts and the food was delicious. Highlight of the trip. Highly recommend.

review_title: Lots of fun and exciting ways to see Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Took an afternoon ride with Vespa Adventures during a recent stay in Ho Chi Minh City. There were only four in our group; each was paired with a driver and then we had our guide, Kathy, who provided information at each of the stops. Our tour lasted around 4 hours and focused on some of the smaller, less tourist-ed sites around the city, including a temple with 1,000 buddhas, floral market, chinese medicine shop, among others, as well as the cathedral, post office, and reunification palace. Definitely recommend a tour with this company if you have a half-day free and want to experience the streets like a local!

Saigon by night with Vespa tours was one of the highlights of our 2 week trip to Vietnam. Very professional and expert drivers. From the moment we were picked up outside our hotel we were safely driven around the stunning sights of Saigon. You see so much more, experience the noises, the smells and the vibrant life of Saigon. We stopped off at superb street food vendors and local restaurants. Each one delicious. Do not eat before you go on this tour! It is a long tour, nearly 4 hours if you do all the stops. We skipped the last cocktail stop as we had only just flown into Saigon and were feeling rather jaded. Our last stop, a hidden gem of a local coffee lounge, showcased 3 extremely talented singers and musicians. Well worth it for something unique and memorable.
What an awesome beer tour of Saigon. So many new craft breweries being built and this tour takes you to all the best ones! Even the food served, and it’s a ton of food, is amazing!! Must try!

We were a bit unsure when our travel company recommended the Vespa tour but it was such a great evening.

The Vespa drivers are clearly very well trained and we all really enjoyed zipping along the roads taking in the evening sights.

The food was very good. It was really nice to get to try lots of different types of local food. I would suggest having a very light lunch because you get to try 8-10 different dishes!

The highlight of the tour for us was the two live music venues. The hidden cafe was very relaxing and we enjoyed listening to Vietnamese songs. The acoustic bar was absolutely fab afterwards! The singers were great and there was a really good atmosphere.

Although it isn't the cheapest tour, we found that in that it was very good value in terms of the amount of food and drink and the overall experience. A must do activity if you are staying in Saigon!

Great way to see the city, experience the local cafe snd food culture, and see parts of the city you might not get to on another tour. The vespa drivers are brilliant and make you feel really safe despite the chaotic appearance of the traffic. Fear Not and give it a go - you will not regret it.

This is a “must do” if in Ho Chi Minh City. Well organized, the route was excellent and the guide and riders were all fun and made sure it's safe. You'll see varied districts and eat and drink at a range of places.
Not sure how anyone couldn't enjoy this.
I don't know how much this trip cost as it was part of a package but it included lots of food drink live music and lashings of fun. Highly recommended
Definitely recommend Vespa Adventures and especially our tour guide Sunny. The tour was adventurous yet safe, personal (only two of us and informative. Fabulous way to see Saigon!

Vespa city tour. In amongst the manic traffic. Close and personal. Went to bars and restaurants that were off the beaten tourist trail. Real local flavor. Must do to get a different perspective on Saigon.
We had a great time even though we had to cut the tour short. The food was outstanding and we learned a great deal. Our host was great as were our drivers. Highly recommend.

Wow! Everyone needs to do this tour. Rosie our guide looked after us very well throughout the evening. Our Vespa drivers were amazing and very considerate. Food stops were so interesting, real street cuisine. The romantic cafe was fun & finishing up in the Woodstock Rock bar was a fab way to finish the evening. Can thoroughly recommend.

review_title: Craft beer tour a must! Ask for Kit Kat :)
review_text: My family and I did the craft beer tour with Kit Kat and she took AMAZING care of us! She clearly has great relationships with the brewery owners and managers in town and she introduced us to so many interesting people who are working in the rapidly developing craft beer scene in HCMC. She is also just so much fun, super knowledgeable about craft beer and about the city, and an absolute pleasure to spend time chatting with. Make time to do this tour while you're in HCMC, you won't regret it!

We did a tour with Vy. Vy is great! Super knowledgeable and a great tour guide. The tour itself was so much fun. You get out of the touristy areas and it's a cool way to see the city. I just wish we stayed longer at the last bar! Great tour!

I did the morning Insider's Tour with four friends and it was the BEST fun. Initially, I was hesitant about this tour due to the crazy traffic in Saigon but I had absolutely nothing to worry about. Our drivers and guide provided us with an amazing (safe) experience on the roads and lanes in between the various stops to view local parks, markets, temples and shops of interest. The tour takes you to locations you might not usually find/visit and you also get to enjoy some incredible food along the way. Many thanks to Elina and her team of drivers (especially Tao) for providing us with a most amazing experience. The highlight of my trip!

We had a blast, Jayden was our guide and she is just amazing, warm,funny and engaging...she clearly enjoys what she does and really made this special for us. This was the best activity in Saigon, the riding is just great fun the food is just OK but that's fine, the experience is worth the money. I cannot recommend this enough and if you are lucky you will have Jayden as a guide, she is amazing, thank you!

My partner and I went for Saigon After Dark Tour with Vespa Adventures the 2nd time around after 4 years and they didn't disappoint. Our guide, Jaden, was full of energy and even prepared a surprise for one of us who celebrated his birthday a day before the tour. And the drivers, Luan and Bao, kept us safe all throughout. Will definitely do this the 3rd time...!!!

review_title: Maybe safer than crossing the motorcycle streets?
review_text: Fun and safe, but thrilling to visit food and bar scene in Saigon. We try great seafood and traditional Vietnamese cafes as well as two bars with singers. A nice slice of the fun night life of Saigon today. Drivers are young, but safe and traffic is like a rollercoaster!

with my family we traveled to Vietnam for three days on the first day we went to the insiders Saigon vespa tour and it was awesome, the perfect introduction to Saigon, its a really good tour to explore the real Ho chi Minh city,
I spent the morning at the back of an holding Vespa across Saïgon and I loved it! Interesting visits and very nice driver! Thank you for this genuine experience!

We did the Saigon after dark tour and everything was amazing. The bikes, the team, the food, the music, the drinks and the whole experience from start to finish was great.
I would highly recommend seeing and experiencing Saigon with Vespa Adventures.

With a group of friends I went on a couple of the Saigon Vespa Adventure tours - touring around the city, the mekong delta, and seeing the nightlife, beer and food. It was absolutely everything you could want.

The drivers: are friendly, attentive, and really look out for you. Even if you are nervous on a bike, there's no need! I have never felt safer. They are extremely conscientious and make sure you are always looking after.

The tours: while seeing the best sights, you also get to see parts of Saigon that you would normally miss out on with the 'standard tours' you can book through your hotel. Trying the food, seeing the markets, meeting local people - it's all fantastic. You get to see the important things too, of course!

Tour guides: are all extremely knowledgeable of the area and what they're showing you, being locals themselves. Their English is fantastic and they do everything in their power to make sure you are having a great time.
