I would 100% recommend Vespa Adventures, and having now been on tours with them in Saigon (and the Mekong), Siem Reap, and Phnom Penh, I can tell you that the quality is always right up there, no matter where you go and which tour you're on.

What a fantastic tour. The drivers were superb. I was a little nervous to begin with as the traffic is extremely busy, and I hadn't been on the back of a motor bike/scooter for decades. I needn't have worried, my driver was fantastic and put me at ease within seconds. He handled his scooter really professionally, was chatty and a great tour guide.I would recommend doing this tour - its the best way to get around Saigon. I would do it again for certain.

We spent 2 weeks traveling around Vietnam, and this Vespa trip in Saigon was one of the highlights of the trip. It was exciting, exhilerating and just the right amount of scary as we zipped in and out of traffic. The street food stops were absolutely delicious and the highlight of the night was ending the tour at Carman's, hosting the most influential and fabulous music.

Our drivers were awesome, and special recognition to Orange who was our tour guide. He gave us great insight into a young persons' life in Saigon, the countries hopes and expectations as well as what it means to be an entrepeneur in an emerging economy. Couldn't have asked for a better guide.

Can't recommend this night time tour enough. It was an explosion.
Bob & Danna Siverts
Seattle, WA USA

My wife and I went on the afternoon Insider's Saigon tour and loved it. Our guide, Fully, was fantastic. He explained all the relevant sites, allowed lots of time for photos and lets us soak in the atmosphere of the markets and pagodas. We never felt rushed. Riding on the Vespas was fun and exciting. Our drivers, Long and Thuan, are experts and have nerves of steel buzzing around the streets. Thanks very much for a highlight experience!

review_title: Only way to See the town, and its fun!!
review_text: I booked the "Insiders Saigon" afternoon tour and just loved it. My friend who is 82 was a bit nervous about the idea of ​​riding a Vespa around town but after the first ride to lunch with his driver all worries were put to rest. It was very easy to hold on and the helmet and air pollution face mask added to your sense of security. We had the fabulous Fully as our guide and he did an excellent job showing the main sites and providing knowledgeable information about each one of them. Using the Vespa is really the only practical way of getting around the city and it's also fun. Being exposed to the outside air really lets you experience the city. Hats off to my driver Tam as well. I highly recommend this outfit if you looking for a great half day tour of Saigon.

We did the after dark tour with Mia on 10 th nov
Fantastic craic. Great food And amazing drivers.
Highly recommend it
Pat and Dee. Ireland

Tonight was definitely the highlight of our trip so far. We've driven, cycled, sky trained, railroaded and walked through Bangkok, we've boated and driven through Siem Reap and tonight, (our first night), we did the vintage Vespa tour in Saigon - Top Class all the way! Our drivers Teo and Loc were excellent and our guide, Orange, was great company. He meets us at every stop along the way and conversed easily and interestingly in very good English. We made 5 stops along the way with drinks, food and excellent live music included (one classical acoustic setting and one excellent Rock setting with a 7 piece band). It's a fantastic way to see the city and experience the smells, sounds and taste of a very vibrant city. We are in our sixties but highly recommend this to any age group! Thank you again Orange 🙏, Teo 🙏 and Loc 🙏 🛵

review_title: Saigon after hours on a Vespa
review_text: We were a group of eight who recently went on the Saigon after Dark tour with Na leading us. The tour was very well organized with great “drivers”, plenty to eat and drink. Good value for money and highly recommended. Go for it.You won't regret it.

review_title: The most entertaining sightseeing tour ever
review_text: My wife and I did a morning tour in Saigon early October and it was awesome. Not a boring 4 hours ride or a boring sightseeing tour, no! Several adventurous 20 minute rides combined with refreshing visits of tourists attractions throughout Saigon! Our guide Orange was very friendly and knowledgeable. He gave us a perfect overview about people, culture and history. Our drivers were very experienced and although the traffic in Saigon is completely crazy, we didn't feel uncomfortable at any time - thanks, Gentlemen, for the wonderful experience!

Had great fun and loads of food and drink on our after dark tour of Saigon. Our guide T. Vi took us to local restaurants and hidden bars to experience Saigon at night. And of course the terrifying Saigon roads navigated superbly by our drivers

If you find yourself in Ho Chi Minh city then you need to make time for a Vespa tour with Vespa Adventures. We did a night tour... safe riders, good food and plenty to drink, music. What more could want? Our guide was helpful and she went out of her to make sure we had a good time. Had a great time, highly recommended.

Did the culinary tour with vintage Vespa adventures last night in Saigon and it was absolutely amazing. Didn't expect to have so much fun as we did. Our drivers Nghi and De were so good and made our driving adventure in the crazy traffic of Saigon fun and safe. Our super cool and friendly guide took us first to a rooftop patio for some cocktails and night views of the city. Then we went to different districts for all kind of yummy local foods and drinks. We finished the night at a Spanish themed bar where a very talented local band played all kind of Latino music. All in all the whole experience was about 5 hours and that was 5 hours of total fun. We highly recommend it to anyone visiting Vietnam, especially Saigon.

I had a fun night out because there were other interesting people on our excursion and we drank sufficient quantities to make everything a bit more fun. However, on the Night Tour, I found that the food was quite mediocre. The music at the two venues was good, but I took exception to being told we were going to a secret local teahouse with live music. It appeared to me that we were taken to a couple of rooms in an empty building where they had put in some couches and decorations then hired performers to sing for tourists. Everybody there was part of a Vespa tour. They stayed for four songs then went on to the next stop. That didn't feel authentic.

Not to be overly negative, but my other issue was worth for money. I felt like I paid $100 for a $50 tour.

Our drivers were very good, safe and helpful. Our guide worked hard but I felt we could have learned a lot more about the areas, history, foods, etc.

So, I definitely had fun, but found it overpriced and not as authentic as expected and not with amazingly delicious local food.

review_title: The Thrill of Saigon's traffic (and beer)!
review_text: If you've got a 'free' night in Saigon, you shouldn't pass up the opportunity for this scooter-assisted pub crawl across the city. The traffic you see from a bus or sidewalk does not compare to riding in it (in the dark, with beer in hand) behind an experienced driver. Authentic food, local beers, music. Experience Saigon's night life firsthand (with you own personal driver). Fun, fun, fun! We had a group of 9 and everyone said it was the best experience in Saigon.

review_title: The BEST experience of seeing Ho Chi Minh City.
review_text: We had the BEST experience.The guide was FANTASTIC and couldn't do enough to make our adventure the best it could be.We would highly recommend this to everyone!

One of the top things I have ever done in my life! My 73 year old father and I went on the tour and were still buzzing with excitement when we got home that we had to debrief over a drink! Safety was excellent! Food was excellent! Entertainment was excellent! Seeing how the locals live, eat and have fun was wonderful. This was a well organized, informative, safe and fun adventure. If you do one thing when you visit Saigon you must do this! Thank you, thank you, thank you!

This has been one of the highlights of our trip so far and I would definitely recommend everyone give it go. Onion and Quoc picked us up from our hotel in pouring rain but I never once felt unsafe. This is the best way to experience the countryside and we stopped at about 4 small businesses and learned to make rice noodles which were delicious. Thank you Onion and Quoc.

you have seen the crazy scooter traffic, well this puts you out among it. Meeting at the first bar for a drink and an update on what will be the program for the evening, then you are off to the first of two restaurants, you have to try all the food offered, it was great (even the jumping chicken), after the food, then you are whisked away to a back alley bar, where we heard some epic singing (both in Vietnamese and English) but a number of entertainers, all accompanied by piano and violin. amazing... then after this it was off to Acoustic Bar to listen to some good old rock and roll.. all up this cost around US$100, but all drinks and food was included, so well worth it..

I both joined insider tour and dark tour during my trip in HMC at last week. They were totally lighted up my trip. As a solo traveler, it's so convenient to explore the HMC in depth with them. All food were delicious, tour guides (Orange &Jenny) were caring and experienced.
The driver Duong took care of me for both tours, his driving skill was excellent and he was nice with smile always. I will definitely join again when I visit other cities with Vespa Adventures.

Riding trip by vespa was fun and exciting. First the driver picks you up from your hotel and the adventure starts !! The nice driver will help you with the safety helmet and to hold on the metal bars behind his seat. First stop is at a bar for drinks and snacks and there you meet members of your tour group and the tour leader as well as a supervisor from the Vespa tour company on my particular night. We continued on to two local food restaurants with drinks in your hand on the Vespa if you choose to !!After eating yummy food we hopped to a bar for coffee or tea serenaded by talented vocalists and their instruments.Last stop for the night was at a fun discotheque with great live music. Our group enjoyed the trip very much and stayed until 10 pm at least. The staff were wonderful, food was so delicious and great music. I highly recommend everyone to join the Vespa tour even never ridden on a motor bike before like me !!! I would infinitely do it again. Thank you so much for the exciting time in Saigon.

I did this tour 18months ago on my previous trip to Saigon and it was fantastic. This time it was awful. They have changed the tour so much that I will no longer recommend it to anyone. Very expensive for what it is now. The food was below average and where previously you could get a house wine, unless you drink beer you are simply out of luck. We even offered to pay for our own wine to have a glass with our meal and we were refused. The tour was so much shorter than previous, Did not do the same sight seeing, note even close. DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY.
The best way to really see the city! From historic attractions to back alleys, there is no better way to experience Vietnam.

We were picked up at our hotel and every minute was an adventure for all our senses. The great food we ate at every destination was one thing, but the people we met, the sites and sounds made it all the better. I would do this again .

Great fun. A must do. Felt very safe despite being in the back of a motorcycle in organized chaos. Food snd bars were great and our hostess who traveled with us was a blast.. Well worth the money, don't miss it.

Great introduction to the hustle and bustle of the manic city. You mingle with all the other bikes, scooters and cars at the busiest time of the afternoon, your drivers are really competent and you never feel scared it's just really exciting to be scooting along with the rest of the crowd.
It was great experience to do! My tour guide Mr. Orange is friendly and knowledgeable guy, we enjoyed the foods and drinks all night.

Had an awesome time in the tour after initial apprehension by some members of the family. The drivers were courteous and excellent and our guide was very friendly and accommodating and food was amazing! We covered quite a bit of distance so was great to do so on the bike whilst checking out some of the sights of Saigon. A must on any visit to this city!

A must do when in Saigon. Nhu and Ba our drivers and Rosy our
guide were the best. From our hotel pick up to our drop back
everything was perfect. Amazing driving through Saigon traffic,
fabulous food in little unknown places and great music. Treat yourself to a great night in Saigon. You will not regret it trust me.
The Ride of your life

My friends and I decided to spend our last day with the Vespa Tour. It was such a great ending because of the amazing team behind it! Shoutout to Sunny for being such an awesome tour guide! She was funny, bubbly and full of enegry! Always smiling :) The Itinerary was perfect, our vespa drivers were so kind and very accomodating (shoutout to Nyim), and the food after the trip was very delicious! Learned so much about the culture of the Vietnamese and felt like a local. Worth the price! Definitely one of the highlights of my Vietnam Trip! :)

review_title: The only way to see Saigon!
review_text:
Seven years ago my wife and I did the After Dark tour and we have brought our mid twenties kids and their partners for a rerun!
This time we did the Morning tour which was a fantastic way to learn about the history of Saigon. Then in the evening we did the After Dark tour which took us to places you will never find on your own. Roof top bars, small live music restaurants, mixed with food outlets and finally another live Rock bar with a Spanish theme! Thank you to Sunny for being a great guide and to all the Vespa drivers. Do not miss doing this either as a group or a couple.

It could be said that Vespa Adventure is the most excellent tour Saigon After Dark. Although the cost is quite high compared to the others but it is worth every penny. With this tour you can enjoy a busy life in Ho Chi Minh City as well as you will have a change to explore streetfood and join the cook. It is so amazing.
If you are in your first time to HCM, don't miss this Tour of course.

Sonny was the best! We didn't have much time in Vietnam and the Vespa adventure was such a great way to see the city. Made lots of great stops and everyone was very kind. Hopefully we can do another one soon!

review_title: Beer Tour and Inside Siagon- Well run and fun. Thanks Sunny and Kitkat. You guys rock!
review_text:
We did two tours with Vespa Adventures. A beer tour with Kitkat and a hidden Saigon with Sunny. You will be riding around on vintage Vespa 2 stroke bikes. The bikes are immaculate and in great shape. Enjoy the blue smoke coming out of the old 2 stroke oil burning motors. That is how they were designed back in the day.

What you are going to get is a chance to be in traffic and feel what it like with the scooters. I always feel safe. You will have drivers driving you around and a guide that shows you stuff at the places. They did have a photographer roaming around taking photos and we got printed images when we were done. . Nice touch but could be seen as a bit much by some.

Our guides - Kitkat and Sunny were fun and sweet. Young and eager. They try hard to make you happy and connected. If they lack any knowledge or language skills they will make up for it in hustle and give a damn. They really do want you to have fun. Good tour.

Today we went on a Vespa food tour of Ho Chi Minh City. We had a great time with Vespa adventures, Saigon After Dark. Our guide, Nam, was really friendly and interesting to talk to. We had 2 different drivers, Nhi' and Dao, who navigated the streets like pros. It was really great to see the nightlife in Ho Chi Minh, especially via Vespa. We had a lot of fantastic food, great conversation, and an overall awesome time and would recommend this trip to anyone.

review_title: Best time! This is a MUST
review_text: Had the best time! We did the After Dark tour in Saigon and couldn't have felt any safer with our experience drivers. The selection of restaurants were perfect and provided great insight into traditional cuisines, the entertainment and bars were fun. These places we will never have seen as foreigners. A MASSIVE thanks to Luna for conducting the tour. Luna was knowledgeable, friendly and organized. And a big thanks to my driver Tuan. You were awesome!!!!

review_title: Off the beaten track. Excellent tour.
review_text: We have visited Saigon before and wanted to see something different but having done a night food tour on the previous trip wanted to use Vespa adventures again. The off the beaten track tour was just the ticket. We visited flower market, monks memorial, China Town, traditional medicine shop, and loads more. Fully - our guide was really helpful, professional and informative. Apart from the fabulous places - the ride on the bikes was exhilarating. Must do.

My husband and I were a little cautious about doing the Vespa tours at first but a few minutes into it and we were loving it. It was so much fun and such a neat experience. I am so pleased we did it. Thank you to our drivers “Danh” and “N.Tu. Brilliant!

A group of four of us did the Saigon After Dark tour and loved every minute. Despite all the (organised) “chaos” of the traffic we felt completely safe and relaxed.
We were picked up from, and dropped off to, our hotel.
Our host / guide Kat was fun and friendly.
You go off the beaten track to places for food and or drinks and entertainment- places you may not find on your own... and you have enough time at each place to really enjoy the atmosphere (and food/drinks). The guide takes care of everything.
I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Ho Ch Min City. We also did one in Hoi An which was just as good.
A ride of your life for sure - and they send you free photos from the tour.

review_title: GREAT WAY TO GET AROUND THE SIGHTS
review_text: I am a second time user of Vespa Adventures having first done a tour in Hoi An in 2015 at age 70 and have just completed a tour in Saigon (HCMC) at age 72 so don't let age stop you from a great day out and about. The drivers take very good care of you and the tour visits some very interesting out-of-the-way places. If I return to Vietnam I will definitely be taking another tour.
My brilliant safe, kind scooter driver M. Cu'ong and host T Vi.made foe a fabulous night out in Saigon

review_title: Great way to see the city
review_text: They have the standard places to show you around MCMC but you can also tailor the experience. I asked them to show me some of the new buildings and architecture around town in addition to the various sites they included.
Thanks to our guide Fully for an excellent tour around Ho Chi Minh City. Great mix of places, exceptional food, good music.

review_title: Great way to be introduced to Saigon
review_text: Did this as an add on to an organized tour and it's been one of the highlights. Tammy our guide made for a fun night showing us places clearly used by locals and our drivers Pho and Dung also added to the tour. If you want to try some Saigon experiences and don't know where to start. I strongly recommend the Vespa tour

We took this tour yesterday and had a great time.
Sunny our guide and the two drivers were excellent and made sure we were safe at all times.
Sunny gave us lots of information about the sites we visited and as her English was so good we had lots of Laughs along the way. We would recommend this tour for a bit of excitement being amongst the traffic on the Saigon streets, local history and reaching areas like the flower market that we probably wouldn't have seen.
Thank you Sunny and your team for a great afternoon.
Yvonne

We had the best adventure recently with our drivers Quyen and Nhi in Ho Chi Minh City and our guide was Hoang. Thank you for this amazing ride I was really scared but found it fantastic a must do to experience the scooters on the ground we will be back 🙏 thank you😘

Sunny took us down walking street and it was so
amazing! She showed us the food places, karaoke, the different types of bars down the street, the different shopping on the street. It was an experience I won't forget. There were so many different types of music all around. When i come back to this amazing city i will be touring with sunny again (:

Amazing, exhilarating and so exciting are the words that can best describe our outing around Saigon with Vespa Tour.
The care and attention by the drivers and staff throughout the 4 hour trip was exemplary.
The event was a mixture of the excitement of Saigon traffic together with an infusion of cultural insight at various historical and other interesting sites throughout the city.
A well chosen stop for an excellent lunch was the icing on the cake.
I'll admit I was anxious, but the ride proved to be exhilarating and actually quite safe! We were taken to some excellent not tourist-oriented restaurants and clubs...Overall a blast!

We went to a temple of 10000 Buddhas and it was so beautiful. The temple and the people are super nice and the architecture is amazing. Sunny our tour guide was super helpful and she knew a lot about the culture and history of the temple. She shows us every floor and what Buddha is on that floor. The top floor was the most amazing sight and definitely recommend going. Shout out to sunny because she was the best tour guide we had and she always offered to take our pictures and she translated to English quite well. Definitely recommend sunny as well ❤️

Loved this tour! Sunny was great and took us to so many cool places! The food and drinks were amazing, and the flower market and temple were so beautiful! I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City!

My wife and I did the Saigon after dark. We were picked up at our hotel by Jimmy and Tish on their scooters. Away we went weaving in and out of the traffic. There were 5 stops for meals and drinks. Each drive between stops will have been 20 mins going past points of interest. Our last stop was a coffee house dim lighting with a violin and panio with 4 different singers (absolutely brilliant). We cut the night short due to an early departure from our hotel the next morning. At each stop we were met by Thien the supervisor who was very informative. This is a must do for very skilled riders. All in all a brilliant night out. Would recommend to anyone and will do it again if we are in a country they operate

I did the Vespa Craft Beer tour with my parents. Our guide Kat was terrific! Very knowledgeable about craft beer in the city and a ton of fun to hang out with. We happened to have the tour on the night of East West Brewing Company's Oktoberfest party and it was an absolute blast. 10/10 would recommend

I took the Insiders Saigon tour with Vespa Adventures and had a great time. I only signed up a day or two ago. They picked me up at my hotel and got to see all of the sites I wanted like the Post Office and Reunification Palace, plus those less visited. The tour went off like clockwork. Our tour guide, Sunny, and was great and so sweet! My driver was awesome and pointed out additional sites a long the way and helped me on and off with my helmet at each stop. Can't recommend this tour company enough!

Sunny, our guide, was influential and wonderful! Our group licensed only of my 9 year old son and me so we could set the pace. Loved seeing the non touristy side of HCM! My son loved it so much he wanted to go on another tour with them.

review_title: Great day out with Vespa Adventures
review_text: We came to Vietnam and saw the Vespa trips last year and decided to book ourselves on a trip this year on our return to Vietnam. They couldn't have been more helpful, we had to have a private tour because of time constraints, but the team were fantastic and took us to the Mekong Delta. We had great fun and loved this day out so much. The meal at the end was the best!
These guys were incredible and definitely the highlight of our trip. Wonderfully organized and great great fun. Thank you so much for making our trip x

review_title: one of the highlights of our time in Vietnam
review_text:
this was a great way to experience HCMC by night and to be in with all the scooters.
Not to mention the great food experience with our food guide.
Our drivers and guide were really passionate about what they were doing.
It was well organized and very safe. We'd recommend as a must do!

My girlfriend and I went on this tour the other day, it was really good fun and a great night out. Our tour guide Khang was friendly and very knowledgeable of the area. Our drivers Q. Quan and Leo were fantastic! Thanks for a great trip.

This tour was great, I was traveling with my ten year old daughter and Hanoi was our first city in Vietnam. This was a fun and informative day and a great experience being on the back of a scooter which we both loved and felt completely safe. Muse our tour guide and the boys were fabulous. We saw a few of the main local sights but also went and experienced some of the local and lesser known things of Hanoi. I would highly recommend these guys without a doubt!!

review_title: We should have done this first!
review_text: The only thing we wish we'd done differently on our trip to Ho Chi Minh was that we had done this tour in the first couple of days of arrival. Not only did Sunny and her team give us a great morning out, but the tour gives good insider tips on how to get your bearings in Ho Chi Minh in terms of the districts and the stops take you to the heart of this beautiful city's vibrant culture. It's not just a hop on hop off tour and the crew are the greatest of hosts. PLUS...you're on a vesper!!!

Took an evening street food tour with this company. Great fun. The tour guide was charming and full if information. The vespa driver was so amazing and careful and sweet (female). Loved every minute of it and would recommend to everyone. The traffic is crazy but I feel safe and secure.

As an older couple and having witnessed the traffic turmoil in Ho Chi Minh City, it was with some trepidation we undertook this tour. Well, we had the time of our life! The tour guide was a delight and our two drivers took the greatest of care. We left the hotel at 6 pm and returned back at 11 pm, sorry to see it finish. We enjoyed food and drinks at a variety of venues, music at an out of the way venue and lastly a nightclub with a rock band. It was great fun and one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

The tour was more interesting than I expected. Firstly, my guide Henry made a contact during the morning to announce the exact time and place for meeting. After we met the adventure started with motorbike riding which was fun and I felt rather safe in traffic. All three places we visited were different with several types of beer and food. Henry was informative about Vietnamese life, culture, etc. and we spent an interesting evening. I would suggest this tour not just for beer tasting but also for getting to know how people in Saigon live.

Our family had an absolute blast with Sunny at Vespa tours. It was exciting, authentic, educational and a great sensory experience. Our while family loved it. Best city experience I have done. Actually being part of the Ho Chi Min traffic chaos is an experience in itself

Upon arrival, one is struck with the ‘chaos ‘ of the Saigon streets. But, there is also an amazing efficiency to it all!

We we fortunate enough to have booked this ‘street food’ tour - and it was a highlight of our visit to Saigon. Experience the thrill of riding thru the streets on the back of a vespa. Great food, too. Don’t miss!!

A fun and entertaining tour. The Vespa drivers were excellent and obviously took our safety very seriously. Our tour guide Sunny was informative with a relaxed and friendly manner. From photo opportunities at the Opera House to sipping herbal tea in Chinatown the route was varied and well organized. Nice lunch at the Zoom Cafe. Highly recommended.

What a unique way to see the beautiful countryside of Vietnam. It's a great trip, however, a certain amount of physical endurance will be required as you spend several hours on the back of a Vespa over some pretty bumpy terrain. We thoroughly enjoyed this trip. Beautiful scenery, delicious food, and interesting sights. Miggy and her team were top notch! Thanks for a great day!
Excellent tour with lovely food and great entertainment. Our guide and drivers were wonderful. I would highly recommend this tour.

I thoroughly recommend any of the Vespa Adventure tours. This is my third tour and as expected it was exciting and fun with a thoroughly organized itinerary. The tour takes you to a few key tourist sites but more interestingly to some lesser known parts of Saigon. Sunny our tour guide was wonderful, friendly and informative. My driver Nam looked out for me and kept me safe on the back of the Vespa. The food at Zoom Cafe is flavoursome, delicious and abundant. Steve and his team do an amazing job. I am impressed with the attention to detail and customer care. Their tours enhance any visit to Vietnam and are without a doubt 'a must do'. Money well spent.

What an experience. The fun of weaving through the streets of saigon on a scooter with another 8 million was breathtaking. The guide was very friendly and informative and the mix of beers matched with food at each of our 5 bars we stopped at was top notch. Would definitely do again if I had the chance
Make sure you are used to the traffic in Vietnam, before you sit behind your driver and then just relax and enjoy your ride and the different stops. It's an unforgetable adventure.

Vespa tour has created some completely different tours that I have ever known. The biker is friendly and professional. Our Tour guide is humorous young lady and informative about local cusine, life and historical sites. They truly help me expand my view of Ho Chi Minh city in an authentic way. They drove me around town by Vespa so I did smell the city ambience closely. A must try Saigon After Dark.

This was one of the highlights of our trip! The tour was so well organized and the guide spoke perfect English. He was very prepared and friendly and took us to various spots. We each loved one of them and we were surprised to notice that they were not the usual tourist attraction at all, in fact you only see locals. The drivers were super safe and we really enjoyed it. If you want to immerse yourself in the Vietnamese culture you should give this a go!

This was the best fun for all ages. Great guides, fantastic places to eat and great entertainment. Riding around on the back of scooters around Hoi Chi Min City was exhilarating, absolutely fantastic.
Very exciting tour through Saigon with many culinaric stops and beautiful impressions. Highly recommended!

Wonderful way to see the sights and better understand the history and culture of this vibrant city. Visited some incredible places all on the back of an original Vespa. My guide Orange was amazing and the driver too. Can't recommend highly enough.

Thank you to Katty for taking us through the craft beer scene in HCMC! It was a lot of fun, her knowledge and experience in the beer scene was top notch as well.
I felt safe during the Vespa trips between venues as well. Phu was very professional, friendly and cautious.
Great job, guys!

We had a great time on our vespa adventure. In fact it was the highlight of our trip. What a great way to see the city at night, and we got to go places we will never have seen. Our tour guide was informative, helpful, and accommodated all our needs. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone.

Highlight of our holiday. What a professional friendly and fun way to see diagonal at night. Our tour guide Katie was above awesome, she made sue we all had fun, had all the food and drinks we could take and stayed with us until we couldn't party any more. Fantastic experience.

A close friend who had lived in HCMC for a number of years highly recommended we do a tour of the city on a Vespa. We looked up how to do this found Vespa Adventure tours.

Initially I was a bit hesitant having my family (wife & 9yo daughter) zooming around the manic streets of HCMC on a motor bike - but that soon faded away.

We were picked up (in Vespas) from our hotel by our drivers Hoa & Quyen who then took us to the muster point which was Cafe Zoom. There we met our fantastic guide - Sunny.

We truly got a personalized tour - my daughter and I had Sunny all to our selves. And we certainly got an "insiders" tour of HCMC - visiting places that we would otherwise not see.Sunny took us to some great spots throughout HCMC and her insight and knowledge was fantastic. She took great delight in looking after my daughter and explained to her all the sights we saw.

Throughout the tour (4 hours in total) we felt very safe as our drivers calmly and methodically weaved their way through the hustle and bustle of HCMC. At no time did I or my 9yo daughter feel unsafe. We got the full authentic experience with rain in the last half of our tour. For this, they were prepared and had ponchos for us to wear.

If want to get a true and up close experience of HCMC - this is the tour for you!

review_title: Best way to experience a bit of Vietnam!
review_text:
Had an awesome tour through the Mekong Delta with the fantastic Binh and my vespa driver Dunh (hope I got the spelling correct). Binh was a super guide - lots of interesting facts and funny stories, very knowledgeable. Dunh needs a medal after getting us through the traffic unscathed :)

Would highly recommend! The guys were awesome, a super day out exploring the countryside!

Thank you Binh & Dunh!

review_title: WE had a great time - recommended!
review_text:
We had a fantastic experience with Vespa Adventures guides.
We took the tour both in Hanoi as well as in Ho Chi Min city - in both cases the experience was great. Guides and drivers were very nice, knowledgeable, polite and took as to hidden places. Great way to experience the city and it's culture! Very recommended !

We did the brewery tour and it was a blast and drank so much beer. Super fun to ride on the back of a Vespa and not really scary at all, although traffic can get a bit crazy. All of the beer and food was good and the tour is well organized. We had a personal guide that met up with us at every brewery and then talked us through the food, beer and kept us entertained. Would be fun with a large group.

Our first impression from taking the taxi to the hotel was that we would never cross the roads of Saigon, never mind taking a four hour tour of the city on the back of a Vespa. But we did, and it was one of the best things we have ever done on holiday. Make sure you're hungry, though, as you are taken to street food restaurants serving amazing food and end up in a crazy bar, where we would have happily stayed for hours.

Make sure you choose Vespa Adventures, and not one of the larger operations offering the same. There were four of us and we received individual attention, but there are other companies where you will merely be one of a large group.

Started in pouring rain (they supplied rain ponchos), ended in clear night, and had a fantastic time. Riding a Vespa through city traffic let's you see the dance involved in weaving in, out, and through. Great food and good music. Never dreamt I'd do it; I would do it again!

This tour was really something special. Very well organized from start to finish. Our tour guide Katie was FANTASTIC. Great English, knowledgeable, great sense of humour, - her one rule - no empty glasses on the table. One of our group of 8 was nervous about getting on a bike in Saigon traffic. As soon as she got on, she loved it. You feel very safe on the Vespas.

Great experience. Ride started in a downpour but we were well looked after -provided with ponchos. Plenty of food and drink and great entertainment. Jenny our tour guide was great at looking after us.

review_title: An Awesome way to experience Saigon
review_text: We just finished a great morning driven around by Long and Chip and a wonderful tour guide ( can't spell name :( ) ......saw so much of the real Saigon and toured and driven by wonderful people who had our safety as paramount . You would think in this city with crazy traffic that it would be a scary experience, but it was an incredibly calm time ..... thanks guys, was a great morning , Greg and Penny

We love food and really wanted to try some authentic Vietnamese food during our stay so we booked onto the Vespa adventures tour and it didn't disappoint.

Not only did we get taken to the best local spots to eat some great food, but we also had a fabulous tour guide (Rosie) who explained every tradition and dish to us, something that was really interesting as it gave us a better insight into the country. Rosie also went out of her way and gave us plenty of tips on other restaurants to go during our trip. (All of which I were delicious!)

The drivers of our Vespa were also very good! Our drivers were called Duy K and Viet and they were very professional and made us feel safe whilst driving through the busy streets!

We had a great time and I would highly recommend this tour!

Im Vietnamese but im really surprised with experience Vespa adventure tour.
The tour was awesome- drivers were excellent (Mr Huy)- with all the traffic we felt always safe. Our tour guide(Mr. Tri), made this an unforgettable experience. He was informative, told us a lot about Vietnamese history and culture.
Thank you to the Vespa Adventures team. I definitely recommend this tour to everyone and would do it again!

review_title: This was a fun and great learning experience!
review_text: This was a fun and great learning experience! Great opportunity to ride a motor bike without having to learn how to drive in the busy streets of Saigon. The places visited were very interesting, and our tour guide, Sunny, explained and informed very well the cultural importance of these sites. The food offered for breakfast and lunch was delicious, and the places where we ate were really cool. Sunny also did a nice job explaining what it was that we were eating.

Great drivers, no safety anxiety despite the chaotic traffic and really interesting and delicious restaurant stops, the evening culminating in a visit to a secluded lounge bar with brilliant singers, off the tourist trail.

The Vespa tour was a great way to get amongst the organized chaos that is Saigon's roads. We ate at varied and interesting places, always side by side with locals. A great night, highly recommended!!!
This was a terrific experience in Ho Chi Minh. The food was good, the skill of the riders in the traffic exceptional and I would recommend it to anyone.

The tour was awesome- drivers were excellent- with all the traffic we felt always safe. Our tour guide, Orange, made this an unforgettable experience. He was informative, told us a lot about Vietnamese history and culture. We highly recommend Vespa Adventures- when you are lucky you will have Orange as a guide- but we bet everyone in this team is great! :)
Definitely take the evening food tour. You will eat things you wouldn't normally try at places you would never find. And experience the roads on a Vespa what could be better

review_title: Sensational way to start your holidays
review_text: We did this day 1 of our trip. Was a great way to get to know the city. Our tour guide "Orange" was very knowledgable spoke perfect English and could answer any question we threw his way. My rider Long was very good and i felt safe 100% of the time even when we were turning corners. To finish off with our meal at the cafe was delish and a cocktail very welcome Would 100% recommend.

I have done 4 tours now with Vespa Adventures including the Mekong Day Tour and the Ho Chi Minh night tour, and it just gets better each tour I go on! I have brought back many friends for the tours and all have absolutely loved it, this time coming back with my partner who couldn't rave about it enough. Our tour guide Na was amazing, so friendly and so informative. We immediately booked another one in Hoi An as we are heading up north. Can't wait!

Thank you to the Vespa Adventures team. Can't wait to come back already.

review_title: Don't miss the Mekong Delta Tour
review_text: We did the "Glimpse of the Mekong" 1 day tour from Ho Chi Minh City. Our tour guide was Miggy, who was friendly, knowledgeable, and organized. Our drivers were excellent, and we experienced the chaos of being on a motorbike in Saigon without fear. This 1-day tour was one of the highlights of our time in Saigon.

review_title: Saigon night tour - don't miss it!
review_text:
This adventure was by far the best optional tour we did during our 10 days in Vietnam. It was exhilarating riding among the chaotic traffic. The food was amazing and being taken to a 'hidden' coffee lounge and local bar was a real treat that the average tourist would not find. Our host Vy was wonderful, very enthusiastic and she looked after us well. My driver, M Cuong, made me feel very safe, a friendly, lovely young man.
I definitely recommend this tour to everyone and would do it again!

Saigon night tour - DO IT. it was the most enjoyable experience i had. Enjoyed every part of this activity would recommend it to everyone. you will see a different side to Vietnam. the food was fantastic - the seafood restaurant, the pancake restaurant, the dingy dive in the back alley that was fantastic when you went in, the latino night club every tour experience was special not to mention my experienced vespa driver that made me feel like a queen taking my helmet on and off. our tour guide was full of knowledge and assisted with everything very helpful

Well worth the money. In short, a big part of life in Saigon is transported by scooter/Vespa, and you really can't get a true feel for life in Saigon without zipping around the city on one. This was a great way to see a lot of the city in one night. The restaurants were good particularly in a district 4. It felt authentic and the tour rotates among restaurants so that you don't end up at a touristy "Vespa tour only" restaurant.

The whole experience is very convenient. Our scooter actually picked us up at our hotel to take us to the meeting point with the rest of our group. A small touch but meant a lot to us and saved us having to navigate the city and pay for a taxi to meet up. On the tour, All the food and drink is Included with the price so the experience is easy and convenient. We never waited in lines as the restaurants were expecting us each stop. You get a lot of food and can drink as much as you want.

The tour would have been fun just riding the scooters around at night but adding the food and drink made it better. My one area that could be improved was the bar selection. We went to 2 restaurants and 2 bars. The restaurants were great and first bar (a small acoustic live music venue) was also great. The last bar was called Woodstock and had a cover band playing American rock. It was not particularly interesting and fairly empty. It certainly didn't ruin the evening but a different bar could be an improvement.

Overall 5 star experience and a "must do" especially if you have only a short time in Saigon
Could not fault! Tour was unreal. We went in a larger group from ages 20 to 60 and everyone had an awesome night. Our guide Vy did an amazing job. Would highly recommend.

Wow wow wow this is a must do when in Ho Chi Minh. First class tour with the most beautiful people that allowed us to see sights that we would never have seen just being tourists. Our guide Sunny was a ray of sunshine and never stopped smiling the whole time. Completely professional and we thoroughly recommend it!!

The Saigon After Dark tour was the highlight of my stay in HCMC. The food was great and it was really nice to visit the music venues of the local. My tour guide Jaden is very friendly and she makes you feel like traveling with friend all the time. My driver Nhi has good driving skills and he was keen to show me around. Thanks to both for giving me a memorable night in Saigon.

review_title: Great initiation to Ho Chi Minh
review_text: First night in Saigon and we had this booked in, what an AMAZING adventure!!!! Slightly terrifying scooting through all the traffic but my driver Used was awesome and although he was the oldest of the bunch he was the fastest and most agile through the traffic, I felt really safe with him and he pointed out some of the main sights. They drop you at points along the way to taste the local food. Our guide Rosy was a gorgeous effervescent Vietnamese girl with great English and a thirst for knowledge of the world around her, all in all it was a really great night. 5 ⭐️

Had a great time on Saigon after dark adventure. The street food we had was excellent - some of the best food we had in the whole of Vietnam. Drinks are free flowing. Our guides Kat and Anne were excellent, fun and had great English.
Only downside was my driver complaining that I hadn't tipped him enough. This leaves a sour taste in what was otherwise an exhilarating evening.
Definitely a worth while activity to enjoy. Highly recommended. Would do it again in a heartbeat. It's great and safe for all ages. Do need to have a good appetite and eat most foods.

A fun night out with skilful drivers, a guide who explained all the dishes we ate at different stops and delicious food.The tour ended at nightclub with live entertainers who were great.Highly recommend this experience.
Crew is friendly and the tour was amazing. Good stories, great route and delicious food. Worthwhile!!

Vespa Adventures (Saigon After Dark) was the highlight of my holiday! We were met at our hotel by the Vespa drivers who took photos of the whole family on the bikes. We then started out on the journey and visited a place for drinks, a local restaurant (the food was yummy and an interesting experience), followed by being taken to a pancake restaurant, a hidden cafe with extremely talented singers (my favorite part of the night), and finished with a lively bar packed with locals.

The trip was extremely well organized, the drivers were friendly and super enthusiastic, especially my driver Nhi. You also get a local friend who takes you round for the evening, we had Rosy who was so funny and friendly and it was a great evening driving round the manic streets of Ho Chi Minh City.

I would recommend this trip, as it was well worth the money and a great experience!

Florence.

Had a great night out with the wonderful Jayden .... friendly, welcoming, and a great sense of fun and humour. Driver Nhi made me feel very safe in the chaos of Hi Chi Min traffic.
A must do, with amazing food in great locations, and plenty of drinks thrown in, ending with cocktails in a very interesting Nightclub.

We've just returned from our evening food tour with Thien and our drivers Mr Fu & Huan and rate this as one of the best food tours we've done. Vespa Adventures is very well organized with itineraries, photographers and lots of attention to detail. The scenic routes to our food destinations gave us a good sense of the city. The seafood stop was some of the best shellfish we've eaten, even according to my fussy husband. The second stop with the pancake special was also delicious but with nine courses it's easy to run out of room. Our last stop was the Cucku Bar for live music which was a lovely way to finish our Vietnam trip. We'd definitely recommend Vespa Adventures: safe, fun, organized, personalized and delicious.

If you are in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam you must take the tour with Vespa Tours. You will get a chance to see the city at night with bike ride.
I don't know from where to begin. Amazing hospitality, very safe ride, unlimited food, unlimited drinks, couple spots for night life ALL in one. They also have a photograph who follows you takes pix for memories and emails you the photos. Tour guys are very sweet, funny and humble. Steve, you are doing it right!

Thank you

review_title: Amazing tour for a daily trip!
review_text: I really enjoyed the tour with Vespa Adventure. I took the Saigon After Dark tour and I could travel around the city including nice local restaurants and coffee shops as well as nice live music cafe My tour guide and driver Ms. Kim Dong was so lovely and I was very satisfied with my day in HCMC. I would love to take the tour again when I visit Saigon next time.

Saigon is famous for its crowded city with many personal transportation on the road. If you have traveled to Saigon, experience the feeling of exploring SG on a motorcycle . My driver was Ms Kim Dong were always smiling , friendly and nothing was a problem . Many thanks for making our night so amazing.

review_title: The Best Way to Experience Saigon's Food, Sights and Sounds!
review_text:
The whole experience is fun and exhilarating! We got to see Saigon at Night - in style. We visited different restaurants and secret cafes I wouldn't know or dare visit on my own.

The Vespa Adventures Drivers are well experienced in driving around the busy streets of Ho Chi Minh. Our tour guide shares tips and trivia about the food and different spots - and she speaks good English too.

Oftentimes, travel will force you to go out of your comfort zone and hop on a scooter. Better do it with #VespaAdventures.

Great experience with Tri from the Vespa Adventures Team!

Everything was taking care for: food, drinks, drivers. We just had to sit on the Vespas, enjoy the view, the food and the drinks and nothing else to worry about!

A MUST DO in Saigon

We took the Vespa foodie tour of Saigon and had a fantastic time. My driver M. Tu was fantastic and very helpful and most of all - a really confident rider of the vespa itself. My wife and five year old child were on another bike and never felt at risk (certainly less than crossing the street on your own!). T who was running the whole show was confident and fun and really open in sharing insights into his life in the modern Vietnam. I couldn't recommend the tour enough as an introduction to the sights, sounds and smell of Saigon.

Wow, that was awesome. Fun, educational, and a great experience. From the minute we met our drivers to the minute they dropped us off, it was just fun. Nothing is spared, more food than you can eat and you never go thirsty.

The food was fantastic. We did the seafood experience and it did not let us down. Sensational. The bars we went to were pumping. Reserved tables and special services.

I highly recommend Fooley as your guide. Very knowledgeable, great English and a lot of fun. My driver was Dong, great rider and always on the front.

We will do this again in Hanoi this week.

You cannot come to Vietnam without doing this.

Did the trip with driver, Nhi and it was terrific. We were concerned about safety and the seemingly erratic traffic of a large Asian city. However Nhi was skilled, informative and sensible.

Zipping through Ho Chi Minh at night was a unique opportunity to see a whole aspect of life you would not get by other means of transport. The evening was effortless as all aspects of hospitality were considered.

Advice don’t eat lunch as there is a deal of eating involved! Also if you suffer with motion sickness the smell of fumes and some of the “zipping” may impact on your nausea levels a little.

Highlights include the crab at venue 1 and the last rock venue- outstanding!

There seems to be several Vespa crowds this one seems to be the original.

review_title: Must do when in Ho Chi MInh
review_text:
I've been to Ho Chi MInh before and frankly I didn't really find a reason to go back. If not for the cheap fair from Air Asia, I wouldn't have. But really, Ho chi MInh for me was just a place to land--- I was really making my way to other parts of Vietnam.

All this changed when i tried the Vespa Adventure tour. I enjoyed my time with them so nmuch that it made me look at giving Ho Chi MInh another chance. They took us to the best local food and we even ended up in a Rock Bar which we barely didn't want to leave. it was really so much fun, we learned a lot about Vietnamese food culture and this was definitely a good start to our trip, I mean, after this, we knew what meals we wanted.

Definitely have to do this while in Ho Chi Minh.

Best afternoon! 3 of us, Very nervous as our ages ranged from 77, 67 and 57. But our guides were patient and careful. Comfortable to sit on the back if the Vesta. They guide you on how to get on and off. At first I was very nervous, because of the crazy traffic, but Ben, my guide soon had me settled in and enjoying the ride. We stopped several times for experiences, and chances for photos. We stopped in 3 villages, one they made bed mats, one that made rice wine and finally where they produce rice noodles. Here we got to make our own and then Mrs Anh cooked us up the best rice noodle and pork pho.....Devine. Each stop was a private home and I felt privileged to be part of this day.

A fun filled morning wizzing through the streets of Saigon. It was my first time on a bike and although a little nervous to begin with it was clear to see that our drivers, Tam and Nhat Chip, were very experienced and excellent at what they do. Our guide Ful Ly was knowledgable and friendly and led the tour well, sharing his inside info of Saigon as we went. Even though this is usually a group tour due to the timing we were lucky enough to have a personal tour making the experience all the more special. Thank you Vepsa Adventures!

Can't remember when we had so much fun! Picked up at Hotel at 6:30. Rode thru Saigon on Vespas. First to local seafood restaurant with scrumptious specialties. Then ride to Vietnamese pancake Restaurant. Then an underground night club with several singers. Last to a live music venue. Lively! Safe drivers brought us home about 11:00 exhausted. Do not miss this opportunity. Once in a life time!

review_title: Outstanding Night Out On The Town
review_text: We had a great night out. Enjoyed the friendship of two Irish couples under the lovely guidance of Rosy. Our two drivers Tuan and Ty looked after us well and gave us an amazing experience in the traffic! We loved the food and the music bars were outstanding. Highly recommend as a must do in Ho Chi Minh.

Fantastic experience. This was our favorite tour on our holidays.
getting amongst the hustle and bustle and experiencing Saigon at night was amazing.
Our guide sunny and her team here load of fun.

It's a MUST do when visiting.

Wow what a great evening- racing around Saigon on the back of a Vespa scooter. We feel very safe in the competent hands of our drivers. We enjoyed the different stops with great food and drink. The last stop - the night club was not for us but I am 70! Would definitely recommend!

review_title: All I can say is wow
review_text: I hope your listening when I tell you this is a can't miss experience to see Ho Chi Min city in a way that you never could. We were led by Fully and his trusted team of drivers. They were all amazing. Navigating the streets of this City in a way that only they could. We were 4 people and even thought there was insane traffic due to Independence Day they got us everywhere safe and sound all you do is sit on the back and enjoy the view. The choices fully made were amazing the food the culture the music. Really wow. Best night in Vietnam so far. Can't say enough. Thank you fully for a highlight in all my travels.

review_title: Saigon After Dark - Put the night tour on your list
review_text:
Excellent night time tour. Steve the owner of the tour is extremely welcoming and has clearly organized a well rounded tour of Saigon. Jenny (guide) and Hoi (Vespa driver) were the consummate guides of their city, the history, the people, the food!
Amazing visit to an acoustic bar that I would never have known existed. You should put this on your list of things to do.

review_title: Thoroughly enjoyed this Vespa adventure-,Saigon after dark
review_text:
From 6pm until 1030pm, this trip was fun filled and was exhilarating throughout.
A great guide called Rosy, who kept us entertained all evening, who along with our drivers was kind and considerate.
A great choice of restaurants and bars to let us experience true Vietnamese food and culture.
Well done to the whole team and in particular to my driver Dao, and a gold star for Rosy!

An excellent trip in Saigon held by vespaadventures.com Rosie our local friend was so funny and enthusiastic the whole night and my driver Phong was very attentive and an extremely good drive in my opinion the best. It is honestly the best day of my life well done guys.
A fabulous night out - excellent driver, knowledgeable guide, great food, and exceptional entertainment. Highly recommend!

This is one of the most amazing experiences I've had during all my years of traveling. Saigon traffic seems crazy, but when you're a part of it you suddenly find out that there is a system and order. Teriffic English speaking guides and a genuine, local foodie experience makes the evening complete. At the end we had drinks at a local night club before being driven safely back to our hotel by the genuine vintage Vespas and our drivers.

This evening foody experience was more than we dared hope for. We were carefully matched with another family and the whole trip so well organized, it was very slick. From restaurant to bar across several well chosen venues which without Vespa adventures a tourist is unlikely to find. In terms of unusual we loved the upstairs coffee bar with local singers best. Not to be missed.

We went on the day vespa tour and were picked up from our hotel on time by our lovely drivers. My husband and I were a little worried but there was no need to be it was such a great trip with our guide Minh. We ate the zoom cafe and plenty of choice too. We also did Saigon after dark a completely different trip. We ate so much.fab food and drink alcoholic and non alcoholic offered all the time. We went to different evening venues too and we all enjoyed it including our 21 and 18 year olds. Sunny our guide was so lovely. At.the end of the trips you get framed photos and all photos taken whilst on your tour sent to you. These trips were the best we have ever done.

This trip is well worth doing for the insight into the village life. You need to be able to get your leg over a vesper and the roads are quite rugged in places so watch your back. We were picked up from our hotel and taken to the departure point in Hoi An. We were soon beeping our way out of the city and into the rice fields. Visited the home of a sleeping mat maker. Very poor people. The man had lost his leg at the end of the American war and had struggled to make a living ever since. Also another home where a lady made rice paper 12 hours a day for a pittance. Then to a house where the family makes rice wine and pigs keeps. The pig dropping's are washed into an underground tank where the fermentation produces biogas which is used to heat the fermented rice to distil alcohol. The remaining rice mash is then fed to pigs. Nothing is wasted by these frugal people. To be able to see into these people's homes is a humbling experience. Great to get into the fields where they were harvesting this time of year. Had a meal of traditional local rice noodles and eggplant cooked over the fire. Great experience. Genuinely friendly vesper drivers. Our tour leader Bean was informative and interesting. Courteous and considerate.

This is one of the best value for money tours we have done. We did the afternoon Vespa tour of Ho Chi Minh City.
Our guide Uyen was extremely friendly and outgoing as were our drivers Tien and Trung. Uyens knowledge of the places we visited allows us an indepth insight into these areas. We were taken to several different places that you may not otherwise visit, but at the same time also covered the major areas of interest. Being in the middle of the traffic on the back of a Vespa was exhilirating, yet also felt completely safe. We would fully recommend any of the tours offered by Vespsa Adventures.
Great fun. Entertaining guide and wonderful food. We couldn't fault it. Make sure you bring the Go pro.

Wow, what a great way to experience Saigon - brilliant drivers, great guide and a cracking evening - would thoroughly recommend it - when we come back to enchanting Vietnam we will definitely do it again

What a fantastic night out. Lots of delicious food to eat washed down with some nice cold drinks. My wife was apprehensive about getting on the back of a Vespa and riding around in the traffic until she met our Vespa drivers Tai & Yu who are experienced friendly locals who make you feel completely safe. She loved it and so did I. We absolutely recommend this night out.

What a wonderful experience eating and drinking at some wonderful places and being taken there by very experienced and knowledgeable Vespa drivers. It was fun and exhilarating being amidst the busy traffic. Our tour guide was fun and I would recommend this tour to anyone wanting to do it. Very, very good value for money!

An Amazing adventure with our "best friend" Hoaiuy & driver DUC !! Don't be afraid of being in amongst the traffic, felt totally safe & comfortable riding on the back of the Vespa. Very professional & lots of fun !!

review_title: Oh, what a night in Saigon
review_text: What an amazing experience .... roaming the city streets on a Vespa... stopping at many restaurants, private coffee club, finishing off at a bar. Great night thanks to our great crew, Kelsey our excellent guide super friendly & knowledgeable. Our riders Nhi & Vu great job boys, kept us very safe ...experienced riders. Highly recommend tour

This was one of the highlights of our time in Ho Chi Minh. Our guide Jayden was fun and informative. The food was delicious and the cocktails and beer flowed freely. The Vespas were new, cool and the drivers were very safe. Weaving in and out of the busy traffic was exhilarating and I am a novice, having never been on a bike before. The bars and music at the end of the night were great and this made the trip better from other companies doing a similar tour. Jayden found out it was our wedding anniversary she arranged a cake for us in the first bar, this was a lovely surprise. The trip is good value and I would highly recommend it.

review_title: Long Weekend in Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
So if you all ever come to Ho Chi Minh; you have to do the Vespa Adventures Craft Beer tour.
23 taster beers in 6 locations with excellent food pairings and great (sober) riders.
Ignore the lack of PPE, this safety manager was safer on the bike rather than crossing the road as a pedestrian.
Great night.

I hate motorcycles but my husband persuaded me to go on this tour and I'm SO glad I did, it was great fun craft beer experience with paired food over four locations. Great value for money, excellent knowledgeable guide and drivers were just fabulous. I felt incredibly safe being driven by Nhi despite the bonkers traffic. I will recommend this trip to everyone I know who is coming to Saigon. Cool bars, great craft beers and food, best of all great companies. Well done Team

My boyfriend and I did the after dark tour on our second night in Vietnam to get an introduction to the food we will be eating for the next few weeks! The tour was great! The Vespa drivers were amazing and it was quite surreal to be zooming through the streets of Ho Chi Minh on a Vespa. Rosy was full of good laughs and information about the food we were eating. My only hesitation on doing a second tour of this would be that you can feel a little rushed at each place to obviously make the deadline to second and so forth. Would definitely recommend to anyone who wants a night out in Saigon!

review_title: One of the best 'touristy' things we've ever done
review_text:
Basically you'd be crazy not to give this a go whilst in Vietnam.
Initially the thought of doing this seemed crazy but once you're on the bikes and in the traffic, whilst intense, it all works and is just so much fun!
They had the perfect balance between safety and thrills and I wouldn't have a problem bringing our kids back to do it (9,14 and 17)
Food was a real slice of local cuisine and delish and Guide Hoi was so much fun!
I could not recommend this tour more!

Amazing evening in Saigon!
Thanks to Jenny for excellent guiding and Ricky for safe driving!
This tour takes you around Saigon on the back of a Vespa... Safe? Yes I feel safe, but you get close to the traffic and I'm glad I'm not driving...
The tour takes us from bars, to local food tasting, back to live music bar..
All included in the price, both food and drinks.
We tasted seafood, frogs, vegetables, pancakes etc all the Vietnamese style. Food was very good and not to spicy.
I recommend this tour to all my friends(children I think must be about 10 years)
I booked this tour through an agency but you can also book directly from vespaadventures.com

review_title: to see much more in HCM
review_text:
We had a half day tour in Ho Chi Ming. It's incredible how much you could see during 4 hours. We saw many different parts of the city, Bird Park, Chinesse Town, central part and had coffee break, lunch included.
The real pearl was our tour guide Sunny, great information, always smiling, making pictures and sending them to you, full of nice ideas. The time had passed so quick, you would like to ride more and more...
Highly recommended!

review_title: Great way to see lots of hidden gems
review_text: Did the 0800-1200 trip, have done it before but came with friends on their first trip to Saigon so wanted them to also experience the best overview of Saigon going. Is a fantastic way to see a whole range of different places and get a feel for the city and it's wonderful people.

review_title: Great way to see the best hangouts and experience local food, music and drinks
review_text: I had a wonderful night-time vespa tour in Saigon with my guide Rosy and rider Thien in August 2018. The trip began at a cafe, proceeded to two restaurants and then 2 bars. It was a great way to experience the food, culture and vibe of the city. The food was amazing, the live music was a lot of fun, but the guides made the trip really memorable with fun facts about the local culture. Everything was amazingly managed by a logistics crew and everything worked like clockwork! I highly recommend this tour as a fun way to get the feel of the city.

review_title: Great fun, and an excellent way to see the city
review_text:
We were told that Saigon has 8m scooters in a city of 10m. It certainly feels like it. Therefore seeing the city by scooter is a very authentic experience, and a great way to cover a lot of ground in a short time. From markets, to temples, to landmarks via just seeing how the city feels, it was a great experience.

The company were very professional. A few points:

- we were asked to mention names on TripAdvisor - that I am not so keen on but it seems very common in Vietnam
- the scooters aren't so new, and belched fumes. This could be improved.
- we debated the afternoon tour vs evening tour, and did the afternoon tour. Very happy with that choice, and fortunately avoided a downpour.

We did the island & countryside tour. Onion Phi was our tour guide. From start to finish it was really enjoyable. There were several stops, all of which were worthwhile. You get to see beautiful things that you otherwise never would. It was the best day we had in Hoi An. If you are in any way concerned about being on a scooter in the traffic don't be, the route taken is extremely safe & quiet and the drivers garlic, bang & hy were very cautious.

At first we were apprehensive that a Vespa tour would be A. too touristy, and B. dangerous/frightening. We were very pleasantly surprised. Not only were the drivers excellent, and the rides safe and comfortable--but also the thrill of weaving in and out of Saigon's densely packed streets was nothing short of exhilarating. One of the best things we did in Saigon.Traveling with my husband, we were assigned a tour guide who met us and sat with us at each stop (a coffee house, a couple restaurants, a bar/nightclub, and a music hall). Our own guide was great--good English, friendly, well-versed in the menus of the restaurants and bars visited. We especially liked that the tour went out of District One into more "local" neighborhoods. The only disappointment was the final stop--a sort of dive bar/music hall--that was billed as a Saigon hipster venue frequented by locals. At least the evening we were there, the only patrons were us and other Vespa Adventures tourists. So it feels very inauthentic and a waste of time. All the other stops were terrific however, and overall we highly recommend this!

Only in Vietnam can you jump on the back of a Vespa like a pillion passenger and be whizzed round Old Saigon as the sun goes down .Start with a beer and then journey through the streets to find street food Well organized and safe drivers .Food was great but lots of it ..make sure you only have a light lunch .Finish with a selection of romantic then rock music Exhilarating!!

review_title: Awesome tour of Ho Chi Minh City.
review_text:
The Insider's Tour of Ho Chi Minh City was entertaining and educational. Truly a great way to learn about what makes this city special. Our guide, Sunny, was a ball of sunshine. Her enthusiasm about everything she showed us made the tour unforgettable. Thank you Sunny!

I highly recommend this tour if it's your first time exploring the city. What a rush.
A must do in Saigon. Exciting, safe, great views, great food.Highlight of our trip to Vietnam. Will be back👌👌👌

I and my friend traveled in ho chi minh city last week we did vespa tour. The tour is very proffessional and visit a lot of places tour guide is very good and speaks very good english, took us to visit flower local market 100000 buda temple, and also took us to visit china town , this one of the best tour need to do in ho chi minh very highly recommend this tour, lets do this tour when you come , but a but expensive.
Great tour highly recommended, we were well looked after by a knowledgeable guide. Good way to the real Ho Chi Min city.

We booked 8 Vespas for our party, with a guide leader, Alina. Alina was so knowledgeable and so much fun. Our Vespa drivers were all brilliant and very, very safe drivers. It was so much fun and thrilling driving through the streets of Saigon. We had about 5-6 stops, which included coffee break, walks through the flower market, Cambodia food market, Herbal Tea shop and a most amazing Buddhist Temple. The city tour took over 4 1/2 hours which finished with delicious lunch.
We would highly recommend this company for the Vespa tours as all had a fantastic time. Thank you Alina and team for making it such an enjoyable experience.

Really enjoyed this tour! Our guide was knowledgable and fun and the drivers were professional and safe. Such a great way to see the sights of Saigon and so much fun being among the traffic like a local. Definitely recommend!
Man I'm a bike rider and this team made my trip it was an awesome experience of food beer and bikes we had a group of 9 and all loved it
Great Adventure.Great foodGood ValueGreat HospitalityHighly Recommend this trip with the Vespa Team
This tour and our host were brilliant!! Would do it again for sure, loved being on the bikes and loved the authentic food we got to try!
We were recommended the Vespa ride and would definitely also recommend. As well as being so much fun, the food was amazing and the guide and Vespa drivers all great. Would do again.
Great fun with good people there to make sure you enjoy the adventure. I would highly recommend anyone to put this on their to do list. It was awesome.
It was a wonderful experience. Great to get an overview of the city felleing like a local. Our guides and drivers were awesome.

we had the best time with the Vespa guys, they were so pleasant, polite and respectful. We were taken on a fabulous tour which started from the moment we were picked up at our hotel, first stop was cocktails, followed by some amazing eateries that we normally would not have tried then we finished the night at a couple of night spots. there was something for everyone. We thoroughly enjoyed our evening and it was the highlight of our stay. Would absolutely do it all again.

We enjoyed a lot! What an amazing Vespa tour in Saigon. “Te” was our street food guide. Everything great, he was explaining the different Vietnam food that we were eating during our Vespa tour. Extraordinary! Everything was great. Vespa drivers ten over ten. Street food experience ten over ten. It's the best way to know the city, the motorcycle driving style of Saigon, and the typical street food. Very recommendable for families with kids over 10 years old. And they do in other countries. Congratulations!!
Excellent tour! Our guide was Sunny, who was amazingly affected. If you fancy trying street food in HCMC, I would recommend asking for her as your guide. So much fun, and such yummy food.

The absolute highlight of our ten day trip to Vietnam. It was our last night but if we'd done it earlier on the trip we would have instantly booked another. Brilliantly put together and fun from start to finish. Can't wait to return so we can do it again!

review_title: Excellent day trip up the Mekong Delta!
review_text: We were very impressed with the wonderful day trip through markets, stopping off at a cafe for morning tea / coffee; visiting a temple; visiting rural areas were both rice wine and incense were made. Our guide was fantastic and our drivers were very friendly and kind. The trip starts in the chaos of Ho Chi Minh city. My wife was a bit concerned in terms of safety to start but the drivers were so good that she felt at ease very early on in the tour. The lunch to end the trip was excellent. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking to learn and wanting to have a safe adventure.

Highly recommend this tour. Great fun, food entertainment and sightseeing Saigon at night. Our drivers picked us up from our hotel at 6pm and dropped us back around 10.30pm. You go to numerous street cafes to try local food and finish up at a romantic music venue and finally a rock bar. We went with my 16 year old and 14 year old who loved it and were very adventurous with food but they could cater for all.
One of the highlights of our 3 week holiday

We did the street food tour through Hoi An it was so much fun night. Ben and his team were fantastic. Felt very safe on Vespas. We were taken to some great places for food and had great conversation, Ben was very knowledgeable and interesting. Would throughly recommend this tour. Thanks to all for a memorable night.

What a fabulous experience to explore Ho Chi Minh City as a pillion passenger on a vespa! Our safe, experienced "drivers", Tam and NhatChip, navigated the bustling traffic throughout the main roads, back roads and laneways of this busy city. Our tour guide, Fulley, was pleasant and informative.
We highly recommend Vespa Adventures!

review_title: Will be talking about this for a long time
review_text: Fantastic night out! Will be talking about this for a long time coming. A very well run operation, great visiting restaurants incl yummy veggie options and our guide Sunny was a terrific host. Highly recommend.

We've done 3 tours with Vespa Tours all fantastic. Thank you to Onion, Garlic, Quoc, Duc, Lanh, Hy and Sang for making our Country side trip so enjoyable and informative. We had a great lunch at the end of our tour and would not hesitate to tell every one to do these tours!!!

My husband, teenage son and I loved this tour. Exciting visiting different eateries on vespas with our knowledgeable local guide. Finale was two music venues listening to french music sung by great Vietnamese singer and rock songs by a Filipino band. Great night!

review_title: Vespa craft beer tour with Kat
review_text: What a great night - good company, great beer and a fantastic way to navigate the city. Loved it and would highly recommend it.

From the moment we were picked up on the Vespas our drivers were excellent and friendly. Our drivers were Dung and M.Than, they were so friendly and nothing was a problem. Our host for the evening was Danny and wow he made the entire night an amazing experience for us. He was so knowledgable and was able to give us so much local information. We will be back to Vietnam and will certainly be doing the Vespa Adventure again. We highly recommend this vespa tour. Many many thanks for making our night so amazing.

At the end of our Vietnam holiday my wife and I had a great time on the Vespa Saigon After Dark tour. It was four hours traveling around several eating/drinking establishments. As well as the Vespa driver, you also have a separate tour guide who meets you at each stop and tells you about the bar/cafe and its history. We learned a lot.

This is a must if you're visiting Ho Chi Minh City but probably best not to do it on your first day….it might be a little bit scary if you're not used to the insane traffic.

This is a must for any family to do, the best tour I have ever done. Having experienced part of the city by foot it was awesome to ride alongside the locals and see areas we would never have found ourselves. Our tour guide Orange was very informative and extremely helpful with local history adding in a personal aspect which made it all even more interesting. He allowed time to look around and didn't rush us from one thing to the next so we could experience Ho Chi Minh properly. Binh, Son, Duong and Nhi were our friendly drivers who took exceptional care of us and made thre trip so enjoyable. They are exceptional drivers especially when we headed off the main roads down small alleyways. Nhi even pointed out various things on the actual ride which was an added bonus. Thank you to team Orange and the other family we were with, it will forever be an amazing trip to Ho Chi Minh city, we might have to return and do the other tours.

review_title: A great way to see the city at night
review_text:
This is a great trip.....not for the faint hearted though.You are picked up from your hotel at 6pm ,on the Vespa & taken to District 1, backpacker land.
You meet up with other Vespa guests & you are divided into smaller groups- normally 4 people maximum.
You have a drink, beer/ soft drinks & a snack.Then off to the 1st seafood restaurant, be aware they take plenty of pictures of you eating, drinking and one with your driver & guide.
If you don't like seafood or are allergic to it, your guide will order you something else.
You have at least 4 courses, which come out very quickly, all washed down with beer/ soft drinks.
Then off to the pancake and spring roll restuarant.Again about 4/ 5 different dishes with beer/ soft drinks.
From there you head to a "romantic" cafe with local musicians and singers, coffee & ice cream.
The final destination is a rock bar with more drinks.
You are then driven back to your hotel to arrive by 11pm.
Your driver provides a poncho for the downpours and also provides a printed picture of you on the vespa.
