A really good night of weaving in & out of the traffic & eating amazing food.

What a great way to experience Ho Chi Minh City. Our tour guide Oehn (hopefully I've got the spelling right) was friendly and made the six of us (from Oz, UK & NZ) feel welcome. The bikes we rode were 40 year old Vespas which have been lovingly restored. My driver negotiated the traffic with ease, giving me the opportunity to just take in the sights and sounds that the city has to offer. We sampled eateries, cafes and a couple of night clubs with enough time to enjoy complimentary drinks. Overall a memorable night.

The Vespa Tour at night was the highlight of our Vietnam trip. Exploring a city in this way was not only exciting but also a very unique way to experience a city. The company is extremely professional and everything is organized to the tee. All the staff are very friendly and knowledgeable. Special mention of our guide Jenny who was so bubbly and made our night out one to remember.

I highly recommend going for this tour, you will not regret it!

Thanks Vespa Adventures, keep up your brilliant standards!
Excellent tour. I enjoyed seeing the nooks and crannies of the city along with more touristy spots. Sunny was a fantastic guide!!

I jumped at the chance to go sightseeing and tasting Saigon after dark, on the back of a classic Vespa. Our group of 6 was guided by the upbeat and friendly Sunny to backstreet restaurants and streetfood stalls were we ate our fill of delicious seafood, pancakes and plenty of cold beer. Another stopping point was a hidden upstairs cafe with a nivghtlucb ambience, and we finished up in a fun bar with a live bad playing hard rock covers. We learned through our eyes and ears as well as our tastebuds! The whole operation worked like clockwork and I always felt safe riding behind Khanh, who expertly steered his scooter from meeting point to meeting point, weaving through the Saigon night traffic. A great way to explore this vibrant and humming city.
Tonight family of 4 went on Vespa trip around Saigon. Quite simply top drawer! Despite middle off a monsoon.

We would not have been able to find such cool places on our own. What a thrill to zip round the city on the back of a Vespa. Thanks to Tu my driver for keeping me safe. The food was great including frog! and Tian our guide made it really interesting with information about the Vietnamese culture. If you like live music you are in for a treat, so sad we didn't have longer.

We loved exploring Saigon by Vespa, it was so much fun! We were only in Saigon for 2 days so this was a really good way to see a lot of the city. Our drivers and guide were all great, we liked it so much that we booked a Vespa tour in Siem Reap for the next day which we also loved.

Took night Vespa Adventures tour which was fantastic, great street food, entertainment both at coffee shop and bar was wonderful, especially coffee stop. Driver and guide were excellent and it was amazing being on the back of Vespa in so much traffic and feeling very safe. Highly recommend taking this tour when in Ho Chi Minh city.
Thanks Rosy Son and Huy, loads of fun, great food, awesome experience and for making us feel safe. We enjoy every moment!
Brilliant vespa tour of city, a good amount of stops with great food. Sunny, our guide, was a lot of fun and made us feel very welcome. Recommended!

Thanks Rosy Son and Huy, we had a fantastic time on pur Vespa street food tour of Saigon, an excellent time with great food a very knowledgeable guide and awesome drivers. Highly recommended experience.

The brewery tour is a must for beer lovers! We had so much fun and our tour guide An was so lovely, we wanted to take her home to Australia! She was very informative and very friendly and taught us alot about Vietnam culture. It was our first day in Vietnam and it was great to have such a welcoming, friendly spirit to introduce us to some great locations within HCMC. She was also very interested in our way of life also. Her sense of humor was very similar to ours which was fantastic! Will definitely be in contact when we go back

We recently went on the Saigon After Dark tour and what an amazing night. Na, our guide, was a vivacious character and made sure our evening was far from boring. Our drivers make us feel safe once in the middle of the craziness that is HCMC by scooter!

The food at the restaurant stops was delicious and we tried food that we would never have been game enough to eat had we ventured out on our own.

The speak easy bar was just so chilled ... you forgot you were in a city of 11m people and our last stop of live music was a great way to end the night.

Thanks Na and our drivers Thanh and G.Huy!

review_title: Best night of our lives tonight
review_text:
Must do this tour when you visit Saigon you will be very surprised!
Well organized and just have fun.
Very professional guide -: Tien, thankyou for a really good night in Saigon
professional drivers-:Then & Nam made us feel safe at all times, they know thier roads!

Go on and just do it you won't regret it.

Enjoyed this Vespa tour of countryside Hoi An. The tour guide was very informative & his English was excellent. I was a little unsure about going on the Vespa (never been on a motorbike before) but he assured me & drove very carefully. We would recommend this tour to others.

First time in Saigon, it was so much fun to be sitting on the back of the vintage Vespa and see the life as you go. The food was awesome, the drinks were amazing and my guide and my driver, Vy & Giao were both fantastic, friendly and knowledgeable. Definitely recommend!!

review_title: The best experience we've had in Vietnam!
review_text: Honestly this is such a fun 4 hours. We did the Saigon at Night Foodie tour. Our guide Henry was fab, my driver (Phong) was excellent and the whole family had a ball. The 3 drinking holes were all so diverse and we would never have stumbled upon them otherwise. Unlimited booze and food so come hungry. Driving around Ho Chi Minh, weaving around traffic you get such a different perspective of what may be like for a local. A huge recommendation!

review_title: Super fun, you must do this!!
review_text: Try the foodie tour. You'll never find these places as a tourist. Outstanding food. Rosy was the best guide!
This was fun! We really enjoyed the ride and the food! Our tour guide Rosy was great! If you are looking for an adventure, you should try this! Highly recommended!
Wonderful Vespa ride around Saigon at night time. Sights, drivers and food were great, but the best part was our smily and super influential guide Oanh.

Having braved the crazy Ho Chi Minh traffic on foot, we were a little worried about taking our two children on a Vespa Tour. However, once we clicked the melee, we felt strangely safe, despite the rain and rushed our traffic..! Great fun, lovely drivers who were keen to chat about their country, a good way to see some local restaurants and music bars. Our teenagers loved it. All in all, a very memorable evening, for all the right reasons.
We just had the most fantastic 4 hour guided tours through Ho Chi Minh (Saigon) together with the best guide Oanh😁. The best way to discover this city👍

We booked the vespa tour in Ho Chi Minh and didn't regret it! Na and her staff were so friendly! Great way to discover Vietnam, its people, its habits while sitting on a Vespa! Definitely a must do in Ho Chi Minh.

Fantastic crazy fun. Food was amazing and they catered well for dietary requirements for 2 members of our family. Visited local restaurants and bars which you would never find as a tourist. All food and drinks included. They provide an English speaking guide who stays with you throughout the tour. Never once felt unsafe on Vespa. A must to do.

We took a morning city tour as a family of four. Absolutely brilliant! to be part of the Saigon traffic madness is an experience like no other, not to be missed. We felt totally safe and extremely well looked after.Tour was really informative too. One of the highlights of our trip
Our family done the vespa adventures or was one of the best highlights if our trip a must do. So safe and knowledge of there city was amazing.

review_title: Absolute must to a highlight of our visit to HCMC
review_text: We did the night time food tour as a family of four with two teenagers. This was the best start to our Vietnam adventure. We enjoyed spending time with our guide Kendrick who went out of his way to ensure our family had a great time and also gave us the opportunity to step way out of our comfort zone allowing us a chance to try foods that we had never had before. We were delighted at the choice of restaurants, cafes and bars we went to and loved the scenic trip around HCMC that our riders took us on to get to our new destination. This was something that we as a family had never done before (riding on any type of motorbike) and have to say that the entire time in the crazy HCMC traffic we always felt very safe. The tour is an awesome introduction to the cuisine of Vietnam and the culture of Vietnam and as first timers to Vietnam this tour certainly makes us more confident in our food and travel choices for the next three weeks. We highly recommend Vespa Adventures. Thanks for an awesome night!

This was a brilliant evening out run by a very well organized company and made all the better by our fantastic guide, SUNNY. She was brilliant, kept it interesting, good fun, we can all recommend to anyone. The various venues were excellent, starting with an eating bias and evolving towards bars/clubs with singing entertainment. I wouldn't hesitate to go back

We went on this trip at the recommendation of a friend who did it before. We were so glad we did it. It was just a great evening for my wife and I and our two teenage children. Despite the traffic in HCMC being best described as manic, we never once felt worried or concerned during our trip on the Vespas.

Great views over a drink on the top of the OMG Bar to start.

The food then followed after a short vespa ride and was brilliant as well. The pancake restaurant on the side of the street made us stop and think but we were fine and our delicate western stomach's were just fine. The food (pancakes) was an experience never to forget.

We then topped off at a seafood restaurant and had equally amazing food. Don't eat too much before you go out as this was enough for a banquet and drinks included as well. Brilliant food and we even had the jumping chicken (aka frogs legs)!!

Then the coffee house - we certainly didn't expect that. - Truly amazing experience.

On top of this our guide Sunny was brilliant. She made it really interesting telling us about HCMC, about the restaurants, about the food, about the beer, life in HCMC and generally being a brilliant guide and host.

Cannot recumbent this tour enough!!!!! % starts plus.

great tour with fully and the drivers. no tourist trap. good start to get into one of the coolest cities in the world. had some good street food and saw two very cool bars. and the vespa ride was good fun...

Thanks Harry. I loved this tour. Went to many off the beaten track places & not a tourist in sight. Had a crack at mat weaving & making rice paper. Also got a pretty good explanation of family temples. The guys took photos with their camera & sent me a link for copies, so thanks heaps.

What a way to start my trip in Vietnam. My friend recommended this tour and although it's not cheap, it's worth every penny! Tien our guide was so knowledgeable and happy to answer any questions and the food was DELICIOUS!! Minh, my driver, also made me feel super safe on the back of his vespa. Such an awesome way to see the city. Couldn't recommend it more.

Excellent staff, Excellent drivers and an awesome experience. Apprehensive at first because we had our teenagers with us...but I must say everyone had a blast and felt safe every single time we hopped on. The staff takes care of you and makes sure your having a great time. Love it!!

review_title: Amazing Day in Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
The BEST way to see Ho Chi Minh!
A highlight of our time in Vietnam.
Really safe, fun and informative trip.
Our guide Sunny made it a day to remember.

This was our second trip with Vespa Adventures and we loved it. Our guide Oanh was amazing, very knowledgeable, professional and friendly and our drivers were lovely! The craft beer tour was great value for money and something we would not have explored on our own! Highly recommend! Thanks Oanh :)

My husband and I had a great time on this tour. I was very anxious about the Vespas at the beginning, but I felt comfortable after the first stop. The drivers are safe and do not go fast. I kept reminding myself they do it everyday! There are 2 food stops and 2 bar stops, so it is not so much of a food tour as it is a tour of Ho Chi Minh. Having said that, the food we had was amazing and abundant. We loved that we went to other districts and places we wouldn't have been to on our own. The guide speaks excellent English and is engaging and friendly. A great night out!

A great way to see Hoi An and experience local food in cafes and restaurants you wouldn't normally know about. Thanks to our guide Flower who was amazing and our very competent drivers Luc, Thy, Orange and Manh.

review_title: The Garden of Four Dark Tour
review_text: What a way to kick off our first evening in Saigon. The crew picked up our family of four at our hotel and we hopped on our bike for the night. They scooted us to the meeting place to meet others on the same tour. A cocktail and snack got the social side going and then we were off to 5 eating places one would never find. All local and all DELICIOUS and all over the city. What a hoot! my adult teens loved it as did my husband and I. they even took us to a coffee cafe for some jazz and finally a bar with a rock & roll band. 5 hours of hilarity and fun. Highly recommended.

This tour was the highlight of Saigon for me.

They thought of everything. We were greeted by our drivers who even had raincoats for us as the weather was a bit rainy at first. We sat down at the first cafe and met everyone. I'd recommend a Vietnamese coffee if you haven't tried it yet. You can drink as much as you want.

You then go to 2 other restaurants. The first is a seafood restaurant. My recommendation is to try everything. I am not a fan of seafood but honestly everything was delicious, even the frogs legs. A person on our tour didn't want to try these so they had chicken as an alternative.

Next you go to a Vietnamese restaurant. By this point I was very full and a bit tipsy which was a great place to be!

You finish off with live music at 2 different places. I loved the last place we went. It was mostly western music that was really catchy and well performed.

There's a photographer that's taking photos for a lot of the night which are emailed to you. You also get a cute souvineer at the end of the night.

After traveling three weeks in Vietnam and Thailand and now home resting comfortably, my family and I are sharing what the highlights were on our trip. We had many wonderful experiences, but this one was one of the best. Our guide, Sunny, was what made it one of the best experiences during our travels. Her smile and immediate friendship made us all fell comfortable and excited. We had no previous experience on motor bike and the idea of ​​cruising the streets of Saigon was thrilling! My family and I love food....she shared this excitement, bringing us to wonderful places to eat, serving us and educating us on how to properly prepare our eats and making sure we were stuffed to the gills! My word did we eat and drink well during this tour. THANK YOU SUNNY FOR A GREAT TIME!!! The communication with Vespa Adventures was wonderful from the beginning to the end. Can't recommend this more highly!!

Such an amazing experience going around Vietnam on a vesper, felt so safe and the food was amazing. Our tour guide Kat was super friendly and told us all about the food we were eating and about the area. Highly recommend

review_title: Best night in Saigon for the whole family!
review_text: Our family of 4 did the Saigon by Night tour and absolutely loved it, was a highlight of the whole trip. At first landing in Ho Chi Minh we weren't sure we wanted to put our 12 and 9 year old on the back of a scooter in this crazy traffic, but after being there for only a day we realized its actually very organized so went ahead with the tour. We all felt very safe with our drivers - even though at the start of the tour it was raining hard - didn't mater we all had the biggest smiles. Thanks to Orange our guide for the night, he was fantastic fun and very informative. The food was some of the best on our trip too, loved it all (but tell them early if you don't eat seafood). As other reviewers have said there was just so much food!! I'm sure many manage... Then rode to a cool cafe after dinner with live acoustic music with amazing voices, then rocked onto a hip bar with a bit of rock, traveling to each venue on scooter. The only down side was having young kids, the youngest was ready to go too early, we would have loved to have kept hanging out, but they took us home straight away. Thanks to Orange and all our drivers, what a great night!!

review_title: Hoi An Rural Life Tour and cultural experience.
review_text: The Rural Life Tour was a pleasant way to spend the afternoon. Beautiful people go about their daily activities. Being involved in their day to day lifestyle whether it be making mats, cooking rice cakes, making rice wine, farming or buying produce from the market was a great insight into the way life is out in the country. The knowledge of our guide Mark was fantastic who explained the history of Vietnam right down to how each mat, rice cake, wine and farm produce is made, grown and harvested. A wonderful experience.

review_title: Fantastic tour on a scooter to the countryside
review_text:
Scooters/motorcycles are the best way to explore Vietnam, especially in the countryside. My one-day trip in the Mekong Delta with Vespa Adventures was a good one.

I was happy to be riding with Mr Thanh. He has been with the company from the very beginning. He rode defensively in the heavy Ho Chi Minh City traffic, and he was mindful of my wellbeing. He really took good care of me.

Ms Na did a good job introducing me to the countryside. She had good relationships with the people at the market in the countryside. She was able to tell personal stories of the people in the Mekong Delta, and it made my trip memorable. I would strongly recommend that you ask for Ms Na if she is available. Her English is good. I understand that she only guides for trips out of the city and for trips at night.

I liked it that the company has good working relationships with the local people. This was a small glimpse into the life of the Vietnamese.

review_title: One of the best nights... ever!
review_text: We were met at our hotel by our Vespa drivers (I was driven by Thien who was brilliant in every way) who gave us a brief safety briefing and took us to meet our guide for the evening (we had Jenny who is a darling... friendly, fun and absolutely attentive). We ate wonderful traditional food in 2 restaurants (only complaint is there was too much!!) with drinks included and then went to a bar with wonderful acoustic live music, followed by a second bar with fabulous rock music to dance to. The food, the music the company and all linked by the Vespa ride... none of us wanted the night to end!

review_title: Thrilling Way to explore Ho Chi Minh!
review_text: We did the Saigon After Dark tour and it's the best activity I had in my entire trip! As a pillion rider of the vespa and manoeuvring through the chaotic Saigon traffic is really exciting and an eye opening. We dropped by several restaurants at the start to have drinks and local food like seafood and pancakes. Just be careful if you have a weak stomach. You can also opt to have alternatives like chicken, inform the guide at the start. We ended the tour with trips to a quaint Cafe bar with singers (really good vocals) and a rock bar (hypes up the group to the point that some can't bear to leave). We rode back to our hotel and were given a momento including a photo of ourselves on the vespa with our rider framed. Thank you Jayden, Jasmine and all drivers!

I've never been on a motorbike before, let alone pillion, and the streets of Ho Chi Minh are not for the faint-hearted - but this was *great* fun!

I was picked up from my city center hotel and joined a NZ family of 5 for “Saigon Highlights” morning tour.

There is lots of fun whizzing about, but also lots of interesting stops to get a feel for the city. Water is provided, and at the end you get a meal and drink. Photo memento to take away is given, and they have promised to email some photos they took along the way.

At one point, it started to rain - so we were all poncho'd up from head to foot. Awesome fun!

I found myself grinning like a loon as we drove around - recommended.

Being a Brit... I'm a bit lost by tipping. I gave the guide $5US. I gave my driver $2 - and he looked really hacked off and tutted at me behind my back... Felt quite guilty, but how am I supposed to know what is appropriate? Wish there was some kind of guidance on the website, or some kind of indication given for “if you enjoyed your trip…” etc. Oh well.

review_title: Best Tour in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: What a fun way to see the sights. Fully our tour guide was fantastic full of knowledge and made the whole experience so much better. The Vesper's are fun and gives you an authentic way to enjoy the tour. A must do when you visit the city and pls ask for Fully.

We had been dying to jump on bikes after dodging them for weeks crossing the roads in Vietnam.

We are a family of 5 and Vespa Adventures organized a custom tour for us around Saigon.

Chung made sure we will go to places that we were interested in. We were taken to the less touristy places that we would have never seen on our own, including the park with locals and their birds, local temples, the flower market, new developments over the river and a local street market. The bike tour gave us an honest and fun snap shot of Saigon, the people and their history.

All the riders were careful and great fun. No footpath antics!

We would love to receive some of the photos that were taken. Thanks for a memorable experience.

We took the evening Street Food tour. Our guide Tri was excellent company to spend an evening with.

The food was amazing and there was loads so had a light lunch! The later stops involved love music and were great fun to end an evening.

Our vespa drivers Huy and Teo were really good and made you feel safe while getting up close with Ho Chi Minh traffic.

We loved this tour and the company were very professional, even taking photos at all stops.

This was amazing - we did it with our children aged 7,10 and 12. Just driving around Saigon (with its 7 million motor bikes) was worth the money alone. Our guide Tri was friendly and knowledgeable and the drivers were great and we never felt unsafe. There is flexibility to change to tour to fit your group according to what you like. Big thumbs up from us.

review_title: Best way to see the city and experience the nightlife!
review_text:
If you really want to experience Saigon, BOOK the Saigon After Dark tour! There is nothing like zipping around on the back of the vespa through the busy streets of Saigon on the way to eat delicious food! This tour gives you the best of things to eat in Saigon and lets you feel like a local riding on a vespa.
The spring rolls and pancake were some of my favorite items of food consumed while I was in Vietnam. Saigon was my first stop in Vietnam, so the tour guide was helpful in showing me how to properly assemble a spring roll.
The staff of Vespa Adventures was wonderful and I never felt unsafe on the back of the Vespa.

A great way to see the city by 4 friends, age 50+, from the UK. Felt safe throughout with very competent drivers in crazy traffic! All the stop-off eating and drinking experiences were unexpected and Sunny, our guide, was enthusiastic and informative. Highly recommended tour.

We loved our Vespa adventures by night tour, so much fun, so informative and our guide Sunny was fantastic!
A must do if in Saigon, feel like we saw another side to Vietnam.

review_title: Another great adventure from Vespa Adverntures
review_text: This was our 4th time using using Vespa Adventure but as we had two kids 10 and 12, I was a little nervous given the traffic in Saigon. However the team were really great and the boys loved it, they felt safe at all times and the drivers were very precautious making it a highlight. Seeing a city from a vespa gives you a different experiences as you experiences the smells and sights off the beaten track that you just don't get in a car yet you cover more distance than you would in a walking tour.

review_title: ride of your life is right
review_text: My family traveled from the states to Vietnam and traveled using Vespa Adventures in each city. We only needed our selves and sunscreen. The drivers and tour guide had everything covered, even if it rained.

Our family had a magnificent tour with Rosy and her driving team of Nhi, Giao,
Danh, Dung. The food was indeed a highlight but the whole experience was very special. The jazz club in the French section was a unique break for dessert and the final stop at the Acoustic Bar was outstanding! The music and atmosphere were a throw back to the ol' days of great live music.
Rosy was a magnificent host and went above the call of duty to ensure we had a memorable night that will never be forgotten!

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the morning Vespa tour around Saigon
It was a highlight of our trip
Our tour guide Sunny spoke English well, was very informative, friendly and nothing was a problem
We felt very safe in the hands of our two expert Vespa riders who were both polite and friendly
The tour provided a detailed insight into the history and life of Saigon
We would recommend it to people of all ages
Thank you Sunny for being such a terrific guide

Paul and Robyn
Australia

review_title: We love Sun, Wendy, and Rosy!
review_text: Our favorite experience in Vietnam - hands down. The employees are so friendly and fun. They truly want to show you the beauty of their city. Sun and Wendy are the best drivers and Rosy is the best tour guide! So grateful for this experience 😍❤️

My wife and I were both a bit anxious but once we met our drivers and started riding around the streets of Ho Chi Minh city we were absolutely excited. It was fantastic, stopping at various street food locations and drinking places. Being at night made even more exciting and definitely one of the best experience of our lives so far.

The Vespa experience we had in Ho Chi Minh was excellent. We had a family of four which they catered for perfectly. Did the night tour with three resturant and two bars. Felt the drivers had excellent experience and very caring to our needs. i would give them a 10 out of 10.

My husband and I did this tour. We met some lovely people from all over. To see Hanoi all of the different areas you must do this tour. We saw the markets, the train track where people lived on the railway line, the old bridge bombed in the war and much more. We were well educated learning so much of the history and our guide Finn spoke perfect English.

My husband and I did a Night Tour of the sites and stopped at many local cafes/Restaurants to try the local food.
We also stopped at the famous train track and actually saw the train come through.
Our guide Gabby was very knowledgeable and super friendly.
The drivers were fantastic talking to you all the time and making sure you were ok.
If your thinking about this tour just do it!
Best tour I have done lots of fun and don't eat before you go, so much food!!!!!!!!

Thanks Gabby for a great night!😜
Gabby your English was great!

review_title: Great way to see and hear the history. Super friendly tour guide
review_text: Great way to see and hear the city's history and experience the culture. Orange was a Super friendly tour guide with good knowledge

First of all, we would like to thank our spectacular guide, Rosy. She brought us around to several different restaurants and local venues and made our trip to Ho Chi Minh so special. We only had one full day in the city and this is certainly a must for anyone who wants to have an incredible adventure while also learning a lot. We felt safe throughout the whole journey thanks to our drivers Danh and Hanh. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh.

Wow what a treat! A great way to see the city at night and experience incredible food and excellent entertainment. It is on the pricy side however is worth it as we would never have found these out of the way spots. Excellent English and if you love Vespas you will fall in love with their bikes! I want to take one home. Tour guide was attentive, funny and exceptional in his role. I rate this a must do. We did the night tour.

review_title: Amazing tour guides, great beer and better food!
review_text: Saigon craft beer tour was a major hit! From the beer and food to the locals showing us the way, all my expectations were exceeded. The drivers were very experienced and the bikes were very safe. The food pairs very well with the beers. Many pictures were taken of us on the way, waiting on an email with digital copies! Thanks to our local guide, Oanh, and my driver, Hanh, for making the experience great!

An amazing way to immerse yourself into the culture of such a vibrant city.
With the tour starting off by picking us up from the hotel, our Vespa guides with smiles all round, take us to the first stop (setting the nerves of young teens with us) and introducing us to our tour guide 'Vy'.

First with a few stiff drinks, Vy starts with some brief history, cultural cues and how the night will play out.

Stopping of at several local restaurants with amazing food (and generous amounts of beer and spirits to wash it down). We anticipate the next Vespa ride on the busy streets of Ho Chi Minh City.

The competence of the Vespa riders navigating through organized chaos, makes you feel so at ease that you can enjoy the ride, taking in the sites, with drink in hand.

We ended the night with one stop at a live acoustic bar, with amazing singers and atmosphere, before finishing up at another bar, with a few drinks and live rock music.

Having been well traveled, this tour has been one of my all time highlights.
It is not to be missed!

To our host Vy,
Thank you so much for an amazing time. You're professionalism, knowledge and infectious enthusiasm made the experience so fantastic. 😁🍻👏🏻

review_title: Best way to see hidden sights in HCM
review_text: Great fun to ride pillion on a vespa with an experienced rider in a very busy city. Hidden gems visited and good guide. Food great too. A great sense of excitement riding with this traffic!

review_title: Amazing way to see the city!
review_text: We booked this tour after hearing great reviews from friends and it did not disappoint. Our guide Rosy made our evening very memorable and exciting by being fun and energetic and providing us with lots of local knowledge and stories. We enjoyed unlimited drinks and a huge amount of food so the price is really worth it in the end. My driver Quan was super friendly and experienced on the busy roads so I felt perfectly safe when being whisked around the city. Would definitely recommend!
We saw the Saigon streets filled with Vespas driven by both families as well as youngsters risking their lives in the busy traffic. Unusual site for Europe.

We loved this! We did the Saigon After Dark tour - 4.5hours of great fun! The tour collects you from your hotel and takes you to meet the rest of the group. Right from the start our tour guide was fun and friendly and the group gets to know each other over a couple of drinks. All of the food and drink places visited were delicious. They take safety seriously - helmets and masks were provided and the drivers are very careful and skillful at navigating the traffic safely. It had rained in Saigon earlier that day and mine even made sure to avoid the puddles so we didn't get splashed! We booked on recommendation from a friend and certainly wasn't disappointed. Would recommend this company to others who visit. They add a few little nice touches as souvenirs too.

Booked this in advance but paid on arrival. Fantastic tour! We were collected from our hotel by Vespa and then stopped at several locations with our group for various food options. A fantastic way to see the city and try things out of the ordinary. Vespas were safe and fun to ride. Tour guide was excellent! Bar at the conclusion was great fun, a karaoke style place with some hilarious singing. Only wish we could have stayed longer!

Absolutely super time was had: a good mix of 'encountering' the traffic in the city, and seeing local life as well as eating and drinking in places you wouldn't normally get to. Thoroughly enjoyed it.

review_title: One of the most exquisite experiences to have in Vietnam
review_text:
This will be by far one of the best experiences one will have in Vietnam. I have toured so many places around the world and this unique idea gets you into hidden gems of the Saigon night life in such a cool and magnificent way.

We were picked up by 2 professional Vespa scooter drivers and toured around the city safely and at each stop a local guide would accompany us to talk us through the local cuisine, night life and culture. The overall experience is so enriching and rewarding that I felt compelled to leave this review the moment I was dropped back at my hotel!

Well done team Vespa Adventures. Thank you so much for the ride of my life and hope we meet again... maybe in Cambodia very soon!

A brilliant fun evening! Felt very safe being chauffeured by experienced Vespa drivers. A great way to embrace the city the same way as the locals do. Visited some really great restaurants, cafes and bars with entertainment at every stop, the evening was made even more memorable because of our wonderful host Sunny. The whole package couldn't have been more enjoyable.

review_title: Sumberged in the Saigon Culture with Vespa Adventures
review_text:
What an evening! Vespa Adventures picked us (my husband and friends/couple) up at our hotel, then wisked us through the Saigon crowds to their own little cafe/bar where the evening started. We'd been in Saigon a few days, so it was fun to zoom through areas we'd seen, then, even more fun to go to districts filled only with locals and eat, eat, eat fabulous food. One of my favorite stops was a seafood restaurant on a street famous for fish restaurants. We had course after course, sitting at a low table on the sidewalk, including the best crab I'd had in 3 weeks in SE Asia. There was another restaurant that was filled with Vietnamese families and we enjoyed classic dishes. The evening was topped off with stops at two music venues - each different and each fun. Wow, we would never have been able to have this real experience - it was a highlight (just as the Vespa Adventures night tour of Siem Reap was almost 2 weeks ago).

These folks are very professional. The Vespa's seems new, and our hosts/drivers were skilled. We had a spectacular time.

review_title: Really good entertainment for an afternoon
review_text: Well organised. Safe. Good driver. Engaged people talking about their city. Flexible in making changes to the route, eg shopping if for clothes
If you live in Ho Chi Minh you get ample opportunity to hop on the back of a motorbike. This tour is an amazing opportunity to see the city and feel like a local. Safety is high regard.

review_title: Ho Chi Minh Vespa Adventure Tour
review_text: We chose the Mekong Delta Vespa Adventure tour and it was amazing, the tour made our trip to Ho Chi Minh what it was. We had an amazing day out in the Vietnamese countryside, our drivers (Nhat and Hoi) were amazing, they were careful and made sure to point out things along the way. The vespas were comfortable and safe too, we were given a helmet and Nhat and Hoi even had ice bags on the back of the bikes filled with beer and water for us. Our tour guide Sunny was amazing too, her English was really good, and she was so happy and helpful which made the tour even better! Sunny gave loads of interesting information about each stop (including a food market, rice wine tasting, incense making and a temple), whilst making us laugh and taking great photos of us along the way. This tour is definitely not a tourist trap, we were the only Western people in each place which made the tour so special, we really got a glimpse of how the Vietnamese people live outside of the city. We were not hounded / pressured into buying anything during the tour, the tour was truly aimed to inform us about their culture and lifestyle, which made it feel so real and tailored for tourists interested in this. We were picked up and dropped off at our hotel and were given fresh fruit at the market. We are both vegan, and the crew went over and above to accommodate for us, instead of stopping at the usual restaurant they went out of their way to find us a vegan restaurant back in the city at the end of the tour, which was absolutely amazing and we are very grateful for that! We had the most amazing day on this tour, we would recommend it to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh, (and the other tours that they offer!) thank you Vespa Adventures for a day we will never forget!!
The best tour ever! Great time! Funny and smart guides, good drivers, great food! You Can't miss it!

My three friends and I went on the Vespa Food Tour and had a fantastic evening. We were brought to a number of excellent restaurants (the food was delicious) and bars that gave us a great insight into Saigon's eateries and nightlife. Special mention to our guide Orange who was knowledgeable, attentive and great fun!

Thank you for an excellent evening.

review_title: Fantastic Vespa Evening in Ho Chi Minh city / Saigon
review_text:
Fantastic – My wife and I both said that this was the most enjoyable and fun activity that we have done, it was a great experience from the start when the Vespa Team picked us up and till they dropped us back at our Hotel. The Team was fantastic and very knowledgeable and very professional.

Highly recommend this activity

A FUN - FILLED EXCITING AND AUTHENTIC TOUR that I would highly recommend. My favorite tour in Vietnam and I've done 12 over two trips . We had an amazing day with our guide Sunny who was knowledgeable , great fun and who had excellent English . We rode on dirt roads, barges, through villages, oyster farms and stopped at family businesses who produced incense and rice wine, Lots of delicious food, and traditional Vietnamese coffee. Our drivers (or riders) were terrific and took good care of us, trying to avoid huge bumps in the road and deep puddles, riding through a torrential storm on the last leg of our tour. Sooo much fun!! 👍👍😊

My family came over from South Africa for a week so I decided to put together a “Saigon Highlughts” tour for them. The Craft Beer Vespa Tour was one of the activities planned. All I can say is that they still haven't stopped talking about how amazing it was. The experience right from the beginning was just unlike any other. A HUGE thanks to Kat who took us on a wild adventure through Saigon's growing craft beer culture. She was exceptionally knowledgeable and a fantastic guide. I would recommend this tour one hundred times over. I will be back to experience another tour!

review_title: The perfect way to explore HCMC.
review_text: I have done the After Dark tour twice now, and both times have been just as brilliant. Getting on the back of a motorbike or scooter in HCMC is an experience in itself, and to combine that with an evening of food, drink and live music entertainment makes a terrific experience. Not to be missed! A local tour guide also acccompanies you throughout the different stops on the route, and our guide Orange was superb company and great chat - thank you! A photographer also took photos throughout parts of the evening, which are sent across to you a couple days after the tour - nice touch.
fun AND educational.....a great group. they were all very professional and we felt completely safe. it's a good way to see saigon/ho chi minh city.

This was the second time in two years that I took this tour and would highly recommend it for those who enjoy good food, excellent cocktails and fabulous music. Both times I met other tour participants that proved to be a lot of fun who added to the evenings enjoyment. The Vespa drivers were true professionals who made you feel comfortable with their driving skills in a rather hectic traffic environment.

We arrived in Saigon at 5 in the morning and thought it would be great to do this on our first night (after a little snooze). What a great move, great introduction to the city even jet lagged we had an incredible evening. Went far too quickly. Paid for the over indulgence the next day with a heavy hangover. Was worth it. Thanks guys.

review_title: One of the best nights of my life
review_text: From start to finish this was just fun fun fun. Vy our guide was absolutely amazing and made the trip. Flying along the streets of Saigon was great, traffic coming from all angles. This is one of the best ways to see the city and a must for anyone traveling in Saigon.

Riding on the back of a bike in the chaotic Saigon traffic coupled with an amazing food experience was one of the highlights of our Vietnam holiday. Vespa are very professional operators and the guide we had gave us the best experience with local food at places where the local eat. She explained each dish and how it was prepared. We were taken to several districts for tastings of which all was enjoyed. We were also taken to a coffee lounge with entertainment in the form of a pianist and several different vocalists. Then our final stop was a nightclub with a band and again several vocalists. The guys taking us from place to place were very competent riders and offered lots of local information. All in all a great tour and taste. We just loved it all. Thanks Vespa you certainly have our tick of approval.

review_title: A must do tour for first time travelers to Vietnam!
review_text: There are other similar (cheaper) tours out there, but my friend and I decided to book this one for specific spots that were on our list of things to see. We did not regret it one bit! They provide a pick up/drop off from your hotel, drinks, snacks, and a complete meal at the end. My driver Ty was so sweet and continued to make sure I was having a good time. Our tour guide Sunny was extremely knowledgeable about the city and really made it special. One thing journey that stood out to me was that our guides/drivers were very protective of us and made sure we were safe throughout the entire. I would highly recommend this company to anyone that needs a quick, fun, and memorable tour around the city!

If it's your first time in Vietnam and you only have a short amount of time, do this Vespa tour. It is a great way to see the city without the stress of logistics. Sunny (tour guide) was very knowledgeable and took us to both historical and local spots. Hoi (my Vespa driver) was a very safe and careful driver.

It was definitely worth the time and money. Remember to tip your driver and tour guide.
Our Vespa tour guides were great and made the trip so much fun. Would highly recommend the Vespa Tours to anyone.

review_title: The ride of my life indeed
review_text: Had a great time riding a vespa in Saigon! It was a wonderful experience, had an amazing driver and the stops were each very special: good food, great rooftop bar and live music at the end. I would love to do it again
Great night with a fantastic variety of food, good company and endless beer! Great way to view Saigon.
A brilliant way to see a city. Great people, fun and some great food and music. We got to ride around the city, eat great food and visit several music venues. I always feel safe.

review_title: Absolute Best Way to See/Experience Saigon!
review_text: I have nothing but amazing things to say about our tour. Our guide, Oanh, was delightful and we had so much fun with her! The food we ate and the sights we saw on the Vespas were incredible. I would do it again if I return to Saigon.

review_title: What a way to see the city!
review_text: We took this tour on the advice of one of our group who had done the same thing the week before. She enjoyed it so much she decided to do it again with us. It was amazing, we got to see parts of the city we would never have otherwise seen. We drank and ate at street-side cafes and the experience was amazing. I can't recommend this too highly. The Vespa drivers were wonderful and managed to scare the hell out of you whilst we were screaming with joy.

Party of 5 enjoyed a great night touring 5 craft beer bars on the back of a Vespa. Super friendly host and very well organized. Although you have snacks with the fantastic named and selected beers, would be better to eat something more substantial before you go.

review_title: still hoping to see the pictures
review_text: the experience was great! lots of fun. They took pictures of the event but sent me pictures of another party - I asked them to please send the pictures taken during my event but they have not replied back. It was a fun time - just with I had some pictures of it to look back on...

review_title: Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: After traveling through Vietnam for 3 weeks, my husband and I finally had the courage to ride motorbike (Vespa). We both wish we tried it sooner!! Our drivers (Hoi and Nhat) were great. They collected us from our hotel and we felt safe throughout the whole tour. Our guide, Sunny, was excellent. She was friendly, enthusiastic and could answer all our questions. I feel like we saw a side of HCMC that many ordinary tourists wouldn't. We zipped and zoomed through little alleyways in all areas. A perfect way to end our Vietnam trip -we will definitely be back next time we're in Vietnam or Cambodia.

It has been an unforgettable experience! It was my first time to Ho Chi Minh and I love food. Experience the city at night on a Vespa and enjoy the great local foods of the city was amazing. Thank you very much to my driver Dong and to my local friend Nguyen. Both were great and much appreciated. Don't miss this oppertunity.

I booked this as a surprise for my partner, being a bit of a foodie myself I was super excited but wasn't sure if he would be as into it as me, especially because he likes to be the one riding the bike not sitting on the back but we both loved every minute of this tour!

Was a great way to see a lot of the city in a short amount of time, we went to multiple districts and restaurants trying all sorts of authentic & delicious local food! I even tried frog which I still can't believe!

Our guide Nguyen was amazing! Gave us loads of information on culture and way of life in a fun and casual way! She was able to answer any questions we had and was a great addition to the tour! Highly recommend you tour with her if you can!

review_title: Saigon After Dark Vespa Tour with Khang
review_text: I just completed my tour with Khang. He was awesome! He is a very pleasant and friendly host. The Vespa drivers were all good. No one got hurt. Admittedly, a little unnerving to be 12" from the next scooter. It was so much fun to travel through Saigon among the locals, to be able to eat local cuisine (including frog meat), and to listen to music at venues we would never have found in our own.

One of the best introductions which you could possibly have to a new city.

Arrived on a Sunday morning for 4 days Business, and wondering what to do on night 1.

Imagine a tour which includes 5 hour night time excursion riding pillion on an Italian Vespa (read this as highly stable and comfortable). Local food, drinks and entertainment. Excellent motorbike drivers.

Savor: Vietnamese seafood, desserts, go to a Coffee Bar with live bistro singers, crooning in Vietnamese and English, go to a Rock and Roll bar. All you can drink.

Please push the motorbike worries aside as the drivers are 1st class and know their city: there was another table which had a dozen 60 and 70s year old Australian seniors, having the time of their lives. My group was American University Students headed for Thailand.

Picture the scene!
Monsoon rain Saigon Traffic riding pillion on a 40 year old scooter!!
What brilliant night.
Kahn and Giao guided the scooters through the traffic and puddles with great ease. Every time we stopped at a venue there was a happy smiling tour guide 'Sunny' waiting for us.
You've got to give it a go.
Well done Vespa Adventures a great night thank you.

review_title: Saigon by night with the family
review_text:
We decided to do something different. Seeing Saigon by night on a Vespa was truly an enjoyable experience that I would not have missed. The drivers took care of the passengers and showed the inner streets of Saigon and how the locals spent their evening. We visited two local restaurants and three local bars which provided fantastic musical experiences. Food was traditional Vietnamese.
The evening ends with each of us presented with pictures taken on our Vespa and a small token from the tour leader. Well worth the money and time. Definitely a big thumbs up.

We didn't know what to expect from the trip but we were pleasantly surprised. Would recommend for a fun evening. We were taken on a mini sightseeing tour and visited plenty of local restaurants and bars - great way to see a part of Saigon that you wouldn't see otherwise.

It has been an unforgettable experience! We have known places that we could never know without this tour. Our guide Sunny has been attentive at all times to us and taught us everything we need to know, she has made this experience even better !!

review_title: Hang On and Enjoy the Ride!
review_text: A fantastic way to explore aspects of Hoi An. Vinh, Tom, Chu Son and Cris took us on a tour visiting a family temple and boat builders, trying our hand at mat weaving and rice cracker making, as well as a coffee stop and panoramic views of Hoi An from a bridge. The morning was topped off with a delicious lunch. Vinh`s commentary was excellent and informative, and he was happy to field all of our questions, and between the four of us we had many!. I had never been on the back of a motor bike/vespa before and loved every minute of it! Definitely a highlight of my visit.

We had a wonderful time with Sunny and the two Vespa drivers. We really enjoyed a new perspective of the city as Sunny explained to us, in detail, the particulars of the Saigon sightseeing spots. Great fun. Highly recommend it. Thanks for the tour!

review_title: Great Glimpse of the Mighty Mekong
review_text:
My traveling buddy and I were fortunate enough to sign up for the glimpse of Mekong Vespa Tour and have Sunny as our excellent guide and Chu Tam and Tien as drivers extraordinaire!

We were a little concerned how we would feel after a long day on the back of a motor scooter but the scooters were comfortable with a small back rest, our guide made sure we had plenty of rest stops and our drivers tried their very best to ensure we had as smooth a ride as possible.

So many highlights on our tour - market visit, fresh seafood snacks (which were big enough to be lunch), the honorable lady who makes incense at her home, temple visit and then lunch in a restaurant overlooking the water. By far my favorite part though was driving through HCM city in the middle of a tremendous rain storm. Our drivers agreed peak hour traffic with ease and we laughed all the way back to our hotel. The raincoats they provided kept us dry and I would love to be able to buy one!

Sunny our guide spoke very good English, was informative and friendly - a credit to the company.

This is my second tour with Vespas Adventures and they continue to surprise me with their professionalism- highly recommend!

review_title: Super craft beer tour in HCMC
review_text: We got to travel (very safely!) on the back of Vespas, savor some wonderful snacks (still thinking about the chilli cheese oyster and buffolo wing) and of course the craft beer..wow! We particularly enjoyed the last place (Pasteur Street Brewing) but there were plenty of tasty porters and sours. Our guide Oanh was also very nice and spoke fluent English. Some may note that it is pricier than some other tours but you really what you pay for and this was worth every dong :)

review_title: The highlight of a fantastic holiday
review_text: We were recommended this tour by friends who had previously done the night tour in Hanoi and raved about it. Best decision ever! Firstly in Hoi An, we visited local villages and really saw what life is like for a local, meeting beautiful people, eating traditional food. So un-touristy and real - loved it. Our drivers were amazing, we felt so safe with their riding skills, and they were extremely prompt in picking us up. It was so good there, that when we got to Ho Chi Minh, we did the night city tour there. Fabulous guide (Katty) and drivers (Long), so exciting riding through the crazy city traffic, best local food, best clubs and bars (we would never have found them by ourselves). A brilliant night which we will never forget. Thanks so much to the company and their people for offering the best tours we have ever been on in the world

Outstanding tour company. Have taken tours in several cities and tours are always thought out, attention to detail is carefully high, guides are excellent and management quick to step in and help when there is a problem.
I have worked in the industry and consider this an outstanding company.

review_title: You have to do it - sooooo much fun
review_text: Yes I was nervous to start but Vespa driver was so careful skills & kept reassuring me of his driving. The experience of whisking around the Streets & over Bridges by night was an experience I will not forget. The local bar & restaurants that we experienced was not only brilliant food but loved meeting welcoming Vietnamese. To end the night listening to melodic music then with rock music - all fabulous fun.

Even though we took off in the middle of a tropical thunderstorm this was a great experience. A poncho was provided and kept nearly all of the moisture out. I felt very safe in the chaotic Ho Chi Minh traffic on the back of the Vespa. The guide Thien rode ahead on his motorbike and organized all the eating places in advance. For me the highlight was the seafood restaurant occupied only by locals but all the food was interesting and good quality. Thien was also very good company ability to give a good insight into life in Vietnam and Ho Chi Minh City specifically.

I got picked up at my hotel by my driver, Ton, and we went back to the VA office where I met up with the other guests and our guide Sunny. Sunny was very friendly and bubbly and was knowledgeable about the places we visited on our tour. It was fun on the back of the Vespa driving through the crazy motorbike traffic in Saigon. Our drivers were friendly and very cautious and did not take chances in traffic. The end of the tour was a little rushed but overall it was a fun 4-5 hour day.

review_title: Got to see the real ho chi minh city
review_text: We were lucky enough to be the only ones on our tour so it was just us, drivers and our fantastic tour guide Miggy. She was great, had so much information about each place we saw. Loved getting to see places that were where the locals went, rather than the touristy places. Seeing the flower market, burning monk and 1000 buddhas were just some of the highlights. Her knowledge of each place we saw was great and felt like we truly had a better understanding of the people and history of Ho Chi Minh. After finishing the tour the lunch at cafe zoom was great too.

This was our favorite tour of our whole holiday!!! There were four of us and all our drivers were just fantastic, and we felt very safe the whole time. We went to places that, as tourists, you wouldn't know to go too, but the food and people were just amazing. We finished off in two different types of nightlife places. One was a very cool Jazz type lounge with great singers and another was a nightclub, again with a live band. It really lived up to its name of a night adventure tour. Would do it again in a heartbeat!!!

We had a customized tour with Orange and his crew. Very competent and friendly drivers and all 7 of us never felt unsafe. Orange shows us some local markets and also explained and shows us the way to eat local food. Even though I lived in HCMC before there were still some things I hadn't seen before. Great job guys!

review_title: Exciting vespa tour through bustling HCMC
review_text: Super fun and well organized vespa tour! Our excellent guide Orange and his team made our tour an unforgettable experience and they never lost their cool even in the midst of a massive tropical thunderstorm :) Loved the food as well, Orange speaks excellent English and taught us how to eat Bhan Xeo properly! Would definitely book with them again!

Very friendly and well organized Vespa tour. Our guide Orange was great, his English was outstanding and he was able to organize everything well. A Tropical rainstorm hit us by surprise but Orange managed everything well and it turned out to be a great adventure! Drivers were friendly and safe drivers.

review_title: Amazing tour and great guide, orange was the best!
review_text: Our guide orange as well as all the drivers were great! English was good, super friendly and also very safe. We were surprised by heavy rain and flooding streets but we still had the best time and some amazing Vietnamese food! Thank you Orange and all the drivers!

review_title: Great for a solo traveler and very fun!
review_text: This was a very fun night out. I love street food and discovering local cultures especially on a cool Vespa bike. My guide Orange was very friendly and helpful. I would recommend it to anyone as an introduction to Saigon lifestyle.

review_title: Vespa Adventure in Oh Chi Minh
review_text:
Awesome way to get a feel of the city life!
My driver was amazing: super sfe, courteous and friendly 😊

We were looked after by a lovely young lady who spoke excellent English. Over a cocktail, she explained how the evening would work. We were taken by Vespa to four different eating places and experienced tasty seafood sitting on low stools in a side street, Vietnamese pancakes with bean sprouts were next, then ice cream in a lovely chill bar with live acoustic music and ac. We finished with a Latin beat over more drinks, near our hotel. We were looked after very well and the staff were very professional. We were given good souvenir photos at the end and we thought it was one of the best nights of our holiday.

Food was really good, Verry accommodations to our needs, fantastic experience.
Friendly staff, would of liked the tour and pub to go a bit longer.
Highly recommended

review_title: Highly recommend this night in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
There were 2 Couples aged 55 to 60 and we had a great night. The riders were very good at no point did we feel uncomfortable in the traffic.
The food was delicious. The last bar that we went to didn't serve wine but they had beer and spirits,
so all was good.

review_title: Experience the crazy traffic and more...
review_text: Super safe driving, comfy seats on vintage Vespas, diving into the crazy traffic what you'd never dare to do yourself. Never felt unsafe for a second though thatnks to the great drivers. Super nice food locations visited with a super cool night club at the end with great live music. If anythink, each stay could have been longer, especially the last one but I guess they would have accommodated if we'd asked. Nice professional pictures included. A clear must-do when in Saigon. Btw. I bought myself a Vespa after we returned home... Was inspiring ;-)

review_title: A fun adventure and a great way to see Saigon.
review_text: Our vespa tour was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. The guides and drivers were great, we got to try food and see corners of the city we would never have discovered on our own, plus the exhilarating experience of joining the swarm of scooters riding through the city at night! A fun adventure and a great way to see Saigon.

review_title: Put this on your to-do list.
review_text: Had the best time, careful riders in the crazy traffic. Our guide good English and was very entertaining spoke. The places we ate at were very good and the entertainment at the end of the night was excellent. Highly recommend this tour.
Absolutely one of the best adventures of my life, so professional, food and drink amazing would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh city. Didnt want the night to end 👍👍👍

Highly recommended !!! Driving (actually - being driven on the back seat of Vespa) through incredibly crowded streets of Saigon is both exciting and surprisingly easy .. Together with my wife we ​​made excellent half-day tour in a company of the experienced guide (driving along on the third Vespa), visiting among typical tourist places some spots, we will probably never find on our own, using only guidebook (bird lover's club, city view from District 2 etc.). Lunch at the end of the tour was equally great as the tour itself. Finally we got very nice pictures of ourselves and our drivers/guide on Vespa with their signatures and wishes - very touching.

a very varied tour, wich many informations about vietnamese food, the young generation and their music, accompanied by a very friendly guide and drivers. Everything was very nice and we never forget this evening in Saigon. Thank you for all

review_title: Oldies having the Ride of Their Life
review_text: Despite our initial fear after having seen the traffic in Saigon for the previous three days, this adventure was so much fun and at no time did we feel unsafe. The young vespa drivers were so polite, helpful and fun to our party of four ranging from 60 to 71. The

The Vespa tour was exhiliarating, fun and the city was alive. Our tour guide was very knowlegeable and spent a lot of time with us explaining the culture and politics of the country. We thoroughly enjoyed the trip and would recommend that anyone visiting Vietnam do the Vespa tour

initially i was sceptical. the travel agency i booked with organized the vespa tour for me as part of a cooking and streetfood holiday package deal. it was: "here it is - like it or lump it"

when it actually happened, i was very very impressed. the driver (long) picked me up at the hotel and took me to the meeting point. there i was allocated to what they call the "local friend" and i‘d call an "individual guide" (nicole). after a quick beer and some pseudo tacos (rice flour?), off we went. i‘d told them i was particularly interested in authentic streetfood - and that‘s exactly what i got. nicole was the perfect guide for me, an enthusiastic and knowledgeable eater just like me. after a (safe, careful, well-managed but hair-raising simply because of the traffic) drive initially spent clinging fearfully onto the back of long‘s scooter, i realised i could put myself entirely in their hands. i relaxed, trusted long to get me safely to wherever we had to go next, and trusted nicole to fill my tummy with delicious authentic local
specialities once we got there.

we went from one district to the next, sampling everything from chilli crab claws, sweet clams, spicy mussels, noodles and ginger-caramelised crunchy whole frog to
spring rolls and fatty pork and prawn omelette sizzling pancakes fried to order before your very eyes in a back alley street kitchen and served with -literally- mountains of fresh herbs and rolled (like fajitas) in crisp romaine lettuce leaves.

can you feel my level of enthusiasm? it was truly amazing for a hardliner foodie like me. nicole was never stuck for an answer - although i really quizzed her on how to prepare the food, because it was all so delicious that i wanted to cook it myself once i got back home. which i did, based on what she‘f told me. and she was spot on every time.

once neither of us could squeeze in one more scrap, we went to an "unplugged" coffee-bar-cum-night-club where young vietnamese singers (amateurs but with a whole lot of talent) sang songs in vietnamese accompanied by a piano and a violin. wonderful. i could have listened to them all night. to be honest: i did. we skipped the loud sing-along-and-dance rock bar (which i sure was good too, but it‘s not my kind of thing) and just stayed put. just one more song... just one more song...

and somehow i did manage to squeeze in a portion of coconut ice-cream after all.

and then long dropped me off back at the hotel, with a little sightseeing detour along the saigon river waterfront on the way, again driving carefully and considerately - without giving me the feeling that i was an absolute scaredycat wimp. just perfect.

it was the absolute highlight of my trip to HCMC. i would recommend it, 100%

a huge thank you to long for driving me through that unbelievable traffic chaos so well.
and a huge thank you to nicole for being my alltime best food and nightlife guru.
you both did a wonderful job.

Superb evening with Vespa Adventures. Great drivers, great guides, good food, good music. Couldn't have asked for more. Highly recommend anyone to book this adventure. Suitable for anyone who can get onto a Vespa ! We are both in our late 60's.

We were picked up from our accommodation by the vespas. We traveled to meet at the Zoom cafe. You feel very safe traveling in the traffic with the drivers. The food and drinks were abundant and very enjoyable. Traveling 30 minutes between districts was awesome. The entertainment was very enjoyable and it was the highlight of our trip.

review_title: Saigon by night on the bike of a bike!
review_text: Absolutely fantastic way to see a lot of Saigon and experience the madness of the city. Great fun with all the vespa drivers, good food and costs of laughter. Put this on your list as a
We were looked after extremely well indeed by a really experienced team. Would definitely recommend not to miss this highlight!!!
This was one of the best experiences of our trip. We had a blast. Everything was amazing. The drivers, Rosie our host, the food, the music, the places. We plan to do it again someday.

We had a great evening with Khang as our guide, he explained what the food was and how to eat it - the food was delicious. We also went to two different music venues, ended enjoying our ride through Saigon!

review_title: Perfect snapshot of HCMC for the time-crunched
review_text: I won't provide a play-by-play, but know that this is a very professional, well-run service that shows you an ambitious slice of HCMC in a short amount of time. My tour guide, Orange, was a great hang and knew a ton about the city. More of a fun afternoon than a heavily guided tour. Really great service
A great historical review and an interesting perspective of Saigon/ Ho Chi Minh City. Sunny and Orange were fantastic throughout the day. A delicious meal at the end capped it all off.

Great day with family experiencing the country side and many attractions... We were well looked after by a great crew, thanks again to Vinh, Hao, Sang, Quang, Dung1, and Dao... you all helped in making this a very memorable day, Highly Recommend....

review_title: A great way to see Saigon
review_text: The Vespa tour was great and I marvel at how easily they navigated through the traffic! I preferred the Vespas to normal scooters as there was less chance of exhaust pipe burn and much more comfortable. Some of the places visited were a little different, the flower markets and temples were good, but was a little underwhelmed by the alley of party things and the Chinese herbal shop.

This concept is great. Buy Vintage Vespa Scooters, make them nice. Hire safe drivers and drive customers around the city, local style on the Vespas while doing a culinary and cultural tour through several Districts in HCMC. I have taken a few visitors on this and it is always there best memory.

You get to sit at very local style restaurants (3-4), try different foods, but the Vespa team makes sure their customers have a bit more upscaled set up. Really well done.

Absolutely loved this. We were safely escorted around HCM by our expert drivers, enjoying the sights from a very different perspective. Sunny, our lovely hostess was fun and informative and took us to some great restaurants and bars to try different Vietnamese food (including jumping chicken!!). We enjoyed coffee watching amazingly talented young singers and then onto a bar for a more lively band and drinks. Throughly enjoyed this tour and would highly recommend it!

Thanks to the team - pilots and guide - for this wonderful experience ! Discovering Saigon by night - eating local and delicious food - listening to different kind of music - meeting others people from all over the world was fantastic ! And always with smile and kindness.
Don't miss this adventure in Saigon!
Laurent

review_title: FUN FUN FUN and FANTASTIC IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE!
review_text:
We recently thoroughly enjoyed our experience with Vespa Adventures on our tour
Countryside & Islands Explorer – Hoi An, Central Vietnam

What an outstanding tour company Vespa Adventures is!!! The guides and drivers were first-rate, friendly, helpful, considerate and outstanding in every way.
They took us to a delightful outdoor cafe for lunch, and helped us navigate and shop for items.
It was so much fun, and we felt safe throughout the excursion. I would enthusiastically recommend Vespa Adventures to anyone looking for an immersive experience that is out of the ordinary.

We're going home on the back of a Vespa 🛵 🎶 🎶 .... last nite we had one of the most incredible experiences, a food tour around Hoi An on the back of a Vespa. Picked up from our hotel at 5pm we then spent the next 5 hours driving through the back streets, eating & drinking beers with the locals. Visiting the night market, boat trip up the river, making our own White Rose dumplings, which I may say looks a lot easier than it is. Also had a helping hand in making Vietnam spring rolls. Tasting the local “Moonshine”. Big shout out to Vespa Adventures, our guide Vinh & my driver Duc, highly recommended 12 out of 10 so much more than I expected xx

It was to commemorate my first trip to Vietnam and I thoroughly enjoyed every moment of it!
From experiencing the local rush hour (cooling night breeze albeit the fumes) with a herd of motorbikes zooming from all directions, and thankful for the swift yet steady skills of our driver 🙏🏻 Nam & Khanh, we made it safely through the night - we were in very very safe hands :)

I must say, the highlight was our local guide, Nguyên, who was not only insightful and knowledgeable, she made us so comfortable with her as soon as we were done with our welcome drink(we had local beer which was very yummy)! I honestly wished we spent more time chatting with her!!

Loved the food, the route, the whole trip thoroughly planned - would definitely rate this higher than 5 stars because that’s what they deserve!

They operate in both Vietnam and Cambodia, so be sure to check them out - even if you’re Asian or not, you’ll have The Ride of your Life with them :)

Good fun Vespa tour, a beer stop, a foodstop for seafood meal, and a pancake stop. The tour was going on for another stop but we had had enough and they took us back to the hotel. It’s great fun weaving through the chaotic traffic and they take you throughout the city. Despite the traffic I felt very safe. A guide meets you at each location. They could maybe give you a big of private time during the breaks , the guide can be a little in your face. The restaurants are very local, not at all tourist, and the food genuine.

We booked this tour through our hotel in Ho Chi Minh City, following a taxi ride from the airport to our hotel we all (4 people) were a bit hesitant about the tour given the traffic and what we saw of the congestion and lack of any road rules (only our uneducated view).
How wrong we were! The tour organiser (Orange) and our four drivers were skilled, informative and we all felt completely safe. The tour took us to both normal tourist spots as well as local markets were you could get a real feel of local life in a large Vietnamese city. I would strongly recommend this tour, well priced and just the right time and well paced. If you get the opportunity take the tour, like us you will not regret it.

Really great experience! Jenny our guide was so fun she had a such a great personality. Our 4 drivers we amazing as well !! The traffic can be a bit overwhelming if your not used to being on a scooter but these drivers made us all feel safe and relaxed. The food stops were good representation of local fare, and the two music venues were a fun twist on the evening. Great be yourself about 4 hrs and bring CASH.. they don’t like to take credit cards at time of payment ( only down fall)

review_title: Great way to see city and try local food!
review_text:
My husband and I (from US) visited Saigon(Ho Chi Minh City on our honeymoon. Our travel agent booked us on this tour and we were very happy with the experience! Although we were worried about riding on a Vespa in a very busy city, once we were on our way, we felt very safe and the drivers were excellent—we had a little Vespa biker gang!
Sunny was our guide and she was very enthusiastic and was a wonderful guide. She explained the culture and food to us and the best way to eat the cuisine. At the coffee shop she had the singer announce us and our honeymoon and sang to us!
We were paired with two couples from the UK and it was fun to meet new people and experience the Vespa tour with others. It is a must do adventure in HCMC!
We had a really good time with Orange - the visit went through the main sightseeing places. Comfortable ride, very nice guide!

review_title: A must do when in Ho Chi Minh city
review_text:
We are a family of 4 (children 13 and 15 and parents) who experienced a Vespa Adventure tour. Tri was our guide. The tour was great and Tri was very knowledgable.

Would recommend a Vespa tour when in Ho Chi Minh city as the tour traveled to areas that are off the normal touristy scene and will show you the normal daily life and traditions of the Vietnamese people.

Would thoroughly recommend this tour if considering.

The Vespa tour was a great addition to our Saigon sightseeing! It introduces people to the key sites with stories and interesting trivia. We did the morning tour starting at the Garden of birds and then ending with a great lunch! With a group of 5 ladies - our guide Maggi was superb and so were each of the drivers. Safe, easy and interesting- definitely a must do for all... especially the rookie visitors!

review_title: Fun experience - best way to see Hanoi
review_text:
We had used Vespa Adventures when we were in Ho Chi Minh and enjoyed the experience so much that we booked them again when we visited Hanoi. We enjoyed the experience this time too.

We had our parents with us, who were in their early 70s (and quite fit) and they made it easy for them to climb on and off the bike. We took a private tour so that we did not have to rush our parents and it worked out well.

The service was great. Our guide, Max and all the drivers, especially Brian, were very friendly and smiley. They were also very skilled and safe, even when it started raining a little. We were also provided ponchos so did not get really wet in the rain.

The tour was very interesting and brought us to places we would never have gone on our own, In Hanoi.

We told them that we were returning customers and also received a 10% discount, which we appreciated.

review_title: MOST FUN THING WE DID IN SAIGON
review_text: Absolutely loved this tour & would do it again in a nanosecond. We did the night tour & it was SO much fun. Great drivers who were extremely caring & careful - the traffic is extreme! Sue, our guide was excellent & made sure we all enjoyed the experience. A definite MUST if you're in Saigon.

We went on a Vespa Tour in Hoi An and it was the most fantastic day of our trip. Our guide Harry, and our two drivers were absolutely incredible. We felt so safe on the Vespas and the tour was incredible, we learned, saw and visited so much of the area. Great way to explore the city - an experience not to be missed!

review_title: Vietnamese food tour after dark Saigon
review_text:
I have taken the food tour after dark in Saigon with Vespa Adventures and it has been delightful.
Our tour guide Rosy was sweet and funny, with great knowledge of the city and Vietnamese culture, explaining more about the food we were trying. She has been so great that even the days after the tour, when reaching out to her, she has advised on things to try in Saigon.
Our drivers Phong and Quyen have also been very professional. I was rather scared driving on a Vespa, but having Phong as driver, made me relaxed, he has excellent driving skills.
The food we tried was fantastic and diverse.
All in all, I strongly recommend the tour - awesome experience!

OMG - this was one of the highlight of our fantastic adventure in Hoi an/Vietnam.
We were a party of 6 (including a 11 year old and 15 year old).

We were met at our hotel in Hoi an by 6 fabulous looking Vespas and 6 very smart, polite drivers -BEN, THI, NINE, HUNG, TRUNG & CHU' SON.

We didn't stop smiling and laughing from the beginning. We went round the back streets stopping at 6 places to eat local street food and drink beer.
The food was outstanding and we tried things we would never have thought to try and in wonderful places we would probably never have seen (the snake headed fish was one of my favourites).
Along the way we saw lots of sights - had a river trip and made a wish with floating candles, experienced the road & back streets of Hoi an and dined with locals and saw the white roses made. My only regret is that we didn't have enough time to book another tour on a Vespa through the countryside.

Rosy from Vespa tours in Saigon was our leader and she was fantastic giving us a great insight into Vietnam, the amazing food and the way people live. The Vespa night foodie tour in Saigon was one of the best tours I have ever done. I highly recommend it and I will be recommending to all my clients ( I am a travel agent). You will not regret doing it. Loved it so much I will be keen to do one in Hoi An

I’m a bit late posting this - sorry! This is a must do for any visitor. Drivers and host were excellent- all stops were well worthwhile - DO NOT eat before doing this tour you will be very well fed on it! We made the mistake of eating lunch and couldn’t eat all that was on offer! Highly recommended!

We took a motorbike tour of the Mekong Delta in Vietnam. It was approximately six hours and our tour guide was excellent and so were the drivers. It was interesting and informative with lasting memories as we learned much about the Vietnamese culture. Seeing the wet market and eating the fresh shrimp etc. was amazing.
