We were well fed and hydrated and they made us feel like we were part of the family. Our tour guide (Na) made us feel very special and wanted us to get the full experience and information. She cared about our experience, never rushed a stop and her English was excellent.

We had the best experience with Vespa Adventures on our first day of our vacation! We did the morning Vespa tour of the city, which was perfect because it wasn't too hot. Our drivers did a nice job of making us feel safe weaving through the chaotic streets. The best part was our tour guide named “Fully.” He was super friendly, funny, and knowledgeable about the places we visited throughout the morning. We never felt rushed, and Fully tried to do everything he could to ensure we were having a great time. After visiting great temples, markets, monuments, an Oriental medicine shop, and even a bird park, we ended back at Zoom cafe where we finished with a nice lunch. Fully helped us order and made sure we had full drinks. Truly one of the greatest experiences, and the PERFECT way to start a vacation in HCM City. Big thanks to Vespa Adventures and especially Fully, the greatest tour guide ever!
Great fun, initially a little hairy, but really enjoyable. Loved the bars we visited. Guide was good, drivers ability to manage bikes very well, even though we're much bigger than them!

There was a group of 6 of us and we completed the after dark Vesper Tour. It was amazing to be in the middle of the chaos that is Saigon traffic and still feel very safe. The places we ate and drank were places we would never have stumbled across as tourist and they were fantastic! An intimate coffee bar with live music and the club we finished at the performers were awesome. We all agreed that it was by far the best thing we did in Vietnam. So much FUN!!!

Thank you Vespa Tours Saigon for taking us on a day trip around the Mekong delta. We loved every minute of the experience, from riding in the sun to meeting so many beautiful people. One of my highlights were the scallops for snacks after a tour of the market! The drivers were super trained and careful, we felt completely confident in their ability to drive us through the crazy traffic of this busy city. Our guide, Thuyen, taught us more about Vietnam than anyone else during our stay. It looks steep price-wise but it is all inclusive (drinks, food, etc.) and, as a couple, we paid for 3 people wages for a full day! Definitely recommend this experience to all visiting Ho Chi Minh City.

Stayed in Saigon for four nights,and on the last night did this tour......well,what can I say? Picked up at hotel on vespa and taken to home hub for nibbles and drinks.just going through the traffic was amazing,having spent so much time trying to cross the road🙂taken to a seafood restaurant which was amazing,as was our guide Miggy,and then to a pancake restaurant,coffee shop and music bar.food and drinks both abundant.definitely a must when in Saigon.big thanks to my pilot Long,always felt safe.all in all brilliant 👌👌

review_title: Really fun evening with delicious food, music and laughter
review_text: This was a highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh city. We loved being a part of the traffic on a Vespa in the hands of capable drivers, having the experience of street foods and bars across the city and learning more about Vietnam with a really fun guide. We were well cared for, well fed, and saw many fun parts of the city. Great evening overall.

We had a wonderful fun and exciting night on our Vespa tour. Fully, our amazing guide supported by 4 experienced and safe riders took us all over Saigon.
The food was awesome and great entertainment.
Our teenage kids thought it was a highlight of our trip.
We highly recommend Vespa tours and Fully for an amazing Saigon experience
Sam G

It was very exciting to have a Vespa run myself among all the cars and motorbikes around me!
The mixture of Vespa riding and excellent food was really great! Go on like this!

We had family visiting us here in HCMC and we were very reluctant to get on a motorbike. The drivers were very professional and were very safe driving through the busy city. It was so fun to see the city sites on a motorbike, I highly recommend this tour! Don't forget to tip these guys, they are great!

This is must do
Food experience is excellent even the jumping chicken
Vespa ride is a lot of fun and suitable for everyone
Drivers are very friendly and drive safely all being
You are in very bust traffic

Night lights are great viewing
Great fun, excellent food tastings and the only way to experience the crazy traffic of Ho Chi Minh City
This was great fun for all of us, including a 10 year old, 14 year old and 73 year old Grandma! A great way to see the sights of HCMC.

This was by far one on the best experiences i have ever had. We had a Vespa night tour visiting sea food restaurants, coffee shops and clubs. I never stopped smiling, ate way to much and so much drink too. Great value for money and believe me you wont regret it. Thankyou to Hoi and Sunny for the great experience xxxx

We had, that afternoon, arrived in Ho Chi Minh and at 18.00 been booked on a Vespa Adventure and, not unnaturally, being over 70 year old's we had our apprehensions.
But WOW did we have fun safely shooting among the bustling traffic and stopping at fun places.
Our Tour guide and the drivers were perfection - my only regret was not having any cash to give a well deserved tip - it will have to me next time !!!
A great evening tour - away from the big tourist crowds - a real experience - thank you for this adventure

We have now been on 3 Vespa Adventure tours and loved all three. From the minute the pick you up to the minute they drop you off, you will feel taken care of. I felt safe and comfortable. We have brought friends from out of town and it is always a highlight of peoples visits! They take you to lively and tasty establishments. We just had a blast and laughed all night! I highly recommend couples or families to go on this tour!

We had an absolutely amazing time. Everything was perfect from the friendly drivers, to our guide Jaden who was just so much fun and the food was out of this world. Absolute must do if you are in HCMC. Was the highlight of our trip!

review_title: A nice way to discover Mekong delta with kids and teens
review_text: I wanted to do something different. We had friends with small kids and we have teens who prefer to stay with their friends. So I booked the Mekong Delta tour and everybody loved it! We left home at 7.40 in the morning and came back at 3.30 pm. We had a fun time with the kids discovering the country!

review_title: Great way to discover the Mekong delta
review_text: We wanted to do something different. With friends with small children and with our teens who prefered to stay at home.But finally, everyone loved that tour. They came at 7.40 to pick us up at our house and we came back at 3.30pm. It was a great day of discovery and fun.

review_title: A wild, safe time had by all
review_text: 16 of us went biking and eating thru Saigon. The drivers were very cautious. The food was safe and good. The guides were knowledgeable. I would do it again. And we were all over 65 years of age!!!

review_title: Exciting, Fun Way to see HCM City
review_text: A hgh-charged, foodie tour. We are mey by 9 orange clad young men who took us, on the rear of their Vespas, to their idea of ​​a city tour: a bar (also their HQ), 3 restaurants, and 2 music clubs. Our leader explained why we were at each restaurant and what dish the restaurant was known for. Overall, a rare, exciting opportunity to eat among locals and see HCM City from the perspective of the street. An absolutely fun evening.

review_title: Very good 'fun time' on a Scooter!
review_text: Not to be missed as it is an excellent way to see what it is like to commute without the stress of being in control of the vehicle. Food selections very good but.... some of the music at venues too loud so you couldn't hear the rep asking you what you wanted to drink!!
Great evening - loved the bike - felt safer on the Vespa than as a pedestrian! Lovely food - would recommend to everyone.
Certainly a highlight of our trip. Recommend this company highly. Would do again for sure. Drivers and staff were excellent, very entertaining. Food and music were terrific.

We absolutely loved this tour, it was so well organized. Brilliant riders so that you felt perfectly safe riding pillion.It was exhilarating to experience life on the roads with all the scooters. The food certainly disappointed, amazing local dishes, the atmosphere and our guide were all wonderful. I would highly recommend the whole experience

I was far to imagine I would have such an original experience in Saïgon! Far to imagine I would be part of this huge flow of motorcycles and discover such confidential places! It was great!!! I would just recommend to offer the possibility to wear a mask for the mouth to your customers so that they can breathe better when riding the Vespa.

My wife and I did the Mekong Delta tour while we were out on our honeymoon.
The tour was fantastic from start to finish - good fun, informative, and the tour guide (Sunny) and two drivers were very friendly.
I had no idea as to what to expect. It was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. The food, drink and entertainment were fantastic. I would highly recommend it.

Although all of my time in Vietnam was very enjoyable, this was my Favorite. Our guide was very knowledgeable and our drivers very professional. The food was delicious, abundant and a pleasure for the palate. If you have only one thing to choose to do in Vietnam, this should be no. one on your list. Saigon at night is truly memorable done with Vespa Adventures

review_title: What an great adventure on the Vespa with Minh!
review_text: We had a great tour on the vespa's. Very safe. Linh speaks perfect english with a great sense of humor. The food was brilliant and diverse! Thanks
Great tour of the city, taking you places you wouldn’t normally see! Guides were excellent and so was the food :)

The tour round with the drivers was great. Felt comfortable on the scooter. Sites visited was interesting. On the downside the tour guide pushed religion a bit much. Didnt appreciate the mini tests he kept doing.

We went on the night street food Vespa adventure and had such a good time! Luna was our tour guide for the night and she was so lovely teaching us about different local Vietnamese foods and having a laugh with us all! My Vespa driver Tin was so friendly and was a safe driver on those busy streets of Saigon! The rock n roll bar we visited last was such a good memory! The vibe was so good and everyone loved the music! I would highly recommend this tour to anyone travelling to Vietnam it was such a good night and such a good way to meet new people!

There are lots of different scooter tours available in Ho Chi Minh City. We chose Vespa Adventures and are glad that we did!

Our tour guide was very informative and friendly. Our drivers looked after us very well! Their skills in navigating the mayhem of the Saigon traffic were awesome.

The morning tour was around 4 hours and gave us ample time to wander around the temples, markets and all attractions we visited. It finished with lunch at a local cafe.

We thoroughly recommend Vespa Adventures!
One of the best nights of my life! Fab food, fab host (Sunny) and fab city!! If you’re in Ho Chi Minh, it’s a must do attraction ♥️

Superb evening in Saigon thanks to Vespa Adventures .. very good organisation !
Special thanks to Rosy !

We joined the vesper night food tour. It was the most amazing night ever.
We had a great group of people and all got on so well.
The traffic in hoi chi Minh was incredible and a little scary but I always felt very safe with our drivers.
We stopped at lots of restaurants and had a course in each. The food was really good everywhere we went. The drinks were free flowing and we could choose whatever we wanted, gin and tonics, cocktails, beers etc.
The last two stops were at a bar with live singers, the first was an unusual location which we would have never found on our own. The singers were really good.
The last bar had a live band where the drinks flowed and we even had a dance.
The trip was so good and I would recommend it to everyone. The best trip in hoi chi Minh. You must do it

The best fun we have had on a family holiday. Our Guide Miggy and our drivers really made the tour! The traffic is outrageous but we felt very safe. Make sure you don't eat before you go as you will be very full by the end. The food is delicious and the drinks are plentiful. A great introduction to Saigon and a must do tour!

I just spent the day with Sunny and Hoi and they are both amazing, friendly and knowledgeable! I booked my Vespa tour last minute (less than 12 hours in advance) and they were able to accommodate me without a problem. I know it seems a little pricey but it’s worth every penny. On the back and the Vespa and with this group you really feel like a local as you’re riding through the streets on Mekong Delta.
A received a cute Vespa Adventure key chain and the picture below at the end of the trip, definitely going to be remembered as a highlight of my Vietnam adventures.

review_title: BRILLIANT, FUN, A MUST TO DO!!!!!
review_text:
Our Guide Tien Nguyen was brilliant, funny, accommodating and took us to amazing food venues (food was DELICIOUS) and live music experience!!!
Our drivers were fantastic, very conscious of our safety at all times.
This is a Great Way to see and experience the culture and get a taste of the lifestyle - YOU MUST DO IT!!

We had the most memorable evening visiting and tasting local foods. Our hosts were fascinating lovely people who shared their stories and gave us a great insight into local life. This is really a must. One of the highlights of our trip.

review_title: Fun tour - Got to see stuff I would never find on my own.
review_text: I recommend this tour. Here is how it works - we did the afternoon sightseeing tour. I did it with my son. Two guys show up at your hotel and take you to a lunch spot. You are introduced to your main guide - in our case Orange (aka Hung). We had lunch and then my son and I jumped on the back of 2 mopeds and Orange took his own solo and we will meet him at each stop along the way. Orange was a great tour guide and we got to learn a lot about the history of Saigon and saw some cool pagodas. We ended our tour at the post office before being dropped off back at our hotel. The entire tour took about 3.5 hours. It was hot so bring sunscreen. They will provide you with some water. You will have fun!

review_title: Highlight of Saigon visit, taste, smells and life of Saigon
review_text:
A wonderful, best value for money tour around Saigon.
Safe drivers, fun informative tour.
4.5 hrs , visiting several districts from Chinatown, fresh food markets,Goat BBQ,Upper middle class District 7.Negotiating traffic of vespas, an exciting tour not to be missed.

I've done several Vespa Adventures tours in Vietnam and Cambodia and highly recommend them to anyone visiting either country.
First things first - safety. All the drivers are highly competent and familiar with the traffic in HCMC. The tours are safe and riding on the back of the Vespa is great fun.
I did the craft brewery tour in HCMC recently with my brother Geoff and we had a fabulous night out. Starting at Zoom cafe we ​​enjoyed bottled craft beer before getting underway.
Great company, plenty of food and most important, lots of excellent craft beer. You won't go back to the hotel feeling hungry or thirsty.
The tour takes in several bars around Saigon where craft beer is served, however only one is a brewery. All of the places have an amazing range of beers, one had in excess of 50 craft beers on tap.
If you like beer, especially craft beer, this is a very, very enjoyable night out. The staff at Vespa Adventures are fabulous, thank you Phuong and our guide Oanh who were delightful.

review_title: Vespa Saigon by night foodie tour
review_text: Fantastic night, full of fun, thrills on the back of bikes in busy times, great food and great guide.

It was a really wonderful trip. We've not even been expecting anything like this: night city full of lights and being a part of this vespa flow, it's really interesting and exciting. There was a lot of delicious food, probably, we've visited something like 4 restaurants, and the final was with the live music bands.
Very good, nothing else to say. 100% recommend.

We really enjoyed the Vespa tour! We booked the Cu Chi tunnel tour combined with the Vespa tour. The tunnels were fun and well worth getting up early to beat the crowds. The Vespa tour was great - lots of stops and interesting things to see. It was really hot but they made sure we stayed really well hydrated. We had one member of our group that was a bit nervous but they made sure to take extra good care - pairing her with the best English speaking driver and making sure she was ok. Lovely lovely bunch of people, they took such good care of us and the tour was so much fun. I highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Just the safest and funniest way to taste the crazy traffic of Saigon
review_text: We just loved!!! Starting with the welcome drink when they joined us to another couple around our age. The two street restaurants have amazing taste food. Then we went to a cafe in an alley that we will never find by ourselves. the singers were amazing and we enjoyed them with ice cream and coffee. From there we went to a rock and roll bar, the rock group was very good and we enjoyed with some cocktails. my husband though it was a bit price when I first wanted to book but in the end he agreed it was worth every cent. The guide was very knowledgeable and we had a course of Vietnamese cousin. The drivers were outstanding and I felt much more secure on the Vespa than trying to cross the streets by foot!!!!

Vee, our tour guide, was brilliant! She was hilarious and always upbeat. Making each stop lots of fun, with lots and lots of laughter. The tour was great, zipping in and out of the traffic gave me a great feel of this busy, vibrant city. The driver was safe, friendly and will always help put my helmet on (even though I was more than capable lol) I highly recommend this tour, there were 8 of us girls and we had a blast!

We went on a two hour private tour with Sunny as a tour guide and we really enjoyed the experience. The drivers were very careful and courteous and it's amazing how the traffic seems to work. Sunny was very good and enthusiastic over her job and gave us a memorable experience. Thoroughly recommended.

review_title: A must-do for any lover of excellent beer!
review_text: This tour takes you to the best craft beer locations in the city. The growth of Vietnam's craft beer since 2014 has been amazing to witness, and it's gratifying to see that young, mostly Western entrepreneurs are making such great beer in Vietnam, using local flavors when possible, and that the Vietnamese are so receptive in their welcome. Definitely do take this tour, and ask for Kit Kat to be your guide. I haven't met anyone here with better English, and she definitely knows her beer. And she is an absolute sweetheart!

Superbly organized with great staff! They create a fabulous evening for you...exciting motorcycle rides thru the chaos of Saigon traffic, excellent restaurants and bars with meals waiting for you on arrival. Our guide KAT was a delight to deal with!

We felt rather nervous to begin with having never been on a vespa before and being launched off into the rush hour traffic in Saigon was a little frightening. However it was one of the most enjoyable experiences of our fantastic holiday in Vietnam. Our host, Luna, was very vibrant and her enthusiasm was infectious. The restaurants and clubs we visited were all really different and we sampled some delicious food. Luna explained how the food was cooked and the best way to eat it. We particularly enjoyed the clubs with the live music. We felt really safe with our drivers who took great care in making sure our helmets were on properly and we were safely seated. We would thoroughly recommend this wonderful experience.

Our most fun part of visiting Saigon was on a Vespa scooter. The drivers took us around the City, visiting restaurants and clubs, and made it a real adventure. After seeing the scooters everywhere for a couple of days, it was great to see the City from sitting on one! I strongly recommend you include this when you visit Saigon.

review_title: Scarey at first! But brilliant experience
review_text: We booked this as part of our tour. So 2 Vespas arrived at the hotel with a guide. Spot on time. The drivers were very safe in the Mad traffic. The guide really engaging and knowledgable. The food brilliant. Drinks great. The Vietnamese folk club was captivating(I wish we had longer there,) the Rock venue was great. The only down side was when we had to return to the hotel. I wish we had cancelled the last ride to the hotel and returned by taxi. Everything was brilliant

This is a great way to see some of the cities sights away from the tourist spots. Our guide spoke very good English and was very knowledgeable. This was our third Vespa tour and each time we were taken somewhere different. Definitely recommend!

Our Vespa Tour in Saigon was one of the best holiday activities I have done. Our drivers looked after us well and we were taken to interesting bars off the beaten track and we had delicious food. The evening flew by and I could have done it all again.

Our friend lives in Ho Chi Minh City and scheduled this ride for the three of us and we truly had the ride of our lives! We got to see the city like the locals, visit sites, taste food and have an overall GREAT time! We made a video of our experience in Ho Chi Minh City, including this tour and you can watch it on our You Tube Channel: Bob and Jill TV.

We've done it here, we've done it there, but never before on a Vespa in Saigon. At 80 years it was the greatest. they dodged in & out with such precision. they stopped at each course of the meal at places we would never find. then on to the music, folk style and finally at the pop/ jazz. No one shoulod miss these friendly people.

It was an entirely spontaneous decision and it was such fun! Having the Vespa take us to small back alleys and local food places was so great. The opportunity to also meet the friendly locals and meet new people was also fun. I had a blast and would recommend it to anyone who has limited time on their hands and just want a quick tour of the city!

When we arrived to Saigon we immediately knew that SAIGON AFTER DARK trip will be a challenge for us. Can you imagine that in a city with a population of about 12 millions , there are about 7 millions of scooters and there are no traffic rules for them? Wow! So, WAW was all our experience in that night.
At precisely 18.00, the drivers were waiting for us in front of the hotel and then all started. If you live in a western country you have to prepare yourself for a high adrenaline ride. I'm not going to tell you too much about traffic as you have to experience it by your self.
The food in the local restaurants was very good. We had a lot of different delicious dishes and a very helpful guide who explained a lot about food, habits and Saigon people. I have just one regret, we had too much food so we left a lot in our plates.
The evening continued in a small , but really very small Vietnamese-style coffee shop, a space where young Vietnamese were exercising their singing talent, it was a karaoke venue. We’ve been lucky as all the singers were very good.
The last stop was in a place that I never expected to find in Vietnam . It was a sort of night bar with live music. The big surprise was the Vietnamese band singing latino hits! They were really good. We had many cocktails and beers and also a lot of fun . What ride ! What an experience!

One of my favorite things about travelling is trying out new foods and being part of the culture. I had been in Ho Chi Minh city for 8 days (on business) and had been to a number of restaurants and a couple of sites. On my last evening, I wanted to experience the local food and have a fun evening out as I was travelling alone. The evening Scooter Foodie Tour was exactly what I was looking for. I decided to brave the scooter - although earlier in the week, I thought

we saw fantastic places in Hanoi. Special explained and described. Special thks to our great Drivers. Highly recommended!!!
Andrea & Dirk from Germany

This was such fun to be able to experience the hustle and bustle of the Saigon traffic and yet feel safe. The drivers were tremendous and the tour such great fun. Experiencing great food, drink and some nightife slightly off the tourist circuit. We have recommended it to some friends visiting next year.
Our Vespa night out was a stand out experience of our holiday in Vietnam, in such good hands with the drivers and the stops along the way are brilliant
Great way of seeing the city at night and trying the different foods at each stop. Thoroughly enjoyed the experience, lots of fun . Would recommend.

The best part of our trip to vietnam. Had to be the vespa tour of Saigon.zipping through the manic traffic at night. Great local food and even night club
Great tour host. Loved the night
Fun ride through the chaotic traffic of Saigon at night with all you can eat and plenty to drink in 4 stops with enthusiastic and happy guides. Not as scary as it appears.

review_title: Vespa Ride of your Life around Saigon
review_text: Brilliant experience. Being nearly seventy, my younger sister had to work hard to persuade me to do it but I am so glad I did. It was fun and a bit scary but I felt completely safe. Good, friendly driver and tour guide and very well organised from the time they pick you up from your hotel to the time they drop you back. As well as the ride itself we stopped at interesting local eating places and bars where we learned a lot about local foods and customs. All in all a great experience, evidenced by the free photo of you on the Vespa with the guide and driver.

review_title: An awesome glimpse of the Mekong
review_text:
Great half day trip and perfect way to see the Mekong on a stylish Vespa if you don't have a lot of time! We visited families making rice wine and incense sticks and had a great seafood lunch at a local market. The landscape was beautiful and there's no better way than doing this trip on the back of a Vespa.
Our guide Sunny and riders Tien & Tam were super nice. Would def do it again!

review_title: An amazing way to see Saigon
review_text: An amazing adventure and an awesome way to see the city on the back of a Vespa, extremely well organised and the varied selection of destinations for food and music was perfect, will definitely be back for Vespa tour 2!

What a great way to see the sites and taste the local cuisine. At no time did l feel unsafe, and the hosts and host were both friendly and professional.All in all great experience and fun, so much that l did the tour in Ho Chi Minh and Phnom phen!!!

This was, by far, one of our highlights of our tour of Vietnam. From struggling to cross the road in both Hanoi and Saigon due to the volume of bikes, cars etc coming at you in all directions (even on the pavement!!) We now were on the flipside - on the Vespas!!! And we loved it. The whole tour was so well organised, from collecting us at the hotel, to introducing us to other people that would be whizzing round this busy chaotic city. Our guide was Kat and she was bubbly and knowledgable. We started off with beer and then our drivers took off to our next destination. To be part of the throng of people on the roads was exhilerating and at no time did we feel unsafe and thats due to the wonderful drivers. We ate in various districts, dining with locals and eating all manner of different food. Towards the end of the tour we had drinks in a little bar with a local singer followed by another bar, Woodstock, where a band belted out some great tunes. This was such an enjoyable tour and I was sad when, like all good things, it came to an end. There were all kinds of people of different ages taking the tour, our group was just 4 people and we enjoyed the company of both Kat and the guests from Singapore. Would I reccomend this tour? Definately 100%

Great fun and friendly drivers. Visited street restaurants, a piano bar and a nightclub. All were excellent choices. It may sound a bit scary sitting on the back of a Vespa in Saigon traffic, in fact the drivers are expert and it felt and was very safe and enormous fun.

My wife and I, both plus 60, were worried beforehand when we realised we were booked on this trip. The number of scooters on Ho Chi Min’s roads looked so dangerous. BUT, it was superb, combining their very experienced drivers with our guide who brought the whole food-night culture alive to us. A must for anyone visiting the city.
great way to explore the city, great service and team, program was perfect, good job of the Vespa team

review_title: The best ride of your life
review_text: Incredible and amazing ride with amazing people that show you the best place of the city and show you the life stile of the city.

This was a great trip and excursion. I'm pleased that I went. The drivers were great and it was wonderful to ride around the streets. It is an entirely different experience than being on a bus or car.

review_title: So fun! The vespa adventure was definitely the highlight of our Saigon trip
review_text: The booking were smooth, drivers on-time, food and drinks abundant and delicious! It was great to know bars that only locals would typically go to. And of course, the vespa ride itself (especially in Saigon) was a great experience.
The best way to get around and see the sights. Our kids said it was the best thing they’d ever done. Tour guide and riders were very lovely.

Zipping through the streets of Saigon on the back of a Vespa is way more exhilarating than any Roller Coaster ride I have ever been on! I typically do not do touristy things when traveling, but Vespa Adventures came highly recommended by a few friends. I decided to give their Saigon After Dark tour a try on a free night and was not disappointed. The company is extremely professional and it is obvious that they have been taking care of people for a long time. Everything was well planned, well organized and executed flawlessly.

We stopped at two "locals only" street restaurants and had exotically delicious food. Met some really nice people from around the globe. Free flow drinks all night. Stopped at a laid back coffee house where very talented locals performed traditional and modern blues, jazz and folk songs. Ended the night in an ex-pat bar, where a live band performed Vietnam's take on many American and British rock and roll songs.

My night was so much fun and I would definitely consider doing their other tours on my next visit.

review_title: The BEST thing you can do in Ho Chi Minh!
review_text:
We did the Saigon After Dark and The Insider's Saigon tours.

Both were just fantastic.

We were looked after by our tour guide Orange on both occasions.

Without giving too much away, the Saigon After Dark tour was one of the best value and most enjoyable tourist experiences of our lives - and we have done a lot, all over the world.

We were in a group of 7. The Vespas are vintage and are extremely comfortable with back rests - there was a 70 year old couple, one on a walking stick, who were having just as good as time as anyone.

The evening is a combination of great street food, an exhilerating ride around the vibrant city and some great - and off the beaten track - musical experiences. All washed down with free flowing drinks and no suggestion of extra charges anywhere.

Our drivers always ensured my wife and I were riding as close as possible so we could enjoy the experience together. Orange was entertaining, knowledgeable and a consummate host (with perfect English).

The day time tour was more

Friendly Staff... Great Places to Visit.. Wonderful experience.
This is the second time we have been on your tour and it gets better each time.
This trip with Vespa Adventures was just amazing. The staff looked after us like family and it was so good that we then took up a Vespa Adventures trip in Cambodia.
Awesome evening sampling great beer. Unique way to see and experience the city. A must fir any beer conisuer

Fun experience. Would highly recommend! Guide was great and the driver was very safe.
Restaurants were authentic and good accommodation for vegetarian food.

It was a bit hair-raising to start with on the Vespa in the throng of Saigon traffic, but the drivers were excellent. The whole concept is brilliant starting with a pick up at our hotel then meeting with our guide for aperitifs in the HQ bar followed by various street food restaurants in different areas of the city. The drivers take you the long way round including scenic landmarks so you get a get a tour of Saigon at the same time. Then we went to a little cafe bar with live singers, accompanied by a piano and violin, very atmospheric ! The last venue was a night club with a live band playing international hits. Food and drink was provided at each stop. Great ambiance. I definitely recommend !!

review_title: An absolutely fantastic way to enjoy Saigon after dark.
review_text:
My wife and I are grandparents and would highly recommend Vespa Adventures. Neither one of us had ever been on a scooter before but our drivers made certain that we had nothing to fear. I don't think they catered to us any more or less than anyone else as we kept pace with the group throughout the evening.

We visited a number of restaurants that I am certain most travellers would never find. We were up and down alleys and then into various entertainment spots some of which were in the most obscure places BUT each and every location, while extremely busy, was clean and the personnel were very professional.

Our guide Vy was exceptional! She made certain that we had every creature comfort and was always on the lookout to make certain that every person in our group was enjoying themselves. I should mention that the age of our group ranged from 11 (with his Mom) to the old timers like me and we all had a blast!

A real fun filled evening. Thank you Vespa Adventures - job very well done!!!

Side note: Not sure about dress code but I would suggest very casual. Sensible shoes are a must. Re what sort of visit - I would think couples, family with teens, friends and solo travellers would find the trip very rewarding.

Great way to see Saigon. Seafood was excellent. Vietnamese pancake restaurant was not clean and food was ok not great.
Seeing Saigon on a vespa and going place to place was lots of fun. The drivers were excellent, very careful and we felt totally safe.

Zooming through the streets of Saigon past the Cathedral, Post Office and Reunification Park, then down alleys to dine on authentic Vietnamese food. You are emerged in local culture. A great way to combine sightseeing with safe local cuisine. Guides speak good English and are so much fun!

This was a great experience and something we would thoroughly recommend for anyone with a sense of adventure. Pick up and drop off from our hotel with an introduction of what to expect from Saigon traffic. Our guide Thien explained everything before and during our Vespa tour. A particular highlight for me was visiting a restaurant in the flower market and experiencing the live music. The drivers are safe and competent. It’s true what they say about Saigon traffic. It just has a rhythm and flow of its own. Something like that. Thanks again guys for a memorable experience.

review_title: Definitely a must do in Saigon!
review_text: What a fun experience! This is a great way to experience Saigon...enjoying the sights of the city, great food and the fun of being on the back of a vespa on the streets at night. I highly recommend it!

review_title: a great way to see Ho Chi Minh
review_text: My kids (13 and 16 years) and did a tour around Ho Chi Minh. Our drivers Hoi, Du and Nhât Chip were great, giving us little bits of information as we drove along. They made sure we were safe and relaxed in the crazy traffic. Miggy our guide was full of information and encouraged us to try local drinks and food. It was a hot sticky day and Miggy made sure we were comfortable. It was a lot of fun to be travelling around the city like the locals. I would recommend this tour.
We had the best food while in Vietnam in this tour. First time riding a scooter with the best guide. Had so much fun. The tour ended in a club with music and dancing.

We booked a private day tour, "Glimpse of the Mekong. Pick up at our hotel at 8:00am was on time", two vintage vespas, two drivers and some good quality helmets. First stop is a coffee shop where you meet your guide for the day and then you are off. The first part of the trip is the longest as you leave the city behind but it is a very comfortable ride and these drivers are expert at navigating the traffic and keeping you safe at all times.

First stop - shrimp farm, then onto one of the many ferries or what we would call a barge that transports all of the motorbike riders from one side of the river to the other side. Our day included plenty of stops, multiple river crossings and the most incredible scenery along the way.

The highlight for us was touring the local wet market. Our drivers slipped into action the moment we got off the bikes and got to work preparing our "snack" (a lot more like lunch!) from local fresh produce including the fruit that we picked out from local stalls along the way. Side note - we have visited Vietnam before but the mango in Saigon is phenomenal. Eat it at every opportunity you get! The food was excellent - fresh seafood including local shrimp, bbq pork and other delicious dishes.

We visited a rice wine distiller and saw the process in action as well as downing a shot of a fairly potent concoction! Next stop the incense maker - a woman working from home with the most incredible piece of machinery pumping out incense sticks.

From there our meanderings took us to Cao Dai temple and finally finishing with lunch back in Saigon at wonderful riverside restaurant.

Our guide spoke excellent English and was very informative at every stop, we learned a lot and enjoyed her company. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to experience the countryside and life outside of the city of Ho Chi Minh. Excellent day, excellent value for money.

review_title: The best ride of your life
review_text:
The best way to tour Ho Chi Minh is on Vespa tours and a Vespa Adventures gives the best experience for the same. Our guide, Orange, was amazing with the tours and my driver Tuan was so sweet ensuring I enjoy the ride !

This really was the best ride of my life!

We were booked for a Vespa Adventure when our cruise stopped in Ho Chj Minh - except when we boarded the cruise we were no longer stopping in Ho Chi Minh. Very disappointed- we reached out to VA and they immediately responded with a FULL REFUND!! They were a dream throughout! Thanks Vespa Adventures!

review_title: Brilliant way to see the sights
review_text: My husband and two children (aged 3 and 8) just did the Mekong Delta trip which was brilliant. We were picked up at 7.30am in Saigon and then made our way through the city traffic and into the country side. The stops we made to a shrimp farm, market, to watch incense being made and to a fascinating temple were all excellent. The stops we made for food and drinks were all delicious and really well timed. Sunny our guide was first class. She explained everything really well and was always on the look out for ways to make our trip more special. The three vesper drivers we had were excellent. Very safe, (especially when navigating through Saigon!) and so very kind to our children who had the best day. The tour was definitely a highlight of our trip and I would recommend them to anyone who wants to see some of the real heart of Vietnam. 10 out of 10 from us!

review_title: You’ve just got to do the Saigon After Dark tour
review_text: Getting on Vespas and getting in amongst the insane traffic of Saigon is just one Etsy cool aspect of this evening. We saw parts of the city we just wouldn’t have seen, ate in restaurants we wouldn’t have been brave enough to select and tried food we’ve never tried before. We ended up at a place called Woodstock with a local band playing awesome rock music. Great guide (Luna), great bunch of people with us (small group of 6). Highly recommend this company and this particular tour.

review_title: So much fun and great food!
review_text: We did the Saigon After Dark with Orange - by far one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam! The tour has a great mix of driving the streets of Saigon, seeing the main tourist spots lit up at night, great food stops (with drinks included) and an awesome guide. So professionally done, we even had a souvenir photo to take home printed before we left! Some of our group were a little worried about safety and riding scooters but all drivers were awesome and made us all feel very safe. Highly recommended!!

Definitely one of the highlights of the trip for us. The trip saw us weaving through the fluorescent lit streets of Hanoi interspersed with some delicious local street food. Our guide Orange was excellent, both full of energy and knowledge about both the history of Ho Chi Minh and also the food which we were eating. The trip was extremely relaxed and I would definitely recommend.

Certainly a must activity. Was one of the highlights of the trip. Our family of 5 got picked up from our hotel at 6pm for a 4 hour food and adventure tour through Saigon. A trip on these vintage Vespas was one of a kind! It was a unique way to see the city and experience it as a local would. Our guide was amazing and took us to a few restaurants off the beaten track which you normally wouldnt discover. We all enjoyed a beer on the trip so our guide would go and buy us some beers from the local corner store if the restaurant didnt sell beer. All food and drinks are inclusive of the price. Highly recommend.

What a fantastic day! Went and booked a day tour around the Mekong Delta, I paid the extra to ride the bike my self and after a short “riding test” away we went heading south. Sunny was a great guide she really knows her stuff and the locals around the markets and sights are very welcoming. I’d recommend this tour to anyone and if you can ride it’s really worth paying that bit extra to have a go your self and experience the “real” Vietnam driving experience!
Thanks again to Sunny and the rest of the team involved for making it a fantastic day out adventure!

Oh my goodness I can't say enough good things about our Saigon After Dark Experience with Vespa Adventures. We did this tour with our two sons, age 12 and 8, as well as another family that had two kids ages 10 and 8. We all had the best time and I have to say that it was because of our amazing tour guide, Sunny! She was so fun and really showed so much enthusiasm for her city and wanting to share this fun experience with us. Her persoanlity is perfect for this job and you can tell she loves what she does. We visited 5 different places to eat and each one was special and interesting! We tried all kinds of food and Sunny paid special attention to the kids and made sure that the experience was super fun for them. Although the traffic in Ho Chi Minh City is something like I have ever seen, our Vespa drivers made sure we were safe the entire time. As a mom it can be nerve racking to see your kids on the back of a Vespa weaving through traffic but I had no anxiety as I had complete trust that we all would be taken care of. If you are looking for a fun, one of a kind adventure, give this a shot for sure and request SUNNY! You won't be disappointed!

Absolute highlight of our 2 week trip in Vietnam.. we had a couple of members of our group who were very nervous and didn’t want to go on a motorbike but within 3 mins were being. Very professionally run, very safe drivers, fantastic food and really fun last bar. Highly recommend
As a family, we had a blast on our scooter tour around Hanoi. Our guide and drivers were great, safe, and fun. This is a first class operation and we would highly recommend!

review_title: An absolutely great night - a must do!
review_text: This is the best night out and a great way to experience the city by night, Our guide was very friendly and the food was great. Plenty of food and drinks. Zipping around the city by vespa was just great fun. Visited local spots that you wouldn't find yourself including a couple of music venue.

review_title: Best trip of Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: This is the absolute best way to see the city and taste the very best of local food in Saigon. My wife and I booked this on the recommendation of a friend and it was fantastic! Our host Nicole was brilliant, guiding us through areas of the city we would never have seen otherwise. She was so friendly and knowledgeable! And Thanh (hopefully spelt correctly!) was an excellent driver. There is no better way to experience Ho Chi Minh City than on the back of a bike, and this is the best way to do that. A* experience!

review_title: Best day in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
My girlfriend and I booked the mekong delta day tour as I had previously done the tour with family and friends 5 years ago. Once again, we were not dissapointed.

From the pick up from our hotel to our beautiful tour guide Sunny, (Yes she lives up to her name!) we thoroughly loved travelling through the bustle of Ho Chi Minh city on the back of the vespa then out to the Mekong. The day was stunning, the tour fantastic and we finished with a beautiful lunch. Absolutely recommended

review_title: 4 hour Vespa tour in HO Chi Minh City
review_text: Fantastic 4 hour daytime trip around HCM. Great for those who don’t have much time here. We went to places that we wouldn’t have had time or even considered. Our son was 9 and he loved it. Didn’t feel dangerous, just amazing being on the crazy streets. Guide (Thien) and riders (Trung, Ty and Thanh) were excellent and really lovely. Ended our 2 week trip to Vietnam and Cambodia on a high!! Thanks!!

review_title: Great Experience - Not For The Faint-hearted
review_text:
My wife & I did the food tour (Saigon After Dark) in early April. They call it the ‘ride of your life’ and it’s probably true! Zipping through the busy streets dodging the other traffic is certainly something we won’t forget.

The tour lasted about 4.5 hours with 2 stops to try local food followed by another 2 stops with music for coffee/drinks. Our guide, Na, spoke excellent English and made sure we enjoyed the evening. Our Vespa drivers, Dong and Thanh were also very helpful & friendly.

We would certainly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City as watching the HCM City traffic from the pavement is one thing, but being driven through it on the back of a Vespa is something else!

This was absolutely amazing. The vespas were comfortable with great drivers. The food the drinks and the entertainment and the guide were suburb. I was a bit hesitant at first but was the highlight of our trip. Wouldn't hesitate about doing it again

This was my first time at Saigon. It’s great experience for me and my family. Night tour very nice and we enjoy with local food and music so much. Thank you our guide Sunny was friendly and very nice. She surprise my birthday with cake and birthday song. Thank you so much. It make me happy and impressed.

I cannot rate this attraction too highly - would like to give it 10 stars! I didn’t really know what was involved in this experience as I booked it as part of a package but was very nervous when my moped driver told me to hang on tight and zoomed off into the chaotic traffic of Saigon. After about 5 minutes, I started to relax (ie. let my vice-like grip of the driver go) and held on to the pillion bar instead!
Visited 5 venues for a variety of drinks, food and music, all carefully explained by our vivacious guide Vi. It was our last evening in Vietnam and I leave with the happiest of memories - the smell of exhaust fumes and the music of Brian Hyland (Sealed with a kiss) which was played at the folk venue, ringing in my ears.
Huge thanks to Bao Tuyen, my driver, who did an expert job. Don’t leave Saigon before trying this evening adventure!

I was so impressed with my first tour with Vespa Adventures in Hoi An a week earlier that I decided to do it again, this time with the team in Ho Chi Minh with a Mekong Day Trip.
And again, another amazing adventure was had.
A rider picks you up from your hotel and whisks you to Vespa Adventures HQ, where you wait for the other guests to arrive.
From there, we were taken to the outskirts of HCM to see how the locals live.
We stopped off for a drink by the riverside, crossed on a barge, went to a market, ate local produce amongst the locals (delicious), tried our hand at making incense sticks and visited a temple.
We finished off with a delicious meal at a restaurant on the outskirts of the city.
So many sights, smells, sounds and experiences you wouldn't be able to discover by yourself. They do it incredibly well.
I dare say this won't be my last dealing with the team at Vespa Adventures.
As with Tu in Hoi An the week prior, our guide Ms Na was funny, warm, inclusive and knowledgable and is an asset to the Vespa Adventures family.
Thankyou also to my rider Ty for continuing to check in with me during the journey.

We had the most incredible time on our after dark Vespa tour in Saigon. The tour provides a great opportunity to have a taste of Vietnam life, and be apart of the craziness on the road. Never once felt unsafe, the drivers are wonderful. Stop offs were equally wonderful, great food and great music venues with our fabulous guide Vy. Highly recommend doing this tour!

There is a reason there are 6 million scooters in Saigon. This is the only way to see The city. It’s great fun, the staff are terrific, the quality of guide is good and it is perfectly safe so even if you’ve never been on the back of a scooter never mind ridden one, just do it!

This should be a mandatory experience for all tourists visiting Saigon! It was a fantastic night out and we are so glad we booked this on the advice of our travel operator.

A couple of food and drink stops followed by an acoustic cafe and a rock venue - hilarious and excellent fun. Lucky enough to be in a group with two other like minded couples and thoroughly enjoyed the experience.

The best bit was weaving through the Saigon traffic where there appear to be no rules...red I go, amber I go, green I go....simples!

Well worth the time and the money, highly recommended. Would not hesitate to book another excursion with them next time we are in Saigon.

We thoroughly enjoyed our after dark vespa food tour. Our guide Nicole was fun and my vespa driver was super. The food choices at each restaurant were varied and very tasty. Nicole went above and beyond getting a cake for our anniversary when we were enjoying music at a bar. Given the crazy traffic in Saigon this is the best way to really get a sense of the city.

We took this tour a few hours after arriving in HCM, to get a look at the city! We were collected promptly, 18.30, and whisked off to a central meeting point. Here, we met our group, 6 per group it seemed. Each group sat together and travelled together, I think there was about 4-5 that night.

We were given plenty of drinks - cocktails, beers, smoothies, juices, water, and toilets were good on the trip. The food was superb, it started with nachos, then glorious seafood, followed by V pancakes and spring rolls. Ice cream for dessert!

We were also brought to an open mike night with locals for about 30 mins and a rocknroll bar to finish the evening!

It was absolutely worth every penny! The drivers were great, helping with helmets and face masks! My friend’s driver got lost at one stage, which was unfortunate as she was terrified, but we believe that to be a one-off as he was new!

review_title: Immense fun - everyone from 19-56 had a blast
review_text: We joined the night tour and thoroughly enjoyed every element of the evening. Dodging the traffic on the back of the bikes was mind blowing and best done after a gin or two! The bike riders were lovely, Fy our guide really good fun and the food interesting and different. We ended the evening in a bar where we witnessed brilliant musicians and everyone had the best night. It has to be done!!!

We went on the daytime tour with Orange as our guide and had a great time. My driver (sorry can't spell her name but short dark hair and a sleeve tattoo) was so lovely - always checking to see if I was comfortable.
The ride itself was exhilarating and great fun - plus we got to see some really interesting places. Orange was the perfect host - well informed and entertaining. Lunch (delicious) and refreshments are all included in the price so it was really good value. Would thoroughly recommend!

review_title: What an amazing way to see Saigon
review_text: This was sooooo fun and my grown up kids loved it! It’s such a great way to see the city, experience local food and experiences off the beaten track including an excellent visit at the end to a bar with live music. The traffic is hair raising but the skill of the drivers totally prevents you from getting scared and they are such nice young guys. Full of fun and nothing is too much trouble. Make sure you don’t eat too much before you go as the food at all the venues is delicious and we could not eat it all!

The reviews are all true, great nights entertainment. A must do in Ho chi Min.
We were travelling as a party of 16 for a 60th Birthday party, our queue of orange Vespas were awaiting out the front of the hotel on time. We all choose a driver, once our helmets are on and masks (optional) we set off into the thralling mass of mopeds which is Ho chi Min, our first stop is for refreshments, and learning some Vietnamese chants for Cheers,
we are all very relaxed with our drivers, the second stop is to a seafood restaurant on the street in sector 4, amazing seafood, delicious soft shell crab, Clams in lemon grass, divine oysters, scallops and finally frogs legs, all washed down with Vietnamese beer or wine or soft drinks of your choice. our 3rd stop was to a restaurant for pancakes, delicious as well, every stop we are met by a genuinely friendly host.
Our 4th stop was for a respectful form off singing, in a small venue, great voices and they also sang happy birthday and provided a large cake, our final stop was to a night club / bar, yet again was great fun, we are all couriered on the back of our vespas to our hotel. We went to places and areas of Ho Chi Min we would not have gone to if it wasn't for our vespa tour. Thank you for a lovely evening.

review_title: Embrace your fears and Do It!!
review_text: OMG the traffic is Saigon is horrendous, particularly as a pedestrian, so the thought of being amongst it on a Vespa was daunting. However our party of 20 haven't had so much fun in ages and it's a great way to see a huge part of the city and its lights at night. We started in peak hours traffic and went to 3 bars / restaurants, then to a private coffee house with a live band playing romantic music, and finally onto a heavy metal joint called Legends I think. By the end of the night the traffic was greatly reduced so it was lovely to see the city at a different pace and from another perspective. Cost of all food and alcoholic drinks was covered in the charge and they were very generous with their servings and offerings.

review_title: Best way to really get to know Saigon
review_text:
We did this tour with our 2 teenagers and it was really nice. Now we can definitely say that we know Saigon, their culture and way of living. The scooter drives are very professional and even being in the middle of an absolutely crazy traffic you feel quite safe. Our guide, Sunny was the best we could hope for, shes super friendly, with a huge knowledge about the historical facts and as her name says, she was absolutely bright and happy all the time.
Great tour.
Renata, London

This vespa tour was highly recommended by a friend. This was probably the best experience my friend and I had in Hanoi.

We booked the morning tour. Together with Tuan and his team, we explored various sites (and tasted some local’s delights) in Hanoi, we probably couldn’t have visited on our own. The riders were professional and experience, they occasionally pointed us to other Hanoi’s popular sites - we were safe in their hands.

We finished off the ride at a local’s home where we got to taste the local’s amazing Bun Ca. Then, we were sent back to our hotel.

Beside a nice ride on the Vespa, this tour was interesting and very insightful, which we knew a little better of Hanoi and its history after the tour. Thank you Vespa Adventures, Tuan and your friendly team! Keep on riding!

This is a brilliant night out in Saigon. Our vespa riders and guide called Tri were brilliant and looked after our every need including dietary requirements and one dodgy stomach! We saw and experienced some great venues ending the evening in a coffee house and bar. Super from start to finish. Nicole and Philip.
This is an amazingly great experience. Don’t allow being on the back of a Vespa rattle you. My 75 year old Mum loved it! One of my favourite memories of Vietnam.

What a fantastic night
Our group of 18 ( including 4 who travelled by car) had a brilliant night being driven from restaurants to bars through the crazy HCM traffic
Great street food and a terrific atmosphere supported by happy and enthusiastic staff
This trip is a must for anyone visiting HCM
The best and most memorable experience! Really good drivers in a crazy city. Our tour guide was so much fun. We had great food and the live music was excellent. We didn’t want the night to end!

Well organised, good food and pretty much unlimited drink. Bars were fun. Real highlight was trying not to squeal as you approached the next chaotic road junction and miraculously popping out the other side unscathed.

review_title: So much fun it is to ride on a two man Vespa sleigh! Hey!
review_text:
After seeing a band of orange vespas ride past us during the day we decided to look them up and as we had a free night in Ho Chi Minh - decided to book the craft beer tour - for that night! Lucky for us there were still spaces available, and it was all booked over the phone in 5 mins.
Our rides arrived at exactly 5:30pm to pick up us, and they guys were professional and fun. They offered to take pics and tried to ride as together as much as possible.
The tour included 4 craft breweries, tastings at each and tapas food to pair with the beer.
When the website says to arrive with an empty stomach - LISTEN!! Literally have never been so uncomfortable ever until that night when we got back to the hotel...i was full to the brim with good beer and good food.
Never would have expected a craft beer scene in Vietnam, but they don't do a bad job! I ended up buying a 6 pack along the way I was so taken with one of the beers...2 of that 6 even made it back to Australia with me ;)
The host was great fun, and even though there were only 4 of us on the tour, she did her best to keep the conversation and laughs flowing. Although - after the first stop the beer took over with the conversation and she was probably wishing for some peace and quiet.
And it was a nice experience to see some of HCMC after dark - zooming around just taking it all in was definitely a good palette cleanser between pubs.
Superb food along the way (chocolate brownies and beer!? who would have thought!!), excellent beer (and so much of it!), brilliant host, some wicked photo opportunities and travelling on the back of a vespa door to door to/from your hotel.
Just book it already!

As part of work conference in Vietnam, I went for the Vespa Roving adventure with some colleagues. It was initially scary but really safe riding in the peak traffic with experienced Vespa drivers. The local food and service were excellent! Highly recommended!

review_title: Excellent tour of Saigon at night!
review_text: This tour was well worth the money! Saigon After Dark was so much fun, riding through the streets with a trusty Vespa driver, actually in the scooter chaos experienced from a bus or on the street. We stopped at several restaurants for food and drinks and I had to remember that I needed to be able to stay on the back of the Vespa! This was an excellent way to see the city at night when it comes to sparkling, noisy, and vibrating life! We enjoyed it so much, we did it again in Siem Reap.

This was a very interesting and enjoyable trip. We did the Glimpse of the Mekong tour and were collected promptly from our hotel and driven on the vespa to the cafe in the centre of town. This was a bit hairy to begin with as it was rush hour but it also really gives you a feel for what it's likes for millions of Vietnamese every morning. Miggy was our guide and she was great, explaining everything in good English. The food on the tour is very good, too. 'Glimpse' of the Mekong is the right name as you really do just get to glimpse the river, but the value of the tour lies in the opportunity to really get off the tourist trail and experience the down to earth reality of Vietnamese life. The vespa riders were excellent and although it is a bit hairy at times, it always felt safe and was mostly just exciting.
Thanks again to Miggy and the two riders.

Great experience. Worthwhile doing in SGN. Places that locals would go to ...

Some of the places we would not have known.

review_title: Saigon after dark tour was soo much fun!
review_text: We booked the Saigon after dark dining and drinking tour and every part of it was soo much fun! The vespa ride in the chaotic Ho Chi Minh traffic, the food, the drinks, the music bar, and also our guide Thien that was really funny and helpful, everything was amazing! It was absolutely worth it! Thank you very much and I strongly recommend it if you want to enjoy a night out in the city!

Was in two minds whether to do this tour in Saigon or not and am SO GLAD we did it! We had the most brilliant time with our guide Linh and our fabulous (and very safe) Vespa drivers. It brought to life the streets we had walked by day to be whizzing past as part of the stream of traffic. The food on our many stops was great and we even tried 'jumping chicken' (frog) which was cooked deliciously, but at all places there was a veggie or meat alternative, so nothing you had to do. The icing on the cake was the 2 fab music stops, so contrasting and both hugely enjoyable.
Didn't think we'd be head banging to an AC/DC Phillipino band in Saigon, but was glad we did. A truly fun and memorable experience. Thanks Vespa.

After 3 days in Saigon dealing with traffic that is beyond hectic I was reluctant to participate in this half day city tour on the back of a Vespa. Fortunately my husband encouraged me to give it a try and WOW it was fabulous. At first blood pressure medication was working overtime but I just hung on tight and trusted the driver and so enjoyed seeing the sights - flower market, having coffee with the locals in a pretty park with singing birds, observing the Buddhist Monk shrine and the very sobering War Museum. Also lunch was included and was extremely tasty. The beer went down well too. Our guide Hung “Orange” was very friendly and knowledgeable and our drivers Hoi & Teo T were just amazing. We are over 60 and would highly recommend this “ride of my life”. Sue & John

Joined this with three older children. Not sure what to expect, especially with the traffic, but we all felt completely safe and had the best fun on the Vespas. All the drivers were very careful and dodging through the traffic was a great laugh.

Our hostess for the evening, Jenny, was just so helpful and dedicated to making sure that we had a great time, as were all our drivers, impossible to fault any of them, They were all great.

The two restaurants that we visited were good, though not exceptional by local standards, although we were a bit surprised that all the groups from the company seemed to go to the same places and we all arrived and left at the same time as there seemed to be a schedule.

Overall, we had the best time and would not have missed this.
Vespa adventure is an amazing and very enjoyable way to discover the country vietnam and a tour which is fun to have

Hi there we had a fabulous night tour with hung. HUNG was very well mannered and spoke excellent English.. he made the tour personable and we felt very spoilt at all spots I highly recommend this tour and this guide it was the highlight of our Vietnam and Cambodia experience. Good on you hung from Dean

Brilliant evening tour an experience in itself being on the back of a Vespa amongst millions of Vespas driving round Ho Chi Minh. Great street food good bars fantastic drivers . Certainly worth doing.

This tour was really awesome! I wasn't expecting much - just a city tour via Vespa, but it was so much more. We went to cool restaurants on the tour - bring any empty stomach bc there is a lot of food and it's all great! Hung was my tour guide and he was awesome. Taking the time to discuss history, culture, and share his experiences of life in Vietnam and Saigon. I really enjoyed this tour and would do it again!
I was excellent, our hostess was amazing, the food very interesting and tasty, our drivers excellent.
Fantastic fun. Great value for money nothing was a problem at all. Guides speak good English. We even took our 6 year old with my husband.
Was a fantastic evening, so may sights to see, good beer and great food. Our guide Sunny was excellent. Would highly recommend.

A brilliant experience. Safe riders very friendly. So much food and drink and the guide had good knowledge of food allergies. We were lucky enough to have Tri as our guide for the evening and he was excellent. A great way to see Saigon by night and the perfect way to try Vietnamese foods. Live music in 2 of the venues rounded the evening off. Don't eat too much before you go as you certainly get plenty of food.

My wife was very nervous of riding pillion with a driver she did not know, but Thanh guide quickly put her at ease.

My rider was Thanh new who was competent and a skilled rider.

We visited the harbour, a couple making mats and a farm house and must add that Thanh our guide was very knowledgeable and really enjoyed his job. He wanted to explain everything and welcomed questions, even when we stopped at the coffee house.

We both felt that the ride was over too soon and if we had, had more time we certainly would have taken another trip.

Both riders are a credit to their company and we were relaxed and happy for them to take us as their pillion passengers.

We would not have any hesitation in recommending them to other travellers.

Great tour, keep up the good work. We give them 10 out of 10.

review_title: Absolutely brilliant and safe, best night of holiday
review_text:
4 of us went on this evening food tour.
My wife is a bit uncertain about "motorbikes" but even she had a totally brilliant evening.
The traffic is chaotic but the drivers were always safe and thoughtful.
Each (4) food stop was reserved, well researched and served lovely food. Alcohol was limitless and this definitely helped make the evening go with a swing.
We ended at two music bars, a solo singer with piano followed by a rock evening at a crowded bar. Both were excellent.
safe driver; nice range of restaurants to visit and the live music at the end was fun. A great evening out with some excellent company with the others on the tour
It was great fun and one of the highlights of our holiday.We felt safe and secure despite challenging traffic conditions.
What a blast!! Four hours bar hopping on the streets of Saigon by motor scooters. The evening was perfect weather and great group fun.

Ok, so Saigon is crowded, the traffic congested and we were wary of the scooters. But we got brave and joined the Vespa Adventures Saigon Street food adventure and WOW what a lot of fun. Each person is paired with a Vespa (antique) driver and in turn small touring groups (6-8 per) are formed. As a small group you visit the "meet and greet" and then 4 absolutely fun stops (2 street food style restaurants, a quiet bar and a noisy bar). Adult beverages are provided along the way. Every stop was very fun and enjoyable. We were paired with 2 other couples and together we had "a heck of a time." The evening is scheduled to go from 6:00 to 10:00 but at 10:30 or so we were barely making it back to the hotel. We would highly recommend this unique and fun way to see Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) and enjoy the food and the people.

I hardly knew what to expect with this tour. Watching all the traffic on bikes made me somewhat apprehensive. However, this was among my most enjoyable experiences in Vietnam. My driver Sam was courteous, careful and hospitable and took away any fears I might have had. I loved the stops at various restaurants and the charm and warm spirit of our guide. The food was excellent, the music was wonderful and I would do this again in a heartbeat, whether in HCMC or any of Vespa Adventures' other locations. I would say this is a must do.

From beginning at pick-up at our hotel to the end drop off at hotel it was a fantastic experience not to be missed. It was great fun to see Ho Chi min City by night and experience different foods at street food restaurants. Our guide was the best.

review_title: Great way to see Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
review_text: We were met at our hotel by local Vespa drivers, who took us to our first of 6 stops where we were met by a very gregarious host. It was a progressive dinner that took us to all parts of town, riding like the locals do. The food was excellent, the host was welcoming and spoke very good English. I felt very safe with my driver and had an extremely memorable evening.

review_title: Best thing we did in HCMC - worth every penny
review_text:
We did this on our last night in HCMC, where we were beginning our Vietnamese honeymoon. At first we thought it was a little pricey, but we were so glad we went for it.
Our guide, Ai, was great from the outset and made the whole thing really good fun, helping the group mingle and relax.
The food was all stunning and there was SO much of it.
While the streets of HCMC/Saigon look daunting, the experienced riders never made you feel unsafe, and there really is no other way to see the city.
If I recommend one thing to do during a short stay in Saigon, it's this!

review_title: Fantastic fun - a great way any to explore the city
review_text: We were collected from our hotel by our two drivers and taken to a meeting point where another two couples joined us. After a short briefing on the tour, We set off for the first restaurant. The food there was good and they included deep fried frogs legs! The second place had some more rtaditi9nal dishes such as fresh spring rolls and pancakes. We then went to a music bar (different singers doing their turn) followed by a. Latino bar which was a bit different and rather fun. The drivers are very careful but you do still get the experience which you see as a pedestrian - sitting at the lights in swarms of other bikes and cutting across a wall of oncoming traffic! All in all, well worth doing.

We had an evening ‘foody experience’ on our Vespa tour and it was fantastic! A real insight into the local area, the traditional food and so much fun! Our drivers were fantastic! We had such fun with them!! A huge thanks to TU, Tom, Thy, Garlic, Chu Son, Duc for a great experience!!
Amazing view of city from the back of a vintage vespa stopping at numerous establishments for food and drinks.

My husband and I had a morning tour with Thien. His English was perfect and he had a wonderful sense of humor. We visited a park where retired men brought their birds, like they were their children. Our guide had photos of the birds, so we could pick out different types. We also visited the famous site where a monk made the ultimate sacrifice and set himself on fire to oppose the Chinese who wanted Buddhists to give up their religion in the 60s. He had all the photos that were taken by a journalist at the time, which added to our understanding of this story. I walked back to get on the scooter with my sweet driver, Hung, who was the age of my grandson. As he put my helmet on my head he saw the tears in my eyes and said “it’s very emotional, isn’t it? I managed to choke out, “yes.” He put his hand on my shoulder and said “You are a very nice woman.” That meant so much to me. We are still telling friends about how great this tour was! Do not hesitate!

review_title: Amazing chance to sightsee in Vietnam!
review_text: Can't say enough how professional and amazing this experience was! We didn't have to think about anything and were taken around to some amazing sights while in Ho Chi Minh. Plus! It was just an amazing experience to get to ride around with expert drivers in the lovable madness of all of those vespas and scooters in the city! Highly recommended!

We had a great day riding with our Vespa guides. It was a great way to get out of the busy town and to be able to interact with the locals and to experience what there every day lives are like. The people were so very warm and friendly! The countryside was amazing. Our guides were very knowledgeable and entertaining. We had Ben (quite the comedian) as our lead guide and Tom, Duc and Nhan as our drivers. We always felt we were in good hands even in some of the crazy traffic! I would highly recommend this experience! Worth the time and money!

From not being on a motorbike for decades to a Vespa ride in Saigon was a major experience. Full marks to the sensitivity and good driving of the Vespa Adventures drivers. The personalised experience was really great.

review_title: Must try one time at HCM city
review_text: What a great tour! Their choice of places to eat was - the food and environment was so typically Vietnamese, varied and interesting. Honestly this trip made our short stay in Ho Chi Minh City one to remember. My driver (Kyle) was fantastic and very friendly with great knowledge and stories of his own. Thanks alot Vespa Adventures.

Certainly one of our highlights during a two week stay in Vietnam. Phan was an amazing host, not just knowledgeable of the City itself but also a great sense of humor too. Arranging a birthday cake and having the three piece band singing happy birthday was most touching and certainly unforgettable!!!
Brilliant experience punctuated by visits to a bar, restaurant and nightclub. Staff and drivers friendly and knowledgeable.

Wasn't sure what to expect but it was a great evening with really friendly drivers and guide. The ride felt safe and visiting the food places gave the evening great variety. The guide really cared about the quality of the experience and everything worked like clockwork.

review_title: You can’t buckle up for this ride of your life.
review_text:
This sort of insanity is one of those things you tell your kids not to do. There maybe 30000 accidents a year a 40 deaths on the road in HCMC but you’re convinced you’re stats immune.

This is fantastic fun. Weave, wiggle, sprint and survive the rush. Meet with like minded optimists and set off on the street food city-wide drive. After a drink at Zoom head to multiple eating locations. Stop at a curious cafe where fine if earnest singers perform. The last stop at ‘Woodstock ‘ is best for the now well-
seasoned quasi deaf nostalgist with an interest in 60’s through 80’s rock. Several drinks might help here.

At the end of it remember not to send videos of your narrow escapes with death to anyone who sells you medical or life assurance.

Just brilliant.
Loved it, loved it & loved it. It was the best way to see everything & have so much fun at the same time. I would highly recommend this.

review_title: One of the best things we did in Vietnam !
review_text:
We did the tour in Saigon, at night and it was great fun. We were a bit apprehensive at first, given the traffic is manic but the Vespa drivers were really safe and so we soon relaxed.
Our guide was so enthusiastic and knowledgeable about everything and her English was very good too- all of which made the evening perfect.
The food was also excellent - (unlike a street food tour we did in Hanoi with a different company). The pancakes were a highlight and the seafood we had was excellent and really different. We also felt as if we were eating with the locals as they didn't have loads of people on the tour at the same place at the same time. The guide was always anxious to ensure we had the amount of food and drinks we wanted too.
The music venues were interesting (!) and again good fun.
We are so glad we did this and would highly recommend it.
Great way of seeing the city of Saigon! Had a great time with the drivers and tour guide. Would definitely recommend Vespa Adventures!

We loved our trip on the backs of two Vespas. Drivers were excellent and our guide was smart and generous with her time. Food was wonderful, too, and so was the hour we spent at the night club with the three cabaret singers.

Loved our Vespa Adventure - Troy our guide was very helpful and made our experience fun - the drivers of the scooters made us feel very safe and were very competent - the food tasting was amazing and loved the little coffee shop with music and then finished at a cool bar for a cocktail listening to a band - would recommend this experience as it is a exhilarating way of seeing the city, thank you, Rachel and Matthew Forgham
A real hoot. Immersion at its most fun. Looked like a geek in my orange helmet but didn't care as part of the great Saigon river of motorbikes.
As I said that night it was a bucket list item I didn’t know was a bucket list item. Recommend it to everyone

review_title: The best night you can have in Saigon
review_text: If you're visiting Ho Chi Minh City then place the Vespa Adventure at the very top of your list of things to do, go on the night time tour and you won't be disappointed, awesome!

I'll start this review by saying that I don't eat sea food . . . something about the texture, smell taste, doesn't work for me. However, I had a great time all around and my tour guide (Miley) was really awesome for attempting to accommodate my picky eating. Thank GOD these guys know how to drive around town because otherwise it'd be pretty scary. I'd highly recommend the experience to everyone!

review_title: Loads of fun - good food - great value
review_text: When you get to Saigon you will see the traffic and think / really I’m going to get on a scooter in that! Well we did and it’s such great fun. We visited some street food venues with plenty of good food on offer (all included) free beer and music - go its great their drivers know what they are doing and it’s safer that trying to cross the road. Enjoy

Nice music, great staff that answer all questions in good English.
Half price when you’re early.
Cool down there!

review_title: Exciting and best way to view vietnam
review_text:
