Had the most enjoyable time doing the Countryside and Islands Explorer Tour via Vespa. Sinh was the best tour guide you could hope for very funny, informative and spoke very good english. The rest of the team Tamz, Dao and Hao were amazing too very safe and experienced riders who took the upmost care to make sure the group were happy and well looked after.

The tour covered a boat building site, coffee roasting, noodle and cracker making, matt weaving and many sights of how the locals live which was very eye opening but informative. Was the best day out and being on the back of a vespa was exhilarating. It feels very safe and fun!!

I would HIGHLY recommend this tour for anyone. Even for the faint hearted being on the back of the bike is the best feeling!!

We would def rate this experience as a 10/10

Mel and Liz ;)

review_title: Great way to tour Siem Reap
review_text: My wife and I spent 2 days in Siem Reap, viewing many many temples. The first tour we had a standard tour guide and that was fun but the 2nd day we went with the Vespa Adventures and loved it. Our guide (David) knew his stuff, spoke very intelligible English, and had a wonderful sense of humor. Our 2 drivers were very helpful and did a great drive. They took us to all the big places but knew how we could avoid the crowds (as you will find, the large temples are very crowded), which gates to enter with fewer tourists. We were treated to an excellent lunch, all the drinks we wanted, and one of the drivers was also a photographer and got lots of good photos. It was definitely a great way to see things!

We did a night tour and it was an absolute blast, really enjoyed it. The tour guide and drivers looked very well after us. Seeing the city at night from the back of a scooter was refreshingly exhilarating, navigating the traffic would be a no-no for most of us, so driving through the city was an adventure in itself. The meals at various points was different yet delicious and the music stops beautiful and entertaining. We recommend this tour as a must-do when visiting Ho Chi Minh city.
Had a fantastic tour of Saigon districts guided by Khang and driver Nhat. Very knowledgeable and interesting tour. Easy safe riding with Nhat, Thank you, look forward to next time.
Fantastic tour in the more out of the way places. Tour guide Ben is a great host and driver Sang was both enjoyable to be around and knowledgeable of the local area. Definitely worth doing.

We had a top day out with the guys from vespa adventures ben ,sa,son,sang,hao and chinew took us all over the country side and sealed the deal with a brilliant feed and a couple of coldies.We had a top day seeing culture tradition and a comedy act (our guide was hilarious ) highly recommend the experience the bikes were comfortable the staff all spoke good english made the day easy would definitely try again
Exhilarating, great fun, and hugely enjoyable. We went on the After Dark tour and enjoyed plenty of food and drink as well as seeing city sights on the back of a vespa

We had a great day tour with our guide Khang. Very knowledgeable guide who spoke excellent English and was able to answer all our questions! Our scooter drivers were very good at navigating the streets and while initially we were quite scared, it wasn’t long before we relaxed and enjoyed ourselves! (So much so that we booked a “Saigon after dark” tour also!)

Do it. You won’t regret it. :)

What a fantastic tour taking in 4 craft beer bars
Collected by your Vespa driver from your hotel we were taken to Cafe Zoom to meet our guides for the evening Katty and Vy who were both great and made the evening so enjoyable
Whisked through the street of Saigon on the back of a Vespa 🛵 to each bar where we sampled at least 4 beers + food
A great laugh with good knowledge from Katty and Vy
Would recommend this trip to anyone and make sure you are hungry and very thirsty !

review_title: Vespa tour in Hoi-An was highlight of our Vietnam Trip
review_text: Our initial trepidations about a Vespa tour in the Hoi-An countryside were quickly dispelled by our charming and humorous drivers, Onion and Tom. They really showed us the Vietnam that we had hoped to see. Driving on small back roads--and even through some alleyways--we saw how most of the Vietnamese live and work. We stopped at a number of villages and visited the homes and workplaces of the folks who make rice crackers, hand-made mulberry paper, woven mats, rice wine and more. We would never have gotten the same feel for the country had we not gone on this adventure. We highly recommend this activity--it was the highlight of our visit to Vietnam.

Words can’t express just how good this Vespa tour is! It was possibly the highlight of our trip to Vietnam! The drivers were so skilled and Tien our guide was incredibly enthusiastic! He made it all so interesting. We ate and drank at great places and got a feel for how the locals socialise . We were out for around 4 1/2 hours and every minute was exhilarating. Honestly, you just have to do it!!

Had the best time in Saigon hopping through 4 of the best micro-brewery bars all in night on the back seat of a Vespa scooter. Also made a short stop in front of the Cathedral for some photo shoot.

Well worth the money on this 4-5hr bar hopping with lots of different types of beer and accompanying bar foods. Oanh was the perfect tour guide. Thanks....

review_title: A Night in Ho Ching Ming City!
review_text: We took a "Vespa Adventure's Saigon Night Tour". It was part a street food adventure and part Saigon nightlife the way locals do that included jazz and old fashion rock and roll. It was a three-hour evening adventure trying a variety of food and drinks at 3 local restaurants. Lots of fun. We sat on the back of the Vespa's while experienced drivers took us across the city on very busy streets filled with thousands of motor bikes. It was one of those once in a life time experiences.

Fun tour. We liked our guide. He was fun but we found some of his information on historical events were incorrect . Perhaps he didn't know and just wanted to give us an answer? Four hours is almost too long in the pollution and heat of the city but we did see some excellent sights that I didn't think we'd see on our own (flower market to name just one) I'd recommend only seeing the sights you really want to see. Lunch at the zoom cafe was excellent.
Lots of fun, great food, good sightseeing and very professional service. I can't wait to try another one of their tours.
Wonderful trip on the back of vintage Vespas to Craft Beer bars and breweries. Expertly guided and piloted with a great range of beer and food matches.

review_title: Insiders View of Saigon on a Vespa
review_text:
With no prior experience of riding a motorbike we were picked up on time by our Vespa drivers & taken to our meeting & briefing point - a cheeky little cafe where the World pass you by. The traffic in Saigon is manic but the Vespa drivers were brilliant at negotiating vehicles coming from all directions.
The Vespa ride was thrilling coupled with an informative & cultural morning. Complimentary pictures were given to all, with further soft copies available to download
The tour finished off back at the cafe with lunch. Thoroughly recommend The Insider's Saigon Tour with Vespa Adventures. Haven't laughed so much in ages.

The drivers, guides, food and whole experience was the best! I would highly recommend this experience. Many people have said it was the highlight of their holiday - my husband and I were in Vietnam and Cambodia for 3 weeks and had many, many different experiences BUT this was definitely a massive highlight!!!!

What an excellent night. whizzing through the traffic to local eating venues, eating the traditional Vietnamese dishes, ending up at 2 very different, enjoyable music venues and with a drink at each place visited, marvelous.

A great night out! It was so much fun being a part of the crazy Saigon-by-night traffic and discovering the city’s neighbourhoods and local restaurants. We tasted their specialities, met other travellers and spent time with the friendly drivers and guide. We learnt a little about the local culture and visited nightspots that we probably would never have found otherwise. I can thoroughly recommend it for anyone of any age out for a good time!

review_title: Best way to see HCMC at night
review_text: Fabulous guide, driver and food. Felt perfectly safe and saw far more of the city than using other means of transport. Would highly recommend!

I had been worried about doing a tour of such a busy city on the back of a Vespa but I needn't have worried at all. Our drivers Bill and Joe were such considerate and careful drivers they made us feel very safe and at ease. Bhin our guide was very friendly and happy to share tell us all about Ho Chi Min whilst showing us around. We had such amazing food and saw much more of the city than we would otherwise have done. Thank you so very much to Bhin, Bill and Joe it's trip we will never forget.
It was an amazing experience in Hanoi. The guides were attentive and the food was so good! We have had a great experience with Vespa Tours.

review_title: One of my best holiday nights out ever
review_text: Don't hesitate to have this experience. I felt perfectly safe and had one of he best times ever. Food and drink all a very good experience.

review_title: Amazing tour through Saigon at night
review_text: On the Vespa back seat through Saigon - the friendly Vespa drivers steer you through infernal motorbike traffic to cocktail and dinner places. Very good and refreshing kitchen with sea food, nice place in China town - then a place with lyrical and strong chansons and by the end the hammer disco
Great evening, eateries I never would have chosen by myself, but good food and fun times at the nightclubs. A different and very fun thing to do!!!

review_title: An exciting ride around a busy city
review_text: We had a great time being zipped around HCMC on these motorbikes. They took us to clubs and bars we probably never would have seen otherwise.
Fantastic way to spend our one night in HCMC. The fun, the food, the friendliness of the drivers, unbeatable experience 😁

Great guides, great food, great experience. A must do when in Ho Chi Minh. Would have never experienced the food/places we went to if it wasn't for the insider knowledge of my guide! Very safe Drivers too.

Booked on a Vespa adventures tour after a friend and Lonely planet recommended it. Great experience and worth every penny. The best part wasn’t the food funnily enough but the live music venues, the cuckoo nest and acoustic. We had Oanh as our guide and she was super friendly and fun to hang out with. My bike driver Viet was fantastic as well. The riding around in the Vespa is so much fun! Was a great insight into life in Saigon, riding through the different districts and seeing the world fly past. Highly recommend this tour and it’s fine if you are a solo traveler as you will meet some fun people on the tour.

We took the Night Foodie tour with teenage kids. Night was great with good mix for kids and adults. Had a minor mechanical issue with one vespa - but no problem the mechanic was on it and fixed things up and within 10 minutes we were off and running again. The night was so good, we decided to book the Glimpse of the Mekong another day and it was great as well. Would recommend both. The drivers and host go well out of their way to make sure everyone of all ages is looked after.

review_title: Absolutely brilliant, what a way to see the city
review_text:
My husband and I decided on this tour as part of our package and what an excellent choice we made.

We left our hotel at 18.00 with a group of around 24 people, 12 bikes. What a wonderful way to see the city at night and to experience sights, sounds and food we wouldn’t normally see, hear or eat.

Our guide Na was very informative, giving us information on varying aspects of Vietnam, it’s cukture, history and people.

What an experience, one that I would never have thought would prompt me to write this..

review_title: An excellent Adventure and not bad food
review_text: 26 people with Vespas & drivers. A wonderful night out, with pretty good food, beers, music, and a side of Saigon we would not have seen otherwise. I would do it again as would my wife. Not appropriate for very young children, but fine for anyone who can get on the back of a Vespa and enjoy.

review_title: Best way to see Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Such a great experience! The drivers and our tour guide were friendly and made us feel so comfortable. We saw all the main sites and got told about the history of HCM. We were served a delicious lunch. Highly recommend a tour with this company. The Vespas were so much fun! Thank you so much :)

review_title: A Great Way to Spend A Night in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
Many Americans might think it is insane to ride around on Vespas in Ho Chi Minh City. However, the people in this city actually know how to make it work, and the drivers of Vespa Adventures do too.

We did the night tour. First, it was incredibly convenient since they picked us up at the hotel. You hop on the back of a Vespa ( after putting on a helmet) and off you go. We did our tour at the end of Tet, so the light displays all over the city were beautiful. The other advantage to the night tour is it is much cooler.

We met our adorable guide, Jenny, at Zoom Cafe. After a snack, drinks and a brief introduction, we were off. Our first stop was a seafood restaurant, then Vietnamese Pancakes, a Coffee House and finally, a rock and roll club. We originally thought we would cut the tour short because 4 hours seemed long, but we actually went a bit longer than 4 hours.

If you are a picky eater, or don't like fish, this might not be the best tour for you. However, if you are up for sampling Vietnamese food, you won't leave hungry.

Our friends were celebrating their anniversary. At the coffee house, they were presented with a beautiful personalized cake. What a nice touch by our guide.

If you have a night free in Ho Chi Minh City, you really should do this tour. It's a great way to feel the pulse of the city at night.

review_title: Hai Van Pass from Hoi An - Hue
review_text: With much uncertainty about the trip due to rain about we set off from our accommodation to get organised for the trip. From the start our senior guide onion was a quick witted and intelligent guide. Neil at their office was very receptive and kind and due to the rain bought us breakfast and coffees, thanks Neil. Although the weather hindered some good scenic opportunities the tour was great fun and we stopped regularly for photos and too stretch your legs. Lunch was a good mixture of seafood and throughout the day it was like being with old friends. Definitely the way to travel through Hai Van pass and certainly an educational and fun day.
Very good way for discovering the city of Saigon with a fantastic guide. My favorite places : bird lovers park and flower market.

We were tired from a full day of activities and thought we might cut our evening Vespa tour a little short. The objective of the tour is to introduce visitors to food and entertainment popular to the locals. Oh boy!!!! I’m so glad we did not – we had so much fun!!! Our drivers, two university students, got us outfitted with helmets and we hopped on board. They expertly drove the Vespa’s through the busy city traffic. We went from district one to district five, from one side of the city to the other!
Our Vespa drivers and our guide, Miggy, took us to two restaurants where we sampled Vietnamese fare. We had tasted deep-fried chili seasoned crabs, oysters, clams, squids, octopus, and frog legs. It was all fresh and magnificently wonderful.
Miggy was a delight. After feeding us well, Miggy and the guys took us to two separate bars that feature live music. The first showcased talented singers who performed three or four songs or ballads (some in English). After their short set, they introduced the next performer and then moved on to repeat the show at multiple venues throughout the evening. The second bar we visited was rocking. FUN! Oh my, the collection of performers was fantastic! While we certainly could have stayed out later, the excursion ended at 10:30 pm.
I highly recommend this delightful excursion! Do not miss this exhilarating, delicious, entertaining evening.

review_title: Saigon After Dark - First Vespa tour at the young age of 71 years!
review_text: We completed the Saigon after Dark Vespa tour on 13/02/2018 and enjoyed every second. For our first night in Saigon it was a thrilling experience to be on the back of Vespa zooming through this buzzing city tasting a variety of delicious Vietnamese dishes. Our tour guide Oanh was outstanding with her knowledge, fluent English and her fun loving personality. For my Mum at 71 years of age this was her first time on the back of a Vespa but she felt safe and confident with her female driver Lén. We had a fantastic time with our group - a night packed with yummy food, plenty of beer and lots of laughter!

review_title: Best thing we did in HCMC
review_text: Thoroughly enjoyed the evening food tour, best way to see HCMC and the beautiful New Year lights. The itinerary is thoughtful and authentic, not too touristy. The delivery is polished and the guides are enthusiastic and sincere and work really hard to ensure everything is thought of. We were lucky to have Danny, who made us feel so welcome it felt like having dinner with a friend. We really enjoyed being able to ask him questions about life in HCMC. Don't miss this tour!

review_title: Saigon craft beer tour - do it!
review_text: Our Vespa craft beer tour was fabulous, lots of fun, very informative and the team were consummate professionals. Our drivers and our host were great and the whole system of organising your beer and food at each bar was seamless. And - zooming through the crazy Saigon traffic on the back of a Vespa was lots of fun. Very highly recommended!!
It was a brilliant evening! Can highly recommend it, but make sure you are hungry before you go! We felt totally safe on the back of the Vespas and the atmosphere of the whole evening was fantastic.
Great idea. Great Trip. Great Beer. ...the food tastings/pairings at some of the locations werent particulary interesting.....

review_title: No better way to experience Saigon
review_text: The funnest thing we did in Saigon hands down. Awesome staff with great local knowledge. Really felt like we were getting an underground experience that any normal tour would not offer. If there is one thing you decide to do as a tour in Saigon, this is it! Enjoy!
Amazing experience with great staff. Surprisingly relaxing, and you get to eat fresh delicious food.
It was good to see crossing the road from the vehicle perspective. We had a chance to go places I would not have seen otherwise. Lunch, included, st the Vespa cafe was also good.

Have to admit; I tried to get my friends to cancel but no go. SOO glad they wouldn't. Tons of fun for a motorcycle hating 60 year old scardy cat! LOVED IT!!!! We were three 60 year old couples and all loved it!

A wonderful whacky wild adventure through the crazy traffic, experiencing the sights and smells of tiny backstreets, sampling street food in unlikely places and ending up at Woodstock a wonderful bar with live rock music. We loved it! The best thing we did in Saigon

One of the best parts of our holiday - I was terrified and we launched out onto a busy roundabout in central Saigon to restaurants and music bars we would never have visited - ate well and were well looked after by our guide and drivers. As a first time traveller on a Vespa the driver made me feel safe and we had lots of laughs along the way! Highly recommended!
I thought it was very good you got the feel for the place.my biker was very good.would rekon made you do it.
Definite highlight of our trip, would recommend this, great and age drivers, great guide and great food experiences 😊

Had a short stay in Saigon and wanted an fun way to see the city - this tour didn't disappoint. Scooter drivers are top notch - I felt very safe. The food and sights were excellent. If you're looking for someone to point out the points of interest and tell you about them, this isn't the tour for you. But if you like adventure and seeing some off-the beaten path areas/eating some local foods - this is for you!

We really enjoyed our vespa adventure! We were 5 and we really had a lot of fun. It gave us the opportunity to feel the city with its colors and tastes, being part of it and not only watching from distance. Thanks to all the staff!
Drivers were excellent.......tour guide meeting us at the restaurants was a joy. Food was very good and many different food items to choose from. All very fresh and tasty.

We did three tours in all. The countryside tour in Siem Reap , Cambodia, the Saigon at night tour and then finally the Hoi An countryside tour. The two countryside tours were fantastic ways to get to see part of the countryside that is still undeveloped and meet locals. Fabulous experiences. Then the Saigon at night was brilliant fun weaving in and out of the manic traffic and visiting different street food restaurants and two amazing bars. We ended up listening to a Vietnamese heavy metal band playing Metallica then following that with a heavy metal Abba medley - surreal.

Fantastic! My husband has two Harley motorcycles at home so he is used to riding, but we were not going to do this because of the crazy traffic. We were with eleven other people from a tour group, and they talked us into it. We are so glad that they did. It was so much fun and one of the highlights of our trip.

review_title: Most fun I had in HCMC
review_text: Our guide was great- she really was entertaining and easy to get along with. Full of information too. Te eateries were top notch- I was big into researching top pho places etc etc but never wouldve stumbled on these places. Local favorites and the food was incredible.

Visiting Ho Chi Ming City and you have to put aside 4-hrs to ride Vespa’s through streets of Saigon.

Safe and one of the most exhilarating things we’ve done. Experienced life and aspects of Saigon that you’d never really get to see.

Plenty of food and drink provided too.
Our main guide was Pham Hung who ensured we were all catered for and enjoying every aspect of the tour.

This was so much fun! Yes, it is scary and in the beginning I had to look down and hold on tight when crossing intersections, but then you started to relax and enjoy. Our drivers really did a good job and drove us through busy markets, China Town, we visited a pagoda, temple and herbal shop. Our guide Thien was very informative and the half day on the vespa was the perfect way to discover more of Ho Chi Min City. Highly recommend Vespa Adventures to young and old.

What can I say? Our riders were Small and An. Our tour guide was called Son/David. They were all fantastic! We had so much fun with them. They were knowledgeable, friendly and we felt very safe on the back of their mopeds. I would definitely recommend this trip and if you are lucky enough to have these guys on your tour, you're in for a treat!!
Go with an open mind to the eateries and embrace the Vietnamese culture.

The Vespa pillion passenger ride around Saigon was great fun to do, Our guide Hung spoke good English and had a good knowledge of the places we visited. Our favorite spot was the flower market mainly due to getting among the local people going about their daily business. The riders were great and we felt completely safe with them. The tour ends with a nice lunch.

Vespa's Saigon After Dark Foodie tour was among the highlights of our travels and experiences in Vietnam. Loved every minute of it - great host/guide Oanh and we had the best drivers. Vespa adventures is the only way to really experience Saigon's amazing neighborhoods, diverse food and amazing entertainment in this beautiful, dynamic city.

Driving with the Vespas through the dense traffic in the evening hours of Saigon was an experience we enjoyed a lot! The food was really good and we felt perfectly safe with our drivers (one's name is Ngoc, the other we unfortunately do not remember) and our guide Anthony (Thien). They took us to restaurants and a bar where we could hardly see other tourists, felt very authentic!
Thanks for making this night unforgettable!!

review_title: Great way to visit Hoi An and Ho Chi Minh City.
review_text: We booked our first tour in Hoi An Rural villages experience and because we were extremely positive we also booked the Glimpse of the Mekong in Ho Chi Minh. The drivers picked us up at our hotel perfectly on time and together with the tour guide we went to non touristic places where we could discover real Vietnamese life & food. He told us things about daily life we ​​would otherwise never had discovered. Excellent English and even a bit of Dutch in Hoi An. Really a great experience!

We had so much fun! I'm not going to lie it's a bit freaky being on the back of the scooter in the chaos but that's part of the fun and after a couple of drinks it's ok. It was raining but it was great we had so much fun. Would definitely definitely recommend this tour.
Our family of 4 rode for the day (one person, one driver per moto) and had a blast! Saw markets, shrines and temples we wouldn't have seen otherwise. One of the highlights of our trip for sure!

No better way to experience Ho Chi Min life than to hop on the back of a scooter! Yes it was crazy, scary but so much fun! I checked with our insurance company b4 we left Home and yes we were as we weren't driving. We were met by our drivers, taken to our meet our guide and fellow group members. We had a great night of wonderful food, company and adventure. We eat where the locals eat and yes you do eat things you wouldn't eat at home. But that is part of the adventure. What I loved about this tour was the added places we went to watch locals sing and a local bar. We had a blast and thought it was such a great way to start our holiday. Yes it is on the expensive side but so worth it. For what we ate and experienced 10/10. Thank you to our guides and drivers who keep us safe. Highly recommend!

Booked the insider's Saigon tour and what an amazing experience it was. Although the driver's must have nerves of steel to drive round Saigon I have to say we had the utmost trust in our drivers Nhi and Hoi and felt completely safe. Khang was a brilliant tour guide with masses of local knowledge. The team were friendly and efficient and made the experience what it was, amazing. It is a brilliant way to see Saigon and we saw lots of things and learn so much about Vietnam's history. We had coffee and drinks during the tour and finished off the with a meal and drinks at cafe zoom (all included in the price) I can highly recommend.
Anne and Ian

You know that feeling you have when crossing a Saigon Street, the one where you feel like you’re playing Frogger? This is from the other side! You see several restaurants and bars at night as you wind through the city in the back of a classic Vespa!

A thrilling night time veiw of beautiful Saigon. A ride of a lifetime on the back of a scooter driven by a virtuoso. Knee to knee scooters taking me and others to rendevous where we sampled delicious local fare. Finally ending at a coveted night spot for great music, dancing, some drinks and rousing fun. All of this coordinated and orchestrated by Vi Thien, she gets my award.

Ben was my guide and he was really nice and helpful, He knows about his city and, If you want, can show you the good places!
I think their prices, though, are too expensive regarding the living standard. But that's another story.... ;)

review_title: Great way to discover the City in a few hours
review_text:
We were only transiting in Saigon and just had the day to spend there.
Vespa Adventures was actually the perfect way to get a glimpse of the City in just a few hours.
Different tours are proposed, and we had no choice to take the afternoon one.
Morning hour might be better since it includes the birds market

Drivers are great, so secure and friendly, and you just ride along the Saigon streets like all locals...

Highly recommend the Vespa night tour. We felt very safe with the drivers and our guide. The food and music venues they chose were fabulous. Would do this tour again here or in one of their other locations.

You must do the night ride with Vespa adventures. It's just about the most white knuckle ride I've ever had, but what a blast. You ride pillion all over the city stopping at various places to try food and drink. The city is infested with scooter riders and they have their own jungle law, which you become part of for a couple of hours. Don't miss your chance.

It really was the ride of our lives on the night when all the two-wheelers in Saigon were out celebrating the Under-23's semi-final victory over Qatar. The streets were grid-locked but our guide Thien and his wonderful drivers got us to all our super food, drink and music venues. Probably the highlight of our trip to Vietnam.
Great way to visit the top sights of Saigon on vintage Vespas. Very professional and knowledgeable guides who went out of their way to help.

We did the craft beer tour on Wednesday night with Kitkat and the boys, cannot speak highly enough of the knowledge, professionalism and overall enjoyment !!!! If you enjoy craft beer this tour is absolutely a must do !!!!!

review_title: The BEST Way to Visit Angkor Wat!!
review_text:
On a recent trip to Siem Reap, my husband and I booked a private "Our Angkor" tour with Vespa Adventures, and it turned out the be the best choice we could possibly have made for seeing the temples. Our guides, Chhay and Sovanna, were fantastic and so professional! Pick up from our hotel was right on time, and it was clear from the beginning that our safety was their highest priority. Once we were fit for our helmets and each presented with a traditional Khmer scarf as a gift, we were off on our vespas. What a thrill to be a part of the organized chaos of the streets of Siem Reap, and to zip through the jungle and countryside as well!

Chhay made sure we got to the front of the line at the Angkor ticket center, and the vespas allowed us to access backroads and gain unparalleled access to all the major temples. Where other sightseers were doing a lot of walking and waiting, we were getting right to the most amazing views and experiences that Siem Reap has to offer! Not only was Chhay incredibly informative and personable, it also turns out he is a very talented amateur portrait photographer. To our surprise and delight, our exploration of Angkor Wat was captured on film in a way that was simply stunning!! Despite all the crowds, Chhay managed to take picture after picture of us where we were the only people in the shot, and he knew all the best places for us to get unique and special photos that will treasured memories forever.

We saw so many amazing sights in one action packed day, never feeling rushed but just exhilarated and grateful for our Vespa Adventure and all it had to offer! For the most efficient, authentic, and privileged access to Angkor Wat and all the other temples, I cannot recommend this company highly enough. Throw in some of the most amazing pictures we could imagine in one of the most wondrous places on earth, and this is hands down the only way to experience Siem Reap! Thank you Chhay, Sovanna, and Jake for one of the best days we have ever had while traveling!!

We (my husband and I) had avoided scooter tours until our last day in the country. We had been told that they were dangerous. However it is quite apparent that the best way to get round Saigon (and Hanoi) is scooter. I never felt in danger. They were really good careful drivers. In 4 hours we saw parts of Saigon we would never have seen any other way. For the previous 3 days we had had a guide and a driver and had spent hours in total in traffic jams. We were met at our hotel by 2 Vespas and drivers (Long and Vu), equipped with helmets. They drove really well. We were subsequently met by a guide ( Nguyen) on a 3rd scooter. Her English was excellent and she was really knowledgeable. We stopped lots of times (flower market, China Town, opera house, herbal medicine shop, a temple, a pagoda, view of the city, ...) and walked for a little each time . It was great. I highly recommend it.

We had a fantastic time. All went perfectly organised from booking, pick up and drop off at our hotel. Most locations and stops certainly of the beaten track so unlikely we would have gone there by our self. Highly recommended.

review_title: Best time with a memorable experience
review_text: I took my friend for her first time in HCMC to this tour. It was a amazing night when Melanie and I enjoy a crowded vibe of Saigon. My friend had a chance to try street food such as seafood, banh xeo, goi cuon and so on, but her favorite belongs to Vietnamese pancakes as well as mine. Not only tasting delicious food, but also we were taken to different places which were so typically Vietnamese. Plus, we made new interesting friends in our group. Especially, the girl full of energetic, knowledge and sense of humor named Jaden, she was our tour guide however during the trip, she gave us the feeling which we have known her for a long time, like there is no distance between us. We had so much fun and enjoyed every minute with this fantastic adventure. Highly recommended you to Vespa when you visit HCM city.

review_title: Highlight of our SE Asia trip!
review_text: This is an amazing way to see Saigon whatever time of day or trip you choose. But we did an evening street food tour which was beyond brilliant! Five of us each had a classic vespa with driver and we rode pillion. It rained, but they had waterproofs for us. The made a series of inspired stops, and different street cafes for different types of food and drinks; cocktails and dips, seafood, pancakes, a bar with live music, and our guide Tien met us at each one. He was fantastic! He's really bright, entertaining and speaks great English. We went back to the hotel after an amazing evening among the local people of Saigon, with lovely photos of each of us on the Vespa with Tien. On top of all this they'd planned around the severe food allergies of one of our sons. Amazing! You MUSt do this.

There were four of us on this trip. The two ladies were dubious about it having seen the way traffic goes around Ho Chi Min City, but what a blast it was. Even the most nervous of them was whooping and videoing after the first stop at Zoom Cafe. This really is a must for travellers, a great way to see the city, eat out amongst the locals and have a night to remember.

review_title: Fun way to experience the traffic in Ho Chi Minh!
review_text: We were collected from our hotel by our Vespa guides and taken to our start point where we met our lovely guide who met us at each stop, explained procedures and made sure we had enough to eat and drink. I had alerted them in advance of my garlic intolerance and “ no red meat” so that aspect was catered for. However although we were told that we could drink as much as we wanted there was only beer available at a couple of stops and I don’t drink beer! No matter as it didn’t spoil my enjoyment of our adventure through the manic traffic. I always felt safe and loved the visit to the speakeasy and the rock music bar- despite my advancing years! It’s great for all ages. My only real criticism is that I sometimes felt a little rushed- but there was a schedule to keep!

Our group of 4 each had a vespa and an experienced driver thru the streets of Saigon to sample street food, a coffee house with wonderful singers and a crowded night club with a 9 piece band. Our leader, Ruby, funny, engaging and openly shared her culture. This 4 hour adventure was worth every penny...tons of delicious food and drinks. I was a bit nervous having walked the street with lots of motor bikes, but never felt unsafe on this ride ( we all wore helmets).

review_title: Wish I could give Ten Stars.
review_text:
This was a fantastic night we were driven expertly around taken to amazing places to eat and try different food none of which we would have found on our own.
Can not recommend this highly enough it was the ride of our life.

review_title: A Safe, Thrilling and Exciting evening!
review_text: Having seen and walked through millions of scooters on the streets of Ho Chi Minh city, I figured there was zero chance I would do this adventure! However, once I got on, I felt totally safe, I relaxed, and enjoyed a very very fun evening. We would our way thru busy streets, back roads, and basically eat our way through the city. So tasty and fun, strongly recommend.

review_title: Must do in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: What a great tour! Their choice of places to eat was fabulous - the food and environment was so typically Vietnamese, varied and interesting. The guide and bike drivers were friendly and informative. What a fun evening!

I spent a long time researching which tour to take as an intro to the city and finally decided on this one — and it was a great decision. Tri was a fantastic tour guide with great knowledge of the city and its history. He was engaging and easy to understand and had a lot to share. His family perspective is also very compelling and relevant. My favorite part is that this wasn’t just a tour of the main tourist attractions, even though you do see the post office and reunification palace and all that. On the morning tour, you get to start by having a delicious cold coffee at the local bird market where retirees bring their birds and you can sit and listen to them all sing. You then visit everything from the flower markets in District 10, to the temples and pagodas in District 5, to the views of the city from District 2. And going everywhere on the back of a Vespa gives you a great local perspective on transportation in the city without ever feeling unsafe.
One of most fun family activities we have ever done! Highly encourage families to do this in Saigon!

This was a great way to see the city by night and sample some of the more local food, drink and experiences. The guide was great fun and the drivers really knew what they were doing. All in all a terrific night out..

Honestly this trip made our short stay in Ho Chi Minh City one to remember. Our guide Na was fantastic and very friendly with great knowledge and stories of her own. Our drivers were all very friendly and professional while navigating the crazy streets of the city and out into the beautiful countryside.
Each of the stops we made was great, we really learnt a lot about the way of life out and around the Mekong Delta as well trying some fantastic, fresh and vibrant food along the way!
Thanks so much guys, we loved it!

review_title: Great experience in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Fantastic experience in Ho Chi Ming. Great way to leave the city. Our tour guide (Mily) was absolutely overwhelming with the a positive energy and enthusiasm put on the trip turning even more a great experience

review_title: cool Vespa tour of Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Perfectly organized, the locations were exceptional, the food was delicious, the drivers well trained. It was great fun-anytime again!

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip!
review_text: We had a group of five for the Vespa Saigon after Dark tour. It was absolutely one of the best activities we did on our 3 week Thailand/Vietnam trip. It was so much fun and they took us to some really cool local food and entertainment places that we would not have found otherwise. We would definitely book this again.
We had a blast. The drivers were safe, the guide was great and the food was amazing! I'd recommend to anyone who wants to get a real feel for the local night life.

We did a Saigon by Night tour and loved every minute of it. Our guide, Sunny, was fun, friendly and informative. She made everyone feel welcome and was very knowledgeable about the food and it’s origins.

When walking in HCMC the traffic seems chaotic but once on the scooters and amongst the traffic it seemed much more organised. Our drivers Duong 1 and M. Phuong, were excellent and we felt very safe and all times. They also pointed out landmarks.

Was fantastic to go to local restaurants and hangouts that we would never have found on our own.

Highly highly recommend this tour!
excellent tour at night to visit saigon and enjoy Saigon food!!!! Too bad we could not stay longer in the apartment with different singers, players,....

My mother and her friends visited Vietnam.. Vespa tours looked after them so well!! 100% Satisfied! The drivers treated them so well, just as if they were their own parents. No rushing but lots of fun. Best tour ever. My mum loved it. Thank you Vespa tours...

Saigon After Dark - Tour 6:30pm – 10:30pm A foodie night out on the town was a complete highlight of our two week trip across Vietnam and Cambodia.

This is a must for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh. We booked the tour for our first evening (which happened to be NYE).

We were picked up from our hotel on time and taken on scooters to our first destination where we met our guide NA who was fantastic providing us with advice on Vietnam and showing us how to eat all of the local dishes. Every stop was different and showed a different side of the city plus riding around on the back of a scooter is great fun and after the first 10mins felt perfectly safe.

I would highly recommend this tour and will definitely recommend Vespa Adventures, our guide and drivers. Thank you for a fantastic evening!

Was very disappointed with the Mekong Delta tour. Our guide Thien was great and tried his best to answer all our questions and be informative, however the tour should really cost half the price of what it is. The riders are unable to speak English so they can't answer any questions, we got told we were going on a ferry ride and obviously thought this would be a nice relaxing trip when in reality, it was a 30 second trip to the opposite side of the river while we stayed on our vespas. The description of this tour given on their website is very exaggerated! Don't be fooled.
The food was very average and the few places we stopped were for a very short period of time. A lot of time was wasted at cafes and restaurants and the few attractions we did see were not educational in any way or related to the Mekong Delta.
The name of their tour “glimpse of the Mekong” is very accurate as that was all we recognized. A 30 second glimpse on the short, misleading ferry ride.
Would not recommend this tour to anyone.

We went on the Saigon craft beer tour and it was amazing, our lovely guide Oahn has good English and knowledge of Saigon and was fun to spend time with. Our drivers Hain and An are amazing navigators through the mad Saigon traffic, we never felt unsafe and they were fun to be with.
We went to four different venues got good explanations about the different beers and the food.
It was our last night in Vietnam and it was the best way to say goodbye to a wonderfull country. Highly recommended!

Brilliant service, hotel pickup up, warm up cocktails, super trip around the city, lovely food. Not street food but well chosen local restaurants you'd never find yourself including a lovely jazz bar. Do it! Also hot a photo print out at the end of the evening and emailed shots from throughout the night

Effective and friendly staff. Very good service. We booked a custom made trip spontaneously and it took only 30 min for them to fix it. Lovely guide and good drivers. Rained a liter just after we took off but it made it even more fun.

review_title: The best way to discover a City
review_text:
Great way to discover a new city from a genuine local perspective.
Fantastic and extremely cordial staff.
Recommendation: do not drive yourself if you are not used to unfair roads.

Expensive excursion. But it was a great experience. Driving in Saigon traffic is insane. Lots of food and drink if u want. My family all had a ball. One of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. Highly recommended.

My husband and I had a great time whizzing around Ho Chi Minh City., eating wonderful local food in non-touristy places. Our Vespa drivers were terrific navigators and very understanding of our initial fear, which we got over very quickly! (One tip: close your eyes when going through an intersection). Our guide was fun and informative and the different venues for food and music were fantastic. We highly recommend this; it's a great way to experience Ho Chi Minh City at night.

Fun, thrill, and unique place with great food, music and drinks. Best guidance by our guide Sunny.
An absolute must - Don't miss it !!!

review_title: Amazing time amongst the real Saigon
review_text: We had an amazing time discovering hidden places of Saigon, and great local restaurants where we could really enjoy what seemed to be the real life of the Vietnamese. We circled the city on Vespas which is an absolute must when in Vietnam. The evening was very well organized and we had a lot of fun. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone coming to Saigon.
Very cool trip to see the villages, markets and life on the country side! Good food and pro drivers!

It took some convincing to get my traveling companions to agree to the tour but they were glad they did. There was a bit of everything, some adrenaline (OMG), great food and great music. Our guide was great, as were all our guides on tour in Vietnam. Highly recommended.
Great way to experience saigon at night. Great drivers, fabulous guide and great food&drinks. THE BEST

Loved this tour, third time we've done a Vespa Asventure tour. Great way to take family to see and experience real Saigon.
Tour guide was fun and didn't ramble on too much for the younger kids, so was great. Only suggestion is to ask people prior to the tour if they'd like all the food for the local seafood surprise (frog), although very common in Vietnamese culture, very uncommon for Western kids. All in all, highly recommend this company!

A colleague and I did the tour as way of seeing around Ho Chi Minh City by night and it didn't disappoint. From the initial greeting and 'get to know you' phase, through to the variety of food outlets visited in various parts of the city, the evening was huge fun and excellent value. I would easily recommend this to anyone visiting Vietnam.

This is a must-do if you're in Ho Chi Minh City! There was a variety of food and drinks, and all of it was awesome! The hosts and drivers were so friendly and so kind. At first, riding the vespa was a little scary... but after the first ride, it was so much fun! The crew takes pictures throughout the whole experience, so you don't have to worry about it. We had to catch an early flight the next morning, so we chose to skip the last venue ... the drivers took us back to our hotel with no problems. I will definitely do this again!!!

I had an excellent rider, skillful and knowledgeable, which added so much value to an entire tour that was very well organized. And what else could be more quintessentially Vietnamese than being on a two-wheeler on the roads of Saigon?
I only need one word to describe Vespa Adventures in Ho Chi Minh - Wonderful! And I only need to two words of advice for anyone thinking of doing it - Book now! You won't be disappointed!

We loved our vespa + foodie ride through the streets of HCMC/Saigon! The drivers were all professional, courteous and safe. After being harried pedestrians in the streets of Saigon which are frenetic and crazy, it actually felt liberating being part of the vespa traffic and made the best few days of traffic more manageable. Also they took us to some great, local street food places which we loved.

review_title: An experience not to be missed
review_text:
It was an amazing tour especially for me and my partner who never rode on a bike. The minute I climbed on the Vespa my smile broadened and never disappeared. Being a passenger on a bike in the chaotic city of Saigon is so much fun rather than scary as I thought it was going to be. It is not just the ride but the street food we tasted with the locals was incredibly delicious, from spring rolls to oysters to sea snails and much more. We were also taken to two local bars both with live music (singing in both Vietnamese and English)

Not to mention our lovely guide Lora and all the drivers who made our experience even better.

And as the Vietnamese say Mot Hai Ba Zoooooooooo!!!

review_title: The BEST way to see Ho Chi Minh!
review_text: A friend recommended a Vespa Adventures tour to me saying it was one of the favorite things she's done on any trip anywhere. And I have to say that I agree! Being on the back of a Vespa gives you an entirely different perspective on the city that was truly eye-opening. My driver and guide from Vespa Adventures were both great! The tour itself which was at night where we went to three restaurants and two bars (each with music) was really fun, well organized and with a lot of great food. Our guide meets us at every stop, ate with us and made sure we had everything we needed! This is a DON'T MISS activity in Vietnam. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

Based on rave reviews from friends who recently took this tour, we signed up. We loved it! The places we experienced we never would have found. Our guide, Sunny, and drivers were wonderful. Very professional, and excellent in navigating the Friday night traffic in Saigon. Highly recommend this!

review_title: Perfect way to discover Saigon by night
review_text: Super chill and easy way to discover the city and the Saigon way of life. The drivers are super careful with us.

review_title: Fantadtic excursion to see, taste and feel Saigon.
review_text: This was a very exciting and enjoyable tour. Our hostess (Linh) was really good. It is certainly a nerve-wracking experience in a Vespa through many streets at night but well worth it. Good food, drinks and music in various settings. Highly recommended!👍

review_title: A top 10 activity on our two week tour of Vietnam
review_text: What fun! The tour was among the top 10 fun things our family did during our two week exploration of Vietnam. The tour guide and all our motorbike drivers were fantastic. Everybody was friendly and engaging. The scenery was fantastic, the food was delicious, and the conversations were super interesting. The Vespa group came to our hotel, picked us up, and there were seven of us, and took us to the Vespa Bar where we got the official download on what to expect from the evening's adventure while sipping on cool Bia Saigon. Then it was off to the races. We zoomed down main thoroughfares and puttered along crowded side streets, weaving in and out of the traffic and making several stops along the way for delicious street food and great stories. Riding a motorbike through Saigon really puts you in-touch with the heartbeat of the city. Highly recommended.
Highlight of our trip to Vietnam, traffic was the best bit!!! Enjoyed every second !!!!our guide was fantastic, her name was Na , would recommend it !!!

Our guide and my driver were excellent. It was a very enjoyable tour! Initially, I was apprehensive about him navigating the traffic; however, once I had confidence (which was quickly achieved) in the driver, I was fine with the quick moves to get about in the heavy traffic.

A brilliantly designed tour that takes you to real restaurants eating authentic cuisine. The drivers were excellent and at no time did I feel unsafe in their capable hands, merely exhilarated by the experience. We took our 6 year old son on the bike with one of us and he adored it too. The two music venues were brilliant and we wanted to stay longer but our parental responsibilities kicked in! The guide spoke excellent English and met us at each location before we got there. Only one thing to add, come very hungry as there is LOTS to eat. This was the absolute highlight of our 17 day trip to Vietnam.

My travel agent recommended this activity in Ho Chi Minh City and was not sure what to expect , crazy traffic etc , but being inside the traffic with the Vespa and driver was an eye opener , thrilling and fun . Thanks to my driver and guide for a great time. I will do it again next time

Cannot recommend this company highly enough.
The guide was extremely knowledgable, professional and friendly with excellent English.
The drivers were safe, experienced and courteous.
I have visited Vietnam 6 times as I have friends who live there and have traveled extensively throughout the country. Although I have ridden my own bike around Vietnam, it was a delight to actually sit back, relax and enjoy the experience. The tour took us to places that I would never have seen on my own and gave us a fascinating insight into the history and culture of an amazing city.
Brilliant way to see the city and get a safe biking experience.

We had an absolute blast on this tour. We met our guide and drivers and felt completely at ease. Cruising through the chaos of HCM City on a very warm evening was so much fun. The tour was so well organized, the restaurants provided excellent food, service and drinks. We also enjoyed the local entertainment.
This tour was one of our highlights in Vietnam. Loved it

Wow what a night. Loved everything we did. We had a super friendly guide who planned the whole night with precise timing. She ensured everyone in our group was looked after, even when I asked for a vodka drink I was given the whole bottle! Needless to say I couldn't drink it all as I was a bit unsure of the craziness of all the bikes and traffic but my skillful Vespa driver navigated the inch by inch road space with ease and I helped him on the back with my excellent back seat driving!
Excellent food and organization. Would totally recommend to anyone!!

review_title: Vespa Adentures in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh)
review_text: What a fantastic way to get to see this beautiful city at night. The tour was extremely well organized. The people were very professional and we enjoyed getting to know the culture of the city.

My own private Vespa driver (polite, sweet, informative) around the crazy streets of Ho Chi Minh city at night? YES. A guide who was funny, smart, interesting, and fun to hang out with? Also YES. We were picked up from our hotel and zipped in an adventurous ride to five entertaining locations to sample tasty local food, drinks, and music. It was filling, but exhilarating. I would do it again; would have done it again the next day.

(OK, the chips and salsa at the Pizza Hut meeting place do not count as local, but was definitely entertaining. It was only the meeting place after all.)

review_title: Great fun great food and drink
review_text:
Recommend to all, goodnorganisation great venues for and drinking
Good riders good safety equipment
Nice to have free photos and easy download

review_title: Vespa Adventures, after dark, Ho Chi Minh
review_text: This is an excellent trip and provides a really great experience. Good company, good food & drinks and nice music venues. The tour was very professionally arranged and conducted. It was one of the main highlights of my visit and will definitely do it again.

review_title: Best evening activity of our holiday!
review_text: Great drivers, safe Vespas, brilliant food-all good. Great experience. Highly recommended - book it!!

review_title: A must if you visit Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: It was without doubt they best 4 hours on a motorbike I have ever had. The drivers were fantastic and very safe, the 4 hour trip around Ho Chi Minh City at night was a blast. The food and drink and sights never stopped it was so much fun.
We had a great evening. Our hostess went out of her way to make sure we were happy. There was an abundance of food and plenty of drinks to go around!

review_title: Do yourself a favor and book this
review_text: We did this the first night we arrived in Saigon . It was Christmas Eve. Was a wonderful night to spend Christmas Eve. Plenty of food and drink. Felt very safe on the Vespa bikes. Would not hesitate to book again

I can't say enough positive things about this company. My friend and I did the 4hr afternoon Vespa tour and it was the best experience we had the entire time we were in HCM. The drivers picked is up on time and transported us to a great little diner where we had a tasty & filling lunch (inclusive of the price) we got to know our guide, who was friendly & knowledgeable and away we went! The drivers were so caring & thoughtful; my driver was always checking that I was ok and pointing out interesting sights to me. We saw so many different aspects of HCM from the flower markets, to Chinatown to the reunification palace; the tour really gave you an insight into Vietnamese culture. I really appreciate how well it was organized and the experience of whizzing around on the back of a Vespa was just exhilarating! I feel safe and comfortable at all times - the drivers are clearly very experienced. With lunch included and transport to and from the hotel, everything from start to finish was just amazing. I can honestly say it was one of the best experiences I've ever had and I can't wait to try this company again when I'm next in this neck of the woods.

This experience was one of the highlights of our recent trip to Vietnam As anyone who has been to Ho Chi Minh City knows the traffic is completely bonkers but we were soon put at ease by the four fantastic drivers who were assigned to our party. We all rode pillion behind our driver and soon relaxed. The food was truly a real taste of Vietnam and it's people.The Company describes this trip as the "Ride of your Life" and it exceeded all expectations Thanks so much Vespa Adventures!

Dean Geddes
Inverness

review_title: Best Excursion I have ever done!
review_text:
We didn’t really know what to expect - but we had so much fun on this adventure. Our host Ms Chang was FANTASTIC! She made sure we had a wonderful time. We were put together with several other people from different groups and everyone was a lot of fun! We loved that everywhere we went there was a table waiting for us and drinks at the ready. Chang was an incredible host! We would never have gone to any of the restaurants or bars if we hadn’t gone on this tour. Everywhere we went we felt like we experienced the culture and had a very authentic experience. The food was good, the drinks were flowing and the entrainment was fantastic! Be prepared for the crazy motorbike travel - but I felt extremely safe with our drivers. Chang even made sure that the piano bar singers sang a song for us celebrating our honeymoon!!

Honestly, this was beyond all of our expectations.

review_title: After Dark Tour a wild ride!!
review_text: Our group of 6 had a wild time last night with Nicole and our drivers. It was exhilarating ride through the big and small streets knowing you had a driver with years of experience navigating the chaos. The food was amazing! Nicole was funny and informative and the 2 music venues were fabulous. The organization was impressive. The evening ran like a well oiled machine. Kudos to the owner and staff for such a successful operation. Last night will be remembered forever!

review_title: Best way to see Ho Chi Minh City!!!
review_text:
This was truly a treat! We had a wonderful night. :-D

Delicious authentic Vietnamese cuisine.
Thank you for a wonderful experience!

review_title: A must do when you are in Vietnam
review_text: At first, we were quite scared to go on this adventure, having experienced Saigon traffic for 2 days. There was no need. The bikers and tour guide was friendly and informative. The food and entertainment was excellent. Highly recommended!

With an ounce of trepidation, we mounted our hosts Vespas and began our journey in the wildly chaotic traffic snarls of Ho Chi Minh City. Not for the feint hearted. This tour truly gives you a first-hand experience of the daily traffic grind for the locals. We visited a wholesale flower market, stopped for a tea in China town and finally dinner at an outdoor BBQ, sampling authentic local fare. The hosts were very friendly, informative and engaging. A Vespa tour of HCMC is a must.

The night tour was awesome!! I’d do another tour with this company again for sure. Everything was five stars! Guide and driver were very professional. We ate, drank and saw a lot of Saigon. I highly recommend this tour!

Make sure when you ask for branded drinks they all push you towards the cheapest by the tour guide . All of a rush from one place to the next. Might as well have been in a coach with 56 other people. Not the expected experience I had hoped and paid for.

So everything about this tour was fantastic, except I am sad to say our tour leader. It felt that she was very much just going through the motions, she openly stated that she didn't like beer which would have been fine if she had still shown some enthusiasm. that said the craft beer seen is great in Saigon, the vespa's, locations, food and beer on this tour were great. Highly recommend this tour but i hope you get a better guide.

Vespa Adventures were recommended by a local friend in Saigon. They are a very professional outfit - who have been doing this for 10 years. There are now many other cheaper tours available - but we thought the half day was definitely worth the $75 pp.
Punctual, efficient, excellent drivers and Thien was a very good guide: interesting, knowledgeable and superb English. They packed a huge amount into the half day. Good to do at the start of your visit to get a taste of this amazing city.

After my experience yesterday at Cu Che Tunnels with a less experienced guide - it proves that if pay less don't expect a top service !

News Years Eve 2017 we took part in a Vespa Adventure trip around Ho Chi Minh city. What a fantastic experience and brilliant way to see the city by night and dodge all the other motorcyclists, food and drink stops were such a wonderful experience. What a fantastic evening, thank you to everyone who organizes and takes safe care of us the tourists. Not once did we feel apprehensive or worried.
Anne and Brent

review_title: Great way to see the Ho Chi Minh
review_text: We had a great tour with Tuen as our guide. It was fun with lots of sights we would have never seen on our own. I would highly recommend it for everyone going to Ho Chi Minh. Go early in your trip so you can use it to plan what you want too see in greater detail.

The best ride and tour which i had it was very enjoyable you also get to interact with people from different group and get the taste of enjoying different kind of food in vietnam especialy the NGEU HAP THAI this was my favorite.The Scooter drivers are very well Trained so this is definately a must to do when you are in saigon

My husband and I recently took the Vespa Night Tour in Ho Chi Minh city and enjoyed the experience thoroughly. We weren't sure what to expect, but our travel agent recommended this and we had a great time tasting local fare, and seeing the night lights of the city. Our tour guide, Chang, was wonderful. She looked after us well and made sure we all were having a good time. Our drivers, who we rode behind, were very sweet too and kept us very safe. The only thing that was slightly disappointing was that their 'unlimited drinks' - is mostly non- alcoholic beverages and beer. The Vespa cafe had cocktails and the last bar had them too. We ate at two other restaurants, one offered only beer and soft drinks and the other had only non-alcoholic beverages. As a white wine drinker, I was out of luck in most places. The total experience was well worth it.

review_title: An evening out with a difference!
review_text: We did this just before Christmas with our children (aged 16-23) We had the most FANTASTIC evening, and cannot recommend it more highly. It was exciting, fun, and delicious. You are taken on a culinary trip to lots of small local restaurants and coffee shops. It was a brilliant evening and a must if you go to Ho Chin Min

Great way to get around the city, see some of the sights and try food you'd probably miss. Our guide, Sunny, added to the experience, educates us in a few Vietnamese customs and explained how to assemble/eat some of the dishes eaten along the way.
The experience of riding through the chaotic traffic was an event in itself.
Well worth the money.

review_title: A must-do in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: We loved our tour with VA, it was such a great way to have a look around the city and get our bearings on our first morning. We felt safe at all times and the bikes were very comfortable. Our guide Sunny was a delight. Worth every cent.
Did a foodie tour on vespa motor bikes. Felt quite safe and well looked after. Must admit the pollution in some narrow streets makes the eyes water.
Great adventure this morning. Visited bird park, flower market plus many more. Guide Thien was great as were the drivers. A good morning for 2 gray nomads from Forster NSW

review_title: Overcome your fear of Saigon street crossing
review_text: Highly recommended on your first evening in Saigon. This is suitable for virtually anyone, even senior citizens. You quickly learn how this city operates as there are millions of scooters. You begin to understand how traffic flows without rancor, cursing or overly aggressive driving. The food is varied and far too much to eat in an evening. In sum, a great way to learn about how regular folks live there. It was one of the highlights of a 2 week stay.
Brilliant one of the best things I have done on a holiday. Felt very safe. Do it early to appreciate the city food people and how the traffic works!!! Chang was excellent

Most enjoyable experience . After having to dodge the traffic in HCM all day as pedestrians , it's great to be on the other side of the fence! On the bikes and flowing with the traffic.

The Vespas are comfortable and the Drivers/riders are excellent. Everyone of us felt really safe on the rides.

Our host/ guide who met us at every stop is Understanding and he did a fantastic job introducing us to the food culture and explaining Vietnamese social practices.

The drink stops are nice too. Enough food and drinks for the night. But the highlight is still the Vespa ride and the professionalism of our Drivers.

review_title: Taste Of The Mekong - An Alternative Perspective On HCMC
review_text:
We have done this tour twice now, once in 2013 and once yesterday. We decided to do the tour again as we enjoyed it so much the first time! While the tour name was the same we were pleased that this time we took a different route and saw different things - offering a truly different perspective from the 'usual' tours of HCMC.
After being picked up from the hotel we had a brief stop at Zoom Cafe and then the tour began! Along small roads, over bridges - even a ferry! Along the way we saw the sights of everyday Vietnam, as well as a local market (with seafood snacks!), making rice wine, making of incense sticks, a local riverside coffee shop, all ending up with lunch in a relaxing waterside setting.
As I have a motorcycle license I was able to drive my own scooter, which was fantastic - but check with the Vespa Adventures team first if you want to do this.
A great day out (8am-3pm) and a very good way to see some of 'real' Vietnam. Highly recommended!

Our nighttime vespa food tour was an absolute blast. We had the best time. A little hesitant at first being on the back of a scooter in the crazy Saigon traffic however the drivers are great. A few minutes in and it was like you'd been crusing around in that type of traffic for years. The food and drinks available were great too. We tried frog and snails which were fine. Vietnamese pancakes, cold rolls, local iced coffee, mussels and so much more. We enjoyed it all! We recommend this to anyone - including my 60+ year old parents. A true Vietnamese experience and the service, safety and care was amazing.

Went from our hotel with mark as our team leader. We got to see the “real” Vietnam on this tour. We made stops in the country to see weaving, rice noodle making and several other great stops. We were nervous at first about riding the Vespas but the drivers were fun and safe. The tour ended with a nice lunch riverside. A real highlight!

What a way to see the city! We had an amazing first evening in Saigon zooming through traffic to get to some great eateries. Our guide, Nicole, had insider information and was able to answer all of our questions. I am really looking forward to booking with them again when I am in Cambodia!

We did the day tour around Saigon. It was an excellent experience - and worth every penny spent for the quality of the scooters, guide, and number of locations around the city.

We had a 7 year old who rode solo behind one of the drivers, and a 5 year old who sat with me. It was comfortable, safe, and undoubtedly the best way to experience the organized chaos of HCMC.

Highly recommend this for adults or families

We had loads of fun on the back of the Vespas as we zoomed around Ho Chi Minh on the After Dark tour. The food we sampled at the different locations was delicious and it was great having Na with us to teach us more about Vietnamese cuisine. Na was great fun and made the tour even more special. The Vespa drivers were also very friendly. I would definitely recommend this tour as it was very memorable. It is quite expensive so I just hope that the guides and drivers receive a good share of the money we paid as it was them that makes the experience what it is!

Our tour guide Thien is very friendly and knowledgeable. It was an amazing experience and first time riding on a motorbike in South East Asia. Great experience If you want to experience local Vietnamese how they live, this would be a great experience.

review_title: Vespa Tour--Beats a Tour Bus Anyday
review_text:
This was by far the best part of my trip to Saigon. My tour guide and driver were both amazing. At first I thought I was going to be driving, I must have misread the pamphlet from the tour agency. So glad that wasn't the case.

You can see so much of the city and its super fun being on a scooter. I don't think I can do a regular tour anymore! I always feel safe, and highly recommend doing a tour. Besides riding around the city, you stop at various places in the city and the tour guide will tell you all about it. You have to do a scooter tour in Saigon!

To make it short: We had a great day and it actually has been a real adventure for us! Although we didn't book a private tour, it turned out to be a private tour for the two of us. We were accompanied during the half day tour by our guide Thien, and two drivers Thach and Nhat. I was riding a Vespa by myself. My girlfriend was sitting on the back of Thach's bike. It all went really well and we both felt comfortable and safe throughout the day. Thien was a great guide! He definitely managed to give us a very interesting insight view into Mekong Delta life and Vietnamese life and history.

We made serval stops at local cafes, markets, distillers and had adventurous rides among them.

We can't say anything negative about the tour and would recommend it to everyone who is interested in experiencing the Mekong Delta, rather than only seeing it!

A bit pricey but excellent. On antique Vespas through the city with a driver and our group had a well spoken guide called Katty. We experienced two local eateries and were given lessons in the food culture. Then onto a lovely acoustic venue for live music and then a bit more of a club scene. 4 hours total. Would do again and recommend!

This was an amazing experience. I was quite anxious as we set off from our hotel in heavy rain and the Friday night rush hour having never ridden on a Vespa before, but there was lots of reassurance from my experienced driver. Our first stop was to a cafe and a welcome drink, followed by a stop at a fish restaurant, pancake house, a bar with Vietnamese live music and then a final bar with a live band before being returned to our hotel. A chance to try lots of delicious Vietnamese food and a fun evening. Thank you.

I never hoped on a bike in my life, but my wife really wanted us to go for this tour as it would be something different. Initially, I was afraid and not excited at all...after the initial few minutes, I was thrilled! One of the best fun I had on a tour. The group was awesome, the guide was very cool, the vespa pilot was very nice and always driving safe and the food they took us to try at the street was delicious.
Bottom line a truly local and unique experience you can have only with the vespa. Loved it every second.

review_title: Good experience to tour in HCM
review_text:
I joined after business meeting and our partners are very satisfied for vespa tour
they can speak in English enough to introduce HCM area. it worth joining once in your life time

For a respite from the busy HCM city I took a Vespa Adventures tour to the nearby areas of the Mekong Delta. My guide Thien and my driver Nhat gave me an excellent view into the vibrant local life. Thien was specially informative due to his education as an environmental engineer. So he offered expert details of the aspects of life in the Mekong Delta. We ate delicious fresh food at the market we visited along the way and at a beautiful restaurant on our way back to the city.

review_title: Great way to experience the city
review_text: This experience is awesome! The drivers were great and negotiated the craziness of Saigon's traffic with ease. We ate authentic local food at roadside restaurants. Frog legs, clams, mussels and an amazing Vietnamese pancake! This was a memorable experience. Our food guide Danny was great!

review_title: A great ride and excellent food
review_text: A very professional well organized evening of thrills and food. Experienced riders and friendly knowledgeable guides made this a great night for myself and my daughter

review_title: Vespa - Day in the Life tour
review_text: This tour was a wonderful way to see the city. It began with a delicious pho lunch and zipped us all around. The tour had a good mix of history and culture and concluded with scenic views. Thanks Ben!

review_title: A great way to see the city
review_text: Who doesn't love a Vespa. The drivers were expert and we felt safe even in the maddest traffic. Our guide, Ben, was a really nice guy, friendly and informative. We visited places we would never have come across on our own. They took lots of photos for us to remember our adventure. Excellent!
This was the best final event for our trip to Vietnam the evening before we left. To be "part" of the every day traffic in Saigon gives you an understanding how crowds work. Very skilled drivers so!

review_title: Great tours in Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
We've just done 2 tours with Vespa Adventure in Ho Chi Minh and we had a fantastic time.

I admit it's the only “motorbike” tour we've done in Vietnam and they might not be the cheapest according to other ads I've seen, we had a fantastic time.

We booked 2 tours in Ho Chi Minh City, the morning insider (the one with the bird club) and the craft beer tour and it was great.

Morning insider tour: pick up at hotel, many landmarks including non touristic ones. We booked a normal tour but it ended up being a private one (not complaining). We didn't see any tourist in the markets we've been to, nor would we have gone into those places by ourselves (thought you could, it looks strange / dodgy but all was fine). Great tour to discover the city.

Craft beer tour: if you like beer, just do it. 4 craft beer breweries (in addition to the Vespa Adventure HQ) with almost 20 beers to taste (always with food - and didn't have any issues with my peanut allergy). We were 6 in the tour and connected well with the people with us, so great night :-) Good thing that water was also provided :-)

With these 2 tours under our belt, we feel confident we can trust them for an entire day and we'll book the full day trip with them from Hoi An to Hue later in our journey.

This is a blast and the best thing we did during our time in Ho Chi Minh City. While I would never be brave enough (or crazy enough) to drive a motorscooter there, motorscooters are an integral part of life in this city and so this was the next best thing and gave us a great sense of what it's like. Our drivers were pros and made us feel safe while still weaving in and out of traffic like everyone else and following the "rules" of traffic, such as they are. I only closed my eyes and prayed a couple of times.

The food and music parts of the tour were top-notch as well. We met our guide, who said to call him "Antonio" at the Vespa cafe, where we had a drink and got an overview of plans for the evening. That was followed by excellent food at two out-of-the-way places tourists might not usually frequent, and then acoustic music and drinks at an open mike bar, concluding with a nostalgic visit to the Woodstock Bar, where we heard "Born to Be Wild" as well as "Dancing Queen" and other hits from my past

This is something not to be missed - and don't be fooled by imitations: book with the original and best vespa tours and look for the people in orange whose shirts say "Vespa Adventures." We are going to try to book with them again in Hoi An or Hanoi.

Absolutely amazing, very well organised, in one night you experienced two different restaurants, a relaxed solo singer bar followed by a night club all the while zipping around with professional drivers on the back of their vespa’s, if you only want to go one tour thus is the one to do “the ride of your life

review_title: Exhilarating night time foodie tour around Ho Chi Minh City on Vespas
review_text: This experience was one of the highlights of our recent trip to Vietnam & Cambodia. As anyone who has been to Ho Chi Minh City knows the traffic is completely bonkers and I have seen so many motorbikes on the road. Any slight concerns about whizzing through this melting pot of humanity were soon put at ease by the four fantastic drivers who were assigned to our party. We all rode pillion behind our driver and soon relaxed and really enjoyed the ride. We were met at our first venue Cafe Zoom by our local guide for the night - a great guy called "Harry" We had such a wonderful evening with him and he was at all of our food stops to help us order and eat like a local. WE went to an open air seafood cafe and sampled delicious grilled mussels, crab, clams and frogs legs. We were then whizzed off to a traditional Vietnamese House Restaurant and sampled the traditional savory Vietnamese pancakes and giant river sails. It was then off for a traditional Vietnamese coffee in a tiny back street jazz/local music cafe. We would have never found the venue if traveling on our own and it had a wonderful intimate jazz atmosphere. Our final destination was a really buzzing live rock music bar - again down a tiny back alley. Dancing and cocktails were the finale to a truly memorable night. The Company describes this trip as the "Ride of your Life" and it exceeded all expectations Thanks so much Vespa Adventures!
Brilliant to experience traffic chaos from the back of a Vespa in Saigon and experience the different foods on the street.

If you do one thing in Saigon it has to be a Vespa tour! It was great to take in the city as most locals do.
