The drivers were excellent and safe and the bars and restaurants that we took in were all different with good quality food and drinks. Our main guide was really engaging and had a good sense of humour. Do it, you'll love it.

I cannot recommend this highly enough. We booked this at the last minute and we were very happy that we did. First, they pick you up from your hotel. You then get a tour of interesting restaurants and live music bars with food and drinks included in the total amount. The highlight is sitting on the back of a Vespa being driven through the city traffic but without any worries. If you have seen the Saigon traffic then you will appreciate that this takes some skill. Our guide, Kitty, was well informed and very happy to share her knowledge. The frogs legs were tasty and the pancake restaurant was a very tasty experience.

review_title: What a thrill, the ride of my life
review_text:
Did the siagon after dark foody tour, from the moment we were picked up at our hotel by Katty and Jaden the final stop at a relaxed music bar it was fun fun fun.
Tne food stops were great and the drivers exceptional.
A must do

review_title: Best way to experience local eateries!
review_text: On our first trip to HCMC, we booked the Saigon After Dark tour. The two drivers arrived to pick us up at our hotel and after a quick helmet fitting and run through, we set off through the bustling streets, to Cafe Zoom. Here we picked up the tour guide and the other couples (there were 3 couples in total plus the guide) and headed off around the city. Our guide was fantastic, and took us to all the local places we would never have found on our own. Brilliantly organized, fantastic food, amazing way to see the city, chat to locals and meet other travelers. 100% recommend.

Absolutely blown away by our Countryside Life Tour.

Have considered this for some time and finally booked it as friend were in town.

Professional, interesting, fun and first class activity to enjoy when in Siem Reap (or indeed one of the other locations in Vietnam).

Would highly recommend this and was even more impressed that our village lunch was prepared fully vegan as requested :)

Thank you for the extra effort guys!

Riding on the back of a scooter through Saigon is the best way to experience this crazy city like a local and this tour gives you the perfect way to do this. Normally not a 'tour' person but was recommended this one by friends and really, really loved it on my first visit to Ho Chi Minh. Second time around it was still really fun, but the last couple of stops weren't as good. Particularly the last stop, which used to leave you at a rowdy bar but this time around the bar was lame and quiet and seems only catering to the vespa tour groups. The food stops were the same, and really tasty. Loved the fresh seafood at the first stop. But the best part by far is just being on the back of the vespas, zipping around in the throats of all the other motorcycles on the road. The drivers are great and really friendly and we always feel really safe. Would definitely recommend this tour to first time visitors to Saigon.

review_title: Amazing fun....close your eyes and go for it!
review_text:
Arranged by our excellent tour company we did not know what to expect. Having seen the horrendous traffic and unlimited number of mopeds (9 million?) did not know what the evening would bring BUT is was hugely fun, very exhilarating and we survived. My driver was first class and I was not worried for one minute, in fact the busier it got the more I enjoyed it.The visit to a very good seafood restaurant and then another local street food place was excellent and then to a couple of local bars en route.
DO NOT MISS THIS ONE OF THE HIGH SPOTS OF OUR VISIT TO SAIGON.

a perfectly organized evening, joined by a guide. The driver collects you from the hotel and drives you through different restaurants and bars. Good food, lots of alcohol, excellent live music and the literal ride of my life thru this unbelievable traffic in Saigon. A must!

review_title: Fun and exhilarating trip in Saigon
review_text: So much fun, great guiding, skilled vespa driving, nice bunch of people. Really felt we saw the real side of Saigon rather than other times I've been there just as a typical tourist.

review_title: Crazy Saigon traffic up close and personal
review_text: A group of 7 of us signed up for the Vespa tour. We were picked up at our hotel and brought to the restaurant where the tour began. Before leaving we were helped with our helmets and gave a short safety briefing. Then the fun began. Our drivers pulled out into the crazy Saigon traffic. The drivers were very careful but kept up with the traffic. I always feel safe and comfortable with my driver. After meeting with the tour leader we had some chips, salsa and drinks and headed off to our first stop, a restaurant in another district of Saigon. We had drinks and sampled crab, frog legs and squid. Don't fill up because you get right back on the Vespa and your driver takes you to another restaurant to sample other Vietnamese delicacies. Back on the bike to another part of town to watch them cook and to sample Vietnamese shrimp pancakes. By the 4th stop we were stuffed with all the great food. Luckily it was an intimate coffee house with sofas, espresso, ice cream and a few singers to serenade us. The final stop was a discotheque but by then we were too tired to continue. We had been on a bicycle tour all day. We were dropped off at our hotel with lots of great memories. For me personally, it was fun trying all the new Vietnamese food but the highlight was riding around Saigon on the back of that Vespa. It was a HOOT!!!!!
Great trip, lots of fun and lovely food. Saw parts of HCM that would otherwise not have seen. Drivers are very professional and safe. Fab music venues!
The Vespa tour is a must do in Saigon/Ho Chi Min City. Great staff and safe "chauffeurs", make this a really great attraction. You feel really part of the city. Awesome, don't miss it!

review_title: Exhilerating visit for food and seeing the city!
review_text: This certainly was one of the most exciting adventures on our recent trip to Saigon. The drivers are great--which is a relief as you zip through the crowded streets of a vibrant city tasting a wide variety of foods. Everything was upbeat, tasty and gave us a good feel for the culture on many levels. We especially enjoyed the coffee shop atmosphere at the 4th stop. Our group of 4 all rate this a "must do" experience!!

review_title: Highlight of our time in Hanoi!
review_text: We did an evening street eats tour in Hanoi and our vespa adventure was the highlight of our time there. Gabby was our guide (super friendly & personable), and our vespa drivers were Xuan & Hieu and I would completely recommend all of them! They were great with accommodating our pescatarian diet, and swapped out one standard stop for a vegan restaurant which we loved. You get a completely different perspective of the city riding the streets at night, and we always feel safe in the crazy Hanoi traffic. We had limited time in Hanoi and it was nice to see a few sights in passing (like the opera house) that we otherwise wouldn't have seen. The food was great too. Definitely a great night in Hanoi.

Vespa Adventures may seem on the pricier side but I can assure you that they are worth it. We went on the Mekong Delta tour today - Thien was our guide who provided us with a lot of information! The tour was excellent with, the drivers were great and kept us super safe. The places we visited were really interesting, with no expectation to buy anything, and they provided a real insight into the rural Vietnamese life. The food we were provided with as part of the tour was delicious, and there were plenty of cold drinks on hand.

If you are considering a tour I highly recommend this company.

review_title: Great way to see the city
review_text:
I was traveling alone and a friend recommended this trip as a great way to experience the city - and it was

From the moment I was picked up the driver and tour guide were friendly and included everyone as a team.

The food and drink venues were varied in style, food and atmosphere and the live music bar was a hidden treasure.

Would definitely recommend for people of all ages

This would have to be one of the most amazing tours we have done! From the moment you engage with this company to the moment they drop you off, they are extremely professional and friendly.

Starts with them picking you up and they take you to their cafe to meet your guide. You are given a card showing the outline of the tour and a drink.

The ride is so comfortable and safe! We did wear long pants which I suggest you do as the bike gets warm. Each stop had our tour guide Uyen give us a history lesson. She was just gorgeous and great English.

The ride is so relaxing and the best way to see the sights, our tour was 4.5 hours inside Saigon and i highly recommend it!

After the tour is finished you have a beautiful lunch at their cafe and they give you a lovely memory photograph.

Thanks team A++ loved it

Was going to drive but then decided to ride passenger so I could take more pictures. Ended up being a great scenic and off the beaten path tour. Really good long day out exploring parts not many get to see. Felt real.

review_title: Such an awesome way to see Ho Chi Minh
review_text: We usually steer away from organized tours as we like to get off the beaten track, but when we found the Vespa Adventure tours, we thought it was too much fun to not give it a go, it was the best decision. It was the highlight of our trip, and my 12 and 16 yr olds had a blast, heading all over the city, trying local food at local restaurants, I couldn't recommend it enough.

Amazing - great to be in amongst the scooters.
Professional riders make us feel safe in the hectic traffic.
Great tour - lots to see.
Best night in Saigon! Scooters were great, drivers were even better. He food and night spots were wonderful, the most fun we had in Saigon this is a must do.
This was one of the highlights of our trip! It was well-organized and lots of fun seeing Saigon at night. i would recommend this to everyone!

Even in the rain this was a good night out. They provide wet weather clothing. Great way to taste street food in places you wouldn't find yourself. They provided veggie food for me no problem and you can have as many drinks as you like. Two real highlights, the local singers by candlelights, in what seemed like someone's lounge, and the final stop live music and cocktails.

review_title: Brilliant evening in Saigon on the back of a scooter!
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed our scooter adventure through Saigon at night - from the hotel pick up, to the welcome drink at a local bar, the street food experience, the pancake restaurant, the hidden gem of the music cafe, and the madness of the night club. A big thankyou to all the team.

I enjoyed the Vespa Adventure enormously. It was exhilarating though at no point was I scared. Yes the traffic is crazy in Saigon but these drivers know what they are doing and they do it very well. I highly recommend this attraction.

Despite the busy streets, I always felt very safe. The ride through Saigon was thrilling, the food was amazing. The entertainment along the way was fun and a great way to experience Saigon night life. The adult beverages were ample and our guide was a great communicator, informative and encouraged us all to have a great time. Overall, one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam and I would recommend it highly!

This was our favorite adventure. The Vespa ride is amazing! In a city of 10,000,000 people and 6,000,000 motor bikes it is CRAZY. You do not drive yourself, but you have an experienced driver. The
ride is exciting but the FOOD is excellent. You go three or four places for food and then end up in a nightclub. It was great!

Don't miss the thrill ride of your life. Speeding around HCMC on the back of a Vespa. The added bonus is the delicious street food tour as well. The "secret coffee house" was a hoot, and the rock and roll finish sent us home smiling.
Great evening with Vespa Adventures - closed my eyes a couple of times but felt very safe with my brilliant driver. Enjoyed the food and the entertainment.

review_title: It Was The Greatest Ride of Our Lives
review_text:
This has to go on anyone's bucket list and if you are thinking of doing something exhilarating this is mind blowing fun.
We did the night foodie tour of Saigon and were so impressed with the way this tour is running. They were punctual, had super drivers and each couple were allocated their own guide and ours, Uyen, was just superb.
Word of advice, get in the back of the bike, hold your breath and hold on. After the first five minutes the adrenalin kicks in and boy are you having fun. To outsiders it seems madness, to the locals, this is just completely normal, this is how it is and I must say, in all the time we were the largest city of Vitenam which brags it has 7 million motor bikes, we never saw one accident.
The tour itself took us to five different venues starting with drinks and nibbles and then into genuine family food restaurants and the big surprise, to a type of cafe nightclub with a simply amazing singer entertaining us. All food, drinks, drivers, personal guide and the ride were included in the price and would have to say the best value ever. There are other motor bike tours but you just have to do it in a Vespa!
Excellent experience overall. The guide, food and driver were excellent. I would recommend this to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon)
Safe and exciting ride with meal stops appropriate for this amazing city. Skilled driver, enthusiastic commentary. Adventure worth doing again.

With a little trepidation we set out on our tour, but the friendliness of the greeting and the expertise of our drivers turned the trip into an unforgettable experience. I would thoroughly recommend the whole experience.
Had a fun ride despite the rain for the first hour. The drivers provided great rain ponchos and our guide even equipped a face mask for me to keep my face dry!

This ride was just fantastic, a nonforgettable memory. I feel very saved with the driver. It was fun, adventurous and an experience that you should not miss! Also the stops for restaurant and Bars were just perfect. Thank you!

As scary as zooming through insane traffic in Saigon seems, this adventure should not be missed due to fear. The "pilots" are very safe, curious and kind. Saigon traffic seems to have its own rhythm that we called synchronized chaos. The food and drink stops were amazing and "real" Saigon. Something you may otherwise miss. Don't be afraid, Just Do It! You're published.
This was a brilliant tour and very well organized. My wife and I had a great time and can thoroughly recommend it to anyone

We had a great time on our vesper tour with our family of 5 ranging from a 9 year old up. The bikes take you places cars can't. They sent a separate guide and in our case a separate photographer with us. You finish with a yummy lunch which even includes beers/wine if you want. We gave our drivers and guide a tip which while not nessessary is always appreciated when their minimum wage is so low. Beware the fumes from traffic are quite potent if you aren't used to it. They also gave us good quality photographs when they dropped us back at our hotel. Kids loved it as did we.

review_title: The most amazing evening out on our whole Vietnam trip
review_text: We were collected on 4 Vespa scooters and taken to a bar for drinks and to meet our group guide 'Miggy'. (What a fun lady) From there we went to a restaurant for at least a 4-course meal and more drinks, then on to another restaurant - more food and more drinks. Next came a coffee/drinks bar with live music - a wonderful vocalist accompanied by acoustic guitar. Then out came a huge brithday cake - my husband's 'special' birthday that day. All the customers have Happy birthday. Our guide must have told them about it. After this on to a 'rock music' bar - again more drinks and more birthday wishes. Getting to each of these stops we were racing around Saigon on our vespas - seeing various different quarters of the city and all the major sights. What a wonderful night out.

review_title: A very enjoyable end to our HCMC trip
review_text:
We went on the Mekong tour which took us outside of the city. It's a 6.5 hour ride and was quite expensive (just under USD 100).

That said.... we didn't regret it. I still maintain the view that it's expensive and there may be cheaper equally good options (which I can't comment on as I haven't tried any other tour).

I do think it's doing one that takes you outside the city so you get to experience the local countryside. I would recommend for the following reasons:

- the drivers were all pleasant enough
- we felt safe on the bikes
- our guide Na was good
- it was a decent ride out to the countryside (covered around 80km on the bike)
- the route was good (we were the only tourists around and weren't taken to any tourist traps)
- authentic experience

We wanted a way to see the city of Phnom Penh as we just arrived and we had been recommended Vespa by a fellow traveler and we were not disappointed-both drivers were excellent and took great care that we were safe-our guide Jackie Cambodia was excellent and we saw parts of the city that otherwise we wouldn't have done-highly recommended you will certainly enjoy

I booked a half day City tour (can't remember the actual name) whilst in Saigon. The tour covered a lot that my actually group tour that I had just finished didn't seem to touch on. This was a much better way to appreciate how the locals live.

I felt completely safe on the vespa. My driver was very careful. It was also a great way to manage the City traffic. Our guide was very knowledgeable. A great way to spend a few hours. Highly recommend booking one of their tours.

review_title: Being on a vesper in the traffic
review_text: My husband and my two boys aged 10 and 13 did a night tour and it was fabulous. We had a great English speaking guide which was particularly important for me as one of my sons has a nut allergy. The guys on the vespers were really friendly. We ate some great food and felt like we were out with locals. This is a must!

Just got back from tour, I'm getting on a bit as was apprehensive after seeing the way they drive but no need it was superb fun, well looked after and not one complaint, I was well spoiled, good food, music and fun, I recommend it

review_title: Seeing Saigon from the back of a Vespa was magical!
review_text: The Vespa Tour was fantastic. The Vespa team - drivers and hosts - are experts and made sure our tour was personalized. From the minute I hopped on the back of the vespa, the driver assured me that he was professional and that everything was under control. Seeing Saigon from the back of a Vespa was ....magical. The streetfood was excellent (I even enjoyed the frog legs). Saigon is a vibrant and exciting city with friendly people and great food.

Recently took the Inside Saigon tour with Vespa Adventures and had a truly memorable experience. The opportunity to ride on the back of a vespa through the streets of Saigon, even in the pouring rain, made it hard not to feel like a local. My guide and driver were both very attentive and friendly and the tour offered a great opportunity to see the city's most famous sights and districts as well as some truly off-the-beaten path nooks and crannies. I would definitely recommend!

I'd heard great things about this company and recently had the opportunity to try their tours out. I took the Craft Beer Tour with my friend. The beers were all fantastic. It was really interesting to see the whole craft beer culture that has emerged in Saigon. In most places the locals outnumber the foreigners and that shows that it's really been embraced here. The Heart of Darkness has become my favorite. The labels for each beer are a work of art in themselves and the bean nachos were the perfect pair with the beer.

We had Kat as our guide who was really good. Had a great rapport with all the staff in the tap-rooms and has a good manner with the guests.

My only comment would be that it would have been nice to have a few others on the tour. I hope this review helps to encourage others to join. I should also say that it is outstanding value.

Hands down, one of the most fun things I've ever done. Did the insider tour, and enjoyed all the spots on the route and thought it was a perfect way to make the most of your time in Saigon. Our guide Tri was funny and knowledgeable and the drivers were professional. I highly recommend.

Wow! A clear highlight of our 12 days in Vietnam. Being part of the caotic driving scene was a blast. Our group of 10 traveled to 5 spots with food a drink and music. Great food. All we wanted to drink. A secret lounge bar for dessert followed by rock and roll and dancing. My driver was excellent. And our leader was outstanding. Don't miss this exciting was to see Saigon.

review_title: You can't go there without riding one
review_text: I advise to rent one with driver and can take you a tour around the city my hotel recipient offer take me a tour was cheap and lovely and you can see how they easy smooth every body driving round without a stop

review_title: Experience Saigon nightlife with a trill
review_text: This is an exciting way to see this vibrant city and enjoy various types of Vietnamese foods. They pick you up at your hotel and then drive you to a bar for your first drink. From there they'll take you to two more restaurants where you will try various Vietnamese cuisine. From there you can continue on to a coffee bar where you will listen to some local musicians play and then finally the last stop is a Disco. The best Vespa ride is not for the faint of heart, be prepared to experience the traffic of Saigon like the locals.

I had a wonderful experience with Vespa Adventures in Saigon today - November 30.

It was a colorful and unique way to see the city. We cut through various alleys allowing us to see parts of the city a tourist wouldn't ordinarily see

Our tour guide was Thien. He was very personable and knowledgeable. He definitely made the tour enjoyable.

My driver was Tam. He was very attentive and observant driver. I felt quite safe at all times.

Would definitely take another Vespa Adventure if the opportunity arises

review_title: A fascinating way to visit Ho Chi Min City
review_text: An excellent evening seeing the sights of HCMC on the back of the main mode of transport - exciting and safe. We would never have found the restaurants or music venues without our guides. Masses of food and drink, not always to our taste but we tried it all. Hugely enjoyable.

review_title: Wow, if you only do one tour this is it
review_text:
I read the reviews, really not sure about the scooters, what is exciting to someone who has not ridden, is mundane to for someone who has
Sitting behind someone on a scooter, local food ? probably average at best, but the reviews were so good, well I admit it, I was so wrong on every account. Skilled & safe scooter drivers in Saigon traffic is something else, you have to be there, I have never been surrounded by so many bikes that seemed to be going in every direction, the food could not have been better, dishes were delicious. I never would have ordered them had i been on my own, but the highlight was the music, no the highlight was how it all was put together, back to the music, amazing, the first one down a back alley through an old door, it was sensational, a young girl singing without a microphone, her voice was like an angel, while we sat around drinking 333, the next spot was just as good, congratulations on such a professional run operation

I was concerned about this tour due to the traffic. Actually it was the highlight of our trip... the guides were excellent and the food delicious. We would NEVER have found the street food and to top it off the two clubs with the singers were outstanding. Seeing the city on the vespa was such fun. Worth doing and would do it again. I can't recommend it highly enough!

review_title: Saigon Food Tour on a Vespa (Quite the "Local" Experience!)
review_text:
So this was such a great experience, and totally worth it. The Vespas pick you up at your hotel, and they provide you with a helmet. Hang on, because of the rest of the trip is just like driving in Saigon! The traffic is quite different and amazing, however, you'll feel safe all along. The drivers are experts in dealing with the traffic, so just hold on to the handles and enjoy the views.

They took us to our first spot to introduce us to our tour guide, Tein. He was super friendly, and knowledgeable. If it's possible, I'd highly recommend him. The first spot was a bar, and we met up with another couple there, got to know everyone, and were off to our foodie part of the tour. All the food was delicious, local, and Tien explained to us how the food was prepared, and how to properly eat it. There were some music venues included as well, all with drinks, alcoholic or not, and delicious Vietnamese coffee.

The trip was an absolute blast and well worth the price of admission.

We stayed at Ho Chi Minh for4 days and this evening was a belated birthday present from our son. Initially, I was a little nervous, as I had never ventured on the back of a moped before, but the evening was superb with a great guide and moped driver. The visits to the various restaurants were excellent, ending with the music cafes, just completed a great evening. A wonderful way to explore a vibrant city. Would thoroughly recommend it.

Next Time we will See a Larger Diskothek Nightlife dancing
The life Music Club was very interesting and the Singer was Great !

Expertly led by Nicole, this was food extravaganza around Ho Chi Minh. Starters in district 4, whisked over to District 1 for mains, followed by late night chilled music in Vung Cafe and then on for final drinks & dancing. Riding in a Vespa convoy was fabulous too, exciting & nail biting at the same time. Hats off to the drivers for navigating the busy streets so expertly. Excellent value too - with food galore!!
it was the best ride ever i had the time of my life and the staff of Vespa Adventures was so friendly and great fun i had lots of fun with my Driver ( Nam ) he was awesome
This idea of ​​a Vespa Night tour is great. The drivers are prudent and the guide that accompanies us for the evening was very interesting. We highly recommend this attraction.

Not to be missed. The tour was very well organized and most enjoyable.
Great choice of restaurants and entertainment. We saw Saigon beyond the tourist scenes.
The drivers were experienced and made us feel safe at all times. The host was most knowledgeable able to answer all of our questions.
One of the highlights of our Saigon visit.

This would have to be one of the best experiences you could have while in Saigon. Picked up at your hotel on a Vespa and then the fun begins. Taken to a central meeting point for welcoming drinks and snacks, then of down back lanes and alleys to a local Seafood restaurant for fresh seafood cooked the Vietnamese way and more drinks. Back on the Vespa and once again down lanes and alleys to a Vietnamese pancake restaurant where you get to see the pancakes being made and then the best part, eat the pancake and without a doubt the best pancake you could ever wist to eat. Then of again to a Live Acoustic Cafe for more drinks and music. To finish of the night it is down this dark alley to a Live music venue for more drinks and pop music and what a way to finish of one of the best nights ever. Highly recommended but go with an empty stomach because of the amount or food and drinks. BEST NIGHT EVER.

review_title: Loved every minute of the Locals tour - wonderful inspiring owner
review_text: I mistakenly posted this review to the Phnom Pehn Vespa Adventures location so I am now reposting to the Siem Reap location where we had our trip. Our travel agent, Trails of Indochina, booked us for a Vespa adventure to experience how the locals lived and played. While in Siem Reap, my husband had a medical condition surface that impacted his ability to ride on the back of a Vespa. Akim, the owner of the business, was extremely flexible in that she was able to accommodate us by changing our trip so we could ride in a tuktuk. She also told her story of her childhood when her family was murdered by the Kymer Rouge. Her only alternative was to live with monks masquerading as a boy as the monks only would take in boys. She said that after a while the monks realized she was a girl but still allowed her to stay as they liked her. Talking to people like Akim and many others about their tragic personal experiences under that murderous regime broke our hearts and made us wonder why the world let this happen. Our guide, Priak, was very knowledgeable and told us many stories about the country and its struggles. We visited a market, met the local medicine man, drove to an amazingly huge miles long manmade reservoir constructed by the Kymer culture in the year 900. Today it is still being used by locals for picnicking and swimming. Families were enjoying themselves with children swimming in the water in inner tubes. We also met a family who earns their living by making palm sugar and saw a family member climb a palm tree using a bamboo “ladder” to extract palm juice. It was refreshingly delicious. One of the best parts of the trip was having lunch at a countryside family's home. Again, Vespa Adventures accommodated us with our vegetarian diet. The food the family made for us was the most delicious we had on our whole 2 week trip. I wholeheartedly recommend taking a tour with Vespa Adventures. It was a transformative experience.

I am an avid motorcycle rider and was somewhat apprehensive about riding on the back in such a congested environment. The drivers were skilled to the level that my comfort level was very high in the first few minutes. Guide was good fun and very attentive.
Vespa Adventures: Highly recommended! Perfect organization, great pleasure, fantastic guides and locations!

It is certainly not cheap, but if you are not an experienced vespa-daredevil yourself, this is a good way to get acquainted with the local vibes.
The trip is safe and very well organized with a driver and a guide per small group of 2-4. The guides give a lot of information and the local food is surprising, nit the places where one would usually go to.
The sites for music are also well chosen, however, the time is too short to fully appreciate what is going on. Anyhow, a lovely evening with a good marketing campaign behind it.

Our Vespa tour of Ho Chi Minh City was one of the highlights of our whole trip to Vietnam! Huge fun, fantastic food and good company! The restaurants you took us to serve some of the best food we ate in Vietnam, and the music bars were both wonderful in different ways. Our guide was so friendly and helpful and the service was great too - being picked up from and returned to our hotel. Definitely one to recommend!

review_title: Saigon After Dark - A Real Adventure
review_text:
After a trip through Vietnam I ended up in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon). After the usual sightseeing I booked the "Saigon After Dark" tour. What a ride! This is the perfect way to see Saigon from a different angle. To be part of that chaotic traffic was awesome. The restaurants and locations we went were outstanding. This is the real Saigon.
Their slogan is "The Ride Of My Life!" - True- I had such a great time.
Regards to local friend Pho and driver Giao. You girls rock!

Chris
Freiburg/Germany

We recently joined the Vespa after dark tour & it was a highlight of our trip. The guides picked us up from our hotel and we spent the next few hours flying through the crazy traffic. We did not worry about the traffic around us at all & Felt very safe on the bikes. The food tour was fantastic and we also visited a great Cafes with talented singers and bars. We will do this tour again over and over again.
Excellent thrilling evening, loved the experience of going through the traffic and city on the scooters. Friendly drivers.
Thoroughly enjoyed my adventure with Vespa. Great service and people. Tien our guide was awesome. I felt very saved with my driver. Loved the food and adventure we had that night.

This was the highlight of our time in Saigon.. was awesome
Our guide was heaps of fun and those experiences were exhilarating!
Great food and drinks and the Vespa drivers were great too

We had an awesome time as a group of 3 women exploring Vietnam. We discovered Vespa Adventures in Hoi An, loved our night tour and did one in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh too. Recommend to everyone, a safe way to travel with friendly and trusted employees. Thanks for showing us a great time!

Great way to see Saigon and enjoy its food and people Our guide was friendly and knowledgeable. We got to see the night life and eat in "local" restaurants. Highly recommend this adventure when visiting Saigon.
Amazing food bars tour great way to see the nightlife and experience Saigon, on the back of a Vesspa, and meet other people from other countries at the end.
Great sights, beers, good and guides, vespas were awesome, a good selection of food with the drinks and very informative guides, and safe, felt completely at ease on the back just enjoying the view

I had one of the best nights of my life on this tour.
Katty was our group leader and her entertainment, humor and hospitality were exceptional. She made it so much fun for all of us.
There was myself and my partner Ken (Aussies)and 4 Germans Sonja, Kat, Michael and Marcus. Katty had us all mixing and enjoying each other's company in no time.
If you're prepared to step out of your comfort zone re the good tasting you'll enjoy yourself more. No point going off tour going to balk at tasting things that are a bit different.
You'll see and hear so much that you'd easily miss out on otherwise.
The Vesper drivers were good fun and never once did I feel unsafe on the back of the bike.
Three food and alcohol were limitless.
Enjoyed the silent karaoke bar and the live music club the best and made some fantastic friends and memories.
I have no hesitation recommending this tour.
had an absolute cracker of a time riders ,(ricky & co ) were great ,our guide eric (a fabulous person) was terrific. the venues we went to were entertaining and enlightening.
This was the highlight of the holiday for me. I absolutely loved every minute of it. The food was excellent, the bars we visited were great.

I was in Ho Chi Minh for a work trip, and our group decided to do the night tour. We had an absolute blast! Our host was great, the food was delicious, and it allowed you to see parts of the city that you wouldn't normally see. I highly recommend it!

review_title: An absolute MUST in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: We take all guests on this! Great way to see city, great food/drinks, very cultural, great staff..and safe!

review_title: Saigon at Night- best tour ever!
review_text: I went with three of my colleagues after our conference had ended and we had the best experience ever. The staff and drivers were amazing. The food and experiences were incredible. This has to be one of the best tours I've ever been on in my life. Thanks again for such a great experience!

I am nearly 60 and thought I'd done everything that makes me grin like a child. Then we went out in Saigon on Vespas. Everything ran like clockwork and the organizers and riders were great. Don't miss out.

I did 2 Vespa Adventure tours - Night markets and the River tours. Both were great. The guides were awesome and the experience was so genuine. You have to do it as there is no better way to experience Vietnam then on a Vespa.

I stopped in Vietnam for only 2 days and thank goodness a friend knew about Vespa Adventures! What a blast. When I come back, this will be my first MUST-DO experience (again). The fun, food and beer for the value was outstanding!

review_title: Very exciting and loads of fun!
review_text: The organizing staff are brilliant. Great local knowledge and useful tips. A ride with these guys is a "Must do" in Saigon. It was the highlight of my Vietnam trip, and these guys know how to entertain.

review_title: What a way to see the city like the locals.
review_text:
Superb way to join in the moped and scooter mayhem, sample some good food stops (might want to upgrade some of the menu..), fantastic way to see the city sites by night too and safely enjoy a beer.

Highly recommended - We will look for similar Vespa Tours in other cities too. A genuine high spot of our South Asian tour.

review_title: Superb Vespa tour of Ho Ching Ming city
review_text: This was a very well run and organized tour which was a real blast. The food was terrific and the drinks flowing. We had a superb evening giving us a better insight into the local culture. Would thoroughly recommend

Such a fun evening and amazing to experience the carnage of the traffic while feeling completely safe with the excellent drivers. A fantastic way to see the city and guide made the evening even more interesting. Food was fantastic and we were kept well watered. Would highly recommended.

review_title: Great way to see hidden gems
review_text: My friend and I did the 'Insider's Saigon' tour last week, and it was definitely the highlight of our time in the city. The guides are informative and very friendly, taking you to see hidden gems around the city like locals in the crowds of scooters that characterize Saigon. We saw a beautiful Chinese temple, as well as a hidden temple of 1000 buddhas. We would never have found these places on our own and going by vesper added to the fun.

Four of us booked the Saigon After Dark Tour, and were picked up on the Vespas and took to the meeting point where we were introduced to Tuan ( Eric ) our guide who met us at each bar/cafe we ​​stopped at. He's brilliant, a good laugh and knows his food.
There is so much food on offer at each stop, you need to go hungry ! The food is excellent, all local, traditional and they will change dishes if you don't eat certain things.
We even tried the fried frog, which was really good !
My driver Thach was really good, he spoke enough English to point out various sights and we both had a good laugh.
If you've got any doubts about doing this tour (I'm no biker or pillion passengers at all) put them aside, this is one of the best things you'll do.

Thanks Eric & Thach for a great time !!

Best experience ever, would have done it every night on my trip if I could have! Was booked trough buffalo tours who were very helpful. The sites and food were excellent and you get to experience Ho Chi Minh in the best possible way!!! Worth the money and will definitely be coming back to do it again.

review_title: Fun, drinks, food and an amazing time
review_text: This was organized as part of our tour so wasn't sure what to expect. It was such good fun, unlimited drinks and great food too. We visited different bars and venues in the back of a scooter in the crazy traffic of Saigon. Katy was brilliant fun and made the night even keeping up on the drinking games!

review_title: Interesting way to see countryside around Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: We took half day tours with Vespa Adventures in Hanoi, Hoi An and Ho Chi Min City, Vietnam and thoroughly enjoyed each one. We're a couple and had two Vespa drivers and an English speaking guide on another scooter on each tour. Each of our tours included lunch and/or a snack at a local restaurant or at someone's home which was a great experience. The tours were a mix of city and country destinations that included landmarks, open air markets, local craft makers and other interesting sights. The drivers seemed to be very experienced and provided a safe and comfortable ride. The guides were all excellent in conducting the tours and very good English speakers. The tours were an unexpected highlight of our trip.

This was one of the best tours we have ever done! From the time we were picked up at our hotel through to when we were dropped off I couldn't stop smiling. An amazing experience to travel through the madness of Saigon traffic on the back of a vintage Vespa 🛵 Visiting the Bird Park, walking through the Flower Markets, Herbal Medicine Shop and so many iconic places in the city were a real highlight of this tour. Our guide was very knowledgeable and assisted us throughout the morning. Lunch at Cafe Zoom was some of the best food we'd had in the city. I can not recommend this tour highly enough....you must do this!

We loved every minute of our Saigon after dark tour! From picking up at our hotel to zooming on the bike of the moped to their Zoom cafe, to the seafood cafe that we'd have never experienced without a guide to the late night 'secret' jazz cafe that we will never have found, this was a full on, exhilarating way to experience Ho Chii Minh City and we loved every minute. Our evening with the team with Jaden as our guide and our expert moped drivers left us feeling elated and on a high! We had brilliant fun and would wholeheartedly recommend this tour.

review_title: Ending my time in HCM with happiness
review_text: This was so much fun. Looking at the traffic in this city is scary, but being on the back of a Vespa with a local driver was fun! Starting with drinks, meeting everyone, on to a delicious meal, what I called an "underground French hideaway" and then to a live band singing American rock and roll with more drinks. Generous souvenirs of a ball cap and paper framed photo too. Just loved the evening and the people. The staff and drivers were thoughtful and eager to please.

This was brilliant beyond words despite a little light rain.

We were in a tour group of 14 - if we'd done this on the first night of our tour we'd have created an immediate close bond and camaraderie.

Great team, great venues, great food and soooo much drinking (leading to Vietnamese drinking shouts an finally dancing on tables to a live band!).

Thanks Katty and Steve (the boss) for a superb night.

One of the best tours we have had on our holiday throughout Asia & Europe. Kat was an awesome guide who made sure everyone was looked after. Vespa drivers were terrific & lots of fun. Food was fantastic, lots of variety & never had to look for a drink. Acoustic music & singers was a great local treat & finishing at a Rock n roll bar was fabulous. Didn't want the night to end. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone

Saigon night food tour - what can I say -crazy traffic, fabulous food and great Vespa driver. Had a great time and didn't want to get off the bike!!! Had so much fun my husband and I booked with Vespa Adventures in Siem Reap and had another blast. Do yourself a favor and book this tour - you wont be dissapointed and you may even think about buying a Vespa when you return home :-)

First off, Katty is amazing. The whole event was well orchestrated fun. The chance to see Saigon, with the wind in your face, as a local is not to be missed.

We had a group of 14 (mid 50's to early 60's) and every driver was courteous and safe. The venues we visited were genuine local flavor.

Due to this—you won't have any regrets.

review_title: Amazing night in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: A definite highlight of our trip to Vietnam. My wife was worried at first about riding through the Saigon traffic but ended up enjoying the tour immensely. We were picked up at our hotel by our guide, Huyen, and our rider/drivers Hieu & Phong. We were then ridden though Saigon to three separate food venues, the last one with live music. Huyen met us at each venue and fully explained what we were to get. Huyen was excellent. The food was great, the ride and our driver/riders Hieu & Phong were great. Highly recommended - not to be missed.

If you though the traffic was crazy in Saigon this tour melds traffic madness with great food.
We were matched up with a rider and sat behind whilst zipping through the evening traffic on the way to our first restaurant. A bit of a sightseeing adventure, excitement of being in the traffic and great food at the venues (3 in total) made it a great night. Make sure you eat the frogs legs!!!
Don't hesitate! Book now :-). Brilliant fun and so well managed. We did the 'Saigon After Dark' tour and stopped at great locations in between the thrilling rides.

review_title: Vespa Adventures Saigon - Don't miss out!
review_text: On our recent trip to Saigon in Vietnam we had the opportunity to go on the Vespa Adventures tour by night. It was amazing! Two guys on Vespa's (Vintage motorbikes for those that don't know) arrived at our hotel, my wife and I jumped on the back and away we went! We visited a number of 'off the tourist circuit' restaurants and the food was amazing. We also visited some night spots and got a great appreciation of the city night life. Our tour guide was lovely, spoke excellent English and was extremely helpful. This is a must do tour if you are in Saigon.
Brilliant morning city tour our guide was brilliant couldn't have been better .The drivers are skilled and what a way to see the city . Used the in Hanoi as well . Highly recommended

our family took two tours with Vespa Adventures and both are highly recommended. kids can join in too. Guide was fun and fabulous and although we've been to Saigon quite a few times, we saw new things and learned a lot. Will definitely book again!

review_title: See (and eat) Saigon from a different perspective
review_text:
Vespa Adventures' "Saigon After Dark" tour came highly recommended from a colleague who had just visited Saigon, and so I made sure to add it to my itinerary when visiting the city for the first time. I'm sure glad I did, as it was easily one of the top (if not *the* top) highlight of the trip for me. Saigon is such an exciting, dynamic city but you can't fully appreciate it from the sidewalk or in the back of a cab. Being in the middle of the throng, zipping around the city, especially at night ... it was such an exhilarating experience. During part of the tour, we had a little bit of rain, but I didn't mind--it just added to the atmosphere (and in case you were wondering/worrying: they had ponchos at the ready!).

The food we had was great--first was a seafood place, then banh xeo. Both were excellent, and had a nice local feel to them (especially the seafood place, where we sat on tables close to the street where you could watch the life of the city flow before your eyes). I had not realized that we would do more than eat on the tour; next we went to a couple of music venues. The first was a chill place, then we ended up at the Acoustic Bar (which despite the name was a rockin' place). Oh yeah, drinks were included all night.

The food was excellent and the right amount (not too much, not too little, as can sometimes be a concern with food-oriented tours), the music venues were fun with something for everyone, the driver and guide were friendly and knowledgeable, and the experience of riding through the city on two wheels was unforgettable. I'll be back in Saigon for a couple of months, and I look forward to doing this or another tour from Vespa Adventures again. There are a couple other companies with similar names, but accept no imitators: book a tour from Vespa Adventures--you won't regret it!

review_title: Vespa tour of Ho Chi Minh city
review_text: An exciting and interesting way to see the city from a completely different veiwpoint. The drivers were excellent and safe and the scooters were comfortable well maintained. Our guide was very friendly and enthusiastic and took us to bars and cafes to sample delicious street food as well as local entertainment. This trip was one of the highlights of our holiday and I would recommend it to anyone visiting the city.
Great alternative evening. We were a bit reluctant to take to the roads in HCMC but once onboard thoroughly enjoyed ourselves! Highly recommend.

As part of our Viet Vision Vietnam tour the 'Saigon After Dark' tour was a blast. We're in our 60's and were wondering whether we should get on the back of a vespa in crazy Saigon...and we're so glad we did!
Although a wet night, we were given ponchos and off we went. We visited bars, restaurants and a cabaret lounge, we saw the beautiful city at night and we were returned to our hotel safe and exhilarated.
If in Saigon, do yourself a favor and get on this tour...it was amazing!

review_title: The best part of visiting Saigon!
review_text: Lovely drivers, kept raining but were given big rain coats and my driver always guaranteed I was comfortable. I felt safer on the back of the vespa than I did crossing the road - it was a fabulous experience. Also given a photo of the experience at the end - lovely touch :)

review_title: A night tour of Saigon is a must.
review_text:
After dark Vespa tour an absolute blast. My wife and I recently did this as part of a Wendy Wu tour and was definitely one of the high lights. Ali and her team where fanatics. We felts so safe zapping around the chaotic but amazing Saigon streets. From start to finish the whole night was so well organized from greeting drinks at the Vespa cafe to the final night club stop. All the amazing local food, drinks and night life in between along with so many laughs and amazing sights and thrills this tour is an absolute must when in Saigon
Cheers to the Vespa team. Excellent.

review_title: Awesome night in Ho Chi Minh City, Saigon
review_text: Our night started wet, but that didn't dampen the experience of our time with Vespa Adventures!! Fitted with ponchos, we weaved through the city streets with ease exploring various districts, the city sites and tasting THE most delicious food. We learn how to assemble our dishes and in some cases watch them being prepared. Don't be concerned about what will be on offer as there are just so many options that cater for all tastes.The entertainment was well suited to a broad age group and the freedom of exploring the city by bike was exciting. We visited an acoustic bar for coffee after dinner and a live music bar for drinks. Our group of 4 felt completely safe and we are very grateful for the shared knowledge and enthusiasm shown by our guide Hanh and our drivers Vu and Gia Huy :) This is money well spent on an unforgettable evening.There is nothing to fault here and a long lasting memory is assured. Don't leave this off your list of must do's!!

Best tour of my trip to Vietman. Submerged into the center of the culture, experiencing the high energy of getting around the city to the eclectic foods and drinks to the beautiful and lively entertainment! Out drivers were excellent. Very cautious and courteous. Our tour guide JADEN HO was the best! She answered every question we had and tailored our experience to our taste perfectly. I cannot say enough about this trip and Jaden. If you are planning to do any city tour here, THIS is the one!

I had this tour booked in as part of a work conference, with about 120 people being picked up from 3 different hotels... i was dubious at first, especially as it was raining at the pick up time. My assigned driver (Kyle) was absolutely brilliant, he made me feel right at ease, always helping me with my helmet, handing me a heavy duty poncho for the rain, he had good English, as did our group leader Na. Both were so friendly and positive all evening. We had three stops on the tour at different restaurants and bars, the food was an experience and all very fresh and tasty, the drinks were free flowing. I had a brilliant evening and would strongly recommend this activity whatever your group size.

We were slightly ambiguous about whether the price would be worth it but so so glad we did it! Went with a couple of friends and was joined up with a group of 2 other guys. Felt really well looked after, and it was nice not to be in a massive group tour which is what we'd kind of expected. The food was great, and they control the portions well so you don't end up stuffed after the first restaurant! We absolutely fell in love with the piano, singing and violin cafe, and Jayden our guide was great and let us stay for a few more songs than planned. She was fabulous throughout the whole night, very funny and knowledgeable! The drivers were great as well, we felt very safe with them the whole time.

Such a great way to see the city - we did it with our 7 year old son and we were worried but VA were so helpful and caring. Once you embrace HCM traffic and trust the drivers - you are away! Amazing food, company and Vespa experience - no better way to see the city!
Exciting way to see the city by night and experience some of the best craft beers and food tha Ho Chi Minh city offers

review_title: Best ever way to see Saigon
review_text: Wow! This was the best time ever..... Traveling on a two seater Vespa experiencing the best local food and sites of Saigon was very safe. My driver was extra safe and we rode the busy streets of Saigon and kept us all together in our small group of four. Our tour included 5 stops and our tour guide, Trien explained how dishes are cooked, the balance of flavors and how to eat the Vietnamese way. This tour is for foodies and for those who love the experience of real Vietnamese culture and you don't have to be young to be on the back of a vespa!

We went on the Vespa Adventures A Glimpse of the Mekong tour of the Mekong Delta. It was an amazing experience and a day that I will always remember. Not only was riding the vespas a whole lot of fun, we got to learn so much about the culture and environment of the Mekong. Highly recommended!

What a wonderful experience. From the scooters to the street food, to the entertainment - everything was amazing. Our tour guide was so knowledgeable and we learned so much from this evening. Thoroughly recommend this adventure

We had a great time. The drivers were friendly, safe and did an amazing job of showing us their city from a very different perspective. Finally got an inclination how the traffic system “works”! Food and drinks all delicious and so much of it. Highly recommended and MUCH safer than trying to drive yourself!!!

Me, my mother and sister had the time of our lives! This allowed us to experience the city in a whole new different way, through the streets among the other motorcycle drivers was so much fun! Tasting delicious local foods and exploring cool music venues! A must-do for anyone visiting Saigon!

A memorable night, with 5 stops, 9 courses, cocktails, coffee house, and live band bar.

The Vespa Adventures team definitely has its act together; beginning with your being whisked from your pickup point, securely helmeted, on the back of individual Vespas, with drivers waiting at every stop to take you on to the next delicious event.

Tien was our guide, magically waiting for us at every new stop, (all local favorites, off the beaten tourist path) explaining the location, food preparation, and showing us how to eat, Vietnamese style.

One restaurant specialized in seafood; the next, Vietnamese filled pancakes; a third, dessert at a quiet coffee bar with live music.

You've undoubtedly had some nice dinners in the course of your travels. You've never experienced something like this.

If ever something was worth more than 5 stars, this is it.

Thank you to our guide Ruby and our drivers Hieu, Nhat Chip, Vu and Hoi for taking us around Saigon on the Insiders Tour of Saigon. We had so much fun and learned so much about this fantastic city. It helps us to get our bearings as well as there is so much to see and do here. The whole family loved zooming around the streets as well as learning about the history of the Vietnam War (or American War as it can be known here). We learned so much about the people, food, history and culture of Saigon. Great fun! A must do. We have used Vespa Adventures for three cities all up; Saigon, Hoi An and Hanoi, and recommend each one!

My husband and I booked the Mekong Delta tour and it was amazing! My driver was so kind and very safe. When you watch from the side of the road it looks terrifying, but I was surprised how less chaotic it was on the back of the bike. We had a guide that showed us many thins and shared much about the culture and history of South Vietnam. This was a great experience and would recommend this to those visiting Ho Chi Minh.

This was a blast! Great food and drink, with experienced (very safe) drivers to ride with from place to place. This was an excellent way to get out in the night life of Saigon, see the sights (Saigon is a visually stunning city at night) and sample eateries and local cuisine that would take much longer to find otherwise. I highly recommend Vespa Adventures

We have three boys aged 11, 9 and 6 and took them on the 6pm-10pm Vespa tour of Saigon. OMG how much fun was it to be part of the crazy Saigon riders. Our guide Na was amazing. The food places that we ate at were to die for. Would certainly recommend anyone to do it.

review_title: Great fun night of sight seeing and food while being driven around on 🛵
review_text:
We had such a fun night doing this tour, you traveled from place to place to eat and drink.. all included in the package... tour guides and Vespa drivers/riders, very professional and great communicators...

You can also purchase hats and T shirts at a minimal cost also for great memories 😁 as pictured below 👍

Highly recommend it as it is a really great experience 😁🛵

Would highly recommend the night food tour! Amazing food, drinks and good fun on the vespas. Great service from all staff. Felt extremely safe at all times. Ended the night at 2 bars which was fun. A definite trip to do!

We went on the Ho Chi Minh Night Tour recently and had an amazing night. It's so much fun to get into the craziness of the traffic and all the stops were exceptionally well planned, with delicious food, drinks and entertainment. Our host Katty was great fun and very informative and our drivers did a great job of making us feel comfortable and safe. This was our second Vespa Adventures tour and we will definitely do another when we next visit Vietnam.
Wonderful drivers and a great experience. Really beautiful food, eating with the locals. It was a great way to experience Saigon.

We went with Vespa Adventures on their Craft Beer Tour the first night and had a really fun night with our guide Nicola and drivers Tien and Ty. Felt incredibly safe riding the streets of Saigon with them. Nicola was great fun and we really enjoyed our night out even if some of the beers were very different!! I don't drink beer but I enjoy the food and bars.

The next day we went on a Meekong Delta Tour and really enjoyed this as well. Ride on the little back roads and tracks and through villages, markets and across on a ferry as well. Just touching the edge of the Delta bit we didn't have time to do an overnight trip. The ride was fun and the morning tea and lunch were fantastic. Would recommend this trip to my friends!

review_title: Vespa tour of Ho Chi Min with Dinner and entertainment
review_text: Fantastic night had by us all. Definitely one of the highlights of our journey through Vietnam. An absolute must! Danny our guide and his team of drivers led by Hung were fantastic

review_title: Saigon Craft Beer Tour, a Great tour!
review_text: Had a great tour! I was alone on a business trip and passed the area where this company had several Vespas. I asked what this was and after a good explanation, i was so lucky to get on board Saigon Craft Beer tour right away. I met very nice people from Iceland and Austrailia and the guide Kat was very helpful and knowledgeable. She made the tour very special. Thanks to Kat for a well spent evening!
Would highly recommend Vespa Adventures. Very friendly guide Ruby and the drivers all amazing. A way to see some of Ho Chi Minh.

We had a group of 9 a mix from the US and Taiwan. A four hour tour sounded long but it was a perfect evening. You hit up two local spots for dinner and Katty our fantastic tour guide explained the different foods and how to eat and enjoy. In between stops it's a great experience cruising around the city on a scooter. The third stop was phenomenal and my favorite. It's a secret gem and one you should experience without explanation. The last stop was a club and for those that aren't into "clubs" it was fun as the stage talent was great and engaging!! This is a must do for anyone wanting to experience the city.

We absolutely loved this night out. Our drivers were brilliant - the best way to experience Saigon traffic! Our guide was terrific - we met some great people and ate delicious food. The coffee stop - in a place we would never have found by ourselves - was stunning. Beautiful, atmospheric venue and superb live singing. Cannot recommend this highly enough - it was the best thing about our time in Saigon. Our teenage daughter loved it.

review_title: Vespa Adventures 7 Day Tour – Saigon to Nha Trang - Unforgetable Experience
review_text:
This is a review of the 7 day tour

Day 1

After arriving in Saigon the night before, we were collected on Saturday morning for a tour of the city by 2 riders and taken to Vespa Adventures (VA) HQ – Zoom Bar. This initial ride on the back of the bikes gave us the impression of the apparently (see later comments) chaotic driving in the city. At Zoom we met out tour guide for the day (Lavender) who was lovely and explained what we would be doing that day. On to the back of the scooters again we visited several sites (the burning monk story and monument was very humbling) before coming back for lunch. I have to confess at this point me and my wife were wondering if we’d done the right thing asking to ride our own scooters for the 7 day tour as there appeared no system to how people rode their bikes. Scooters went in the wrong direction, on the wrong side of the road and pulled out in front of you without looking – we honestly thought “what were we thinking?!”
That afternoon after a further small tour, we went to be assed as capable of riding the scooters. Both me and my wife have motorbikes at home in the UK but riding a Vespa (with manual left hand clutch control and gear change) is quite different. My wife couldn’t get on with it so she opted for a twist and go scooter. We then signed our lives away (usual disclaimers) and agreed what we would pay if we damaged the bikes. Having shown we were safe to ride and completed a circuit in the local area, we then went back to our hotel.

That evening we went on the night tour of the city with our new tour guide – Na. Equally nice and friendly, we jumped on the back of the scooters (if you think day riding is worrying, wait till you see how the night ride is) to go to Zoom bar where we met others tourists with VA. Then off to various restaurants and bars (one bar in particular was awesome with beautiful singing and we got ushered in to the front like celebrities!) and it absolutely poured with rain. No problem as ponchos were supplied and it was still warm. After this we went back to our hotel and a beer at the bar next door.

Day 2

We were collected at 7.30 the next day by car to take us to a ferry port to cross a river. There we would start to ride our own bikes!! Once we got on the scooters, it was a great relief to be out of the city, even though scooters were everywhere. We quickly settled in to the pattern of riding for 1-1 ½ hours and then taking a break and we both knew at this point we had done the right thing riding our own scooters. The sky was blue, the sun was hot and all was right in the world..we’d also worked out the road ‘laws’ (anything bigger than you gets right of way regardless of which direction it comes from, you always try to go behind people crossing the road be this on foot or on a scooter, seeing a bike coming onto the road from your right means they won’t look – you are responsible for avoiding them etc.) and it all worked well.

Towards the end of this first day, we had our first (and only) near miss. On a long roughish road, school children were streaming out of a school and seemed to have no road sense at all. They were everywhere and it caused problems for us and locals alike. We slowed down but a scooter avoided a child and nearly crashed into my wife but she avoided it, dropped into a pot hole and bounced around a bit but got through ok.

This was a long day and we got to our hotel about 17.00. It was a nice enough hotel (a little ‘tired’) with a huge suite for a room right by the beach. A few beers and dinner and we were tucked up at 22.00 exhausted but loving it.

Day 3

In the morning we had packed up and were on our way after breakfast. We visited various things including being taken to a little cottage industry where they made rice paper at the rear of the house. The heat was intense where they were cooking the liquid but this was really interesting to see. We also visited a local market that was quite big and seeing how the raw meat was handled made me thankful that I was a pescetarian. It was all hustling and bustling and this was really an experience of local life you probably wouldn’t see on a normal tourist trip (in fact nearly all the places we went had no tourist coaches as they were quite remote or intimate which suited me just fine).

Again we stayed at a very nice hotel right by the sea but this was in a larger tourist area. We went for a walk after dinner and found a local bar that was huge but quite quiet and again indulged ourselves with some local beers.

At this point you may think we are alcoholics but a Vietnamese method of drinking a lager is to place a solid block of ice in the glass and the beer is in a separate tin or bottle. You then add the beer to the ice cold glass and this makes it so refreshing (and slows down the amount of alcohol you actually drink as well). This is a practice I’ve now taken back to the UK and on a hot day it is the best thing ever. This will horrify the purists but I don’t care – it’s a great way to have a beer!

Day 4

Today whilst riding through the countryside we had a little run in with the local Police who were stopping everyone on scooters – particularly tourists. They said to our tour guide that I’d not indicated when I came round a bend (complete nonsense of course) and promptly asked for all my documents. Even though everything was in order, a ‘fine’ was paid after some negotiation and we eventually went on our way. This left a sour taste for me for an hour or so but this is something you have to expect in developing countries where the people and government employees are poor.

We arrived in De Lat where the temperature is much cooler (most days in Vietnam it is 32-34oC), probably about 26oC so this is refreshing. De Lat is a relaxed place with a French influence. The hotel we stayed at was very nice and again a suite like room with balcony was provided which was really nice and an ideal location. Here we would stay for 2 nights.

Day 5

It was a beautiful morning with a clear sky and we were off again. We passed a large group of school children on a parade ground with large flags practising and it was idyllic. We visited the train station with lovely old carriages and a steam train and took lots of pictures.
We were also taken to a coffee farm where we were shown how to properly assess the taste of coffee which was really interesting to do with the different smells and tastes. I had no idea coffee was so complicated.

The heavens opened towards the late afternoon and basically flooded the streets for a few hours. We rested up at the hotel to wait for it to stop which it did later but the sun was gone for the day. We went to dinner with Na and afterwards me and my wife found a bar with a female DJ (this is very common in Vietnam) and sank a few more beers (and blocks of ice).

Day 6

We left De Lat in the morning, rode along next to the lake and off out of the city. For me, this was going to be the best day of the trip. You get on to open roads that are in very good condition (good tarmac) and you start to climb into the mountains. This is just beautiful with lots of Z bends and little traffic and makes for a wonderful ride. Once you reach the top of the mountains, it is even better coming down and you take in some great scenery. Here we got some great pictures and if you have a Go Pro or similar, make sure you’ve got a lot of battery life for this part of the trip.

After this and several stops later you reach the outskirts of Nha Trang. Now, there is a lot of construction going on in Nha Trang and therefore a lot of construction traffic in and around the city. To be honest, this is worse than Saigon. For this reason my wife got on the back of the tour guides Vespa rather than ride herself (yes, you do have this kind of flexibility which is what makes this trip so well supported). My wife’s bike was ridden by one of the support team and in we went. Well, for those of you old enough think ‘Death Race 2000’ and you’ll get the picture. Ok, a slight exaggeration and I actually loved the challenge and happily rode in without a problem; you just need your full attention on the road and everything around you.

We made it to our hotel, washed and changed before going out for the night to an authentic Vietnamese BBQ restaurant with the whole team (tour guide, van driver, mechanic and back up rider) as you normally only have dinner with the tour guide. This was really nice to do.

Day 7

Off on our scooters for the last day for a visit to some sites near or in the city and the day was done. Our Vespa Adventure was over and we’d made it without any problems – phew! Our tour guide Na had been a pleasure for the whole trip along with the rest of the support team.

Summary

To be honest I never want to see a Vespa seat ever again, but I loved every minute of the trip!!

If you really want to see the real Vietnam, you HAVE to do it on a scooter and get out of the city into the country. It was tiring in places (I’m 54 and my wife is 50 although we are quite fit) but its more than manageable for almost anyone.

Hopefully this review has planted the seed of thought to do this trip yourself – I hope so and if you do plan such a trip, Vespa Adventures are the team to do it with. The support is fantastic and you are looked after so well, you never feel there’s an issue the team can’t deal with. Everyone is friendly and supportive and we would give the whole organisation 10/10!

Thanks for the memory Vespa Adventures; it’s one we’ll never forget!!!!!

Top Tips
1. Sunscreen - the sun in Vietnam is incredibly hot, especially as you go further north during the trip. With the wind in your hair, it's easy to forget its strength. After burning my arms on the second day from not applying enough cream and wearing at shirt, I had to wear a long sleeve top for 2 days to let it cool down.
2. Pace – you will go at a pace that is safe for the slowest rider. It was only me and my wife on this trip and she is a less confident rider than me so the speed was slower than I'm used to but I accept that. If you join a mixed group, you have to accept that the speed may be slow. To be honest, the speed rarely went above 35mph due to the road conditions as pot holes seemed to appear out of nowhere.
3. International Driving Permit – you MUST get one of these. Less important for VA, but definitely needed when you get stopped by the Police (like we did). If you don't have it, expect a big fine, your bike confiscated or both.

My wife and I had the best ever afternoon seeing the sights of Saigon and landmarks in other Districts throughout the city. Sitting on the Vespa you can truly experience the sights and smells of Saigon and surrounding districts. We saw some of the usual tour highlights of the city, but also unique areas such as Flower Market, site of the burning monk in 1976 and Ong Bon Temple (district 5) for example. We spent 5 hrs. riding, listening, sightseeing and lunch with periodic drink stops. The guide and two drivers. They were informative, polite, attentive and accommodating. They were the best. One of the most creative and best tours of a city I have been a part of. Well worth the experience. Dare to do it, you will not be disappointed! Lunch was at there restaurant Zoom! It was delicious!

We did 3 trips with these guys 1 in Cambodia and 2 in Saigon. We loved all of them and never felt worried sitting on the back of the Vespas even in peak hour in Saigon, what a buzz!! the food was great on all the tours and scenery was really interesting in all places. the guides made the trip and had so much information to share and made it so much fun! Would very much like to do more if/when we come back.

One of the best experiences we had on our Southeast Asia adventure. By far a great time was had by all. Our guide, Kit Kat, couldn't have been better. She really showed us a good time with great rides, good food and great drinks. I recommend that anyone, of any age, put this on your "must see & do" list......
The tour was amazing, we had a great guide and driver. The selection of breweries we're on point and very good.

We had an amazing adventure, my husband and I were picked up at our hotel by our Vesper drivers and rode through Ho Chi Minh City in the traffic to Cafe Zoom where all groups left from. From here we went to an amazing seafood restaurant then back to district 1 to another restaurant for Vietnamese Pancake. I'm not going to spoil the surprises of where else we went but it was fabulous food, great fun on the back of a Vesper and so much more. Our local friend Vy explained everything and chattered to us about everything, she was very interesting. If you are 18 or 65 you are going to have the ride of your life.

My daughter and I chose the country side tour (afternoon tour) in Hoi An. We had a wonderful time with our tow great guides Phi and Vu. Amazing team! Fun, available to answer questions, full of knowledge. Thanks to them we made a deep dive into the Vietnamese culture, they made our trip so interesting. They were happy to take time for us to explain, to translate, to help us to have the best experience! We highly recommend this tour and this team.

I have also experienced the Ho Chi Minh night tour several times when I had some friends or relatives visiting us in Saigon, and I loved each of them.

On the spur of the moment I called Vespa adventures number and arranged for the tour for the following morning. At 8am prompt, my guide Tam arrived and off we went for nearly a full day of ferries, city & countryside riding, food & drink, markets and some unexpected events thrown in.
To say Tams riding and control of the Vespa was excellent would be and understatement, first class!
The sights, sounds and smells of the Mekong delta were amazing, just sit back and take it all in.
Even in the event of a rear puncture in the middle of nowhere, Tam found a garage and within 15mins we were enroute again like nothing happened.
Would I recommend Vespa adventures when in HCMC, without a doubt and I look forward to my next trip sometime this year.

review_title: Great Food, Great Guide, Great Tour!
review_text: This was our 2nd vespa adventures tour, having done one previously in Hanoi. Although Hanoi was a good tour, this one beats it by far! We were collected from our hotel at 6pm and taken to the meeting point to meet our guide - Lora and the other couple who were on our tour. Here you had drinks and appetizers whilst you get to know each other. Lora was brilliant, her English was advanced and she was a bubbly energetic and lively guide - she was chuffed when we told her it was our honeymoon, and the other Ozzy couple Paul & Jo were on their 25th wedding anniversary holiday. We headed to the 2nd stop, an eatery serving mainly seafood, Lora ate with us telling us all about the food, how to eat it and the local area. We got to try crabs, muscles and clams. As much drink (wine, beer, soft and cider) as you like which is diffetent from the hanoi guide as he limits us to one drink per place. while we were here and chatting the heavens opened Vietnam style! In seconds the roads were flooding! Not to worry though as the vespa tour provides big overcoats for you - and the rain thunder and lightning adds to the experience! Driving through the city streets was an experience in itself! The are no traffic rules, mopeds everywhere! But you can relax and enjoy the atmosphere knowing your drive has got you in safe hands! The drive over the big new bridge is brilliant and if you're lucky enough to have an English speaking driver which I did then they point out interesting places enroute. Our 3rd place was a proper local eatery! We had the traditional southern shrip pancakes, the deep fried spring rolls and summer spring rolls - Lora showed us again how to eat everything using the lettuce leaves and herbs to make delicious parcels. Our 4th stop was to a hidden coffee shop, this place was fantastic! It's all candle lit and you order your drinks before you go in as there is a live singer with pianist and violinist but they don't use and mic so you can hear the true tones of their voice it was a brilliant place to relax, made even more special when the singer singled myself and Sara out in a shout out saying we were on our honeymoon and then she dedicated a song to us whilst Lora appeared with a huge cake with a fresh personal message on! The vespa tour didn't have to do any of this for us and Lora had only been told about 2hrs ago it was our honeymoon. It's these personal touches that make it an unforgettable experience! Our final stop of the night was to an acoustic bar with a live band on. Again as many drinks you like and another point which makes it different to the hanoi tour is that come 10pm in Hanoi we were rushed back to our bikes saying the tour had ended. But here we were having that much fun soaking up the atmosphere and having a good laugh it wasn't until 10.50pm we all decided to depart! At the end we were given a souvenir photo of us,Lora and our drivers as well as the discount for future bookings in other cities - but to be honest I don't think any of them will beat this one!

Amazing day yesterday on a Vespa- tasting real coffee, seeing the countryside of Hoi An including being invited into people's homes to sample rice wine, taste pancakes, make noodles and eat with them. Thank you Onion Phi and Tom for an experience we will never forget. 🇻🇳10/10

review_title: Such a cool thing to experience
review_text: Recommend to anyone traveling to Hoi An to have a go at.Vespa Adventures tour guides Onion Pi and Tom could not be more highly praised for their top effort at making it as pleasurable as possible.Happy to slightly modify the norm to suit the customer.We learned more than we would of thought.Local insight a valuable thing.Have never met more accomodating families welcoming us into their village/homes to share customs and knowledge.Photos ,food,history and safely returned to hotel.A cracker 4 hours spent.

This was great fun! I was a bit apprehensive at first, with the heavy traffic on the road,
but my driver Due, was very experienced, so I started to relax and enjoy myself.
Our tour guide Tien, did a really great job of explaining everything to us and I loved visiting the local restaurants. The food was delicious.
Overall, it was very enjoyable and I would recommend it to everyone.
