Great fun, very safe and found some really interesting food stops. The highlight has to be the music venues - who knew Saigon had such a good music scene. We were with a lovely group of people and didn't want the evening to end!

review_title: Do a tour with these guys!
review_text:
Without a shadow of a doubt, this is one of the best tours we have ever done anywhere (and we have been traveling for most of the last 12 months).

We are backpackers on a bit of a budget but wanted to splash out for this having seen that they offered a craft beer tour - I am a big craft beer fan. The professionalism of the company bowled me over from my first interactions with them. They have every last detail thought out and made the booking process very easy.

We were picked up from our hotel on time by two great drivers on awesome vintage vespas. My driver Nghia was brilliant, he was so friendly and chatted to me a lot, he was a skilled driver and made the ride so much fun! I've never experienced anything like whizzing around the streets of Ho Chi Minh like this.

I knew the beer would be good having discovered that HCMC has a great up and coming craft beer scene but I didn't expect the food to be equally as awesome. We got SEVENTEEN beers to try across 5 venues, each paired with delicious food. The beer was excellent and would be thoroughly enjoyable even for the most committed craft beer fans/snobs like myself.

Our guide was Truc and she was perfect. She was friendly and kept us laughing the whole night - she really made this experience for us. Thank you so much Truc, we really did have such an incredible time.

review_title: Saïgon by night with Vespa Adventures
review_text:
Family trip with "Voyageurs du Monde" (French Agency) and Vespa Adventures.
Beginning of our trip in Vietnam.

Really exciting going through the streets of Saigon with what seems like the other 2 million mopeds. Stopping at regular intervals for food was a good idea but food provided left a lot to be desired. We were told not to eat before the tour but had to eat at the end. If you could do this tour without the food and stop at bards instead it would be a 10/10 experience.

review_title: The best way to see Saigon!!!
review_text: This was suggested to us by our Hotel Manager. He said that it was the best thing that he had done since he got to Vietnam himself and I'd have to say i'd have to agree with him. Myself and my wife were on honeymoon in Vietnam and had traveled from Hanoi all the way down to Saigon and did many different things. I'd have to say that this was one of the most enjoyable things we did. a great way to see the city, from a locals viewpoint, zipping through the city on the back of a vespa in evening traffic with the bonus of food and drink along the way. A must do if you are in the region!

review_title: The best night out in Saigon
review_text: The Vespa night out was fantastic. The riders were very safe and careful to ensure we enjoyed ourselves. Our host, Lunar, was fantastic. She took us to local restaurants and helped to prepare our meals so we could make the most of sampling the local cuisine. The food was amazing and there was plenty of it. Beautiful cocktails capped off a wonderful evening.

review_title: Best thing to do in Vietnam
review_text: Visiting Vietnam for the second time we (again) did the Vespa food night tour...because we loved it so much last time. Two years after our first experience I can honestly say that it has only gotten BETTER! Such fun, great drivers and wonderfully orchestrated by my old friend Na (who I originally met in Hoi An 2 years ago) it was so fabulous to see her again, like seeing a long lost friend. My group of 17 had the best night... they loved every minute. We then did the countryside tour in Hoi An - a completely different experience. I highly recommend that you do both. Thank you Na and Vespa Adventures.., we will definitely be. Back!

My wife and i went on the night time Vespa tour.A little scary at first on the back of the scooter in the middle of the traffic but i soon got used to it Went to some nice little cafes to eat.Finished the evening at a little music place that a tourist would never find😊 I will do it again when we go back.

review_title: Great fun - but had to close my eyes at times!
review_text: This was really good fun. The traffic is horrendous, but our Vespa drivers were very skilled. The food was interesting - not sure about the jumping chicken though.

Fantastic tour , Katty our host and the Vespa riders were excellent , great food and drink , lots of Laughs , interesting sights and live music to end .
Riding through Saigon at night with friends through back streets taking in the atmosphere was a great experience.
Photos forwarded to us before we got home, tour was very professional yet chilled and relaxed at the same time.
Excellent !

On 18th August we were picked up at our hotel by Trung (N) and Truong - two lovely young men and transported on the back of their Vespa's to meet Jaden Ho at a local cafe. Unfortunately the weather had turned very wet but we still had a great time wizzing through the streets of Saigon, stopping regularly to sample local fare - sometimes with our eyes closed. The whole experience was exhilarating and would encourage any visitors to do this.

What an exciting way to experience Ho Chi Minh city, we feel like the whole city was moving with us. Our guide and driver were very accommodating, very friendly and knowledgeable,. We felt comfortable and safe all day.
The Vespa adventures in Saigon is a truly unmissable experience! You really get a sense of the city. I will always remember this trip fondly and I strongly recommend this to anyone visiting Vietnam!
Fun fun fun. Plenty of drinks and heaps of food!! Great experience. Good way to see the city too. Highly recommend

review_title: A great night on a Vespa tasting local street food
review_text: The Street Food Vespa tour in Saigon was fantastic. Its one of the best tours we have ever done. At the beginning I thought it was going to be very touristy but they have managed to arrange it that you don't feel like you are part of a big group. You arrive at different destinations at different times to the others. The guide, Truc, and drivers were so friendly and Truc went out of her way to ensure we had a fantastic evening. The food and venues were really great and you visit restaurants that the locals go to. I especially enjoyed Seafood Street and the coffee house that we visited to listen to local musicians. I would definitely recommend this tour.

review_title: The Most Awesome Fun Vespa Adventure
review_text: Fantastic Tour, well organized, great food, great drivers, fantastic host - did the trip with a group of 11 and we all were raving about it for days. One of the best things we did in Saigon! Recommend it to anyone who enjoys a bit of adventure. It was sooooo much fun in the rush hour traffic.

review_title: Truly wonderful food and ride experience
review_text:
Had a great night even though it rained. Ponchos on and away to the next stop complete with a plastic glass of wine.
Highly recommend this adventure.
Nice Trip! I Enjoyed it so much! Drivers and tour guides are very accommodating. This is recommendable to others. =)
We really enjoyed the tour and it was great to ride in the traffic. Felt very safe. Food was very good and we loved the place we went to for coffee and heard the singers.

If you are in HCMC this tour is a must, to be part of the chaotic Saigon traffic on the back of a Vespa is such an amazing experience, the drivers are very experienced and very friendly, they make us all feel very comfortable at all times. The restaurants and bars that we went to were again such a great experience, they certainly aren't places we would find just wondering the streets. I totally recommend this to anyone who is traveling to HCMC.
We had the time of our lives, best fun ever & believe it or not we felt safe on the roads. Definitely a must when in Saigon.

review_title: Fantastic tour- highlight of Vietnam trip
review_text:
Absolutely amazing trip.
Once you have got past the nerves of being on the back of a Vespa in a city of around 10 million bikes, you will soon begin to enjoy yourself! Food is amazing, the company is fantastic and you will visit some of the most romantic, fun and memorable places of your life! Nguyen our guide was amazing and so knowledgable, friendly and funny. Highly recommend trip which has left us wanting to return to Vietnam!
What a fantastic experience , one of the highlights of the holiday . Great food, lovely staff and the only way to see Saigon.

It was great, there were 3 people on the tour which was a good number. The guide gave us interesting information, my Vespa driver was very friendly and smiley! The lunch was appropriate and I enjoyed the company of the two other punters whom I didn't know.It was a novel way to see around Saigon and I would definitely recommend to people. I enjoyed the street / flower market and tasted the cakes made by the local lady on the roadside! Job well done!
this tour was well worth the money, apart from being on the scooters we had several stops - rather like a progressive dinner party -and what a party we had.
Despite it raining most of the time, this was one of the best parts of the holiday - go for it....it was great fun

review_title: The best way to discover Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: By visiting Ho Chi Minh City on a vespa, you will discover the city from a citizen perspective. Moreover, the Vespa Adventures Team member will do everything to make your journey memorable. They will bring a local taste into your trip wether in the locations you will be visiting or in terms of food and drinks. This team loves their city and they like to share it.

We had a large group of coworkers from around the globe for a conference and everyone really enjoyed the entire experience. The drivers were all great, very safe. The points of interest we visited were also wonderful.

Tien (Mr t) was the best guide i ever had. He made the Vespa Tour really perfect.
He showed us everthing perfectly
Highly recommend. My wife and I had an amazing time. Extremely well thought out and our local friend Truc made the experience wonderful.

This tour was a total blast in every sense. We only had one night in Ho Chi Minh so it was a great way to get a feel of the city and to experience delicious food and a couple of fun clubs. Highly recommended.
The best thing we did during our holiday. Was an amazing experience as to how the locals live & loved the local food!,,

This tour was an absolutely fantastic experience. As a solo traveler, I saw parts of Saigon that I otherwise would never have seen. The food was fantastic and the music bars were great fun. We had very heavy rain the night of our tour but the drivers were safe, professional and fun. I highly recommend.

Fantastic experience and a great way to see the city.
Definitely recommend this to everyone. All staff were very friendly and took great care on the roads.

review_title: Great way to see Hoh Chi Minh!
review_text:
Highly recommend this tour, myself and my husband did it recently on our honeymoon and was great.
We had a great group, got to see lots of Hoh chi minh and cool little stop off points that we definitely wouldnt have found on our own.
Our tour guide was really knowledgable and had perfect english and the drivers were great at weaving through the insane moped traffic of Hoh Chi Minh
it rained all the time we were on it and it was still quality
Highly recommend!

We loved our vespa tour. It was a wonderful way to see the city and all the food we got to taste was delicious. It was great to visit out of the way bars/cafes that we never would have found on our own.

This Tour was Superbly Organized and Safety Was a Highlight of The Company. The Tour was a highlight of my first trip to Saigon.We booked for a Two Hour Tour and extended it to Four Hours,I'd suggest that people do the same,what a trusted group of people they were.

...even in the rain. Felt perfectly safe and well taken care of. The meals were sumptuous- delicious seafood, wonderfull dress wraps and rolls. And the Musik on the cafe for dessert - yummy coconut ice cream for us - beautiful. Such talent. A wonderful way to spend an evening in Ho Chi Minh City. Don't miss it!

We had a fantastic experience with Vespa Adventures. We were taken around many different types of local restaurants that we would have never found ourselves. This was one of the main highlights of our two week trip!

This was the highlife of my time in Ho Chi Minh. The Vespa drivers were friendly and great drivers. Our guide Sue was a wealth of knowledge and made our time so much fun. Was amazing getting right in the thick of the traffic and the places we went to were great. Definitely recommend this tour 👍

review_title: Fantastic! An essential activity in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: This is a must do activity when in Ho Chi Minh! The guides are excellent, you will be taken to amazing local restaurants away from the main tourist area. Vespa Adventures really do have very cool vintage Vespas. The drivers are both careful and considerate, avoiding bumps in the road, making sure you are safe. We had some rain during our trip, not a problem as we were each given rain capes. Certainly the best thing we did in HCM!

We went on the Saigon by night tour with guide Ai. She was delightful and insightful . What an invigorating evening! My smile muscles hurt! The food was sensational and the music locations were awesome. Can not recommend highly enough!!
This was so much fun and a great way to visit some authentic eating places/cafes and bars. Ruby is an excellent host and very informative and the drivers are safe and fun. Excellent value for money.

We had a great / fantastic tour with them! The scooter drivers are professional, and the tour guide was awesome cool very educated with the history of Ho Chi Minh and Vietnams culture in general! The restaurants they took us are amazing with yummy food! The bar was great too with a wonderful band.. This tour gave us a beautiful vibe and we saw the city clearly! Thank you Vespa team for the great job! We will def do it again!
Fantastic experience. Handree was a fantastic tour guide. The sites were great and a privilege to eat in your district. Thank you Handree

We didn't really know what to expect from our night time tour of HCMC but it exceeded all our expectations! The initial 15 minutes after our hotel pick up was just crazy and terrifying but the drivers were brilliant and we soon got used to speeding through the crazy traffic and it was fantastic! Our guide Vy was brilliant, amazing English and sense of humor and happily changed our last stop from a bar to ice cream hot pot! All the food stops were delicious, including frogs, clams, omelette and there was so much food you don't need to eat the first! Any choice of drinks included and the acoustic bar we went to was quite special. What a great night and worth every penny - would have loved to do it again. The drivers even gave us a photo as a souvenir and such a nice touch.

I was in Vietnam on holiday and our tour was booked in with Vespar Adventures and it was the most amazing night tour. The young girl i went with was just beautiful. So friendly and considerate and i felt very safe. we had food stops and ended up in a bar with music. It was the best night I have had for a very long time. Highly recommend it as a must if you are in Ho Chi Minh City.

review_title: Best thing we did in Vietnam
review_text:
Did the night time food and drink tour - absolutely brilliant.

I could never imagine being on a Vespa in the HCMC traffic, this is the way to do it.

Food, drink and music thrown in too.

Wonderful way to combine adventure, culture, and exploration. Exhilarating but not too scary. HCMC is always on and night time is the right time to explore it. Our drivers were great and our guide was so engaging. I highly recommend them.

This is a fascinating way to experience the city. Our drivers and guide were excellent, the drivers were cautious and drove very defensively which is reassuring considering how everyone else drives here! The guide was brilliant, engaging and knowledgeable. We saw parts of the city we would otherwise never have seen. A fantastic experience I would definitely recommend!

We got picked up on time on the vespas by our drivers and set off through the streets of HCM.

The vespas are super cool and the tour guide and drivers were great!

The food wasn't that good but the overall experience was so fun.

The tour guide made it really I formative and riding on the bikes is just really cool.

I highly recommend this tour!!!

review_title: A safe way to experience the manic Vietnamese traffic!
review_text: We had lots of fun, were well looked after, ate some delicious and interesting food and heard some interesting music too.

What to say that hasn't been said in other reviews..........we will remember this for a very long time. It was great to be whizzing along the streets, and being just ever so slightly scared (though Vespa drivers seemed pretty competent t be fair).

Yes it is expensive ($93 current list price per person), and it is rather contrived (you go to places where there are a lot of other Vespa Adventures customers, so you will not discover some hidden gem that no-one else knows about). But it lasts 4.5 hours, and is so much fun! Even the dreadful rock band in the club at the end was somehow enjoyable........perhaps because we had plenty to drink (and generally, unless you are a world record-breaking trencherman, you will be very well fed and watered over the 5 different venues you visit).

And, we got to taste some things we wouldn't have risked from a streetfood vendor (when you see them "washing up" in filthy water all over the city) like mussels and frog.

Tuan / Eric our guide was hilarious and great company too, which only added to the experience.

Never dreamed I would be sitting on the back of a Vespa in the chaotic traffic in Ho Chi Min. Had a fantastic night even in the rain . Brilliantly organized fantastic food & wonderful live music . Would thoroughly recommend to all ages

Hop on, buckle your chin strap and prepare for a once in a lifetime experience!!
It was off the charts fun.
Na was our leader and she is fun, fun fun.
Book this trip!!!
Spent the night cruising on theVespa eating some fabulous food and visiting authentic Vietnamese coffee house for some music with the locals .Definately would recommend

Did the 'Saigon by Night" tour with our 2 teenage daughters. None of us had been on a Vespa before and having spent a few days in Ho Chi Min and Hue already, were apprehensive about the chaos of the city traffic and the way locals drove! However, our drivers were exceptional and we felt very safe at all times. Great concept for a tour and lovely to see the city in its 'night clothes' all lit up. We visited local food markets (managing to cater for special food requirements), a bar with singers and a more lively band at the end. We even contended with torrential rain (the Vespa drivers were well equipped with waterproofs for all and had a slick routine to get you togged up and on to the next venue). At each venue, you are met by your allocated guide who talks you through the local customs and gives you interesting insights into Vietnam life. The tour runs like clockwork - we all really loved it and highly recommend it. A novel way to see the many corners of the city.
Great fun charging about Saigon on the back of a Vespa. Felt surprisingly safe. Teenage daughters loved it. Highlight of holiday.

review_title: Fantastic night even in the rain
review_text: We booked this as part of our Vietnam tour and we are so pleased we did. We were picked up at our hotel and whisked around the city on Vespa scooters for an evening of eating, drinking, dodging the traffic and live music. It was a totally brilliant night for parents and two teenagers alike and we had perma-grins on our faces all night. Couldn't recommend it enough

We booked a private trip for a group of 4. All of us were a little unsure of traveling on motorbikes at night, but I have to say that it is very safe and I was really at ease. The moving lines of motorbikes are like a wildly orchestrated musical piece that comes together with precision. At no time while in Vietnam did I observe any road rage. We could learn something from this! Everybody calmly goes about their business and gets there in the end! We met Lunar our host at Zoom Café for a drink while she explained how our evening would go while we all exchanged a little bit of our culture, we were then on our way to many different eating places and sampled some craft beer as well. The most enjoyable part for me was tasting the Vietnamese pancakes and learning what to put with them and how to wrap it all together. I enjoyed this food so much and felt very comfortable ordering this through out our trip thanks to sampling this on our Vespa foodie tour, There were some really good local places that you might never come across if you didn't do the tour. Food was very generous. Lunar was a great guide, made for a good companion. Also a big thank you to the boys who drove the Vespa's, always making sure we were safe, and navigating through the traffic mayhem. Definitely a really enjoyable fun night out and great way to see the city of Ho Chi Minh.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Vietnam
review_text: Exhilierating and fascinating tour of Ho Chi Min City which included being taken off the beaten track to try delicious street food and some very special music venues. My teenage children all loved it - as did I! Friendly and very organized guides too.
Fun to do and well organized! Visited some nice places to eat and the staff was really helpful, communicative and pleasant. Must do if you can.
wear your mask for the dust,great way to see the city,the trip was excellent and very well organized.we got lunch to start in a very nice place to e with great food and the drivers were very polite
Great experience. Great people. Felt safe all the time. Would highly recommend to our friends and family.
Worth the money. A great experience. Staff are nice and friendly and cater to all diet types. so much fun.

review_title: Great way to get to know HCMC
review_text: We did a nightlife tour and the taste of Mekong. The night tour was fantastic, got out of district 1 to see more of the city, food was great, felt very safe on the bikes. highlight was the Vietnamese cafe with live music where we enjoyed coffee & ice cream and listened to some soulful sounds then onto a fun bar with live band. The Mekong trip was interesting getting out to the south of the city into rural landscape, glad for a cushioned seat! Nan our guide was very knowledgeable, the market place seafood snacks were so fresh & tasty, and the lunch in floating restaurant was awesome too. The older gents who drove us did a wonderful job getting us around & through traffic, road works, rural tracks & a down pour! All part of the experience. Highly recommend this company and would use again on our return trip to Vietnam!
This was an awesome way to see and experience Saigon at night. The guide was wonderful, drivers safe and fun, food out of this world and entertainment a blast. We loved it!

review_title: Vespa Adventures Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon)
review_text:
One of the best things I did in Vietnam and I was there for three weeks traveling from Ho Chi Minh City in the south to Sapa in the north.

I am 56 years old' 187cm tall and over 100kg and these guys rode with me on the back in complete safety.

We saw things on our tour that many tourists would not see, traveling through a variety of districts.

Highly recommended,
A great way to see the city and delicious food!! Host and Driver's were super nice and fun! It is a must do!!

review_title: Brilliant night. The best tour in Vietnam!
review_text: We loved this tour. Fun, informative, interesting and value for money. We especially loved the end of tour visit to local bars that showcased local singers. Thanks for an awesome night.

One of the highlights of our 10 days in Vietnam (of which there were many). From the pick-up at our hotel to the drop off 4 hours later this was a fun packed adventure. Great food on the way round and a very 'different' way to see Ho Chi Minh City. Worth every minute.

It was an awesome adventure. Driving on the back of the vespa, weaving in and out of the traffic. Stopping for food and drinks on the way. Eating like a local. Enjoying 2 stops with life entertainment catering for the westerners. Our guide and scooter drivers were the best. Will definitely do this again. Highly recommended.

review_title: Thoroughly enjoyed the experience and would highly recommend it. I feel safe in the hands of my driver.
review_text: It was awesome to be part of all the chaos on the road and I was amazed at how well it all flowed. I would do it again!

As an experienced Vespa rider it was great to get the opportunity to ride solo on the countryside excursion. It was great to see rural life first hand, and some of the stops were excellent, but the condition of some of the roads we were taken on meant you spent more time looking for pot holes than glancing at the surrounding scenery.
That said, it's probably hard to get to the rural stops without going on these tracks.

Loved every aspect of our night tour (as did our usually ultra cynical teenagers) and will never forget it. Eric our host was fabulous, the drivers utterly professional and the stop off points brilliantly chosen. An authentic rather than sugar coated version of Saigon. We were properly looked after by everyone we came into contact with. Worth every penny.
What a fabulous night! Great fun, friendly drivers and excellent tour guide. We loved every moment and would thoroughly recommend this tour to everyone.

review_title: Saigon sightseeing from the back of a bike
review_text: Saigon is home to 8 million mopeds and motorbikes, so a ride round town on the back of one is definitely the best way to get a local's eye view. Vespa Adventures provides you with a driver to scoot you from one location to another, passing the main sights in the center of town. There are frequent stops, for drinks and HUGE meals, when you are joined by a second guide. My guide joined me at restaurants and live music venues and was very friendly, knowledgeable and chatty. I had a great night and recommend their tour to any visitors.

review_title: Best Way to See Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
I've been in the region for work these last few weeks, and decided to sneak away to Vietnam for a quick weekend in Ho Chi Minh city. Because I only had 2 full days, I wanted to make sure I could fit in as much as possible in a short period of time.
On day 1 I did the Vespa Adventures tour and am grateful I did. I saw everything the city had to offer in a 4 hour blur from the back of a Vespa. You quickly learn that is the main mode of transportation for locals, and you really get a feel for the electricity of the city as you weave in and out of traffic.
We hit more than several locations, and our guide was fantastic. She had a good grasp of the history, and a passion for what she showed us. Having finished the tour, and after a pretty decent lunch included with the tour, I had a grasp of what this city had to offer, and also where I wanted to swing back to before I left. (the market, the War Remnants Museum, etc).
Thanks to Adventure tours for making my Vietnam experience a great one.

This was a HIGHLIGHT of our Vietnam trip from north to south. Brilliantly run, fantastic guide, lovely drivers, made you feel very safe. Lots of drinks at each stop and the food - with everywhere in Vietnam it just keeps coming! Best food we had in HCMC as we were taken to local spots, not tourist traps. Loved the music stops, both the piano bar and the rock bar. We also heard from our guide about how karaoke is popular in Vietnam and heard a hilarious man singing (badly) when we were eating - all part of an amazing local flavour of the city.

Our kids 18 and 13 loved every minute of the vespas - they were smiling broadly every ride and we certainly felt we got a lot of riding in with 5 stops on the tour. Such fun being part of the madness that is Vietnamese scooter-packed cities! Great touch of the photos given to you too.

My only slight wobble was that my husband found my vespa has no rear light which worried me a bit (however this is hardly unusual in Vietnam!) and my driver did apologise.

DON'T MISS THIS AMAZING TOUR

review_title: Loved the Ho Chi Minh night tour!!
review_text:
Our travel agent recommends this tour. We were a bit nervous after observing the traffic in Ho Chi Minh City but decided to go for it. We are so glad we did!! We had the best time. Our drivers were outstanding and made us feel safe the whole time. At the beginning of the ride I was grabbing the handle bar so tightly, and by the second stop I was so relaxed that I was holding on loosely with only one hand.
Our hostess was kind and friendly, and we enjoyed all of the stops. We liked that the stops were all authentic spots for locals. We loved trying the various foods and then enjoyed relaxing at the two music venues. We are so glad that we got to experience the craziness of the Ho Chi Minh streets on the Vespas. A night that we'll always remember!!

We did a last minute booking and although it was raining we managed to get around to several great eating places and didn't get very wet at all. Really loved the experience of riding on a Vespa in the Saigon traffic. Felt very safe. Also visited great night time music spots and the singing and entertainment was excellent. A must do tour.

review_title: "A fantastic way to see everyday life in Vietnam"
review_text:
I would highly recommend the morning Countryside & Islands Vespa tour operated out of Hoi An. My wife and I had a fantastic time riding around on the back of Vespas with our ever attendant drivers. Communication was also no issue, as our guide Vinh spoke excellent English. It was great to experience real village life, meeting local families and seeing how they live. Zipping around the back laneways and crossing the bamboo bridge will always remain with us. We learn a lot about Vietnam's past and how different aspects have shaped their lives.

This is also a 'hands on' tour, with a chance to make rice noodles and laughing at ourselves while trying to weave a sleeping mat. And then there was the coffee roasting place - wow!! Fantastic coffee, but watching the owner pour coffees was a work of art.

Thanks Vinh, Vu, Dinh, Thanh & Bang for such a great experience - we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. And another big thank you to the Italian couple (M & S) who also enjoyed the tour with us - you were great company.

If you want a great time with excellent guides, I can definitely recommend Vespa Adventures in Hoi An.

review_title: Top here in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Our guide was very pleasant & informative with great company, great food & entertainment! Would do it again in a flash!

Fantastic group "foodie" tour (with six other people) around Saigon city. Great feeling to be in amongst it on the back of a scooter driven confidently and safely through very busy Saigon traffic and stopping off at a variety of food and music venues along the way. An absolute highlight of our stay in the city.

review_title: A "Must Do" attraction for Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Excellent tour. Essential if you want to really experience the sights, sounds & tastes of Ho Chi Minh City. Visits the street food stalls you want to visit but will never find on your own, with some great live music thrown in. Excellent, English speaking guide and scooter drivers. Highly recommended.

I will recommend this tour for all the people we want to visit the Mekong delta, avoid to travel in a boat or a bus full of people. Our tour guide Miggi and the driver were really friendly and they drove us into the daily activity and life of the people leaving in the Mekong delta. I have always felt saved during the tour and on the Vespa is a perfect way to see the hidden spot of the countryside.
It cost more compared with other tour but the quality is definitely high!

What an amazing must do experience!!! Had some serious doubts about this experience but so glad I went through with it. Our guide was super friendly and a wealth of information. When we explained that a few of the stops doubled up with another tour we completed, he took us to some different places instead! Being on the back of the Vintage Vespa was a lot of fun and an interesting way to see the real life of Vietnam!

our guides picked us up at our hotel on old scooters (way cool!) then to a small bar for drinks and then more riding and more drinks and plenty of food. I enjoyed this event completely. the tour company spared no expenses in the quality of our food and drinks all evening. The scooter ride was as exciting as a roller coaster ride(if you've been to Vietnam, you understand how scary the driving scene is). I very much enjoyed also the performers at the last bar we went to. they were very talented. my favorite was our guide, "mai li". spunky and full of information about the beautiful city

Great fun being taken to wonderful food places, bars, coffee & jazz musician hole-in-the-wall places we would never have found on our own. The Vespas (& drivers) were really good. The Guide was fantastic! So much fun & so much food. Absolutely recommend it.
From time of pickup to drop off our whole family had huge smiles on our faces would definitely recommend this adventure!
The Vespa tour is really capable of showing you a side of Saigon you would never see if you were just walking around. Really fun seeing all the parts of the city, and the food was fantastic
Fabulous night, Ai and her team were wonderful. Enjoyed every aspect Vespas, street food and music venues. Would highly recommend! For young and old

As German I was a bit sceptic in the beginning about safety etc. But everything was perfect, the drivers were very skillful, very easy. The tour was just amazing. The real Vietnam! Thank you so much and best greetings from Munich, Germany

This tour was booked by a friend, therefore had little information and probably no idea on what we were about to do. Probably also a little hesitant about the fact we were riding around on the back of a Vespa in a hectic City. Everything about Vespa Adventures was amazing, the guides, the drivers - we actually felt safe. And the food was amazing. Even dropped us at Carmen Bar instead of our hotel.....Thank you and would highly recommend.
Absolutely brilliant, a great night out where can experience the local food, beverage and traffic all while on a Vespa scooter. Great tour guide..

The only true way to experience Ho Chi Minh City - submerged in the insane traffic! I was a Vespa novice and hated the idea of ​​riding one. My friend who lives in the city insists that I give it a go. Our guide Tien and my driver Duong knew this and reassured me. It was a wonderfully exhilarating experience!!! And that was only the ride! The food and drinks provided were in such quantities that no one was anything but stuffed! We finished the night at a night club where the female lead singer had the best rock voice I have heard. Our motley group came from all over the world and we really enjoyed each other company. If you go to Ho Chi Minh City this tour is a MUST!!
Very exciting and varied 4 hour vespa tour of Saigon as soon as we arrived. Got a really good great taste of life in Saigon. Thoroughly recommend!

My wife & I absolutely enjoyed the countryside & the drivers were professional and well mannered...

They just took care of us ,,,

From start to finish this was a great evening.
Whizzing through the traffic on a scooter was exciting and the places we were taken to, we would never have found on our own. Great food, great live music - fantastic!

review_title: young Driverin with good old Vespa
review_text: Restaurants are not good for European People, more Lifeevents are better. The last Event were the best .

review_title: Great Experience / A highlight of Vietnam for my wife and I
review_text: This was very fun. There was a bit of shock involved for my wife and I at first. Once we got over our shock and fear this was so fun. You get used to driving straight into traffic after the first experience. Ironically I felt safe. The little restaurants they took us to were fascinating and she explained how to wrap and arrange the rice paper around the food, as well as which sauce, etc.... I would do this again in a heartbeat.

1. The Vespa Adventure Rides were excellent
2. We need more bikes and bikers to ride around the city
3. The rides are very safe and adventurers
4. I will definitely recommend a trip to Vietnam and the Vespa Adventures rides, website please
Was the best way to experience Ho Chi Minh City at night. I will be doing it again and also when I visit the other locations that Vespa tours are available.

Fantastic tour of Ho Chi Minh with stops at great food outlets and excellent music venues. Plenty of drinks including 'roadies' for the journies and front row seats for the live music. Great tour guide and drivers - felt very safe on the bike.

Couldn't fault it. Highly recommend!

We did the Vespa tour on our 2nd night in Ho Chi Minh, it gave us a sense of bearing within the city, a much greater sense of confidence in taking on the traffic as pedestrians and ultimately a wonderful sense of the ebb and flow of the city. Organized chaos at its most sublime! A fabulous experience.

Six of us from 50 to 12 did the tour and we absolutely loved it. We did the half day that included water en route, coffee so you want it and lunch at the end.
I can honestly say it was the highlight of my time in Saigon. Safe, fun and interesting with an English speaking guide.

We took the vespa tour for the afternoon and was incredible
Our chofers were very kind and excellent drivers. Of course motos in Saigon are a bit crazy, but inbeliable they drive very safe and comfortable, dont be afraid!
We visit lots of interesting places with Min a guide who speaks our language.
We also went to the AO show
Higlly recomended

review_title: The only way to check out Ho Chi Minh City :)
review_text: The Saigon after Dark tour is the best tour if you want a taste of Ho Chi Minh City at night. My partner and I had the best time!! Big thanks to our guide Haili and our driver's Duong S and Ton. Considering the "organized chaos" on the road, we feel safe on our vespa's and cannot recommend this tour enough. Haili was informative and so much fun to be around. You could tell how much our entire group enjoyed her as our guide. If we were to go back to Ho Chi Minh we would do this again for sure. Special thank you to my driver - Duong S - he was amazing among the crazy traffic.. Some of the group wanted him as their driver because he was first all the time! :) I had to mention that! A must do for sure, you will love it!!

My Mum and I did the Saigon after Dark tour, what an amazing experience!! Our guide Kit Kat and my driver Long made the experience safe and fantastic. The Live acoustic cafe was the cherry on top. I would highly recommend this to anyone who wants a great vibrant night in Saigon 😊😊👍🏽

review_title: A great way to see the countryside
review_text:
What a wonderful day.
I was a little nervous as have never been on the back of a Vespa and I am certainly not young but our wonderful guides Onio Phi and Chili gave me a day to remember.
We were so lucky to see the amazing countryside and visit interesting places and meet many friendly Vietnamese people. Also enjoyed fabulous food.
Our guides were always there to look after us with lots of water and lots of jokes and fun
I highly recommend anyone to do this tour it should be on everyones bucket list.
Thank you Onion Phi and Chili you have made my holiday one I will never forget

review_title: Great way to see the city!
review_text: Great way to experience a variety of night or day activities. I have done the night Vespa in Ho Chi Minh twice because it was so great! I also worked in hospitality in Ho Chi Minh for 6 months and these tours are always top recommendations for the cities best hotels. If you are limited for this time is a must do!
Super fun, organized by a friend for 20 of us and we had a blast! I'd definitely recommend for anyone visiting Saigon, even after living there for several years

I found the Vespa experience very expensive. Watch out check all places for value for money. Some have meals included that we could have gotten for a quarter of the price. But others just drove around and you were done.

Believe it or not, this was the highlight of our Saigon/ HO Chi Minh City 3 days. I would highly recommend this night time tour to quickly see the city. There is soo much traffic in SAigon it takes forever to get anywhere; however, on a vespa scooter you can work your way through back streets and traffic quickly. These guys were amazing.. There were 7 of us on vespas and they guided us through the city quickly, efficiently and we all stayed together. They have some great places they take you to depending upon your tour: we had several dinner/quick eat places, an awesome ecclectic club with singers/violin, a rock and roll club which was excellent. It was an amazing night and what a rush the vespa's were as they flew through traffic.. Would recommend for anyone.. As I said earlier, it was the highlight for everyone in the family after 3 days of touring all the main sites in saigon

review_title: Main Saigon attractions in half a day
review_text: Great way to get a taste of Saigon if you're pressed for time or want to get an orientation of this amazing city.

This Vespa tour far exceeded my expectations! We had a family of 7 with varying ages from high school to young adult and had an amazing time. Seeing the city by way of scooter is incredible. We had Ai as our tour guide and she did an incredible job and made sure everyone was taken care of and having fun. Also, the food along the way was incredible and some of the best street food we have had in Vietnam so far. I would highly recommend this adventure for all ages!

review_title: Great, exciting and safe tour even with children
review_text:
We enjoyed the tour with Maili and her team of drivers. They were on time, safe and friendly. My children of 16 and 11 years old were looked after perfectly.

Thank you so much again.

review_title: See the other side of Saigon...on the back of a vespa moped.
review_text:
What an excellent afternoon we spent with Vietnam Vespa Adventures!

I would highly recommend these guys if you are visiting Vietnam.
We used them in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon).

The three of us were met (on time) by a very helpful team from Vespa Adventures. We were initially taken to a small cafe not far from our hotel where we were offered lunch and did the paperwork. We were sharing our vespa tour with another chap who had just arrived in Saigon on holiday. We had no issue with him joining us and was happy to have a fresh face along on the ride.

Vespa Adventures are very conscious for safety for their customers so no need to worry there. The mopeds look well maintained too and all worked perfectly.

We then spent the next 4+hrs travelling around some fascinating parts of the city, some well off the tourist beaten track. Our guide was very knowledgeable and his english was excellent. It really gave us a completely different perspective on the city and we all LOVED IT!. What we also appreciated was there was no trips to tourist shops or any hard sell.

Towards the end of the tour the heavens opened and to be honest I have never seen so much rain, certainly from the back of a moped. But we were safely transported to our final destination, the Central Post Office. Vespa Adventures provided all the wet weather gear so no need to bring any with you.

All in all, an amazing experience and we will definitely use them again in Vietnam when we next visit.

review_title: Great way to see the city
review_text:
Guides will pick you up at your hotel and after a short ride on the minibus - it is time for the Vespa´s. You feel perfectly safe as a Vespa passenger and during 4 hours you will see lots of sights on the Ho Chi Minh city day tour.
This is a personal and much better way to see the city than on a bus. Also some of the sights are not on ordinary tours. Guides have a lot of knowledge and can explain history and also current status on the differences between North and South Vietnam.

Made our day perfect.

Thanks to Nguyen our wonderful tour guide and driver Tam for a great afternoon! All the bases we're covered.
Lunch was tasty @ the Cafe Zoom, not authentic Vietnamese but my ginger chicken was delicious.
Ponchos provided & we most certainly needed them. Tour was as described and it was very convenient to have door to door service too.
I'm looking forward to doing the glimpse of the Mekong tour too!

My friend who is the Head Chef of The Sheraton Saigon took me and my 18 year old son on this tour. She has done this tour 15 times now and took all her visiting friends on it she loves it that much (she should be getting a discount now people!) We had such a fun time, the drivers were great, the host is great and the places they took you were great. Lots of the locals wave at you and smile because they love seeing you having a great time. I loved it when we would go zooming over the bridge and scooting off down little alleyways too. Awesome fun! Would definitely do it again! Thanks Lorraine for taking us xxx

Really get your money worth here pick up from hotel driven to cafe zoom.
Cafe zoom 30 minutes i had 2 tall beers and nibblies. Given option of travel beer for ride to next destination.
Seafood restaurant in district 3 unlimited beer best crab ive ever eaten. 4 dishes served in total here you leave full. Travel beer provided and off to next port.
Pancake restaurant fruit smoothies beer spring rolls and viet pancakes delicious.
Secret cafe drinks provided amazing singers in atmospheric location.
Hard rock bar awesome music cocktails and then back to your hotel.
We stayed on at last bar.

review_title: Fun and facts in Hoi An
review_text: I booked the 3.5 hours afternoon Vespa tour in my hotel resort outside Hoi an. Surprisingly enough I was picked up at my hotel in time and joined in Hoi an the two girls from Australia, who had also booked this tour. After visiting a local fish market (strange smell in the afternoon) we took hidden trails to see a family producing rice crackers. Van, our guide, was very well informed about the local culture and agricultural activities. Due to her excellent English command, it was easy for us to understand her and to have intense discussions with her on the lifestyle of the Vietnamese people, especially during lunch time at a farmer's hut in the countryside, where we had our next stop. On small trails through the peddy fields with water buffalos we reached the house of a carpet maker. The best for last! Our final stop was at a distillery of rice whiskey, also in the hands of a family. Tasting was a must and it was a unique experience. With the evening sun we arrived in Hoi an. All in all it has been an unforgettable afternoon. Adventure and information, diving into the countryside of Vietnam. As it was my first trip with a scooter, I have to say that I at any time felt very safe, thanks to Nine, my reliable and experienced driver.

What a ripper night!!!
Went with 2 friends on seperate bikes and had a blast!!!
Tried lots of new foods including frog!!
All food and drinks included.
Felt completely safe!!!
Last stop was a rock bar which had a live band... lots of fun!
Very expensive but well worth the money!
Will definitely do it again!!
Thanks for a great night!!

review_title: Must do... exceeded our high expectations! Go hungry!
review_text: Our guide was Uyên and she was so smiley all night with excellent spoken English. We went thinking that the main fun would be the Vespa ride on the mad roads, but it is way more than this. The 10 courses of street food with drinks was an experience in itself. We then went to 2 music venues. Both were amazing and we wouldn't have found them without this tour. Thanks for the greatest night out in Vietnam!

review_title: Vespa Adventures Ho Chi Minh MUST DO
review_text: 2 of us did the Saigon Insider tour with Ruby as our guide😀. This tour was more than we expected, the drivers were great never felt unsafe, the busy Vespa life of this city is crazy, being in it is an experience but watching it is even more exciting. The sites we saw were very different from birds to flowers to pagodas to post office, street food etc and a great feed at cafe zoom to end our morning. Thankyou to Ruby for her knowledge,and guidance through out the tour. Ruby and the drivers are an asset to Vespa Andventures I wish them all the best in the future and will definitely recommend Vespa Adventures to everyone. Thankyou Leanne

review_title: A Fantastic way to see the City
review_text:
This is a great way to immerse yourself in Saigon life. There are so many Scooters on the road and to be amongst them gives you a real sense of the city.
To be taken to local restaurants and music venues as you go around the city makes the trip a MUST

review_title: Absolute highlight of Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
We did this tour on our last day in Saigon and it was the best thing that we did. Our guide Thien (Antonio) was so much fun and told us a lot about the city. Our drivers Thach and Vu were amazing and kept us very safe at all times. They provided us with water, Vietnamese coffee, herbal tea also.
This tour takes you to many of the other districts in Saigon that you do not see on a normal tour. The information is great and very informative.
I loved it because you had the opportunity to travel with the locals in the crazy but organized traffic. It seems nuts, but there is much courtesy from everyone and no road rage.
I would recommend this tour to everyone. It was the most fantastic 4 hours of fun.
They collected us from our Hotel on time and then took us back after the tour.
I thought I would be very scared in the crazy traffic, but the drivers are amazing and I was smiling the whole time.
After the tour they give you a link to download pictures of your fun tour and your driver also gives you a photo with him and the guide.
I would definately do this tour again and am going to look for this great company in other cities in Vietnam and do it again.
Thank you so much to Thien, Thach and Vu for a great time, you are all amazing.

review_title: Such a Fun and Info Filled Day!
review_text: We had an amazing time with our guides (Na, Thanh and Tam)! Na kept the tour interesting and seemed truly engaged in making sure we had a wonderful time. The drivers were professional and safe (but still fun). Ate delicious food, meet some locals and how things are made. This is exactly the type of tour we love going on. We were celebrating our 5yr anniversary and wanted something a little different for our adventuring weekend. This was perfect. I'm also a big fan of the retro vespas! Thanks again!

review_title: Miss this and you will regret it!!!
review_text: Four of us did this tour - the kids being 16 and 14. To say we had a fantastic time would be an understatement. We were apprehensive at first-have you seen the driving in Vietnam? We needn't have worried. The drivers expertly guide you through all the traffic and you eventually relax into it and enjoy. As it gets darker the city is beautiful all lit up. The places you go to eat are fantastic-wonderful food, more drink than you can consume and then you go to another place for more. The places we went to for the music were amazing. You will never find them on your own. One was quiet, romantic the other more rock and all equally brilliant. Our guides and drivers were excellent, courteous, kind and great company. If you do nothing else - do this. You will not regret it.

My friend and I had a great time in this tour! Thanh and Phuoc were fantastic tour guides, we felt safe on the bikes yet it was such a fun and thrilling way to travel and see the beautiful countryside. Thanh spoke excellent English and we really enjoyed learning about the various professions of rural Vietnamese people- which you do on this tour- up close and personal! Highly recommended.

review_title: So fun! Delicious food, lots of drink and good music!
review_text: This was the best thing in Saigon we did. We did the food and drink night tour. Great food, lots of drinks included ( be careful it's easy to have a lot), and great live music spots. The live music spots were pretty touristy not local. Would've loved to go a more local bar as well. But still an amazing time! Especially the seafood restaurant! We would love the names of the places we went if you guys can provide them!

review_title: A great tour which covers many highlights
review_text: We were a little apprehensive about getting on the back of a vespa considering the crazy traffic but the drivers were excellent and made us feel very safe. Our tour guide was knowledgeable but was a little defensive at times (if he felt our questions were rude). We enjoyed all the parts of the city we were shown but some places we thought might have been included, like the Opera House, weren't. Overall the tour was great fun and we would highly recommend it.

review_title: Best tour company in Vietnam, you won't regret it. So much fun with this awesome team
review_text: Hands down the most fun we had was with Vespa Adventures during our time in Vietnam. We did a lot of their tours and each one was amazing. The guides are incredibly knowledgable, experienced and friendly. They all know English so that helps a lot. Drinks and food are free on the tours and the vespas are so much to ride on the back of. I highly recommend to anyone traveling to Vietnam to give them a try, you won't regret it. All the food tours are the best and we LOVE the new Craft Beer tour in Saigon! Thank you Vespa Adventures for all the kickass memories!

Just came back from the real Saigon experience, it was a great way to see the most important things in Saigon. We had a great tour guide Thiên (Anthonio!) he was very knowledgeable and very friendly. Our motor rider Tô Lã was also very nice! Thank you so much for showing us around Your city! We loved it.

We were fetched at our hotel at 6pm on our first night in Saigon and had absolutely no idea what to expect of this tour. The next 4 ½ hours were absolutely incredible and we all loved every minute of the tour. We were a party of 2 adults and 4 teenagers. A highlight of our trip. I highly recommend.

I was a little nervous to go on a Vespa tour but man was this fun! The first ride on the Vespa from our hotel to their meeting place was a little scary as I had never been on one and in a major city at that. At the meeting place you meet your guide and other people that are going on the tour with you. They serve you drinks which helped calm my nerves and made it more fun to get back on. We stopped a couple of times to eat and drink so make sure you are hungry! The tour was really fun and enjoyable. I have never done anything like this but I will in the future. It was a great way to see the city and have fun! I highly recommend anyone visiting the city to do this. It was my favorite thing we have done so far!

Super friendly and very helpful staff.They made our first experience of Saigon absolutely amazing. I would recommend this tour to everyone.
So pleased, I found it.

review_title: Glimpse of the Mekong - do it!
review_text:
We didn't have long in HCMC so decided this would help us get round the Mekong Delta area quickly - it was amazing & well worth it!! Nicely off the tourist track, felt like we got an insight into the life as a local villager - great if you're a foodie too (the market seafood was delicious).

Na's tour guide skills were fab and she was a font of knowledge and ray of sunshine. Special shout out to our cheery & extremely safe drivers - Mr Hy & Mr Trung!

Thank you to my driver Anh and my tour guide Na, for a wonderful tour. I really enjoyed all the stops we made and felt very safe with my driver, who expertly navigated the rush hour traffic.
The company was very quick in responding to my queries via email in the lead up to my tour and my driver was at my hotel prior to the start time ready for me. Fantastic tour - I highly recommend.

I have to admit I wasn't completely confident when I booked this. I was nervous about riding on the back of a vespa around the busy streets of Saigon. But after the first the few minutes I felt completely at ease and had the most amazing time. I felt secure on the back of the bike (it had a kind of back rest on it so you feel really stable) and the driver was very experienced. We got to stop off at places off the beaten track, flower and fabric markets a Chinese medicine shop and the morning bird park. It was a great way to get an overview of the city as well as being lots of fun. Our guide was lovely and very knowledgable. Lunch was included.
This experience was amazing. Taken to the back street restaurants & clubs. My 75 year old Mum did the tour & its one of the best experiences in my life. Don't be put off by the Vespa & traffic.

Thanks Ai & the crew for an amazing Saigon After Dark tour last night! A definite must do for anyone travelling to Ho Chi Minh City! Riding through the hectic streets on a vintage Vespa sampling the most amazing food. So much fun & most certainly gets the adrenaline pumping! Our second time on this particular tour & would definitely do it again.

We did the Insiders Saigon tour and it was excellent. Ruby was full of fascinating information on all the places we visited and gave it a real personal touch with stories about her own family.
Hung, Nhat and Vun were also terrific.
We visited heaps of interesting places and crossed from one side of town to the other.
The lunch at Zoom cafe at the end was also very good.
Highly recommended!

review_title: Full day tour including boat ride and Cu Chi tunnels
review_text: Total excellence - I have just downloaded Tripadvisor so I can write this because I am so impressed with this company - my 2 teenage sons and I have had such a fantastic day, action packed, great service, our Les Rives tour guide was so friendly and helpful - the boat trip fabulous lots of education and stories on the way to Cu Chi and throughout the tour, clean well maintained boat, the food and drinks were quality especially the lunch and being in a small group was fabulous. Vespa tour was incredible, tour guide again knowledgable excellent English - felt like a friend was showing us around, so genuine, wanted us to have all the information and a great time, also informative not rushed or boring lots of personality - the Vespa driver 'Hung'also fabulous, he pointed out things as we went and was so helpful on and off the bike etc. feel like I've done so much and easily, it's been a perfect day for me and my boys.

Overall the experience was really fun. However the only area for improvement would be to start the tour on time when scheduled. We, 6 people, had to wait half an hour after the time our tour was scheduled to depart, for one additional guest to arrive. This caused our guide to continually rush us through the entire tour, Although our tour started half an hour late the guide finished the tour on schedule without giving us an additional half hour. When asked if we wanted to stay longer at the last stop she said we could but would have to take a taxi home because our vespas and drivers were leaving.

review_title: Great fun - a must do evening !
review_text: Having seen the traffic both here and in Hanoi my wife and I were a little apprehensive. After been collected by our guide and two scooter drivers we were offered a drink and then we were off ! Our guide, Tuan was really fun and he took us to a couple of great eating spots which we would never have found on our own. Following that we went for coffee in an upstairs place where acoustic sets were being performed - showcase kind of thing. We then ended in a music venue for cocktails and some live music - informal and fun. All in all this was a great evening and I am really glad we didn't let the traffic put us off.

This review only allows 5 stars, I could give it another 5 stars for our guide, Na. Do not leave Ho Chi Min without experiencing this amazing memorial night. Out guide was funny, informative, so much energy. Our drivers were fantastic. The experience of weaving in and out of traffic was such an amazing, exhilarating experience. The different food places we went to were great. Tasty authentic food. Too much food. The end of the night was at Woodstock, live band rock venue. What a way to finish the nite.
The ride was so safe, great for any age.
We got a free photo at the end of the night, 1 for each of us.

Must Try 10/10

Put your life in the hands of a local driver and discover the Saigon that millions of locals do. Our guide Tuan was fantastic, knowledgable and entertaining. Riding around the streets of Saigon is hair-raising at first but you soon realise your driver knows his stuff and you're in safe hands. It certainly makes for an exciting afternoon. See a side to the city away from the usual tourist traps and really get a glimpse of a day in the life of this wonderful city.

review_title: Great fun, what a way to experience the city
review_text:
Our first night my wife and I with our 2 children aged 13 and 11 went on the Vespa tour and had a great time.

To experience the traffic on the back of the Vespa and to see all there is to see in the city is highly recommended.

The children thoroughly enjoyed the scooters, and as the tour includes 4 stops of food and drinks and was a chance to sample some authentic Vietnamese hospitality.

Definitely a must do in HCMC

I've lived in Saigon for 3 years now and was dubious as to what I would get out of doing a Vespa tour of the city. I was wrong! This tour was well organised, great fun, great value for money and I would highly recommend it. We were well looked after, my driver was super friendly and a good driver, food was excellent even for a fussy vege like me and the whole experience was wonderful and memorable. Loved the live acoustic venues that we visited that I never knew existed and am looking forward to booking another trip!

review_title: Fun Vespa Experience in Hoi An Countryside
review_text: Fabulous morning adventure in Hoi An with Vespa Adventures. An amazing local experience and loved to see the country side's people life. The vespa team: Sinh, Lam, Vy, Hieu and Tom are awesome. They are friendly, knowledgeable and fun. We enjoyed ourself so much. Highly recommend!

Absolutely terrific night! Restaurant & Nightclub/Bar adventure on the back of a Vespa. Safe, reliable and terrific people guiding us around the city over 4hours. Excellent value for money and cannot recommend highly enough - they're worth 10 stars! All you can eat and drink and knowledgable English speaking guides make for a wonderful night!

Wow! Had so much fun on the Saigon at night foodie tour with Vespa Adventures! My husband and I and our two teenage daughters were picked up from our hotel at 6pm. Our drivers were courteous and friendly. When we first started off I was thinking "what have I booked here" as the traffic is crazy but the drivers were professional and made us all feel completely safe. I soon relaxed once I realized my driver (Khin) was completely in control. We drove to Zoom Cafe where we met with 2 other adventurers and also our guide for the night Jaden. Jaden spoke excellent English and was lots of fun and informative for the whole night. We had drinks at Zoom then went to two restaurants and had 8 courses (loved the "jumping chicken") then went to a coffee house with live singing and finished up at a fun bar with a live band. There was more food then we could possibly eat and it was all delicious. Also endless supply of drinks.

I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this to anyone. All four of us had an absolutely fantastic time. Thank you to Jaden and our four drivers!! Do yourself a favor and do this tour!!!

Perfect for couples friends or even better families with late teens. Great tour host and "drivers" and the venues visited felt like real Saigon. Ate well, drank plenty, felt safe, laughed
lots.

After several previous tours with Vespa adventures in Hoi An we took our team of 14 on a tour. Mark and Leo were incredible hosts. Great English and told fantastic stories as we visited each site. So many things to see from boat making, mat weaving, incredible coffee maker that learnt his trade through u tube. Finished with a highlight of lunch in a hidden oasis. Thanks Mark and Leo. You're legends.

review_title: Saigon by night tour! Must do when in HCM
review_text:
We did the Saigon by night tour with Truan/Eric and it was such a fun night.
We were picked up by the drivers at the opera house and taken to the zoom cafe, which is the starting point of the tour. We were met by Eric and after a brief introduction, we were off. Whizzed across the city on a vintage Vespa and part of the organised chaos that is the HCM two wheeler traffic. We visited 2 popular street cafes that served up really delicious sea food and Vietnamese pancakes. Next stop was a hidden cafe that took us back to the war time, saloon atmosphere, with live jazz music, dim lights and dramatic performers. Our night ended with a nightcap at a modern bar which had youngsters singing and dancing live to MJ, Adele, eagles and Bon jovi. The tour ended a photographer who took candid shots through the night and sent them through to us a day after. What an amazing night!
Special thanks to Eric. He had all of us in splits with his stories and anecdotes, and was so passionate about his city that it got us al excited. Good job Eric.
The drivers were also very courteous and drove us through the traffic in a very safe though exciting manner. Even though it was raining during part of our trip, we were given rain coats and the drivers made sure they drove extra carefully, so as not to panic the passengers. A good way to get a glimpse of and be a part of a usual day at HCM.

review_title: The only way to see Saigon.
review_text:
Anyone who follows me knows I only write about unusually great off the hook experiences. We just spent two weeks in Vietnam and this was our final night - and what a night it was!

Locals still call it Saigon though the town name was changed to Ho Chi Minh City in the late 1970's. Same can be said about Leningrad vs. St. Petersburg. So feel free to call it Saigon, especially downtown (District 1).

The only way to see Saigon's lights, traffic, and energy is from motorbike just like the locals do. The only way to smell and taste Saigon is from off the path street cafes and restaurants just like the locals do. The only way to hear the sounds and music of Saigon is from the coffee houses hidden in back alleyways, like the local do.

If that's the Saigon you want to experience, then make this your lasting impression.
If this is the first time you have ever been to Vietnam or you are interested to find out more about Vietnamese food more than just Pho, this is a must.

Best thing we did in ho chi min city ! We definitely recommend this to anyone.

You get picked up from your hotel and taken to various locations. Make sure you do not eat or drink a lot before the trip as you end up very full!

You will not be disappointed

We had a trip with Vespa Adventures up in Hoi An and we enjoyed it so much we booked again in Saigon.
What an experience... riding through the streets (from highways to alleyways) alongside hundreds of other moped riders, safely driven by our Vespa drivers, was fantastic.
The evening commenced with a pick up from our hotel and the first stop was at a street cafe for a drink and to meet our hostess, who explained the evening's entertainment.
We would ride through the city stopping at a local restaurant for our first dinner course, and then continue on our journey to another restaurant for our next course.
All very good, with our little hostess riding ahead to welcome us on arrival .
The third stop was at a music club for coffee and live entertainment and the last stop was at a club , again with live entertainment.
All good and drink included in the price.
An excellent evening out with a chance to engage with the guide and find out more about her and her journey.

review_title: Highlight of the trip - MUST DO
review_text: I wasn't sure I wanted to do this tour after seeing HCMC cyclo traffic. But once we started, man, what a ride! The drivers were great, and the experience was better. Highly recommend the foodie tour. Visited 5 stops, each one better than the last. Start with an empty stomach and thirst for cheap SE Asian beer, and take lots of videos!

My girlfriend and I did the craft beer tour... we had an absolute blast. Met some cool people on the tour, ate delicious food, and drank a lot of delicious local craft beer; what more could you ask for?! Katy was an excellent tour guide too!

review_title: The nighttime vespa ride and food tour was one of the highlights of our trip.
review_text:
5 stars for this Vespa tour, it's a really cool experience and fun way to see the city at night. The drivers were all very safe and cautious with their driving and gave us helmets.

We had Mai Li as our tour guide and she was super friendly, engaging and knowledgeable about the city. We stopped at 2 restaurants and a local speakeasy with live singing performances.

The food was incredible. Very authentic local spots and everything was delicious. They also had a photographer at some of the restaurants taking pictures, which they email you at the end. If you have to choose one thing to do, this is the tour to take. We did it in Ho Chi Minh but they offer it in many locations and other cities around Vietnam.

This was seriously one of the most amazing experiences!

We loved both absolutely loved it!

Highly recommend the night foodie tour to everyone!

We did the day time Vespa tour and visited many sites, our tour guide spoke fantastic English, had a great sense of humour and was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable on the content of the tour! Would definitely recommend.

Recently went on a Vespa tour of Ho Chi Minh with a group of ladies. We all enjoyed
It and felt safe. Had a nice meal and drinks at their own Restaurant. Drivers were
Careful and helpful, assisting with helmets and getting on and off.
W

Having done the Vespa by night foodie tour in Saigon (which was fabulous and have recommended to so many since) we thought it would be a good way to see Hoi An and the surrounding countryside. It was fantastic! Such a great way to explore and see places that you wouldn't normally venture to. Just like in Saigon, our guide was informative yet fun and went out of his way to make sure we had the best time - Onion Phi, his name. We flew round the countryside stopping to see the locals and for a traditional coffee before a delicious lunch by the river.
I could not rate this tour highly enough and Vespa Adventures offer such a great concept. Both tour guides I've experienced have been excellent and they really do make the difference.

review_title: Wow! Highlight of our trip- what a way to see HCMs best bits!
review_text:
Lots of friends recommended this tour to us so our expectations were high...but it was even better than expected! Our guide was called Tien and was fantastic- excellent English, so friendly, knowledgable and generally great fun and made us feel so at ease from the second we met him. Thank you Tien!!

Our Drivers, Nhi and Anh were amazing Drivers and made us do feel so safe (which isn't easy in a crazy place like HCM!). They were lovely and pointed out all the sights of HCM along the way- sights we didn't have time to visit on our short trip so this was an extra bonus to be able to see the Notre Dame catedral, war remnants museum, City Hall etc all while on a fantastic food tour.

The booking process was so easy and staff SO efficient and friendly. Picked up and dropping off at hotel.

The food....just WOW! And Tien taught us so much about how to eat certain food and always keep the drinks flowing.

If you're unsure of whether to do a night tour/worried about safety...don't be! Just book with Vespa Adventures and you will to be disappointed! We're booking more tours in Hanoi and maybe Hoi an after our fab experience!

Thanks everyone at Vespa!!

This tour is highly recommended even though it is on the pricey side of usd 93 per person. But for the adventure, experience, places, food and drink, it is worth every penny...the guide was fun and knowledgeable and I am lucky to have a superb driver as well.
So if you want something different to do in ho chi minh, this will be it...
So what are you waiting for......go book it!!

We were fortunate enough to have Tien 'T' as our tour guide. He was very friendly, knowledgeable and made sure we had an incredible experience. Food was delicious, plenty of beers and safe/fun ride from place to place. Thank you for a great time!

review_title: Saigon After Dark is the foodie tour you NEED
review_text: If you love food and want to experience Saigon as a local, then this tour is for you. Our guide "T" spoke excellent english and was extremely knowledgeable, and our drivers were true professionals who handled the legendary traffic with ease. Come hungry, as the food (and beers) are plentiful! We will definitely book again when we return to Saigon.

Vespa after dark tour is an excellent tour to explore decent night life in Vietnam.
It gives you s flavour if everything like local food outlets, old coffee bars, live music night.

You will get a lot to eat during this trip... so make sure that ur tummy is flexible to accommodate all that 😀

Tour guides are well trained ones and take care of your food choices.

I was thinking that i might have a tough time in food outlets because of my vegetarian food habits but i never felt like that throughout the tour. You do find very good vegetarian food also in Saigon (HCM City) , though you will have to explore a little for the same. Thanks to my tour guide 😀

Vespa driver and guide were both very nice and friendly, thanks to both (TRUNG & MAI LI) of them for making it memorable.

review_title: Don't miss this - best time ever!
review_text: Picked up at hotel my husband and 15 yr old daugher who had never written on motorbike before. It's such fun and I felf totaly safe with these guys. Arrived at first stop and met our guide Tommy who was fantastic great English. Really informative and helped us try new dishes in the restaurants. We went to 1 bar, 2 restaurants plus 2 music bars. It says street food but these are still seated venues with good surroundings and toilet facilities. Final stop was a bar witha good covers band. Free photo art end of night and emailed.

Our hotel concierge recommend Vespa Adventures and booked it for us ,what a fantastic night .It lasted for nearly 5 hours of amazing food and great company with other people on the tour that we met and i can not say enough about our wonderful tour guide Katti and the vespa riders .We experienced so much in one night that I belive we would not have without this amazing tour .Definitely a must when in Sigon. I am usually a bit nervous about doing different things,but our guide was with us the whole time and the drivers made us feel so safe .
Loved it!

Having never been on a bike before, this was a unique experience. Careful well trained drivers took us around the streets weaving in and out of the manic drivers with pit stops for food , drink and music. Excellent evening

I organised a group tour for 4 in Hue and we had the most amazing day Duong was a fantastic, knowledgable guide and the team of gentlemen that came along were fantastic. I can't remember all of their names but Vinh, Mr Toa and the others were lovely and made the trip fun. The destinations and the information given was what made this tour so amazing. We can't thank Duong and the team enough. We had so much fun that we did a second Vespa Adventure the next day with an extra mate joining us, giving us a group of 5. Another amazing day with great information and the same lovely guides. Highly recommended by us and hope to do more Vespa Adventures in the future. 😘

This was the second time I have visited Saigon and taken a Vespa Adventure Tour. The first one was sensational so I was hopeful that a second visit would live up to the first. Since my last visit a Beer Tour has been added and on the back of a Vespa Yu travel between local bars that brew their own beer. At each location you get to taste four beers and food is served to compliment each beer. This has been a highlight of five days in Saigon and is a must, must, must do. The chauffeurs are a riot and the tour guide that we had (Katty) made the night even better. This is the best way Tom see the night life of Saigon and visit locations you would never find without the help of a local. Don't go to Saigon and not take a Vespa Adventure Tour.

review_title: Fantastic Trip- Hoi An to Hue
review_text:
We had a great time with Onion (our guide/driver), Dao (driver) and Nine (spare driver/mechanic if needed) on our tour.

We started in Hoi An and headed to Danang, through the Hoi Van Pass (ie as per Top Gear route if you've seen) and on towards Hue via a local waterfall for a very good local lunch and swim. There are lots of great sites/views on route. It is possible to do this route in reverse ie Hue to Hoi An via the Hoi Van Pass.

We had lots of drinks/comfort stops etc which broke up the ride. Onion (our guide) was very knowledgeable and spoke English very well. We stopped at some local spots of interests including Charm ruins, a local ship building yard, a local football game we passed which the whole village was watching amongst a number of other things. We certainly got a feel for local Vietnam and understood the history/culture better by the end.

We were riding pillion with drivers who were good and made you feel safe. They also took lots of photos etc at the stops and were good fun. It is a full day tour so if you've never ridden a moped pillion (particularly on some bumpy roads) I would suggest trying one of Vespa Adventures shorter trips first to see if you like it.

Obviously it's worth bearing in mind some of the roads are not great in Vietnam and the quality of driving is mixed at best plus there are hundreds of mopeds on the roads.

Having said that we had a fantastic time and felt it was a great experience/adventure and it will stick in our memories.

review_title: Unique experience you will never forget
review_text:
We booked a Saigon Night tour for 5 pax and certainly no regret at all. The guide explained to us on the cuisine and the right way to consume that. It was interesting to experience the Vietnam culture via dining. We were really impressed with the hidden romantic cafe which no way we are able to locate the place by ourself. This is a must visit cafe in HCM!

We simply love the Vespa adventure that we booked another tour- A Glimpse of the Mekong. This was a totally different experience from the previous tour. If you want to experience how the local live and stepped into their houses to see wine and incense making and more, this is the tour just for you!
