review_title: Vespa Adventures Hoi An food tour
review_text: What a fantastic experience. Ben and his team members were brilliant, the food stops and adventures fantastic and their friendliness and sense of adventure makes this trip very memorable and very worth your while. One of the must see and do tours when in Vietnam but especially in Hoi An. What a wonderful way to experience driving in Vietnam and eating the local food. Well done on an excellent tour. We will be back for more. George, Bennie, Neesha and Mahendran!
Tuan is the best guide i have ever had, quite fun riding around the city on scooters, follow the leader

This is a "can't miss" experience! Off you go on the back of a Vespa with thousands of other drivers. After the first nervous minute or two, you really get into the fun. There are a number of stops for food and drink. These are places for locals you would never find on Your own. We were taken to a coffee house in an alley up a flight of stairs, and the live singers were excellent. Worth the money.

Our Vespa Adventure tour out of Hoi-An was the highlight of our holiday in Vietnam!
The Vespa team of Mark,Chu Son and Thanh really looked after us and made sure we felt safe as we toured the countryside. Visiting local villages, making rice noodles, weaving sleeping mats,and roasting coffee was so interesting and our group enjoyed meeting the local people going about their daily lives.
I would suggest that you confirm your booking the night before.

review_title: Best way to see the city
review_text:
We did the evening food tour and loved it. Our guide Ruby was super fun and the places they took us to were super authentic. The food was incredible as well and we loved the fact that they take you you to a mix of restaurants, cafes and clubs.
We did another motorbike tour in HCMC but this was definitely the best.
This was one of the highlights of our time in Vietnam. Amazing must do.

review_title: Great location stops, great food and awesome fun!
review_text: I recently did the Siagon after Dark tour and it was fantastic! Ho Chi Minh traffic is insane but it was so much fun being part of it. The driver was great - very safe and fun. We stopped at two restaurants that had amazing food - where the locals go which is a great way to see the real Saigon....then two really interesting live music venues, both of which were great - we would never have found them ourselves. It was great value for money....a really great way to see a lot of Ho Chi Minh on the back of a bike!

review_title: Ride to locations with delicious food or beverages in Saigon
review_text: Great experience - a ride with a Vespa as a ant in a family of ants to really nice or hidden locations with delicious food or beverages in Saigon! Recommendable!

First impression with the price tag is - its expensive and is it worth?

Its 100% worth and as they say its kind of "The ride of my life"

Its a 4 hrs experience of local food, drinks, culture and whole lot of fun. We took an evening ride. Not sure if they have a day time one but evening one is whole lot better to see and feel the pulse of the lit up city with a mix up of local culture and some foreign influence. You will not get a vespa all the time but my driver made it up with some interesting catching up of stories and facts.

The price includes food and drink

Super...duper!!!

review_title: What a way to see the city at night!
review_text: The roads on Ho Chi Minh seem utter chaos when crossing on foot- however on the back of an experienced Vespa Tour rider's bike you feel totally safe and able to enjoy the madness that is the city at night! Our tour guide Luna was absolutely amazing. Such a lovely person , great English and able to show us the best eating/ drinking spots in town. The food was exceptional- plenty of it too! Live music topped the night off. Worth every penny!

I booked at the last minute as I only had two days in Saigon. I wasn't disappointed. This is a very well run operation. The online booking was easy with almost immediate email confirmation. My Booking was for a morning tour called The Insider's Saigon. My vintage Vespa was driven by Gnat who very capably navigated very busy Saigon traffic. I felt very comfortable on the back and felt very confident with his driving skills. My guide, Tuon was a a powerhouse of energy and full of knowledge about Saigon. They took me to a lot of places not normally seen by tourists. I loved it all! Thanks guys!
PS The trip concluded with lunch at Zoom Cafe. The food was plentiful and delicious.
Craig

My wife and I, along with our friends, booked this tour initially thinking it was fairly pricy but it was the best fun tour, the best value and it lasted for over four hours! We were collected from our hotel by the Vespas, helmets on and then off we went into the maze of traffic to commence our tour of drinking as much as you wanted and that included spirits!! Ate ourselves until we couldn't eat a further thing and saw and heard some amazing live entertainment.
This is a very well run tour, excellent food at the restaurants, all very clean and is a progressive dine from a number of restaurants placed throughout the tour. The tour guide riders were very safe and it was a very up front and personal insight into Ho Chi Minh as you weave through the traffic like a local. My god we had the best time laughing at friends that pass you from time to time in the group. We THOROUGHLY recommend this tour, you won't regret it for a moment.

review_title: Not only a highlight of our Vietnam adventure but one of THE best things I have ever done!
review_text: I've travelled a fair bit and experienced some amazing things but our Saigon After Dark tour with Vespa Adventures is up there with the best. Saigon was our 6th and final destination on a 3 week visit to Vietnam so we were used to the traffic and high volume of mopeds but nothing quite prepares you for actually being on a moped in the middle of it all! All I can say is, you MUST do this. Put your trust in your vietnamese driver and embrace whizzing around hidden gems for food the vietnamese eat, drinks and live music for an evening. Our group was hosted by Lora and was myself, my partner and an Australian couple on the last night of their honeymoon. The four of us had an amazing evening with Lora and our drivers looking after us. Do it - its amazing!

This was a highlight of my trip. It is something you would not normally do if you did not ride a bike.
CHECK IT OUT & JUST DO IT

What a great "Craft Beer" tour! We had been on an XO Tour the night before (competing tour company in Saigon) and it was absolutely terrible, so it was so refreshing to experience an awesome tour in Saigon.

Our tour guide, Katty, was brilliant and made the night for us! We had a complete blast, and all along the way learning and experiencing the new and exciting Saigon craft beer scene. Do yourself a favor and request Katty for your beer tour.

All the breweries were great, and we were given a really nice amount of beer at each location. Would have been better if we could have chosen the beers we wanted, but with a large group I can see how this could be hard to arrange to completely understandable.

I'm a craft beer nerd, and there was plenty here even for me. I've done probably over 100 brewery tours and visited most all of the best breweries around the world, and I still really enjoyed this tour. Not trying to boast, just letting the beer nerds out there know that they will enjoy this tour, as its less about the brewing and more about the drinking!

The Vespa drivers were also great, and the Vepsas were comfortable and a pleasure to be on. I have a bad back (XO tours almost finished me), but these were comfortable and even had back rests.

This is obviously a company that has its stuff together. Will not hesitate to book another tour my next time in Saigon. (PS: don't use XO Tours, they sucked and pretty much ruined one of our nights here)

A must do when in Saigon is to experience the city where there are more scooters than people especially on a vintage vespa. Great food, culture and music in a city full of adventure. Vespa Adventures in both Vietnam and Cambodia is a first class operation.

Last night en Saigon (Ho Chi Min City). Last night in Vietnam.
What a great ending for an unforgettable travel.
Living the city at the end of a Suturday´s afternoon like local people does. Drinking at the bars, eating street food, listening music end, even, dancing along with a greatest rock & roll band. All, with the best guide ever: Lunar!
In the midle, to ride a Vespa in the middle of the indescribable Saigon´s traffic.
Crasy, but safe. Not to lose!

A must do in Saigon. The dinner ride at night was the most amazing night ever. The exhilaration of riding in the local people at 6pm at night and then to go to the amazing food and drink places was second to none. Thank you to Lora for being fun but professional and to the drivers who were exactly the same. Well worth every cent. Don't miss out!!!

We visited HCMC in April and had a fantastic experience! However the highlight of the trip was a day spent with Vespa Adventures into the Mekong Delta! We were met at the hotel reception (bang on time) and introduced to the guys. We were then transported to Vespa HQ through the early traffic a surreal and slightly frightening (but electrifying) experience. We then met Antonio (our guide for the day) who explained the adventure ahead. What followed was a great day of dodging traffic and learning about real Vietnam people and customs! Snack was taken in a street market and as Antonio said "if it moves you can eat it" Clams, shrimps and oysters all prepared to perfection and all tasted great. What followed was a tour of a street market, rice wine manufacturing plant (shed), Temple and an incense makers house. A meal was provided in a very swish Resturant on a lake, which was again fantastic! Overall a fantastic day, very educational and a great way to see the real country!

My husband & I did the Countryside & Islands Explorer tour in Hoi An and what a delight it was. We had already experienced the Saigon After Dark tour in Saigon & it was just ok, I guess having my husbands vespa 'conk' out 10 times didn't help. I have to mention they did change the driver half way thru the tour so I think that tells us all something as it was good after that. The Manager was waiting for us at the end of tour to apologize which was a good touch. I wasn't very excited about this tour due to the problems we had previously experienced but I was so very glad I persevered. We were met at reception in our Hotel and what an absolute delight the young woman guide 'Van' was, everything was spot on throughout the whole tour & both drivers were great & always making sure we were comfortable along the way. Lunch in a restaurant surrounded by rice paddies was authentic local food which we loved. If you are a bit unsure about getting on the back of a vespa (as I was) with a complete stranger don't be as it is a memory that will stay with you 4eva. Fabulous scenery & meeting the locals was awesome. Highly recommend to do in Hoi An

review_title: Our last night in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: We decided to go on this tour on our last night and it was a brilliant way to end our trip. We booked via our hotel, they arrived on time, very professional. We were taken to the meeting bar for our first drink, and met the others on our tour. The guides were very competent, felt very safe amongst the crazy mopeds, the restaurants we stopped at served great food. As many drinks as you wanted. We had a great laugh on the back of the Vespas. Highly recommend this tour company, we had a great time.

A must do in Saigon. Tien and the Vespa Adventures team were amazing, and our Saigon After Dark foodie tour was amazing. The food was incredible, and all the spots we visited were filled with locals and foodies alike - my friend and I felt like Saigon insiders!

review_title: A Must Do in Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: The evening Vespa eating tour was one of the highlights of a friend and my's trip through Vietnam. They pick you up at your airport and from there it's a magical night. Get ready for amazing food, fun rides on the Vespa, and amazing service. Tien, our guide was the best - amazing English and so much fun. He shared a great deal of information about each area, the traditions and history of the foods, and the appropriate way to eat dishes :) My driver, Tam, was also the best female driver out there in my opinion :) Amazing time - highly recommend!

review_title: Great tour of the city but timing could have been better
review_text:
This was the city tour but combined with a speed boat trip to the Cu Chi tunnels.
Positives: really great experience, Hung my driver was great, felt safe and relaxed and he had good English. The tour was interesting and the bikes were great.

Negatives: we came off the Cu Chi tunnels tour and were collected straight away by Vespa tours however, hand over to Vespa tours was good but they had already started the tour so we missed out on the first stop which I am a little annoyed about, surely you shouldn't start the tour without everyone there! Or the tour should be scheduled for a later start time if the first tour always comes back later?

Vietnam Vespa Adventures is something that cannot be missed off the list.
Enter into the scooter chaos that is Ho Chi Minh City on scooter... you'll throughly enjoy the thrill of ripping around this city with an experienced guide,
The food along the way is genuine, and what the locals eat, followed up by a brief spell of local live music of a couple of verities.

Would I do this again.... oh heck yes I would... it was an awesome experience

Kickstarting in 2007 from Ho Chi Minh City, we are the original Vespa tours in Southeast Asia. We operate in & around Ho Chi Minh City, Hoi An, Hue, Hanoi, Vietnam and Siem Reap & Phnom Penh, Cambodia- enlightening and entertaining guests to this day. We are passionate about what we do, and our goal is to share the things that we love about Vietnam and Cambodia. We don’t want to just give you a tour, we want to give you an adventure that you won’t forget.

My daughter and I booked the morning Insider's Saigon tour. Uyen is our guide and Hung is one of our drivers. The three of them were friendly and enthusiastic people.
The places we visited including the bird park, the flower market, fabric and accessories markets, Chinatown, temples and District 2.
Since we have been to District 1 attractions before, they changed the itinerary and took us to District 4 where the underprivileged lived. The trip was eye-opening. We ended up at Zoom cafe for lunch. Great trip and experiences. Thank you.

We had a fantastic day, we went as a group of 8 including 4 children ranging in age from 4-11 and all of us thoroughly enjoyed the entire experience. We were taken to a farm, the home of a mat weaving family and the home of a rice wine making family. It was extremely interesting to visit these private houses that we would otherwise not been able to experience. Our guides, Sihn, Thy, Quoc, Dung1, Dong and Dao were fantastic, they were friendly and helpful and ensured we were comfortable the entire time. I would highly recommend this tour.

WOW! After my review with Vespa Adventures in Hoi An, I decided to try the Vespa Adventures tour at our next stop, Saigon and it was even better! Cannot believe how these "kind of" tours place you on the pulse of each of these 2 cities!
All I can say is definitely do these tours but make sure you do them with a reputable company like this one!
Thank you Vespa Adventures for making my vacation so memorable❤️

My Husband & I were picked up on time by Vinh & Quoc to great guys, Vinh's English was exceptional so our tour was awesome as Vinh was able to give extremely knowledgeable talks throughout the whole of the tour and explain everything in detail both lads were amazing bike riders I just relaxed the whole time taking photos of the country side and just had fun not a worry in the world.
The food was amazing .., lunch was plentiful / fresh & tasty 😋 No 1
This tour had everything a ride on a Vespa without stress and a tour with a differences seeing mat weaving, rice cake making, boat building and a visit to a family temple all while traveling thru rice fields and country villages and across modern bridges and an amazing bamboo bridge it was a true countryside adventure.

We when on the foodies tour with Onion Phi, great guy full of information and good laughs.
We have done a few of the vespa adventures and have really enjoyed meeting the locals and see what real life is all about. Couldn't recommend enough!

Reading the extensive informative reviews one has the feeling that the travellers who experienced this tour desperately want the readers to enjoy their wonderful experience and I am now part of this fan club too.

I cannot add much more than to say it is a unique experience, very well organised, fabulous iconic local restaurants and fantastic live music at Acoustics in motion bar. We said we would stay for a few minutes and then begged to stay longer. Most tourists would never find these venues. Our poor guide Hanh did an amazing job ordering me gluten free, garlic free ( severe allergy to garlic ) food in a country that adds garlic to everything. She is a great guide, interesting and enthusiastic. Our drivers Long and Hung were very considerate and safety conscious. I was nervous for about 5 minutes but after viewing babies, young children etc casually sitting upfront on scooters I decided to relax, have faith and enjoy the night. Highly recommended.

My husband & I went on a 4 hour Vespa Adventure tour throughout Saigon this morning. What fun! Throughout out Vietnam travels, we've been watching, with wonder, how the motor scooters weave in and out of traffic.

We were given helmets and sat behind experienced drivers. Our guide drove his own motor scooter & met us at each stop. We drove on regular streets, through alleyways, tunnels, & freeways. I always felt safe, despite the way the Vietnamese drive. Water, soft drinks, coffee and/or tea was provided 3 different times. Lunch is included at the end of the tour, too.

I imagined we would be joined by other tourists, but it was just my husband & myself, our drivers & our guide. We were obviously given a lot of one on one attention! It was great as we could ask all kinds of questions and speak candidly with our guide.

The price seemed high, $72 (US) per person, when we signed up, but it was worth every penny. It was a great way to see a new city from the perspective of a local...& feel like a local. I highly recommend this fun & adventurous tour!

We booked this excursion not really knowing what it envolved,
We had a great time and it was pretty exciting to be in the flow of the city traffic which had thousands of small Vespa Scooters, motorbike and all in the fast moving city
If you fancy a fast moving excursion this is for you.

Four of us did this tour on the 21st April 2017.We booked through our travel agent in the Uk before we went. This tour was fantastic fun. We felt very well looked after from start to finish. We tasted lots of different food in different cafes on the way & were taken to two different types of coffee shops. We can't recommend this tour enough it's just fun from start to finish. We toured around all the different districts & our drivers were all fantastic & very safe. Please do this tour if you get the chance it's fantastic. We're all still buzzing about it now.

If you want a somewhat bizarre but totally enjoyable experience in Saigon, this is for you. You'll find yourself tearing around town on the back of a Vespa. At first you wonder if you will make it to tell the story but when it becomes clear the drivers know what they are doing, it's just a lot of fun. You go from a bar to a cafe for seafood to an outdoor restaurant for more eats to a hidden music club with some wonderful performers and finally to a rock and roll club. A memorable night in Saigon!

We went on an evening tour with our 10 year old son. Firstly don't worry about letting children go on their own Vespa as it was very safe. Our drivers were Son, Tung & Due with our excellent guide Katty We had five stops with authentic food and drinks. We also went to a coffee house with live music and a rock bar, it was all amazing a definite must trip. The drivers were brilliant and gave us all an experience of a life time into real Vietnamese life, and certainly a taste of the moped filled roads.

super cool way to see Ho Chi Minh City .. they do not let u drive with good reason! at first you are a bit nervous weaving in and out of traffic .. but the learned and frienly drivers soon make you forget and u can really take in the whole experience. short but informative pitstops along the way..really friendly guide Jenny made sure of that .. definitely a must!!

I took my two children (8&9) on the morning tour of HCMC and it was an absolute blast! I was obviously a little concerned about their safety on the roads but they wore good helmets and the drivers were sensible and considerate taking good care of how they rode. I really shouldn't have worried at all. We had a bike each and the kids smiled the whole time from 8am - noon. The guide, Uyên, was very interesting, informative, relaxed and enthusiastic about her job and her city and country. She answered all of our many questions! We learnt so much about Saigon and the history of the people living here as well as everyday life. I would highly recommend this tour company to other parents wanting a tour with kids. I was disappointed not to go on a foodie tour but this was at night finishing too late for my kids. However, this tour did exceed my expectations as I learned a lot about Saigon I wouldn't have otherwise. It's an expensive activity ($200 for three of us) but I think my children will remember this experience for a long time and will be the highlight of our trip to Vietnam.

If you want a fun night out and enjoy a beer, look no further - this is the tour for you. Vespa Adventures are a truly professional outfit. Excellent tour guides, great riders, great scooters - there is no better way to see Ho Chi Minh city and enjoy great food and local Craft Beer. Just do it!!
Booked a Saigon after Dark Tour by Vespa. It's a realy great adventure. We had a very fun day. Enjoyed also all the street food! Will highly recommend the Vespa Adventure!

I took this tour with a couple of friends who have lived in Vietnam for over 20 years. They enjoyed this tour as much as I did! We did the evening food/drink tour and it was amazing! The drivers were incredible professional and safe, I went from hanging on for my dear life to actually videoing while riding on the scooter. We got a great feel for local life and had a blast at some very cool bars with incredible music. Very special surprises!! Even if you have only one choice of a tour, chose this one and you will NOT be disappointed. Fantastic!!

Any Europeans visiting South East Asia might look at the roads and think, "dangerous chaos", and consequently be put off going on a tour on the back of a scooter. The reality is, in Vietnam at least, that the chaos is ordered, and the roads are therefore relatively safe, even for pedestrians crossing through a tidal wave of oncoming motorbikes and scooters.

This tour was a, if not The, highlight of a full north to south tour of Vietnam. You are picked up by the Vespa drivers from your hotel, given your helmet, take a quick photo and off you go. The drivers are clearly well-trained and err on the safe side in all their driving. The result is that you quickly relax into the spirit of the tour and get to see the city from a perspective not normally available to tourists.

Arriving first at a coffee shop for drinks, nibbles and to meet your host, the evening kicks off with a smile. Tuan (a.k.a. Eric) was fantastic - fun, great sense of humour, but balanced by being informative and helpful all evening. He explained the format of the evening, and before you know it, you're off again into the evening traffic.

Next stop is the first of two street food experiences. I have to say that these street restaurants produced amongst the best food we ate on the whole trip, and happily catered for us as vegeterian/pescatarian eaters. There is more than enough to eat, and the beers flowed all evening. Again, your host meets you at each stop and the entertainment continues. With Tuan we never stopped laughing all night.

Fourth stop was a traditional Vietnamese coffee shop (and one that no tourist would ever find on their own) - quite a surreal experience - and then the final stop was a "club" in which a live band played cover versions of western rock songs. You are then returned to your hotel with the biggest cheesiest grin on your face that it's possible to imagine. Tuan/Eric, we salute you: thanks for making the evening so special.

Thoroughly recommend this tour, the Vespa ride gives you a totally authentic experience of navigating the main streets and back streets of Saigon. So much good food to taste, music stops and drinks included, it was a highly entertaining way to spend an evening. Thank you for making this one of the best holiday tours ever!

Our group had the most amazing time with Vespa adventures. We are all 65 plus and found the drivers and guide Chris were excellent.
We felt totally safe wherever we went and found the varying destinations to be a good mix of fun and cultural experience. The bars, night market, temple , restaurant and rice wine shop were all great. What a way to see Siem Reap's night life! Highly recommended by all our group!

They picked up 22 of us at our hotel and were very helpful with helmets, getting on the vespa and tasking photos before we left. It was a two hour drive. Very hectic traffic in the city and it was exciting weaving in and out of the traffic. We stopped at a couple of sights along the way and tasted rice wine at one of the stops. My driver was very funny and helpful. Two of our group were in their late 80's and they had a great time as well.
I would thoroughly recommend it to anyone.

review_title: Yes! Must do even with kids!
review_text:
We did the morning tour with our 6y old son. He never sat on a motorbike before. When we booked we asked for a back support. They took care of him so lovely! And he loved it.
It is the best way to see the city. Just do it.

It was thrilling to be on the back of a Vespa, after dark, in all of that crazy traffic. Even so, it felt safe and it was great to get away from the main tourist areas and into what felt like the authentic Saigon. We ate great food in small street side restaurants, sat in our baby chairs at baby tables as they do and drank more beer than we would have done had we had the front seat of the Vespa. A great, sociable evening.

Guide name: khang
Better to explain everything what i would like to know, just to suggest for every one

We did the Saigon by night tour and absolutely loved it. Terrifying at first, but so much fun! After the first hair-raising 20 minutes in the insane anarchy of Saigon traffic (and a few beers), we just relaxed and went with the flow. Not the cheapest way to see Saigon, but probably the most exciting, and a great way to experience some excellent food in non-touristy places.

A friend who had lived in HCM city told us we just had to do this tour. We signed up in advance, and after arriving in the city and seeing the traffic started to panic! There was absolutely no need to panic. Our driver came on time to our hotel to pick us up and we headed out into the chaos. We had chosen the evening food tour and we were whisked from bar to restaurants feeling safe every step of the way. We ate in lovely local restaurants we would never have found ourselves and learned about the varied dishes we were tasting. I totally recommend this tour - so much fun and very safe - even in the craziness of HCM city.

My friend had visited Vietnam last year and recommended this excursion. When I showed my husband our Vietnam itinerary a few days before we left (yes, that's when he looked at it), he immediately was alerted by the vespa tour. We had not yet known what the traffic was like, but he already was concerned. I figured we could get off if we were that scared (we are in our late 50's). My husband was a motorcycle cop for many years and I think he needed "control". Anyway, we showed up at our designated spot and were offered a drink. We were greeted by Na, our go to person. She was friendly, professional, and a lot of fun. We went to a few restaurants outside where we were staying and to two bars. The first bar had some really good singers and the second bar had flamenco singers/dancers. This was a very fun evening and not something we would have experienced had we just walked out our hotel room and found a restaurant. Our drivers were very nice and drove safely.
Felt very confident in my driver, thanks for the great pair up Thomas! Really enjoyed the little stops along the way and just a different way to experience traveling around.

review_title: Best tour in town and best we have experienced
review_text:
Professional staff, great guide and a real experience. A must do.

Our six year old daughter loved it and the driver was great with her. Only problem with a six year old was watching her on the back of a scooter. Enough to give a parent a heart attack! She was great and the driver was very aware of her safety.

We will use again!

Wow. This tour exceeded all our expectations. What great enthusiastic passionate knowledgeable lady katty was. We had such a great night cruising to each craft beer stop. Some of the beer and food was award winning world class. The stop into "the heart of darkness" was the highlight for its award winning craft beer, the chocolate chilli is a must try beer also! Thanks again for the awesome night. The drivers were very safe and fun. Loved it. Would do it again

review_title: EXCELLENT WAY TO SPEND A FEW HOURS
review_text: Instead of spending a long layover stuck in Ho Chi Mihn's airport my wife and I decided to head in to the city for this Vespa tour. Are we glad we did. Vy and her guys (Nyuk & Thach) were amazing. Not only did we get an abridged tour of the city, but had a blast doing it, and Vy was a great host. If you're looking for a really unique way to understand the flow of the sprawling city, this is a really great way to do it. Hope you have as much fun as we did.

i say do it now because old saigon is disappearing rapidly.soon we shall be left with the main tourist centre and five star shopping.
the tour provided hotel pick up and return,we visited some of the older parts of this city as well as a quick look at the tourist centre, the tour finished with a meal at there own cafe which included a couple of beers and a chance to ask a few questions and regain our composure after daring the saigin traffic.
traffic is horrendous of course but to attempt a quick tour by car is very difficult.
i am seventy years old but i enjoyed every minute of it.
Joined a half day city tour with other 5 people from different nationalities. We all had great trip. Very safe tour though driving in Saigon is so dangerous. Highly recommend!
You want to get local, this is the trip for you, scary but absolute fun! Lots of bars and foodie places you wouldn't find on your own, magical!

review_title: The best fun I've had in years!
review_text: We were looking for something a little different and we found it! Vespa Adventures have recently started their 'Craft Beer Tours', and although we were unsure about what to expect, we had a helluva night! Seventeen different beers to taste across four venues with food accompaniments.... a great tour guide in Truc (Nicole). And the drivers were fabulous.... I was a little apprehensive having never been on a bike before but they managed the traffic and our safety without question. So much fun! Can't wait for the Mekong Delta tour on Sunday!

We did the night Vespa tour on our last night, it was a fantastic trip, if you are reading this thinking about doing it, book it you won't regret it. We were picked up by our drivers from the hotel and taken to our first stop a road side cafe,where we were out into groups with 3 other couples of similar age, and nationality met our guide and given free drinks. Then we were off, riding through the busy chaotic streets on our Vespa, the drivers made us feel very safe, we then stopped at our next visit for street food and more drinks, each dish explained to us by the guide, food and drinks included throughout the tour. Off again, another restaurant indoors this time, more food, drinks, then off again! This time to a little hidden away club with local live bands playing, coffee at this stop, then off again to another club for our final stop, live music, all excellent, then safely taken back to our hotel. Thank you for a great experience

review_title: Really good day organised by Vespa Adventures
review_text: Really helpful online when I made a short notice booking for a full day tour of the Cu Chi tunnels in the morning and then 'hidden' HCMC in the afternoon. Pick-up in the morning was prompt and friendly and the boat trip to the tunnels included breakfast, refreshments, lunch and a great guide. I was collected on return straight from the dock by my Vespa driver and accompanying guide. Both were great. After spending the day before dodging the mopeds in the busy traffic as a pedestrian, it was great to be part of it! Although it was nice to have a private Vespa tour, I would have preferred a group experience as I think that would have added to the fun as it had in the morning. That aside, it was a great day and I saw exactly what I hoped. Although not cheap: $135 + tips, I thought it was good value and would definitely recommend.

Our tour group of seven women spent our last evening in Vietnam on the Vespa tour. It was amazing. The traffic was madness, but our skilled riders kept us all safe and transported us to the various venues we visited, all of which were enjoyed by all. Coming from a country town and also being a scooter rider myself, the traffic could have been overwhelming, but I just sat back and relaxed, and thoroughly enjoyed the ride. I smiled the whole way! A great way to see the city and get amongst the action.

I would absolutely recommend this evening tour to anyone and everyone. I can't think of anyone who has a sense of adventure, who wouldn't enjoy it.

review_title: Don't miss out on this epic adventure
review_text:
For me mate's bachelor's, we planned a trip to HCM, after searching around the reviews and all, we took a chance at Vespa Adventures after reading some awesome reviews. There were in total of 5 of us, all dressed in super hero outfits, and ready for some great food.

Our drivers were very professional, and they drove very safely. I'm a 6 foot tall 185lb male, and I thought it'd make it difficult for him to maneuver his bike. But, Duong, was great. He expertly weaved the streets, and knew the streets like the back of his hand. He was also able to answer all my questions as I pointed to the major monuments and beautiful buildings.

The food tour was by far the highlight of the whole adventure. If you're so lucky to get Lora as your tour guide, you will not only be learning about food but politics and life of day to day Vietnamese people. She's sharp, witty, and clued in. You will not have a dull moment with Lora, and she will bring life to the adventure which you'd never expect.

Thanks Vespa Adventures for this epic time.

We did the foodies tour and it was fantastic Onion Phi really looked after us with lots of information and amazing food!
We have done the Vespa tours before and this was one of the best as Onion Phi was a crazy, funny and entertaining!

Loved my evening tour of Saigon with Vespa Adventures so much, that I rave about it to everyone and anyone that will listen! It was definitely one of my holiday highlights.

I chose the Saigon After Dark tour, as the mix of zooming around town on the back of a Vespa, non-stop munching, and drinking appealed to me the most.

I was picked up from my hotel promptly by my driver and we set off to meet the rest of the group. After meeting for a welcome drink we spent the next 4 hours exploring Saigon in the safe hands of our experienced drivers, and our lovely tour guide.

The food we had in both restaurants was excellent, and I really enjoyed the acoustic cafe we visited. My only gripe would be with the drinks, or more so the lack of choice. The website clearly states that you can eat and drink as much as you like, but the choices available were quite limited, it's either beer or soft drinks, and I can't stand beer! I only had drinks that I enjoy at the first and last stop, so unless you drink beer fill your boots during the welcome meeting at Cafe Zoom!

Fantastic experience we will never forget, it was mayhem at night, but we all relaxed & enjoyed the experience, drivers for our group were very friendly, picked up at the hotel & straight into the traffic. Street food was good although don't look at the kitchens or the chefs smoking. Its a must do - we all survived - and very much recommend this trip.

Went for business but at night wanted to do something before take the flight at 2am

Take this tour with Vespa Adventure and it was indeed an ADVENTURE

Great vespa motorcycles with very nice hosts Mrs. Anh and the drivers very nice. My group was of 5 so we all 5 enjoyed too much

We saw the city in a very differebt way. Went to little bars and food local street shops to eat good food

I totally recommend it.

We didn't expect to have as much fun as we did and eat the best local cuisine. We were skeptical about taking a scooter tour because it seemed dangerous since this was our first time in Vietnam. Now we know better. The Vietnamese drive better than any other country we've driven in including Italy and South Africa. We ate at two restaurants which had the best food we'd eaten in Saigon and we went to two live music venues. A coffee house and Acoustic Cafe which we didn't want to leave. The evening starts at their cafe for drinks to meet up with your guide. I'd do this tour again and I want a Vespa for at home now.

We wanted to see a bit more than the centrally located sights in HCM City. Seeing that motorcycles and scooters are the primary mode of transportation for many locals, we thought this would be a fun and adventurous way to see the city. We were met by our drivers at our hotel. After putting on our helmets, we had a short ride over to Zoom Cafe where we met the others in our group - 6 on our tour. A simple lunch was provided before our afternoon tour. Not many choices, but the ginger chicken and pineapple fried rice were good along with a couple beers! The tour was a blast. We had so much fun riding in the midst of all the traffic and chaos. Have faith in your driver and just enjoy the ride. They know what they are doing. We stopped at various points of interest. Some were just ok, but some like the 10,000 Buddha temple were very enjoyable and off the beaten path. Each time we stopped, our drivers would remove our helmets and put them back on when we were ready to go again. When it rained, they did the same with the rain ponchos. We loved the experience and think it is a great, unique way to see some of the city.
After watching the traffic from street level it's great fun to actually get amongst it, you'll feel safe in the hands of the experienced bike riders

We have traveled to Vietnam many times but this tour was a first for us. Soooo much fun traveling through the crazy traffic of Ho Chi Minh, stopping off for meals & drinks at local cafes & finishing at a night club. Definitely a highlight of our trip. The youngest age from our group was 12 years of age up to about 70 years of age.

We loved this tour and did an afternoon after the Cu Chi tunnels..loads of fun and our guide was pretty funny as he was a little out there..went off the beaten track and visited lots of cool parts of the city that we would never have got to..highly recommend

What a blast going around town on the back of a Vespa! Went to District 4 for a dinner where locals dine - fun to watch the passers by. Also went to Zoom Cafe for a most refreshing lemonade slushy! Various stops along the way included the flower market. Miggy most informative and wish I knew the name of our drivers because I wanted to commend them for the professional way they drove.

5 blokes at first wanted the beer tour. Last minute we changed to Saigon after dark food your. Ended up being the best of both worlds as there was plenty to drink as well as some nice seafood.

Highlight of the 'tour' was our host Lora who has an absolutely awesome personality. She's very down to earth and by the end of the night she's like an old friend already. Funny, smart and smiley, she really showed us a great time with lots of local restaurants and bars.

Vespa tour was safe and was a great way to see the city at night. Highly recommended all round. You'll have an unforgettable time if you're lucky enough to get Lora as your host. She's great. Thank you Vespa adventures!

review_title: The BEST thing to do in the city!
review_text:
This tour was a blast, and it couldn't have been made without the wonderful Lora. We had the best time touring the city, together with exploring the sites as well as eating amazing food.

Lora is an adorable and a wonderful and bubbly host. She was attentive, fun, witty and knowledgable.

She's a massive asset to Vespa Adventures and deserves all the praise flowing her way! Much kudos to her and a lovely time.

If possible, defiantly get Lora as your host. You won't regret it!

This was the most brilliant fun. Zooming round Ho Chi Minh City at night was fantastic, and I'd urge anyone to try it. Our hostess Miggie was lovely, and the drivers were great too. The food we ate was some of the best street food we ate in Vietnam, and the 2 bars we visited rounded off a perfect evening. Didn't want it to end. Highly recommend.
The only way to experience Saigon! Brilliant whizzing around the streets on the back of a Vespa. Great drivers. Good street food and an enthusiastic guide.

So much fun & highly recommended for 10-80yo. Felt very safe with all our drivers despite the apparent chaos of traffic.
The night food tour was a definite highlight of our 3 weeks, fantastic food & surprising conclusion that made me feel like I'd fallen down the rabbit hole like Alice in Wonderland.
Seriously not to be missed!

What a great night we had with Vespa Adventures. We were a group of 10 and riding on the back of the Vespas was a highlight of our trip. The local Vietnamese restaurants they took us to very fantastic and the food delicious. All food and drinks are included in the tour price very good value. Our guide Katty was fantastic. All the drivers of the Vespas were excellent and did not feel unsafe at any time. Would highly recommend.

Excellent night out on the back of a Vespa, stopping at yummy and amazingly delicious local eateries. Our hostess, yuen, was a pleasure to talk to, and the guys on the Vespa were caring and careful drivers. Too much food, btw, but it was all a fabulous experience. We also stopped at a cafe, where a Vietnamese pianist and violin player accompanied a Vietnamese singer that sung in English, songs originating in Russia. It was quite an experience!
Would recommend to anyone traveling to Ho chi min city.

What a treat! Can't recommend this tour highly enough! It was our first night in town and seeing the city from the back of a scooter was spectacular. Plus our tour guide Katy was awesome! She was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and spoke great English. The beers here are awesome. We were blown away by what these small guys are doing and how well. Mmmm... hops
Great beer, tasty food and vespas are so much fun! Staff are super friendly and we were lucky enough to speak to some of the brewers.

review_title: A must do - highlight of our trip
review_text:
If you aren't sure whether to book this, then just go for it. £70 sounds like (and is) a lot, but it's well worth it and this was by far the highlight of our two week trip. We did the after dark food tour, a visit round some great local eateries with loads to eat and drink, lovely people and interesting foodie tips before drinks and live music at a cafe and bar.

You get into the swing of the bikes seconds in - I'm by no means an adrenaline junkie, and absolutely loved the experience of being on the bikes and weaving through traffic. Guides are conscious of keeping you next to not only your group, but your partner/friend/family member and it really is so much fun. We felt very safe and really trusted the drivers.

This is a great experience and a must do - the business has earned itself a well deserved excellent reputation.

review_title: Had the time of our lives
review_text: Once you overcome your fear of weaving through traffic on the back of a scooter you'll be fine. It's actually quite safe and the riders are very experienced. You get to see experiences and some great sights, sounds and of course food. Would do it again in a (very fast) heart beat!

Vespa Adventures is a wonderful opportunity to truly experience the travel, food and entertainment components of the Vietnamese culture. Trust the drivers and hang on for the excitement that is Vietnam.

review_title: Super evening! Loved every minute! Great food tour on the back of a vespa😀👍
review_text: We were collected from our apartment by five lovely drivers & their Vespas and taken to meet Hang for a drink and briefing. After the first journey all my anxieties disappeared;our youngest(11) loved every minute of it!! Lots of lovely food, including frogs legs..something different at each stop👍 We missed the last stop as it was getting late but we enjoyed every minute and would highly recommend it. The guys and Hang were superb!

Must admit I wasn't sure what I'd let myself in for but it was a great fun experience. We were collected from our hotel and taken to the starting cafe for a drink and to meet our team to be led by Na. We then buzzed round the streets of Saigon visiting two restaurants and two music venues. The food was abundant and excellent. I couldn't manage much at the second though it looked delicious. Drinks flowed at all the venues and our drivers were excellent weaving in and out of Saigon traffic. Our guide was also informative and fun. An excellent way to experience Saigon at night!

Very good. Thought i would die. What an interesting way to see the city and What an adventure. We didn't have too much time and with this ride we saw a lot. Excellent drivers. Great Laughs. Thanks Cao Huy Ly (Lawrence lee)!

review_title: Saigon day tour on a Vespa!
review_text: We took the afternoon Saigon tour, WOW what a great time. Picked up at hotel, provided lunch to start. The drivers were very safe conscious and made sure we were comfortable, little bit of rain and out came the raincoats so we didn't get wet at all. Our guide Tu was very informative and spoke great English, explaining the various sights. In particular our drivers, Ku and Huang were terrific, funny and careful. Great way to see Saigon, the Vespas were PX 150 and looked really cool, if you love vespas you will love this experience, if you want to try a scooter experience then this is great safe way to see Saigon thanks guys ps we loved this so much we also took the HOi An tour.

Friends recommended this tour to us and we weren't disappointed. We were picked up promptly and off we went on our scooters, wearing our orange helmets. We had Tunh as ou unidentifiable brother made sure we got food we liked a each stop. There was lots of food, which was really good - from frogs legs, crabs, clams, mussels at the first stop to spring rolls, pancakes and ice cream at other stops - just masses of food! You could order several drinks at each stop if you want them. You feel safe on the back of the scooter very quickly and it's great fun zooming along in the traffic. You stop at a couple of music venues which are great. This trip is a 'must' no matter what age you are - our group ranges from 55-70 and every one thought it was a real highlight of the tour. As one person in our group said "I don't know what we paid for this tour but it was worth it"! (The cost was included in our whole tour package). We were all smiling all the way round, it's fantastic! You get a photo at the end to take away with you.

Just had one of the best tours so far on our trip to Indochina, admittedly helped by meeting up with two other couples we know who happened to be in HCMC at the same time, and our guide Tung (sorry if I've got your name wrong). I was quite nervous about doing this tour, but surprisingly felt safe with my driver very quickly. Went to places that as a tourist you just wouldn't go to, great venues, great food, great music.

We only had 1 night in Ho Chi Minh City and are so glad that we booked the 'Saigon After Dark' tour.
The whole experience was excellent.
It was well organized, right down to Being picked up by your Vespa driver at the hotel.
Food, drink and venues were fantastic.
Thanks for making our night so memorable. Will definitely book with Vespa Adventures again!

We did the Saigon After Dark tour and had one of the best times we have ever had. Our guide, Tien, was excellent and we thoroughly enjoyed spending time with him. Our drivers were excellent as well. I would definitely recommend going hungry for this tour as there is a surprising amount of food to eat. The drinks were great as were the diversity of places we stopped at. It was exciting and a great way to tour around the city. Definitely a must do! If I am in the area I will certainly do this again!

review_title: An adventure not to be missed!
review_text: We went on the street food evening tour. A really good evening including far too much food, so make sure you are good and hungry before going. The coffee shop with music was lovely, we could happily sit there all night. Drivers were excellent. Do not leave Ho Chi Min without doing this 😄

My boyfriend and I selected Vespa Adventure for our Mekong Delta trip and we were not disappointed. The vespas took us through the many streams of the Mekong delta that were definitely on the off beaten path. Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable. Please do not hesitate to book with this company. It was the highlight of our trip here.

We did the Saigon After Dark experience and I can't recommend it highly enough. The organisers, the drivers, the restaurants and clubs, the fabulous old Vespas....everything was absolutely top notch. We were a group of 40 colleagues, you can imagine the logistics required to manage a group that size - and they pulled it off flawlessly. The most fun I've ever had in a foreign city, huge adrenaline rush but felt quite safe at all times too. The chaos of Saigon traffic was insane, but the drivers were excellent and confident, making it an outstanding experience.

They picked us up, complete with helmets and bikes in good shape. They took us for drinks where we met our guide (Hung) and the rest of our group, then we went for a tour through two districts and for food - local seafood (7 dishes, including frogs legs for the more adventurous!), then on through more of HCMC, to a Vietnamese pancake restaurant (where we were taught to make our own spring rolls), then on to a cafe for tea/coffee and ice cream with live music, onto a bar/club, with more live music.

They catered well for my vegetarian friend. They never rushed us, but we never felt like we were bored or waiting to move. We felt safe on the bikes and we each had the same driver each night (thanks Pao!). Fantastic evening and topped off really well by them giving us our photos from the evening. Highly recommended!

An incredible and thrilling experience! A fantastic way to see Saigon at night, with the street lights providing a warm glow to the streets. Our fabulous guide Ruby, made it seem like the evening was planned just for us. Each food stop was unique and filling and just when you thought you were done..we were back on the Vespa for yet another stop. Our Vespa drivers were delightful and professional. It was a highlight of our stay in Saigon and would highly recommend it!
Super fun experience! It was a great tour full of amenities and varied plans, definitely recommended for another perspective of the City (Saigon) and to have a great time. The tour guide was great!

review_title: The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: From a hidden temple to an outdoor bird cafe to the shear fun of experiencing the city on a Vespa, we loved every minute of our adventure. Our guide Terry was witty and knowledgeable. My driver was charmingly courteous and safety-conscious, always making sure my helmet was strapped on correctly and pointing out sites along the ride. Highly recommend!

If you are thinking about doing the Tour by Night don't think just do it.
They really look after you. Their food is authentic and so yummy. Drinks are free flowing. The riders are great and you see a lot of HCMC. I also loved the music at our stops. A really great night.

The formula is known- get around the bustling city on a Vespa "like a local", taste some local food, get to know the city, etc, etc. YOU KNOW that they are taking you to the same restaurant everyone else goes, YOU KNOW that the jokes have been told many (many) time before, yet VESPA ADVENTURES makes it feel real! All the awards mentioned in other reviews are spot on. Which is exactly the point. The operation is flawless, each and every guide is charming, each driver is kind. You have no choice but to fall in love with the experience and feel it is authentic.
It was a lovely night indeed. the ride on the Vespa through the rushing traffic, the food was interesting and good, the booze flowing and the company delightful. A night that started with a guide and 4 other strangers, ended at the wee hours with some good new friends.
Even though you know what to expect- Don't miss this experience.

The night tour of Saigon (Ho Chi Min city) is a definite must do. We had so much fun being guided through this bustling city on Vintage Vespa's. our guide Nam was absolutely outstanding and treated us like royalty. From the first stop at the pedestrian bridge and a delicious local drink enjoyed while learning about all we can see to the next stop at a local seafood restaurant, that is typically enjoyed by the local people. The fresh seafood was excellent. Next stop was a local Vietnamese Restaurant, again fabulous food and a local favourite. Onto a coffee house where we treated were to the beautiful voices of two local singers, performing in both their native dialect and English. The final stop was a local bar with entertainment, local bands performing cover songs of a wide range of well known artists. It was a 5 1/2 hour journey of non stop fun.

It was one of the best things we did. It gave us the opportunity to feel, smell and taste Saigon at night. One thing is to watch the motor bikes go by and to watch everyone eating at all the outside food places but it was fantastic to experience it ourselves.

This is a must adventure for all visitors to Saigon. It is thrilling, yet safe, and allows one to feel the beat of a great Asian city. There are 5 stops including welcome drinks/spirits, street seafood, street Vietnamese pancake, coffee or sweets at a club with great singers and a trip to a bar for a drink and the local band scene. The drivers are amazing and skilled. Our guide Thien provides a wealth of information on Vietnamese life and customs. He spoke perfect English. The best way to get around!

We just did the "Saigon after dark tour" and it was fabulous! There are 7 of us and we range in age from 16-64 and we all had a great time. The food, drinks, and music stops were all wonderful and the drivers are super safe! Don't miss out on this! Yes, you are literally inches away from cars and other bikes and at first glance it seems insane, but we did not ever feel unsafe. It's really a very neat thing to experience! "Controlled chaos" really is the perfect way to explain it. Seeing Saigon as an active participant really made us appreciate the city much more.
Must do if in Saigon. The food was great and went to locations that I would have never tried. Great band at the coffee bar and friendly tour director.
Amazing evening in Ho Chi Minh City - Lunar was a great tour guide. The best way to see the city, we would thoroughly recommend it.

If you come to Saigon this is a must. Any age can do this as long as you can get on and off a Vespa! We had a really fun evening, the drivers were competent, careful and relaxed. Felt completely at ease, saw so much night life, ate food I would never have tried and totally loved the atmosphere. Warning though! Don't eat lunch or any meal a good few hours ago, we came back completely full!!! One of the best tours I have ever done. Very professional, our guide was there at every stop explaining everything!

review_title: Fab Way To See Saigon At Night and Brilliant Fun
review_text:
Just returned from our Vespa Adventure foodie tour of Saigon and can't think of a better way to have more fun in an evening here in Saigon.
The whole thing is extremely well organized and we both felt extremely safe the whole time. We were picked up from our hotel at 6.00 pm by vintage Vespa and taken to a cafe to meet our guide as well as had our first drink. Before long we set off across the city to a street food stop for crabs legs, mussels and shrimp salad plus loads more drink. The next stop included three courses of food and more to drink before we headed off to a delightful coffee bar and listened to live music . The final stop was a small club bar - Acoustic - where we listened to more excellent live music whilst drinking our cocktails. We were then returned to our hotel at about 11.00 pm .
This is a brilliant evenings fun, with great food and drink thrown in. It's also a great way to see the city at night and experience what it's like to ride a Vespa in this city of the scooter. It's crazy but it just seems to work.
Can't recommend this highly enough . Just do it!

An evening tour on the back of Original Vespas (mine built in 1968) gives a great sense of the city at night and of how the traffic feels when viewed from the other side! Very professional and safe whilst creating a sense of excitement. Our tour was broken into small groups (6 in our case), each with a guide which made it all manageable. Su was excellent and knowledgeable. Two restaurant stops providing delicious seafood dishes at the first and pancakes at the second with plenty of beer (passengers only!) to quench the thirst from the chilli, salty crab claws and dusty roads. You need a hunger for this tour! A brief stop at an "unplugged" open mic club was charming and we finished up at a busy young music venue before being taken to our hotel. The emphasis is on the stops rather than the journey, so you may have to remind your driver to tell you what you are seeing as you whizz by. I would highly recommend this if you have an evening to spare.

review_title: Best thing to do of an evening in HCMC
review_text: Brilliant trip around the city to very different places for food and drinks all in. The food was fantastic. The tour leader great. The 2 bottles of vodka went down well also. To be recommended.

This was recommended to us by friends and did not disappoint. Whizzing through the streets of Saigon. 2 restaurants and 2 night clubs. A real adventure. Vespa drivers were excellent and we reached parts others do not get close to. Very good value for a fun night out. Thoroughly recommend

It was a great experience. Our guide Terry was fantastic and brought us to places we would not have visited on our own, such as a cafe where retirees bring their bird cages, across the Saigon river where you have a fantastic view of Saigon skyline, and various pagodas. Our guide provided us with insights of the Vietnamese culture and history that made the tour even more interesting. I would definitely book another tour where Vespa Adventures operate.

review_title: Best thing we did in Vietnam
review_text:
We did the Saigon after dark tour. We had such good fun.
Our drivers came and picked us up and delivered us back to our hotel which was in District 2.
The food and drink was great and our tour guide Catty was great fun.

Had the most amazing experience on this tour. Guide was fabulous Vespa drivers superb we had so much fun, food was wonderful, coffee bar and night club were a great experiences. Well organized highly recommend this as a way to see Saigon by night.

review_title: Was disappointed, rushed through by guide
review_text: I so wanted to give this a five but sadly I cannot. It started well and I was so excited. My driver was great and the group of people (two other couples) were lovely and fun, but our Guide rushed us through the night as she wanted to finish early! The food is great but we were still hungry and left a lot behind due to the guide wanting to move on. The first music stop was nice but we were not there long as the guide liked the next place (and last stop) which was horrible. It was so crowded in the end we had to stand on the entrance steps until more standing room became available and then it was so loud you could not talk to anyone. I would try it again and hope to get a different guide as it was fun on the vespa and I had a lovely driver.

review_title: Perfect tour of Saigon by night - don´t miss out on this
review_text:
We were a family of 10, youngest nine years old and oldest 69 years old. Our guide and the drivers made us feel completely safe in the chaotic traffic of Saigon.
We had five stops in total and the food, drink and staff at all the places was fantastic. This is a journey you do not want to miss out on. Everyone in our family had such a great and memorable time.

We were met from our hotel by our drivers who then sped off to our first destination bar Cafe Zoom where we were met by our guide Chung who was absolutely fantastic. She asked questions she listened had great English and was really good fun.

After our beer we went off around town to a sea food restaurant at the side of the road (they all are). Food was great, Chung explained all the dishes and how to eat they accepted for Jumping Chicken (frogs legs) 😜 which were delicious.

We were then back on the Vespas and arrived at a back street music venue where local talent sings a few songs. Some in Vietnamese some in English.

Back on the bikes we headed for another bar called Yoko for live bands. Absolutely brilliant.

Once finished Chung wished us goodbye with framed photographs of us on the Vespas and we headed back to the hotel.

The drivers are excellent and very experienced and at no time did I feel unsafe. It's a must do trip.

We did the evening tour visiting a number of restaurants and clubs. Great fun being driven around in the controlled chaos of Saigon traffic. Very well organized and excellent drivers with real Vepas. Great way to see the city one night. We had a wonderful woman (nickname- Lavender) who was with us at every stop to handle the ordering of food and drinks (of which there was plenty) and answer our questions. Felt very safe every.

review_title: Not to be missed at any cost
review_text: What ever you do in Saigon, go on this tour. What a fabulous evening although I doubt if "uncle Ho" would have approved! Difficult to think you are in a communist city under a totalitarian regime. We were lucky as the lights from the Tet festival were still in place.

review_title: Our second Vespa Adventure tour and we are looking forward to our third tommorow
review_text:
We took the Morning Insider Saigon Vespa tour. Like every Adventure arranged by Buffalo tours at was fantastic. My wife and I are traveling on a one-month vacation in Vietnam. We consider ourselves extremely fortunate that.we booked our entire trip through the Vietnamese company called Buffalo Tours. Buffalo Tours looked after all accommodation, sightseeing Adventures and all transfers. Buffalo tours worked with us to customize a holiday to suit our needs and desires.
They always seem to arrange the best of the best in terms of local travel adventures and guides every place we go.
For every trip we go on, a private vehicle and Driver picks us up at our hotel, takes us to wherever the tour starts, and after the tour takes us back to our hotel.
Our first Vespa Adventure tour was A Day Tour in Hanoi. We loved this tour so much that we were very much looking forward to our second Vespa tour in Saigon. The Insider Saigon Tour, like all the custom adventures arranged by Buffalo tours was fantastic, fun, safe and very enjoyable. For this tour, the Vespa picks you up at your hotel. You get to visit 11 very unique educational and fun stops along the way. And just riding in the Saigon traffic with a professionally driven Vespa was tons of fun as well. The pacing of the Vespa tour is superb, and lots of coffee, water and WC breaks are provided. The tour ends with a wonderful lunch including ALL beverages .
We enjoyed the Unique Saigon Vespa tour so much, that we had Buffalo tours arrange on short notice the evening Vespa Adventure Foodie tour tomorrow.

The night tour was more fun than the day time. Did not see anything really significant or unusual during the daytime tour although our guide was very good
Did enjoy the ice coffee at the local bird park where bird owners bring there caged birds to chirp with other caged birds while the owners have coffee

review_title: Great fun night out on two wheels
review_text:
We really loved this trip. Each person has their own Vespa driver and you weave your way through the traffic much of which consists of other motorcycles which is exciting (some people were a bit nervous at first but it's fine really).

It's a great way to see HCM city by night and get some good food and entertainment on the way. We stopped at a bar, a seafood restaurant which was really good, a pancake place and two music venues - one local acoustic place and another which was more Spanish style. Drinks and food all included.

Highly recommended.

review_title: One of the best times on our trip
review_text:
The "Saigon After Dark" Vespa tour was one of the best times on our recent trip to Vietnam. Our group of six went on this tour on Valentine's night and had a great time. Food was nothing short of fabulous as well as the drivers and our lovely tour leader. The stop at a coffee shop with live music was the cherry on top.
We had no idea how much fun this would be and again the food was amazing. Two stops at different resturants one for appetizers and one for main courses. Free flowing drinks all the while. Tour leader even arranged to have one of the drivers pick me up some roses for our wives. I gave her one as well. Easy to give a five star review.

review_title: What a BLAST ! Too much fun and excitement!
review_text: We were picked up at our Hotel with the tour director and our drivers. My husband behind one and me on the other. Divers have to have grown up in this MAZE of every kind of transportation on the streets. Cars, motor bikes, bikes, loaded motorcycles and millions of the specialty vespas, yes they are a motor bike too. However there are varied degrees of bikes on the streets! The people don't seem to pay much attention to red lights, or lanes or for pedestrians. Walk on the streets at your own risk..However what a crazy fun tour, first drinks at office (which is just a drink stand) one restaurant for starters, the next for main meal and night cap at a jazz club with drinks. It just happened to be my 67th birthday and the drivers and tour director got the singers, band and the audience to sing happy birthday to me! One of my greatest surprises and BD! The next place was a hard rock club....not too important to us. But we manage to deal with the loud and very distorted sounds. Good for the young. Head back to the hotel where they (give) you a picture of you on the Vespa. As they say. JUST do it 👍🏼

review_title: Great fun, a good way to see Saigon by Night
review_text:
This tour was recommended by friends and I'm very glad we did it! It was a large group, split up into smaller groups, ours was 6 people plus our guide Hang. Seafood restaurant was excellent, we did see local people apart from our group eating there. The banh xeo place was delicious too. The acoustic music cafe was very interesting to see. Open mic night I think. And the rock bar was great fun! The band was very good (although too loud!)
Definitely a fun evening! Not cheap, but very well organized.
What a great way to see HCMC and to also experience the craft beer scene!! The drivers were great and the taprooms they took us to have awesome beer and great food too.

When our travel agent booked this adventure we were a bit hesitant to go on the tour. However from the minute we were collected from our hotel by the very confident and skilled Vespa bike drivers this was an evening never to forget.
When in Ho Chi Min city the traffic is manic. But on the back of a Vespa stopping of to different restaurants in the different districts and eating local cuisine something not to be missed.

This was a wonderful adventure around Saigon after dark. Visiting interesting places and being in the heart of the city among the local people. My driver was very experienced and friendly and our guide was very knowledgeable. I was provided with a framed photo of myself with my driver. Highly recommended.

Loved every second of the Night Foodie tour. Our host, Tien, was SUPERB (fun, knowledgeable and extremely likeable).
The Vespa drivers are also great. It is thrilling to be on the back of a Vespa in Saigon and you feel surprisingly safe! The food stops were delicious and the Vietnamese Coffee House was wonderful (the singers and musicians good). You will NEVER find such a place on your own. May be the best thing we have done here.

Really a great experience. The food was very good and local. Just what you want to do when visiting a place like Ho Chi Minh City. And the service was spectacular. The drivers were safe and the equipment was in good working order. And our Host, Jaden was simply the best. Her enthusiasm, tour knowledge and professionalism made the night very special. Definitely something I will do with other friends on my next visit AND of course, I will ask for Jaden to host!!

I have just been going through old photos and videos and reminded we hadn't written a review for our tour. We had so much fun - the food was great - staff were amazing and we definitely wouldn't have seen these things on our own. We still talk about it and it's a hot tip for friends who are heading over.

review_title: Go with the traffic flow on this foodie fest
review_text: Come hungry...and ready for an adventure. We whipped our way through Saigon's city streets on the back of a Vespa with our experienced driver. Each stop brought us to local restaurants, bars, and music venues we never would have discovered on our own. Truly immersive, this is an excellent way to see an overview of the night markets, taste a wide variety of Vietnamese cuisine at the fav hot spots of the locals (and I'm not kidding, come hungry, its a progressive feast) and get right in the middle of that crazy traffic that looks like a free-for-all, but works on a rhythm you have to experience to understand. Possibly my favorite attraction in Saigon--glad we did it at night, as it was comfortably cool and the lights of the city were beautiful.
If you come to Ho Chi Minh city then this tour is a must. Food was excellent & guide "Ai" very good.

review_title: Vespa Adventures at Hoi an, Danang, Vietnam
review_text: This was the highlight of our visit to Hoi An. My wife, Su, and I was recommended this tour by the hotel we stayed in - Almanity Resort and we enjoyed every minute of it. Not an ordinary tour like most small group tours by bus or car - this was an incredible small group tour on real vintage Vespa scooters by very experienced riders who gave us the thrill of our lives visiting remote farms, experiencing traditional crafts, tasting Vietnamese coffee, lunch in the midst of fields all led by a very charismatic and articulate tour leade who goes by the name Onion. You will miss a wonderful experience if you miss out on this Vespa tour in Hoi an.

And a crazy way to see it. Our kids absolutely loved this evening. I was nervous but quickly settled into enjoying every second. Fantastic places to stop and eat and drink like locals. Seeing the lights whizzing by amongst the traffic was extremely exhilarating and unforgettable.
Good route, the staff is very helpful... Cool bike, happy attitude and most is affordable! We love it and will come back!

review_title: Vietnam Vespa Adventures is a must!
review_text: I've booked 7 different times for guests that come to town and EVERY time is the same with great service!!

review_title: Food, drink and Vespa.... the perfect combo!
review_text:
Recently took this Vespa tour in HCMC, following a recommendation.... and was not disappointed!

The "riders" were courteous and safe, the Vespas well maintained, the helmets provided were clean and in good condition, and our Guide was friendly and knowledgeable.

The duration of the tour is 4+ hours, and involves several pit stops at bars, cafes and places to eat (including some of the must-visit street food markets).

Be prepared to trust your rider as he or she threads their way through the traffic, relax, enjoy the views and make a few new friends along the way.

Not to be missed! 👍🏻

review_title: Fun way to explore Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Its one of the best fun filled way to explore Ho Chi Minh City, teh riders are safe , friendly and patient..the tour is for about 3 -4 hours and you can to see most of the touristy places of HCM city.
We had a wonderful time touring around Hoi An with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. Our drivers were very friendly and also great tour guides. Highly recommended!

review_title: A Fun activity to do in Vietnam
review_text:
We took during the night the motorbike in a very fun and tasty tour of Saigon. We were riding the center of the city and later we went to the best street food in Ho Chi min city. You get a glimpse of local life as you taste a range of dishes in a little neighborhood that their specialty is sea food and is one of the most famous street for nearly 30 years . Its not a fancy restaurant is a simple but tasty restaurant we visited everything you eat and drink is local . After tasting different dishes, we went to a pub to see local music very nice a lovely and later we went to see Vietnamese rock band.
It was fun and completely different from the common travel tour.

If you want to do something fun and different, this is the tour you need to take
Highly recommended

Lourdes Miranda
San Juan
Puerto Rico

review_title: one of my best tours in Asia
review_text: Great value for the money, good drivers, excellent guide, perfect schedule, nice places to visit during tour

A group of us took the Vespa Adventures Saigon After Dark package. It was part of our tour so I am not sure what we were charged but regardless it was loads of fun. The tour starts with you and a driver on a Vespa- you have a helmet and the driver is very professional so you are safe. You visit five different venues with unlimited food and drink. All the venues were most enjoyable but our favorite was the Live Acoustic Cafe.
There are no negatives with this tour and it is a must do. My only tip is avoid eating and drinking before the tour because you will be absolutely stuffed.

review_title: The best tour we have undertaken!
review_text: Having traveled extensively, we consider this the best tour we have undertaken. The combination of the experience of driving through Ho Chi Minh traffic, the fantastic eateries that we will have never seen by ourselves, the music venues and the friendly staff made this a brilliant night. Have recommended to friends!

A half day tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Astonishingly good fun.
Picked up from the hotel and taken to meet the other two folks who had also booked. The city is manic traffic-wise. No rules. No lost tempers either.
We started off fairly sedately but as the drivers clearly assessed our tolerance, the speed ramped up! we saw many of the main tourist photo shoots, the guide was very informative and it was rounded up with a great lunch. Thoroughly recommended.

This was probably the best thing we did during our trip to Vietnam! It was a little pricey, but it was definitely worth it. Mai ("Jaeden") was our guide and made the trip so much more fun! The drivers in Vietnam are scary (haha!), but our Vespa drivers were skilled, so it was enjoyable. I think riding around on Vespas is a necessary part of truly experiencing the culture, so I'm super grateful for the opportunity. Not to mention, the food was delicious and the drinks were free flowing! Doesn't get much better!

After being picked up at the hotel, we then went to the main meeting point, where we got familiar with the others in the group. We rode around a part of HCMC to 5 locations and sampled the different type of foods, our guide was very knowledgable. Highly recommended but a bit pricey but recommended,I will go again but in another city.

Well..... when I was told I was going on a Vespa tour the morning after landing in country, I snorted my beer and chuckled to myself!! I mean..... having just survived what seemed like the most chaotic taxi ride from the airport, nobody would be crazy enough to book me onto a scooter tour right??.......Wrong!!!!
The Bikes landed early and after a few photos of some very nervous travellers we met our drivers, climbed aboard and buzzed off into the city!! Mr Lee was very friendly and within no time I was comfy on the bike, whizzing through the city traffic!! I'm a big guy (6', 20st plus) and had no problems fitting on the bike.
Not wanting to spoil the surprises on the itinerary, the morning tour is VERY VERY good and we saw things that maybe aren't on a traditional tour route. Our guide was super friendly and spoke great English. His tour was excellent and informative.
Buzzing through the (very) busy city we felt safe at all times.....even when pulling across four lanes of traffic!!
Aside from being covered in big city grime by the end of four hours I had an absolutely amazing time.
The tour ended with a lunch in the company cafe, which gave me my first taste of delicious Vietnamese food....however there were more western dishes available which looked equally tasty.
The trip ended with a ride back to our accommodation, a lot less stressed than the ride out had been!!!
I wish I had had time to do the night time food tour as speaking to others it is supposed to be amazing, maybe I will get the chance another time.

You won't regret booking a tour with these guys, it was legit!!!:-)

We went on the half day tour of the Southern Provinces.

They do waste time as some have noted in their reviews, taking you to meet up in a cafe, taking you to their shop and then a petrol station to fill up with petrol. Not sure why they couldn't do all of this before??

Tour was good. Ruby was knowledgeable and my driver Tam was happy friendly and I felt safe being driven by him.

I would do another tour with them.
