Despite a last minute reservation for the night tour, they organized additional vespas and tour guide to accommodate our group of six people. Staff was very professional and easy going. The tour is highly recommendable if you want to have a nice glimpse of the city, eat delicious food, visit unique places and have fun!

To be fair and honest, we did a Vespa adventure in Hoi An and it was amazing and safe. We thought it might be the same in Saigon. It was still amazing and our guide was great. However the speed at which they drive and the weaving in and out of traffic, it's only a matter time before someone is seriously injured as a tourist. It may have happened in the past as well. I would not do the Saigon Vespa again given the lack of emphasis on safety.

Brilliant, on (the back of) a vespa in a tour of "Saigon after dark", you get a good feleing for Saigon at night. Had the time of our life. It is not cheap ($93) but it includes all drinks ( yes alcohol also) and food. 5 stops: welcome drinks and snack, local seafood place (delicious), Vietnamese pancake restaurant, a live music cafe and a live music venue. Don't eat lunch that day as the food and drinks are plenty. You leave your hotel (they pick you up) at 6pm, back at 10.30pm. A great and brilliant evening and added bonus: groups are only 7 people plus a guide, who spoke very good english, so we all mingled and compared notes on our various trips.
Not the cheapest but he seems like a guy you can trust and I say that it was about £4 for the day bargain good bike although it wasn't a Vespa best bike hire in town

Ho Chi Minh by night on the back of a vespa is an adventure to be had. My teenager son and adult kids enjoyed the madness of the city traffic, you get to experience Ho Chi Minh traffic up close and personal, so close that you can reach out and touch the person next to you. The places they they took us to eat was reasonable, clean but nothing to WOW us by. It was still flavoursome and lovely nevertheless. The last two venue we visit with the acoustic singers and band in the bar was a highlight for us. We could have stayed there a lot longer to see the local talent and soak up the party vibe a little longer. Overall the Vespa Adventure by night was still awesome, value for dollars and something different. Would do it again.

Please don't waste your time and money. Just get chatting with a local and they will be happy to take you to some better places than this tour group and probably for free. Hell, you could get a Xe Om or a grab bike for about $2-$5 and follow the tour group, once you see where they go, you'll be glad you didn't spend over $100.

review_title: Best experience during our stay in Saigon
review_text: Toured the city with great driver. They bought us to places we never would have found on our own. Authentic food, drink and music of Saigon. The highlight was our tour guide Tuan. He was excited, enthusiastic and so much fun.

Given the unbelievable chaos Of Saigon traffic, you might think that spending an evening on the back of a Vespa scooter would be next thing to a death wish. But is was a great evening! It is an upbeat adventure all over the city, with several stops for food, drink and music, all of which were convivial and of good quality. Not cheap, but a very exciting and enjoyable experience. Highly recommended. They take all ages.

A super fun way to get out and in the mix with the motor bikes. The multiple stops and great food made it into a fun night out.a wonderful way to see all the lights and decorations for the New Year too.
We enjoyed our night, food was great, entertainment was fun and the Vespa was full of adventure. Our tour guide was excellent, her name was Moon.

review_title: Still a great experience even in pouring rain
review_text:
I had booked the Country and Island (Hoi An) explorer for my family of four. It was pouring pouring rain. My husband felt ill and my little one was complaining she was cold - so only my 14 year old daughter and I went and only 2 others joined (because of the rain ... it was not a small rain but a big downfall hard rain).

Ben and his riders turned up with big rain coats and said - "yes, it will be great", and it was. Of course it wasn't how I pictured our tour but it just made it that kind of extra crazy fun. What we saw is that even when it is pouring, life and work still goes on in Vietnam. Still plowing the rice fields, old ladies riding their push bikes and we joined in. Ben was informative, friendly and the riders were great. We did come back cold and we did come back great but despite the odds, we came back smiling and enjoyed our experience.

review_title: Kids voted it the highlight of the trip!
review_text:
You haven't experienced Saigon until you have been on a Vespa! We did the insider tour our first day and my 13 & 16 year-old loved it. The Bird park & ​​coffee was a great way to start the morning. We went back and did the Night time food tour the next day and it was really a whole new experience being on the bikes at night.
Crazy fun, but I felt safe at all times. The drivers were very good at keeping us together and the kids are still thanking me for choosing Vespas and not a hot walking tour!!
VY and Hanh were great guides and their English was very good and easy to understand.
We made a few adjustments to our original tour, changed times to avoid the heat and ended the night time tour at Ice Cream instead of the bar. Vespa adventures was very accommodating and responded quickly to my email requests.

review_title: A crazy night out in Ho Chi Minh!
review_text:
A great night out, drinking local beer, eating local street food, experiencing the buzz of HCMC traffic from the back of a Vespa scooter.
We visited a number of restaurants, a coffee house, and a rock music bar.
Absolutely unforgettable!
The Vespa Adventure team did a great job. The traveling around was suitably scary, but really really safe. The drivers were very experienced and took no risks. Our hostess made sure that we all had a really good time. Looking forward to the next trip!

This is a must if visiting Vietnam it is great way to se Ho Chi Minh city at night. It was well organised a very professional and the staff are excellent . They take you to places that you would never find and also the food is traditional . We are going to da nang next and will do the tour again there with Vespa adventures

review_title: Hair in the air....bike on the ground...
review_text: A lovely experience whether you are seasoned tourist, resident or other. Totally enjoyable experience feeling safe and secure at the same time you are feeling exhilarated on the open road and in the city streets. The drivers are courteous and safe drivers and look after the individual and the group's needs. I have done trip both in Saigon's busy streets and in Hoi An countryside and they are both fantastic.

review_title: Good way to see Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
We did the Vespa night food tour in Ho Chi Minh. It was a really fun night and we got to experience local vietnamese food, however I wasn't game to tried fried frog legs. I was full by the end of the night.

They provide unlimited beer and soft drinks, however no other alcohol until the final bars of the night. We ended up in a small hipster bar with a small jazz type band playing which was alright, and then went to a rock pub which seemed to be filled only with vespa tour customers and no locals which was a shame. Also our main tour guide left us halfway through and was replaced by a guide who could not speak english (only the very basics).

review_title: Best of Hoi An in 4 hours
review_text:
We would recommend the excellent night tour with Ben. He was prompt, polite, friendly, full of knowledge and we felt at home with him.
We loved the programme with Vespa here in Hoi An right from the welcome drink, food choices, boat ride, and the drinks - they were not stingy with them here. We felt extremely safe during the entire tour - it had been raining most of the day, the roads were wet but we were in safe hands.
Ben was a great host, he made us feel comfortable and has excellent English.
The first night we arrived in Hoi An it was pouring down and so we called to see if we could change the tour to the following evening. They were so accommodating and we were very grateful.
We grew more confident food choices after this tour.
When we are back we will do a full day tour with Vespa and hopefully with Ben.

I haven't been on a bike since college days. Hesitant at first. These guys make you feel completely safe and comfortable from the first hello. Chien led three of us on a night tour around Saigon. Thy was my driver. Everyone wears a helmet. There is room to sit and to hold. Chien's knowledge of his city and enthusiasm for his job made the night very special. A fantastic way to see the hustle and bustle of the city. So much fun.

review_title: Great time in Hue and Hoi An
review_text: We did the rural tour in Hoi an and the historical one in Hue and just loved it .without scooters you cannot see much in Vietnam.these tours are brilliant ways to meet locals ,get out the city's and as a bonus you get an English speaking local as your guide .cannot rate mark in hoi an and dang.in Hue highly enough .

We only had a couple days in Saigon and really wanted to see the whole city. This tour was the perfect opportunity to cover ground in many neighborhoods with a wonderful guide, Chin. He was so knowledgeable and friendly, answering tons of questions. Our drivers were excellent, especially mine named Long. This was so much fun that we booked another Vespa Adventures tour - Hanoi After Dark- for the end of our vacation. Our 2 Vespa tours were some of the highlights of our entire 2 week trip in Vietnam.

This is a must do whilst in Saigon. We were picked up in the evening by our drivers from our hotel on time and taken to the meeting point where Hanh greeted us and the group (3 others). Hanh made the tour both interesting and enjoyable. She speaks perfect English and keeps us all entertained. The two drivers we had were safe drivers and great people. The driver I didn't mind speeding through the traffic as I was asking for it which made the experience even more enjoyable. At every stop we had delicious food awaiting us and by the end of it we didn't want to see any more food until the next morning! Food wise we had the traditional spring rolls, chicken dishes, oysters, beef dishes, frogs (i didnt try them but heard they were nice!), various sea food dishes. At every stop we were offered a drink "for the road". So we were drinking our beers on the back of a vespa whilst speeding on main roads and side roads! A great experience! We ended at a couple of bars where there was live music which was entertaining and enjoyable. For anyone worried about safety, please don't, speak to your driver and they will slow down for you! I cannot recommend this tour enough, its a MUST DO for all foodies and people that just want to have fun!! Thank you so much to Hanh who was an amazing tour guide and an amazing person and also thank you to our individual drivers!!

review_title: Great and exciting way to see Saigon
review_text: Definitely a must-do to see your way around the bustling city - from the finer sections of District 1 through to the "real" bars and restaurants of other districts. Great taste of Saigon - including snails, frog's legs and a great taster of more ordinary foods. Great guides and a load of fun!

review_title: Crazy and memorable New Years Eve on a Vespa
review_text: Recommended to us by friends, we were not disappointed. We did the evening city tour which took in bars and restaurants. It was exceptionally well organized and executed. We were whisked around to off beat restaurants that served some wonderful street food and offered an experience of the city we simply wouldn't have had on our own. We brought our 12 and 16 year old children on the tour and they loved it too.

My wife and I LOVED this although from the photo taken before leaving you would think there was a degree of apprehension! The two drivers we had were great and it made me realize that the madness on the streets is very controlled. There is no anger and everyone seems to understand the dynamic. Hooting seems to be used to inform fellow road users that a person is there, and not that they want you to get out of the way.

We were taken to a venue for cocktails and to meet with the others in our group and the company rep, Na, who was great. From here we had street seafood and drinks at Ninh Khanh Street and then off again for Vietnamese pancakes and southern food.

The pace slowed down then when we were taken to a coffee shop offering live music — we saw three acts in a relatively short time — some lovely voices. We declined the last stop (Karaoke and live music) as we had an early start but we both agreed this was one of the best tours we had on this trip.

review_title: Great alternative to a boat trip down the Mekong
review_text: Booked on the Glimpse of the Mekong Delta on the recommendation of a friend and it did not disappoint! Vy was a wonderful guide - knowledgeable about a range of topics and very personable. There was a minor issue with one of the bikes before we left HCM, but the operations manager Sun handled the situation extremely well and we did not miss out on any of the experiences on the route. Definitely a great way to see some more traditional aspects of Vietnamese life and culture, and the lunch venue afterwards was great!

An interesting night on the back of a vintage Vespa being educated about Vietnam food and then listening to folk music and rock music. A great night. It was expensive compared to whole day ride we did from Hue to Hoi An. However it was a great night of food and music riding through the bright lights in the warm, balmy air.

Such a fantastic afternoon organized on short notice- Realizing we had a small window of opportunity to go on a tour of Ho Chi Minh with our two teenage girls, we contacted Vespar Tours to see if they could help us out. We have been on three different tours with Vespar adventures before, in Vietnam so we knew it was going to be fantastic. Steve arranged a private tour for us, to cater both to our limited schedule AND to see all things we're keen to see & experience. We had a wonderful afternoon, whizzing through the crazy Saigon streets, seeing out of the way, interesting and non touristy sights & learning interesting history. Our guide Chin, was fabulous. What a terrific guide he is- if you arrange a tour with Vespar Adventures, in HMC ask for Chin, he is fabulous!! Highly recommend this company & their tours for teenagers! It's such a fun way to engage them.

This was amazing and so much fun - one of the best tours I have been on and we are pretty seasoned travelers! Buzzing around pillion on vespers in the traffic of HCMC! Great food free flowing alcohol, excellent guide - just an amazing experience!

What an adventure. Best 'tour' ever. Buzzing through the streets of Saigon like a local. My driver (dholce I think thats how to spell it) was so lovely and i felt completely safe with her. Seeing the sites at night from the bak of a bike is so amazing and the food was delicious. Our guide for the might - Ruby was an amazing guide and gave us an insight into Vietnam n saigon which we hadn't gotten from any other guide during our visit. This has to be up there with the very best tours anywhere in the world. If ur in Saigon dont dont dont miss it.

review_title: Vespa Tour at Night in Saigon"
review_text:
Well when I got told about doing this tour i was nervous as I dont like the thought of being on the back of a motorbike let alone going on one in the traffic in Ho Chi Minh. Wow this tour has been the highlight of our trip so far. It is so worth the money and the food and people that you meet along the way are so courteous and friendly. The tour was run extremely well from start to finish and the drivers of our bikes were so lovely as they checked with me to see how i was going as I think they sensed I was a little stressed out to begin with. Our guide Tien who was new was great, he was so courteous and couldnt do enough for us. He even helped us with other questions that we had about shopping and other adventures. Very well mannered gentleman who i would highly recommend to anyone thinking about going on this tour. Make sure you ask for Tien.
Jenny & Derek

review_title: A must-see tour when in Vietnam
review_text: Our family of 5 spent half a day touring the Vietnam Countryside with Vespa Adventures with some amazing guides: Mark, Phuoc, Hong Ly, Dung and Lam took us around country roads, small villages, farms and into three peoples homes which really showed our family what life is like in this amazing country. (ages of kids: 20,18,12).

review_title: Perfect and delicious way to see HCMC!
review_text: We had a great time with leader Ha, Ruby and Long and teaming up with three Australian travelers and their hosts! Going by vespa at night in Saigon is really spectacular! The trip took us to different districts on both sides of the river and we made a quick stroll at the flowermarket. The food is delicious! We had dive courses and dessert at different places and ended up full. We can strongly recommend this professional team and company!

review_title: Glimpse of the Mekong Delta Tour
review_text: We did the 'glimpse of the Mekong Delta tour'. It's a day (from 8 am till 3 pm) with lots of driving on the back of the Vespa, which is great. You visit a local market, a rice wine factory, a home for Vietnamese coffee and you cross rivers using the ferry. All in all it is a great day of seeing totally different sights truly off the beaten track and getting lots of information on Vietnamese customs and culture. It is expensive however ($93 pp) and it's not really a glimpse of the delta, you see lots of things but they are not necessarily related to the Mekong delta.

review_title: A fantastic way to see the Mekong Delta
review_text:
This is a fabulous tour, it's quite amazing how much is packed into one day without ever feeling rushed. You get to see parts of Vietnam you'd never seen during a "normal" vacation.

The bikes are superb and the riders are really excellent. I know what I'm talking about, I teach people to ride motorbikes.

You stop off at many places and take two boat ferries to cross the Mekong. The food is fabulous and the guides are brilliant.

There is an option to ride the Vespa by yourself but you really must be very experienced and also have some off-road experience. If you pass their test you will be allowed to ride but remember it's not that easy. I chose to ride by myself and I loved it, but I am very, very experienced both on and off road.

An absolutely superb day out. I'm going to do it again.

We did the night vesper tour in Saigon. Wow what a great tour, had a fantastic time, tour was extremely well run. Free flowing drinks, plenty of food.
You get to see things off the beaten track, which you will never find on your own.
Would highly recommend this night tour.
Did this morning tour yesterday with my 12 year old daughter and found it very enjoyable and our guide kevin was very informative, we had good fun whizzing around saigon city!

We did evening food tour around the city. This was great fun and the guides and drivers were all very friendly fun to chat with. Food was amazing! It was interesting way to get to know the insanely busy traffic up close and personal.
This has been the highlight of my visit to Vietnam thus far. Great food, lots of drinks, great fun riding on the back of the Vintage Vespa. Simply the best.

Best way to get introduced to the city and the food. The team is fun and amazing. Well done. I highly recommend this service. For those worried, at no time did it feel unsafe on the back of the vintage 1964 Vespa

Booked a tour with Vespa Adventures after seeing their recommendation in the New York Times article "36 Hours in Ho Chi Minh City". This is my second motorbike tour in Saigon and it far surpasses my first experience. Over the 4 hour tour, we saw so many locations that tourists rarely get to, and our guide and drivers were fantastic. Seeing Saigon on motorbikes is truly the best way to get a feel and understanding of the vibe of the city, and Vespa Adventures does exactly that.

Excellent tour - we were collected by our drivers - taken to Zoom Cafe for lunch and then we zoomed off thru the crazy traffic to discover sights and historic locations with our knowledgeable guide Vy. My Vespa driver safely negotiated the mad traffic ... Great fun and such an interesting tour!!! Highly recommended

What an excellent tour organized by the Vietnam Vespa Adventures group! Safe drivers, excellent sites and a perfect way to spend 4-or-so hours in HCMC. Interesting locations to stop and sample Saigon's food culture and free flow drinks along the way. Many thanks for a very well done job!

The Saigon Vespa Vintage Tour is my second time with this tour. First was in Hanoi. We are 3 of us, my husband and my teenage boy. The Saigon one was a complete package with drinks at the roof top cafe at the 32th floor building, street food by the bridge, an amazing seafood dinner (love all the seafoods served and the bread was so good too). As we continued to ride we also had Vietnamese pancake which is actually very healthy with all the herbal leaves and of course. The last stop was coffee and live music. Coffee was so damn good, buttery and creamy at the same time. Some of the group continued to the Bar with more live music, we had to go back to the hotel since we had to leave early in the morning. This has been one of the best experience in my vacation experience. I would recommend anyone who comes to Hanoi or Saigon to try this tour. You wont regret it!

I've been to HCMC a couple of times but places where Vespa Tour took us still surprised me (in a good way).

We traveled in groups of 6-8 ppl. Drinks are free flow during the tour, including beer. Seafood was AMAZING. Then we had some savory pancakes. Third stop was my favorite, where we entered an alley and pushed opened a book shelf to enter a small area with live band. Last was a pub with a rock band.

Food was good. Music was great. Our guide Who speaks fluent English. My husband and I definitely enjoyed the tour.

review_title: great fun way to see the city with really informative guide and friendly 'chauffeurs'
review_text: We booked the afternoon trip in combination with morning trip to Cu chi Tunnels. Really great way to see more of the city plus really good fun. Saw things we probably wouldn't have otherwise bothered to visit but intact were worth it e.g. the Pagoda of 10000 statues. We were taken to markets and shops but there was no hard sell at all - in fact not even a hint of it which was refreshing. Would definitely recommend this to anybody - and it was not too hair raising - you feel very safe on the scooters.

We were given a voucher for the afternoon tour as a present and it proved a really enjoyable experience. Travelling on the back of a Vespa and weaving through the dense Saigon traffic is not for the faint-hearted, but our team of drivers were most capable and very attentive, and our guide Chienh was excellent, as was his command of English. We explored parts of Saigon we wouldn't have thought of visiting (the flower market was a highlight) and our drivers even took us back to our lodgings in District 2 at the end. Highly recommended.

We've just got back from an amazing Vespa experience in Ho Chi Minh City, it was really busy on the roads as it was NYE but our drivers were very experienced and we felt very safe.
We went to 5 different places to Eat & Drink the local Vietnamese food, the last 2 places were Music venues so that really finished off the evening, our host Tian made it a really enjoyable and I would say defiantly do it, if you are in Ho Chi Minh City.

We did this on our first evening in the city and after being blown away by the number of bikes it was great to join in with the locals on the streets and be on the back of one ourselves.
It was extremely safe, this should not be a concern.
The 4 places they picked to visit were authentic and we would never have discovered the live music lounge or cafe if it wasn't for the tour.
Seeing places that the local themselves felt we should visit was ideal as we felt properly introduced to Saigon's culture.
It left us feeling buzzed and even more eager to explore.

review_title: Rough start that ended up really well
review_text: Just finished a tour with four friends and had a blast. Was some confusion about our pickup location as our group was staying in two different places. Once we got that frustration all worked out (as it seemed that one person was not speaking to the other and they were also picking up a second group at the same location which made them even more confused) the tour was great fun and amazing. Would recommend it to anyone and everyone.

Did the Mekong Delta Tour. Driver appeared at my hotel promptly. Spoke no English but I didn't care. Went to the business site and had a cup of coffee and bull corned with one of the employees.
Definitely an Interesting aspect of Saigon.
Would recommend to the owners of the business to have camera so someone (other than the passenger) takes pictures.
The driver and tour guide were great.
Would I recommend the tour? Without a doubt.

review_title: Do this on your first day!
review_text:
Simply WOW!
Although it's only my second time on a bike, the drivers are well experienced and very safe. Our guide NGUYET was fantastic and gave us a real taste of local food and culture!

I won't write too much, read my other reviews and you'll see I can get clinical about restaurants or attractions, but this doesn't need any such detail. An absolute treat, there is something seriously wrong with anyone who can't enjoy an experience like this. The average age of our group was over 60 and everyone loved it, get on the bike and see Saigon. Absolute must, worth every cent.

Wonderful drivers took us on a Tour of Saigon visiting many diverse places which you can explore on the website. Fun, safe, care and attention all excellent. Would thoroughly recommend it to get the real flavour of Saigon in a relatively short time. Inclusive lunch afterwards was very good too, washed down with a Tiger Beer.
A must do 😃 tour was great and amazing food service was 10/10 both driver and tour guide would highly recommend

This has been the best way to see Saigon (HCMC) as one of the locals. You get so much time on the bikes, I thought it would be a bit scary/dangerous but I felt totally safe sitting on the back seat of the Vespa. The traffic in this city is CRAZY! But being in the midst of it was certainly an adventure. On top of this you get to visit various street restaurants and sample Vietnamese food. DON'T EAT BEFORE YOU DO THIS TOUR! All food and drinks are included. Then the last two stops were fantastic. We stopped at a cafe which had really good live singers then at a bar which had live rock music. Our guide, Jayden, was brilliant. She spoke really good English and was very helpful with communicating our food preferences (vegetarian and nut allergy) with the food outlets. YOU MUST DO THIS TOUR!!
Great adventure with lots of fun stops we especially enjoyed our easy going funny guide onion phi. He spoke English very well we had a great time

Our family of four just took the Vespa adventure in HMC. Such a blast! Vespa riding was really fun, the restaurants and food were fantastic, and the overall experience was fabulous. Could have been cheesy but instead it was interesting, varied, and a highlight of our trip.

Hold onto your seat and prepare to enjoy Saigon as a local. You stop at various excellent street testaurants as you tour this huge city ss a pillion passenger - so know worries about drinking. Must do!

We were picked up from our hotel, taken to the cafe for lunch, then whisked away on the vespas to see HCMC. Our guide, "Two" was knowledgeable, enthusiastic and professional. The drivers were calm and safe in the chaos of HCMC's streets.
The kids loved the vespas and we got to see a big part of the city in half a day. We didn't do the food tour because it's not really suitable for children.
The best/weirdest part for the children was the Chinese medicine store where you can taste some fortifying liquid. The temple of 10000 Buddhas was fascinating.

This is a great way to see HCMC. Never thought I would get on a bike, let alone a Vespa in the middle of this CRAZY traffic. The Drivers are tops you feel so safe and really enjoy the experience. We were picked up from district 7 so it was a good amount of time on the Vespa at a reasonable speed. Our guide, Chin, spoke great English and was so informative. Lunch was excellent and the cold beers at the finish went down a treat. I would DEFIANTLY recommend you do this, even if you are a little nervous as they are so good you'll soon forget and just enjoy the sights. There is no more authentic Vietnamese experience. AWESOME.

This tour was super fun! You get picked up on Vespas are driven around to local spots for food. Riding around those vespas at night in itself is quite an adventure.

All the food was delicious and it nice to go to spots that most tourists don't know about. You also get taken to cafe type place with local singers performing and then a soft rock type bar. Highly recommend!

We had THE most amazing time on the Vespas! The food was amazing too with everything super local, but our time was made by our amazing guide Tu. Our drivers Lich, Huy, Nam and Tuin (sorry for the spelling mistakes!) were absolutely amazing and really lovely.
Weaving in and out of all the traffic in the city was so much fun, we couldn't stop laughing!
If you're visiting Ho Chi Minh, the Vespa Adventure is an absolute must!! Thank you so much for a fab time!

We did a one day tour in the Mekong Delta. At first we thought: a bit expensive. During the tour, it was well worth it.

We visited temple, rice wine factory, saw amazing scenary and the food was like heaven. The tour guide was friendly, took care of us and showed some interest. The drivers were skilled!

Well worth the money!
BTW: we (my friend and I) had a private tour because there were only two people@!

Absolutely amazing tour! We felt a bit apprehensive zooming through Ho Chi Mihn city on mopeds, knowing how chaotic the traffic is, but the drivers were supersafe. Also vintage Vespa bikes are fun to ride and are very comfortable.

Really wonderful food everywhere we went. Special mentioning of a seafood restaurant serving terrific crab claws and clams.

The tour is very well paced and guides are very nice and very informative. Took us to a little cafe tucked away in a back street which turned out to be an intimate performance venue with wonderful singers and a pianist.

The last spot was a proper bar called Acoustic Bar (I think) with pop singers which were absolutely outstanding. We decided not to go back to the hotel and stayed in the bar till quite late enjoying the music.

review_title: Far and away best part of trip
review_text: Yesterday we did the mekong delta trip and the night before we did food tour. The Mekong Delta trip was amazing. The tour took us into the back country (vs river trip). We were introduced to absolutely beautiful country, rice patties villages, etc. Crossed over the river on local ferry (like the locals). Visited the local markets and we're introduced to local foods. Picked up snacks of fruit and vegetables from the stalls. Visited the shrimp farms, incense maker, local temples, etc. Vy, our guide, spoke perfect english, and really honestly answered our myriad of questions as we tried to get to know her life. The food tour introduced us to new foods .. waa delicious and again, guide spoke perfect english. Vespa drivers made us feel safe and comfortable. We loved seeing eye to eye as we drove through the city on the vespas. We highly recommend!

We had no idea as to what to expect from this organised tour. I don't want to say too much and risk spoiling the surprise element for others, but it was truly fantastic. Please, please go on it. You will not regret it. (We started off in a torrential downpour which made us reconsider our trip - thank goodness we decided to go ahead).

review_title: Awesome way to spend an evening
review_text: Our guide Jadeen was amazing. So personable, friendly and attentive. The whole operation was very professional. Riding around on the back of the scooter with very competent drivers was a great way to see the city. Experience the night life. And just have a ton of fun. Definitely got our moneys worth. Highly recommend

This is the easiest review to write ever !!! Emailed to organize this tour and arranged to meet at Zoom cafe for an afternoon tour around Saigon. Having been there several times before and nearly disenchanted to cross the road alone, it was such a great afternoon to see the city riding on the back of a Vespa among the thousands of other motos. The tour took us to places we would not have seen alone, the Vespa team are outstanding and my husband and I loved every minute of it!

Ho Chi Minh City is a constant vast migration of motor scooters. To go round the town on the back of a Vespa, expertly chauffeured by Vespa Adventure with stops for food and drink was an unforgettable experience, not to be missed.

Excellent part of our trip to Vietnam. The Vespas are a really good way to see the city, and the tour will take you to some amazing places! Our night-time food tour was amazing, very good local street food and nightlife.

review_title: Absolutely amazing evening.......you must do this
review_text: We met everyone at Zoom Café - had a beer and then got on the Vespa for a fantastic evening of food and fun - I highly recommend this tour - you will have great food, have some fun and meet some great people.................

We had booked Vespa Adventures for our first night in Saigon; picking us up at our hotel at 6.00. Our plane got in late and we arrived at the hotel at 5.40. Just enough time to check in, dump the luggage and go.
That evening was definitely one of the highlights of our whole trip. Every stop was a great experience and we all felt safe and secure as pillion passengers behind our expert drivers. It is the only way to see the big cities of Vietnam.
The food and drinks kept coming and everything was delicious. We particularly like the contrast of the different stops - especially the last two. The hidden club upstairs at the back of a garage was magical with wonderful performers and then the rock venue where we danced and drank till it was time to go. The best five hours we have spent in a long time.

review_title: Great evening, worth the premium over other food tours
review_text: We booked Vespa Adventures' Night Food Tour our first night in Saigon, which was perfect. Our drivers (each of us rode behind a personal driver on respective vespas) picked us up from our hostel and took us to Zoom Cafe to meet our guide, Ai (pronounced "I") and other couples in our group. We had a drink and then set out on the vespas, my driver Phat assuring me that he was a very safe driver, into the sea of ​​vespas and motorbikes dominating the urban jungle of Ho Chi Minh City. It really helped me get over my initial fear of the sea of ​​motorbikes parting around people to be on the vespa, in capable professional hands, taking in the night on the streets of Saigon from the back of one. Eventually I relaxed (underneath the heavy-duty rain ponchos that our drivers quickly and carefully removed before we entered a restaurant or a club and just as quickly replaced when it was time for the next stop) and just let the cool, post-downfall air roll over me in my cozy, poncho-nest. Can I just say I can't remember the last time someone put a poncho on me, and it felt like very posh service. My driver was Phat--he's the best! As for the food: Who led us to a seafood restaurant in the former "mafia-type" mafia in saigon. I loved the jumping chicken! Ai also went out of her way to make sure we had everything we wanted: drinks, seconds, even a whole set of alternate dishes for a few vegetarians. Whenever we would be touching food (ie, shellfish) she was out with the antibacterial gel like she had it on a holster. Ai was such a fun and informative hostess! After that we had Vietnamese crepes and rice paper rolls at a beautiful restaurant on the other side of the city. Who described traditional herbs for the rice paper rolls, not just lettuce and basil but also moon leef and an herb that tasted fainty of fish, and walked us through rolling some with a pork crepe inside (the vegetarians had something else in their rice paper rolls... maybe french fries?). There was so much food. It was so, so good. I wish I had eaten more. Next we visited a cafe where we had a drink and listened to a couple acoustic sets. The guys were good--some love songs in Vietnamese and one that was very funny, despite the fact that I didn't understand a word of it, oh and Adele... a very sultry and convincing rendition, truly. Finally we ended up at a rock bar for a few more drinks and sing-along opportunities. Can I get a Living on a Prayer? No, but I did get a Smells Like Teen Spirit and it was lovely. The tour also includes a framed photo of you and your driver on the back of the vespa--a memento of which I am proud! My best advice is splurge on this tour, but show up hungry and make the most of it!

We'd rate this as our best night out in twenty years.
Being 65+, the idea of riding pillion around Saigon at night for over four hours was a little out of our comfort zone. In the event, despite the crazy traffic, it was a safe and joyous experience.
The itinerary was perfectly paced, taking in five stops from the hotel pick up / drop off. Absolutely no stinting on drinks - whatever you wanted, as much as you'd like - and amazing food. Possibly, the best of our lives. That good!
The tour closes with two visits to night clubs, a romantic stop, followed by a rock venue.
Just inspired! If you're in Saigon, don't miss it.

What a great day, one of the best trips we have done. Na and her team were fantastic, helpful and engaging throughout. We stopped off at many different places enroute to the Mekong and really got a taste for the real Vietnam and how the Vietnamese live.

One thing we regret doing is not buying some incense sticks at one of the stop offs. The lady making the stick works 16 hours a day for around £6, so a gesture of a purchase would make a lot of difference. Whereas this is a credit to the tour that they do not suggest that tourists buy things, in hindsight, we wish we had.

If you are looking to get off the beaten track and away from anything touristic then this is the tour for you.

So glad we booked it, worth every penny, thank you!

It was a different experience for sure. Make sure u have a strong back. Our guide Two was really good and very informative. His English was good too. The food provided as snack as well as lunch was more than enough for us and was extremely delicious too. Especially the restaurant we were taken for lunch was a very unique experience. If you're looking for an off beaten track tour with personal attention I'd suggest go with these guys.

Three mature ladies😉 had the most fun tonight on the Vespa tour around Saigon . We were a little nervous before we went because the traffic is mad busy but our drivers were great and once you are amongst it it is organised chaos! 😳😳
The food was delicious and loads of it. We went to 5 venues all very different and thoroughly enjoyed it.
Highly recommend.5 star👏🏻👍

My friend and I had the best time on a day tour by Vespa! We were nervous about being on a Vespa in this crazy city, but we're in great hands with our amazing tour guide Phi. Phi went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. We will definitely be coming back, and would recommend a tour with Phi to anyone who wants to experience a real Vietnamese experience!

review_title: Lots of fun, well organized, great guides and locations
review_text:
I booked the Saigon nightlife tour in a 2-for-1 deal with the AO Show - Lune Production of Teh Dar, on the Vespa Adventures website.

Everything was well organized, punctual and our guides and drivers were super. The locations they brought us seemed very local to me (there were few tourists in the places, we seemed like the only ones).

If you're riding on the back of any motorbike in Vietnam, I highly recommend a face mask especially if you're not feeling well.

The nicest part was also at the end, when we were surprised by a beautifully printed photo of ourselves posing on the scooters. And they went as far as sending us a google drive link for the digital photos of everyone in the group, by email the next day.

Excellent! I hope they come up with more tours and interesting locations, in combination with special promotions.

review_title: Fabulous Vespa Adventures Ho Chi Minh, Hoi an township and Hanoi citiy
review_text:
During my stay in Vietnam I joined three Vespa Adventures, two that highlighted the local food in local restaurants and nightlife in HCM city and Hanoi. In Hoi An, we chose an afternoon tour called Rural village experience.
All three tours were fantastic experiences with drivers that were highly skilled at Weaving their way through the massive traffic, making me feel safe and comfortable at all times. The guides that rode near were always informative and ready to answer any questions or requests we had.
I learned a lot about the wonderful history, culture and beautiful people that is Vietnam through these tours.
My personal thanks to the fabulous teams that made the Vespa adventure tours so much fun
In Ho Chi Minh City - our guide Jason Nguyen and his team of drivers
In Hoi An - our guide Thanh and drivers Phuoc, Phuong, Houng and Hieu
In Hanoi. Our guide Emma and drivers Finn and Hung
Their personalized commentary and great sense of fun, added most spectacularly to the experience. I highly recommend these tours.

review_title: Great way to experience the city!
review_text:
Definitely a must do in Saigon! They take you to two great restaurants that you probably won't have visited otherwise and then two great bars.

Our tour guide Jayden was a ton of fun! The drivers are safe and always make sure you feel comfortable.

review_title: If you do one thing, do this
review_text: The expectation I had of Vietnam;s tourism facilities is that it would be very similar to Thailand. I could not be more incorrect. I expected sub standard equipment and no regard for safety. Wrong again. The Vespa night tour of Saigon was our groups highlight of our Vietnamese visit. We had 15 "New" or newly refurbished vespas waiting for us outside the hotel. The guys were in their element! From here the riders took us to Zoom Cafe for a quick intro and a beer. We then hit the road for a local dinner, followed by a traditional pancake dessert at another stop, followed by a stop at the most fabulous "unplugged" music joint. The round it off we went to local saloon for some rock tunes. This is without a doubt one of the best experiences I have had in 15 years of travel.

This is one of the must do things in Saigon. I enjoyed my experience so much! I could tell you everything about the tour, but I would spoil the surprise. Go on the tour, you are going to have so much fun! The company is extremely well organized and they think of everything. You won't regret it!

review_title: Highlights of Ho Chi Minh Trip
review_text: This tour is a must when visiting Ho Chi Minh for the first time. We took a private night tour of the city and it was absolutely amazing! Our tour guides picked us up at our hotel and took us to meet our guide Ooyen who spoke perfect English and was so much fun. We stopped at some of the best local street food restaurants and experienced the crazy traffic of the city. We stopped at a karaoke coffee bar to hear some Vietnamese karaoke and then ended the night in a super fun bar that with Vietnamese cover bands singing old classics. We had 3 teenagers who loved the tour. Don't miss this tour! Highly recommended.

review_title: Vespa adventure of Saigon by night
review_text: My adult son and I had a brilliant night out with Vespa adventures - Vy was our host and she really brought it alive for us. The perfect way to experience Saigon by night and so exhilarating to be on a moped with the rest of the city dwellers. Had some delicious street food in a variety of locations and went to a really hidden away club. We felt totally safe throughout and I really recommend this as a great way to see this fun vibrant city by night.

review_title: Vesper experience; Ride like a local
review_text: Superb fun! Felt as safe as you can riding pilion on the back of a Vesper in the middle of Ho Chi Minh city. Superb hosts, food and music on the Saigon After Dark tour

review_title: Great night trip with kids 14 and 17
review_text: We had a fun evening on the Vespas, in the warm Ho Chi Minh night. Stopped at a few restaurants and had street food + also a small concert venue. Safe and friendly! Recommend it!

review_title: Fantastic night, you must try this!!!
review_text: Yes the traffic in Saigon is crazy and you often wonder how anyone drives their so why not get on the back of a Vespa and find out. My wife and I at 60 had our first ever motorbike adventure and it was great. Felt completely safe. Drivers were great and our guide T was fantastic. Picked up at our hotel then of to meet our guide had a drink and some canapés. Alcohol is fine as long as you are not driving. You just need to hang on. Next stop street food and more drinks. Very fishy menu so if you are not a lover of seafood you might struggle but the food was great and we were taught how to eat it in the traditional way. Next stop pancakes then a traditional tea house and finally a bar for a couple of drinks before being dropped back at the hotel. A fantastic night. If you are in Saigon don't hesitate to get on that Vespa.

review_title: Highlight of Visit to Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: My wife and I visited Ho Chi Minh City and went on the Saigon After Dark vespa tour. This was certainly the highlight of our visit to this bustling city. Our friendly local vespa drivers were waiting in our hotel lobby and we were soon off to our first stop to meet our personal tour guide. Our guide was extremely friendly and knowledgable about the city, the abundance of food we sampled throughout the night and Vietnamese culture in general. He helped make our night fun and I can certainly say we felt like locals for the evening. Any tourist to Ho Chi Minh City should certainly sign up for a Vespa Adventure tour. Great way to see and taste the city!!

review_title: Best thing I did in Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
I was really nervous about riding around the city on a vespa at night - due to the crazy traffic and driving conditions, but I'm so glad I did. We did the night-time street food tour and had a really great evening. Our drivers picked us up from the hotel on Vespas and took us to the cafe to meet the rest of our group (around 8-10 people in total made up the group), then - accompanied by our guide, who spoke excellent English, we headed off into the city to 4 different stops. The first stop was a brilliant seafood place - it was a restaurant (not a cart on the side of the road) but it was very much filled with local people, and certainly not a place that I would have found independently. We tried a range of different dishes and our guide showed us how local people eat the various foods- some of the best I had on my trip. Stop 2 was another great restaurant where we learned how to make fresh rolls and tried some other dishes which I hadn't come across before.

The third stop was a tiny tea house with live music performance - again, not somewhere i would have found alone and a really great experience. The final stop I didn't enjoy - it was a backpacker style dive bar with strong, but not particularly tasty cocktails and a band doing covers of rock songs. As we still had to get driven back to the hotel, I didn't really want to consume the amount of booze needed to make that kind of place enjoyable. However, the other three stops were amazing and I'm really glad we did the tour.

review_title: Best experience available in Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
We d8d an evening Vespa tour. We were collected from our hotel and whisked off to a coffee shop to meet our Guide. We were then taken to a small seafood restaurant where we were given several light sea food courses which has we had never tried before. Our guide Tuan gave detailed instructions on how to eat and how the food was cooked. We were then whisked to another large restaurant with other Vietnamese specialties which Tuan explained and showed us how you eat. Delicious but feeling vey full by now.

Next stop was a hidden little coffee/tea shop in a private road where very talented singers a violinist and a pianist were performing. After a few singers and a drink we were moved on to Woodstock, a bar with more drinks and live music. This was much more Rick and roll and great fun. More drinks and then back to our hotel.

We didn't know what to expect from this evening but felt that it was quite surreal. Several fun evenings all rolled into one. We would highly recommend this tour. Very safe and although no comnentary we saw lots 9f colorful and lively back streets and nightl8fe which had we would otherwise have missed.

We did three adventures with the friendly and professional girls and boys of Vespa adventures, Hidden Saigon, which was fantastic, and our guide was brilliant, sorry I have forgotten her name. My driver for this and for Saigon by night and the 'glimpse of Mekong' was so calm, even in the most adrenaline rushing traffic, that I never felt any concern about being on Vietnamese roads! Tuyen, our guide for the Saigon by night was great, getting the group 'relaxed' at the bar and restaurant visits, and the coffee bar and nightclub were brilliant. Our Mekong trip was an experience, as the flood waters rose around us!!
We also spent the evening with Phi in Hoi An, another brilliant evening, and met Steve the owner, who had just come back from planning the Hanoi launch. Highly recommend - Superb way to see Vietnam!

Didn't want to do those large tours that have you stuck in a boat and rowing down Mekong, therefore chose this.
The Vespa was comfortable and 45min was the longest stretch you spent zipping through the country on it but with the wind blowing, it didn't feel uncomfortable or long.

You get to see the countryside, shrimp farms, a wet market, rice wine distiller, incense maker. While I'm Asian and these aren't new to me, it's the experience of traveling by Vespa in an unhurried manner that I value. At the wet market, there was a mid-morning break where I was fed fresh prawns and mussels cooked on the spot for me. This was rounded off with refreshing fruit.

If you want a different Mekong experience and enjoy riding a bike, this is the one to take.

review_title: Vespa tour through Ho Chi Minh city at night
review_text: Amazing experience taking a Vespa ride through little known local haunts in Ho Chi Minh city. Many surprising experiences - great food, terrific entertainment and the thrill of negotiating some of the busiest streets in the world!

The Saigon After Dark tour was recommended by friends. It was fabulous. Riding around HoChi Minh on a Vespa was a perfect way to see the city.
The drivers were competent and very caring. We easily joined the hundreds of bikes on the road, weaving and dodging through the chaotic traffic. I never felt uneasy....it was exhilarating!
The food on offer at the Zoom Cafe and 3 restaurants was amazing. A great way to sample all the local dishes! We couldn't possibly finish all that was served up!
Then off to the nightlife! An upstairs bar/coffee house in a backstreet was enjoyable and relaxing...then off again to a hidden away club with the most amazing live band! Wonderful music

We had the best night! Thank you Vespa tours!

This is a must do in Saigon, night or day , we went on the night trip , picked up from hotel and straight into that mad traffic , fantastic start have the video ready it's worth a 1 hand ride just to capture all around , drinks to start , restaurants and live music all really fantastic , this is worth the money for sure 👍👍👍👍👍👍👍

Amazing experience. Initially very nervous on back of Vespa because of the chaos of vehicles on Saigon roads!! But quickly realized the experience of driver who weaved in and out of traffic so skillfully! Real scooting about Saigon like a local!!

Food on route sampling real local Vietnamese food, off the tourist track! Thanks to Huo who told us so much about Vietnamese culture & spoke excellent English. Also visited local venues for live music only known to locals!

Thanks so much to Viet & Hai who drove us so skilfully round crazy traffic in Saigon!

I was initially apprehensive about getting on a vespa and driving around this crazy city, but it turned out to be a fantastic experience. The drivers are great and you cover so much of the city that it would otherwise take days to see. Guides are knowledgeable and allow you to enjoy each location. I would highly recommend these guys.

Just back from our trip to Vietnam and this was one of the highlights. Really well done and taking us to nice places we would never have seen. Thanks to Hang our guide. I was a bit apprehensive but the drivers are so experienced and you soon get comfortable and feel secure in the mad traffic. It is great fun to experience all the dodging of the traffic. A truly unique experience and thoroughly recommend it. Go for it.

My husband and I did the Saigon after Dark tour on the second evening of our 3-week holiday in Vietnam. It was definitely a highlight of the holiday and I would recommend it to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh city who wants to try local food and is up for a little bit of adventure.
The night of our tour there was a thunderstorm with torrential rain and surface flooding up to 20cm deep, but it did not deter our trusty Vespa drivers. They picked us up from our hotel, kitted us out with ponchos and helmets, settled us into our pillion seats and drove us carefully around the crazy Saigon streets. Even though I'd never been on a scooter before, let alone in such frightful weather, I soon felt quite safe. It was a great fun way to see the city, and oh my gosh, the food was delicious.
There were other people doing the tour on the same evening as us, and we all started at the same bar, but from then on, each group or couple had a separate guide and did the tour quite separately, which I liked.
The tour included at least five different venues, including a seafood joint, a place specializing in binh xeo (local pancake), and a delightful intimate cabaret hidden away above a motorbike workshop. Places we will never have found on our own, and only frequented by locals.
A brilliant night out.

review_title: Great way to discover Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: I did the night tour twice and it was a blast. Experienced drivers will take you around the city in Vintage Vespas and the nicest tour guides will go with you. There are 2 stops for amazing local food and drinks and 2 stops for music and drinks. It can take about 3 hours and is totally recommended.

review_title: The best way to see Saigon
review_text: We had an evening in Saigon on Vespas. It was such fun and a great way to see the city. Even though it was raining, we felt safe and well looked after. If you go to Saigon, you need to do this!

I'm coming to the end of a three-week trip to Cambodia, Laos and Vietnam. I can't think of a better way to get a quick sense of Saigon than by doing the Vespa Saigon after Dark tour. The Vespa ride was great fun, the food was really excellent and if you're very lucky you'll have prestige as your taste. Her English is excellent, she's really warm and chatty and, while she claims she can't cook, she guided me very well through all the foods on offer. Great fun!

review_title: Probably the best tour I've ever done!
review_text: We were always looking forward to this tour having seen some of the crazy Hanoi and Saigon traffic but nothing prepared us for just how much fun we were about to have on the Night Tour! Brilliantly organized from start to finish with fantastic drivers and guides. We saw parts of Saigon we'd never have seen and experienced bars, music and food that we'd never have seen and got a fantastic photo to finish with. A truly fun and memorable evening...thank you!

This was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. We had read about having a Vespa tour in Saigon and thought it would be kind of fun. Our tour company contacted Vespa Tours and we had a Saigon After Dark tour. We were met at our hotel by two people riding vintage Vespas and we proceeded to wind our way through the busy traffic to their restaurant, the Zoom cafe, where we were met by a cute girl named Jaden. She proceeded to order us drinks and a snack and told us about our night. All drinks and food were included. So...we rode to our next stop and had a great dinner with some street food and beer and good conversation with Jaden. The rest of the night was food, a hidden bar where we listened to some very talented musicians singing, then ended the night at a nightclub where we listened to a good band, female singer, old guy blues singer, and a singer/rapper. Extremely talented and entertaining. Then they took us back to our hotel. We didn't want the night to end, but we were flying out the next day and decided to leave. I would recommend this tour for everyone. Great people, fun winding through the traffic, good food, drinks and just an all around great time.

review_title: Vespa, traffic, drinks, food and music
review_text: We booked Saigon after dark tour based on our experiences on a Vespa tour in Hoi An. We had a great driver, host and times....cannot say enough about it ...all the food and drinks you want and experience Saigon in the traffic that almost runs you over everyday on the sidewalk....

I booked this off the back of a recommendation from my parents. You ride Pillion for the evening and go on an adventure with new people. The food was great, hopefully you get the Jumping Chicken or Lemongrass Clams.
Some parts are interesting and it was a great way to see the city at night but not some places that you wouldn't expect. This is the best way to experience the traffic and I feel very safe with my Rider. I'd certainly recommend it as it is the best way to go to the places you probably wouldn't try without some local knowledge.

We did the day tour of Saigon with Vy ('Vee'). Loved it. Excellent choices on where we stopped. Vy was fantastic- very bright, good sense of humor. She is the most fun guide we had during a three week trip in SE Asia.
I had a trip with experienced guide Onion Phi. I would recommend this guy to everyone, definitely. Thank you Phi.

review_title: The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City by far! Superb experience!
review_text: We spotted the Vespa Adventures tour advert in our hotel and were immediately drawn to it as a great way to see Ho Chi Minh city from within the buzzing traffic. We were not disappointed and thoroughly enjoyed our lunch and afternoon with Vy and the Vespa team. The bikes are old Vespa two-seaters and ideal for whizzing through the city and exploring all the little streets that we would never have found by ourselves. Vy guided us to see several locations including the flower market, Chinese Temple, textile market in addition to main historical sites and, for us, simply being part of the swarming mass of bikes felt both exhilarating and safe. An afternoon we will never forget and would highly recommend. Thank you!

review_title: The best way to see the city
review_text: I was a bit apprehensive about getting on a Vespa in the city but I'm glad I did. My driver Phi was great. I always feel very safe. The tour was great. I had a blast. Highly recommended

It is a toeristic tacticity, but you really meet Saigons local life and traffic. What an experience! Nice driver, guide, food, drinks and music performances. They treat you in a nice personal way! Thankfull Greetings Jelle & Jessica

Eating fantastic food and drinking

review_title: Great way to eat your way through HCM
review_text: Scoot around HCM city on sunset from bars to local food haunts with other travelers. Great way to see many parts of this bustling city. Food stops were great, bars so so. Highlight was the food and opportunity to meet other travelers.

Had a fantastic time eating and drinking my way round Saigon
Katie was a brilliant leader and introduced me to the art of Roadie- great fun being a pillion passenger drinking lager while being whisked round Saigon.
If you have the chance of a night tour take it you won't regret it

review_title: Vespas in Hoi An are brilliant!
review_text:
Ben was a great tour guide, and took care for the group sharing his local knowledge. All drivers were great and drove safely.

Whole experience was awesome! Did the night foodie tour - warning make sure you leave room for all the food, brilliant! If it rains, they carry poncho's in case. We went as a family group with people ranging from 60 to 9 years, and we loved it! We loved it lots, we booked the next day for the country tour.

These guys are the ones to use. Lots of fun zipping about through Ho Chi Minh City on the back of classic Vespas. The 'excitement' of the traffic, the bustle of the back streets and the knowledge of Vy (our guide) was brilliant. It's a fantastic way to see a bit of the city. The lunch after was also spotted on. Do it, you won't be disappointed.

We took the 1/2 day Inside Saigon tour.

Loved this adventure. We had two children 14 and 11 and this was one of the highlights of their trip.

We arrived the day before (from NZ) and this being their first trip to an Asian country, they were both a bit shellshocked (cultural overload). Doing the tour was a fun way to get a great overview of the city. We loved zooming through the seafood markets, and being on the back of the bike was a welcome relief from the heat. We felt perfectly safe and all the drivers were lovely. Our guide 'Chin' was so informative, funny and good company. Thanks so much for this experience. PS: the lunch was also pretty fab.

We were collected and returned from our hotel - it was incredibly easy and even though we had a downpour, it added to the adventure and our drivers assured we all had our poncho's on!

review_title: A great introduction to Saigon's neighborhoods and gastronomy
review_text:
Really nice and complete tour to discover HCMC by night and get a glimpse of what the country and the city in particular offers in terms of food (be sure to come with an empty stomach, because it's actually more than a glimpse and you won't lack of any food). The Vespa ride offers a welcome pause between each stop and signature dish !
And our guide Jaden was really nice and knowledgeable ! It was cool to chat with her and exchange about culture and food (and she does know her stuff when it comes to cooking). She really made the tour worth it, being keen to have a laugh with her guests and sharing her knowledge of the different places you go to during the evening. Would recommend for sure !
Great experience overall

Thank you Onion Phi and phuoc for a very interesting day out. We took the local life tour. It is great to see how the local life is. Simple life can be led happily! Thank you again for this eye opener. It makes you think twice if you want to complain about pity things in our occidental world. Jc

review_title: Best way to start our visit to Saigon!
review_text: Thoroughly recommend this awesome adventure. What an amazing way to start our week in Saigon! Thank you to Steve and our tour guide Khoi for making this a night to remember. The drivers were friendly, capable and you felt really safe riding pillion with them. The sights and sounds of our After Dark Saigon tour completely wowed us and that's before we started eating! Fantastic street food, doing what the locals do and eating what the locals eat. Doing a Vespa Adventures tour right at the beginning of our trip was an excellent way to introduce us to the city, it's people, the amazing food. A++++++++

review_title: Fantastic way to see Saigon and have a blast!
review_text:
A friend recommended Vespa Adventures and I'm soooo delighted I chose them!

Their email communication before hand was great. The driver had a bit of time getting to pick me up as my airbnb place was not familiar but it was ok.

My driver was fantastic - Do - and our guide Lora was brilliant.

I met some amazing NEW friends from the UK and Colombia from my group and we "ate" our way thru Saigon on a trip of a lifetime for sure.

The food was to die for. The ride was so awesome seeing so much and everyone was fantastic. And they gave us a souvenir photo with our driver on our bike plus we will be emailed photos taken throughout the night.

Definitely recommend to everyone I know coming here and will try their other tours sometime too!!

Thanks guys!!!

This should be a must do activity in HCM. Individual Vespa's with attentive drivers provides a fantastic view of this busy city. Always felt very safe despite the fact that we were very close to other vehicles at all times. Even though the last part of our journey was undertaken during one of the worst rainstorms of the season we were well protected by provided rain ponchos.

review_title: Get in the thick of it!
review_text: As the saying goes; When in Rome ... and in Siagon, then you scooter! These tours were suggested by a friend before we left for Vietnam and we booked once there, last minute and on-line - easy as. It was fantastic, fun way to see the city - even the sun came to the party on the day! Getting amongst the swarms of scooters and playing dodgems with other road users wasn't half as scary as sitting in a tour van and so much more real, and just as safe. Add in knowledgeable tour guides, access to places usually off the radar, snacks, drinks and a yummy lunch to finish at Zoom Café (we did a morning tour), I think it was excellent value (especially compared to some of the others we did) and the fun factor incomparable. Do it! We definitely will again :-)
What a way to tour the City, in amongst the many Motor Bikes. Safely driven around the City by professional riders whom I felt safe with

review_title: Don't leave HCM without experiencing this
review_text:
HCM could be a very simple city and a bit boring if you come from a metropolitan city. Make your trip in Vietnam, HCM by getting a Saigon After Dark tour with Vespa Adventures. It is a wonderful experience. You get to meet new friends. Experience Saigon culture like a local. And ride the streets of HCM in a Vespa! Super super great experience!

Two thumbs up to our 'tour guide' aka 'local friend' Nam for taking good care of us during the tour. Lovely!

Picked this tour over a boat ride up the river to see the tunnels. Very nice operation. "Two", our tour guide, was very knowledgable and informative. Pick up and drop off from the hotel was very convenient. The best part was weaving in and out of traffic all day. A bit pricey for SE Asia in my opinion (coming in at $79USD after tax). Seemed like they had a lot of overhead with their staff, cafe, and Vespa fleet. I ALMOST regret my decision to skip the tunnels...but to be completely honest and fair, I'm an outdoor kind of guy.

I have done this tour 3 times now and I enjoy it everytime. Anyone I talked too who has done it says the same. A great way to see the city being part of the crazy vespa traffic. Great food and the guides are always insightful and have so much to share not just about the food but their everyday lives. A definite must do.

To be honest after watching how the traffic worked in Vietnam I was absolutely dreading this tour, but my driver made me feel completely safe from beginning to end. We saw so much of the city, ate so much good food including fresh crabs and pancakes and also went to see two live music venues. A big thank you to our tour guide who all five of us had a great laugh with. Would highly recommend this to anyone.

This was the best experience we had in Vietnam. From the moment we were collected until the drop off we had so much fun. The street food we experienced, the night life buzz from the back of the vesper and the places we visited made this tour one to not miss. We got to visit places most tourists would never know about all whilst enjoying the ride.

Thanks again- Paul and Noeleen

review_title: Do not leave Saigon without doing this tour!
review_text: Hands down one of the best things we did in Vietnam!! Absolutely loved it. Having never been on a motorbike let alone on a busy cut road I had some trepidation before, not least because I had my 12 and 15 year old with me. Well you couldn't wipe the smiles off their faces during this fabulous night around Vietnam. My driver Hai was so attentive I felt in good hands. Our guide Khoi was fantastic too. With good English he illustrates our journey from start to finish. I had been concerned concerned that I may lose sight of my children but I think they must have been aware of this because with no request from me great efforts were made in this regard and the bright orange helmets helped enormously. Thank you for an evening we will never forget!! Also the free photographs given to us after the tour are a lovely touch. I will do this again in a heartbeat and if you do nothing else in HCM you have to try this!!! It's so much more than I said in this review!!!

Thankfully we'd spent a day driving in Saigon so we knew how the driving 'worked'. The drivers were superb and I felt very confident in their abilities. It is a brilliant way to see Saigon and taste different dishes and experience different clubs all in one evening. This is truly a must for anyone visiting
Saigon.

We did this tour last night and it was such a wonderful experience, such a great way to see the city at night. They took us to different restaurants where we tried local food, which was all delicious. We also went to a couple of bars, one which was a 'Romantic' bar and another one with a live band. We had such a great a night and felt completely safe on the vespas. I would highly recommend this tour.

Crossing the road can be a challenge in Ho Chi Minh city. Try riding on the back of a Vespa, then you understand why it all works. The one rule is that there are no rules except for common courtesy and it is followed by all.
The tour took us all over the city and to places we would never have seen. The drivers were excellent and our tour guide was very informative of the local history which helped us understand the past and present of this nation.
The highlight of our stay in HCM.

Fantastic - the highlight of our 2 weeks in Vietnam - it came recommended to us from a family of four. I was a bit hesitant after trying to negotiate the road as pedestrian but I felt completely safe and the selected spots were terrific.

We loved the local morning tour so much we went back later in the week for the nightlife tour. Na was wonderful, she made us feel like we were visiting with friends. Our drivers Mr Dao, Mr Tien New, Mr Tam Du and Mr Tam No.8 made us feel completely safe and comfortable manoeuvring their way through the traffic. We were able to experience great food and local secrets we would have missed on our own. Our kids (11 and 13) have made it the highlight of our trip!

The night tour in Phnom Penh starts and ends with cocktails with a delicious seafood meal in the middle, with buckets of beer. Very good fun but it seemed that the cultural part was a slight add on to the party atmosphere. Having said that, this venture is new and the guide and drivers were friendly and capable.

Fantastic experience not just for the buzz of the traffic or the visited locations. For us it was the young adults who showed us around, it made the trip. They were an absolute delight to spend the evening with. Polite, friendly., enthusiastic and great fun. Wonderful advertisement for the youth of Vietnam. Be sure to book this trip it's worth the money and time.

Just back from our morning sights tour. Brilliant! So much better to see this city from a motor scooter. The drivers were excellent and have reflexes like ninjas to safely navigate you through the sites. Highlight was the Buddhist pagoda- it's jaw dropping! Both our boys (10 & 8) had "cool" drivers which made the trip for them even better.lunch is included too. Thank you for a wonderful last morning in Vietnam

What a wonderful night with a few unexpected surprises. Thank you Buffalo tours for recommending this. My kids are aged between 5-12 and everyone loved it. Drivers and guides where very caring and professional. Food was very local but delicious and everyone enjoyed (even my fussy eaters!)
Great to get on the Vespas which were very comfy, an exhilarating ride around HCMC! Appreciated the content on the tour, and the friendly drivers.

Brilliant night zipping through the crazy city of Ho Chi Minh on the back of Vespa getting among the mad traffic with hordes of other motorbikes, visiting local restaurants eating beautifully prepared Vienamese food, bars, listening to Vietnamese music, as well as a local band. Katty was our guide she made you feel very welcome & has a wealth of local knowledge. Both drivers made us feel very safe, & we loved the ride. Thanks team. Would highly recommend this to anyone who loves their food & a little bit of adventure!

My wife and I recently went on the Vespa tour at night for the local food and music. I can honestly say it is one of the best value tours I have ever been on. The drivers pick you up at the hotel and take you to a local bar to meet the rest of the mods. Then it's of to the local restaurants which were amazing, you end the evening by visiting to venues for music. The first place was a bar where locals sang without microphones, it was superb. Then onto the last venue which was bands and individual singers, we really had the time of our lives and will definitely do this type of tour again, I must thank our tour guide kitty who was passionate and informative during the whole trip

Phi and his team of drivers were ultra SAFE, very professional and extremely knowledgable. The tour was totally off the beaten track with visits to authentic ship building, mat making and handsome traditional cooking experiences.
I cannot recommend this tour provider enough both for value and quality of service.
Kind regards
Chris

I did the Food/Drink and Music Tour and it was phenomenal. It rained on us, but the Vespa drivers were prepared with raincoats. I had such amazing food, including frog legs, and I really enjoyed the one Speakeasy type acoustic lounge that had no sign, dimly lit, and wonderful singers/musicians. I also enjoyed the liveliness of Bar Woodstock. Definitely one of my favorite tours in HCM.

Wow what fun, Katty our tour guide was brilliant, we felt completely safe riding around in Saigon even though it rained for some of the time. Our drivers didn't speak a lot of english but we didn't speak a lot of Vietnamese either we both had a lot of fun trying. The way i can only explain how great the tour is, I have friends that work and live in Saigon and every time they have someone to visit they recommend the tour and if they have the time go on the tour again. I recommend that you fit this tour in at the start of your visit to Saigon so you get a feel of the town and people..

We did the day tour first we were picked up promptly from our hotel on the vespers drivers were very friendly although they didn't speak English we meet out guide Chin when we returned to the starting point. He was a fantastic guide and the tour was amazing as it was a Sunday we were highly intrigued by the people that met at the park with their caged birds which were hung on supports so they could all interact ..... after the social event they were then covered over and taken home on the motorbikes
We went through small alleys to the flower market which was absolutely amazing whole experience was very memorable traffic is rather daunting but worth it. We had lunch back at the Zoom cafe which was very nice and a great way to end and amazing experience
We also did the night tour which was all about the different restaurant food which was all interest but I definitely enjoyed the day trip more

It's over AU $100, so probably one of the more expensive things to do here in hcmc but it's definitely worth it. We did the Saigon by Night, and were taken to 4 stops. The first two were food related, and the second 2 were cultural (2 styles of live music). After getting used to being on a Vespa I felt completely safe. The guide had excellent English and the trip is suitable for all adults!

review_title: Great experience not to be missed
review_text: Lora our guide for the vespa tour ran a good show and we had the best time on the tour in Ho chi Min. Took us to 3 local places for street food, coffee house and night club. Started at 6pm and dropped us back at hotel at around 11pm. Quite a buzz on the back of a vespa amongst the best organised chaos on the road. This was a highlight in Ho Chi Min for us and rate it as a must.

We braved the streets of Saigon on Vespa's which were skillfully manoeuvred by some great riders! The ride between each of approximately six stops turned out to be a highlight of the night! The Vietnamese are overall lovely people!! The food, drinks and entertainment at the various destinations were great! A large variety so there really is something for everyone... Even those unlucky enough to have food allergies!!

Ai (our guide) was awesome fun!! Highly HIGHLY recommend doing this!! Be brave and you will never forget the experience 😁

We did the After Dark tour on the advice of our travel agent and loved it. If you just relax on the bike and let the driver do their job you will be fine- this was easier as it was our last night in Vietnam and we had been exposed to Hanoi traffic earlier! Great street food that we would never have been brave enough to try on our own and we loved the hidden bar with Vietnamese music- would have preferred to stay longer there and miss out on the nightclub but that is probably a reflection of our ages (50ish)!
Staff were all brilliant

review_title: Mekong tour. A great way to spend the day!
review_text:
We went out with Na and a team of approximately 8 scooters. 2 of us were riding our own scooters and 5 were riding pillion. The day started with Bin and Mr Tam #8 picking myself and my wife up at our hotel on their scooters and taking us across the city to Zoom cafe where we met the rest of the party. A short time later we were on the road to pick up our own scooters and after a quick check that we weren't going to crash them, we were off.

The tour was brilliant, there was no rush with any of it, we zig zagged our way through busy streets, markets, over little iron bridges, and through the countryside. it reminded me of a good old fashioned ride-out, I never really got out of 3rd gear for best part of the trip.
