Occasionally we will pull over and Na will give a bit of background and explain more about the people and what they were doing, it was all very interesting, from coconut sellers to inscense makers, we managed to have a look at what made the area tick, stopping at a market for some fresh produce and then having it prepared for us further up the road at the Wet Market.

The day ends with a cold beer, or two, and some more freshly prepared food. Mr Tam #8 and Bin then zoomed myself and Mrs B back to our hotel!!

Great fun, and a brilliant way to spend the day.. Highly recommended.

My tip.. Ride your own scooter!!

Went on this trip March 2015, well what can I say? It was our last night in Saigon and what an amazing evening, great guys , took us to great places-great food , and the best night ever, a night we will never forget !!!!!

Our original plan was a night street food tour but it was raining too heavily so we postponed to a morning city tour which turned out to be a much better option. The drivers were amazing, weaving in and out through the crazy traffic, ducking up alleys and zooming through the markets.

In Ho chi minh city and Around Vietnam people using a lot of motobike so instead of seating on the bus s seeing city tour so seating back at Vespa old model (look like you are visiting Italy also) every one has their own tour guide ..Driving around the city you feel like you are local vietnamese ..More fun , especialy young visiting will love it . But make sure not to go when raining day or too much sun...

We did two tours with this company in Saigon -the Glimpse of the Mekong and the Insiders Saigon day tour. We both loved tours and can't really decide which was best. We loved visiting the park where the men took their pet birds to the Bird Club and seeing things we wouldn't see on any other type of city tour. It was a great orientation for us as well as we did it our first morning in Saigon. The Glimpse of Mekong took us out of the city where we were sometimes on little pathways, at one point a ferry and we saw fish markets, little villages and a great local lunch stop on our way back to the city which was really tasty. The combination of both tours gave us a wonderful look at life in Vietnam and we throughly enjoyed them both.

review_title: The best way to see the hidden side of Saigon!
review_text: Great afternoon spent on the back of an amazing vintage Vespa. The driver & guide are skilled and give lots of information about culture, food, religion and the city. On the way back, get them to drop you off of @ Zoom Cafe for a finishing drink. Best way to end a great trip.

review_title: The perfect way to see the city!
review_text:
We did a half day, morning tour of Ho Chi Minh. It was the perfect way to start off our weekend. We have 2 kids ages 12 and 14 who said this was the best tour they have ever been on. We stopped at 10 of the main sites in the city. Our guide did a fantastic job explaining them to us. The tour ended with lunch at cafe Zoom, which had something for everyone.
I'd love to do another Vespa tour in another city some days.

It is a great way to discover the city and the food. You sit in the back of the mopad and they take you everywhere. The traffic is quite crazy but you surely have good driver. Be ware of bag snatching which everywhere in Saigon

review_title: Saigon by Night - Must during Ho Chi Minh visit
review_text: Just did the Saigon by Night Vespa Tour and can highly recommend it - great fun to cruise through Ho Chi Minh on a Vespa and visit 5 locations, having 9 different local dishes and free-flow drinks! Highlight was the visit of a hidden Vietnamese music gem...

review_title: The most amazing thing we've done in Vietnam
review_text:
If we could give out 6 stars, we would. By far this was the most fun we have ever had on a tour. There were four of us and were picked up at our hotel with four vintage Vespas and great drivers. We were on the night tour so it included food and drinks plus an amazing ride through downtown Saigon districts. If you have never seen the chaotic traffic in Saigon (5,000,000 motor scooters in the city) it is hard to describe what it is like to weave your way in and through scooters, cars, buses and pedestrians. After you get over the first impression that you will never survive the evening, it will be the most fun you will ever have. The city is beautiful at night and we stopped five times for cocktails, food, and entertainment. Our evening was led by a remarkable young guide, Jason, who led us through the 10 food courses explaining how to use all the sauces and ingredients to enhance the dishes.

If you only have one night in Saigon, book this tour. It will be worth it and an experience you will never forget

review_title: One of the best ways to appreciate Saigon
review_text: This was a hoot. I've never been on the back of a bike before, let alone in the traffic of Saigon, but it was just such fun. Once you get over the "I might die tonight" moment when you first head out into the seething traffic, it was great. The food enjoyable and music venues and performers about as diverse as you can get. While you're eating street food the stalls have been vetted to meet the VVA standards so you don't need to worry about getting sick. Our tour guide Katie was great and shared lots of her own stories about Vietnam and growing up in Saigon. VVA are a very professional group and - if you're going to risk your neck on the back of a bike - then they're the ones to do it with. I'd do it again and take my kids along.

review_title: Just as good the second time
review_text: Did this tour 2 years ago and loved it just as much the second time. This tour is simply the best for young and for old, just leave your fear at home, throw caution to the wind and just do it as this will be the best fun you will have in Vietnam. You will see the real Saigon, eat real local food and be entertained at real venues.

We did the night Vespa tour on our last night in Saigon & it was amazing!
Our tour guide (Lamb), was excellent very knowledgeable & entertaining. The food was some of the best that we have experienced in Saigon & the drinks were abundant (all alcohol was included).
We went to a lovely intimate music venue to hear two male singers accompanied by a violinist & pianist. I loved it & didn't want to leave. Next we went to a bar to hear a rock band. They were great & very entertaining. We drove through several districts of Saigon that we hadn't yet visited & our drivers were excellent- I felt very relaxed & comfortable in the crazy Saigon traffic. The four our tour went very quickly & we were sad but buzzing when it was over. If we had done this earlier in our trip, we would have definitely booked another Vespa tour...it was definitely a highlight of our holiday & I would fully recommend it to everyone.

review_title: A highlight of ten days in Vietnam
review_text:
Absolutely a must-do. We have spent ten days in Vietnam and this would have to have been a high point. We were a large group of mostly Aussies, most of us on the upper end of 60, with a smaller group in 30's (our next generation). Just as we were departing the heavens opened. It would have been easy to say we are canceling. However despite it scaring the "something" out of most of us we headed out. It rained for the next hour but by then we had realized our drivers were extremely competent and very careful. (You do not know what traffic is until you have walked through Hanoi). And as for our guide (we love you Katty) her energy was infectious, her enthusiasm was catching, and her ability to communicate exceptionally. This in itself makes it well worth doing.
Added to that this was a really well constructed tour. Five stops, each of which provides us with a different foodie or music experience. Food was wonderful but added to by Katty's information about ingredients and how to put them together; we even managed a glass of reasonable wine at one of the dinner venues. And then the two music venues were fab, crossing the generations admirably. I have done this once, but I promise you if we are ever back in Saigon we will do it again. (Please Katty do not have moved to US before then). And thanks to my Bing driver who made me feel safe.

review_title: Vespa tour - ride if your life
review_text:
We did this tour with our 4 year old, and 9 and 10 year olds. This is not the sort of thing I would do in England where I am a normal mum who never takes her kids on mad motor bike tours in some of the craziest traffic we have ever seen. I did wonder if I was being irresponsible having my son on the back of a moped at 4 but then we passed a family of 4 including a babe in arms and I thought "when in Rome". This was easily one of the highlights of a fantastic holiday in Vietnam.
The drivers were very safe and clearly know their way round. You instantly feel you are part of the city if that makes sense.

The food on the tour was amazing and not be missed. Including frog...or jumping chicken! they were so fexible we us and changed to include an ice cream stop!

Our lovely guide Ai was the perfect hostess and really clicked with our kids and I would recommend anyone young or old not to miss this unique experience. 10 out of 10! Thank- you so much Ai!!!

My 2nd tour in Hoi An with Vespa adventures Can't speak highly enough about this company. I have also done a Vespa tour in Hue.
The Hoi An tour took us through beautiful countryside , met locals including a fantastic local who builds his own equipment to roast coffee. Best coffee we had. Beautiful lunch in a heavenly venue. Our tour guide Trinh was fabulous. Great English, very knowledgeable and really helps you understand more about Vietnamese culture and life.
Really good fun. Safe drivers negotiate peak hour Saigon traffic with ease. Our tour was 2 hours, helmet and driver included. Plus knowledgable commentary. Gift at end a charming touch.

We were travelling with a group of friend from Cambodia to Vietnam. When we arrived in HCMC some of us decided to take the vesper night tour. As it was raining some of our group pulled out. Did they ever miss a great adventure!!!
Wrapped in thick ponchos we zoomed around the city stopping for drinks, food and music.
It was my husbands birthday and he was a bit unsure whether he would enjoy it. He had a great time, and they even presented him with a birthday cake at one of our stops. His only comment was we can't tell the grandchildren that we road around HCMC in the pouring rain.
Thank you to our guide Katty who made this a memorable experience.

Been to Ho Chi Minh City before, so we wanted something different and new. We can highly recommend Vespa's Insider tour. Had personal drivers and our own guide who's English was fluent. Fun - interesting - and very friendly! And the lunch was good, too. Furthermore the AO show at the old opera house was included - the most fantastic and spectacular show I've seen in a long time!

We're a family of five that has traveled throughout Asia on annual vacations. One of our very best experiences in all of Vietnam. The number of bikes in Saigon is unreal and the chance to ride around through traffic gives a unique perspective on the city. The focus of the night is the food – great seafood stop and Vietnamese pancakes were both delicious. Our favorite was the coffee stop with a singer, candlelight, and a location that would never be found by tourists. With several kids, our night concluded at a gelato shop. What an amazing experience – must do!

review_title: In amongst all the buzz of the city
review_text:
This is a great evenings' entertainment! Anyone who has been to Saigon knows all about the crazy traffic - although, in fairness, it works for them! And I reckon if they deployed traffic lights or something similarly prosaic, it would all grind to a halt!
So, in the spirit of that - enter into what appears to be complete mayhem, on the back of a Vesper!
The drivers are great, very experienced and have an unerring way of weaving through the myriad of mopeds and scooters (around 8 million we were told - and I believed it!!)
You get completely submerged in the traffic and the city in a way you can by walking or taking a taxi/bus - you need to be in it - and this does exactly that!
A word of warning (we did it on a frantic Friday night) the pollution fumes from all these engines can get a bit thick, take a lead from the locals and strap on a mask/scarf before you start and wear glasses/sunglasses to shield your eyes - and then, let the games begin!!
Absolutely not to be missed - and a lot of fun swapping phones in mid ride to take pictures of each other ............. along with nice stops for food and beer! Great fun for all ages!!

We had a wonderful experience going on a Vespa Adventures tour in Hoi An. It is a great way to see the countryside and people living in the outskirts of the city where travel by car is not feasible. We stopped at many places along the way to see the attractions and sample the delicious food in local small restaurants. We also got a chance to visit some local factories making different ingredients for the food we ate; such as the fish sauce and the banh trang (rice paper). The ride was driven by very experienced Vespa drivers and their conscious care of safety made us feel very comfortable during the vespa ride. I highly recommend to anyone who wants to explore the countryside to contact Vespa Adventures.

review_title: Great way to experience the sights of Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
There were only the two of us on the tour that morning.
We did a number of scooter tours during our trip through south East Asia (in Saigon, Phnom Penh, Siem Reap and Hanoi). All of them were great as the let you experience a city much better then from a tour bus.
We had drivers and a separate guide and while they all were very nice and professional the whole experience was not as personal as the one we had on some other tours that were staffed with local students.
No need to be afraid sitting on the back of a motorbike in the crazy traffic. The drivers actually do stop at red lights while you sit on their bike and admit that they adapt their driving style to make us tourists more comfortable.
Go for it. It is so much more fun than staying in the "bubble" of expensive hotels, restaurants and air-conditioned tour buses and a great way to experience a place rather than just visit is.
Go for their combo offer with the AO show at the Saigon opera house like this is definitely worth watching and will save you some money.

When we booked this we did not what to expect - it was recommended because our top priority is the local food - this was one of the best experiences - but you have to love the experience of riding on a scooter in the downtown Saigon traffic - the tour guide was outstanding and he explained the safety features and once or twice made sure that I had my iPhone stowed properly - the drivers are exciting (driving fast) but without being rash - a very nice way of seeing the city (obviously you do this in the evening) and they were kind enough to customize the trip - making stops short or long depending upon your mood at that moment. Highly, highly recommended

Having seen the organized chaos that is scooter traffic in Saigon, this is a great way of experiencing it for real and getting to eat and drink in some places you will never find on your own. Safe riders took us to great street cafes, backstreet bars where all food and drink was included in the price. Great guide (Tian, ​​his first tour but played it like a veteran) met us at each venue to talk us through the tour and help out. Thoroughly recommended and a definite highlight of our Vietnam trip.

review_title: Amazing way to discover and feel the city
review_text:
We have just arrived in HCMC for a 3-year stay and thought this the best way to get to see our new city.
And it definitely was!
We were picked up at our home, taken to the Zoom where we were met by the tour guide in excellent English. He explained the tour, and off we were.
Great spots, not the tourist traps, he told us interesting facts.
A must when you visit HCMC!
After a lovely lunch, the Vespa-drivers took us home again. I had the funniest driver, who was constantly singing and checking if I was ok in the back.
Thank you Vespa Adventures, I will highly recommend you to our visitors!

review_title: Fun way to get a real feeling of Vietnam
review_text: Not for anybody scared of being part of life in Vietnam, get you right into things fun and wort the time

What an adventure great way to start our holiday in Vietnam. Exceeded our expectations in every way Professional high quality operation by all involved in the company.
Our anxiety in the first 10minutes of zipping in and out of absolute peak hour traffic mayhem quickly turned into adrenalin pumping excitement as we gained confidence in our scooter riders. The trip promised a night in the shoes of a local and it didn't disappoint amazing food and great entertainment. We loved every minute of it. If in HCMC you have to do this!

review_title: Awesome way to see the city!
review_text: Really enjoyed the Vespa night tour in Saigon - a real foodie experience as well as a completely different viewpoint of the city - from the back of the Vespa the madness of motorcycles makes a lot of sense - it's actually quite well ordered and safe. A highlight was the singer and piano / violin group at the second last stop - a hidden gem we would never have found otherwise. Our guide was lovely and drivers very friendly and safe. The 4.5 hour night tour is excellent value - I'd recommend it for any visitors from older kids and up.

review_title: A must to see Saigon /HCM City in the raw
review_text:
We didn't know what to expect at 5.45pm this evening on the Vintage Vespa tour around Saigon / HCM City. We were picked up by delightful drivers ahead of time and taken to meet Hanah our guide for the evening where we had our first cocktail of the evening. We then went off with our very skilful drivers to a stretto of restaurant for second crab, clams, frogs etc washed down with local beer. Then off on another journey for the next course equally delicious pancakes and spring rolls. What was so good was to be shown how the locals eat and enjoy these items. The next two stops were very different one at a club with singing and then onto a club with rock music. Such brilliant fun and truly the best way to see a city at night and be won and ones in a variety of locations.
Such fun.

For me, the highlight of our trip in Vietnam. Whizzing, jigging and blending through the streets of Saigon, where there are more than 7,000,000 scooters, while being introduced to real Vietnamese food and culture among Vietnamese people. The roads are a little intimidating - the Highway Code in Vietnam is for broadest guidance only - but everybody drives defensively and it works - crazy as it sometimes seems. Your food and drink is included. The food is really very good. Do this if you can. (I assume there is a minimum age requirement).

review_title: Best part of my HCMC trip!
review_text:
I can't recommend this tour company enough! I did the night Vespa tour and loved every minute! We eat at very local places and eat food you would probably not otherwise see. (Frog legs were very tasty!) Towards the end of the night we ended up at a cover band bar where we danced and enjoyed bottomless drinks until the tour concluded (included in price).

The tour lasts 630 - 11ish and they arrange all transportation! Riding on the back of the Vespa is surprisingly very stable - you will adapt very quickly :)

We had an awesome group - great guide & really cool people - and I wouldn't hesitate to do it again next time I'm back!

Thanks for a great night!

We were picked up from our hotel just as it started to rain, but luckily the drivers were very prepared, and had raincoats on hand and the shower quickly disappeared! We went on the 3 hour trip to experience the best of the night life. Our highlight was the secret caberet venue, where they played live acoustic music - very atmospheric! We also experienced Vietnamese cuisine from various street stalls which included fried pancakes and 'amphibious chicken' (Frog). Overall, the experience felt very authentic, and exhilarating!

Wow! What an amazing experience we just had. We took the night tour and from start to finish we had wide grins on our faces. We were picked up at our hotel by our excellent drivers and then taken to a cafe, weaving through Saigon's evening traffic. There we met our guide Jaden who was superb. It was more like being out with a friend than a guide. She really made the experience a personal one with insights into the Vietnamese food we ate (there was a lot and it was tasty!) and lots of Laughs! If you can, ask her. We are on honeymoon and were treated so well with a few surprises. I don't want to give too much away but enough to say this is a must for anyone coming to Vietnam. Thank you to everyone involved for making our night so amazing!

A truly novel & delightful way to see Saigon! My wife and I decided on the Saigon by Night adventure and we had the time of our lives.

The Vespa pilots were great as the maneuvered and outmaneuvered the 'chain-link' traffic to get us through and to our destinations safely and with a contented smile plastered across our faces.

The Saigon by Night tour included 2 dining spots...1 seafood and 1 local 'pancake' eatery, 1 jazz club (Vung)...which has local singers crooning Vietnamese love songs/ballads and 1 rock & roll club belting out current and past favorites.
It did rain towards the end of our journey but it was still fun and enjoyable.

They picked us up from our hotel and dropped us off. It's not a low cost adventure per se but it's well worth the dime!

Highly recommended!!

review_title: Amazing personalized tour of the country side around Hoi an
review_text:
Phi, our guide and his two fellow riders turned up early at our hotel and were incredibly personable. We ended up having a personal tour. It was myself, my wife and the two kids (8 and 5). The kids loved being on the bikes.

The "countryside tour" includes many stops, country lanes, country paths, back streets and local interactions.

The stops included a coffee roasting cafe, a number of home stops where they (and joined in) making rugs through to rice crackers through to a 'family-house' and rice fields. The level of insight and information was far higher than we were expecting.

The drivers were all uniformed, well kitted and empathetic to two hot parents and the needs of the kids.

Really enjoyed it.

Great experience. We went on the night tour and were taken to some great restaurants, a jazz club and night club. You will never find these as a visitor so you really see the real night life of Saigon. The drivers were great and clear experts in weaving in and out of the busy traffic!

What a great way to see the city. We did an evening tour of Saigon stopping off at several restaurants and bars. All the food and drink was included and after the first touristy bar it felt like we were seeing the real city. The drivers were really good although they could have pointed out landmarks as we drove past. Don't be scared of taking to the busy roads because you will miss a great experience.

Probably the most fun we have had in Vietnam.... Scratch that; it's the most fun we have had anywhere 😀
Great scooters expertly driven by Doung & Thach, we had the best view of Saigon from within the epicure of the hustle & bustle. We were picked up from our hotel at 6 in the evening so witnessed the city in light & dark - magical!
From our hotel we were taken to the Vespa Adventures cafe for a quick drink & snack where we met our guide for the night Thuan "Eric".
Eric was absolutely brilliant, providing us with expert information & guidance on the food that was delivered to us at the 2 restaurants we scootered to.
Following our copious amounts of food & drink we went to a fabulous little coffee bar with live music (again great!) then onto a night club for more live music before being returned safely to our hotel.
The evening was right up our street & seriously that good that I'm struggling to attain justice adjectives to do the evening....Exciting, exhilarating, intoxicating & certainly fun😉

review_title: Night Vespa Tour - Awesome!! Highly recommend.
review_text:
We did the night tour of Saigon with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. It was one of the best tours we've ever done, having experienced a wide range of different tours and trips all over the world.

They pick you up from your hotel on the Vespas and take you to the bar where the tour starts. There were two of us, and although one of the drivers had limited English the other was nearly fluent and was great fun/had good banter. You're assigned a driver for the evening, are put together in a group of 5-6 plus an additional 1-2 guides, who will sit with you during the meals and explain about the food etc.

The whole experience was extremely professional, and needless to say very very fun. For example, the experience of going round a Saigon roundabout was mental! Think at least 100+ motorbikes all attempting to get on/get off without any kind of rules or system....Saying this, the driving felt completely safe at all times and I wouldn't fault the drivers or company in any way in this regard. Vespa's looked new, helmets good quality, it was raining when we got picked up and drivers had raincoats which were good quality.

The tour includes 2 restaurants - one seafood starter and one main course. We probably wouldn't have found / gone to either on our own despite happy to go off the beaten track. No other tourists in either. Obviously there are a number of groups doing the tour at the same time, so although you're only in a group of 5-6, you will see other groups at the same places which slightly ruins the illusion, but this wasn't an issue for us.

The guides teach you how to eat the food, by this I mean what foods go with which sauces, how to make fresh spring rolls using the ingredients and explain how the food is cooked. Even managed to convince us to try some "jumping chicken"......which was actually delicious.

This was followed by a "coffeeshop". In other words, a small venue which has live classical music being performed. This was good for a couple of songs. The other tour groups being there at the same time was a bit more of a put off at this place.

Finally, the tour finishes off at a bar which had live rock music playing. I'm not a fan of rock music so this wasn't for me. The price of the tour includes all food and drinks, so we made the most of this at the bar!! The tour finishes at around 11pm, the team were happy to recommend another bar to carry on with our group, and drop us there rather than take us back to our hotel.

Not a cheap tour, but considering all that's included and quality of staff / small group size, I think it was worth it. Riding on a motorbike in HCMC traffic is something we will never forget!!

Thanks to our guide (Joana) and to our drivers!!

Collected by a real Vespa from our hotel & rode pillion to a bar to meet other tourists, then a tour of Saigon in the deepening dusk past most of the Landmarks of the city. Through roundabouts, alleys, markets, across the Saigon River to a seafood restaurant. Excellent food & drink, all included in the price. Beware of the 'jumping chicken'! Then off again to another street restaurant for Banh Xeo, with more drinks. Then off to a coffee bar to listen to local singers and finally a more conventional bar before being dropped off at the Hotel.
Crash Helmets mandatory and drivers excellent, deserved their gratuity
Just great fun, would definitely do it again

review_title: Island explorer, Hoi an - great fun
review_text: Took a trip with two young children (5 & 8). A bit anxious about safety but they were great - bikes have proper passenger seats with a back rest so feel completely secure. Proper helmets, including for kids. Great stops along the way - learned about rice growing, made rice crackers, helped weave a mat with some local villagers. Coffee and lunch stops to break up the heat and plenty of water provided. Our guide 'Onion' Phi and drivers Dung2 and Long were great and looked after us and the children fantastically.

review_title: A must-have in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
Wow, wow, wow
I have just finished an evening food tour and I and honestly blown away with the professional outfit that has just looked after me. The vespa drivers were all amazing and you instantly felt so safe in what can only be described as a very chaotic city. The places that we ate gave a great insight into true Vietnamese food and our guide Lora (I hope I've spelled that right) was informative about the food and kept us on the straight and narrow with our timings. We were a slightly rebelious group and she had her work cut out. I cannot recommend this outfit enough. A definite must to introduce you to the wonders of Ho Chi Minh City

review_title: 2 day Wildlife Trip to Mekong Delta
review_text:
From the moment Lam and his team picked us up from our hotel, they were fantastic. After some instruction and testing we chose to drive the Vespa's ourselves and were expertly guided through the traffic on the suburbs of Saigon by our own personal 'minders'. Lam's knowledge was excellent and all of our stops were very genuine encounters with locals about their daily lives. The food was very good and frequent stops to re-hydrate were included. The 3 ferry crossings were all expertly managed (the team even had to lift the Vespa's onto one of the boats!).
Make sure you bring an International Driver's License – we hold motor cycle licenses in our own country, so this was shown on the International version and we understand that we would be covered by our Southern Cross Travel Insurance if we had had an accident).
Also make sure you carry suitable cash for tipping – particularly in the Vam Sat Park. 30,000 – 50,000 is the going rate for the boat drivers/rowers.
We would highly recommend this trip if you want to get away from the usual tourist trail and have a bit of adventure. Vespa Adventures offers a very professional, safe and fun tour.

Wow, what an unbelievable morning. The four of us (incl 12 and 15 yr olds) spent a morning with Vespa Adventures. Picked up at hotel at 8am on 4 Vespas, dropped back after lunch. Brilliant fun, voted best moment if our holiday... And kids hate site seeing. Amazing to dart through all the madness of HCM traffic. Saw all the key sites, great guide (Loc)who also walked us through great market streets, china town and a couple of temples.... An absolute must !

Its a great idea, great experience to drive in this crazy traffic, the program is varied including 4 stops to try different local specialties in Vietnam; its professional, well organized, guide was great.

Highly recommended.

This is a four hour tour circling the city with a stop at bar - some dutch courage which was greatly needed, two food stops: seafood and the fillers, and two music bar stops, all with drinks, everything included.

There is the driver and the guide. The guide sits with you at the stops and chats and explains: our guide Jaden was on her first day, but she was great.

The food was very good - full size seats so the places aren't that local! But certainly good food.

The music stops are something different and provide a break to more whizzing around.

The drivers were great. If its a couple they try and keep you side by side/ in view of each other, that is no mean feat in the traffic.

I lost track a bit, but we must have been an hour on the vespa - which was more comfortable than I expected, and with a handle to save me hugging the driver! I have never ridden a bike before and this was a real experience - initially from fear to some real fun.

A really good way to spend an evening in Saigon,

It ends with them emailing you souvenir pictures. Great. And all included in the price (as were the second drinks etc) so no penny pinching, just making sure you have a memorable evening.

This Vespa adventure was one of the coolest things we did on our trip to Indochina! We did the night tour, starting from our hotel to Zoom Cafe. From there we cruised around Saigon, stopping at several places to sample the local tastes of the city. Along with restaurants, we stopped at a coffee house to enjoy a drink and some music. We also stopped at a local "music bar" to listen to some live popular music. The ride was exhilarating; the food was fantastic; and the city tour was enlightening! Hats off to our Vespa drivers, who were safe and most experienced in the hectic Saigon traffic.

Can't rate this tour or company highly enough. A fabulous and fascinating day from start to finish. Very professionally run, informative and experienced guides and careful drivers. Having never ridden on the back on any form of motorcycle I was slightly apprehensive but need not have been concerned at all. From the very first moment I loved it and felt completely safe! Such a great way to see the countryside and the everyday lives of the lovely Cambodian people. The traditional Khmer lunch is worthy of a particular mention as was abundant and so fresh and delicious. Would certainly book another tour without any hesitation.

review_title: Adrenaline Fueled Tour of Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
The Vespa tour was a riveting, engaging tour of Ho Chi Minh city. Each person gets their own skilled Vespa driver. Riding through the streets is like being part of a school of fish. The drivers expertly maneuver through traffic, giving the amazing rider confidence despite the chaos.

We saw the highlights of Ho Chi Minh city: the Pagoda, Temple, Post Office. We also saw a flower market and a bird park. We felt like we saw the city from both a tourist's and an insiders point of view.

Highly recommend it!

review_title: My family's in collective agreement - it is one of the top 2 things we did in SE Asia.
review_text:
So when my family travels, we aren't ones to do organized tours or what we think as "overly touristy" things, but the travel company we used (Trails of Indochina - highly recommend) scheduled this for us.

I've never ridden on a motorcycle/scooter before in my life, and I didn't know what to expect. Well, it was one of the best experiences of my life.

Every single person involved, from the drivers to the guides were so kind. You drive all over Saigon and see all corners of the food/bar scene. The places that they chose are amazing - but that's all I'm going to say on that. I don't want to ruin it for you!

At the different places, you have dinner with your guide, and get to know them. It isn't a scripted "I'm going to talk at you for 2 hours" sort of deal. You learn about where they come from and they learn about you, all over some pretty awesome Vietnamese food. The whole thing is just so well done. No waiting, everything runs so smoothly.

The Vespa rides were amazing. Driving through all these different parts of the city at night halfway around the world was indescribable.

I can't think of the words to accurately describe how awesome the night was. Just do it. I can't recommend it highly enough.

review_title: Saigon Vespa Night Food tour should be mandatory with the visa entry
review_text: I have been very lucky to travel extensively and fully and this is the best thing I think I have ever done. In 5 hours the whole of Saigon is brought to life. Not cheap so unlucky backpackers (approx $100USD) but bloody amazing. Our guide Nuyen was just the best, ask for her if you can and she will add to the brilliance. Nuyen made it for us and our drivers were superb. I could so it again and again and again. An ingenius idea and really well organized tour. Bravo.

review_title: Vespa night city tour - Excellent way to see the city at night
review_text:
We had very little time to see the city. The tour was an excellent way to unwind and catch a glimpse of the city.

The guides were excellent and considered. Our meeting had overran by 30 minutes but the guides were super understanding. I had never been on a bike, so was very nervous. My guide made sure he was super careful and after 2 stops I was comfortable. We were joined by a family of four with 2 pre teens. The tour was appropriate for all age groups (except very young kids I guess).

Is a tour I would recommend to everyone who wants to unwind and see the city. Next time I'm there I'll try the day tours.

We did the tour in Hoi An and it was brilliant from start to finish. Our two girls 7 and 10 absolutely loved it. During the short time we had in Hoi An, it was a perfect way to see the country side. The Vespa ride itself is very comfortable and safe and FUN!

Brilliant way to get around in HCM and see the unusual.
Great tour guides, good location selection.
Worth the 4 hours and getting a bit of local knowledge.

Will do it again next time in town

Many of the people describe this adventure as their life's best experience. So it is difficult to add any other superlatives. I traveled to HCMC just for one night and I'd spent most of it with Vespa Adventures team. But probably when I will come here next time for longer, I will choose them again. Whatever they promote, is true. And its more you will get. Emotions! Worth 6 stars, as minimum.

review_title: Night tour was a lot of fun
review_text: I did the night food tour. All you can eat and drink well worth it for the extra you pay compared to the other food tours. We stopped at 2 different restaurants ate some fantastic local dishes, with plenty of food left over. You also stop at 2 bars and cruise the town of Saigon on the back of a Vespa

Vietnam Vespa Adventures were great, picked us up from the boat dock before exploring the city they knew, not the touristy area - while they were still covered. Really interesting, felt safe even when weaving among the traffic, drivers were knowledgable, friendly and helpful. Helmets and face masks provided, we stopped for drinks along the way as it was hot. A fun afternoon exploring the other side of Ho Chi Minh.

review_title: Ho Chi Minh vespa tour was one of the most fun events of our trip!
review_text: The vespa tour through Ho Chi Minh was unbelievably fun! The vespa drivers for me and my two friends were fabulous and we felt safe the whole time. Our guide, Lam, was awesome. He was very informative and fun at the same time. All the food we had was delicious and the two music venues we visited were great. If I ever get back to Vietnam, I will do this tour again and probably just hire someone to drive me around on a vespa the whole time. Thanks Vietnam Vespa Adventures for a great, memorable night in Ho Chi Minh!!

Fabulous, fabulous tour.

Amazing scenery, charming and funny tour guide (Na) and careful and competent drivers on restored vintage Vespas. It's a must do.

We were picked up at our hotel and made several stops to various restaurants, a coffee house and a bar. Drivers were friendly and cautious. Guide was personable and knowledgeable. A great way to experience Saigon by night and Vietnamese food and way of life.

Agree with the last reviewer that this is one of the best things to do in Vietnam. What an introduction to Hoi Chi Ming City.

My wife and I were picked up by our kamikaze Vespa drivers at 6pm. A 15 minute drive through the city traffic to a corner bar where we met our guide, Yuge.

After a cocktail and some dips back on the bikes for a 20 minute drive to a restraunt. Beers and a five course meal; crab, shrimp, frogs legs.

Back on the bikes for another 20 minute drive to a "bakery" for fresh spring roles, pancake with shrimp, then desert and of course more beer.

After a short drive we arrive at a cafe for coffee (or wine). A candle lit venue with live music and singers. We would never have found this location on our own.

Next a drive to "Woodstock" a local pub and music venue with a great rock / pop band. More cocktails.

Our guide met us at every venue and thoroughly entertained and hosted us.

review_title: Great night out with Vespa Adventures
review_text: Just finished a wonderful night tasting great food and riding Vespa's. Our family of 5 all enjoyed themselves. The food was delicious and adventurous. Our guide spoke very good English and explained the food and culture very well. We particularly liked listening to the local music in the underground cafe. I would recommend it highly.

review_title: Best thing we did in Vietnam
review_text: At first we were a little bit apprehensive about the tour (Vietnamese traffic is really hectic), but it was great to experience Saigon on the typical motorbike. I felt very safe. We had really good food and drinks on the way and also some lovely surprises. Great night out!

Just finished the 4+ hour evening tour - great fun , felt surprisingly safe with experienced lady driver and loved the food - they provided plenty vegan options for me and we couldn't eat any more ! Plenty of drinks and ended up in two bars with local music - great way to get a taste of the city . Many thanks

We had a fantastic trip around this amazing city experiencing it in a unique fashion. Our host Terry kept us entertained in numerous restaurants where we drank to our hearts content and ate a wide selection of food. The tour ended with some classical Vietnamese singing followed by a Vietnamese rock band. All the time we were in the capable hands of Terry who had a great sense of humor and elegance with the rock band and our drivers Danh and c.Ba. who steered our Vespas around the thronging streets with ease and confidence.
A great experience and one not to be missed.

There were six of us on the Saigon by night tour, and our super enthusiastic and outgoing tour guide, Loan, made us feel like old friends! Everywhere we went, she explained what we were eating, and even demonstrated how to eat it! The drivers were also wonderful. It rained the entire night, but that didn't make the trip any less enjoyable. We were offered raincoats that covered us head to toe. There are several stops on this tour, so pace yourself!

review_title: much better than regular bus tours
review_text: I did the Glimpse of the Mekong tour which was a great chance to get out of the city and have a taste of the Vietnamese countryside. Riding on a Vespa was way more fun and exciting than sitting in a bus. The tour guide was great, spoke good English, and was lots of fun. They were very attentive to our needs and accommodating to our food restrictions. While much more expensive than your regular tours, I would highly recommend Vespa Adventures if you're looking for a different kind of adventure.

We are a family of four aged 50, 47, 21 & 18 & we all smiled for the four and a held hours on this tour

They massively undersell themselves

This tour included a five course taster of a street food seafood restaurant , another stop at a Vietnamese street food pancake shop, Vietnamese coffee at at great music cafe & finally an acoustic music venue and that's without even mentioning the great Vespa drivers

This tour simply has to be done - you won't regret it
Fantastic evening and took me back to my teens. Felt safe throughout and was a really great way to spend an evening.

Our Vespa adventure was the highlight of a fantastic fortnight in Vietnam. I booked it whilst still in the uk via trailfinders and had become increasingly worried after seeing the madness of Vietnamese traffic and all suffering tummy problems. But we couldn't have enjoyed it more! It was hugely fun to be among the traffic and we felt surprisingly safe driven by our expert weavers. And the food was delicious in great locations. Our 4 Vespa drivers were lovely and smiling every time we struggled with the helmets and our guide Lam very friendly and knowledgable. We especially enjoyed the two memorable nightspots we visited at the end of the evening . Could not recommend it more!

Amazing tour! We saw and learned so much. We booked this last minute and they accommodated us without a problem, collected us from our hotel within 45 mins of us booking. Uyen our tour guide was great, she told us so much about the city. I would highly recommend if you have a spare morning or afternoon in Ho Chi Ming city

I was lucky enough to arrive in Hue just after Vespa Adventures starting operations in the city. Having used them in Saigon, Hoi An and Siem Reap the local boys had a lot to live up to. I was not disappointed.
I elected to do the Countryside Tour because it was so different to other tours I had done in Hue over the last few years and totally enjoyed the day, visiting villages, local artisans and market. Having seen every tomb around Hue I was glad they were NOT included.
Organization could not be faulted, from pickup at 7.45am to the finish about 2pm. Lunch was at one of the best settings over a lagoon and the food the high standard I come to expect from Vespa. You don't need to eat the eel and frog but I recommend it. Bao Huy and the drivers made for a perfect day with their knowledge and friendliness a highlight.
Highly recommend this company for all their tours.

We had a great night. My partner was very scared to start with as the traffic is scary but once we got going she relaxed. The food stops were excellent and the music stops later were very good. It's a must do!

Had an amazing adventure and fearlessly tackled Saigon traffic unscathed. Our friendly drivers and knowlegable and very charming guide, Thu, guarantee we had a fun time discovering an ecclectic mix of foods and nightlife on offer in this fantastic city. Don't miss out this will enhance your time in Saigon and make you appreciate the importance of the scooter, all 5 million of them.
Saw the city from the back of a Vespa! Fun guides who know a lot. Top experience like a real Vietnamese without driving yourself in the crazy traffic

We went on this tour the night we arrived in Saigon and it was amazing! Our tour guide's name was Na (hence the title) and she was awesome. Na took us to a seafood restaurant (we ate frogs!) and then to a traditional Vietnamese restaurant. We ate the savory pancake wrapped in a wasabi leaf and made our own rice paper rolls - so good! We then took the Vespa to a night cafe with live music and ice cream before finishing with karaoke. Definitely recommend doing this!

An exciting way to see Ho Chi Minh City by night. "Jason" was a great guide full of stories. Street food mixed in with bars and live music. I mean really, flying through the city mixed among the locals, how many times are you going to get in your life to do something like that? Highly recommended
What an amazing evening with family and friends among beautiful HCMC. Great value and great fun. Food and drinks delicious. Chin our guide was fantastic. Thank You!

review_title: Brilliant Tour! A Must in Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: We booked this tour at the last minute based on a friends recommendation and it was well worth it. Our tour guide was amazing, very funny and spoke English well. The local food experience was fantastic, really yummy food! And the ride on the Vespas was so much fun! Do yourself a favor and book it now!

review_title: Great introduction to Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Went on this trip the second night we were in Vietnam. It was a great introduction to Vietnamese food and culture. The Vespa drivers and tour guides were professional and good fun to be around. We would highly recommend this trip. Make sure you come hungry!

After much convincing, I decided to try the Vietnam Vespa Adventure Tour in Saigon! If you've seen the traffic in Saigon you will understand why I was a wee bit nervous to hop on the back of a Vespa. But I'm so glad I stepped out of my comfort zone and gave it a go! The drivers are amazing! After the first few minutes I felt completely comfortable and enjoyed looking around at the city! The tour consists of 5 wonderful stops at local restaurants. The food is AMAZING! Our tour guide, Uyen, was incredible and I really enjoyed learning about the food, culture, and city. I honestly feel this is the best way to experience Saigon!

If you are in HCMC you absolutely have to do this! From start to finish it was a world class experience.

The customer service was excellent, the food was delicious and there was plenty to drink.

Lam was our guide and he was brilliant, he made the evening so enjoyable and easy for all of us with his knowledge and friendly style.

This is one of the most enjoyable things I have done on holiday and highly recommend it.

The experience of being on a Vespa in HCMC is incredible.

If you could only choose one thing to do in Saigon this would be it.
I feel like a local zooming around in the night traffic on the back of a vintage Vespa. We visited a number of food outlets that I would have never of picked and was very happy with the food on offer. The night finished in a funky bar with good music the perfect way to end the night. The staff are fun and make me feel safe on the back of the scooter and I also make some new friends. Don't miss this tour.

review_title: For the tourist that doesn't like super touristy
review_text: Amazing time! I was reluctant to sign up for this because I err on the side of trying local spots and staying away from big tour groups. This tour however came highly recommended by a friend that visited HCMC last year and so I had to try. So happy I did! I met some great people on the trip, we went to some delicious food spots and one destination was off the beaten path, my fav. The final destination I'll have to say wasn't the best. It was a bar with a Vietnamese band playing American hits. Cute concept but not what I'm looking forward to when in Vietnam. Aside from this, the other four locations, the people, the tour guide, the ease of setup up, the matter of safety, etc., all on point. I did the night tour btw.

review_title: Fantastic adventure to see the city sights
review_text: We went on this tour of ho chi min city. You get right among the swarms of traffic and experience the thrill. The guide we had was Chin and he had excellent knowledge of the sights we went to and spoke good English. The Vespa drivers were experienced at negotiating the busy streets. The roundabouts were awesome.

We did the Saigon after dark tour and it was a definite highlight!
Being among the traffic was really great fun and the food was fantastic and so was our guide he made the whole night fun and informative.

It's certainly more expensive than visiting bars and restaurants on your own, but we had a great experience on our Saigon by Night tour! An excellent guide, fun rides around town on the Vespas, and great food.

We did the night tour and really enjoyed it. A great way to be in the thick of HCM and the traffic. Expert riders and taken to great venues, really enjoyed the variety of music places.
Would definitely recommend, lots of fun and a great experience.

This tour consists of being transported via vintage Vespa to various places in the city to sample local food, drink and music. We found the rep Chien to be extremely kind, thoughtful and welcoming. Helmets are provided, and we both found the drivers to be extremely careful; we felt safe the entire time.

This is a great way to see the city, particularly the less touristy back streets where the street foods and market stalls dominate.

We were taken to two local restaurants, both serving traditional Vietnamese food, then to a secret bar with live music. Unbeknownst to us Chien arranged the singer to dedicate a song to us for our honeymoon, which was a lovely and very thoughtful touch. Finally we went to a rock bar/club where an excellent live band were playing, before being returned to our hotel.

Overall we found the experience to be an ideal way to see the city, and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it. You should do this!

We read great reviews about the company, and they were indeed very responsive and helpful when we were planning our trip. Unfortunately, not through any fault of theirs, we encountered a veritable tropical downpour during our tour, so we were limited to visiting a small Chinese pagoda, and the Binh Tay market for what would have been a 4-hour tour. The company provided us proper rain gear for the ride, and the drivers gamely pressed on, but it was too short for the price we paid.

Not enough stars available to rate this tour - went out to Mekong Delta. Our guide Lam was very informative, drivers were also lovely. Stopped for coffee at very traditional place on a tiny road. Got a punt over to a bigger town, where we rode through markets & stopped. Lam told us what everything was & bought stuff for us to try. Then sat under a shelter trying local scallops, clams & fish soup. Then back on the bikes to explore tiny paths, across bridges, through the Mekong delta. Stopped at a Cao Dai temple to have a look. Then great lunch over the water at a restaurant on the way back to Saigon. Truly amazing, authentic journey. Guide and drivers all excellent, food fab & felt very connected to the locals everywhere we went. I cannot recommend these guys enough!!! 10 stars

review_title: Great night out in Hoi An!
review_text: Had a great night in Hoi An with my mum and Vespa Adventures! We were the only ones on the tour and had an excellent time. The Vespa rides were great fun, in and around the streets of Hoi An, crazy traffic but always felt safe. Van was an excellent guide, she spoke great English and showed us some great places off the beaten track that we would never have found ourselves. A great night out, thanks Van, Win and Son!!

This was the highlight of our time in Vietnam.

Thank you for such a great experience and to feel like a local.

we/ my husband and I, really had a great night with Vespa tours, from the pick up to the drop off it was FUN FUN FUN.

I recommend it highly. At 67 years old, I felt young and alive. The organization, food driver, club etc were AAA+++.

Thank you.

Penny Walker

review_title: Awesome Mekong Delta tour - off the beaten track
review_text: We did the 'A Glimpse of the Mekong' tour and firstly it is so different to the bog standard (albeit much cheaper) coach tours available from all the travel agents around Saigon - you are completely taken off the beaten track on the back of vintage Vespas (ours were from 1963 and 1968 I think) and right in amongst the local villages and fishing communities around the Mekong Delta. We mixed with locals, visited markets, ate some seafood, ranked some Vietnamese iced coffee and we loved it all. Our tour guide Lam was very friendly, enthusiastic and extremely knowledgeable - he helped us get some great photos too. Loved it!

review_title: The ONLY way to see Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Great way to see Saigon through the eyes of locals. Traveling on motorcycles was awesome, navigating traffic even more exciting. Saw the cathedral, post office, unification palace, bird park, chinese temple, budhist pagoda, flower market etc. Highly recommend them!

Our trip with Vespa Adventures to the Mekong Delta was fantastic. Our guide, Na, was great - knowledgeable, professional, fun and just a very sweet person, who made sure we had an amazing experience. And our drivers, Tien and Hai, took us through the traffic in a manner, where we always felt safe and well taken care of. Highly recommendable!!

The Saigon by night Vespa tour was a combination of exhilarating trip around the city on the back of a Vespa in and out of the traffic with a local driver, great food and a hugely articulate host with a wealth of local knowledge and a great thirst for learning from his foreign guests.

review_title: One of the best nights of my life!!!!
review_text:
A truly brilliant experience the leader was awesome made everyone at ease and got everyone involved and made the experience really fun. It was such a surreal experience weaving through the streets of Saigon but I felt completely safe.

Anyone could take this trip is not just a young persons thing. there were 60/70 year olds on the group in front of us and they loved it also.

This tour was recommended t me by an Aussie mate living in Vaung Tau.
Booking was a breeze, picked up from hotel right on time, my driver Steve was a pleasure to be with our Hostess Claire, beautiful bubbly personality and taught us a lot about Vietnamese food. Group of 6 all excellent company. Can not speak highly enough of Vespa Adventures- you have not lived till you have zoomed through Saigon's night traffic on the back of a Vespa!! A wonderful group of people who made it a very enjoyable experience. Many Thanks.

Highlight of being in Saigon. Great guide. Fantastic food, entertainment. Excellent value for money! Love that we got to go to restaurants usually only patronised by locals. Ending night at acoustics bar was special.
Our tour guide Chin was so fun and professional! We had great food and riding on the back of the Vespa was the highlight of the tour!

Mekong adventure day tour - This tour was very expensive but great fun!!

It was the best part of a day and you got a really good taste of the region. It was not only a scenery and cultural tour. You also got to sample some fantastic food.

Our guide spoke v good English which allowed us to learn a lot.

I would recommend but do think it is expensive

We've booked the city tour of Ho Chi Minh City to get an overview of the city. What a pleasant and fun surprise, the tour was an absolute highlight, fun, easy and extremely well run.
Our guide Chien was fabulous, well informed, not pushy and a great companion. The drivers were well experienced, friendly and easy to get along with, l'm going to book a Vespa adventure tour again and again, THE BEST!

review_title: City tour surprise with a difference for my friend
review_text:
Surprised my friend who is a tourguide in another city in Vietnam with the Vespa tour- Saigon after dark.
What a wonderful Saturday evening that was, and I am so happy with this great choice.

From the moment the drivers picked us up at the hotel (it was raining heavilly) we felt well taken care of. They introdoced themselves and already knew and used our names and helped us to put on rain ponchos and comfortable helmets.

Binh and Nam brought us on their vintage vespas to the gathering point from which the tour started and where we met with other participants. I liked that we were grouped into small independant groups, all with their own guide. We met our guide, Son, who spoke excellent English and the other 3 participants in our group and were invited to a drink and nachos with salsa.

After making the payment, we had time to got to know our fellow group members from Adelaide, Toronto and Hong Kong.
After 10 minutes we started a 20 minutes ride to our first stop, a seafood restaurant in district 3, popular with Saigonese. We were served spicy crab, clams, frog and seafood noodles. As a vegetarian, these delicacies had less appeal to me and I was very happy to be served meat and fish free alternatives, like stirfried morning glory and fried tofu with a savory crust.

The next stop was a vietnese pancake house, were the traditional Banh Xeo pancake was served, with fresh and deep fried spring rolls. BBQ beef and lots of fresh herbs and leaves are used to wrap pieces of the pancake and beef to form a roll and then dip it into a delicious sauce. Son did a good job in demonstrating how to wrap the food in a professional way so were able to eat our pancakes with a degree of grace... And I was very happy to receive a vegetarian version of the pancake, with some other goodies.

The next stop was a cafe in the back of an old building. I would have never dreamt to walk down the alleyway, cross the courtyard of what looked like a private house to then climb one floor up into a cafe that just simply blew my mind away. I don't want to actually take away the surprise and delight others may experience as I did. So I just say it was amazing and most moving.

Final stop, Timberhut, a local rock bar with live music playing anything in the charts at the moment.

In all places I felt very cared for, the driver Binh and Nam drove very responsible and manouvered us safely and efficiently through the mad Saigon traffic.

All in all a great experience which I am very happy to recommend to anybody who wants to get to know Saigon on a deeper level.

Thank you to the team at Vietnam Vespa Adventure.

The Vespa crew in Ho Chi Minh were 5 star!! There were 6 of us on the tour and everyone was catered for accordingly. The scooters themselves were so comfy eg. Separated seat from driver and a backrest. Great way to see a bit more of the buzzing city.
The food was all really good authentic Vietnamese and the beer was flowing (included in cost) all night.
It is quite an expensive tour but it is well worth it! Was a really great time!

Saigon traffic is rightly famous for its chaotic nature so becoming part of it on a vintage Vespa is certainly a memorable experience. I am not a 'biker' in any sense of the word and having booked this activity in the UK, I was more than a little apprehensive before embarking on this adventure.
But I needn't have worried the expert drivers ensured that I, along with my wife and 14-year-old son, felt 100 per cent safe as we weaved in and out of the thousands of other bikes and cars. Our guide was knowledgeable and entertaining and we saw parts of the city we would never have found on our own.
All in all a first class experience everyone should try.

Visited April 2016

We had a great time on the back of the Vespas being taken around the district of HoiAn. Our guide was very knowledgable and friendly we got a great insight to life in Vietnam by visiting different people in their homes running their businesses from Rice Noodle making to boat building all very interesting. The scenery was amazing and the walk over the Bamboo bridge was lovely. We had lunch at The Field restaurant which was a really pretty place in the middle of a Rice paddy. I highly recommend this tour well worth doing !

Amazing tour!
I have experienced more than twice times with Vietnam Vespa Adventures by day and by night as well.
I can live the real life of local people: eating, drinking in street among and with local people, touring with them in very, very busy street, among thousand of thousand motobycles. It is really a good experience, amazing adventure!

review_title: A fun night experiencing Ho Chi Minh by scooter with devine food and drink on tap.
review_text:
Had the most amazing night on the back of a scooter being driven around Ho Chi Minh on the Foodie Tour. Went to lots of Districts. The guide was very professional, knowledgable, friendly and personable. The food was devine. Even ate frogs' legs.
This tour is a "MUST".

Definitely worth the tour of HCMC with Vespa Adventures. The tour guide Khanh was really polite and friendly. We really enjoyed ourselves. The information provided about the history and background of the places in HCMC was very enriching. A must do day tour when if you're there.

I chose this tour based upon the previous Tripadvisor reviews, and I was not dissapointed! They picked us up on cool, old Vespa scooters and gave us a whirlwind tour of a fantastic city. We did the morning tour, and our first stop was the Bird Cafe, where people bring their songbirds for everyone to enjoy while drinking tea. It was a really fantastic cultural experience. We spent the next 4 hours driving around town and seeing the major sights, all while traveling like a local. If you have the time, I highly recommend this tour!

Very professionally organized with a professional photographer to capture your experience. Placed in small groups so you can have conversations with others on the tour. Great drivers and great bikes. A bit touristy, especially with the music portion of the tour but had a great time! Highly recommend Saigon after Dark!

review_title: Vintage Vespa Trip to Mui Ne
review_text:
We booked the 4 days / 3 nights trip from HCM City to Mui Ne. Started on first day with the standard day & night tour before leaving the busy city next day. So with this day u are booking 3 in 1.

First we have to say thank u to all the staff we met. Very friendly and helpful some speak more english some less but enough for simple conversation.

Special we have to say thank u very much to:
Lam, Tam & Phuoc

They stayed with us on the trip to Mui Ne. Even u had to start ur Vespa or turn in right direction to continue ur trip after a break:-)) also the helmet they put on ur head.

The hotels we stayed was great and almost the best at the place we stopped. Also the food was excellent on the trip even i had always specials cause i was on strong diet at that time.

U feel very safe on this trip cause the Minibus follows u with all ur bags. Also if ur pillion tied from riding can take a rest in the minibus.

Only one suggestion: let the tourguide read the website in english before starting cause u awaiting all this things will happen. I would say we got 70 % same they say on website.

Overall the tour was great and the price fair for what u get. The vintage vespa runs great all the time and gives u great feeling.

We can recommend this trip.

We booked this online before we came to Vietnam which was really efficient! (Although have read and spoke to another person on our tour who confirmed that it may be significantly cheaper of booked by your hotel when you arrive!) Picked up from our hotel lobby and our drivers took us to Zoom cafe to meet the rest of the group.
Our guide was lovely, really informative and explained the food brilliantly.
This is by far the best way to experience the city at night. A little daunting to start with but by the second ride so liberating sitting on the back and soaking up the views and the traffic!
Food was excellent and LOTS of it! Definantely should have skipped lunch for this!
The bars at the end were a nice touch and if we had more time in Saigon we would have come back.
Loved the gift at the end too!

My two adult dsughters and one partner did the night time food trip. Two were very nervous having watched HCMC traffic for 3 days.
They all loved the fun, the food was terrific and the riders great. They enjoyed seeing a different side to the city
Highly recommended.

review_title: An absolute highlight of our Vietnam Holiday
review_text:
The evening Vespa food tour has to be up there as one of the most memorable experiences we've had in 30 years of travelling.
This tour is suitable for all ages. Please don't think that you're too old - we're in our late 50's and saw other groups of a similar age.
The drivers are careful and courteous and even though we had an incredible downpour and found ourselves driving through rivers of water we at no time felt unsafe.
First stop was Zoom Café where we had drinks and nibbles, then off to a streetside seafood restaurant were, amongst tasty seafood, we tried some delicious frog legs. Then on to another restaurant for a larger Vietnamese meal, followed by a quiet club and then on to a nightclub.
Will remember this trip for many years to come.

What a great night. We only had a short time in Saigon and a brilliant way to see it. It seems like it is cheaper it you book it through the hotel travel agent rather than online but great evening either way and worth the money.

Guide was great, food was good and vespas rock.
Visit street restaurants with excellent food, speed through narrow allys with people dodging out of your way, listen to excellent local music at late night clubs, get to know Saigon at night!!

Arrived and was greeted by a wonderful bubbly host loan enjoyed a couple of drinks then a brilliant tour of great food and drink finishing in a bar with great live music a definite must do if ever in ho chi minh city

review_title: Great Afternoon and Completely Safe For Our 9 Year Old Daughter
review_text:
we did 2 tours, with vespa adventures, the afternoon tour and the night food tour. i am reviewing the afternoon tour.
it was great. super informative and completely safe for our 9 year old. the vespas have single seats, back rests, and fixed bars to hold onto. the drivers were awesome with all three of us. it seems a little daunting when you have experienced scooter traffic, from a closed vehicle with 4 wheels or from a sidewalk. these guys and gals have experience driving in ho chi minh traffic. within minutes you get lost in the sights and sounds and forget about the crazy traffic. it all seems to flow. you start at the tour companies restaurant for lunch which is included. there is both Vietnamese/south east asian cuisine as well as north american, (including nachos, tacos, burgers and fries, and sandwiches).
after everyone in your group is acquired from different hotels and you have shared a meal and introduced yourselves you go out to see the sights. its a great way to get an overall view of the city and its history. you look at some french colonialism architecture and more resent history involving the veitnam war. yo visit the imperial palace and get a look from outside the gate, the cia building were it was photographed with a line from the rooftop up the ladder to the small landing during the evacuation of saigon. the street corner and shrine with a history lesson regarding the monk that set himself on fire in protest to the government. we learned a lot from our guide. i would highly recommend this tour.

This is a must do tour of Ho Chi Minh, very informative, great fun, great food etc. probably the quickest four hours ever, just flew by. felt really safe at all times and you get to see places that you probably wouldn't do by yourselves.
thanks to Son and everyone at VVA

I was initially very nervous about this tour due to the crazy traffic but I had so much fun!! It's a lovely way to see the city and we loved every place we were taken. The food was lovely and it was nice to get an idea of where the locals eat. The different bar venues were also fantastic, both very different but both great. Our guide Na was sooo lovely! Very bubbly and great fun, and full of knowledge! She definitely made the night for us...it was our last night on our honeymoon and she definitely went out of our way to make it the best night! Our drivers were also extremely friendly and helped me relax easily! A must do I would say in Saigon! ☺️

review_title: Ride in the fast paced traffic and eat what the locals eat
review_text: This would have to be one of the best tours I have ever been on. The ride through the traffic on the back of a Vespa and you felt very safe as the other bikes, trucks, cars and scooters buzzed past you. Stoping at different places to eat street food as the locals would. We had a brilliant host "Loan" not as in car loan but sounds like lowanne. For the group of us this was more like a progressive dinner or a pub crawl on wheels as most of us drank fairly well. Where else can you ride on the back of a Vespa or bike with an open can of beer in your hand. If you have a GoPro take it along or use the movie set up on your phone. This is a real blast that finishes up at a pub with music

review_title: Adventure in Traffic Chaos and Food Delights
review_text:
If you are truly going to experience Ho Chi Minh city, you have to take the Vespa tour. We took the night food tour. You are instantly transposed into the local way of life. Darting through traffic chaos like butter. Thought I would be nervous but found myself totally relaxed and safe. Enjoyed numerous sights as we bounced around from restaurants and cafes and bars to enjoy a foodie night out in HCMC. Brought my 12 year old son and he had a blast as well.

Very happy I chose this tour. Great memories (and thanks for the picture souvenir given at the end of the tour)

Full recommendation...enjoy!!

A great night on the back of a Vespa in Saigon traffic. A bit scary but the drivers were great. The places we stopped at were good and varied with plenty to eat and drink. This is the second tour we have done with this company the other in Hoi An both great value. Only negative we booked directly on line and paid deposit months ahead only to find out that if we booked from hotel is would of been 30% cheaper don't think this is fair.

review_title: Awesome way to see the city
review_text:
Ho Chi Minh City has 9 million inhabitants and 7 million motorbikes and most of the time, it feels as if every one of them is on the road. This is, therefore, the way to see the city the way the locals do.
They give you a mask to help protect you from the fumes but I found this way to hot and managed perfectly well without it. You get a quick lesson on how to mount and dismount your Vespa and then you're off with your driver firmly in charge. It's a bit hairy for the first few moments and but you soon realise that your driver knows exactly what he's doing and you relax and really enjoy the ride.
You make several stops at places of interest where you learn a bit more about the city and all in all, we were out for around an hour and a quarter. It was a fabulous experience and I would do it again in a heartbeat!!

Our travel agent booked us in for this Saigon by night foodie vespa tour. This was my husband's best night every...he loved it. A great blend of food destinations, fabulous guide and very good drivers as we became one of the millions of motorcyclists zooming round the city all translated to cecome our "best night in Vietnam". We loved the food stops where we tried food we probably wouldn't have normally chosen but enjoyed the experience.
Congratulations on a very professional and slick tour guys. Truly enjoyed what you do and we're spreading the word already.

Great way of exploring the sights and food of Hoi An and we were given a real insight by tour guide Mr Phi who is a local. Definitely recommended as we would have never found these places on our own. Particularly enjoyed hopping on a boat as part of the vespa tour too and enjoying the experience of lighting lanterns and placing them on the river whilst making a wish!! My young daughter thoroughly enjoyed that bit.. :)

What a great time we had on our Vespa Tour. Our guide, Tu was knowledge and informative. We were picked up by Vespas at our hotel and taken to a bar where we met Tu and had a beer and chatted about what the evening involved. We were taken via Vespa to a sea food restaurant via the long route around the city where we had a fantastic meal with Tu who advised us what the food was and how to eat it. Then we were taken, again via Vespa (long route) to a local pancake restaurant, ate with Tu advising is what to do and how to eat. Drinks were plentiful. We were so full. Then we went to a local quiet romantic bar where a pianist, violinist and singer played. This was on the first floor and accessed by a back stair case that you just would not know was there had you not been taken to it. This was very relaxing with beautiful music. Then onto a rock bar called Woodstock which was great on this night. (I have posted a sperate review of this bar as we had issues when we went back to it the next day on our own) we were taken back to our hotel at the end of the evening. What an absolutely fabulous evening. Why only 4 stars??? My Vespa driver did not say word as he was driving me around. It would have been good if had he pointed out local land marks when we passed them.

review_title: Most charming way to see Ho Chi Minh or 'Saigon'
review_text: Vietnam has an unprecedented amount of motorcycles and Vespas. To truly get a feel of the city and whip about fast and efficiently, the Vespa adventure is the best! We were truly so happy, the guides were on time, knowledgeable, accommodating and compassionate. Open to other cultures and spoke frankly and with humility about the trials and tribulations of Vietnam. We learned and saw so much, and we had the best pineapple chicken rice ever! Definite five star, must do and completely recommended.

We did the Saigon After Dark tour. Can't recommend it highly enough. Always felt safe on the back of the Vespa and the driver shared a lot of info about local landmarks. Our guide for the night was Tran and she did a great job with our group of 4. She gave us fantastic info about the local food we were eating and she joined in with us to have a laugh. Coffee shop with live music was a highlight and not something you'd otherwise come across. A couple of bars thrown in for good measure if you enjoy a drink. Wojld do again!

Oh my goodness. If you are reading this to decide whether to book or not it's a definite YES!!!!
Fantastic tour of the city. Superb food in local areas and then we were taken to a tiny bar tucked away by the Marie Curie school where you would never know it was there. Live music. Singing, piano and violin. Then to a rock bar In complete contrast.
The food was fantastic. Lovely seafood followed by pancakes eaten the local way. I can't recommend this highly enough. One of the best things I have done this holiday and we have covered a lot of the country!!
Absolutely brilliant.

We went on the morning tour and we're absolutely blown away. We saw places way of the tourist strip and visite some amazing pagodas, fish and flower market a beautiful linchpin and very knowledgable guides.

Take this tour and you will never forget the experience!....we took the night tour around central Saigon, experiencing street food local drinks and some tourist impossible places to visit
A great trip

review_title: Find out what HCMC traffic is really like
review_text: We had a great night on the Vespas with Ai as our guide and Thanh as one of our drivers. After having experienced the traffic in a taxi and as a pedestrian, we were able to see what it's really like from the point of view of the normal Saigonese. What an exhilarating and at times adrenaline-pumping experience! Ai took us to very good street restaurants to try local delicacies, and to two very different music venues. They were all places you'd be unlikely to find and navigate on your own. Ai had great skills in organising a very diverse group and making sure we all enjoyed ourselves. Highly recommended.

review_title: Don't miss out - Saigon After Dark tour is a MUST!
review_text: Worth every penny! The Vespa ride through Ho Chi Minh was exhilarating, yet I felt safe the entire ride. We saw local music and ate lots of delicious food. Our guide, Lam, explained what everything was and how to eat it. He also answered general questions about the city and the Vietnamese. We went to 4 restaurants and 2 music venues. It was really a magical tour. A word of advice...if you don't normally have 6 alcoholic drinks in 4 hours, you shouldn't guzzle down a drink at each stop unless you are looking for a hangover the next day. Oops! Nonetheless, I highly recommend the tour. It was the highlight of the city for us.

We booked this as part of our tour with Les Rives. They took us to several places around Ho Chi Minh City. The traffic is scary and we nearly crashed a few times but we didn't. You have to be brave but it's not as scary as it sounds. I actually found it quite relaxing. Went to some interesting places such as a Buddhist pagoda and the place where the monk famously burned himself. Lovely guide and good drivers. Recommended.

review_title: Getting off the track- Mekong Delta
review_text:
Wow what a trip! 08/05/16!
I was the only rider on this journey today but that never stopped them form making this journey one of the most memorable occasions I will ever experience.
You cannot come all the way to Vietnam and not get on the back of a bike and experience life the way they do.
