Through the city and then into an area that feels you so far from reality. Be submerged into the heart of Vietnam. Drink and eat what the locals enjoy. Be taken into a world one only imagines exists. There is so much history on this route it cannot be missed.

Don't pass up any opportunity to taste and drink something your eyes think "hell no"

Take a lot of sun cream, camera and go pro if you have. Don't miss this out!
Thank you to my driver and local guide you guys were amazing!

It was our first tour with a Vespa and we loved it.

We booked a private tour for my husband and I. We had a Vespa driver for each of us and a guide. They were all very friendly. The drivers were also safe riders and I felt very comfortable during the trip. We were brought to some places that we would not have ventured out on our own (example flower market, temple in Chinatown, park with the singing birds in cages). They also stopped to take some fun pictures of us on the bikes.

I recommend the morning tour as it does get very hot on the bike in the afternoon, which may make the trip less enjoyable.

review_title: This will take street food to a new level.
review_text:
This is our 3rd visit to Vietnam. I look at the traffic and am amazed there are not more accidents . When we hopped on the back of the Vespa's in HCM it was such a rush. I did not at any time feel unsafe or vulnerable . Riding through the traffic seeing local life, sights, smells and motorbikes. Then we arrive at the first on many food stops and was greeted by our food guide for the night. We started off with nibbles and drinks and off again to our next stop. Our guide was always one step ahead of us waiting at the next stop with recommendations on food and how the locals eat. What herbs and sauces compliment it best.i lost count of the places we went. Desert and coffee was pre ordered and when we got there we went into a beautiful old French house to find comfy couches and very quiet except for local singers. This was just magic. The next stop was more music to wake us up. We declined this as we had a big day and called it a night at about 10- 10.30.
This is a must do while in HCM.
We went on 2 tours and loved it. The guides and drivers were great. We thoroughly enjoyed the tours, guides knowledge, the places we visited and the history.

review_title: Fab evening...not to be missed when in Ho Chi Minh City..
review_text: We had a great evening with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. Four of us went and our drivers met us where we were staying for the ride into the city. We had a great host who met us on arrival and at each of the venues we visited during the night. You visit a bar to start off with then during the evening you move onto a couple of true vietnamese restaurants where the food was excellent, an acoustic music venue and then to round the evening off a live music bar for more drinks and dancing! It was a brilliant night, the drivers really look after you and are very safe and our guide was fun & helpful. Certainly a great way to see the city at night and have good fun along the way!
One of the best things we did in Ho chi Ming city. Would recommend to everyone. The food was great also.

Thoroughly enjoyed the night Ho Chi Minh City tour. Our guide was great, very friendly, great English. Riding on the back of a Vespa through the chaotic streets of the city was exhilarating, a bit frightening at times, but I felt comfortable and safe with the experienced and competent drivers. Food was amazing. Coffee shop with a live singer was fab as was the nightclub at the end of the night also with live entertainment. Would definitely recommend it and if I come back to HCMC I'd do the tour again for the thrill of getting around the streets on the bike with with someone who knows what there doing at the controls!

My husband and I have just done the Vespa Adventures Taste the flavours of Hoi An. We were picked up at our hotel and from there our Adventure with food started. We had the best night ever our tour guides were Van and Vinh they were fantastic. We travelled on our Vespas through parts of Hoi An and little laneways. We had typical Vietnamese Street food which was amazing and fresh. We also were driven on our Vespas over the river where we boarded a row boat and taken to another of there wonderful selection of restaurants and food. The tour guides are very knowledgeable about their heritage and food. We would absolutely say this is a must do while in Hoi An and would totally recommend for a fun night, great food and great guides. Thank you Vespa Adventures.....
My husband and I braved it on the night time vespa tour. It was expensive but had great street food, went to a fantastic bar (acoustic bar) and was back safe and sound! Well worth the money.

review_title: Best way to experience the traffic of Saigon
review_text: Such a buzz to travel through the streets without the worry of navigating on your own. Taken to fantastic local food places we would never have found ourselves. Guide and vespa riders were wonderful hosts. Great night out.

These guys are the best and most safe Vespa adventure tours in Saigon
We had a group of 23 on our tour of this beautiful, busy city full of bikes and traffic and not once did any of out group feel unsafe or fearful
The riders are all dressed in orange, so very easy to spot and all have lots of experience so making your ride exciting but also very safe
The tour takes u through the busy streets of the city and also through bustling shopping areas, local temples and along the beautiful river bank and stopping for some city views and lots of photo opportunities
Very well executed ride with lots of fun a must do in Saigon

review_title: HCMC night tour is one that you will always remember
review_text:
I have done this tour 3 times, as I keep wanting to take people on the tour. It is just that good! It is pricy, but well worth the money. It is like a progressive dinner... but the cool part, is that you go from place to place on a motor bike.

It is completely safe... You will certainly have a great time.

Highly recommended. It's not cheap but well worth the money and can't replaced the experienced that we've had. Our group leader Hanh was fantastic. We sat on the back of Vespa amongst hundreds of motorcycles around you in congested traffic with buses, cars and no road rules. It was exhilarating and nerve racking experience at the same time and we felt very safe. we stopped at so many places - places that you would never know or thought of going while on holidays. We had our 12 years old daughter with us and she absolutely loved it.

It was a Saturday evening and where we were collected in District 2 and taken by our guide on a retro Vespa to our meet up point. From the offset we knew it would fun as we were welcomed by our primary guide who provided us with beer and as the other guests arrived the drinks flowed. We experienced @5 authentic restaurants and bars where all provided lovely food but the highlight was certainly darting in and out of Saigon traffic during the evening hours. This was certainly our favorite evening in this vibrant city.

Zipping through the back streets of Hoi An on the back of a Vespa was fantastic. We visited out of the way restaurants that you never would have visited as a tourist. The food was simply delicious everywhere we stopped. An experience never to be forgotten. Our tour guide IHi (Vu, Tam, Luong, Sy, Nuygen) and team were all amazing. A must whilst in Hoi An!

This was one of the highlights of our trip. We did the night tour which started at 6pm, finishing about 11pm. The drivers picked us up from the hotel and off we went. Riding through the crazy traffic of HCM was so exhilarating (scary at first). We visited several different restaurants and tried some amazing food (drinks included too). Our last stop was at a local nightclub with live band. The place was rocking. We had so much fun, it was worth every cent and if we had more time, we would have gone again the next night. We only had 6 people in our group which was great.

review_title: A perfect way to see Saigon by night
review_text:
Thanks to our host Na we had an absolute ball on the back our Vespasian weaving our way through the thousands of locals all seeming to be making a dash for home. At first it wasn't for the faint hearted but after a beer and meeting two other couples in our tour group - Italian and American - it was an absolute hoot.
Food great as well. It might be a bit pricey, but the speakeasy was fun, the bar at the end where we saw an 8yr old Vietnams got talent finalist playing the drums alongside acoustic musicians was surreal.
Would I recommend it - hell yeh, it was fantastic, I couldn't stop smiling all night. Will be checking out vespas when I get home ;)

Needed a night away from the Fam so jumped on their night tour!
Pretty pricy and they've clearly cashed in on the lonely planet guide review, but he experience was amazing!
I wouldn't say it's exactly a foos tour- you go to 2 places when all my food tours went to like 5-8places. But you try about 6 things, then follow onto a cabaret style place and gave coffee, then onto a bar and have another drink!
We were lucky, being a Sunday night the music was super awesome but can imagine it could be a different vibe on a Monday night!
The ride is what makes this the best! After having crossed roads all over for 3 weeks, you finally become part of the road and culture that is mopeds!!! And I had the fastest driver on the road that night!!!
Great hospitality and smiles all round from the team!
Thanks so much!

Spent the evening with a fantastic group of people who were looking to experience Street food.
Great guides, always felt safe on the back of the Vespa, even after a few amber beverages.
Professional team, Thumb up!

We visited a few main sights -Reunion Palace, Post Office, Cathedral,..- as well as some off-the-beaten-track places - Chinese-quarter, flower market, pagoda & temple. These sights were lovely, and well described by Xin (I probably spelt that wrong - sorry) our guide, but not the best part. I don't ride motor bikes, I have no inclination to ride a motorbike, but the best bit was the Vespa ride. My driver Du'ong (think I got that right), gave me a proper experience of driving through the crazy, but strangely it works streets of HCM. I felt more like I'd been to Ho Chi Minh by virtue of this experience than because of anything I specifically visited. Plus the entire time I felt completely safe. Didn't want to stop & I'd do it all over again.

We booked as a family. Myself, my husband and our 8 year old daughter. At first i though OMG, what have we done. The traffic in Ho Chi Min City is ridiculous. This ride however was incredible for a whole lot of reasons. We met fabulous people, you really get to see the city up close and personal, but... the food is incredibly. We visited a number of local style eateries, tried all sorts of things and that is frogs legs included but the taste was sensational. We visited a very quirky out of the way night cafe and then a very boisterous bar, the entertainment was fantastic, i didnt want to leave. At the end of the night they took us very safely home. Cant wait to do it again. Our 8 year old absolutely loved it and yes she is a girly girl, couldnt get the smile off her face, my husband couldnt believe the food and beer. You just have to do this

We took the evening street food vespa tour on our first night in Saigon, and it was so much fun. We had extremely professional drivers who made us feel confident in riding round a city where people seem to ignore any rules of the road that there may be. A friend of mine was worried that we might not survive the experience because she had previously visited this city and experienced trying to cross the roads, but we did, and we would do it again. We travelled round the city in a small group of 6, from one street food place to another, where our guide would meet us and explain about the food which we then ate. We visited some great places and ate delicious food. All of the food and drinks were included in the tour price, as were some photographs of the experience, which were given to us before we were returned to our hotel. This is an absolute must do if you decide to visit Saigon.

review_title: Experience the real Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: This is the best way to experience Vietnamese city culture, riding around on the back of a Vespa, and being taken from one bar/restaurant to another all evening. Being a part of the frenetic Ho Chi Minh street traffic life, then eating delicious Vietnamese food and drinking local beer was such a fun experience. I highly recommend it and would definitely do this again.

What an amazing tour! Guides and drivers all so super friendly and knowledgable. Food was was great and very fresh. Any trepidations you have about riding with these guys forget them immediately. Super safe, super courteous. Booked without telling the husband who was initially very nervous and now is posting all over Facebook about what a great experience it was. Thoroughly recommend. Do it!

This adventure was part of a custom made package to Vietnam, and it was the best fun we have had for many years. We were collected from our hotel by two young but very capable Vespa riders, and after joining the rest of the group, we were taken all round Saigon at night. There were meal stops, drinks and even a couple of clubs all included in this very well organised trip.
A definite must for those seeking adventure and fun!

review_title: A Tour of Ho Chi Minh City on a vespa
review_text:
I always have friends (who come to Saigon for a quick weekend trip) ask me how the vespa tour is. I'd tell them that i cant recommend it as i have never experienced it yet. Having no experience with this tour would be me putting my friends life on the line given the fact that motorbike accidents are very common in vietnam. I think about all the worst case scenarios. Do they have travel insurance, what happens if they end up in some local hospital, etc... I didnt want to be responsible for their safety. But one day, a friend of mine was traveling alone and i promised him i'd do the vespa tour with him so that i could finally experience it and give honest and real feedback. This is what my experience taught me:

1.) when i thought that being on a vespa tour would be no different from how the locals drive on their motorbikes... I was right. The way you see motorbikes go about their day is how some (not all) vespa drivers drive. Some would go on the side walk instead of the road. This would be a cause for concern based on safety of the passenger and those on the sidewalk.

2.) i'd like for them to improve on the day tour as i found that some stops werent interesting or we could have done without. But then again maybe others would be interested in it... My group though wasnt as interested once we got to the herbal medicine shop. I guess it couldve been cause of the heat, and the many hop on hop offs we had to do, and our general lack of interest in herbal medicines.

3.) their head tour guide should have a portable head piece with speaker so that the whole group can hear the explanation. Sometimes we have to stop on a busy street so you cant really hear what the guide is saying.

4.) the vespa tour staff is VERY FRIENDLY. I enjoyed their company.

5.) you get to meet other fellow travels and make new friends.

Now the question is... Would i recommend vespa tour to my friends?

I still do not feel comfortable being responsible for the safety of my friends that inquire about this. I cannot recommend it 100% but i can advise them of the possible scenarios they'll be getting themselves into and that it is up to them to decide. If they are thrill seekers, then i cant stop them. It might be the only way for them to experience being on a motorbike- the vietnamese way but a tad bit safer than hiring a random xe om.

Vespa Tour group is a good company with friendly staff. Its just that vietnam is the way it is and road
ettiquette isnt really practiced in this country. Especially taxi drivers and motorbikers. So its really ride at your own risk.

Maybe it would be less stressful if their service was used in a more peaceful and laid back town. I will still have to experience it one day outside of Ho Chi Minh City.

*do note that this review is only for Ho Chi Minh tour. Vespa Tour has other cities that they operate in. Ypu may check it out on their website. The ones in other provinces seems to be of a better experience than in the busy streets of HCM.

This company allows you to ride yourself or with one of their drivers if you don't have a motorcycle license. They take you deep into the Mekong Delta on the back roads. You really get to see a different side of Vietnam!

This tour was a suggestion of our tour guide and he was spot on.

Seeing Saigon at night on the back of a classic Vespa was a brilliant experience, together with sampling local restaurants and getting to chat with our guide was excellent.

Our guide was amazing. She kept us entertained, as well as quite informative with her explanation of what we were eating and experiencing. We tried three local restaurants, as well as a coffee club (with singers performing) and last stop a bar to watch a local band perform.

Would highly recommend this tour if you want to see Saigon at night.

Incredible ride!! The best way to know the city and to be part of it. Every stop is special. Food is great! I absolutely loved every single thing we tried! Special thanks to my driver Hung! If you want a good ride with a lot of tips and nice recommendations ask for red vintage vespa and Hung ! Our guide Chin also the best! Next time i will do it again!

My wife, daughter and me had great night with Vespa Adventures! The best way to experience the city...the buildings, the crazy traffic, a couple of local restaurant stops, some music clubs...and a fun team running the show.
One of the highlights of our holiday!!

review_title: Half day tour of Hoi An
review_text: Wow what a cool way to spend the day!! 4 adults and 4 children aged 10 to 14.we loved our tour. Or tour guide was Phi Onion he was exceptional. Full of local knowledge, humour and charm. Really interactive and great with the kids and adults. Our drivers were Nine, Hieu, luyt, Nhan, Long, New, Lam. They were really considerate and friendly and very careful drivers. We went to family ancestors place, rice cracker place, boat building place, rice harvesting farm, mat weaving place, rickety bamboo bridge ( my son's highlight of vietnam!!) coffee bean roastery and Cafe for a yummy drink of coffee. Seafood restaurant and swim at the beach. Really enjoyed every minute and totally recommend!!!

review_title: Great way to see the city!
review_text: I took the city sights tour, directly after coming back from the Cu Chi Tunnels. Even though I was tired it still went really well. Our guide spoke OK english, and some of the sights weren't that interesting. Seen one Pagoda, seen em all... My rider was awesome. His riding skills were superb & he dropped me back right to my hotel door. Good stuff.

I had never driven on a motorbike before and so I was a little apprehensive and nervous but I m glad I went on this tour.
This is an experience of once in a lifetime for me . Getting in the middle of Ho Chi Minh traffic at peak time is not something to be missed. My heart was pumping but I enjoyed it very much.
We stopped at several eating places to experience the local cuisine and we ended up at a night club called Vunga.
Here they play rock and roll loud music so we only stopped very briefly.
Great evening

Booked a private hidden HCMC tour, and it was a very interesting way to discover the city indeed. It was a lot of fun to get stuck in the crazy traffic and slalom through hundreds of other scooters (ask your guide for a mask as the fumes can get overwhelming at time). Our drivers were quick and nippy, including some thrilling manoeuvres through tiny alleyways. The tour covered interesting spots like the flower market, and even took us to the other side of the Saigon river for a view of the city from District 2.

review_title: Fantastic fun adventure with lovely people
review_text: We took the evening Saigon food tour and it was wonderful. Great to tour the streets of Saigon with a confident driver and be taken to local food and music venues. The drivers and our guide were all friendly and fun and wanted to make our evenings the best it could be - it was!

Memorably good. A brilliant thing to do in Saigon. Good safe rider, enthusiastic and amusing guide. Skimming through the streets at dusk, stopping to eat, visit bars, cafés - just right. You aren't taken anywhere too crowded or touristy so you will eat well and plenty of people will come and talk to you. Do it!

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip!!! Don't miss this.....
review_text: On a referral from the states, we booked a tour for 23 in the evening. The evening is great because of all of the crowds of Vespas and the additional food and drink that the tour provides. You have a helmet and a driver. The thrill of moving with the traffic is unbeaten! There were stops for food and stops for entertainment. We ended up at a live band bar, singing and drinking with locals! Too cool!

Did the night tour with my children ~ experienced Saigon night life as a local ~ exciting, thrilling & amazing ride thru the different streets , neighbourhoods & crazy chaotic traffic of Saigon ~ with lots of food , drinks and fun ~ first time ever on a Scooter ~ brilliant time we had ~ recommend it !

Being new to Saigon we thought we would go on a Vespa tour. I'm glad we did. All the drivers spoke some English and our tour guide spoke good English. The meal provided was nice and we were shown lots of landmarks and given history on Saigon. Loved riding on the bikes in amongst the mayhem.

This was the best part of my Vietnam trip. I was amazed by the skill of my vespa driver and I felt very safe. The food was excellent where we stopped. I loved, loved, loved this trip. I am 67 years old and my first time on a motorcycle. The absolutely only danger I was in was laughing myself to death. Do it, Do it! your in for the ride of your life.

Highly enjoyable evening filled with as much food and drink you could want. Beautiful candlelit location with intimate music. Great bar at the end of the tour with super atmosphere. Excellent night out, would definitely recommend.

Myself and my fiancé were on our honeymoon and had no idea what this entailed as our trip organiser had sorted it out for us as an activity to do! If you are here for a short stay in Saigon this is a must! It is the only way to see the city at night and is an amazing experience if you are a foodie - stopping at many great local destinations with top tips from your guide. The tour was personal and the service was outstanding. Our local guide was exceptional, and I would recommend anyone to give it a go and ask for Trúc! We dos this as a couple - I would happily go back and do it with friends.

The 3 drivers we had were very friendly and courteous. We were taken first of all for a drink at a local cafe where me met our guide Truc. We were then taken to 4 other local establishments where we tried various local dishes with Truc showing us how they are eaten. It was a fabulous evening and even brought a smile to our 15 year old son. This was by far his favourite activity whilst in Ho Chi Minh. Thanks to the drivers and Truc for being able to inform us about Vietnamese culture and was a good laugh throughout the evening. Would definitely recommend it to a family travelling with teenagers.

What an amazing night out!
Chin was an amazing guide, showing us all how to eat the food. Not all to our taste but very pleasant.
Bin and Thong were our vespa drivers and they were curteous and friendly. Their driving skills were brilliant and we felt very comfortable and safe.
It was so exciting riding around in the mayhem of Saigon.
Would defo do it again.
Thank you.
Really nice tour and amazing staff (!!!) but vespas reallyyyy need service. More than 2 broke during a 1 day tour. Including mine. Didn't got any money back.

review_title: Saigon city tour at night on Vespas
review_text: This was one of the most fun things we did in Saigon. We were picked up at our hotel by the Vespa drivers and driven around the city to the Zoom Cafe. This was a private tour for four people. We met our guide who explained the evening. We rode to two different restaurants having dinner at local cafes. The food was excellent. For someone who didn't like seafood, they gladly substituted beef. We continued on to a local coffee house for musical entertainment and coffee or tea. We finished off the evening listening to more music and a return to our hotel about 11 p.m. You always felt safe while riding on the Vespas, even with the Saigon traffic. It was a great and different way to spend an evening in Saigon. I strongly recommend it.

Myself and my wife did the "foodie" evening trip and it was FANTASTIC!!!!! Collected from our hotel by Vespra and taken to the meeting point, met up with the other 4 people on our tour and given a drink from the bar staff. Then off we went with our tour guide Lora and what a great time we had. Firstly a seafood sampler menu at a resturant then 20 minute ride to another that serves different kinds of saviour pancakes, then on he bikes again to a secret coffee shop with live music. Then finally to a bar for a couple of drinks before being driven back to our hotel.. Fantastic Night!!!!!! Thanks Lora
The best way to see the city. In amongst the mad traffic, stopping of at different places to eat, listen to music, eat ice cream. Just brilliant.

After a disappointing trip to Vungers (hotel). that is a high light to our trip, very very staff made you feel very welcomed, our guide and vespers drivers excellent. Abit nervous at first, whoo hooooooooooo, food brilliant,service excellent. All I can say a must thing to do.

There are over 6 million motor bike in Ho Chi Minh City. The traffic looks frightening but it isn't - it is quite safe. So why not be part of the traffic and take this excursion. You will not be disappointed. The food and the sites you visit are incredible. I believe this is a must do excursion when in Ho Chi Minh. You will feel the energy, the vitality of this wonderful city. It is such a pity that the locals do not speak much English.

We did the 'Saigon After Dark' tour. It was booked as part of a package by our travel agent, so the only thing we knew was it was a tour of this city on a Vespa taking in some street food and night life. Based on this we weren't really sure what to expect, but it was so much more than anything we had imagined. This was a brilliant way to spend the evening and the time flew by.

They started off picking us up at our hotel on Vespas and taking us to the starting point at the Zoom cafe, where there were several others doing the tour. Here you get a snack and a drink whilst your guide for the evening outlines the plan. There is an individual guide for every small group, who meets you at each stop and chats to you and tells you about everything you are doing.

We were then taken to our first stop for some street food. This consisted of several dishes, crab legs, clams, mussels, noodles and deep fried frog legs. The guide explained what it all was, the various sauces and how they eat each item. The food was all very tasty and good quality.

The next stop was a restaurant, where you get some more food, including several different styles of pancakes/spring rolls.

From there we went on to a quiet cafe with live classical-style music by a violinist, cellist and pianist, at the Piano Café, before being taken off to our final stop at Yoko Bar where there was more live music, this time bluesy/funk/lounge versions of various well known music.

At every stop there are unlimited drinks included, cocktails, beer, soft drinks, tea, etc.

The Vespa rides between venues take you around scenic parts of the city.

The whole night was a brilliant experience. The only criticism I would have is that it sometimes felt a little rushed at each venue due to the amount they fitted in.

Tip: make sure you are hungry, there is loads of food!

review_title: Terrific way to see the city.
review_text: We had the evening Vespa Tour which included pick up form the hotel, drive ot a local bar where we met our fellow Vespa passengers over a drink, off to a restaurant serving delicious food, off to another where we had Vietnamese pancakes. Then to a bar where a guitarist and violinist accompanied a singer - very atmospheric. Finally a Viet Rock bar where we were deafened. A fantastic experience and great fun. The drivers were superb and so was Lora the guide. 2 wheels is definitely the way to view the city.

Very well organised and driven. Our teenagers loved it. You are on main, busy roads but it felt very safe.

Multiple food stops and vast quantities of food, don't eat beforehand!

review_title: The best ride of my life
review_text: This trip on the back of a Vespa at night in Ho Chi Minh City was a definite highlight of our holiday in Vietnam. We went from being terrified to being thrilled by riding through the streets of the city among the millions of other bikes. The food tour was great and they catered for non meat eaters. The end of the evening in a music club was brilliant. We could not recommend this tour highly enough and we are over 65 years old.

This is seriously the best way to see the town
Make sure you wear a mask to breath but it's safe and fun
The take you on the back of a Vespa as a group all over town.
Really cool

Ok, so a fairly pricey trip taking Vietnamese costs into consideration, but if you've got to cash, I'd definitely recommend booking! All food, drinks, bars, transportation, guides included for the night, you get to see parts on Saigon that you would otherwise miss including secret bars and tasty restaurants filled with locals. The guides can't do enough for you (even providing you with drinks to take with you in between each step of your journey between bars if you want!)
You meet at a central point, then split off into smaller groups of 5-6 people and stick with that group for the night, moving from bar to restaurant to bar.
We even have souvenir photos for free to take home from the trip! A brilliant night, and an excellent end to our holiday in Vietnam.

review_title: Make sure you book this tour when visiting Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: This tour was definitely a highlight of our holiday to Vietnam. What an amazing experience to be travelling around the city just like a local. Always felt totally safe on the Vespas & the drivers were amazing. Our guide who met us at each stop was fantastic. So much food & I ate things I never thought I would try & even liked them. Drinks are included which was great. Also stopped at a singing lounge to listen to amazing singers & last stop was a night club for more music & dancing. Cannot fault this tour & can thoroughly recommend it.

Fortunate enough to be in Saigon during Lunar New Year, so the trip around the city on a Vespa was very exciting as the streets were packed with traffic. Both the driver and food guide were friendly and professional.

My husband and I were a bit hesitant at first as we had seen what the roads were like in Saigon, but that quickly went away when we got out there on the road. People of all ages can do this and the drivers were amazing and don't go too fast, quite safe - although I kept urging ny driver to go faster! All the stops were great, and good food. The good thing is there is so much food to try that its ok if you don't like something because you will still be full! We did many tours travelling around Vietnam and this was by far one of the best for, and you meet some really nice fellow travellers as well. The last place was the jazz bar with live music which was busy but really good. If we didn't have to wake up early the next morning to leave Saigon we probably wouldn't stayed longer. Highly recommend to all!

All I can say is so much fun, the tour staff were amazing form the Vespas to the food and drink. went to 3 restaurants and 2 music venues. My wife has not experienced riding on a scooter before and loved every minute of it and always felt safe

This adventure is great for all ages

My son, who is in his 30"s and I, in my 60"s signed up for the Saigon After Dark Vespa Adventure. Our drivers picked us at our hotel, on their Vespas and weaved in and out of the Ho Chi Minh traffic expertly. We arrived at a bar--the meeting place for the other travelers in our group. We then proceeded to a few other restaurants, a lounge and a bar. Our food was excellent and riding from place to place was so much fun! Definitely a highlight of our vacation.

Four adults and three teenagers went on the Vespa tour tonight and cannot rave about it enough! We all agreed it was the highlight of an amazing two weeks in Vietnam and we have done some great tours. No need to worry about safety - the drivers are professionals. The food was amazing, all drinks included, even souvenir photos - great value. Went to awesome out of the way places we would never have seen otherwise. Exhilarating, fun, unique - would recommend it to anyone of any age.

We went on this night your because it was recommended by our friends and it was aboloutly fantastic. The restaurants and bars were all great the scooter drivers were safe and our guide khoi was the best. Would recommend this as a must when visiting saigon.

review_title: The best way to see Saigon
review_text: We visited the city for two nights as part of a wider tour of the country. The Vespa tour was the best thing we did all holiday. My wife was a bit apprehensive about how safe the trip would be for our 12 year old boy. But we gave it a go anyway and were not disappointed. We were collected at our hotel at 6pm then taken to a range of local cafes and restaurants, nine courses in all. This included two live music venues towards the end, one a darkened jazz lounge off the beaten track (excellent) another playing more modern tunes. Drinks and food along the way, lots of lovely local dishes all superbly cooked. The drivers are great and will go at whatever speed you want, though you end up going quicker as you gradually get a taste for it! It's definitely not one for the very faint hearted, and while there were a few slightly edgy moments there was nothing to really worry about. The traffic can be a culture shock for westerners, while it looks chaotic there is an unwritten code of conduct and you never see anyone getting annoyed (compared say to taxis v cyclists in London). This was without doubt the highlight of our holiday and I would come back to HCM just for this. If you like bustling Asian cities, great food, live music and a bit of a thrill, you will love it.

What a great experience! The Biker are very sophisticated and the tour guide very good in his explanations. The stops have been very interesting. We felt all e safe in that terrific trafic of HCMC. It is a must for everyone who visits Saigon.!

Saïgon is not Rome, but it feels the same on the Vespa Adventures scooters !
Everyone feels young and adventurous on those machines.
Drivers are very good, considering the hectic traffic of Saïgon.

Highly recommended by a friend, I chose the last night of my Saigon adventure to have one of the highlights of my stay. I was very nervous as the traffic in Saigon is horrendous at the best of time but with Tet approaching, everyone was out and about to see the city lights at night. I need not have worried. The tour guide and my driver were both excellent and I had a ball. I didn't feel unsafe at any time, the food was fabulous as we went from venue to venue to sample real Vietnamese food with the locals, and even ended up at a coffee lounge and a night club, which I really enjoyed. I would highly recommend this for any age. We even had 2 people in their seventies on the trip. And they had never been on a motor bike before. What a fabulous night. Thanks so much.

We were 3 couples visiting Vietnam for the first time - all in our 50's. We had pre booked the Vespa night time adventure as part of our holiday. We were all a little apprehensive before the trip but what a great time we had. The trip was very well organised and the staff and Vespa drivers were top notch and very experienced. We always felt safe and the drivers very professional ensuring all the group stayed together. Being in the Saigon traffic really is something to experience (if you know Vietnam - you will know what I mean). We were taken to a number of bars and street venue locations finishing at a bar with live music before being returned safely to our hotel approx 10.30pm. we all agreed it was our best holiday excursion and was really glad we did it. If you get the chance - Go for it!!
Great fun. We would thoroughly recommend this experience. The guide was very entertaining, the scooters were great fun with excellent drivers and the street food delicious.
Exciting and breathtaking tour really enjoyed it the drivers and the hostesses were friendly and caring

Did both the evening tour of the city and then the mekong the next day. Evening tour was great, we were with 4 other people. So so so much food, and as much as you can drink. Great way to see the city early on.
Mekong is a longer day tour, and you visit 6 or 7 different places, all really interesting. Again, plenty of food along the way. Good to get out of the city and see some real life.
Really worth booking both tours, but if you're only here for a short time I would go with the evening tour.

review_title: It was a great way of seeing the city at night
review_text: Enjoyed it thoroughly and specially the different t stops.Interesting visits to the clubs bars and eating houses. All our friends in the group consider this as 1 of the highlight of our trip.The Vespa drivers were very courteous.

I took a group of 27 on the Vespa tour & my client said' best ever tour he had taken'! All my group, including me, had the best time ever - I wouldn't hesitate to recommend. The bike riders were very professional in their approach which helped put my groups mind at ease from the start.

I cannot rate this experience highly enough. Yes the traffic is insane in Ho Chi Minh but at no time did the 4 of us in my party feel at risk. Our drivers and guide were superb. The numerous stops throughout the tour, ensured we were able to soak up the Culture and atmosphere of night time HCMC to its fullest.
Brilliant !!!

review_title: The Bedt Way to Experience a City
review_text: My partner and I joined Vietnam Vespa Tours in HMC. It was by far one of the best experiences we, well seasoned travelers, have had in becoming familiar with a new city. We chose to join the night tour. We were well catered for in food and beverages and it was one of the most fun nights we've had travelling.

We had this food tour during our honeymoon in Hong Chi Minh City and it was excellent. Friendly staff, excellent fun and great food. Safety was always in thier mind, and they tailored the food for us personally.
Highlight of our holiday. Nice organised places for dinner. Fantastic! Well organised! Nice people!!

Great experience riding through Saigon going to all of the districts and experiencing fantastic food.
Highlight was a pop into a jazz club for dessert.
Well worth experiencing however if memory serves me correct it was quite expensive.

Possibly not for travellers on a tight budget, in saying that I would advise anyone considering it to DEFINATELY spend the money.
Wanted to spend longer at places. Great drivers and amazing experience flying though the streets of Saigon on a Vespa!

The tour was super-fun and I would recommend it to anyone whl has decided to have a good time. My parents and I all had enough to eat (some of the food was an adventure!) and a few drinks. No-one in our tour group seemed unfriendly, everyone was great, especially the driver.

I couldn't think of a better way to soak up the culture and atmosphere of Saigon. The traffic in the city is insane... so 'if you can't beat them - join them' is definitely the motto here. The food was delicious, the drivers (thanks, Dong) were brilliant and the guides (ask for Lo An!) were incredible!
Highlight of the trip!

It is one of the best ways to "feel" Saigon in full sense. Night is time when city moves into another energy and it has special vibe. Vespa tour is great way to start your Saigon experience. Stuff is super friendly and helpful, great ride and very good food. Maybe too much food for such a short tour but...hey its Saigon you should do all you can! And its a bit too just a bit high price...but hey its you vacation, just do it!
Thanks for a ride!

review_title: Highlight of our time in Vietnam
review_text: Four of us, two retired couples of around 70 yrs, went on a Vespa Adventure. We were excitingly yet safely driven off into the Saigon evening traffic, seeing many of the usual sights on our way to around 6 stops at roadside cafes where the food and local ambience were outstanding, and accompanied by wine or beer at every stop. At the end we went to an atmospheric night club with a sultry singer for coffee and brandy, followed by a loud nightclub with a very good live rock band. What an end to a super evening. Brilliant! Highly recommended!

review_title: Unexpected High Point of Hanoi Visit
review_text: Loads of fun. Wouldn't want to tackle Hanoi traffic by myself but there is a real energy to the city which I doubt you would tap into any other way. Congenial guides, excellent and interesting food, stuff you probably wouldn't have access to otherwise. Our expectations were vastly exceeded. Would recommend it for adults and teens.

If you go to Vietnam and miss this you are missing a true adventure with great guides and people! The sites were spectacular; the local food was great. Too many times travelers get a prepackaged vaction this is unique and exceptional!

A great experience with good guides , reliable Scooters , great scenery and cold beer.
To do this as a rider is probably not a good idea unless you have reasonable riding experience in your own country.
My friend did it pillion on a guide and had a great time

Such a great way to see a city (in my case Saigon) guides were super helpful and knowledgable, food was a real treat. So fun to see places that I normally wouldn't have gone to. Felt very safe on the bikes. Overall wonderful experience that I highly reccomend.

review_title: Fantastic apart from the food poisoning.
review_text: My friend and I went on the food night tour and had an amazing night. It was so much fun, the food was tasty (though fairly standard fare) the drinks were flowing and we had a great group. However a few hours after getting to our hotel we both got ill and having an early flight the next day let's just say it was a very unpleasant trip. Once at our next destination we couldn't leave the room all day. I'm not blaming the company for this, Asia is always a bit tricky and anything could have happened to make this occur. However, when I contacted them the next day and let them know we were sick all I got was sorry, have 30% off your next tour. Now I'm not in the industry but I would have thought the offer of a refund should have been made. We lost a whole day of our holiday after all. I won't be taking them up on their offer of another tour.

We had some reservations regarding this trip when we first booked it. But it was one of the most amazing evenings we had in Vietnam! It was well organised and you felt really safe (as traffic is manic in Saigon)! We were picked up from the hotel and taken to a bar where we met other travellers. This was nice too as they sat you in small groups where people spoke the same language. We had a group of 6. Drinks were plentiful and included in the trip. There were 5 stops in total. The 2nd stop was a local seafood restaurant. You were given lots of different sea foods to try. Our guide showed you how the local Vietnamese people ate them. And more drinks! Then it was off again to a pancake house where they used local products to make the biggest savoury pancakes ever. By the time the trip was over you were absolutely stuffed with food and drinks. At the end of the night you are given a framed photograph and an email link to access other photographs. This is a really nice touch as you have memories to keep. Absolutely brilliant trip!

Had a terrific time and saw alot of the countryside. Our tour guide Vinh contributed in no small way to our enjoyment he had extensive knowledge and spoke excellent English. He was very inclusive with all on the trip. The Vespa drivers instilled confidence and also added to the overall experience. Would recommend and if you were fortunate enough to have Vinh as guide consider yourself lucky

review_title: An OK trip but not for the money.
review_text:
Everything went well, really. But it costs too much!
And also the advertising is not quite accurate: the tour starts later, and it ends much sooner than advertised. Then, for that amount of cash (2 million) I would expect that all you can drink (a few thousands per drink) would mean exactly that.

review_title: Best way to get the feel of HCMC
review_text: This was an excellent way to travel HCMC. We travelled in areas of the city tourists would rarely head to, in district 3 and 4. The food was great and the feeling of being part of the crazy city buzz was even better. Vespas as such an iconic part of HCMC's life, it is great to have this first-hand experience. Everyone from the guide to the drivers was extremely helpful and friendly.

Great way to see the city like a local. Driving through the traffic is crazy and exhilarating! You eat at a bunch of places and listen to music at two places, with lots of locals. So fun!! Do it first thing when you get to Saigon.

We participated in the night food tour and had a fantastic time. Even though my husband wasn't feeling great because of some earlier food issues - he and I thoroughly enjoyed every element of the night. It was such a unique blend of stops and events. Highly recommend as a must do if ever in Ho Chi Minh City.
We really got a feel for the food and the city. The guide was wonderful and everyone had a great time. Would recommend the adventure!

review_title: Best Way to be Introduced to Ho-Chi-Minh-City Nightlife
review_text: You get your Vespa driver and your personal coach to start your adventure: like a fish in a swarm you are driven through the nightly traffic, having a first stop at a popular bar for a drink, at another place you get wonderful seafood, it continues with more street food and ends at two places to enjoy some music - the first place rather intimate with vietnamese songs, the second a typical hard rock bar. It was simply wonderful.

Very smoothly operated, picked up from the hotel, and all the restaurants had places for us to sit. Too much food! But very good, especially the seafood restaurant. Unlimited drinks. Quite scary sometimes and sometimes you cant see the kids anymore, but they all know where to go. Great singing bar at the end!

review_title: Exciting Vespa tour of Saigon at night
review_text:
This is not to be missed. Excellent fun, meet at the buzzing zoom cafe for an evening really in the heart of the city, on a Vespa in the thick of the traffic frenzy , a real insight and feeling completely safe.
Through all the city sights and delicious foodie stops, plus 2 night clubs were a treat. The first a romantic cafe , followers by a club that got you dancing and was full of local Vietnamese on a night out.
Really good fun evening..and a few drinks thrown in too!

The Vespa trip was a great experience. Loved it from the minute we started until the end.
People were very nice and really took care of our safety too. An adventure you should not miss.

A great tour to experience Saigon in a different way - much closer to the action in the midst of the incredible traffic - while always feeling safe and secure. A wonderful selection of Vietnamese food which we may otherwise never have tested - like frog, which is really good. Great, lively and knowledgable guides and two wonderful clubs which we enjoyed.
Very well done and highly recommended.

We really loved this evening tour. Zipping through the traffic on the back of old Vespa scooters was great fun and gave a different perspective on the city and the traffic. We felt perfectly safe as we weaved through traffic. The first stop was a bar for drinks, then to a seafood restaurant where we sampled a number of tasty dishes. Then on to a back street restaurant serving Vietnamese pancakes, different and delicious.
We we're then taken to a cafe which was behind a small warehouse and up back stairs. A lovely place with great atmosphere and good live music, not a place you would stumble across. Then to a rock and roll music bar with more live music and beer.
Finally back to the hotel. Wonderful night out even for oldies like us.

review_title: Fun foodie tour in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Great fun and fantastic food tour by Vespa. Felt very safe and in good hands. Enjoyed the sightseeing by night. The 2 night clubs visited were good too.

review_title: muss man gemacht haben - extremly must have
review_text: best adventure we had in Vietnam. Organisation perfect, not cheep, you get a view in some places you would never found yourselve alone.

This was the best thing we have done with the kids !! Tu, our guide gave us real insight into Saigon and it was exciting riding around on the back of the Vespa through the mad traffic.
Thanks guys, we are now booking a tour for Hoi An !

Perhaps due to the high standards left by my food tour in Hanoi (where we walked the local street eats and tasted many delicious Vietnamese morsels), I was left wanting more from this experience. Not only did it cost almost triple other food tours (US$120 - which doesn't sound astronomical but relative to the prices of tours and amazing food over there is a lot), the places they took us was more an experience for party people and the selling point was unlimited booze. I wanted so badly to love the experience and see things from a locals point of view, however the 3 places they took us consisted of a seafood restaurant (all other customers were other groups from the same tour company), a alleyway Vietnamese pancake restaurant (this was probably the highlight experience within the tour however the food was Hugely westernised) and then a bar with extremely loud music which I would have loved if I was with friends back home. I think the expectation of how it was marketed (cultural experience and best of Ho Chi Minh city) is what lead to my disappointment.

If you aren't looking for a cultural experience, but a fun night out this is for you. Riding around in a Vespa to your 3 destinations is pretty cool, however the places they take you are for the party crowd (keep in mind: I'm 23 love a good party but I wanted a more genuine experience).
A thoroughly enjoyable tour , great fun and the staff and drivers were helpful and charming. The food was good although there was an awful lot of it.
The best night we had in Ho Chi Minh city.Great food,huge fun,lovely guide!We learnt a lot about the city!!

For the last night of our holiday we were booked in with Vespa Adventures.
It was fabulous.
Picked up from our hotel and taken on the back of a Vespa through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City.
Taken to local restaurants and ate local food. Explanation given about what and how to eat with good amount of liquid intake.
Tried some rare food - you go on the tour to find out what!!!
Went to two different music venues and taken back to the hotel at the end.
Met some great co-passengers and felt extremely safe throughout. Safety seems a byword for this group of Vespa lovers.
Do it, enjoy it, have fun. Age is no barrier from old to new!!!! All you need is life in you.

review_title: Not 100% as advertised, but a super duper great time.
review_text:
My friend and I signed up for the Wild-Life Mekong adventure. True to their word, we were picked up on Vespas from hotel in Saigon. I didn't realize that there would not be a support van on this adventure and had no where to stow my luggage. Luckily we pack light and were able to stow the luggage at the company warehouse. I would highly suggest finding an alternative to your luggage and only bring a backpack. For the Wild-Life Mekong trip, you will be on a Vespa the entire time and might need to hold your own bag.

The first day was super fun! The ride out of the city was exhilarating. We first stopped at a coffee house — where we never saw another tourist for the rest of our trip. Lots of stops along the way to way to lunch, where our guide was super informative and offered a lot of information at each location.

Lunch was fantastic! Easily the best part of the whole trip. The stilted restaurant was super fun. We drove right up in it, and was truly an unforgettable experience. The food was exceptional.

The hotel we stayed in that night was nice, a lot of local people and again, no tourists. The tour says we eat dinner with a local family in their home, but we instead ate at a smaller restaurant near the hotel. The food was delicious, but I would have liked to eat with the family (or even the drivers and the guide!)

Day two started out great. Breakfast of Pho was the best I'd had in all of Vietnam. The trip to the wildlife park was full of adventure. The ride on the ferry was an experience I'll never forget! Unfortunately, it was not bird breeding season so we missed them. We also did not get a trip on the traditional Vietnamese canoe to see the fruit bats. Not sure if they were migrating too or not. Feeing the crocodiles and avoiding the monkeys proved to be a super great time!

Our trip back to Saigon was a bit uneventful, but we had a long distance to cover. The last stop at a road side sugarcane juicer was very appreciated.

Overall I had a terrific time! I wish the communication was a bit better: what to bring/what not to bring and what exactly we'd be able to see based on availability. I would recommend a trip with Vespa Tours as our guide and my driver were wonderful people and I really enjoyed meeting and learning from them. If I had more time in Saigon I would look forward to sharing another tour with them.

review_title: Great way to see the city!
review_text:
Having been in Ho Chi Minh for only a couple of hours we embarked on an evening Vespa tour which highlighted some street food delights and local entertainment!

My wife and I jumped on the back of a couple of Vespa scooters and from 6pm until 10.30 were taken around the city by two experienced local riders during which time we stopped at s number of street food outlets and enjoyed some amazing local culinary delights. We opted for fish and seafood which incl prawn, clam and mussels ...all amazing!

Having mastered crossing the road in both Hanoi and Saigon this was nothing compared to the experience of manoeuvring around the city on the back of a scooter ...crazy but what a great experience and somehow we felt safe throughout and would definitely recommend this. Note there are a few of these tours but can only speak for 'vietnamesevespaadventutes.com' who were first class plus you have a local guide that meets you at each stop!'

review_title: Brilliant, so much fun. Do it!!!
review_text:
Wow, am I glad I found this on tripadvisor. What an amazing day out, doing the Mekong delta tour.
My girlfriend and I went with another friend for the day, and what an experience. You see sights that other tourists just won't see.
Traffic in Saigon is crazy, but I felt completely safe - never once doubting the ability of our drivers. Our guide, Na was great - fun, knowledgeable, entertaining and informative. You get out of the city, travelling down dirt tracks and paths, and grinning ridiculously at it all. Good lunch to wrap it all up.
Be prepared to be very weary at the end of it, be prepared to be covered in dust, and (at least for the men) be prepared for your backside to be a little sore if you are unused to riding pillion.
If you book more than one tour with them you will get 10% off both of them. We are doing one of the Siem Reap tours later next week - watch this space for a review!
Thanks so much, Na and the team, you were all brilliant!

This was an amazing experience which we've recommended to everyone who would listen. Great fun and the food was wonderful. We felt safe. Ending up at the rock and roll place was perfect. The part we liked the least was the other music venue, but it's a window into that culture, so worth it - but don't stay long.

We were picked up at our hotel by our drivers and were issued with safety helmets.
We were taken to meet the rest of our group. We were 5 in total.
After our introductory trip we went on the vespas around Ho Chi Min and into District 4 to try different food dishes at various cafes on the streets. Our guide explained what each dish was and how to eat it. Absolutely delicious!!
We were then taken to have coffee at a place where we were entertained by a man playing a violin, a pianist and a singer. Excellent and so talented. This was very soothing.
The evening ended by us going to listen to a live band at a small pub. They were outstanding...would have loved to stay there for longer!!
The evening was first class. The drivers were safe, fun, very caring and professional in their work. The guide was very informative.
It gives you an insight into what the food is like in Saigon and the thrill of riding around on the back of a vespa in Saigon. Bonkers but thrilling and safe!! Go for it...you wont regret it.
Finally we were given a free photo..nice gesture. Thankyou.

What a fantastic tour this was. I loved every minute of it. I did the Mekong Delta tour; an early start but worth it.

1. Booking

This was really easy and straightforward from their website. I just booked online and paid using my credit card. Very easy indeed.

2. Organisation

A very well run tour. Na was our tour guide and she was superb. Very knowledgable and engaging and she did a super job showing us around. My scooter driver turned up at my hotel exactly at 8:00am as organised and we all met up for the first time at the cafe (which was our departure point) before setting off. Every part of the tour was professional and all of us were impressed by the amount of stuff we did and what we got to see.

3. The Tour

It's hard to summarise what we did in such a small space, but if you want to see bits of the more rural locality around Ho Chi Minh City it's a great way to do so. There were regular stops on the way so we could see local markets, experience life in the delta, taste amazing food (which is part of the tour price too!) tour a local temple and see what Vietnam is truly like outside the city. We saw everything form shrimp farming to rice wine brewing (and tasting!) and also got to make some incense. At every step we were in the capable hands of our tour guide, Na who explained it all and answered our questions. If you're a photographer there are some great photographic opportunities too. The tour ends with a tasty lunch just outside the city before heading back where you are dropped off at your pick-up point.

At no point did we feel rushed and were given ample time to look around and explore.

4. The Ride

Riding the Vespa is great fun and totally safe. The scooter drivers were professional and friendly and certainly knew what they were doing in the busy traffic. I felt safe and well looked after the whole way around. However it is bumpy, as one would expect. If you have back problems maybe this isn't the trip for you but only you can really decide that. There was one guy whose back actually felt better afterwards so maybe it's not so bad. I was totally fine with the bumps and I didn't even have a sore bum afterwards! As an engineer by trade I was curious about the classic scooters. They were in good condition and were obviously well looked after and maintained. Really nice little rides!

6. Verdict

Go for it. You won't regret it and you'll certainly make some new friends. It's lots of fun and something you'll talk about for years to come. It was the highlight of my trip to Ho Chi Minh and I would definitely do it again. What are you waiting for?

This tour was fantastic and one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. It should not be missed! The scooter tour was exhilarating, the food stops were all great, the music venues were such fun and our driver/guide was excellent. A brilliant trip. I was initially nervous on the scooter but the guide was a careful, calm driver. We're so pleased we did this trip. Good for all adults and we're 60+.

Felt a bit nervous initially but soon relaxed and enjoyed every minute. The tour is well organised and I felt totally safe with my skilful driver. We met our guide at the first stop and then visited various street cafes to sample Vietnamese cuisine. Our tour ended at the secret cafe bar where we watched a number of acts

It was an amazing experience and I felt like a local riding through the busy streets of Saigon, I’m so pleased I did it.

review_title: Awesome way to see Saigon at night
review_text:
This tour is a must-do in Saigon. Picked up promptly at our hotel, my wife and I met our drivers/tour guides and the Vespa that we would ride. We even got to sit as drivers...to take a picture.
The tour consists of visiting various food places in the city. You get to sample/drink numerous Vietnamese dishes which were all wonderful.
We visited places all about the city. You would never get to many of them on your own and especially not walking.
The entire tour was well done with knowledgeable and fluent in English guides.
Would do it again

review_title: Evening on the back of a Vespa in Saigon
review_text:
A slightly daunting prospect when one looks at the traffic conditions - but, as we had hoped, the evening proved to be a most enjoyable experience and definitely one of the highlights of our trip.
Being in the thick of the sea of scooters, mopeds and other road users was great fun - and the evening was much enhanced by the leader of our group who introduced us to some interesting nightspots and to food which we probably would not otherwise have tried.
Definitely not to be missed!

Rightly so, there's not many more positive words and stars I can add that others haven't already.

We went on the evening tour in Saigon and it was one of the best things we have ever done. Riding through such an amazing city at night with a cup of beer in my hand and the love of my life on another bike nearby, going from one food joint to the next had me smiling from ear to ear and laughing all night. It was exhilarating, and such a rush!

Our guide was brilliant, as were the drivers, the food was incredible and the city was beautiful. If you like all these things and throw in the added thrill of riding pillion on a Vespa through a swarm of cars and a million other scooters then you HAVE to do this!

When you first get to VN you wonder how anyone can move through that traffic safely!
The scooter trip showed you how
Great fun & the food was a bonus
Wouldn't have missed it

review_title: Excellent way to see the countryside either as rider or pillion
review_text:
I drove a vespa and my partner rode pillion, we both enjoyed it immensely. The staff are super friendly. They have an office at a cafe which is a great place to meet up and discuss the various trips.

We were collected at our hotel and driven (as pillions) to the cafe office from where we started the tour.

We were able to experience the atmsohere and feel of genuine Vietnamese countryside and the memories have stuck with us.

Truly a fantastic experience

The reason I gave a 4 instead of a five is because the Vespa's are maintained to be in tip top condition, they are safe but its more a reactive type of maintenance than something that is planned to keep them in the best condition

I wouldn't recommend riding unless you have experience with crazy traffic and misbehaving motorcycles, mine for instance only had a reliable 1st and 4th gear with it jumping out of 2 and 3 at the worst possible moments. However, you get used to the quirks and after an hour or so you tend to forget and just enjoy the experience.

For me the best parts were riding over narrow river bridges and getting in and off the ferries.

Can't recommend it enough
I've been on the tour 3 times with friends and family visiting HCMC. Always fun and always the same reaction from our visitors - awesome, great fun, great experience.

This is a must for those looking to get inside information on the philosophy behind Vietnamese food. The added bonus is the night time scooter experience full of flour and sound. Great guides and skilful scooter riders.

This was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam!
We loved it and it was very well organised.

So much fun. Whirled wind tour of the night city driven by very competent vespa drivers. Great food and drinks along the way. I always felt safe as we laughted and drank and ate exploring nighttime Saigon. Ypu will laugh put loud!! Do it!

review_title: Vespa tour in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Outstanding experience! We had almost decided not to do it when one of our friends who had done it encouraged us to do it. Great stops. Very skillful driver. And friendly. Out host was terrific. Never felt scared on the Vespa.

review_title: Fabulous way to experience the city's energy at night
review_text: This was one of the most memorable experiences of our SE Asia tour. Two couples, in our active 60s & 70s, had an exhilarating time riding on the back of 4 Vespas to experience the crazy scooter traffic of HCMC after dark. The tour criss-crossed the city taking us from one restaurant to another for small plate tastes of Vietnam's delectable cuisine. In spite of, or perhaps because of, the free-flowing nature of scooter traffic that only rarely heeds the traffic rules we Westerners are used to, we were able to experience the busy streets first hand without ever feeling at risk – far safer than renting scooters on our own. We were comfortable enough to take plenty of photos and videos to relay the experience to friends and family back home. HIghly recommended!

review_title: Vespa tour of Ho Chi Min City
review_text:
Very well organised. Guide was enthusiastic and got the small group talking very early on.
Interesting to visit a number of restaurants and bars during the tour. Looking at the roads in the city we were expecting to feel a bit nervous and vulnerable riding on the back of a scooter, but far from it we felt very safe and in good hands.
Can recommend it
The Vespa foodie tour was a lot of fun with very good drivers and an excellent guide. We would recommend it to everyone.

review_title: Highlight of our Ho Chi Minh stay
review_text: Thoroughly enjoyed the Saigon after dark tour. Met some awesome people and our guide and my Vespa driver were fantastic! Very friendly staff. Amazing experience and would do it again anytime!
Do not miss, the ultimate city tour plus restaurants plus shows.DO NOT eat before the tour, great food experience as well.

starts with a talk in a local bar, then through the streets on the vespas, stops at all sorts of street cafes, and explains all the different dishes that you would normally not try, ends up in a night club ,al i can say about that it is more funny than interesting, as a westerner,young lady called loan (pronounced lo an ) was our guide and she was fantastic
Truly amazing fully recommend the night trip we had the private tour which was one of our highlights of this wonderful country

We absolutely loved our Saigon After Dark Vespa Ride. It was a highlight of our trip traveling through the streets of Saigon like the locals! We would have never visited the authentic restaurants and clubs on our own! Extremely organized and we'll run too!
What a fun way of exploring HCM City by night. Such a variety of sights, sounds and smells! The bars and restaurants were all good but we really enjoyed the two very different music bars.
What a great way to see the sights and sounds of the city after dark. Also sampled a wide variety of Vietnamese style cooking at 4 different restaurants. Well worth it.

review_title: Vespa tour of Saigon by night
review_text: An exciting experience of Saigon - An great opportunity to taste the street food and feel the buzz of the city by night - just as local inhabitants might. Exciting!

Having not been on an Organised tour before, we were all sceptical of what was in store. All members of our family had a fantastic time, smiling all though the adventure. Off the back of it, we have booked into the night time eating tour.

review_title: Fun ride in a buzzing city
review_text:
Fun and exciting opportunity to be part of the thousands on their bikes.
Taken care of by extremely competent personnel.

This was fantastic. The kids will tell you it was the highlight of our trip. Felt safe at all times. The foods/ pop up restaurants we went to was a great experience. Finishing off at the ice cream place was perfect.

review_title: Perfect way to end our incredible trip!
review_text: We booked this with 2 of our friends for the last night of our holiday and it certainly did not disappoint! We met some incredible people, saw some amazing places and ate the most wonderful food. I will be booking again if we ever go back to Vietnam - thank you for ending our trip on such a high 😀

The Vespa Tour was great. We were picked up at our residence and stopped 15 minutes later for a first drink. We drove through the busy streets of Saigon at night, the night was warm, the streets were lighted colorful and the drivers were friendly. We made different stops at various restaurants/bars, for the starter, the main course, the second main course and dessert. After dinner we drove to a private "concert" with vietnamese music and the last stop we made in an vietnamese disco.
It was an adventures evening were we learned a lot about local food, music and traditions.
Very well organised great food skilled drivers would definitely do it again. The best night of hols!

Amazing from start to finish, a must if you want something different and very Vietnamese as you ride with the locals. The secret cafe bar was fantastic with great singers, would have liked more time there. Food was all good, drink as much as you like too.

This was a highlight in Vietnam. The tour took us to some local haunts and was so much fun weaving in and out of the traffic. We ate and drank so much. The drivers were fun and knew how to maneuver like pros :-)

review_title: Seriously overrated if you want true food tour
review_text:
Our tour company booked the After Dark tour for us, singing its praises. Same with the reviews on trip advisor. But after our excursion last night, my husband and I both left baffled at the five star ratings. Basically, you get driven around Saigon in a troop of about 40 mopeds. While they divide you into groups of six or so at the start, by the end you are arriving en masse at supposedly authentic Vietnamese nightlife. Seriously? What is authentic about a little cafe packed with 75% tourists from one group night after night?
We did enjoy the food at the two stops at the beginning but the final two just felt silly and fabricated.
The tour guides were professional and kind and spoke excellent English and riding through Saigon in a motorbike is an unforgettable experience but there must be a better way...

review_title: Hoi An Country Side Explorer - Great day!
review_text: We took the half day countryside explorer with Van on Sunday March 20. Van was a great tour guide and both our drivers were excellent. We saw a side of Vietnam we hadn't seen before. Great tour - couldn't have asked for more. Thanks, Sarah and Leigh.

We did the Saigon night tour which includes VN food with the locals, a coffee house and finished off at a night club with food and drinks included. It was the best night and the experience of riding in the Saigon traffic was superb. Hai our guide was fantastic. A real insight into Vietnam.

review_title: The only way to experience Ho Chi Min City
review_text: Booked this on iphone whilst in Viet Nam. Picked up by two riders at 550pm straight into rush hour traffic on the back of vespas. What an experience. Went to Zoom cafe and then on the food tour, Lovely food. The music places were so different but both were amazing experiences. My wifes vespa pilot was a young girl on her first customer ever. She was brilliant. Could not fault anything. I even ate frog legs.

Great way to experience HCMC especially on a very tight schedule. We were picked up from the hotel on time, and each of us had a designated Vespa driver. We also had an interesting guide, Lora, who provided interesting information about the Vietnamese food philosophy. The food was good but not great; however you get to feel like part of this vibrant city.

Booked a full day including a river cruise to Cu Chi Tunnels followed by a Vespa four of hidden places around the city. My nervous parents smiled from start to finish. My dad said it ws one of his top ten favorite experiences. And made memories imprinted for a life time. Being on the Vespa also gives you more courage as a pedestrian crossing the road!

review_title: A must-visit in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Saigon has 10 million inhabitants and 7 million motorbikes. It’s amazing to watch! But when I got to ride on the back of a motorbike, I felt like I was part of the vibrancy of the city, not just watching from the sidelines. I could have just ridden around on the back of the bike the entire evening. We were picked up at our hotel, each of us had a motorbike driver (all very nice), and the group of 6 had a tour guide that followed us around the town and explained everything to us. We got to experience local food, local music, and a night club. The tour was one of the more expensive tours we booked, but the joy of seeing the city from a bike was totally worth the expense. The reason I gave 4 stars is because we had better food tours for less money, but they weren’t on a motor bike. I absolutely recommend this tour, but also recommend that you do other food tours if you are a “foodie”.

review_title: Amazing half day Saigon city tour
review_text: this was the highlight of our short stay in Saigon; we took a private tour for the 2 of us, it was professionally run and great fun, providing a brilliant intro to the city and seeing things that we would never have found by ourselves. we loved it.
A great way to experience the city. We were able to eat in places that we would have never have found on our own.

review_title: An Absolute Must If You Are In Hoi An!!
review_text:
I really can't put into words just how fantastic this tour is!

Having arrived in Hoi An in the early evening - we rang Vespa Adventures who jumped into action straight away and within 30 mins we were met at our hotel by Phi and his driver Quoc to begin our Evening Street Food Adventure!

Phi is an absolute hoot! A real cheeky chappy with excellent English and hospitality! His knowledge of Hoi An and street food is incomparable which was perfect for my foodie Boyf and I!

We were taken to approx 5 destinations, not only on the back of the Vespa but also incorporating a trip on a boat down the river - buying lanterns and making wishes! I was particularly touched that Phi seeks to utilise the older members of the boating community as to support them and takes you to places well off the beaten track that you would never have known existed! You really do eat like a local!

We ate at a popular street side place; ate and attempted to make white rose; had venison in lot leaf; baby clams and amazing beef boiled at the table in a delicious soup!

Each part was documented on Phi's camera and the high quality pics were sent to us via email! We had such an informative; entertaining time and felt completely safe throughout!

This really was a highlight of our whole Vietnam trip! If you do take part; ask for Phi! Nothing is too much trouble and he seems to enjoy plying you with beers!!!

Well done Vespa Adventures and Phi - a real gem!

We had the morning tour for 6.5 hours
It was the best ride
Excellent tour guide Na
Very well spoken and full of knowledge
Well done Na
Lots of food /drinks along the way
Very safe and very well run
Took us to some very interesting places
Drivers were all excellent and felt very safe
Highly recommended

We did the evening night stall tour where we are at four or five food stalls and then went to a bar. The food was fantastic!!! The Vespa rides were so much fun (we didn't want the Vespa ride to end) and we learned a lot about the Vietnamese culture. Also the tour groups are broken down into small groups of 8-10 people so you actually get an opportunity to meet and get to know the people in your tour group. The tour guide spoke excellent English and really showed us a great time in Saigon! We really recommend booking this tour!

Not only was the food great and more then plentiful , it was the best way to see the city! Lori our "handler" took really good care of us and our drivers added to the spice. Our trip has been great so far but this was a real highlight.
Wish we would have done it also in other cities

review_title: Amazing the ride of your life a true mystery tour....
review_text: Night tour with food this tour on vespa bikes is amazing you see and eat things you wouldn't try normally , the drivers are great the guide .We had loann who was amazing explaining how to eat like the Vietnamese making everyone feel at ease so much food we couldn't eat it all..high praise where it's due sleek super trip , I feel I don't want to give too much away as its a mystery tour ...fab

review_title: speed the route away on a vintage Vespa!
review_text: We were staying at the Reverie Hotel Saigon and the Gen Mgr suggested that we take the Vespa Adventure Tour and it was to us, the best way to view the countryside with those small roads not manageable by car and the fastest to get through the busy streets. The company is well run, very secure and the guide and driver took us to places that are not on regular guide books. We even met the woman who started her pancake business on a pushcart and now owns 2 bldgs where she lives and a full blown pancake restaurant. It was a lot of fun and I highly recommend it.

We were a party of 4 (aged between 60-70) and whilst a couple of us were a little anxious about this trip having seen the total chaos on the roads and the complete lack of an apparent system, this was actually one of the highlights of our tour.

We were met at our hotel which was the first surprise as this was located some 20 minutes out of Saigon. The journey in meant we negotiated the equivalent of the A316 and the M3 at rush hour weaving in and out of the traffic. We had envisioned being collected by taxi to get into the centre of town and then a sedate trip on the Vespas around a few quite back streets - how wrong can you be!

Our drivers were fantastic, seriously street savvy and well versed in negotiating the chaos of Saigon . The food stops all offered excellent food of the highest quality with the guide fully explaining what food was on offer and how to eat it.
