(each stop was about a 10-15 ride away from the last so we were hopping on and off our Vespas all night) We ended our evening in two amazing bars offering diverse but fantastic live music. The evening started and ended with cocktails of your choice and as many as you could fit in in the time! We did not get back until at least 10.30 p.m. by which time we were totally relaxed and enjoyed the ride home, probably helped by the last couple of cocktails. It is a really fun evening out and one not to be missed.

Two middle aged women visiting from New Zealand. What to do with them? I decided that the Vespa guys were worth a go. They loved it. They had white knuckles from holding on so tightly but you couldn't get the silly grin off their faces all day. Lots of interesting places were visited - Cho Lon, a memorial, the flower market, a Chinese medicine place etc. Highly recommended.
Went into the interior parts of Vietnam. Visited a farm, a vine-making household, and a temple of worship..all within the rural parts of HCMC.

What an experience my wife and I included this in our itinerary before leaving the UK. We were greeted by our drivers who collected us promptly at 6pm from our hotel and we were taken to a bar in District 1 where we met Lau-Anne our guide for the evening who was EXCEPTIONAL. She detailed the plan for the evening and we Set off for the first stop - a seafood restaurant in district 4. Food was superb we had crab claws - clams - mussels and jumping chicken. Next stop Vietnamese pancake restaurant which was again superb and the white table wine wasn't bad either! Feeling suitably well fed and watered we headed to a coffee "speak easy" type of bar. Live singing and music which was very pleasant & the red Vietnamese wine was drinkable too which was a bonus! Back on the Vespa and off to out last spot a bar with a rock band playing, the band were surprisingly excellent and everyone in the bar was enjoying them a lot. At about 10.30pm after an excellent insight to the life of the Saigon people our Vespa drivers took us back to our hotel - slightly more relaxed on the Vespa at this point (think the wine/beer and vodka helped!) overall an excellent experience would highly recommend to anyone.

The drivers are so polite and friendly and safe. We had so much fun and saw so much more of the city on the backs of their bikes. Food was also excellent - authentic local street food - it was superb! This was our second trip with this group and we enjoyed it even more the second time. Highly recommend you book a trip

review_title: Highlight of Saigon....and perhaps the whole trip!
review_text:
This was definitely one of the highlights for my husband and I in Vietnam. You watch the scooters go by every day and it was just amazing to be part of that crazy traffic.

In a group of 6 we had a great guide and very good drivers. Weaving in and out of the crazy Saigon traffic to some great eateries and bars.

Fantastic street food - don't bother with lunch - you are getting an 8 course dinner! Every dish explained and shown how to eat by the guide.
One old style cafe and finishing at a club with local love music playing some great cover tracks.
It was just awesome from start to finish.

Three nights in HCMC was the final part of our 17 day Vietnam trip. We everything loved about Vietnam but this was by far the most fun I've had for a long time. I've not been on the back of a motorbike since my teens and was a little apprehensive. However the drivers were excellent. We did the night tour which started during the busy traffic period at 6 pm which added to the fun. My driver had great English and was really personable but my husband's driver was less able. We had so much food during the various stops that I'm thankful I hadn't eaten since a late breakfast. We visited a small intimate music bar which seemed to be for young romantic couples. A guitarist and violin player backed several solo singers who sang without amplification and spoke in Vietnamese. It was interesting and pleasant but not to my musical taste. It was though a nice contrast to the noise and bustle of the traffic and street food scene. We ended up at a rock music venue with a group doing western cover material. They were really not bad and we would have liked to stay a little later but had to be up for an early trip the next day so left to be dropped back at the hotel about 10.30 pm. I would recommend this to anyone traveling to HCMC it really gets you in the mood of the mad traffic scene there and is an exhilarating way to see the city. I am in my late 50s and had no problems coping. You would want to wear shorts or trousers though as getting on an off is a little bit of a challenge to accomplish with aplomb especially if you are short and not so trim.

While in HMC we took the evening vespa tour. Having never been on a scooter before I was somewhat apprehensive. I needn't have worried and would recommend this tour to anyone visiting HMC. It was a fun, informative and entertaining evening. We visited local street food outlets with a great guide who was there to meet us at every venue, experienced Vietnamese night life and enjoyed music with the locals. The evening lasts about 4 hours. The drivers were all young but experienced riders and made us feel perfectly safe. Do it!

Recommended over breakfast by a fellow Australian. Must say this evening from 6pm was everything we were told. Can't believe we tried this, but both so happy we did. No feeling of fear, just elation and smiles all through the experiences of inbelievable traffic (how calm the drivers are - no road rage here) and the various stops for food and entertainment. Can't speak too highly of our guide and lovely drivers. DO IT!

This night was our best night in HCMC!! They picked you up from your hotel and already the adventures begin as you get on the back of a Vespa. You start at their office with a free drink of choice and small snack. Once the whole group arrives the real exciting mayhem begins. You weave in & out of the crazy traffic and past different places of interest. The first stop is a traditional Vietnamese traditional street eatery where you will feast on many interesting and traditional foods. (Don't worry they will cater to any dietary requirements- I didn't eat seafood)! Then off you go again to another Vietnamese restaurant; very delicious. With all you can drink (or courage as I liked to call it) offered all night, there was fun had all round. The next place was very delightful change, a very quiet and quaint Japanese inspired cafe with the an acoustic band and some stunning solo singers. The last place and most fun was a nightclub. Great music and more drinks!! Then you're driving back to your hotel on the back of your Vespa. My partner and I had such a blast!!

I'm still trying to wipe the grin off my face! Negotiating HCMC on the back of a Vespa at night sampling the street food and ending up a night club. What more can one say but an experience never to be forgotten - for all the right reasons. Wow!!

Booked at the last minute but no problem. 4 of us on the tour. Our guide Chin was fantastic - very knowledgeable and great English spoken. Our drivers K and Hua were very safe and navigated us safely thru some of the 7 million motorbikes that whizzed round HCMC.

We saw some great markets, the post office, temples and pagodas and we ended up at their cafe for a delicious lunch.

It's not cheap but it's worth every penny. Had a brilliant time.

Don't hesitate - book it now!

This is a really fantastic trip - great food, great venues and best of all the excitement of sitting on the Vespa whizzing thro the traffic in Saigon. The driver's courage and blind faith that somehow a space would open up in front of us each time he accelerated thro a junction with other scooters ad motorbikes traveling with and against us, converging from the left and the right and then suddenly we were free until the next junction. Red lights, one way streets, pavements were all disregarded in the chase for space. At the end of each trip we had a new and unique venue, first a pub with snacks, next a restaurant serving shell fish and frogs' legs (a white delicate chicken like meat) - fantastic - our guide skillfully describes each course. Next a feast of rice flower pancakes in a grotty looking venue down a narrow street away on the other side of town from the riverside fish restaurant. But what great food! Then a complete change of mood - coffee in a most elegant room, entertained by the most fantastic singers (mostly Jazz and 60s classics). The room was hidden down another narrow street, accessed via a dark concrete stairs in the back of a motorbike garage. The singers, accompanied by a fiddle and piano performed on a small stage, no amplification required in that small elegant room, decorated with moody black and white photos. Suddenly we were off again, speeding down back streets to a booming bar called Woodstock, more beer while we stamped along the Springsteen hits. Finally, back to the hotel on a last exhilerating dash thro the streets on the Vespa. Fantastic. A "must do" in Saigon

Two Vespa's picked us up from our hotel and we rode into town to meet 3 other couples. Had a drink whilst the trip was explained. We stopped off at three local food places, then went to a bar for a drink and listened to great local singers. Then back on the Vespa to visit a night club with two great local bands, before being driven back on the Vespa to our hotel. It is a must do.

review_title: Great fun and must do in Saigon!
review_text: We have made the trup Glimpse of Mekong Delta at the back of an old Vespa. The tour is great fun and we can really recommend it! The driver takes you through the hectic trafic of Saigon to the Mekong Delta. On the Vespa you reach places and villages where tourist buses don't come. The tour is realy very nice as you are part of the scooter families of Vietnam. Lunch was also very nice.
The night tour was amazing! Awesome food, so much fun riding around, and our guide Laura was perfect. It felt like an old friend showing us around town. Highly recommend this!

review_title: "Street food" and drinks with a designated driver
review_text: For over 4 hours, we ate and drank on the crazy streets of Saigon, out for "Street food" and drinks with a designated driver. We started out with drinks to get acquainted. Next stop, seafood: mussels, clams, shrimp, frog legs, excellent. The Vietnamese pancakes were fun. I really enjoyed the coffee bar with a professional violinist and pianist and great vocalists.. Finished up at a bar with a live cover band. Our guide, Loan, did a fantastic job of keeping the group safe and together. My driver took good care of me and was cautious with his 60+ passenger who had never been on a bike in traffic before. Very very fun. Truly a different side of Saigon that I loved.

what's the best way of getting around and seeing as much of Saigon in the few hours we had Without getting lost...we came across Vespa Scooters. The crew picked us up from the hotel and took us to their restaurant for lunch included in the package before the tour. Lunch was great. Our tour guide was well spoken and very knowledgable with a great sense of humour which made the trip that much more fun. If you've seen the amount of scooters and cars around in Saigon, one might feel a bit nervous but the short distance to the restaurant made me feel quite at eased. We toured for almost 3.5 hours and saw many parts including areas where only locals go. This was well worth doing and would recommend it to anyone who enjoys a different kind of adventure instead of group tours on the bus. Thanks for a fun and memorable experience.

This was one of the highlights of our visit to Ho Chi Minh! The scooter drivers were amazing , merging and weaving through the busy traffic and between crossing pedestrians with no difficulty. The ride felt very safe and the scooters were so stable we could take photos and video easily . It was quite exhilarating to be part of the chaos surrounded by thousands of other scooters and experiencing how the Vietnamese travel around the city!

me an my friends did the tunnels and afternoon vespa tour in October last year it was the highlight of our holiday, please don't just think about doing it DO IT, very professional and interesting from start to finish lovely guide and Very good drivers I cant push this tour enough, I,m going to Hanoi this year and am going to do another tour, Very well done your vespa tours are amazing well done, Pete, Mick, Dave an Paul we will be back

After a couple of days in Ho Chi Minh city we were ready to experience the city properly, along with the other 8 million scooters.
64 scooters were out on the night tour the evening we went but you were split into small groups (ours was 6) and you stayed with your guide and the group. Go with a sense of adventure and an empty stomach! I never felt unsafe on the scooter are literally weaving in the craziest traffic on earth.
Ok, you go to pre-arranged food stops so it's not 'street' food in the true sense but they were places we'd never have visited otherwise. The groups all go at different times - first stop after pre-drinks was seafood, the best mussels ever, frogs legs, clams in sweet & sour soup. Second stop was freshly cooked pancakes where we learned how to eat them with rice paper & accompaniments.
After the food we went to a coffee/singing bar. This wasn't really for us, but again, we'd not have ventured into an upstairs back alley bar if we hadn't been on the tour.
For us, the tour ended on a high in a live acoustic music bar, a couple of cocktails & if we didn't have to leave w'd have been there until the wee small hours....

I chose the Saigon After Dark/ foodie night out on the town. I was a white-knuckled bundle of nerves at first but soon realized how competent these drivers are to navigate the whirlpool of Saigon's traffic. I always feel safe (to my amazement) and enjoy sightseeing from this unique point of view. The food was fine...I think I would like to have stayed a bit longer at the restaurants and skipped some of the music, which would have given us a little more time for talk.
Our guide kept track of everyone and all the details....a good thing considering the chaos all around us. It was a good night out, though not cheap by any means, baring in mind the insurance, safety gear and hotel pick up and delivery (district 2), an ok price. I certainly had a lot of fun.

review_title: The best thing you can do in Saigon
review_text:
If, like I was, you're apprehensive about trying this, just get it booked and you won't regret it.

We did the night tour of Ho Chi Minh, which included a pickup from our hotel by Vespa and five stops around the city with free flow booze all the way round. Our guide, Son, was fantastic and spoke passionately about Vietnam and the food we tried along the way (of which there is a lot). There's a lot of seafood involved which was great but if you're not into that then your guide can make other arrangements.

Our drivers were also brilliant and we felt safe all the time. A great way to get amongst the chaos and see Saigon.

This was a fantastic experience!!! After three weeks in Vietnam and Cambodia we were in awe of the scooter drivers and the skill with which they navigated their way through the narrow streets without hitting other scooters, cars, buses or pedestriansj! We were a little apprehensive before the tour but the friendly drivers immediately put us at ease and it was great fun!!! We went in the afternoon with quite a big group and were taken through a market and along some fascinating streets that we would not have seen otherwise. We stopped at a couple of interesting venues and our guide was very informative. Please do this tour if you can.....it was a highlight of our holiday!!!

The Vespa tour is not to be missed. You get picked up from the hotel and join the rest of the Vespa tour adventurers at a bar. Then you are off! weaving in and out of the traffic with the locals. We visited restaurants and bars that we would have never found. The guides were lovely and the experience is to be recommended. One of the highlights of our 2 week tour of Vietnam.

Booked online before visiting, very easy site to use. The Vespa was parked up ready and waiting 5 minutes before picking up with friendly riders. Did the morning and night tour both excellent. A great way to see the city on the back of a classic Vespa. Felt completely safe riding through the traffic, we were looked after from the moment of pick up until we were dropped back to hotel. Both trips I would highly recommend better than walking the streets!

I am not one for putting a whole lot of stock in to reviews as it seems difficult to weed out the crabby from the happy sometimes. All that said... You gotta do this, I traveled a month around the Philippines and Vietnam and hands down this was an experience not to be missed!!!!.
This company is fantastic, on time, English speaking if you like, excellent drivers, and believe me you will not see traffic like that anywhere!, I was taken down main streets back roads and into tiny dark alleys to find dark candle lit night clubs and ending with a live band rock n roll club with all food and drinks included!!!!!!
Go with an empty stomach and you will still explode! I will do it again tomorrow!

There's not much more to say... All the other reviews have done a wonderful job describing this fun and exhilarating experience. Towards the very end of our three weeks in SE Asia, after marveling at the sea of ​​motor bikes and cars in every city of Vietnam from the inner sanctum of our travel vans, we found ourselves a part of the vast sea of ​​traffic, and what a ride it was. Great fun, both riding on the back of our Vespas, and exploring some of the culinary aspects of Saigon that we'd never have done on our own. Don't think twice about this- tons of fun!!

having experienced Saigon traffic from a pedestrian perspective I couldn't believe we were about to tackle it from the other side. It was an eye opening couple of hours, we appreciated the skill and care of our drivers and the general courtesy they showed each other on the road. At no time did we feel unsafe.
This is by far the best tour in Ho Chi Minh. The drivers are great the guide was very good and you get to go to places you otherwise wouldn't see.

We had a blast...must try in saigon. We got to try local food and see places in saigon that are not touristy...you need to bring something to cover your hair as the helmet they are providing kinda stink.

My wife and I were lucky enough to be the only ones on our "Glimpse of the Mekong" tour. The Vespa's were really great fun and scooting around the crazy traffic of HCMC was so much fun! Our guide (Nan - I think, my memory for names is terrible!) was great company, offering plenty of information not only about the Mekong way of life but also loads of recommendations for our upcoming visit to Hoi An; which all turned out to be excellent advice. Picked up from the hotel and dropped off at a place of our choosing at the end of the tour with a brilliant lunch and street food snacks in the middle. Lots of fun, and highly recommend. Thanks! James & Katie

review_title: What a thrill! Great ride, great experience
review_text: We loved our evening Vespa adventure, not only for the thrill of threading through Saigon's ceaseless traffic and illuminated streets behind an experienced driver, but also for the tasty food from two different venues patronized by lots of local Vietnamese. Crabs, clams, mussels and frog-legs in one place, and a huge sort of crepe stuffed with veges and pork and served with fresh greens at another, on the other side of the river. Then coffee or tea in a little student-style coffee house with local Vietnamese singers. Very interesting. As senior citizens, we stopped with this, instead of going on and finishing the evening in a noisy disco. This was definitely one of the main highlights of our trip. We highly recommend it.

We got picked up from our hotel. We were shown exactly how to get on and off the bike. We were provided with a helmet. We stopped off at typical Vietnamese eating places, shown how to prepare the food before eating and which dips went with what food. After eating we were taken to a coffee shop (not as we know them) where we were given a drink then listened to music. The next stop was at a night club, it was packed. At the end of the evening we were taken back to our hotel. Will be doing this tour again 😃

review_title: A fantastic experience, the highlight of our trip!
review_text:
We took this tour (the Saigon After Dark Tour) because of the very positive reviews and it turned out to be even better than we expected. Be prepared for a whole evening treat for all your senses. The wind in your face as you motor around Saigon on the back of a Vespa, sitting on a loudly puttering engine with hundreds of motorcycles, cars, even buses passing by you just inches away. The beautiful buildings all lit up at night. The food, freshly cooked, some quite exotic, all very delicious. The singer performing by candlelight as you sip Vietnamese sweet coffee in a dim upstairs room of an old house. The band at the end, capping the night with drinks and high energy before the last ride back to the hotel.

Words can't capture just how fantastic the experience is. You must do this when you visit Ho Chi Minh, and you won't regret it. The staff are very friendly, courteous and communicate well. And while the idea of riding around among swarms of motorcycles may see scary, at no time did we feel unsafe in the slightest.

review_title: I did this trip with my husband, friend and parents.
review_text: This really was a great way to experience Ho Chi Minh. For a typical Saigon experience, you need to get on a bike and having a driver gives piece of mind in the crazy traffic. The food tasting was interesting! The sights were great, the dancing at the end too rounded a really entertaining night. Highly recommended. Also did it as part of a hen do.

review_title: One of the most exciting experiences of my life!
review_text:
We took a night food tour and it was fantastic!
I was a bit apprehensive when our travel agent suggested this tour because I heard how crazy the traffic in Saigon was. But boy, was I happy we took this tour!
We were fitted with helmets, seated on vespas behind young Vietnamese drivers, and sent off into the streets of this crazy city. We became a small organism in the living body of roaring motorbikes. We were ones of the smaller organisms, consisting of two elements each. Many bikes comprised 3 or 4, and one had 5 live beings: two adults and three children, including one sleeping toddler. We were flying in a cloud of exhaust fumes and black smoke, zigzagging between pedestrians, buses, and other bikes, and that was terrifying and exhilarating at the same time!
Our first stop was in a coffee shop where I had a mug of ice-cold Vietnamese beer. Now, that my blood was laced with alcohol and adrenalin was rushing through my body, the fear was gone and the second leg of the ride became pure fun.
The second stop was at a seafood restaurant, a local joint on a street lined with seafood eateries. We joined the locals on plastic chairs and sampled the most incredible seafood dishes I ever had!
The third leg took us through a crowded narrow street to another local joint where we sampled the famous stuffed pancakes cooked by several women on an open fire in 15 tin pans.
The next stop was a retro night club where we sat on low couches and sipped drinks while listening to a throaty cabaret singer crooning Vietnamese songs accompanied by piano and violin.
The last stop was in a crowded rock-n-roll club.
This tour was the highlight of our 2-week trip to Vietnam.
Be sure to go, but it would be a good idea to wear a face mask - the exhaust fumes were really bad.

review_title: Experience of a lifetime! Love an adventure, then this is the trip for you!
review_text: This will surprise and delight you! Worth every dong! We did both the day tour of the city, which was an experience not to be missed. Yes, I could share everything you would see but then you may be disappointed because you would know what is coming next! There were sights you wouldn't ordinarily see. Riding on the back of a Vespa with the wind blowing on your face, capturing many special people moments, how the real Vietnamese live is a privilege! Then to see Saigon after Dark, this is a tour not to be missed! Best foodie night out where you get an insight into the local culture. You visit places you would never find by yourself. There was plenty to eat, in fact, so much we couldn't eat it all, and I'm a great eater complimented by a few drinks plus a couple more. Overall, this is a wow! " I've never had so much fun in my life...it was a real thrill!"

A great way to see and experience Ho Chi Minh city. Many years since we rode motorcycles but great driving overcame our concerns. Given the manic traffic in the city that is a huge skill. The various eating places we were taken to added to our knowledge of the people and their ways. A great guide magically turned up ate each stop and made us feel at home in unusual environments. Food was excellent - if a little overwhelming by the fourth stop! A truly memorable evening.

review_title: Most exciting way to see the city we could imagine
review_text: When you visit Ho Chi Minh City you will initially be surprised at the plethora of scooters in the city. What seems like total chaos on the streets is really less so than it seems. How to experience this yourself without taking your life in your hands? Take a Vespa Tour! We took the night tour which included five stops at various restaurants and bars. The ride on the back of the a Vespa with your personal driver was exciting and gave the feel of being part of the city's nightlife. The bars we stopped at were exciting, served good food and potent drinks. The good news we weren't driving.

We had a fabulous time on our Vietnam Vespa Adventure this evening. An amazing way to tour Ho Chi Minh City in the evening and truly experience this vibrant city. This is a definite "MUST DO" when in Ho Chi Minh City!!!

review_title: What a way to experience Saigon City!!
review_text: As you travel through Vietnam you see motorbikes/scooters everywhere, it's the main method of travel or so it seems. Then you hit Saigon and, so we were told, a population of 9 million with 7 million bikes! My wife has never been on the back of a bike, yet she booked the Vespa Adventure (Night time food tour), over 4 hours through Saigon, at night! What a fabulous experience! never did we feel unsafe, the guy's and girl's operating the bikes put our safety as No 1 and our enjoyment as No 2 and what a great job they did! Definetly one of the highlights of our visit to Vietnam, and I have no hesitation in recommending Vespa Adventures!!

review_title: Only way to see Ho Chi Minh City.
review_text: It's too hot during the day to wander aimlessly in the city so we booked the Vietnam Vespa Adventures – HCMC night tour. We found this company well organised. We booked through their website which was really easy and they contacted us to follow up immediately. The drivers collected us from our hotel (one person on the back of each bike) and brought us to the central meeting point to meet the rest of our group. We had a group of 6 people, which was a comfortable number. The food provided in each of the venues is typical Vietnamese, which is really the point of a food tour. The tour covers 2 restaurants (both serves local Vietnamese food). Very tasty. We were offered beer and soft drinks or wine in each of the restaurants. Then we were brought to a funky speakeasy-style cafe and music show and finally we finished the tour with a drink in a bar. The whole thing took 4.5 hours and was totally worth the money. I really loved the part of the tour where we were being driven around on the back of the bike between venues. Crossing the road is one of the must-dos in Vietnam because of the absolutely astounding lack of rules relating to traffic. Being part of the crazy traffic and seeing how it works was amazing. The drivers are all highly experienced for this type of activity so I felt completely at ease. This was the highlight of our trip to HCMC.

We did the night time food tour, and the whole thing was pretty "meh", especially considering the high price!

The tour started at our hotel where two riders who spoke very basic English took us to the meeting point (Vespa cafe) to meet our group and our guide, who spoke great English.

There was no safety talk at all! I asked our guide if he had any tips as I had never ridden a scooter before and I was nervous, and he replied "just relax"...this wasn't the most helpful advice. Luckily, I was able to relax as riding around on the back of a scooter quickly gets pretty boring! If you live in a big city, they all look pretty alike and i didn't get any kind of adrenaline rush from riding around on the back of a scooter. We seemed to go around in big circles a lot, I think to make the rides longer.

The food tour was ok - we went to two restaurants after the first bar. In the first one we had seafood, and they very kindly provided three veggie dishes as I don't eat meat or fish. The food was good and the guide was knowledgable about it - he didn't provide much info about the city or the different districts though. The second restaurant did very big pancakes filled with pork & veg - they did a tofu veggie option which I liked a lot. There were also some kind of pork spring roll type things, and summer rolls (including a veggie option).

We then went to a really boring bar, which really killed the mood! You have to be silent when in the bar as there are some really serious local singers there - they sing about three songs each before changing over. They are accompanied by a guy on a piano and a guy on a fiddle. They appear to sing songs in Vietnamese, French and English. No conversation is allowed at all - you have to order before you get there. The guide said we could have an ice cream or a drink (we were not allowed to have both - I wish we could have had both as we chose ice cream and then had to suffer through the boring music without a beer!). The singers were ok but this was really not my type of thing at all - I'm not sure exactly who it's aimed at, but I don't think it appeals to mainstream western tastes.

After that, we went to another bar where conversation is impossible as it was so loud! It's just like a student bar in the uk - there was a loud band singing in Vietnamese, then some kind of long and boring kissing competition on stage while everyone shouted in Vietnamese. It was pretty boring although someone told us this is apparently edgy for Vietnamese culture? By uk standards it was a bit like a night down the student union, except that everyone spoke another language.

Overall, I wish we had done a tour with one of the other companies - they are half the price and it sounds like they go to more districts and do more interesting/unusual things, as well as trying street food stalls (rather than restaurants, which are easy enough to find on tripadvisor). I wouldn't recommend this tour.

My BF and I did the Saigon after Dark Food Tour. Our guide was very fun and spoke excellent English. The first stop (seafood) was the best food we've eaten in Vietnam. The second stop was different from the normal place because it was the New Year and many places were closed. The best part in my opinion was the Vespa. It was completely invigorating. Definitely the highlight of our trip to Saigon!

Really enjoyed our morning with Vietnam Vespa tours- they definitely took us to places we would never have seen, like a wholesale flower market and a park surrounded by pet bird enthusiasts. The guide and drivers were great. The only thing is I found the tour to be too expensive for what it was... I would have rather spent less and not have the lunch that was included at Zoom Cafe. The menu was completely Western-oriented which was an odd way to end what felt like a truly local-focussed tour.

We chose the Saigon by night tour and it was fantastic! It's a great way to experience the buzz of the city and you visit places you probably wouldn't find on your own! You start off with a couple of drinks in a local bar, followed by two restaurant stops to try the local specialities and then two totally opposite music venues! The drivers and the guide are great fun and they make sure you have a brilliant night! It's one of the best tours we have ever done anywhere!

My husband and I signed up for two tours, one during the day and the other food tour at night. Both were really good, but if you can only do one- I would suggest the PM food tour. Lora was our guide and she was very personable and fun. We had a variety of different food- crab, clams, frog legs, and pancake, just to name a few. All delicious. They can work around any allergies you might have, and they will ask you in advance. Our group was allergy-free so not sure how much that varies the experience. The last two stops were smaller music venues, it was a fun way to end the night.

The drivers were excellent and we felt safe with them at all times. It was great to be in the middle of the action and to be able to enjoy the ride.

Definitely recommend this to anyone who is looking for a fun and different way to explore Saigon.
I had a great time in finding the mayor attractions in the whole city. Well elaborated tour with an amazing view over the story of the city.

Did the foodie night tour on Christmas Eve. Certainly different from my usual Christmas Eve activities, and a lot of fun. Food was great - even my daughter ate and enjoyed the seafood which she wouldn't normally touch. Picked up from hotel, taken to a cafe for a cocktail and to meet rest of party (quite large), and then off round the city on the back of a Vespa, stopping at various eating places to sample some delicious local dishes. Our guide was great, explaining what we were eating and being very entertaining. Ended up at a couple of music venues which we probably could have missed, and were then taken back to hotel. Really impressed with the tour. Drivers were excellent - ride was exhilarating but still felt safe. Great entertainment!

review_title: Best way to see Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who has only a few days in Ho Chi Minh. 7 of my mates did this on a Friday evening and was an amazing way to see the nightlife and enjoy some Traditional Vietnamese cooking.

Our host Tran was very friendly and informative and my Scooter driver (Huy) was also very friendly.

Really happy that we went on this tour and would recommend to everyone else out there.

review_title: /what a great way to experience the city!
review_text: Two of us senior citizens set off early morning on this tour. Our guide - Yu - was fantastic and I learned more about the history of the country as well as the city. Since our group of 6 had already visited major sites, Yu tailored our time together based upon what we wanted to see. Our drivers were very skilled at moving around the city. I even held on with only one hand and filmed with the other. It was a wonderful experience and highly recommended!! Pickup and Drop off at our hotel was included but if you wanted to be dropped off at another location within district 1, they could accommodate that request. By all means put this high on the list of things to do!

Hello Everyone,

This is the best tour around Ho Chi Minh City! I enjoyed being driven around on the back of a Vespa in the crazy traffic! I loved the food! We had a goat ragu at a local spot and it was absolutely the best goat I have ever had! I enjoyed the seafood as well- everything was so tasty!

I was taken to see beautiful views of the city, in addition to very unique streets that I would not have known to explore on my own.

The staff is very friendly and accommodating. I felt very safe and cared for.

I recommend this tour to everyone who wants to get a good glimpse of the city, experience how people get around and try some amazing local eateries!

Phuong
Good team to guide every one in tour, the tour guide is fun and friendly so much. Next time i will come again

review_title: Best Vespa Ride of my Life!
review_text: I would recommend these tours to anyone who wants to get out and really see the people and the culture. We did another one in Hoi An and Cambodia and it was great. The crew is very helpful, English is not an issue if that is your primary language. Visiting local craftsman and seeing them in action is very informative, they also give you the opportunity to try it out yourself. We did the night tour in Ho Chi Minh and would stop every 20-30mins to eat and drink, learning about the area we stopped in and just visiting with everyone. This is the way to go and Vespa Adventures is the best company to book with, everyone is professional and willing to help in anyway they can. Go do this!!! Have FUN!!

review_title: One of the highlights of our visit to Vietnam
review_text:
Absolutely great fun and the food tour around Saigon is certainly not to be missed.
It was just brilliant fun from start to finish and my wife and I felt very safe with our respective drivers. The food on the tour was of excellent quality and explained to us in detail.
After the quieter local acoustic music cafe, we then went to a nightclub / bar where there was live music and the singer only allowed to do 2 or 3 songs before someone else got up and sang.
Don't miss out on this trip !!!

The Foodie Vespa tour was an absolute highlight of our time in Ho Chi Minh City! I was a little nervous at first but the drivers are all very professional and my driver, Van, made me feel very safe and I ended up being completely exhilarated by the ride! Our tour guide Lora was fabulous too!! She looked after us all, took us to some great locations and taught me how to eat frogs legs which I never thought I would do! I would definitely recommend this tour and especially Lora as a guide!

My partner and I took the after dark food tour and had an excellent, memorable evening. Our tour guide, Tran, was knowledgable, friendly, and fun loving. She always made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Both of our drivers were great as well. They always seemed to be in control throughout all of the crazy Saigon traffic. The journey through this beautiful city was exhilarating but never felt dangerous. All off the food stops were well planned and provided more than enough to eat. The two after dinner stops were fun and memorable as well. Vietnam Vespa Adventures provided professional service and a great way to explore the sights and food of this frenetic city. We would recommend this tour to anyone new to town.

Never having ridden on a scooter before, and seeing how they dominate the Saigon street scene I was a little nervous before the start. But wow, I never wanted the evening to end. We were collected from our hotel given helmets and set off behind very safe and confident drivers. The scooters have back rests so you have something to hold on to if you want. We visited 5 different locations around the city trying different foods or drinks at each. The last 2 having traditional music at one and a rock band at the other.
All food and drink was included in the price. It was an absolutely brilliant evening and by far the best thing I did in Saigon

We were a bit apprehensive about a vespa ride around Saigon at first...the roads are absolute madness.....this disappeared after 2 minutes with our expert rider and guide. One of the highlights of our trip through Vietnam, Cambodia & Laos.

This experience is highly recommended.

review_title: An amazing introduction to Vietnamese food and culture
review_text:
We went on the Saigon After Dark Tour and we thought it was exceptional.

The tour started with the vespa drivers picking us up from our hotel and taking us to Zoom Cafe for a welcome drink. There we met our incredible guide Tuan. Over the course of the next 4 hours we sampled many delicious foods from 4 wonderful locations.We particularly loved the seafood of the first restaurant, the traditional Vietnamese Pancakes and spring rolls of the second (particularly as we were shown how to properly roll and eat them) and the live music of the last two stops.

It was an excellent introduction to Vietnamese food, and our guide made sure we learnt a lot about the food and some of the different Vietnamese practices. The drivers were very skilled, and despite the very very busy streets, we never felt unsafe as they weaved in and out of the traffic with ease.

Make sure you bring a big appetite because there is plenty of food to sample.

Absolutely fantastic, excellent value and very cool! Highly recommend. My teenage son and I booked this in advance and we got to see places we probably otherwise would not have visited. Guide spoke perfect English and really knew his stuff about the historically and religiously significant places we were taken to.

This is well worth the money you spend! Our guide An brought us on a great journey together with our drivers in rueal Vietnam. I joined the tour including a cooking class on the river. We visited the market, a rice wine destillery, coffee shops and more. Ask a lot of questions and your guide will give you valuable insight to the local history, culture and living in Vietnam!

Highly recommended!
Perfect tour for a real tourist. Very friendly drivers and You is the best city guide around! Make sure you have some cash to tip the drivers

review_title: Great way to see the city and experience the local cuisine
review_text: An exhilarating ride around the hidden spots of Ho Chi Minh - the drivers are very safe and attentive but at the same time give you a definite taste of the chaos of Ho Chi Minh traffic. The food is never-ending and the tour enables you to discover the hotspots of the locals, not just the tourist restaurants. The meals are adventurous to say the least - we tried frog and other unidentified seafood that I would never have dreamed of ordering in a restaurant myself. Drinks are free and the tour takes its participants to two great live music venues that cater to all Westerners and locals alike.

review_title: fab way to see the city
review_text: We did the night tour and couldn't see any way to improve. Very organised, efficient and sooooooo much fun.

We did the evening food tour and absolutely loved it.

We had been absolutely amazed and intrigued by the traffic in Ho Chi Minh from the moment we arrived, this tour let us feel we were part of it.

as neither of us had ever ridden a scooter before we were nervous about the tour, but felt very safe but excited and enthralled with our driver.

As well as the scooter riding the food stops were brilliant allowed us to try different street food in a safe (for our western digestive systems) way.

Finally the café and rock club were great stops taking us to places we would never have found on our own.

All in all a great experience we thoroughly recommend.

At first it might seem daunting to get into the middle of Ho Chi Minh City's scooter madness. Once you're on the back of one, its not so scary.

From 6 to 10:30pm they took us to two different Vietnamese restaurants, a coffee shop/lounge, and a rockin' bar. They took us through fancy neighborhoods and working class neighborhoods. We saw streets and things we never would have seen on our own.

Our tour guide ate with us and explained all the food and showed us how the locals eat it. After two restaurants, we went to a coffee/dessert/acoustic music lounge. They sang soft cover versions of western pop songs...but the coffee was great. Then we went to a raucous bar with a live band playing 80s and 90s pop-rock tunes. You might wonder how this fits into a Vietnamese cultural tour, but the Vietnamese are much less uptight than many of their Asian counterparts. They rock out, they dance, they drink, they stay out late...all that stuff.

All in all, this tour company has their act together, and even though it is on the pricey side, it is totally worth it.

Fantastic experience on a Vespa after dark visiting a number of local eating and drinking spots where we tasted traditional foods. The chance to ride on the streets and experience the craziness of the traffic all around you is a must not miss. It was an amazing evening

An absolute must and the greatest fun. We did the Saigon After Dark tour and so glad we did or we would have missed one of the best evenings we had on our trip. The whole tour runs like clock-work. Thanks to our guide "Yu" who was full of energy, information and cheer. If you don't like seafood, don't worry... they will arrange something else. They managed to produce wine everywhere as well. The cost includes all food and alcohol. The street food was delicious and we didn't suffer the next day either. The Hidden Cafe was slightly odd, and we preferred the Vietnamese music to the Western music. All of our group declined the final venue but it didn't matter, we all had a super evening. Thoroughly recommended and if we get to visit Saigon again, we will definitely do their other tours and probably repeat this one too!

review_title: Fantastic way to see Saigon and taste street food!
review_text: We just loved this night time adventure on old Vespa scooters. The drivers were safe and friendly and the food delicious. One not to miss in Saigon!
Fast fun and if you are a Vespa junkie go for it. Totally safe and fun plus you get to see sites that are hard to see in a car.i would recommend this to anyone.

I am not much for guided tours, but opting for this tour ended up being the best decision ever! You can book the tour very easily by phone, and the drivers come pick you up at your hotel on cute little Vespas. They then take you to the first bar/cafe, where the guide briefs you on all the places they'll take you to. Our guide was very knowledgable and spoke perfect english. All the food and drinks are included in the price of the tour, and it ended up being so much fun! They take you, one by one, to many local eateries and bars, where you get to taste all the local specialties. If it weren't for this tour, we would never be able to find some of the places they took us to, which were absolutely incredible, specially the place with the vietnamese rolls - they were to die for! The night ends at a bar with a live band, and you can choose to stay on, or be dropped back to your hotel. My vespa driver's name was Tri, or Tree (I don't know how to spell it), and I had a blast chatting with him throughout the tour.

A definite must-do!

review_title: sightseeing, entertainment and good food, fantastic !
review_text: Nothing to add to the title ! A no-brainer for visitors who are willing to spend US 75 for this excellent 3 in 1.

review_title: What great fun and a different way to see the city.
review_text:
Although I was a bit nervous of traveling at night on the back of a Vespa in the manic traffic of HCM City, I loved this tour. After 5 mins on the scooter, having complete faith in your drivers skill and ability I managed to relax the white knuckle grip on the bike and relaxed and enjoyed every minute of the tour.
The staff were great and our guide "you" was a lovely pleasant and helpful lady. The street food was ok and different with several courses for the adventurous to try , plus as many drinks as you needed. Speeding through the busy streets, dodging the thousands of other nighttime road users was a real thrill. Great fun and I would recommend everyone to give it a go.

review_title: One of the best holiday experiences we have had
review_text:
This is a fantastic way to see the city and enjoy its food .
We were picked up at our apartment for an exhilarating ride into the city centre.The drivers have amazing skill and it is a real roller coaster .Despite the weaving traffic we never felt unsafe.It was such fun to go in a group and the riders were so courteous.
We started in a bar with good drinks and snacks meeting up with two lovely Lebanese Australians who joined us .On to a street seafood cafe and then to a pancake restaurant .Amazing food .Then we enjoyed gorgeous music in a piano bar finishing dancing to a rock band at the Woodstock Bar . All the time enjoying free drinks and wonderful views of the city.
Our host Lora was fantastic and made the evening special
This is a must tour.Superb.

review_title: absolutely the best way to see Saigon at night
review_text: I was a bit nervous about this tour having seen how the traffic works - or doesn't- in Saigon. Getting on a Vespa for a 4-5 night tour of the city seemed a bit crazy, but it was fabulous! Each of our party of 4 had their own driver and at each stop - two local restaurants with great street food and then two music bars - we were met by the same guide who explained everything and wo gave us just a great time. There is no way we could have seen this vast city otherwise and we ate and danced at places we could never find again. Everything was included - drinks, food, Vespa drivers and pick up and return to our hotel. A real highlight of any trip to Vietnam and definitely worth the price.

Well if you want a fun night don't miss out on this trip , fantastic host , Chin, kept us entertained all evening and tasted some magnifique food which the tourist really wouldn't find ! Then onto 2 music venues one quiet and serene the other rocking with great musicians , if your scared of getting on the back of the bike ......DO IT you will be writing a review like me thereafter! Thanks again from Peter & Helen

review_title: My third time on the Saigon after dark Vespa tour
review_text: I have traveled to Vietnam three times and each time have been on the Saigon after Dark tour. It is so much fun and we want all our friends and family to experience. And so should you. It really is a tour that can't be missed! Thanks so much to everyone at Vietnam Vespa Adventures who make us feel a part of the Vietnamese culture. Can only hope to return soon!!

My friend booked this- I never would have elected to ride on the back of a moped for a 4 hour tour. But it was amazing! The drivers are very kind and confident, and our tour guide (Yu) was really charming and knowledgable and great at her job. I spent the first five minutes feeling like I was having a near death experience and then the ride was exhilarating! FYI we did an AM city tour.

review_title: The best way to see the path less traveled
review_text: I went on the morning tour into the mekong delta which started off by us being picked up from our hotel then driving to a workshop where all the Vespas are and we opted to drive our own Vespa (an option which I can not recommend more) our very kind tour guide, Chin, told us at anytime he could drive us which is great if you're possibly nervous about driving yourself. We then rode to a shrimp farm after a drink on the way at a local place which was interesting followed by a small place we got to by going on the ferry across the river with 50 other people on their motorbikes where the shrimp markets thrived. It was very interesting see where a lot of the sea food comes from in this area. We then went to a town with amazing food markets where our guide bought us watermelon and rose apples, which were washed and cut up for us where we stopped about 5 minutes away to try some of the local sea food. After this we visited a place where rice wine in made followed by where incense is made (which I thought was the most interesting part). After that we asked to skip going to the temple which the guides where happy to do as where in a group by ourselves and we were starting to get a bit tired. We then headed to a delicious lunch then back to our hotel. Overall this was an amazing experience and I would recommend it to every person who comes to Saigon and if you're confident enough, definitely ride your own Vespa.

The Saigon After Dark tour is a 'MUST DO' - it has to be on the top of your list of things to do in Saigon. The tour had an excellent balance of experiencing riding through Saigon's traffic, seeing local landmarks, sampling the array of local food - all beautifully cooked and extremely tasty, to wonderful live music. The drivers were friendly and I felt safe. The tour guides were fun, knowledgable and accommodating. Steve and the Vespa team set and maintain a very high standard. If you are in Saigon, I recommend doing this tour!

This was, hands down, one of the best things to do in HCMC. I'm a bit of a worry wart and was a little concerned with this excursion in the beginning but I easily got over that after meeting our guide, driver, and group. Chin, our guide was fantastic! Very personable and funny.

I would do this trip again -- I even contemplated doing an evening tour after finishing the morning one.

In my travels, I've spent days caring for and riding elephants in the Thai jungle, hot air ballooning over the rock formations in Cappadocia, Turkey, getting up close to the big 5 in Kenya and Tanzania, as well as other amazing adventures. That said, this Vespa tour is high up on my list of awesome adventures. One that I would recommend, and do again any without hesitation.

Great day trip! Our guide Na was very knowledgable and I got to drive even though she was a little nervous. The cooking class and trip to the market paired my love of cooking with my love of scootering

Went on the Saigon After Dark food tour. Absolutely everything about the tour was excellent and of a very high standard from the beautifully restored vintage vespas, the friendly safe drivers, the fun & knowledgable tour guide, the quality & selection of food, the servers at each restaurant and the diverse entertainment. This is the number one must-do in HCMC. You will not be disappointed.

review_title: Great way to see the city
review_text: I did the night tour. Was a great evening. The drivers are really safe and the tour guide is very accommodating. Learnt loads about the food and culture. Was perfect was to experience the city

review_title: Quick and dirty intro to the city
review_text: You see a lot of the city quite quickly, and they were very accommodating in adapting the itinerary based on what we had already seen - meaning we visited the more unusual places. The drivers were very solicitous. However, the guide was, in my view, too bossy. Although she was pretty informative, she scolded us when we didn't know the answers to questions, or when we did not give her our undivided attention. Perhaps she needs to relax a bit - the same information could be imparted in a more relaxed manner (especially as the tour is not cheap).
Best thing we did in Vietnam. Amazing experience. Very professional. On a high all evening. Great value for money and wonderful guide and driver. Would do again like a shot

review_title: Night tour a must in Saigon!
review_text:
After an amazing Vietnam Vespa tour in Hoi An we decided to do the night tour in Ho Chi Minh. We can highly recommend it as it was loads of fun and an experience you'll remember forever...Zooming through busy Saigon traffic on the back of a Vespa with a cocktail / beer in your hand!

All drinks and food included and worth the spend. Drinks include cocktails, beers, wine. They're very generous with drinks so pace yourself. I had 2 mojitos at Zoom Cafe before we headed off with a 3rd in my hand for the trip to the first restaurant :) Make sure you take a "roadie" - a drink for the road.

The food in the two restaurants was very good. So nice to go to non-touristy restaurants and try some unusual, traditional food. Be brave and try everything. We also stopped at a music recital in a small venue behind a private home, which was amazing. Next stop was a bar with love music - could have stayed for hours!

Can't recommend this highly enough. The highlight of our time in Saigon

What a way to see Saigon from the back of a Vespa. Our guide, Tu, was a great host and told us about all the food we were eating. The view of driving around the city on the Vespa can't be beat. Then the food!!! It was some of the best we have had this trip. Being from Louisiana we know good food and this was it!
From seafood to pancakes it was great. Don't miss it if you are in Saigon!

We joined Vespa thru our hotel. They have hotel pick up and my driver spoke fluent English.

They are very caring and make sure you are safe during the tour. Our package include a free lunch in their restaurant (I think, same business name). They showed us different corner of Ho Chi Minh City, even the poorest local area that we won't visit as travelers. Due to our safety, we only pass by there and won't have any stop.

They have 10-15 mins stop to each tourist site and we have enough time for photo shooting.

The trip is around 4-4.5 hour and our drivers were willing to drop us off to opera which is not included in the list. We had so much fun and highly recommend Vespa to everyone!

review_title: A must for Ho Chi Minh
review_text: We booked the evening food tour online a few days before we did it. We were picked up at 6.30 on the evening by our drivers for the evening who were great. The tour starts by meeting the others in your group in a cafe for a drink. We were expertly driven through the different districts in the city seeing things you wouldn't normally get to experience and given lots of information by our guide I wasn't expecting to be sitting on the back of a Vespa riding through the streets with a beer in my hand. All of the food we stopped for was great and catered for me being a vegetarian. We were also taken to two places playing live music, one candlelit and laid-back and the other more vibrant with cocktails. This was one of the best things I did in my three week trip of Vietnam I highly recommend it.

My husband and I booked the Saigon after dark tour through this company. It was a very fun experience as you get to ride a motorcycle like a local, eat like a local and enjoy entertainment like a local. The whole tour lasted for 4 hours and within this 4 hours, we've been drinking and eating. We met alot of nice people, enjoyed the local food and visited a very nice small local cafe (thats located in one of the alleys!) with local singers and the last stop was a bar/pub with a band. People were singing, dancing and enjoying the night.

The guide and staffs were all very nice.

The tour company also gave us a photo of each one of us riding a vespa and a keychain. Not only that they will also send you photos taken during the tour.

Its definitely worth the money and time.

Thumbs up to Vietnam Vespa Adventures!

What an awesome experience ! We are hosted by friendly tour guide with amazing local foods ! The best part of the tour is to enjoy fresh and yummy local foods. Besides , a cool ride through breezy evening will never be forgettable !
What an awesome experience! Such a great way to see the city. Drivers/guides are so helpful and entertaining. A MUST for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh.

review_title: An excellent way to cap off a two week Vietnam tour
review_text:
Just came back from this tour on the last day of an exhilarating fourth tour of Vietnam!
Nothing extraordinary I can add to the review of this activity that many others have already posted.
What an excellent business idea! It works well! A tourist gets to experience the "chaotic" traffic that Saigon is AND also gets to visit neighborhoods beyond the touristy district 1. I would never on my own have visited the neighbourhoods and local food places that Saigon citizens experience everyday.
From the plentiful food and drink to the local club where aspiring local vocal students sing ( very well! ) and the great music bar -- this tour is a MUST for any tourist visiting the city
Dieu -- our sprightly, energetic and totally charming tour guide made this evening even more memorable. Just wish the scooter riders were more fluent with their English --- would have loved to communicate with them.
This tour is a no brainier for any visitor to Saigon!!
This vespa tour was a fun way to get out of the busy Ho Chi Minh city and see part of the Mekong Delta. Our drivers were very attentive and incredibly competent.
Wow! We loved our tour and visited many places we never would have found on our own. In fact, we liked it so much, we signed up for more Vespa tours in Hoi An!

review_title: Great Way to See Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Best thing to do in Ho Chi Minh. Guides are excellent, I felt very safe even though the traffic is chaotic. The restaurants were great and we tried things we might not have before. The night clubs at the end or the tour were great entertainment. This is a must do.
We did an evening tour of HCM city and it was the highlight of my time in the city! What a way to experience how the Vietnamese get around every day!

We booked this tour as we had previously done a Vespa tour with another company in Hanoi and absolutely loved it. As we booked the 12pm session, we were collected from our hotel by drivers who were friendly but could not really speak English. We were taken to the companies cafe and offered lunch. We politely declined, as we had both been sick the night before. We were also introduced to another 2 people doing the tour with us. The tour started at about 12:30pm with a tour guide, fluent in English, explaining where we will be going and what we'll be doing. We were taken to some historically sights, as well as a temple, pagoda, the flower market, china town, local areas and the new up and coming area, district 2. The tour guide explained each area, giving us background information and encouraging us to ask questions. She clearly explained the difference between a pagoda and a temple. Overall she was an excellent tour guide and made the experience very educational and enjoyable.

Riding on the back of the scooter was a complete adrenalin rush and lots of fun. You really got the feel for the city as you weaved in and out of traffic, narrowly missing other scooters and cars.

My personal highlight was driving through district 4, and really seeing how people live in this city.

The tour takes you to hidden parts of Ho Chi Minh that you could never do on your own.

We did the 4 hour morning tour in HCMC and had a blast. We were picked up on time with our driver and Vespa, and it was so fun and exciting to see the city from the back of the Vespa. Gives a completely different perspective from when you are only the pedestrian crossing those overwhelming roads! We visited a number of stops along the way and I enjoyed seeing some places that I would not have gone to otherwise, particularly those outside of districts 1 and 3. I particularly enjoyed the bird talk cafe first thing in the morning, as well as zipping through Chinatown. The drivers were all very professional and I felt safe the entire time. It is an expensive tour, but it was worth it. Such a fun morning!
We did the night food tour of the city - what a great experience! Really helpful and fun staff, the drivers always made us feel safe and the food was superb. Definitely the highlight of our trip.

review_title: Incredible 4 Hours in Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: Unreal. We had half a day in Saigon before heading back to the US, and we found Vietnam Vespa Adventures through the New York Times' 36 Hours in Ho Chi Minh City feature, and we couldn't have been more thrilled. Each of our group of eleven jumped on the back of our own Vespa (driver included), and toured the incredible city of Saigon. Our guide, Yu, was not only knowledgable and tactful, but quite hilarious as well. As the end of the four hours approximately, I found myself wishing we had more and more time to explore. I would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone with four free hours in Ho Chi Minh City.

We did the Vespa Night Food Tour of Saigon. OMG - it was the best thing we did in our five weeks in South East Asia! So much fun! Gorgeous food, brilliant entertainment, throbbing city on a vespa. Who could ask for anything more. We all would highly recommend this experience!

This was the highlight of our trip! Amazing night street food tour that took in the sights of Saigon plus some amazing food. This trip is a must. Our guide was fantastic and we finished the tour in a couple of fabulous live music venues. Absolutely loved it and can't recommend highly enough.

One of the best nights me and my wife had in Saigon. My wife didnt want to do at first but glad she did. Great food, Great group cold beer. All was brilliant and don't be too worried about the crazy traffic.

review_title: Highlight of my trip throughout Southeast Asia
review_text: At my arrival at Ho Chi Minh City, I couldn't find anything special about the city. Yet after taking the decision of taking the vespa tour this changed. The vespas picked up me and my group of 10 people at the entrance of the hotel I was staying at (Park Hyatt) and they where there 15 minutes before schedule. After being given some instructions we took the tour in which we went to 5 different places. Every place was different from the other, yet my favorite spot was the local seafood restaurant where I had the opportunity to try mussels, clams, crab and even frogs in the local way Vietnamese people eat it. At the end of the tour I had drank a lot and ate even more. It was totally worth my money and my time and I would recommend this tour for anyone that likes adventures. I think this is the best way to really get to know Saigon in a short amount of time.

We did this tour on our last night in Ho Chi Minh and it was a blast! The food was amazing and really fresh at all places we ate.

This tour is great for everyone, ranging from friends, couples and to families.

review_title: The highlights of our Vietnam trip
review_text:
We did 2 tours with Vespa Adventures; one in Ho Chi Minh, "Insiders Saigon" & one in Hoi An, "Countryside & Islands Experience". Both were the highlights of our time in each place.
For our Hoi An tour, the lovely Trinh was our guide & Trien (Nine) was our other rider. Both of them were so lovely! Trinh was a fantastic guide; so knowledgeable, fun & friendly. She really made the tour special for us.
In Ho Chi Minh, our guide was Yu. She was a great guide also & made it a great morning, even changing around a few things since we'd already seen a couple of places on the route.
Although it's a bit more expensive, I can highly recommend going for a private tour which we did for both of ours. This gave us the freedom to stop whenever we saw something we wanted to photograph & sometimes change things up a bit. We will certainly do more tours with Vespa Adventures when we return to Vietnam...Amazing!!!

review_title: Fast and fearless way to see Saigon
review_text:
Wow! What are ways to get the taste and feel of being part of Saigon life. Get to seat behind the classic Vespa with experienced driver and be part of the flow of Saigon traffic. Evening ride starts at Vespa cafe then ride through city while making food stops and music breaks. One of high lights to our Vietnam tour. Guides are wonderful too.
I say, its better then a Disneyland ride.
Thank you.

review_title: First thing to do in Saigon
review_text:
The only reason we're giving this tour a 4 instead of a 5 is that we had a really hard time understanding the English of our guide. Everything else was great.

Our family of five (Ages 22-64) all loved the Vespa riding. Also, we had been in Ho Chi Minh for 2 days already and still had not seen the parts of the city this tour showed us.
It's amazing being part of the THRONGS of motorbike riders.

This tour gives each customer a driver- you sit on the back and enjoy.

We have rented motorbikes before but we would NEVER rent them here - the driving is too crazy! We felt safe and secure with these seasoned drivers.

The reason we said to do this tour first, is that it will give you a layout of the city. Then you can return to what you'd like to do.

Do it!

Best thing in Saigon. Don't miss this tour on the back of a Vespa with stops at a bar, a restaurant, and a nightclub. Sounds like a crazy thing to do but this was such fun and surprisingly safe for all ages. Our group included a 10 year old and an 81 year old!

review_title: What a way to spend New Year's Eve - one to remember
review_text:
This tour was booked back In the uk. We were picked up bang on time, we had four superb scooters. Straight away we weaved through the traffic with our skillful drivers. The traffic was horrendous, perhaps made worse because it was nye. First stop was for seafood, then another scoot across town to a backstreet restaurant for Vietnamese wraps, all drinks were included. Next another stop for more food and more free drinks. Next helmets on and off to a cool music club. This place was really dark and quite, almost like someone's front room, amazing singers - did not want to leave. Then a short hop back on the scooters to a live music club for some rock music.

This tour is very professionally run and extremely well organized, with everything ready as you arrive.

review_title: Saigon by night food tour - Brilliant.
review_text:
Thank you so much to Tu and the skillful drivers for a fantastic adventure around Saigon. The best way to see the city - you go to places you'd never tried for yourself and get to see the way that Saigon works close up. The food stops were amazing - local seafood and south Vietnamese specialties in an authentic setting and very very tasty.

Our guide Tu was knowledgeable and very passionate about his city - the whole tour is slick and you are made to feel very welcome.

All in all, this is the only way to get a proper feel for the city outside of the tourist district and eat wonderful food at the same time.

Do it!!

Gary & Anna
Edinburgh
The night tour through Saigon is a wonderful experience. Do it on your first day in order to get an overview of the city using a unique, Saigon-specific perspective.

review_title: Had an amazing time with 4 other friends! Get to see a lot of the city and learn heaps in a rather small amount of time
review_text:
I feel like I have been super lucky in Vietnam and Cambodia. So everything far we have done has been a 5 star excellent experience..and this tour delivers another 5 star experience

Boasting a fleet of almost 150 vespas, this company has hundreds of drivers and guides. We upgraded to a private tour for 5 and it was worth every penny. The guide (one of the people assigned to our tour), her name was Dieu, spoke perfect English, was hysterically funny, super knowledgeable about all of the subjects regarding the sites we were viewing.

She was so good she was even featured on CNN. Anyways, we zipped around the city, the 5 of us, on the backs of new vespas and became intimate with the chaotic intersections, sights, sounds and smells of HMC.

I highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants a crash course in getting to know Ho Chi Minh City. Highlights of the trip included seeing the exact location where the famous photo of the monk that self immolated happened (which is now a monument) a china town temple, and amazing buddhist temple, and much much more.

take the tour..you wont regret.

review_title: The only way to see Saigon!
review_text:
WOW. What an evening. The ONLY way to see Saigon at night!

When we first arrived in Vietnam, we found the sheer volume of traffic – trucks, cars, people and scooters to be a little overwhelming - with so many people all wanting to be in the same spot and no obvious traffic rules it all seemed a little chaotic. Even crossing the road looked a little dangerous.

We were persuaded to take a moped tour of the city and all of a sudden it all made sense. From the back of a Vespa and being part of the traffic flows you can see how it all works – there are no hard and fast rules, just the reliance of the next person to use common sense – and it just works.

Anyway – the tour itself was great. Brilliant fun and a great way to explore all the highlights of the city in one evening. We saw all the major sights and had some incredible street food experiences, with some very varied cultural experiences too.

All very well organised and you’ll have some great photo opportunities from the back of the Vespa if you want some action shots – although you’ll need to make sure you hold on tight to your camera – Saigion is like any town with opportunist thieves.

All in all a great experience and highly recommended. Our guide, Lo An was just brilliant. Very proud of her city, the culture, sights and sounds she really worked hard to bring everything to life and give us a truly immersive experience. If you do just one thing in Saigon, make it a Vespa tour at night..!

We had been feeling kind of overwhelmed trying to navigate Saigon by foot -- it's not a terribly pedestrian-friendly place -- and so I decided to spring for one of their morning tours. What a difference seeing the city by motorbike! We saw different parts of the huge metropolis, both landmarks and everyday life, and the ride felt utterly secure yet thrilling. Would recommend highly. Morning tour comes with lunch at their cafe, which is fine but maybe not the cuisine you came to HCM for ...

review_title: If you do only one tour in Saigon...
review_text: Do the foodie night tour! Although there were a lot of people who arrived for the tour, we were broken into small groups- we had only 4 people in ours so it felt very much like a private tour. We loved eating really unusual food, and not just the usual street food and all of it was delicious. We ended up in a small upstairs live-music coffee shop followed by a Vietnamese pub also with live bands, we had so much fun! Highly recommended.

review_title: Great off the beaten track fun!
review_text:
This is probably the best way to see HCM City! Experience the city from a "local" perspective.

I tookt he trip into the countryside/Mekong Delta. We visited some shrimp farms, local coffee houses, temple, sampled local food and markets and rice fields. It was nice to experience something that appears to be off the beaten track. We really saw parts of the city and suburbs that many wouldn't get the chance to see.

The tour guide picked us up from the hotel with other riders, took us to the vespa tour shop//cafe where we met other people that were part of the group. We then went on a short ride to swap out from the bikes onto Vespas. We then went on a tour. It took the good part of the day and we were exhausted when we were done. We started around 8am and were back at our hotel for about 2pm. A long day and great fun! I'll be sure to do this again the next time I visit just to see what the night city tour is like.

We had a great time on this Vespa dinner tour, we felt like a local on a scooter in the very busy traffic of Saigon. Dinner stops interesting and great to pass by the key buildings of this wonderful city. And not scary at all!

We did an evening dinner tour. The food was fun and interesting if not very filling but touring around on the vespas was great. We had an informative guide and great, safe drivers. We had such a good time that we signed up for another tour during the day.

My husband and I went for a morning tour with Vietnam Vespa adventures whilst we were visiting Ho Chi Minh as part of our honeymoon.
The whole experience was fantastic! We were picked up from our hotel at 8am and jumped straight on the Vespa to the first destination. You are allocated a driver for the whole day and they also provide you with a helmet. It was great to travel by Vespa and mingle with the locals on the road (can be a bit scary at times but so much fun!)
We had Chin as our guide, he spoke very good English and was enthusiastic and knowledgeable of all the places that we visited.
The trip ends with lunch at the zoom cafe which was brilliant.
I recommend this tour if you are visiting Ho Chi Minh for a few days as its an excellent way to see the city

A fantastic experience and must do in Saigon. Best way to see the city and try the different local food. Food is very good, guides nice and service minded and Vespa drivers take you safely between the different places.

review_title: An absolute highlight and great fun
review_text: This is not only the best way to see the city, it is a great way to immerse yourself in the 'mad house' that is traffic in Ho Chi Minh City. We got to see places and meet people that most don't take the chance to. A private tour with the most friendly and very knowledgeable drivers/tour guides made for a fantastic half day tour. This, together with the Vietnam Vespa Tour in Hoi An, were 2 of the real highlights of our Vietnam stay.

We were not too sure if this would work for our children, but the drivers were excellent and very safety conscious. We did the Saigon highlights tour in the morning and the guide kept checking to see that the kids were interested and happy. She was very good at explaining the history and was so well prepared with pictures and maps. Overall, we loved the trip and would go back again, maybe for the full day tour to the delta.

This is a very efficient way to experience HCMC. I did it for a demanding full day and saw a lot. My guide has shown me a wide variety of HCMC and spook very clear english. Recommendable, though a half day will do.

We booked the Saigon Night Tour, highly recommend. You embark on a Vespa with driver through the CRAZY streets of Saigon. If you've been to India and thought that traffic was bad you have not seen anything yet. It's such a thrilling, scary, exciting drive through the different neighborhoods in Saigon. I loved the concept of meeting at a café when the tour begins and meeting other travelers from around the world. We then ate at approximately 4 different local restaurants (authentic food, not a tourist trap). We ended the night at a coffee house and then "American" type bar. It was a great way to see the city, eat authentic and tasty food, meet different travelers and end the night listening to loud bar music (30 minutes maximum) for those of you who don't enjoy loud music.

We were very impressed with this tour. Our guide, Dieu (pronounced Yu), picked us up at our hotel. The drivers gave us helmets, helped us up on the back of their vintage Vespas, and off we went.
We were shown some places in the city center, district one, that we had missed, and then went around the outlying districts, including districts 4 and 5.
This is really the best way to see the city and the sights, and the drivers were quite confident and experienced, so we just sat back and enjoyed the experience.
At the end of the tour, we went to their café for a complementary meal before being returned to our hotel.
This is definitely a must do if you like adventure and getting away from the tour bus type tour.

Had to cancel trip
Instant reply and a lovely email
Would like to send Ha and Stephen all my upmost respect and wish them a happy and prosperous new year
Nice to see their are still some real people left in this world

We had a great time doing this. There were four of us and it was so much fun. The drivers (Hue and crew) and our guide were incredibly genuine and went out of their way to make it a fun evening- they even catered to our meal preferences and took us to a great vegetarian restaurant. I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting HCM!

review_title: You can't do this on your own!
