review_text: We spent an incredible day with our guide and drivers touring around the back streets of Ho Chi Minh City, which was a unique experience that we couldn't have done on our own. We had our two kids with us (6 and 8) and they loved it every bit as much as we did. Our guide took us to various city districts, visiting a variety of sights but they always took the off-the-beaten-track route which allowed us to see much more than we otherwise would. Book this tour - it's worth every penny.

I was really looking forward to this tour, and was really surprised at how good it was. Sure it is a little expensive for SE Asia ($89 USD for the tour), but I would still encourage you to go.
Visited some famous local restaurants and ate enough to keep you going all night.
Learned about local methods of cooking, eating and making the most of all the extra sides that come with dishes.
In between stops we also saw the main sights (and after the first stop we were able to take a roadie with us) before heading to a small cafe with some live music.
Then we went to a famous local bar where the whole crowd was singing along to Vietnamese rock'n'roll style music.
The tour leader and my driver were excellent, and really helped the small group of us bond during the course of the night.
Well worth it

My partner and I did the 'Insider's Saigon' afternoon tour. It was such a great experience. The tour guide was very knowledgable about the sites and local areas and spoke great English. The drivers made traveling on the back feel extremely safe especially in the crazy Saigon traffic. They took us to places that tourists wouldn't generally go to which was great. It was awesome to get the inside knowledge about these places. A friendly, exciting, welcoming company that I would recommend to anyone.

review_title: Fast paced varied night tour - lots of food & drink
review_text:
I did the night tour my first evening in HCMC. It's a large operation and I think we had about 20 people split into at least two groups with a guide for each. You sit behind a driver who weaves you in and out of the crazy traffic.

My driver picked me up at the hotel and took me to the gathering place (the Vespa cafe) and I recall at least 4 stops - the first two were eating and the last two were clubs with entertainment and drinking.

Yes it was a big tourist group experience but it gives you a chance to quickly see a few places and get a feel for the city at night.

review_title: this was a fun evening riding around Siagon on the back of a Vespa
review_text: A great evening with an introduction to the night life, street food and night clubs of Saigon. I had every confidence in the driver and was enthralled by the lights and the traffic!

review_title: Great way to get a "taste" of Ho Chi Min
review_text:
When you first arrive in CHM city the traffic is kind of overwhelming, especially the scooters, so this is a great way to experience the traffic of Saigon, visit some interesting areas and try some great food.
I went for the after dark tour. There were four other people plus our guide. Although there was a preset menu, when I asked if I could try a bit more "adventurous items" our guide talked to the restaurant and I was able to try a pineapple snail. It's pretty awesome eating great Vietnamese food and riding through traffic.
I'm a pretty big guy and I was worried how they'd mange with me on the back of a scooter, but my driver handled it without an issue. It was fun and I also got to meet some cool people visiting the city as well.

We did the after dark tour in Ho Chi Minh and had a great time. You become a true local for the night, eat authentic Vietnamese food and experience the city by Vespa. Our guide (Tu) was really friendly and looked after us well the whole night. The Vespa drivers also make you feel very comfortable and safe.

I would highly recommend this tour

I did this tour twice in one week at night. You get enough food and drink on this trip for dinner. All food and drink is included. The first time was with people from work and we had a group of 13 and we had our own guide. The 2nd time was with my wife and we got to meet several people from other countries that were in our group. The Vespa drivers were very courteous and helpful. We had 5 stops. 1st for drinks and chips, 2nd and 3rd for food at local restaurants, 4th at a singing lounge with drinks and last was at a bar with live band. The trip was a blast which is why I did it twice. I highly recommend getting a roadie (beer in a plastic cup to go) at a few stops. Nothing more fun than darting through traffic with a beer. One certainly gets a new and different perspective of the traffic on a scooter.

The after dark was fantastic. We've spent over 3 weeks here and suffice to say it will be one of the most memorable evenings to do in Vietnam.

We were pleasantly surprised by the timeliness of the drivers at our hotel followed by the friendliness and enthusiasm of our guide for the evening.

The evening comprised of 5 stops, a huge amount of food, all you can drink and above all, an amazing exposure to the local sights and sounds of Ho Chi Minh city.

Definitely the best way to see Ho
Chi Minh and above, a must do on anyone's route.

Booked the night vespa foodie tour to get a view of ho chi min by night, Had such a great time zipping around the streets eating at all the local spots. Had so much fun booked for the next day as well for a longer day trip. highly recommended if you want to see a lot of Vietnam for a short amount of time.

My two friends and I chose the day trip to Mekong and we absolutely enjoyed ourselves throughout the whole trip! Our tour guide, Chin, was patient and warm, and was very willing to share everything about living in Vietnam with us. The pace of the trip was just nice as we were always given sufficient time at each stop to learn about the cultural experience behind. Will definitely try out their other tours when back in Vietnam!

review_title: So much fun!! + really good food!
review_text:
The Saigon after dark tour couldn't have been a better last night of our trip through Vietnam. Our guide, Son, was great fun and extremely knowledgeable about Saigon and Vietnamese food (and I had a lot of questions...)

I was a little apprehensive about getting on a bike, given that it's not the safest thing to do in the UK let alone in a city with thousands of them everywhere you look, but any nerves disappear within minutes. The drivers were really nice guys, I felt very safe and it was incredibly good fun. By the end of the evening I didn't want to get off.

All of the food stops were excellent and offered a great variety over the course of the evening, and the bar that the tour finished in had the best atmosphere for live music I've been to in years (the fact it was Friday night probably helped).

Yes it may seem a little expensive when you consider the price of things in Vietnam, but you get more food than you can eat, as many beers as you would like to drink and 4 and a half hours of whizzing around the most incredible city on the back of a classic Vespa so in my opinion it was worth every penny.

review_title: Brilliant way to see the city!
review_text: The Vespa tour of Ho Chi Min was fantastic! We only had 4 days here and wanted to see as much as possible and this was really the way to do it. We did the afternoon tour April 12, starting with lunch at Cafe Zoom, which was delicious! Then we each had our own Vespa driver and a tour guide - Vic - for the 4 of us (myself and 3 friends) who was very informative and friendly. We went to see so many different places, many of which you wouldn't necessarily know about and went down streets you may not come across. The drivers were safe and helmets were provided. It was strange but it was more relaxing being on the back of a Vespa than trying to walk places!! A great way to see the city!

review_title: Fantastic!! 4 hour afternoon tour of the city.
review_text: What a great way to get to know Saigon/Ho Chi Minh! In fact, probably the only safe way, as it is pretty bonkers there... I have never seen so many bikes in my life, and was very glad I was on the back of, and not entirely responsible for said bike! This is a high quality outfit, it was a small group of just four, all the drivers were excellent, as was our 'guide' Dieux, who was fun, informative and kept us all interested as we meant our way on a pretty good circuit of the city. A very good way to get a 'sense' of the city. Thoroughly recommended!!

review_title: A Must Do - So well organized, so well looked after
review_text:
Collected from the hotel, must admit at 1.9m at 110 kilos i worried that the Vespa would be up to the task, need not have, my driver was superb and was still able to thread his machine through the streets.

Warm welcome at Zoom and first bit of alcohol to help prepare for the evening. We visited a couple of street restaurants, full of locals, where our guide carefully explained what we were going to eat, where it was from and its traditions

A coffee in a very nice revue bar and then a few more drinks in venue with live rock and roll bands

All in all a great evening and i would highly recommend it

review_title: Cracking way to spend an evening in HCMC!
review_text: The pick up from our hotel was on time with our drivers waiting for us with a sign with our names on! When we reached the first bar our guide Hanh greeted us and was so friendly throughout the whole night. The food was amazing and I felt so safe on the back on the Vespa. The 3rd place we stopped was a small coffee house which was so intimate and a lovely experience which we would have never seen if exploring the city on your own. The night was finished off in a really lively bar with live music which was great fun! The drinks were flowing all night and we ate our weights worth in food! Although it may be a little on the expensive side for someone traveling it is worth EVERY penny! You would be crazy to miss out on such a fun night!

WOW,
This almost beat Bungie Jumping for me. It was never a dull moment and it was interesting to see from a scooter drivers point of view. No time for day dreaming or spacing out. It was totally an adrenaline rush all the way. A few times I actually had to close my eyes. Highly recommend doing it.

Thanks Steve

This was one of the most fun evenings we spent in Ho Chi Minh City. The food was excellent, and if you are new to Vietnam, or Ho Chi Minh City, or Vietnamese cuisine, it is a great introduction. I feel 100% safe on the vespa with my driver - Yes. The entertainment after the food was just that - entertaining. The guide was friendly and taught us important lessons like how to cross a road in Saigon! Highly recommended!

review_title: Great Fun, A Must Have Night
review_text:
A great way to see Ho Chi Minh City by night.Zipping through the traffic on a vespa is a one off experience.
A taste of the street food and the atmosphere is one to remember.
This is one way to see locations you would never normally see.
One great night.
Thank you Vespa Tours.

Hands-down my favorite experience in Vietnam. This four-hour tour is an amazing way to see Saigon--you'll zip along with traffic and take guided tours of key landmarks with a knowledgable guide, all capped off with a delicious lunch. I loved it so much I nearly booked a second tour (but ran out of time).

review_title: Great Fun & A Brilliant Way to see Saigon at Night
review_text: An absolute must whilst in Saigon. A trip around the bars and restaurants of Saigon at night on the back of a Vespa? Great fun, a great way to see the City and no upper age limit!

review_title: Amazing!!! Do not miss this or you will miss HCMC
review_text:
This trip was amazing. We chose for a private tour for the two of us. The company met us at a pre-agreed meeting point with two Vespas, a guide/driver and a driver. Nguyen, Quoc Dat was our guide - AMAZING - and his second driver was great too. I was so impressed. We saw the sights, we heard the whole and the inside story, we asked questions and got answers. The whole Vespa piece was an added fun thing and then so, so central as we were with the locals, not stuck on a crazy big coach.

I cannot recommend this enough. It was superb!

Thanks for a great afternoon!
I did the city adventure tour and it was cool to see the parts of HCMC that are not on the usual tourist lists. It got really hot though so I recommend taking the morning tour to avoid the heat!

review_title: Good way to see the city
review_text: We had an excellent guide Dieu and the drivers were helpful. We spent three hours touring popular sights

Saigon scooter and motorbike traffic is beyond description. If you can envision a flock of blackbirds whirling in a flock, you begin to get the idea. As near as I can tell, in the absence of very many traffic signals, right of way for one clump of scooters/cycles is determined when someone breaks the scrum at an intersection and allows hundreds to pour through the breech.

Now, envision being in this, on the back of a Vespa. The tour my wife and I took was at night, in an intermittent light rain. Exhaust. Now you understand why many wear face masks. Traffic. Periodic bumping up on the curb and onto the sidewalk when streets proved too confining. Stopped at two restaurants we would never have found, let alone eaten in, and had all manner of interesting things -- snails, frogs, spring rolls we made ourselves -- and had no after effects. Visited a second story coffee shop/club and a night club with bands. Highly interesting and informative.

When I say it was exhilarating, I mean I was swearing incredulously to myself the whole time and wondering whether my life insurance policy would pay off in the event it came out I had engaged in such suicidal behavior.

But excellent drivers and we both survived and would recommend it heartily.

... Or Vietnam (!) you must get on the back of a Vespa... It really is the locals transport of choice. Have had no motorbike experience (in fact I'd go as far as saying I hate them at home) but threw caution to the wind and jumped on the back. Team took great care of us, were eager to educate on their city sights, customs, religions and traditions. A genuinely thrilling way to weave through the traffic and get where you were going - fast! Highly recommended.

We booked the Vespa tour of Saigon prior to our arrival. The communication & booking process was easy.

Upon arrival we met at Zoom Cafe & were given a nice cold drink.

We had an amazing day being drive around the city & stopping at landmarks. The traffics is mental but we felt at ease with our drivers.

Our tour guide was very informative & friendly

This was one of the highlights of our visit to Vietnam & would definitely recommend it to others.

review_title: A Saigon highlight not to be missed!
review_text: Arriving in Saigon and seeing the crazy traffic I couldn't even imagine what it would be like to drive the streets on a vespa, but we were told it was too fun to miss so off we went. The driver was fantastic! And the guide was knowledgeable and flexible to our interests. It was the highlight of our visit in Saigon!

We did both the Day tour and Saigon by Night and it was the most fun we've had on this trip. The guides and drivers were great - very knowledgeable, fun and attentive. The visits to out of the way areas of Saigon and the foodie tours in the evening made this all the more special - definitely not a "tour bus" agenda. Would definitely recommend both.

review_title: Best adventure!! Evening street food tour.
review_text:
I nearly chose out of this activity.

From the outset our guide Dieu was organized & enthusiastic. She maneuvered our group through the full range of experiences, she explained what we were about to try, and the way the locals ate each dish.
We were expertly driven through the crazy Saigon traffic by our riders, & I felt relaxed & comfortable on their scooters.
The bars were diverse, & we all had a dance as the drinks (abundant & included in the price) kicked in.
We were then safely delivered back to our hotel about 10.30 pm- totally pumped.
If you have only one evening in town- then this is how I'd advise you to spend it!!

We did the half day tour in the afternoon of ho chi Minh city and loved every bit of it. Our guides picked us up from our hotel and took us to have lunch at the zoom cafe which was lovely.

Then we hit the roads and it was exhilarating! My driver Thanh was experienced and I felt really safe. I forgot to put sunscreen on and asked our tour guide Vic whether he had any. He didn't but said we could stop and get some if I wanted. I said no it was alright. He must have told Thanh my driver because for the rest of the afternoon Thanh pulled up at every light in a shady spot or drove in the shade. He was so beautiful.

This tour was the highlight of our trip to Vietnam.

review_title: Best part of our trip to Ho Chi Minh.
review_text: My friend had recommended the trip and I'm so glad she did. We did the one day in Saigon trouble from 12pm till 4pm. Lunch was yummy before and it turned out we were the only 4 in that session but I'm glad as it made our trip more memorable. We had our own drivers and an English speaking tour guide, Vic :) there was no pressure to rush any of the stops and we could ask as many questions as we wanted. We had drinks included and visited places of the beaten track. If you don't have long in Ho Chi Minh, this is defiantly the best way to get around some of the bigger attractions as well as visit some lesser known places. Thank you for a great afternoon.

review_title: Best way to experience the city!!!
review_text: We did the night ride tour that included dinner and drinks, although we were spectipcal about the price and safety of riding a scooter it was such a great night with some amazing food and visited places we definitely wouldn't have found otherwise. Having only a short time in this city it was a great way to get out and enjoy ourselves - young and old! Our tour guide was super knowledgable and my scooter driver was amazing and made sure we stuck with the rest of the group amongst the chaotic traffic and felt safe and had such a great night. Highly recommend doing this!

review_title: Now I understand the traffic in Saigon!
review_text:
I did the Vespa night tour of Saigon. It was one of my favorite events on a 10 day private tour of Vietnam. Hahn was our guide. She was great!

The two wheeled motor vehicles are called many things regardless of the brand like: scooters, mopeds, Hondas, motor cycles. They are everywhere. The number of mopeds is about 75% of the population number. As you walk through traffic they are intimidating, at first. After riding with the Vespa Adventure professional drivers you being to understand the riding rules of engagement. It works! It is not excessively dangerous.

The tour includes food, lots of drinks if you are inclined, and plenty of socializing and city touring. I give it an A+.

BTW: We had some rain, which was even better. They provide rain gear.

review_title: Best way to discover Ho Chi Min
review_text: From pick up to drop off I had a true blast with this Insoder's Day tour of Saigon. After a lovely lunch you hop on the back of a beautifully restored Vespa to start the exploration of the city. As I had very limited time in Saigon it allowed me to make a selection of the places I wanted to visit on my second day. Clear and precise historical information are provided for each location. Refreshments are offered throughout. A taste of adventure amongst a sea of motorcycles.

Vespa drivers were expert on the road, feel safe even it's crowded road. They picked us from our Hotel and brought us back safely (6:30 pm - 10: 30 pm). Drove around Saigon and stop at 3 locations with great food and drinks, last stop was local bar with live band music. Will ride again!!!

All the other reviews say the same thing... it is so much fun, a highlight of our long weekend in Ho Chi Minh City. Really worth it, you laugh so much and the vespa drivers are "amazing" how they can get you from one stop to another . It is fast moving and fast pace with 4 stops and a good amount of biking in between... you will love it
We took the half day tour from HCMC into the Mekong Delta. Tour guide and drivers were friendly & knowledgable. Wish we were younger so we could have done the all day gig.

review_title: Night time tour not to be missed!
review_text: Brilliant experience and a great way to see the city after dark. The tour well surpassed our expectations and the scooter drivers were great. My wife had never been on any form of motorized bike but she loved it! Included are stops for food which was delicious, fun and fresh and we also had an amazing couple of stops at musical venues which were quite unique. This tour is a must to see a different side of Saigon in a fun way.

One of the best things we have ever done, anywhere! Our drivers were excellent and we felt very safe. our guide was a delight. Everyone was so knowledgeable and helpful. Will do this again. So much fun.

My husband and I took the Vespa city tour and because it was so enjoyable and informative that the very same day booked the Vespa whole day country tour. Recommend you have one of the drivers drive both the city and the country for you so you can sit on the back of the bike and enjoy the scenery and take in all the exotic sights. The country tour roads are off pavement and can be a little precarious if you're not an advanced motorcyclist. Not recommended for young children due to safety however teens and up will love it!

This tour was a very unique experience. We cannot speak highly enough of our tour guides! Great senses of humor and brilliant knowledge of the areas we stopped in at. Every day was full of new sites and experiences. This is a must do if you want to see the real Vietnam. These guy's are the greatest!

We did the vintage vespa tour by night! We were picked up from our hotel by our englush speaking tour guides to experience Ho Chi Min for the next 4hrs! We were taking to local flower market, sampled herbal tea on the street, experienced eating out at local night market & taken all over Ho Chi Min City! It was a great experience and highly recommend!

Enjoyable ride off the beaten tracks!
We went around the countryside still nearby Hcmc, ride along the dusty roads then pop up in some local market to have a bite.

Worry not, they can accommodate any dietary requirement just tell them in advance.

The journey started by the guide picking you up in your hotel around 8am. Then we'll go the garage on the outskirt of the city near dist.7 area for your test to ride the vespa.
If they consider you pass/can ride on your own, you got to choose the scooter from the garage. There're dozens of them!! hahaha

If you fail? sit on the pillion.
Then off you go.... started with some coffee break in a local hut after about 20mins riding, stop by shrimp farm, some local joss-stick makers then pop up on a local market to have cheese baked scallop with fresh coconut as drink.

continue abit further to see the old Cao Dai (spelling?) religion's church, crossing the ricketty old bridge then ride on to have lunch in a very nice restaurant with tilted hut.
Traditional Vietnam fish dish here...

Then we'll back to the garage return your scooter, and the guide will bring you back to your hotel.

I did tour tours with Vespa Adventures and had the best fun! My first night we did the Saigon at night tour with Ugyen as our guide and enjoyed so much delicious food and history of the town! The second adventure was the Mekong Delta tour where we learnt so much about the area and again more great food and site seeing!! The best way to see Vietnam and highly recommend!!

review_title: a fun and interesting way to see the city!
review_text:
we took the afternoon insider's saigon vespa tour. we enjoyed the riding as a great way to see a lot of the city in a short period of time! we had a great small group, and very friendly drivers. the tour started out with a filling and delicious lunch, and then we proceeded to fly around the city - it is amazing how the drivers navigate the traffic and stay together!

the drivers do not speak english very well, but we had a tour guide that joined us (mr. lam). at each stop he would give us a brief overview of the city and give us context for each stop. we had a bit of a tough time understanding mr lam, and often missing about 50% of the explanations. (we are regular travellers and even live in asia but found his accent particularly tricky to understand) however, his great demeanour and high energy all but made up for it!

the tour was really fun and it was just what we needed. thank you!

Booked 2 tours with these guys and it was worth it. It s the best way to see HCMC. Our guide Dieu was very friendly and very knowledgeable while explaining to us during the day tour. The night tour with its food and nightlife was also nice . Actually, the drive by itself is worth while experience. Do try it!

The Vespa tour was great fun. I would recommend it to anyone of all ages. Our guide, Lori, was full of interesting information and helped us enjoy the food and experience. The drivers were very good and we felt safe all the time, the roads were full of traffic zooming everywhere and being part of that was exhilarating. The sea food restaurant was very good and the frog surprisingly good. The local pancake restaurant was interesting with the food cooked as you watched and we learned all about the ways to eat the food and use the many green leaves and herbs available. The passion fruit juice and fresh coconut juice were delicious. The coffee bar was bizarre and the local singers enthusiastic. The final bar with live rock music and dancing was a nice way to finish before a final race back to the hotel. We would like to give special mention to our guide for the evening as she was excellent.

A friend recommended this before we left the UK and I am so glad I ran into him. This was one of the highlights of our holiday in Vietnam and Cambodia. SUCH fun. We did the Ho Chi Minh City night tour. Vietnam is all about the motorbike and you really feel you are experiencing the city when you are on the back of one of these Vespas. And you don't need to be young to enjoy this. I am well into my 50s and I loved it. The whole evening was one I won't forget. I felt completely safe behind my driver (they took 6 months to train) and we went from bar to restaurant, to restaurant, to bar and ended at a club. The food was delicious and we tried some pancakes we had not had anywhere else. Our guide Chin was so enthusiastic. The whole thing was very professional. It ended with a monsoon downpour but didn't spoil our enjoyment, in fact it almost added to the fun!

review_title: Nice half a day tour outside of Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
Very well organized. Precocious to all aspects a tour by bike they offered us a pleasant safe tour.
All sites, rest places and restaurants were in advanced selected to be kept within the daily schedule
Escorts/drivers very polite and helpful could answer any question
Driving very carefully , had with them anything maybe in need (first aid kits, helmets, raincoats,etc)
Strongly recommended for anyone who wants to have a complete view of Vietnam

This was so much fun. Truly one of the best experiences we have had anywhere in the world and we travel a lot. It was a wonderful way to get a snapshot of Ho Chi Minh City in a few hours. It was so authentic - we would never have found those places on our own. The food was amazing. We booked a private tour because I have fructose malabsorption and can't eat a lot of things. Tuyen, our guide, handled this really well and told the restaurants to leave out the things I can't eat. And it still tasted great! He was also a wealth of knowledge on Vietnam culture, history and attractions which made conversation really easy.
The Vespa ride was fantastic. Our riders were careful and polite and not once did we feel nervous in the traffic. The Vietnamese are very respectful to other bikes/cars and the max speed allowed is 40kph. Ending at Acoustic(nightclub) was a great way to finish and we were surprised at how good the live music was. Definitely one for the bucket list.

This was truly one of the best nights of our lives. Seriously. The food is incredible and the entire Vespa/tour guide experience AROUND Saigon was so perfect. We ended loved at the acoustic bar and we loved the free flowing beer. We did a street food tour in Hanoi but this one was even better. We couldn't recommend it more. Our tour guide Lam also deserves a mention as he seemed to know everything about everything and spoke perfect English (and French) while he looked after us the whole night with the food/drinks/top ups/info. JUST DO IT.

We did the night foodie tour. There were 6 of us in our group. Our guide was 'Chin' who was brilliant as were our Vespa drivers. I felt safe on the back of the bike at all times. It was a wonderful experience & something that would be hard to do on your own. The restaurants, bars & clubs we went were all excellent. Loads of food & drinks. At the end of the evening, it started raining very heavily but our drivers made sure we were kept dry by providing us with waterproofs. Highly recommended!

We did the foodie night tour. Fabulous! Our guide was lovely and our drivers careful and attentive. We were scheduled to stop at 5 locations for different aspects of South Vietnam food and nightlife of Ho Chi Minh City. Terrific experience and something the average tourist would not be able to do alone. Highly recommend.

we did the night tour, we were 7 in a group, we were picked up at our hotel 6pm and it went on till 10pm, they brought you to every corner of HCMC and feed you loads of food and booze! we have seen lots of places that we wouldn't have seen in a normal tour.
I highly recommend this adventure!! the tour guide was very nice and the drivers of the vespas were nice and friendly also! would love to do it again!!

I went on the night food tour with some friends and was not disappointed. I was a little worried at first about the bikes but was soon having so much fun I forgot about it. It was a little hot when we started the tour but it cooled down towards the end of the night.

review_title: Sit back and enjoy the ride!!!
review_text:
WOW Saigon after dark completely exceeded all expectations!! Perfect mixture of food, history, culture and dance party!! Incredible way to see the sites and sounds of the city like a local! Felt incredibly safe on the bike at all times and wish they could drive me everywhere!!! Uyen our guide was knowledgeable and funny!! Would recommend to anyone visiting Saigon!!!

Come with an empty stomach and full heart!!

review_title: Best fun ever on two wheels and super safe.
review_text: Booked 4 tours with this amazing company whilst inVietnam. Hoi An and HMC. They show you things you just wouldn't see otherwise, and take you to places you would never find on your own. Guides speak great English and they seemed to enjoy their time as much as we did. The food they give is superb. (except river clams yuk). Everything else yum yum. If you're deliberating "just do it" you won't regret it. I have never bothered leaving feedback on trip advisor and I have been to some truly great places but these guys are a massive stand out experience and they deserve it.

What a great way to see the city on the back of a Vespa!!! Had a great time on this tour although I would say they finished the tour with a quiet coffee house and then a bar, would have preferred the coffee house earlier in the night. Overall great tour and guides.

Just the best way to spend a couple of hours to see some of this very interesting city....a fun and interactive experience .....you are out there in the thick of this crazy traffic....and at all times I feel very safe and comfortable

A wonderful opportunity to explore "up close" the country. Professional service, new Vespa scooters in excellent condition. Very good guide. Everything perfect, professional and in a very friendly atmosphere.
I would highly recommend!!!

review_title: After enjoying other Vespa tours with this company we were completely disappointed 😥
review_text:
The only reason I am giving this attraction a "poor" rather than "terrible" Is because our lovely young guide, Van, rescued the evening with her uplifting personality and pleasant conversation.

We had done a vespa day tour in Hoi An with Ben and Messy...they were both excellent drivers and guides who met us at our hotel, explained where we would be going and what we would be seeing, and kept us informed and engaged the entire 4 hours. THIS TIME, however, we went outside our hotel at 6:00 PM, looking for the guide, because no one had shown up at our hotel..we located two drivers on the street, holding up a sign with our names, who spoke no English, gave us no information nor any idea what the plan was or who would be guiding us, but just plopped helmets on our head, indicating by hand motions that they wanted to take a photograph, then got us on the Vespas and zoomed off into the night.

It was absolutely ridiculous, and frankly, very upsetting. When we stopped at the Zoom Cafe, Van was waiting, which was a very good thing, because if we had just been dropped off with no communication or any idea where we were or what was happening next, we'd have taken a taxi back to our hotel and asked for our money back.

The cafe was super crowded, and so close to the street we could hardly hear what Van was saying....and as far as ambiance or sharing time with the locals, that was a complete bust. We tried to talk with Van, finished our drinks, and then went to one more stop (a seafood restaurant) before asking to be taken back to our hotel. Again, the restaurant was crowded, noisy and lacking any kind of charm, so we were relieved the food was good.

The drivers brought us back and we said goodbye, completely sorry we had signed up for this tour. Thank goodness the Hoi An one was wonderful, because we will never do this kind of thing again.

(Side note: if you are older than mid 30's, this might not be the trip for you..it is definitely a young person's activity)

Was on a small tour with Lam- my husband and I and two others so it was semi private. We were picked up at our hotel and brought to zoom cafe. The Mekong delta tour is very off the beaten path and definitely not many other tourists except those who are on the cooking tour also run by them. This is the rural experience of Vietnam. Some parts of the ride on the Vespa went up to 45 mins, which got increasingly uncomfortable thru the tour. The drivers seat has suspension while we do not so many unpaved roads were bumpy and you felt it. To quickly sum it up, the tour was very low level activity and although informative, it is not the most exciting. You go to an overpass which is over the Mekong delta - that's all you see of it. You will go to a local coffee shop to kill time, walk around the shop to see them making rice, off to a wet market where you will also have some lunch, a rice field, local incense maker, temples, and finally a restaurant to finish before you head back to your hotel. The guide and plan were flawless, the drivers did their best to stay together and know the route well. We had a very educational experience because you ventured into the local villages and saw life as it is. The guide makes an effort to allow you to have bathroom breaks and ensure you stay hydrated. Bring sunscreen!

When informed of this tour I was hesitant, and after a day in Saigon seeing all the motor bikes and Vespa my heart started beating a bit faster, should I do this on the back of a Vespa? The tour was amazing from start to finish, we were fitted with proper helmets and insisted where to sit and put our feet. Off we went, slicing and swinging through the trafic, passing others on bikes and vespas, cars an busses. This was fun. We stopped at the operations center of Vespa and were served beverages, then off to a street restaurant where we feasted on local sea food and frog legs, the evening wen on as such making five stops with the last being a local night bar with some life music out the late 60's. A great evening enjoyed by our group of 12, all felt it was amazing. Go for it and enjoy, Your driver will take care of you considering your safety and ensure you have your raingear (supplied) on in case of a rain falls, and in case you shop for something enrolee he will store it for you in the carrier. on the Vespa.
The best way to see the city by far. Exhilarating the riders know what they are doing I feel truly safe the guides knowledge was excellent and just right in duration I can't recommend this enough😃😃

Just did the Glimpse of the Mekong tour with the cooking class and it was FANTASTIC!! Dat was our guide; he spoke impeccable English and made the trip so fun. The places we toured were truly off the beaten path - no tourists in sight, plus they were all local businesses and not big commercial factories. It was really nice to get out of the city and see the beautiful countryside surrounding Saigon. Can't recommend this company or tour enough.

My niece and I were picked up at the port from our cruise ship and driven to Ho Chi Minh. The driver Dong was prompt, courteous and pleasant. We arrived to be greeted by Thai and Hyung our drivers and our wonderful guide Diem. What a fantastic day. We had certain sights we wanted to see and Diem mapped out our best route. Through the streets we went safe and sound. Saw every sight we wanted and any that were on the way we did a quick drive by. Took many pictures, stopped for a cool drink and delicious lunch with a beer. Our driver met us on time with a big smile. They helped us with all our bags and shopping and delivered us to the port in perfect time. No need to take excursions from cruise ship. Book directly with Vespa. It's well worth it when you only have one day!

My husband and I booked this last minute so we could get a taste of the Vietnamese Culture and this was such a great experience! "Green Lantern" was such an amazing host...very good with English, knowledgable, a pleasure to be around, and full of energy and excitement. You can tell he really enjoys his job and wants all of his clients to have an enjoyable experience w/ lots of hands on with the Vietnamese local families. I made rice cakes, helped a local weave a bed mat, and we enjoyed a really nice seafood lunch at a restaurant right on the beach. This was our favorite experience outside of what we came for, which was of course the tailors :-).

So we took a trip to HaLong Bay and had a couple of days in Saigon. Big city, strange road rules and colorful past. But what to do? This all-inclusive morning tour on a Vespa is a must. Turned out to be the highlight. Tourgide Na shows us a real day in the Mekong Delta. Fresh air, (very) fresh food and friendly people sharing a bit of their lives. What an extraordinary way to learn about and experience a country.

Loved the city tour, great guide with a huge wealth of knowledge. Easy day sitting on the bike seeing the sights, lunch at the zoom cafe afterwards was superb also. Highly recommended as a half day attraction.

review_title: Vespa Adventures Mekong Delta Wildlife Tour
review_text:
We enjoyed this two day trip with Delta Adventures so much we are thinking about going back and doing it again.
The three of us drove our own scooters and our tour guide Lam and his 3 colleagues were incredibly helpful and diligent, making sure no one got separated. Always a guide at the front of the scooter group and a guide at the back. Also helping us on and off water ferries, filling up our scooters with fuel and generally doing their very best to ensure we were all taken care of. Lam was extremely knowledgeable about local customs and food. We stopped at loads of interesting sites (markets, farms making rice wine, temples, incense stick makers etc) and he found great local places for us to eat. The local food was so tasty and healthy. Lam was a super star, a really great guide.

We did the evening food tour and it was quite good. The food varieties was good although I had tried a lot of it before and as such was not blown away. The guide was friendly and seemed to know his way around.

review_title: An absolute must when in Saigon!
review_text: This was undoubtedly one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. The Vespa guides are totally professional, friendly, knowledgeable and make you feel entirely safe when dodging the mayhem of Saigon evening traffic. The food we sampled was out of this world and a great cultural experience. You've gotta do it if you're visiting Saigon! The culmination of the evening was visiting a local nightclub and feeling entirely welcome. Thank you so much to the great team of guys who looked after us. My husband and I felt entirely exhilarated after the experience.

We chose the 3 hour afternoon trip which included a picnic lunch at the agri fields.

The outlet manager Neil was very welcoming and entertaining (spent good amount of time explaining to us about life in Vietnam). Our drivers, Huy, Luyt, Quoc and Vien were very polite and cheerful. The tour guide Trinh was well informed and organized. We only eat Halal/Vegetarian food and they made sure we got Vegetarian for our picnic.

You can clearly feel that the tour organizers have spent considerable amount of time to choose attractions/ locations that best depict true Vietnamese culture, lilfestyle and cottage industry (something that I am sure that you would not find in other tours).

Definitely a must go!

Thinking there was no way we ever get on the back of a scooter in such chaotic traffic we did exactly that and felt safe the whole time. Our tour started at 6 pm where we were picked up at our hotel and introduced to our driver for the evening, we then toured the city on the Vespa and went to two eating places,sampling typical Vietnamese street food, including seafood and being shown how to make authentic rice paper rolls and pancakes. Chien our guide was informative and friendly. We ffinished up in a night club and was taken back to our hotel at 10.30. Absolutely recommend this tour.

We loved our adventure out of the concrete jungle onto the dirt roads and into the beautiful country side. A big thank you to Trinh and Luke as they skillfully took us on a ride to remember our trip to beautiful Vietnam. We visited the locals and enjoyed pancakes at the markets and noodles in the fields - so relaxing.

We enjoyed a great tour. Started off with lunch @ Vietnamese cafe, followed by a fun 1/2 day tour around the city. It poured rain for about 1/2 of the tour, but even in the rain it was fun (and they provided us with ponchos which kept us 90% dry). We brought our kids (ages 1.5 & 3.5) and they had a blast. Totally accommodating and felt very safe having them with us on the scooters.

review_title: Hoi An from a different angle
review_text: I have done many Vespa adventure rides and loved them all. This time I tried the adventure day tour. We took a small ferry to the Island of Cam Kim and drove along the waterfront and through beautiful rice fields and little villages. My highlight was the bamboo bridge ...created and maintained by a local family .. that was just so " Vietnam " like. We finished with a great seafood lunch on the beach with the waves at oyr feet. Great day... Will do it again.

My son and I are here for a week. I saw this online and knew I had to try it. I ride motorcycles back home, but living overseas makes it hard to do. We rode on the morning tour, making stops along the way at points of interest here in Ho Chi Minh city. The ride was about 4 1/2 hours. And included lunch at the end before taking us back to our hotel. They also offer a night ride which I will try next time here. Taking you to local food, and bars. Our tour guide was fantastic too, thank you!!!!

Fabulous experience for our family of four riding together in the thick of the Saigon traffic. Our delightful but cheeky hostess plied us with food and drink at each stop. Totally entertaining and we felt perfectly safe. Just don't give an email for each member of your party or they will all be pestered to give a review!
If there is one thing you do in HCMC - DO THIS!! It is fantastic and you will never see the city in this way otherwise.

Without doubt the highlight of our trip to vietnam. We were picked up at our hotel and brought by vespa to a bar for a drink or two, then we headed off on our vespa tour, we headed to a restaurant to try vietnamese food, then off again to another bar, then another bar, then off to hear some music and then another bar!!, there are over 2 million vespas on the road in ho chi min city and it was the most amazing experience to be traveling in the midst of all the mayhem, this tour is a must, such a fantastic experience, loved it.
Great food and trip. Only had two nights in Saigon so was a great trip to see the City and meet people as well. Highly Recommend.

review_title: Vespas in Hoi chi min City
review_text:
Fantastic evening,fantastic guide,incredible food
Vespa rides safe and loved by all from the 11 yr old upwards
One of the Highlights of the holiday!

My husband and I did the Saigon After Dark tour with Vespa Adventures and it was the highlight of our trip. From zooming around in the crazy traffic, to exploring new neighborhoods and their local dishes, having coffee at a speak easy and ending the night at a local club, we had so much fun and would recommend this to anyone and everyone visiting Saigon. Our tour guide was so nice and helpful as well.
Had a great time. Saw parts of saigon we wouldn't have otherwise. The food was excellent. Would really recommend it.

We did the "After Dark - Saigon tour" the last night in our trip... and it was the perfect closure of our vacation!!!!!
The tour was a lot of fun, loved that they take you to local places to experience street food but without pushing it too much, food was excellent and our group was great, we all had so much fun... I agree with one of the other reviewers... "you haven't seen Saigon until you have seen it after dark on the back of a Vespa"

Don't doubt it.. take this tour!
So much fun. Great way to see the city sights and more. The guide and drivers were knowledgable and friendly. First stop for complimentary food and drinks at Zoom Cafe.

review_title: A thrilling way to get the feeling of the City from a Vespa seat view
review_text: I only had one full day available in HCMC and am interested in cultural diversity and architecture. I chose the Vespa Adventure and it delivered as promised, the guide was knowledgeable and I enjoyed the "off the beaten path" approach to exploring the City

What a blast. We just got home from touring Vietnam from top to bottom and I have to admit that the Saigon tour after dark on the Vespas was one of the more memorable moments in a sea of memorable moments. Being immersed in the sights, sounds and the thick haze of exhaust that is Saigon takes the art of touring to a whole new level. We were fortunate enough to visit some of the local hangouts for both food and entertainment and once again these are simply things that you would not experience in any other way. Our guide and drivers were courteous and informative and certainly added to what was an already surreal experience. All the food and drinks were included so it was nice not to have to worry about any additional charges once the tour was complete. We managed to take some great photographs along the way but I have to tell you that the staff also did the same and provided these little treasures to us FREE of charge at the end of our tour. In fact we recently received an email with a few extra photos of that wonderful night. Who provides this kind of experience any more? Last word - you haven't seen Saigon until you have seen it after dark on the back of a Vespa.
We took two older teenagers on this ride and we all had a ball! Food was fine, drivers were excellent and variety of entertainment was fantastic. Highlight of our trip.

review_title: Excellent way to see Ho Chi Minh City by night!
review_text:
Wonderful way to see the city by night and experience the craziness of Vietnam's traffic while enjoying good Vietnamese food and company. The Ho Chi Minh city team of Vietnam Vespa Adventures was very professional and made us feel like home.
Totally recommend the experience! It's so worth the money!

review_title: Vespa Adventures - The best way to see Saigon, day or night!
review_text:
There is no better way to see Saigon, than on a vespa and be in amongst all the action.
I have never sat on the back of a bike before, so the thought of doing this in a city where bikes, cars, buses charge towards each other from all angles sounds quite daunting, even if at a low speed, but if you are going to do it, relax back on a vespa and this is the way!

I was recommended to do this tour by a friend, who knows the owner so I did the Saigon after dark tour on my third night. If you have a few days here, I would suggest that you do this after at least a day or two so you have climatised and have seen some of the sights, and the crazy traffic and lack of highway code are not much of a surprise.

Eric the guide was very good and spoke fluent English, my driver was experienced, safe and took very good care of his passenger. I must say sit back (holding on of course!), tune out everything around you and focus on the moment and you kind of let go, and go with the flow, it becomes a very enjoyable trip rather than a scary experience!

The tour is great value for money, it includes; pick up and drop off from hotel, welcome drinks, dinner and drinks, post dinner snack supper and drinks, coffee and drinks, bar and drinks... Photos, and over 4 hours of entertainment and local experiences, with local guides and you meet a few other tourists too.

You are not advised to use your smartphone or selfie stick when on the bike, they will take some photos for you and email you afterwards, which is a nice touch.

review_title: The evening tour was a highlight of the whole of Vietnam - amazing fun!
review_text: Our family of four had an amazing evening. We were picked up at the hotel and wizzed to a bar to meet 2 others for the evening with our own guide who was great fun and spoke excellent English. We raced - it probably was not that fast but it felt like it thanks to all the traffic - riding behind some very competent drivers on yellow vintage Vespas around Saigon. We visited 3 different restaurants, a quiet bar with local singers, and a club with an excellent Western band. There was drinks included in the cost at each visit. Great fun and worth every dong!

review_title: A different fun way to experience Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
This was a surprise trip from my wife. We were 8 touring Ho Chi Minh City for a true evening experience. The guide was very friendly and spoke perfect english. He made the evening go super smooth and full of nice surprises. The drivers were safe. Our kids 10 & 12 really enjoyed it and never felt worry about driving in the chaotic traffic of Saigon.
Will not give much details about the dinner experience to avoid spoiling the surprise but it was a great memorable experience and i definitely recommend it particularly if you are a large family or a group of friends regardless the age. The food served at the different stops was good and tasty. All positive !!!

Fabulous way to go round the city and see areas we would otherwise not. Charming drivers, felt very safe and all round a fulfilled evening. Delicious street food. Would advise, our teenager boys loved the rides.
FL from the UK

Superb evening from start to finish. Picked up from our hotel & delivered back after a fun filled evening. Great fun & amazing tearing around the streets of Ho Chi Minh city on the back of a Vespa. Very friendly, fun group leader & great Vespa drivers. Fabulous food, some of the best we had in Vietnam, sea food, spring rolls, amazing Vietnamese pancakes & as much as you wanted to drink. group of 6, all good fun. Terrific night, thoroughly recommend it. A buzzing city at night & no better way to be part of it than on the Vespa with the throngs of locals.
Everyone with his/her own driver. Amazing! Adrenaline on the streets of Saigon. Dress confortable, no bags. Enjoy the images, food and people around... And, of course, thousands of Vespas!

review_title: Fantastic Way to connect with Vietnam
review_text: I took a few tours with this operator in Cambodia so I was interested to compare. Well that's difficult because they are both highly professional companies that make every effort to ensure the tour is both fun educational and culturally sensitive. I chose to ride solo as I have an old Vespa myself so was keep to explore the Mekong riding. I did a short practical test and passed. Even if I didn't I would have had a great time. A great experience and big thanks to Mr Dat whose knowledge was greatly appreciated

review_title: Fantastic tour off the beaten track
review_text: My partner and I did the Mekong Delta trip which last for 6.5hrs. We were picked up at our hotel in the morn by our two vespa drivers and I must say I was a bit freaked out about how I would cope in the insane traffic, but once we were on the road I felt safe with our obviously very experienced drivers. We went out of the city and stopped at a number of interesting places, one being a market place where we wandered around and then had some seafood snacks which were delicious. No one at the market tried to sell us their wares, everyone was friendly and just busy going about their daily chores. We went down dusty tracks, saw how the locals live. Stopped at a ladies home where she spends all day making incense, earns about US$7 per day to feed her family of 5, all such hard working people. Our tour guide, Na, was wonderful, friendly, chatty, explained everything well and answered all our questions. The tour ended at a café where we shared a nice meal & were then delivered back to our hotel. A really enjoyable day, when we return to HCM in a couple of weeks we plan to do the night tour as well. Highly recommend :)

review_title: Awesome day adventure in the mekong
review_text: Had a great time with the Vespa adventure team. Highly recommend it!! Short tutorial on Vespa driving and sign a disclaimer and I was off riding my Vespa through Saigon. Very good English speaking tour guide great food and well run.

review_title: A change from the usual bus tours
review_text:
Well planned, first hand view of the rural life around HCMC. be prepared to sit for a long bike ride ;)
What i liked the most of the daytrip were stops at a fishmarket were we got to go around and interact with the hawkers, take pictures and eventually try some of the things there. Then we got to the ricewine factory, a temple, incense factory. It was good to see all that but those stops lacked real content (interaction with the locals, a real glimpse of the rural families). The guide explained well the culture and local customs.

We were taken to a few of Saigon's attractions with plenty of history learnt. Then we were taken to some back street markets which was a real eye opener and a great insight into a culture we were overwhelmed by. We (mum, dad & 2 teenage girls) thoroughly enjoyed the experience and our guides were fantastic.

Another fantastic day with these guys. We did a trip last year in Hoi An and my other half has been raving about it ever since. Accordingly we decided to do another trip in Ho Chi Minh. Our guide was Ha who was adorable. So friendly and informative. Despite the torrential rain at times the day ran very smoothly. After a short test and a bit of paperwork Roy was allowed to ride his own Vespa. (He is currently sat trying to search for one to buy on Trade Me!).
We did the Mekong Country Tour and it was great to get out of the city and see how the rural people live. We visited a shrimp farm, shrimp market, fish market, temple, jasmin stick makers etc. Fun packed and Ha explained everything. We took heaps of pictures and feasted like Kings with fishy snacks at the market and a banquet with beer for lunch.
My driver was so kind.....I've forgotten his name but he seemed to be the more senior of the drivers. Bless he helped me with my helmet everytime I put it on or took it off and helped me with the rain jacket like I was a princess.
Vietnam Vespa Adventures you have a lovely team. Cannot speak highly enough about them. We have recommended you to lots of people already and will continue to do so. Keep up the excellent work!

We went on the Siagon after dark tour on the recommendation of our hotel. What a lot of fun. This is one of the more expense tours to do in Vietnam. We felt it was great value for money and a definite bucket list experience. Great way to learn about the food/culture of Siagon.

review_title: Nice way to visit Mekong delta
review_text:
We did this trip with some friends, the drivers are really carefull and the guide speaks well english.
They take you on a tour around the Mekong delta, you visit small villages, shrimpfarms, a local market, a beautifull temple, and a small manufacturer of ricewine and another of ensent sticks. But no tourist traps, the people didnt even have stock on hand to sell us.
The food served at the lokal market was delicious. You experience driving on a bike in HCMN great!

review_title: Ideal introduction to Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
Do this on your first or second day in the city. It's a great way to get a taste for the city and to acclimatise to the insane traffic. I took the half-day morning tour but I expect the other tours would be equally enjoyable.

What I liked was we didn't just see the usual touristy sights - we also went to several out-of-the-way spots. And we went to quite a few different locations so you feel like you are getting value for money.

Plus it was super-safe. At no time did I feel in danger, despite the crazy traffic.

I was told about this by a friend who done a tour with them and enjoyed the tours with them as 1 was chu chi tunnel and saigon after dark i do recommend to do tours with this company as nothing isn't to much trouble and very informative guides and there staff at the cafe are very helpful and friendly

The vespa tour "Saigon after dark" is definitely worth every cent. We were collected from our hotel, even though it was a little out of the way and taken to Cafe Zoom to meet our leader Kimmy and the others in our group. This tour is so much fun. Weaving in an out amongst the local traffic gives you the opportunity to feel like a local, smile with them and even have brief conversations when you are waiting at traffic lights. Each stop we were served delicious food and local beers....so much food and then finished the evening with cocktails at a local nightclub. Very entertaining. Our vespa drivers were gorgeous...my little fella spoke hardly any English but treated me like a Queen. These tours, whether you book during the day or evening, are worth every cent you pay and so much fun. We will definitely book another Vietnam Vespa Adventure Tour next time we are in Vietnam. Thanks again for the fantastic night.

review_title: Geoff & Diane H The insiders Saigon
review_text: The most amazing experience we have ever done. It is definately a must do. A wonderful insight into the real Ho Chi Minh. The riders and guides are very special and their knowledge is outstanding. We cant wait for our next Vespa adventure.

review_title: Best thing we did in Saigon
review_text: We did a morning tour today with Lam and his guys - was the best way to see the city and felt incredibly safe the whole time. Locations were great as it took you out of the main tourist areas and got to see the heart of local Saigon. Would highly recommend it to anyone - one of the best experiences we had in Vietnam!!

Wow. Not to be missed. Worth every cent. All staff so very obliging. Super friendly. A total experience. Loved the music venues. ( very underground type) plenty to eat(well explained) . Plenty to drink... instantly booked mekong delta tour. Fabulous too. If you only have 24 hrs in saigon do these 2 tours. Cheap at the price fir the experiences...so impressed we also booked 2 tours in Hoi anh.. fab too

I booked via phone from my hotel in HCMC the day before. They took my details told me to wait in the foyer of my hotel which I did. And was early. And they didn't show. Very unprofessional. They ruined my last full day in Vietnam and spoilt my chance of visiting the Mekong. Would not recommend

I was very skeptical about doing this tour but a friend convinced me we should do it. Once on the vespa's it was amazing. Getting in there amoungst all the traffic and the people was so much fun. They don't actually go very fast, so it's quite safe.
The pitstops along the way were really great. They take you to places where most of the locals eat. The food was great and heaps of it.
The only down fall with this tour was that they took us to a place that was like opera singing and we were only allowed 1 drink. It wasn't a very enjoyable place.
The the last place they took us was to a nightclub. We had a great night with lots of dancing but again we were limited to 2 drinks. When we asked if we could stay longer, the tour guy was very rude and told us we were too far from our hotel to get our own way back.
The tour itself is very good but I think it's a bit pricey for what you get.

Today we went on the Mekong Vespa day trip with a cooking class. This is a fantastic way to see the countryside south of HCMC. Dat and his boys were always accommodating and we learnt a lot at all the spots. A must do in this amazing city. If you are a weary traveler these guys have got it right with drink and pee stops at all the right spots!! Make the most of the beers at lunch lol!

Yes not scary AT ALL! REALLY! We are both in our 60's and had an absolute ball on the night Vespa tour. I felt very safe in the hands of my driver, things look scary at times but the drivers are highly experienced in the conditions, so just relax and trust them! Our guide was excellent and fun to be with, and the locations of the food and entertainment truely obscure. There was no way you were ever going to uncover these places by yourself. I highly recommend this to anyone who visits Saigon!
Wonderful experience. A great way to see Saigon from another point of view. We went through small villages and did not cross any tourist. Very authentic tour, just like what we were looking for.

review_title: What a way to see Saigon!!
review_text: We were a family of 4 on the last evening of our trip to Vietnam and what a way to finish a holiday. Yet again an activity in this country which surpassed our expectations. As a 50+ lady I did not want to be left behind by my boys. We had a fantastic time. We did the night tour and we went to a range of varied restaurants and music venues. Once I had relaxed you could start enjoyiong the city at night and what a way to see it. We had complete trust in our couriers and our guide Duane was so enthusiatic about his city and the food. We tried food we would never have dared order if we had been on our own and went to places which you would not have visited on foot. A super experience one not to be missed.

review_title: A great way to see outside Saigon City
review_text:
We found these guys though Trip adviser and the Day tour was all it promised to be. The guys were great from the moment they picked us up from the hotel and took us to meet up with the rest of the group. A quick riding test and given a great little Vespa and away we went. The tour is great if you can ride and want your own bike or my wife went Pillion with one of the guys who looked after her the whole day.

Our guide spoke great English and provided an overview and information at every stop. Plenty of drinks and food provided and back at the Hotel by 3pm. Although a little expensive it is well worth the cost for the days tour.

review_title: What a way to see the city!
review_text: I'm really pleased that I booked a tour with these guys. The whole experience was really well organised and I felt safe throughout, even in the barking mad Saigon traffic. I did the afternoon tour as that was what fitted in best with my available time - the morning session would probably have been a bit cooler and the evening food tour more lively if I had had the time. It was very interesting to see another side of Saigon and to explore some of the less touristy streets. The free lunch at the Zoom cafe was good too. All credit to my guide Dat for proving such an interesting and informative afternoon.

review_title: Great concept, really promissing but so dissapointed
review_text: The idea of going through the city on the back of a bike was really exciting, as you would immerse yourself in the city as a real Saigonese. However if the idea is brilliant, the execution is not as good. First they claim you will be on the back of classic vespas. Well this is not exactly true since you are on the most modern versions of the Vespas (70's and 80's), not the real vintage ones. But that does not really matter. What really matters is that you will spend very few time on the road. I was expecting to discover the small alleys, the real underground Saigon, the neighborhood. Well this is not the case. You will spend most of your time on your plastic chair in the street having a beer with ice (quit local experience indeed) or some street food. Not unpleasant, but not as promising. All in all for a price that is really not cheap. Well, disappointed yes.
A great fun night out on the back of a Vespa. Enjoy the food and the city, get to see some interesting places with knowledgeable guides. A must do!

review_title: A wonderful way to see Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
Although slightly nervous about jumping on the back of a Vespa and being whisked through the mad streets we couldn't have been safer.
A really great way to see the city and at the end of the tour finishing in a local nightclub was perfect.

review_title: A bloody good day nd night
review_text:
Lots of fun great drivers do not miss this!! Don't drink to much Saigon lager! It's good though.
A fun and hair raising trip to places you will never visit on an upmarket tour.

We heard about this from a couple before we left and decided to book the vespa tour in once we arrived. The day/night of the vespa tour it was raining heavily so we were not to sure about doing it but we ended up doing the tour.

What was great was every time we jumped on the bikes the rain stopped but to be honest once your on the bike you just don't care. Its such a good view to be out on the bikes and among the locals. The vespa adventures had rain jackets if you would like to wear one.

I'm a pretty fussy eater so I wasn't overly confident i would like the food but by the end of it i was amazed.

Each driver of the vespa adventures are smooth riders and make you feel safe on the road.

I highly recommend doing this tour as it was the top highlight of our week long stay in Ho Chi Minh.

Excellent work Vietnam Vespa Adventures Day Tours.

Thanks, Damien

So many great trips to choose from, we selected the Insider's Saigon tour so we could see the city highlights with a guide. What a fantastic experience. A great lunch at Café Zoom (delicious) and then whizzing all over Saigon on the back of the classic Vespas. My husband and I had no problem using the Go Pro and camera while on the move. Our guide was very knowledgeable with great English and we felt very safe with our drivers, despite the chaotic traffic. It's hard to choose a trip when you have limited time but I think any of their trips would be a great fun experience. Don't let the price put you off, the trip is unique and worth it. I highly recommend this to any traveler.

review_title: why I fell in love with HCMC
review_text: Best experience ever! I strooooooooongly recommend this to everyone that's travelling to HCMC. I opted for the night tour and it was the perfect way to see the city. When I arrived I thought HCMC was just a sleepy town, but VVADT showed me the real side of the city and how vibrant it was. From amazing neighbourhood restaurants to hidden cafes and music bars, this was the reason why I fell in love with HCMC.

Wow, what an amazing experience! We are a family of 4, and had the most fun we think of our hole holiday. Our guide was charming with brilliant English and the variety of food and locations we were taken to was fantastic. Seeing the city like this at night was amazing, and I would recommend it to anyone and everyone. The adrenaline was brilliant, we loved every minute of it !!!!!

We did the night tour and it was the best way to get up close and personal with HCMC and see parts that you would not do as a tourist. From the moment we were picked up from our hotel we had so much fun. The food along the way was excellent and right down to the last stop a night club with cocktails included we could not stop laughing. The riders were very safe and went out of the way to make sure you felt comfortable. Even with some rain along the way it did not dampened the experience. Cannot recommend this enough one of the best adventures we have done on our travels around the world. Would definitely do this again next time in Vietnam!

What fun we had! A brilliant way to experience Saigon and the food it has to offer, as well the mad traffic! We did the evening tour and it was fantastic from beginning to end. We had a lovely young guide, who was very knowledgable about Saigon's history and the food. The food we had was absolutely delicious, and so different to experience street cafes rather than smart restaurants. The tour ended with a couple of surprises - a visit to a supper club type of venus for coffee which featured a delightful Vietnamese singer accompanied by a pianist and violinist, followed by a last drink at a music club with a brilliant rock band. What a night! One of the highlights of our time in Vietnam and Cambodia.
Saigon after dark - the best tour we've ever done. Loved it from start to finish - a real must on any visit HCMC.

We did the night tour - what an unreal experience! Sitting on the back on the Vespa weaving through local traffic and not once did we feel unsafe. The drivers were absolutely professional. The night tour is all about the food, and we tried seafood dishes (including frog) at a local restaurant. Highly recommend this attraction to anyone that wants to see the city in a different light.
A great way to see parts of the city you wouldn't normally see on the tourist trail. Felt very safe and loved the mix of stops - restaurants and music venues. Very friendly guide and drivers.

Fantastic experience and definitely a highlight and always felt safe but a thrill at the same time.
The tour guide "You" was informative as well as fun and the Vespa riders were safe and concerned for your well being.
The tour took you to places where there were no other tourists.
A++++

We join the night tour and we were absolutely satisfied with the great organization during all the tour, riders drive very quite with no sensation of danger in any moment. But it's also fun riding trough Saigon with new friends surrounded by locals in their bikes. Food is also a key point as you will eat in authentic restaurants where locals eat in districts far away from tourists. I would really recommend it as a authentic experience far away from the typical walking around the city center.

review_title: Rarely are things as good the second time...
review_text: This should be compulsory for all foreign visitors to HCMC! Our group of friends did the foodie night tour around HCMC 12 months ago and loved it so much we organised to fly back for one night only to do it all again this year! I actually think it was better the second time! Not only do you eat the most fabulous food, but sitting the back of a vespa allows you to capture the vibe, sounds, and smells of one of the most exciting cities I've visited. It is truely the best way to see the city. If you are travelling with children too it would be fabulous. Be assured you are very well looked after and very safe. We were treated like family by the whole team at Vietnam Vestpa Adventure. Thank you to all team at Vietnam Vespa Aventures for showing us the most wonderful time....again!

review_title: Saigon by night foodie tour- DO IT!
review_text: We can't recommend this highly enough. So much fun! The guides are excellent, friendly and informative. Despite the hectic roads we felt safe the whole time and you get such a buzz whizzing around the city. The places they take you are authentic, the food fresh and delicious. We never felt like we'd been taken to somewhere that claimed to be authentic but was actually touristy. You would never find these spots just walking about on your own. Great value for money and our favourite activity during the holiday.
We (family of 4 including 2 boys 11 and 14) took the Saigon nightlife tour and were thrilled with the experience. The best introduction to Saigon. An absolute must.

review_title: Amazing Day on the Mekong Delta
review_text: We had a great tour by Vespa adventure. We enjoyed seeing the Mekong Delta and learning about the local people. The tour guide was amazing - he spoke perfect English, educated us on Vietnam, and he was fun. We did the cooking tour and I highly recommend this. The food was incredible, and it was a really fun way to learn about Vietnamese cooking.

review_title: A great fun night out with teenagers!
review_text: We were recommended to use Vespa Adventures and we had a fabulous night out! We were picked up on the Vespa's by our 4 drivers and requested that they kept our 2 daughters aged 12 & 14 in front of us so we could see them. On from the Zoom bar we were grouped with a couple and had Lucy as our host. We had a blast from start to finish - the food was varied with great authentic recipes over the 5 stops - including 2 music stops one with traditional modern Vietnamese and a rock bar at the end. We had a rain shower but were immediately provided with ponchos . They took photos which were simply e mailed to us the next morning. Felt very friendly, fun and safe and our girls loved every minute. Worth every penny!

Had another great tour by Vespa adventures. Truly adventurous!
Glimpse of the Mekong gives real insight in life in/on the Mekong Delta. Excellent drivers and guide!

If you visit Saigon, the city with not so many historical monuments, book the tour with Vespa Tours, and you will not feel sorry. A team of bikers will take you around Saigon, show you incredible Vietnamese cuisine and culture. The best thing about this tour is it lets you feel the vibe of the city, the vibe which is unique in Vietnam.

I was recommended Vespa Tours and I am really glad I booked it. I did a Glimpse of the Mekong with a cooking class. It was good fun from the first minute! Visited non-touristy areas, very interesting villages and markets. The cooking class was easy and fun, loads of tasty nice food. All food and drinks included. I was curious about certain exotic fruits and they even bought some so I could try them. Very well organised. But the best was our tour guide, Na. She was brilliant, gave us very good information, was entertaining and a very good driver. Had a fantastic day! Totally recommended.

review_title: Vespa tour of Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
Probably the most expensive pillion tour of Ho Chi Minh but well worth the money. You have to remind yourself that 1.4 million Dong is £41. But you get a main course dish and a drink included that could be worth up to £8 whatever you order. The tour itself is 4-5 hours, which suddenly means you're paying about £8 an hour.

The tour guide is knowledgeable and funny, and actually quite cute if you get Dien (Jen). She drops in her own experiences as a Vietnamese of Chinese descent and even though she must do it ten times a week she still looks embarrassed when explaining what "happy water" is in the Chinese medicine shop.

Best thing about my tour was that it started pissing down with rain with thunder and lightning in the last hour. Although I actually thought my death might be imminent at every road bend and junction, if you rise above this and embrace the fact of ubiquitous mortality it's one hell of a trip. I was on an actual adrenaline high by the end.

You should bear in mind that in Ho Chi Minh road rules like not driving on pavements, driving on the right side of the road, not driving at high speed through marketplaces, stopping at traffic lights etc seem to be considered "guidelines".

The Zoom cafe where they're based itself is great, with delicious food and 2-for-1 cocktails and free (and reliable) wifi. They'll even give you a free beer if you like them on Facebook.

My only regret is that I wasn't wearing a gopro. And body armour.

review_title: Lots of fun - and loads of food!!
review_text:
This tour has a really high rating for a reason - it is really good!!! My wife bought the night tour for us to celebrate our wedding anniversary. The rain came down hard and set in for 2 hours before we before we began. Was tempted to cancel but the operator assured us they could cope with the weather issue. 2 efficient oilskins later we were off, weaving through the Saigon puddles and traffic with ease. We each had an assigned driver who clearly knew how to handle a scooter. We were swiftly taking photos and shooting video from the pillion!! The tour advertises as inclusive of all food and drink for $90USD. Food-wise - few will come away disappointed. I was stuffed and tried many different Vietnamese cuisines with explanations on etiquette and content from our guide Tuan. My wife has a restricted diet and the tour really tried hard to cater for her particular needs - a big tick on a special day. In terms drinks, there is a limit per each one of the 4 stops but it is probably reasonable given the potential risks of (1) coming off the back of the bike or more likely (2) splitting at the seams as the sheer volume of food and drink takes its toll!!!

The stops were a seafood restaurant, a pancake restaurant, a coffee club and a live band night. Great variety - enjoyed the Vietnamese violinist performing "Delilah" and the rock band doing a cover of "Counting Stars". The only negative comment I saw on this blog prior was about a negative comment from a guide about the size of the tip. Our guide humbly said thanks and goodbye and shot off so quickly I hadn't even managed to get appropriate notes out of my pocket to leave him anything at all. Thanks Tuan - and Vespa adventures.............we had a ball. Recommended.
Excellent service we had 5 stops on the Vespar ride . All very varied , felt very safe with driver . A very professional set up

review_title: Top Tour of our entire trip
review_text: If you want to experience something that you've never experienced before then we highly suggest you take the Vespa Night Tour in Ho Chi Minh City. 100% one of the most memorable times our family of 5 experienced. Our vespa drivers were so attentive to our needs and the places we were taken were spots that you will never have seen on your own. Whisking through the streets of Vietnam on a vespa...we highly recommend.
