What can I say, we only had 2 nights to spare in HMC and I am so glad we chose the Vespa adventure as it was brilliant - probably the best night out we've had for ages (bar our wedding night!!)

The Vespa and driver collected us from the hotel where we drove off to meet our guide at the first food place. Our guide Dieu was fantastic and clearly the best guide we've had on our 3 week holiday.

In-between the ride through the city we stopped off at a number of fantastic food places and our guide was brilliant at explaining the food and customs.

We had such a great time and would highly recommend this - my face is still aching from smiling so much!

By far the best thing we did in Vietnam. From start to finish great evening. You are taken around HCMC at speed on back of an original Vespa stopping at restaurants and nightspots for food and music. Lasts about 3 1/2 hours but we could have carried our for much longer !

We recently did the night city tour. We were so impressed with the divers riding skills. We felt very safe. We ate and drank many delicious foods and drinks. It was great to try the local cuisine and learn about how Vietnamese people eat. Our guide, Lo-an, was very fun and friendly and was very knowledgable. It was nice of her to share information about her own life and experience. We had fun on the bikes too and couldn't stop smiling. It was great to ride through the city with the people of Ho Chi Minh. Fantastic adventure. Would do it again!

Can't recommend this tour highly enough. My daughter had been to Ho Chi Minh earlier in the year and hadn't found it to be a terribly exciting city. After coming with the family on this tour recently, she assessed it very differently. Our guide was second to none and was so well prepared and the drivers are wonderful. We were on a cruise doing SE Asia so had prebooked this private Secret Saigon tour before we left. They even arranged transport for us from the ship with a van and driver. Everything ran seamlessly and we covered in a day what others might have done in several days. Great city overview, exciting, informative with great historical insights and one of the most memorable tours we've ever done.

The BEST way to see Ho Chi Minh city by night and eat and drink as locals do! Great to have your own guide, as well as bike rider, who is happy to chat and give more of an insight into the city and its inhabitants.

My husband and I did both the Angkor and Foodie Tours and it was a fabulous experience. We are both in our seventies and we were well catered for. The Angkor tour was an experience to be remembered, our guide pointing out the history. Water was provided throughout the day and the scooters were always on time to pick us up to transfer us to another place. Lunch was very special and a typical Cambodian meal. There were young children in our party and they were given different foods if necessary.
Kim was our guide on the Foodie Tour and we were taken to places we would never have found on our own. We ate at the markets and tried everything, it was very interesting and Kim is a wonderful guide.
I strongly recommend this company - the scooter drivers were very safety conscious and we always felt comfortable.
Something I would do again and wondered if they visited other venues as it was just such a great thing to do. Never once felt scared!
It was a great time!! The food places we went were amazing and very much local, we did not see many tourists around. It was a wonderful and exhilarating time :)

We did a tour of the Mekong Delta with a cooking class.

It was just my son and me, two drivers and the guide. This was the first tour we did in Vietnam and I think the guide was the best of all the tours we did. His english was good and talking to him felt more like chatting with a friend than listening to a lecture.

Scooters in the city is a crazy experience but we got out to the country side pretty quickly. Then we stayed on back roads got a really great feel for rural Vietnam. In some cases the roads were just paths. We went over quite a few narrow bridges and we took one ferry.

We made a lot of stops. We looked at a shrimp farm, a market, a temple, a place were they were making incense. Other times we just stopped to have drinks and rest.

The cooking class was fine. It was held in a open air space next to the river. The techniques were pretty basic, sautéing shrimp for example, but the result was quite tasty. A very pleasant way to have lunch.

This is the "must do" activity in HCMC. Forget the tacky tours to the Mekong, book a trip with these guys. We popped into Cafe Zoom and explained to Na that we wanted to spend the day down in the Mekong and wanted to see a bit of real life, no tourist traps, no cheesy activities, and we wanted to taste a bit of real local food. Na assured us that that was what we'd get to do. The next day, Na and her crew arrived at our hotel (on time!) and we met up with the only other traveler that was on our day trip. I understand the groups can be bigger, but we were lucky. The day was fantastic, we traveled down back roads, crossing little bridges across the rivers, passing through tiny villages and visiting small local sites, and we got to eat some great local food. Na was fantastic (as were her whole team), her English was perfect, she had a fantastic relaxed nature, was informative, never pushy. An absolute highlight of our trip to Vietnam! I have nothing negative to say about this company and I wish Na all the best, keep up the good work.

This tour was so much fun. The traffic is insane so it's great to have a driver. The food was excellent and the venues visited were really good. I don't think we would have found these places if not for the tour. Worth every cent and would highly recommend.

review_title: Day tour of the Mekong countryside !!
review_text:
Got my motorcycle license before going on tour since I wanted to ride my own vespa so getting some experience would help in the the crazy chaotic Vietnam traffic. Considering it was the second time I rode a motorized bike in my life, I opted for the automatic transmission scooter - a manual would have been suicide !! Note that riding your own bike is optional. If you want to ride you own bike, they will give you a small proficiency test around the block. Otherwise you'll ride with the tourd guide, or they will provide a driver and tour guide.

So about the tour, this is an excellent tour, but that really depends on the tour guide, and less so, the weather conditions. Many stops along the way from small villages, temples, and traditional businesses (NOT tourist traps) as well as food and water breaks. This tour reveals the real daily life of Vietnam countryside. When I say businesses, one such business is family run incense fabrication, and another is a shrimp farm, the lunch stop is a large fishing market/village. Definitely do this tour !!!

A suggestion, if you have a GoPro, slap a 64 GB card inside, bring lots of batteries (I brought 5) and bring a few helmet mounts and backup tethers (these are all cheap on amazon). Here's a track of road that was under construction (unbeknowst to my tour guide) - all part of the adventure !! https://youtu.be/qRjdLqks2Qo
My tour guide Dat was awesome - I forgot a gopro harness and he mailed it to me express so that it was waiting for me at my hotel when I reach Hanoi later in my tour !! I wanted to repay him but he said don't worry about it and enjoy your tour !! Dat, my friend, thank you very much !!!

review_title: Stunning way to see the city
review_text: This was a wonderful adventure which took us to parts of the city that we would not have seen otherwise.

Once again a fabulous tour. An absolute must when visiting HCMC. Our guide Son and all the drivers were amazing. Felt very safe on the back of the bike. Food was delicious as well. All in all a fantastic night.

Vespa ride was exhilarating way to explore some highlights of Saigon. Trip leaders terrific. Heavy rain during our trip but they ensured everyone remained safe. Food interesting and local drinks generous

review_title: Evening tour of Ho Chi Minh by vespa ! Hold onto your helmets !
review_text: Great experience. Bit hairy in early evening traffic with vehicles flying from all directions as you try to find your balance, this is the safe way to experience street food and Saigon life. Five visits with buzzy vespa rides between: little aperitif, street cafe, little street restaurant and coffee shop cabaret ending with a cocktail bar with live music. All food n drink included and a chance to talk with the guide about Vietnamese life. Really nice evening. Worth the cost.

review_title: Excellent Way To Get Right Into The Mix In Ho Chi Minh
review_text: We did an evening tour and was very impressed. The tour guides and drivers were very experienced, knowledgeable and good fun. They made a good night even better. The food we sampled on the way was interesting and you definitely didn't need anything to eat by the end. We felt 100% safe at all times and would highly recommend this to anyone.

If you really want to experience the local flavor and sights Ho Chi Minh City aka Saigon, Vietnam, you need to book the Vespa tour. The company personnel were marvelous. The local food eateries with memorable. The coffee shop and bar stops provided top-notch entertainment.
The best way to see Saigon! Great food and we had a fantastic guide - Sandy, who was super friendly.

This was one of the highlights of my trip to Vietnam!!

We were picked up by the Vespa drivers for the After Dark tour, who were extremely sweet and helped us out with our helmets, all the while telling us to be careful with our bags once on the Vespa.

We went to our first stop where we were introduced to our guide who then set us up with 3 locals. We spent the entire tour as a group and it was wonderful meeting such lovely people!

Vespa is an amazing way to see the city. Especially when the attractions are drenched in light at night!

I'll never forget the quaint little cafe we went to where the awesome singer made me cry with his spellbinding voice.. Nor will I forget the club after that where we went absolutely crazy. And the food, oh my God, so yummy!!

The tour guides were nice enough to drop us off at a destination of our choice after the tour got over.

Will definitely recommend this! Brilliant experience, loads of fun!!

review_title: See the parts of Ho Chi Minh, that are hidden. Best experience!
review_text: Awesome fun, loved the guides, incredible food....don't eat breakfast, or you wont fit it all in. Get your adrenaline hit on a safe scooter. Didnt want it to end! So many sides to one city in one night.
The best day in Hoi-an. Fun and excitement experienced cruise along with Vespa!! Well trained and high experienced drivers (Ben, Duy, Thuan and Nhan) thank you 👍. We had so much fun!!!

Having heard positive things by word of mouth, we arranged to take the night time food experience on one of our last nights during our stay. We had already explored HCMC a lot during the holiday and I didn't have high expectations of seeing areas that we hadn't already seen... but I was entirely wrong!

Our bikes picked us up from where we were staying and once you're over the initial terror of writing a vespa (first time on anything with two wheels and an engine!), it is totally thrilling and the by far the best way to travel around HCMC. The drivers were safe, fun, and very engaging. We joined the other tourers at a bar where we discovered that not only was food included but all of our drinks as well - perhaps this is the point I should have realised that I would have a headache the next day!

The drive was exhilarating and so much fun. I discovered a whole new perspective to HCMC's roads (for example, why wait at a crowded interchange when the pavement would do!), and saw a lot more of the traditional streets that I hadn't yet explored. The food was excellent and our host was brilliant; she stayed with us during the whole tour and made sure we were kept supplied with food and drink. Our final destination was a great bar with a brilliant atmosphere and live music. Again, our tour guide made sure we were comfortable and stayed with us until the end of the evening when our vespa's drove us to wherever we wished to go.

It was an amazing experience, felt like good value for money, and a brilliant way to end our holiday. This is highly recommended!

review_title: Ho Chi Minh food experience by night on Vespa - GREAT!
review_text: This was one of our highlights of our short weekends in HCMC. Being picked up at our hotel by three vespas - and then toured around town from 6pm to 10.30 pm visiting amazing food places with an extraordinary local guide Lou-Ann (sorry if spelling is wrong!) Vespa tours is a must to try when in HCMC!

It all started with being picked up at the hotel by the guide and his Vespa.. I was told that it was gonna be me and one other guy only so small group tour witch was fine with me .. less stress and more enjoying the countryside...
We started out by going to District 7 on the back of the Vespa so we could try out to see if we could drive by ourselfs..
Didn't go so well for me with the Vespa so i got a automatik bike (Vespa is with gear shifting)
We went off on our own motorbike .. the thing i was worried about was how crowded the streets would be where we were gonna drive.. But we went outside the big roads so there was no trouble driving what so ever :)
Our guide spoke perfect english had no trouble undestanding him and all my questoins was answerd without any problems..
We had a amazing snack (snails and scallops) the other guy and me ate anything we were served so it was easy...
We saw things at the market you would never see in the city center markets ... and the visited diffrent family buisness for shrimp, rice, essens and rice wine and a temple with a religion ive never heard of before (quite new religion compared to the rest)
The lunch was really good and i had alot of fun with the other person on the tour .. The guide offered us extra beer when we were finished eating and we relaxed and had fun.. No stress no pressure on time so everything was perfect..
Eventhough we both forgot out suncream and got some nice lobster necks and arms...

review_title: A great ans adventerous way to see Vietnam
review_text: We schedules an evening in Saigon with Vespa Tours on a whim and a coupon. We were guided by very gentle, kind friendly and expert drivers that took us to wonderful places that we never would have found on our own for a reasonable price. We got all that we wished for and more!

We went on the Mekong Delta day trip which was absolutely fantastic. Na was our guide and she was very knowledgeable...shared a lot of insights and was great company for the whole day. From pickup to drop off these people look after you with impeccable hospitality and you can feel safety is the major concern the whole way through.

This simply has to be the highlight of our 3 week visit to Vietnam. We took our 2 teenage children on the 'After Dark' street tour, that includes stopping for drinks, supper and visiting the most amazing cafe with live music (French feel) and a bar with loud rock music - brilliant.

We had a ball. Having also visited Hanoi, we were in awe with the millions (no exaggeration) of scooters weaving around the city of Ho Chi Minh, swarming like insects but with such control. To have been taken out to experience such a journey was incredible, our drivers was safe, never did we feel we were at risk and we absolutely loved our experience.

Worth every single penny - a must if in either Ho Chi Minh, Hanoi (or another other Vietnamese city that they tour in!).

Booked a tour to the Mekong Delta and cooking class. Riding on vespa is THE way to travel and see HCMC, just like the locals. While you're not allowed to drive it yourself, it was still fun. My driver was safe and friendly. Our tour guide spoke very fluent English and was super friendly and knowledgeable. You could tell that he enjoys his job. Our group only had about 8 people which made it intimate and we were able to interact like friends. Vietnam is HOT, so make sure you lather up with a lot of sun screen because most of the trip you'll be exposed to the sun. The cooking class was fun, but if you are already familiar with Vietnamese cooking and cuisine, then you might not enjoy it as much. Overall a great experience because the vespas were so cool! They have a night food tour too, which I think sounds like a lot of fun too.

review_title: Safe fun playing in the traffic, as well as eating and drinking in HCMC
review_text:
We booked this tour on the recommendation of one of my wife's friends when she found out we were going, so it wasn't on our original list of things to do in and around HCMC.
We had three in our group - wife, myself (early 50's) and son 17.
I ride a motorbike at home so had no worries about getting on the VESPA, but knew we had picked the right people when we were picked up at our Hotel. Clean and well maintained looking scooters and good communication skills from our 'drivers'. My wife was very comfortable as she is my pillion passenger at home and the 17 yo is, well 17 so he was fine.

We had a great tour starting with drinks and an evenings activities briefing session and met another couple with their 20yo daughter from Melbourne that we moved from venue to venue with.
The food at all stops was very good - allowing us to be more adventurous with locations and food types - think frogs etc here - than what we had been.
The last two stops were highlights as they were venues we would never have found - great atmosphere and music.
Would highly recommend these guys and this tour and we would do it again if back in HCMC.

We recently enjoyed the Vespa night tour in Saigon. It was a highlight of our trip to Vietnam. Pickup at our hotel was prompt and our drivers were fantastic. We were whisked off to the Vespa Cafe for drinks ,snacks and to meet the other 3 people in our group as well as our lovely hostess. The evening was clearly explained then we were off on a sightseeing trip around district one and other areas with stops at various food places to try different and interesting dishes. As much as you can eat and drink was the order of the night with a surprise stop at a "secret Romatic Coffee joint" and ending the night at a local nightclub where the place was jumping. This trip took us to places we would never see on our own and was heaps of fun. we are in our 50-60's but there didn't seem to be any age limit on this trip with children included up to the very old. Defiantly for the Young at heart I would highly recommend this trip to all those visiting Saigon.

review_title: My family loved the mix of the old bikes and street food
review_text: We did the Saigon by Night tour and like the mix of seafood restaurant (with frogs legs), vietnamese pancakes (Banh Xeo), coffee shop and live music bar with cocktails. The Coffee shop did forget to give two guests their icecream but this was a minor mistake... Loved the Acoustic bar finale that our guide accomodated at my request.

My traveling companion and I wanted to see some of the sights of HCMC rather than sit in the airport during our long layover. We contacted Vietnam Vespa Adventures to request pickup and dropoff at the airport, plus a quick tour. To our delight, they got back to us quickly with a YES!

Arranging the tour online with Ha was very easy. When our flight was delayed about an hour and a half, we wondered whether they still would be waiting for us. Sure enough, we were met with a wonderful gentleman holding a name board. He then led us to two awaiting vintage Vespas and we began our tour.

Scooting around the city by motorbike is the perfect way to avoid traffic and pack in as many sights and sounds as possible in a short period. Our tour guide and drivers were extremely friendly and professional, and we felt completely safe riding through the streets with them.

And, as promised, they got us back to the airport exactly on time, and our guide even escorted us to the International terminal.

Highly recommended!

review_title: Great way to see Ho Chi Minh and experaince local foods
review_text:
This is great experience a great way to see the City and experience Local Cuisine! Worth doping early in the trip as it gives you a good view of the city and the happening places so you can venture back on your own.

Completely safe you are provided with helmets etc and drivers definitely know what they are doing, it is by far the best way to get around the city!

Food has a wide variety for all tastes and there is plenty to go around including drinks!

We arrived in Saigon and within an hour we were like all the locals - on the back of a vespa! The tour was amazing - cruising through the streets of Saigon and weaving in and out of the traffic was exhilarating and the food was really good. We were promptly picked up at our hotel and headed for cocktails - we then were driven past the sights to a local restaurant where we were given a selection of local food with the beer flowing. My teenagers were perplexed by the "jumping chicken" we were served - one did try the frog's legs which were very tasty.
We then went on to savor some street food before going to a coffee house where we were treated to some of the most amazing solo performers - before topping off the night at night club with live music and delicious cocktails!
Definitely would recommend doing this tour to get a taste of Saigon.....

The evening Vespa tour is such a great way to see Ho Chi Minh. The drivers are safe and considerate and the venues varied and interesting. You really do get to see a whole different side to the city and life of Vietnamese people.

Where to start,I went on the Friday nite food tour and had a blast.I was picked up at my hotel and went to the starting point.We drove around HCMC for a half an hour through the traffic on the back of a vespa,what a rush!!! We went to 4 differnt places to eat and drink and mingle with the locals.the food was great and the drivers are the best.I would highly encourage everybody to give it a try.

Saigon after dark is wonderful tour:
- Itinerary is very suitable & interesting.
- Mr. Khanh (driver) & Ms. Chi are friendly & enthusiasm.
- Food is delicious & too much for me

Great way to look around, friendly tour guides and lots of laughs. Food was amazing.
Can't wait to do it again.

Very nice experience
The trip to do when you visite Saigon
Very safe (in spite of traffic)
Good organisation
It is not looking as only a tourist attraction
Thank you for the moment
Marie-Pascale and Bernard

review_title: Fab way to see amazing city
review_text: Really enjoyed this tour. Got to enjoy some amazing food and go to lots of different places. Definitely recommend

Greatest experience ever!
Well organized , friendly guides, safe driving and great food! Can you ask for more ?

review_title: The best fun on two wheels
review_text: The best way to see Saigon hands down! So liberating and inclusive to be out there on two wheels cutting through the traffic instead of sitting in a taxi watching it all go by (or standing on the side of the road trying to cross through it). Felt absolutely safe the whole time and absolutely part of the local population out enjoying this amazing city. Of course the terrific food and ample drinks helped also! I was expecting just a foodie kind of experience but got so much more. The best thing we did in Saigon!

Had no idea what to expect from this tour as my friend booked it for us. Not only was it so much fun being a part of the chaos on the back of a scooter, but the stops that we made were really great. Places we would never go otherwise. So much great food and cool spots. Would recommend to anyone who wants to check out some parts of Saigon that they probably would otherwise never see.

This is a fabulous adventure through the streets of Saigon on Vespas, interspersed with the most incredible food tasting stops. The drivers are highly professional, making this a very safe and enjoyable experience. The food is delicious and a great combination of fresh, local and slightly off-beat dishes. I am a vegetarian and I came away stuffed. It really was a treat. Highly recommended for young and old, couples and famllies (although I suspect you would not feel comfortable taking a child under the age of 7).

I personally have never been on a scooter in my life (my partner however owned one as a teenager) and after experiencing the traffic in HCMC, among other parts of Asia, I was dead against getting on one here. My darling fiancé decided after this conversation to book us on the Glimpse of the Mekong tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. I was mortified, terrified and not happy! Our drivers arrived right outside our hotel on their Vespas, put our helmets on, I got on the back and within seconds of leaving I knew I was going to have to admit I was wrong! This tour was amazing, incredible, informative and one of the best experiences of my life to date. The drivers have been doing this job for several years (so they know what they are doing!) and make sure you are comfortable and safe. The tour takes you through rural areas showing shrimp farms, how the locals produce rice wine, local markets and a temple. You are fed some amazing local dishes and kept hydrated. This is truly an amazing experience and the best way to see the real Saigon away from the craziness of the city (In our opinion).

Riding pillion on a vespa, in the evening, amongst 4 million other bikes has got to be an adventure! We visited 5 different eateries over four and a half hours. We don't eat meat, but that was well catered for. The food seemed endless, lots of small plates of all sorts at the different stops. Ended up in a 'secret' coffee shop, up dark stairs, into a crowded dark room, to listen to a range of singers accompanied by violin and piano - there's a nightclub option too - but we thought this choice a perfect ending.
The drivers were very good and careful and out guide Na a happy, helpful personality plus!
Only suggestion - do wear a mask - the fumes are choking/blinding!

The tour was very good but, given the fact that tour operator knew in advance that our group included younger children, they could have varied the last two venues we visited. Clubs and bars were not good options for children, particularly late in the evening. Other than that, the first section of the tour was enjoyed by the whole group (13 of us)

You will miss out if you fail to book this 4hr adventure.

Our guide Chin was great, and he looked sfter us really well

They take you around the city you have drinks and plenty of local food including jumpin chicken!

A real must do
Fantastic night. Great food. Way too much alcohol was given. With 50/50 vodka/ mixer encouraged onto teenage children. Ruined next day

review_title: Fantastic ride, guide, food and entertainment!
review_text: Our guide was hilarious and informative, the bike riding was thrilling, and the food and entertainment will not be forgotten for a very long time!

review_title: Best thing to do in HCM
review_text: Great fun way to see Saigon. Drivers, food, entertainment and guides all excellent. Definitely would do again.

The best thing we did in Vietnam. Very caring staff, enormous fun and good food. Even torrential rain didn't dampen the evening. If you feel unsure about riding pillion in Saigon, don't! I was a little nervous but my fears dissipated after 30 seconds. Tip - take a headscarf to cover your nose and mouth.

A wonderful way to see the city and lots of fun! Coming back and will do again!! The drivers were careful not to crash and were lots of fun. It was a way to get involved with the people of Vietnam. Loved the city and country. Not daring enough to drive by myself. Maybe in the country.

Great organisation, great riders, great hostess - Loan (Low Arn)
It was terrific to get in amongst the throng of Vespas! I felt safe the whole time and I'm a scaredy cat! Food was fantastic, a real taste of Vietnam. Can't say enough about how much fun this night was. This is a must do experience!

review_title: Adrenalin Rush - not to be missed!
review_text: Great fun being driven around the teaming streets of Saigon amongst the seeming millions of other scooters; stopping off for interesting food along the way and catching some cool jazz and some very loud rock in the clubs and bars.

What an incredible experience! The scooter traffic is overwhelming when you are riding in a car, but when you become part of it, it just becomes surreal! Tam was an awesome driver, and our group saw parts of the city that we would not have seen otherwise. Do not leave the city without doing this tour!

review_title: How to see the city in style & feel like a local.
review_text: I have read about the Vespa tours before coming to Vietnam so decided to do something different (for me) and try a tour on the back of a motorbike. One of my best experiences ever of a city & everything was well organised with great food to taste along the way.

The trip itself was amazing cannot fault it I would highly recommend. At the end of the trip however when we were taken back to hotel there was the time for the tips. Now we had paid a lot for the experience so felt like $10 per scooter rider was fair, there was 4 in total. When we handed over the money the guide said "Is this it for all guides?" and we said yes and he just gave us a horrible look and walked off. For us tips is an extra not a guarantee and good service should not be solely based on the prospect of getting a tip but the fact you take pride in your job. The mood of the guides went from super friendly to cold giving us the feeling that the nice attitude was just to get tips. We felt that $10 per guide was very generous and it really upset us.

review_title: Best time we had in Saigon!
review_text: From the time Vespa Tours picked us up to the time the dropped us off, we had big smiles on our faces. They took us by Vespa to various restaurants and clubs and we ate and drank to our heart's content. The Vespa rides were so exciting, with all the other motorbikes all around us and the lights of the city. I would highly recommend this tour! Please don't miss it.

Nice way to discover the city and some local restaurants ! accompanied by a french-speaking guide it was a real pleasure. The ride looks dangerous at first sight cause the traffic in HCM city is awful but the drivers managed this really good and made it something breathtaking and unforgettable !

review_title: Excellent and different view of Saigon at night!
review_text: I had pre-booked this evening tour for my family of 4 prior to coming to Vietnam. It was well worth the $90 listed in their brochure - met at our hotel by 4 vespas and drivers, taken through the teeming streets to the Zoom café which seems to be part of the enterprise, a drink included as was all the food and beers as desired at the 2 cafes which followed - really good and different street food including a pancake eaten inside a wasabi plant leaf; then on to a 'secret' café (you would certainly never find it by chance) ending up in a live music bar with a rock version of Dancing Queen by Abba along with audience participation(more drink included). In the middle it poured tropically so we got Vespa ponchos - but it wasn't cold so we easily managed. All went to schedule so we left at 6pm and got delivered back at 10.30. With 2 adult children we agreed this was the highlight of our time in Vietnam!

We were booked on this trip on the advice of our tour operator, I was a bit apprehensive at first, as I had never been on a vespa or motorbike before. We were met promptly by two drivers and their vespas at our hotel and taken to a cafe to meet four other people on our tour and a guide. They provided helmets and I didn't feel at all scared, baring in mind the volume of vespa drivers in Saigon. Am amazing evening, including amazing views of the city, two stops at resteraunts where I tried some food for the first time, a visit to a bar and a nightclub. When it rained, they provided capes to stop us getting soaked and safely delivered us back to the hotal at 10.30pm. Well worth the experience. All the food and drinks were provided.

review_title: Great Food and FUN: Saigon night tour
review_text: Without spilling the secrets everything was awesome. A bit pricey, but you get the real local scoop.

Even if the price is quite high, it definitely worth it.
I recommend it to every traveler !
Have fun !
So much fun! Great food and awesome tour guide. Was a great experience seeing the city on the back of a scooter!
What a great way to see another side of HCMC!! Our guide Dieu was hilarious and made our night great.

review_title: Fabulous Ho Chi Minh Vespa adventure
review_text: A great night out, taking in the sites, flavours and music of Ho Chi Minh, with the very polite staff of Vespa tours.

This was just fantastic I was a single traveller and had an absolute fun fun time. Saw and ate some amazing dishes went to the coolest coffee bar and club. Tour guide was great. Saw so much more than I would have any other tour plus the food was amazing

Great way to get out of Saigon and see the "real" parts of the city.
Fairly expensive I thought.
It was a bit frustrating the speed the bikes are driven, I would have preferred less stops, and a slower pace to be able to admire and see the scenery and take photos.
All in all though, I would recommend it.

review_title: You must do a Vespa adventures tour!
review_text:
A "must do" Tour!!!
Four and a half fantastic hours going around the most interesting sites of this wonderful city. Our tour guide was Lucy - she was superb!!!!

When myself and 10 work friends booked to go on the evening foodie tour around Ho Chi Minh City at night we had no idea it would be the absolute highlight of our time in HCM City.
Right from the start when we were each paired up with drivers, some of whom spoke a bit of English on the way around, some of whom did not (and that was totally cool still), it was clear we were in good hands. This is a professional outfit and it was well organised.
Within minutes of mounting up, fastening helmets and heading out into the streets of HCM, I had already got my money's worth, as had others. The drivers are exceptional, adeptly manoeuvring thru the organised chaos, you feel safe while getting the full rush of the experience.
The tour is a well put together combination of time on the Vespas and time at bars, restaurants and a super cool coffee house. Everyone was pumped up and raving about how great a time we were having, from start to finish.
Thanks must go to our informative and friendly guide for letting us know what was happening and where we were going next throughout the evening, along with showing just how to dine on the local Vietnamese cuisine.
I honestly can't recommend this tour and tour co. enough.
Thanks,
Paul

It's funny that at one stage I felt as relaxed as I had ever been as we got further into this tour.
I had no idea what the traffic was going to be like in Vietnam prior to booking this. When we drove from the airport to our hotel a few days prior I was already starting to worry, was my travel insurance going to cover this, would my daughter be ok, my wife could she handle it,me , could I handle it.
What a professional and amazing outfit. When they picked us up at the end of the Les Rive River boat Tunnel,tour they made us feel very welcome, I can not remember the young ladies name that lead the tour but gee she needs a promotion or pay rise. She immediately asked us about where we had been, where we would like to go. As we had done a great deal of walking the day before we had already covered a lot of what she had planned for the tour. This didn't pose a problem at all to her and she modified the route to cover so much including some of the rarely visited " poorer" areas some new development areas. The drivers were amazing, the guy I has was excellent, although inititially I was a bit worried as he was the smallest driver and I am a 6foot 2 105 kg passenger. He was regularly asking me " how are you mr Andrew" my biggest concern initially was that I was going to crush his bike by squeezing my legs so tightly hanging onto the bike. 45 minutes into the tour as I said I was so relaxed and comfortable it was weird.
The guide knew her stuff, explained everything in detail, was hilarious.
Our only regret was that maybe we should have done the Scooter and street food tour as well,Mobutu that will,be a definite when we go back. We had many people tell us it was also amazing.
Great way to see Saigon and taste some of the local cuisine. It was fun to zip around the streets with a rider who knows how to get through the mayhem. Highly recommended.

review_title: Perfect tour to see the sights
review_text:
Traveling with a group of friends on my first trip to Saigon, this tour was suggested for us and we were not disappointed.

They collected us directly from our hotel to take us to lunch where included in the price was a drink and a choice of one dish for lunch, as there were a group of us, I had the opportunity to try a few different selections. I can recommend the yellow curry, calamari and fried rice in pineapple, all delicious!

Our tour guide Dat was informative and the tour was the perfect way to see the city.

You ride on the back of the Vespa, it felt safe with an experienced driver and it gives you the chance to see and take all the sights in.

They also have other cities that run the tut from in Vietnam. Professional and informative tour which I would recommend and use them again.

After seeing all the amazing reviews about the after dark Vietnam Vespa adventures tour we jumped on their website and were immediately hesitant about the price (about $90aud each).
Do not be! This was an amazing tour and well worth the money.
We were greeted by Dab our tour guide at 6, she definitely made this night amazing.
There are unlimited drinks throughout the night and the food you get to try is delicious!
Just a heads up, each person has a Vespa driver, so you don't need to worry about driving on the crazy Ho Chi Minh roads.
You'll be part of the busy Saigon streets while sightseeing the highlights. An English speaking guide will explain the why, when and what. A wonderful way around town!

We had our 3 teenage children with us on this tour and they absolutely loved it. The drivers were amazing...you felt so safe even weaving in and out of the crazy traffic. It gave you such a great perspective about how they handle the traffic and you understand why it's safer to be on a bike than be a pedestrian! The food stops were terrific but our favorite was the coffee lounge with the amazing jazz singers. Just getting this special glimpse of Saigon nightlife was priceless. It's an excellent tour to do as a family and although it initially seems expensive it's great value for money.

Wow!, what fun! You wiz around from eatery to eatery on the back of a Vespa ! Felt safe all the time through crazy traffic. The range of genuine street food was great. We even got talked into trying frog legs! Yumm! Thanks NA ( great guide). Finished with a visit to 2 styles of night clubs! An absolute highlight of our trip! Do it!!

review_title: The smiles on our teens faces said it all.
review_text: We chose the Saigon after dark tour. The traffic in Saigon is crazy and I was quietly panicking about booking our family on this tour. What a HIGHLIGHT of our trip. Our drivers were safe and made the tour so much fun, my driver sensed that I kept counting heads and showed me where one of my daughters was when I couldn't see her in the traffic (so considerate). You really need to go hungry .... we had been in Vietnam nearly 2 weeks and had eaten at many varied and out of the way places so I was worried this was going to be basic tourist fare .... I wasn't and we would never have found these places. The tour guide was great and helped to ensure we were never without a drink (completely included). This tour with VVA is not to be missed!

This is something I never thought I'd do in a million years (particularly after seeing the traffic in Saigon), let alone take my children, however I would do it again in a heartbeat.
My husband and I took our two 12 year old children (boy and girl) on the tour on a Saturday night in Saigon. Never having been on Vespas before, I was apprehensive about the traffic and how we would manage safely on bikes. I needn't have been.
Our drivers met us promptly at our hotel in District 2 and were very careful with us novice passengers. They were all clearly very experienced and safe drivers, which went a long way towards assuaging my concerns about the crazy traffic. We were accompanied by our friendly and knowledgable host/guide on on his own bike.
We are generally very independent travellers but on this tour we ventured into areas and visited restaurants and a coffee/jazz club down a tiny alley that we would have never experienced on our own. The whole experience of the city at night from a bike was amazing, as was the food. We didn't go to the final club as we had the children with us. We saw many people of all ages taking the tour and only one older women seemed to not be enjoying the experience. Everyone else seemed to be having a ball. The only negative is that I would organise masks/scarves next time to combat the occasional exhaust fumes.
The tour was the highlight of our trip. Highly recommended.

Cruising the streets of Saigon on the back of a restaured Vespa is thrilling. You will not regret overcomming a natural fear of moving between the other million of motorcycles - it disappears after a minute and you will enjoy !
They took us to alleys and restaurants that we would never find on our own (let alone stop ...) but where the food was wonderfull : in Vietnam you can eat everything that moves, if you whish - but the safer things are also there :-).
Last stop was a couple of bars with Vietnamese singers, and caraoke. Loved it all the way . Would do it again next time in Saigon.

We did the half day tour with a group of friends. What a way to see the city. dat the tour guide was great, informative and funny.

The only way to do a your I say.

Our family, including a 10 and 13 year old, loved riding the Vespas. We had a friendly tour guide who made the tour more fun. We enjoyed all the food. This may not be a great tour for families with young children since it does visit some bars.

review_title: Enjoy Ho Chi Minh like a local
review_text: I was so scared initially to get on the Vespa after having seen the traffic and how people drive. But let me tell you this was so much fun and an amazing experience for the whole family. We enjoyed the ride, the amazing and unusual food and loved our guide Chien. He was so knowledgeable and fun to be with. The music at the end of the evening was a true gem. Would do it again any time.

Went on the Saigon night tour and had a ball. Yes, the traffic is an utter nightmare but the drivers are so good that it's oddly relaxing being on the back of a scooter and let someone drive who knows what they're doing. The food stops are terrific and you end up stopping into a couple of the city's best nightspots - we saw a terrific dancy Cuban band at one club. Unlike so many on the tourist route in Vietnam, these felt real rather than just somewhere to herd through the foreign visitors. The guide we had, who gave an anglicized name of Eric, was a top man: really knowledgeable, enthusastic and informative. We really felt we learned a lot on the night. Have to say it was the highlight of our stay in Vietnam.

review_title: How to know more about Saigon
review_text: That company guarantees a lot a fun for tourists. Hop on the Saigon after dark tour (and send DEPP, the guide lady my best). The tour takes you around Saigon at night, from one bar to the next and you will love it. Dont panic on the back seat of your Vintage Vespa - the driver knows how to drive through what looks like pure chaos to us.......

review_title: great night out on pillion sampling the street food in Saigon
review_text: I would recommend this evening tour as a fantastic way of sampling Saigon street food. The traffic is bonkers in this city so not for the faint hearted but the drivers are careful and experienced. Just hang on and be whizzed from cafe to street bar for a great selection of authentic vietnamese street food. Great guides and good company. Traffic fumes can be a problem from these old scooters particularly at traffic lights.so you could purchase a small face mask as the locals do if it would bother you.

The biggest highlight of my trip! All tours I've done have been great but if you really want to experience Saigon you have to do the Night Tour and they aren't wrong when they say bring an empty stomach! So much food, drink, entertainment and the crazy Vespa. I felt safe he entire time, met some great new friends and had the best tour guide. I have since booked a private tour for a couple of days time. Can't recommend highly enough!!

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Vietnam
review_text: This was the best night out my husband and myself have had in such a long time. Everything about this tour was great , the tour guides, drivers, eateries , you get to see so much and not always on the main streets so you get to experience local places. The drivers are careful and recommend this to all ages, i know we will be doing more of this on our next visit to Vietnam, Maz Aus

Drivers are really careful amidst the chaos. Loved all the stops especially the seafoods. The tour takes you to alleys and streets that you do not normally go through. It is a good way to start to get to know Vietnam food as well.

review_title: Night tour of Hoi An was spectacular
review_text: My boyfriend and I did this with another couple and it was so worth the money. Our guide Ben was so down to earth and knowledgeable. He and his team made us feel very safe but the ride was still very exciting. We did 5 very different stops in total and tried 9 different types of food. The boat ride down the river was just amazing as well. The highlights for us was the soft beautiful squid and the clams. We just loved riding on the vespa's at night with the wind on us. It is a little expensive compared to other tours but the experience was totally worth it

We booked the night food tour and the riders picked us up from the hotel right on time. It is an experience to ride with the traffic especially during rush hour. Hold your handbags tight! We met our tour guide at Vespa Cafe and from there went to at least 3 places to have awesome yummy local food. Our best experience was at this unique 'secret' lounge. We had good fun at the dance club which was the last stop. It is a great way to meet strangers (my tour group consisted of 5 people) and to have awesome local food. Would take the tour again :)

review_title: A great way to see the city at night
review_text:
This was my second time taking the evening eating and drinking tour in Ho Chi Minh City.
What a great time!!!
It was 4 hours of pure fun and laughs.
I highly recommend this tour.

review_title: An excellent way to see the city
review_text: I just finished the afternoon sightseeing tour (12-4 p.m.) and it was great! A driver came to my residence on a vespa, and after ensuring that I properly wore my helmet, we set off for the Zoom Cafe, where I had a nice lunch with other tour participants. Following lunch, we started touring the city on vespas with an English-speaking guide, visiting historic and religious sites. We also visited the wholesale flower market. It was great! I plan to take the evening tour in the very near future!

We booked the day tour out the Mekong with Vietnam vespa adventures. The trip out of the city was a great way to see the countryside of the Mekong. We had a few stops along the way, and or guide was very patient answering all the questions we had along the way. Would recommend them for a great trip out of Saigon.

I have lived in HCMC on and off for over 7 years and when guests come to town we always do this tour. Definitely one of the best tours I have ever done and surprisingly very safe. It is slightly more expensive than what you normally pay in Vietnam, but some things are worth splurging out on, especially if you are a nervous traveler but want to try the local food and culture, but remain safe at the same time. All you can eat and drink for the most part. Especially love the seafood restaurant and make sure you try the jumping chicken

An amazing experience and prompted my first review on Tripadvisor! Was slightly put off by the price initially but the tour is worth every penny and more, made all the better by the very friendly group and the excellent hosting of Chi. We visited 4 different locations and sampled a range of local cuisine, culture and live music. As for the transport...... Being driven through HCMC's crazy traffic on a Vespa is unique to say the least and loads of fun - a must try

review_title: A fantastic time on the Mekong Tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures
review_text:
This tour was an absolute highlight of my recent trip in Vietnam. The level of care and attention the whole team give to their guests is brilliant. We were picked up at 8am to meet the others on the tour, before being driven to District 7 (around 10 minutes) to choose our bikes. I chose a beutiful lime-green 1968 Vespa to spend the day on.

The bike was great (for something older than me) and the tour guides (there were 9 of them on the trip) made sure the traffic was manageable and helped me get out when stuck in the mud.

We visited a rice wine house, a temple, seafood market, incense making and went on a ferry. A great day out followed by delicious late lunch in the pouring rain.

I would give this tour a firm 10 out of 10 and highly recommend it to anybody coming to Saigon.

Happy travels.
The staff were lovely and spoke very good English. The food was astonishingly delectable and we followed the same trail as Anthony Bourdain. I loved zipping around all the traffic on a scooter.

We did the Vespa Adventure in Siem Reap before this, so we were a little acquainted with how they run these tours.
We opted for the Mekong Tour in HCMC. As promised, they picked us up from our location, though we weren't staying at a hotel. We were taken to the classy Vespa Cafe where the others joined us. After a cup of green tea, we were taken to a location where they assess your capability of riding their Vespa, in case you choose to. Whether you're riding or sitting behind one of their expert drivers, you're in for a great experience. I definitely wanted to ride, and I'm so happy I chose to.
They took us through the country side, into the Mekong delta, across bridges, rice fields and a whole lotta green all around. We stopped for iced coffee, to see rice wine and incense sticks being made, through a quaint market, where we ate some terrific seafood and finally at a temple where Vietnam's Caodaism is practiced. Our last stop was a lazy lunch with beer which was a splendid end.

The guide was informative, fun and the drivers were helpful as well. I'm not sure if it was part of the authentic experience, but my Vespa broke down and I was pushed atleast a km or two by another Vespa behind me, which was fun as well!

What a great introduction to the crazy traffic in HCMC whilst being fed, watered and entertained on the way. A 'Must do' trip. Here is a youtube link to a crap video that I made with my phone....
https://youtu.be/Zs1AOnaMUo4

It's an excellent way to see Saigon, and its a lot of fun on the back of the Vespa. The traffic in Saigon (about 7 million motorbikes) is organized chaos but the drivers do a fantastic job of taking you from point to point in a safe manner. Very very good food, cold beer and informative guides. Highly recommended!

review_title: An ABSOLUTE MUST! Sagion After Dark was TRULY THE HIGHLIGHT! Thanks DEP!
review_text:
Had no expectations going into this other than I would be riding on the back of a VESPA while the driver took me around in the crazy streets of HCMC!

Driver picked me up directly from the hotel and brought me to the bar where I met the rest of the small group (8 total) and had a few drinks, exchanged stories, then we were off!
Pinging from bar/restaurant with DRINKS in hand!! Trying everything from crab legs, prawn, frog legs, to mussels & local beers/cocktails!

We even stopped at a local cafe were an acoustic set was going on with singers/piano, truly special and intimate!

Dep was a fantastic guide and tried to make sure we were all getting enough alcohol and having a blast!

My husband & I went on the Saigon After Dark Tour, we had never been on any bikes before, but wow, how exciting!! The whole experience was the highlight of our trip, had a fantastic bunch of young people with us, great drivers and a wonderful and informative guide Dep. The places we visited were amazing, got to eat the authentic Vietnamese street food, even tried frog's legs.
Would highly recommend this tour.....Thank You 😃

Best 4hrs I spent in a long time much safer than I imagined great drivers great look at cosmopolitan Saigon wonderfull food and nightlife and I should add Im 76 and my wife 73 so its not just designed for young people

I have never ridden any kind of scooter before so I was dreading this tour. When we arrived in Saigon and I saw the number of scooters on the roads, I was positively petrified. However, I needn't have worried. We were on the night street food tour so we were picked up from our hotel at about 6pm - rush hour! Full of trepidation, I got on the Vespa. We were driven to a bar in Chinatown for our first drink. I closed my eyes at a couple of crossroads but other than that, I felt completely safe on the scooter. Our guide, Lam, was very knowledgeable and chatty. We were taken to a couple of street side restaurants for some lovely food and then onto a café in somebody's lounge with singing and entertainment. We could have gone to another bar after that but we left as we had an early flight to catch. I'm so glad that I didn't let my fear get in the way of this trip. It was really good to see different types of food and drink and to see how there actually seems to be some kind of order in the mad traffic when you're in the thick of it. I would definitely recommend it. You get photos emailed to you afterwards, the food was delicious and the toilets (something else I was worried about) were all spotlessly clean, even in the so called slum areas.

On the recommendation of a friend we booked to do the Saigon After Dark tour. Everything about this tour was amazing. Our guide Deb was warm, friendly, well travelled and great at creating a "happy" vibe. Generous application of cocktails helped too! The ride itself was an experience of freedom in the city where the traffic pace can feel overwhelming. The spots we stopped along the way gave us a fabulous peek into Saigon that we would never have discovered otherwise. THANK YOU!

Absolutely amazing evening doing the saigon by night tour. Started off at a bar where we were introduced to our vespa guides. Despite my initial fears, I felt very comfortable on the vespa! They were well prepared with rain hoods.
The food stops were fantastic and there was a great choice of food and drink on the tour. Went to a couple of bars - one lovely and intimate, the other loud and rowdy - great contrasts. There was no complaint when we lingered a bit longer in places as we were having so much fun.
Our guide, Na was very knowledgeable about the food and local cultures.
You also get photos sent after the tour. Highly recommended!!
Just great, loved the evening of true Saigon, loved the food, I will recommend this tour to all my clients when visiting Saigon.

review_title: You can thrust in this guys
review_text:
I foubd this Tour Operator in HCMC by the reccomendation of a college, in this mm onebt in Vietnam is very important find Tour that is Safe, really tou gonna enjoy every penny and ypu can thrust...
You can thrust in this people!
Serious, very well organised, profeasionals and super friendly!
They take a care of me from the 1st moment, my Vespa-Driver pick-up me in my Hotel, we went to the meeting point and start the tour..
Welkome drinks, and you gonna have a drink between stops like a kings yes!, you gonna enjoy a nice drink during the trip.. imagine ride in a nice Vespa between the crazy traffic enjoying a coold Beer!
The stops are out of any turist circuit area, sow you gonna diacover streets and lical places put of the center, traditional street food in a safe places with History, but this is not everything .... you gonna discover where the Vietnamise go to enjoy a party night out... live music.. hooo i pove this small coffee. .. places that otherwise you never gonna discover. ...
Absolutely an amazing exoerience that i can recommend to everyone.

review_title: 2 days Mekong Delta trip - absolutely perfect
review_text: If you want to see the Mekong Delta at its best, choose this trip. Steve and his team make sure that you will experience local life style, without the changes that tourism has done to Vietnam. Doing all this on Vespas gives it a special flavour. You can be a driver as well as a pessenger, it is perfectly safe thanks to the staff. Special thanks here to Nhyg and Du (sorry if misspelled) they helped us all the way with the scooters, packages, they led the way and watched our back constantly. Also special thanks to Lam, our guide. He has done all he could to tell us everything about the Mekong Delta, with a good sence of humor and a constant smile. He is also a local guy, so he really knows what he talks about. In summary: do not hesitate to join the trip!

review_title: Fantastic fun, something you won't forget in a hurry
review_text:
We immersed ourselves into the Saigon traffic on the Vespas piloted by our very capable guides and experienced an amazing night of local food, local insights and local culture that would be difficult to obtain any other way.

The food we were served at the eateries normally only frequented by locals was very good as you would expect, but the visit to the "secret cafe" to view a live acoustic music set followed by a live band at a nearby local club was an amazing way to top of the night.

The experience of being on the back of a scooter in the Saigon traffic that is crazy yet somehow workable is something you won't forget, I can't recommend this experience highly enough!
Ride of my life. Exiting tour. Delicious food. Saigon by night in the most caotic traffic on a Vespa scooter.

Excellent way to to get around the city!
Do NOT eat all day before this tour as it provides so much food and drink and alcohol is included!!!
Excellent food
Excellent service
Highly recommend

This tour is a fantastic experience - travelling on Vespas is a great way to experience the local culture. The stops along the way at markets, pagodas, and family run businesses were fascinating and often off the beaten track. We couldn't fault our guide and driver who looked after our very need - all with a lovely sense of humour. Highly recommended.

We booked this tour through our hotel and was the very best thing we did in VIETNAM!!!! The vespa drivers take 4 couples (8 scooters) around Saigon which lasts about 4 hours. The tour does not go to tourist stops! There is no shortage of beer and food. Very safe, helmets are provided. Absolutely reommended and will not disappoint!!!

We booked a Saigon by night tour on the vintage Vespas. Our riders were friendly and great tour guides, telling us all about the places we were passing. Our guide, Hanh, was absolutely lovely. We have truly made a friend for life in her. She was fun and interesting to talk to. Very good English too! The stops we visited were great. It was fun getting to try foods I'd never had before, especially the frog! The bar was great and the band awesome! And the secret location visit definitely pleased! I highly recommend this tour to anyone! Saigon was amazing at night and what better way to see it then on the back of a Vespa! Thank you Vietnam Vespa Adventures! I will be back for more!
A bit nerve wracking at first with all the traffic but felt safe the entire trip. A lot of fun. And a great way to tour he city Not to be missed.
Best night of my life and the food was amazing. Loved being able to joke around and use Aussie slang with our tour guide. He was very fluent in English.

review_title: A Must Do While in HCMC!!
review_text: My mother and I had so much fun riding through HCMC on the back of the Vespas and eating our way through fantastic street food. The drivers are amazing, our guide was a lot of fun, and the food you eat along the way was some of the best we had in Vietnam. I can't recommend this tour enough. One of our favorite memories from our trip through Vietnam.

review_title: A great way to experience Vietnam!
review_text: We did the Mekong Delta tour and it was a great way to escape the hustle and bustle of Ho Chi Minh City and see the beautiful countryside. The itinerary is perfect, with several stops to get up close and personal with the locals. We were able to do a cooking class too as part of our booking and it was a lot of fun. Motorbike drivers are very safe and provide plenty of water to beat the heat. I would definitely recommend this to anyone who wants to do something adventurous and fun while learning more about the Vietnamese culture.

Great trip. Got picked up from hotel by a 1960s vespa and set off on night tour. Met the rest of the group at cafe and a couple of drinks later set off around the city. Lots of local food stops and ate a lot of the delicacies. Great night out, good food,good music and good company. Best way to see the city at night

This was an absolutely amazing way to see the city. Our guide Chin (sorry if I've miss-pelt your name) was wonderful - enthusiastic and knowledgeable. We saw the city from the locals viewpoint, tasted a lot of local food with explanations of what it was and how to eat it and really didn't want to stop! We were picked up and dropped back at our hotel - couldn't have been easier.

This trip is must. Picked up at hotel, drive around city with professional driver. Loads of stops for food and drink. Excellent street food and any drinks you want. Brilliant value. In between stops you are driven around on rhe back of the Vespa which is a real experience. Food and drink stops you probably wouldn't find yourself. The tour finishes at firstly an intimate venue with piano player, violinist and singers. Really brilliant. Lastly to a music venue with a brilliant band and excellent singers. Then driven back to the hotel. Fantastic night had by all. Recommended without a doubt. Best night out we had all holiday.

review_title: This is the real HCMC feeling
review_text:
If you want to dive in the atmosphere of this vibrant city, do explore it on this Vespa tour! Move around like the locals do and you will notice that this is the only way that makes sense.

The best way to explore the city as well as the Mekong delta. See, hear and smell local markets, relax on the countryside, have a ferry trip.... We had a day trip and it was worth every minute!

review_title: If you do one thing in Ho Chi Minh City...
review_text:
Do this! Took the night tour last night. Much fun ensued! You'll see a side of the city you wouldn't see otherwise.

Were picked up from the hotel and driven to the meeting point, where we met our host for the evening, who was great fun.

You'll drink too much (necessary and somewhat compulsory!), have some great local food, in the course of which you'll eat all sorts...and drink some more.

You'll stop off and eat...and drink, at a number of different places in the city. The food was excellent at each establishment.

Loving the liquid top ups (roadies!) en route to each!

review_title: A whole city in one afternoon
review_text:
Following a very good trip with Le Rives to the Cu Chi tunnels we were handed over to the very good care of "Vietnam Vespa's". VV are skilled, entertaining and safe. we flew all over the city at a steady pace, stopping to get off and look/Chat every 10 minutes or so.
There were seven of us. Our guide took charge and rode one bike whilst the other six riders skillfully and calmly looked after us but also very impressively each other. Getting around smoothly by bike allows one to cover 5-10 times as much ground. Very impressive.

We were three couples that spent the last evening in Saigon on the Vespa. We simply LOVED it. We came to se a different side of Saigon and experienced the horrorlike traffic. Our drivers got us safely from one place to another! And we experienced the most delicious food and outstanding musicexperience in a well hidden tea house.If you og to Saigon , the Vespa Tours is a must!

We just arrived back from a 2 week trip to Vietnam, and the highlight was a night tour of Saigon with Vespa Adventures. Picked up at our hotel by our fantastic drivers (How and Ben) on two authentic Vespa scooters then taken for an amazing adventure - the ride of our lives. First stop we were met by our guide Han who looked after us really well all evening. We had a choice of drinks at each stop (5) and choice of food at 2 different local street restaurants. The quality of food and service was amazing and plentiful. Entertainment unbeatable and the tour also included a secret speakeasy bar and a rock bar both with great and very different live music. What a night and well worth the price - highly recommended!

review_title: THE must do activity in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: We did a half day city tour and if we'd had more time, would have done the evening foodie tour. This was the most fun and a fantastic way to see the city - some of the main sights as well as parts of the city that you would probably not otherwise see. All of the drivers were great and our guide (and my driver Lam) was incredibly friendly, enthusiastic, entertaining and knowledgeable. I can't recommend this attraction enough. At the end of a brilliant 11 day tour through Vietnam, this was definitely a highlight. Drinks and lunch were also included on the tour.

We were sceptical but ended up taking in Saigon's internal beauty with this amazing 6.5 hours trip. we got to see how the true culture of the Vietnamese and how it plays out in the rural areas. Lam, our tour guide who is so passionate about his country gave us the full lowdown on what the history of Saigon is. thoroughly impressed. Such a warm reception in Vietnam..definitely will go back if given the chance!

review_title: A fantastic evening out in Saigon and a great way to experience the city
review_text:
If you have a spare evening in Ho Chi Minh City / Saigon - just go on the evening Vespa street food tour! A great evening out, stopping at some really nice and authentic places to have lovely food; a coffee shop you will never find on your own and finish with a final beer (or two) in a bar.
The staff and drivers are very friendly and great fun, as were the staff in the restaurants we stopped at. Safety is not a problem - drivers all very safe and the restaurants were clean and good quality.
This was a real highlight of our 12 day tour of the whole of Vietnam - greatly helped by our guide for the night, Yieu (sp?) who is one of life's great characters.
HIGHLY recommended.

review_title: Perfect way to start our stay
review_text:
Took the morning city tour our first morning in Saigon. Perfect way to see the city and get an overview. Great guide with alot of knowledge safe and drivers :). Finnished of with a cold beer and real good Vietnamese food in zoom café.

Com on! (Or how they spell it)

I did the Saigon By Night trip a few days ago, and had a great time. I was a bit apprehensive about getting on the back of a Vespa in the middle of the crazy traffic out there, but felt really safe. The trip was great - visited some great food places and a couple of music ones which I would never have found in three days there by myself. The guide and drivers were really friendly and professional, and the group was nice. It's definitely pricey compared to the local cost of activities, but well worth it - the best thing I've done in a fortnight in Vietnam. Do it!
Great way to explore the city and visit local restaurants and coffee houses. Englishspeaking guide, nice drivers.

Well what a day. This trip is expensive and yes you'll think twice about it but honestly there's nothing much to do in Saigon so do the Mekong and learn to cook while being driven round on a scooter. The cooking class is less of a cooking school and a simple mealset of "make your own lunch" but a great stop and lots of fun. Well don't guys you've done something here that's brought a lot of good spirit to Vietnam.

review_title: A great way to experience Saigon
review_text:
It was a wonderful way to experience Saigon nightlife. We were picked up at our hotel and joined a group with four other people. On our trip we were taken to three restaurants to sample various local dishes and then eventually onto a club which had live music and we had drinks. The restaurants were fun and the food good. The young host and the drivers were great fun and we never felt unsafe. This should definitely be on your list of 'must do's' for Saigon.
We highly recommend it.

This is magnificent - traffic dodging, street food, great company and exhilaration! Just do it, whatever your age. Look I am close to 79 and weigh over 100 kgs and I could do it with their help and enthusiasm and so can you.

review_title: What a cool way to see HCMC
review_text:
What a blast. I was a bit concerned about having an accident on a bike, but that quickly passed, after the first 2 beers. The food was pretty good and local, which was a plus point.
i guess they always go to the same places, but for a tourist who cares. It was a great evening and I would recomend it to all.

review_title: A great night out on the back of a bike
review_text: This night food tour was great! We were taken to numerous restaurants, most in little back streets that only the locals would know of. All drinks were included in the cost which everyone made the most of. The night finished off with dancing to a great live band. Wonderful food, wonderful drivers and a great atmosphere at the two bars at the end of the night.

review_title: Brilliant night - a must do in HCMC!
review_text:
The Saigon by Night Vespa Adventure was one of the best tours I have ever done! My young adult children and I had an absolute ball travelling through the city on the Vespas, trying different delicious food at restaurants that we woud never have found on our own and going to a couple of clubs afterwards for drink and music, before being dropped back at our hotel. The vespa driver's were all very friendly and courteous too. But the absolute best thing about or tour was our wonderful tour guide Hanh Dinh. She was very knowlegeable and was such a pleasure to spend time with, we all had a great night! Don't miss the opportunity to have a wonderful evening of fun and entertainment.

Neva, Teag & Bodin Pohlner, Melbourne, Australia (Apr15)

I really enjoyed this tour, there's a lot of riding but of course there's going to be to get you into the Mekong area.
At the end of the day I tipped my rider 50,000VND. Now I have no idea how much I should tip or if I'm supposed to tip. I'm Australian and we generally don't tip and this tour wasn't cheap.... anyway I tipped him and he gave me a very disappointed look.
With the price of these tours, I would like to think that the staff are being paid fairly and if they are relying on our tips then I think that we should be told.
Other than that, a great day was had.

This was the best tour. We laughed, we ate, we drank we met good people. This was the best tour, great value for money, I can't believe we had second thoughts. What a great team Vespar tours have put together.... Seriously good riders. The understanding that a couple of drinks assist the passenger to go with the flow and great presenters who get western culture and gave us an excellent tour of new Vietnam, who knew there was a serious coffee house scene happening? Vespar tours that's who. Thanks Jill.."yul.....

Being of mature years and having spent a couple of days amid the madness of the Saigon traffic, we were wondering how wise our booking of this excursion was.
We were picked up by our riders, given a helmet and driven off to the rallying point for the tour before we could blink. That first ride - about 10 minutes - told us that we were going to be fine and that, contrary to kerbside impressions, the 6 million scooter riders of Saigon DO know what they are doing and that there is some sort of plan - honestly.
The next four hours were a joy ; about an hour on the back of the Vespas between locations; good company with lots of laughs; a good group leader and super riders; great and interesting food in places we would never have found on our own; finally taken back to our hotel safe and sound!!! What had we been apprehensive about? It was a blast.

review_title: Ride of your life - Saigon after dark tour
review_text: This tour was the highlight of our HCMC visit. You really get to be part of the city on the Vespa. The drivers are extremely good and easily weave in and out of the traffic. We did not feel unsafe at any point. The food along the way was tasty and it was good to try all the different dishes. Our guide was also very friendly and personable. Above all, the tour is a lot of fun! Enjoy the ride!

we did the Saigon After Dark tour last night. It was absolutely exhilarating, the highlight of our 16 days in Vietnam. My wife and I are in our late 60s and not exactly into adventure any more, but this was great. Zooming in and out of the traffic on the back of a Vespa you see Ho Chi Minh City in a different way. We laughed the whole night. The food was great, the drivers and our guide were terrific. I cannot praise it highly enough. Other travellers to Vietnam have to get out and do it.

Me and my husband booked this before leaving our place for some exciting stuffs. We had booked Mekong delta tour hoping to see lot of places and to gAin some knowledge. But all in vain. The tour consisted of only travel. The moped rider did not know English to answer my questions. They charged fee for my 10 month old daughter . There was nothing exciting about the tour. No great food. Did not learn anything at all. Truly disappointing.

This was an exceptional trip out- what a great evening!!

It's got a fast pace to the whole evening, great street food - what a brilliant way to see Saigon

We had a great guide, brilliant retro bikes but the best was still to come- we went to a coffee house and heard some just brilliant classical soloists and then a club with some brilliant singers- places we would never have found on our own

It's not the cheapest tour I've ever been on, but easily the best- I would do it again if I ever visit again- it's was our last night in Vietnam and probably our best night- thanks for a great memory

review_title: Saigon After Dark - thrilling and fun
review_text:
I am not one to do touristy things but I liked the idea of seeing things from the back of a Vespa. This tour did not disappoint! Yes, it is touristy and all the people on the tour were Westerners, but the plusses were many. Firstly, it is super well organized, but not in a way to undermine the feeling that is is kind of spontaneous. The 4 stops - seafood, street food, coffee house and bar are all pretty cool. The seafood place was great and the coffee house was unusual (in a good way). The guide was great and they break the tourists up into small groups (6 or so) so it is very personal. The best thing of all is the ride on the streets. Great drivers who weave in and out of traffic with ease. Near misses with cars, busses and other bikes, but always a feeling that the driver knows exactly what he is doing. That, for me, made the tour great. Plus at under
US$100 for 4 hours (including food, drinks and everything) it is a really good deal. Zoom over to Zoom and do this!

Thoroughly enjoyed this tour of Saigon, after being a little apprehensive about going on it! Drivers were fantastic though and made you feel at ease- of course the included drinks also helped! Was a great way to visit some places we never would have found on our own in the time we had in the city. Definitely a must!

Went on the 'Saigon after dark' tour in March with Dieu as our guide. She made the whole evening a mega success. Did everything that was described in the flyer, had as much as we wanted to drink and eat and didn't want to leave any of the places that we stopped at. Drivers were fantastic, very safe but made it very exciting for us all. Make time to go on this trip - you won't regret it.

My wife and I were unsure about committing to this tour (night foodie tour) because of the price but are SO glad we did -- it was worth each and every penny!! This was definitely a highlight of our time in Vietnam and, so far, has been the best food we've tasted in our 5 months in SE Asia! Our guide, LoAn, was funny, extremely knowledgeable, fluent in English, and...most importantly...really seemed to love what she was doing. There is no better way to see Saigon than on the back of these cool looking vespas piloted by excellent drivers. So much variety, deliciousness, and fun...we cannot recommend this highly enough!!

review_title: Saigon after Dark- fascinating insights into Saigon food culture and the city's nightlife
review_text:
Vespa Adventures and especially the Saigon after Dark tour were recommended to us by other travelers we got to know during a city tour.
First of all, I was very positively surprised that they were able to offer two places in a group on short notice without any problems. Additionally, as I had planned this as a special birthday treat for my boyfriend, they were even able to organize an amazing birthday cake for him!
Our group consisted of only 7 people which made it possible to get to know each other and spend an enjoyable evening. During the whole tour you get drinks for free, so we started with some birthday cocktails and beers. Already in a good mood we ascended the Vespas and the drivers drove us safely through the city's heavy traffic and alongside the river to our first stop. There we had some really amazing seafood, just to be surprised by delicious food at a very local open air restaurant at the next stop. Following we had a music performance in a hide-away bar which unfortunately was very touristic. Also the bar with an open mic night that we ended up in as a last stop was very touristic, but we enjoyed it nevertheless.

Altogether we both had an amazing night with very nice company, good food and an exceptional driving experience through Saigon. My boyfriend even said it was his best birthday ever.

review_title: Much better than expected, a must do in Siagon!
review_text:
This tour (Saigon after dark) was one of the highlights of our trip, I cannot praise it enough..in short it was awesome! We had been in the city a few days but experiencing the roads from a vespa is completely magical. I was always disappointed to disembark my vespa at each of the stops, only to be completely wowed by the intimate dining experiences and live music.
