Our guide was great and having her dine with us meant we could pick up some tips on the local cuisine as well as discover her insight into this incredible city.

All food and drink is included so we ended the night stuffed, a little tipsy and thoroughly satisfied, thank you Vespa tours!

review_title: Highlights of Saigon at night from the back of a Vespa
review_text: This is a busy, exciting tour that shows you the best sights, dining, and nightlife that Saigon has to offer at night, whilst giving you the experience of Saigon traffic via the back of a Vespa. Its a thrill of a night. The drivers are very safe,and your host is the friendliest. Guarenteed a great night out.

Words cannot express how much you should book a tour with these guys. We booked 2 tours, the countryside half day in Hoi An and the night food and nightlife in Saigon. Both were outstanding. In Hoi An we travelled out into the countryside down roads and paths only accessible by bike or scooter. The views are stunning and the trips to observe villagers cooking and weaving mats were superb. Our guide Trinh spoke perfect english and asnswered all of our questions, patiently allowing us to stop and take photographs of the scenery. We had water and drinks provided as well as a delicious lunch on the beach to end a perfect morning. In Saigon the experience was just a positive, we started out with a beer and then headed into the chaos of the night. The drivers were attentive and spoke great english. At no point did you feel unsafe despite the traffic and the trip was enhilarating. We had so much food we were fit to burst, stopping at a local seafood restaurant and then onto another restaurant serving delicious spring rolls and pancakes. Wine and beer was included so amazing value. We were then taken onto just the most amazing place with live music in what appeared to be someones front room. The atmosphere was unbelivable and the hairs stood up on my arms. I won't spoil this but all I can say is get these tours booked. We paid in the UK via Paypal before we left and had excellent communication. They even organised for us to be collected from our hotel in Danang for our Hoi An tour as this is about 20 minutes drive. BOOK BOOK BOOK and if you feel nervous about being on the bike then don't be, the fear will disappear and the experience will live with you for a long time. Worth every penny. Thanks guys.

Myself and my husband did the evening food tour which was food and drinks included. It was great fun and although I was nervous about the driving, I had nothing to worry about as it all felt very safe. The food was delicious and they were also accomodating and provided my husband with lots of meat dishes instead of fish.

I would highly recommend it!

review_title: No matter what, a must when in Saigon!
review_text:
The vespa adventures offers a lot of different tours, and we decided to go with the Saigon-at-night tour.
Basically the idea was that you will be behind the wheels of a vespa running around the city at night, going through the cities main landmarks. In the meantime they will stop by the local food spots, bars etc and dine/enjoy the local food/drinks, with your local guide.
The local tour guide will explain everything you need to know about Saigon or anything else! Very friendly and enthusiastic, you will enjoy the tour.
You will also be divided into small groups who are also on the tour so it's a great option to mingle around with other travelers!
Even though not the cheapest option to go with, I highly recommend the tour and wouldn't hesitate to go back and do it again..!!

review_title: Romantic night experience with few comments
review_text:
The night Vespa tour was a romantic experience . Weather was cool with a romantic breeze I could feel on my face while on the motor bike. The duration of the tour was 3-4 hours where we visited few poor and other areas and towards the end it started becoming boring so we just left the last place we were visiting. Every couple has their own tour guide .
I can say that I didn't like that the guides seat together with the couples on the same table and eat from the same plate . It's not hygienic . Even in the last place they took us to try locally prepared salty crepe and spring rolls , our tour guide cut it with his hand ( we don't know when last he had washed it ) and offered it to us . That night I went home hungry . I could not eat because of that reason .

Being in our 50's both my husband and me were a little unsure of this part of our stay in Ho Chi Minh city, however this turned out to be a great night out for all ages.

Without wanting to give to much away, as it would spoil the experience, we would recomend this.

The price includes all food, drinks and enterance fees. The only money we paid out was for tipping the drivers.

Don't worry about being it being dangerous, it was the first time on a bike for me and within a couple of minutes I had settled in to the point that I was not even holding on.

We did consider, due to our age, giving the night club a miss but so glad we did not. Again I am not giving details away but would encourage all ages to go.

In a nutshell its a great night out and remember you only live once.

This was absolutely brilliant!!! We enjoyed every minute of this evening tour of Ho Chi Minh City. We had insights into the city that we would not have found ourselves. I felt really safe on the Vespa (my first time on a bike and I was worried), the drivers were brilliant. We had a guide with us for the evening too who was brilliant. We stopped at places for food that I would never have stopped at, but it was delicious. The music part of the night was by far my favourite. I could talk about it for ages but I wouldn't want to give too much away. I would love to do it again.

We had NO idea what a fun evening this would be! We met our drivers when they picked us up at our hotel (12 women)...... Drivers are extremely safe. Stops along the way were so much fun, great food, great drinks. Finishing the evening at a wonderfully cozy bar with "open mic" -- young Vietnamese "college age" kids with fabulous voices. And we range in age from 40 to 82!

I did the Glimpse of the Mekong on my last day in Saigon and I only wish I'd done it on my first day so I could've fitted in the other tours they do too!!
I was picked up from where I was staying, was well fed and looked after and felt completely safe the whole time.
We were taken to farms, markets, people's houses...I really feel like I experienced what life was like in the Mekong Delta. Our main guide Chien was very knowledgable and spoke English like it was his first language. There was a family on my tour with a ten year old boy who loved it...so totally appropriate for older kids too!
Adding to this the vespas are so cool. You really should see Saigon by bike and what better way that with an experienced guide on a super cool bike!
An absolute must in Saigon!

Living here now in HCMC, I booked this recently for 3 people. Had a great night. Great setup and very professional. Vespa's are very comfortable too.. Definitely will book again when family/friends visit. Go on... book it ;)

review_title: Fantastic adventure on the back of a Vespa
review_text:
This was fantastic. Picked up at the hotel on time, first stop was the Zoom bar where we met our guide for the evening. Then back on the. Vespa to be taken to 2 street food venues to try the local delicacies. Next stop was a secret coffee shop to listen to some beautiful music. Final destination was a loud rock bar. The local female singer was a chic rocker with a huge voice. After a few initial nerves by the end of the evening zooming in and out of traffic seemed so natural as if we had been doing it for ever.

The drivers were excellent, the evening hosts were knowledgeable and the venues were fun. A definite must try despite your age.

Having traveled to HCM several times over the years I request that Vespa Tours take us to places that HCM have too offer away from the typical tourists destinations. We got what we wanted, great feed back from tour operators prior to starting our tour. Plus staff on tour and back at HQ Zoom Cafe. After this tour we had booked tours in Hoi An and Siem Reap.

As soon as you land in Ho Chi Minh, you will notice the thousands of motorbikes around the city, there are so many, its probably a world record! The fun about this Vespa Tour is that you are part of all this traffic! You are not driving the vespa but sitting at the back, enjoying the night view of Saigon, going through small alleys, then back to main roads, driving across crowded streets and next to the city sights. Meanwhile, other motorbikes are next to you like a swarm of bees! In between the rides, you have 3-4 stops to eat Vietnamese traditional food and have some drinks and the good thing is that a guide is there to explain what you are eating.

Everything starts from a cafe, something like the HQ of the Vespa Adventures, where you meet your guide and the rest of the team (usually around 7 people in total). After that you ride your vespa with your personal driver and the guide follows you. The guide we had was really funny, her English was great and she was very kind. Everything you drink and eat is included in the price. She will arrive at the "pit-stops" before we will and wait for us, a table was reserved for us at all the places we stopped and the food arrived fast. The guide will ask you before you start the tour if you are ok we certain food, chicken, fish etc. and will arrange special food for you if there is something you don't like. Just let them know at the HQ.

Its definitely something you HAVE to do when in Saigon. I would suggest you book before you get to Saigon, go for the 6pm ride!

Enjoy!

If you are in Saigon, you really must not miss this! As a couple in or 50/60s, we were bundled onto the back of a couple of scooters outside our hotel and for the next 3 hours we sped around the city center of Saigon in the dark with a sort of joyful abandon, stopping from time to time at the street markets to eat local food and drink the occasional glass of beer. There is a sort of scary poetry about the flow of a million scooters on the streets, and you will just never forget it…. and by the way neither of us for one moment felt scared!

review_title: Whizzing around Ho Chi Minh City on a Vespa
review_text: One of the most fun things you could do when in Vietnam, I did the Saigon after dark tour (4 1/2 hours). The tour was recommended by many other tourists and they were right. What a great way to see the city, eat incredible food and enjoy a fantastic evening out. Well and truly worth doing, met some great people and we were all looked after superbly.

With a few friends, we booked onto this tour and it was excellent!
The tour guide, a lady called Dep, spoke brilliant English and never left our side all night.
We went to a seafood restaurant (the long way round on the Vespas) where the food was amazing. I do NOT like seafood but I eat everything. Snails, mussels, frogs, noodles. The lot.
Then onto a BBQ restaurant to eat meats and "pancakes", all the time Dep shows us how to eat in the traditional way.
Moved onto a small cafe for live Vietnamese music then onto an acoustic bar, more westernized.
Great value for money and great experience on the bikes. I'm a BIG buy and I had no problems on the bikes and felt safe all the way (whiskey sours for the ride helped somewhat)!

We did the After Dark tour on our first night in Saigon and it was brilliant. It was a great way to see the city and share the scooter madness. We were taken to places a tourist wouldn't normally get to and try local dishes. We were also taken to a local bar with traditional singing then a modern bar with a Vietnamese rock band, polar opposites but both really good fun.

We weren't too bothered about Saigon but this was the best thing about our visit. We'll be returning to Vietnam and definitely look this lot up again elsewhere.

review_title: Not for the fainthearted but great
review_text:
We only had 24 hours in HCM city and wanted to get a feel for the place so thought the back of a Vespa was a good way to go. Loved it from start to finish and once we understood that the seemingly chaotic traffic actually had its own rules could relax and enjoy the ride.
Got taken to places that tourists wouldn't normally see (or find) and the guide provides a good insight into life in this busy city. We ended up really glad that we managed to squeeze this into our very short stay.

review_title: Best option to start and finish our trip in Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
When a friend of us recommended Vietnam Vespa Adventures we tried it for the city tour as we thought it would be the best way to kick-off our trip in Saigon. Indeed it was! Our guide was super nice and he answered every single question we asked him. We enjoyed the day and then we ended up having lunch all the group together (which it was included).

We liked the experience SO MUCH that we booked another tour for our last day to visit the Mekong delta and the countryside of Saigon. Both tours worth every single dollar and I would definitely recommend them to my friends visiting the city.

The Vespa Night Market tour was probably one of the best highlights of our holiday. It was absolutely fantastic and well worth it - we actually did not find it very expensive and the hospitality and friendliness of all the drivers was without a excellent! I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Saigon

review_title: The excellence tour - After the dark!
review_text: Last week, i had to join this tour with my friend and it was unique. This was my first time to try to seat a back of a scooter which called vespa. After picking you up at your place, they will bring you to coffee "Zoom" that place you will to conbine you to meet some new friends, drink your like, then your driver will bring you to some famous restaurant with seafood and Banh Xeo (vietnamese pancake),...listen some good songs at an ancient house with antique architecture. and the evening ends with a live music band. The trip is worth it. A little bit scared for tourists with a very first time to try to explore the traffic of Saigon. The most favorite valuable things in this tour of the tourists are taking delight in their dishes, seem to have no limits in food and drink.

review_title: Saigon After Dark - A Superb Experience!
review_text:
We booked the Vespa Adventures "Saigon After Dark" trip through our hotel. It seemed a little on the expensive side at 1,900,000 VND each, but after taking the trip, we'd say it was worth every penny!

Traffic in Saigon has to be seen to be believed with somewhere between three and five million motorbikes on the city's roads, so we were a bit anxious about jumping on the back of our Vespas in rush hour, but our guides were expert riders and we soon relaxed. A short trip to the Vespa Adventures home base at a Vespa themed bar was followed by free drinks to improve our relaxation, then on to the first restaurant in a residential area in District 4. Food here was superb. Pho, followed by clams and then a surprise local dish (try it - it is superb!), washed down with beer. Back on the Vespas to another restaurant down a back alley, where fantastic pancakes and spring rolls were served, along with more beer. Finally, the Vespas took us to a bar with live music. The band were great and four of us were invited to play and sing with them onstage, topping off a great night out.

All in all, this was a truly memorable experience - we saw parts of Saigon we would never have found ourselves and we got to experience driving in the madness of the city's traffic in the hands of experts. Thoroughly recommended!

We (two 60+ 'youngsters') joined this tour with some trepidation, but as soon as we overcame the seeming chaos of Hoi Chi Minh City's evening traffic, we relaxed and had great fun. Whisked away regularly by friendly Vespa drivers, we experienced cocktails, a three course dinner (in different street eateries), a piano bar, and a nightclub, before being safely returned to our hotel. Worth every penny/dollar - the best thing we did in a three week holiday!

What a novel way to feel like a local in a faraway city. I would never drive a vespa here myself (no rules!), but I felt perfectly safe with my driver. The food was amazing. Our guide (Huong) was very sweet and really gave us some insight about everyday life in Viet Nam in the city and in the country, which was where she grew up. The mix of different types of establishments was great (Bar, several different restaurants on the street, coffee house with great entertainment, disco) was welcome.

review_title: Fantastic end to our trip- Huyen Brilliant
review_text:
My fiancé and my two parents did this tour on the last night of our trip to Cambodia/Vietnam.

I was apprehensive before we started this as the roads were hectic to say the least but we were really glad we did.

We started by meeting our guide for the night who was a lovely girl called Huyen who was absolutely fantastic and spoke excellent English. She stayed with us the whole trip and we really enjoyed talking to her and her company- thanks Huyen!

The food stops were great and we ate some really interesting and tasty food we wouldn't have tried normally. We also really enjoyed the cafe and bar at the end. Most importantly the drivers were very good and made us feel safe.

All in all a perfect way to end the holiday and would highly recommend this.
A 4 1/2 hour whirlwind trip around Siagon on the back of a Vespa, Good company, loads of food (possibly too much?) and a few beers - Probably the best fun you can have with your clothes on!

Wow! HCMC is madness. However, with a Vespa tour you join the sea of ​​bikes and explore this frenetic place at the perfect pace. I was a little anxious that my parenting decisions could be a little off when I booked this for our family with a 9, 11 and 14 year old. I need not have worried my girls loved it - they said it was the best tour ever. The drivers really are brilliant and very careful. You our guide was helpful, informative and flexible. It was hot but the tour to Monument, a flower market etc. was interesting and so much fun. We all agreed that this is the way to see this city and even with children I think this is very do-able. I would love to have tried the night foodie ride, but, we are out of time. One tip where a proper t-shirt or you will end up very burnt.

This tour is simply just great fun and so well managed, they truly do take you to places were most tourists do not go and seeing the city from the back of a Vespa, alongside of the natives is a great way to experience Saigon. It's not at all scary and the drivers are experts. Do the tour at night.
Cheers

We did the night tour and without a doubt this was a highlight of our one month holiday. We were picked up at our hotel by our drivers. Probably about 6.30pm?Helmets worn of course and you get on the pillion seat and zoom of to a meeting place where all the other riders and groups are. They split us up into groups of about 8 and then we're off. We couldn't stop smiling! On a bike seemed so much safer than crossing the roads as a pedestrian!
The tour takes in 2 street food places, a dark bar where there was a trio - violin, piano and singer, then on to a noisy bar with rock music an singers. You get 5 ( I think! ) free drinks in with the price and, of course, you have had your evening meal via street fod. Back to the hotel for 11.00pm.
What a wonderful experience of sounds, sights, smells and tastes. YOU CANNOT MISS THIS !!

I had this trip recommended to me by another traveller and it was a great tour! I selected the Saigon by Night trip and although a bit expensive at $89 was really well organized and well worth while for the experience.

I was picked up from my hotel and met the others in my group at a cafe where we had pre dinner drinks. The guide spoke English well and had a good sense of humor to make the evening fun.

We visited 2 local restaurants for some really good local food, then a music venue and a bar with a live band. All of the menu items were explained to us and how to eat them. Our drivers would pick us up at the end of our time at each venue on the Vespas and take us on a cruise around the City to the next venue.

The trip went from 6pm to 10:30pm and was a great way to see the City and experience night life local style. Being a solo traveller it was also good to be out at night with a group of fellow travelers. This trip is really a 'must do' in Saigon.

review_title: Vespa tour of Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
this was the most fun I've ever had!
Our Vespa drivers were excellent & filled us with confidence, even with the madness of the traffic in Ho Chi Minh. We were taken to 3 cafes, a jazz club & a night club.... We had fantastic food & the drinks were included in the price too!
Our guide & drivers were so friendly & couldn't do enough for us. I'm vegetarian & they rang ahead to the cafes so instead of the fish or meat dishes I was given veggie ones, it was most unexpected but so appreciated. We found the Vietnamese as a nation are the friendliest, happiest people we have had the pleasure to meet. I would definitely recommended this trip if visiting Vietnam, I'm sure that the trips in other cities would be just as good.... a must do trip!

review_title: The only way to see Ho Chi Minh City.
review_text:
This is a copy of an email sent to my friends when I got back to my Hotel after this brilliant trip. I titled it The best white knuckle ride ever. By the end of it I'm sure you will understand how I felt and why I loved it and such good value for money.
Well folks my darling p may be on blood thinners but boy oh boy does she know how to have fun. When we were out this morning our guide told us of this amazing sight seeing trip around Ho Chi Minh City . I was a little apprehensive infact almost terrified it involved sitting on the back of a Vespa scooter and driving around the city. So almost reluctantly we signed up for this jaunt infact not much choice really as as you know she is the boss. So at 6.0pm tonight we arrived down at reception and was greeted by a young man wearing a crash helmet he quickly ushered us outside and there they were two Vespa scooters both with drivers and after putting on our crash helmets we were told how to sit on these death traps I have to say whilst the instructions were being delivered P looked as always calm and collective me I have to say was xxxxxxx myself. So off we go unfortunately my driver whilst I,m sure is able to deal with a little being was not so confident with a 14 stone miserable old so and so sat behind him bless his heart his little legs nearly buckled under the weight every time we had to stop so anyway we pull out into the traffic well I just can,t tell you there was cars buses and 50 thousand other scooters coming from each direction how we made it into the flow of the traffic I don,t know but anyway there we were one or two of thousands of people trying to reach their destination. Our first stop was the hub of the organisation who had thought of this ludicrous idea of transporting terrified clients around the city. Anyway things here started getting me in a better mood I heard this voice say what would you like to drink I was so overwhelmed I shouted beer know make that two and do you know that's what I got so okay maybe I,m now feeling a little happier whilst in the mean time p is just having the time of her life oh I do love her. Then food arrived and once finished we were off into the world of cars scooters and cycles all coming towards me at once from every direction their were so many near misses I just don,t want to bore you lets just say I can't believe I am still alive and writing this account
Of tonight's experience. So their are P and I with two other couples one from France and one from the phillipines they were really very nice and as the night wore on great company. We stopped at many venues and at each one there was food and most important beer we saw jazz groups and rock bands and beer at every venue absolutely brilliant. When they delivered us back to the hotel some four hours later. I found myself no longer worried about my next leg of that terrifying journey and do you know what I was sad to see it end. I really hope my next bulletin of this epic journey of P and J will be as exiting. Love you all and very glad to still be alive. Have a good day. Jeff
I highly reccommend Vespa by night! Wonderful experiance and very good way to learn the City. Our guide was great, the sellection of places we had visist - could not be better.

This was one of the highlights of our stay in Saigon. We rode pillion on the Vespas with two very capable drivers. Weaving in and out of the highly congested streets of Saigon was a delight. We never felt scared or frightened just a feeling of excitement and curiosity. They stop at the zoom bar for a drink to relax and a briefing of the evening.Then off you go into the madness of the Saigon streets for a stop at the first food bar. Our guide was called Dat and he spoke excellent English and he was a delight to be with, He explained all the dishes and showed us how to eat what was offered on the plate. We sampled the delights of a seafood stall with oysters, clams crab claws and frog. The food was excellent and we couldn't fault it. The second stopover was to sample the pancakes and local dishes with a nice drink of your choice to wash it down. Again the food was delightful. The next stop was the hidden cafe a remnant of the French influence during their occupation of this country. We were led up a little alley and up some spiraling stairs to a delightful boudoir that was dimly lit by candle light. We sat on sofas in this room that was full of character and ambience. We listened to three local singers taking their turn to sing with the accompanying piano and violin. The whole experience was a delight. The last visit was to a rock bar with character , a local band was performing singing typical rock songs.They were very good and it was a perfect end to a brilliant tour.You must try it.

review_title: best way to see Hoi Chi Minh City
review_text:
this was the best part of our trip. Vespa bike tour in Hoi Chi Minh City (Saigon). comfortable bikes with the best drivers. also had a good English speaking guide. we felt very safe through out the journey.
KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK VESPA ADVENTURES - VIETNAM

I have to tell you that if you are due to visit Hoi Chi Minh City of Saigon as it is still very often called you absolutely MUST do the tour. It is just the best fun ever. Brilliant way to see the City eat fantastic food at restaurants you would never find and get a real insight into this fantastic city by the best way possible on the back of a Vespa. Please do NOT think you are too old to do this, we are both in our sixties and loved every minute . It is incredible value for money. Just do it -it's amazing

review_title: Vespa by NIght - A MUST DO!!
review_text: When our travel agent arranged this we were a little worried about this... but we shouldn't have been. This was one of the highlights of the tour. We were picked up at our hotel on Vintage Vespa's and taken to the central meeting place, a café/bar, for a briefing. The traffic is crazy but the drivers were astounding and within minutes we were totally comfortable. We were met at the briefing by our guide for the evening who was great, good English, and fun. We gave our dietary restrictions and then we were on our way. The tour of the city was amazing and incredibly safe. We were in for a culinary treat as well with a 9 course dinner along the way in different districts. The guide met us at each place and had a table for us, explained what we were about to experience and then show us how to eat it. WOW!!! It was all streetfood and totally safe and drinks came with it We ended up at two amazing clubs....one a café with live singers, all young and all very good. Then on to a rock cover club for up an comers. What a fun evening. I would do it again.

review_title: Incredibly terrific start to our trip!
review_text: This was definitely a highlight of our 3 week trip - and on the first night. Our guide, Loan, was easy to understand and fun to be with. We sampled lots of new foods - and the right way to eat them! We got to restaurants and night clubs that we would never have found otherwise. The Vespa drivers were pleasant and attentive to making sure our helmets fit and were comfortable. We were nervous about setting out in the insane Saigon traffic on a motorbike,(never before on a motorcycle) but after the first couple of blocks it was just invigorating and thrilling. It's a great way to experience the city! The food and drinks are included in the price.

review_title: Highlight of our trip so far.
review_text: Excellent tour round Saigon at night on back of Vespas. Fabulous food, plenty to eat, interesting and informative guide. You feel safe on the bike,! Takes you to places you would never find on your own. Highest recommendation.

review_title: Vespa by night - Saigon after dark
review_text: The friends we travelled to Vietnam opted not to do the Vespa tour so we asked to be grouped with other people. We were in a group of 6 people. It was a good decision. We all got along famously. We did the night tour which consisted of pickup from hotel on Vespa and ride to meeting place. We had a welcome drink and met the rest of our group and our tour leader Chau! The tour consisted of ride on Vespa then first restaurant, ride on Vespa then second restaurant. Very full at this stage. To a coffee house with nice entertainment but really Vietnamese coffee which we didn't really like. We finished up at a bar with a live band. The fun part was definitely the Vespa experience in the Vietnamese traffic. This was our favourite night on our first trip to Vietnam

This was by far the best thing I did during my stay in Vietnam. It was so much fun!
It happened to be Tet while we were there and the streets were lit up with beautiful
decorations. Truly a magical experience!

We did the evening tour where we experienced this beautiful cities lights, great food and entertainment! We were taken to places we would have never found by ourselves, Chien was a fabulous guide and the drivers were safe and took good care of the riders! Do This!!!!!!!

It was really nice to take the tour with a Vespa and see Ho Chi Minh with a local guide. HE took us to non touristic places, explaining the story of each place.
The Vespas are really nice, the guide was very very kind, speaking very good english.
The lunch included after the tour was very good

review_title: A great night out in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Wee did this on the last night of our stay in Ho Chi Minh - we wished we had done it on the first night. traffic is crazy in Vietnam - no need to be nervous as the drivers are excellent and an no time do you feel at you at risk. Don't eat before you go, there is food and drink Aplenty. The night ends at a music club - fantastic. One of my best holiday experiences.

We joined the Vietnam Vespa - Saigon after dark tour in Ho Chi Min City! What a great night! It was like a night out with friends :) We cruised around the city on the back of funky little vespas in amongst the crazy and chaotic HCM traffic, ate popular delicacies on the street with the locals, danced, found hidden venues that we never would have discovered on our own! I can't recommend it highly enough, the tour guides, drivers, photographers were happy, friendly and extremely helpful, nothing was a problem! So good we did it all again in Hoi An a few days later.....next stop Cambodia and we will definitely check it out there as well!

review_title: Saigon by night and great food
review_text:
We usually see Saigon out of a vehicle and not at ground level. Excellent way to experience the vibe and the feel of Saigon.

You arrange for pick-up at your location and then you get whizzed off to the Zoom Bar that is the base of the Vietnam Vespa Adventures. If you are a group, you will probably do it as your group, but we were 3 and joined 3 others with their drivers. Safety is ++++, you get a full head helmet and sit at the back with a proper seatback supporting you.

Mixed, from seasoned travellers, to Saigon residents do this and certainly a way to introduce visitors to Saigon and the food. The foody tour on a Friday night just gives you the buzz around town, they do drive you around to give you the feel, living here clearly saw there were shorter routes, but scenic is certainly better on the back of a scooter. The choices were excellent, from clams to frog legs and a cold beer at the first street food restaurant. Vietnamese pancakes, spring rolls that you roll yourself at the back in District 3 which we probably won't find again. Caphe Sau Da at the little hidden gem of a coffe shop upstairs where there is live classical music, violin, piano and a singer or two and then you end this off with the Rock & Roll at Woodstock Bar in District 3 which rocks with a live band from anything from Mariah Carey to Black Sabbath, but certainly rocking the night away. All the drinks are included that we had at each location while on the tour, which included beer, soft drinks and some mixers.

Certainly recommend this as a thing to do in Ho Chi Minh City.....

Tip: Do it in Winter / Spring as this is still the dry season, can get wet and humid in Summer

review_title: Great way to see the city
review_text: We did the vesba tour the night we arrive. This was super fun and a great way to get a taste of saigons. You ride in the back of a Vespa... Which is great, no forgiener should drive in this city. They take you to a variety of restaurants and clubs so you get a nice sense of the city. The staff was great too.

review_title: Great for birthdays, bucks or a hens night celebration!
review_text: I had a blast celebrating my friend's birthday. The tour is both cultural and eating at two local eateries but there is more focus on having fun and drinking. What a rush! I recommend this for a celebration. I would avoid it if you are looking for more of an authentic tour, this is a party Xe Om!

review_title: Amazing way to see the city
review_text: This was a fantastic way to experience the city. I felt completely safe with my excellent driver. The evening tour was just great fun

Zipping around Ho Chi Minh City, is by far the best way to travel. Our tour and guide were brilliant, my husband who was very reluctant enjoyed this tour so much he convinced others here in vitnam to try it.. Great fun experience, fantastic guide. Loved it

review_title: Best night out in a long time!
review_text:
The thought of getting on the back of a scooter after seeing the traffic in Saigon terrified me but my driver was brilliant, even though she was tiny. The whole evening was great fun with a brilliant guide who made sure all my food was MSG free.

The drinks were pretty much free-flow, the food was tasty (even the frog) and the entertainment varied. The coffee house we visited was very cool and never to be found again. The Woodstock Bar at the end of the tour had an amazing house band on and had we not been flying on an early start the next day, we would have stayed until the small hours.

I really did feel like a local and saw so much more of Saigon had I been on foot or in a taxi.

Great concept, great tour and great guides and drivers.

Four of us got on the back of Vespas and headed out into the night. Who cares if it was pretty touristy? It was a blast. We got to zip around the city and see parts we hadn't visited, as well as taste lots of different kinds of food & experience a bit of the nightlife in Saigon. The food was great -- definitely go hungry -- there was everything from drinks, appetizers, a meal & coffee and dessert, as well as a bar with live music and a coffee house with live music. Our teenagers loved it as well. Highly recommend!

What a brilliant experience. I was nervous initially having never been on a bike, even in the UK, and riding thru Ho Chi Minh after dark, was never on my bucket list! The guide was excellent and we really appreciated her knowledge of the street food we ate. The food itself was tasty and we ate and drunk in a range of venues. The driver was amazing. How do they negotiate the weaving in and out! Felt completely safe with my helmet on.
The only negative comment I can make is about the final destination. It was a night club, lit by candles and we were concerned that the place was a fire hazard.
Certainly a night to remember and so glad I took part.

Bloody brilliant. We did 'the insiders Saigon tour'. We did a rickshaw tour 2 years ago and that was good but ducking around like a local kills it. We covered a heap of ground on the 4 hour tour and got to see a lot of places tourists wouldn't know about. our guide was super informative (even though the poor lady was exhausted from doing back to back tours). Slipping through the tiny lane ways was a lot of fun.

review_title: Fantastic way to see Saigon - a must do
review_text:
We have done several tours with Vietnam Vespa Adventures, who have been offering tours for many years. The After Dark tour is great fun with a group of friends and allows you to experience places and eat food at local restaurants you would not otherwise experience. We've also done the Saigon Insiders tour with a group of visiting friends (6 adults and 6 kids aged 8-12) who said it was a highlight of their trip, and even as ex-residents we saw places we hadn't been before.
The drivers and guides are always friendly, knowledgeable and helpful and you feel safe at all times (even for those unaccustomed to being on a bike in traffic).
Having lived in Saigon, I'm often asked for ideas about what to do when people are planning a trip to Saigon, and a tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures is top of my list.

This will be the highlight of your trip to Saigon, trust me. My travel agency, Black Tomato, hooked up my wife and me with this excursion and we really weren't prepared for how good it was going to be. The four hour night tour was very well choreographed with strategic stops at perfect locations for street food (I had great crab claws, snails, and frog legs at one stop alone!) and romantic music in a gritty speakeasy kind of hideaway.

Buzzing about the busy streets on the back of the Vespa was quite a thrill. There you are, shoulder with other bikers and zipping around like a local with the cold night air blowing through your hair. It was a fantastic way to see different Districts in Saigon and see how the nightlife rolls out. Saigon is a very cool city after dark with so much to see and experience.

Our tour guide, Kah, was extremely informative about the city and very adaptive to what we wanted to do and try, even if it was off the gameplay. He was also very attentive and looked out for me and my beautiful wife.

We did a lot of fun things throughout our 4-city vacation in Vietnam, but this was the most thrilling. I highly recommend it, and so does my beautiful wife.

I was a little hesitant due to the high cost, but definitely worth the money. I did the Saigon after dark tour last night and still raving how wonderful this was. It surpassed any hesitation I have. Great guide, well organized, fabulous food. All done riding on the back of a Vespa,like a local, to places around HCMC that most would not have seen. I'm still swirling from the great experience.

review_title: If you do one thing in Saigon do this
review_text: Such a great idea. Not to be missed experience, brilliantly organised, feeling part of the madness of the city's traffic combined with varied, intriguing venues, good food and as much booze as any sane person would want. Highly recommended for young and old.

My husband and I did the day tour and had an amazing time! The tour guides were excellent! They picked us up at our hotel right at 8 and took us to meet the rest of the group. They took us to several different sights which were really interesting. We would def do this again!

review_title: A terrific way to see Vietnam!
review_text: My daughter and I did the nighttime Vespa tour in Saigon and the day tour in Hoi An and both were terrific! I highly recommend them. The guides were fun to be with and very knowledgeable and the drivers were terrific. We felt totally safe and well taken care of

My husband and I both did the saigon foodie after dark tour and we had a wonderful time, we can't recommend this tour highly enough other than to say if you are in saigon and don't do this tour then you have missed a truly remarkable experience. From start to finish it was fantastic and excellent value for money too, you are picked up from your hotel and dropped back again it truly is worthwhile doing.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our experience, it was truely an adventure. Starting from Ho Chi Minh city to the coast and highlands then back to the coast, finishing at Nha Trang. The tour guide made our trip so memorable, with a wealth of knowledge and passion for the regions. The support crew, made our trip easier by taking care of our belongings and guiding us safely back into the traffic after many stops sightseeing. The luxury accomodation was just that, and a great way to top off the day!

review_title: Insiders Tour - A really great experience
review_text: We took a morning vespa "Insider's" tour and both thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. Our drivers Dat and Khuong were very competent and we felt quite safe despite the very busy traffic around us. Dat was also our tour guide and he was fantastic. We both enjoyed his company and interesting conversation..... and good sense of humour. Our tour took us to an interesting range of destinations including visits to the Memorial for Thich Quang Duc (I remember as a 5 year old this Monk self immulating as if it was yesterday - very moving place), a local bird watchng park, a local wholesale flower market, China town markets, temple and a visit to a traditional Chinese medicine apothercary, and the rather fantastuc 10,000 Buddha Pagoda. Lunch at the Zoom Cafe was also very yummy. This was an absolutely brilliant experience and a real highlight of our trip to Ho Chi Minh City. When we come back we now plan to take one the the multi-day tours,

review_title: Saigon After Dark Tour a must!
review_text:
This was the bast this we have done in ages, really it was, Saigon at night is a must, get picked up from your Hotel by two experienced bike riders, you need to be experienced to ride about this city, it's MAD. Really it is!

Firstly we went to Zoom Cafe for drinks, as many as you like, then we went across town, though all the traffic, had to shut my eyes a few times, to a seafood resturant that also sold Jumping Chicken, no imagination need as to what that is, then it's whizzed away on a 20 min ride to a proper local place that did these amazing pancakes, we were shown how to make them, the tourist that we are ;)

Now the Coffee bar was the best I thought, it was local artist singing and playing, would never have found it, it was though a garage and up some stairs, very memorable.

Into Woodstock bar we go, there's a Tina Turner type on, again drink away, so good.

Great bunch of people to do it with and very good fun.

All in all it was the best fun, we had in Saigon, this we would never have seen. Well worth the money.

This was such a fun fantastic experience.My husband and I approached it with some trepidation but in the event felt quite safe on these very comfortable bikes and in the hands of our very experienced drivers.The whole event from the exhilarating rides to the food and venues were simply brilliant .What a night !!

I loved being on a Vespa being ridden around the Mekong delta back roads seeing the poorer parts of living conditions of the locals.
It wasn't hot bring on the bike , the open air is refreshing after our pit stops along the way -
Really do recommend it- way better then the bus tour which I've done previously.

The Saigon After Dark Food Tour was the best food tour we have ever taken. Whoever thought of combing Vespa scooters with a restaurant tour is a genius. Once you get used to moving in traffic with about 50,000 other motor bikes and scooters you really enjoy the atmosphere of Saigon. We were driven to a meeting point where we met our group leader and the other five people in our sub group. We had a couple of drinks, got to know one another and then hit the streets. The first stop was a seafood restaurant where our table sampled crab legs, clams, mussels, shrimp, frog legs, noodle soup and local beer. The second stop gave us spring rolls in rice paper, the best prawn and bean sprout pancakes I have ever eaten and grilled beef with condiments in lettuce leaves and a rice wrapper. Our favorite Vietnamese restaurants at home pale in comparison. Take this tour. The food is great and the experience even better.

Awesome tour with Ju. Was a group booked trip but I was lucky enough to be the only one on our tour!!! So got a completely bespoke experience and got to see some extra hidden gems. There is no other way to get a true feel for the city in such a short space of time! Such a beautiful place, an excellent knowledgeable tour guide and driver & got a feel for what it's like to actually be on these crazy roads! Amazing!!!!

review_title: A must have experience while in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: So glad we booked the Vespa night tour. It was the best experience we have had so far. Loan our tour guide was an excellent host for the night and our drivers were excellent. It definitely gave us the experience of riding on the roads on a Vespa just like the locals do. We started at a pub/cafe for drinks then to 2 restaurants for delicious food/drinks then a coffee shop/singing cafe and finally a nightclub. $89 US but was well worth it having a driver drive you from place to place on the Vespa and pick up from hotel and drop back at end of night. Would recommend for young and older tourists. Loan had good English and drivers good understanding too.

We were pick up by our drivers after dark, 20 more Vespas mingle with the millions existings motorbikes in Saigon. Fantastic go about, sense of trust or my driver and the others. We visited parts of Saigon which I had serous doubts that we would visit any other way.
I may say I LOVED this Adventure Tour.

By far one of the scariest yet most exciting evenings spent whilst in Vietnam. We were picked up from our hotel and from the word go I felt confident with the driver. Never having been on a scooter in my life and feeling I might be too old for such an activity, this was in at the deep end. However it was fantastic.I felt safe, even as we sped in and out of the Saigon New Year traffic. The food stops were wonderful too, places we might never have found and food we might never have eaten.All food , and there was plenty, and all drinks , again plenty and any choice, was included in the price. Everything was explained to us in perfect English and in a delightful manner. Would certainly recommend , whatever your age and experience.

We took the night tour in a large group.
My driver was outstanding and gave me great insight to many things as we toured around.
They took us to dinner and several hotspots for music and drinks.
What an awesome way to see this amazing city.
Well worth it especially if it is your first time in Saigon.

The four of us were a bit apprehensive about the After Dark Food Tour but it was amazing. Our guide Tuyen was brilliant, spoke very good English and had a good sense of humour. The drivers were all very compentent and we all felt safe weaving in and out of the traffic. The food stops were very good and we all ate the jumping chicken which looked (and tasted better) than how they looked hopping about their cage. This is a must do when in Saigon.

review_title: Great way to get out and about
review_text:
My friend and I were picked up at our hotel for the glimpse of the Mekong tour our English speaking guide Chein together with the other drivers helped us have an awesome day
I highly recommend this as a tour to see a bit of rural life
We both came for food adventure and fun and we got it on this tour
A varied and entertaining day full of information you won't be disappointed

As a british tourist, the streets of Saigon can be incredibly daunting. This tour allowed me to be part of it and feel 100% safe and able to enjoy the City.
The tour riders were friendly and very experienced. Having never been on the back of a bike before, I felt incredibly comfortable and safe. My driver was always helpful and conscientious throughout the tour.
The tour took us to a mixture of lesser known tourist areas (2 beautiful and tucked away pagodas, a traditional food market, China town and by the banks of the Saigon river via the only underwater tunnel in vietnam.) and some of the bigger ones (reunification palace, notre dame and the post office).
Lunch was included at the beginning of the tour. I did the afternoon tour, but if you do the morning tour you get lunch afterwards.
Our main tour guide was very knowledgeable, friendly and very open to any questions you had. If you wanted to buy anything, he would grab you a
bargain too!
Overall a brilliant experience and personally, I feel, it was worth the money. There are cheaper tours via minibus, but I prefered this over any group tour you can take.
Fantastic experience!

review_title: Best way to see Ho Chi Min in a day!
review_text:
My husband, friends and I only had one day, unfortunately, in Ho Chi Min, so wanted to make the most of it - mission accomplished! This tour was fabulous. First off you meet for a great lunch, second you sit on the back of the motorbike so you can worry about sightseeing (not crazy drivers).

We stopped at 5 different places and our tour guide was FABULOUS - she taught us so much about the city, the people, the history / culture. We also covered a lot of ground, between 12 - 5 pm. Definitely a must do!

My girlfriend and I went on the "glimpse of the Mekong delta" day tour with Vietnam Vespa adventures. From the moment they picked us up from our hotel that morning, the guides were wonderful, happy and knowledgeable. I drove my own Vespa and both our guide and the owner (Steve?) made sure I was comfortable on the scooter and actually knew what I was doing. From there we took off into the countryside, stopping at local cafés, fish farms, rice wine makers house, incense house and eating great food along the way. Our main guide, Chin (spelling?) was incredibly friendly and very knowledgeable. Highly recommend this tour to anyone in HCMC or other areas they offer in Vietnam.

My boyfriend and i participate in the Saigon After Dark Tour 17.feb. It was really fun, good food, nice live music(at the last stop) & we were very lucky with a fantastic guide named, Dep ❤ She spoke good english, were funny, and treated us great! I can understand that some think it is a bit pricey, but for us it was abselutly worth it! In fact this was our most exiting night in Vietnam.

- Thina Svendsen, Norway

review_title: Eat, Drink & Ride! Most important of all, relax!!
review_text:
Joined two tours by Vespa Adventures: Glimpse of the Mekong & Saigon after dark. Both are good!

Ho Chi Minh city is vibrant (or hectic to some) so the Mekong Tour is a good get away from the city. Visiting the family business, be it cafe in the front and shrimp farm in the back or rice wine factory, you get to better understand the rural life.

We had the best clams in the market and the colorful fruits and vegetables would feed your phone well!!

Our guide and the drivers were all very professional. You have to trust your drivers. Regardless you are in the right lane (or not), there'll be incoming bikes. Keep calm and relax. It's part of the fun!!

Wear a long pants though despite it's 30C, the Vespa metal surface gets hot and you might get metal-burn if in shorts.

Foodie after dark is truly endless food, drinks and fun. I do hope they ordered less food to minimize waste, one can only eat and drink so much, come with an empty stomach please. For our tour, it's a group of 6 and we had a great company with the other family.

If we ever come back, would consider the 2D1N tour to explore the wildlife : )

Loved every moment of our country side tour! I rode on the back of a Vespa, while my husband and friend rode their own bikes on the tour. Driving through the city was exhilarating, and seeing the countryside and seeing how the people live were such rich experiences. Loved every moment. We dropped by some local businesses, the wet market, and had some local snacks. Our tour guide was super, and I felt very safe and in good hands with my driver. I would urge you to take part in this awesome tour, you won't regret it! Tip - wear sunglasses to protect your eyes from the dusty roads, and wear running shoes and lots of sun block!

review_title: See Life From the Back of a Vespa
review_text: They picked us up at the hotel at 6 PM for the evening tour. It was like a progressive dinner. We were driven around Saigon (out of the tourist center) and stopped at three different street restaurants - open air restaurants with seating on the sidewalk. There was a mix of locals and tourists so the experience was akin to the way the Vietnamese travel and eat in Saigon. At each stop we had a few dishes with beer to wash it down. Afterwards, we were taken to a coffeehouse with guitarists and singers. Finally, we stopped at a bar with rock music. We didn't get back to our hotel until 11:00 PM and could have stayed out later is we had the energy. Incredibly enjoyable!

When you arrive in Saigon, all you can see are the millions of scooters around you.
There are nine millions apparently.
To ride a scooter as a passenger at night in the city makes you feel like you are part of daily life. It is absolutely the best way to discover the different districts. Exhilarating, fun, joyous.
They will take you to different areas to eat seafood ( great), Banh Xeo ( not the best) to music venues during a four hour tour that will leave you inspired!

To have the chance to spend the day on the back of a vespa in Ho Chi Minh city is a real treat!!!! This amazing city of 11 million people has 8 million motorbikes and on this tour you really feel like you are part of the city. There is no trip to the countryside on this tour, you are right in the city and get to see and experience some wonderful locations; the temple of 1000 Buddha's is truly spectacular as is the monument to Thich Quang Duc, the "burning monk". Our drivers were friendly and fun and our guide was equally enjoyable. The drivers pick you up and return you to your hotel which makes it so easy. This tour is safe and a lot of fun for adults or for families (we were a family of 5; kids ages 12-18. A definite must do trip while you are in Ho Chi Minh.

review_title: Insider's Tour of Saigon - great experience
review_text: we took the Insider's Tour of Saigon during the day time and thoroughly enjoyed it. sitting on the back of the vespa and travelling on the streets of saigon is an experience in itself. the scooters are in tip top condition and the drivers are really good. its not a touristy tour in itself, it takes you to the main tourist places and also to the inside streets and lanes of the city. its a new thing experiencing the city away from the tourist hot spots. as part of the tour we went to the flower market and amazing to see different varieties of flowers and so colorful too. the highlight of this tour for me was the ride inside the tunnel. a special commendation to the tour guide who was extremely knowledgeable and efficient and had a good command over the english language and explained everything very very clearly.

My friend and I did this about 10 days ago and I would say that if you did one thing in Vietnam, do this... We were in Vietnam travelling for a month and this was one of the best things! It was exciting and great to be part of the massive 2 wheeled fraternity, in the middle of it all! We tried different foods and a person met us at every stop who was very informative. We went to a cafe/bar, up a seedy staircase and we were shown to a candlelit room where a lady was singing, accompanied by a violin - it was lovely, and then on the last stop we went to a modern music bar. It was great to see how the younger population spent an evening. We thoroughly enjoyed our evening,seemingly all very casual, but extremely well organised. The excitement was heightened by the start of Tet (their New Year) which meant many streets were adorned with illuminations.Great time- do it !

review_title: Had a great time and the food was great!
review_text: I did the Saigon After Dark and overall I thought it was a great experience. I got to eat a lot of different food that I may not have tried or known how to properly eat otherwise. The drivers were nice and flying around Saigon on a vespa is just a ton of fun. That having been said, the $87 price tag really is exorbitant, especially for Vietnam.

My wife and I participated in the Vietnam Vespa Adventures “Saigon After Dark” Tour and were disappointed with the tour (and quite surprised that the reviews on Trip Advisor had been so overwhelmingly positive).

In particular, we felt that the tour’s description was misleading and that it was definitely not worth the 87 USD price tag (which is no small sum anywhere and is exorbitant for Vietnam). As part of this tour you won’t be eating street food, you’ll be eating at two restaurants surrounded by approximately 50 other people also on the same Vietnam Vespa Adventures tour. For most of the evening we felt like we were on a grade school field trip. Here are a couple of examples of how we were disappointed in the tour:

We were told that we we’d start off on a long ride on our Vespas (~20 minutes) to get out into areas where no tourists could be found. We set off from Café Zoom and indeed seemed to venture far out from the touristy Pham Ngu Lao area in District 1. We assumed we were on our way to our first local street food spot far away from Café Zoom. However, after about 20 minutes, I realized we had in fact driven in a giant circle and were back to where we started. We were meant to have the impression that we had in fact traveled somewhere interesting. This felt very dishonest of the tour, as if we were literally and figuratively being “taken for a ride.”

In the brochure, the tour is described as “an intimate evening” with “several stops for delicious street food and drinks at our favorite local spots.” We were specifically told by our guide that we’d go places where no other tourists would be found. The “several” stops for street food ended up being just two restaurants: one seemed to be legitimately local and was actually outside of District 1 (although filled with something like 50 other people on the same Vespa Adventures tour), while the other was a banh xeo place listed prominently in the Lonely Planet. In fact, we had considered going on our own to that exact place earlier in the day for lunch. Not exactly a hidden spot where no other tourists would be found. That restaurant was full of the same 50 people on our Vespa tour, plus any number of other tourists who had found the restaurant without expert assistance from the locals at Vietnam Vespa Adventures.

Prior to setting off on the tour, we were informed we would, as a small group, decide what places we wanted to visit and chart out a route. The implication was that there was flexibility and even spontaneity that would figure into which local street food spots we would visit. Instead, we felt like we were on an assembly line, being driven from place to place upon which a mass of Vietnam Vespa Tour guides, drivers and tourists would descend. It was hardly the “intimate” experience described in the brochure and there wasn’t any flexibility in the itinerary.

After eating, we were taken to a “hidden café.” While the setting was intimate, it felt anything but authentic when we looked around the room and saw it was filled only with the other 50 people from Vietnam Vespa tours on our same field trip. In fact, thinking about it now, we wouldn’t be surprised if this “hidden café” really only exists as a spot to take Vespa tourists.

We won’t complain about the tremendous cheesiness of the last stop at a local bar (which, again, was right in the middle of District 1 where all the tourist traps are) because it was essentially billed as this in the brochure. And, quite frankly, at that point in the night, we expected nothing less.

Our guide, Eric, was very nice, and we appreciated our drivers who were attentive and drove safely. However, this was an incredibly disappointing experience and not worth $87 per person. Clearly Vietnam Vespa Tours has found a formula that is easy and apparently sufficient to keep the tourists happy based on the reviews. But, for those of you who expect some degree of innovation, spontaneity and an honest attempt at personalizing the experience for each group, we would recommend you try your luck with another one of the many street food tours available in Saigon (although we cannot vouch for any of them).

Most fun to be had riding carefree 'shotgun' style with excellent Vespa driver and excellent group guide. With agreement from the other 4 comprising this group, I had requested seeing a bit more of non-tourist Saigon. The guide complied by taking us into another district which provided insight into the everyday living quarters, where housing was being demolished, streets were passable only with motorbikes and we did not get off to "walk around". Clearly a different side of Saigon from the tourist center. Exciting, eye opening. As a passenger it was easy to take photo's as we zipped around cars and corners. I know this would be my teenage granddaughters first choice for seeing this remarkable city and only sorry I didn't also opt for the evening tour. Couldn't talk my husband and friends to hop on the bikes with me. Now, they wish they had. It's a GREAT way to turn the clock back for 60 and 70 something, and continue to learn while having fun. The Driver manipulated the bike with care through the traffic and you get a real sense of what it's like "threading a needle". Visited an herbalist shop in Chinatown, wound our way through the largest open market in the city, walked through the flower market district and crossed the river to see the site of future luxe development. This tour operator is a MUST DO (and next time I'll try their services in their other locations as well).

This is a sure fire way to overcome any trepidation you may feel about HCM 10 million scooter population. Climb on the back of a Vespa with a friendly guide after welcoming drinks and scoot around town for 4 hours. We managed to avoid an over exposure to the tourist must do sights and had some insight to other aspects of Saigon life. On our return theres lunch waiting and the ever ready Green brew.

Slightly more expensive than the other scooter options in town but well worth the experience.

This tour was so much fun!! We were a bit apprehensive about getting on the Vespas after witnessing the crazy traffic in HCMC, however the drivers were excellent and we felt very safe.

Our guide Lo-an was fantastic, so friendly and knowledgeable about the food. She was really fun.

The tour involved 2 food stops, followed by live music at a really funky coffee shop, then lastly a lively bar with the best live band! Drinks were free flowing (mostly beer but a few cocktails at the first and last stops), and the food was good - went to places and tried things we never would have found on our own.

We ended up staying out long after the tour finished at 10pm as we were having so much fun!

Excellent way to see the city, highly recommend this tour

Spent the day riding around the outskirts of Saigon on a Vespa, the day was nicely paced with many stops and interesting sights and points of interest along the way.
The guides were very attentive and everything was thought of, dust masks for the gravel road, hand towels and good food and drink.
I could not think of anything these these guys could do better, I would thoroughly recommend doing this trip.
Great day, totally professionally run operation, I felt safe and looked after the whole way. This is a terrific way to spend a day, and see some countryside outside HCMC.

We took the Saigon Night Tour by Vietnam Vespa Adventures by End January 2015. The tour exceeded our expectations. Perfect guide, perfect drivers, very well organized tour. Wonderful meals and wonderful places in 4,5 hours. Would do it again without hesitation.

My wife and I did the night ride around the city sampling food. The food was great and the little coffee bar was probably my favorite (live music, Vietnamese coffee, and a cozy spot with local people). My only gripe was that the next day my wife and I both had some GI issues. Nothing too serious, but I was a little disappointed in the tour for not choosing restaurants that would be ok for us to eat at. Of course, it could have been a freak occurrence, so take this with a grain of salt.

A fun time and we would do it again!

What a fun night. Did the "Saigon After Dark" tour and had a fantastic time. Driver and guide were great. Didn't even have to close my eyes once - unlike driving in a car there. By the end of the night, I was no longer holding-on for dear life - in fact, hardly holding on at all. Enjoyed all the stops - both food and entertainment. Lee (70), Philadelphia, PA

As a pair of early sixty year olds who hadn't been on a scooter for forty years, and seeing Saigon traffic, we were a little apprehensive. We should not have worried. We were picked up from or hotel at 1800 and returned at about 2230 having had a great night. The drivers were very careful and the lady who met us at each of the several stops looked after us , ordering drinks and showing us how to eat the local foods. A great evening. If you have any doubts , don't . Go for it.

Fantastic evening if you have limited time in Saigon. Picked up from hotel promptly and taken to first bar for a drink,snack and quick briefing from our guide for the night. Then off to Chinatown for first meal of seafood and jumping chicken. Very fresh clams,mussels and crab. Back on the scoters to a pancake restaurant for more local food. Restaurant is up a side street and in the family for over 65 years. Quick lesson on how to wrap herbs and meat in rice paper followed by special crispy pancakes. Next off to soul/jazz club for another drink. Finishing up in a rock club playing mainly American tunes and then back to the hotel. Cost including all food and drink was £60.00
Sounds expensive but a unique evening and great that someone else is driving in this scooter mad city. Tour lasted 4.5 hours. As it says in the brochure "The ride of your life'"

review_title: Don't miss it - a great experience
review_text: We took the "Saigon After Dark" foodie tour with Vespa Adventures. We really were not disappointed at all. After our nerves settled and the rush hour traffic died down a bit, we felt like old pros zooming around Saigon. Our drivers were excellent and even though they did not speak much English, they had a calm friendly manner about themselves which quelled any anxiety we had. Our food guide, Tuyen, was a university student who works as an evening guide to help pay for university. He had good English and was knowledgable both about Vietnam and the food we were being served. It was a pleasure to meet and chat to a young Vietnamese student like this. The tour is slightly over priced for the food you are served, especially if you do not drink much but our only true let down was Vespa Adventures said they would send us photos of our trip but it has been a week and we have not got them yet. Hope we get them soon.

I did the Saigon by night Food Tour

Good points

1. Being driven around Saigon on a scooter - what a buzz!
2. Great food at 2 restaurants I wouldn't have found myself.
3. Friendly informative guide and skilled safe drivers

Bad points

1. Definitely overpriced for what it is - only 2 eateries. Other companies provide more eating stops and at cheaper prices.
2. I felt I was on a conveyor belt. As soon as you arrive at a venue another group is leaving, and when its time to leave, another group has just arrived.
3. The photos that were emailed to me a few days after the tour were of a different group. I did not get the courtesy of a reply to either of 2 emails sent regarding this. And YES I DID check my junkbox!

Overall I think they are resting on their laurels now from the many favourable reviews.

review_title: A brilliant way to experience Saigon traffic
review_text: One of our best adventures during a packed tour of South East Asia. Some nervousness to begin with but the expert and friendly drivers soon dispelled any anxiety and we were well into the fun of apparently racing round Saigon (in reality rarely exceeding 30mph) from one eatery to the next. All three food stops were good with authentic and tasty food served each time - a great way to sample some of the key specialities of the area. Then a visit to a musical evening in what seemed to be a very obscure location (at the back of a garage and up some old stairs) - lovely atmosphere (everywhere lit with candles) and finally to a Night Club where one act in particular was very entertaining. I'd recommend this to anyone over 18 but especially to more 'mature" people as it really does bring back youthful experiences.

review_title: Truly an Adventure - not to be missed!
review_text: Vespas adventure? - help! I'm seventy and I haven't been on one before, and it looks like mayhem the roads. My wife and I and another couple went for it. Reassuring, exciting, memorable, amazing - just do it!

a group of 16 of us went along on the Food-nightlife tour with Vespa Adventures! A night that was by far one of our most memorable! The food was well selected and they had options for anyone not willing to give frogs legs a go. The coffee shop stop was culturally trendy and the final stop at the bar/club was tons of fun! The hostess and the drivers were polite, careful and hilarious! We had the most fun with this tour and for the price you certainly get a lot more than you bargain for!

We were picked up at our hotel and whisked to the Zoom cafe where we had a drink and an appetizer, and met other Vespa riders and our tour guide.
We then cruised along to different restaurants with wonderful food and service!! Dep our guide told us about all the foods and what sauces to use . Wonderful experience.
We then headed to a cafe and listened to an awesome violin player, piano player and different singers. They sang so beautifully I didn't want to leave. But to my surprise we went to a wonderful nightclub with great singers too. They rocked the house !!!! Sadly it was time to leave and end our night! The ride on the bike was so fun cruising through the busy breezy streets , just a great time!!!!

review_title: Fantastic! Must do if in HCM
review_text:
Definitely recommend these guys. Picked up in style by vespas from our hotel. Delightful lunch at their headquarters (which is included). Our tour guide Binh introduced himself to us after lunch and away we went.
We visited fantastic sights we never would have come across if it wasn't for this tour. His explanations were excellent and the drivers that took us around were so courteous.

After the tour concluded, the drivers detoured to help us find a dish that we hadn't found during our trip, before taking us right back to our hotel.

So many other tours to go on. Will literally be back again.

We had a seven hour layover in HCMC and decided to book a Vespa tour. I contacted Stephen and he was most helpful in making all the arrangements for our group of eight. We were met by the guides at the airport, jumped on the Vespas, and were off on our adventure through the city. It took a few minutes to get used to the traffic patterns and chaos. Our bags were kept safe at their cafe headquarters. We were fed lunch, taken to many sites around the city, including a market, a temple, the post office, and more. Everyone was delightful, friendly, helpful, and good natured. I highly recommend this tour and this company. In the end, they delivered us timely to the airport for our continued journey.

review_title: The Only Way to See HCMC
review_text: We were picked up at our hotel by our drivers and taken to VVA's office (restaurant) to meet our tour guide and discuss our particular interests. Our tour guide Yu, was exceptional. Her English was excellent and she had an infectiously enthusiastic personality. She asked us what we wanted to see as opposed to the "canned tour". We agreed with the second couple that we wanted to see the "real HCMC" versus the typical tourist spots. So off we went to an incredible day. Wonderful sights, sounds and smells! Not to mention the exhilaration of being in the teaming scooter school! At the end we were served lunch and given guide books to the city that were far better than the one we had. I can't recommend VVA any higher, especially if you can get Yu as a guide. (But buy a face mask before you go)

review_title: Best part of my stay in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: While I did not like Ho Chi Minh city very much, this tour made it worth it. Was so exciting riding the Vespa through the city and out to the Mekong. The tour guide was very friendly and spoke English quite well. Would definitely recommend. Also they do tours in hoi an which are great too.
Timid need not apply. For the rest, it's a great way to see the town. Most hotels can arrange this. Ours was a foodie tour that hit several restaurants and bars. A hoot and well worth it.

What a fabulous idea. You see the vespas and scooters wizzing round the city and this is your chance to have a go.
It doesn't matter how old you are, my husband and I are in our 50s and it was perfectly do-able.
Our little guide, Chau was an utter delight, explaining what the food was in the restaurants we visited and the correct way to eat it.
What can I say! Just do it. A super company. They do what they say. 100% reliable. It was one of the highlights of our trip.
Many thanks,

review_title: Awesome .. A must do in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Loved it .. Have been to Ho Chi Minh many times visiting friends and this was suggested to me by them . A different view of the city , taken to interesting spots with a very good English speaking guide who had lots of history info . Very friendly riders , not at all scary felt very safe the whole time . Loved it so much I'm about to book the 2 day Mekong trip for the next couple of days . Keep up the good work guys :)

review_title: Awesome night tour in Ho Chi Minh!
review_text:
Awesome experience. Great way to explore Ho Chi Minh (Vietnam) riding a Vespa and enjoying the local food with your friends.

The Vespas picked us up in our hotel and took us to four different places: two with local food (get ready to eat a lot!) And two with music and drinks (get ready to dance!). Food was local and really good; music was perhaps geared towards western style. Fun, but perhaps more local music would have been appreciated.

Overall great experience. Loved the plan!!!

We visited Ho Chi Minh for two days in the middle of our honeymoon in Cambodia and Vietnam and it was honestly one of the highlights of our entire honeymoon. Such great fun!!! We only had 2 nights in Saigon, and this is certainly the very best way to see the city and take in as much as possible, the local way.
As someone who is a little afraid of motorbikes, scooters etc, I honestly couldn't have felt safer. Our vespa drivers were excellent, and our guide Chien (pronounced Chin) was so much fun. We had such a laugh with him throughout. The food was delicious at the local restaurants (included in the tour price) - it was nice to eat where the locals do!
Thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone - any age or type of traveller. Thank you again to Chien - such a top guy!

review_title: Awesome day trip - Mekong delta and cooking class
review_text: What a fantastic day! A highlight of our Vietnam trip! Great fun with experienced drivers, and an interesting cooking class set up similar to Masterchef! Learnt loads, and had lots of fun! Highly recommend this tour!!!

This is probably one of the most fun things that I have ever done!

You get picked up from your hotel or wherever you are staying by your personal driver on an old school Vespa.

First a quick bite (1 drink, 1 meal ALL INCLUSIVE) at a decent lunch place, and then it's time for a 4-hour tour through HCMC.

Driver are very experienced so no need to worry about the buzzing traffic. Really, it's unbelievable how many scooters you will see in this city. But don't worry, you are in safe hands with these drivers.

You drive though the whole city, and stop at all the must-sees and some very local spots. Local spots where you will be the only tourist! The flower market for example.

Tour guides know everything and their level of English is perfect.

The only thing you need to worry about is the other participants. If you are unlucky you share the tour with a boring group. But does it really matter if you are seated on an old school Vespa and are driving through such an exciting city like HCMC? NO

The few hours my wife and I spent with Vietnam Vespa Adventures was truly memorable! The company was extremely organized and made the tour flawless. We were picked up right on time at our hotel and brought (by vespa chauffeur) to the their meeting point. From there, we met our guide for the day (Chien), who spoke excellent English, and was very knowledgeable about HMC and all of the sights we saw. I chose to ride my own scooter, while my wife rode as a passenger with one of their drivers. We took the Mekong Delta tour and it was fabulous. We saw authentic parts of Vietnam that we could not have seen any other way.

Overall, I highly recommend this tour company and look forward to using them again!

BY far the highlight of our stop visiting friends in HCM City. My friend that has lived in HCM City for the last 2 years booked this for us and it did not disappoint. The city traffic is insane, and on this tour you get to be in the middle of it like you ride on the back of a vespa. The food and drink is also very good and enjoyed every stop along the way. The guide was very knowledgable, friendly and truly enjoyed showing us around. They guide asked that you not take pictures while riding, but we took plenty, just hold onto you phone/camera so a thief doesn't get a gift as they snatched it on the way by. Looking back I wish I had brought our GoPro and put it on one of those selfie sticks and just taped the ride through the traffic from about a foot above my head. That would be the only way to truly capture the fun of driving around the town. Cant recommend it enough, would easily do it again because they changed up some of the restaurants that they use. Have fun!

What a crazy few hours - an amazing night with loads of food, drinks and surprises. Our guide Tuyen was great. Riding the back of the bikes through Saigon traffic was exhilarating! An unforgettable experience that I'd definitely go back for. Highly recommend!

review_title: HCM city in the fast lane
review_text:
