A great way to eat local food and see the city at night. Our guide talked us through how to eat various dishes through the night. On the Vespa we drove past key attractions at night and ended the evening at a local bar with live music.
The Vespas are very safe and I felt at ease the whole time. This is a great way to see HCM at night and eat some unusual foods too

review_title: A crazy ride for a crazy evening !
review_text: If you want to spend a very special evening in Ho Chi Ming City, you cannot miss Vespa Experience! You Jumeirach on board of a nice Vespa with a happy and safe driver ( which is fondamental!) and you start your Crazy ride in the caotic traffic of the city. There are stops in a restaurant on the street where you can taste the most fresh seefood in Town, in a romantic bar where you can listen soft and lovely live music, in other particular places where you can share the real vietnamese night Life. And the experience to taste the Crazy local traffic is absolutly unique! And if you are so lucky to have a guide so pretty and gentle as Huong, the evening will be perfect !

review_title: 7 day Saigon to Nha Trang tour
review_text: We recently did the 7 day tour from Saigon to Nha Trang. We were the only two people on the tour so great to have that personal attention with Huan as our tour guide and Do ( apologies for the spelling) as our mechanic. Do yourself a favour and get out of the mainstream tourist crap and get yourself on one of these multi day tours. You get to experience things which are off the beaten track. Also, if you have no bike experience then don't even consider riding your own bike. I have many years riding a big bike around nsw and it was a challenge for me.......especially the ride into Dalat. Sit behind a guide and enjoy the view knowing you are in good hands. I enjoyed my time on the classic Vespa so much that I'm buying one when I get to Sydney.

review_title: Do the Mekong tour with cooking class!
review_text: My husband and I participated in the Mekong day tour with cooking class in December 2014. Overall, it was a great experience. My husband, who owns a motorcycle at home, was excited to drive his own Vespa during this tour. I, on the other hand, sat behind a nice driver! So nice to see the outskirts of the city although be prepared for some cultural things that are a bit shocking to western people - don't say I didn't warn you about the dogs in cages and frogs at the wet market! Stopped for some refreshing Vietnamese Iced Coffees along the way. Had a delicious lunch with plenty of food and beer too! It was a great experience and worth the $$.

I have to say first that this is my personal review. My wife hated the vespa rides and was really sacred, however I absolutely loved the whole evening.

We were picked up promptly from our hotel at 6pm and taken to a cafe where we had a drink and some snacks and a guide briefed us about what we were going to do. He was very good and spoke English very well.

We had a total of 5 stops when we ate some amazing street food including frogs legs. The 4th stop was at an amazing upstairs cafe down a side street which we would never have found ourselves, let alone plucked up courage to go in. There we were serenaded by some really good singers and musicians. It was really relaxing ....

... which is more than can be said for our final stop where our ears were assaulted by an amazingly good rock band. The atmosphere was great and the music first class. Special mention must go to the lead guitarist who would have given Hendrix a run for his money!

We got back to our hotel at 10.30pm. I don't think I stopped smiling the whole time. Jane has finally stopped trembling!

Thoroughly recommended if you are looking for an adventure

We arranged this day tour while we were in port during our cruise, December 28th. We were looking for something adventurous and not sightseeing in the city and it turned out to be the best trip!!!
They picked up our group of four at the port in Phu My and drove us into the city. Each of us had our own Vespa driver. The drivers were amazing. We felt safe as we wove through the other motorbikes and over the country roads. The drivers and tour guide were very kind, friendly and attentive. We made several stops during the day: shrimp farm, incense, rice wine, local food market, temple, ferry crossing, etc. The food we had for lunch and later on was so fresh and delicious. We really felt that we experienced the culture of Vietnam and would love to go back and have another Vespa adventure. Don't miss out on this adventure, it will definitely be a day to remember!

We had done a Vespa tour in Rome, and thought this would be a great experience, too. We were not disappointed. We were flying from Hong Kong to Phnom Penh, and purposely built in a 6 hour layover in HCMC. Our group of 8 were met at the airport by our Vespa leader and 8 Vespas with drivers. With only 4 hours to spend in the city, it was a great way to get a quick look at HCMC and experience the craziness of the downtown streets while learning some fabulous information along the way. Included in the tour was lunch and a drink. Definitely a 'must do' and a very good value.

review_title: 6.5 hrs Glimpse of Mekong cooking class
review_text:
Excellent. Because you got to get out of the craziness of the city, you get to relax on the bike and enjoy it. Always felt safe, definitely one of the best things I have done. US 129 on brochure, I paid 141 aud via internet rebooking it. There was only 4 of us on the tour, which also made it so pleasant. The actual cooking class is quite basic, but in a lovely location on the Mekong river.
We made chili prawns, garlic veggies, beautiful tiny mussels and pineapple rice. All really nice and easy to make again. Got to see the local markets, eye opener. Local village, taste rice wine, see incense being made. We went across the river on a vehicle transporter and over numerous bridges. We were glad we bought face masks beforehand, as the pollution can be bad. Loved every minute, fabulous way to feel like a local and see the countryside.

We were a little apprehensive about the tour but we loved it so much. The drivers were very friendly and although the roads seemed hairy and speedy. Our guide Cho was fantastic, very friendly and caring and taught us so much about the city, culture and food. The food itself was delicious and we went to places we would never have found on our own and try things that we definitely wouldn't have been brave enough to try ordinarily! This is a must-do activity for tourists in Saigon.

review_title: Best tour I did in Saigon
review_text:
I totally recommend the Vespa night tour to experience Saigon by night.
I was a first time Vespa passenger. The tour guides and drivers were fun and professional.
Great night with fantastic local food, sights of the city, great music company.
Also fab to be picked up and taken back to your hotel at the end of the tour. Do it :)

Amazing! anyone going to HCMC MUST do this! and if you are like me and worried about safety - don't - our family of 5 - 3 kids - never felt unsafe. This was definitely the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. So well run (our bikes were early to pick us up and never were we pushed to finish our "tour" by 10pm) and the places we visited were fab - all different experiences. book ahead - on the night we went they were fully booked - 90 bikes all booked!!! we were told by friends to do this and so glad we listened. its an experience you will never forget and rave about like we are! enjoy!

A great and unique experince. Our guide was very knowledgable about the food and all things in vietnam. Besides excelent food, we had insightful conversation. The venues were all fun and I have never exoerienced anything quite like zooming through Ho chi minh city after dark on the back of a scooter. I would definitely reccomend, but eat a small lunch! There is a lot of good food. All fodd drink and transport was paid for, making it a great and carefree evening out.

Myself and my girlfriend done the night time streetfood tour and it was absolutely brilliant. We started off getting picked up from our hotel abd were whisked over to zoom bar for a complimentary drink and were introduced to our guide Tuang ( if i remember correctly) we met the other 2 couples who were in our group then after our drink we were off into the madness of Ho Chi minh city. On our tour we stopped off at two local restaurants to sample the streetfood and have a few drinks the food was amazing and our guide was excellent and very informative about the food and making sure we all had plenty on our plates, after the restaurants we went to a coffee shop for some live music and a coffee then it was off to a rock bar for a few drinks and more live music, before getting dropped off back at the door of the hotel.It was a brilliant night the company was excellent the food and drink outstanding and everything included in the price, our guide Tuang was really nice as were our drivers, definitely worth doing if you are in Ho Chi minh city it's great fun and great value for money

This was my 2nd trip back to Saigon, and my 2nd time with Vespa Adventures. It's a riot, a must-do when in Saigon. If you want ot experience the roads, smells, tastes, and people of HCMC, get on the back of one of their Vespas and have a blast!

We took the vespa tour through the streets of Saigon and it was great - just when you think it is totally unsafe you look over and see a family of 5 with a baby cruising on a scooter next to you and you realize its crazy but ok. The tour stops were fun - good eating and a fun nightclub. I think it is a must do in Saigon.

This was such a highlight for us in Ho Chin Minh and would highly recommend! We were picked up at our hotel and then drove on the back of a Vespa to Zoom café for our introductions and welcome drink. The guides were informative and professional which was such a relief as we had experienced some less than professional tours across Vietnam. I was apprehensive about riding a Vespa in the crazy traffic of Ho Chin Minh but felt completely safe at all times and had so much fun! The street food was so amazing and delicious, full of locals and very different to anything we had tried so far. All the locations including the street food, cafes, and bars had a great atmosphere and we felt it was worth every penny.

Thanks for making our last night in Vietnam so memorable

I could not stop smiling on this tour. Our guide (S'on) was charismatic and hilarious. He was so passionate about Vietnam, Saigon and food, which definitely elevated the experience. Riding around the city on a Vespa is the coolest way to see Vietnam. The drivers are super friendly and cautious - I felt incredibly safe. Do watch your bags and cameras...although we didn't have any problems on this tour, my purse was snatched by a motorbiker the next day in HCMC. Back to the tour: great experience if you want to eat interesting, delicious food that you probably wouldn't find on your own and see neighborhoods outside of the main tourist district. This isn't a sightseeing or historical tour, but more of a cultural and epicurean experience. Highly recommended.

review_title: Enormous fun and a great Christmas Day
review_text:
Took the trip on the 25th December, having arrived in HCMC that afternoon, and what a fantastic welcome to the city.

Really good time, the driver was very safe but even then exhilarating, and it was a fantastic experienece we stopped at no less than four different food places and a music stop, great way to spend an evening and a wonderful intro to HCMC.

Do it you will not regret it.

We went on the rural village tour out of Hoi An Jan 2015.....the tour was simply amazing!
First of all, emails from Australia were answered straight away. We bumped into two of the vespa riders while leaving our hotel, they were dropping off customers and offered to ride us to their office, what great service! Service from all staff was fantastic: from riders, to tour guides, to Neil who took the booking and of course the Green Lantern who went above and beyond to make the trip that extra bit special. Fun, safe, great food, awesome service and very colourful vespas make exploring Hoi An countryside just spectacular. Would recommend to all for a great day out.

A perfect adventure! Cruising around Ho Shi Mihn City on a vespa which also included several stops for Viatnemese snacks, dinner, bars with Vietnamese music was the highlight of our vacation. It is really one of the very best way to get to now Vietnam. RECOMMEND!!!

By exploring Saigon by vespa you get the best of both. No need to walk a lot or get cabs, just hop on the vespa. You visit all the main highlights and the guide will tell you everything you want to know. After this daytour you've seen the main things and participated in the choatic traffic. Absolutely great!

review_title: 2nd time I've done this tour, and it's still excellent!
review_text: Don't worry that it isn't the cheapest tour - it's often possible to bargain for a better price and the tour is worth every single Dong. Just do it.

review_title: Fun Tour of Saigon After hours
review_text:
We visited Saigon (HCM City) at the end of our 12 day tour of Vietnam. We had done a number of food tours,=- both walking and on motorbikes. We had even taken a riding evening food tour of Saigon 2 days before we were signed up to go on the "Saigon After Dark" tour with Vietnam Vespa. I was a bit worried that this tour would repeat what we already did..... but it did not.

The Saigon after dark tour was a combination of food tour and nightlife tour. It was a large group,-- but broken down into smaller groups of 6 who rode pillion with drivers and with each group being led by its own guide. Not only did we get a tour of all of the various areas of Saigon, but we were taken to amazing food stalls where we sampled Vietnamese delicacies. The guides worked with any food restrictions. The highlight for us was going into a "secret" coffee house, to hear singers, and also to a bar where a local rock band was playing. We had a ball. Also , if you've never sampled the craziness that is riding in massive motor scooter traffic in Vietnam,-- this is one fun way to experience it. Our 2 twenty something sons, and my husband and I all really enjoyed this tour and would recommend it highly.

review_title: So Much Fun!!! Great Food and People!
review_text: I did the Saigon after dark tour as well as a full day Mekong tour. Both were excellent. I had a blast on the Saigon after dark tour and our guide was enthusiastic and informative. The locations for food were excellent and very authentic. The tour was very organized and executed well. The drivers were great and got me to each desitination safely. It was scary at first due to the way people drive in Ho Chi Minh but you get used to it. I highly recommend any tours by these companies. I had also done other tours with other companies and these guys were by far the best!!!! Thank you for such a great time! The tour out to the Mekong was great because you get to see green and nature. A nice break from the city and again great food experience and market experience out of the city. No compliants!!

My wife and I did their morning tour that included many really interesting places that we'd not otherwise have seen, such as the flower market. Our guide (Yu) was knowledgeable, charming and great fun, and the scooter drivers were very skilled. This is one of the best few hours we have spent in a long time, and would highly recommend it.

Our family of six did the Saigon by night tour on our first night in town. With three boys and a girlfriend it was perfect..felt very safe the whole time but also pretty exciting. The food was all pretty good and we got to taste some new things. Got a bit sick of the music stops at the end but we could have gone back to the hotel if we wished. Could have done with a bit more whizzing around on e scooters it was such fun.

We highly recommend the "Saigon After dark" tour of four hours. The food experience was amazing, the vespa drivers were very careful on the busy roads; the guides extremely knowledgeable and professional; and the taste of the local culture truly memorable!
You simply cannot see Saigon without doing this tour!!!!

review_title: The best way to see Saigon at night
review_text:
My wife,son and I arrived in Ho Chi Minh City in the afternoon and went for this tour at 6pm. We were picked up from our hotel by the Vespa drivers and given a ride around to the Zoom cafe - headquarters for the tour. After a welcome drink we headed out for another four stops including starters, dinner, folk club and ending in a rock bar.
We were shown all around the inner city with great rides on the back of the Vespas. The New Year lights were spectacular whizzing by!!
This is one of the best tours anywhere and is not to be missed. I'll do it again for sure

review_title: Saigon by night was great fun!
review_text:
My daughter (16) and i did this for her birthday and as we live in Ho Chi Minh city we thought we'd seen it all (or at least a lot), but we were so wrong! The Vespa tour was great and took in 4 new venues for us, which was very cool. Tasty food, a quiet acoustic night spot and a loud night spot called Acoustic.

Highly recommended for visits, expats and locals allke!

We decided to use up one of our few free nights in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) on going with these guys for the Saigon after dark. We felt safe the entire time whilst on the bikes and the riders were very understanding of the fact that I have been recovering from a very serious motorcycle accident. The utmost of care was displayed by my rider. The food was so very tasty, legitimate and plentiful. All you could eat and drink. We are going back to Vietnam again this year, and we will do this tour or another of theirs every time we go to Vietnam. A true delight and adventure. The places you attend would never be found on your own. Absolutely one of the best experiences of our lives. DO IT!

review_title: Fabulous way to see Saigon in style
review_text: As a 71 year old, I had a few reservations about zipping around the city on the back of a Vespa, but loved every second of it. The drivers are extremely capable in the mad confusion of traffic, we stopped at a variety of places and our guide explained everything so well. My driver was so kind to me, always put on my helmut & removed it, and also made sure that I was comfortable at all times. I had no problem getting on and off the Vespa. We did the morning tour with lunch back, it was excellent value for money. As my friend said later, "Every time I looked over at you, you had a huge grin on your face'. That sums it up, do it and enjoy every moment.

My wife signed up three couples (all in their 50's) for this tour. Some of us were skeptical, and one individual dropped out. But this turned out to be one of the most fun nights of our trip. The concept is wonderful. You experience Saigon at street level and every sense is engaged: sight, smell, hearing, taste, touch... Our guide, Dep, was great and made sure everyone was comfortable and having fun. Being able to experience the crazy traffic of the city was an experience in itself- zipping down busy city streets and back alleys on the back of a Vespa. Add to that the local eateries and night clubs and you have the makings of a fantastic evening. Everything was well planned and perfectly executed. The food was excellent, drinks were included, restrooms at every stop. The final stop at the rock 'n roll club was loud, but having grown up in the 70's, we appreciated the band's renditions of classics from Journey, Pat Benatar, Guns 'n Roses, etc. Thought I died and went to heaven.
We brought our cameras and took lots of pictures and video. Actually wished we had a GoPro. I'll show my age again by saying it doesn't hurt to also bring along hand wipes and ear plugs.
This tour is a must-do for fun loving adventurers.

review_title: Nice Tour but a little pricey
review_text:
Did the afternoon Saigon sightseeing tour. A fun way to see the city. The guide and individual drivers were excellent. Stops at sights were well explained and a good mix of things. We were a group of about 12 Vespas with 1 Guide. Pick-up & drop-off at hotel was good and lunch also.

Would have been nice to have a better idea of where we were between stops and a few things pointed out as we were going by.

They flexibly catered to taking a smaller group of us to poorer areas of Saigon and the small alleyways of District 4 instead of the common tourist sights of District 1 which was excellent.

Overall very good and recommendable although after some weeks travelling in Vietnam with a good feel for prices, $70 per person seems quite pricey and no doubt leaves a very healthy profit margin...

review_title: Fantastic evening experiencing Saigon cuisine and lifestyle
review_text: I can't say enough good thing about Vietnam Vespa Adventures. My husband, son and I signed up for the evening tour - Siagon After Dark. Khoi, our guide for the evening, picked us up at our hotel with the scooter drivers and provided an overview of the evening plans and made sure that we were comfortable on the scooters. There were five stops planned for the evening and all of them provided a different experience with local foods and beverages. In each of the stops we were provided an overview of the menu and got to watch demonstrations of Vietnamese cuisine being prepared. We were full and very tired by the fourth stop and actually returned to our hotel early as we were jet-lagged. The Vespa team was gracious and accommodating to our to our early departure request and returned us to our hotel. The entire experience was fantastic and I would highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Great overnight trip to the Mekong!
review_text:
My partner and I joined the overnight Vespa trip to the Mekong Delta, and absolutely loved it! It was the first time that they were running that particular tour and the owner, Steve, came along with the group to see what it was like.
We went at the end of April, and so the wet season was just beginning. On the first day we stopped for lunch at a great place, and luckily the rain waited until we were under cover, and poured down for a couple of hours, but was over by the time we were back on the bikes. Loved the mangrove forest here! And the boat trip and crocs were great too.
After the rain the dirt roads pretty much became rivers if mud, and my partner (who was driving his own vespa, but did not have any off-road driving experience) had a small spill but just got a bit muddy, with no scrapes. The tour company was very accommodating, and organised for one vespa to be picked up, while my partner changed to riding on the back of one of the more experienced drivers (like I was doing!)
The accommodation in the Mekong Delta was pretty rough, but we hardly spent any time in it. If you don't like roughing it it may be not up to scratch (we only received one VERY small VERY thread bare towel for the two of us, the shower was traditional Vietnamese style with only a shower head on a hose right next to the toilet, quite a few mosquitoes, not a great bed, just generally run-down looking). BUT in saying this, it was absolutely fine for one night!
The home-stay dinner was one of my FAVOURITE parts of the tour. The family we had dinner with was very warm, welcoming and full of laughs. The home-cooked food was INCREDIBLE and seemingly endless, while the beer kept flowing as well. The small chickens and children running around the table added to the authentic atmosphere :)
Long post, and I'll stop here but the tour company packed SO MUCH into this overnight tour that I haven't mentioned, and it was such a great way to get out of the city and see the countryside and experience the culture. I loved viewing it all from the back of the Vespa. I loved all the interesting little places we stopped at along the road. I even loved watching how the vespas were transported across the many little rivers of the delta (the loading and unloading of the bikes on the tiny boats is pretty amazing to watch!)

We loved the Mekong tour so much that we decided to do a vespa day tour around Ho Chi Minh City with the same company. We didn't love this one nearly as much (Which is why I haven't given 5 stars). It could have been because we were nearing the end of our trip and we were tired. The places we visited didn't excite us that much, and we didn't have nearly as much fun. Also at the end of it one of the Vespa drivers got quite angry at us for not tipping him, and that soured it a bit.

review_title: Vespa night tour Saigon - simply the best
review_text: My wife and I (live in Saigon) and organized a night tour when my daughter and her fiancé visited from Australia. The four of us had a ball, as did the couple from Adelaide who were in our group. Our tour guide Ms Chi was excellent and kept things organized as well as being an entertaining hostess. All the Vespa drivers were excellent. The tour takes you down the back alleys of districts 1 and 4 and is a great way to experience a slice of Vietnamese life. Cannot recommend highly enough.

review_title: Best way to experience Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Fantastic night! We did the 'After Dark' tour and it was the best possible way to experience the sights, sounds and tastes of HCMC. Our drivers were incredibly friendly and despite our reservations about the slightly chaotic traffic, we felt totally at ease in their capable hands. Our guide was very knowledgeable and shared all sorts of interesting bits and pieces about this vibrant city. The food was fantastic, as was the music and the company. Highly recommended!!!

review_title: Best night in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: We had one night left in ho chi Minh, we decided to do the night time Vespa tour and it was the best decision we ever made. There were 4 of us (2 couples). The tour kicks off quick with a short ride from our hotel to the first bar for a beer and explanation of what's happening. There is heaps of local food, the best I had in Vietnam, and plenty of beers. Visited a little cafe that will strangely impress you. Then a rock and roll club, where a band will play all of your favourites. Wish I had done the tour at the start of the trip, as I prob would have done it again. Really good value for money.

OMG, the Vespa Tour in Ho Chi Minh City was our group taking a chance and ended up being a highlight of the trip! Riding on the back of a Vespa in the middle of the chaotic traffic was exhilerating and fun. We made four stops with plenty of food and drink at each and touring in between. We met at a bar for a snack, drinks, intro, and to connect with our drivers and tour guide. First stop, food sampler including frog, mussels, crab claws, and noodle bowl, and drinks. Second stop, barbecued beef rollups and Vietnamese pancakes with, you guessed it, drinks. Third stop, a very quirky coffee bar with acoustic singing. Last stop, rock and roll done Vietnamese style - with female singers who sounded amazingly like Journey and Axel Rose. I kid you not! The tour ran a bit over because we were having such a great time. Not likely we would have found any of these places on our own. I HIGHLY recommend this tour. My face hurt at the end of the evening from smiling so hard all night.

Went on an evening tour of HCM city with this company in November. The tour was good, quirky, good guide, interesting food. Part of the deal was that there were photographers taking pictures which the company would e-mail us, so I didn't take my camera. However, they didn't send them, despite assurances by e-mail that they would, which I find very disappointing

My family and I decided to be very adventurous and experience an evening tour of Ho Chi Minh with Vespa Adventures. Being amongst the millions of moped riders and seeing another side of HCMC was one of the best things we have ever done in all our travels around the world. This is a must do to anyone visiting HCMC, our riders were awesome, our hostess Chau was fantastic, the food was great (even the jumpy chicken) and the 2 music clubs to finish off fabulous and returned to hotel safely. (price all inclusive). Will definitely be doing again when we return. A must do.

This is a must for anyone visiting Saigon. As the guide points out you experience much more from the back of a bike. On your way in from the airport you will have marvelled at the synchronicity of the hordes of motor bikes and wondered how it all works so to try it at least for one evening gives you a sense of how Saigon functions. The food chosen is excellent and gives an overview of the range of cuisine. Why not rated excellent above? Ended up at a rock band bar venue which I didn't think matched the demographics of our group.

Possibly the most fun we had in Vietnam. A fantastic experience. Great to be in the center of the traffic and weaving around but felt completely safe the whole time. The drivers were very professional. The food and the entertainment were also idea. We would have gone back to both of the music clubs on the tour if we were in Ho Chi Minh for longer. I can not recommend the tour enough.

review_title: Insider Saigon Tour - best way to see Ho Chi Minh
review_text: We did the tour and although I've been to Ho Chi Minh many times before this was a truly great way to see some of the city. I unreservedly recommend this trip. It's well organized and although there are a number of groups we had 5 people and a tour guide to ourselves. The drivers are great and take a lot of care.

We went on the afternoon tour. You start with lunch at their cafe together with the other participants and the guide. After that you get a driver and you as a group explore the town for 4 hours. Very interesting stops very much behind the scenes. Recommend!

I did the night foodie ride with triet and the glimpse of Mekong with chíen
I had a great time , an amazing experience and got to know real local young people, good local food in genuine places
You can't go wrong with this guys!!
There's nothing to be afraid of, it's chaos but everybody on the roads is mindfully and respectful of each other space , so you will be fine
And the glimpse of Mekong will remain in your memory on the shape of the kinds smiling and waving as you pass by the rice fields and the canals

My friend and I (aged 21) did the Hoi An day tour and enjoyed it so much we did the Ho Chi Minh night tour too. It honestly was the best thing we did in our month of travelling. I was nervous to ride as had only ridden once before and had an accident, but the drivers really are wonderful and take care to drive more slowly if you're worried. We really did feel on both tours that we got to know the towns in a way which we would never have experienced without the trips - the beauty of Hoi An and the poverty in some of the outside areas, and the exciting nightlife, culture and food of HCM. We had been recommended by friends and I cannot stress how much I suggest doing it. The tour guides go out of their way to ensure you get the most out of it possible and are keen to take photos for you, tell you about their lifestyles, and the tour lasted longer than expected - maximum value for money!!!. DEFINITELY DO THIS IS VISITING VIETNAM!

review_title: The best way to see Saigon!
review_text: We landed in Ho Chi Minh city at 3pm and we booked the Vespa adventure which picked us up at 6pm at the hotel and 5 of us (wife, father in law, 2 kids aged 8 and 10 and I) were whisked away to a cafe where we had a welcome drink and an introduction to what the night had in store. So after 4 stops and having eaten the best street food, drinks and listened to some great music and meeting some very interesting folks and riding in the rain I must say this has to be one of the highlights of our Vietnam holiday. This is a must do and the most fun we have had in a long time. Many good memories and the kids can't stop talking about it!

Excellent tour ,great way to see Saigon taken to great cafes and bars, drivers very considerate, felt safe at all times. Even caught in storm didn't dampen experience , added to it.
Tour guide Chien was very good. Food and drinks included as well as photo's emailed next day. Highly recommended.

We booked an afternoon Tour for the Insiders Saigon and were not disappointed!
The sights/places we visited were very intersting and we felt very safe with our drivers.

We chose to do the Countryside & Islands tour and it was a fantastic trip from start to end. Traveling on the back of a Vespa with local drivers was an awesome experience. Our guide Loan was very knowlegable and told us of many customs and traditions. It was packed with things to do; first a ferry ride across to Cam Kim Island, a tour of a boat building yard, we got to see how the locals made their sleeping mats and how to make banh dap (rice cracker), we also had Vietnamese coffee at a local village cafe. Add to this we crossed a 300 meter long bamboo bridge and had lunch at Ha My beach, This is a tour packed with fun and learning. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for some adventure and fun with some local culture and cuisine as well.

Excellent day out, well recommended, expensive by local standards but worth every Dong!
Great guides, very knowledgeable.

We have taken two tours with Vietnam Vespa Adventures with our two sons aged 11 and 10 the tours were excellent and the drivers and guides fantastic. The comments at the end of the day from our two boys where "Epic" and "Awesome"

As a frequent visitor to Vietnam on business it was a "real" Vietnam experience and the Glimpse of the Mekong tour took you off the beaten track and away from the tourist trail we saw no other tourists all day.

Many thanks to the team and our guides Dieu and Hoan for great tours.

McLellan Smyth Clan

Nothing I say will ever convey the brilliance of the tour! The drivers are all excellent and extremely helpful. I felt so safe and enjoyed every minute of it. We stopped at a few good sites, and also got to see parts of the city I would not have otherwise seen. It was definitely the highlight of my trip. Worth every penny, and ends with a lovely lunch at Zoom cafe.

If you have ever been to HCMC, and witnessed their insane traffic and seemingly no rules of the road, you will understand how anxious I felt getting onto the back of a scooter. Within minutes of driving with my expert guide I relaxed and found that the evening far surpassed my expectations.

The evening involved going to out-of-way places for drinks, apps and mains, as well as couple of bars, one small and low key, the other much larger playing Rock n' Roll - "Saigon style". These restaurants and bars are ones that a tourist would not know about as often it was down narrow alleys and there were no signs. The food was hands down superb, and the music so much fun.

Our guide,Dat, was charming and warm and allowed us a glimpse into how the Vietnamese live and play. It was an experience I will never forget and would do again in a nanosecond!

We did the Saigon After Dark tour. Easily the best part of our entire trip all around Vietnam. Food/booze aside, just riding on the vespas all around the town at night was amazing. What a great way to see the city.

The food was good, certainly at places we wouldn't have found. The music bars were nice, too, but I was way too jet lagged to enjoy them. (Although, even without jetlag, I'm not sure if I ever would've enjoyed that one band that played 4 non blondes....that really took me back.)

review_title: A fun way to enjoy the city
review_text:
We did the evening foodie tour on Vespas and had such a fun evening.
We were collected from our hotel by Vespa and taken to Café Zoom which is the starting point to the tour. We then whizzed away on the Vespas around the city to two more street food cafes (with excellent food) and a couple of bars for a really memorable evening.
It was such fun traveling on the Vespas among the motorbike traffic in the city - I think I smiled the whole time. If you have never been on the back of a motorbike before (like me) this is definitely the place to do it!

The Vespa Adventure Saigon After Dark tour was recommended to me by a friend and it would have to be one of the best recommendations I've ever had. The tour lasted four hours and you definitely get your money's worth, visiting two restaurants (and a cafe if you include the Vespa Adventure home base) and two fantastic bars. The food is excellent (you go to non-tourist areas, where the locals go), the drinks are all included and the bars had some of the best live music I've ever heard anywhere. And of course, there's the unreal fun of weaving through the crazy nighttime Saigon traffic on the back of a Vespa - I was laughing non stop, it's that much fun!

Our guide, Eric was excellent, being a fount of knowledge, giving us heaps of information and doing it all in fluent English.

Can't recommend this tour highly enough, it was one of the highlights of my three weeks of travel through Vietnam.

This is a fun, safe, interesting and well organized trip. They are very flexible and will make any adjustments to the trip you care to make. A good way to see the non tourist spots in the City and to taste street food. I'm so glad we didn't miss the opportunity to go on a trip. If you are too old for a Vespa (and who is!) they will organize a car for you.

review_title: Chin was great! Steve and his wife are great too!
review_text: Steve and his wife Phuong created a custom tour for me on very short notice. I did part of the wild life Mekong tour that was in one day. I got to feed the crocodiles, see the bats and see the Mekong delta from 40 meters high. I paid a little more but not significantly more. Chin was a great tour guide and I got to drive my own automatic scooter. It was great!

review_title: Good way to see the city quickly, but no information mostly eating focused
review_text:
We did the evening tour and enjoyed it, but it was mostly moving from place to place trying food. Our guide was good, and the food was good, but since you cannot really talk about the Vespa I was a bit disappointed in how little we learned about the city itself.

Also the last stop was a Karaoke Bar (and the stop before was a very low key music venue) so the tone of the tour changes drastically. My girlfriend and I had no issue with this, but some of the older folks on the tour immediately left the Karaoke bar as it was "not their scene"

review_title: Great Experience. See the city on their primary mode of transportation.
review_text: Saw the behind the scenes of the city. Flower district, temples and more. Great drivers. I felt completely safe and taken care of.

We did this tour on our last night in Ho Chi Minh, and it was a great way to end our trip to Vietnam. The guide and driver were extremely friendly and very informative about the food. Ate at spots we would never have tried on our own. Highly recommend this tour to anyone that wants to experience a different side of sightseeing.

review_title: Vespa Tour? ABSOLUTELY, DEFINITELY, TOTALLY, COMPLETELY BIG BIG BIG "YES"
review_text:
If someone asks how can I know Ho Chi Minh city when I only stay there for one day, one night...VESPA TOUR will be your suggestion.

Although I was born in HCM city and have been living here for 25 years, I haven't known all of concerns of my city. And today, thanks to VESPA ADVENTURES DAY TOURS, I can testify what I have not seen for years.

The seafood, the coffee shop, the pancakes, the bar, the friendly driver...everything made my life at that night. How wonderful the trip is!

Thank you for your care, your kindness, your loveliness. All of those precious things bring us a warm and happy atmosphere. Like we are at home, sitting with relatives in a big party and looking at the slow slow move of our life.

VESPA TOUR AGAIN? Definitely YES and it will be in my priority list when I recommend to my foreigner friends even my local ones.

Wish you all - VESPA team healthy, cheerful and happy in the next Christmas and New Year.

Sincerely yours.

review_title: A great way to see the city.
review_text:
While on a trip around Vietnam, we chose to go on a Vespa tour around Saigon city. The tour we chose was a single evening trip.
Although not the cheapest way to see the city, this was a really fun way to go out and discover places I never would have had on my own.
The trip was very well organized, the places we visited were very good and the team were very friendly and helpful.
Highly recommended if you don't mind paying a bit of a premium.

review_title: A must-have when you're in Saigon
review_text:
WOW! We just finished our fourth adventure with Vietnam Vespa, over five days based out of Saigon. We can't recommend them enough – they totally made our trip. It was the vintage Vespas and adventure descriptions that originally sold us… but it was the whole team and their superlative service that ultimately won our hearts.

Saigon after Dark is pure magic. All food and drink is included - you get picked up from your hotel and they take care of the rest. My friend and I joined a group of 4 from the UK, and had a blast - we laughed all night. Our group was reluctant to leave each place, we were having such a great time. Throughout the night we also bumped into other fun groups from VVA at the restaurants and night spots, so the numbers swelled and ebbed but the energy was consistently high. Dat was amazing – kept us on time, with the best seats, the best food and refreshments. Awesome food in local restaurants – we got to try a lot of things we'd never had before, and we loved all of it. The speakeasy was candlelit and über cool. We tried iced Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk and LOVED IT!!! The rock bar was high energy – bars aren't usually my thing but everyone was so talented, the crowd was completely engaged and everyone was singing out loud. Then add the riding pillion behind your driver at night, when the city is totally alive and electric…. The drivers flowed in and out of traffic like ether…we felt completely safe at all times and always had a huge smile on our faces. It was hard to say goodbye when the evening ended, it was so much fun. My friend and I immediately wanted to do it again. My driver, Duong, was excellent - always in control, and he made me feel like a VIP. I can't imagine a better introduction to Saigon. Saigon after Dark with Vietnam Vespa Adventures is a must!

My whole trip to Vietnam was great, but the Vespa Food tour was a highlight. I hated Saigon when I arrived...hot, crowded, noisy, dirty. The next day we got out of Saigon, went on a day tour to the Mekong Delta. Upon returning, we were picked up at our hotel for the Vespa Food tour. What a blast and food was awesome! Don't think we could have had a better day.

We did the night Vespa Tour in Hoi Chi Min and it was awesome! Its our best tour today. Plenty of great Vietnamese dishes, plenty of food...and I mean plenty... a heap of fun and very safe - for Vietnam anyway. Must do!!!!

we have done the Glimpse of Mekong tour and it was AMAZING! we liked everything about it: vintage and colorful Vespa, friendly and safe drivers, beautiful landscapes! It is a great getaway from the hectic life of HCMC. IT'S a MUST DO! How can you ask for more?...Vespa rocks!

review_title: THE best way to see Saigon and enjoy food
review_text: i did the nite time tour and i have to say of all the things i have done on my travels to Vietnam and Cambodia over the last 3 weeks this was one of the highlights. What FUN and what a brilliant way to see Saigon at night, have great food, coffee and live music and meet new people. The vespa ride is safe and organized and never at any point did i feel unsafe. Collection was on time and from y hotel to a central point from where you all heard off. we were supposed to be a party of 3 but 2 guests couldn't make it and this was not a problem. Just the best way to feel the vibe of the city at night, its buzz and vibe and street food.

I did the night street food tour. I was picked up promptly from my hotel and taken to meet my guide Huyen who was excellent. All food and drinks (as many as you want) are included in the price but the best part for me was the ride on the Vespa seeing the sites at night. Don't worry about the traffic the drivers are very good and you will be safe. I haven't been on a motor bike for years but you quickly get used to it. I didn't want to get off. I would highly recommend this experience.

We have done the vespa adventure tour to the Mekong delta. This tour is very nice to visit the Mekong delta and surrounding areas, you don't do as deep into the delta as a bustour, but it is more adventurous and you are able to explore it more on a relaxed tempo.
If you can't drive with manual gears, there is the option for an automatic moped, or on the back of a guide.
Great way of experiencing Saigon life. You sit on the back of a motor scooter and weave through the traffic. Safe. And you see parts of the city otherwise unknown.

review_title: The best experiences we've had in Saigon!
review_text:
We have been to Saigon twice before and have done tours with Vietnam Vespa Adventures on both trips - Saigon After Dark on our first visit, and The Insider's Saigon on our second visit. Both tours were fantastic. This time around, our third visit, we did both the Glimpse of the Mekong day tour and the Saigon After Dark tour (for the second time). It was so good to get out of the city and see the countryside from the back of a Vespa - much better than being ferried around from place to place on a bus. You just see so many things that you wouldn't otherwise get to see. We had a fantastic guide, Dat, who had so much knowledge of the area and was just a lovely guy. The drivers were friendly and very safe, and the food we had throughout the day was delicious.

We were lucky enough to have Dat again as our guide when we did the Saigon After Dark tour that night. Although we had done this tour before and visited the same places, it was great to try local food and eat at places that tourists don't usually go too. I highly recommend the "jumping chicken", delicious! We had a great group on our tour and it was fun to get to know fellow travelers from around the world, some of whom we ran into again later on our trip in Cambodia.

As with our other tours, it is not scary at all riding on the Vespa, you feel safer on the bike than you do crossing the road! I cannot recommend Vietnam Vespa Adventures enough and tell everyone that is traveling to Saigon to do a tour with them - so much fun!!

review_title: The way to see Saigon at night
review_text:
For many tourists Saigon/HCMC can seem a little daunting, especially at night. If you want to see the city the way the majority of its residents do, from a moped, this is absolutely the way to do it and I couldn't recommend the night time tour enough.

You're met at your hotel by your rider(s), we were part of a big group but my wife and I were escorted separately by Huyen. We were shown to our scooters and drivers, and with helmets fitted were on our way. Neither of us have been on a scooter before, however I should point out first of all that we felt safe and comfortable throughout. The drivers clearly knew how to properly navigate the crazy traffic in the city, but did so at a comfortable pace without taking any risks or dangerous manouvers. In fact you feel safer being part of the traffic than crossing the street or walking the sidewalks!

The tour takes you on a variety of bars and restaurants to sample the local cuisine, whilst enabling you to take in the sights, sounds and smells of Saigon. Starting in a cafe to grab a drink whilst Huyen explains the format of the tour in perfect English, we then head on a 20 minute ride to a local restaurant to try some unique Vietnamese dishes (including crab claws, stir fried beef, and even frog's legs!) I should point out though that they are very accommodating to food preferences and allergies, so don't worry about having to try things you won't necessarily enjoy. I'd certainly recommend giving everything a try though as it is all so good!

A Vespa ride later the next location provides traditional pancakes, where you see the cooking method and are able to try making different types of roll, all guided by Huyen of course.

You're then taken to a back street cafe with live acoustic music (very relaxing), with the tour culminating in a 'rock band' style bar.

Without a doubt this was the top highlight of our tour around Vietnam. It was booked through our travel agent so we don't have a breakdown of costs, however if you want a great taste of Saigon/HCMC, especially at night, with a full belly at the end of it, the back of a vintage Vespa is the way to do it!

review_title: If you only do one tour in HCMC it must be this one!
review_text: We did the night tour. Our drivers were great, very careful but very skilled. Our guide Huyen spoke great English and was very knowledgeable and funny. The food was amazing, even though I don't eat seafood, there was always an alternative. There was so much to eat and the beer flowed freely. The two final stops were so cool, a lounge bar then a nightclub with a rock band! A night to remember. If you miss this tour, you are missing a great experience! Thanks VVA!

review_title: This tour is an absolute must.
review_text: On this tour you get to see all the sights & sounds of the streets of Siagon in a safe & fun way. Our group was great fun & Chi our guide was 1st class. The riders know the City including how to dodge a boy playing football in the middle of the road. The food was lovely including "jumping chicken" & the beer flowed freely. I can't recommend this tour enough. If it's the only thing you do in this great city "book now" thank you all for a really fun night.

We had a wonderful time and loved riding around the city on the Vespa. The scene in the night club was great to experience with the young people of Saigon. all the music was from America. father food was also great and our guide was a lot of fun to be with.

Fantastic evening adventure... zooming about the city on old Vespas.. very safe drivers! Fantastic street food and best of all ...ending up at a secret club with amazing coffee and fab singers (lounge/ballad style)...then onto a Rock club!!! Wow happy times. A must do for any age!!

I decided last minute to do it on my last night in Saigon. So glad i did! Amazing experience to be driven on the bike through the crazy traffic and taste the food. The drivers are very skilled so never feel unsafe. Great guide (thank you Dep!!), great company met on the tour. Nice way to say good bye to Saigon.
Lukasz

And it was, a fantastic experience with Dat as my guide and Tam as our support/driver.
Tour includes the city tour and Saigon night tour. There's nothing like riding on the back of a Vespa in Saigon's amazing has to be seen to be believed traffic.
Had a practice on the bike to familiarize in the afternoon before driving the next morning to a safe starting point outside of Saigon.
And then we're off riding back roads, looking out for cows, dogs and anything else that may jump out.
Fantastic scenery, wind in your face. Does it get better?
Dat was great guide, informative, always felt safe.
Accommodation exceeded all expectations. Highlights so many, but possible Vietcong memorial pagoda and chatting to locals.
Thanks Dat and for helping back in Saigon. Now talking to friends about coming back.

This was the top memory of Saigon and one of the top three things we did during our month holiday in Vietnam and Cambodia. There were six of us, 3 chose to go on the tour "Saigon after Dark" via Vespa and the other three followed by Taxi. We all enjoyed ourselves but the three who rode the Vespas had a very memorable experience. We are all retired and found this tour to be great fun and easy for us to do and enjoy.

review_title: If you don't do this trip then you're REALLY missing out!
review_text: The absolute best tour I've ever done! Best way to see Saigon, from the back of a vintage vespa driven by great drivers. We did the after dark trip with a small group seeing the sights and eating and drinking plenty. Saw places you'd not see if looking by yourself and ate things that most people would laugh at... smiling faces from ALL on the trip. Our guide Dep was amazing, funny, informative and very beautiful. Thank you Vespa Tours. I'll be recommending this to anyone and everyone! Do this tour! Or you're a fool.

I did the day tour, which tool in the Flower Market, Bird Park, 10,000 Buddha Temple, Burning Monk Monument and several more. I thought I would be nervous on the back of the bike, but felt safe at all times, even among the crazy bike traffic. It was a great way to see the sights, sounds and smells from street level.

The guides were great at explaining each attraction and provided water. The tour ended with a delicious lunch at Cafe Zoom.

Well worth doing if you want an exciting adventure.

This is a great way to get a quick glimpse of Ho Chi Minh City. The guide was wonderful, the Vespa drivers courteous and skilled, and it was just a great half day. We saw many places which were important to the creation of the modern Vietnam nation. Not much focus on what they call the American War. There are tours to visit important sites to the tour.

I was very impressed with the Mekong Delta Vespa tour and it exceeded my friends and my expectations. I generally avoid organized tours but this tour did not have any of the elements that so many organized tours have that turn me off to them such as added expenses, people trying to sell you something at every stop, guides with little knowledge, etc. The tour was well organized, the guide was very knowledgable and always smiling and happy to answer questions, the places we were interesting, no pushy vendors at the stops, and the food we had was not only fantastic at each place but also bountiful. In addition to the route we took was a lot of fun and a good sampling of the countryside.

review_title: An awesome way to see Saigon.
review_text: I did the Saigon by Night tour and absolutely loved it. There's nothing quite like riding through the crazy traffic on the back of a Vespa. My driver and tour guide were both great. We stopped off at a couple of local restaurants and made it to live music venues I would have never found on my own. Can't recommend this highly enough - a highlight of my travels in Vietnam.

review_title: Great way to see the city
review_text:
Great to see the city if your time is short. Fun safe and tour guide was funny, intelligent and knowledgeable. We visited places off the beaten track and we'll known areas.
So glad we did it. 10/10

Did the half day Insiders Saigon tour, and it was a great way to get oriented to HCMC, and see some sights that the normal tourist route would never know was there, let alone take in. It's fun enough just whizzing about on the bikes and weaving in and out of the crazy traffic, but our guide (Dieu) also gave us just the right amount of history and insight into events that have shaped Vietnam and the city of Saigon, with an enthusiasm that even managed to make our teenagers ask questions. I'd recommend this to anyone who wants to experience a more 'local' way of seeing Saigon.

review_title: Interesting way to explore the city...
review_text: The vespa adventures night tour was an unplanned addition to my route but turned out to be amazing! Lots of mouthwatering food, off the beaten track locations and good company made it an evening to remember. The tour guide was brilliant as well.
Took the night time tour ho chi chi Minch City fantastic experience it's a must didn't want it to end felt very safe in a crazy city

review_title: Great insight to culture, city and lots of fun!
review_text:
So much fun! We did an evening tour and I couldn't stop smiling the whole time. Vietnam is incredible with its number of mopeds always whizzing along the road but being out among them at night is so much fun!!
The tour was great and you get taken to district four to experience local food (all of which was delicious!! I've never liked mussels, or crab, or clams but I loved them all and can still taste those magic crab legs! Mmm!)
Then off to another food stall for more local food, then some relaxing live music and then some fun live music at the end! Such a great night and a brilliant whistle stop intro to Vietnam, and one of the best nights we've had all of traveling! Highly recommend and definitely worth the money!

review_title: Great Way To See The City
review_text: We did the day tour on Vietnam Vespa Adventures and had a great time. The drivers were all great and we never felt at risk even in the heaviest of traffic. In fact, it was a great way to understand the hectic motorbike traffic that engulfs this city every minute of every day. We visited many great sites including a bird park (where people take their caged birds to sing with other caged birds), the flower market, meat market, fabric market, the post office, Notre Dame Cathedral, Reunification Palace, several pagodas including the 10,000 Bhudda Pagoda and the famous site where the monk incinerated himself in protest. The tour was a very full one traveling all over the city and seeing life in HCMC. Afterward, we had a great lunch at the Zoom Cafe. This is a must in Vietnam.

review_title: Highlight of Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: We did the Vietnam Vespa Adventures Street Food Tour in Ho Chi Minh City and it was AMAZING! The drivers are sensational and we felt quite safe on the vespas and our guide Eric was sensational! The food is great and they will cater for preferences - we ate on their recommendation but if snails frogs and seafood aren't your thing there were other options - there was SO much food, all drinks were included and you get a good amount of time on the vespas. We would definitely do another vespa tour with these guys if we go back to Vietnam.

We did the night ride, it was a good way to have a glimpse of very busy city. Guides were professional and we went to a few places we wouldn't have found on our own. Food was nice our favorite stop was the seafood spot. Over priced compared to the other bike tours and food walking tour we had done further up the country.

I have been living in Saigon for 2 months. I had a friend visiting so decided to try the Inside Saigon tour. The company was recommended by a colleague. I loved riding around town to places I had been to and new sites that I hadn't seen before. It was a great change from taxis! The guide was difficult to understand at times but he was enthusiastic and provided interesting political insight into HCMC. I enjoyed visiting a small temple off the beaten track which was simple and had a great view-nothing spectacular but a pleasant change from major tourist sites. The highlight for me was the first stop we made at a park where men hang up their birdcages so that their birds can sing together and one can drink very strong Vietnamese coffee. The drivers were responsible and pleasant and I recommend this company to anyone who is interested in seeing HCMC's sites in an adventurous manner!

We had a fantastic time. Loved how they took the scenic route from place to place. Did not get the feeling that they only picked places they're hooked up with and that you would otherwise never go to. On the contrary, everywhere we went was great. We definitely went to some extremely 'local' places, including what felt like a private home, converted at night into an underground-ish music venue.

My mother and I were wanting to do something different and a friend of mine living in Saigon suggested the Mekong tour. Lots of different company's to choose from but we picked Vietnam Vespa Adventures due to the reviews. We didn't want to shop or be hassled with the normal touristy stuff.
We were promptly picked up at our hotel and we then zoomed off into the crazy Saigon traffic. That ride alone was worth the price of admission. Once we arrived at Cafe Zoom we were greeted with a hot tea and then whisked of to an are in district 7.. Could be wrong there but anyway we met up with the owner Mike you greeted everyone with open arms and then test began. Those wanting to drive their own Vespa were followed around his neighborhood to make sure they had the skills to handle the bikes. Some did and some did not. Those who didn't pass muster were glad the had a driver in the long run. Word to the wise "if you're not comfortable don't drive" or if you're there to see the sights and take pictures,use a driver. You really need to pay attention when driving in this area and it's not unmanly to ride on the back. Everyone in this country does it. Other than that I think everything else has already been mentioned. It's a great trip and a great company. They even took care of my mother at the food stops who is a gluten free vegetarian.

review_title: Mot, Hai, Ba, Yo! Saigon After Dark
review_text: Fantastic evening led by our guide Tuyen. Exiting to be part of the swarm of motorbikes instead of negotiating how to avoid them crossing the road. Come hungry as you are offered a wide variety of local food at various stops - all delicious. Choice of drinks also offered at every stop - very generous! Highlight was the visit to the French cafe on the second floor to experience a little of the local music scene in a quiet, cozy atmosphere!! Taken to places you will never find yourself. Our drivers even dropped us off at the tailors to pick up some items. Staff were professional and courteous. Must do tour!!

Did the Glimpses of the Mekong day tour from HCMC. Really great day. Not one of those tours where you get taken to places and are expected to buy souvenirs. This takes you down country roads to markets, farms and backyard industries so you get to see how the Vietnamese live outside the big cities. We saw fish & prawn farms, an incense maker, a rice wine producer, and a Cao Dai temple. Plenty of delicious stops along the way, there were clams and lemongrass at a market for brunch and a big lunch later on. We got caught in a tropical thunderstorm which was not surprising given it's the middle of the wet season. They gave us big capes to put on which were hilarious. The drivers were very careful so came back in one piece, albeit with a slightly sore bum. It was a lot of fun and can thoroughly recommend it.

This was such fun and the highlight of our holiday. Having watched the fascinating Vespa traffic we were suddenly part of it ! The tour took in a bar, two eateries, an intimate music venue and a night club - with an English speaking guide. I was anxious about it as had broken my elbow two weeks before but felt thoroughly safe. Absolutely recommend it.

As an older group, we were apprehensive about getting on to the back of a scooter in the Saigon traffic from hell. Well, we didn't need to worry! The rush, buzz and confusion of the hectic Saigon traffic seemed to fade away as our expert riders weaved and ducked between the other scooters and any wayward four wheel vehicles that crossed our paths. We were collected at our hotel by Vesper and taken to Cafe Zoom for a briefing on the night's activities, a drink or two for some dutch courage, and then we were off. The food was great, our guide was fantastic, and our riders made us feel relaxed and safe on the back of our Vespers. The restaurants/cafes were visited had fantastic food and atmosphere. The band at the Woodstock bar was pumpin' - the lead singer had a fantastic voice. This is a must do adventure if you are in HCMC. Worth every cent of the modest price - the four of us had a ball. Thanks to Stephen and his team.

review_title: So much fun. Best way to see HCMC.
review_text:
This is probably the most fun you can have in HCMC. Book the Saigon After Dark tour. You meet up with the group at Cafe Zoom in the backpacker district, down a few beers (free) then head out on the back of a Vespa (with a roadie for the ride). After a 20 minute cruise through the streets of Saigon, you stop at a locals only type restaurant for seafood dinner, then another ride and a mungbean pancake place. The third stop was kind of an odd "secret" bar with music, but it's quite low key. The last stop was live music venue with a good cover band playing rock.

The food was great. Plenty of drinks along the way. The guides are funny and happy to answer questions about Vietnam, the food, the culture, anything. You also don't have to pay for anything on the tour - just the initial fee to the company. Great way to experience the traffic of HCMC and get a feel for what it's like to live there on a daily basis. Probably the most fun we had on our trip. Would highly recommend.

The buzz of a million scooters venturing the four points of the compass, sometimes all on the same road, could be enough to put off the uninitiated from venturing as a pillion on these cities wasps. Thankfully a friend referred us to Vietnam Vespas for one of their many tour options. The Saigon Insiders tour took us places tourists wouldn't normally see as well as the must see city highlights. After putting our faith in the intuitive skills of our drivers and with the delightful Dieu as our guide we had blast. I won't detail the stops but after an invigorating and interesting afternoon getting around HCMC with this professionally run company the tour has been the highlight of our Vietnam travels.

review_title: glimpse into the life on the road in saigon
review_text:
This tour was an eye opener following a week plus as a pedestrian in Hanoi and saigon.
The bonus was the quick introduction to the street food culture of young vietnamese.
The drivers and guide were amazing, after couple of minutes we felt very comfortable at the back of the vespa.

I landed yesterday and booked this after seeing rave reviews on trip adviser. I'm so pleased I did it :-) It was a fabulous experience a great way to get a feel of the city. My driver Ang was super nice, polite and sweet and the tour guide was so knowledgable. Its now given me more confidence that I can ride a scooter around the city! If anyone visits me I will recommend this as a great way to see the city. I now want to do the After Dark tour and Mekong Delta experience, especially as they give you 10% off. Thanks Vietnam Vespa Adventures x

review_title: A great way to get out of the city
review_text: We went on the delta day tour and had a wonderful time. The 1960's restored bikes were great and we got to see some of the non touristy areas. Ended the day with a nice lunch too. Saw a shrimp farm, a local market, a temple, a rice wine farm and an incense house. All very interesting. A great day out.

I live in Saigon and have had the good fortune to experience three trips with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. It is the first place I think of when guests arrive. I have been on the Insider's Saigon tour once, and the Glimpse of the Mekong tour twice, most recently this week. Each time, our guide was friendly, informative and very happy to answer any of our questions. The drivers were well organised and friendly. We felt safe and in good hands riding with them. Best of all, door to door service from and to our home in D2. Highly recommend this adventure!

I agree with what others have said. When you first arrive and see the horrendous traffic in the city, you would not have thought that riding on a scooter would be much fun or not hair raising. But noone is racing; all the motorbikes move in a seamless flow.

We had a guide all to ourselves as well as two drivers since we had booked through a travel company. Don't eat lunch so you can fit in all of the food and drink! We were collected from our hotel and whisked to the starting point which is a bar where we met our Guide, Dieu, and had our first free drink. Then we rode the long way around and through some narrow lively streets to our first street seafood restaurant where we had 5 courses: spicy crab claws with chili and lime dip, clams in lemongrass broth, barbequed mussels with a peanut and sweet chili sauce, frogs legs in spcy batter, and shrimp vermicelli with fish sauce and chili and more beer. Our guide was very entertaining and showed us the proper way to eat everything.

Then it was on to a rice pancake street restaurant with an onstreet kitchen where we had summer rolls with lettuce wrap with chili and soybean dip, prawn rolls: thai coriander, rice vermicelli and spring onions wrapped in rice paper, and then large rice pancakes coloured with turmeric and stuffed with prawns, beansprouts and mung beans dipped in fish sauce with chili. Washed down with fruit smoothies. Then barbequed beef wrapped in rice paper with mustard lettuce, thai basil pickled white radish, pickled carrot, cucumber, green banana aand star fruit!

Then to the 'Hidden Cafe' with live music and singing from students at the Ho Chi Minh conservatoire. And finally to a club called Acoustic Emotions' with live 'rock' music, but 1980s hits like Dancing Queen! All drink is inclusive, so it's just a question of how much you can down in the time available.

You can stay on if you wish but we chose to be whisked back to our hotel to lie down to try to digest everything - in all senses of the word! The drivers are 1st class, skilled and attentuve. It rained briefly when plastic capes were offered.

This is truly an unmissable experience, and rates highly amongst the many adventurous things we have done. There are other Vespa tours but this is the original company.

My husband and I did the Saigon After Dark tour and it was definitely one of the highlights of,our month long journey through Vietnam and Cambodia. We thought it sounded expensive at first, but this is incredibly good value and all inclusive - our guide was very friendly yet professional, the drivers are exceptionally skilled in all that hair raising and exciting traffic, and at every stop we ate delicious food until we thought we would burst - plus drinks! I don't want to give any 'secrets' away, but we stopped at two amazing clubs to listen to music - at opposite ends of the spectrum musically - highly entertaining and excellent musicians - which was absolutely unexpected and in places we would never dare to go alone! I landed up dancing on stage with the band - we had such fun! We felt safe at all times and saw a lot of saigon we would not otherwise have seen. I highly recommend this tour and this organization.

review_title: Definitely the most fun part of our trip!
review_text:
We arrived in HCMC at 10 pm without a set agenda and tried calling several places. These guys not only answered the phone with a smile, but at 8 am the following morning they were waiting for us to start this adventure. Our tour guide (Dat) was not only very knowledgeable of the history of the city and the country, but also willing to share with us his perspective on current affairs in the region, which led to a very interesting conversation with a cup of delicious iced Vietnamese, which you must try! I doubt that you can get to see so much of the city in so limited time, which is only possible riding the vespa.

We enjoyed it so much that at the end of the tour we booked the night tour, which we enjoyed as much as the morning tour. You get to taste local food, bars and rock bands that you could hardly discover by yourself, and the city a night is gorgeous!! Actually, what you get to eat and drink will cost you more if you go by yourself, so consider the night tour a free ride (I hope those guys don't read this or they will be tempted to raise their prices!). We were in a group with two other couples and had a lot of fun, you gotta do this!

review_title: Great way to see the Mekong Delta
review_text: My last day in Vietnam and I am so glad I took this tour. In addition to the fascinating scenery, you get to see the fishing communities, rice wine and incense producers (small scale), and sample some wonderful cuisine. The drivers are very skilled, and always careful to take water and other pit stops. Food in the local market was delish (clams, muscles, fresh fruit) and the tour guide always checked to make sure you were comfortable before he made selections. I couldn't recommend this more highly. That said, it is hot and dusty. Bring a bandana and just be prepared to get sweaty... so worth it.

review_title: The highlight of our 2 week holiday
review_text:
I find it interesting that they rank only #3 of things to do in HCMC, as I cannot imagine anything better. We booked the tour of the Mekong with the cooking class. First rate fun from beginning to end.

One of us drove, the other rode with a driver. Either way the excitement level was the same, I truly believe that this is the best way to see parts of the countryside that many will never experience. The fact that we learned to make 4 traditional Vietnamese dishes in a scenic outdoor kitchen was the icing on the cake, so to speak,

Be sure that this is the first booking you made when traveling to Vietnam, Perfect day all around.

Unless you've grown up and learned to drive in a country that has no lanes for vehicles, and the scooter to car ratio is 10000 to 1 any opportunity to wiz around on the back of a vespa with a seasoned driver taking you to local food haunts, coffee houses and bars, it doesn't get any better than this. The free flow alcohol, for a night of complete inhibition doesn't hurt either. Well done -- great concept -- and it makes me wonder if this would work in other parts of the world.

This is something I probably would never have considered when first arriving to see the 'traffic situation' in Ho Chi Minh but turned out to be one of the most memorable experiences in my travels so far .. 'surfing' the traffic and tasting the local food .. what more could you want .. yes a little pricey for Vietnam value but well worth it.

i am very sorry to say that even though this tour is nice it is just overpriced i took this tour last year by myself and i don't recall riding it being this high priced $85 we went to 2 restaurants a coffee house and a night club in addition to around the city on the back of the vespa which was fun the night club even for my 28 year old daughter was just too noisy the restaurants were good but not special the coffee house was nice add another restaurant or two and lower the price to make this a great experience

We were four over 50's, with some never having been on a scooter before. It was a superb night. Exciting, safe, great food, entertaining, brilliant value, with a friendly guide and drivers. It was themed "a night out with friends" rather than a tourist trip and it really felt like it. Thoroughly recommend it.

My husband and I did a half day tour of Ho Chi Minh City and it was mega fun!!! our guide was not only well informed and friendly, she shared with us personal insights into life in Vietnam. Our riders were very careful and smooth and at every step we felt very safe and secure whilst feeling like we were having a real adventure! We were the only 2 on the tour so everything was paced at our speed and they wished the route varied to meet our specific.

Thank you for a memorable ride!!

My 5 friends and I did both the "Saigon by Night" and the day trip to the Mekong with the cooking class and were possibly the 2 best things I have done while traveling!! What a hoot. We rode pillion on the night tour going to lots of bars and out of the way restaurants. Food was phenomenal and Chien our guide really great fun. Enjoyed it so much we booked the Mekong delta day tour. Some of us rode pillion again the others rode their own bikes. Really safe. Awesome day. Cooking class was a highlight. Just the best fun. Definitely recommend!!!
DO IT. Just the most amazing night tour ever, great leaders, food, music and adventure. Loved every minute.

Four ladies all in the senior age bracket took this tour on and OMG did we just love it. We didn't want the night to end, Torrential rain, jumping chicken to eat (AKA toad) nothing could dampen our spirits, we were on a high from start to end.The only improvement that could be made for this tour would be we needed to stay longer in the nightclub. All credit to the organizers, our drivers and wonderful guide, our only regret is not having another day for the day trip.
Do it!! Best way to see the city at night! Food and entertainment were amazing. Tried all different food and. Drinks are included in the price.

Vietnam Vespa Adventures certainly do take you on adventure riding the streets of Saigon, dining at local restaurants, trying Vietnamese coffee, enjoying a beer whilst our guide Ted engaged in conversation on the history of Vietnam. Our Vespa drivers drove with caution and felt quite safe at all times. Finished the evening at a local bar - a most memorable night and would recommend it to others. Photos were taken by company throughout the evening and received them by email this morning - all inclusive of cost. A nice touch and great memories.

My wife and I learned about this the night before and didn't know what to expect. We woke up the next morning to find two smiling Vespa riders waiting for us outside our apartment. For the next 7 or so hours we found ourselves seemingly all over Vietnam on the back of their Vespas. From chaotic Ho Chi Minh City to the gorgeous, surreal countryside, we zigged, we zagged and at times we held on for dear life. How invigorating! When we weren't zigging and zagging we were seeing the local sights and learning how Vietnamese people live (most times without a tourist in sight), and we got the chance to cook delicious food in a hut alongside a river, seemingly millions of miles away from the skyscrapers, crowds and car horns. I can't recommend this excursion enough. Our tour guide, Chien, was great and very knowledgeable about all things Vietnam. He spoke very good English as well and we never had an issue with communication.

So what are you waiting for? Book this! You'll never forget it, I promise.
We toured local eateries and bars for the evening and it was the highlight of our trip! Their choices of restaurants, drivers and tour guides were nothing short of fantastic. Definitely do it again!
Good way to spend an afternoon in HCMC, the tour guide (Dieu) was great and being on the back of a vespa is good fun. Highly recommended

review_title: Great foodie tour, even with a toddler
review_text: We did the night street food tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. We wanted to sample the street food and the Vespa guys took us to every nook and corner around Ho Chi Minh to bring us to sample some amazing street food around the city. We traveled with our daughter 1.5 years and she loved the ride on the vespa. Highly recommended if you are on short trip and a foodie. Very professional. We cut our trip a little short due to our daughters sleep schedule. The guys took us back and were very professional. Great trip and definitely a must do!

review_title: Make sure you see Saigon by night on a vesper!
review_text: This was a fabulous experience! Really exciting and exhilarating! The staff are great and the drivers are very good, safe and friendly! Terrific food, plenty to drink and fun entertainment. We were really looked after with care ☺ thanks for a memorable last night in Vietnam.

review_title: Greatest night out, best fun ever!
