review_text: had the time of our lives , the food was great and the tour was unreal . driving through saigon at night is a blast and the drivers a very good at what they do . worth every sent a great tour and a must do

One of the best tours I've done in my 15 or so years of traveling- takes you to places you wouldn't normally go to- great food, drink and company with the added bonus of riding on the back of a Vespa around one of the craziest and vibrant streetscapes. The live music was a great surprise.

review_title: So much fun and very informative
review_text: This was an option on a Scenic Tour that we did recently and only 6 of us chose to do it. So sad for the rest because it was a highlight of the entire trip. Two of our group were in their eighties, two in their seventies and two in their sixties. We had so much fun being in that chaotic traffic and witnessing daily life in Ho Chi Minh City. Our guides took us to great places of interest and we all agreed that we never once felt that we were in any danger. It was a truly fantastic experience and I would highly recommend it to anyone traveling in Vietnam.

We were collected from hotel around 5-00 pm with experienced Vespa staff and jumped on the back of 60's era vintage Vespa scooters and headed off in peak hour traffic to a bar to meet other people on the same tour. I feel very safe. Clear communication from staff of how the night will transpose. Mix of cultures and the fun begins, with cocktails to drink and then back again on Vespa scooter to ride to next spot for great food and drinks amid the city life.. We loved the authentic local culture, hidden cafe's and nightlife that we wouldn't have found. Live bands and singers were excellent. It met every expectation of what brochure had shown. So much food, you definitely won't go hungry. Highly recommended tour.

review_title: Great fab amazing what can I say
review_text: We like a lot of other reviews had an amazing time on this to our tour , were guild was Dieu she was so funny and very heart warming all evening , and her English was very good , we did not drink a lot during the evening however it was unlimited drinks and there were lots and lots of food , were of very good quality and the two nightclubs where brilliant thank you

review_title: Great Way to See Saigon after dark
review_text:
the guys picked us at the hotel right on time-they took to their rendezvous place to await additional participants-then we literally took off amid the traffic chaos-we visited two restaurants and two night clubs-in between we got a great tour of the city-even though it was drizzling and dark-
this was truly and expereince not to be missed-the food that was served us was truly local Vietnamese the two night clubs were as different as night and day-one was quiet piano/violin and the second was loaded contemporary -we never would have found these places on out own-
the ride was exhilarating to say the least-the highlight of the night!
thee guide spoke really good english and the ratio was one guide to 4 or 6 people-

Did the Saigon after dark tour last night. What a blast!!! Such fun, a truly memorable experience from start to finish.

Here's why it's so good. Firstly, the pace. It's just perfect, never rushed and all the spots you visit are ver well organized. Secondly, the value. When you factor in the ride, food, and basically unlimited beverages it's excellent ROI. Finally, the guides. They are fun, warm hearted and there to ensure you have a safe and amazing experience.

Good times awaiting on Vietnam Vespa adventures.....looking forward to my next tour.....let's ride!

Final comment....please get proper t-shirts. We wanted to buy the shirts then noticed the style on offer....Just simple Ts in white, black or orange would be perfect.

In Vietnam 2 weeks and this was probably my favorite time. 5 of us did the Mekong Delta. The Vespas are a hoot. After you spend 10 minutes in Saigon you know you MUST ride a scooter!
The countryside was awesome and all the stops were interesting and authentic. Our guide was great. I will definitely do this again and also both HCMC tours.

Mekong Delta with cooking class day trip, and Saigon Nights food tour. Without a doubt the best experience we had during 2 weeks in Vietnam. Hoang, Dep and their teams provided the most memorable of experiences during our time in Vietnam.

review_title: Great way to experience this vibrant city!
review_text: The tour guide was awesome; spoke good English, knew the city and very friendly. Vespa drivers drove safely and were friendly as well. The tour takes you to very off beat locations for some great live music and awesome local food. Also a great way to meet new people. Highly recommended!

We did the evening food tour (twice) we decided to do it again after my daughter and her boyfriend joined us on their world tour. It is a great way to see the city and get amongst what looks from the pavement crazy roads and junctions. The food is very very tasty and filling, you will not go hungry or thirsty. The drivers all make you feel very safe and our guide for both evenings was a chap called Chien, he was brilliant, spoke excellent English and explained everything at each restaurant and stop. A magical night and fantastic experience you will not be disappointed. Big thanks to Chien.

We went on the night tour which was so much fun. We stopped at 2 restaurants for authentic food then we were taken to a coffee lounge which was down a lane and looked like it was residential. The next stop at a bar was the same....without local knowledge you would never find it.
I would strongly recommend doing this tour at the start so you have places you can go back to. Our guide Loan was amazing and made the whole adventure so good.
We were told they have the same type of your in Siem Reap so we will do this first up to give us some insight for the rest of our time there.
An amazing 4 hours!!!!

review_title: You must go on a tour with this company!
review_text: What a wonderful morning spent on this half day tour. As I was visiting the City for work I had just 8 hours of sight seeing time and this tour gave me a great feel for the city. Chin my tour guide was interesting, informed and a complete delight. I saw things I'd never have seen and loved the excitement of being taken around the city on a scooter. As a lone traveler this was a great way to see the sights. Oh, and lunch at the cafe at the end was delicious! A great value tour that I couldn't recommend more.

We had the pleasure of 3 tours with these guys, Saigon after dark, insider's Saigon and glimpse of the Mekong. Words can't describe how amazing the experience was, each tour is epic and is a must, if you have time! The service/communication from this company is outstanding, can't wait to return and do more 😀

review_title: Excellent way to see the city!
review_text: We booked an afternoon tour in Ho Chi Minh City. Our guide took us (group of 12 adults) all around, with numerous stops (flower market, post office, Buddha memorial, local restaurant) and did a wonderful job filling us in on the history of Saigon. At the flower market we got off our bikes for a tour through the market and past the homes of the merchants who worked there. Unbelievable. But the best part was just being a temporary member of the "vespa nation" and riding through the traffic of Ho Chi Minh, looking at the people and absorbing the rich culture. At the end of the tour we stopped at a local restaurant for beer and sea food - fresh crab, clams and mussels. Delicious! Helmets are provided, and they are prepared for rain w/ponchos if needed. Even though we were weaving in and out of traffic, and occasionally venturing the wrong way down a one-way street I never felt at risk. The drivers are excellent and friendly.

review_title: Food, drinks, sightseeing and good company
review_text: Went on the night tour of Ho chi minh and thoroughly enjoyed it! Saw the city from the back of a moped at night and was blown away by how amazing the city looked. Guide was excellent, drivers were friendly and professional and the choice of stops was diverse and fun! Great night all round!

This was recommended to us by one of our friends and it was absolutely the highlight of our trip!
We had so much fun! The food was great and our tour guide was really out going and knowledgeable! We also met some really fun people in our group!
I would recommend this to everyone!
I literally couldn't stop smiling the entire time!

I booked the Mekong Delta + Cooking Class, the Insider Saigon and the After Dark Tours. As a solo traveler, Vietnam Vespa Adventure Tours made me feel like my stay in Saigon was hosted by friends. They pick you up from and return you to your hotel. I give them a 10/10 for their organizational skills, their professionalism, the driver's skill and care, their English and knowledge is impressive and all the tours were great value for money, everything is included. I've learned so much about Southern Vietnam in just 2 days. Do yourself a favour and book at least one of their tours. Thank you to all the team at Vietnam Vespa Adventure Tours Saigon. Chris :-)

My second time in Vietnam and my third tour with the fabulous Vespa Adventures Team. Great Staff, amazing people.. everything was perfect, well organised and "glimpse of the mekong" gave us the most beautiful portrait of the and outside Saigon.
We booked a sort of customized tour form my family and Chien (our tour guide) made an extraordinary job!!! We visited a lot of site and we had also the opportunity to see the ceremony at Cao Dai Temple.
Thanks to all of you for the great time we had around Saigon and special thanks to Chien, excellent guide, proud of his wonderful country.
This is the best tour you can book if you're planning to visit Vietnam.

review_title: Its a Must on your 'To Do' List
review_text:
From the time I booked, till the time we were taken back to our hotel after a fantastic 'Insider Vietnam Tour', dealing with Steves 'Crew' of Vietnam Vespa Adventures was one of the highlights of our trip.
Its a few weeks ago now that we went to Vietnam and Im writing this from memory (should have taken notes or written earlier!). But the things that still come to mind are; men riding vespas are competent and kind. My 12yr old, 16 yr old and I did this tour and I was a little apprehensive given I had my 2 most precious 'belongings' under the care of an unknown adult on a motorbike! I soon knew I had no worries. These guys know what they are doing - and while the riders English language is limited, the tour guide has excellent English language which she uses constantly to point out places and things of interest. You definately go to places you wouldn't get to on other tours - I still remember the bird 'talking' park. The meal at the end was delicious. Its one of the best things we did on our 2 weeks in Vietnam and we did heaps! Many thanks again to all at Vespa Adventures - I can now see why you get such favorable reviews again and again. Next trip to Vietnam would have me a return customer and Im happy to recommend to other parents if considering this as safe and fun way to spend a few hours visiting a beautiful country.

review_title: Great way to see the city
review_text: My partner and I actually did the tour by night and were a little aprehensive at first as we are not people who tend to go on excursions in big groups on holiday, we like to keep things quite personal. However, whilst we were in a big group of people on the same tour it didn't feel like it. We had our own personal guide as well as our drivers who were excellent and we felt very safe. If we had not done this tour we would not have gotten to see some of the places we did as we were only in the city for 48 hours. The two street cafe's we visited were both excellent and a backstreet traditional coffee bar gave us an insight into how local people socialize. It was one of the holiday highlights for us and would definitely recommend it to anyone.

This was one of our highlights of our trip to Vietnam! We did three tours during our stay and this was by far, the best..
A group of us were taken on vintage vespa's after dark from our hotel and tripped around the streets of Saigon, stopping at about 6 places during the evening. We tried all sorts of Vietnamese food and drinks and learned plenty along the way. The tour guides were awesome and spoke really good English. Thoroughly recommend this company! Had the best time....

My friends and I went on the Saigon after Dark tour it was amazing even tho we had torrential tropical rain for most of the tour (they supplied raincoats) it was filled with magical moments great food drinks music etc it was faultless and I recommend it as a must do when visiting Saigon.

The 'Saigon After Dark' tour may have been almost as hectic as the local traffic but what a brilliant and apt way to get to know HCMC! Weaving our way through 4 different districts, we ate and drank the night away with locals, including a very knowledgable guide. After dinner we visited an extraordinary hidden coffee house / lounge where Vietnamese musicians performed to a small, captivated crowd before ending the night at 'Acoustic', a music venue with some excellent cover bands playing both Vietnamese and Western rock.

Even torrential rain didn't dampen our spirits as the drivers were well equipped with ponchos to keep us dry.

Would recommend to anyone staying in HCMC, especially those keen to get an authentic feel for the place and with a sense of adventure

My Friend booked this trip when I was visiting Ho Chi Minh. We went with a group of her friends and it was brilliant, there was plenty to eat and drink! A range of seafood, frogs legs and rice dishes. There were alternatives if you're not keen on seafood! The guide really looked after us. I added a bit too much chilli to one dish and didn't handle it very well - my eyes started streaming and the guide got me some sugar to counteract the spiciness. It worked a treat. I'm really grateful. From there the group was taken to a couple of music venues and we got to end the night with a few cocktails!
The trip also included traveling through different districts.The drivers and the guide were really helpful. I recommend this trip to experience some of HCMC.

We did the Saigon by night tour with our kids aged 10, 13 and 15. It was a blast. The guides and drivers are great. The whole thing is very well-organized and safe. At one point it rained and out popped the rain gear. A great way to see Saigon ad spend a fun evening.

Family tour with 6 Members. Excellent tour guide. She is very punctual, patient and lenient.
We have many first time experience in our tour that she arranged. All were cheap and good.
1) Wonderful lacate food.
2) Drink coffee in a very special place.
3) Washing hair and nail painting locate style.
4) Massage .
5) Very flexible schedule.etc
Vi tour was very special that you will never experience from tour agency. I strongly recommend her to be your guide.

review_title: highlight of my trip to HCM!
review_text:
I was initially a little dubious about shelling out $86 for a 4 hour motorbike tour of HCM, especially since taxis and food are so cheap. However, it was totally worth it. The drivers are incredibly professional and very skilled, navigating the crazy HCM roads with ease. It was amazing to see the city from that vantage point, and very convenient for people who have limited time to visit the city. The food and drinks were great, and all of the stops were a ton of fun and definitely not places I would've found on my own.

One complaint (and thus one star taken off)--even though Vespa Adventures advertises as unlimited food & drink, they actually have a one-drink limit at the last stop, a club-like location with live music. Not a huge deal, but I didn't like feeling nickel and dimed, especially given the all-inclusive nature that its advertising materials proclaimed.

Did the night tour. What a blast! A friend did the tour and suggested it to me.
Was skeptical as to how much fun this would be, and I am a motorcyclist, so sitting on back seems a bit lame, but was very very happy. Most pleasantly surprising was how smooth he and professional this outfit is. Everything, and it mean everything was so well orchestrated and run. Literally every detail is handled, so just sit back and relax. Food and drinks flowed without issue. Great quality food, and the guides were true customer service experts.
THe two evening bar stops wed so much fun, too. Expected all stops to be tourist traps, but clearly weren't. These are indeed locals places, and you would never drop in as a tourist.
Bravo.

review_title: Saigon after dark Vespa tour- awesome
review_text:
Hilight of our time in HCMC. Zipping through the crazy traffic felt so easy behind our friendly & very safe drivers. Great value - awesome guide, food, drinks - but best of all the eclectic mix if venues we visited - we would never have found such great places by ourselves.
If we had more time we would have tried the other tours too. Recommend this tour for all ages.
We will book more tours on our next trip to Vietnam

Fantastic night. very nervous before getting on the Vespa but guides were very helpful and friendly. our guide Lamb was brilliant. Definitley highlights of our trip to Saigon. favorite stop a little back street cafe up a flight of stairs playing live music. Violin/piano/singer candle lit room- could have stayed there all night. Would recommend ++++

We were a family of 5 - youngest child was 7. We took the evening tour. We were a bit nervous about safety to start with but soon realized that you're better off moving with the traffic on two wheels rather than crossing it on two legs. Our guide was wonderful, very genuine and enthusiastic. The street food was amazing, with the highlight for the kids being the KFF. The only problem was fitting all the food in - don't eat lunch previously!

review_title: Saigon when the sun goes down
review_text: My husband and I were recommended this tour by our travel agent. It was a great night indeed, We tried the local seafood and other traditional dishes. We are in awe of our drivers of the vespas and our guide for the night was heaps of fun too.

review_title: Another 2 fantastic tours with Vietnam Vespas
review_text:
After doing their Glimpse of Mekong tour last year and loving it. When we decided to come back to
Vietnam this year and finding out they now do tours in Hoi An, we just had to book again....we actually did 2 in Hoi An.
The Hoi An countryside and island tour and the Streets & Eats Of Hoi An.
Both were great fun yet again, nothing more exciting then zipping around on the back of a Vespa!
We even got to meet and do the night tour with Steve the owner and his lovely wife and their two young sons.
We tried so many different local foods, and places that we would have never been able to try if we hadn't gone with these guys.
All drivers were professional and had our safety in mind at all times.
If you go to Hoi An don't hesitate to book a tour, you will have the best time.
All the best Steve and family.
The most fun tour I took on my trip. Loved seeing the city at night. The tour guide was so much fun. We stop at all kinds of local out of the way places for great food, drink and music.
This was extremely great fun. Guides were fantastic. Tour took you to real Vietnam and if was safe and fun. Show you how respectful they are in a system that looks chaotic.

Hojolj

Absolutely one of the best tours I have ever been on. The drivers are great. Each group has a personal guide. You get to experience nightlife in Saigon in a way that no visitor ever could. I would recommend this tour to anyone.
Saigon is beautiful! Had the tour with a cool couple from NZ and got the best guide one could wish for. Thanks for showing us around, Eric!

Had a brilliant evening driving through the streets of Saigon on the back of vespa's. the drivers were really great and made sure you felt safe. We went to two places to eat where food was really tasty and both small local Vietnamese places. We went to an acoustic place and a live music venue. All fantastic with lots of food and drink throughout the evening. We were a group of 7 with a mixture of ages but we all had fun and our guide was great. I would highly recommend the tour and want to do it again in Hoi An.

We had a fabulous night. The evening is organized ensuring that everyone has a great evening, we never stopped laughing and our guide Dieu made it even better. Her friendly and cheerful demeanour made it a brilliant night. Included in the tour price are drinks and fantastic food.

Best tour we did in Vietnam. Foodie tour by night, brilliant end to the holiday; drivers we fantastic, food was great.

Drank too much, ate too much, but amazing.

Just got back from a 4hr Vespa tour. We went as a group of 5. 2 adults 2 teenagers and one child age 9. What an amazing night! Drivers were extremely careful, we went to some cool bars and restaurants. Our guide was really sweet and informative whilst being friendly and chatty. Loads (if not too much to eat) and free drinks all night. Had such a fun and exciting time. Would thoroughly recommend.definitely as a must do in vibrant Saigon.

This was the best tour that I did in Vietnam. It was a very well planned evening and never a dull moment. Every stop was different and the drivers were very careful. They took us to places where other tourists don't go. The food was so tasty. I could do this tour every night

review_title: 6 days - HCMC to Nha Trang - amazing!
review_text:
We were a bit nervous about safety in the days leading up to this tour but from the minute we climbed on the bikes I don't think one of us gave it another thought!
8 of us from Newcastle, Australia had the most amazing 6 days. If you can't do the 6 days, then at least do the night tour in Saigon! Amazing experience and amazing food! The crew Vietnam Vespa Adventures have working for them were absolutely amazing and the most charming group of people I have ever experienced in a tour.
Sitting on a bike you see so much! So much better than sitting in a car or bus, you are there among the sights, the smells, the vibe of Vietnam! A must do!

Saigon by night Vespa tour was fabulous, would recommend to anyone. The drivers were brilliant, our guide delightful. We went to places we would never have been, ate amazing food and whizzed round on a Vespa, absolutely loved it

review_title: Absolute must do while in Saigon
review_text: We did the Saigon after dark food tour and loved it so much we did the Mekong also. It was so much fun and very well organized. The food was amazing and lots of it. The guides were fantastic on both tours and always made safety a priority. Half the fun was experiencing the traffic on the back if a bike, as chaotic as the traffic was I never felt unsafe on the back. Don't miss these tours as they pride themselves on going where must tourists don't go. The Mekong tour was great. About 7 hours on a bike and the scenery great. I would do both of these tours again and I'm not one to do things twice

review_title: A must-do in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: Despite our apprehension before starting the tour, you don't need to worry about safety, the scooter drivers were brilliant and kept the four of us (including son 16 and daughter 14) out of harm's way and quite much in convoy. Tour guide was also superb, telling all about food at each stop we made and lots about Vietnamese life in general. We had delicious seafood and many other things, but you can tailor the food to your likes at the beginning. Such a thrill to spin through the streets at night, got to see so much more than we would have otherwise, and last stop of the night was a great bar with live music! A brilliant end to a fabulous holiday.

I took both the "Saigon After Dark" & "Glimpse of the Mekong" tours and they were both outstanding. The Vespas are really comfortable. More comfortable than most of the motorbikes you see around Saigon. Each tour us to some great places that were very non-touristy -- like the kind of places you'd see Anthony Bourdain eat. My guides, Chien and Dat, respectively, were both extremely friendly and their English was great.

Finally after I had some disappointing tours in Vietnam and ho chi minh. .I found myself enjoying the night life vespa tour.
Just to ride on a vespa in hcm is a unforgettable experience.
4 hour of stoping in some hidden places and riding around the streets of hcm .
Inc food beer and coffee its really worth it.
If you are in hcm dont miss the nightlife tour.

What a brilliant evening. I have to admit to being slightly nervous given the scooter jungle, and the fact that both of my children (7 and 14) were on the back of a Vespa with an unknown adult! Well, we all had an amazing time, we were collected from the hotel at 6pm by 4 riders and a guide and then whisked through rush hour to our first stop where we had beer and nachos (not the kids!). We then set off for more scooter time and headed to a seafood restaurant in District 3 which was delicious, then back on the bikes and over to another restaurant back in District 1 - 9 courses in total. We then scooted over to the Super Bowl for a quick game before ending up in a little cafe with live music to finish the evening off, being dropped back to our hotel at 10.30. Our drivers and our guide were brilliant. Pretty much one of the best things we've done which entertained the whole family! Would definitely recommend as a brilliant way to see the city and feel like a local!

We had prebooked this through our travel company and had been assumed it was both safe and fun bearing in mind our youngest child was an 11 year old. It proved to be one of the best things we did all trip! We were picked up from our hotel by 5 Vespa drivers including a young woman driver form our 11 year old daughter which was a nice touch. Then we were off amongst the thousands of Vespas vying for street space. Our tour started at 6pm which is ideal as not only do you get to see Saigon at night but equally importantly you get taken into districts and streets that you might not discover on foot. Stopping first at the tour HQ for a quick drink we then went down side roads with locals selling fruit and veg, having acupuncture treatments and tattoos. Second stop was a fish restaurant where we were able to taste crab, mussels, fish chicken and Singapore noodles. All was freshly cooked and everything tried and enjoyed by all of us. Back on the Vespas again and more sight seeing before we ended up at a famous family run pancake shop where rice pancakes were served for us to fill lettuce leaves with the pancake and pork, shrimp and bean sprout filling. Then deep fried spring rolls arrived filled with gently spiced pork which were a big hit. Back on the Vespas and more sights around the Opera House and more before ice cream at a cool dimly light little cafe where some gentle live music was played before a last hop to a bar for one last beer before hotel and bed. Would recommend this to everyone - don't think twice about it just book it and enjoy. You will not regret it!

This was our second time booking with VVA and our family of four (2 boys 11 and 12) was really looking forward to our Mekong Delta day. We had done the tour around Saigon the last time we were in HCMC and had loved it.

Unfortunately, through NO FAULT of VVA our son burned his leg on a delivery person's motorcycle about 5 minutes before we were supposed to set out. The motorcycle DID NOT belong to Vietnam Vespa Adventures or their staff. The Vespas supplied by them have completely covered exhaust pipes. This was a random person who pulled up and left her motorcycle running. My son backed right into it. The burn was very bad and they immediately jumped into action giving him care and comfort. Even ran to a nearby pharmacy for a burn kit (motorcycle burns are very common in Vietnam). It was obvious we weren't going to be able to go on the tour. The money not only refunded we had just paid but also offered to refund our deposit. The full amount. We declined taking back the deposit and made sure we had given them enough to pay the drivers that were standing there waiting for us. They drove us back to the hotel and gave us the address of the local SOS expat clinic.

I know the next time we return we'll do another tour and wouldn't do it without anyone other than Vietnam Vespa Adventures.

review_title: Vespa after dark - Highlight of trip!
review_text: We did the vespa after dark tour and were originally a little wary of riding on the back of bikes in the Saigon traffic, however as soon as we met our drivers who picked us up at our hotel and got on the bikes we were at ease, the traffic didn't move that fast and the drivers are very safe. We had an amazing night, the food was delicious and unlike anything else we ate on our trip, and mixed with the locals at the music venues we went to be a real highlight. This was one of my most favorite experiences in Vietnam.
Wow, this is the way to truly see and taste Ho Chi Minh City at night! Great tour guides and Vespa riders. The 4-5 hour tour was filled with surprises. Don't miss this tour!

review_title: If you can cross the road in HCMC .. you're ready for the night tour
review_text: What a whirlwind .. it was fantastic .. to understand why you need to see the scooter traffic in HCMC - check youtube for this.... over the course of the first day in HCMC you'll have to cross the road at some stage ... it really is an art - slow, deliberate and steady - don't hesitate or waver. Once you've got the confidence to do that, you're ready for the vespa tour. It is exhilarating - even for experienced bikers - Jay and her team are in total control and all were very safe drivers. Most of the Vespa's have a second seat so the ride is comfortable and you stay with the same driver for the evening. The bikes are all in good nick and the helmets provided are clean. They picked me up at my hotel and dropped me back after, which was very much appreciated. The tour is great fun .. it is brilliant to be part of the swarm of bikes and swept along with the tide of the city. The food stops were great - all food and drinks (beers for me) are all included in the package. The pork in wasabi leaf was a top dish. Jay phones ahead to make arrangements for vegetarians and non seafood eaters. The traditional Vietnamese music was superb - an oasis away from the madness of the city - french in nature but distinct - lots of laments for unrequited love !! The tour wraps up in a bar with live rock/pop music. Without a doubt a "must do" - Many thanks to Jay and Maugh for a great night.

review_title: Top Of the list to do inVietnam
review_text: I've been here 3 years and done this tour around 17 times, all our friends commented the night tour was the highlight of their trip to Vietnam, the sites, lights, smells and backstreets all inclusive drinks and food is great for value of this fantastic four hour experience. Great trip cheers and thanks to all the team.

I enjoyed every minute of the tour, Saigon after Dark. First our group of 7 were seated on a table to get to know each other. Everyone was very friendly and expected a lot from the tour. And at the end of the trip all of us were very happy :)
The tour guide and the riders are both extremely helpful and kind. I couldn't have asked more questions, although it can be difficult to hear the answers when sitting at the back and the vespa was quite loud, and the speed and the wind didn't help either. The food and drink was well chosen and really delicious. One big note here though, don't try to eat all the food in the first restaurant you visit, leave room for other places too. The food and drink is equally good in all restaurants and cafes you go to. You won't want to miss out on anything.
SG after dark is a beautiful twinkling sparkling city full of life. There's so much to see on the streets. With the experienced driver and very comfortable seat on aged vespa, I really had the time of my life :)
Highly recommended for every one.

review_title: See Ho Chi Minh the way locals see it
review_text: We booked the Glimpse of the Mekong trip and got picked up at the hotel bang on time. A quick trip through the streets, stop first at Cafe Zoom and then once all the participants are there, on to a nearby house in a quiet street where you can test the bike if you are going to ride. The tour then heads out at a gentle pace through busy suburbs and out into the country. There are stops for a shrimp farm, coffee, a wet market and finally lunch, which on our tour includes the cooking lesson as well. On the homeward trip we made a couple more stops. Even the torrential downpour at the end of the ride was interesting. Everything was excellent, this is well worth the money and if you can ride, you should.

My wife and I did day tours of Ho Chi Minh City and later the Hoi An countryside with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. Both tours were fantastic and filled out the day with interesting spots where we saw no other tourists. Our awesome guides, Dieu in HCM and Loan in Hoi An, were fun to be with and expertly filled in the historical and cultural contexts of our stops without being boring or sounding like tape recorders. Last but not least, I loved riding around on the (back of a) vespa, though I'm not sure my wife feels the same way. I'm seriously considering getting a vespa when we get home. All in all, highly recommend.
Note: pack a poncho in case it rains.

My girlfriend and I are back packing on a budget, so we weren't so sure about this tour. However, I was quite keen, so we eventually coughed up the cash and it was worth every penny. The tours are in small groups of 5-7 people and each person gets their own driver. We had a very friendly group and our drivers were brilliant. They spoke great English and you always felt safe. Our guide was great too! It was a lovely way to see Ho Chi Minh city. The local food, including frogs legs, was amazing and the music venues were very good. The unlimited drinks at two of the venues is an added bonus too! Couldn't recommend more!

I booked the Vespa Adventure tour because of a friend's recommendation. At 7.55 AM a young man walked in to the hotel lobby with a neat sign board carrying my name. He took me to the office on the back of his Vespa where I met with the other participants of the tour. In our group there were 3 of us, 3 drivers and the guide but I saw other groups also preparing to leave at the same time. During the tour which starts at around 8.30 AM from the office to 12 AM you are driven around Ho Chi Min City on the back of a Vespa which gives you the opportunity to participate in this very popular means of transportation yourself. I felt safe all the time and the driver confirmed if I was Ok several times. We stopped at a number of points in Ho Chi Min where the guide, Dieu, would give us explanations and I specially liked the map she was carrying and the marker to make Vietnamese History clearer to us. We also stopped for a drink on the way, sugar cane juice or coconut juice was on the menu. I had done a biking trip through Bangkok a few weeks ago and found the Vespa Tour to be a very entertaining and relaxing way to get to know Ho Chi Min City. I would recommend this tour to everyone who wants to see HCMC like the locals do from their Vespa's. When we returned we were invited for lunch and were allowed to choose a main dish and a drink of the menu, it tasted very well after having been in traffic for a couple of hours.

review_title: The perfect way to see the city like a local!
review_text:
I felt completely safe the whole time. Walking along the streets the traffic looks pretty crazy, but the speed limit id only 30km so once your on a bike you realize it's not that fast.

The tour guide put my backpack on him (facing forwards). I sat behind him taking photos with my camera around my neck.

I asked if I could use my ohone but its recommended not to as its easy for another rider to come up & steal it from your hand then take off.

I did the half day city tour that started at 12pm. I was picked up from my hotel, then taken for lunch at a resort where i paid for my tour. I was then given a tour of the city stopping at several of the major sites.

My tour guide spoke perfect English & was very informative. they even provided rain coats when it started raining!

very professional, I recommend to anyone adventurous!

* dont forget sunscreen!

I also wanted to go to the market the day before & bought a face mask (like what they wear) to protect myself from the pollution. It really helped keep the smog out of my lungs, plus you look like a local! FYI, I paid 10,000 for mine.

review_title: Hoi an Vespa adventure with Vu
review_text:
What a great find, first of all we stumbled on Zoom Cafe Hoi an, so friendly and inviting and great food and drinks.
While having a cold iced tea we noticed they offered vespa tours, morning , afternoon and a street food tour.
We made inquiries and let them know our interest to do the afternoon tour that day.
we were asked to wait till the tour guide Mr Vu was contacted so we went for a short walk and 5 minutes later Mr Vu and another guide found us wandering the shops of Hoi an and invited us back to Zoom cafe to finalize the tour.
Vu explained the afternoon tour and off we went.
How awesome the tour was going to the markets, through the villages, along the river, rice paper making, rice noodle making (my husband actually got to make his own), visiting a local farmer and actually walking through the farm, trying the local coffee, hoping on the locals ferry and Vu was then kind enough to take us for some delicious pork where we made our own spring rolls.
we had such a fantastic tour we chose to do the night time street food tour the next day. starting of with Banh Can, then off to the beach for a sea food treat, then on to sample what the locals call their beer food, back on the vespa again to sample the local favorite Chicken Rice (yummo) , at this stage we were so full.
Vu finished off the tour with a visit to the Locals Tavern, where there is a band and locals or yourself can get up on stage and sing your heart out.
great atmosphere and great talent.
The other Tour guide who needs a special mention was Mr Mab (mr awesome) such a kind friendly guy.
We got back to Zoom Cafe and Mr Vu and Mab kindly took us by vespa back to our hotel in Da Nang.
This Vietnam Vespa Tour was the highlight of our trip and we would like to encourage others to give it a good you will have a wonderful time and see the REAL VIETNAM.
Thank you Vu and Mab.
From Mr John and Kelly

I did this twice in as many weeks and had an absolute ball both times! After witnessing Saigon traffic as a pedestrian I was very uncertain about attempting this. So glad I did as I really never felt in any danger and it was a blast seeing the traffic just work together so easily and I was completely relaxed the entire time. Went to places I would never have thought of going and where most tourists never get to see. Highly recommended!!! Expensive by Vietnamese standards but totally worth it.

Me, my husband and 2 friends did the Vespa tour after seeing amazing reviews on trip advisor and it did not disappoint. From the moment we were picked up from our hotel and whizzed to the first bar for free drinks and nibbles we were loving it! You get a real sense of the city and you get various different foods at the stop off points. It is really well judged and lasts for just the right amount of time, our tour guide was also great and ended up partying with us after the tour was over which was fun! Overall I wouldn't even hesitate to book this tour, total highlight of the holiday so far!

review_title: What A Memorable Night - Could Not Recommend Highly Enough
review_text:
I am certainly not a fan of motor bikes so I was not excited to be doing this tour with my husband. How very wrong I was!! We had such a fabulous night. Riding on the bike with all the traffic was a little scary at first but it was also soooo much fun. The food was fabulous - even enjoyed the 'jumping chicken'. The coffee and live music at the end just topped off a really great night.

Step out of your comfort zone, I know you won't be disappointed its a fabulous night out.

the idea of doing a Vespa tour initially worried us but the staff of that company were just excellent and very friendly, we loved all the stops and eating with the locals and being in the rush hour traffic in the city is a whole new experience in life!

review_title: Excellent day with the glimpse of Mekong tour
review_text: Fantastic tour. Having done a tour of the tunnels the day before in a bus I cannot recommend getting around Saigon via Vespa enough. Staff are all lovely and excellent drivers, we all felt completely safe the whole time. You get to see the beautiful countryside, try amazing local food in bustling markets, sit down with locals for a coffee. At no point is there any pressure to buy from any stores or vendors, and we didn't see any other tourists for the whole day which definitely adds to the sense of authenticity provided by the experience.

It was amazing to ride around and actually get Into the crazy traffic. The first 5 minuets are the scariest, but then you get used to it and relax and enjoy it. I would defiantly recommend this tour to friends.

review_title: vespa ride in the city but heaps more
review_text:
Vespa Adventures have got a great night covered. If your wondering whether to do this or not ,don't just do it. Its not for the faint hearted. Pick up from hotel
by your vespa drivers. Short ride to Zoom cafe meet your guide for the night . Explanation of the evenings events and a warm up drink and snake while sitting on an outside table watching the massive traffic movement going on. Then we're loaded up on the vintage vespas ,very cool, and we're off like a race start into the river rapid like traffic. Laughing and smiling like fools.Then on it went riding and eating and drinking through narrow streets ,lanes, major roads all over exploring the major sights of HMC.Finally a few of the night spots of the city that only well connected locals would know about. Yes some singing and dancing as well. So if you would like some fun this is the activity for you. Simply the best.

My husband and I were in Ho Chi Minh City in April on a private tour with Trails of Indochina. They arranged for a night tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. I was somewhat leery as I assumed this would be touristy or worse. Well this was one of the best experiences and we just had a blast. We were met in the lobby of our hotel by 2 drivers. We were supplied helmets and we each hopped in the back of the Vespas and off we went. We both felt so safe and comfortable and really felt a part of this most amazing city. We had no idea what was in store for us! We pulled up to a small outdoor bar and that is where we met Our guide for the night, Dieu. Not only was she adorable , her enthusiasm and passion and energy was infectious. We were offered any drink we wanted and chips and salsa! The bar is operated by the Owner of the VVA so this is where you start the tour. Dieu explained the evening and we were going to 4 different very authentic restaurants and bars in HCMC. Again, I was thinking we would visit tourist traps and again I was so off the mark. Hop back on the Vespas and Dieu has her own Vespa and just appeared at every place . We went to 2 amazing restaurants and you really get a chance to eat wonderful Vietnamese street food. Dieu will explain the food and history and we just had some great conversations. We then did a coffeehouse with local,singers which was really unique and we got to see a slower side to HCMC. Our last stop was a disco/ rock bar! Too fun. Great to see all the young Vietnamese singing and dancing to American songs. Live bands and loud music and we were probably the oldest people in the bar! The energy level was tremendous and it was a great way to end the night
Highly recommend VVA .Top notch company and a great experience. Dieu was the added bonus so if you reserve try to get her, but we talked with other guides and they all seemed good.

This was our 3rd time in Saigon and our 2nd time with Vietnam Vespa Tours. We did the Saigon at night tour which was fantastic, the food at the local eateries was great fun and delicious, although l might not have the frog legs again, even thought the were delicious also.....
The night club with the cover band and their 10 singers was amazingly good, could of gone there again to chill. Next time in Saigon we will do another tour given time. All ages would love this.

I don't think there is a better way to understand how Saigon works. Picked up at the end of peak hour and off into a mass of scooters with some unfathomable road rules. Visited some great local restaurants , more food than you can eat and each transit was a tour to another part of the city. Guide and drivers were great

review_title: If you can't beat them, join them
review_text: Great way to spend the evening. Trick is to look sideways and enjoy the view not at the traffic coming towards you... Guide was fantastic and drivers very considerate. Even in torrential rain had a great time. Food was excellent. Last venue, band was a little too reminiscent of the Clash..but little matter. Recommend it to anyone

No regrets in signing up for this trip! Me and husband plus another couple, all HCMC first timers except for husband (12th visit) totally enjoyed it :) Brings city touring to a whole new level!

Saw really good reviews online so decided to call them upon my arrival in HCMC. Booked the next day and they picked us up at 0800hrs at the hotel lobby. Stopped at Café Zoom to make payment and itinerary brief. Our female guide (Pronounce YOU) is a great girl. Seeing us Asians, she adjusted our itinerary so we wouldn’t be seeing similar things as back home! She asked us what we would like to explore and included them in the tour. English wasn’t British perfect but hey, it’s a holiday and it feels local!

We set off after 10 minutes and pillion on Vespas, riding alongside locals in the bike-heavy traffic. Super exciting! We had female riders for the boys and male ones for the ladies! Steady riders. And they will always check on you to ensure you are alright. DO NOT WEAR SLIPPERS ESPECIALLY IF YOU ARE SHORT. I am 1.58m and my feet couldn’t rest on the bike’s foothold properly and my slippers were flying off too. So for all the time, I perched my feet on the tyre’s metal platform and looked like a monkey in an orange helmet.

We visited most of the local attractions. WAR REMNANTS MUSUEM is a MUST TO VISIT. More interesting than expected. Guide will make frequent stops along the way and explain the background and history of certain spots. Cold bottled water served when you need them :) As per our request, we also visited slums and stopped for a local snack outside a residence, I didn’t see that special rice paper snack anywhere else in the city afterwards! Towards the end, you can also wear your helmet and snap a picture on the Vespa! Last stop was back to the café for lunch. A main and a drink is included in the tour package. MUST ORDER burger and coconut shake. BEST CHOICE! Others that we ordered wasn’t fantastic.

All those who are keen on a local adventure, this tour will be the cherry topping of your HCMC holiday :)

It was our last night in Ho Chi Minh (Saigon) and it was the BEST way to spend it. Got driven around on Vespas and stopped off at some awesome food places and got to try some local dishes which were all DELICIOUS, even the frog!! And went to some cool bars. Got to see some local talent! Was truly an awesome experience. And our guide - You or Ew.. cant spell.. but pronounced You.. she was soo funny and made the night even better!! Best guide ever!!
Thank you so much!!

review_title: Saigon After Dark Tour - brilliant experience
review_text:
We had the Vespa tour as part of our vacation package, so I don't know how much we have paid for it.
We highly recommend this tour, it was an amazing experience to start our visit in Saigon, as riding on the back of a retro Vespa through the chaos of Saigon streets was a definite thrill.
We were met by our Vespa drivers in front of the hotel, had a quick photo, and then taken to the bar where we met our guide and the rest of the group. There were only 5 tourists, and the guide (a young lady named "You" - apologies, but I have no idea how to spell her name) was brilliant, she was so energetic, full of interesting stories and kept the tour very funny for us.
There were 4 stops, 2 for food and 2 for drinks, but I am not going to spoil the surprise for you with providing more details on the stops. Food was great, we have really enjoyed it.
Highly recommend this tour - it reveals Saigon to the tourists in a manner that they won't normally discover by themselves.

review_title: Great way to have fun and see the best of Saigon
review_text: We booked the Vespa tour through our hotel and whilst we initially thought the approx $100 US pp was a little more than we would like to spend, it was well worth every penny. We were met by our Vespa drivers at our hotel and after a quick photo we taken to the bar where we met the other members of our group. There was only 6 of us so a really nice number to spend the night with. Throughout the night we were driven to four different places for street food, places that you wouldn't otherwise choose as a tourist but such a taste sensation. From clams to jumping chicken! Well, frogs legs we know them. You can be as adventurous as you like and they do cater for dietary requirements. Riding on the back of a Vespa through the chaos of Saigon streets was a definite thrill. Even when the clouds opened up, quick as a flash, out came the ponchos and our journey continued. The sights, the sounds, the smells and the vibration of the Vespa engine added to the fun. Our guides were friendly and looked after us well. We felt incredibly safe in their hands.i won't spoil the fun by telling all about the food except to say the food and drink, inc alcohols were plentiful and we ended the night watching a live band with a few more beers. A definite must if your in Saigon.

I recently did a trip to phu quoc island and vung tau each spending 4 days in both places.flew with a local flight company(vietjet) to phu quoc.landed at a brand new airport which is now international..the size was about the same as perth international airport.
I would recommend anyone going to Vietnam..to try both these places as,many things to do.i travelled with Saigon tours in Vietnam.very well looked aftert and cannot heap any more praise on this company in Vietnam/I realise they would be a competitor to trip advisor..but I had to mention this company..ok?the beaches/food etc..first class..hiotels 3star though the vung tau hotel /did not supply breakfast...rolls29//royce

review_title: The best way to experience Saigon!
review_text: I did the tour on my second day in HCM and loved the experience!! We were on the back of lovely Vespa's. Very comfortable and i felt surprisingly safe. They take you to little hidden marvels in HCM but also the bigger must see attractions and they explain along the way which is great! Definitely worth a try if you want to experience Saigon at its best! We did the day tour but the rest of the family did the night tours and loved it!

This was the highlight of our Saigon trip.
We are lead by Eric. Be advised you're on the back of a Vespa (driver is included per person). We went to many restaurants which were safe and insider local picks. Excellent culture and cuisine. We also went to a rock cage and evening coffee shop (think candlelight and violin and singing by artists). Super... Will definitely do again.

If you are in Ho Chi Minh, this is a must do tour. Very professional company, everything done to detail.
Very friendly tour guides, very safe professional riders, I run a motorcycle training school in the uk, it takes a lot to. Impress me, but these chaps can ride very smooth, safe and efficiently even the most nervous passengers will relax as pillion on these bikes. You are better as pillion on evening tour to relax thru the streets of Saigon and take in the scenery.
I did not want the night to end, first 2 stops were to try excellent traditional food, following two stops were traditional local clubs where we were welcomed very well and brilliant live music. Tour guide chine was a great laugh with a lot of knowledge.
Best money I ever spent, and my highlight tour of 2 weeks in Vietnam. Loved it, as did the wife.

review_title: If you only do one tour in HCMC, this should be it
review_text:
My wife and I were recently in HCMC, & it being our first time in this most wonderful city, we knew a "local knowledge" tour was necessary to afford us an insight into its deeper character and culture.
After consulting with our hotel reception (at GK Central Hotel, also highly recommended) we booked the 4+ hour "Saigon After Dark" tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. Having been blown away by the otherwise inaccessible aspects of Beijing that we had discovered via "Beijing Sideways" (a tour of the Beijing city on a Chinese replica of a WW2 Russian Army motorbike, complete with sidecar), our benchmark for quality and expectations were high, and Vietnam Vespa Adventures did not disappoint.
Commence at 6pm, our riders picked us up at our hotel, already beaming with smiles and confidence-inducing friendliness. We set off to the company's tour HQ, a quaint coffee shop decked out with all manner of Vespa memorabilia, on their 1950s era Vespas. There we met our guide for the night, Eric, and another couple who would be joining us on the night's adventure.
After being seated and greeted with our first drink of the evening and some excellent salsa and corn chips nibbles, Eric talked us through the plan for the evening, including explaining that the cute young Vietnamese girl who was taking photos of us was infant our dedicated photographer for the event, and not some snap-happy stalker. Eric's English was excellent, and his knowledge of both the bikes we were to be cruising on, and (as we discovered through the course of the tour) of the city of Saigon itself, was first class and delivered in a perfect "friends chatting" manner that perfectly complimented the sights, sounds, tastes and smells that we were about to enjoy on the tour. I really cannot praise Eric enough; his personal touch to the explaining the places we visited, the food we ate, and the general context of both to the daily lives of Saigonese people, truly made us feel like we were experiencing local life, rather than a view through tourist goggles.
After a 15 minute cruise through the after work chaos of Saigon's streets, we arrived at the first dining venue: a street restaurant specialist in seafood fare. We ate deliciously salted crab claw, deep fried frogs legs, and enjoyed our first of a few local beers. Eric continued his local insights, including rousing us into the Vietnamese version of "Cheers!" over our mugs of beer. Sufficed to say, by the time we left this restaurant the 5 of us were enjoying laughs like old friends.
After cruising around the very French part of town (past such beautiful sights as the Notre Dame Cathedral replica, ex-ambassadorial residences and gorgeous little parks) our next stop was Saigon's most famous (according to Eric) savory pancake restaurant. This packed outdoor venue so good that it apparently drove all the other pancake restaurants (that used to be in the street) out of business, and from the first mouthful of their food we could understand why. Here we also enjoyed a quick lesson in making our own fresh spring rolls, adding to the evening's sense of living like a local.
After washing down the grub with more local beer, we were back on the bikes and heading to my favorite of our four stops: a small, intimate 1st floor coffee house, hidden down a series of smaller and more hidden alleys. Eric advised us to keep our voices low and cell phones off, and as soon as we entered we could understand why. After ascending the in auspicious flight of stairs leading to the small, candle lit room, we were presented with a divine intimacy, focused on the live piano, violin and female vocalist performing at the head of the room. A hushed reverence and respectful focus floated over and through the candle light and divine sounds from the musicians. I admit to becoming a bit emotional with pure bliss and joy as I sipped my Vietnamese-style coffee and blessed out on not only the ambience of the room, but the perfect timing of this leg of the tour. It was at this point that I realized how well the creators of the Saigon After Dark tour had crafted their customer's experience. After the hustle and bustle of the city streets and roadside outdoor restaurants (something that can be experienced to varying degrees in most Asian cities), this sublime escape demonstrated the incredible depth of culture and range of emotional experience available in Saigon. Then and there, if not before, I knew that this had been money extremely well spent.
After immersing ourselves in this bliss for around 30 minutes, it was time to move on to the final venue of the tour. Another 5 fun-filled minutes on the Vespas took us to "Acoustic", a medium sized, packed rock bar, where we enjoyed our last of the all-inclusive drinks while listening to 3 very talented singers belting out everything from Bob Marley to Miley Cyrus, accompanied by what I presume was the house band. I think we were the only 4 people dancing in the entire venue, but after such a high created by the rest of our nights experience, our buzz must have been infectious, for we managed to get a few of the locals around us moving (well, tapping their feet or swinging their hips a little).
After a handful of tunes, a couple more drinks and a bucketload of laughs and smiles, we bade farewell to our tour buddies, thanked Eric profusely and jumped back on our respective rides for an ecstatic, almost overwhelmed cruise back to our hotel.
Bliss: achieved :).

I have now experienced the Glimpse of the Mekong tour four times, as the tour was so fantastic when I did it first, that every friend is always taken on this tour when they come out to see me in Vietnam. I have been to the Mekong before by coach, and whilst pleasant enough, I wouldn't hurry back there, but the Mekong they show you on the Vespa Tour is so stunningly beautiful and interesting, that you suddenly realise that this is the real Vietnam you have always dreamed of. I think this is because many of the routes and places you are taken too, are off the tourist track and some can only be accessed by motorbike and scooter and not by coach or car. We traveled through beautiful rice fields on narrow concrete paths, through fields of beautiful golden flowers, with lonely little pagodas in the distance, past local schools where all the girls wear the beautiful long white dresses over trousers with conical bamboo hats, over hair raising narrow wooden hump back bridges with no sides to them.....and so much more. We stopped every so often to see something of interest so it really is a very good balance of travelling and site seeing. Some of the journey is by dirt road and this is particularly exhilarating as well. The company is owned by a very professional and friendly couple, Steve and his wife and the drivers they train are absolutely safe and 'sure footed.' You can choose to ride your own scooter, or sit on the back of a trained driver, but both ways are tremendous fun. Food is included and whilst it is a seaside snack on the way, in a local market, when I mentioned that i would just eat the fruit as I 'm not keen on sea food, immediately the driver arranged for pork wraps to be cooked for me instead, even though I said that I was happy to just eat the fruit. The drivers really are all so very kind and friendly. The meal at the end is absolutely delicious, a good variety in a tranquil rural rustic looking local restaurant next overlooking a small lake with floating lilies. The tour is not cheap, but considering it is the best trip I have ever been on anywhere, then it is worth every single dong. Now I can't wait to experience all their other tours too, although as I am moving to Hanoi next week so I will have to wait until I come back to visit Ho Chi Minh City again in the future.

We did the Siagon by night tour(for the second in 2 years) and it was the highlight of our trip! Vietnam Vespa Adventures are a very professional outfit and if you are interested in food and keen to try some of the street food, this is an absolute must!! You get taken to areas of the city that you would never find even if you had a map at your disposal! The guides are lovely and speak good English. The drivers are great, very professional and do make you feel relaxed and at ease which, if you have ever travelled through traffic in HCMC, is a huge feat! The food was good and even though our group came from all corners of the globe everyone had a ball!! Even if you are not that into food a great way to zip around and see the city. Although it may seem quite expensive i couldn't think of a better way to spend my Dong!!

review_title: Vespa Food Tour of Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
I should start this by saying, I'm 50+, and relatively cautious when travelling! there's no use spending your holiday in Hospital!
We were in Vietnam last October, beautiful weather and travelling with another couple, also in their 50's. They had booked this tour as a surprise and knowing my love of food.
I was extremely apprehensive about doing this, especially after being immersed in Ho Chi Minh traffic for a couple of days, which until experienced, is beyond all belief! So off we went, picked up at our Hotel on 4 Vespas, all ridden by nice local lads with reasonable English, (tour guide was an absolute delight and spoke very well). Pick up was about 6.00 pm as ours was a night trip with dinner and a "nightclub" afterwards. It is fair to say, peak hour exists in Ho Chi Minh for 24 hours, so the traffic was coming at us from every conceivable angle and speed, to say I was nervous is an understatement. The skill these guys have, eventually makes you relax and we travelled into areas where the average traveller would never go, the food was exceptional and the experience unbelievable. My rider told me the celebrated Vietnamese Chef, Luke Nguyen often ate at the next place we were going to, and sure enough, we parked the bikes and there he was, that will teach me to be cynical!
With out a doubt, this was the highlight of our holiday, and believe me, in a country like Vietnam, there were many highlights, I would urge everyone to experience it, it is culinary adventure you will never forget

The evening Vespa tour was the highlight of our visit to Ho Chi Minh - do not miss. The hosts spoke excellent english, educated us about food and culture which was really helpful, and took us to 4 places we would never have found. Can't recommend highly enough.

A Vietnamese local recommended this to me and I can't believe we even hesitated! A fantastic night out in Ho Chi Minh! The food was great and we found places that we would have not found in a guide book or on our own. Our guide Chien was extremely attentive, had a great sense of humor and was very informative. We had a great night and would definitely put this tour on the "must do" list for Ho Chi Minh.

We did the Saigon at Night tour on our first night in Vietnam and it ended up being one of the highlights of our trip! It was the perfect introduction to the city - zooming around on the back of the Vespa and getting off to eat and drink. Our guide was friendly and made sure that us vegetarians had plenty to eat as well. Highly recommend this trip and company to anybody and everybody!!

review_title: Don't miss this or you will be sorry
review_text:
I can't praise Steve & hís staff highly enough, from the initial email to the hugs goodbye, we had the best time òf our lives.
I initially booked the Glimpse òf the Mekong trip & enjoyed it so much, we decided to book the Hoi An tour ás well.
From the greeting at our hotel to the goodbyes at the end òf a day & evening, we were treated ás friends. We learnt a lot about the Vietnamese culture & taught them some "Aussie" culture ás well.
To Steve & all òf hís staff thanks for your company, your gểnerosity & your friendship, we had an amazing time with you all.

review_title: I Wish We Had Time For Another Tour!
review_text:
Escaping the chaos of Saigon on the 'Glimpse Of The Mekong' tour was our best decision ever. Our guide took us out of the city and to homes of genuine Vietnamese working people, our guide spoke excellent English and had good humour too. You can ride solo or passenger and feel so safe at all times. We stopped at locals homes for cold drinks, in a market for clams and scallops both delicious. And after the tour to a beautiful restaurant for lunch (LOTS of food) It was a fun but very informative tour with great drivers and a great guide. A must do if you visit Saigon.
Thank you
Sarah Paul & James

I would highly recommned this to anyone, from the mod to the backpackers to people just in ho chi minh for a short break. Totaly friendly staff, great scooters and amazing trips out. Highly recommend riding the scooter yourself. 5 blobs from me. You have to try this!

Jim (England)

Had heard, while living in Hanoi, about a Vespa tour in Saigon, and after recently relocated, decided to join up - a fun evening was had zipping around the town, with local food, and a couple of fun, out of the way music spots that you normally would not get to... Definitely worth including in a visit to the city.
We had a fantastic time touring Saigon at night. The vespas felt safe, and our guide and drivers were awesome. I would highly recommend the tour!
Would really recommend. Felt really safe, ate lots of new interesting food and had lots of fun. One of the best things we have done

We had a fantastic time on our tour today to the Mekong Delta. It was so nice to get off the beaten path and see different areas of Saigon and the countryside. We felt safe at all times and there were many interesting stops along the way. One of our favorite days in Saigon!

review_title: Vespa into the night in HCMC
review_text: Wow what a great night out! Heaps of fun to be had. The Vespa drivers collect you from your hotel zip through the busy city with ease and drop you off at the meeting place where you can have a complimentary drink. The tour groups are small and personal, the tour guides are friendly, helpful and speak good English. They explain what will happen on the tour -food, drinks and places we visit. If you have an special dietary needs please let them know at the time of booking, so they can prepare your meals. Food is amazing good, where you discover hidden cafés and clubs you would never find in the daylight. Even though you travel by Vespa, you always felt safe. Drivers are part of the great night out

We had the pleasure of experiencing this vespa night time tour where we went to a local bar, enjoyed a drink and then experienced a couple of restaurants with fantastic food and then onto two local vietnamese night spots. We also had so much fun doing a city tour on the back of the bikes. this was a great fun night - great experience and I would thoroughly recommend it all drinks and food were included in the price. we met up with another couple who joined the tour which was also great to meet other people. had a ball - definitely make sure you do this tour when in Ho Chi Minh City.

review_title: You can't leave HCMC without this experience
review_text:
This is the best way to explore Saigon, Day and Night, the Mekong Delta, a trip to the beach. I did them all and I just loved it. And I did it several times. With friends from HCMC and with guests from overseas.
It's just great to explore the area on the back of a Vespa in the middle of the crowd, in the middle of the traffic. In the heat. Cruising the city or the country side. If you ask for little changes in the tour - even this is possible. Watch the video on their website and you get a brilliant idea of the tours.
So great. I totally recommend it to every tourist and every expat.

review_title: Vintage vespa night tour of Ho Chi Min
review_text: Arriving in Ho Chi Min City can be a bit of a culture shock and getting up the courage to cross the street amid the miriad of racing mopeds can be daunting, so the prospect of hoping on the back of a vespa , at night was nerve wracking. Our drivers however put us at ease and after a quick trip to cafe' Zoom for a cocktail and snacks was enough to settle the nerves and kick off a fantastic evening. Our guide Chin ,met us at Zoom and gave us a break down of how the evening was planned. Once we'd finished our cocktails and after a few photo's by the tour companies photographer, we were off. Zipping through the crowded streets, right in the thick of the traffic was exhilarating and so much more fun and interesting than being on the pavement. Our first stop was a street food restaurant that served fish and shellfish and we were given a gentle introduction to Vietnamese food. The crab claws were delicious and we even enjoyed the frogs legs (Vietnameses KFC). Next we were whizzed again through the streets and over the river to another street vendor where we sampled vietnamese pancakes, springrolls and bbq beef. All the food was amazing and it was great that our guide instructed us in the ciorrect way to roll fresh springrolls, how to eat the pancakes and what sauce went with what. We then went to a beautiful house to listen to some fantastic traditional signing and have pudding/coffee before finishing in a night club listening to some vietnamese punk rock with a night cap. All in all an amazing experience. Perhaps a bit pricey but as all food and drink plus guides , drivers and vintage vespa's are included, good value.

review_title: Not my version of value for money
review_text:
firstly they forgot my booking which was done via email four weeks prior! Then I went to the Zoom cafe and the tour had already started. I was given a minimal discount for missing the first 45 mins of the tour and was able to go with a guide (on her bike-not a vespa) to join the tour at the first seafood restaurant. We arrived 10 mins before everyone else so I suspect I missed out on some other sights as well.
The food was good but did not have the WOW factor that I was expecting and as I had been in VN for 2 weeks already i had basically already tried what was offered. However if this is a starting introduction to VN food , it did cover the most popular and fun style of eating ie roll ups etc.

I found the Banh Xeo (fried rice "pancake")very oily and the quality of VN oil is not up to my taste...been spoilt in Aus :) but that is not something these guys can change . except maybe to offer a different food.

The acoustic cafe and fruit juice place was a great contrast to the other venues, however as most of the tour were younger people, they were keen to do something more upbeat. So onto the nightclub- I had a look and decided that I am not into smoke filled crowded room , ear splitting music venues so I had a beer and waited outside...just to watch the band roll up and smoke a few "joints" right outside the entrance!! mmm

Then I asked my guide if I could be dropped off at the Ben than markets as it was only about 9.00pm. My driver (I was now on a Vespa rather than the guide's own moto) thought he was in the Moto GP I am sure. He went thru 3 red lights before I told him not to do it. The poor old vespa was groaning with the way he treated it. Vespas are very wide at the base and really need two feet either side when stopped to keep them level. My Driver only ever put one foot down hence I was hanging almost sideways on the back whenever we stopped. He spoke no english and seem to be in desperate hurry to get home!! I had been ridden around HCMC prior to this tour with another company so I knew what to expect of the traffic etc, but this ride was far from a pleasant cruise around HCMC at night on a vintage Vespa as the spiel for the tour implies.
The guide was very attentive and almost apologetic for my experience, however I cannot recommend this tour based on my experience.

review_title: Loved it so much I did three of their tours!
review_text:
After some local and expat colleagues in HCM City raved about the Saigon by night tour, I had to try it. It exceeded my expectations and I went on to book two more of their vespa tours – to the Mekong and around Hoi An (both also exceptional).

Takes you away from the tourist trail and gives you a glimpse into the real Vietnam, featuring some of the most amazing food I ate during my travels. I loved the sense of freedom you get travelling by bike, you really feel like part of the action but not once did I feel unsafe. In fact, the bike was so comfortable, I had no trouble on the fairly long (and interesting) ride out to the Mekong – better than a bus any day!

Each tour was different so I didn’t feel like I was doubling up. Apart from a variety of local food, I experienced some local nightlife, spent time in small villages where I sampled home-made produce including rice wine – very strong!

All of the drivers were excellent guides and very friendly. In fact, Vu, my driver in Hoi An even made time to show me around the town later that evening day to sample some different food and more Vietnamese coffee (I am addicted) after he saw how much I enjoyed the food during the tour.

review_title: One of the Best things we did in Vietnam
review_text: This was absolutely fantastic, we were a bit worried when we arrived in Ho Chi Minh City as there are soooo many motorbikes. They picked us up at our hotel and on our way to our first stop (cafe Zoom) we relaxed and enjoyed the ride. You feel so safe sitting on the back of the vespa. The drivers don't speak very good English, but our guide was great. You go to 2 street restaurants which were great, (one seafood and the other was Vietnamese pancakes). Then we went to a place in a dark dingy alley up some dark stairs and sat and listened to a guy playing a violin and piano, and 2 girls singing, amazing. Next, more riding and off to a nightclub where there was an amazing live band with different singers, could have stayed there all night. Overall, amazing !!!!! They also email you some photo's of your group. A must do!!!

The combination of the wonderful people we met, the fantastic Hotel we stayed at (Park Hyatt Saigon) and the Vespa Tour at night combined to provide the best short break we have had anywhere in the world over the past ten years (And we travel from Sydney to somewhere at least four or five times per year). The tour was recommended by the Park Hyatt and at 6:00pm last Friday 17th May two Vespa scooters arrived with riders to start our tour. Although we felt very safe with what were very competent local riders taking us on our tour it was a thrilling ride through the traffic to their base 15 min ride away. There we were given a beer and introduced to other fellow travellers and a guide. On the scooters again and off we go to a REAL Vietnamese restaurant serving seafood and "Frogs Legs if you wanted them" It was up a dusty laneway and had a "shanty" feel to it and was frequented by lots of locals - it certainly did not feel like a tourist restaurant but that is exactly what we wanted; the real local experience. The food and friendly nature of the staff was exceptional. On the scooters again and off to another local restaurant for more beer and superb local cuisine. Do not expect a shiny restaurant - but do expect a safe one and fantastic local food and plastic chairs and possibly hard dirt floor. ... well on the scooter again and we go to this building that looked derelict and abandoned - a place where on your own you may feel inclined to "lock the doors" and drive with the lights off for a while. However - we alight and go down a short narrow laneway (too narrow for any vehicle except perhaps a bike) , past animals in cages (was this to be our fate I thought?) and then up a large concrete set of internal stair. At the top they opened the door and there was a Vietnamese Jazz Band in full swing - complete with Piano (How did they get it up there?) , Violin and a wonderful singer. It was obvious that this was a local hangout for the Jazz scene. After a few more beers (all provided by the Vespa Tour People) we reluctantly left to board our scooters once more. Had we be staying any longer in Saigon we would have returned to this venue - we left reluctantly. Then on to a local dance club. It was getting later in the evening now and Saigon still had more treats in store for us . The Club had some older (say late 60's) guys playing Hendrix style music - with some feeling I must add ; with a young female Vietnamese singer who was simply electric. More beers and cocktails (still provided by the Vespa people) then onto the scooters for the return to the Hotel. We have no "buts" no "howevers" and no "regrets" in taking this very unique tourist attraction. it was enough to make us go back to Vietnam ..... and quite soon... and for a longer break. Once you get over the pain of actually getting a visa to visit this place you realise that it is without doubt still an unspoilt culture - and Vespa Tours at night facilitate access to the real Vietnam ; a Gem within the Asian Community.

review_title: DO NOT MISS THIS - LOVED IT! 5 STAR FUN ALL THE WAY!
review_text:
I booked this tour of Saigon After Dark mainly for my husband's benefit as he is a bona fide Ulyssian bike rider and I thought a Vespa ride might be a bit of a different experience for him (NB: I DO NOT ride with him at all!) So, for me it was going to be a big leap of faith!
LOVED, LOVED, LOVED IT! Picked up from the hotel by waiting vintage Vespas and off we went into the chaos and madness of peak hour traffic. Felt totally safe as the driver was well in control, very experienced and careful as he manouvered the scooter in and out of the endlessly flowing traffic. Cafe Zoom was first stop for a welcome drink, briefing of the night's activities and safety instructions. Two local food stops followed with plenty of cold beer supplied. Next stop was a Cafe / coffee house where dessert and cold drinks were ordered. There was a singer and piano player to set the mood. Final stop was the Acoustic Bar with live bands playing for a superb rocking finish to the night. All food, alcohol and drinks are supplied (to within reason; you can purchase more alcohol at your own expense). The whole tour was about 4.5 hours and extremely reasonably priced at $US 87 per person (if you book direct from website).
ONE OF THE BEST NIGHT'S I have ever had!! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
Even for us old farts this was a highlight of our trip and vespa tours putting on a thunder storm just for us was just amazing.

Greay way to see another side of Saigon. drivers are safe and respect traffic signals (not always the case in Vietnam) !

We visited some landmarks but also went to a local flower market where we were the only tourists and local fish matket. We travelled in districts 1-3-4-5-7 so we covered a lot in the 3hrs of our tour. It is also great to get a breeze in the 35-40c heat on a vespa !
Must do in Saigon

Great fun - delicious food - interesting venues.
