Definitely the way to see the town by night without having to drive yourself in the challenging traffic of this city.

Felt a bit rushed at Banh Xeo place and Cafe after. Last stop was a bar with a live band playing very loud so talking was a challenge and I didn't enjoy the cocktail.
But overall time well spent and I would do it again.

I've tried the 3 tours, Mekong delta, Saigon by day and Saigon by night and all were very good. The guides are nice and well informed, the food (especially for the Saigon night tour) excellent and you're going to see things you'll never see by yourself. Beside that to really experience Vietnamese life you have (unless once!) to go around on a motorbike (and the Vespas and their drivers make it pretty safe)! Strongly suggested!!

Wow what a hoot this was! Our second day in Vietnam and there we were, zooming around on the back of a Vespar, weaving in and around crazy traffic of Saigon! I couldn't believe my eyes!! My 2 teenage girls aged 18 and 15 say it was one of the best things they did on our recent holiday. The food at the various eateries we visited was so plentiful and unique, we even ate frogs legs! The late night dessert/wine bar was a short relaxing break where we listened to live singing accompanied by a piano and violin player before we hit the road again!

review_title: Vespa Adventures, so much fun, its a must do!
review_text:
Spent a few days in HCMC in April, had an excellent time, mainly due to our trips on Vespa Adventures, first I booked a day tour, for myself and 2 sons aged 18 and 12, we were picked up from our hotel by a lovely guide call Dieu, we were each assigned a Vespa ( and a driver) and off we set, such a great way to see all the sights of the city, and lots of fun.
I then booked Saigon by night, its an absolute must do, won't give any details to spoil the fun, was a brilliant evening! our guide Gee was great and took such good care of us.
An absolute must do when visiting HCMC

Is a must do in HCMC! Friendly female tour guide, English speaking not perfect but good enough, very fun especially such humid place. Really no better way to see the city. Highly recommend I am coming back for the night and Mekong river tour + cooking class. Fee include one lunch at USD65.

review_title: Once in a Lifetime for Even Older People
review_text:
Having experienced the crowded streets of scooters, we weren't sure that this would be a safe thing to do, but as you say, you only live once, and once we began our journey, it was quite clear that we were very safe and in fact, loving every minute of the experience. For most westerners, we are told to stay away from street food, but with the guidance of the tour, we had the best food ever in Viet Nam. The ride was fabulous, saw quite a few neighborhoods, and enjoyed the few others who were with us for the evening. The night club was a bit crowded, but still an open-eye experience. The musical place we went to for piano and violin was outstanding. So do it!

One last thought. I had wished my driver spoke more English as I could not ask questions while we were riding along. Oh well, probably safer. They also take photos of you which I am hoping to see soon in an email.

Wow! This tour was brilliant. Right from the start watching our amazing drivers weave and navigate through the crazy traffic of HCMC to the dirt roads through the Mekong Delta. We stopped at many places for drinks, food and to see locals working on their land. Our guide was great, very informative and helpful. We felt very safe on the back of the beautiful Vespa's even in the craziness! Would recommend this tour to anyone!

What a wonderful introduction to the street food of Saigon. A great way to acclimate with Vietnam and it's traffic. A very knowledgeable tour guide who was fun to hang out with. A night not to be missed in Saigon

In need of a wild Saigon adventure, to supplement the tried and tested excursions? Make sure you don't miss this one. Weaving in and out of the crazy Vietnamese traffic astride the scooter pillion seat, wondering how they all manage to avoid smacking into each other, yet perfectly safe in the hands of expert drivers. Four restaurant and bar stops add to the fun and games. The highlight? The rock band in the final venue? The jazz singers in the coffee lounge? Close - but the real winner just had to be the main course in the first restaurant, Saigon Fried Frog. I kid you not! Go for it.

Had a fantastic night in Saigon on this Vespa tour. Saw parts of Saigon that you would not see as a regular tourist and ate food that again you would be unlikely to try if not for this tour. It is expensive in relation to other things in Saigon but totally worth it. Guides and drivers were fantastic. A must book tour when in Saigon!

The Vespa tour was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam. The guide (Chien) was great, he was fun, personable and very knowledge. You could tell that he loved his job and loved meeting new people. The drivers were also very good. Would recommend this trip to anyone - even the oldies (of which I am one, 61).

What a professional crew. Felt exhilarated throughout ride but also felt very safe.
Our guide for the night was Chien and he made it fun and memorable.
The food was great and varied and flexible

review_title: Excellent way to see Saigon at Night
review_text:
The Saigon at Night tour was a really excellent tour and highly recommended. It really made a difference on our opinion of our visit of Ho Chi Minh City from average experience to good experience. We did the major sites on our own during the day first followed by this tour. The night tour really gave us a different perspective of the city, in places in which we may have never bothered to go. It was great to get a food explanation during our meals with excellent local food. I enjoyed the Secret Sesame cafe the best. All food and one drink was included in the price. We were pretty surprised to find that the additional beer at Acoustic bar was $5 USD, but that isn't a reflection on the tour.

Vintage Vespas are super comfortable to ride pillion, even better than modern ones. There are some really good hand holds for the passenger. The group really cares about you and belongings and give really good advice at the start - i.e. no selfies if you don't want another motor-biker to snatch the phone out of your hands. The helmets are Vespa branded too and are the most protective ones I've worn in Vietnam so far. They cover your ears, but they don't cover the cheek and chin, FYI. I thought my driver was very professional and I felt safe.

The professional photographer they included in the tour price was a great added value. I'd almost wish the photographer could capture us riding on the bike (since selfies was a no-no) as we arrived at a destination.

Booking was done really well. Steve was super communicative, and accommodating with us when our flight was late and we couldn't do the tour on the evening intended. He moved us to the next day without any issues.

My only comment for improvement is that they shouldn't take all 3 different Vespa tour groups to the same spot. There were two other groups of folks, which I assume must have been different language guides (i.e. English, French, German), to the same exact restaurants and spots. It'd gave the spots a bit of a 'commercialized' feel even though it's all the same people from the same company. It might be a good idea to take them to different restaurants, or different bars or space them out to different time slots.

The tour begins or ends with lunch or dinner included. The drivers are very good and the vintage Vespas are noticed by everyone. Do not expect this tour to show you everywhere in Ho Chi Minh but you visit interesting sites that are otherwise overlooked. Best way to see the city.

We went seven of us on a vespa tour around Saigon. The vespa are old school so we appreciate that. They came to pick us up at home and took us to zoom cafe , had some drinks and introduced our guide. After that They took us around the city show us some sights and We stop in two restaurants, good I have to say! Local feeling on the street, as We like! The dessert, We had it on a small, cute, secret bar with life music and after that on a "rock'n roll" bar a bit sad and not so good.
The drivers are really nice and they don't get crazy on the road, unless you tell them to.
In general the night was great. They have a good service.

We did both the Saigon by Night and Glimpse of the Mekong tours and absolutely loved them both. Vietnam Vespa Adventuress takes great care of you and truly wants you to have a memorable time. From the fun of the city at night on the back of a scooter to riding our own out in the Mekong Delta, these two trips provided some of the very best highlights from our 2 weeks in Vietnam. Highly recommended.

Vietnam Vespa Adventures claimed to bring such experience - “The Ride Of Your Life“ to their customer, and I would say, they did it!
We took the tour to discover the Mekong Riverside, we have experienced so many interesting things, such as cross bridges over river tributaries, ride on a river ferryboat, visit riverside market; stop at local cottage industries and taste some Vietnamese local seafood dishes…etc.
Most important, we experience the city with their most popular means of transportation and we feel the red dust in the country side.

We had a family of 4 including two teenagers! This was a fabulous event for us. There is nothing like the Saigon traffic of motorbikes and being right in the middle of it was thrilling. The excursion on the back of the bikes felt very safe with great drivers. We started out Vespa's home base for drinks then off to 3 different places for samplings of Vietnamese food. It was just fun!

Live like a hip and affluent native for a night. We zipped around town tasting amazing foods, then stopped at a jazz club to hear a lovely chanteuse. Capped the night at the small Yoko Bar to hear a fantastic trio that made the finals on X Factor Vietnam tv show. We took the tour on our last night. Wish we had gone on our first night!

What better way to see the city than by local transport. The tour cost is inclusive of all your food, drink and entertainment. The restaurants were local eateries so you got an authentic cultural experience of food along with a tour guide who was able to discuss their city, culture and food in great detail. We had a wonderful night and would highly recommend this tour if you want to delve a little deeper into the Vietnam way of life, food & travel.

review_title: So good, had to do it again!!
review_text: First experienced the Saigon After Dark tour offered by the Vietnam Vespa guys as part of a four day package which took us from HCMC to Mui Ne earlier this year. That tour was so much fun we took full advantage of the opportunity to repeat (part of it, at least) the experience when in HCMC this week. So glad we did! The boys who drove us were great, the food at each stop was exceptional, the Clubs very entertaining and our Guide was gorgeous! It is the stand out memory of Saigon and would highly recommend it to all who visit the city.

This is the ultimate in touring Ho Chi Minh City. Riding on the back of a Vespa between restaurants, night clubs and bars spread throughout the various districts of Ho Chi Minh is the best way to see parts of the city a tourist would not normally visit. The tour includes all food and drinks and you are in groups with your own tour guide who add to the experience. The food is traditional Vietnamese including some foods you may be initially reluctant to try. The Jumping Chicken or frogs as we know them as tasted delicious. This is one tour that is highly recommended and not to be missed. Between visiting the restaurants the bikes travel around all of the major tourist locations in Ho Chi Minh.

Really good fun- a chance to see proper Saigon. The guide was so proud of her city and that was infectious. We visited bars and street cafés we wouldn't have dreamed of visiting ourselves. What a special night. Thank you so much.

review_title: The ONLY way to experience Vietnam
review_text:
Taking a bike tour is both a thrilling and amazing experience.

We had less then a Day in Ho Chi Minh so we decided to see what all the fuss was about with all these bikes and we were directed to Vietnam Vespa Adventures Day Tours.

And I wouldn't change it for the world.

I went with my dad so we had 2 divers and a tour guide. The tour was well thought out and covered everything that needed to be covered. The price is 100% worth it, Our Guide Chin was amazing had had great english. You can customise your worn tour if you wish.

If you have never been on a bike before do it. You will not regret, the time will fly by all too quickly.

It was just... wow.

I can't wait to go back and do it again good luck to my amazing driver Hai who is an aspiring Tour guide.

review_title: Coast ride to Nha Trang ... awesome
review_text: In a two month trip in Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Thailand, and Myanmar, my week riding a motorbike from Ho Chi Minh City to Nha Trang was THE BEST on every level. We got off the beaten track and saw so many interesting places and people. We ate in restaurants with no English menus - real Vietnamese food. The guides - Chien, Huy, and Tom - were incredibly helpful, knowledgeable, and attentive. The scenery was spectacular, especially the switchback roads up and down to Dalat. And, of course, riding the bikes was just FUN!!!

review_title: You haven't done Saigon unless you do a Vespa tour!
review_text: We did this tour with our 12 year old twin girls. After the transfer from the airport to hotel the night before and seeing the traffic I was a bit apprehensive! But I have to say the tour was an absolute highlight. We all thoroughly had a ball and was thrilling. If you are in Saigon it is a must do tour! The drivers are very experineced and very safe. Tour guide is excellent.

We did the Saigon by night tour, we were picked up by Vespa at the hotel. Our riders were early and before we knew it we were off to Zoom cafe for a briefing and drinks.
Several food and drink stops, all were excellent and get you to places you wouldn't find yourself.
Felt safe as houses on the back of the Vespa, the guys are very competent riders.
Whilst the tour is relatively expensive by Vietnam standards, it was great value and one of the highlights of the trip. All food and drinks are included in the tour price.
This tour is a must do in HCMC.
They also emailed pics of the night after the event, which is a nice touch.
We did both the 'Insider's Saigon' and the 'Mekong' trip. Both are highly recommended although we found the 'Insider's Saigon' more interesting overall and less tiring!

review_title: A must do when in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
Our family of 3 generations enjoyed a 3 hour tour with this group yesterday. It was fab, we all had a ball.
We found the tour to be a little different to our expectations and out of the ordinary so were pleasantly surprised.
The guide was a hoot, very funny and very informative. The riders very skillful, they made us feel safe in a city with traffic that has to be seen to be believed.
There were only 6 in our group which led to some spontaneity in the choice of places to visit.
Our hotel tour desk found this tour for us as we had difficulty finding one at the last minute. In fact most companies were booked out for 5-6 days. This company was as well but was able to provide a private tour for us.
My tip.......... Book ahead or you will be disappointed.

review_title: Highly recommend, brilliant afternoon, not to be missed!!
review_text: Such a good afternoon out! The main guide was both full of information and history, he was flexible to our needs, ensured you had the best day, took time when needed and overall made you feel so safe in the crazy traffic that is HCMC. I, we would HIGHLY recommend taking the time to see the sights with this crew, thanks again

review_title: Great Fun and a Great Way to See HCM
review_text:
We went on a morning tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures and it was great fun. I went with my wife. daughter and grandson (10 yrs old) and we all thoroughly enjoyed the tour.

The experience of Saigon scooter traffic from the inside was amazing, and no where as scary as some of us had imagined. The guide was helpful, fun and informative with excellent English and the scooter pilots were fantastic.

I would heartily recommend this company and their vintage Vespas.

I went on the Mekong tour April 2014 and had an EPIC day. I was picked up from my apartment at 8am and taken to Zoom cafe for a drink (free) before heading to Steve's (the tour owner) house to be introduced to the bikes. There you are given the option of the manual Vespa, or for the less experienced, a fully automatic scooter.
The tour took us down country roads, across old wooden bridges, through small villages where children shout ‘hello’, and on a couple of ferry rides.
We stopped at a local fish market and our tour guide (who spoke perfect English) explained the produce before taking us for a meal of fresh seafood. We also visited a shrimp farm, a rice wine refinery, a temple and a incense stick factory (or more accurately, a house).
Importantly, at no time on the tour did anyone pester us or try to sell us things we would never want or need. The locals were just happy to show us what they do - a very unique element of the tour.
We ended the day at a lovely restaurant in D7 with an array of food and beers. It was a fantastic tour and one that I will certainly do again!!!!

review_title: Highlight in Trip filled with Highlights
review_text: We loved the Vespa HCM night street food tour! Our guide, Dieu, made for a memorable evening, not only filled with delicious food, and great entertainment, but her good humor and fun personality made the experience one of the highlights of our three week trip to Southeast Asia.

I did the morning city tour (The Insiders Saigon) and had a blast! The guide was fun and spoke great English and the drivers were good. It's a lot of fun zooming in and out of traffic with the locals. You cover a good amount of the city on tour, with quick stops along the way. The lunch at the café was included and was really good.

We did this with 2 kids - 4 and 6 yr old - and it was awesome.

Saw heaps of stuff - which you wouldn't normally see - lots of back streets and "real" life.

A definite must!

Well went on this tour after recommendations from 2 Ozzies we met on the Mekong delta tour! Manage to get on tour last minute, really worth doing! Seeing HCM by night, trying all the different food and I love jumping chicken! It was good to see how the young Vietnams go clubbing defo stark difference between UK, and I love the secret cafés and you should defo have the Cold coffee's! Dat our tour guide was fab, would HIGHLY recommend it!!!

review_title: Awesome way to see the Mekong
review_text: Did the Glimpse of the Mekong tour. What a great experience! Experienced tour guides picked our group up from our hotel, then took us on a day long tour from the city to the Mekong. Made a number of stops along the way at various sites, including an old distillery, some local fish markets, an incense factory, some river crossings, with a pleasant seafood snack, then capping off with a great meal and beers at a restaurant. The guides are very experienced riders, so felt very comfortable riding pillion (don't try and ride yourself unless you're very experienced in local Ho Chi Minh traffic). Our guide leader spoke good English and was very engaging. And yes, you get a bit of a sore backside at the end of it (many off roads), but it was worth it.

A not to be missed experience. We were picked up and dropped off at our hotel.(6-1030pm)
Pillion passenger on an old fashioned vespa, negotiating Saigon's inner city streets teeming with motorbikes, was absolutely amazing. We felt safe with wonderful drivers and an excellent host. We visited 3 typical, little, out of the way restaurants for drinks and an array of tasty food, and 2 night clubs. This was a highlight of our memorable stay in Vietnam.

review_title: Best way to see Saigon at night
review_text: We are an expatriate family living in Saigon for over a year now and we decided to book a Saigon After Dark tour on a whim. It was probably one of the best things we've ever done since moving here. We are always inside a car or a taxi and our biking adventures are limited to our village so seeing Saigon from the back of a Vespa was really a treat. We took our 13-year old daughter with us and she had a blast. Definitely not for the squeamish (think frogs and snails at a street side sea food joint) but something that the adventurous ones will enjoy. The drivers were very good- expertly navigating the Vespas thru Saigon's busy streets and never did we ever feel unsafe. Bring your own helmet if you can but they provide one for you, as well. All in all, a wonderful way to spend 4 1/2 hours in Saigon at night. Can't recommend it enough.

review_title: The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: When you are in a city with millions of people and almost as many mopeds, there is no better way to see the city! It's exhilarating to be in the middle of hundreds of motorbikes, and mopeds, not your typical boring city tour! The vespas were in great shape, and I felt extremely comfortable with the drivers. One of the drivers doubled as a guide, was extremely knowledgeable and spoke English well. I felt that we were taken to several places that were not in tourist areas which was fantastic, in fact we saw very few tourists for the 4 hour duration of the trip. We had actually seen 2 of the stops on the previous day, the drivers were very accommodating, asked us what we would like to see instead, and took us to 2 other places. Well worth it!

Having seen the traffic in Saigon we were a little apprehensive , but cannot recommend this tour enough. We did the four hour Saigon tour and had such an amazing time. Our driver and host were excellent, you are well looked after and we had such a good time tasting the food, and seeing a side of Vietnam that many visiting would not see. Everyone visiting Saigon should do this you will not regret it. A real highlight of our trip!

WE DID THE inside Saigon tour ,,,we were picked and dropped off up at our cruise ship port .. transported by mini van to restaurant drinks and lunch was included..they wished off for 4 hours on the backs of vespa bikes for a tour most people would never see visiting Saigon .We are and older couple and were scared big time.. both of us never been on a motor bike..and to see the sea of motor bikes passing in street mayhem even seconds before getting on we weren't sure.... DO IT..its amazing ..it was one of highlites of 28 day cruise ..cant say enough ..tour was excellent ..after first few minutes we had our cameras and mini cams in our hand filming and snapping pictures as we rode.

review_title: Don't miss! Special way to see and live Ho Chi Mihn
review_text: When in Saigon DON'T MISS this amazing way to see the city and surroundings. I took the Mekong Delta w/ cooking class tour and also Saigon by Night. Can't recommend enough. Flawless . Brilliant idea.

I can't recommend this company enough. Local culinary delights, local music scene, free flowing beverages, knowledgeable guides, welcoming Saigon inhabitants.... all enjoyed on a restored, vintage Vespa. I say... DO IT!

There were 6 of us on the Saigon by Night tour and at the end we all agreed on one thing: why the heck isn't this the number one rated thing to do in Saigon? It should be. Trust us and all the other reviewers, you DON'T WANT TO MISS OUT ON THIS!!!

Was a very special & memorable night out. It doesn't get much better than this - seriously if I could rate it higher I would.
Experience the sights sounds & smells of HCMC on the back of a Vespa, the crazy traffic adds to the atmosphere as you quickly work out that you are in very capable hands.
The food was great, especially the seafood in district 4 & our host was fabulous.
Don't come to HCMC & miss this.

So we did the Saigon by night tour and it was one of our absolute highlights on our SEA tour. Great organization, supernice people, great food and things to see. Felt like really something else. Thanks a lot guys and we'll come back next time.

My wife and I had a superb time on the night tour! Definitely the best way to see and experience the incredible sounds, smells and excitement of HCMC. We felt totally secure on the scooters, the drivers are very competent and never put the passengers into any unsafe situations.

We were also involved in a wedding party where 10 of the party were transported by scooters to the venue, by Vietnam Vespa's. Without exception everyone loved the experience!

The local food restaurants and the live music venues were excellent. Unfortunately I dont think I could find them again!

Well done to the owner Steve, and his top-team! Next time we will go on a longer tour!

We took the 'Vespa night tour' and it was amazing! Being in the 'middle' of the Vespa streams is a fantastic way to experience Ho Chi Minh City. The Vespa drivers are very attentive and professional. I felt very safe during the whole tour. The restaurants we were taken serve very authentic/special food. The cafe where you can listen to local artists play and sing is just unique. Totally recommend!

From the moment we arrived our guide was so attentive and welcoming. We had such a great group which made the night so much fun. The food was amazing and so much to drink. The hidden bar was a surprise and such a treat. Riding on the cool Vespa is thrilling ..... Being part of the TRAFFIC! Recommend if you want a fabulous night out.

We had so much fun on this tour. We booked the day before and thought it was a little expensive (well for Vietnam anyhows), however it was worth every cent.

We were picked up and taking to Cafe Zoom where we could choose any meal and any drink from the menu for lunch, which was included in the tour price. The food was amazing.

We were then taken on the back of two vespa's to an 'off the beaten track' tour of Saigon city. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and very friendly to chat with too. We say a few of the regular sights and travelled to difference districts around the city too.

Overall I would be highly recommending this company to anyone heading to Saigon who wants a little bit of an adventure!

I went on this tour with friends that are living in Ho Chi Minh City, and I had an amazing time! It was such a unique experience, and a great way to see the city! The drivers and tour guide were all really friendly, and took good care of us! Not only do you get to see some different sites around the city, getting from site to site is an adventure, and just as interesting! A definite must while in Ho Chi Minh City!
Guide was fantastic. You go to the areas of Saigon that show you what life in Saigon is really like away from the standard tourist attractions. Great fun to be ridden around on a Vespa!!

This will remain as one of the best memories I have of our travel to Vietnam. This was a Vespa tour - never pictured myself on a motorcycle but it was the BEST!!! There were 4 of us on the tour. We were picked up at our hotel at an appointed time, our drivers were excellent. We made several stops, the 1st at an outside bar/café, A charming young lady then introduced herself as our guide, her English was excellent and she stayed with us for the entire evening. We made stops at 2 local eating spots and the food was fresh and wonderful. Our next stop was at a coffee house/bar with a singer, where we had wonderful ice cream, and coffee. We finished off our evening at a bar that had live rock music. All of our food and drink were included in the price. The evening was lovely and truly gave us a glimpse into what Saigon is, places we would have never discovered. A must!!!! Would do it again in a heartbeat.

Friends who live in Saigon booked this for us, and it was the best thing we did during our 3 week trip. Picked up and driven round the city at night on the back of a Vespa with friends - brilliant. 4/5 stops at street stalls for food and drink - all delicious, and if you are a quick drinker then fill your boots! Great value evening out.

review_title: Great night grat way to explore saigon
review_text: I was flying solo and this tour gave me a chance to meet other solo travellers. The guide my (me or mi) was great had am excellent sense of humor and very informative. I though the quiet cafe wasnt that interesting but an experience no the less. Prepare to eat a lot and have a good night. The cost is definitely worth it.

review_title: THE BEST ADVENTURE EVER " Saigon After Dark"
review_text: Live in Saigon for nearly 10years, but when I was going with Vespa tour “Saigon After dark”, I recognized that there are many places, really nice, very close to me that I haven’t been!!! Especially sitting behind the Classic Vespa Scooter. The group just a few peoples, good English speaking tourguide and it’s nice that I feel so comfortable and relax after the whole week working in “Vừng ơi” kind of light music and very quiet, then lived with the live music at Acoutic bar, amazing tour, If you are coming to visit Vietnam, you should have spent your time with Vietnam Vespa Adventures to see how busy Saigon at daytime and how special in Saigon after Dark, n dont forget that you really need a big "appetite" in the tour, i had so much food n drink then i even could not walk home after =]]=]]

review_title: great way to see the city
review_text: very safe and fun way to see the city, off the beaten track places, went to flower market and temples. guide very informative!

This tour is excellent. Scooter travel is the mainstay of most locals and there is not a better way to get a feel for the pulse of the city than by traveling at night on the back of a vespa. I felt very safe with the drivers and they brought us to many local eating spots showing us how cuisine is prepared and eaten. They also stop us to enjoy some musical entertainment. Our guide had excellent English and the rest of the staff was very friendly.

The highlight of my trip to Saigon. Cutting through the traffic with thousands of other motor bikes. Stop off's at a couple of authentic food bars, an atmospheric coffee with singer and a pianist, finished off with a beer and live rock music. Fantastic fun.

We never realised how good this trip would be when we were booking this back in the UK.

We were picked up from our hotel on the back of the vespa and taken for a pre drink where you could have the pick of the drinks list; cocktails, beer or soft drinks.

Then we were off on the back of the vintage vespa for a tour through the crazy streets of Ho Chi Minh. It was great to be so close to the 6 million locals also on the back of their motorbikes weaving in and out of the traffic.

First stop was a seafood restaurant where our guide talked us through the menu and again the drinks were included. The food was lovely and as we were feeling adventurous ( probably the drinks kicking in) we had scallops in shells, crab and frog!

Then off again for a 25 trip through china town to the next stop. Again loads to eat and choice of drinks, (at this stage I chose something non alcoholic,fresh coconut from the shell ) the guide who was so funny talked us through all the courses and tempted us to eat food we would probably never had chosen ourselves.

The penultimate stop was a secret coffee cafe where we were treated to iced coffee together with a live performance of great music. So atmospheric with the candles and smell of the car workshop below ( it really was hidden away)

Finally the bit we were not really looking forward to, a club in a back street. How wrong we were about this. Again after choosing from the drinks menu we settled down to an amazing life show al l be it amongst people half our age. The various artists were amazing, better than some concerts I have seen in the UK. Our guide said we could stay as long as we wanted and we were certainly in no rush to leave.

Finally we were driven on the Vespa back to our hotel

Thank you for an amazing experience which really was the highlight of our holiday.

review_title: Did at night tour on Vespa
review_text: It's a great and fun way to see the city. And includes local meals, visit to sneaky places & the great scenery of the city - really good fun! Really fun to do some sightseeing "the local way"

Just got back to our hotel from this trip. It's fantastic! It really should be compulsory on a trip to Siagon. The Vespa trip itself is an experience not to be missed. Exhilarating but not as scary as you would think when you are standing on the corner taking your video to show everyone back home how crazy the traffic is. But the Vespa but is really only part of the tour. You get to see, hear and taste flavours of Siagon at night that you would never, ever find or try by yourself. Go, go, go!!!!!!

Taking the Vespa tour through the nightly Saigon is the ultimate kick. To experience the city from the back seat of an original Vespa is something different - you blend in with the locals and smell the city (as well as the pollution). The stops are well chosen: drinks, appetizer, main course and dessert. Everything well-handled by our fantastic guide Jill (with the tiger grip). Besides being fun it also felt safe - drivers did a good job. Thanks, dear friends, for taking us!

review_title: Highlight of Vietnam - don't miss out!
review_text:
Had a fantastic experience with them taking their night tour - from the initial email through to the end of the night. Even if you're on a budget - you should stretch it for this.

Our guide was knowledgeable, and the drivers incredibly safe. Also, the Vespa's are made in such a way that you can sit back and relax (or take photos to your heart's content), you don't have to have your arms behind you holding on for dear life (like every other motorbike ride you will take in Vietnam)

If you haven't already tried an Avocado shake, be sure to try one at the second stop!

This was just a blast for us. An extremely well organized tour with competent drivers who had us sitting back and relaxing in the ordered chaos of Ho Chi Minh at night. We saw areas of the city would never have discovered without Saigon After Dark. Got to chat with the owner at the first stop, Zoom Cafe and chat with our group who accompanied us for the evening. The evening only got better then with us visiting and tasting some unique restaurants and quality foods throughout the tour. The evening ended with a lively nightclub with drinks and live music. For a long married couple in their late fifties it was one of the highlights of our 17 day trip to south east Asia. Many thanks to our co-ordinator Dat who would explain the dishes, local drinks and customs of Vietnam. A special thank you to my driver Do, a happy and engaging you man who was also an extremely competent driver!

A definition must do! A highlight of our trip! Our guide was just brilliant and loves her job. My Vespa bike driver was knowledgable, friendly, and I always felt safe with him. Food and drink was so nice and cooked beautifully, the jumping chicken a must! Overall my friends and I had the best night and regard it as one of the best tours of our holiday! Thanks everyone we loved it!!!!

Wow - The highlight of our stay in Saigon. From the welcome at The Cafe to the second we were dropped at the door to our hotel we had a truly wonderful experience that should not be missed by visitors to Saigon. Whisked away through the streets of Saigon heaving with traffic we felt safe and went on to two different eateries sampling local dishes, then off to a first floor piano/violin concert in someones house and finally off to a local bar to sample the youth of Vietnam playing live music. Absolutely terrific , a one off price includes all drinks and food and a memory that will stay with you forever
Friendly guide, good drivers and lots of delicious food and drinks. A must to try if you're in Saigon. I will do it again!
Our evening on the Saigon After Dark Food Tour with our guide Dep was the highlight of our stay in Saigon. We highly recommend this experience.
it a fantastic tour a few beers a bit to eat and the excitement of being on the back of a vespa was amazing great fun,i would love to do it again.

We wanted to book with Back of the Bike but they were fully booked and recommended Vespa Adventures. It was expensive but we were so glad we did it!

The secret cafe was amazing, we were there on xmas eve and the atmosphere was fantastic!

Gave us such a great insight into Ho Chi Minh night life that we would never have been able to experience on our own.

We did the evening tour. We loved it. It gets you in to the local culture both on the surprisingly benign city roads and in the restaurants, bars & clubs.
Initial fears of the traffic fade away as the smile widens. Despite the seeming mayhem on the roads there is no aggression whatsoever. Everyone fits in and it's truly a ride worth experiencing.
Everyone rides pillion & riders are split into groups of no more than 6 or 7. Each group has its own very knowledgeable guide. The guide leads you through the local culture, customs & history of the street food, the bars and club. Free flowing drinks/cocktails add to the evening, knowing you'll just have to hang on and enjoy the ride back to your hotel.

Compared to other experiences in Vietnam it initially appears relatively expensive but it is an all inclusive evening like no other. I believe you get what you pay for and would heartily recommend this night out.

As three seniors (and with a little trepidation to start!!) we did the Saigon evening tour with our very competent and charming Vespa drivers weaving in and out of the unbelievable traffic. We soon got into the spirit of the evening as we zoomed around the city with stops for local street food, an authentic local coffee shop with casual entertainment and a small night-club with a local rock band. The tour guide was excellent, making sure we felt safe and comfortable. Fabulous evening - this is not to be missed. Kudos to Vespa Adventures.

We did the evening dinner tour, what a fantastic way to see the city, try great food and experience urban Vietnamese culture.

Recommend you do this at the beginning of your trip as good way to get your bearings.
We felt completely safe yet still had the adrenalin of speeding around the city at night.

Absolutely the "Ride of Your Life"!! Two senior citizens (one never having been on a motorbike) thoroughly enjoyed the evening. Riding handlebar to handlebar in the Saigon traffic was thrilling and the restaurants were too fun, even ate the jumping chicken (froglegs). The drivers were very competent and we felt very safe and secure.
As the other reviewers have said, You gotta do this!!!!!!!!!!!
Thanks to Audley Travel for including this adventure in our route.

review_title: Good fun but night tour is more food focused...
review_text: This is a great way to quickly see the city. The night tour has a more food and drink focus. We thought it would be more about seeing local sights but on our travels we still got to see a fair bit of the city and get a good feel for the town. Tour guide was excellent and everything was well organized.

The evening Vespa Tour was recommended to us by our Tour Company. Oh Boy, it lived up to and exceeded our expectations. Our guides/drivers collected us from our Hotel and whizzed us through the streets of Saigon to the Zoom bar. Here we were met by a host who looked after our needs with drinks and nibbles. She was sooo informative, also asked if we had any food allergies etc. then we were off and feeling quite safe even though the roads were manic. It was an amazing to be among the throngs & the locals having a chat at the traffic lights. We visited a restaurant we would never have found on our own. The food was fabulous, as was the venue for dessert, drinks and local music. The evening was finished up at a bar with a rock group who were really very good. A nice touch was receiving photos of our evening by email a few days later. We are so glad this was an experience we never missed.

review_title: The Vespa tour was a highlight of our trip to Vietnam
review_text: My husband and I loved our experience of flying (sort of) through the streets of Saigon on the back of a Vespa for our 4 hour tour of the city. The tour took us to places we would not have visited but enjoyed, such as the park where bird owners take their birds (in cages) for a daily visit with each other and other birds. Also, a Chinese herb store was part of the tour. The Vespa "drivers" picked us up and returned us to our hotel in the Old Quarter, unharmed! We being loved in the thick of the traffic where riders of motor bikes and autos vie for position. It was like a well-planned dance. Masks and helmets were provided as was lunch at the meet-up point. Our group was 5 riders, from Greece, Australia and the US. We booked online but you can also book when you are in Saigon. We had an excellent guide, Diem. Don't hesitate--take the tour!

We were on a 2 week cruise in Southeast Asia and spent a night in HCMC rather commute back and forth to the port. We were glad we did when we found Vietnam Vespa Adventures and took their Saigon At Night Tour. We had built up high expectations for the tour and the fact that those expectations were exceeded was amazing. When you see the traffic in the city you know that you would never drive there yourself, but the men and women who drive you around are well skilled. It's one of those situations where you have to trust the process. The food venues were excellent and we got to visit a number of places that are definitely not on the tourist trail. We really loved the music at the first music venue and didn't love the very loud rock music at the second club, but our guide gladly let our driver take us back to the hotel as the second club was the last stop. We would do this tour again in a minute.

review_title: Saigon After Dark. Absolute must do in Saigon. Such a blast.
review_text:
Omg this is an absolute must in Saigon. It's probably the highlight of our trip. It was just such a fun and exhilarating experience. We decided to do the Saigon After Dark Tour. First of all it's around 4 hours long which you think may be long to spend on a scooter but there is so much more. First the experience of riding on a scooter in Saigon is insane and exhilarating. Then stopping at different local bars and eateries along the way adds even more flavour (excuse the pun) to the tour. Zoom bar was our first stop which is a great meeting spot. We had a great group of people which made it even more fun (6 of us). Our guide for the night was Dep who was an absolute gem, so efficient and organised and on top of everything. The guys that were riding us around were so lovely and accommodating and took such great care of us.

Anyway off we were for some sightseeing on the scooter throughout the city which was fab. Then stopped for the first meal of the night at a seafood place in district 4 which was fantastic. The next eating spot was the famous Vietnamese pancake joint in district 3 which was crazy busy but fun. Next was a very underground kinda of a cafe called Vung Oi (from memory) where we had desert or a drink and listened to some fab music and singing. Very different kinda of experience. Then we stopped at a club where there was a Vietnamese local band playing which was crazy fun. Everything we ate and drank was included in the price which made things so easy.

Omg it was a fab night. It was the eve of my 40th birthday and this was my bday present from hubby and omg one of the best presents ever. Loved loved loved it. Will do it again when (not if!!) back in Saigon. The entire experience was fantastic - from our initial communication with these guys all the way to post event comms where they sent us a thank you email with photos attached which their guys had taken of us throughout the night and of course the night itself was so much fun and so well organised and totally unforgettable. Highly highly recommend it.

We only had one evening in Saigon - and I cannot imagine any better way to spend it - we got to see the streets, squares, buildings, lights, all round us as the moped drivers took us around several central areas. We got to eat a delicious variety of local delicacies in street restaurants, all drinks included, and the cheerful group guide happily ran off during one food stop to buy us Balut (duck-fetus-in-egg - scary, but something you have to be able to say that you've tried), as a few people in the group were keen to try it, but nervous. The on to an atmospheric "home" jazz club that we would not have found on our own, and finishing in a cheery cover-band live club. All *so* well organized - and efficient, cheerful and tasty - I would recommend this to everyone passing through Saigon. Even being on the mopeds on the so-busy streets was not as scary as one might expect - and great fun.

Me and my boyfriend wanted to do something special in Saigon, so we saw this advertisement of Vespa adventures at our hotel. We gathered some information about it at the reception and we decided we wanted to go on this trip. We asked of we could go the same night, and the called to check. It was possible!
We got picked up at our hotel by two experienced drivers. After meeting the group and our guide the tour begins. At first I was a bit nervous. Anyone who has seen the traffic in Saigon can understand why. During the tour we went to different 'secret' spots in Saigon of which I'm sure that we would have never seen if wandered around the city by ourselves. We had a very friendly, nice, cute guide, Loan (?). Two thumbs up for her! She really wants everyone to have an amazing time during the tour, and she makes sure that happens!
The tour was a bit expensive, but it was all worth it.
I definitely recommend this tour to everyone who wants to do something unique.
Keep up the good work!
A real highlight of our holiday.Beautifully orchestrated ,a great thrill,and we felt very welcomed and very well looked after.

Excellent all around - perfectly coordinated, perfectly responsive, great time. They've got it down. A few hours on a Vespa eating, drinking, chatting. Our guide was perky and provided a good amount of information but still let us enjoy the experience on our own. Could be suitable for anything from a solo traveler looking to get out right up to a group. Well done.

If you want to experience Saigon in a super fun way...this is the best! Our drivers were polite and friendly and somehow knew how to navigate Saigon traffic and chaos. We saw all the highlights and my panic subsided in a very short time as I realized these boys were very careful and knew the ins and outs of motorbike etiquette.
We had a ball! I would call this a fabulous adventure....do not miss this while in Saigon.

Brilliant night. Just do it.
Didn't realize when we booked in uk everything was included - food, drinks etc. Finally had to give up at 2230 in the nightclub.
Also really safe.

We took this tour New Years Eve when the streets were absolute chaos. We felt safe and well looked after. What a blast. My hubby was pumped as we visited a restaurant that Anthony Bourdain had recommended and it was indeed awesome. Great staff and well organized for street food. Don't miss this one.

We'd already looked round Saigon and thought the tour would visit the same areas. It did a couple of them, but there were also places we would never have thought to go. And heading out on the back of a Vespa around town is brilliant fun. They guys were really nice and like most Saigon bikers, utterly fearless. Not cheap but very well worth it. Even bought the t-shirt and I never did that. Really recommend if you've not long to spend in Saigon (or if you have for that matter).

I did the day tour of the Delta. I had an absolutely amazing and fun time! My guide was extremely easy to get along with, and spoke excellent English. The sights they take you to are in my opinion something you have to experience yourself.
An excellent way to truly experience the raw side of Vietnam.

Mitchell.

We decided on the tour after reading reviews, especially since all reviews in regards to the boat tours were horrendous. So to avoid tourist traps and the hassle of everything else, we picked the Vespa tours. We were picked up from our hotel at 830 am and were dropped back at 3 pm.

I thought sitting at the back of a bike would be easy especially since i've ridden a scooter for quite a few years, but i was wrong..
It does get a bit uncomfortable after a while but not enough for me to say don't do it.
riding through Mekong delta via narrow roads through villages, stopping for a coffee and just generally every time we wanted to is more than what we hoped for in this trip.
The entire team who went along for the tour including our tour guide were super fun. He spoke relatively fluent English and took a definite interest in showing us around (even though he does it almost everyday)
From shrimp farms, to a short market visit to show us the local fruits and veggies, or meats and tofu, Vespa tours covered it all.
Snack time was excellent. Mussels, clams and spring rolls in the market place with a drink of your choice.
Lunch was equally good. This came at the end of our tour, in a nice little restaurant. Sea food rice, veggies, noddles and BEER.
We didn't have to pay a dime over the cost of the tour,as all food and beverages were included in the cost.
Everytime we stopped, we were given wet wipes and a bottle of water, oh and a face mask mid tour.
Do note, its hot, so carry sun block, shades and an open mind..
Its dusty so be prepared to take a long shower after your trip.

Over all i would recommend this tour to everyone.. as long as your up for a slightly sore bum.

Just finished a 1/2 sight seeing tour on a vesper motor bike. It was fantastic, would highly recommend it. Because all of us that went (5) had done most or all of inner city sites we did a lot of extra things that I would have never got to see. Thank you so much for "the ride of my life" and a huge thank you to my wonderful driver Duk.

We just returned from the "insiders tour of Saigon" on the back of a Vespa. It was without a doubt the most fun we've had on almost any tour we have ever taken. Riding on the back of a motorcycle in downtown Saigon is an experience I know I will never forget! We wore masks on our faces so the fumes didn't get to us. And of course we wore the mandatory helmets. This is an excellent tour company, with top notch experienced drivers, and outstanding guides. I was never concerned for my safety. Our guide, Tu Thi Thu Huong was absolutely charming and very knowledgeable. We felt like we learned a lot about the culture and history of Saigon and Vietnam in general. I would definitely recommend this tour for anyone who wants to see Saigon from a different viewpoint. You can go so many places on the back of a Vespa that you wouldn't go on a tour bus or even a taxi. The company offers several different tour options. I would think any of them would be excellent choices. It's a great adventure!

review_title: A really fun tour and lovely people
review_text: My husband had never ridden pillion on a motorbike of any description before so it was with trepidation that he took the risk on a Vespa in Ho Chi Minh city. We both had a really great time. the riders were obviously very experienced and we felt very safe even with the crazy number of bikes on the road and the way the traffic flows! We did the after dark experience and it was a varied choice of venues which we felt were perfect. Good food, good music and all in all a thoroughly enjoyable evening. Highly recommend. They also send you photos of your adventure afterwards (free).

What I most enjoyed most was being ferried around HCM on the back of a Vespa as we saw parts of the city we might not have visited. However, the food was poor on the whole and a lot of the venues were very unclean. My chief bugbear was our Vietnamese chaperone who insisted on monopolising the conversation. Moreover, we felt that she was probing for information at best, spying at worst - we lived in a China so have become rather accustomed to it.

review_title: Best Day in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: After watching all the Vespa's zooming around the city we wanted to be part of the action. Our family of three 2 adults and a 12 year old daughter went on the tour. We were picked up at our hotel by three drivers and a tour guide. The day was perfect going all over the city! We will always remember the day as it was so informative and exciting perfect for all family members! I also felt safe with the drivers. We are actually planning on a week trip with the company when our daughter turns 16 and we plan on each driving our own Vespa. We will be practicing in Seattle, WA and will be back to Vietnam for more adventures. Thank you!!

One of the best days spent in Vietnam. Ideal for nostalgia searchers who can enjoy a ride on a vintage vespa to the suburbs of Saigon and the land of small villages, water canals, markets, crowded ferries, narrow bridges...
I went with a driver as I wanted to enjoy the sightseeing. The trip was really enjoyable and informative - our English speaking guide was very informative and made interesting stops - at shrimp farm, local cafe with hamacas, local market and even the stops at ferry crossings were interesting with all that people and motorbikes. I felt completely safe o with my driver on Vespa and the ride was very smooth even in the hectic traffic. At the end we had a fabulous lunch at cafe Zoom which is the headquarters of Vietnam Vespa Adventures in Saigon. Also a must stop for classic Vespa lovers as the cafe is decorated with Vespa items and photographs.

review_title: No jump, no life! Awesome experience!
review_text: This is the second time I have been on a VVADT trip. Both times I took the foodie tour (first time with my 11 year old daughter, last time with my wife and 5 year old son as well). The experience is one for a lifetime and is completely safe, but exciting at the same time. We arrived in HCMC for a couple of days during Tet New Year and these guys were one of the few tourist operations open. Steve is a class act and responded to email quickly and adjusted our tour time to end a little early as we had a young child with us. Tour guide spoke perfect English and was very knowledgeable of the local area and food. I had some problems with my bank card and Steve helped me work out an alternate payment method. Can't say enough about this operation, it was the highlight of my last visit to Vietnam and will likely be the tops for this current visit.

I only had a day in town before heading on to Phu Quoc so decided to do Vietnam Vespa's 'Insider's Saigon' tour in the morning and then XO Tours' foodie tour in the evening (reviewed separately). Both companies are brilliant and this is such a fun way to see the city. I thought the tour was great value for money as it lasts around 4.5 hours and you cover a lot of ground in that time. The vintage Vespas have obviously been lovingly restored and are very comfortable to ride, and the drivers are excellent - although the traffic looks terrifying at first, once you're on a scooter and in the thick of it you can see that it flows quite organically. I felt very safe at all times and found it exhilarating to zoom around town soaking up the street life. Our guide was great fun, full of energy, very knowledgable and spoke brilliant English. I loved seeing less 'obvious' sights such as the bird lover's cafe in Tao Dan park, as well as landmarks like the Renification Palace and the old Post Office, and appreciated her detailed explanation of the background to famous events such as monk Thich Quang Duc's self-immolation in the 1960s. The tour finished with lunch at their centrally located cafe, which was nice, although I thought it would have been even better to have gone somewhere for some Vietnamese street food. Overall highly recommend this as a great way to see the city, particularly if you are pressed for time.

review_title: by far the best tour to do in hcmc
review_text: for the "after dark" tour they pick you up from your hotel on a vespa - that same driver is then "your" driver for the whole night as you move from one bar/restaurant to the next - in between each stop they take you for a drive on the vespa (which is half the fun). the stops they pick are really great

review_title: Adventure with a friend instead of a tour guide
review_text:
We booked the 'Saigon After Dark' tour on January 13th 2014.

We have been picked up from our hotel (Sofitel Saigon Plaza) on schedule with two Vespas, got our helmets and stormed into the streets of Saigon. Suddenly we were part of this traffic which seems to be more organic than rule based. Our drivers were professionals and so the rides were very safe and relaxing (at leat as a passenger) at any time.

After a short cruise we met our tour guide at our first breakpoint - a small coffee shop. "Treat me as a friend not as a tour guide" she said and this shows how we should understand the journey. Being part of the town and do what locals do, being part of the real life not of the history.

After a drink (all drinks, doesn't matter what and where, were free during the whole tour by the way) we cruised a little bit through the town and met her again at the first small restaurant. She explained all about the meal and how to eat it. Even if we had found the place, we definitely would not have eat all we've eaten if we had been alone (even frogs).

Four courses later we again drove to the next restaurant and enjoyed new experiences with three more courses e.g. on the table grilled beef, wrapped and rolled with salad leaves and a lot of herbs and other things.

Station number 4 was a hidden coffe shop - and that is to be taken literally. We even had even to go through a kitchen to come to this place. Local musicians and drinks waited for us again.

The last station was a local bar with live music, very loud but a very good atmosphere and very much alive.

Summary

It was a very interesting and unforgettable adventure. We visited places we would never have found and we ate things that we never would have eaten if we had been alone. It's a must and it's absolutely worth the money.

Thanks again to our friend, she was so enthusiastic and open to talk about everything under the sun.

A real highlight of our Vietnam trip. Enjoyable and informative - our guide Liu was very friendly and made us laugh a lot! We felt completely safe on the Vespas and the ride was very exciting through the hectic traffic. The food was good too!

We went out on the 'Saigon After Dark' tour on our last night in HCMC and oh what a brilliant way to finish the Vietnam leg of our trip.
It was my first ever ride on motorbike (back or front) and it was a great initiation. Having seen the seeming chaos on the roads from the safety of a car interior, I was just amazed at how effortless my driver made it all seem - by the end of the evening, my fear factor had dropped from around 8 out of 10 to nothing - he must have been concentrating all the time. But then it just seemed to flow naturally.
On top of this, we were taken to taste some excellent food and to visit some other hidden gems.
It was worth every penny (many times over) - an absolute must do for your trip!!

We did the Saigon After Dark tour and were amazed. It was our first night in HCMC and we literally went for the ride of our lives! To say the streets of HCMC are hectic is an understatement and to be able to ride them on the back of a vespa was amazing. We felt completely safe with our drivers. Our tour guide (Vin) was knowledgeable and the food was fantastic. This tour is HIGHLY recommended!

My husband and I participated in the Saigon After Dark and could not have asked for a better experience! We were shocked at the various spots they took us to, the knowledge of our guide, the ease and comfort of the drivers, and the yummy treats. They brought us such a unique view of Saigon, one that we would have never found on our own. I almost wanted to do it again but instead we did the Glimpse of the Mekong so my husband could have the opportunity to drive the Vespa :) Do yourself a favor and book Saigon After Dark for at least one of your nights. The drinks were tasty and the food was abundant! I ate frog legs for the first time and it was surprisingly delicious. Booking is super easy, they actually took my reservation over the phone and made payment very easy. We even got a discount for booking two tours! Don't question this, just do it. You won't be sorry!

review_title: Vespa tour of Ho Chi - a must!!!
review_text:
We had the most wonderful experience on this Vespa night tour of Sigon, we highly recommend this evening. We were picked up from our hotel at 6pm and taken to a local bar to meet our guide. This was peak time for traffic however we felt very safe in the hands of our drivers who were steady and aware at all times ensuring our helmets were on and that we were comfortable before leaving.
Our tour guide was very sweet and made us feel special by asking us all about our honeymoon and remembering our dietary requirements.
The evening started off with a few cocktails of our choice. We were then driven to a local seafood restaurant where the local cuisine was explained to us. You are very well fed on this tour so you must go with a hungry tummy!!
Then we were whizzed off to the next restaurant where the food was made in front of us and once again explained by our guide. The experience is wonderful as although other groups/couples were having the same experience along side us, we very much had a private tour with our guide.
Next stop was a wonderful traditional Vietnamese cafe where local music was played, this was a magical experience for us.
We were dropped back at our hotel just after 10pm with massive smiles on our faces.
Please do not be scared or concerned to try this Vespa tour - it was an amazing evening and would suit anyone of any age.
A Sigon must!!

review_title: One of the best nights we have had
review_text:
My husband and I did the night tour and loved every minute of it.
Our riders picked us up from our hotel on vintage Vespa's from the moment I got on I felt safe and probably had only 1 shut eye moment.
We had a wonderful guide called Sunny who was the life of the party.
There were 6 people in our group and everyone wanted to have a great time.
We were taken to 2 restaurants that probably tourists would walk by the food was fantastic the best Vietnamese pancake I have ever eaten. We were told about the food and how to eat it.
We also went to a wine bar/ coffee shop that had singers accompanied by pianist then off to a night club for a final cocktail.
Then we were returned to our hotel.
Just do it.

My husband and I joined a group of friends to do the Saigon After Dark tour and it was awesome. They picked us up at the hotel and dropped us off at the end of the tour. It was very easy to book (all in English) and completely worth it. The food we ate as part of the tour was fantastic and they even took care of the folks who had dietary restrictions. It was a lot of fun riding on the back of a Vespa and being part of the night traffic, which was kind of crazy, but we felt very safe the whole time. I really recommend doing this tour, especially if you’re in town for a short time. It’s a great way to see a lot of Ho Chi Minh City. Even though we went to places that are used to catering to ex-pats, we were still very much in Vietnam. Loved it!

review_title: This is a must do, you really get a locals view of Saigon
review_text:
I was living in Viet Nam and my partner come over for a quick holliday while I based there. Wanting to show her Saigon by night and how great it is and the wonderful food I was going to put her on my scooter and race around, then I saw these guys and thought why not.

Although not "as cheap" as things in Saigon, you get your monies worth ten times over. As an ExPat I went to places I didnt know where in Saigon, I even was able to introduce my Viet Nam firends to these small cafes and coffee shops after the tour.

My partner loved the Vespa and racing around and well as a bigger bloke I was worried however the drivers where great and had it all under control.

This was really the best way to see Saigon by night and it is really how things are in Viet nam. Truley a must do, is the best night invesmtent you can have, and you will get to expereince life on a scooter in Saigon and that is a once in a life time let me tell you.

Best thing I did whilst I lived in Viet Nam and one of the best nights I have ever had. And well once you pay everything is free, drik and eat and enjoy the tour met new friends and most of all actually expereince Saigon and get out of Q1 (Ben Than) and see the wonderful city.

review_title: Best part of our whole cruise
review_text: I convinced my husband and two good friends to book this trip - all of us in our 50's -as part of our Cruise from Hong Kong to Saigon. We were all nervous but I cannot say how fabulous the trip was for each and every one of us. Three of us had never been on a bike before but all of the drivers were gentle, kind and despite the mania and madness of the roads we still felt completely safe. My husband even let go to shoot some film from the back of his bike. We are veggies but we still felt we experienced something of real vietnamese street food (minus the jumping chicken! ...wait and find out yourselves!) The exposure to all areas - some busy, some quiet gave us what we needed on a short stop to this fascinating city. Cannot fault the whole experience and would highly recommend you add this to your short-list of must do things in Ho Chi Mihn City.

Our family of six including 77 year old Grandma, had an absolutely fabulous time on the back of vintage Vespa motorcycles for our "Glimpse of the Mekong" tour. We went to a range of places we would never have found by ourselves and had everything explained in a way a brochure would never be able to do. Dat, our guide was terrific. His English is excellent and his knowledge is extensive. We plied him with all sorts of questions about the area and life in general in Vietnam.

This trip included our first experience of the Vietnamese iced coffee made with condensed milk which we actively sought throughout the remainder of out time in the country. Consideration was given to food allergies such as peanuts and sesame seeds as well as a dislike for seafood.

In places the road was rough but our skilled riders were very good at choosing the best path. If you had a back problem it might not be for you. Overall, this was a major highlight of our 19 days in Vietnam.

review_title: Love love loved it - a must do!
review_text: We booked this at the last minute & we're so glad we did it -- it was incredible. Both the drivers my husband & I had were friendly, safe & funny. They made the evening an absolute pleasure. Our guide (Dep) was also warm & funny. We were paired up with another Aussie couple, so it was cool to hang out with some great people for the evening (the drivers & guide included!). I thought I would be freaked out on the vespa, but I was completely comfortable. Would absolutely recommend this as a must do in Saigon, it's well worth the money & a lot of fun

review_title: Unique way to see Saigon after dark!
review_text:
We went on the Saigon after Dark Tour just before New Year's Eve,so the Xmas decorations were still in place turning the streets into a vast fairground in the middle of a Formula One racetrack!!! We had a very welcome cocktail at the company's street bar and then moved on to experience street food like no other!!!
We went to at least 3 different venues all with exceptionally different and delicious traditional food. After that we were taken to a very old coffee shop,tucked away in a district you would never go to by yourself as a tourist,here we had more cocktails or indeed coffee if you wished,listening to local singers practising their repetoires.Finally ending up at the company's cocktail bar to be greeted by the American owner who offered us another delicious cocktail and hoped we had had a good time!!! How not to,very good value for money and a very very very unusual way to see Saigon at night.
By the way,they do give you a helmet to wear which is a comfort!!! The drivers are very experienced and everyone managed to get back to their hotel safely.

review_title: Saigon After Dark Vespa Tour- the Best!
review_text: Glad I booked the tour after being waitlisted by XO foodie tour and recommended by them. Love that Saigon After Dark tour isn't just a food tour but you get to visit a really cool, unassuming coffee house with great ambiance to listen to the singing of amazing local talent accompanied by a violinist and pianist and later in the evening visit the top club in Siagon for live, classic rock entertainment!!! Didn't expect that at all. Riding the Vespa through the streets of Saigon at night is an adventure. The drivers are experts and not once do you feel unsafe amidst the pack of motorcycles.... even for mommy me. The food stops were also incredibly good. Loved the seafood and banh xeo! The tour ended at 10:30 pm and this worked great as our flight out of HCM was at 1 am. Will do this tour again in a heartbeat and wish every destination had a Vespa tour!

I almost feel like this review is superfluous, seeing all the others on here.

We took the "Saigon After Dark" tour and had a wonderful time. It was one of the most memorable tours I have ever been on.

The food was excellent - and not at places the casual tourist would ever stumble onto.

The guides were wonderful and truly engaged with us.

All that, and seeing Saigon by night on the back of a vintage Vespa? It was a perfect night. Thanks so much to Vietnam Vespa Adventures for giving us this experience.

review_title: Amazing Experience - only way to see Ho Chi Minh!
review_text: I really recommend me this to anyone who is spending a couple of days in Ho Chi Minh City. It is the only way to see the city! Also the drivers and guides were very friendly.

The Vespa food tour was the highlight of my stay in Ho Chi Minh, The guide was super friendly and open to conversation, the food was AMAZING and the places they took us to we would have never seen without them. You truly get a taste of the Vietnamese/Ho Chi Minh vibe. A must do!!

review_title: The best we've had in Saigon
review_text:
Certainly the most interesting and un experienced we had in our 10 days in Saigon. We decided to book the tour for the evening of New Year's Eve and it was a good decision. The streets were crazy, full of people partying and motorbikes in every corner. After the tour we stayed in the Vespa pub and waited for midnight with the owner and his family and friends. It was the highlight of our trip and if ever we'll go again to Saigon, we'll do it again.
Definitely recommended !

I can't think of a better way to feel Vietnam than riding its streets on a scooter. My wife and I took the Coastal and Highlands trip - 6 nights HCMC to Nah Trang. I was the pilot and my wife the pillion. On a scooter you feel Vietnam. It tantalises the senses. You feel it, see it, hear it, smell it, and taste it. Every moment is an adventure - and on a vintage Vespa! What a hoot! The ride up to and down from Dalat is fantastic. From my first contact with Steve via e-mail to our final farewell to Hoan in Nah Trang everything about Vietnam Vespa Adventures was first rate. They did everything they said they would and more. Dec/Jan 2014. Stephen B

review_title: See it like the Lord sees it
review_text:
Brilliant. We had a late breakfast and they were more than accommodating to let us have the meal after the tour. Our guide spoke fluent English and the Vespa drivers were excellent .
You feel completely safe. They tailor the tour to your needs. A bit expensive but worth it.

What a fantastic night! Vespa Adventure tours pull out all the stops and make sure you have an enjoyable / fun night. Following pick up from our hotel the first stop was a bar to meet our fellow pillion riders over a cocktail, then it was off on a great evening adventure. Being in amongst (what Brits would perceive to be crazy) traffic on a Vespa is a great way to get a sense of what Ho Chi Minh City locals experience every day - it's great fun and gets the heart pumping! During the evening we made 4 stops around the city - 2 for fantastic street food (some of the best we had whilst in Vietnam) and 2 for drinks and music - a brilliant night all round. The guide who traveled with us was very welcoming, informative and spoke excellent English - a fantastic night! A big thank you to our guide and Vespa drivers!

Before I get to my review I want to personally thank Steve Mueller. Steve is the most down to earth owner/person that you can meet. We had some last minute changes in our group and Steve made those changes without a blink of an eye. I had recently had back surgery (removal of two ruptured disks from my back and Steve went out of his way to ensure that I had a back support on my vespa for the tour)...Thanks Steve!!! We also had the pleasure of having Steve and his son, Brian, on our tour that special evening...what a treat.

Our group did the Vespa Adventures tour Saigon at Night, and let me tell you...what a night! Steve Mueller's team picked us up at our hotel at our scheduled time (prompt service is always a plus in a foreign country) and made sure we all had helmets and were comfortable with our Vespas. And before our eyes there we were in the middle of downtown Saigon weaving in and out of traffic...ZOOM ZOOM! The only words you can feel are EXHILARATING AND AWESOME! The drivers are professional and know what they are doing and the tour guide is very knowledgable of all the stops. I am not going to reveal too many details because you have to experience this tour yourself to truly appreciate and enjoy the sights, sounds, smells, and life in Saigon at Night! I will tell you that you will be stuffed with awesome drinks and great food! Our tour included our kids, and Steve was kind of enough to alter our tour to end the evening at one of the local ice cream shops...so yes, it's kid friendly!

The organization of the tour is quite simple by visiting Vietnam Adventures website..http://vietnamvespaadventures.com/tours. Steve and his team are very professional, polite and very accommodating. The tours are very affordable and worth every penny! This is the best way to enjoy the many food variations, see the multiple districts, and move in and out of traffic like the locals. Our group loved the tour and in the end we were full, happy, and tired; but we would not have missed it for the world.

I did the daytime city tour with my wife and 12yr old son and everyone had a ball!

The drivers don't all speak excellent English but they are very friendly and drive carefully.

The tour guide that also accompanied the tour spoke excellent English and was very knowledgeable about Saigon. This is by far the best way to see the city as you get to travel round as the locals do. Tour also includes a great mix of places to see. Our son now thinks every tour should be on the back of a bike :)

review_title: The best way to see Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
Steve,
Sorry we missed you when we got back to the restaurant from our 'Insider's Saigon' tour we did today, because I so much wanted to tell you how fantastically, awesomely exhilarating we thought it was!! If your other guides are as half as good as Dieu, then you are a lucky man to have such professional, talented, knowledgeable staff. She was able to customize a tour for us to cater to our particular interests, with no prior warning, after only a brief conversation at the start of the day! A great way to see HCMC. The guys were also great as our 'chauffeurs', and made us feel really safe in an environment we were, I must admit, a little apprehensive (ie, Saigon's traffic) about venturing out into. Keep up the great work - you are providing a fantastic service to visitors to Vietnam.
John O'Brien, Janine & Thomas Freeman

review_title: THE ONLY way to see Ho Chi Minh!
review_text:
A brilliant thing to do in Saigon if you have time is Vietnam Vespa
Adventures, easily organized via email. We only had half a day as we
were
docking in Phu My on a cruise so this seems ideal for us! We were
lucky and had a tour just for us two, each riding pillion on the back
of a restored vintage Vespa around the city for 5-6 hours! Exhausting
but exhilarating! Nerves of steel required as you weave through
traffic!
We were also accompanied by our guide Dieu, who was
amazing and so knowledgeable about the history and current affairs of
Vietnam. Included was water, lunch at the Zoom Cafe, and we also had a
sugar cane juice from a street vendor, something I would have shied
away from normally, but wow what an experience! Overall a worthwhile
experience.
The tour company also does evening Saigon tours, and rents vintage
Vespas for longer terms so you can go off by yourselves. We plan to go
back to
Saigon soon, having had only a little taster, and will be doing another
VVA trip!

review_title: Good way to see the city
review_text: We did the day time city tour and seeing loved the sites from the back of a Vespa. The tour guide was excellent and very knowledgeable answering all questions on the sites and history. Would also have loved to have done the night tour but ran out of time. Lunch is also included in the tour but is not great.

We booked this and I was nervous. Was not looking forward to a scooter in the madness of HCMC! However, soon got over this with the thrill of riding pillion in the madness of HCMC. Did the Mekong Delta tour. Guide was very friendly, had great English and gave us fantastic local insider knowledge. Had dietary requirements which are EXTREMELY restrictive and they catered so well for this. Was brilliant value and our best day in Vietnam!

Decided to book the Saigon at night time tour after seeing the pamphlet at our hotel reception.

We were picked up at 6.15 and taken to a bar where we met our tour guide for the evening called Kevin, and the other people who had booked on. There were 6 of us in our group.

After a quick beer we jumped back on the Vespas and headed to our first stop which was a street side cafe. The food here was awesome and Kevin talked us through each dish and how the Vietnamese people eat them. We ate small snacks here, the most adventurous being frog legs which Kevin the little scamp told me was Chicken! All good fun and they tasted great.

It was then back on the bikes and off to another restaurant where we enjoyed the main course of spring rolls and Vietnamese prawn pancakes. Again the food and beer were amazing.

The next stop was the jewel in the crown of the tour. A small coffee shop down an alley way and up some stairs that will take some finding on your own. There was an amazing Pianist here and we listened to 3 singers (one of which sang western songs). Beer was on offer but we plumped for the sweet and decadent Vietnamese Coffee, a great move on our part.
