The final stop was a Rock Bar/Club with a live band. A great way to round off the evening. We were dropped off on the Vespas back at the hotel around half 10.

A great evening spent in the company of some really lovely people. Can't recommend highly enough.

My husband and I did the Saigon by Night tour. It was fantastic.

Seeing the city on the back of a bike is the best way! The guides picked up us from our hotel, they even had a sign with our names on it, so it was easy to find the guides. I love little gestures that make things easy. Their driving was safe and super fun!

First they take you to cafe zoom to meet the other members of your group, they give you a drink and a little snack. Then you visit 2 restaurants, a little cafe with a local folk music for coffee and lively club with a band for a drink or two to finish the night. So five stops total. The food was some of the best I had while in Vietnam and at places I would never have found on my own. The food was local: seafood (clams, crabs, shrimp), fresh and fried spring rolls, vegetables and our favorite was the pancakes cooked with shrimp and vegetables. Delicious.

If it wasn't the last night of our trip, we would have gone back and eaten there again.

The best part about bike tours it takes you to areas and places that were off the beaten path and got us out of district 1 and 3.

Special mention for the organization of the trip, everything was running like clockwork and super smooth.

This is a "must do" on a trip to HCMC

Whether it's this vespa company or another - I would highly recommend anyone going to Saigon book such a tour.

There's really no other way to see Vietnam and especially Saigon than on the back of a motorbike or scooter. Strangely, I always feel safer on one than on feet.

Good stuff about this experience (we did Saigon at night):

1. Live music venues. Truly surreal and outstanding and we wouldn't have been able to find them on our own.
2. Drivers
3. Being able to get out and see a lot of Saigon very easily
4. Accommodation/communication of the company

Not so good:

1. I thought this was some of the worst food we had in all of Vietnam - way too touristy.

This is a MUST do while in HCMC. We didn't have time for the full 4 hour trip which included food and drinking stops but they tailored a 2 hour trip for my family. It was a thrilling way to end our trip to Vietnam. The Vespas were great and safe and the drivers excellent. My only criticism is that it was expensive considering that we didn't have food or drink included. I think the 4 hour trip is better value for money. In any case this was fabulous and the very best way to see HCMC.

review_title: A Must Do when in Saigon
review_text: I did both the 1/2 day tour around Saigon and also the Saigon by Night. Both were excellent however if you are able to do one do the Saigon by night. I booked directly with Steve on Vespa Adventures website/email. Everything was spit on from the reservation, the pick up by the Vespa driver (note the Vespa drivers are locals so are at home on the streets) and you have an English speaking guide with you. After the first 5 minutes of being outside of my comfort zone, I realized everything was just fine. I totally felt safe and at ease. We even had an 11 year old girl on the night tour and she was fabulous , relaxed and thoroughly enjoyed herself. I absolutely recommend this company. Do the Saigon by night...it will be one of your highlights!

... this 'ride of your live' should be on every bodies route ... !!!!
Superb people, superb experience, great fun...!!

A great and safe way to see the city! Just finished the half day Vespa tour through HCMC and would really recommend it to everyone - also for families with kids over 10 or so. Safe and friendly drivers, Vespas and helmets in great condition so nothing to worry about.. you sit on the back which gives you the opportunity to see everything and take pictures. They take you to the famous highlights but also to less known places. Do it!!

If you can only do one thing while you are in Saigon this is it. We did the night tour and the city tour and with a teenager who hates churches and monuments the guide made it interesting and fun for Mr 15. Highly recommended.

What an amazing evening! Weaving through the night time traffic in Ho Chi Minh City is something not to be missed! The food was seriously good, jumping frog included, great little acoustic bar, then a packed live rock club! Do take this tour, you get to see a side of HCMC that as a tourist you usually don't get a glimpse of, a real treat! Thanks, guys!

It was new year's day 2014 and we had to do something special, off the beaten track and culturally immersive and this tour was it! We took the Saigon by night tour with 5 of our kids ages 14-20 and we all had a blast. The drivers weave through traffic laden streets like pros. Our tour guide Kevin (his screen name as his Vietnamese name is hard to pronounce) spoke great English and did our tour flawlessly without missing a beat. Our family is a family of foodies and let me tell you that with this adventure the food is good! Plus the entertainment in between is superb. And every place we visited was already prepared and ready to receive us like we were on VIP arrangement. Definitely the highlight of our visit to Vietnam. My children will always remember Ho Chi Minh as fun, adventure filled and definitely a place to come back to.

review_title: What are you waiting for? Book it now!
review_text:
We took the afternoon tour of Saigon. I'd never been on a scooter before so was a bit nervous but it's clear right from the hotel pick up that the drivers are extremely experienced and in control.

You see things that are way off the normal tourist route and cover a lot of different districts all the while seeing and learning new things.

It seemed expensive to us poor backpackers at first, but now I would do this trip again in a heartbeat. If we were here longer wouldn't hesitate to book the other tours too.

Thank you for the best experience ever!

review_title: So fun! Best activities in the city
review_text:
We were in Saigon for 3 nights with our family and some friends. We enjoyed our time there over Christmas immensely. It is a very vibrant city and the neighborhood in District 1 where we were (we stayed at the Park Hyatt) was extremely nice. It was not what I expected as we had just spent 3 weeks in Cambodia and Vietnam is much more developed.

The highlight of our time in the city was the Vespa night tour. We have a friend who lives in Siagon with her two boys, and she added some other friends to our group to fill out all the space and the 20 of us then had in essence a private group tour.

It was the 4th time my friend had done the tour and she said it was the best because of the time of year. It was a lovely temperature, but more importantly, the city is all lit up for Christmas and it made touring around at night that much more beautiful and special.

The owner - Steve - and his wife have this tour running like clockwork. We ate a variety of "street" food which felt adventurous, but each spot was well vetted and safe (in terms of your health). We also really loved stopping at this intimate club setting where they had open mic night and the singers were very talented. But the best part is just riding around - being in the thick of it with the locals. Do not hesitate to go - it's great for all ages!

review_title: Do Not Underestimate How Much Fun This Is!!
review_text:
We booked for the 'Glimpse of the Mekhong' tour, and were picked up at 8am at our hotel by two friendly drivers on two lovely Vespas - after a brief stop at Cafe Zoom to pray and collect the remainder I'd the group it was off the District 7 (again 'chauffeur driven' in crocodile of Vespas) for a briefing and 'check out' session for those that will drive the bikes.

It was here that we learned we had been upgraded to the cooking tour - thanks Steve! The rest of the day was spent driving the Vespas (or on pillion if you preferred) through villages, over rickety bridges, between rice paddies and even on a ferry! This was punctuated by stops to see local crafts, temples, etc - and of course for the cooking lesson! The cooking lesson was preceded by a stop at the market to see where the produce we will cook with had come from, and included 4 simple but tasty dishes all cooked on the riverside (plus 2 'bonus' dishes!). The chef clearly and patiently described/demonstrated each step and made the whole process fun!

At the end of the tour we returned to District 7, from where we were ferried back to our hotel - again as pillion passengers.

The day started at 8am, and we got back to the hotel about 4pm - exhausted but happy! A great day out - friendly, helpful and knowledgeable guides, and of course great bikes! Do not under estimate how fun these Vespas are to ride!

At first glance the price seems expensive, but when you finish the day you will be more than happy with the value you have received! I would definitely do this again, and am even considering the 7 day tour as we had so much fun!

review_title: go see ho chi min city at night
review_text: we only had one day in saigon to get a taste of the city, this was by far the best choice !! These guys show us things that we would have Never discovered on our own. As a bonus, we got to hang out with travelers from Australia, Hong Kong, etc. Do Not miss this adventure....btw, great food and drinks along the way!!!

review_title: The best way to experience HCMC!
review_text: The noise, smells, and tastes of Saigon can only be experienced by motorbike! It was scary at times, but a real buzz! We lived in Saigon for 3 years and learned more about the history & culture in these 4 hours. Absolutely recommending to as many people as possible!

We were very impressed by the willingness of our Vespa drivers to meet us in D2. Our teenage children declared it was the best day ever. The guide was informative and the drivers helpful and caring. A good start to our stay in HCMC. Recommended to others.

review_title: Thrilltastic, a middle aged lady's heaven!
review_text:
Found Steve's website, Vietnam Vespa tours on Trip advisor when first planning our Christmas holiday some months ago. I duly noted from others feedback that one didn't have to be either skinny or fully able bodied to be able to participate in these tours. Apart from my mobility issues, (I walk with a crutch having had both hips replaced), I also wanted to ascertain the night tour was suitable for my 15 year old son.

With Steve, the proprietor's email assistance, I chose the Vietnam City tour and Saigon by night tours to complement our 4 night stay in Saigon. I also enquired as to whether it would be possible to prepay the very fairly priced tours from the UK with Paypal, (which was my choice as I am poor at budgeting!) & Steve facilitated this too.

On the morning of our first tour the guys from the company were in reception at the appointed hour carrying a name board. We were joined by a charming duo of Australian businessmen keen to see a little of Saigon city before flying back to their families in Sydney for Christmas.

Dat, our tour guide was a charming chap with excellent English. He explained everything fully to the 5 of us and ensured we had enough time both at each stop but also that we were safe at all times and helmets were properly in position. Each driver was a gem and unfailingly helpful.
My poor driver had to ensure this his substantial, somewhat disabled passenger was in place each time we mounted/dismounted and had to carry my crutch with him too.
Quite seriously, nothing seemed too much trouble and I had a simply wonderful time.
I won't describe this tour in full as other Tripadvisor mavens are more adept than me in this respect but I muss add that riding in a crocodile of 5 through the tightly packed and very popular Saigon flower market on a aver spa must be one of the most amazing experiences of my 54 years on this planet!

Furthermore, Cafe Zoom where our took stopped for a spot of included lunch, post tour,(before being driven back to one's hotel), is an excellent and friendly venue in itself. The eastern and western dishes that our party ordered were all met with thumbs up for taste and appearance and the entire cafe is spotlessly clean, (including the loo).

Sadly I couldn't participate in the Saigon by night tour but my husband and son enjoyed this thoroughly too. They were met at the hotel in the evening by a lovely, Vietnamese lady called Yoo, again with superb English. They were then driven to Zoom where they joined up with a couple of German academics and a Swiss lady who was travelling alone. Everyone was asked about food allergies/preferences and then the group started its tour.

My husband and son said they had the most amazing time. Wonderful, always hygienic ally prepared and interesting Vietnamese street food, a visit to a night club and bar. An evening which they will both cherish.

In short, Steve's tours are BRILLIANT!

review_title: Worth every bit of it! Vroom for it!
review_text: To be very honest, I was a bit hesitant. I was on a shoe-string budget and the USD$79 seemed a bit on the high side. But boy am glad that I took the tour! It started with a lovely chat at around 6PM with co-travellers at Cafe Zoom, sipping on to some Saigon green and Huda while our tour guide made us extremely comfortable, she chatted with us, and assured that we were well served. After an hour or so, we hit the chaotic order that is Saigon traffic at the back of a vintage Vespa! We vroomed through the streets and on to the footpath and stopped at lovely places and sampled seafood, crabs, chicken, soups, famous Banh Xao, spring rolls, coffee shop and a pub as well and ended at around 11 PM. All this while, our guide ensures that she explains everything to us, how to savor a dish, what are the ingredients and if there's a story behind the dish. All in all a lovely experience, worth every bit of it! Very professional and I will recommend this to my friends for sure. Thanks guys!

review_title: Coolest thing I did in Saigon
review_text:
I went on the Saigon after Dark tour. Was an amazingly fun evening. From the beginning welcome drink(s) and meeting our guide, 'You', I knew it was going to be a fun night. Riding through the streets at night was a trip! My driver was smooth and safe. Stopped at 2 great local restaurants and 2 music clubs. Our guide was awesome, spoke great English, and had a personality bigger than the room.. but not overdone.. The only thing that I wish was different was that the first music club we went to was a quiet, almost romantic place where the locals were singing love songs.. some Vietnamese and some Western. The music was great, the drink was great but it was only myself, (male) and my another guy on the tour sitting there.... Sorry buddy.. just wasn't feeling it. haha. I really enjoyed the second club we went to.. ended up going back the next night.
The tour wasn't cheap, but was definitely worth it. I'd do it again in a heartbeat.

My husband and our two college-aged sons loved the tour of street food of Saigon. The drivers were safe, the food excellent and the entertainment value a definite highlight of our trip! Great way to sample lots of local food and see many parts of the city.

The erratic traffic conditions and swarms of motorbikes on every street and corner and the non stop horning from motorists we testified on our first 2 days didn't help calm our nerves for this Vespa adventure which was scheduled on our 3rd day in HCMC. We got nervous towards evening when our tour began at 6.00pm but there was no turning back. Our afraid disappeared very quickly because the drivers were all very friendly and careful. It drizzled midway to our first stop and they stopped the Vespas and offered us raincoats. I started to get worried when my husband on his Vespa did not show up at the first stop. Then, I was told that his Vespa broke down. Help came and my husband finally caught up with us. They did replace the Vespa but it broke down again but recovery was fast. The drivers could not communicate too much in English but there was an English speaking tour guide assigned to each group who will provide more details at each stop (4 stops - food followed by music). It was nice having the night breeze caressing our faces when the Vespa moved through the streets. HCMC is beautiful at night especially with the Christmas lights adorning the streets. We enjoyed the "hidden cafe" (3rd stop) and went back on our own to visit the next night. Local musicians - one plays the piano and the other the violin. Local singers with great voices. 4th stop (acoustics) was overcrowded on a Saturday night and the drink I ordered never came. Avoid the weekend tour to enjoy the full experience. Vespa tour was not cheap but the tour was a good experience of HCMC. My family including husband, 2 teenage daughters and 7 year old son all gave a thumbs up for this Vespa experience. Very creative way to let tourists discover Vietnam.

If you choose one tour when in Saigon, make it VVA's Saigon After Dark - it is amazing. Zipping around Saigon on vintage Vespasian, eating exceptional fare and locally, not in westernized cafes, watching uber-cool tunes at a secret music haunting, and finishing of with something more lively. Our guide had excellent English, didn't dominate the tour, which was refreshing. It may seem to be out of the price range of the backpacker/budget traveler, but due to what I did and treated myself to this tour. My daughter (21) and I rate this as a major highlight of our Vietnam adventure.

review_title: Saigon After Dark- WOW! Don't miss it!
review_text: After a month in Vietnam, Loas & Cambodia, this was the best way to end our trip! Others have described the details, suffice it to say, it was up there with the most fun things we've ever done. and we've had 6 decades to do them! Yes, we were reluctant, but once picked up all fear disappeared. Seeing parts of HCMC that westerners wouldn't see, eating in places you'd never find - delicious, fresh food, and hearing a mix of traditional, coffee house and rock music. No matter what your tastes, spending level or age, it's just the best!

Perfectly organised tour with nice guide and rivers.
It is like going out with a friend who knows the place not like only looking from a tourist point view.
We were 3 persons plus the guide. You find a lot of interesting food- it could also be a food tour in the beginning before going to a small life music cafe and after to a life music club.
The best we did in hcmc!

I loved this. Never been on a bike before so I was rather nervous, especially as the traffic in Saigon is wild!

It was just amazing. I was collected from my hotel and my driver was so lovely, safe and reassuring. We weaved in and about the traffic and I never felt worried. We ended up in bars and restaurants that we would never have found and it was fab!

I ate frogs legs - weird but had to be done. Not sure if I wanted to know that they were "bumped" off for me.. Went to a quiet, little music club with local singers but best of all ended up in a great rock club. Eric the singer from the Philippines was just great...I wanted to stay all night but would have had to get my own taxi home so was a good girl and went back on the back of my Vespa.

There was more than enough to drink and eat. So you need a good appetite, but don't be boring and drink coke !! Get the beer down your neck !!

Amazing trip - so do it!!

We were picked up at the front of our hostel and taken for a nice lunch at the Zoom Cafe, after which we commenced our tour. The drivers were friendly and helpful and our guide was great; very knowledgable and spoke excellent English. The vintage Vespas are heaps of fun and easy to hang on to in the hairy HCMC traffic. I would highly recommend a tour with this company!

Picked up right outside my hotel - the Rex - with both a guide and a driver, hoped straight on to the back of the Vespa and off we sped into the throng of Saigon traffic.
Weaving in and out of the traffic to make it to Chinatown, then through the flower markets, under the tunnel and out to District 2 - where by 2020 an extra 1.63 million people will live.
A wonderful adventure and if you have a spare 2 - 4 hours during your stay - definitely give this a go!

What an amazing way to experience Ho Chi Minh. We went on the Meekong and the Night tours and had the best time ever. If you are visiting Ho Chi Minh this is a must. The guides are very friendly and helpful, the food is amazing and the sights breathtaking. You have to do this, we can't wait to go back. Huge thanks to everyone

The Ho Chi Minh to Na Trang Vespa Tours for 7 days was one of the best things i've done. The guides we're extremely helpful and friendly. The bikes were great. It's the best way to see Vietnam. We were a group of 6 and had an amazing time. Every day just seems to get better and better. We had a little rain but it didn't ruin the experience. Well done to the owner, Steve, for a fabulous concept.
Trish

review_title: The best Vietnamese food on our trip
review_text: Fun, fun, fun all the way! Seeing the millions of motorbikes in Vietnam is an experience in itself…riding one completes it. It´s set up perfectly…they pick you up and you ride with an expert driver. Our guide took us to two restaurants set up on the sidewalk where we tasted snails, frogs, seafood…it was all delicious…and then rode to Banh Xeo where we had the best rice and coconut milk pancake ever, the spring rolls here will be hard to ever top. Save space for this meal because it is abundant. After eating they took us to a typical nightclub…where Vietnamese chill after work..and then to experience a live rock scene at a bar…things we probably would never have done on our own. We booked through our travel agency Trails of Indochina who provide serious and fantastic service. Absolutely worth it!

review_title: Night tour - The feel and food of Ho Chi Minh city
review_text: If you was a really good time adventure with the fun of immersing themselves in Hcm traffic, this is terrific fun. You do a bunch of stops with food or drink or both all included. As much as you want of everything. The guide was terrific, the drivers (your in the back of the Vespa) we're excellent and you just have fun. This is a must!

review_title: A fantastic way to see Saigon!
review_text:
I did three separate tours with VVA (the day city tour, the trip to the outskirts of the Mekong Delta and the night tour) and HIGHLY recommend them to anyone visiting Saigon. I was lucky to have the same driver (Tong) for all three tours. I had never really been on a motorbike before and he was always very careful and safe. My first tour was the Hidden Saigon city tour. I was the only guest on the tour (probably because it was pouring that day). The guide was incredibly informative and fun to chat with. Despite the rain, I really enjoyed seeing parts of the city that were lesser known to tourists. The tour concluded lunch at the VVA's Zoom Cafe before getting dropped back off at my hotel, which was pretty good. The following day, I did the Glimpse of the Mekong Delta tour with Dat, who was fantastic - knowledgeable, accommodating and very easy to talk to and ask questions. In addition to riding through the countryside, we visiting a couple of different villages, stopping for coffee and later to walk around and have a ridiculously good "snack" of bbq'd scallops and clams in a spicy lemongrass broth. As a heads-up, make sure you're properly covered in sunscreen (or bring a light sweater) as you don't notice your skin baking in the sun. The last tour I did was the night tour. This was my last night in Vietnam and it was a fantastic way to end my visit to this extraordinary country. There were 30+ people on the tour that night, but the group is broken down into smaller groups and is given their own guide, so you still feel like you're having a very personalized experience. Riding through the streets of Saigon was an incredible experience, as it gives you a whole new perspective on the city. We stopped at a seafood restaurant where we had several different (and super tasty) seafood dishes, including scallops and "jumping chicken" and then moved on to a place that served traditional shrimp and pork pancakes and different kinds of rolls, all of which were really good. From there it was on to a small, very hidden club with live acoustic music, which I really enjoyed. The night ended at a club/bar where there was also live music.

Thank you so much for such an incredible experience! My tours with you were some of the highlights of my trip!

This tour was the highlight of my trip to Ho Chi Min. They team was excellent and had everything ready from start to finish. We drove through the outskirts of the city and saw pieces of Vietnam you would never get to see from another tour. We stopped in a rice paddy, shrimp farm, small market, a wet market (w/ a shrimp auction), and a few roadside stands. We drove down dirt roads and took a ferry across the river. We got to sample food and drinks along the way at different locations. The owner, Steve, was on our tour as well as a group taking a weekly tour. Steve, an American, provided us some great insights into the area and his own experiences in Vietnam. Chan(?) and Dum were always assistant and provided me with their own take on matters. Local food and drinks were provided along the way with water available whenever needed. We finished the day at a great restaurant where we had some local food and a few beers.
The tour is not for the faint at heart. You can ride w/ someone or yourself on a Vespa or automatic motor scooter. You might have to drive in the rain. You will get a little dirty going down dirt roads and crossing into rice paddies. However, for someone wishing to see something completely different and experience a fun tour w/ a bit of excitement, I would highly recommend this tour.

This tour is the best tour I've ever done in HCMC. It shows you a side of HCMC which you would usually not be able to see: you drive in heavy traffic on the back of a super nice vespa which tours you around town and drops you off at local eateries which are safe to eat. The tour guides speak perfect English and check with you on your food and drinks needs continually. They have several tour options - but I loved the {Saigon after dark} the best, as its shows the best of Vietnam.

Don't miss this tour when you're in town!

What can you say... The tour was highly recommended and now I know why. We were picked up from the hotel by our riders and Vespas and taken to the cafe where we were greated with drinks and corn chips... Anything off the menu and as much as you want... We then set off for the official tour... 5 local places 3 with amazing local food and drinks worth it just for that and then 2 local bars all drinks included... Our guide was terrific she made you feel welcome and brought so much enthusiasm and cheer to the night she was fantastic our riders made us feel very safe and made the ride so enjoyable surrounded by a million other bikes on the street.... This tour is one of the best I've ever done and can't recommend it highly enough! It's a must do when in Saigon!!!!

review_title: Excellent first night in Saigon - tough to beat
review_text:
We booked the evening tour of street restaurants and bars. It was not cheap but it came highly recommended.

The scooter traffic in Saigon is amazing and horrendous at the same time - 9 million people on 6 million scooters. So I was a bit worried - but once you were on the back of one of these antique machines and a couple of beers had been put away, you really relaxed.

We were in a small group of 6, but I think they usually are quite small and we were all very social at the end of it.

A highlight for me was visiting a coffee bar where the guests volunteer and sing - so not karaoke, much more refined. Great insight into the Saigon nightlife.

I loved every moment and, if anything, it all ended too early.

We took the day tour for 3.5 hours on 17th November. The drivers were sweet and polite, very safe and considerate. They were absolutely punctual.
However the guide did not speak English properly. We have been in Vietnam and Cambodia for 8 days and have taken many tours. We know what level of English to expect. So this was disappointing. Furthermore he was extremely reluctant to talk (guides are supposed to talk - that's their job). We were only 4 people but he wouldn't wait to gather all 4 before speaking. So between his reluctance to talk, his bad accent and the traffic we hardly get any information.
The food at the cafe was very good.

review_title: Saigon by night on a Vespa - a must do experience
review_text:
What a fantastic way to see Saigon by night. From the moment my fiance and I sat on the back of our Vespas we were given the best tour of Saigon you could ever image. From the mayhem of traffic to trying out local foods to music venues to a private setting in a home listening to singers.
Our Vespa guides made us feel so safe, our tour guide made the trip and passed on his life experiences in this part of Vietnam

Our evening aboard the very cool looking antique vespas in Saigon was awesome! It exceeded our expectations at every turn. They were safe, the food was fantastic, the drivers were professionals, and our guide Dhou was the best! Everything, including all you want to drink or eat is included and it was both a cultural experience as well as an adventure. We really felt like we knew Saigon a bit better when we were through. Highly recommended for those seeking a bit of adventure!

We were on the Saigon by night. The previous night we tried to explore Saigon by ourself but didn't knew where to start in this kind of chaos city. To be honest, the price is very high, and if you do not drink that much as we do, they'll do a good business with you. However, I had rarly such a greath night and I would do it again without thinking twice! This is something I won't forget to soon.

We were recently on an Asia Cruise that stopped in Phu My -- a port 2 hours from Ho Chi Minh. We wanted to overnight in HCMC, and were trying to make arrangements to do so. Steve responded quickly and professionally. For medical reasons, we were unable to take the actual Vespa Tour, but his transportation arrangements were wonderfully done. The port is a challenge in that most taxis have to wait outside. Our group of 8 were apprehensive. Would our taxi be there? Would it be a reliable vehicle? Well-- Steve's arrangements were perfect. He takes pride in what he does. Highly recommended.

The best way to get a real feel for this fantastic city. We were picked up by our great drivers from our hotel and taken to cafe zoom where we met up with our guide and other members of our party. We then had an amazing night travelling through HCM, experiencing the buzz of the traffic and fantastic street food, with a wonderful guide and great company, finishing off the evening in the bar singing along with locals - brilliant. Worth every penny, an absolute must do when in HCM.

review_title: $ 166 for 2 pp and worth every penny
review_text:
This was one of the highlights of our trip. Nearly a full day tour to the Mekong Delta. XO Tours is a class A act and truly made it an authentic experience. From the moment we began our tour every detail was in place. We went to a shrimp farm and stop by two see two women owned businesses, we ate in authentic places and even bathroom options were considered along the way so we can be most comfortable. Water and meals were supplied.

Dat was our guide and he was incredible. He was knowledgeable and made the experience truly enjoyable. Yes this is an expensive tour and worth every penny.

review_title: A great way to see the city
review_text:
My parents, sister & I were in HCM for about 4 days. Knowing that there was so much to see in HCM, we thought that a motor bike tour was a great way to cover as much as possible. My sis & I initially wanted to book with the more popular bike tour. I wrote to the in-charge only to be told that the dates that were looking at were full. He recommended other tours & this was one of them.

On the Sunday, we were also recommended by expats at the church that we were visiting. We decided to call up to see if they were available. We were glad that the guy on the other end of the phone was so helpful. He even asked us to text our hotel address so that he could arrange for the pick up & texting back the confirmation very promptly.

The Saigon After Dark is a should-do for any one who loves food. It was basically a night food tour that combined eating, drinking with a brief tour around the city.

At about 6:15pm, we got picked up at our hotel by 4 chaps in their bright orange polo tee & their old school Vespas. Although it was my parents' first time on a motor bike, the Vespa was a comfortable way to introduce these basic mode of HCM's transportation to them. Although the price is quoted in USD, we were able to pay in VND at the Cafe Zoom which was our first stop. There, we were served drinks, tortilla chips & salsa. My mojito had a generous dose of alcohol. We also met up with our guide for the night whose name I can't quite remember. He was such a friendly guy who spoke good English & was able to answer our various touristy questions about the city.

Cafe Zoom had such an interesting decor using Vespa parts that I would definitely would love to have in my own home. Apart from being the home base for the Vespa tour, it was a cafe opened to anyone who wanted to soak in the atmosphere of the busy streets of HCM.

After our pre-dinner cocktails, we zipping through the evening traffic to dinner. We ended up somewhere in District 4 (I think) at a little restaurant along the road, after passing a street of local eateries. As our family were small eaters, we requested for smaller portions. We were treated to a variety of food from sea & land. This place deserves a review of its own.

After dinner, we were whisked away to another eatery which served the Vietnamese-style bánh xèo. This place was crowded when we got there which showed how popular it was. Apart from the bánh xèo, we were served Gỏi cuốn with prawns. We were also given the fried version of it. There was also a little grill where we grilled slices of beef to be rolled up with either fresh mustard leaves (which was slightly bitter) or lettuce. You can imagine how full we were by now but this was not the end of the feast!

Next stop was a silent cafe. We had to place our order before we left for the venue as were told to be silent in the place. Very mysterious. In fact, the cafe was located in some dark back alley with a fierce dog hiding in a make shift "cage". What I mistook for an entrance to the lavatory was in fact the door way up this dimly lit staircase which led to a unassuming wooden door which was the actual entrance to the cafe. The cafe was dark apart from flickering tealights & the spotlights shining on the guy singing to a full house.

Here we were treated to local arts students. Someone would be singing accompanied by other son their musical instruments. This was quite a rushed visit though. However we managed to listen to 3 songs by 2 different singers. The musicians were good. The ambiance was so chilled & so different to what I have known about live music to the point it felt slightly avant-garde. I was so impressed by the visit that I immediately raved to a friend who was in HCM for working half a year.

Just when we thought the night was over, we went to a local bar called Acoustic Bar that was packed to the brim with locals! The alcoholic drinks was super generous. My drink was pretty much 50% gin & 50% tonic water. It was so crowded that I could not even see the band.

The band belted out English songs which the tourists/expats sang along to & their rendition of Vietnamese hits that were greeted with loud cheers from the locals. After I managed to worm my way to the bar, I tiptoed & realised the band was mainly Caucasian men. I was impressed by their repertoire. We were there for about 15min before we left to head back to the hotel.

In conclusions, tt was worth the slightly expensive fee (by Vietnamese standard). However, it covered all expenses - food, drinks, dessert. This gives you a peace of mind to enjoy the night out. Go for it!

review_title: Best way to see the Mekong
review_text:
I'd heard some horror stories about the usual tourist mekong delta route so I was so happy when I tracked these guys down. Yes, it may be 10x more expensive than your usual tour but if you're fed up with the average excursion (I certainly was) then the extra money is worth every penny. Loved the scenery wizzing round on the bikes, very liberating and travelling on the back of a Vespa certainly ticks those 'Vietnam experience' boxes (with a bit of added style!).
Particularly loved our tour around the markets and getting to try some local seafood.
Be warned, you do need a strong backside for this journey - all in all you're in the back of the bike for around 6hrs.

Overall I would highly recommend this tour - fantastically organised, friendly, safe drivers, plus a nice little way to top up your tan.

review_title: You MUST try this, best thing ever!
review_text:
Wow, I have to say this really is one of THE best things we have ever done. We were staying with friends living in District 2 and they booked the night Vespa tour. 8 Vespa's arrived to pick us up and whisked us off to the first stop, which is their office & a bar! A couple of drinks and some nibbles later and we were off again. I won't go through the entire trip as you have to do it for yourselves but I will say, the beers flowed and the food, of which there was huge amounts, was absolutely delicious. Our 9 year old son has his go-pro on and we all loved it. You also get to visit the Hidden Cafe which is a gem, won't spoil that for you either.
I think we had the bonus of getting dropped home too as most other people were staying in the centre of town. I could have done it again the next night, brilliant. Our guide, that came with us throughout, was funny, smart and incredibly helpful. I can't spell her name but it is pronounced You, if you go request her, lovely lovely girl. Enjoy :-)

review_title: an experience not to be missed
review_text:
i lucked up on this when i met a darling german in singapore before headn to vietnam. he insisted that i HAD to do the vietnam vespa night tour. His other recommendations had been awesome so i trusted his advice. however when i arrived in saignon and saw the hoards of scooters whizzing by i realized i may not have the heart to hop on the back of some tour guide's bike and possibly die in some horrific traffic accident on vaca.
But after day two i got up the courage to do a day tour, figuring it was safer.
I am sooo happy i did because it was the best tour i have ever experienced anywhere in the world.
Our tour guide was knowledgeable and fun. We toured the major highlights then finished with a lunch at the owner's cafe {didn't realize that lunch was included in the price} after that fabulous experience we were sold on doing the night tour! That tour highlights the non tourist street pancake spot~ delicious!!! and two live music spots. the first was perfect for couples, it was an intimate/cramped {depending on your style} speakeasy with local jazzy vietnamese singers and the second spot, 'acoustic,' was a rock cover band spot, packed and smokey but tons of energy and fun. both were void of tourists : )
i highly recommend it!!! they have a variety of other tours also
definitely well worth the value

review_title: Fabulous two days of touring - what a way to experience Saigon & the Mekong Delta!
review_text: This was a fantastic tour experience! We were only in Vietnam for 2 days on a cruise stopover at Phu My port. Our small group ranged in age from 15 to almost 70. I pre booked transfer between port and Saigon and 2 day tours with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. A driver and van picked us up outside the Phu My port gates. Enjoyed the scenic drive into the city through the countryside. Van took us to Cafe Zoom which is the office for Vietnam Vespa Adventures. We had lunch included in the tour and then were paired up with our individual vespa motorbike drivers, helmets were strapped on everyone and away we went for the Insider’s Tour of Ho Chi Minh City by Vespa motorbike. What a terrific day...unanimously our group decided this is absolutely the best way to tour the city! Our female tour guide, Dieu, led the group through small alleyways and main streets, stopping at most of the key historical tourist attractions and the best was going through local flower and produce markets, a traditional medicine shop and wandering past the local homes and into Buddhist temples and pagodas. Dieu was very sweet and informative...a great guide and the motorbike drivers were amazing...navigating through the chaotic volumes of motorbike, vehicle and pedestrian traffic. They expertly wove us through the zigzagging traffic...so much fun! Even the more apprehensive of our group soon got over any fear and had a blast. At the end of the tour we were dropped at the Hotel that I had pre booked for our overnight stay in Saigon. The next morning our Vespa Adventure drivers were prompt and ready for us before the 0800 pickup time. They even called the office to request two additional drivers for another couple who had decided to join us for the Glimpse of Mekong Tour. Within minutes the extra drivers were there and we all headed off to the office at Cafe Zoom to store our overnight bags and meet our guide for the day. Our guide was Dat who we later found out is the boyfriend of our guide Dieu from yesterday. They were both very sweet, informative and enjoyable...great representatives for the company and their country! Our vespa drivers took us about 40 minutes beyond Saigon into the Can Giuoc area of the Mekong Delta countryside. We drove by local homes along roads that became progressively more rural and agricultural, eventually onto single width dirt trails. We crossed a short ferry and many bridges most of which were for motorbike or pedestrians only as we moved throughout the countryside over various water branches of the Mekong Delta. We had a stop to learn about the shrimp farms in the fields and a stop to wander the local shrimp market. Lots of photo ops in the market that included much more than shrimp...fish, eels, toads, beef, chicken, pig, every part of fish and meat including feet, intestines, all organs, brains, some parts unidentifiable, some parts all too identifiable and unmentionable.The market was filled with locals going about their daily shopping. We also made a stop at a local thatched home at the side of one of the dirt roads where the family ran a coffee shop. We were served iced coffee, hot green tea, iced tea and water alongside locals playing table games or napping in hammocks. Further along our route we stopped to try walking across a log bridge spanning a stream between rice fields and also had a stop to learn about incense making. We stopped at a lovely pagoda where a ceremony was underway. Dat was very informative at all stops and the tours for both days had no stops for shopping under pressure that are often included in standard organized tours....perfect! As we passed by or stopped at places, the locals were all smiling, welcoming and friendly. Our motorbike drivers were once again fantastic and very skilled. To conclude our tour we stopped at a lovely outdoor restaurant in the countryside before returning to Cafe Zoom for the van transfer back to the port. This was a very enjoyable two day experience that I would highly recommend.

review_title: How isn't this the #1 thing to do in Saigon?
review_text: My wife and I travel a fair amount and this is one of our favorite nights from any trip. I can't see a better way to spend a night in Saigon. Part of the scene of Saigon is the frenzied traffic that is largely made up of scooters and motorcycles. This tour allows you to experience all of the chaos of driving the streets of Saigon with none of the stress. Our drivers (we each rode on the back) picked us up at our hotels and eventually dropped us off there at the end of the night. In between we made 5 stops a local places. The first stop was for a drink where we met our guide for the night. The drivers are not the guides. The guide would greet and join us at each stop. Our guide was very friendly and knowledgeable and answered many different questions we had about Saigon. We stopped at two very local places for food that we probably would have found or stopped at on our own but we loved them and the guide explained each course. Then the last two stops were both musical entertainment which were both fantastic. Again they were places we would never have found. Each stop was great, and each time we got back on the scooters was a blast. I couldn't get the smile off my face as we zipped thru the city. We will do this again without a doubt when we make it back to Saigon.

review_title: If you only do 1 tour in Saigon...this is the one !
review_text:
I have participated in this tour twice now and still can not get enough of it. You will experience Saigon in a different perspective and when in Rom do as the Romans do...fits here.
The management of this company have thought of everything and I consider them one of the top notch Tour Operators. You get picked up, driven to the Zoom cafe have plenty of drinks and food all night long in all the various great spots and then get driven back to your Hotel filled with such an amazing experience you will never forget. The food is fantastic as you get to taste real street food places and it introduces you to the local fare and taste. You feel like a local driving through Saigon on the back of a beautiful and comfortable Vespa as your driver is well trained and cautious. We had Dep as our guide for the evening and learned loads about foods-customs-likes-and dislikes. She spoke english well and we could bombard her with all our questions which she patiently answered and explained. I organize tours in Vietnam and this tour definetely is included in my future itinerary. Well done adventure for everybody.

Myself and two friends had a fantastic night out with about 7 others riding on the back of a Vespa Scooter enjoying the food and lights of Siagon (as the people like to call their city). We had so much fun. The food, the beer, the guides, the people were just amazing. Wanted to do it all again the next day!!
Well done guys!!

review_title: Best way to see Ho Chi Minh and great fun!
review_text:
We did the morning tour that started of at 8 at Cafe Zoom. Excellent guide, friendly staff and careful drivers. It was great to zip around the city on the back of a Vespa! Stopped at all the main sights of Saigon and got to see some - off the beaten track - things as well. Our guide gave us lots of interesting information and was a very bubbly and entertaining person. We were a group of 8, ages ranging 10-50, but she kept us all entertained. Drivers were very responsible and friendly. Lunch at the cafe was very good!
Loved the -jealous- look on the faces of all the other tourists who travelled in coaches :))

I went on the "Glimpse of the Mekong with Cookery Class" tour. The guide, Lam, spoke excellent English and he was full of interesting facts about the Mekong Delta area and Vietnam's history. I was given the option to ride my own Vespa, and really enjoyed the experience. The sights we saw were fascinating and along with Lam's local knowledge it made for a very interesting day. The cookery class was well organised, and the food was very fresh having been bought from the local market earlier that day. All in all, an enjoyable day out with a professional, well-organised company, and for a very reasonable price ($119). Highly recommended!

We had a fun group of six with a great tour guide I went on the night tour which began at about 6 p.m. and lasted until 10:30 or so. We went to several restaurants and two really nice music venues, one a laid back coffee house setting and one an upbeat rock venue We rode on motorbikes with great leaders. It poured at one point during the ride. No problem. We pulled over, stopped, got out the rain slicker and continued on with a barely a raindrop to disturb us. You must go on this trip. It is just too much fun. Great food. Plus unlimited drinks and the Saigon beer is really good. Do it. You won't regret it.

review_title: Great way to feel like a local
review_text: I did one of the morning tours and was a fantastic tour and a great way to get around the city and see all the sights. Riding on back of a Vespa is a really great way to feel what it is like for the locals that zip around the city. But you don't have to have the stress about having to drive and navigate. The entire tour was professional from beginning to end. You are picked up from your accommodation by your driver for the day and then taken back to Zoom cafe to meet the others and your tour guide. From there you are out and about for 3.5 visiting the different sites around the city. Then it's back for Zoom Cafe for lunch with your choice of anything on the menu and it was delicious. You may think it maybe a little pricey but it is well worth it. If you have limited time in Saigon this is an excellent way to feel like you've experienced the city.

Great fun hopping from bar to local restaurant, street eats, local piano/violin cafe and night club on the back of vintage vespa around town. All the places you are unlikely to find on your own as a first time tourist to HCMC. Go with an empty tummy and an open heart and enjoy the ride!

A very professional company offering exellent tours with a true insight into Vietnam. Accomodating us all the way - from booking the trip at very late notice to my boyfriend's request to drive the Vespa himself - we were looked after impeccably and learnt a ton of new things along the way. Highly recommend this and will sing the praises to all my friends. Also wanted to mention that the drivers were skilled at negotiating the sometimes frightening roads in HCM. I felt safe at all times and the bikes are comfortable and very well looked after.

Our first day in Saigon and just had the 4 hour trip round the city on the back of a Vespa, expertly driven by Keung. Don't even think about driving yourself in this town. There seem to be no rules and it is a fantastic free for all. Somehow it works and it is great fun. We visited 8 local spots and were told about it all by the guide Liu.. The morning ended with a simple meal and drink and then we were driven back to our hotel. A most enjoyable morning.

A couple in our early sixties, we thought this might be fun to try and one way of getting around Ho Chi Minh City quickly and easily.
Well believe us, this was fun. We did two trips - Saigon After Dark - absolutely "Brilliant" and a great guide with very careful drivers.
The other trip we did was "A Glimpse of the Mekong" and this too was interesting, fun, educational, and a great way to meet people a get an authentic look at some peoples daily lives.
The staff at Vietnam Vespas were all very friendly and most helpful and I would recommend these trips to people of all ages.
Couldn't fault them.

review_title: The best way to see & experience the Mekong Delta.
review_text: We were blown away by our experience on the back of the Vespa's along the Mekong Delta. It was a great way to immerse ourselves in true Vietnamese culture. The drivers & our tour guide Dat kept us safe & well looked after every step of the 70 km way. Thank you for an amazing experience. Love Angela & Jackie

review_title: Great Vespa night tour of Ho Chi Minh
review_text: The night tour on the back of a Vespa was fabulous. These guys know how to do good customer service and you really get a good feel of the city zooming round on the back of a Vespa in the capable hands of a local - something you would not do yourself. The food experience was also great especially the the bbq'd mussels at the seafood street cafe. This tour is not to be missed when in Ho Chi Minh!

We were six older ladies doing Saigon by night and the city tour by day. Yu our guide took us to places other tours do no go to, drivers were excellent, it rained (bucketed down) at times, not to be deterred. The food tour at night again a great experience going to other districts off the beaten track. A couple of interesting night clubs. A must do.

You get an honest and extensive view of the city - both day and night. I can't recommend this enough. The people operating the tour was insightful, patient and graceful. The information was exciting a fun. This was the best thing I did in Asia!!! It is worth every penny you spend.

My boyfriend and I took 'Glimpse of the Mekong' and 'Saigon after Dark' in May 2013.
We had also completed a tour with 'Hoi An Motorbike Adventures' who I believe are affiliated and were also great.
Saigon After Dark was a fantastic way to experience local food and we were not short of options, some old favourites and some new experiences like clams and frog! We were also kept very satisfied in terms of drinks.
Glimpse of the Mekong was also great fun, we got to meet some local people and feel like we were really involved in the life. Unfortunately as it is only a 'glimpse' we didn't get to go too far into the Mekong, which is understandable.
Only other downside is it can get quite uncomfortable sitting on the vespas all day, but you do get plenty of breaks.

This was the best tour I did while in Ho Chi Minh City. I did the day tour through the city and even though it rained part of the time I still really enjoyed it! My guide was really knowledgable and took me all around the city so I got to see a little bit of everything. Would definitely recommend this tour service

This is the best thing to do when you visit Ho chi minh city is was an amazing experience a definite MUST do the drivers are fantastic you will see the city like no one else !!! :) LOVE LOVE LOVED IT :) :)

Just last night we took the saigon after dark tour and we had so much fun that we will never forget this wonderful experience. For sure we will reccommended to our friends as well. Vespa Adventures Staff organized everything perfectly, from the pick up in the hotel, through the ride while stopping for foods and drinks in 5 different places, timing is very well calculated, the adventurers do not feel under pressure like sometimes happens when you get organized tours. They even took care of small details such as rain coats and a small gift at the end of the tour. We had great local food, the mojito in zoom bar was really good, we visited places that otherwise we would have never visited, so hidden and kind of known only by the locals...Price for the tour is just right and we think everybody visiting Saigon should try it.GREAT EXPERIENCE!!! Thank you guys for everything!

If you want to make the most out of your time in Vietnam, you should definitely do a Vespa Tour. I had a fantastic time making my way across the Mekong Delta with my friends. The owners are lovely and make sure that you learn to ride safely. Once you are on the road, its easy and its a real scooter experience! We had a huge adventure, tasting food and seeing beautiful sights. Definitely a must do experience.

4 of us booked this tour by recommendation from a friend. They said it was a brilliant tour to do & they were right. We were picked up at our hotel & taken to our first destination where we were greeted warmly & given a run down on the tour, the tour was creative, informative & exciting for the whole night. You were given so much information about the food, culture & people. Everything was included in the price, all your alcohol & food was included & the drivers were so caring & made sure you were comfortable & safe all the time.
I would highly recommend this tour if you want to be in the real peak traffic of Siagon, it sure is something that you will never experience anywhere else, & eat some fantastic tasting food.
Was a great advernture & if you only do one thing while your there then do this tour

Having lived in Ho Chi minh for a year, this Vespa night tour is one of the best excursions we did, and we recommended it to all our friends that visited us. The bikes picked us up from our accommodation. The bikes were great, good condition and well restored. The drivers were competent and safe. Rain was threatening but they had all the necessary rainwear. The tour starts from the Vespa cafe, a great central spot for people watching that we have visited frequently. You are allocated a tour guide that rides on ahead and is waiting for you at each of the stops. The stops themselves were great, local restaurants with local food. Highlight was the "secret cafe" then topped of with pub and live music. Trip lasted 4-5 hrs, well worth the money.

We did both the 1/2 day tour and Saigon by night tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures, both I cannot recommend enough. We did not too much planning for visiting HCM city and both these tours gave us great insight into city surroundings and options to try and experience much of the city. The drivers are very safe, the food is fantastic (local and delicious) and the guide we had for both tours was great value/fun, and gave you a little more insight than the traditional guides, we also met other people on our tour which added to the enjoyment.
Cannot recommend this Company enough for any length of visit to HCM City!

We did the half day tour and saw places off the tourist trail that we would never have found. I was initially nervous on the vespa but soon began to enjoy it and by the end had a permanent grin on my face. I did not feel unsafe at any time and would urge everyone to give this tour a try.

It was a splendid ending to a brilliant holiday. I was a sole traveller and I was at a bit of a loose end on the last day of my holiday. I booked the tour the day before I was due to take it and I was picked up from my hotel the next morning.

Chau, my tour guide was knowledgeable and I got a real insight of life off the tourist trail. I was limited for time and the tour gave me a flavour of rural Vietnam; I just wished that I had seen more.

If you are prepared for a bit of sore bum and you want a see an alternative to the usual tourist hotspots then I would highly recommend this tour.

Go for it!

review_title: A Tale of Two Cities in one night
review_text:
If you're in HCMC and want to try a tour with a twist, Vietnam Vespa Adventures is for you. Forget the usual guided tours with commentary on a place's history. Our Saigon by Night tour was something totally different. It was fun, eye-opening and good value for money.
We met our guide Eric after two Vespa riders picked us up at our downtown hotel and we rode with them through the busy streets of HCMC and into winding lanes to meet him at our first restaurant. He was there with a couple of very nice Malaysian ladies who also joined the tour that night. A pleasant surprise was when we learned they were attending the same trade show as us in the city!
Our first taste of Vietnam was at a roadside restaurant known for snails and creepy crawlies. The frog and snail dishes we had were absolutely delicious. This tour is not for the squeamish as every dish was prepared live - meaning your dinner was still moving around in glass containers near your table when you ordered. The food was great, but even better was Eric's charm and his casual talk about Vietnam, her people and her culture. We learned a lot in one meal than from any guidebook we bought.
Our second stop was to eat Vietnamese stuffed pancakes and grilled beef. We rode to another district in HCMC. I think it was near Chinatown. Along the way, the light rain did not dampen our enjoyment of the city at night. I liked being in the middle of the action through rushing traffic and feeling like a local. The food we had again was great. Eric taught us the art of rolling soft spring rolls and other skills needed to fully enjoy a Vietnamese meal. Much fun.
Our third and fourth stops, for me. were a letdown and confusing. The third stop was a sort of 'underground' coffee place that you had to enter through a back alley and a dead quiet ground floor of a shophouse. You go up to the second floor and entered a somewhat dark and dimly lit quiet room where mainly couples were sitting and listening to a lady singer accompanied by a violin and piano. Everyone was taking in the soulful Vietnamese tunes sung by the talented singer with a solo candle lighting each table. Our group did not particularly enjoy this venue as it was an abrupt and surprising departure from the first two very exhilirating food experience. We could not continue the amusing conversation and our rapport within the four of us seemed to have been stalled. I mean, we could not even talk in this cinema atmosphere listening to music we could not understand and were sitting around playing with our mobile phones.
The fourth and final place was even more jarring. It was a disco packed with college students that was so crowded that again we had to go in a back way. This was like a disco in any town anywhere in the world. It was more of a place to be with close friends than to truly go and take in the dancing or the music. After awhile, it became uncomfortable. As with the coffee place, our group could not talk. While it was interesting to see how HCMC youths partied, we were standing around with cigarette smoke lingering in the air, people pushing past us to go to restrooms and thinking what we would do if there was a panic or a fire. Eventually we all agreed it was time to leave.
I think if Vespa Adventures would adjust the second half of the program to something else that allows a talented guy like Eric to show his stuff, then you would have the best night tour ever anywhere. As it was, our Saigon by Night tour was a memorable excursion into the other side of HCMC that few foreign visitors get to see. I recommend the tour to those with a sense of city adventure in more ways than you can initially imagine.
Four Kiwis had a great half day in Saigon, scooting around some less well known sites, with fabulous drivers. Our guide was very knowledgable, and loads of fun.

For two oldies in their late 50's, we had an awesome day out and about the back blocks of the Mekong Delta on the Mekong Glimpses tour. My husband had never been on a bike so I was hesitant to sign him up for an initiation with Ho Chi Minh City traffic! However the drivers were skilled in local conditions and moved through the traffic with us on pillion with ease. With a start and finish at our hotel, we basically had to sit back and relax. Well, not quite, as there were some very bumpy roads and tracks, and a few ferry crossings as well. However, I never once felt other than confident with my driver (Hieu). It was fantastic to meander through the countryside, wend through the markets and villages, and get a more personal perspective. With water, a snack in a market, and lunch included, I felt the cost was money well spent, and would definitely recommend to any of my friends coming to HCMC to sign up. The trip was about 6 hours in total (8 til 2)

What an amazing experience! We booked The Insider’s Saigon tour and we found it to be very good.

If you live in Asia,the riding experience is more the center of attraction than the places we visit (if you do, it is same same but different as our lovely guide mentioned)

If you never lived in Asia, you will get the riding experience and the thrill of uncommon place (the food market especially).

You will visit a park where people bring their birds to practice singing while they have coffee, you will see the corner where Thich Quang Duc burnt himself to death (and the corresponding monuments), China town, a traditional market (flowers and food), a traditional medicine shop (star fish is good for you), a pretty cool pagoda (I now know the difference between a Pagoda and a temple), and more traditional landmarks.

Our guide was awesome, full of energy and very knowledgeable. the drivers were steady and reassuring while in the chaotic yet smooth traffic

review_title: A fun way to explore the Mekong Delta
review_text: Riding through narrow market walkways, the scenic countryside of the Mekong Delta, and the chaotic road traffic in the “quieter” parts of Saigon, was certainly an adventure! It was good to get a closer look at local life and see this part of the country in more of a local way. A downpour of torrential rain put a bit of a dampner on our day, leaving us back at our hotel looking like drowned rats. But it was a fun day for us nonetheless. We did this tour in addition to a car tour to a different part of the Mekong run by …… and thought both tours worth doing. If you don’t have time, and have an adventurous spirit, go for the vespas.

One of the best tours I've ever done. The only way to see Saigon at night. You get right out in the local areas and dine with them, visit a silent bar and then finish up with a live music venue. AWESOME !!

What a great night! We joined the Saigon After Dark tour and highly recommend it. We had a blast! The bikes are great--beautifully restored 1960's Vespas with the most superb drivers. The first stop was Zoom Cafe, where we met Steve, the founder of the company and our guide, Dieu. She is amazing--so much energy, a font of knowledge, and just a lot of fun to be around. The traffic in Saigon--and throughout Vietnam, for that matter--is something to behold. Driving around on the back of a motorbike gave us a perfect introduction to navigation techniques! The city is beautiful at night, and the places where we ate were ones we would never have found on our own, nor, for that matter, would we have known what to order. The seafood restaurant, our first stop, was delicious. The highlight was the "secret bar," which fully lived up to its name. The musicians we heard there were fantastic. A must-do in Saigon!

We are a 50++ couple. I have never been on a scooter and the idea of riding through peak hour in HCMC on the back of one is not something I would normally even contemplate, let alone do. On the strength of TA reviews I decided we would risk it! Wow what a good decision. This is an awesome tour. Our drivers Dung and Cuong effortlessly drove us through the wildly busy streets and at no time did I feel the slightest bit concerned for our safety. The effervescent Yu was the quintessential guide explaining the food and culture in an entertaining and informative way. We were extremely lucky to have two other lovely fellow travellers and as Yu said we felt like a family. The food is great, you will not be hungry. The entertainment is superb, particularly the Silent bar. A small word of caution, if you don't like smokey loud rock bars the last venue may not be entirely to your liking. That said, we loved it even with the smoke and noise it was a different side of Saigon you would not normally experience.
I thoroughly recommend this tour it is brilliant

We went on the Vespa Saigon after dark tour and it was an absolute blast!!! We loved every minute. Our tour guide Yiu was amazing and we were taken to local eating spots. We tried frogs snails and the most divine Vietnamese cuisine. This is a must do in Saigon!!

We did the Mekong tour with cooking class. The day was 8.5 hours long, with a good portion spent on the back of the Vespa...which was great, but simultaneously exhausting! The cooking class was lots of fun with ample food and drink. It was also great to ride on some of the narrow roads that are not accessible via bus or boat. These routes allowed us to see firsthand how people in this region live.

I was lucky enough to be paired with our lovely tour guide, who spoke English allowing me to ask questions as we travelled. However, none of the other drivers spoke any English, which I thought was a pity and is probably one of the reasons why XO tours rates a tad higher on Trip Advisor. The other people on the tour could ask away at the many stops along the way (prawn farm, coffee shops, incense maker, temple, etc.). In any case, it's such a minor point and one that didn't affect me anyway.

All in all, it was a really fun day and is very much recommended.

We booked the Wartime Memories tour and it really made us gain a better appreciation of Saigon and Vietnam. Our guide, Dat, was friendly and fluent, and the tour itself gave us a look at the parts of Saigon that you won't see in regular city tours (i.e. the location of the former secret CIA office, the church where the former South Vietnam president hid before he was arrested and assassinated, etc. etc.), as well as common tourist attractions such as the post office and Notre Dame. Sadly, we only had so much time during our visit, or we would have taken the Saigon at Night tour as well. Maybe next time!

Having seen the traffic in Saigon for the first time (I've never been to Vietnam or Asia in general before), I was a bit afraid of taking a four hour trip on the backseat of a vespa. I stood corrected - I didn't feel stress or danger at all. The drivers and the tour guide were friendly, and the guide spoke fluent english. The tour was well organized, definitely worth the time an money.

At first I was skeptical as it carries a higher price tag than just renting a driver for the day, but this tour was 100% worth it. We did the Saigon at Night tour. The restaurants and bars were really unique and "local" places we never would have found otherwise. Additionally, the management is great. I made a schedule mistake but they were able to accommodate me the day of the tour with no hassle. Much thanks to them for making our trip to Saigon a blast! I would definitely do again if I came back.

Travelling solo can be such a bore with so many activities geared to couples and families. On this great tour I was lucky to be included with a lovely family who were very welcoming and friendly, which made the day perfect! The tour was very well organised, and there were lots of options for riding solo or pillion, Vintage Vespa or auto scooter, so everyone was happy.

It really is a must do, as they take you to the non-touristy part of the Mekong, through villages and on local ferries. One highlight is the chorus of local children calling hello as you pass, make sure you wave back - they love it.

Hint: wear long sleeves (or take along lots of sunscreen) and a collared shirt. The cooling breeze as you whizz along on your Vespa is deceptive and it's not until later you realise you are burnt to a crisp.

Great day, thanks so much to Vietnam Vespas and the Kellys!

Thanks to Vietnam Vespa Adventures I had the opportunity to live one of the best experience in my life!!! You can't leave Saigon without attending almost twice of those amazing tours.
My preferred are Saigon After Dark and A Glimps of The Mekong.
Don't forget the chance to see the real Vietnam, less touristic and more real.
The staff is great. All the people are very enthusiastic and passionate about their job, their country and their culture.
Seating on the backside of a Vespa is the best way to taste Saigon and its neighborhood.
The drivers are really good, and you will enjoy every second of your trip.
Forever in my heart, Saigon and Vietnam Vespa Adventures.
Highly Highly Recommended!!!!

review_title: A great experience, not only for a Vespa-Fan
review_text: We booked the Glimpse of Mekong tour because we love old Vespas and wondered how it would be to drive one in Vietnam. Not only did we experience that, we were taken to places around Ho Chi Minh where you would never get to on your own. Dat was the perfect guide, giving us a lot of information on the habits, food and living of the Vitnamese. They take you to a local market, into the ricefields and to a temple. It is worth every dollar.

My husband and I were treated to a fantastic day trip seeing many sites and being well looked after by our tour guides. Steve said that we would have an adventure and we surely did and can't recommend Vietnam Vespas high enough to get around and see the sites of Ho Chi Minh and the Meekong delta.
We always felt safe, saw sights that not every tour group would get to see and all of the extras on top, like snacks at a village market and lunch were spot on. Even the drenching didn't put us off and just added to the adventure.
Thank you Vietnam Vespas, you certainly made our holiday to your wonderful country the best.

review_title: This is a real experience of street food and life in the city.
review_text: Thoroughly enjoyed our evening. Felt safe on the back of the Vespa winding our way through the busy streets of HCMCity. Our guide showed us how to eat the food and told/showed us how it was cooked. Finished off in a tiny jazz type club well off the beaten track then finally in Yokos for a cocktail. Well worth booking this trip.

review_title: Exciting and fun (with a dash of hair-raising)
review_text:
We booked this because we had such a good time on a similar tour in Hoi An and were offered a discount because of this (not the fact we had a good time, but because the Hoi An crew knows the Saigon crew).

We did the night tour but during the day it bucketed a crazy amount of rain so we sent a cancellation email at 2pm (it starts at 6pm) thinking that we didn't really want to participate due to the weather being pretty savage.

By 5:30pm it cleared up to just the odd drizzle which was a shame. So I don't know whether it's good or bad that the drivers arrived at our hotel at 6pm expecting us to come down. I guess they didn't get our cancellation email, but then again, the weather cleared up - so ok - let's go then.

We were greeted by warms smiles, two riders and two helmets for us.

After a minor incident with one of our Vespas (which was quickly rectified) we were on our way zooming through the streets, looking at shops, people, traffic and many many other bikes! We stopped at several food places which to be honest, we would have never visited on our own. We were gently encouraged to try some of the local foods and it was done in a way that gave you confidence and knowledge to have a go if you wanted to. Tried some amazing stuff which we would probably never have ordered. That's one of the highlights, encouraging you to not only see things you normally wouldn't, but to try little bits of food you probably wouldn't.

We saw a small lounge band which was great, then onto a slightly bigger club with a larger rock band. Each stop was long enough to get a taste of the atmosphere, food and people. Our guide was always extremely forthcoming with information, explanations and a few jokes.

We were dropped back to our hotel at 10:30ish and really had a great night. It did rain a little for one stint but we were fitted with a rain coat to keep us dry.

It's an exciting tour in regards to being on the back of a vespa in heavy traffic and, on occasion, wet roads. But the boys know what they're doing and the tour is great for foodies and explorers. We were fed enough food and drinks that we had to start turning some down. You won't go hungry.

This was our best night out in Vietnam. Highly recommend this. We went on the night tour of Saigon. We ate at some awesome restaurants along the way, ones we wouldn't normally have gone to. Our drivers were all great. Cannot recommend this enough. The experience was amazing! Would do it again in a heartbeat....

We were recommended to take this night tour of Saigon, it turned out to the best tour of our trip,the pleases we visited all showed us a Saigon I never knew existed each new place was another highlight. The next night we revisited two of the clubs great music great atmosphere.
Take the tour you will not be disappointed, our Tour guide Tuyen was excellent. Just a great tour.

Of the 3 weeks my husband and I spent in Vietnam traveling from North to South, this adventure was an absolute highlight of the trip. We did the evening tour and had 2 wonderful drivers and a lovely young lady, Truyen as our guide.Being over 50 was not an impediment to us enjoying this evening.The food, the places we visited and just being surrounded by the Saigon traffic was totally amazing. We felt completely safe at all times and have since recommended this experience to friends of the same age group to include in their Vietnam adventure.

Glimpses of Meekong (1/8/13).
Family of two adults & 2 kids (boy 15, girl 12). Dad & son rode and girls pillion to guides at same prices. Vespa's easy to handle and easy to learn clutch/gears. The sights awesome and unlikely to see them any other way. Food along the way included in price and superb. Seems expensive until you have done it, then it's worth every cent then some. My wife usually a nervous wreck about anything and she loved it, felt safe and wanted to do the
night tour this evening. (A bit much). When you see the traffic and how the bikes ride it is mind blowing and this tour gets you safely amongst it.
I strongly recommend this tour with these guys who do everything for you with a smile.

Well worth doing. This is from someone who usually thinks he can find his own way around. We were taken to places we would never have found or even though to look.. highly recommend ...we will do again when we are here without hesitation

At first I was a little nervous, but all that soon faded. I felt very comfortable and at ease with my experienced driver. Our guide was excellent. Had wonderful food, some things we had never tried before, great entertainment and excellent company. Definitely will book another tour.

What a fantastic night. Great experience. Go on an empty stomach. So much food and the food was delicious. Probably places you would not pick to visit but so worth it, from seafoods thru to Vietnamese pancakes to ice creams. From the silent cafe to Yokos bar, places you would never find on your own. Overall an amazing experience. The drivers were great and our guide was excellent overall an absolute ball, something not to be missed!!

review_title: The best thing we did in Vietnam
review_text: I booked this from home and was initially excited as it sounded fun and I thought our teenagers would really enjoy it. Then my friend said that she thought I was crazy to think of doing this because of the chaos on the roads so we very nearly pulled out of the trip. Fortunately we didn't as this was so much fun, we had a ball. Our guide was Tuyen and she was perfect, her English was great and she was there to show us a good time. There were plenty of drinks and the food was great, she took us to places that we would have never seen ourselves. The 4 drivers were fantastic and I never ever felt unsafe, it was great zooming through the streets. To see Saigon at night like this was something I will always remember. Thank you Tuyen and thanks to our drivers also :)

We did two tours and had a blast! The day tour of Saigon started with a pick up at our hotel to Zoom Cafe and then we went to see the highlights of Saigon. Tour guide was awesome, Dat! Afterwards we returned to Zoom for a fantastic meal!

We then did night tour to experience the street food and bars! Food was awesome and a great experience!

We did 2 tours with Vietnam Vespa Adventures - Insider's Saigon and Saigon by Night. The highlight of our trip was our vespa tours. Outstanding service and truly just an amazing experience.
