I'd highly suggest the Saigon by night! You won't regret it.

I know it seems on the slightly higher side in terms of price, but it is well worth it considering the service, the friendly tour guides and just the overall experience!

I can't praise this organisation highly enough. We loved everything about them. Our family of 4 did 2 tours: Saigon After Dark and Insider's Saigon. Both were excellent - the Saigon After Dark tour in particular was a great way to experience aspects of Saigon that we would have simply missed. Incredible street food and two very contrasting music venues. Whizzing around the streets of Saigon at night on a Vespa was just the best fun. The guide was friendly, knowledgeable and professional and all of the drivers were extremely competent. Vietnam is an amazing country with lots of natural highlights but this was right up there amongst them. Fab!

Cannot praise this tour highly enough. Initial concerns about riding pillion completely disappeared. Traffic in Saigon is unbelievable especially the number of motorbikes but my driver never made me feel anything other than confident. Did this tour with my husband and sons aged 16 and 21. Picked up at our hotel and rode to their cafe. Over drinks we were told what we were going to do. Drove round districts 1 and 4, it is a great way to see the city. Stopped at roadside restaurant and ate delicious seafood. Our guide spoke first class English and was very engaging. Then on to another which made large savoury pancakes. So much delicious food! Then to a completely out of the way club with singers. Drank Vietnamese coffee which was rather like a thick syrup! Then on to club with live band, drank cocktails and beer. Tour took about 4 and a half hours in total before being dropped back at our hotel. Thoroughly enjoyed by us all.

I'm just back to my hotel after spending a fabulous afternoon with the Vespa adventures crew.

I was collected from my hotel at the agreed time & then taken to Zoom Cafe where I had cashew chicken & a freshly squeezed pineapple juice for lunch - yum!! My tour guide then went through our plans for the afternoon and was accommodating and friendly when I asked if they could be changed as I'd seen the cathedral & post office on my early morning wanderings already.

Our first stop was a pagoda and I was very impressed with the amount of history and knowledge the guide had - I asked lots of questions throughout the tour and they were always met with a friendly response. I feel like I got to know a lot more about the people and culture of the city on the tour. Many more stops and departing from the schedule I asked if I could end the tour at the war remnants museum which was accommodated.

This is the first tour I've done in Vietnam and I'm hoping the rest live up to the standards set by today!!

review_title: Feel the spirit of this bustling city- Saigon After Dark
review_text:
We couldn't say enough about this memorable night out in Saigon. Our friends recommended this company after they had a blast on the Mekong Delta tour earlier this year. After reading the amazing reviews on Tripadvisor, we were confident it would be well worth it.

I was hesitant regarding attire but on seeing the Vespas, I could see the evening would be spent on a gorgeous shiny Vespa with a backrest. Very comfortable and stylish way to see the city. We met up with the rest of our group at Cafe Zoom and off we went.

We had a great group and our guide (Dieu- I think this was her name! I'm sorry if I get this wrong) who was a spunky, personable and fun HCMC native made the night even more memorable.

We had 4 stops in all. Plenty of food in the first 2 locations (to get to the first stop, we crossed a bridge over the river which was magical with the city lights) then a cafe for the third and finally a modern bar which had a decent cover band for the final stop. From this point, the drivers can return you to the hotel but we were all having such a brilliant evening, we decided to stay out and experience more of this bustling city with our group.

Now, the price we thought was a little on the pricey side but the experience was well worth it. We felt safe and in good hands on the Vespas and the drivers fitted us with helmets before starting every leg of the trip. If you are looking for quality and willing to pay for peace of mind, I highly recommend it.

This tour was undoubtedly the highlight of our Saigon trip. (bring a big appetite and your sense of adventure!)

review_title: Wartime Memories and Mekong Delta cooking class tour - TERRIFIC!
review_text: My family (5 of us - wife, 3 adult children (22, 20, 17 years of age) and I) did the 4 hour Wartime Memories tour with Walter, an Australian Vietnam war veteran living in Vietnam. What a fantastic tour!!!! Walter took us to the various places of interest relating to the Vietnamese struggle from 1945 - 1975 including the locations where particular iconic photos were taken at that time. It was hugely informative and complemented by Walter's own personal experiences and photos he had on his ipad that was brought out at each location to help us get a deeper understanding of what it looked like in the 40s, 50, 60s, 70s compared to now. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who has an interest in the French/American involvement in Vietnam and the politics behind it. A big thank you to Walter and the team of drivers - and the staff at Cafe Zoom of course. On the basis of the War Memories tour we also did the 7 hour Mekong Delta Glimpse with Cooking Class tour a couple of days later - another great tour and a big thanks to Dat and Yue (excuse the spelling!!) for their leadership through the day. It was a fairly long trip out to the Mekong Delta area and back but great fun on the back of the vespas and enough stops along the way to break up the trip. We had two other families in the tour group with kids ranging from about 8/9 up to mid teens and it was no problem at all for them. The stops along the way were interesting, local shrimp farms, incense stick makers, temple, etc and topped off with the actual cooking class (including shopping in a local market - all the bits and pieces you'd expect to see in a local country Vietnamese market!!!!!!!!) which was a lot of fun - not to complicated, tasty and included a few beers/softdrinks. What made the trip interesting was going along the back roads (I mean back roads - only wide enough for vespas or on foot) using the local ferries and seeing some of the local countryside just outside of Saigon. The tour leaders were informative, attentive to our needs and the team of drivers were great as well - always conscious of our safety and comfort.

After our first choice had been booked out we chose this tour as our second option. We were looking for a 'foodies' tour in Saigon but this promised a little bit extra. The night was raining and we thought it would be called off but no. We had a terrific night, we were kept safe and dry, Steve and his helpers did a fantastic job, we ate some great food especially the 'jumping chicken' (!!) and the entertainment at the end of the night was amazing. Fully recommended !

Amazing after dark tour that immerses you into local life. Sitting on the back of a Vespa in peak hour traffic, you feel like a local. Each of the street food restaurants were authentic and the food delicious. The highlight was definitely the "secret" coffee shop. Hidden away in the back streets of a beautiful old building we entered the darken room to the sound of a 3 piece Vietnamese French style jazz band. The music, the place just took you back to another era. This is definitely a must do.

We had the most amazing day out with Vespa Adventures - such fun and a great way to see places in Saigon that you wouldn't probably even find by yourself. I must admit to behing a little aprehensive after seeing the 'organised chaos' traffic, especially having never been on a Vespa or any other two wheeled motorised vehicle!

You could not be in safer hands and if I felt comfortable, then anyone would! We had a really great guide called Dieu who was very informative and had a great sense of humour too - she was great!

If there are any particular sites that you are interested in seeing, you can tell the guide who take you and they will tailor the tour to suit you.

Our only regret was not having time to do the night time tour - oh, and the beer and food at the Zoom Bar is also excellent! Thoroughly recommend.

review_title: Saigon after dark tour - Vietnam Vespa adventures
review_text: I joined Vietnam Vespa Adventures for their Saigon after Dark tour - what a blast. I had the most fun of almost my entire trip in Asia on this tour. The tour came very highly recommended by a friend who lives and works in HCMC, and though this was her 3rd time she joined me. The food is great, the guide is wonderful, and the whole evening - riding around HCMC on the back of antique Vespa, leaves you feeling connected with the city. A real pleasure.

review_title: Great way to spend half a day!
review_text:
What a wonderful way to spend half a day, (although I could have happily gone the whole day!), zipping through the city streets of Saigon, riding pillion behind an expert driver, stopping at sights, often off the beaten track, chatting to our wonderful, friendly guide, and finishing up with a good lunch. A perfect morning!

First thoughts were that this is completely over priced at US$59 each, but then after reading all the reviews on Trip Adviser, there was obviously something that made everyone before us so happy, and as a disabled traveller, good reviews for me are tantamount to instilling enough confidence to make initial contact. So, contact I did, before we left on our trip. I heard back from Steve, the founder, almost immediately, and after a couple of emails back and forth I felt confident enough that I could get a) get on a Vespa b) stay on a Vespa and c) that the tour could be modified enough so I didn't need to do too much walking. We paid our $30 deposit, through Paypal, (I actually felt a bit uneasy doing this bit, as it done through a link in an email, rather than through their main site), and hoped for the best...!

6 weeks later, on the day of our tour, our 2 drivers arrive at our hotel perfectly on time at 8am, and lead us to our bikes; beautifully reconditioned Vespas from the 50s - very stylish! Our drivers fit our helmets on us, and I am helped carefully into my seat. This sets the scene for the rest of the morning, as I am helped on and off the bike at each stop, with patience and care, with my helmet removed and refitted when necessary. I didn't need to worry at all about safety - with these guys, safety and comfort were their number one priority. For me, this is a deal breaker. I never at any point felt unsafe, or uncomfortable. My husband took my walking stick, just so that I only had to concentrate on holding on, but to be honest, I would have managed fine. The Vespas are exactly the right height too for me to slide on and off, so getting in position for riding was easy enough.

We were taken to Cafe Zoom first, which is the meeting point for the Vespa adventures. Our guide for the day came and introduced herself, and gave us a detailed outline for the day. She then asked me about my walking, (as I had my walking stick). At this point I felt a little unsure, as it appeared that my discussions with Steve, prior to our trip had not been passed on, and this worried me slightly. She then asked me for a detailed history of my illness / disability so that she could tailor the tour for my needs. She very quickly presented an altered plan which would enable us to still see enough, but would limit greatly the amount of walking I would need to do. I quickly felt reassured and relaxed again. She put us completely as ease.

We were then off on our trip, which covered the following sites, (separate reviews written for the sites that we stopped off at):

Tao Dan Park, District 1
Thich Quang Duc Monument, District 3
Ho Thi Ky Flower Market, District 10
Ong Bon Temple, District 5
Traditional Medicine shop, District 5
Van Phat Pagoda, District 5
District 2, view over Saigon River
Reunification Palace, District 1
Notre Dame Catherdral, District 1
Saigon Post Office, District 1

Wow, all of this in only half a day! This tour just fits in so much, and so many unusual sites, off the beaten track. We also passed through, as examples, the fish market, the fabric markets, the cigarette markets, the Chinese lantern markets .... So much to see, that you would never get to see on a normal tour bus.

Our guide was lovely and her English was excellent! She was so chatty, it actually felt like you were talking with a friend, rather than a guide, so we definitely felt like we learnt so much more than we have from other tours. She gave us so much of an insight into the history of the sites, the country, the people and the way of living, and all in a funny and entertaining way.

At the end of the tour we were taken back to Cafe Zoom for our lunch, (which was included in the price. You get 1 drink and 1 meal. Unfortunately, I wanted a ham sandwich, and they didn't have any ham, but as this was the only bad thing I have to say about our morning, then ... Oh, that and they'd run out of the free maps, which was a shame as it would have been good to take down our route. Our guide however, went an extra step, and wrote down a list of every single one of our stops for us, and the addresses, so that I had this to refer back to for my writing. Thank you for this!

So, in summary, yes, a little on the expensive side, but definitely worth every $. An excellent way to spend half a day, we loved every minute of it, felt completely safe and comfortable, learnt so much, and made some friends! Highly recommended!

I had done another city tour and not that it was bad but no comparison to the vespa tour! I, also had done a 3 day tour of the Mekong Delta and being shuttled from one bus to another, it was just average at best. After 6 days this was the last thing I did, and I am so glad I did! Just being on the back and zipping through traffic is just fun! You really feel like your part of the city being on a motorbike. The destinations were off the beaten path and our tour guide was a wealth of information. It was well worth it! I would recommend to anyone!

I cannot imagine a better way to see all the different neighborhoods of the city than the night tour offered by Vespa Adventures. In addition to that, you get to hang out with other interesting and adventurous tourists, to eat great local food, and to listen to amazing live music. Oh, and Steve, the owner of the company, is great!
Amazing way to see saigon great guide, Food and drivers. A true authentic Vietnam city experience Getting amongst the locals Street food, hidden Coffee shop and bar. Good to do when first arrive.

review_title: Mekong Delta Tour a mystical and wonderful experience
review_text:
Don't even think twice about NOT doing this tour - it's inspiring, humbling and delightful. What a wonderful day of adrenaline, insight, sensory overload and education. You'll see so much of Vietnam in such a small amount of time. THe scooters are brilliant, the drivers are amazing and the experience of seeing 'out of town' landscapes, people and places will stay in your heart and memory forever.

From tasting local food in a remote market, to jostling through Saigon traffic and meeting locals in their daily life, this is such a great way to enjoy a thrilling day learning and absorbing life in this sensational country.

We had just a couple days in Saigon and this was the perfect way to spend one of them. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable, the scooters were in good condition (both the 50 year old vespas and automatic Hondas), the route was interesting and beautiful, and we really got off beaten track. We stopped at a town square market for clams and scallops, watched the seafood traders and saw a family who makes rice wine. We had so much fun and highly recommend this company!

review_title: The best thing I did in Vietnam
review_text: This was a lot of fun, and one of the best things I've done in Vietnam. It is an excellent way to get around Saigon and to feel a part of everything that's going on. My friends and I did the night time tour; they picked us up at our accommodation on scooters around 6pm, and for the rest of the night drove us to some great restaurants and bars, places off the main streets that we never would have found on our own. Our guide, Dat, was really great and knowledgeable. Nothing like scootering around in the Saigon heat at night! Very memorable.

The Saigon by Night tour was the most fun! Felt very safe on the Vespas. Great to experience the bustling traffic and visit many areas around the real Saigon and experience some wonderful food. One of the best tours we've done and highly recommended.

this was our favourite outing in all of Viet Nam. There are 3 million motorcycles in the country so this was quite the experience. We even went to a small cosy club with young people who sang romantic songs with piano accompaniment - we need to have more of that in Canada instead of our stereos! The one bad issue is the food - don't get me wrong, the food at the places we were taken was spectacular, however, you really can't trust the water in Saigon and thus you can't be sure the ice cubes, or the washed lettuce etc are clean. In fact, my wife paid the price the next day. So if you do this, and I recommend you do!!!, be awfully careful about the food you're being offered.

review_title: The best way to see Saigon!
review_text:
I have been living in Saigon for a few years and I'm so happy to have found out about this Vespa Tour. It is the perfect way to show someone all Saigon has to offer. The drivers are safe and we were treated like V.I.P. at every stop.
The tour guide spoke English well and I was really impressed at the places we were brought to. One sidewalk seafood place was amazing, clams and crab so fresh you could see them move before they cooked them. I've been here a while and this tour really picks the hidden gems left behind in tour guides. One stop was a very famous Ban Xao (Vietnamese pancake) restaurant and another was a cafe known for discovering Vietnamese singers. I never knew where it was located and I consider myself a local! Overall, worth every penny for a really fun and well done tour! Plus you are guaranteed a table so I'll probably do this tour again on a date just to have a hassle, stress free plan in place. Finally, I had no idea how much fun it is to be on a Vespa! Really fun people and places. I highly recommend this tour!

I just had a couple of days free on my hands during my business trip in Ho chi Minh and I booked this tour when i stumbled upon it and read the reviews. It was absolutely brilliant and the Insiders guide to Saigon was perhaps the best way of going around the city. What was fun was the fact that it was on a vespa. My guide was lovely and extremely accommodating. I was taken to nooks and cranies of the city and got to see stuff that a tourist doesn't necessarily get a chance to see. I highly recommend this to anyone who wishes to see HCM. If i had more time, I would have gone on the night tour as well.

I was in HCMC for only a couple of days, so wanted to make the most of it. Tearing around on a Vespa definitely fulfilled that brief.

I'd already seen a couple of the attractions so my guide asked me what I liked and customised the tour for me.

I did the day tour, but would definitely do the night foodie tour next time.

Don't worry if you find the traffic intimidating - you feel 100% safe the whole time and the Vespa is very comfortable.

We were a bit hesitant to book the Saigon by night tour as at US$80 it was a bit on the pricey side by Vietnam standards, but as it was the last night of our stay we thought why not and we were so glad we did!

We had a great evening! We started at the Zoom cafe, met the rest of our group and had a very large Mojito which was delicious. Then we zoomed off into the traffic on the back of our Vespas to our first stop in district 5 for seafood and frogs legs (which were very tasty!). The food was fabulous and our guide was great, taking the time to explain each dish. We then went off to another restaurant for fresh spring rolls and crispy pancakes (my faves!!). There was so much food and it was all amazingly good!

It had started to rain but fear not they had ponchos to keep you nice and dry. We then went off to a lounge bar with live music (piano, violin and singers with no mics), the atmosphere ... you could hear a pin drop! Absolutely amazing, you would never stumble across this place, such a hidden gem!

It was then off to our last stop of the evening, a club with live rock music - the bands were ace. You had the option to stay and get a taxi back to yoru hotel or your Vespa guide would take you back around 10.30pm. We all stayed and had a great night!

What a way to end our trip in Vietnam, you won't regret it!

PS: Your drinks were also included in the price as well as all your food (although just the one drink in the last bar).

I'll reiterate what most everyone else has said: this was the highlight of my visit in Vietnam. I did the Saigon at Night tour with 6 other Americans. We all had a blast riding the scooters, the food was excellent, and our tour guide was fun and informative.

If you can choose 1 thing to do there in HCMC, choose this tour. You will have lots if fun!

review_title: Highlight of my trip to Vietnam
review_text: Although the price is expensive (for vietnam), this is worth every cent that i paid for... Those who have passion for motorbikes will absolutely love the experience... taking vintage vespas out to see the mekong riverside, riding along dirt roads and taking your vespa across the river via a mini ferry.

We had a great night on this tour. I still can't believe I was so confident & comfortable riding on the back of a vespa through Ho Chi Minh city traffic. The guides were lots of fun and introduced us to a number of different tastes and experiences. I particularly enjoyed the silent cafe with vietnamese singers serenading us while we sipped on our delicious vietnamese coffees

review_title: A unique and fun way to see Saigon
review_text:
This tour is admittedly expensive for what it is, but the experience is truly worth the money.

I was on the tail end of a business trip and did not have much time, so I took the Insider's Saigon tour that started from 8:00am and went to 12:30 including lunch. I started the morning with pick up at my hotel and a nice leisurely ride to the Zoom cafe. I then enjoyed a delicious Vietnamese drip coffee and had a chance to chat with the owner Steve, and met my guide Ms. You (sp?).

It turns out that I was the only one on the tour so I had the option to get a customised session. Since I had already seen a lot of the attractions on the original itinerary, I opted for adding on a tour of the outlying areas - both the modern high rises area and traditional neighbourhood.

I'm a Vespa aficionado and part of the attraction was to see the scooters. The vintage Vespas were truly impressive - lovingly restored and ran perfectly. Its hard to find older Vespas this nice much less in regular service.

Keep in mind that the city tours are pillion only. You need to take the longer tours that get outside of the city if you want to take control of the Vespa. I was disappointed at first, but realised it takes some skill to ride in Saigon and my driver was truly an expert.

Best thing about Vietnam Vespa Adventures is the staff. They are happy and enthusiastic about their jobs and deliver a great service. I had a chance to learn a bit about Vietnam and see some sights I normally would never have a chance to see on such a short trip.

I'd really like to get back one day and take one of the longer journeys.

We took the night tour which I booked as a last minute addition to our tour of Cambodia and Vietnam and I have to say it was probably the highlight of the trip. We went places and ate food we would otherwise never have experienced. One piece of advice our guide gave us was don't book it for your first day in Saigon, apparently a lot of people that do cancel after seeing the traffic. After a day or two the traffic is less intimidating so you can relax and enjoy the tour.

review_title: If you only do 1 thing in Saigon!!
review_text:
We booked the night tour of the city and I can honestly say it was the best tour I have ever been on!
We were picked up from our hotel, the drivers were early so no hanging around. The helped us put the helmets on before jumping on the back of a beautiful Vespa then took us off to the first bar. We met our Guide there who was fantastic! She loved her city and the tour so she was really enthusiastic.
We spent the evening whizzing around the city eating & drinking as much as we wanted and really getting to see the real side of this beautiful city! It was an unforgettable experience.

review_title: A great way to tour Saigon...
review_text: My daughter and I took the Saigon Day Tour last week and had a ball! Our guide, Dieu, was informative and fun, the drivers were attentive and confident and the sights were fab. We live in Saigion and are experienced tour travellers...this was extra special. We say..skip the taxi, car, bus, van and pop on the back of a Vespa with Vietnam Vespa Adventures...you will not regret it!

This tour was outstanding! We travelled with our 10 year old daughter and she was quite reluctant to ride on a scooter with a stranger. Her driver took the time to reassure her and promised her two alternatives if she didn't feel comfortable. Thirty seconds into the ride (literally) she was hooked.

The night tour is like a progressive dinner! We stopped for cocktails, then an amazing entree of great local specialities, then to a main course venue with again great traditional food. After this we enjoyed an interlude at a traditional 'silent cafe'. The singing was amazing. Then off to a nightclub.

Our guides were delightful, funny and very informative. This tour is one of the greatest decisions we have ever made. We visited venues we would never have found on our own.

Once is not enough!

My husband, myself and a friend decided to do this one Friday evening after work. If you are in Saigon. . .Do this! It was a great time! The Vespa drivers picked us up at our apartment and we went into town to meet our "guide" to hear about our evening. Food and drinks (yes, alcohol) are included in the price. . .and it's reasonable for what you get. You stop at different locations throughout the city, weave in and out of traffic -- all on the back of a vintage Vespa! Even though one of the stops was a sidewalk cafe we frequent (Thanks, Anthony Bourdain) - the trip was just a fun evening. We decided we are doing it again. There are day time tours and night time tours. It's a great way to see the city.

A group of 8, including my 10 y.o. Daughter, spent an awesome 4 hours exploring HCMC on the back of a Vespa. Started with a cocktail at Zoom cafe and progressed to a restaurant for starters. The frogs legs were adventurous! Mussels great. Then off to another restaurant for dinner and a coffee bar to sample a "surprise" - I won't give it away, but worth it. All the while riding thru districts, other than #1 district. Drivers were careful and the tour operator is professional. This is a must do activity whilst here.

My wife and I did the wartime memories tour and it was brilliant. The two Vespa guides we had gave us a great memory for our trip.

From the time they picked us up at our hotel, and they were bang on time, they looked after us and explained things and made sure we knew what was going on and where we were going next.

My wife, who initially had reservations abut getting on the back of a Vespa in this manic city, soon lost those fears and really enjoyed it.

At the end of the tour we had a brilliant lunch back at the cafe they run and this just finished the morning off perfectly.

The only minor criticism/request is that we would of liked to spend more time in the actual museum and felt this was a bit rushed. The museum is a big place and full of interesting facts.

Obviously there are time constraints when they have to get us round so many sights but more time at the museum would of been great (for us anyway)

All in all we highly recommend this to anyone and Steve and his team do a fantastic job.

review_title: "The Way" To Experience Saigon At Night
review_text: We were advised in advance that this was the best way to experience Saigon at night "like the locals do", and it far exceeded our expectations. Buzzing around on the back of your own professionally driven vintage Vespa scooter without needing directions, driving skills or a care in the world was easily the highlight of an already exceptional 10 day Vietnam visit. All of the stops were predetermined (although we had no clue where we were going or what was next), where we ate everything and anything that the street vendors dished out. Excellent!!! With our own private designated drivers we consumed plenty of local beer and other liquid refreshments along the way making the tour all the more adventurous on the back seats of our rides. We zipped from stop to stop including a otherworldly romantic coffee house (more like a speak-easy) complete with live piano, violin and eclectic English & Vietnamese vocals to enjoy our iced coffee drinks with, followed by a rock & roll night club with one of the best and most diverse cover bands we've ever experienced. We were picked up from our hotel and safely returned there at the end of the night, all smiles and full of stories to tell our friends and family.

review_title: Excellent Tour: A Full History Lesson on the Back of a Bike
review_text: I took the Wartime Memories tour, which through my research appeared to be unique to this operator. During the tour itself, I was at first concerned that I was just seeing ordinary buildings all around town. But as my holiday progressed over several more days, I found myself recognizing seemingly ordinary buildings all over the city as having some historical significance. The guide does a wonderful job of showing you the sites in historical order, so you can learn how the conflict developed and then was resolved. I came with a lot of interest but without much knowledge, and left both with a familiarity for the city and the toll it took on the city. He planted seeds in my mind that took a couple days to grow, but once they did, I was very appreciative of the knowledge imparted. But for the war, I would not have chosen to visit Vietnam, and this tour was the best / only one in town to focus on that topic in such a detailed manner. It was the best way I could have spent my first day in country.

We had a fantastic day in Saigon with Vespa tours. We were picked up from the Phu My Port by a mini bus which was arranged with Vespa tours (extra cost but well worth it). We saw old parts of Saigon that coaches can't access. Despite being 65++ we felt quite safe on the back of the bikes. Better than on foot!! That was scary. We made lots of stops including the flower market, Notre Dame Cathederal, Post Office. We had a wonderful lunch at the Zoom cafe,which was included in the price. This is a must do if in Ho Chi Min City, they are a great friendly bunch and nothing is too much trouble.

The Vespa by night tour was absolutely brilliant and definitely a highlight of our two weeks in Vietnam. The drivers were excellent as was the guide. The little places we went to eat were amazing and definitely something we wouldnt have experienced on our own.
Zooming through the traffic at night was exilerating. I recommend this tour if you are in HCMC.
Value wise we ate and drank as much as we wanted and the food was delicious. What an experience.

To infinity and beyond!

I take the saigon after dark tour, from the first time I arrived at the meeting point at zoom cafe, I got the best impression about this activity, this is the Must for all tourist if you want to enjoy saigon city originaly and unique. The guide "Erick" is very friendly, the food is fantastic and the whole experience make me want to arrange next trip to saigon with friends.

review_title: The best tour of our trip
review_text:
We took this tour on our last night in Vietnam. It was certainly the highlight of the trip! It is an amazing experience in amongst the crazy traffic! Thankfully the tour provides as much beer as you can drink....you need it to take the edge off the nerves!!!
We went to some amazing eatery's and ate street food along the way, including frogs! The food and beer plentiful.
We also visited the secret cafe, which was a mecca for soloists and musicians. Whilst their we felt we were in a club in Paris! A real WOW moment! Then we went to a venue where a band was playing 'Cold Chisel', 'Eagles' and others. We didn't want the night to end! A special thanks to our amazing guide and our drivers.

We did the 'Saigon after dark' tour, were picked up at the hotel to meet at the Zoom Bar where we met the other tourist, our guide and the founder Steve. After a Mojito we had a four hour tour with two food stops (very good authentic vietnamese food and cold beer) and two drink stops, in a hidden coffee shop and a club with live music. all places a normal tourist with just few days time would never find, we where very surprised by the fabulous live singers at the hidden coffee shop and the cool rock band in the club! unfortunately the time plan was tough and no time to stay longer. four hours passed so quickly. also our drivers were very nice and we had a good time on the vespa. really enjoyed it!

review_title: THE best way to experience Ho Chi Minh City/Saigon!
review_text: We would thoroughly recommend this adventure to anyone visiting this great city! We were whizzed about the city - expertly and safely - on the back of cute comfortable Vespas! We ate delicious - tasty and clean - street food that we've never had before. We were shown to hidden, amazing Vietnamese night spots. We met some lovely people. We laughed all evening! It is honestly one of the best city nights out in Asia EVER!

review_title: For Mods, Bikers and Adventurers alike...
review_text: Being lucky enough to be visiting Saigon for the second time I really wanted to do something a bit different this visit. I was not however expecting this trip to blow me away as much as it did. Having owned a Vespa back in the UK some years ago I really wanted to ride myself but was a little nervous as it had been a few years and the traffic in Saigon is something else! With a little practice and a few pointers however I was ready to take on the roads and try the 'glimpse of the Mekong' tour. What followed was quite simply the highlight of my visit to Vietnam. Not only riding the highways and byways but taking to narrow dusty tracks, rickety bridges and outstanding countryside. Our guide was fantastic, lots of information and friendly and very happy to be spending the day with us. We were lucky, even in the high season that there was just the two of us along with the guide and drivers so we the pace was set just for us. All our food and drinks were included and we were treated to some of the tastiest and freshest food I have ever tried. This was a whole day experience, being collected from our hotel early doors and dropped back to the door in time for a cold beer. I can't recommend this tour enough, there is simply nothing to complain about, it is by far the best way I have found to experience a city in action. Ride as a pillion or if you have the experience, ride, you will never regret it.

We went on a night Vespa tour and it was by far the best excursion we did in Vietnam. We were travelling with our 10 year old daughter and I was worried she might be scared on the back of a bike (for the first time ever) in the midst of the Saigon traffic. When I asked her about it at the first stop she said it was 'exhilarating' and by the end of the evening she was fist pumping and whooping as her driver wove in and out of the crazy drivers. I didn't have a moment's concern about her - he was super careful and made sure we were all within sight of each other at all times. The food that we enjoyed that night was among the best we ate in Vietnam - even the frogs' legs were delicious. Our guide (the closest we can get to her name is 'Twin' but I'm sure it's nothing like that!) was absolutely charming and really made the evening for all of us. We only made it as far as 'secret coffee' and whilst it was interesting, the singing wasn't really for us. We left the others before they headed for the 'rock music bar' part of the evening, so I'll have to leave that to other reviewers. I would definitely do this again if I were in HCMC.

review_title: Outstanding. The BEST way to see Saigon.
review_text:
This was an outstanding way to see Saigon in a day, in no short thanks to the superb organization and friendliness of Vietnam Vesper Adventures. Organizing an independent tour off of a cruise ship for 14 people can be a challenge.

Yet Steve and Stephen (the owners) were very responsive and organized, and other than a small snafu at the meeting point (which was quickly resolved) our group had one of the most outstanding tours of our entire trip. Given our limited time, there is no way one could have seen this much of Saigon in this short a time.

Forr me one of the best parts was getting from points A to B on the back of a Vesper in the hands of a very competent driver. Other than the first 5 mins of "Oh my god what have we gotten ourselves into", you soon realize there is pattern to the chaos and settle in for the sights, sounds and smells that you would never get from a bus or even walking. The organized lunch from "The Lunch Lady" (from Anthony Bourdain) was also a highlight - so delicious !

Add in the friendliness and organization, with the owner coming himself to have lunch with us, you really can't do much better that this tour. I hope to return and do a night tour and more extended visit in the near future!

I did the Saigon at Night tour. Had an excellent guide and driver who gave a unique insight into Vietnamese food and also some interesting Saigon subcultures. The time on the bike wasn't nearly as anxious as I thought it might have been. I have a far better appreciation of Saigon for this tour. Well worth it.

My time in Ho Chi Minh City was short (only two nights) yet the Vietnam Vespa evening foodie tour was the absolute highlight. My only regret was that we did not do this tour on our first night in town! It was a blast riding through the city streets like a local on the back of a bike. The food stops were great, our guide was adorable, and I thought this was such a wonderful way to get an 'insiders' intro on the variety of street food available in town. A fantastic evening for sure!

review_title: One of the best evenings spent in Vietnam
review_text:
There's nowhere else in the world that Vietnam's traffic system could work. It's chaotic, noisy, and many of the road rules are more though of as polite suggestions. 

The system fits Vietnam however. It's grown organically with the country and fits what the people need and are familiar with. 

To understand Vietnam, don't be a bystander watching what appears to be total anarchy in the roads. Get in amongst it and experience exactly how it works and flows so well. 

Best way to do this in Ho Chi Minh (HCM)? On the back of a Vespa. 

Our night with Vietnam Vespa Tours (VVT) was excellent. Don't go into this night thinking that you're going to cover a lot of ground though. You'll see familiar buildings during the night as you cross-cross you're relatively small travel area. Being HCM however you can go around the block a couple of times and see something completely different each time. 

What you do get is an open pass to areas that you'd never walk to of a night on your own. As we were going along it was rare to see another Westerner. You'll also be served food from local sidewalk eateries that you'd never generally stop at. 

And there is the interesting point. We had been paying cafe and hotel meal prices which were probably three times as expensive and yet were probably half the taste. The food is amazing. Take off your blinders and let yourself taste things, like frogs legs, that you may never have ha before. You've probably never had then in the settings like there are on a night with VVT. 

The Vespa drivers are experienced locals and I found them helpful and attentive. I was reminded to keep my feet in and my camera close when, looking spring at the enthral long spectacle around me, I'd let it dangle out to the side. As a guide, you can tip your driver at the end of the night about 50k - 100k Dong. 

On our tour there wasn't a bad word to be said about the nights activities. I think you'd be a hard person to please if you did have.

review_title: You HAVE to do this tour!
review_text:
I did the Night Tour last week and it was the absolute highlight of my trip to Vietnam.

From the moment their drivers pick you up at your hotel you feel like you're amongst friends and meeting up at the Zoom cafe first is a really nice touch as it brings the whole group together and makes you feel comfortable. From there we went to great roadside cafes and then on to some bars that were fantastic and we would never have known about otherwise.

Our guide Van was fantastic. Really knowledgeable and a huge amount of fun, she made the experience somehow even more than the sum of its parts.

The scooters were ace too - they feel mercifully stable and the drivers are real experts, so there's nothing to fear from the unhinged Saigon traffic

Seriously, you should do this tour. You'll love it.

review_title: great way to spend an evening
review_text: four over 50s took the saigon after dark tour and what a buzz great evening travelling the city trying out foods two stops to sample some night life .we saw real peoplein their everyday life ,the tour guides were great don't miss this tour

review_title: This is a must for anyone who comes to Saigon
review_text:
I have done both the Glimpse of the Mekong and Saigon by Night tours many times. Whenever I have visitors come to stay with me in Ho Chi Minh City I take them on one of these tours and they all agree - its the best thing they've done here.

You'll see parts of the city and the country that no other tour will take you to, you'll understand how the people and country work and you'll have the best time!

Generally, I write hotel reviews only. However, I will make an exception for VVA as we had such a great time when going to a Night Safari through HCMC.

The owner, Steven, has restored countless Vintage Vespas and organises brilliant tours for tourists. His drivers will pick you up at your hotel and manoeuvre you safely through HCMC's chaotic traffic. The tour includes all beverages (incl. alcohol) and food. 2 food stops give you a very authentic street food experience. The food was delicious and we tried many new things, even 'jumping chicken'. Then there are two further stops to sample some night life (a quite coffee shop and a rock bar). Very fun and authentic. You will see a totally different side of the city.

Being on the back of those Vespas is also great fun. The breeze at night is heavenly!

Whatever you do in HCMC, don't miss this tour.

review_title: Superb way to spend an evening
review_text:
Really excellent trip / company - picked up locally, and dropped to the bar. We then spent a great evening travelling the city, seeing sights and trying out foods and drinks - a secret coffee bar and an accoustic set were a few highlights.

Even the most conservative would have a good time with a careful driver and guide and plenty of stops it really is a good way to get a feel for the city.

My husband and I took both the "Saigon After Dark" and the "Glimpse of the Mekong" tours earlier this month. We enjoyed both. The Saigon Night tour was a fun way to see the city. We saw sections of the city that we would not have had time to see on our own and probably would not have been able to find. There was plenty of food and drink along the way as well.

The Mekong tour was fantastic. It totally exceed my expectations. We saw real people in their everyday routines and were given a glimpse into a world not seen on the tourist path. Again, we were given more than enough food and drink along the way.

The vespas are comfortable and the tour guides are both professional and knowledgeable.

Without any doubt the best tour we've been on anywhere in S E Asia (and we've done many). We went on both the 'Saigon After Dark' and the 'Glimpse of the Mekong' tours - both were fantastic, unmissable and great value. Customer service is the name of the game with these guys and you get to see, hear, taste and imbibe aspects of Saigon that, as a tourist, you would never come across. Download you favourite The Who tracks plug yourself in and enjoy yourself - you'll regret it if you don't!

We were part of a group of 9 taking Vespa tours and had an evening we will never forget as part of Saigon by Night. Over 5 hours of driving through the traffic, eating at a variety of street food locales and listening to music in downtown clubs was an adventure we would certainly like to repeat

I did the tour with my husband and my 13 year old son. They picked us up from my sister-in-law's house in District 2 at 6.45pm and we were taken to the first stop, where we had a drink/nibbles and paid the money for the tour. From there we went to a local pavement restaurant for delicacies such as clams, crab and frog's legs. Next stop was a famous pancake restaurant where again we ate and drank. Stop four was a 'romantic coffee shop' which was hidden away before heading to the last stop which was a bar with live bands where we were given a maximum of two drinks.

We were then driven home again on the back of the Vespas back to District 2 - arriving around 11pm.

We were full by the end of the tour and had covered a lot of the city. The tour guide (Twee - apologies for the spelling) was very nice and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend it.

My wife agreed to the Mekong Delta ride for my 68th birthday. What an incredible day. We were picked up at our hotel by 2 drivers (on Vespas of course) and taken to Cafe Zoom where we finalized the payment of the tour. We were able to leave our bags at the cafe as we were going back to our cruise ship after the tour. We were then driven to the suburbs where the scooters are kept. I was given an oral and driving test (about 4 minutes around the neighborhood) to prove that I could handle a Vespa as it had been 46 years since I traded in mine for a motorcycle. I passed and shortly afterward we were off on our adventure. I drove my own and my wife was on the back of another with a driver from the tour company. There were also 4 others taking part, 2 drove their own and 2 were on the back of scooters driven by tour drivers.
We drove about 40 miles around the delta, going through small villages, past shrimp ponds and through a market. The drivers were well informed, spoke English well and were very helpful if there were any problems with the equipment. We stopped in a market where we had a snack of fresh clams and scallops. Phenomenal! I have nothing bad to say about any part of the tour except that we had to cut it short to get our bus ride back to the ship.
I want to thank Steve and his crew for a fantastic day. It brought back happy memories of the 2 years that I owned a Vespa in the mid 60's.

We took the after dark tour. From the moment we were picked up to dropped off, it was an awesome experience. Our.drivers were careful, our tour guide was knowledgeable and very funny and witty. We got to see Saigon by night and taste different food we never would've tried. Highlight of evening was the secret cafe, for this experience alone the tour was worth it. def recommend it to those looking for unique experience in Saigon.

review_title: An Insiders Tour of Saigon After Dark
review_text: The value and fun of the Saigon After Dark Vespa Tour can not be over-stated or matched. With an expert guide as scooter driver you climb on the back and glide from the best of street food to an insider's coffee shop to the best bars and bands in town -- finding the highlights it could take years to find -- all in one night. From the first moment when they picked us up at our apartment complex to the orientation meeting at Zoom bar, it was a total blast. Never a dull moment and never an empty glass. From ice cold beers to Long Island Teas to Viet iced coffee, nothing is out of reach or added to the tab. It is all included at the most reasonable price you are quoted for the night. The food is all local and all amazing -- get ready for frog legs, crab claws, and more. You will drink and/or eat more than what they ask.

We booked this tour and from my initial contact with the owner Steve, I could not fault anything about this one. The tour is fun, informative and best of all, you will find parts of Ho Chi Min that you would not otherwise know about. This is a food, beverage and adventure trip. Its so much fun and if you do nothing else in Saigon, do this!
We were collected on time from our hotel and the tour itself goes for about 4 hours. You can be dropped back at your hotel at the end, or to Zoom Cafe, or simply stay on where you are and kick on.
An exciting,wonderful night "must do" when in Saigon, We did the 'Saigon After Dark Tour'..The tour was well organized included 5 stops. This was the highlight of our 10 day trip.

review_title: Best fun on two wheels in Saigon!
review_text:
Browsed the HCMC trips recommended on Tripadvisor and this company caught my eye. Since emigrating to Hong Kong I've not been on a bike and really miss my old Triumph. I signed up for the half day city tour and was collected promptly at 8am by my driver on his 150cc vintage Vespa. I was delivered to the Zoom café for a quick drink and short wait for the other five guests. We then had a great morning being chauffeured around HCMC on the back of our scooters. We visited temples, pagodas, monuments, another café, a park, the old colonial Post Office and other touristy and non touristy sights around the city. Lunch back at the Zoom café came too quickly and there was a choice of western or Khmer food - the western burgers looked great, the local food was ok to good.

I had such good fun that I signed up for the all day self drive Taste of the Mekong tour the next day and the evening Saigon After Dark food and drink tour. Both of which were excellent, much more fun that the half day city tour in fact. Steve, the owner is a great guy who offers progressively larger discounts the more tours you book! Book any of these tours, you won't regret it.

We were recommended Vespa Adventures, they did the evening street food vespa tour which they highly recommended. We had only 1 day in HCMC so decided to do the Insiders Saigon Tour. All correspondence was carried out by email and was very quick but you can pop into Zoom Cafe. They picked us up from our hotel on really cool vintage Vespas and took us to Zoom Cafe to check in. We met our guide for the tour who had so much knowledge. At the end of the tour lunch was included. Highly recommended.

review_title: 7-day Nha Trang Coastal Highland Adventure (Vespa Tour)
review_text:
The four of us (two couples) had a grand time on this 7-day guided Vespa tour. We started in Saigon (HCM City) and ended this 7-day journey -- driving our own Vespas -- in Nha Trang. There is a tour guide that leads the group and another tour guide follows, along with a pick-up vehicle which carries our luggage. Support services and safety are most impressive. Everything was perfect !

Dat, our tour leader, was the best tour leader -- thoughtful, kind, and knowledgeable. He was always there when we needed him -- but still gave us "space" and time to be on our own. He helped keep us safe, and throughout the tour we felt he was both are friend and guardian angel.

Two other team members -- were highly competent and gracious. Always going out of their way to help and guide us.

Hotels and food were very good. We were impressed that we always seemed to get the best rooms (with super views) at every hotel we stayed at. Thanks !

Our many coffee stops and visits to tourist sites along the our motor cycle journey added to the interest during this vespa tour. Much of the scenery was both stunning and memorable.

We learned, grew, and were challenged. Above all, our skill and interest in motor cycling really developed as each day we faced new motor cycle challenges, success, and fun.

This was a superlative vacation and life experience.

The highlight of our visit to HCMC! Fantastic to zip around the city on the back of a moped and see the sights whilst going to some amazing 'local' places to eat and drink which you would never find or venture to as a tourist. Very safe and well organized as you even get your own guide who stays with you for the whole evening. A great company to book with. Many thanks to Steve and his team for making our visit (and my birthday) very memorable.

review_title: A highlight of our visit to Vietnam
review_text: My husband and I took the Saigon After Dark tour and it was fantastic! I booked the tour on line in Australia. We were picked up on time at 6pm from our hotel and taken to the meeting point - Cafe Zoom, for a drink and to meet the tour guide for the night and an Australian couple who were joining us on the tour. The traffic in Ho Chi Minh City is pretty crazy - crossing roads on foot is pretty frightening, but somehow on the back of the vespas in amongst it all was very exciting. We were able to experience the nightlife of HCMC that the average tourist never gets to see and eat at great local street restaurants, visit a secret coffee lounge to enjoy a drink and hear solo singers. Our last drink stop was at a very popular pub with great live music before being returned safely to our hotel. All in all a great night and definitely a highlight of our visit to Vietnam! Highly recommend this tour!

review_title: One of the best things we did in HCMC
review_text: We found Vietnam Vespa Adventures on Tripadvisor.....and what a find. The streets are HCMC is a little crazy to say the least but these guys were great. We did the night time adventure as suggested by the people at the Zoom Cafe.....where these guys operate out of. You not only get to feel the energy of the city but these guys take you to lots of local places you would never find on your own......and you eat and drink till your hearts content....and our 11 year old son thought it was the best thing we did......I would recommend not missing this one!!!!

hi, on sunday night i took vespa tour and it was great experience. Started with the beer and nice chat wand then we started driving. We had great food, great drinkgs and we experienced really original places which you will never visit on your own! It was a bit expensive for Vietnam standard but it was worth of it - you have to try it when you are in vientam!

review_title: Saigon After Dark - Vespa Tour ... A Great Way To See The City!
review_text: I'm an American expat and have lived in HCMC for the past 6 years, but on my "Saigon After Dark Vespa Tour" I saw places that I had never seen before and ate food I had never eaten before. The staff and drivers were all extremely friendly and very well-organized (especially by Vietnam's standards), and provided a great glimpse of HCMC at night from a local's perspective. I would highly recommend doing this tour if you get the chance!

Riding these 50 year old scooters is quite nostalgic ( I owned one as a teenager). They are well maintained and in good condition with the owner having over 40 in his collection.
You can either drive yourself, or have a guide and be a passenger. Don't be put off by fear. They first take you out of the city to their depot. There you can chose either a Vespa (manual gearbox), or a scooter with automatic gears. You then drive around the block a few times to get comfortable before heading off into the more rural delta.
Take sunscreen and extra water with you. Wearing shoes instead of slops is also recommended. Dusty and hot, but definitely would recommend it. Sure beats sitting a taxi or bus all day.

We did a Saigon by day tour and a Saigon by night tour with our teenage daughter, and both tours were excellent. The guides were knowledgable and friendly and the locations visited were perfect. Vespa drivers were safe and professional. What a great way to experience Saigon, definately worth doing!

This was the absolute highlight of our week in Ho Chi Minh. The Vespas picked us up at our hotel promptly and took us to Zoom cafe where we met the others taking the tour, and had a chat with Steve (the owner) and our guide. The were five of us booked on the tour - interestingly we were all from Australia (Canberra, Goulburn and Sydney!). As it got dark we set off to District 5 and had an interesting meal of frog legs, clam soup, mussels and noodles. We then travelled to another back alley restaurant and ate bun xiao (pancake) and fresh spring rolls. A visit to a hidden cafe which had acoustic music was absolutely brilliant and our last venue was at a night club which was hilarious - Vietnamese band wearing cowboy hats singing Beatles songs to hard rock. All meals and drinks were included in the price of the tour (approx $80 each). The experience of riding through peak hour traffic was amazing, and this was an absolutely brilliant way to see the sights of the city by night and get a feel for local life. I would absolutely do this tour again when we return, and would highly recommend it.

What a fantastic trip. It was exciting, interesting, informative and most of all fun.

My husband and myself took our trip on 14th March. The boys collected us from our hotel at 8am and we travelled to Cafe Zoom in the rush hour traffic very exciting - very different but we felt safe in the hands of our drivers. The boys were professional and looked after us very well all day giving us an experience to remember.

The trip itself was amazing - we travelled many dirt roads, ferries, traversed many rickerty bridges, stopped at shrimp farms, fish markets, a local market where we had a snack of delicious scallops and clams, and visited a wonderful temple and also the home of an incense stick maker to see her at work. I'll certainly think of her in the future whenever I see incense sticks. We then had a lovely late lunch before returning to the city.

I left my sun hat in my driver's bag and he kindly returned it to my hotel that evening.

Thank you for an amazing day.

We recently returned from an action-packed trip to Vietnam and Cambodia. Four of us aging baby boomers were traveling together. On our last evening in Saigon we arranged to do the Saigon After Dark tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. It turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip--a fantastic and fun experience, and very safe. After being fitted with helmets and taking some photos to show friends and family that we actually did this, we seated ourselves behind an experienced driver on the back of a reconditioned vintage motorbike and plunged into the thick of the fast-moving traffic that terrifies pedestrians visiting the country for the first time. Our first stop was at Cafe Zoom, headquarters for VVA, where we sat down over drinks with others in our small group and and chatted with Stephen Mueller, who runs the operation. Friendly and congenial, he told us about himself and how he started the business, gave us a preview of our evening, and introduced us to Dieu, our lovely and enthusiastic guide for the night's activities. From the back of our too-cool Vespa scooters we would drive past many of the city's important sites, stop at two restaurants to eat popular local street foods on the sidewalk with the rest of Saigon, and stop at two popular clubs to hear local music. The first restaurant in District 4 specialized in seafood, the second (called Bahn Xeo) was the go-to spot for incredible Vietnamese pancakes with delectable fillings. We watched the crispy pancakes being cooked in an outdoor kitchen area just steps from the street, then devoured our pancakes seated at low tables surrounded by people from the neighborhood. Everything went down well with Vietnamese beer. Our first stop for music was a real hole-in-the-wall, sort of a secret music club you'd never find on your own, where local "cabaret-style" singers with excellent voices took turns at an open mike. The second club featured a Vietnamese band that covered American and British pop music of the 60s and 70s. You haven't lived until you've heard a Vietnamese band cover Lennon and McCartney! It was tons of fun, a genuine peak experience! Steve kept popping up at the various venues all evening to make sure his clients were having a great time.

This was one of our highlights in Saigon. We were not quite sure what we were letting ourselves in for but it was amazing. We were collected at our hotel by Vespa and headed into the city. Some how you feel quite safe in among all the other 6 million motor bikes and it gives you a feeling of belonging. We had 5 stops along the way, the first was for drinks and to meet our guide who would be at each stop to look after us, the second for street sea food, some of the best we ate the whole trip, 3rd stop savoury pancakes and much more followed by a creme caramel, 4th stop a back street bar to listen to various singers much of it Western ballards and very good, last and final stop a night club with live music. Our guide Lilli (not sure if the spelling is correct), was great fun and looked after us really well. Highly recommend this tour, we were back in the hotel by 10.30pm having started at 6pm.

I returned to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) this December 2012 and decided to continue what has historically been a great experience, a tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures.

This night tour of Saigon keeps getting better, with new locations added to keep things fresh and up to date. This is the way to experience Saigon, the "non-tourist' way on the back of a vintage Vespa scooter. You will experience the lively, "Saigon Street Cafe" lifestyle along with locals outside of District 1, doing it quite literally like a local, on the back of a motor bike! Experience quaint out-of-the-way local coffee shops with acoustic live vocalists, contrasted with a trip to experience Saigon's budding Rock-N-Roll live music scene.

You can experience the "run of the mill" tourist activities and eateries of Saigon that are well covered in the travel books and share your travel memories with a bunch of other foreigners all experiencing the same overdone thing. Or....book Saigon After Dark tour and experience Saigon the way locals do, away from the tourist sights for a more authentic insight to the vibrant and exciting city of Saigon, while sampling a great selection of Saigon style street food.

I have traveled to Vietnam a number of times, and VVA continues to keep things fresh and updated with their tour offerings. Well done, safe, and worth the price. Their drivers are top-notch, safe, and courteous.

Sarah and I have just returned from our day trip to the Mekong. We had a great time and recommend the tour to anyone wishing to see what it's like outside the cities and beach resorts of Vietnam.

The guys picked us up from our hotel and provided all food and drinks during the tour. They also gave us some help learning how to operate the vespa's interesting manual gear operations before we departed.

It's an adventure tour with real riding and participation so be prepared to get dirty. The two of us had our own support team of three with us at all times, a mechanic, english speaking tour leader and an English speaking guide. We tried local cuisines and toured markets and spoke to local people.

Thanks guys for a fantastic day.

review_title: Excellent fun and a great way to experience Saigon
review_text:
This tour was booked for us by Trailfinders in advance and is a unique, interesting, fun and interactive way of seeing Saigon.

We were met by our 2 young vespa drivers at our hotel for the 'Saigon by night' tour and what an experience !

We went to a bar in the backpacking area for a couple of beers then 2 completely different but superb Vietnamese street restaurants where we mixed and sat with the locals and were treated to more drink and wonderful food.

We then moved on to a classical music bar followed by a Vietnamese rock club.

If you only have 1 or 2 days/nights in Saigon do one of these tours - one of the highlights of our holiday in this wonderful country !

Saigon by Night - What a great tour! Sampled local cuisine, experienced the night life at a bar and drank coffee at a secret cafe. Drivers were experienced and polite and it was truly an adventure one shouldn't miss.

If you visit HCMC this a must do!! You will see coach tour after coach tour head out to the Makong Delta but you won't experience it like this! On the back ( or front depending on your experience of riding) you make your way from the city out into the delta. You haven't had coffee until you have had it in the little shack that we did Amazing!! The owners of the business were so genuine and interested in our trip. We were so impressed that we did the night tour as well it was just as good. If you have heard about the "secret cafe " you will find it on this trip!

We went on the vespa adventures in Ho Chi Minh during the night tour. Despite the fact that we didn't have much time to visit and see this city ourselves, we were fortunate to experience the vespa adventure at night. We were able to try local foods which were delicious and see local places such as hidden night spots only the locals would know. The vespa ride throughout the city was refreshing and extremely fun! Overall, the night was organised well and was a highlight in our holiday adventures!

This is a must not miss trip while you are visiting HCMC! We booked a last minute Mekong Delta trip and we're sure glad we did. This trip gives you a much more personal and local view of the Mekong Delta, not to mention you get to drive your own Vespa. The riding is fun, you get to stop and eat great local food, and the VVA Team is excellent. Lastly, you're never taken to a sales pitch site where you are pressured into buying something. You will enjoy every minute of this trip.

review_title: Exceeded my expectations which were very high
review_text: We went on the Saigon After Dark food tour which was fantastic. Our drivers picked us up at our hotel and took us to Cafe Zoom where our guide for the evening Duyen met us. Since we were a group of 2 a third person joined us so we spent the evening as a foursome. After drinks and chips and salsa, we headed to a seafood restaurant and had crab legs, snails, mussels, noodles, and frog legs. At the first stop the company founder and general manager showed up and talked to us to make sure everyone was happy. Duyen had excellent English and was helpful in explaining how to eat various dishes. She was an enjoyable companion for the evening. Our drivers were also amazing and skilled. Our second stop was a restaurant that serves the best bahn Xeo in Saigon. In addition to the Bahn Xeo, we had fried spring rolls, cold Goi Cuon rolls, and grilled meat. (This place also had a clean toilet.) After eating we went to a hidden candle-lit coffee house with some decent singers. We went back to the hotel after this because we had an early morning the next day but the tour continued at a club. All food and drink (including alcohol) and pick up and drop off at our hotel were included in the price. Definitely a must do.

review_title: Great! A "must do" if you are in Saigon!
review_text: Night Vespa tour of Saigon is a must if you are visiting HCMC! You get picked up by a Vespa from your hotel and taken to cafe Zoom in backpacker district for a couple of drinks and to meet the group. Then vespa takes you around backpacker district and then onto 1st stop is at a local eatery for seafood, which was very yummy, and some more drinks. Second stop is in another district for more drinks and food and then the last stop yet another district and visit a bar with live music , which was a highlight! Then they take you back to your hotel or if you choose to stay on, you can taxi it back. Great value, all food and drinks included. Our group all knew each other which was a bonus. Best thing I have done in Saigon and this was my 2nd visit here!

I would highly recommend this activity when in HCM! We took the tour through the Mekong Delta, which was amazing. It got us out of the hustle and bustle of the city. You can either drive your own scooter or ride on the back of a vintage vespa. We chose to ride on the back so that we were able to take photos and videos as we rode. We cruised alongside the Mekong River through local markets, rice fields, temples and so many other amazing sights. We stopped quite a few times for photos ops. The price of the tour included a coffee break, a small snack with beer and then finally lunch with beverages, to include beer. I felt completely safe the entire time and our tour guides were very informative & considerate. The other members of our tour group were really cool folks who shared our passion for creating memorable adventures around the world. It was a really great experience. If I were to ever go back to HCM, I would definitely try any of the other tours this company offers.

I was in Ho Chi Minh City during Tet (Lunar New Year) so for the first three days of my visit to the city the Vietnam Vespa Tours weren't running. That meant I spent a lot of time exploring HCMC on my own before going on the "Insider's Saigon" 1/2 day tour. I was pleased to visit quite a few places that I had not seen written up in the travel literature. Also, although I had experienced traffic as a pedestrian, it was wild to be on the Vespas in the thick of it. The drivers were excellent and I felt very safe the whole time. I didn't realize that lunch was included in the price of the tour, so that was a bonus. The food at Cafe Zoom was excellent. After lunch the drivers returned everyone to their hotels, which was another added bonus.

This is a must. We did the day tour as well which was fantastic but the night tour was simply spectacular. We went to out of the way local restaurants that you will never find on your own, a classic secret coffee house then sensational bar with live music. We took our two children 15 and 11 and the drivers really went out of their way to look after them at every stage. I highly recommend this tour.

We thought it might be something new if we try to discover HCM via Vespa instead of just walking around. Right choice! We were picked up in our hotel on time and had lots of fun in the coming hours. A great tour guide told us many things we didn't know before. This tour is highly recommended!

Just done Siagon by night, only way to see the city, taken to places that the average tour would not - so refreshing - met locals- ate authentic food - felt safe the whole time-bikes were so much fun- Thu was a great guide - Had a hoot
So good we are doing their Mekong Day Tour

review_title: Unique way of seeing HCMC by night
review_text: This tour was amazing - I would highly recommend for a unique way of seeing Saigon. We booked the night tour via our travel agent and took in an amazing array of different sights including two different street food restaurants, pre drinks, a trip to a music bar, and a stop in a cafe which sounds really low key but was amazingly unique to watch a singer steal the show - you could have heard a pin drop! I have to confess I was quite nervous about getting on a vespa when you saw the traffic but the drivers had us in such incredibly safe hands, we never felt unsafe at all and somehow when you're in the midst of the traffic it somehow all feels like organized chaos anyway. We had such a great time and would wholeheartedly recommend this tour!

review_title: The very best thing I've done
review_text: I have traveled a lot and I think that the night tour is almost certainly the very best organized tour I've done. It was an explosion. I felt safe the whole time. The food was the best I'd eaten in the four nights I had in Saigon. The guide was delightful, my rider was a charmer. The "secret bar" they took us too was just amazing. It was like a movie andi was in it. And for the price which included beers and food and four hours of amazing fun was just great value. I have to go back to Saigon in three weeks and we are inking of doing this agin. I'm sure there ap,entry forebear visitors for this. It's sooo good I'd call this a "bucket list" adventure for sure. Well done to Vietnam Vespasian adventure tours!!! Stutravel

This was the second time we had done a tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures, the first being the Saigon After Dark tour on our first visit to Saigon in October 2011. This time around we selected for the Insider's Saigon tour in the afternoon. It started with lunch included at Cafe Zoom (anything off the menu plus a drink) then we were off on our tour. As mentioned this was our second visit to Saigon so we had already done the main tourist-y things and were hoping to get a good look at areas we may not have already been to. We were extremely satisfied with all of the stops which included the flower market, China Town, a Chinese medicine shop, a pagoda, a pit-stop for fresh sugar cane juice and more. We also had stops outside the Reunification Palace, the Post Office and Notre Dame, all of which we'd seen before but it was nice to see them again just over 12 months later.

Our guide was fantastic (cannot remember her name unfortunately) and our drivers were so professional, we felt nothing but safe weaving in and out of the crazy Saigon traffic, even with the roads a little wet from morning rain. After two tours with Vietnam Vespa Adventures we cannot recommend them enough to anyone who visits Saigon.

review_title: Hang on to your hat and have a blast
review_text:
My husband and I booked the Saigon by Night tour when the Xe Om company wasn't available. I was a bit apprehensive as we are in our 60's and I had never been on the back of a bike. I remained a little anxious through the evening and was glad to arrive back at our hotel with arms and legs intact. But nevertheless I wouldn't have missed it for the world. My husband relaxed right after the first couple of minutes and thought this tour was the highlight of his holiday in Vietnam.

The touring around the city and seeing the lights, river, bridges and general business of the city was great; the two food places we went to were interesting, although the selection of "seafood" left a bit to be desired and in fact my husband must have got one that left him sick the next day; but hey, them's the breaks.

The highlight of the night for both of us was after the food experiences (food and drink is all included - as much as you want), the first bit of entertainment was upstairs in a really atmospheric kind of big "living room" - lots of comfy sofas and candles with couples listening to the entertainment which was a piano player and a violinist accompanying various singers (male). It might not sound much but it was really quite unique. After that we went to a kind of nightclub to have the experience of modern music/entertainment.

All in all it was a very varied programme and the young woman who was our tour guide was very personable and it was enjoyable being able to talk to her and find out first hand how young people are living in HCMC.

This kind of tour is definitely a case of "when in Rome, do as the Romans do".

My partner and I booked the Mekong Delta tour first of all and enjoyed it so much we ended up booking the Saigon night tour two days later. The food was delicious on both tours and the staff were very informative, helpful and very safe drivers amongst the crazy traffic conditions in amongst the city! Both tours are a great way to see Vietnam and experience some local dining. I would like to make a special thank you to Charlie Ta who booked both tours for us and helped make the rest of our Vietnam trip very enjoyable!

review_title: One of the highlights of our Vietnam trip
review_text: I booked two tours, the Mekong Delta and Saigon at Night tour and had a wonderful memorable day in Saigon. Stephen the owner responded promptly to my questions by email and his young staff are easygoing and eager to please. It was one of the highlights of our 11 day tour through Vietnam. The food we ate both on the Mekong tour and Night tour was some of the best food I ate while in Vietnam. It's wonderfully managed and caring company with an awesome owner and staff. The old Vespas are so cute I almost wanted to take one home with me.Stephen the owner gave us some beginner lessons on clutching and off we went. He even joined the tour with his lovely wife. We had a great time. Keep up the good work guys! I originally was going to book XO tours but they actually recommended me to Vietnam Vespas and I'm so glad they did!

review_title: Safe, Fun and a Unique Experience
review_text:
Went on both the Insiders Saigon and Saigon After Dark tours.

On the Insiders Saigon tour we visited, markets, temples and shops that tourists don't and also visited the main tourists spots such as the Reunification Palace, Sigon Central Post Office and Notra Dame Cathedral and the tour was capped off with a great lunch and drink at the Zoom Zoom Cafe.

On the Saigon After Dark tour, we had meals at restuarants that tourists don't visit, as well as live music in a classical bar and live rock bands in a nightclub once again that tourists don't visit.

All beer supplied at resturants and music venues.

Always feel safe on the back of the vespas and once in a lifetime experience to be riding around the streets of Saigon on the back of a motorbike.

Zoom Zoom cafe was that good we also visited again another night for dinner, drinks and people watching.

I'm not in my first bloom of youth, and had never ridden a motorbike or scooter before so, having just arrived in Saigon and seen myself that most of the city's 5 million motorbikes/scooters were on the road at the same time with an apparent absence of clear rules of the road, I was to say the least apprehensive that my wife had booked the city tour for around 3 hrs
My wife and were picked up on time at the hotel and greeted by our guide, who rode her own bike with us, and two very personable 'pilots'. The first road junction was the most scary, but these guys were very experienced and within 5 minutes I was sitting as relaxed as if I were on a bus, but experiencing what it really must be like for a local to travel around the city.
Our Vespa tour was quite flexible. There is a suggested tour but as we had seen some of the items near our hotel, the guide asked us what we would like to see. You certainly get away from the normal tourist attractions and into the back streets of the outlying districts. We visited a flower market, Chinese temple, pagoda even a funeral parlour. We went through the tunnel to district 2, for a panoramic view of the city, stopped or a freshly squeezed galss of sugar cane and there is plenty of time for photos, but hang onto that camera!
