Regardless of age or biking experience, if you are active and mobile be adventurous and have a go at this. It's around $59 for the day trip, we ddn't do it but you can do a night trip stopping at bars and restaurants fom 7pm - 10 pm which is a bt more expensive $79 but I believe that includes food and drink.

review_title: Vespa Tour in Hi Chi Minh City (Siagon) Jan 2013
review_text: It appears this review is way overdue! If you are in HCMC, you MUST MUST MUST take the Vespa Adventure night city and street food tour. What a wonderful thing to do. It was our last night of our Vietnam/Cambodia trip and this was absolutely the highlight of our 18 days. I am 58 and my husband is 70, so I was a little anxious about the idea of ​​riding on the back of a motor bike at night, in downtown HCMC, but our wonderful guide, DAT, and great drivers Dong, and Quat (not sure of that spelling) where young, fun, and definately reasuring. We cruised the street for four hours, eating the best street food, and seeing the city from the streets rather than the window of a bus! Top the evening with two nightclub activities, very different from each other, but full of young Vietnamese and not Westerners. May be hubby doesn't like rock and roll, but I was reminded of the great 70's! Oh to be in my 20's again! I love the young energy of the city, and thank you for being PAST the wars. This city will be among the great ones such as Shanghai, Tokyo, Dubai in a few years - go now before it gets crazy busy and expensive. Thank you Vespa for giving us a wonderful insight of the city. The clams, mussels and jumping chickens are soooooo good!

review_title: A unique tour of the Mekong Delta
review_text: After a recommendation by a friend, I went on the Mekong Delta tour. I did not have experience driving a vespa, so I would not have been allowed to drive one, but that was actually my preference. I wanted to relax, see everything and take photos. The owner came to us, which was a bonus. Lots of food, information and great scenery. I had originally wanted to go on a tour that went to the river market - but this was very worth it! Their other tours sound great too!

My partner and I have arrived home from our Vietnam/Thailand holiday and have both agreed that the Vespa Tour was the highlight of our holiday.

We would like to thank Vietnam Adventure Tours for a fantastic "Glimpse of the Mekong" Tour we took on January 10th 2013 in Saigon.

My partner and I both travelled as pillion passengers and were very pleased with the way the drivers handled the bikes and rode according to conditions with utmost concern for the safety of their passenger and pedestrians.

My driver was sooooo courteous, helpful and considerate. He saw me struggling to undo the clip on my helmet to remove it at our first stop. From then on, every time we stopped, he immediately helped me remove the helmet and then brought it to me and helped me put it back on when we were off again. My partners driver was also very considerate and went to find him and show him to the bike every time we were on the move again.

There is not one thing that we could complain about or suggest that the tour operator/drivers change for this tour. We felt it was fantastic value for money, the food included in the price (meals and drinks) was fabulous and the sites we stopped at were interesting.

We only wish now that we had known about the multi-day tours they offered before we booked our private pre-arranged itinerary – Maybe another time?

We would certainly recommend this tour and tour provider to our friends and couples/families looking for something a bit different to do on their Vietnam holiday.

review_title: Great way to see the Mekong if you don't fancy getting in a boat.
review_text: Super fun day; great trip, guides and group.Would definitely try to squeeze this in. Everything was organised to perfection with lots of stops along the way.

My wife and I joined the Mekong tour and were picked up promptly at our hotel and whisked off on the back of motorbikes to the Zoom Cafe to meet up with the other group members, and then on to an out of town spot to be checked out on our capability to ride our own Vespa. With my wife on the back of our Vespa we were led through villages, paddy fields and other interesting spots you would never see or be able to access other than on 2 wheels on small tracks and paths.We crossed the rivers over narrow bridges and wooden crossings as well as using the local boat ferries.We stopped and were fed some great food in a local market food stall and a great meal at a restaurant at the end of the ride. All the drivers that were carrying the group pillion passengers were very competent and our guide was knowledgeable and all were great fun. This is a great 6hour trip for bike riders and even more fun for people riding pillion that had not experience a biking experience.

I enjoyed this lot, never even been on a bike in my 38 years. Opted to see if I could ride, team seemed confident I was OK - so off we went. Be aware this is off road also - some hairy bumpy and very thin tracks... tested my wits to my fullest for our 6 hours. I loved the Vespa, few niggles with it missing gears but probably that's my fault to be honest as being a virgin Vespa. If your not 100% for driving, get on the back and enjoy the trip....

Money well spent.

PS the food stops are out of this world in taste...;)

So happy to have done this and the team lead was a great guy, who watched over me for safety.

I'd upload some pics but tripadvisor uploader is not working on IE / Chrome AGAIN.

See Saigon at night as a local. This tour is not your typical "attraction" tour. It is MUCH better. It introduces you to local food, local communities and entertainment. You get an insider view into Saigon after-dark. Great seafood, beautiful music, the color of Saigon streets - all in the comfort of a Vespa. A MUST DO activity in Saigon... should be done on first or second night as an introduction to the city.

Our first night in Saigon, we were determined to do something "local" ...well ..as "local" as you can get when your a tourist! After scanning Trip Advisor, we came across these guys and decided to give them a go!

We were picked up from our hotel on the back of the Vespa's and taken to Cafe Zoom where the tour began. We felt safe at all times....great tour, great food and great laughs. Would always recommend this tour to anyone, we had a blast..and what a way to experience Saigon! Really was a highlight of our time in Vietnam.

We went for a tour during the morning and were picked up at our hotel by 4 Vespa's being my wife and 2 teenagers and myself. Instead of viewing the busy trafficker we were part of it. We always felt safe and saw a number of interesting behind the scenes events from the flower markets to a funeral ceremony along with some other stuff (I won't give the game away) that really gave us a lesson on the real Saigon.

The Vespa's winding through the traffic was a real buzz as you feel part of this frenetic city. Our guide gave a vibrant explanation of all the points of Interest.

The tour includes a lunch which was excellent.

Instead of trying to find stuff yourself I think this will illuminate you and your family much better.

I recommend it.

DIEU.....our tour guide for the day...you ROCK !

I booked this tour on line and was apprehensive (as all of us generally are). The service was professional and information accurate. We were picked up from our cruise ship on time, in a clean mini van and safely taken to Zoom Cafe, offered drinks and confirmed our plans for the day.

Eight cycles were waiting for us with well mannered drivers, who helped us with our helmets at each stop. We were never rushed, the drivers were humble, polite and full of smiles. We were taken to different sights and Dieu (i may be spelling her name incorrectly, apologies if i have) was very energetic, informative and answered all our questions confidently. We even stopped at Hard Rock Cafe for a quick beer (it was really hot)
We went back to Zoom for an amazing lunch, we all had excellent food. My son who is allergic to fish, opted for a hamburger which he said was delicious. My two daughters had chicken fried rice with a fried egg (even though we back home they still say it was one of the tastiest meals they had) the beers were ice cold as well!!

After lunch we continued our magical fun, weaving through the chaotic streets of HCMC to more exciting places. We even weaved our way through the very poor areas on our Vespas which gave us insight to the poverty and then were taken to the "rich" area as well. Our tour ended after our quick shop and our taxi picked us up and transported us back to the boat.

We mentioned our day to a few of the passengers on the boat and were met with envy as their tours were coach tours and they saw half the things we did.

To Dieu and our 8 drivers ....thank you for the most memorable day ever, i would truly recommend Vietnam Vespa Adventures to everyone who may be travelling to HCMC.

Moira & Peter

review_title: Saigon After Dark - if you only have 1 night in HCMC - do this!
review_text: I can't recommend this tour highly enough. After considering one of the longer tours with Vietnam Vespa's where we would be riding Vespa's ourselves - but being to scared to do so - we opted for this evening tour. We were with a group of 3 Germans and we had the best evening we could have imagined. Starting off at Cafe Zoom we had a few drinks and then got onto the back of the Vespa's with our lovely guides. Off into the Friday night traffic which was exhilarating and not at all scary. This truly is the way to experience Saigon like a local. We made 2 stops at out of the way street eateries where the food was great and very unusual. A stop at a hidden locals club with cool singers and more drinks, then off to a club where a band did excellent covers, and then we were dropped off at our hotel. This tour definitely lives up to the hype. Just do it.

My mom was skeptical of getting on a Vespa but we had the most brilliant time doing Saigon by night and have already recommended it to people we have met, see amazing places you just would go to or come across by yourself! Super safe and the guides are brilliant!

This was the best thing we did in Vietnam. We went on the 'Saigon after dark' tour only a few hours after arriving in Ho Chi Minh and we weren't disappointed. We were collected from our hotel and taken to Cafe Zoom to meet the rest of our party. After drinks we were taken into the Chinese quarter for seafood and 'jumping chicken' (frog) and then for Vietnamese pancakes. After eating we went to a cafe bar which you would never have found without a guide. It was a superb place to relax with a Vietnamese coffee listening to a singer accompanied by a pianist and a violinist. They even did a few Christmas songs. Then the evening finished at another bar with a live rock band. We had 2 teenage children with us and they both loved it. An excellent well organised experience.

review_title: This is a Must Do - an unforgettable experience!!
review_text:
I had heard of doing a Vespa tour through a friend and it was a toss up between Vespa adventures and XO tours. We ended up booking both the Insiders tour and then the Saigon at night foodie tour through Vespa - I'm so glad we did as it was the highlight of our holiday and a great way to experience Saigon if you've been before or if its your first time.

For the day tour I would recommend doing this as soon as you arrive in Saigon. They cover both touristy and non touristy road less travelled spots such as temples, flower markets, china town, traditional medicine shop etc The drivers are friendly and look after you and our female guide (Yew) was knowledgeable and was very personable. The Vespas range in models - try and get one with a high padded back as it will make for a much more comfortable trip.

The foodie night tour we did the following evening and we were all looking forward to this and it certainly didn't disappoint. They picked us up from our hotel on Vespas and the drive to cafe zoom was great and a more bustling and crazy experience. There were 8 of us on this tour which was a good number for us to meet and have a drink before the tour started. There were fewer stops on this tour vs the day tour which suited us to relax and take our time. First stop was a seafood place where we sampled Vietnamese chicken (frog) as or guide Lamb told us and other seafood which was very good. Then we went to I a backstreet and ate the best Vietnamese pancake along with beef rolls. Next was a highlight as all hidden candlelit bar where we sat and watched acoustic singers sing along to a piano. It was really a unique and magical experience. Last stop was a live band bar which was good but would have preferred to end on the previous bar. Slightly too noisy for our liking but I guess you need to cater to a wide variety of nightlife.

Overall one of the best experiences I've had in Vietnam and this is my 3rd time here. I would highly recommend this to anyone and great for all ages. My parents are 65 years old and had a fantastic time. It's very safe and you get to experience Vietnam how the locals do.

review_title: Great way to see and taste Ho Chi Minh city
review_text: If you want a real insight into Vietnam you can't go past this tour. The night tour was amazing, zipping through the city on the back of a Vespa, eating the local fair, drinking, live music, Charlie the tour guide from California was the best and couldn't do enough to make sure we had the best time ever. Thanks for the memories.

review_title: Get out of the city on a classic!
review_text: Best thing I did in my 5 days in Saigon. Don't worry about riding yourself - you can learn to ride in minutes, and the traffic outside the city is easy. They'll spot you a kilometer away and will steer clear. Food/drink stops were plentiful and not too touristy. Well, maybe the last spot. Ask your guides to get food they like, not things they think you'll like. And food/drink is all inclusive, so drink up! Okay, maybe you should get a driver.

We read about this on trip advisor and decided to go for this, instead of the big group tour thing further away from HCMC to go into the Mekong Delta. And what a fantastic choice. We took the Glimpse of the Mekong and it was super. With a great guide Phuc and a super driver Khuong we took the vespas through small villages, ricefields and across rivers. The guys took us really on an off the beaten path tour. We had brunch at a small market (fantastic fresh sea food!), coffee in a little house in the middle of ricefields, and sugar cane at a small shop. Along the way we stopped at a number of interesting places. During the drive we didn't see one other tourist! It was great, we really enjoyed this and it is well worth the money! It's a shame we left HCMC the next day otherwise we would have done another tour with them! Their cafe, cafe Zoom is also nice!

Via the internet and because of TA reviews I signed up for two motor cycle tours in Saigon. One tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventure Day Tours “Insider’s Saigon”…. and one with XO Tours (night Foodie tour) so I could have two different experiences with two different companies. Both were very good and very different, but for me XO Tours was run more professionally and I enjoyed it more.

My husband and I went on Vietnam Vespa’s Insider’s Saigon Tour and we were picked up promptly at our hotel by minimally English speaking motor cycle drivers and taken to the Zoom Café to meet the other participants. Our group comprised of only 5 people and I appreciated the special attention given to us, in such a small group. XO’s Foodie tour is more of a party atmosphere so the group size was larger (14 people) and each guide who was also the driver, spoke fluent English. For the Insider’s Saigon, I wasn’t really excited about the places we visited; nothing was that unusual or interesting, however I really enjoyed zooming around the city and the drivers were very safe!

The guide was very knowledgeable about Vietnam’s history, culture and language, but at times a bit long winded for me and with the traffic, honking etc…sometimes very difficult to understand. We visited a bird park, funeral temple, Chinese temple, flower market, post office and Notre Dame. After the tour, we ended up at the Zoom café and had lunch before being taken back to our hotel. I appreciated meeting the owner and the interest he showed in learning about our experience and if we enjoyed ourselves. Certainly it was fun, but if I only had one tour to do it would be the Foodie tour…which is also offered by Vietnam Vespa’s and might just be good fun.

Booked the glimpse of Mekong for a chance to see sights outside of the city, enjoyed it.

Visited markets, rode on river ferry, toured through small villages for a great experience. The tour staff was great, very informative and helpful throughout. You have the option to drive or ride with a driver.

Highly recommend and I'd consider taking a longer tour on a return trip.

Similar to other reviewers, we turned to Vespa Adventures (VA) because XO tours was fully booked. Funny enough, it was XO tours who recommended us to VA so credit also goes to XO!

I signed up my 6 year old and my "senior" mother on the half day trip. Following my deposit payment, I heard all these horror stories about the general safety in HCMC. At one point I thought about forgoing my deposit with VA. Being the really worrying type I emailed VA expressing my concern regarding the safety of my party. They came back saying customer safety is their first priority, and I decided to trust them.

Anyway, to cut the long story short, we were totally thrilled by the overall VA experience. There were parts of the tour which were rather Chinese focused. Being Chinese we didn't find those too "special". Having said that, we just had fun on the Vespa around HCMC. The guide and the drivers were all very friendly and helpful. My daughter who didn't care much about the historic stories just waited around for the bike ride to continue, but the crew always managed to entertain her one way or the other.

I don't think you could see HCMC better or more clearly than a bike tour, and I recommend VA for its quality service.

It was cool riding a Vespa around Saigon because I get to actually see the pedestrians and the crazy Saigon traffic from a motorcyclist’s point of view. Other than the morning coffee at Bird Lovers’ Park, however, I wouldn’t say that the visit to the flower market, or the Chinese temple in Chinatown, or the Chinese traditional medicine shop, qualify as an “insider” experience (we booked The Insider’s Saigon tour), and it's not because I'm Asian. I was quite disappointed that the guide didn’t remember who the first President was after South and North Vietnam reunited. On the whole, I didn’t quite get the ‘Vietnam’ experience I expected, especially on Vietnam – the history, culture, education, etc. Lunch at Café Zoom, which was included in the tour, was only so-so.

review_title: Best fun we had in Saigon!
review_text: Our family of 5 each had a driver. Our children aged 17, 15 and 10 all loved the tour. We each wore helmets and sat on the back of the bikes and held on to handles provided so don't think you have to cuddle the driver! Dat was an excellent leader. It was a great overview of Saigon on our first day there. We didn't tip the drivers but in hindsight, I'm not sure if we did the right thing!?

Wow this was the best experience! Despite the detour (due to police block) and the rain the whole day was FANTASTIC. Feel sure we saw the real rural life of Vietnam. Can't tell it all here but it is an adventure everyone should try. Staff/riders were wonderful, food awesome, whole day exciting! Suit all ages this from a 62 year old!!!!

review_title: A must do when in Saigon!
review_text: My husband and I did the Saigon at Night tour. A fantastic night of food, drink and vespas! We met some great people from all over the world and were chauffeured by our Vespa drivers to places that we would never have known about, let alone visited while in Saigon. Our host Huyen was fantastic - very knowledgable and concerned always that we were having a good time. Can't recommend enough. You'll giggle and laugh and eat some amazing food :-)

review_title: Great Local Experience - Worth every second.
review_text: I started my search for a motorbike tour and initially spoke to XO Tours which looked quite appealing. I looked around for few options and came across Vespa Tours and I am glad that I did book this tour. I did the Saigon by night tour and every second of the tour was memorable. They took us through the streets of Saigon that I would not have managed to explore myself. The first few minutes of the bike ride was bit different till the time you get used to the bike and the traffic. Some of the places we visited like the local vietnamese joint with singers and local crowd in a beautiful setting very local was an experience. The food was awesome and the tour was well managed. I would highly recommend this tour.

We tried the Saigon at night tour via Vespa and had a great time. Our guides-Tuyen,Van, and Nguyen, we're engaging and interesting and eager to show us the city. We had very safe Vespa drivers as well. We started at a local coffee shop and had drinks and appetizers and headed off to a street food restaurant which served some local favorites. We were then whisked off to a local pancake street shop. We finished off the night at a live music coffee shop and then a bar with a band. At every stop, our hosts made sure our glasses were full and showed us a good time with locals.

My friends and i did the day trip out of Saigon and had a great time. We saw some of the back country that you cant get to via car or most tours. The guide was very knowledgeable and stopped frequently to explain where we were and what we were looking at. Some of the small towns we went through had children very excited to see us on such cool old scooters which was great to see. Overall me and my friends would highly recommend this tour for many reasons. Steve the owner met us in the beginning and was very personable and made us feel welcome and at home. Furthermore him and his staff spoke very good English. David D.

We originally wanted to do XO Tours, but were unable to get in. I am happy we didn't as we had an AMAZING time and drank our way through the city with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. Our guide, Hoang, was so much fun and had thick enough skin to put up with three rowdy 25 year old males. She knew her city, was able to joke around, and showed us an all around excellent time. After we were finished, she was nice enough to take us out for drinks and chat about Vietnam. Definitely recommend! Oh, and the food was amazing, although I wanted to get a little bit more adventurous with the tastings.

Hi Steve

Just wanted to give some feedback on our recent tour of Vietnam

To start with the day tour included so many of the local markets and temples it was unbelievable. We saw so much more than the average tourist by being on the back of the vespers it was incredible. The guys who showed us around on the bikes made us feel comfortable and safe in an alien environment it is a credit to their professionalism and ability.

The night tour was everything and more you explained prior to us setting off on our evening adventure. The food and sites we experienced were beyond our wildest dreams. From eating the local cuisine to visiting both the quite club (which i might say was a beautiful experience)and the local popular night club where we experienced more western music was fantastic

If the trip had ended then we wouldn't have been disappointed. However YOU obviously know this was only just the beginning.

We set off the next day riding along some of the most spectacular coast line we never imagined to see and the sites never seemed to end, the whole trip was incredible.

Anyway enough of the scenery and and the great times we had along the way.

Both Sharon and I want to express our greatest thanks and appreciation to the guys who lead our tour.

Dat was an absolute gentleman who went out of his way to ensure our experience was as comfortable and safe as it could be. His knowledge of the Vietnamese history was amazing and his willingness to share his culture and country with the 4 of us is a credit to himself and your company.

Hieu is a great guy who lighten the mood on the longer days riding on the vespers. He always had a smile on his face and nothing was ever a problem when one of us wanted to take a break form riding.

Phong was was always a turn on the head away. Always there at the lawless roundabouts and shadowing us through the intersections to ensure our safe passage. I am sure without his patience and always happy approach we wouldn't have had the same experience that we did.

The time and research you have obviously have put into this tour is what made it what it is. We will never get on a tour bus ever again and we want to thank you for the experience

We can't talk this holiday up enough and are telling everyone of our experience. I would expect you will be getting a lot more enquiries over the coming months form the Newcastle people and hope they have the same fabulous experience we did.

p s Dat was nothing short of amazing and we consider him a true friend. We will be recommending him to all our friends to lead their tours should they choose to take on this adventure of a lifetime.

Thanks again for sharing this amazing country with us and we are interested in any other amazing adventures you may have to offer.

Don't know where to stop, we had the best time. Just watched the replay of the trip, I have not seen this many smiling faces ever.

Thanks again.

review_title: Don't take the Mekong day trip
review_text:
I went on the Saigon by night tour and had a great time. Tour guide was great and went to some interesting unique places I would not have found on my own. It was truly a great evening.

The next daY, yesterday, I booked the Mekong one day adventure for me, hubby and twelve year old daughter. Being on the bike was all fine and fun, but other than that, saw absolutely nothing. We get trice small unimpressive rice paddy and the guide says," this is a rice paddy". Uh.... Thanks. They basically take you thru a peri urban area and well off communities. The landscapes are far from nice or interesting in any way, if you have ever gone fifty km outside of any town in Asia, you know what I am talking about. We basically lost 220 usd on nothing. Lunch was an unsatisfactory fried rice and noodles just outside of town. Not a good day.

During our stay in Saigon we decided to go for the Saigon after Dark tour from Vespa Adventures. It is a great introduction to the city. During the evening you can literally live the chaos on the road by means of a classic Vespa from the sixties. Meanwhile, we stopped at several local places for dinner. The stops are great, some local (street food) places that serve the best fish I have had in Vietnam. Clams, crabs, mussels, and frog you name it! If you don't like fish, no problem.. The additional stops will serve different Vietnamese classics such as fresh spring rolls with rice pancakes. Our guide, Van Hoang, made sure that we got what we requested for! She was a great guide to hang out with and we had lots of fun during the evening. After dinner we ended up in a place with live classic music and after that a good bar with a band! Afterwards one more ride took us back to the hotel. Unfortunately the Vespa couldn't handle it anymore, she's pretty old you know.. Therefore Van brought us 'home'. We had a great time and she even had some additional recommendations to eat the next night of our stay in Saigon.

If you are more into city sightseeing you should go for the Insiders' Saigon tour. For a fun night out definitely choose Saigon after Dark!

This is a great way to see HCM
The guides were very good and helpful and also flexible about where they would take you and what you want to see
The flower markets and all the different manufacturing sites were amazing to see
Everyone works in this city or starves, and you can see them young and old, able and disabled all grafting!

My family of M & D and 3 adult children (18, 20, 22) did the after dark tour. It was just fantastic and one of the best things we did on our 10 day holiday in Vietnam. It's a bit like a pub crawl with a difference! The street food was amazing and authentic and the buzz of driving on a scooter through the Saigon night traffic was awesome. Our guide, Dieu, spoke very good English and was a wealth of information. Highly recommend.

We only had one night in HCM before going on a tour of the South, and having trawled the internet, I picked this for 4 of us (girls in our 40s), and we are so glad we did. Very well organised, lovely guide, a very sweet girl, full of information about life in HCM, we visited a mix of food and drink places, all of which we would never have gone to/never have found, on our own. On top of that, I had advised them that it was my friends birthday, and they arranged a couple of little cup cakes with candles on, at the start.......a lovely kick off to the evening. I couldn't recommend this more highly..........

review_title: Wonderful Vintage Vespa Tour of the Mekong
review_text:
If you like motor scooters, appreciate Vespas, and want to ride a restored vintage Vespa into the Mekong Delta, this is the tour for you. We started around 8:00 in downtown Saigon, ride to pick the Vespas we would drive, and departed around 8:30 am. We returned around 3:00 pm.
The cost of this wonderful day was $75 US Dollars. It was worth it, as it included the Vespa, a tour guide with excellent English and knowledge of Vietnamese economics, culture, and history, plus food and drinks.
We stopped during the ride for sugar cane juice, fresh scallops and clams, and finally, a mid-afternoon lunch. Roads ranged from paved two-lane to gravel one-lane, to dirt one-meter paths. We drove between rice paddies and shrimp farms. Except perhaps for taking the same tour on a bicycle, I cannot imagine a better way to see this part of Vietnam.
This tour company also has Saigon city day rides on Vespas (with a Vietnamese driver to handle the traffic) and evening rides to experience the nightlife in Saigon.
I am attaching photos from my tour through the Mekong Delta, near Hồ Chí Minh City (Sài Gòn), Việt Nam, last Sunday on a vintage Vespa.

review_title: Best Memory of Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text:
I booked the Saigon After Dark tour simply because I was travelling by myself and I had a spare night - and oh my gosh, I'm so glad I did!
The night tour was so much fun! You get on the back of a scooter and whizz around the overcrowded and busy streets - that itself is a thrilling adventure! Then you stop into a bout 5 or so different food and drink places where you can tantalize your tastebuds with all sorts of weird and wonderful foods - they're all great, i'd say just TRY EVERYTHING!

The tour was so great that i ended up booking to do another tour the next day - the Mekong Delta Day tour.

THis was also super awesome as you got to get out of the city and into teh heart of vietnam. I don't think i saw any other tourists that whole day apart from those in my group, which was great. They include food and drinks on the tour, and the food is delicious. I had such a great day!
Would recommend to everyone going to Saigon - you have to do one!!

This 4 hour tour is really exciting as you experience not only Vietnamese street food but also Vietnamese traffic on the back of a Vespa! We were picked up from the hotel by our drivers and given a helmet and taken to Zoom bar to meet our fellow diners, after a couple of drinks here (alcohol included) we all set off for a tour of Ho Chi Minh city by night and our first stop for seafood, our guides described what and how to eat what we were served - delicious and so many courses, lots of different shellfish cooked in so many different ways vegetarians are also catered for. Then the next stop to sample pancakes, spring rolls and other street food. Back on the bikes for coffee and music and a very Vietnamese bar and finally more drinks with live music at another bar. Great trip and a chance to meet and chat with others. Quite memorable tour of Ho Chi Minh

review_title: 7 Day Adventure was THE TRIP OF A LIFETIME!
review_text:
Exhilarating and exhausting, we're still on a high from the extraordinary ride from Dalat to Nha Trang, surely one of the most beautiful stretches of scenery in the world.

Witnessing such wonder while riding a scooter is one of the best things I've ever done in my life and helps to erase the memories of the white knuckle roundabout negotiations and terrifying gravel spills that preceded it.

This tour isn't for the faint hearted: it's a relentless, challenging schedule - but absolutely, positively the trip of a lifetime and one we will never forget.

Charismatic and kind tour leader Chau and superb crew Vo and Hu together with base support from Steve and Josh ensured that our dealings with Vietnam Vespa Adventures from my initial email inquiry 6 months ago right up until we loaded the bikes on the train on the very last day, was absolutely faultless.

If you get the chance - do it!

This review is about the Mekong Delta day trip.

Ok, first of all they pick you up from your hotel on a scooter with a professional driver, which going through downtown Ho Chi Minh City is an amazing experience in itself and almost worth the full day cost just to do. They then take you to sign up and be driven out to a place where you are assigned your scooter and driver, or to practice driving and get your scooter if you are comfortable enough. They are super safe and professional and made me take the driving test twice, with the owner Steve (who is awesome) and with one of the other drivers Josh. After passing, they have a tail scooter with emergency medical supplies and who blocks some turns for the group and lead and follow scooter to make sure no one gets lost. The views, the route, the food, and the fun will make this one of the most memorable experiences and definitely the best day trip in the world I have ever done.

It is exhilarating, cultural, and a beautiful way to see Vietnam, hands down if you are even questioning if you should do it, GO!

We did this tour on our last night in HCMC and Vietnam. What a great way to wrap up our fantastic experience of Vietnam. I kind of wish we had done it on our first night so that we knew some of the clubs and secret cafes and could explore them more later. Dzu (Yu?) and Josh were fabulous hosts - humorous and knowledgeable. Thanks to the guys on the Vespas too!
This was the best thing I did on my Vietnam vacation. I would highly recommend it. If you have ANY dietary restrictions, be sure to let them know up front. Worth the money, even if it rains.

I must admit I was a bit nervous about going on this tour with my husband and my three teenage daughters when I first saw the chaotic traffic in Saigon. How wrong I was! We never felt safer! After boarding our Vespas we were whisked off to the Zoom Cafe for a drink and a snack. We then went to a great seafood street stall for a delicious dinner (frogs and all!) This was followed by a quiet drink at a cocktail bar. We finished the night at a bar where the rock n roll singing was outrageous. Honestly, we have never laughed so much and enjoyed a night so much. Thanks guys for a fabulous night!

review_title: What a blast, do yourself a favour and book this...now
review_text:
What a great night we had with Vietnam Vespa tours, four hours of terrific fun.
From the moment we were picked up from the hotel until we staggered in four hours later we loved every minute of this tour, just being part of the crazy traffic is worth the price. Check out our blog for some more details and photos.
http://asiadreaming.wordpress.com/2012/09/25/jumping-chicken-and-vintage-vespas/

My family of 7 adults recently went on the "Saigon after dark" tour. You couldnt wipe the smiles of our faces as we were riding through the chaotic night traffic with thousands of other bikes. This was our first night into a 3 week holiday in Vietnam and we could not have asked for more fun. We were picked up from our hotel and taken to their headquarters "Zoom Cafe" and what a welcome we had from Steve and rest of the crew with drinks & snacks. By the end of the night we felt like we had known everyone for ever. They all made sure we had the absolute best time and fun. The street food we tried was all fabulous and there was no shortage of drinks flowing all night.

All the riders were excellent navigating through the traffic and so friendly to us all. We went to 3-4 street restaurants and ended the night at a local live music nightclub. Don't think too much about whether to do this tour or not even if you can't imagine yourself on the back of a vespa I guarantee you will have a blast. Thanks Vietnam Vespa for the memories!! :-)

review_title: Definite must-do! The best way to see Saigon.
review_text:
My boyfriend and I had just a few days in Ho Chi Minh City and we did 3 tours during that time. We chose the Saigon After Dark tour and had SO much fun. 10 days in Vietnam with tons to do each day, we had the best trip--and this tour was the highlight. 4+ hours, great people, the most energetic and fun tour guide we could have hoped for (I wish I remembered her name to give her the credit due!), and fantastic food (some semi adventurous food too--we ate frog!). There is nothing like zipping around Saigon on the back of a motorbike at night. A little scary at first if it's your first ride there, but you do quickly feel safe. I was a little iffy about the price as $70 goes a long way in Vietnam, but it was most definitely well worth the money.

Really, I can't say enough about it. After doing 2 other highly-rated HCMC tours as well I can say that this one is the best by a mile. If I could do it all again I'd have done their day tours as well.

review_title: Best thing to do in the city by FAR!!
review_text: You can purchase tickets online, so super convenient. The Vespas pick you up from your hotel or residence on time and take you to Zoom Cafe for drinks and snacks. There you meet the other riders from all over the world. Such interesting people! Then you will be off on your adventure to 5 different venues around Ho chi Minh. Either Steve or his wife seem to be on every tour and they make sure your experience is up the highest of standards. Seeing the city this way is by far one of the most fun things I've done on vacation anywhere. A must do, totally worth the money! Word to the parents, would not do this tour with a child under 12 because of uniqueness of the cuisine you will eat and availability of alcohol.

review_title: Best thing to do in Vietnam
review_text: I created this tripadvisor account expressly so that I could review Vespa Tours and give them 5 stars. So great I did it Saturday night and Sunday morning (a little hungover). Absolutely great value - around 70 USD for all you can eat and drink for 4 hours driving around Saigon. There is nothing like being in the pack of scooters cruising around saigon at night. It feels suicidal (and making left turns sometimes is) but I always felt very safe. This tour is a must.

review_title: Ho Chi Minh by night! What a buzz!
review_text:
My partner and I took the night tour on the day we arrived in Saigon and had a great night out. The traffic is just crazy though you feel quite safe in the hands of obviously experienced drivers and your right in amongst it all weaving in and out whilst taking in the sights and sounds.
Our guide kept us entertained and looked after us well. The food could have been better at some of the places we visited but was average in quality and taste.
We stopped at various street restaurants, a very cool coffee house, and finally at a bar with live band. We enjoyed the whole thing and could have stayed in the bar till the sun came up. The food and alcohol was all paid for in our initial cost which was $72US pp.
All in all a very good experience and one I would recommend.

We opted for the Saigon after dark tour and had we had more time, we had have done the others on offer too. It was incredible. We ate till our bellies could take no more of the culinary delights in places we would not have discovered on our own even if we had a month to spend in the city. Our tour guide was super friendly and knowledgeable and our drivers were not only handsome, but very safe drivers as they maneuvered us through the city.
I don't know how else to say this, but don't leave Saigon without having been on at least one of the tours on offer. Great, Great, Great.

review_title: Money well spent – Vietnam Vespa Adventures
review_text:
My buddy and I booked several tours through Vietnam Vespa during a weekend visit stay in Saigon (August, 2012) and what an amazing experience it was.

I was initially apprehensive about riding on the back of a Vespa but you quickly learn that the traffic is not as chaotic as it may seem and the drivers have many common understandings and rules about operating a motor vehicle.

The vespa operators I had were all great, often checking to make sure I was comfortable and the gentlemen who was the main leader of the Saigon after dark tour, Josh, was absolutely great. He was real easy going, very knowledgeable and helped guide every aspect of the tour to ensure that everyone was having a good time.

We had a chance to explore areas outside of District 1 (main tourist area) which I’m positive we would not have seen otherwise. In addition to seeing areas outside of District 1 Josh helped us experience many of the local dishes which was awesome. We were extremely well food on the tour and just had an awesome experience overall.

Because our experience on the Saigon by night tour was so great we decided to book an additional tour for the following day and that was equally great. Josh didn’t lead that tour but the women who did was great. She was knowledgeable, friendly, funny and just an individual who really enjoyed her work.

I’m so glad that we booked tours with this company as our experience was nothing short of fantastic. I would strongly recommend them.

As a note, we booked three tours with them - Glimpse of the Mekong, The Insider’s Saigon, and Saigon after dark.

review_title: Must do in Ho chin Minh
review_text: It's very cool to ride on a vespa to see the city. For the Asian though, some of the stops may seems a little boring as you have them at your backyard. Catered I would say for the westerner but worth a ride if you like professional stress free way to see HCM, all the main attractions are covered like post office, cathedral etc so it's basically one stop. The zoom cafe owned by the owner of the tour provided good local food. . A tip: the Vespa can send you to your preferred drop off location hence there is no need to go back to hotel if you do not want to. I get them to send me to a spa hence I saved on taxi fare ;)

review_title: Coolest thing to do in HCM City
review_text: Loved it! A friend and I went on the night tour. Had a blast! Really well run and coordinated - still don't know how they pull this off given the traffic in this crazy city. The food was excellent - so much on offer! Drinks along the way - we couldn't have wanted for anything else. Thanks guys!

review_title: Best thing we did in Saigon
review_text: What a great tour! We visitied places that tourists just don't see on this tour, and all on the back of a vintage vespa. Felt really safe the whole time. Our tour guide was wonderful, fun and informative. Because we booked online a great lunch was included at the cafe at the end of our tour. Thoroughly reccommend this tour.

So much fun!!!! We really enjoyed our night tour with these guys. everything was well organized and very professional. we felt safe the whole time and left with many great new memories of Vietnam. we will book another tour with them next time we are in Vietnam.

review_title: Vespa Tour of HCMC - What a blast!
review_text: Went on this tour based on reviews on TA and was not disappointed. Four of us (including a 12 year old) went on the City Insider Tour with another person (5 of us total). It is a great way to see the city without getting stuck in traffic. Guide was very knowledgeable and took us to many local places that we will never have thought to go. The Flower market in particular was lots of fun. Had so much fun that I am thinking of buying a restored Vintage Vespa from Steve the owner who also restores vintage Vespas from the '60's. Highly recommended!

I took 2 tours with the Vespa team, one on the Nighttime Ho Chi Minh City and one on the Mekong Delta tour. Both give a good perspective of the contrasting styles of the HCMC region, city life and rural life styles. Causes one to wonder why the rural areas are still so poverty stricken and desolate, almost 40 years after the end of the War. I noticed the people are very friendly, smiles abound and at the sound of approaching vespa the kids run to say hi and wave, it's as if they are the happiest people on the face of the earth. The tour guides were very well informed about the region, the people and the foods. Riding on the back of the Vespa is cool and let's you take in the scenes and try to take pictures. All day on a bike is a bit hard on the underside and I would have hoped for more stops along the way, to stretch and adjust. Locals dais the pkg was a bit pricey but from a western viewpoint it's with the USD75 if you want to see life outside the "Top 10" tourists areas, as was my plan. If I return to hcmc I would consider another trip with the team here.

review_title: Liked it so much we did two tours!
review_text: My husband and I had a great day tour around HCMC. When we first arrived in the city I couldn't imagine getting on one of those bikes in what appeared to be insane traffic, but am so glad I did. I actually came to appreciate how good the drivers are, and particularly our guides. They were very considerate of how we were doing, and conscious of their responsibility. We visited some interesting sites, though my husband and I thought they could have fewer Chinese attractions with more focus on Vietnamese culture. We liked the day tour so much that we did the evening tour as well. That was even more fun! We ate dinner at some typical VN restaurants (including a great dish of Bahn Xeo) and heard some good music at two different venues. You should DEFINITELY do one of these tours!

My husband and I went on the Saigon After Dark tour last night and had a blast! There is something about being on the back of a vintage vetspa and working your way through the streets of Saigon just like the locals! We had a great experience and our guide Dieu was the absolute best! She spoke wonderful English and made the trip what it was-fun and adventurous! The food stops were great-local seafood and traditional southern Vietnamese dishes-all yummy and the atmosphere was the real Vietnam! We then had fun riding our Vespas to a cafe and bar both with live music-def a highlight and two places you could never find as a tourist! All in all it is a must do if you travel through Saigon! Dieu-you were the best! Thank you!

I think everyone travelling to HCM needs to try out this tour of the city! You get to see and feel so much more by being on the back of the bike! After getting over the way they drive there you see it is pretty safe. I was with my 15 year old daughter who was on the back of one bike, I was on another and then there was a mother of 2 young boys, one was 7 and the other 3 on 2 other bikes. We all loved it and now my daughter wants her own Vespa! It was a great tour and really fun, a definite highlight of our trip!

review_title: Nothing beats a Vespa for tours of Saigon
review_text: Am very pleased with my three Vietnam Vespa Tours in July 2012 and will certainly do another tour next visit. Bikes are in top shape (they have a company mechanic and restoration shop) and drivers filled me with confidence. Guides and Cafe Zoom staff are outstanding; enthusiastic and helpful. They even pick you up at your hotel to begin a tour so no taxi ride needed. Must admit I was apprehensive at first about riding on back of a scooter in traffic, but fears alayed; if you figured out how to cross a Vietnam street on foot you know there's a method to the madness. Viet's sense of spacial awareness, collision avoidance and merging traffic is tops in the world. Night tour included good local food and way cool bars with excellent musicians; war tour took us to sites important to Vietnam and US, and guide happily took me to additional US sites not on the regular tour. Vespas are the way to go; most sites have no parking for cars, much less buses, meaning vehicles with more than 2 wheels will only go where they can park. Highly recommended by 'Fast' Eddie V.

Did a night tour with a group of friends. We all live in HCMC, so we are used to the traffic and noise, but it was so different seeing it from the vespa instead of a car. I loved this tour. The drivers were very professional and conscientious. It was so fun seeing another side of the city that we don't usually go to. The restaurants were all very good and the "secret cafe" was such an unusual experience. Also, all food and drink were included in the price of the tour. I can't say enough good things about this tour. I plan on recommending it to all our visitors now.
Did both the Mekong tour and the Saigon night tour. Both excelent ways to see parts of Vietnam. Recommend to everybody. And not just because you get to look cool riding around on a VESPA.

review_title: Saigon in style and great fun
review_text:
Steve has a great gig going on here: he greeted us like old friends and offered us a drink at his bar after introducing his wife to us; we felt like we were old friends from the start. The vespas arrived as we were enjoying our cold beer and minutes later we were on the road.
The drivers are great, the food was amazingly amazing (mark my words) and it was a true pleasure to not be a tourist for a few hours but actually be part of something.

Thanks again Steve and team and whoever reads this, book 'em before it's too late!

I couldn't have chosen a better way to end my 1st visit and quick trip to Ho Chi Minh City.

I decided to do the "Glimpse of the Mekong" tour for the day, sat back, enjoyed the ride and clicked away on my camera. The tour is well organised, off the beaten track as advertised and the guys are incredibly conscious about safety. I also didn't spend any more money than the tour price - yet ate and drank local until I was full.

If you're thinking of doing a quick dash outside HCMC and want to see a little of the village and riverside life of the Vietnamese then definitely choose Vietnam Vespa Adventures.

Thank you Dat for being such a careful driver!!!

This tour company was not my first choice. My first choice would not allow my 8 y/o to ride alone because they were scared that he would fall asleep during the ride. I am traveling alone with two kids (3 and 8) so that didn't work. I e-mailed Vespa adventure and they got back to me quickly and said they didn't have a problem with my 8 y/o riding alone. Paid my deposit and I was done until tour day.

Day of tour:

Picked up at hotel lobby like scheduled and transported via Vespa to restaurant for drinks and meet withrest of the group. My group was small, my family (3) and Canadian family (2). Tour guide was Dan. ( I'm sorry if I got it wrong). Tour was great. A good amount of time on bike and good amount of time walking. Great sites especially Tao Dan Park. What a peaceful and clean park! Will visit park again before departure. Tour guide was great. Very Nice and patient. Drivers were great. Always felt safe. Very nice to kids. Tour flew by and after tour finished, we had nice lunch at starting point. Both of my boys really enjoyed tour. Although this tour company was not my first choice initially they are now my ONLY choice. I will recommend to anyone visiting this area. FYI: both kids stayed awake during tour because they were having so much fun.

Only recommendation I have for someone with same children is to bring bicycle helmet for home because company did not have small helmets. Not sure how much helmet would help if accident occurred but I still like to try.
A group of friends and I did the Glimpse of Mekong tour. All I can say is that it was one of the best experiences I have ever had in my life and definitely the No' 1 highlight of our Vietnam holiday.

review_title: Utterly amazing experience, not to be missed.
review_text: We were collected from our appartments by our guides for the day and taken to the owners home where we swapped over the bikes to larger beautifuly restored 1960's Vespas. We were about to star in our own Vietnam adventure movie. I initially wanted to ride the vespa myself but was advised that for our tour of the mekon delta i should ride pillion. This was the right choice. My driver was very experienced and i never felt nervous for one minute. We were taken out of thr city and thru the outskirts of Saigon. We must have crossed over 50 bridges during the day some more solid than others! The tour took us to places we would never have dreamed of going and would never have been accessible from a bus. Single dirt track roads and down to the market to stop for afternoon tea. This comprised of the most amazing street food. Clams steamed with lemongrass and scallops with peanut and chilli. We stopped a few times for drinks and to be shown the shrimp farms and a house where the girl was making incensce for the temples. The return leg was due to conclude at the Relax restaurant in saigon. Again we had amazing food all pre ordered and all included in the cost of the tour. Our guides were kind enough to drop us at the Zoom cafe where we stopped for a well earned beer. If you're in Saigon and want to experience rural vietnam, this is the tour for you. Just bring a well cushioned behind! A day i will never forget.

We did a half a day tour of Saigon. We were all a little worried about safety etc until we sat on our 3 restored Vespas, but that went immediately awAy as our very experienced drivers took us on our " adventure". We saw parts o Saigon that we wouldnever have seen on our own, little markets etc, and our wonderful guide brought it all to life for us with very good explanations. This is a very worthwhile experience, definately reccomended.

review_title: Mind blowing tour "Glimse of Mekong" with Vespa Adventures!!
review_text:
Had an amazing day today on tour with Vespa adventures!! From start of day with "Dat" our tour guide picking us up from our flat, through to explaining best options on bikes...to lunch provided, coffee breaks , shrimp farms, insence factories and alll the interesting sights along the way.
Not being a risk taker in life, I was amzed at how safe these guys made us feel throughout our journey!! Everything was thought out, intuitive, and amazing.!! Beers at the Zoom Cafe topped off the day!! Anyone like me who never thought they would set a bottom on a vespa for a minute , never mind a day, will I promise, LOVE IT!!!

review_title: Had An Absolute Blast! The Best Tour Of All...
review_text:
The Saigon after dark tour was recommended to one of a group of 6 friends traveling Vietnam together, based on this we decided to do it on our first night arriving in Ho Chi Minh. It was simply booked via email for 6 at around $70 USD per person. Initially I thought this was a little expensive compared to other tour prices encountered, but it turned out to be worth every cent and much much more, being a night to remember! All food and a decent amount of drinks are included in the price.
6 Vespa's rolled up to our hotel right on time at 6pm ready to ride off into the night. Now if you don't know, in Ho Chi Minh the roads are buzzing with swarms of motorbikes going in every direction, some how road users just seem to make it work and people confidently make it from A to B tooting their horns and flashing their lights. Although, Ho Chi Minh gains a little control with traffic lights; unlike what we had previously seen in Hanoi.
I am over 6 foot 4 inches, so was concerned if a little vespa could handle me pavilion, but I jumped on the back with ease. So with brightly coloured helmets firmly fastened and complete confidence in our more than experienced drivers, off we set. As we were buzzing along with the flow of traffic, we all had expressions of excitement and exhilaration, taking numerous photos of each other and the surroundings. Our first stop was Zoom Cafe where we met our tour guide Tuyen, she promptly got the night started providing cocktails/ beers with a light snack and described what adventures the night would entail. Originally what drew us to this tour was that it was something different, off the beaten track of the typical boring tourism sites to experience this unfamiliar city, local style! That is exactly what we got, zooming from local restaurant to restaurant sampling various combinations of beautiful freshly cooked chicken, seafood, salads and delicacies never eaten before, and of course washed down with a beer or two. Tuyen our tour guide was loads of fun, and quickly became a friend teaching us the lifestyle and 'cheers' call of the locals. From a hidden treasure of a candle lit vocal/ instrumental cafe to a live band venue, then club to party the night away. So much adventure in a short space of time. With a group of 6 good friends we made the occasion all it could be, dancing the night away. The Vespa drivers ensure their passengers are always safe and although the tour seems relaxed and easy going, it is a well organised night for almost all. Most of our group traveled Vietnam from North to South over 3 weeks taking numerous treks and tours and we all decided this was up there as the best!

We did the half-day tour with this company. The Vespas were in good condition and there was no problem hapened on the whole journey. The guide was experienced and showed us amazing sites along the way. The food on our lunch was delightful as well.

This tour was exactly what I wanted in Saigon. A bit of safe adventure and an opportuntiy to try some of the amzing Vietnamese street food. My motorbike guide was very careful and confident. Also the route was planned very well to avoid all of the scary intersections in Saigon. We were taken to some fun and 100% authentic street eateries. Loads of fun and well organized. Not cheap, but well worth it!!!

I just organized this Vespa tour for friends to enjoy Saigon by night before breaking up for the summer holidays. First and foremost I must give a big thank you to Steve for being so accommodating and allowing me to add an additional 6 people to our tour less than 12 hours before the tour was due to begin. I just read a post from CBumblebee stating that there were limited Vespas......well, to his defense, Steve told me that he could provide motorbikes for our late additions but that he did not have enough Vespas for the tour because he already had 4 other tours that had previously booked and paid for their trips. I passed this information on and no one seemed bothered at the time. It is a shame that this disappointment was later expressed on Trip Advisor. Now, on a more positive note. My husband and I had a fantastic time on this tour. If you want a true Vietnamese experience, on the back of a Vespa or any motorbike for that matter is the way to do it! It was such a thrill to be in the mix of madness cruising around HCMC. We visited four different venues from the local backpacker hangout, to the very local restaurant serving up Saigon's tasty street food, to a very impressive piano bar and ending up with live music at a great nightclub called Yoko. Steve and all of his Vespa drivers were very helpful and safe drivers. I can't speak highly enough about this adventure. I would recommend it to anyone and plan to take all of our guests on the same tour. It may seem pricey but considering all of your food (and there was alot of it) and all of your drink are included in the price of this 4 hour tour. I think it was money well spent and look forward to the next Vietnam Vespa Adventure Tours.

review_title: Average, expensive and not always on a Vespa
review_text:
We were met by a group of scooters & motorbikes. There were only 2 vespas, not sure if they were vintage so that was a bit disappointing. First off had a drink and nachos at a rendezvous vous point, luckily that held me over as the first restaurant offered us overlooked crab, then I went to the toilet and saw the kitchen- nasty! I live in Vietnam and don't think that my Vietnamese friends would eat anything out of that kitchen. The staff got me better crab and tried quite hard, and kept telling me is was all about the experience. The next place was much better and cleaner. Then we went to a cool bar/ cafe for live unplugged style of music, really enjoyed that place, then onto Yoko bar which I love.

Highs- staff try really hard, English level of staff is good
Lows- filthy kitchen producing bad food, some small lady drivers who have a hard time keeping the bike up when you get on and off which did not make me feel safe, very pricy

review_title: You've never been to Saigon until you ride a bike!
review_text:
I booked Wartime Memories and Saigon After Dark with Vespa Tours. You’ve never truly experience Vietnam until you ride a bike and a Vespa at that.
I booked for my husband the Wartime Memories tour as he is very interested in history and is quite familiar with Vietnam's. All in all, he enjoyed the tour, but he did ask me afterwards if he had to pay for the entrance fee. I told him that the owner did not mention that. Well, my husband paid when it was supposed to be part of the tour. While he enjoyed the tour, he had a feeling that he is being rushed. When he wanted to go to the War Remnants Museum he had to ask his guide to give him at least 15 mins to look around as the guide was quite in a hurry. I told him that that should not have been the case. This tour, esp if you're a group, you can pretty much do on your own.
However, the Saigon after dark tour is not to be missed! It was one of the highlights of our tour. We ate where the locals ate and drove us around the different districts. Our drivers for this tour was thankfully not the one that my husband was earlier assigned to. They were courteous and always asking if I am ok. (They knew I was freaking out and was sooo stiff the whole time I was on the bike! HCMC traffic is mad! And I came from Manila.) Our tour guide Dat is very knowledgeable and accommodating. We ate seafood, which could have been fresher (crab claws, their version of mussels, Singaporean noodles, Tom Yum Clams and jumping chicken or fried frog legs) for the appetizer course in District 4, had our main meal (rice pancake with shrimp and sprouts rolled in various Vietnamese greens, grilled beef wrapped in rice paper, fried spring rolls, fresh spring rolls) in Bhan Xeo, capped of with Vietnamese coffee in Sesame Café/Bar (this is supposed to be a “secret” hang-out) where the younger Vietnamese set go for live entertainment (someone sings a capella, plays the piano and violin). Then for the last stop, we headed to Yoko Bar for more drinking and live entertainment. All stops included drinks (more beer!) The tour started 6.30 pm and ended 11.30 pm.

review_title: In a bus you’re watching the movie, on a Vespa you’re in the movie!
review_text:
We booked the Glimpse of the Mekong, this was the tour of a lifetime! We opted to drive ourselves, as we ride a Vespa back home. This type of experience was on our “life list” and every moment lived up to our expectations and beyond. This is the true Vietnam Vespa experience, rolling on classic Vespa’s navigating through Vietnamese terrain and life. Does it get any better?

We began our journey navigating our way through the busy streets of HCMC, then on to rural Vietnamese roads. We crossed many bridges of all types, ferries, narrow paths, drove through dirt piles, all while enjoying the views, the smells, the breeze and the excitement.

Our guide, Mr. Chau and his team provided us with a first class experience. Props to Steve for his great communication, this made booking this tour effortless. I am thankful for Steve and his staff’s passion for classic scooters, not to mention their amazing fleet of Scoots.

Bottom line, you get what you pay for and this tour was worth it! If you are looking for a unique perspective and love to ride and have the breeze in your face, this is the experience / tour for you. It will not disappoint. I wish we could go again!

Here’s a link to a little video we made about our experience: http://youtu.be/b0HvDLny-pI

Side Note: In my opinion, I would only recommend you drive on your own if you have plenty of motorcycle driving experience. This is not a beginner course. There are certain off and on road situations, bridges, narrow paths, dirt piles, etc. that a more experienced rider may be more versed in dealing with. Not to mention driving a classic Vespa / scooter can be a bit challenging for some, with the weight of the scoot, the clutching, gear shifting and foot breaking. As mentioned in previous reviews, they do have automatic scooters if you are looking to simplify your personal driving experience. If you’re unsure, go as a passenger, relax and enjoy the views!

review_title: It is amazing and worth doing it.
review_text:
I had used this tour during my stay in Thailand, It was really amazing, I could not believe that, I could get the best with reasonable price and much cared for. they managed to all what I had suggested on e-mails, I have no ideas to say more then enough for this Tours.

Overall, If I come to Thailand< I would come and do this arrangement once again, and I would definitely recommend to everyone.

Good Job, and Cheeeeeeeeeeers.

Had so much fun and I want to go again!
To cut the story short - we all meet up at a cafe 8am, 10 min drive to scooters...we all sign docs and gives us plenty of time to learn/adjust riding your scooter in a nice residential neighborhood...if you don't know how to ride a manual Vespa - no worries! They have automatic scooters too! If you never rode one...like me...I grabbed an auto and after a good 30 min practice I was ready! BTW, last 5 star bathroom stop! The adventure begins...through rice fields, across bridges, on/off ferries, everything mentioned by other reviews. I just wanted to call out 2 things on this tour: (1) bathroom along the ~ 5 hour tour - is your nearby bush or the outhouse in the market (beyond description). I had to do #2 and that was an "adventure"! (2) It's not a foodie tour so the lunch provided is limited to the adventurous eater. Guys, pack your toilet paper...liquids...snacks, energy bars and a sandwich...and make sure you go to the bathroom before you begin the tour! The tour is a blast and I had an amazing time. But just be prepared!

My wife and had one of the best nights in Ho Chi Minh with Vespa Tour.
We went on the night tour the food was great, the hidden cafe was unreal.
It is great that you get to see the real thing, keep up the good work.
Went we go back to saigon we will go again.
Thank you.

We were looking for something to do for the day like a tour to see the sights in the city and we were luck to find out this tour. We couldn’t think of a better way for exploring this city.The Vespas are in new condition. The guides were brilliant, explained eveything and were very flexible with us. A huge thank you :)
You have to do this, my son and I just got back from the glimpse of the Mekong tour, it was brilliant. Can't thank Steve and the guys enough for a great day and a great experience!

Thank you Dieu our tour guide for an amazing experience.
It was incredible being part of the throng of motorbikes on the roads no matter what time of day as all day seems to be rush hour! When we got on the back of the scooters our 12 year old too, I must confess I thought fleetingly what am I doing!!!! Once we were on our way that thought melted away quickly and we just grinned from ear to ear at the fun, sights, sounds and smells.
We really got a taste of the city. We started with traditional Vietnamese Coffee in the park with the birds singing in there cages. we saw the monument to the Monk who set light to himself to protest at China's occupation of Tibet. We were taken to the flower market, to a run down part of town that is to be re-developed. to temples, the Post Office and much much more. For most of the tour we were in parts of the city with no westerners and seemed a bit of a curiosity to some. we were told of Vietnamese flower symbols ie 999 red roses is a marriage proposal. we also went to a traditional medicine pharmacy and had lots explained.
Our guide had such a pride and love of her Country and her city it was a priviledge to share it with her. I wish we had had more time perhaps we could have done a night food tour too!

My brother and I took an evening tour in late October 2011 (leaving from Zoom Cafe). It had been recommended by a family member currently living in HCMC, and provided to be one of the highlights of our visit. We visited a couple of local street restaurants (the frog at the first one, and the ban xao at the second, were both amazing) and then visited a couple of local music venues. Although initially daunting (even though we were only pillion passengers on the scooters), the tour gave us a sense of the 'organised chaos' that was HCMC traffic - as a non-bike rider, it was probably as close as I would be willing to get to Vietnamese motoring, and it was a great experience.

Definitely a great way to explore this city. The guides were extremely helpful. We had a great day, my girlfriend loved her surprise trip and this Vespa tour was an excellent tour in our whole trip. Can't recommend this enough!

I took the Vespa Vietnam tours with our female tour guide, Dieu. Our trip started from our hotel where the vespa riders picked us up and dropped us off at Cafe Zoom. Lunch was provided together with drinks as part of the Insider's Saigon package. We had a fried noodles and a sandwich. I have to admit that I am not blown away by the food, but the portion is relatively big.

After lunch, Dieu, together with our riders (the Vespa drivers), brought us around Ho Chi Minh from District 1 to as far away as the Chinese part of HCM. It was quite interesting as we were brought to numerous stops, from the monument that commemorates the burning monk, to pagodas and temples. The guide was very good and knowledgeable and took the time to explain the stories behind each site as well as taking any questions we had.

All in all, it was an enjoyable 4 hour ride with Vespa Vietnam as we zipped around the crowded streets of HCM. Just travelling through HCM on a bike is an attraction by itself. The tour definitely gave us a more local perspective of things. However, a point to note for maybe Chinese travellers from Malaysia and Singapore, many of the sites that we have seen on Vespa Vietnam tour are quite similar to the Chinatowns and markets that you will find in Malaysia and Singapore. Nonetheless, travellers from other countries will find this a very insightful tour.

As experienced motorcycle drivers we opted to take a chance and hire our own bike even though technically you are required to get a Vietnam drivers licence - if you don't you aren't insured in an accident. After lots of emails with Steve, we felt confident that driving our own bikes would be fine.

We got picked up from our hotel, givien a lesson and a chance to get comfortable with our vespas before heading out on a 6 hour tour to the Mekong delta. This tour exceeded my expectation. It was awesome, the drivers, guides and tour leaders were fantastic and take our safety on the road seriously.

They were quick to help, made everything smooth and easy, we never had to wonder what to do or how to do something. We made a few stops at really fascinating places. The food and snacks were awesome, the scenery and terrain amazing.

We are glad we drove our own bikes and got to experience a piece of Vietnam in a safe but adventurous way. Definitely recommend whether you drive your own bike or chose to go out as a pillion

review_title: Saigon by night tour was a fantastic night out!
review_text:
If you like the idea of riding around the bustling streets of Saigon on the back of a vintage Vespa, feasting on local delicacies (seafood, beef, fish) at night markets, cold refreshing beer, and fascinating stops at hidden coffee houses and bars to hear local music, then you will love this tour. I am sure there are other companies offering similar concepts, but Vietnam Vespa Adventures really know what they are doing - small groups, two guides (English and Vietnamese speaking), really good itinerary that takes you well off the tourist path, plenty of food and drink, very safe - so we had a wonderful evening. The tours start at 6pm with a free drink at Cafe Zoom, owned by the owner of the tour company.

We did also do one of their day tours (Saigon Art and Architecture) a couple of days later, and it was very interesting, but it was not anywhere near as much fun as Saigon by Night. Daytime tours include lunch at Cafe Zoom, but the cafe food is pretty average and mostly western rather than Vietnamese.

Having read some great reviews of Vietnam Vespa Adventures on Tripadvisor, I decided to book the newer "Glimpse of the Mekong" tour. Most reviews seem to be the city tour or the night tour, but for my partner and I, we conquered the city in a day and a half and wanted to see something different.

We had no idea what to expect, at first I was a little nervous. At the first stop, Steve himself showed my fiance how to ride a manual. They do have automatic's available too. I personally chose to stay with my guide, Mo, the entire way! Maybe it was the low season, but we lucked out and it ended up just being the two of us, plus the two guides. Both were locals, only one of whom spoke english, but we had no problem communicating and shared a few of laughs along the way, learning a few Vietnamese words for us to take back.

As far as the tour itself is concerned, it was everything we were looking for: something different and completely away from the city. It's hard to explain, but even just riding on the back of scooter for hours, soaking in and enjoying the scenery was the best time I'd ever had in SE Asia. As for my fiance, he was just happy to be riding! (Men and motors, there's something about it!) The tour takes you deep into the heartlands, on some adventurous bridges and through a local market, just to name a few. We were the only tourists around, so it felt like a very "real Vietnam" experience. After the tour ended, walking/busing/cabbing or any other form of transportation felt like a slow and boring way to get around!

I am reluctant to give any more details, simply because no words or photos will capture how much fun we had. Bring your sense of adventure and lots and lots of sunscreen! It gets hot out there, but the guides will keep you well hydrated with stops and refreshments along the way. If you have a spare day in HCMC, just book it and see for yourself! You will not regret it.

review_title: If this is the only thing you do in Ho Chi Minh City, you will not be disappointed
review_text: My husband and I loved this so much that we want to go back and do a 7 day trip around Vietnam on a Vespa. We did the "Saigon by Night" tour, and it was truly an experience not to be forgotten. There were 8 of us, we got picked up by our drivers at our hotel, then spent the next four hours riding on the back of Vespas all around Saigon. They took us to some of the best food we had on the trip. One of the places had these clams in a lemongrass broth that I'm still dreaming of. You definitely got to experience what it would be like to live there and one of the coolest ways to do it. Highly recommend this to ANYONE - young or old!

Spent today cruising on the back of an awesome 1985 PX150 while my partner looked like the cat who got the cream riding his restored 150 Vespa (late 60s?). We did the Mekong day trip, it was absolutely fantastic. There is no pretending that you will be taken into the actual Mekong Delta, rather this trip skirts the edges and takes you into some fascinating villages that owe their livelihoods to the many tributaries of the Mighty Mekong. Our guide was Josh, he was such a lovely, softly spoken guy. Steve who owns the company was there to greet us and also joined us for lunch at an almost surreal restaurant on the edge of HCM city. We stopped at some cool places; the food and scenery was superb. Totally off the beaten track, we never saw another tourist for the whole time we were on the bikes. The fact that we were able to drool over some beautiful old Vespas was a bonus. This tour is so worthwhile; if you dont have time to do a couple of days in the mekong or you want to escape the tourist traps then this is for you. We have booked the night tour for tonight and can't wait.

These guys really know what they are doing!! From hotels to attractions and the vintage vespa are absolutely fantastic to ride!!

Would recommend this for someone wanting to visit non-tourist parts of vietnam in truly rememberable way!!

review_title: Great Vespa Tour through the Mekong Delta
review_text:
We wanted a tour through the Mekong Delta with an easy rider. We couldn't find one until we meet Steve from the Zoom Cafe and the owner of the Vespa Adventures Day Tours.

We drove the Vespa by ourselves but you can also choose to sit on the back of a guide.

It was a great tour and we saw so many local people and the real Mekong Delta. People are staring at you if you are an Alien.

Don't choose for a tour by bus with lots of tourist, just drive through the real Vietnam by yourself!

review_title: great tour, an unusualy and off-the-beaten path view of Saigon
review_text:
It was very nice to discover some of Saigon from the saddle of a Vespa: the traffic seems daunting but after a while you get used to it. I was at the end of a bicycle tour which started in Hanoi, so it was great to see the differences between north, center and south of Vietnam.
The food on the vespa tour was excellent and we really went to places where I could have never been by myself. I recommend it to whomever likes to have a full immersion experience of Saigon in a 2-3 hour short time. Good job guys, as a cyclist and 2-wheel lover, it was great to rest my legs and let the driver lead me through the apparently-not-regulated traffic of Saigon. Cristiano

review_title: Get ready to see parts of Vietnam that most people don't get to experience
review_text:
My husband and I did the Mekong Delta tour and it was our favorite tour while in Vietnam. It was such a unique, thrilling adventure that unfortunately many tourists DO NOT get to experience but they MUST! Josh, our fantastic tour guide for the day, took us on so many great backroads and stops along the way. I recommend wearing long pants and/or a long t-shirt as you'll get very dirty from the dirt roads. Don't know how to drive a Vespa? No worries. Someone will drive while you sit on the back enjoying the view. The lunch at the fishing restaurant was yummy!
