Thanks for a great adventure!

review_title: Best tour in the hole trip
review_text:
We were traveling for one month we had tours every day and this one was for far the best one. Since they received us was great, they received us with chile con carne and tortillas since we are mexicans, they took us to local places where you get to know very well the country, everything that we liked they got it for us (for example one peper and salt melange), we tasted frog, crab legs, shrimps, oysters and so many more things, Then we went to a bar with live music to have a drink and at last to a very local restaurant. We loved the tour we loved that the owners took us and shared with us much information! thank you very much!!
Sol. (Mexico)

review_title: Best Ever Adventure and great Food!!!
review_text: This was our favorite experience in Vietnam! Don't miss this! We did other great things like private cooking class, private tour of the Mekong Delta, water puppet show, and this was the Highlight of our trip! I was thinking a lot that this was out of my comfort zone, being in the middle of the traffic with only a helmet and a driver to protect me. By the second of five stops I couldn't stop smiling because I was so enjoying being in the middle of the action and seeing the sites, sounds and smells of the city from the seat of the Vespa. The food choices were an adventure, delicious and a perfect way to explore the flavor of the city. i felt this was a culinary culture tour rolled into an adventure experience! There were four of us, from 21 - 60ish and it was each of our favorites!

review_title: A real feel for the authentic Vietnam
review_text:
A truly amazing and unique experience which we would highly recommend to anyone we know heading to Vietnam for a holiday.
The Vespa ride was magnificent...heaps of fun and perfectly timed with stops and amazing experiences with the locals along the way.
When we return to Vietnam in the future, Vietnam Vespa adventures will be a definite priority for us.
We also appreciate Josh looking after us so well with food and drinks all day!
His guidance and expertise allowed us a very relaxed day sampling foods and drinks that otherwise we would not have had the opportunity to experience.

review_title: Best Way to Really See Saigon
review_text: Had a GREAT personalized tour w American Guide Josh. Saw parts of the city we'd never encountered even after living here for years. Drivers trained well, make you feel safe and "in control" while on the back. VESPAS in GREAT condition. Owner, Steve's really hand picked his "hot spots" and knows what expats and tourists willing to pay these rates are interested in seeing. This isn't a cheap, thrown together tour. With Vietnam Vespas, you definitely get what you pay for
Booked a Corporate trip with clients. Well serviced from Hotel pick up through to interesting visits around CBD. Thanks chaps.

review_title: The most fun I had in Ho Chi Minh City!
review_text: I did a night tour with friends and it was an absolute blast. You get to see sights, sounds, food, and music that you would never find on your own. For the money you will not get a better and more exciting tour in HCMC! We had so much fun we booked a day tour a few days later which was great but not as crazy as the night tour. It was still very unique and we saw places you normally wouldn't find on your own. I never felt unsafe and the guides will teach you so much about the sites and the culture of the city. If you don't book this tour you'll be missing out!

review_title: a thrill in saigon - musthave! mustdo!
review_text: no matter how old you ar'' dont skip this one!! SAIGON LIKE YOU COULD ONLY IMAGINE. Safe and friendly scooter drivers and ambiance that makes you come back for more. Had the best time ever on a scooter and in such cooool places in saigon.thanks and COM AN

we went on the saigon after dark tour, we had booked the tour after having a drink at cafe zoom . we really did,nt know what to expect especially after seeing the traffic chaos in saigon we were more than a little apprehensive,our worries were unfounded. the vespa guys were great and very experienced and our guide the very lovely trang showed us the real saigon,the food and drinks and the entertainment was all included in the price. if you want to experience the real vietnam you must do this tour. angus and yvonne.

Having been to Saigon before and seen the sheer number of bikes on the road, at first it seemed like a scary and dangerous thing to do. Far from it, once on the scooter you realise they all know what they are doing and wheras i never feel safe on a bike, i was relaxed on this. Touring the city on these is easy. A couple of minutes and you're at the next location - no fuss. Not like forever getting on and off motorcoaches. Our guide "Tiny" was so helpful and informative and made our day the trip of a lifetime. A big thank you for the experience

It was the best tour we had out of all the tours we went to in Ho Chi Minh:) i enjoyed it even if i really don't know well how to drive the motorbike.. Josh and Josh and the rest of the Vespa guys were really wonderful! Just make sure you bring your sunscreen and jackets/ long sleeves! It was fun, and bumpy, and thrilling!

review_title: Best tour Ive experienced on my two month trip
review_text: I did the Saigon at Night Tour.....and hands-down, this is a must-do tour if you enjoy food! I've never ridden on a motorbike before, but I felt very safe with the drivers. The guys take you to hole-in-the-wall restaurants, but everything is fresh and delicious. The lemongrass clams at the first stop was my favorite dish throughout all of Vietnam. Everything is run very smoothly.....as they send people ahead to make sure there is proper seating, set-up, etc. There is plenty to eat.....and a lot to drink. It certainly helps if you have a fun group! Dishes are a bit seafood heavy, but if you tell them that you're allergic beforehand - they are very accommodating. If you are in HCM, you REALLY need to try this tour.

review_title: The best tour I have ever taken!
review_text:
I signed up for the one-day “Glimpse of Mekong Tour” after seeing positive reviews on the internet and some correspondence with Steve, the owner of Vespa Vietnam Adventures. I had taken a very interesting rural-view tour in Cambodia on ATV, and was looking for something similar. This tour exceeded all of my expectations.

By the end of the day I told our tour leader Josh and Steve that this was the best tour I have ever taken. The tour was a great mix of a fun ride on the scooter, great scenery and the friendliest people ever. Even though they frequently run this tour, it seems that most of the local people you interact with have never had much contact with foreigners, and the people you meet at the various rest and lunch stops are very friendly and inquisitive.

Josh (the one from Michigan – there are 2 guides named Josh), our main guide was an energetic and accommodating guy, always making sure we had enough to eat and drink and time to rest. He has also spent a lot of time in Vietnam and S.E. Asia, so he was able to answer lots of questions I threw at him. We also met the other Josh later and he seemed like a very knowledgeable and friendly guy too.

The tour started by meeting at Zoom Café which is close to any hotel in the back packing area. We went to the tour staging area riding on the back of some staff scooters which was smooth and a fun way to see Saigon in the morning. After an introduction to the bikes we were on our way scooting through the remnants of Saigon traffic and heading into the Mekong.

I selected a newer automatic scooter instead of a traditional Vespa as I wanted to focus on the scenery, not changing gears. It worked flawlessly and was very easy to control. My last bike was a supersport bike, so experienced riders don’t worry, there is enough zip in the bike for the riding you will be doing on this tour and also seemed easy to learn for someone not used to operating a bike.

There were a few highlights of the day, including some ferry crossings where you get off the bike and smile and interact with local people, including a group of school kids on one ferry. We finished off the day with a cool beverage at a spot near the staging area where you can also try your luck at fishing from your table.

I think some people might be wary of the tour due to the price compared to other attractions in Ho Chi Minh city, but I could recommend this tour even if it were twice the price. This is not a boat ride down the Mekong river, but a real “glimpse” into rural Vietnam. If you like riding and/or want to see rural Vietnamese life first hand, this is the tour for you. I am definitely “wow”-ed!

we went on a vespa after hours tour(6pm-10:30ish) last week and it was awesome, probably the highlight of our nites out in saigon. we rode on the back of a vespa to different places for dinner(meals and rinks incuded-and you go to about 3 different places to eat) and into some local bars as well. was a really enjoyable night, fun on the back of the vespa to get amongst all the action! may seem a little steep for some, esp backpackers, but it really is a great night out. host(josh)and drivers were excellent, definately will recommend this to anyone heading to siagon.

Had a night tour around Saigon - it was the highlight of our trip! 4 of us+one more couple+2guides and Vespa drivers of course. They took us to no-tourist zone - District 4, fed up with great snails, mussles and frogs in local eatery, then took to another place for some vietnamese hot pot (and beers!), then to local rock club and salon-style hidden cafe - all was very unexpected, cool, FUN! Great time, want some more!

review_title: Fantastic evening of food, drink and touring.
review_text: My wife and adult son thoroughly enjoyed our Vespa night tour. Wide variety of stops and venues we would never have found on our own. Drivers and guides were excellent, safe and informative. Highly recommend and a real highlight of our time in Saigon.

What a great way to see HCM at night and savour its culinery delights. We stated our tour at the Zoom Cafe where we met Josh, Josh & the owner Steve and had a few beers. My 20yo daughter, biker husband and I were allocated our vespa guide and bike then off we rode into the madness of HCM traffic with a group of 11. We ate delicious food in great company finishing it off in a nightclub for cocktainls and 70's music. To top it off, the boys delivered our luggage to the last stop then rode us to the train station to catch our 11pm train. If its adventure you want then this is the tour for you, we highly recommend it.

review_title: My best night in Ho Chi Minh City
review_text:
We did the "Saigon after dark"-tour. It surely was a fantastic experience. Food was excellent, and i got to taste frog for the first time in my life.

The tour was a perfect choice for a perfect evening. Well worth the money. Highly recommended.

I was originally trying to arrange with a different company who seemed not so keen to provide services on January 1. After getting in touch with Steve and Patrick, I knew we were in luck. Despite being a young couple we are relatively unadventurous with our food and wanting to take a bite out of the real Saigon, I thought that going on a guided tour would be our only chance to try local delicacies in a safe and fun environment. We started our adventure after being picked up at our hotel (my driver being Steve himself), first stop Cafe Zoom which functions as headquarters for the company. After an included drink, we launched ourselves into the craziness made of mopeds and bright lights. I don’t want to reveal too much because I think it is nice to be surprised but personally I thoroughly enjoyed the whole experience which includes food and entertainment. I also had the pleasure to be driven around by the man himself and we had some interesting conversation about his background and life in Vietnam. To normal standard the price of the tour might sound significant but I felt it measured up with the 4 hours of fun and entertainment...but most of all safety provided during the tour. Their website is well put together and gives a good insight on what’s on offer. They also offer longer vespa trips outside HCMC which sounds like a lot of fun. One last remark: I am not affiliated with this business, I just enjoyed and if you have doubts I would just recommend getting in touch with the guys who will only be happy to answer your questions as they did with me. We were also lucky with the group of people who were with us on the night: big hello to Katja & Thilo and Florian & Christine.

We took the Saigon After Dark tour with our two daughters, ages 12 and 8, our last night in Ho Chi Minh City. What a blast! We had a great time riding on the back of the vintage bikes with very able and safe drivers as we ate local street food and sampled some local music. The drivers were great with our girls and took care to make sure their helmets were fitted correctly and they were feeling safe. Steve and his wife were really wonderful companions on the tour, sharing the city they know and love so much. We will definitely be back!

So here we go ....

The best way to see Saigon by day or night, is possibly from the back of a scooter for the faint-hearted. We had barely mastered the art of crossing the swarming streets when we saw a recommendation at the back of Jetstar's inflight magazine, for Vietnam Vespa Adventures.

Given that we were in Saigon for only a couple of days, we booked with Steve Mueller (founder), the night of our arrival and luckily, he could fit us in. We were very excited when the riders turned up and fitted us with helmets, and off we went ... firstly to headquarters "Cafe Zoom" recognisable by the fleet of scooters out front. We were introduced to our guide Josh Guikema, offered a cocktail and then met Steve and his other guide Josh Baker. Our guide Josh Guikema was a very gracious host and so friendly, we felt like adopting him :-) Josh had just done a 7-day Vespa tour so he must've been tired but he was just focused on making sure we had the best time.

With a putt-putt-putt, we were soon scooting along in the slipstream of hundreds of other motorbikes. We got up close to the locals, checked out girls in short skirts in high heels, and families of 3 or 4 on motorbikes. En-masse, we glided more smoothly than the large expensive cars driven by the local elite, and probably got places faster too.

Thus began our progressive dinner that evening, starting with a pork baguette on a busy street, then some very fresh seafood dishes (with frogs staring dolefully at us), followed by a grill and roll-yourself spread in a laneway. Towards the end of our awesome adventure, we were treated to an 'underground' music cafe except it was up some dark, creaky stairs, and listened to local musicians performing sweet ballads whilst we sipped cà phê đá in a cosy, intimate venue. We said farewell at our last stop, a live music bar (except it was quiet that night), sated and very satisfied. Our single fee covered all meals and drinks so we could enjoy ourselves without having to count out millions of dong.

Steve, Josh and his team have given us a glimpse of Saigon by night and made us very jealous of their expat life-styles there! Of course, it is no fun for the local motorcyclists who have no choice but suck in all those traffic fumes. We have come away with admiration for the Vietnamese people, with the look of sheer determination on their faces and everyone is always going some where to do some thing ....

This is a MUST-DO when in Saigon, at least ONCE in your life!

review_title: Great food and a bunch of nice people
review_text: Have been on the street food tour yesterday, which was apparently extremely busy, but the team handled wellmby splitting into subgroups and thy were really caring for everybody. The food was fully authentic and very very good. And some entertainment came on top, to be absolutely recommended.

We went on the Saigon After Dark tour on 2 January 2012. Although some of us were a little apprehensive about getting on the Vespas, all our fears disappeared within 2 seconds of getting on them. We were picked up from our hotel by the drivers and were taken straight to Cafe Zoom, which was a great idea as it quickly settled our nerves.

We were met at Cafe Zoom by our tour guides, Patrick and Josh, who were so accommodating and friendly. We were taken to some amazing food spots and ate Banh Mi, Banh Xeo and plenty of other local delicacies (we won't spoil the surprise for you!).. but the food we ate that night ended up being the best meals that we had over our entire stay in Vietnam!!

Between the Vespa rides, the delicious food + drinks and our wonderful tour guides - the whole tour was one of the best experiences we've ever had! This is one of the best ways to see Saigon and you really do feel like one of the locals.

After the tour - we spent the next few days in Saigon getting as many xe om (motorbike) rides that we could get, because we were hooked!

Thanks again to Patrick and Josh for a truly memorable evening! We would love to come back and do the multi-day tour to either Mui Ne or Nha Trang.

Riding a scooter is useful because the city is huge but honnestly you could also rent a moto driver for a few hours and discover the same places by following your Lonely Planet. We did not feel we got an insider view of the city and on top of that we did not see some of the major monuments of the city as planned.
Besides, our guide barely spoke English so it was difficult to understand some of his explanations.
We felt even a little bit abused when they served us lunch at their cafe (food is very touristy and not good by the way) and were asked after only 20 minutes if we were done because the driver wanted to drop us back at our hotel... In the end we were at hour at 12:00 while the tour was supposed to finish at 12:30.

review_title: One of the best tours I've taken
review_text: I hand read the reviews and knew it sounded interesting but I never expected it to be so good. We were exposed to parts of Saigon that we would never have found on our own. We always felt safe on the vespers. The staff was extremely friendly and very well organized I would recommend this to anyone wanting a unique experience
We did the night Food/Culture tour. Brilliant! It is not fair to tell what will happen, but if you want to get down to the real Saigon then this is it. Do it.

review_title: Can't imagine it gets any better than this!
review_text: I'm having a hard time not gushing, so maybe I just will... We started with the Saigon After Dark tour, exploring all kinds of food and places we never would have found or tried on our own and I thought it couldn't get any better. The next day, we learned to drive our scooters, had coffee in a "bird park" and saw the first glimpses coastline; And again, I didn't think it could get better, but it just did. Throughout the 7-day tour to Nha Trang, I felt like I had a smile plastered on my face the entire time. Our guides were cool and fun but safety conscious. The other travelers in our group also made the trip super enjoyable. There are so many things I saw, tasted and did that I will remember for the rest of my life. I will add pictures once I figure that whole situation out. Do this trip and you will not regret it!

The tour was great, 5 of us went on the afterdark tour, we went to Zoom cafe for a drink, a streetside seafood restaurant with incredibly delicious seafood, best I had in Ho Chi Minh for sure, followed by a secret local music cafe hideout and finishing with a rock&roll club. I had a blast, and highly recommend this tour.

We did the evening Vespa tour visiting local restaurants and it was such a great time! You dont find these places by yourself so it was a great opportunity to try real vietnamese meals. So dont miss it!

review_title: Authentic Locations and Extraordianry Foodie Experience
review_text: Had a perfect night out in Saigon. There is probably no better way to discover the city, get to know hidden places and taste a great variety of local foods. Thanks, Steve!

It is a difficult task to add to almost all the reviews prior to this one. However, the Saigon After Dark tour taken by my daughter and myself proved to be one of the best commercial city tours we have ever taken. We were especially lucky as the downtown area of the city was benefitting from the special lighting erected for the celebration of the New Year and the Tet celebrations in some three weeks time. The tour operators also exhibited a great degree of flexibility in the tour as they omitted one location which we had visited previously and substituted a new venue - in this case a jazz club with some very talented musicians and a great atmosphere. Thus our tour commenced with an introduction at the Zoom Cafe in District1, then proceeded to a seafood stall restaurant in District 4 (highlights were the salted crabs claws and frogs legs), thence to a Bang Xeo restaurant and finally to the jazz club close to the centre of the downtown core. The tour lasted some five hours and all food and drinks were included in the tour price. Overall, the tour as a pillion rider gives one a unique perspective of life after dark in Saigon and a completely different perspective from that which one would normally gain from air-conditioned buses or cars which would be too cumbersome to negotiate several of the streets visited by the Vespas.

We did the Mekong day tour. Our only disappointment was the day went too quickly! We were taught to ride the bikes in the morning and then set off early on the back roads for a day touring around the Mekong. We were out from 8am to 3pm. I was the least experienced and felt totally safe at all times. They go at your pace. The roads you take were mostly very quiet. The places were really beautiful and because you get to go on some dirt tracks you get to see places off the tourist trail. It was fantastic riding through rice paddies on a motor bike! The food was delicious at the two stops. Steve and his staff were so helpful and absolutely lovely. I would recommend this for anyone who wants to escape the city and is a bit more adventurous. Thanks Steve! From Josie & Chris

review_title: One of the most thrilling and fun things I've ever done.
review_text: This was such an incredible experience. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't slightly terrified some of the time, but it was so great. So great. What a great way to experience a city to the fullest. Reasonably priced for what you get--just fantastic.

review_title: Fun, interesting and very exciting on the Vespa
review_text: Booked in the morning and did the half day city tour on the Vespa in the afternoon. Was very very exiting on the Vespa in the local traffic and all sights visited were interesting. Tour included lunch which was delicious. Tour guide was great. Defiantly recommend for a quick fun and exciting way to see the city!

review_title: Great food, great guides, great fun!
review_text: My friend and I have been living in Saigon for nearly one year and have never been to some of the places they take you on the Saigon After Dark trip. You get to try some really great food and meet some nice people.The pace of the tour works well and the guides are really friendly and interesting to talk with. However, for expats or people living here, you should know that a decent portion of the tour focuses on the experience of riding on a Vespa through the streets of HCMC. If you are used to doing this, you could possibly ask to be taken directly to the next location instead of taking the scenic route. The tour guides are happy to work with you to make the tour a great experience!

We did the After Dark tour and were delighted by the impeccable service, the great food and an exciting ride on the back of the Vespa through streets large and small in D1,3 and 4 of the city. A great way to see the city and sample some very delicious local food that I wouldn't have tried on my own. Stopping at some local joints for live music and drinks was a great way to end the evening. Highly recommended!

review_title: Best way to get a feel for night life in Saigon
review_text: We had an excellent adventure on Vespa Adventures' Saigon After Dark tour. Patrick, Lu and Diem took very good care of us and exposed us to parts of Saigon that we had not seen before. The drivers were very good at making even scooter newbies like us feel comfortable in the Saigon traffic. The tour is very well organized, and you'll have a chance to taste some delicious foods and hear some great music that you could not normally experience unless you had a native guide. This was an insightful and fun outing that we recommend both to visitors and expat residents. Thanks Vespa Adventures!

The Vespa tour 'base camp' is at Zoom Cafe in the middle of the backpacker area, we had some problem to find and where, BTW, you get one of the best burgers in HCMC at a very reasonable price.
We arranged to be picked-up the next morning in front of our hotel, the guide and the drivers came on time, even though they did not say much, we felt safe the entire time, loved venturing out to districts we would have never bothered going to on our own (especially Chinatown) and felt the Flower market was a highlight of our little trip.

Must admit despite all the great reviews here on TA, our expectations were not really high - we have been living and travelling around SE Asia for the past 10 years and did explore different Asian cities on scooters many times in the past, so we basically went on a tour to kill the time. And yes, we found some places more predictable than others and felt like 'been here, done that', however it still was an interesting and fun experience with a very friendly crew, who worked their guts to give us the experience of our lives, which I appreciate and would by all means recommed to fellow travellers, especially for a good introduction to HCMC and Vietnam. What a lovely country! Don't think twice, it is a must-do in HCM.

P.S. We paid 50 $ each, which I found a little bit overpriced, but after living in Asia for so long, you get a bit 'cheap' yourself, I admit. LOL

I returned to Vietnam this past fall with plans to embark on a "new" tour, custom tailored for my friend and travel mate, Jim Linser. Appealing to our request for something adventurous, Steve put together a combo-tour that included riding vintage Vespa's around Saigon and the countryside, and a very adventurous motorbike tour of the Central Highlands. It is refreshing that a tour company can accommodate a special request for personalized tour! Excellent customer service by VVA.
The Vietnam Vespa Adventures and Zoom Cafe staff, were as always, excellent and very friendly and professional. They always go out of their way to make your experience a memorable one. It is a testament to the professional management, that a year later, I received the same friendly, helpful, and professional service. I cant say enough about them.
If you are in Vietnam and want to do something a bit different and off the "well worn beaten path", give a Vespa tour a try. I can guarantee, you will have done something most will never do, and you will actually have FUN on your vacation.

We love scooter tours in foreign countries, but in the city that is flooded with scooters what could be a better way to see the city than from the back of a scooter like a local !
We were picked up from our hotel by our guides for the afternoon and given the option to have a quick lunch at headquarters -Zoom cafe -where we met the expat owner and brainchild of this amazing concept tour ! We went to the most interesting local points of interest which you would not do on your own or on a normal sightseeing excursion or even know existed like Chinese funeral homes and real traditional herbal apothecary ! The scooters used are reconditioned vintage Vespas, which have a very cool attitude attached to them ! So much information was given to us about current topics and local concerns and growth . This was the most fun and inciteful excursion we have ever had on any of our trips and we wish we had known about Zoom before, as we would have booked a longer city to city trip, which is offered !
AWESOME and CRAZY!!!

I did the night tour. and it was fabulous! I thoroughly recommend it for your first night in Vietnam. We got to try 10 different Vietnamese dishes. Foods that you might never think to try because you normally don't have anyone to advise you on what is what or how to put it together.

There were quite a few people booked in for the tour that night so Vietnam Vespa's ran multiple groups. The maximum group size is only 8 which helps to make the tour more intimate and enjoyable. We all left the tour feeling like we'd made friends.

We stopped four times. Firstly for appetisers, then for main meals, after that coffee at a "hidden" cafe and finally for cocktails at a pretty new western nightclub

I loved it so much that I am going to book another tour.

Do it, you won't regret it!

review_title: If there is one thing you do before you die.....
review_text: This is definitely amazing value for money. This is no normal "tour", you visit local villages where not too many tourist get to go. Because you are travelling by Vespa you see so much more and have the option to stop if you wish. After being on the scooters it is great to have top class accommodation at the end of the day. The food is excellent and plentiful (in actual fact we were fed way to often and way to much). The guides are both informative and professional but thank god they also have a sense of fun, adventure and a sense of humour. We travelled with friends and our 14 years old daughter. At no time was our daughter left out and was at all times treated like a VIP. We are heading back again with the same group as everyone didn't want the trip to end.

review_title: Ho Chi Minh City at Night - as local.
review_text:
This tour is on genuine Italia Vespa.
The girl who took me spoke excellent English and was fun to hang out and have her show me around.
Tour includes meals and drinks at all 5 stops.
I recommend this tour immensely !
Roni.Israel

review_title: Great way to see the city by night on cool old school vespas, sampling great food along the way!
review_text: Had an excellent time on the tour! Me and my girlfriend both booked the night tour and were very impressed! Saw a different side of ho chi Minh with all drinks and food included along the way. The boss is American and seems very cool. I'm keen to go on one of the longer tours next time im in Vietnam

We went for the vespa night tour and it exceeded our expectations. We got to see lots of areas and places that you wouldn't normally see. We got to eat and drink at a few different places and there was no extra expense involved. Great value and great tour leaders! The vespas were all super cute and in excellent condition :-) highly recommend it!! Jimmy & Monika Australia

My partner and I live in HCMC and were looking for a unique experience to spice up our weekend. Vietnam Vespa Adventures was just the night out we needed to remind us of how awesome the city is... We were assured that we'd go to a few local spots we'd never been before, and we did. The Saigon after dark tour kicked major butt and we can't wait to send our visitors out on a trip they'll never forget. It was truly an amazing experience!!!

review_title: Awesome, new found love for Vespas!
review_text:
Fabulous insider tour with Duie (sorry if this is wrong, the lady whose name means wonderful. She is!)
Loved the tour, being part of the traffic and the insider info.
Booked the nighttime tour straight after!

review_title: The only adequate way to discover Saigon
review_text: When you get to Vietnam one of the first thing you notice is the overwhelming number of Scooters, they are everywhere omnipresent in every sense. So my idea was to rent a Scooter and explore the city my self, in hind side I am glad I did not do that. But when I found the Vespa Tour on TA I called and someone who spoke very good english directed me to the location, since the address is correctly in the listing, but Google maps does not place the blue dot where it should be. Look for the "Zoom"-Cafe, same address and dot placed correctly. You can hardly see the sign for the tour since it has been worn off by people scraping by. You get a meal with your tour in Zoom Cafe and you get your own driver - and a tour guide. Since I was the only person that afternoon, I got both just for my self! The price is somewhat high for Vietnam, with $48 for half a day (incl. a meal) its actually very expensive, but I had the feeling I got my moneys worth and I saw the city as its supposed to be seen - from the back of a "motor cycle"

We did the night tour and loved loved the tour. Thran our guide was an absolute STAR.... We back to Saigon after 10 of constant travel through Vietnam so we will now book the day tour .... Well done guys :-)

Fantastic to be amoungst the action on a vespa on the streets of Siagon! We did the night tour and had a brilliant evening. A friendly team of staff and drivers took us for a great drive around the city, to some great places to try street food and some really fun bars.
Highly recommend this trip!

review_title: By far the best experience we had in Vietnam.
review_text: We were looking forward to doing this tour since before we arrived in vietnam, we left this until our last day and it did not disappoint. We did the night tour and it did show us more of Ho Chi Minh City then we ever would have seen alone. Thanks to Steve and his team for a great experience. I will be back for the multi day tours.

We did the Saigon after dark tour on November 19. We had already spent a week in Saigon but this opened our eyes to another side of Saigon that we were able to participant in and had not seen before. The best way to see Saigon is on the back of a bike. All the riders and guides were fantastic.

review_title: fantastic trip well worth the money
review_text: great trip ,fun and informative , good English speaking guide , drivers very polite and helpful -thoroughly recommend this tour,our guide had a great sense of humour

Did the night tour on 22nd by recommendation of Exotissimo guide. Simply one of the best experiences ever. Food,drinks and company (= my wife, 3 girls from Holland and Arron and Laura from Oz + drivers/tourguides) were sooooooo great. Will definately get on Vespas in Vietnam when going there again! My own Vespa is "hibernating" as too cold here in Finland at this time of the year.

review_title: The Best Night We Had In Saigon
review_text:
If anyone is reading this review to see if they will feel safe on the back of a Vespa, especially having seen how traffic moves in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), then let me tell you straightaway-- this trip was perfectly safe and remarkably fun. It was definitely the best time I had while in Saigon.

I was in Saigon as part of a group of physicians that was teaching trauma to other physicians and EMTs in 3 places in Vietnam and Myanmar. When we finally had a night free, we took a Saigon Vespa Adventure tour (the night one). It was safe, remarkably fun (I found myself giddy and laughing while on the Vespas), and the stops were wonderful. The food is incredible and better than anything you will find on your own, and the company was great. I met Patrick and Stephen, and they are wonderful and gracious hosts. I recommend partaking in this adventure. I cannot overestimate how fun this was.

review_title: Taken care of from the minute we sat on the bikes!!
review_text: We booked the Insider Saigon Tour, half day of seeing the hidden parts of Saigon - mostly hidden under water with the Tidal Flooding in D2!! but the team rallied together, dried out the bikes and soldiered on with much merriment, making for a laughter filled trip around the city..........completely and utterly enjoyable, thoroughly recommend it!

review_title: Great trip, good food and adventure, worth the money.
review_text: My wife and I did a ride with these guys on our last trip to Saigon in July. We have been to vietnam in the past and have spent some time in HCMC but we still managed to see a part of the city we had never been too. It really was alot of fun and we met some good people. Usually I am a bit reluctant to take a 'booked trip or tour' but this was a good experience with good food and the guys that ride the bikes were great. As a guy that rides bikes in New Zealand, I take my hat of to anyone that can ride around that city at night! An added benefit is that ZOOM Cafe is a great place to use as a bit of a base and we found the staff their really helpfull and friendly.

review_title: This is an excellent way to see Ho Chi Minh like a local and taste their food.
review_text: My husband and I only had a short time to visit Ho Chi Minh. We went on the Vespa Night Tour after a recommendation from a couple we met earlier in the day. It was a fantastic experience. You sit on the back of a Vespa and tour the city and make various stops at typical local Vietnamese restaurants and singing venues. The driver was excellent and the owners explained the various local foods and sauces in detail. They took us to places that you would never find on your own. The roads are very busy and chaotic with 100s of other bike riders but the drivers are very skilled and you feel safe in their capable hands. Wear comfortable clothes and shoes - safety helmets are included.

My wife and I recently did the nightime tour around Saigon and this is not to be missed. Tasting food cooked by locals and experiencing out of the way sights....secluded bars that have vetnamese singers etc quite romatic...it was something that we would never have experienced on our own....do yourself a favor and do this tour....

review_title: Great experience on our first night in Saigon
review_text:
My partner & I did the Saigon After Dark tour on our first night in Saigon, at Steve's recommendation. As we were staying just around the corner from Cafe Zoom, we made our own way there, arrived early and enjoyed a few drinks while we waited. Our tour guide (I unfortunately cannot remember her name) arrived and chatted with us for a while - turns out we were the only people booked for that night! - before we jumped on the vespas. They would not let us pay for the drinks we had when we arrived early - no complaints here!

Our first stop was a streetside restaurant, one that as a tourist you probably wouldn't even look twice at. Here we had a delicious meal of mussels, clams and crab, drinks included. We were encouraged by our guide to try something 'weird' and as my partner is allergic to snails, we opted to try frog which was actually delicious! Being the only couple on the tour we were able to ask our tour guide lots of questions about life in Saigon and in return she asked many about life in Australia.

Our second stop was another restaurant down a small alley, here we tried crispy Vietnamese crepes, drinks included, all again delicious. Third stop was a local coffee house where we tried our first taste of traditional Vietnamese coffee and listened to some local performers sing in both English and Vietnamese.

Lastly we stopped by a bar called Yoko where we had more drinks and listened to a local band. Our Vespa drivers then took us back to Cafe Zoom.

This was definitely a fantastic way to spend our first night in Saigon and we felt completely safe on the Vespas despite the crazy traffic. It perhaps would have been better to have had other people on the tour, as we love to meet and chat to fellow travellers, however this could not be helped and it was nice to be able to learn about life in Vietnam one-on-one with our guide.

Highly recommended to all those who visited Saigon.

I was lucky with the weather, not so lucky with rather untalkative fellow travellers, but I had a great time on this tour. Saigon is difficult to get to grips with, so busy and all over the place, so I enjoyed sitting back and just looking up. Some sights were amazing, like the Chinese temple. Some a bit predictable, like Cathedral, but I felt like I really did get to go all over the city. The ferry ride was my favourite! I really enjoyed the day, it was an easy rest from self-inflicted walking tours!

review_title: What a way to start our holiday in Vietnam
review_text: We just did the Vespa after dark Siagon Tour, wow what a way to start our holiday. We where picked up from out hotel and taken to the zoom cafe, snacks and drinks while waiting for our group. Then the fun began, how much fun in and out of the traffic, little nervous at first but then relaxed. The food was great, not your usual food but so good. The coffee lounge was relaxing almost forgot we where in the middle of HCMC. Then off to a night club, more cocktails and drinks. We are travelling with our 11 year old son and he loved every minute of it. The drivers where great, very experience and very friendly. A definate must when visiting HCMC.

This tour should be called the “Not the Lonely Planet Tour”. I went to places I never would have seen as a tourist, or even as a resident. I have actually been living in Vietnam for over two years and I was shocked about what an incredibly authentic experience the day trip was.
Our first stop was the Shoalon (I can’t remember the correct spelling) Tailors Market. The market, quite difficult to find through the maze of small streets, is an ancient Vietnamese clothing market. It’s filled with rolls of cloth and different materials hanging down from the tops of the tailor’s booths. I was told that if I had brought some clothing with me that I wanted to copy the tailors here can make an exact copy for only a few dollars.
After this we went to see traditional funeral homes of the Vietnamese. This was a place whose people were not accustomed to having foreigners however our tour guide, Mr. Dat, did an excellent job of explaining the long history and traditions of the Vietnamese burial customs and making us feel comfortable.
Next we took an awesome ferry ride across the river! It was really fun as the group drove the bikes onto the boat. Travelling across the river was really beautiful. The ferry took us out of the industrial grey of the inner city to the natural green landscape of the countryside. Here we went to a centuries old Vietnamese market. Nothing could be further than the tourist-trapped Benh Thanh market in district one than this place was. At this place you can find everything from small jeweled trinkets to dozens of kinds of exotic fruit.
Mr. Dat was really nice, I want to say thank you to him. He was polite, articulate, and very knowledgeable. Thanks to him the Vespa tour was a really wonderful experience that I would be happy to do again.

I feel so so lucky that this tour was recommended by one of my Japanese friends who visited last October even though i'm staying here ! My mom just came visit me on Sunday and i'm just wondering how i can show the city i'm living in the most comprehensive and true way and this tour has won both of our hearts!

For the day tour Saigon Insider's Tour something, it's so great to have such complete look and understanding of this 10-million-people city within just 4 hours. For touristy landmark, what we can easily get on our own, they brought us there for stop and conversation real quick so we can have time to see many much more interesting and real local things that we couldn't find by myself ( i have lived here for 1 year) especially in district 2 and district 5. I'm pretty proud of myself that i chose this to welcome my mom. She felt 100% safe, comfortable and enjoyable! Can't miss mentioning such helpful, friendly the tour guide and staff plus beautiful nice lunch <3

So excited i was that i even registered the After Dark tour what my friend actually suggested me. I can't be more satisfied: fantastic food and people. Super true and authentic Vietnamese atmosphere. They brought us to places that are full of local people with hundreds of their interesting normal activities from self-training dancing on the street just to sell chewing gums in district 4 to one open kitchen area in a Vietnamese pancake restaurant or a little secret coffee shop among sweet acoustic music. By the time I finished my margarita in a live music bar at the end, my mom told me that I was so lucky to live in a city full of life and soul...

Thanks Vietnam Vespa team for bringing us such wonderful experience.

I live in Mui Ne, Vietnam Wanting something special for my friend arriving from New Zealand I booked us on the night tour... We had a fantastic night out. From the seafood, frog, banh xeo to the folksy hidden cafe and 70s rock cafe with very talented Vietnamese musicians!! If you are new in Vietnam, I highly recommend this activity in Saigon.

review_title: HCM RIDE around city and outskirts.
review_text:
I want to thank Steve for a great 4 hr ride around HCM .It was the real deal with all sorts of interesting views and culture , modern living to years gone simple living life.
I have been working in Vietnam for 8 years and was still special to me.
Sure there was some traffic at times and a few dusty roads but that was all part of the adventure .The guide Steve was totaly in control and always ensured you were safe along the way .
Thank you for a great time and great hospitality Steve.
I will try and nite tour and maybe the Vung Tau 3 day some time .
Thank you from Robbie and Mai

Absolutely amazing! Highly recommend to anyone and everyone who is visiting Vietnam. This is the only true way to see the city. The drivers are professional and I felt safe the entire time on the Vespa - actually was surprised at how safe I felt considering the traffic and the amount of people on the road.

review_title: Maybe it was one bad day, but this was dreadful
review_text: Me and my wife, our (adult) daughter and her boyfriend all went on the one day Insider's Saigon tour. It was a complete waste of time and money. Firstly, our riders - none of whom could apparently even attempt to speak English turned up at our hotel to collect us. Being an experienced motorcyclist I had confidently told the rest that they would not be meeting us on the scooters as the website stated explicitly that they supply ''top of the line full face helmets'' and that they would not know what sizes we needed. But up they turned, with four open-face helmets all one size, large. We may as well have had buckets on our heads. (If a helmet does not fit properly it falls off on impact) Next our guide - like our riders - was a lovely guy but unfortunately for a tour guide could not make himself intelligible in English. We could not understand 90% of what this guy was saying, despite his best attempts. To put this in context at that stage we had been in Asia for the previous four weeks so were reasonably used to Asian attempts at English, and our daughter and her boyfriend live in Singapore and travel throughout Asia on business. Then despite the website saying the price covered all entry fees we were told we could not go into the palace unless we paid extra, and finally two of the stops on the tour just consisted of looking at Statues! So much for hidden Saigon. Total waste of time and money and does not correspond with what it says on the - admittedly brilliant - website. We've travelled a lot and this is up there with one of the worst tours we have ever experienced. So much so we didn't even bother completing it, just told our guide we would make our own way back. And no, I can't explain why it has got such good reviews, I can only say what we experienced. Riders and tour guide lovely helpful people but avoid, avoid.

review_title: A must to do whilst in Ho Chi Minh
review_text: This was an awesome tour and a fun way to see the city. The tour leader Bau (sorry for spelling) was wonderful, helpful and considerate. The tour takes 4 hours and everything is included from the moment you arrive at the first bar. You are taken on a wonderful tour which shows you the highlights of the city but also where you get to experience a "local' feel of the city. It was a highlight of my time in Vietnam.

review_title: fun night out - I'd go again
review_text: I went on the after dark tour and will go again if I return to Saigon. I couldn't fault it really - fun people, great food, new sights and riding on a Vespa on a warm evening are a pretty good recipe for an enjoyable night out. Importantly though, the organisers have ensured that the venues we visited were clean, had decent bathroom facilities and used filtered water so there was little danger of an upset tummy afterwards.

We did the night tour which we were a little concerned about at first as we thought it might be too long but as we only had one night in Saigon, Steve convinced us that it would be great for us and he was totally right. Everything was planned to perfection and it was a fantastic experience. My several food allergies (which can make it v tricky to eat in SE Asia due to language barrier) were catered for as our guides were able to help us with the food.

Riding around the busy streets on the back of the vespas, by our great drivers, showed us a glimpse of the city from a whole new perspective and took us to places we never would have gone to, simply because we wouldn't have found them and wouldnt have been brave enough to eat there! Thank you to everyone on the tour, our guides, drivers and the group for a fantastic night in Saigon. The secret music cafe was my favourite btw!

review_title: Don't leave HCMC without doing the After Dark tour
review_text:
The After Dark tour by Vietnam Vespa Adventures was the best activity on our weekend trip. We had a group of friends - some more comfortable on Vespa's then others, and everyone had a great time and felt comfortable on the back of the bikes. Drivers were very professional, safe and very nice guys too!

The tour takes you around HCMC to places that were very local- be open to try new things and have lots of fun! You wouldnt find these places unless you lived in HCMC.

The tour guide and all staff were so friendly and made our night lots of fun! and all food and drinks were included- well worth the price of the tour.

Will definately be returning to do this tour- at the end of the 4 hour tour, we would have been quite happy to continue for another 4 hours!

Thanks to Patrick and the team for a great evening!

We booked the Saigon insiders tour. It was only our second day in Vietnam so this provided some great insight into Saigon. It was definetely more than we could have expected, taking in a large part of the city and stopping off at local coffee/yoghurt spots, flower market, locals market, funeral house and more. It also takes you into the lesser known districts of the city. The tour guide was great providing us with lots of tips and insider information. Including helping us to purchase tea and fruit, which was cut up and served to us when we got back to Cafe Zoom.

We loved the tour so much, that we booked the Saigon After Dark tour for the next evening. This is also a great tour as you get taken to some local restaurants, cafes and bars and get shown what to order and how to eat it! We definetely got to try more than we would have otherwise. We also got to hear some local music at a trendy coffee shop and bar. All in all a great night!

Tours are run very professionally, with pick up/drop off at your hotel. The drivers make you feel very safe and at ease. Tour guides are also very informative and happy to answer any questions. And the vintage vespas are awesome!

review_title: Ride a Vespa, relive the 1960s London mod era in 2011 HCMC
review_text: For anyone old enough to remember (or have been one) mods in London riding scooters in late 1960s this is a trip for you, if you're unlucky enough to be too young to go back that far this is for you too. Fantastic trip around HCMC at night, see parts of the city you would not see, enjoy excellent food and visit places you'd never find and enjoy fantastic company. I've been to a lot of places around the world over 4 decades but this is one of the highlights.

review_title: The only way to see Ho Chi Minh City.
review_text:
What an awesome experience I had. The gang at Zoom Cafe made me feel very welcome and the sites I was taken to was exceptional. Even though you're on a Vespa, it can be a bit of an adrenaline rush as the traffic is crazy and your tour guide is extremely skilful to be navigating around the city, especially the traffic.
Very knowledgeable and friendly people that go out of their way to make you feel at home.
Would highly recommend Vespa Adventure tours to any perspective Vietnam tourist.

review_title: Fantastic way to spend a night in Saigon
review_text: I had the pleasure of doing the Vespa Night Tour with a group of friends while in Saigon for the weekend. I was nervous to begin with having never been on a Vespa before, however I had a good driver (and the only Vespa with a seat with a back on it) and the tour guides put us at ease. The venues they took us to were all great and we enjoyed all the local food and the many drinks! I would recommend this tour to anyone wanting to experience a more local flavour of Saigon - the drivers will then drop you off at any location you wish at the end. Thanks to Patrick, our awesome tour guide.

review_title: Look, Ma. No hands! (Saigon After Dark)
review_text:
If you do only one thing in Ho Chi Minh City (and have a little sense of adventure), it should be the "Saigon After Dark" Vespa Tour.

This 4-hour tour of HCMC is SO worth the highly affordable price. Aboard the back of vintage Vespas driven by friendly, experienced drivers, it's the only way to see the city. Stop after stop, the tour offers local (delicious) food, drink, entertainment and company. I felt like I was getting a truly unique Vietnamese experience.

I highly recommend this excursion and tour company -- Patrick was our guide -- to anyone who wants to see the city in a fun, culturally-infused way.

review_title: great time on after dark tour!
review_text: We went to places that we would have never experienced on our own. We loved all the food and especially liked the coffee house with the acoustic musicians. Thank you to Bao and Stephen for a wonderful experience in Saigon. We didn't have much time in the city so we were glad to have had this option to see so much of the culture of the city. We highly recommend this tour! And the drivers were very safe...

review_title: The HIGHLIGHT of our stay in HCMC!!!
review_text: We cannot express how much of a fantastic time we had on the Vietnam Vespa Adventures Saigon After Dark tour. It was one of the coolest experiences EVER! Not only do you get to ride on classic Vespa's with friendly tour guides, but you get to experience authentic local culture. The food, drinks, experience and fun were more than we could have asked. I would do this again in a heartbeat. Recommended? DEFINITELY! :)

Last month I had a night out with Vespa Adventures and could not have been more pleased. Their classic vespas take you back in time and I enjoyed hearing about their role, past and present, in the dynamic city, that is HCMC. Plus, the food, entertainment and meeting new friends made it a night to remember. It was so nice to take the thinking out for a night and just sit back, relax and enjoy the ride.

To top it off now, my boyfriend wants a vespa. Well done!

Read about the rest of my experience here: http://www.travelfish.org/blogs/saigon/2011/09/09/saigon-vespa-adventures/

review_title: An absolute "Must Do" when visiting Ho Chi Minh
review_text:
This was my 3rd trip to Vietnam but I had never done the Vietnam Vespa Tour. As I was travelling with friends this time, I decided to book the Tour before we left Australia. All that was required was a $35usd deposit and it was the best decision I have made. We were picked up from our hotel and taken to Zoom Cafe to meet with the rest of the group. From there, everything was simply amazing. The company, the food, the experience, just fantastic. And how friendly and welcoming are the crew that run the Tour???
Have read most of the other reviews & cannot understand those complaining about the cost! I have all intentions of taking this Tour every time I am in Ho Chi Minh from now on.
Value for money & an experience not to be missed. Do Not Hesitate to book a Vespa Tour!!!

review_title: Fantastic evening in HCM while traveling solo
review_text: Met some great people, felt safe, and will do it again in about 4 months when I return with my wife. Loved the intimate music venue! They took us to places we never would have found as tourists...pretty cool.

review_title: Saigon After Dark: Great Intro to the City's Food & Culture
review_text:
If you've never been to this part of the world, signing up for this tour is a GREAT way to get a quick introduction to its food and culture.

Mind you, the night we chose to join the tour, it was pouring rain. I emailed Steve just two hours before the start of the tour to see if the weather would cancel our trip, but Steve promptly responded back and assured us that the tour was still on. Needless to say, I was extremely nervous. All those bikes on the road at once, none of them fully abiding by the traffic rules and now you add the element of rain and wet roads? GREAT.

They provided a rain poncho and we unnecessarily gripped onto those Vespas for dear life when we set off. Just minutes into the trip, even in the rain, I relaxed my grip and took in the scenery whizzing by. Our drivers truly knew what they were doing not only on the bike, but also when it came to ordering the food. Food allergies? Squeamish about certain kinds of food ,or totally willing to try anything (because the word adventure IS in their name)? Tell them and they will adjust the food order accordingly.

We were fortunate to have Bao, one of the tour's partners, be one of our hosts for the night. He said that the company's intention in creating this particular tour is to make it feel like you are out on the town with good friends. I believe they do an excellent job in trying to achieve this - they keep the group size to a minimum, they select venues that are off the beaten path and Bao himself is so personable and friendly. We took advantage of this and asked him as many questions as we could about the city, its culture, the different types of food, etc.

It was great insight for us and I felt more confident striking out into town on our own the next day. If you haven't already guessed... we highly recommend this tour.

Note: Ladies, if you are a germa-phob like me, it's best to bring your own napkins and TP. That's not a hit against the tour company, it's just a fact of life in this part of the world.

I could not believe that I, a Saigonese, born, grown up here for 29 years, would be one day paying a tour agency to experience my own city on the two wheels but I'm so glad i did that. The experience is such an eye-opening one and it makes me feel even prouder of my city.

It's very interesting to sit at the back and view the city by night on the slow (I joined Saigon After Dark tour). The vespa guide takes you to key districts of Saigon and to very local spots, yes, very local: from street food ventors to popular hanging out places of Vietnamese youth. The food covered in the program is mostly street food but very reliable and tasty. I especially loved the nails cooked in different ways and the banh mi (Vietnamese baguette). One of my newly discovery during the tour was the coffee shop called "Vung oi, Mo Ra" just down in a small alley with great Vietnamese music. If you join this tour, prepare a big stomach as you will eat and drink from the beginning to the end. Don't want to spoil you with too many details but it's a good mix and a very immersing way to really live the Saigon experience.

As a local, I must say, without experiencing this vespa tour, you can't say you have a truly Saigonese experience just yet!

review_title: BEST EXPERIENCE OF HO CHI MINH
review_text: We were recommended to do this trip by some friends who had previously gone on the after dark tour. We called Steve and asked if we could arrange something special for one of the kids in the group as he was celebrating a birthday, we left it to him to organise for us and just waited to see what they could come up with. We were picked up from the hotel on the Vespa's and taken on a short ride to a cafe to pay for the tour and have a cool drink before we started out. First stop was a quick trip on a ferry to get to the other side of the Saigon River (one of the group was left behind as they were paying for the ferry ride and didn't make it before they closed the gate which we all thought was pretty funny!) When we got to the other side and waited for the last rider to get across we were told about the governments plans to build up this side of the river with high rises which is a shame but inevitable, we toured through open fields and smaller rivers. The road gets slightly flooded twice a day by the tides but we went through this easily. We wound our way back over the bridge and stopped at some tourist sites, Notre Dame, Post office and Reunification Palace which was interesting and then moved on to Chinatown and all its sights and smells! We visited antique shops in the most expensive street in Saigon and then finished up at a local restaurant Quan Nuong for dinner. We had four kids aged fifteen to nine in the group and they had the best time on the ride and found it really easy on the back of the bike (even started a game of tag on the tour) all the guides ride really safely and even in peak hour traffic we had no problems. We met up with Steve and Phuong at the restaurant and they recommended some dishes for us to try which were sensational. They were going to leave but we forced them to stay and enjoy dinner with us and a couple of beers. We would highly recommend this tour and the only drawback for some of us was that only one of the guides spoke English so all the information had to be passed on after the tour about the different sights we saw. This is a great tour and the owners have great personality and a really good story to tell about their business. YOU MUST DO THIS TRIP TO EXPERIENCE THE REAL HO CHI MINH!!!

review_title: An amazing week that left our entire group dying to do it all over again
review_text:
The tour was so AMAZING that we are already planning to come back for our next Vespa adventure! The crew was brilliant from start to finish - they popped out of thin air whenever we needed support on the road, they showed us a legendary time on-site, we simply felt like part of the family. A MUST do!

Bring long sleeve shirts, biking gloves and sun screen. I would recommend some basic medecine kit as Vietnam can be tough on travellers who have never been in Asia (hydration powder, disinfectant, imodium, light pain killers, etc). Don't worry about the rest, you're in good hands!

review_title: This is a must do in HCMC. A great escape.
review_text:
We booked a Saigon after dark tour with Steve and a couple of boys turned up at our hotel and we were off...a little after 5:30pm.

First stop Cafe Zoom to meet our host Steve and his wife Pho. After being greeted very warmly we are seated outside and frosty cold beer is brought out as we get to know our hosts and about the tour. After a few more cool ones we are off. Steve and his wife lead the way with us on the backs of beautifully restored Vespa's.

The after dark tour takes you around HCMC in a way most do not get to see it.....its frantic and frenetic and brimming with excitement. We dart and weave our way into the city centre and finally after a while we pull up to the first destination.

Food is ordered and delivered very quickly and fresh cold beers accompany the feast. The food was outstandingly fresh and the best tasting we have had in the city. The night and conversations flow on and you feel your on a tour with old friends as we laugh our way to the next place. More amazing food is brought out and expertly BBQ'd by Pho. More beer on ice and then we moved on.

The last 2 places are both eye opening and inspiring....I won't spoil the surprise for you. Lets just say that if you have any pre-conception about Vietnam or its people.....this may change it for you in an exciting way.

We arrive back at the hotel around 11pm both exhausted and excited at the same time after what we consider is the best fun we have had in HCMC. This really is the most fun after dark you can have in town and is a must do for all ages.

By the way....you don't have to drink beer.....everything and all is on offer....we just like beer :)

Thanks to Steve and Pho and the boys for a great night out. Keep riding hard Mop :)

Since it was my first visit to HCMC, i researched for things to do there and boy was i glad i found this! Steve replied my emails very promptly, and so when one of my cousins could not make it last min, he made the necessary changes. It was my first time on a bike, and the ride was alittle scary at first but i soon got the hang of it. The drivers were very professional and always bore a smile on their faces.. (even if i was heavy and clumsy).

Did the Saigon in the dark tour and we were promptly picked up by our drivers who brought us to cafe zoom where we had some drinks (anything on the drinks menu) and chatted with other ppl who also joined the tour. LIke the others had mentioned, they are generous in their food and drinks, everything is being paid for and all you have to do is to enjoy the ride, the wind, the food (which was excellent, seafood yum!) and drinks and the accompany of your guides..

thanks josh and steve for the great experience.. would definitely go for another tour with you guys during my next vietnam trip!

I did the afternoon tour on my first day in Ho Chi Minh with my mom and brother. Our drivers smoothly cruised the crazy traffic, were always courteous and though they don't speak english, were very friendly. We were accompanied with one guide who spoke very good english, knowledgeable and shared with us many stories and local culture.
Before the tour we were served a hearty lunch at the Zoom Cafe, where we met the owner Steve, such a nice guy!

The weather was really hot so prepare yourself with some sunscreen, hang on tight and enjoy away!

I think it's the best way to see the city...considering transportation wise, there's no really better way to get through the traffic and small streets. Plus we stop frequently, so there's no need to worry about going to the bathroom, buying water, etc.
A fabulous adventure. Very well organised. Friendly and experienced staff. You just have to do it!! Thankx guys xx

Pre visit - email queries all answered promptly by Steve.

We were impressed that they trust us enough to pick us up at the hotel without demanding we put down a deposit.

2 Vespa Riders arrived 10 minutes before pickup time at Sanouva Hotel and we biked to Zoom Cafe for a drink (such as beer, soft drinks and fruit juice, haha, finished my 1st glass of juice 30 sec flat - don't like to see fruit juice oxidizing), and they offered me a second glass pronto.

Besides the 2 Vespa riders, our guides for the night are Patrick and Ms Trang. Thanks, Trang for the second helping of orange juice.

This set the climate for the rest of the night - they don't stinge on the food and drinks.

Even the constant drizzling cannot put a damper on our mood. They provide us with disposable raincoats. A woman’s touch – seeing that my husband’s raincoat was torn, Ms Trang bought an extra one for him.

Within those several hours, we filled our stomachs with local and street food such as seafood (crabs, cockles, etc), BBQ Beef wrapped in rice paper, Banh Xeo – pancakes, plus drinks (a coffee place with singer+pianist+violinist) and music (a place called YOKO). All food and drinks are inclusive in the tour price.

I had come across tour co / guides that are highly recommended and popular, in the end, their popularity works against us cos these guides will be too busy answering phone calls by potential customers to really do a good job of guiding. But not with VVA – they are professional and efficient. You can trust them to do a good and great job of bringing you to parts of HCMC which most 1st time visitors will not venture to.

Should I be back to Saigon with the kids, we will book a tour with VVA again.
Good job, Patrick and Trang. Thank you for the great time.

Those considering the Saigon after Dark tour – remember to bring an appetite…

Hey y'alll!,

If you have ever wanted to tour a foreign country while experiencing the international hospitality of Vietnam mixed with a twist of the US...Hit on " Book Now!" We are both totally pleased with our VVA Experience of the " Saigon After Dark" Tour in which both Steve and Phuong were in the pilot seats of
and made our dreams become a reality! This was our second time in HCMC and decided to take an extra day for ourselves beyond the normal business stay. We are glad to say that it was well worth every second while with these finest of people! Steve and I had bantered back and forth between e-mails on thinking up something both special and meaningful added to the tour I had selected for the proposal, and he rawked it! All stops for food and beverage were simply put...OUTSTANDING!!!! She said yes and we will be finalizing the deed on 11/11/11 at high noon in Gaitlinburg, TN on a Helicopter!!!
Thank You again for everything!!
Chris and Beth Jordan

This is my third Vespa After Dark trip (live in Saigon) and as always Steve, his wife Phuong and their guys looked after me and my visiting friends so well. This is a real value for money experience and is safe, reliable, well-planned and entertaining. When you come to Saigon, it's easy to get-caught in the District 1 (D1 or Q1) bubble and this is the best way to escape that, get-out amongst the locals and experience what this wonderful city has to offer.

Well done guys ! I Will continue to introduce my visitors to your fabulous all-inclusive service !!

Having attempted to cross the road in Saigon, we faced the Vespa tour with a little trepidation. Happily, I can confirm that the drivers are absolutely safe and careful.

We went on the Insider's Saigon tour and would love to take the other tours...maybe next time. We learnt a lot about Vietnam from Lou, the guide.

Highly recommend this tour to see parts of Saigon you won't find on your own.
H

review_title: Great experience with friends or solo
review_text:
Steve, Patrick, and Josh really created a unique Saigon and Southern Vietnam experience on this tour. Having been to Vietnam a few times, this was my most memorable as far as unique experiences along the tour as well as meeting great people.

You stay in great resorts along the tour and get to ride a vespa in Vietnam!

review_title: See Saigon like the locals see it
review_text: You will not find a better way to experience Saigon. Motorbikes are very comfortable, drivers are very safe, and the experience unforgettable. Steve and his team do an A plus job bringing you around to local food joints and cafes. The night tour is not to be missed.

review_title: There is nothing like an adventure in Vietnam on the back of a Vespa!!
review_text: Traveling around Saigon on a Vespa is the best way to feel like you are part of the city. Not only is it super fun, the guides at Vietnam Vespa know their stuff and can take you to off-the-beaten places you normally couldn't find on your own or on a stock tour. In addition, they treat you as their own! Vietnamese food is out of this world and these guys know where to get it good, cheap and authentic.

review_title: Great alternative to typical tourist traps.
review_text: If you want to experience the streets, food, and local hangouts of the city. This is the best way to do it. Friendly and knowledgeable staff will make you feel very comfortable and at ease throughout the experience. Thank you guys.

review_title: Best way to experience Saigon and its countryside
review_text:
Just got back to Singapore from long weekend in Saigon and Mekong Delta. Without a note of exaggeration, Vespa Adventures was the highlight of my entire trip !!! I initially signed up for the Saigon Night Tour and loved so much that I did 2 more trips with the team. Saigon Highlights and Saigon Countryside. In my view, the Night Tour is a must do in Saigon; sightseeing the city from a Vespa is a lot more enjoyable than any other option as there are some small streets in Saigon where you can only get by motorcycle. And finally, if you feel a little bit of adventure in you, I recommend the Countryside option. But, my thanks go to Steve and Josh who made these trips special. The vintage Vespas are great, but at the end of the day, the people make the experience. Thanks a lot Steve and Josh!!!

ciao

review_title: Fun way to see Saigon if you're short on time and want to see a lot
review_text:
We were only in Saigon for 3 days and wanted to make the most of our time, so we booked both the day tour and the night tour.

The day tour was fantastic. It was a mix of all of the famous, tourist sites and places that no tourist would ever visit (or find!) if you were on your own. There were numerous photographic opportunities and the tour guide was really informative and answered all of our questions. There is no way we'd be able to have seen so much in 3.5 hours if we were on our own. Even if you were on a bus or van city tour, you wouldn't be able to fit so much in because the traffic is so crazy there and the Vespas can just zoom around it. It ended up with a lunch at Cafe Zoom (included), which was fantastic.

The night tour was fantastic. It's a tour of cafes and restaurants. It was not an ideal situation to start out with because it was raining very, very hard. On top of that, we're vegetarian, which is not easy to be in Saigon. But VVT was very accommodating. They called ahead to all of the places we were visiting and sorted out food for us. It was certainly interesting being on a motorbike in that sort of rain, in a hilarious and fun way. It is not a night we'll soon forget!

All of the food and drink was covered in the price of the night tour - it was extremely good value and we were able to eat at places that we'd have never seen otherwise or have been able to eat at being vegetarians.

Both tours are highly recommended, but if you could only do one, I enjoyed the night tour more.

review_title: The best way to see Vietnam!!
review_text: Words can't express how great this tour was. The team was excellent and everything was so easy whilst still being an adventure. Congrats to Josh and Mr Chow - they made you feel very looked after. Great sights, great people, great food - what more could you want. We will be back!!

review_title: Best way to experience Vietnamese cuisine and nightlife- local style.
review_text: Had a lot of fun on this tour! Drivers were friendly, Steve is great! Each part of the tour was unique and fun. We'd never find these places on our own. Kudos to vespa tours and zoom cafe!

review_title: The most fun we've had in Saigon
review_text: Let me start by saying, I'm Vietnamese. I've been back to Vietnam 4 times but this is probably the best time of them all. This time, I traveled with my wife and two others. We had the best time of our trip on this tour (Saigon After Dark). Steve, Josh, and Co. treated us like a family. They even made me a birthday cake and celebrated my birthday before we started the tour! I'm not going to ruin the surprise for you by telling you everything. Lots of great food, lots of drinks and Saigon Loads of fun. If you're thinking of taking this tour, just do it. You will have a blast!

review_title: If you don't want your tour of Saigon to blend into all the tours of other cities you've done, then do it on a Vespa!
review_text: I arrived in Saigon in the afternoon, and rather than waste time, I went straight for the "Saigon after Dark" tour. Steve (owner) recommended I come 'hungry and thirsty'; and it was a good call. An indulgent night. No better way to come to grips with the famous Saigon traffic than on the back of a scooter at night. Make no mistake, Vespas aren't just another scooter, they are cool and not just a little funky - and they command the attention of the other motorcyclists. I was so impressed, I took in the "Insider's Saigon" tour the following morning to get my daytime bearings. This sets me up well for the subsequent days of sight-seeing where I could focus on my own interests.

this tour is really a wonderful experience to my husband and i as we booked insider saigon and saigon after dark and even i scared to ride in a vespa i still enjoyed the tour coz the driver takecare of us and evethough rather are not good in english the smile that they are giving to us give us a good meaning during the tour.I highly recommend this for city tour coz we really go inside saigon,and we really feel the belongingness from the Vespa Staff specially to steve and give us time to meet and talk to us.And dont worry about the food coz u will be full....

We had a saturday afternoon tour with Vietnam Vespa adventures and it was just perfect.
The company picked us up at our hotel with a vespa on time and brought us to cafe zoom for some free lunch before the start of the tour.
The tour is really great as you see the main highlights within just a short amount of time. Also the detail provided by the guide on the places visited was great, although his english was sometimes hard to understand.
I can highly recommend to take a tour with vietnam vespa adventures as the mode of transport and the tour itself is just a great way of exploring ho chi minh city.

review_title: A Must Do Adventure For Young And Old
review_text: My first day in Vietnam and this grandma from Australia had booked the morning tour with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. Was picked up from my hotel by Josh and taken to Cafe Zoom for a cool drink. There I met up with four ladies who were also doing the tour. I had never been on a Vespa before and was a little apprehensive but it soon passed. The tour took me to places I would not have gone to on my own. My favorite place was the An Khanh Market in District 2 where we were the only tourists. Crossing the river on a "ferry" was a fun experience. I got to go to and take photos of all the places I wanted to see. The Chinese Temple is also a great place. We finished the tour with lunch at Cafe Zoom. It was such a great tour. I am recommending it to all my friends, young and old. Thank you to Josh and all the drivers.

Thank you Ian, then Steve, Josh and the wonderful drivers for the excellent experience. I would certainly recommend the "After Dark Tour of Saigon" which myself with a few friends from Perth experienced in July. Will also try the other tours when in Vietnam next time. The ride was full of fun, food was amazing, hosts wonderful. Looking forward to the next trip, hopefully soon. Janusz

review_title: Highlight of our trip - witness true Saigon 'After Dark'
review_text: This was such a fun, safe, delicious and informative tour. It was so much fun and our guides made it this way. Everyone who goes to HCMC has to do this, it's a MUST!

review_title: vespa sSaigon tour what a buzz
review_text:
One of the best nights out i have had
