Steve & Josh the guys that run the show do a really professional job . If your a scooter fan these bikes were in mint condition fully restored felt like i was back in my teenage years .
We were picked up by the guys & driven to there office a really cool place where we were told what the night would have installed . We were given some wicked dips & a beer & had a chat with the guys .
We then got on the bikes dressed in spotty ponchos witch just set the mood for the evening.
We were then driven around Saigon to see the sights, then we stopped for some of the best food i had on my whole trip to Vietnam.
All the drivers of the scooters spoke good english & were really friendly
If theres one thing i can say about this trip is Do it Do it Do it you wont regret it
Well done Steve & Josh look forward to seeing you again soon
Pom !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

review_title: Best way to see Ho Chi Minh ever!!!
review_text: The tour was absolutely fantastic. It was a highlight of our trip to Saigon. I would, and indeed have, reccomended it to others. Very professional and the bikes were the coolest ever. We intend to visit Vietnam again and would love to take another tour. It is the best way to see Saigon!!!

Challenge !!!
Five lads from Perth Western Australia, week in Singapore for a conference, head to Ho Chi Minh City for the weekend to catch-up with myself (resident here 4 years). The call goes out what can we do Ian. Without hesitation i emailed the lads back recommending Vietnam Vespa Adventures After dark tour, thumbs up from the boys we headed out Friday evening 29th July 2011
From my emailing booking, the on-time pick-up from a chosen venue (Bar 5), the wonderful food, the ultimate host Steve Meuller, Josh Baker, and not forgetting the safest riders of a Vespa's in VN, the evening was just outstanding. Professional, Punctual, Safe, Culinary delights.VN nightlife its all there.
Cheers Steve, Josh and your staff for a memorable experience and one the lads in Perth will talk about for many years to come.

Vespa tours 'Saigon after Dark' was excellent! You really eat and drink as much as you can, and you get to see some hard-to-find places where you'd never be able to order chilli snails and peanut-coated-clams without help. Fellow tourmates were fun to get to know, and funny stories were shared through the busy night. I loved the live music venues, very special! I would recommend vegetarians and especially request people to remind tour guides of these just before the start, because they do cater for everyone, but they can switch to default ordering mode if they forget.

review_title: Highlight of our stay in HCMC!!!
review_text:
My group of 4 friends (all early 20s) spend 4 days & 3 nights in the city. While we visited the usual attractions like Cu Chi Tunnels and the War Museum. This Vespa Tour was the highlight of the trip, for all of us!

My experience first started about a month before the trip, when i emailed Vespa Adventures to ask about the availability of their night tour. Steve was especially helpful and patient as i clarified all the nitty gritty details about the tour. He even agreed to send Vespas to pick us up from our hotel (which they took a while to find!)

We finally arrived at Cafe Zoom for welcome drinks (not free) and payment (US$59/pp) before setting out on our journey to the local eating places. Traffic in Vietnam is crazy to say the least but all the members of my party felt like we were in safe hands.

Safety is a priority for them so if you're worried about getting hit, don't.

The food was awesome. I shall not reveal exactly what we ate and where so as not to spoil the tour surprise for you, but let's just say it was real Vietnamese food.

The prices for the tour are all inclusive, so food and drinks at all the places become FOC. All the other people in our tour group spoke english (Australian, American mainly) so starting a conversation wasn't a problem at all.

The best thing about this tour is not only the food but also the interactions with the other members of the group.

This tour is a MUST DO for any trip to HCM (i hope they expand to Hanoi some day). Whether you're young or old (the youngest in our group was just 15?!), this is for you.

Thanks so much to the Vietnam Vespa Adventures team for your hospitality, time and service.

--Abraham-- (7th July Tour!)

review_title: Must do, must do, must do!
review_text: I booked this tour after reading the reviews on Trip Advisor, and it really didn't disappoint! We went fot the Saigon by Night tour, which is a eating and drinking tour. I won't give too much away, as the website doens't either- but you will be pleasantly surprised. I thoroughly enjoyed this tour, and felt very safe and secure throughout. As for the cost- I would say this is super value for money as everything is included! Thank you Vietnam Vespa Tours- The night was amazing!

review_title: You haven't experienced Saigon unless you've seen it from the back of a vespa!!!
review_text: If there is one thing you do in Saigon make sure it's a vespa tour! I didn't think I would have time to fit this tour in but I managed to get on my last morning in Saigon and I am so glad I did. I only booked in two days previously at Cafe Zoom and the staff were very helpful and polite. I mentioned that my mum was hesitant about doing the tour but they reassured me they would look after us and they did! It was so much fun and never did I feel unsafe. Our guide took us to all the places we hadn't had time to visit over the previous couple of days which was fantastic. I would highly recommend Vietnam Vespa Tours if you have a sense of adventure and want a tour with a difference!!!

review_title: Great trip, Josh is a great guy to do a tour with
review_text:
We traveled a lot, we've been there & done that. But I must say, the trip we took with Josh and one of his drivers was a great trip. Fun and lots to see. A must-do when in Vietnam.
After or morning tour was so great we also booked the evening tour. That was totally different and maybe even nicer to do. Great food, lovely music and the best part was that we went to places where no tourist would ever go!

review_title: Great Evening Tour of Some FUN Sites in Saigon
review_text: A great way to see some different sites in Saigon and enjoy some good food while touring the city on classic Vespas. I would definitely recommend it as a way to see the "real" city and not just the tourist attractions.

On June 25, 2011 we have participated in the evening tour of HCMC City and we just say "perfect and unique"! We recommend that each of the time spent in HCMC to participate. It was an unforgettable experience! Thanks to the tour guides and drivers

Rgds Ingo * Titik

review_title: Thanks to this tour, Ho Chi Minh City redeemed itself.
review_text: I was in HCMC for business. I asked around what can be done but no one could give me any interesting suggestions. All I was able to go to was Ben Thang Market and after two visits I'm bored already. Then fiddled around TripAdvisor and found your tour. Super glad to have done it. I'm sucker for everything on two wheels since I cannot have one. When I saw Vespa Adventures I went for it. I didn't realize Saigon After Dark is an eating tour. This I prefer over the usual "LOOK HERE, THIS IS...." and "LOOK THERE, THAT IS..." When I visit a foreign land, I would like to experience how the locals do things and where they go. This tour did just that. I didn't read enough about the details of this tour. The evening tour was the only one I'm able to do. I took lots of pictures and even videos. By now, I've shown them to many friends and told stories. The three tour guides where great. Not a dull moment. Highly recommended...

best tour i have ever done in any holiday i have been to...and i travel alot !!
this tour was an experience to say the least it started from the time i actually called the company and spoke to Bao ....i felt his warmth over the phone given me a feeling like im not just another number.....from then i decided i would book.... we did the saigon by night tour...it ran for 4 and half hours.....weeeeeeeeeeeeeeee loved it!!!!!so many times ive gone on tours and the people just dont get the personal touches that are needed to make a tour successful!!
my partner and i had soooo much fun, we met Phoung Doung then later Steve ..what a treat to have such fun and wonderful people giving us this amazing opportunity to meet not only the locals but the amazing places that just the normal tourist would never find...i was blown away!!! if i had more time i would def look at doing the 4 or 7 day tour! i also would do the this tour again and again value for money and also i have to say the hidden cafe AMAZING!!!!

THANKYOU SOOO MUCH BAO ,PHOUNG, DOUNG, AND STEVE FOR MAKING US FEEL SAFE ON THE BIKES AND MAKING SURE WE HAD ENUF TO EAT AND DRINK AND BELIEVE ME YOU WILL ON THIS TOUR!!!!! PLS IF YOU GO TO VIETNAM DO THIS TOUR YOU WILL BE AMAZED AT MUCH YOU WILL SEE OF SAIGON IN ONE NIGHT!!!

THANKU GUYS YOUR THE BEST :)) THIS TOUR TOTALLY COMPLETED OUR HOLIDAY!!!!!!!

We booked an afternoon tour for 4 adults and 4 children,(aged 16, 12, 12 & 5 1/2) . The youngest in our group was only small so Steve organised their most experienced rider for her. Also being fair haired she attracted a lot of turned heads as we rode around Saigon and became part of the throngs of motorbikes zooming through the streets. It was so much fun. We were picked up outside our hotel in the heart of the backpacker district and whisked off for lunch at a fabulous cafe. (Cafe Zoom) The food was included in our tour price and was great. Our guides were all happy and we all felt at ease as pillion passengers. My eldest son (16) was sceptical about the tour but thoroughly enjoyed the experience of weaving through traffic and seeing the highlights of Saigon, catching a ferry with the locals and briefly heading out to the countryside to see the markets and the locals going about their day. I can't stress enough how much fun and good value for money this tour is. No matter how old or young you are they will find a way to accommodate you. Book a tour before you go as I suspect they will become more and more popular. If we should get back to Vietnam I would not hesitate to book another tour with Vietnam Vespa's. I still smile thinking about the great afternoon we had.

review_title: Best Part of Our Trip So Far
review_text: This is my first review ever on TripAdvisor - I signed up just to give Steve and his team a glowing review for their Vespa tour through Saigon. We did Saigon by Night, and the tour was perfectly arranged. The food is AMAZING. I was hesitant to do the night time tour, since I figured all of the street food in Saigon is delicious, but you absolutely will not find food and experiences like this on your own. It's a great way to see the city, and the vintage Vespas are beautiful, but the food was out-of-control delicious. I think all of the reviews are a bit vague on the details of the itinerary, but that's because it's ever-changing and the mystery is part of the fun. Steve and his wife Phuong are fun and informative guides, and it's just like visiting friends who are Saigon locals, showing you their town for a night. It's completely worth your time and money.

review_title: No better way to see the city
review_text:
Really enjoyed the two tours I did.

Saigon by Night was incredibly fun and a foodie's delight. You jump on the back seat of a vintage vespa and immediately feel like you're part of the Saigon scene. The guides weave around main streets and back alleys alike, and take you to two hidden gems for all you can eat and drink local fare (we were the only non-Vietnamese people at these places). After that we hit one of those you'd-never-find-it-yourself cafes with local piano/violin performers--incredible. From there they took us to a posh bar with a live rock band. Great value for the money, and a unique experience because of the transport, the locations, and the very knowledgeable guides. There was never any down-time, as they had the bikes ready at all times, and tables reserved at every place we went!

Speaking of great value, we also did one of their newest tours, their Saigon shopping experience. They won't take more than 2 or 3 people at a time, but the personal shopper they hired for us looked great herself--always a good sign--and was invaluable for our last minute shopping before heading back to the airport. They knew our sizes and what we were generally looking for before we started, and our personal shopper had some items lined up at her store at one of those crazy big markets for us to try. For everything else, she took us to the stalls where we could find what we were looking for and even negotiated the price for us. We got everything from name brand dresses, men's dress shirts, jeans, athletic wear, and outdoor gear to oil replicas of fine art at TOTAL bargains. We never felt like she was pushing us to buy things we didn't want, which has happened to me with other tours. She was attentive and tried really hard to get us what we wanted! The attention to detail and personalized service can not be beat, particularly when you're short on time and have a long list of things to buy. She even went and got my husband's new jeans hemmed while we had lunch (the brand of jeans has distinctive stitching, so she had the tailor remove the stitching from the old hem, rehemmed it with the same material, and only charged $2USD!!!). We had a ton of fun and came home feeling that we could not have had a better shopping experience.

review_title: After Dark surprises - I'll be back - fabulous - well done Steve & co !
review_text:
In May 2011, I had a visitor from Brazil who wanted a fun way to see the sites of Ho Chi Minh City and having read about Vespa Tours in one of the local English language mags, booked her on one of the by-day four hour trips. Glowing reports about Steve Mueller and his team, careful driver, interesting places and all-in-all a joyous experience.

So, having lived here a number of months and seldom stepping outside District 1 (apart from the occasional sortie, across the Saigon Bridge, to District 2) decided it was time to see more of what Saigon has to offer and booked Vespa Tours After Dark Saigon trip for me and my companion (she from Hanoi and also a reasonably new Saigon District 1 resident). Having booked the previous day-trip Steve generously gave us a 10% discount on this second booking. We were collected at my residence just before 6PM by two charming Viet Vespa riders, kitted-out with well fitting helmets and taken to Zoom (Vespa Tours HQ) on the edge of the back-packer district for a welcome drink (anything from water thru beer, wine, cocktails, shakes) and to meet-up with the other funsters for a fabulous evening. Having paid the booking fee, a dozen of us plus the drivers took-off through Districts 1, 3, 4 & 5 to see Saigon sights the Saigon way.

The tour included stops for street food and drinks at a number of locations in District 4 (seafood), District 1 (Viet Spring Rolls, omelettes and BBQ) a very cool speak-easy with acoustic music and finished the night at Yoko where the music was 60s / 70s rock and fine cocktails. The sights along the way are really interesting and lots of photo opportunities.

All-in-all a fabulous evening, a lot of fun, amazing contrasts, well organised and great value for money (everything (including drinks, eats and entries) included in the tour fee) and dropped-off at home by 22:30. I was impressed by the drivers who made us feel very very safe and looked after us so well. Well Done Steve and family - good job and, in the words of Arnie, I'll be back for more !!!

We made a bit of a last minute booking for the Saigon After Dark tour, and Steve was fantastic in accommodating us even though they'd had a big do the night before.

We can't recommend this tour strongly enough... it's a FANTASTIC way to see the city, in a way tourists can't usually do in a short stay like ours. It's a cheaters way into the real 'local' part of Saigon, and you'll be taken places you'd never ever find on your own.

We were able to sample foods at two very different, but equally good food destinations, with descriptions of all the food along the way by our awesome guide Josh. He also gave us a lot if information about the city and the local culture. After that, we went to a truly unique coffee house - I can't describe it at all, but it was amazing experience. Not at all what you'd expect to find in Saigon or in the particular location we went to. After that it was to a bar with a great live band that almost had a New York type vibe. All the entertainers were fantastic, and Josh made sure we felt right at home.

The vespas are a hell of a lot of fun - none of us (a group of 4) had done something like this before, and we all loved it. With all the traffic chaos in Saigon, you actually feel safer on a vespa than as a pedestrian!! Props to our great vespa drivers!

We would not only recommend this tour to anyone visiting Vietnam, we'd definitely do this tour again! We wish we'd thought about/known about these guys before we went because we would have booked more tours, or a longer tour, with them.

Anyone visiting Vietnam should definitely not miss out on this! It totally made our stay in Saigon.

review_title: Saigon after Dark tour a must!
review_text: we went on the 'saigon after dark' tour. i've been living in southeast asia for two years and have been on many tours in the region. this was one of the best tours because it was authentic and didn't feel like a manufactured tour for foreigners. this was my third trip to saigon and the tour took us to local eateries and live music venues that we never would have found on our own (or in any guidebook for that matter). josh was our tour guide and he did an awesome job. the owners, phuong and steve, are really cool as well. we hung out with a husband/wife at the cafe who had just finished the 7 day tour and they loved it.

review_title: Vespa Vietnam Adventures Nha Trang Costal Tour
review_text:
An awsome way to see that part of the country is off the general tourist route.
The traffic is an adventure in itself.
Food was sensational I can't recall any meals that were just OK

We went on the night tour and enjoyed it so much we grabbed some more friends and went 2 nights later. Great tour, especially if you are foodie and like a drink or 2. Highly recommended, a must in Saigon

review_title: Go for it - you'll see more of Saigon than any other way
review_text: Great fun tour - we saw loads of things that we wouldn't have got to see otherwise and it was a highlight of our trip. I'd love if it could have been longer so we could have had more time. Also, the option of a (more expensive) private tour would be great.

After the sun gets tired of shining and the moon offers its dreamy light, backed-up by the colored street lights of Saigon and watches the locals riding in their bikes, there’s nothing in your mind but to join them, ride in their bikes and experience what it is to be like.

That’s what I want to do in Vietnam and bingo the “Saigon After Dark Tour” offered to us by Vespa Adventures outshined my expectations from the moment I saw their Vespa scooters in ORANGE color  (my fave color is orange so that adds 1 point for you guys).

Riding in their bikes and roving around the main streets and alleys of Saigon, street food trips with an original touch of Vietnamese style, it was superb. For an hour we became one of the locals in Saigon.

The discovery of “Secret Coffee Shop” two thumbs up for you guys- we love it. Nice place, haven’t seen it in the Philippines like that. They have good and adorable performers, soothing voice; lovely song even thought I don’t understand (LoL). I want to stay for more.

Thanks to Josh, Patrick, Steve (even though we didn’t meet him personally), the two charming and nice ladies (how I wished I did not forget to get their names), the drivers- It is more fun if the Vietnamese drivers can speak English as well, so it is easy to communicate with them. I am not contented in waving my hands only and just smiling at them. 

To sum it all, you all guys are amazing, you gave us amazing and unforgettable moment in Saigon. Cãm õn to Vespa Adventures Team.

I’ll tell my families and friends about Vespa Adventures. Maybe we can come back not so soon but in the future. 

Salamat at Mabuhay!

Our Vespa night tour of Saigon was everything we didn’t expect but thoroughly enjoyed. To say that we had a fantastic time is a definite understatement. The first stop would have easily been my favourite had it not been for that secret cafe that left me captivated. It was enigmatic and there’s passion permeating the air that I felt like we were in a Paulo Coelho novel.

The moment we mounted up and hit the road was exhilarating; but to be part of the real Saigon – stopping for red lights side-by-side with some of Saigon’s biking demographic; riding past streets rife with history; dining on the sidewalks where the Vietnamese do (the best food I've had for the entire trip!) -- is an experience like no other. True to their words, Patrick and Josh and their Vespa drivers took us around back-alleys where no tourists go.

We wish we had more time for that last stop, but alas we must catch our flight. But it was one great adventure to cap off our trip. The rarity of the experience is something I know we’ll yearn to return to. We hope we can come back for a longer Vespa adventure.

We thank Patrick, Josh, Steve, Bao and Phuong and your Vespa drivers for this odyssey of visual and gastronomic enjoyment. Everything was exceptional – on and off the road!

We started planning the tour over a year ago after watching the Top Gear Vietnam special. Myself and seven mates had no previous experience on bikes but Steve and Josh put us through a good familiarisation with the bikes on day one after taking us riding as passengers through Ho Chi Minh. I can honestly say I have never been on a better run tour in terms of organisation, the places you stay, the food etc and the support from the guides. We had an absolute ball, have never laughed so hard, and saw the things in Vietnam that you wouldn't be able to see from the confines of a bus or similar tour.

Josh and the other guides(the Iceman,Knight Rider, Duk and Yo) go above and beyond to make the trip a success and nothing is too much trouble for them.

One of the most memorable things I have ever done. Do yourself a favour and get on it!

review_title: Awesome experience that I would repeat in a heartbeat
review_text: Although I ended up electing to be a pillion on the Vesper tour I had an amazing time. We stayed in excellent accomodation, ate absolutely amazing food and went to places where there were no other tourists in sight. I highly recommend booking a trip RIGHT NOW - and personally am looking forward to when the tour expands and covers the other end of Vietnam. Excellent customer service, heaps of fun and surprises that I wont elaborate on as it would spoil your experience. JUST DO IT!!

review_title: Best way to see the country
review_text:
Far exceeded my expectations. This is a great way to experience the country, the scenery and the ride will be something you will not forget. The support staff were very attentive, and ensured that we had an enjoyable journey. From assisting with the bikes, providing rain jackets ( it did not rain) to water and food and every stop, Vietnam Vespa Adventures went out of their way to make our holiday great. I would definitely recommend this to anyone.
The most memorable parts of the journey was the nightly entertainment and activities.

review_title: Commercialized motorbike tour with no local touch
review_text:
I am someone who hates to write bad review about any particular tour or accommodation but I feel a need to write about this tour, as I honestly think travelers going to HCMC can get so much better tours/experience with the amount they pay for at Vespa Adventures.

This was the most horrible tour I took for my 16days in Vietnam. Firstly, it's wayyy overpriced for a bike tour in HCMC. Secondly, you might just get unlucky and get yourself a bike which stalled 10 times during the entire 3-4hours tour - almost everyone took the tour experienced their bike stalling. This might be okay if it's at some other places but in HCMC where traffic is chaotic and crazy, there's a high % you might end up in an accident, if the vespa stalled in front of a huge moving bus at the round-about!

Thirdly, Vespa Adventures will bring you to the tourist attractions, e.g. museums etc, and give you 5mins to take pictures WITHOUT actually buying a ticket and letting you enter the building. Do not expect to visit the War Museum or any of the best places in HCMC. I would say the only highlight of this tour is District 2 but you can always just hire a motorbike yourself and get them bring you over. It would probably cost you 10% of the tour price you are paying at Vespa Adventures.

The tour guides were horrible too. They barely know anything about the buildings (if you ever read up about or explored HCMC before, you will know). Moreover, they will speak so fast to confuse you. At the end of the tour, I was like "I wasted my entire 4hours doing this when I could've gone to Vung Tau" instead.

Seriously, I would advise ALL travelers to avoid this tour. It is horrible... Just take the day to walk around and explore HCMC yourself. You will learn more about it and probably meet some nice and friendly locals who can provide you ample information on the city itself. If you can't find your way to any of the attractions, just hire any motorbike on the streets, they are sooo cheap (remember to haggle) and better riders.

Do you really wanna pay 30USD for a 3/4hours tour when you can use that amount of money for a 1night stay or a 3day tour (10USD/day) at some other places? You decide for yourself =)

review_title: A PERFECT WAY TO SEE HCM CITY especially if your are tight for time.
review_text: We had a few hours in HCM city before flying on into Vietnam, but we wanted to see some of this city , while we had time. This was the perfect way to get a good overall glimpse of the city, and really feel the pulse of the place. The drivers were great, amongst all the traffic, I felt safe and secure and my 4 year old son had a blast!!!! We aren't big mortorcycle riders, but this was just great fun, the drivers carefully negiotated the traffic like pros, and we had a thoroughly enjoyable time. They took care of my son Nate, liked their own, and showed him the sights and were just wonderful . Don't miss this opportunity, seeing Saigon on the back of a bike is definitely the way to go, even for an old girl like me at 50!!!

review_title: Seeing some of the real HCMC(Saigon) in 5 hours
review_text:
We are a couple who are over 60 yo and we wanted to do a tour of HCMC that is not regulated to the tour bus stops and is controlled by schedules etc. and to see some of the other HCMC. We found Vietnam Vespa's on on the Internet and reviewed it and asked for further details. We reserve a time on a date when our cruise vessel will be berthed near the center of HCMC.
Met by the a bunch of orange shirted guys on their vespas with our guide with them. No cars or buses here. Hopped on the back as a pillion passenger with helmet on and entered straight into the HCMC motor scooter traffic, trucks, buses and cars.

Yes, we saw the Cathedral, Caravelle Hotel, Rex Hotel, Reunification Palace, GPO but these were only short stops. What we did see were some different temples and a cathedral, schools finishing for the day and no 4WD or BMW's just scooters with mums and dads picking the kids up, crossed the Saigon River on a local ferry with the other local scooter riders, were taken through the local areas that will soon be high rise, saw local homes, people and other amazing sights like an internet cafe in a broken down house, past some fields, visited a real local market, went through lots of majopr roundabouts, down lots of back streets of HCMC. We also went to a french bakery operated by local vietnamese where the cakes/pastiserries looked so good and the ice cream was great.
It was an amazing 5 hour tour finishing in peak hour transport going back to our cruise vessel. You sat there among all the scooters where people were in suits or dirty work clothes, women in high heels, kids syanfding in front and sitting on back, goods(fruit, roller doors, panels of glass etc) being carted on these scooters.
You have to love it and sure the first few minutes were met with some intrepidation but this soon disappears when you see the city sights. and realize what you are seeing at this level. You are among the locals in their environment to some degree.
The drivers of the Vespas are absolutely brilliant and safe.
The guide was great and was not over the top.
Finished at base camp which is Cafe Zoom(located on amjor intersection so great for people and traffic watching) for a quick drink and bite to eat(included in price) before going back to vessel on the back of the Vespas.
All in all one great way to see some of the real HCMC not matter what age you are.
Yes fumes can be a problem but my lady suffers asthma and had no problems.
If you are in HCMC and wish to do a tour a little different.
Well organized for us.
Would be difficult if your cruise vessel is berthed at Vung Tau(the big ones seemed to be) which is 90 minutes.
However, whether arriving by plane, bus, train or boat into HCMC you should organize this tour as part of your trip. Prices are extremely reasonable.
We did all inquiries and reservations on the Internet from Australia.
Look up Vietnam Vespas and check it out.
One final comment : if you are tour bus or an organized or group tour type of person read the information on the internet before saying No.
If you do this tour enjoy it.
Touring HCM on a Vespa is certainly a great way to know the place and the peoples way of life. It was thoroughly enjoyable.
Simply must try the insider Saigon tour if you want to see the road less traveled by tourist.. its adventurous and fun-filled... we really enjoyed even with the slight tan. :)

review_title: A stylish way to get the lay of the land!
review_text: I did both the day and the night tour. Silly me thought that I would be riding the Vespa but once I saw the traffic in Saigon, I was very grateful I wasn't !! Great way to get around town and see things you just wouldn't see otherwise.

review_title: Guide, Vespa ride, food and drink exceed expectations
review_text: Traveling by myself, this was the perfect way to meet up with fun people for moped rides, food, drink, and great conversation. I was greeted by Steve at Cafe Zoom where we had a couple glasses of wine and met the others. We rode on the reconditioned Vespas about 10 minutes to an outdoor place (there were tables) where the seafood and snails were the highlight. This was a local place...no tourists in sight. I mentioned to Steve that I'm a beer enthusiast so he keeps feeding me different beers. We hopped back on the Vespas to ride to the next outdoor place where we had tradional Vietnamese food. After another Vespa ride, we were at a candlelit lounge where there was live music, including a piano player, violin, and singers. After 2 more beers we headed back to Cafe Zoom for a night capper. Price was well worth it and it exceeded my expectations as a foodie and tourist.

review_title: The best way to see Saigon.
review_text: Just to echo all of the other comments on here, really great tour. Josh and his crew are friendly, efficient, and go out of their way to make sure you have a good time. You cannot go wrong with a Vietnam Vespa tour.

Vespa Scooter Night Tour... I did that USD55... The experience is a nice surprise.

The website did not offer details of exactly where they are taking you and what is and is not included.

Basically, they will take you around HCMC and sample some street eats at places out of touch by foreigners.

I am not getting into details here but I am very delighted about the tour.

I feel like Brad Pitt.

review_title: This is an exciting way to see Saigon at night and what a deal!!!
review_text: I took the evening tour, riding on the back of a Vespa, weaving through the alleys of old Saigon to several excellent open air restaurants with a great variety of local food, then to a cozy nightclub and finally back to the Zoom Cafe for more drinks and food (though I could eat a little after the restaurants. It's a great deal, $59, for all you can eat of excellent food and drink, plus the great adventure. I've been to Saigon 6-7 times over the last 10 years and this was the most fun of all!!

I took some visiting friends on the night tour of Saigon, and we had such a great time. The restaurants, bars and cafes we went to were really great (we got to eat some pretty crazy seafood!), our guide was friendly, funny and knowledgeable, and the attention to detail was great. I've been in Saigon for a while working, but I saw a completely new side of the city! I will definitely take other friends who visit on the tour again. Thanks guys!

review_title: THE BEST WAY TO EAT IN SAIGON!
review_text: This was an awesome tour. You get to see HCMC the way the locals do, and eat and drink the same too! The food was delicious and riding through the city on the vespa was amazing. Plus it's a great deal, all you can eat and all you can drink!!!! It's a must for your trip to HCMC!

review_title: Great introduction to the exciting city of Saigon!
review_text: This was a great way to see the somewhat intimidating city of Saigon. All under the twinkling night sky. The Vespa crew really tries hard to ensure a great time and it is a decent value for the money. A little more explanation of the sights and what our price included would have been welcomed as well as a few photo ops. I only had two other people on the tour with me but I can see how crazy the night would have been with more people. Go with a group for maximum value but certainly don't miss this unique city tour!

review_title: So much fun and a great way to see the city
review_text: I just went on the one-day city tour and it was so much fun I wish I could go back and try the night tour as well. The drivers are very experienced and drive carefully, but you definitely get a sense of thrill as you weave in and out through the mad traffic of HCMC. Our guide was great - knew his stuff and gladly checked out new things if he thought they looked interesting. The pace is quite fast so don't expect to spend ages and ages at each sight. I thought it was the perfect pace as you wan't to spend as much time on that Vespa as at all possible. We went to the other side of the river (getting the ferry) which was my favorite part of the trip. We were taken to a market which wasn't full of tourists. Quite and experienced. The tour ends with lunch at the cafe which was rather nice as well. I would recommend this to anyone (but I would mention that wearing a face mask might be a good idea due to air pollution - they can be bought everywhere in the city).

You have to try that. We really enjoyed bikes . Visited a lot of local places, you will never get in as a tourist. It was like being local, like being involved in Saigon night life.

We like bikes and our guide so much that we take a Saigon tour next day and that was very interesting something not typical, beyond any tourist programs. You will visit all "popular" sightseeing places, and visit some poor districts, and a new future Saigon city-center and you will cross the river on a boat with bike, and you will just have fun on a bike..

As a retired woman, the night tour of Ho Chi Minh city (Saigon) was one of the most exciting and fun-filled I have experienced for quite a while, and I do have a thirst for adventures. I joined a mixed group and met our experienced drivers and Vespa guides over a few drinks at the Cafe Zoom at the above address, which is located right in the middle of the backpacker district. The Cafe alone is a memorable experience, full of all types of people, and the food is scrumptuous and not expensive. And of course the Margaritas really hit the spot.
We set out on the night tour, sitting pillion behind an experienced driver on a classic restored vesta (in excellent mechanical condition) taking in the delightful city lights which decorate many spaces, and stopping at top restaurants. We ate the freshest and mouth-watering seafoods, such as chilli clams and crabs etc. and also traditional Vietnamese food - the most delicate and flavoursome pancakes, spring rolls and other really fresh treats. This is a great way to meet other travelers, feel safe in the chaos of the city, see many districts and take in the night life. In fact, the last stop was an exotic nightclub, full of locals, expats, travelers. The music was live, varied, and the musos - a Philippino group - were brilliant. Love every minute of it. Worth every penny!

I am not normally a fan of organized tours and activities while traveling. I often feel they fall short of giving you any insight into the real life or culture of where ever you might be visiting.

This is not the case with Vietnam Vespa Adventures. I had such an Amazing experience on the "After Dark Tour" I recently took it has spawned my first Trip-Advisor review ever:
You start off at Cafe Zoom, a restaurant in the backpacker section of town also owned by same people as the tour, sit, chat a bit, have some drinks and snacks with your tour mates. The guide in this case Patrick, (a very cool expat thats been living in Saigon for a couple years) will give you an idea of the plan and get a feel for the group and of you go on the back of a restored vespa. Its an amazing experience being thrust into the chaotic traffic of saigon, even just being a passenger. I believe the tour changes every night more or less with the attitude and desire of the group, but our experience was a great seafood stall/street restaurant in district 4, a neighborhood most tourists have no reason to visit. You sit on tiny stools eating amazing food that I would never have known to order with out the guides help, local vietnamese people eating and drinking all around you, sometimes offering you the mic for impromptu karaoke. Patrick was great at answering any questions, explaining the culture, and even sharing great stories and insight from his time living there. I don't want to get too long winded, but the night continued on like that for a couple more stops, great food, beer over ice and finally concluded at a hidden upstairs coffee shop where we were the only non-Vietnamese, drinking strong coffee over condensed milk watching what I believe was a open-mic night, singers taking turns with a piano and violinist.

In my many travels through asia and europe this is by far the best organized tour or activity I have ever been a part of, and I can assure you, with all the guide books in the world you will not find most of the places they take you. Next time I am in the area I hope to take one of the longer excursions.

Thanks again Patrick and everyone else at Vietnam Vespa Adventures for a great time.

Best,
Travis

review_title: EXACTLY what we were looking for! experience local nightlife and great food.
review_text: Forget about those night boat cruises - live like a local for 1 night and enjoy actual vietnamese nightlife. Feel secured going out and enjoy awesome food. See the people Zoom by at their cafe while sipping awesome vietnamese coffee. We even used their fast wifi connection and skyped our kids. Patrick (co-owner) sat down with us and made us feel at home. Josh (american) and his co-driver/mechanic (vietnamese) make a great team and are terrific safe drivers. Oh and did i tell you that they use finely restored Vintage Vespas? Book them now!

review_title: Wow - miss this and you'll regret it - feel like a local exploring the city
review_text:
The ultimate travellers experience, that's why it's number one and will stay there!
Young or old it's a unique and unforgetable way to see the city. We went on the 4 hr day city tour, our guide was Josh and he was so knowledgeable on all aspects of Saigon and Vietnam in general, it opened our eyes and gave a real taste of the city that would take days to accomplish on your own.
The classic Vespas are a joy, keeping you cool as you go, with a driver who gave me the confidence I needed to feel 100% safe in his hands(I dont normally ride motorbikes). We stopped at viewpoints along the way, both the obvious and non-obvious tourist spots, feeling like locals for a couple of hours in the heart of the traffic and chaos and it was great!
It does on the surface seem an expensive trip compared to others available but this is so unlike any of the others and such a fantastic memory of an amazing city, you wont regret it. Next time we wont hesitate to do a longer tour out of the city with them.

You know those night club tours that you take in New York? Forget about it. The Vietnam Vespa night tour of Saigon is the real deal. For a fraction of the price real people, real classic Vespas, real food and a real Saigon adventure. Next time you're in Indochine don't miss it

review_title: Great for out of town trips
review_text:
Vietnam Vespa Adventures offers some of the coolest vintage rides that I have seen in years. I am personally a classic Harley Davidson rider, so a scooter was not my top priority. However, I must admit that these are beautiful bikes and these guys really know how to restore a bike. They all still have their original look and feel and the bike that I had ran very well.

They operate out of a cafe in the backpacker district in Saigon. The "Zoom Burger" with avocado, bacon, and American cheese is the best burger that I have had in Vietnam. It is easy to find this place just down the road from the big Go2 Bar.

The city tour that I did was very interesting. Traveling alone, this was a great way to meet a few interesting people who also traveled up the coast of Vietnam over the next few weeks. The guide was great and showed everyone how to operate the bikes and he gave a good safety briefing. The only negative was unfortunately a big one. The roads in Saigon are simply INSANE! Just sitting at the cafe before we set out I saw almost two accidents on the busy Tran Hung Dao road. I am a confident rider and know to always expect someone else on the road to do something stupid, but this really is a dangerous city so amateur riders should find another city tour. However, I am also going to do their trip up to Mui Ne and that does not involve all of the city driving and is probably a much better suited trip for novice riders.

All round an excellent company and they do offer trips for different levels of riders. If you are inexperienced and don't have health insurance then you really should skip the city tour and go for one of their out of town rides.

I have been searching extensively for things to do in Saigon (because i don't want to join the usual tourists' tour, you know what I mean) prior to arrival as it was my first time in Vietnam when i came across VVA which has a Saigon After Dark tour. It was a pity that most of the places are closed because of the TET festival. But no worries, Josh will come out with a list of places to go to once he finds out your preferences. The tour was fun as we traveled to other Districts/places that a girl wouldn't go alone, to see where the locals hang out. The owner of the company, Steve, and wife decided to drop in on one of the stops and it really makes you feel like being accepted, feeling more comfortable as the night goes on. I believe the night will be even more fun if not of the TET.... Well, I've already like Vietnam and im now planning for my next trip there, hopefully to be able to join in one of the vespa tours! (P/s: What's the name of that dish (snail) again??, i really like it btw)

review_title: See Vietnam like a local weaving through the hustle and bustle on a Vespa
review_text: We booked this tour with a lot of excitement. The tour around the city exceeded our expectations with a tour guide who spoke great English, had diverse knowledge of Ho Chi Minh City and was able to answer all of our questions. We feel like locals weaving through the traffic and not a hint of danger with the experienced drivers. We saw sights that we would not have gotten to by foot and caught a ferry across the river. After your personalized tour you enjoy a nice meal at Cafe Zoom, make sure you have a beer to cool down. We recently learned that there are new tours like a night time food expedition. I can't wait to return to find the best places to eat in Ho Chi Minh city. I have already recommended this company to colleagues traveling soon.
